<!-- Message Controls (Copy, Edit, Delete) -->
<script>
  function initMessageControls() {
    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    if (!chatMessagesEl || chatMessagesEl.dataset.controlsReady === '1') return;
    chatMessagesEl.dataset.controlsReady = '1';

    // One shared definition for an unfinished AI-owned bubble.
    // Completed bubbles stay interactive even while another reply is generating.
    window.isFuraiActiveAiMessageElement = window.isFuraiActiveAiMessageElement || function(message) {
      if (!message) return false;
      if (message.classList?.contains('furai-active-ai-message')) return true;
      if (message.id && message.id.startsWith('typing-')) return true;

      const content = message.querySelector?.('.content');
      return !!content && (
        content.classList.contains('typing') ||
        content.classList.contains('furai-message-thinking')
      );
    };

    const isLiveMessageBubble = (message) =>
      !message || window.isFuraiActiveAiMessageElement(message);

    // =====================================================================
    // FORGIVING MESSAGE-CONTROL HOVER CONTRACT — DO NOT REMOVE OR SIMPLIFY
    // =====================================================================
    // The toolbar sits below the visible bubble. A real pointer briefly leaves
    // the bubble while crossing that gap, so immediate CSS-only mouseleave logic
    // makes the toolbar vanish before the user can reach it.
    //
    // Keep one delegated pointerover/pointerout pair on #chatMessagesEl, retain
    // the hover state for a short grace period, and cancel dismissal as soon as
    // the pointer reaches the same message or its toolbar. Do NOT replace this
    // with per-message listeners, immediate mouseleave hiding, repeated timers,
    // or geometry checks. Click selection remains the persistent fallback.
    const messageControlLeaveTimers = new WeakMap();
    const MESSAGE_CONTROL_LEAVE_DELAY_MS = 180;

    const keepMessageControlsHovered = (message) => {
      if (!message) return;

      const pendingTimer = messageControlLeaveTimers.get(message);
      if (pendingTimer) {
        clearTimeout(pendingTimer);
        messageControlLeaveTimers.delete(message);
      }

      message.classList.add('furai-controls-hovered');
    };

    const scheduleMessageControlsLeave = (message) => {
      if (!message) return;

      const pendingTimer = messageControlLeaveTimers.get(message);
      if (pendingTimer) clearTimeout(pendingTimer);

      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        message.classList.remove('furai-controls-hovered');
        messageControlLeaveTimers.delete(message);
      }, MESSAGE_CONTROL_LEAVE_DELAY_MS);

      messageControlLeaveTimers.set(message, timer);
    };

    chatMessagesEl.addEventListener('pointerover', (event) => {
      if (event.pointerType === 'touch' || document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return;

      const message = event.target.closest?.('.message');
      if (
        !message ||
        !chatMessagesEl.contains(message) ||
        message.id === 'personality-selector-message' ||
        isLiveMessageBubble(message)
      ) return;

      keepMessageControlsHovered(message);
    });

    chatMessagesEl.addEventListener('pointerout', (event) => {
      if (event.pointerType === 'touch' || document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return;

      const message = event.target.closest?.('.message');
      if (!message || !chatMessagesEl.contains(message)) return;

      const nextTarget = event.relatedTarget;
      if (nextTarget && message.contains(nextTarget)) return;

      scheduleMessageControlsLeave(message);
    });
    
    // --- 1. Master Event Listener (message selection + control buttons) ---
    chatMessagesEl.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
        const clickedMessage = e.target.closest('.message');
        const clickedInteractive = e.target.closest(
            '.message-controls, button, a, input, textarea, select, [contenteditable="true"], .image-grid-container'
        );

        // =====================================================================
        // CONSOLIDATED MESSAGE-SELECTION CONTRACT — KEEP CR CONTROLS STABLE
        // =====================================================================
        // Clicking any finished bubble selects it. Selection, highlight, and its
        // control bar must remain visible until the user clicks away or selects a
        // different bubble. Do not make control visibility depend only on hover:
        // short and empty bubbles leave no safe pointer path to a detached toolbar.
        // CR selection is applied directly even if VN target resolution later fails.
        if (
            !clickedMessage &&
            !clickedInteractive &&
            !document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')
        ) {
            if (typeof resetVnSceneTarget === 'function') {
                resetVnSceneTarget();
            } else if (typeof syncFuraiCrVnSelectedMessage === 'function') {
                syncFuraiCrVnSelectedMessage(null);
            }

            window.furaiCrSelectionPendingForVn = '';
        }

        if (
            clickedMessage &&
            !clickedInteractive &&
            clickedMessage.id !== 'personality-selector-message' &&
            !isLiveMessageBubble(clickedMessage)
        ) {
            if (typeof syncFuraiCrVnSelectedMessage === 'function') {
                syncFuraiCrVnSelectedMessage(clickedMessage);
            }

            const vnTargetSet = typeof setVnSceneTargetFromElement === 'function' &&
                setVnSceneTargetFromElement(clickedMessage, {
                    autoScroll: false,
                    userLocked: true
                });

            if (vnTargetSet) {
                window.furaiCrSelectionPendingForVn = currentChatId || '';
            }
        }

        // Find the closest button if the user clicked an icon inside it.
        const btn = e.target.closest('.control-btn');
        if (!btn) return;

        const message = btn.closest('.message');
        if (!message) return;

        // Live typing bubbles are not DB messages yet.
        // Controls should only work after completeGeneration() saves the message.
        if (isLiveMessageBubble(message)) return;

        // A. Copy Logic
        if (btn.classList.contains('copy-btn')) {
            const textToCopy = message.querySelector('.content')?.innerText || '';
            if (!textToCopy) return;
            
            // Helper to update icon
            const updateIcon = (success) => {
                if(success) {
                    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-check fa-sm"></i>';
                    btn.style.color = "var(--primary-color)";
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size: 18px; vertical-align: middle;">content_copy</span>';
                        btn.style.color = "";
                    }, 1000);
                }
            };

            try {
                await navigator.clipboard.writeText(textToCopy);
                updateIcon(true);
            } catch (err) {
                console.warn('Clipboard API blocked, using fallback.');
                const textArea = document.createElement("textarea");
                textArea.value = textToCopy;
                textArea.style.position = "absolute";
                textArea.style.left = "-9999px";
                document.body.appendChild(textArea);
                textArea.select();
                document.execCommand("copy");
                document.body.removeChild(textArea);
                updateIcon(true);
            }
        }
        // B. Edit Logic
        else if (btn.classList.contains('edit-btn')) {
            if(window.editMessage) window.editMessage(message);
        }
        // C. Delete Logic
        else if (btn.classList.contains('delete-btn')) {
            if(window.deleteMessage) window.deleteMessage(message);
        }
        // D. Regenerate Logic
        else if (btn.classList.contains('regen-btn')) {
            await retryFuraiMessageFromElement(message);
        }
        // E. Generate Image Logic
        else if (btn.classList.contains('gen-img-btn')) {
            const promptText = message.querySelector('.content')?.innerText || '';

            if (window.generateImagesForMessage) {
                window.generateImagesForMessage(message, promptText);
            }
        }
        // F. Save to Concept Board
        else if (btn.classList.contains('concept-save-btn')) {
            if (window.saveChatBubbleToConceptBoard) {
                window.saveChatBubbleToConceptBoard(btn, message);
            }
        }
        // G. Pin to Key Facts
        else if (btn.classList.contains('pin-fact-btn')) {
            if (window.togglePinnedFactForMessage) {
                window.togglePinnedFactForMessage(message);
            }
        }
    });

    // --- 2. Lightweight Element Creator (No listeners attached here) ---
    window.placeMessageControls = function(message, controlsContainer) {
      if (!message) return;

      const controls = controlsContainer || message.querySelector('.message-controls');
      if (!controls) return;

      // One anchor for every bubble shape: the content wrapper owns the toolbar.
      // Never append ordinary controls to the outer .message row again. That row
      // also contains avatars, so one-line and empty bubbles would place controls
      // too low and make the toolbar jump when bubble geometry changed.
      const wrapper = message.querySelector('.message-content-wrapper');
      const grid = wrapper ? wrapper.querySelector('.image-grid-container') : null;

      if (wrapper) {
        if (grid) {
          wrapper.insertBefore(controls, grid);
        } else {
          wrapper.appendChild(controls);
        }
        return;
      }

      // Defensive fallback for malformed/legacy rendered nodes only.
      message.appendChild(controls);
    };
    
    window.addMessageControls = function(message) {
      if (
        !message ||
        message.querySelector('.message-controls') ||
        message.id === 'personality-selector-message' ||
        isLiveMessageBubble(message)
      ) return;

      const retryRecord = typeof furaiGetMessageAtDomElement === 'function'
          ? furaiGetMessageAtDomElement(message)
          : null;
      const fallbackRole = getFuraiMessageFrameRole(message);
      const retryMessage = retryRecord?.msg || {
          role: fallbackRole,
          userUid: message.dataset.userUid || '',
          botUid: message.dataset.botUid || '',
          botIndex: message.dataset.botIndex,
          speakerName: message.dataset.speakerName || ''
      };

      // A true nameless system notice remains immutable. Human turns, AI turns,
      // Silent Notes, Cutscenes, and anonymous user broadcasts all receive Retry.
      if (isFuraiTrueNamelessSystemMessage(retryMessage, message)) return;

      const controlsContainer = document.createElement('div');
      controlsContainer.className = 'message-controls';

      // --- Gen Image Button Logic ---
      // UNLOCKED: Generate image button is now available for all messages in all modes
      const genButton = document.createElement('button');
      genButton.className = 'control-btn gen-img-btn';
      genButton.title = 'Generate Images';
      genButton.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size:18px; line-height:1; vertical-align:middle;">mms</span>';
      controlsContainer.appendChild(genButton);

      // Standard Buttons
      const copyButton = document.createElement('button');
      copyButton.className = 'control-btn copy-btn';
      copyButton.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size: 18px; vertical-align: middle;">content_copy</span>';
      copyButton.title = 'Copy';

      const editButton = document.createElement('button');
      editButton.className = 'control-btn edit-btn';
      editButton.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size: 18px; vertical-align: middle;">stylus</span>';
      editButton.title = 'Edit';

      const deleteButton = document.createElement('button');
      deleteButton.className = 'control-btn delete-btn';
      deleteButton.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size: 18px; vertical-align: middle;">delete</span>';
      deleteButton.title = 'Delete';

      const conceptSaveButton = document.createElement('button');
      conceptSaveButton.className = 'control-btn concept-save-btn';
      conceptSaveButton.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size: 18px; vertical-align: middle;">note_stack_add</span>';
      conceptSaveButton.title = 'Save to Concept Board';

      const pinButton = document.createElement('button');
      pinButton.className = 'control-btn pin-fact-btn';
      pinButton.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size: 18px; vertical-align: middle;">push_pin</span>';
      pinButton.title = 'Pin to Key Facts';

      const retryKind = getFuraiMessageRetryKind(retryMessage, message);
      if (retryKind !== 'none') {
          const regenButton = document.createElement('button');
          regenButton.className = 'control-btn regen-btn';
          regenButton.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size: 18px; vertical-align: middle;">autorenew</span>';
          regenButton.title = getFuraiRetryButtonTitle(retryMessage, message);
          controlsContainer.appendChild(regenButton);

          // Variants remain an AI-reply feature. User and Magic Wand retries replace
          // the authored turn directly instead of creating misleading AI variants.
          if (String(retryMessage.role || '').toLowerCase() === 'ai') {
              const variantNav = typeof window.createMessageVariantNav === 'function'
                  ? window.createMessageVariantNav(message)
                  : null;

              if (variantNav) {
                  controlsContainer.appendChild(variantNav);
              }
          }
      }

      controlsContainer.appendChild(copyButton);
      controlsContainer.appendChild(editButton);
      controlsContainer.appendChild(pinButton);
      controlsContainer.appendChild(conceptSaveButton);
      controlsContainer.appendChild(deleteButton);

      window.placeMessageControls(message, controlsContainer);
    };

    // --- 3. Optimized Observer (subtree: false) ---
    const observer = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
      mutations.forEach(mutation => {
        mutation.addedNodes.forEach(node => {
          if (node.nodeType === 1 && node.classList.contains('message')) {
            addMessageControls(node);
          }
        });
      });
    });

    // KEY FIX: subtree: false prevents checking every tiny change inside the message
    observer.observe(chatMessagesEl, { childList: true, subtree: false });

    // Initial load
    chatMessagesEl.querySelectorAll('.message').forEach(addMessageControls);
  }
  
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initMessageControls, { once: true });
  } else {
    setTimeout(initMessageControls, 0);
  }
</script>
<!-- End Message Controls -->

            <h4 style="color:var(--primary-color); margin-top:0;">1. How to Submit</h4>
            <ul style="padding-left: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px;">
                <li>Create your Character, Reference, Chat log, or Magic Wand utility profile in the settings.</li>
                <li>Open their Profile, click the <b>Share</b> button, and copy the link.</li>
                <li>Use the builder above to format your post, then choose Submit PG-13 to post it in the correct dedicated submit channel. Mods review these channels regularly to add submissions to the Expansion Pass.</li>
            </ul>

            <h4 style="color:var(--primary-color);">2. Community Rules</h4>
            <ul style="padding-left: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px;">
                <li><b>Respect Originality:</b> For all types, do not submit canonical characters from existing media. Do not steal, rip off, or re-upload other users’ original creations, OCs, fursonas, lore, art, or character cards without permission. Credit creators when required, and only submit work you created, own, or are allowed to share.</li>
                <li><b>Control:</b> You can update, retract, or cancel your submission at any time.</li>
                <li><b>Keep it PG-13:</b> Only appropriate, non-explicit content is allowed in the PG-13 channels. No NSFW or overtly suggestive material.</li>
            </ul>

            <div id="expGuideNsfwSection" style="display:none; background:rgba(244, 67, 54, 0.05); border-top:2px solid var(--danger-color); padding-left:20px; padding-top:20px; margin-top:20px; margin-bottom:20px;">
                <h4 style="color:var(--danger-color); margin-top:0;"><i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i> 18+ Content Rules</h4>
                
                <p><b>Submission:</b> Submit NSFW items <i>exclusively</i> to <b>#nsfwsubmit</b>. If you misplace a submission in <b>#submit</b>, it will be ignored and deleted.</p>
            
                <p style="opacity:0.9; margin-top:0;">
                    <b>NSFW Tags:</b> If a submission is still tasteful enough for PG-13, you can still prefix adult-leaning discovery labels with <code>(nsfw)</code>, such as <code>(nsfw)MILF</code> or <code>(nsfw)Daddy</code>. These labels enrich discovery while keeping the PG-13 view clean. Explicit submissions still belong in <b>#nsfwsubmit</b>.
                </p>
            
                <h4 style="color:var(--text-color); margin-bottom:8px;">Extreme Content Policy:</h4>
            
                <p style="opacity:0.9; margin-top:0;">
                    Dark or harmful themes may be depicted for story, horror, drama, tragedy, crime, villain writing, recovery, or justice. Depiction alone is not endorsement. They are not allowed when framed as advocacy, celebration, or practical instruction.
                </p>
            
                <p style="opacity:0.9; margin-top:0;">
                    The following themes are sensitive in public sharing and may be restricted when they cross that limit.
                </p>
            
                <ul style="padding-left: 20px; margin-bottom: 0; line-height: 1.6;">
                    <li><b>Feral NSFW:</b> Feral refers to characters depicted with the natural body form of real animals (quadrupeds/non-anthropomorphic). SFW feral designs are welcome, but they are restricted in NSFW content.</li>
                    <li><b>Pedophilia:</b> Both visuals and context are reviewed. Claiming a character is a "500-year-old elf" does not excuse a childlike appearance.</li>
                    <li><b>Incest:</b> Any sexual or romantic act between family members, including siblings, parents, or relatives by adoption/marriage (pseudo-incest).</li>
                    <li><b>Non-Consensual / SA:</b> Scenes depicting rape or non-consensual sexual acts.</li>
                    <li><b>Scat:</b> Stool, waste, or exaggerated flatulence.</li>
                    <li><b>Watersports:</b> Refers to scenes where urination is fetishized.</li>
                    <li><b>Diaper Fetishes:</b> Depicting anyone older than a toddler who is capable of normal self-care wearing diapers.</li>
                    <li><b>Gore:</b> Moderate bloody gore or dismemberment may be allowed in 18+ contexts when mildly sexual in tone yet not explicit or extreme, such as zombie or horror settings. Fetishized or extreme cruelty is restricted, including torture, mutilation, or suffering as the focus rather than the story.</li><br>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <h4 style="color:var(--primary-color);">3. Content Types & Best Practices</h4>
            
            <div class="guide-card">
                <div class="guide-card-icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-user"></i></div>
                <div class="guide-card-content">
                    <div class="guide-card-title">Character</div>
                    <div class="guide-card-row"><b>Character:</b> An AI Character profile.</div>
                    <div class="guide-card-row"><b>Link:</b> Use the URL generated by the Share button.</div>
                    <div class="guide-card-row"><b>Tip:</b> Preview text appears on the character ID card. The preview image doesn't have to be the avatar; you can submit anything (e.g., a full-body sprite instead).</div>
                </div>
                <div><img src="https://user.uploads.dev/file/1a0de0bd262f6e53bfafa815a0b410d5.jpg" class="guide-preview-img" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></div>
            </div>

            <div class="guide-card">
                <div class="guide-card-icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-sliders"></i></div>
                <div class="guide-card-content">
                    <div class="guide-card-title">Preset</div>
                    <div class="guide-card-row"><b>Preset:</b> A shared chatlog or a full system backup.</div>
                    <div class="guide-card-row"><b>Link:</b> Upload an exported chat or backup file link. Make sure the link never expires.</div>
                    <div class="guide-card-row"><b>Tip:</b> Presets are perfect for sharing a complete custom Group Chat roster, combined with a specific theme, storyline, reference, background, and music setup.</div>
                </div>
                <div><img src="https://aigc.uploads.dev/image/e17488c0e09d99e6c2ad318dd74386c5a115c48fec629bbb03568ffaf29b063f.jpeg" class="guide-preview-img" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></div>
            </div>
          
            <div class="guide-card">
                <div class="guide-card-icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-book"></i></div>
                <div class="guide-card-content">
                    <div class="guide-card-title">Lorebook</div>
                    <div class="guide-card-row"><b>Lorebook:</b> Reference text for world-building or prompting.</div>
                    <div class="guide-card-row"><b>Link:</b> Upload a <code>.txt</code> file link. Do not submit the full text content directly in the post.</div>
                    <div class="guide-card-row"><b>Tip:</b> Lorebooks have plenty of room for Preview text. Give other users important context here: you can build a worldview, RPG instructions, professional knowledge, or a story for a visual novel.</div>
                </div>
                <div><img src="https://aigc.uploads.dev/image/43116958b5f56c72831461750228a3500c7f471bd9499de482c01ee66e62be24.jpeg" class="guide-preview-img" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></div>
            </div>

            <div class="guide-card">
                <div class="guide-card-icon"><i class="fa-regular fa-image"></i></div>
                <div class="guide-card-content">
                    <div class="guide-card-title">Wallpaper</div>
                    <div class="guide-card-row"><b>Link:</b> Direct wallpaper URL. Supports image files (<code>.jpg</code>, <code>.png</code>, <code>.gif</code>, <code>.webp</code>) and muted video backgrounds (<code>.mp4</code>, <code>.webm</code>, <code>.mov</code>, <code>.m4v</code>, <code>.ogv</code>).</div>
                    <div class="guide-card-row"><b>Tip:</b> Video wallpapers are background-only and always muted. Use short, lightweight loops when possible. FHD resolution (1920x1080 px) or above is recommended for images.</div>
                </div>
                <div><img src="https://user.uploads.dev/file/2c9db27fe2c892f80965aec9231c2a07.webp" class="guide-preview-img" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></div>
            </div>

            <div class="guide-card">
                <div class="guide-card-icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-music"></i></div>
                <div class="guide-card-content">
                    <div class="guide-card-title">Music</div>
                    <div class="guide-card-row"><b>Link:</b> <code>.mp3 (.wav .flac .m4a .ogg)</code> or other common types of music links.</div>
                    <div class="guide-card-row"><b>Tip:</b> Music items do not have a slot for preview text. You can use free AI tools to make your own music such as <a href="https://suno.com/playlist/c3ef13ee-0110-4593-b469-51ac1567d57a" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Suno</a>.</div>
                </div>
                <div><img src="https://aigc.uploads.dev/image/2ad89881fa21b5248deb2a5d200c9c3bc3cc38b4718de13efba730227437d429.jpeg" class="guide-preview-img" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></div>
            </div>

            <h4 style="margin-bottom:8px;">About Tags:</h4>
            <ul style="padding-left: 20px; opacity:0.9; margin-top:0;">
                <li><b>Custom Tags:</b> You can add useful label words to promote and explain your item (e.g., "Wolf", "Sci-Fi", "Bard"). They appear as visual discovery tags and also help users find your item through search.</li>
                <li><b>FurAI:</b> Anyone can make their own version of FurAI, either having different art, instructions, or personality. If your submission is a variation or has a deep connection to FurAI, use this tag.</li>
                <li><b>Skin:</b> Any variation of an existing character (e.g., different visual art or personality). If you wish to update an existing submission permanently, do not use the skin tag.</li>
                <li><b>Update:</b> Use this if you want to update an old submission and don't want to keep both versions.</li>
                <li><b>Utility:</b> Use this as the broad special label for tool-like helpers, Magic Wand profiles, NPC, Narrator, prompt builders, counters, items, or agent-style entries.</li>
                <li><b>RPG:</b> Use this if your submission could support RPG-style play, campaigns, worldbuilding, quests, music, settings, maps, encounters, or adventure prompts.</li>
                <li><b>Productive:</b> Use this if your character / reference / wallpaper / music could enhance productivity and is not merely for roleplay chat.</li>
            </ul>

        </div>
    </div>
</div>

// This is the shared public-API boundary for ALL inline HTML event attributes in the
// entire file, not a feature-specific compatibility patch. Any function called by
// onclick/onchange/oninput/onfocus/onpointerdown/onerror/etc. must remain globally
// reachable through window. Perchance evaluates those attributes outside local,
// module, and initializer scopes, so never hide their handlers inside an IIFE,
// DOMContentLoaded callback, block, class, or module. Code can parse and initialize
// normally, then fail only when the user activates the control with
// "ReferenceError: ... is not defined".
//
// Keep existing window exports, and add a window export whenever an inline handler is
// added or moved. Do not remove an export merely because JavaScript search reports no
// callers: the caller may be HTML. This regression has affected many controls before.
// The list directly below is a maintained public API, but it is not proof that every
// later inline handler is safe; feature-local exports such as window.storyContinue
// must also remain explicit beside their implementation.

    'global-',
    'global_glossary_',
    'ref_text_',
    'furai_'
];

const FURAI_LOCAL_DATA_EXPLICIT_KEYS = [
    'globalBotRoster',
    'globalStoryBotRoster'
];

function normalizeFuraiStorageMode(value) {
    const mode = String(value || '').trim();

    if (mode === FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_INDEXEDDB) return FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_INDEXEDDB;
    if (mode === FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_LOCAL) return FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_LOCAL;

    return '';
}

function readSavedFuraiStorageMode() {
    try {
        return normalizeFuraiStorageMode(localStorage.getItem(FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_KEY));
    } catch (e) {
        return '';
    }
}

function writeFuraiStorageModeFlag(mode) {
    const normalized = normalizeFuraiStorageMode(mode) || FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_LOCAL;

    try {
        localStorage.setItem(FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_KEY, normalized);
    } catch (e) {}

    return normalized;
}

function hasLegacyFuraiLocalData() {
    try {
        for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
            const key = localStorage.key(i);
            if (!key || key === FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_KEY) continue;

            if (
                key.startsWith('__furai_pending_write__') ||
                key.startsWith('__furai_pending_remove__')
            ) {
                return true;
            }

            if (FURAI_LOCAL_DATA_EXPLICIT_KEYS.includes(key)) return true;
            if (FURAI_LOCAL_DATA_PREFIXES.some(prefix => key.startsWith(prefix))) return true;
        }
    } catch (e) {}

    return false;
}

function getInitialFuraiStorageMode() {
    const savedMode = readSavedFuraiStorageMode();
    if (savedMode) return savedMode;

    const initialMode = hasLegacyFuraiLocalData()
        ? FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_LOCAL
        : FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_INDEXEDDB;

    return writeFuraiStorageModeFlag(initialMode);
}

function setFuraiStorageRuntimeMode(mode) {
    const normalized = writeFuraiStorageModeFlag(mode);

    StorageEngine.mode = normalized;
    StorageEngine.cache[FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_KEY] = normalized;

    return normalized;
}

/* --- HYBRID STORAGE ENGINE (Auto-Healing & Connection Pooling) --- */
const StorageEngine = {
    mode: getInitialFuraiStorageMode(),
    cache: {}, 
    dbName: 'FurAI_DB',
    storeName: 'keyval',
    
    // --- NEW: Connection Pooling ---
    _dbInstance: null,
    _isOpening: false,
    _openQueue: [],

    openDB: function(callback) {
        // 1. If already open, return instantly
        if (this._dbInstance) {
            return callback(this._dbInstance);
        }
        
        // 2. Add to queue so we don't spam open requests
        this._openQueue.push(callback);
        if (this._isOpening) return;
        this._isOpening = true;

        const request = indexedDB.open(this.dbName); 

        request.onupgradeneeded = (e) => {
            const db = e.target.result;
            if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(this.storeName)) {
                db.createObjectStore(this.storeName);
            }
        };

        request.onsuccess = (e) => {
            const db = e.target.result;
            
            if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(this.storeName)) {
                const nextVersion = db.version + 1; 
                db.close(); 
                
                const upgradeReq = indexedDB.open(this.dbName, nextVersion);
                upgradeReq.onupgradeneeded = (ev) => {
                    const newDb = ev.target.result;
                    if (!newDb.objectStoreNames.contains(this.storeName)) {
                        newDb.createObjectStore(this.storeName);
                    }
                };
                upgradeReq.onsuccess = (ev) => {
                    this._dbInstance = ev.target.result;
                    this._flushQueue();
                };
                upgradeReq.onerror = () => this._flushQueue(true);
            } else {
                this._dbInstance = db;
                this._flushQueue();
            }
        };
        request.onerror = () => this._flushQueue(true);
    },

    _flushQueue: function(isError = false) {
        this._isOpening = false;
        const db = isError ? null : this._dbInstance;
        this._openQueue.forEach(cb => cb(db));
        this._openQueue = [];
    },

    _pendingWritePrefix: '__furai_pending_write__',
    _pendingRemovePrefix: '__furai_pending_remove__',

    _applyPendingStorageMirrors: function() {
        const keys = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
            keys.push(localStorage.key(i));
        }

        keys
            .filter(key => key && key.startsWith(this._pendingWritePrefix))
            .forEach(key => {
                const realKey = key.slice(this._pendingWritePrefix.length);
                const value = localStorage.getItem(key);

                if (realKey && value !== null) {
                    this.cache[realKey] = value;
                }
            });

        keys
            .filter(key => key && key.startsWith(this._pendingRemovePrefix))
            .forEach(key => {
                const realKey = key.slice(this._pendingRemovePrefix.length);

                if (realKey) {
                    delete this.cache[realKey];
                }
            });
    },

    init: async function() {
        if (this.mode === 'localStorage') {
            for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
                const key = localStorage.key(i);
                this.cache[key] = localStorage.getItem(key);
            }

            this._applyPendingStorageMirrors();
            return;
        }

        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            this.openDB((db) => {
                if (!db) {
                    console.warn("DB Open Failed. Reverting to LocalStorage.");
                    this.mode = FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_LOCAL;
                    writeFuraiStorageModeFlag(FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_LOCAL);
                    this.cache[FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_KEY] = FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_LOCAL;

                    for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
                        const key = localStorage.key(i);
                        this.cache[key] = localStorage.getItem(key);
                    }

                    this._applyPendingStorageMirrors();
                    return resolve();
                }

                const tx = db.transaction(this.storeName, 'readonly');
                const store = tx.objectStore(this.storeName);
                const cursorReq = store.openCursor();

                const finishInit = () => {
                    for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
                        const key = localStorage.key(i);

                        if (key && !(key in this.cache)) {
                            this.cache[key] = localStorage.getItem(key);
                        }
                    }

                    this._applyPendingStorageMirrors();
                    resolve();
                };
                
                cursorReq.onsuccess = (ev) => {
                    const cursor = ev.target.result;

                    if (cursor) {
                        this.cache[cursor.key] = cursor.value;
                        cursor.continue();
                    } else {
                        finishInit();
                    }
                };
                
                cursorReq.onerror = () => {
                    finishInit();
                };
            });
        });
    },

    persist: function(key, value) {
        this.cache[key] = value;

        const writeMirrorKey = this._pendingWritePrefix + key;
        const removeMirrorKey = this._pendingRemovePrefix + key;

        if (this.mode === 'localStorage') {
            try {
                localStorage.setItem(key, value);
                localStorage.removeItem(writeMirrorKey);
                localStorage.removeItem(removeMirrorKey);
            } catch (e) {}

            return;
        }

        // Synchronous crash/reload mirror.
        // If the page refreshes before IndexedDB finishes, init() restores this newest value.
        try {
            localStorage.setItem(writeMirrorKey, value);
            localStorage.removeItem(removeMirrorKey);
        } catch (e) {}

        this.openDB((db) => {
            if (!db) return;

            try {
                const tx = db.transaction(this.storeName, 'readwrite');
                tx.objectStore(this.storeName).put(value, key);

                tx.oncomplete = () => {
                    try { localStorage.removeItem(writeMirrorKey); } catch (e) {}
                };

                tx.onerror = () => {
                    // Keep mirror so next refresh still sees the newest cache value.
                };
            } catch (e) {
                // Keep mirror.
            }
        });
    },

    remove: function(key) {
        delete this.cache[key];

        const writeMirrorKey = this._pendingWritePrefix + key;
        const removeMirrorKey = this._pendingRemovePrefix + key;

        if (this.mode === 'localStorage') {
            try {
                localStorage.removeItem(key);
                localStorage.removeItem(writeMirrorKey);
                localStorage.removeItem(removeMirrorKey);
            } catch (e) {}

            return;
        }

        // Synchronous crash/reload mirror for deletes.
        try {
            localStorage.setItem(removeMirrorKey, '1');
            localStorage.removeItem(writeMirrorKey);
        } catch (e) {}

        this.openDB((db) => {
            if (!db) return;

            try {
                const tx = db.transaction(this.storeName, 'readwrite');
                tx.objectStore(this.storeName).delete(key);

                tx.oncomplete = () => {
                    try { localStorage.removeItem(removeMirrorKey); } catch (e) {}
                };

                tx.onerror = () => {
                    // Keep remove mirror.
                };
            } catch (e) {
                // Keep remove mirror.
            }
        });
    },

    bulkImport: async function(dataObj) {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            this.openDB((db) => {
                if (!db) return reject(new Error("Failed to open database."));

                const tx = db.transaction(this.storeName, 'readwrite');
                const store = tx.objectStore(this.storeName);
                
                Object.keys(dataObj).forEach(key => {
                    store.put(dataObj[key], key);
                });

                tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
                tx.onerror = (err) => reject(err);
            });
        });
    }
};

/* --- MULTI-TAB SYNC CHANNEL --- */
const furaiSyncChannel = new BroadcastChannel('furai_db_sync');

/* --- MAIN DB WRAPPER (Compressed & Multi-Tab Safe) --- */
const DB = {
    set: (key, value, skipBroadcast = false) => {
        try {
            const stringVal = JSON.stringify(value);
            const compressed = LZString.compressToUTF16(stringVal);
            StorageEngine.persist(key, compressed);

            if (typeof syncChatSidebarMetaFromSet === 'function') {
                syncChatSidebarMetaFromSet(key, value);
            }
            
            // Broadcast the highly-compressed string to other tabs (Very low RAM overhead)
            if (!skipBroadcast) {
                furaiSyncChannel.postMessage({ action: 'set', key: key, payload: compressed });
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.error("Save Error:", e);
        }
    },
    get: (key) => {
        const raw = StorageEngine.cache[key];
        if (!raw) return null;
        const decompressed = LZString.decompressFromUTF16(raw);
        if (decompressed) {
            try { return JSON.parse(decompressed); } catch(e) {}
        }
        try { return JSON.parse(raw); } catch(e) { return raw; }
    },
    remove: (key, skipBroadcast = false) => {
        StorageEngine.remove(key);

        if (typeof syncChatSidebarMetaFromRemove === 'function') {
            syncChatSidebarMetaFromRemove(key);
        }

        if (!skipBroadcast) {
            furaiSyncChannel.postMessage({ action: 'remove', key: key });
        }
    }
};

/* --- SYNC DEBOUNCERS (Prevents CPU Spikes) --- */
let syncSidebarTimeout = null;
let furaiBlockSidebarUntil = 0;

function blockSidebarDuringFastStart(ms = 2200) {
    furaiBlockSidebarUntil = Math.max(furaiBlockSidebarUntil, Date.now() + ms);
}

const FURAI_SIDEBAR_META_KEY = 'furai_sidebar_chat_meta_v1';
const FURAI_SIDEBAR_META_SCHEMA = 4;

let furaiSidebarMetaRebuildQueued = false;

function isChatStorageKey(key) {
    return typeof key === 'string' && key.startsWith('chat-');
}

function getChatKeyFromAnyId(id) {
    const value = String(id || '').trim();
    if (!value) return '';
    return value.startsWith('chat-') ? value : `chat-${value}`;
}

function getBareChatId(id) {
    return String(id || '').replace(/^chat-/, '');
}

function getProfileKeysForChatKey(chatKey) {
    const key = getChatKeyFromAnyId(chatKey);
    const bareId = getBareChatId(key);

    return [...new Set([
        `profile-${key}`,
        `profile-${bareId}`
    ].filter(Boolean))];
}

function getChatKeyFromProfileKey(profileKey) {
    const rawId = String(profileKey || '').replace(/^profile-/, '').trim();
    return rawId ? getChatKeyFromAnyId(rawId) : '';
}

let furaiSidebarMetaIndexCache = null;
let furaiSidebarMetaSaveHandle = null;

function cancelPendingSidebarMetaSave() {
    if (!furaiSidebarMetaSaveHandle) return;

    if (window.cancelIdleCallback) {
        cancelIdleCallback(furaiSidebarMetaSaveHandle);
    } else {
        clearTimeout(furaiSidebarMetaSaveHandle);
    }

    furaiSidebarMetaSaveHandle = null;
}

function invalidateSidebarMetaIndexCache() {
    cancelPendingSidebarMetaSave();
    furaiSidebarMetaIndexCache = null;
}

function getSidebarMetaIndex() {
    if (furaiSidebarMetaIndexCache) {
        return furaiSidebarMetaIndexCache;
    }

    const data = DB.get(FURAI_SIDEBAR_META_KEY);

    furaiSidebarMetaIndexCache =
        data && typeof data === 'object' && !Array.isArray(data)
            ? data
            : {};

    return furaiSidebarMetaIndexCache;
}

function flushSidebarMetaIndex() {
    cancelPendingSidebarMetaSave();

    if (!furaiSidebarMetaIndexCache) return;

    const indexToSave = furaiSidebarMetaIndexCache;
    furaiSidebarMetaIndexCache = null;

    DB.set(
        FURAI_SIDEBAR_META_KEY,
        indexToSave,
        true
    );
}

function saveSidebarMetaIndex(index) {
    furaiSidebarMetaIndexCache =
        index && typeof index === 'object' && !Array.isArray(index)
            ? index
            : {};

    if (furaiSidebarMetaSaveHandle) return;

    const save = () => {
        furaiSidebarMetaSaveHandle = null;

        if (!furaiSidebarMetaIndexCache) return;

        const indexToSave = furaiSidebarMetaIndexCache;
        furaiSidebarMetaIndexCache = null;

        DB.set(
            FURAI_SIDEBAR_META_KEY,
            indexToSave,
            true
        );
    };

    furaiSidebarMetaSaveHandle = window.requestIdleCallback
        ? requestIdleCallback(save, { timeout: 1600 })
        : setTimeout(save, 350);
}

window.addEventListener('pagehide', flushSidebarMetaIndex);

function makeSidebarProfileSummary(profile) {
    if (!profile || typeof profile !== 'object') return null;

    const bots = Array.isArray(profile.bots) ? profile.bots : [];
    const activeBots = bots.filter(bot => bot && bot.inActiveCast);
    const primaryBot = activeBots.find(bot => bot?.avatar) || bots.find(bot => bot?.avatar) || null;

    return {
        profileCustomized: !!profile.profileCustomized,
        user: {
            avatar: String(profile.user?.avatar || '')
        },
        bots: activeBots.slice(0, 12).map(bot => ({
            avatar: String(bot?.avatar || ''),
            inActiveCast: true,
            isActive: bot?.isActive !== false
        })),
        activeCount: activeBots.length,
        primaryAvatar: String(primaryBot?.avatar || profile.user?.avatar || ''),
        hasBots: bots.length > 0
    };
}

function getStoredSidebarProfileSummary(chatKey, index) {
    const existing = index?.[chatKey]?._sidebarProfile;
    if (existing) return existing;

    for (const profileKey of getProfileKeysForChatKey(chatKey)) {
        try {
            const profile = DB.get(profileKey);
            const summary = makeSidebarProfileSummary(profile);
            if (summary) return summary;
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    return null;
}

function getSidebarRecentSearchText(chatData) {
    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];

    return messages
        // Human chat search should find Silent Note / muted-note text too.
        // AI context filtering is handled separately by shouldSkipAiContextMessageRole().
        .filter(msg => msg?.role !== 'cutscene')
        .slice(-4)
        .map(msg => String(msg?.content || ''))
        .join(' ')
        .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim()
        .slice(0, 500);
}

function makeSidebarMetaFromChatData(chatKey, chatData, profileSummary = null) {
    const safeChatKey = getChatKeyFromAnyId(chatKey || chatData?.id);
    const title = String(chatData?.title || chatData?.name || 'New Chat').trim() || 'New Chat';
    const personality = String(chatData?.personality || 'researcher').trim() || 'researcher';
    const timestamp = Number(chatData?.timestamp) || Date.now();
    const hasMessages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) && chatData.messages.length > 0;
    const isPinned = !!chatData?.isPinned;
    const isCustomized = !!profileSummary?.profileCustomized;
    const hasBackground = !!chatData?.background;
    const isRenamed = title !== 'New Chat' && title !== 'Home';

    const lastMessagePreview = getSidebarRecentSearchText(chatData);

    return {
        schema: FURAI_SIDEBAR_META_SCHEMA,
        id: safeChatKey,
        chatKey: safeChatKey,
        title,
        timestamp,
        personality,
        isPinned,
        folderId: chatData?.folderId || null,
        hasMessages,
        isCustomized,
        hasBackground,
        isRenamed,
        lastMessagePreview,
        _sidebarProfile: profileSummary || null,
        _searchText: [
            title,
            personality,
            lastMessagePreview,
            new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', year: 'numeric' })
        ].join(' ').toLowerCase()
    };
}

function isSidebarMetaEntryUsable(meta, chatKey) {
    return (
        meta &&
        typeof meta === 'object' &&
        meta.schema === FURAI_SIDEBAR_META_SCHEMA &&
        meta.chatKey === chatKey &&
        meta.id &&
        meta.title
    );
}

function isSidebarMetaUntouched(meta) {
    return (
        meta &&
        !meta.hasMessages &&
        !meta.isCustomized &&
        !meta.hasBackground &&
        !meta.isPinned &&
        !meta.isRenamed
    );
}

function syncChatSidebarMetaFromSet(key, value) {
    try {
        if (key === FURAI_SIDEBAR_META_KEY) return;

        if (isChatStorageKey(key)) {
            if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return;

            const chatKey = getChatKeyFromAnyId(key);
            const index = getSidebarMetaIndex();
            const profileSummary = getStoredSidebarProfileSummary(chatKey, index);

            index[chatKey] = makeSidebarMetaFromChatData(chatKey, value, profileSummary);
            saveSidebarMetaIndex(index);
            return;
        }

        if (String(key || '').startsWith('profile-')) {
            const chatKey = getChatKeyFromProfileKey(key);
            if (!chatKey) return;

            const index = getSidebarMetaIndex();
            const entry = index[chatKey];
            if (!entry) return;

            const profileSummary = makeSidebarProfileSummary(value);

            entry._sidebarProfile = profileSummary;
            entry.isCustomized = !!profileSummary?.profileCustomized;
            entry._searchText = [
                entry.title,
                entry.personality,
                entry.lastMessagePreview || '',
                new Date(entry.timestamp || Date.now()).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', year: 'numeric' })
            ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

            index[chatKey] = entry;
            saveSidebarMetaIndex(index);
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Sidebar metadata sync failed:', e);
    }
}

function syncChatSidebarMetaFromRemoteSet(key) {
    if (!isChatStorageKey(key) && !String(key || '').startsWith('profile-')) return;

    try {
        syncChatSidebarMetaFromSet(key, DB.get(key));
    } catch(e) {}
}

function syncChatSidebarMetaFromRemove(key) {
    try {
        if (key === FURAI_SIDEBAR_META_KEY) {
            invalidateSidebarMetaIndexCache();
            return;
        }

        if (isChatStorageKey(key)) {
            const chatKey = getChatKeyFromAnyId(key);
            const index = getSidebarMetaIndex();

            if (index[chatKey]) {
                delete index[chatKey];
                saveSidebarMetaIndex(index);
            }

            return;
        }

        if (String(key || '').startsWith('profile-')) {
            const chatKey = getChatKeyFromProfileKey(key);
            if (!chatKey) return;

            const index = getSidebarMetaIndex();
            const entry = index[chatKey];
            if (!entry) return;

            entry._sidebarProfile = null;
            entry.isCustomized = false;

            index[chatKey] = entry;
            saveSidebarMetaIndex(index);
        }
    } catch(e) {}
}

function scheduleSidebarMetaIndexRebuild() {
    if (furaiSidebarMetaRebuildQueued) return;

    furaiSidebarMetaRebuildQueued = true;

    const run = deadline => rebuildSidebarMetaIndexInBackground(deadline);

    if (window.requestIdleCallback) {
        requestIdleCallback(run, { timeout: 1600 });
    } else {
        setTimeout(() => run(null), 250);
    }
}

function rebuildSidebarMetaIndexInBackground(initialDeadline = null) {
    const chatKeys = Object.keys(StorageEngine.cache).filter(isChatStorageKey);
    const index = getSidebarMetaIndex();

    let cursor = 0;
    let touched = false;

    const queueNextStep = (step, delay = 0) => {
        if (delay > 0) {
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (window.requestIdleCallback) {
                    requestIdleCallback(step, { timeout: 1600 });
                } else {
                    step(null);
                }
            }, delay);
            return;
        }

        if (window.requestIdleCallback) {
            requestIdleCallback(step, { timeout: 1600 });
        } else {
            setTimeout(() => step(null), 80);
        }
    };

    const step = (deadline) => {
        const blockedFor = Math.max(0, furaiBlockSidebarUntil - Date.now());

        if (blockedFor > 0) {
            queueNextStep(step, blockedFor + 40);
            return;
        }

        const startedAt = performance.now();
        const hasIdleBudget =
            deadline &&
            typeof deadline.timeRemaining === 'function';
        let processed = 0;

        while (
            cursor < chatKeys.length &&
            (
                processed < 1 ||
                (
                    hasIdleBudget
                        ? deadline.timeRemaining() > 2
                        : performance.now() - startedAt < 8
                )
            )
        ) {
            const chatKey = chatKeys[cursor++];
            processed++;

            if (isSidebarMetaEntryUsable(index[chatKey], chatKey)) continue;

            try {
                const chatData = DB.get(chatKey);
                if (!chatData || typeof chatData !== 'object') continue;

                const profileSummary = getStoredSidebarProfileSummary(chatKey, index);
                index[chatKey] = makeSidebarMetaFromChatData(chatKey, chatData, profileSummary);
                touched = true;
            } catch(e) {}
        }

        if (cursor < chatKeys.length) {
            queueNextStep(step);
            return;
        }

        // Re-read live keys at completion so chats created during migration
        // are never deleted from the freshly updated index.
        const finalLiveKeys = new Set(
            Object.keys(StorageEngine.cache).filter(isChatStorageKey)
        );

        Object.keys(index).forEach(chatKey => {
            if (!finalLiveKeys.has(chatKey)) {
                delete index[chatKey];
                touched = true;
            }
        });

        if (touched) saveSidebarMetaIndex(index);

        furaiSidebarMetaRebuildQueued = false;

        if (typeof updateChatList === 'function') {
            updateChatList(document.getElementById('chatSearchInput')?.value || '');
        }
    };

    step(initialDeadline);
}

function getSidebarMetaRowsForList(searchQuery = '') {
    const index = getSidebarMetaIndex();
    const chatKeys = Object.keys(StorageEngine.cache).filter(isChatStorageKey);
    const liveKeys = new Set(chatKeys);

    let indexTouched = false;
    let needsRebuild = false;

    const query = String(searchQuery || '').trim().toLowerCase();

    Object.keys(index).forEach(chatKey => {
        if (!liveKeys.has(chatKey)) {
            delete index[chatKey];
            indexTouched = true;
        }
    });

    const rows = [];

    for (const chatKey of chatKeys) {
        const meta = index[chatKey];

        if (!isSidebarMetaEntryUsable(meta, chatKey)) {
            needsRebuild = true;
            continue;
        }

        if (query) {
            const searchText = String(meta._searchText || meta.title || '').toLowerCase();
            if (typeof smartSearchMatch === 'function') {
                if (!smartSearchMatch(searchText, query)) continue;
            } else if (!searchText.includes(query)) {
                continue;
            }
        }

        rows.push({
            ...meta,
            id: meta.id || chatKey,
            chatKey
        });
    }

    if (indexTouched) saveSidebarMetaIndex(index);
    if (needsRebuild) scheduleSidebarMetaIndexRebuild();

    return rows;
}

function debouncedSidebarUpdate() {
    if (syncSidebarTimeout) return;

    const run = () => {
        syncSidebarTimeout = null;

        if (Date.now() < furaiBlockSidebarUntil) {
            syncSidebarTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                syncSidebarTimeout = null;
                if (typeof debouncedSidebarUpdate === 'function') debouncedSidebarUpdate();
            }, 900);
            return;
        }

        if (typeof updateChatList === 'function') updateChatList();
    };

    syncSidebarTimeout = window.requestIdleCallback
        ? requestIdleCallback(run, { timeout: 1400 })
        : setTimeout(run, 700);
}

let chatListSearchTimeout = null;

function queueChatListSearch(query) {
    if (chatListSearchTimeout) clearTimeout(chatListSearchTimeout);

    const delay = String(query || '').trim() ? 220 : 0;

    chatListSearchTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        updateChatList(query || '');
    }, delay);
}

/* --- MIGRATION TOOL --- */
async function upgradeToIndexedDB() {
    const btn = document.getElementById('upgradeStorageBtn');
    const previousMode = StorageEngine.mode;

    if (btn) {
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin" style="margin-right: 8px;"></i> Processing...';
        btn.disabled = true;
    }

    try {
        const backup = {};
        const keys = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
            keys.push(localStorage.key(i));
        }

        keys.forEach(key => {
            if (!key) return;

            const val = localStorage.getItem(key);
            backup[key] = val;
            StorageEngine.cache[key] = val;
        });

        await StorageEngine.bulkImport(backup);

        setFuraiStorageRuntimeMode(FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_INDEXEDDB);

        showToast("Memory Expansion Active!", "success");
        setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 900);
    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        setFuraiStorageRuntimeMode(previousMode || FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_LOCAL);

        alert("Migration Failed: " + e.message);

        if (btn) {
            btn.innerHTML = "Retry Memory Expansion";
            btn.disabled = false;
        }
    }
}
