  const SCROLL_BOTTOM_EPSILON = 1;
  const CR_BOTTOM_STICK_BRAKE_MS = 350;
  
  function brakeCrBottomStick() {
      autoScroll = false;
      crBottomStickBrakeUntil = Date.now() + CR_BOTTOM_STICK_BRAKE_MS;
  }

  function canCrBottomStick() {
      return Date.now() >= crBottomStickBrakeUntil;
  }
  
  function getDistanceFromBottom(el) {
      if (!el) return Infinity;
      return Math.max(0, el.scrollHeight - el.scrollTop - el.clientHeight);
  }
  
  function isNearScrollBottom(el) {
      return getDistanceFromBottom(el) <= SCROLL_BOTTOM_EPSILON;
  }
  
  function scrollElementToBottom(el, options = {}) {
      if (!el) return;
      if (options.respectUserBrake && !canCrBottomStick()) return;
      el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight;
  }

  const FURAI_STREAM_MIN_FRAME_MS = 28;

  function getSmoothStreamStep(lag) {
      if (lag > 240) return 28;
      if (lag > 120) return 18;
      if (lag > 60) return 10;
      if (lag > 20) return 5;
      return 2;
  }

  function clearSmoothTypingIndicator(messageEl) {
      const state = messageEl && messageEl._furaiStreamState;
      if (!state) return;

      if (state.rafId) {
          cancelAnimationFrame(state.rafId);
      }

      delete messageEl._furaiStreamState;
  }

  function getLiveTypingMarkdownText(text) {
      let value = String(text || '');

      const fenceCount = (value.match(/```/g) || []).length;
      if (fenceCount % 2 === 1) return value;

      const backtickCount = (value.match(/`/g) || []).length;
      if (backtickCount % 2 === 1) return value + '`';

      const boldCount = (value.match(/\*\*/g) || []).length;
      if (boldCount % 2 === 1) return value + '**';

      const plainStarCount = (value.replace(/\*\*/g, '').match(/\*/g) || []).length;
      if (plainStarCount % 2 === 1) return value + '*';

      return value;
  }

  function formatLiveTypingContent(text) {
      return formatMessageContent(getLiveTypingMarkdownText(text));
  }

  // =====================================================================
  // LIVE MESSAGE HEADER CONTRACT — NEVER DROP NAME OR TIMESTAMP MID-STREAM
  // =====================================================================
  // Announcement, Silent Note, Cutscene, and other compact message styles keep
  // their header inside `.content`. Streaming previously replaced all innerHTML,
  // briefly deleting [name][timestamp] until final rendering restored it.
  //
  // Move the existing header nodes out, replace only the message body, then put
  // the same nodes back. This preserves layout/state without rebuilding DOM on
  // every animation frame.
  function setFuraiLiveContentHtml(contentEl, html) {
      if (!contentEl) return 0;

      const headerNodes = Array.from(contentEl.children).filter(node =>
          node.classList.contains('chat-username') ||
          node.classList.contains('chat-timestamp-row') ||
          node.classList.contains('vn-message-timestamp-tail')
      );

      const headerFragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
      headerNodes.forEach(node => headerFragment.appendChild(node));

      contentEl.innerHTML = html;

      if (headerNodes.length) {
          contentEl.insertBefore(headerFragment, contentEl.firstChild || null);
      }

      return headerNodes.length;
  }

  function queueSmoothTypingIndicator(id, text, withTypingEffect = true) {
      const messageEl = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!messageEl) return;

      const state = messageEl._furaiStreamState || {
          fullText: '',
          visibleText: '',
          rafId: 0,
          lastFrameAt: 0
      };

      state.fullText = String(text || '');
      state.withTypingEffect = withTypingEffect;
      messageEl._furaiStreamState = state;

      if (state.rafId) return;

      const paint = (now) => {
          state.rafId = 0;

          if (!document.body.contains(messageEl)) {
              clearSmoothTypingIndicator(messageEl);
              return;
          }

          if (now - state.lastFrameAt < FURAI_STREAM_MIN_FRAME_MS) {
              state.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(paint);
              return;
          }

          state.lastFrameAt = now;

          if (
              state.visibleText.length > state.fullText.length ||
              state.fullText.slice(0, state.visibleText.length) !== state.visibleText
          ) {
              state.visibleText = '';
          }

          const lag = state.fullText.length - state.visibleText.length;

          if (lag > 0) {
              const nextLength = state.visibleText.length + getSmoothStreamStep(lag);
              state.visibleText = state.fullText.slice(0, nextLength);
              updateTypingIndicator(id, state.visibleText, state.withTypingEffect, true);
          }

          if (state.visibleText.length < state.fullText.length) {
              state.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(paint);
          }
      };

      state.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(paint);
  }

const FURAI_THINKING_SVG = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="4" cy="12" r="3" fill="currentColor"><animate attributeName="opacity" begin="0s" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite" values="1;0.22;1"/></circle><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.4"><animate attributeName="opacity" begin="0.15s" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite" values="1;0.22;1"/></circle><circle cx="20" cy="12" r="3" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.3"><animate attributeName="opacity" begin="0.3s" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite" values="1;0.22;1"/></circle></svg>`;

function getFuraiThinkingStatusMarkup(safeName, statusText) {
    return `
        <span class="cr-status-icon" aria-hidden="true">${FURAI_THINKING_SVG}</span>
        <span><span class="status-speaker-name">${safeName}</span> ${statusText}</span>
    `;
}

function getFuraiMessageContentElement(target) {
    if (!target) return null;
    if (target.classList?.contains('content')) return target;
    return target.querySelector?.('.content') || null;
}

function clearFuraiMessageThinkingIndicator(target) {
    const contentEl = getFuraiMessageContentElement(target);
    if (!contentEl) return;

    contentEl.querySelectorAll(':scope > .furai-message-thinking-body').forEach(node => node.remove());
    contentEl.classList.remove('furai-message-thinking');
}

function setFuraiMessageThinkingIndicator(target) {
    const contentEl = getFuraiMessageContentElement(target);
    if (!contentEl) return;

    // One placeholder body for every live message role. Header nodes remain in
    // their assigned frame slot; only the body changes between waiting, stream,
    // pause, and completion.
    const headerNodes = Array.from(contentEl.children).filter(node =>
        node.classList.contains('chat-username') ||
        node.classList.contains('chat-timestamp-row') ||
        node.classList.contains('vn-message-timestamp-tail')
    );

    const thinkingBody = document.createElement('span');
    thinkingBody.className = 'furai-message-thinking-body';
    thinkingBody.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Preparing');
    thinkingBody.innerHTML = FURAI_THINKING_SVG;

    contentEl.classList.remove('typing', 'furai-message-thinking');
    contentEl.classList.add('content', 'furai-message-thinking');
    contentEl.replaceChildren(...headerNodes, thinkingBody);
}

function clearFuraiActiveMessageThinkingIndicators() {
    document.querySelectorAll('#chatMessagesEl .content.furai-message-thinking')
        .forEach(contentEl => clearFuraiMessageThinkingIndicator(contentEl));
}

function clearFuraiGenerationThinkingUI() {
    clearFuraiActiveMessageThinkingIndicators();

    if (typeof hideCrBottomStatusPill === 'function') {
        hideCrBottomStatusPill('typing');
        hideCrBottomStatusPill('cutscene');
    }

    if (typeof hideVnStatusHint === 'function') {
        hideVnStatusHint('thinking', { forceThinking: true });
        hideVnStatusHint('typing');
        hideVnStatusHint('cutscene');
    }
}

const FURAI_GHOST_INPUT_CARET = '|';
const FURAI_GHOST_INPUT_BLINK_MS = 520;

function getSmoothInputState(inputEl) {
    if (!inputEl) return null;

    if (!inputEl._furaiInputStreamState) {
        inputEl._furaiInputStreamState = {
            fullText: '',
            visibleText: inputEl.value || '',
            rafId: 0,
            lastFrameAt: 0,
            blinkTimerId: 0,
            caretVisible: true,
            isGhostWriting: false
        };
    }

    return inputEl._furaiInputStreamState;
}

function paintSmoothInputDisplay(inputEl, state) {
    if (!inputEl || !state) return;

    const baseText = String(state.visibleText || '');
    const displayText = state.isGhostWriting && state.caretVisible
        ? baseText + FURAI_GHOST_INPUT_CARET
        : baseText;

    setSmoothInputValue(inputEl, displayText, false);
}

function stopGhostInputBlinkTimer(state) {
    if (!state || !state.blinkTimerId) return;

    clearInterval(state.blinkTimerId);
    state.blinkTimerId = 0;
}

function setGhostInputBlinking(inputEl, enabled) {
    if (!inputEl) return;

    const wrapper = inputEl.closest('.chat-input-wrapper');
    if (wrapper) {
        wrapper.classList.toggle('furai-ghost-writing', !!enabled);
    }

    const existingState = inputEl._furaiInputStreamState;

    if (!enabled) {
        if (existingState) {
            existingState.isGhostWriting = false;
            existingState.caretVisible = false;
            stopGhostInputBlinkTimer(existingState);
        }
        return;
    }

    const state = getSmoothInputState(inputEl);
    state.isGhostWriting = true;
    state.caretVisible = true;

    const activeEl = document.activeElement;
    if (wrapper && activeEl && wrapper.contains(activeEl) && typeof activeEl.blur === 'function') {
        activeEl.blur();
    }

    if (!state.blinkTimerId) {
        state.blinkTimerId = setInterval(() => {
            const liveState = inputEl._furaiInputStreamState;

            if (!liveState || !liveState.isGhostWriting || !document.body.contains(inputEl)) {
                stopGhostInputBlinkTimer(liveState || state);
                return;
            }

            liveState.caretVisible = !liveState.caretVisible;
            paintSmoothInputDisplay(inputEl, liveState);
        }, FURAI_GHOST_INPUT_BLINK_MS);
    }

    paintSmoothInputDisplay(inputEl, state);
}

function setSmoothInputValue(inputEl, value, keepFocus = false) {
    if (!inputEl) return;

    inputEl.value = String(value || '');
    inputEl.scrollTop = inputEl.scrollHeight;

    if (keepFocus && !inputEl.closest('.chat-input-wrapper')?.classList.contains('furai-ghost-writing')) {
        inputEl.focus();

        try {
            const end = inputEl.value.length;
            inputEl.setSelectionRange(end, end);
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
}

function clearSmoothInputText(inputEl, flush = false) {
    const state = inputEl && inputEl._furaiInputStreamState;

    if (!inputEl) return;

    if (state) {
        if (state.rafId) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(state.rafId);
        }

        stopGhostInputBlinkTimer(state);

        const cleanText = flush
            ? String(state.fullText || '')
            : String(state.visibleText || '');

        delete inputEl._furaiInputStreamState;
        setGhostInputBlinking(inputEl, false);
        setSmoothInputValue(inputEl, cleanText, false);
        return;
    }

    setGhostInputBlinking(inputEl, false);
}

function finishSmoothInputText(inputEl) {
    if (!inputEl) return;

    clearSmoothInputText(inputEl, true);
}

function queueSmoothInputText(inputEl, fullText) {
    if (!inputEl) return;

    const state = getSmoothInputState(inputEl);
    state.fullText = String(fullText || '');
    inputEl._furaiInputStreamState = state;

    setGhostInputBlinking(inputEl, true);

    if (state.rafId) return;

    const paint = (now) => {
        state.rafId = 0;

        if (!document.body.contains(inputEl)) {
            clearSmoothInputText(inputEl);
            return;
        }

        if (now - state.lastFrameAt < FURAI_STREAM_MIN_FRAME_MS) {
            state.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(paint);
            return;
        }

        state.lastFrameAt = now;

        if (
            state.visibleText.length > state.fullText.length ||
            state.fullText.slice(0, state.visibleText.length) !== state.visibleText
        ) {
            state.visibleText = '';
        }

        const lag = state.fullText.length - state.visibleText.length;

        if (lag > 0) {
            const nextLength = state.visibleText.length + getSmoothStreamStep(lag);
            state.visibleText = state.fullText.slice(0, nextLength);
            paintSmoothInputDisplay(inputEl, state);
        }

        if (state.visibleText.length < state.fullText.length) {
            state.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(paint);
        }

        // Do not finish here.
        // Generation may pause between chunks, so the fake caret keeps blinking.
    };

    state.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(paint);
}

function escapeStatusText(value) {
    return String(value || '')
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
}

let furaiVnRenderableCacheVersion = 0;
let furaiVnRenderableCacheRoot = null;
let furaiVnRenderableCacheObserver = null;
let furaiVnRenderableCache = {
    chatId: null,
    version: -1,
    root: null,
    messages: []
};

function invalidateFuraiVnRenderableCache() {
    furaiVnRenderableCacheVersion++;
    window.furaiVnDataCacheDirty = true;
}

function ensureFuraiVnRenderableCacheObserver(root) {
    if (!root || furaiVnRenderableCacheRoot === root) return;

    if (furaiVnRenderableCacheObserver) {
        try { furaiVnRenderableCacheObserver.disconnect(); } catch(e) {}
    }

    furaiVnRenderableCacheRoot = root;

    furaiVnRenderableCacheObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
        invalidateFuraiVnRenderableCache();
    });

    furaiVnRenderableCacheObserver.observe(root, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        attributes: true,
        attributeFilter: ['class', 'data-message-uid', 'data-message-index', 'data-created-at']
    });
}

function getVnRenderableMessages(forceFresh = false) {
    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    if (!chatMessagesEl) return [];

    ensureFuraiVnRenderableCacheObserver(chatMessagesEl);

    if (
        !forceFresh &&
        furaiVnRenderableCache.chatId === currentChatId &&
        furaiVnRenderableCache.root === chatMessagesEl &&
        furaiVnRenderableCache.version === furaiVnRenderableCacheVersion
    ) {
        return furaiVnRenderableCache.messages;
    }

    // CR is smooth because it works from already-rendered message nodes. VN should do the same:
    // read direct children only, cache the list, and invalidate on DOM mutation instead of
    // querySelectorAll/scanning the whole log on every VN click.
    const messages = Array.from(chatMessagesEl.children || []).filter(m =>
        m?.classList?.contains('message') &&
        m.id !== 'personality-selector-message' &&
        !m.classList.contains('is-regenerating-replaced')
    );

    furaiVnRenderableCache = {
        chatId: currentChatId,
        version: furaiVnRenderableCacheVersion,
        root: chatMessagesEl,
        messages
    };

    return messages;
}

function isLiveTypingMessage(messageEl) {
    if (!messageEl) return false;

    const id = messageEl.id || '';
    const contentEl = messageEl.querySelector('.content');

    return (
        id.startsWith('typing-') ||
        contentEl?.classList.contains('furai-message-thinking') ||
        contentEl?.classList.contains('typing')
    );
}

function isVnPendingThinkingBubble(messageEl) {
    if (!messageEl) return false;

    const contentEl = messageEl.querySelector('.content');
    return !!contentEl && contentEl.classList.contains('furai-message-thinking');
}

function getVnCurrentMessageElement() {
    const messages = typeof getVnRenderableMessages === 'function'
        ? getVnRenderableMessages()
        : [];

    const index = Math.min(
        Math.max(parseInt(vnCurrentIndex, 10) || 0, 0),
        Math.max(messages.length - 1, 0)
    );

    return messages[index] || null;
}

function getVnDbMessageRecordFromElement(messageEl) {
    if (!currentChatId || !messageEl || isLiveTypingMessage(messageEl)) return null;

    const dbIndex = typeof getRenderedDbMessageIndex === 'function'
        ? getRenderedDbMessageIndex(messageEl)
        : -1;

    if (!Number.isInteger(dbIndex) || dbIndex < 0) return null;

    const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
    const msg = chatData?.messages?.[dbIndex];

    if (!msg) return null;

    return {
        chatData,
        msg,
        dbIndex
    };
}

function getVnRawContentFromElement(messageEl, fallback = '') {
    const record = getVnDbMessageRecordFromElement(messageEl);
    if (record?.msg) return String(record.msg.content || '');

    const contentEl = messageEl?.querySelector('.content');
    return String(contentEl?.innerText || contentEl?.textContent || fallback || '');
}

function getVnMessageDataFromElement(messageEl, fallback = null) {
    if (!messageEl) {
        return fallback && typeof fallback === 'object' ? { ...fallback } : {};
    }

    const record = getVnDbMessageRecordFromElement(messageEl);
    const contentEl = messageEl.querySelector('.content');

    // A DOM source is the current VN truth. Do not inherit actor fields from
    // vnMessagesCache here, because DOM/renderable indexes can differ during live typing,
    // retries, cutscenes, and imported logs.
    const base = record?.msg && typeof record.msg === 'object'
        ? { ...record.msg }
        : {};

    const isAnnouncementAgent =
        record?.msg?.announcementAgent === true ||
        messageEl.dataset.announcementAgent === 'true';

    if (record?.msg?.role) base.role = record.msg.role;
    else if (messageEl.classList.contains('user')) base.role = 'user';
    else if (messageEl.classList.contains('ai')) base.role = 'ai';
    else if (messageEl.classList.contains('cutscene') || messageEl.dataset.role === 'cutscene') base.role = 'cutscene';
    else if (messageEl.classList.contains('muted-note') || messageEl.dataset.role === 'muted-note') base.role = 'muted-note';
    else if (isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(messageEl.dataset.role) || messageEl.classList.contains('narrator')) {
        base.role = isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(messageEl.dataset.role)
            ? messageEl.dataset.role
            : 'narrator';
    }
    else if (messageEl.classList.contains('system')) base.role = 'system';

    if (isAnnouncementAgent) base.announcementAgent = true;

    if (record) base.dbIndex = record.dbIndex;
    if (messageEl.dataset.botUid) base.botUid = messageEl.dataset.botUid;
    if (messageEl.dataset.userUid) base.userUid = messageEl.dataset.userUid;

    const botIndex = parseInt(messageEl.dataset.botIndex, 10);
    if (Number.isFinite(botIndex)) base.botIndex = botIndex;

    const emotion =
        messageEl.dataset.vnAvatarEmotion ||
        messageEl.dataset.vnEmotion ||
        record?.msg?.emotion ||
        '';

    if (emotion) base.emotion = emotion;

    if (contentEl) {
        base.content = isLiveTypingMessage(messageEl)
            ? String(contentEl.innerText || contentEl.textContent || '')
            : getVnRawContentFromElement(messageEl, base.content || '');
    }

    if (isLiveTypingMessage(messageEl)) {
        base.isTyping = true;
    } else {
        delete base.isTyping;
    }

    return base;
}

function getNewestVnMessageIndex() {
    const messages = typeof getVnRenderableMessages === 'function'
        ? getVnRenderableMessages()
        : [];

    const liveLength = messages.length || vnMessagesCache.length || 0;
    return Math.max(0, liveLength - 1);
}

function getLastReadableMessageIndex() {
    const messages = getVnRenderableMessages();

    for (let i = messages.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (!isLiveTypingMessage(messages[i])) return i;
    }

    return Math.max(0, messages.length - 1);
}

function jumpToNewestMessage() {
    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');

    hideCrBottomStatusPill();
    hideVnStatusHint();
    clearVnFinishedUnreadState();
    clearVnPinnedMessageElement();

    if (document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) {
        if (typeof syncVnData === 'function') {
            syncVnData();
        }

        vnAutoScroll = true;
        vnCurrentIndex = getNewestVnMessageIndex();

        const newestMessageEl = getVnRenderableMessages()[vnCurrentIndex] || null;
        if (newestMessageEl) {
            setVnSceneTargetFromElement(newestMessageEl, {
                autoScroll: true,
                userLocked: false
            });
            if (isLiveTypingMessage(newestMessageEl)) {
                pinVnMessageElement(newestMessageEl, { autoScroll: true });
            }
        }

        vnUserMovedAwayThisSession = false;

        if (typeof renderVnMessage === 'function') {
            renderVnMessage('bottom');
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            if (typeof syncVnData === 'function') {
                syncVnData();
            }

            const freshMessages = getVnRenderableMessages();
            const freshNewestEl = freshMessages[freshMessages.length - 1] || null;

            if (freshNewestEl) {
                setVnSceneTargetFromElement(freshNewestEl, {
                    autoScroll: true,
                    userLocked: false
                });
            }

            if (typeof renderVnMessage === 'function') {
                renderVnMessage('bottom');
            }
        });

        return;
    }

    autoScroll = true;
    scrollElementToBottom(chatMessagesEl);

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        scrollElementToBottom(chatMessagesEl);
    });
}

function jumpToMessageElement(messageEl, options = {}) {
    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    const follow = options.follow !== false;

    hideCrBottomStatusPill();
    hideVnStatusHint();
    clearVnFinishedUnreadState();
    clearVnPinnedMessageElement();

    if (!messageEl || !document.body.contains(messageEl)) {
        jumpToNewestMessage();
        return;
    }

    if (document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) {
        if (typeof syncVnData === 'function') {
            syncVnData();
        }

        const messages = getVnRenderableMessages();
        const targetIndex = messages.indexOf(messageEl);

        if (targetIndex === -1) {
            jumpToNewestMessage();
            return;
        }

        setVnSceneTargetFromElement(messageEl, {
            autoScroll: follow,
            userLocked: !follow
        });

        if (follow) vnUserMovedAwayThisSession = false;

        if (follow && isLiveTypingMessage(messageEl)) {
            rememberGenerationVnLiveTarget(messageEl);
            pinVnMessageElement(messageEl, { autoScroll: true });
        }

        if (typeof renderVnMessage === 'function') {
            renderVnMessage('bottom');
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            if (typeof syncVnData === 'function') {
                syncVnData();
            }

            const freshMessages = getVnRenderableMessages();
            const freshIndex = freshMessages.indexOf(messageEl);

            if (freshIndex !== -1) {
                setVnSceneTargetFromElement(messageEl, {
                    autoScroll: follow,
                    userLocked: !follow
                });

                if (typeof renderVnMessage === 'function') {
                    renderVnMessage('bottom');
                }
            }
        });

        return;
    }

    autoScroll = follow;

    messageEl.scrollIntoView({
        block: 'center',
        behavior: 'smooth'
    });
}

function positionCrBottomStatusPill() {
    const chatInterfaceEl = document.getElementById('chatInterfaceEl');
    const inputWrapper = document.querySelector('.chat-input-wrapper');

    const chatRect = chatInterfaceEl?.getBoundingClientRect();
    const inputRect = inputWrapper?.getBoundingClientRect();

    const left = inputRect ? Math.max(12, Math.round(inputRect.left)) : (chatRect ? Math.max(12, chatRect.left + 16) : 16);
    const center = chatRect ? Math.round(chatRect.left + chatRect.width / 2) : Math.round(window.innerWidth / 2);

    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--cr-status-left', `${left}px`);
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--cr-status-center', `${center}px`);
}

function ensureCrBottomStatusPill() {
    let pill = document.getElementById('crBottomStatusPill');

    if (!pill) {
        pill = document.createElement('button');
        pill.id = 'crBottomStatusPill';
        pill.type = 'button';
        pill.className = 'cr-bottom-status-pill';
        document.body.appendChild(pill);
    }

    pill.onclick = jumpToNewestMessage;

    positionCrBottomStatusPill();
    return pill;
}

let furaiRecallPreflightShowTimer = null;
let furaiRecallPreflightHideTimer = null;

// Warm Deep Memory turns stay silent. The hint appears only when recall is
// genuinely taking long enough to be noticeable (for example, a cold model).
function scheduleFuraiRecallPreflightHint(chatId = currentChatId, delay = 420) {
    hideFuraiRecallPreflightHint();
    if (!chatId || !isFuraiDeepMemoryEnabled(chatId)) return;

    // Do not narrate ordinary recall. This UI exists only for a cold local model
    // that still needs to initialize; ready/indexing engines stay completely quiet.
    if (['ready', 'indexing'].includes(furaiSemanticStatus.state)) return;

    furaiRecallPreflightShowTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        furaiRecallPreflightShowTimer = null;
        if (chatId !== currentChatId || !isFuraiDeepMemoryEnabled(chatId)) return;
        if (['ready', 'indexing'].includes(furaiSemanticStatus.state)) return;
        showFuraiRecallPreflightHint(chatId);
    }, Math.max(0, Number(delay) || 0));
}

function showFuraiRecallPreflightHint(chatId = currentChatId) {
    if (!chatId || chatId !== currentChatId || !isFuraiDeepMemoryEnabled(chatId)) return;

    let hint = document.getElementById('furaiRecallPreflightHint');
    if (!hint) {
        hint = document.createElement('div');
        hint.id = 'furaiRecallPreflightHint';
        hint.className = 'furai-recall-preflight-hint';
        hint.setAttribute('role', 'status');
        hint.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
        document.body.appendChild(hint);
    }

    positionCrBottomStatusPill();
    hint.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin" aria-hidden="true"></i><span>Preparing Deep Memory…</span>';
    hint.classList.add('is-visible');

    if (furaiRecallPreflightHideTimer) clearTimeout(furaiRecallPreflightHideTimer);
    furaiRecallPreflightHideTimer = setTimeout(hideFuraiRecallPreflightHint, 6000);
}

function hideFuraiRecallPreflightHint() {
    if (furaiRecallPreflightShowTimer) clearTimeout(furaiRecallPreflightShowTimer);
    if (furaiRecallPreflightHideTimer) clearTimeout(furaiRecallPreflightHideTimer);
    furaiRecallPreflightShowTimer = null;
    furaiRecallPreflightHideTimer = null;
    const hint = document.getElementById('furaiRecallPreflightHint');
    if (hint) hint.classList.remove('is-visible');
}

function showCrTypingHint(name = 'AI') {
    if (document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return;

    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    if (isNearScrollBottom(chatMessagesEl)) {
        hideCrBottomStatusPill();
        return;
    }

    const pill = ensureCrBottomStatusPill();
    const safeName = escapeStatusText(name || 'AI');

    pill.dataset.kind = 'typing';

    if (pill.dataset.label !== safeName || !pill.classList.contains('is-visible')) {
        pill.dataset.label = safeName;
        pill.innerHTML = getFuraiThinkingStatusMarkup(safeName, 'is typing');
    }

    pill.classList.add('is-visible');
}

function showCrUnreadHint(label = 'NEW MESSAGE') {
    if (document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return;

    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    if (isNearScrollBottom(chatMessagesEl)) {
        hideCrBottomStatusPill();
        return;
    }

    const pill = ensureCrBottomStatusPill();
    const safeLabel = escapeStatusText(String(label || 'NEW MESSAGE').toUpperCase());

    pill.dataset.kind = 'unread';
    pill.dataset.label = safeLabel;
    pill.innerHTML = `
        <span class="cr-status-icon" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fa-solid fa-angle-down"></i></span>
        <span>${safeLabel}</span>
    `;
    pill.classList.add('is-visible');
}

function hideCrBottomStatusPill(kind = null) {
    const pill = document.getElementById('crBottomStatusPill');
    if (!pill) return;
    if (kind && pill.dataset.kind !== kind) return;

    pill.classList.remove('is-visible');
    pill.dataset.kind = '';
    pill.dataset.label = '';
}

function ensureVnStatusHintEl() {
    const glassPanel = document.querySelector('.vn-glass-panel');
    let hintEl = document.getElementById('vnTypingHint');

    if (!hintEl) {
        hintEl = document.createElement('div');
        hintEl.id = 'vnTypingHint';

        if (glassPanel) glassPanel.appendChild(hintEl);
        else document.body.appendChild(hintEl);
    } else if (glassPanel && hintEl.parentElement !== glassPanel) {
        glassPanel.appendChild(hintEl);
    }

    hintEl.onclick = jumpToNewestMessage;
    return hintEl;
}

function showVnThinkingStatus(name = 'AI') {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return;

    if (typeof showVnThinkingHint === 'function') {
        showVnThinkingHint(name);
        return;
    }

    const hintEl = ensureVnStatusHintEl();
    const safeName = typeof escapeStatusText === 'function'
        ? escapeStatusText(name || 'AI')
        : String(name || 'AI');

    hintEl.dataset.kind = 'thinking';
    hintEl.dataset.label = safeName;
    hintEl.innerHTML = getFuraiThinkingStatusMarkup(safeName, 'is thinking...');
    hintEl.style.display = 'flex';
    hintEl.style.opacity = '1';
    hintEl.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
}

function isVnViewingNewestMessage() {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return true;
    return vnCurrentIndex >= getLastReadableMessageIndex();
}

function isVnBodyNearBottom() {
    const vnBody = document.getElementById('vnMessageBody');
    return !vnBody || isNearScrollBottom(vnBody);
}

function getVnMessageIndex(messageEl) {
    if (!messageEl) return -1;
    return getVnRenderableMessages().indexOf(messageEl);
}

function isVnViewingMessageElement(messageEl) {
    if (typeof isVnPinnedMessageElement === 'function' && isVnPinnedMessageElement(messageEl)) return true;
    if (typeof isVnSceneTargetElement === 'function' && isVnSceneTargetElement(messageEl)) return true;

    const targetIndex = getVnMessageIndex(messageEl);
    return targetIndex !== -1 && vnCurrentIndex === targetIndex;
}

function getVnLiveEdgeState(targetMessageEl = null) {
    const messages = getVnRenderableMessages();
    const newestIndex = messages.length - 1;
    const currentIndex = Math.min(
        Math.max(parseInt(vnCurrentIndex, 10) || 0, 0),
        Math.max(newestIndex, 0)
    );

    return {
        messages,
        currentIndex,
        currentEl: messages[currentIndex] || null,
        newestIndex,
        lastReadableIndex: getLastReadableMessageIndex(),
        targetIndex: targetMessageEl ? messages.indexOf(targetMessageEl) : -1,
        targetEl: targetMessageEl || null,
        bodyNearBottom: isVnBodyNearBottom()
    };
}

function shouldVnAutoFollowMessage(targetMessageEl = null) {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return false;
    if (!vnAutoScroll) return false;

    const state = getVnLiveEdgeState(targetMessageEl);
    if (!state.bodyNearBottom) return false;

    if (!targetMessageEl) {
        return state.currentIndex >= state.lastReadableIndex;
    }

    if (state.targetIndex === -1) return false;
    if (state.currentIndex === state.targetIndex) return true;

    const targetIsNewestPending =
        state.targetIndex === state.newestIndex &&
        isLiveTypingMessage(targetMessageEl);

    return targetIsNewestPending && state.currentIndex >= state.lastReadableIndex;
}


function stickVnToMessageElement(messageEl, scrollMode = 'bottom') {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return false;
    if (!messageEl || !document.body.contains(messageEl)) return false;

    if (typeof syncVnData === 'function') {
        syncVnData();
    }

    const messages = getVnRenderableMessages();
    const targetIndex = messages.indexOf(messageEl);
    if (targetIndex === -1) return false;

    setVnSceneTargetFromElement(messageEl, {
        autoScroll: true,
        userLocked: false
    });
    vnUserMovedAwayThisSession = false;
    clearVnFinishedUnreadState();
    clearVnLiveReplyState();
    hideVnStatusHint();

    if (typeof renderVnMessage === 'function') {
        renderVnMessage(scrollMode);
    }

    return true;
}


function shouldVnKeepMorphedTypingBubble(messageEl) {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return false;
    if (!messageEl || !document.body.contains(messageEl)) return false;

    return !!(
        messageEl.dataset.vnLiveAttached === 'true' ||
        isVnPinnedMessageElement(messageEl) ||
        (
            typeof isVnSceneTargetElement === 'function' &&
            isVnSceneTargetElement(messageEl)
        ) ||
        (
            isVnViewingMessageElement(messageEl) &&
            isVnBodyNearBottom()
        ) ||
        shouldVnAutoFollowMessage(messageEl)
    );
}

function finalizeVnMorphedTypingBubble(messageEl, options = {}) {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return false;
    if (!messageEl || !document.body.contains(messageEl)) return false;

    const shouldStick = options.shouldStick !== undefined
        ? !!options.shouldStick
        : shouldVnKeepMorphedTypingBubble(messageEl);

    if (typeof syncVnData === 'function') {
        syncVnData();
    }

    if (shouldStick) {
        if (options.liveId && typeof promoteVnLiveSceneTargetToFinalMessage === 'function') {
            promoteVnLiveSceneTargetToFinalMessage(options.liveId, messageEl);
        }

        pinVnMessageElement(messageEl, { autoScroll: true });
        vnUserMovedAwayThisSession = false;
        clearVnFinishedUnreadState();
        clearVnLiveReplyState();
        clearVnPendingTurnAnchor();
        hideVnStatusHint('thinking', { forceThinking: true });
        hideVnStatusHint('typing');
        hideVnStatusHint('unread');

        if (typeof renderVnMessage === 'function') {
            renderVnMessage('bottom');
        }

        return true;
    }

    vnAutoScroll = false;
    hideVnStatusHint('typing');

    const label = options.unreadLabel || 'New message';
    if (typeof showFinishedVnUnreadForMessage === 'function') {
        showFinishedVnUnreadForMessage(messageEl, label);
    } else {
        showVnUnreadHint(label);
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return;

        if (typeof showFinishedVnUnreadForMessage === 'function') {
            showFinishedVnUnreadForMessage(messageEl, label);
        } else {
            showVnUnreadHint(label);
        }
    });

    return false;
}

function getVnSpeakerNameFromMessage(messageEl, fallback = 'AI') {
    if (!messageEl) return fallback;

    const nameEl = messageEl.querySelector('.chat-username');
    if (nameEl) {
        const cleanName = typeof getCleanTimestampSpeakerName === 'function'
            ? getCleanTimestampSpeakerName(nameEl)
            : nameEl.textContent.trim();

        if (cleanName) return cleanName;
    }

    const botIndex = parseInt(messageEl.dataset.botIndex, 10);
    if (Number.isFinite(botIndex)) {
        try {
            const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
            const botName = profile?.bots?.[botIndex]?.name;
            if (botName) return botName;
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    return fallback;
}

function isVnMagnetStickingToNewest() {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return true;

    return (
        vnAutoScroll &&
        isVnBodyNearBottom() &&
        vnCurrentIndex >= getNewestVnMessageIndex()
    );
}

let vnUnreadSessionReady = false;
let vnUserMovedAwayThisSession = false;
let vnUnseenFinishedMessageEl = null;
let vnLiveReplyMessageEl = null;
let vnLiveReplyIndex = -1;
let vnPinnedMessageEl = null;
let vnPendingTurnAnchorEl = null;
let vnPendingTurnAnchorChatId = '';

function setVnPendingTurnAnchor(messageEl) {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return false;
    if (!messageEl || !document.body.contains(messageEl)) return false;

    const messages = typeof getVnRenderableMessages === 'function'
        ? getVnRenderableMessages()
        : [];

    if (!messages.includes(messageEl)) return false;

    vnPendingTurnAnchorEl = messageEl;
    vnPendingTurnAnchorChatId = currentChatId || '';
    return true;
}

function getVnPendingTurnAnchorElement() {
    if (vnPendingTurnAnchorChatId !== (currentChatId || '')) {
        clearVnPendingTurnAnchor();
        return null;
    }

    if (!vnPendingTurnAnchorEl || !document.body.contains(vnPendingTurnAnchorEl)) {
        clearVnPendingTurnAnchor();
        return null;
    }

    const messages = typeof getVnRenderableMessages === 'function'
        ? getVnRenderableMessages()
        : [];

    if (!messages.includes(vnPendingTurnAnchorEl)) {
        clearVnPendingTurnAnchor();
        return null;
    }

    return vnPendingTurnAnchorEl;
}

function clearVnPendingTurnAnchor(messageEl = null) {
    if (!messageEl || messageEl === vnPendingTurnAnchorEl) {
        vnPendingTurnAnchorEl = null;
        vnPendingTurnAnchorChatId = '';
    }
}

function clearVnFinishedUnreadState() {
    vnUnseenFinishedMessageEl = null;
    window.vnDeferredNewMessage = false;
}

function clearVnLiveReplyState() {
    vnLiveReplyMessageEl = null;
    vnLiveReplyIndex = -1;
}

function isVnPinnedMessageElement(messageEl) {
    return !!(
        messageEl &&
        vnPinnedMessageEl &&
        messageEl === vnPinnedMessageEl &&
        document.body.contains(messageEl)
    );
}

function clearVnPinnedMessageElement(messageEl = null) {
    if (!messageEl || messageEl === vnPinnedMessageEl) {
        vnPinnedMessageEl = null;
    }
}

function pinVnMessageElement(messageEl, options = {}) {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return false;
    if (!messageEl || !document.body.contains(messageEl)) return false;

    const messages = typeof getVnRenderableMessages === 'function'
        ? getVnRenderableMessages()
        : [];

    const index = messages.indexOf(messageEl);
    if (index === -1) return false;

    vnPinnedMessageEl = messageEl;
    vnCurrentIndex = index;

    if (options.autoScroll !== undefined) {
        vnAutoScroll = !!options.autoScroll;
    }

    if (typeof setVnSceneTargetFromElement === 'function') {
        setVnSceneTargetFromElement(messageEl, {
            autoScroll: options.autoScroll !== undefined ? !!options.autoScroll : vnAutoScroll,
            userLocked: false
        });
    }

    return true;
}

function getVnPinnedMessageElement() {
    if (!vnPinnedMessageEl || !document.body.contains(vnPinnedMessageEl)) {
        vnPinnedMessageEl = null;
        return null;
    }

    const messages = typeof getVnRenderableMessages === 'function'
        ? getVnRenderableMessages()
        : [];

    return messages.includes(vnPinnedMessageEl) ? vnPinnedMessageEl : null;
}

function getGenerationByTypingElement(messageEl) {
    if (!messageEl?.id || !ongoingGenerations) return null;

    return Object.values(ongoingGenerations).find(genData =>
        genData && genData.typingId === messageEl.id
    ) || null;
}

function rememberGenerationVnLiveTarget(messageEl) {
    if (!messageEl) return;

    messageEl.dataset.vnLiveAttached = 'true';

    const genData = getGenerationByTypingElement(messageEl);
    if (!genData) return;

    genData.vnLiveAttached = true;
    genData.vnLiveTargetTypingId = messageEl.id || '';
    genData.vnLiveDetachedByUser = false;
}

function clearGenerationVnLiveTarget(messageEl = null) {
    if (messageEl) {
        messageEl.dataset.vnLiveAttached = 'false';
        clearVnPinnedMessageElement(messageEl);

        const genData = getGenerationByTypingElement(messageEl);
        if (genData) {
            genData.vnLiveAttached = false;
            genData.vnLiveDetachedByUser = true;
        }

        return;
    }

    clearVnPinnedMessageElement();

    Object.values(ongoingGenerations || {}).forEach(genData => {
        if (!genData) return;
        genData.vnLiveAttached = false;
        genData.vnLiveDetachedByUser = true;

        const liveEl = genData.typingId
            ? document.getElementById(genData.typingId)
            : null;

        if (liveEl) liveEl.dataset.vnLiveAttached = 'false';
    });
}

function getVnMessageUidFromElement(messageEl) {
    if (!messageEl) return '';

    const directUid = String(messageEl.dataset?.messageUid || '').trim();
    if (directUid) return directUid;

    const record = typeof getVnDbMessageRecordFromElement === 'function'
        ? getVnDbMessageRecordFromElement(messageEl)
        : null;

    return String(record?.msg?.uid || '').trim();
}

function getVnLiveIdFromElement(messageEl) {
    if (!messageEl) return '';
    const id = String(messageEl.id || '').trim();
    return id && isLiveTypingMessage(messageEl) ? id : '';
}

function syncFuraiCrVnSelectedMessage(messageEl = null) {
    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    if (!chatMessagesEl) return;

    const oldSelected = chatMessagesEl.querySelector('.message.furai-cr-vn-selected');
    if (oldSelected && oldSelected !== messageEl) {
        oldSelected.classList.remove('furai-cr-vn-selected');
        oldSelected.removeAttribute('aria-current');
    }

    if (
        messageEl &&
        chatMessagesEl.contains(messageEl) &&
        messageEl.id !== 'personality-selector-message' &&
        !(typeof isLiveTypingMessage === 'function' && isLiveTypingMessage(messageEl))
    ) {
        messageEl.classList.add('furai-cr-vn-selected');
        messageEl.setAttribute('aria-current', 'true');
    }
}

function scrollFuraiMessageIntoCrView(messageEl, block = 'center') {
    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    if (!chatMessagesEl || !messageEl || !chatMessagesEl.contains(messageEl)) return false;

    const containerRect = chatMessagesEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    const messageRect = messageEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    const currentTop = chatMessagesEl.scrollTop;

    let nextTop;
    if (block === 'start') {
        nextTop = currentTop + messageRect.top - containerRect.top - 18;
    } else {
        nextTop = currentTop + messageRect.top - containerRect.top
            - ((containerRect.height - messageRect.height) / 2);
    }

    chatMessagesEl.scrollTop = Math.max(0, nextTop);
    return true;
}

function resetVnSceneTarget() {
    vnSceneTarget = {
        chatId: currentChatId || '',
        type: 'none',
        element: null,
        uid: '',
        liveId: '',
        index: -1,
        autoScroll: false,
        userLocked: false
    };
    syncFuraiCrVnSelectedMessage(null);
}

function resolveVnSceneTargetElement() {
    if (!vnSceneTarget || vnSceneTarget.chatId !== (currentChatId || '')) return null;

    const messages = typeof getVnRenderableMessages === 'function'
        ? getVnRenderableMessages()
        : [];

    if (!messages.length) return null;

    // Primary VN camera anchor: the actual bubble element.
    // During normal generation, completeGeneration() morphs the typing bubble
    // into the finished bubble, so this survives the temporary id removal.
    const directEl = vnSceneTarget.element;
    if (directEl && document.body.contains(directEl) && messages.includes(directEl)) {
        return directEl;
    }

    // Live id fallback while the temporary typing id still exists.
    if (vnSceneTarget.type === 'live' && vnSceneTarget.liveId) {
        const liveEl = document.getElementById(vnSceneTarget.liveId);
        if (liveEl && messages.includes(liveEl)) return liveEl;

        // A live auto-follow target must never fall back to the previous saved
        // message index. If the live node was replaced, use the newest rendered
        // message instead of snapping backward.
        if (vnSceneTarget.autoScroll) {
            return messages[messages.length - 1] || null;
        }

        return null;
    }

    // Saved uid fallback after re-render/reload.
    if (vnSceneTarget.type === 'message' && vnSceneTarget.uid) {
        let uidEl = null;

        if (typeof findRenderedMessageByUid === 'function') {
            uidEl = findRenderedMessageByUid(vnSceneTarget.uid);
        }

        if (!uidEl) {
            uidEl = messages.find(messageEl =>
                String(messageEl.dataset?.messageUid || '').trim() === vnSceneTarget.uid
            ) || null;
        }

        if (uidEl && messages.includes(uidEl)) return uidEl;
    }

    // Index is only a last-resort explicit index target. Failed live targets do
    // not use this path, because that is what caused the VN jump-back bug.
    if (
        vnSceneTarget.type === 'index' &&
        Number.isInteger(vnSceneTarget.index) &&
        vnSceneTarget.index >= 0
    ) {
        return messages[vnSceneTarget.index] || null;
    }

    return null;
}

function setVnSceneTargetFromElement(messageEl, options = {}) {
    if (!messageEl || !document.body.contains(messageEl)) return false;

    const messages = typeof getVnRenderableMessages === 'function'
        ? getVnRenderableMessages()
        : [];

    const index = messages.indexOf(messageEl);
    if (index === -1) return false;

    const liveId = getVnLiveIdFromElement(messageEl);
    const uid = getVnMessageUidFromElement(messageEl);
    const autoScroll = options.autoScroll !== undefined
        ? !!options.autoScroll
        : !!vnAutoScroll;

    vnSceneTarget = {
        chatId: currentChatId || '',
        type: liveId ? 'live' : (uid ? 'message' : 'index'),
        element: messageEl,
        uid,
        liveId,
        index,
        autoScroll,
        userLocked: options.userLocked === true
    };

    vnCurrentIndex = index;
    vnAutoScroll = autoScroll;
    syncFuraiCrVnSelectedMessage(messageEl);

    if (options.userLocked === true) {
        clearGenerationVnLiveTarget();
        clearVnPinnedMessageElement();
        clearVnPendingTurnAnchor();
    }

    return true;
}

function isVnSceneTargetElement(messageEl) {
    if (!messageEl) return false;
    return resolveVnSceneTargetElement() === messageEl;
}

function promoteVnLiveSceneTargetToFinalMessage(liveId, finalMessageEl) {
    if (!finalMessageEl || !document.body.contains(finalMessageEl)) return false;

    const wasLiveTarget = !!(
        vnSceneTarget &&
        vnSceneTarget.chatId === (currentChatId || '') &&
        (
            vnSceneTarget.element === finalMessageEl ||
            (
                liveId &&
                vnSceneTarget.type === 'live' &&
                vnSceneTarget.liveId === liveId
            )
        )
    );

    if (!wasLiveTarget) return false;

    return setVnSceneTargetFromElement(finalMessageEl, {
        autoScroll: true,
        userLocked: false
    });
}

function rememberVnLiveReply(messageEl) {
    vnLiveReplyMessageEl = messageEl || null;
    vnLiveReplyIndex = messageEl ? getVnMessageIndex(messageEl) : -1;
}

function isVnFinishedUnreadMessageEl(messageEl) {
    if (!messageEl || !document.body.contains(messageEl)) return false;
    if (isLiveTypingMessage(messageEl)) return false;
    if (messageEl.classList.contains('user')) return false;
    if (messageEl.classList.contains('system')) return false;
    if (messageEl.id === 'personality-selector-message') return false;

    return (
        messageEl.classList.contains('ai') ||
        messageEl.classList.contains('narrator') ||
        messageEl.classList.contains('cutscene') ||
        messageEl.dataset.role === 'ai' ||
        isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(messageEl.dataset.role) ||
        messageEl.dataset.role === 'cutscene'
    );
}

function getNewestFinishedVnMessageEl() {
    const messages = getVnRenderableMessages();

    for (let i = messages.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (isVnFinishedUnreadMessageEl(messages[i])) return messages[i];
    }

    return null;
}

function getFinishedVnMessageFromLiveOrNewest(messageEl = null) {
    if (isVnFinishedUnreadMessageEl(messageEl)) return messageEl;
    if (isVnFinishedUnreadMessageEl(vnLiveReplyMessageEl)) return vnLiveReplyMessageEl;

    if (vnLiveReplyIndex < 0) return null;

    const messages = getVnRenderableMessages();

    for (let i = messages.length - 1; i >= vnLiveReplyIndex; i--) {
        if (isVnFinishedUnreadMessageEl(messages[i])) return messages[i];
    }

    return null;
}

function markVnFinishedUnreadTarget(messageEl = null) {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return false;

    const targetEl = getFinishedVnMessageFromLiveOrNewest(messageEl);
    clearVnLiveReplyState();

    if (!targetEl) return false;

    if (isVnPinnedMessageElement(targetEl)) {
        clearVnFinishedUnreadState();
        hideVnStatusHint('unread');
        return false;
    }

    if (isVnViewingMessageElement(targetEl) && isVnBodyNearBottom()) {
        clearVnFinishedUnreadState();
        hideVnStatusHint('unread');
        return false;
    }

    vnUnseenFinishedMessageEl = targetEl;
    window.vnDeferredNewMessage = false;
    vnAutoScroll = false;

    return true;
}

function markNewestFinishedVnUnread() {
    return markVnFinishedUnreadTarget();
}

function showFinishedVnUnreadForMessage(messageEl, label = 'New message') {
    if (!markVnFinishedUnreadTarget(messageEl)) return false;

    showVnUnreadHint(label, { force: true });
    return true;
}

function markVnFinishedUnreadSeen() {
    if (!vnUnseenFinishedMessageEl) return false;

    if (!document.body.contains(vnUnseenFinishedMessageEl)) {
        clearVnFinishedUnreadState();
        hideVnStatusHint('unread');
        return false;
    }

    if (!isVnViewingMessageElement(vnUnseenFinishedMessageEl)) return false;
    if (!isVnBodyNearBottom()) return false;

    clearVnFinishedUnreadState();
    vnUserMovedAwayThisSession = false;
    hideVnStatusHint('unread');

    return true;
}

function resetVnUnreadSessionState() {
    vnUnreadSessionReady = false;
    vnUserMovedAwayThisSession = false;
    clearVnFinishedUnreadState();
    hideVnStatusHint('unread');

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            vnUnreadSessionReady = true;
        });
    });
}

function markVnUserMovedAway() {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return;
    if (vnCurrentIndex < getNewestVnMessageIndex()) {
        vnUserMovedAwayThisSession = true;
        clearVnPinnedMessageElement();
        clearVnPendingTurnAnchor();
    }
}

function shouldSuppressVnUnreadHint() {
    if (!vnUnreadSessionReady) return true;
    if (isVnMagnetStickingToNewest()) return true;

    return !vnUnseenFinishedMessageEl || markVnFinishedUnreadSeen();
}

function markFinishedVnNewestSeen() {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return false;

    const messages = getVnRenderableMessages();
    const newestEl = messages[messages.length - 1];

    if (!newestEl || isLiveTypingMessage(newestEl)) return false;
    if (vnCurrentIndex < messages.length - 1) return false;
    if (!isVnBodyNearBottom()) return false;

    clearVnFinishedUnreadState();
    vnUserMovedAwayThisSession = false;
    hideVnStatusHint();

    return true;
}

function shouldVnAutoFollowReply(targetIndex = null) {
    if (targetIndex !== null) {
        const messages = getVnRenderableMessages();
        const targetMessageEl = messages[targetIndex] || null;
        return shouldVnAutoFollowMessage(targetMessageEl);
    }

    return shouldVnAutoFollowMessage();
}

function showVnThinkingHint(name = 'AI', targetMessageEl = null) {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return;

    clearVnFinishedUnreadState();
    hideVnStatusHint('unread');
    rememberVnLiveReply(targetMessageEl);

    const hintEl = ensureVnStatusHintEl();
    const safeName = escapeStatusText(name || 'AI');

    hintEl.dataset.kind = 'thinking';
    hintEl.dataset.label = safeName;
    hintEl.onclick = targetMessageEl
        ? () => jumpToMessageElement(targetMessageEl, { follow: true })
        : jumpToNewestMessage;

    hintEl.innerHTML = getFuraiThinkingStatusMarkup(safeName, 'is thinking...');
    hintEl.style.display = 'flex';
    hintEl.style.opacity = '1';
    hintEl.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
}

window.showVnThinkingHint = showVnThinkingHint;
window.showVnThinkingStatus = showVnThinkingStatus;

function showVnCutscenePreparingHint(messageEl) {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return;

    if (messageEl && isVnViewingMessageElement(messageEl) && isVnBodyNearBottom()) {
        hideVnStatusHint('cutscene');
        return;
    }

    const hintEl = ensureVnStatusHintEl();

    window.vnDeferredNewMessage = true;

    hintEl.dataset.kind = 'cutscene';
    hintEl.dataset.label = 'Cutscene';
    hintEl.onclick = messageEl
        ? () => jumpToMessageElement(messageEl, { follow: true })
        : jumpToNewestMessage;

    hintEl.innerHTML = getFuraiThinkingStatusMarkup('Cutscene', 'is preparing...');
    hintEl.style.display = 'flex';
    hintEl.style.opacity = '1';
    hintEl.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
}

function showCrCutscenePreparingHint(messageEl) {
    if (document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return;

    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');

    if (isNearScrollBottom(chatMessagesEl)) {
        hideCrBottomStatusPill();
        return;
    }

    const pill = ensureCrBottomStatusPill();

    pill.dataset.kind = 'cutscene';
    pill.dataset.label = 'Cutscene';
    pill.innerHTML = getFuraiThinkingStatusMarkup('Cutscene', 'is preparing...');
    pill.onclick = () => jumpToMessageElement(messageEl, { follow: true });
    pill.classList.add('is-visible');
}

function getVnLikelyReplyName() {
    try {
        const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
        const personality = chatPersonalities[currentChatId];

        if (!profile || !profile.bots || !profile.bots.length) return 'AI';

        if (personality === 'group') {
            const activeBot =
                profile.bots.find(bot => bot && bot.isActive && bot.inActiveCast) ||
                profile.bots.find(bot => bot && bot.isActive) ||
                profile.bots[0];

            return activeBot?.name || 'AI';
        }

        return profile.bots[0]?.name || 'AI';
    } catch (e) {
        return 'AI';
    }
}

function showVnTypingHint(name = 'AI', targetMessageEl = null) {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return;

    // Real streamed text is the only normal transition out of VN "is thinking...".
    hideVnStatusHint('thinking', { forceThinking: true });

    clearVnFinishedUnreadState();
    hideVnStatusHint('unread');
    rememberVnLiveReply(targetMessageEl);

    if (targetMessageEl) {
        if (isVnViewingMessageElement(targetMessageEl) && isVnBodyNearBottom()) {
            hideVnStatusHint('typing');
            return;
        }
    } else if (isVnMagnetStickingToNewest()) {
        hideVnStatusHint('typing');
        return;
    }

    const hintEl = ensureVnStatusHintEl();
    const safeName = escapeStatusText(name || 'AI');
    
    const previousKind = hintEl.dataset.kind;
    hintEl.dataset.kind = 'typing';
    hintEl.onclick = targetMessageEl
        ? () => jumpToMessageElement(targetMessageEl, { follow: true })
        : jumpToNewestMessage;
    
    if (
        previousKind !== 'typing' ||
        hintEl.dataset.label !== safeName ||
        hintEl.style.opacity !== '1'
    ) {
        hintEl.dataset.label = safeName;
        hintEl.innerHTML = getFuraiThinkingStatusMarkup(safeName, 'is typing');
    }
    
    hintEl.style.display = 'flex';
    hintEl.style.opacity = '1';
    hintEl.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
}

function showVnUnreadHint(label = 'New message', options = {}) {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return;

    const force = options.force === true;

    if (!force && shouldSuppressVnUnreadHint()) {
        hideVnStatusHint('unread');
        return;
    }

    const hintEl = ensureVnStatusHintEl();
    const safeLabel = escapeStatusText(label || 'New message');

    const unreadTargetEl =
        typeof vnUnseenFinishedMessageEl !== 'undefined'
            ? vnUnseenFinishedMessageEl
            : null;
    
    hintEl.dataset.kind = 'unread';
    hintEl.dataset.label = safeLabel;
    hintEl.onclick = unreadTargetEl
        ? () => jumpToMessageElement(unreadTargetEl, { follow: true })
        : jumpToNewestMessage;
    hintEl.innerHTML = `
        <i class="fa-regular fa-bell" style="margin-right:7px;" aria-hidden="true"></i>
        <span>${safeLabel}</span>
    `;
    hintEl.style.display = 'flex';
    hintEl.style.opacity = '1';
    hintEl.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
}

function refreshVnLiveStatusHint() {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return;

    const messages = getVnRenderableMessages();
    const newestEl = messages[messages.length - 1];

    if (!newestEl) {
        hideVnStatusHint();
        return;
    }

    if (isLiveTypingMessage(newestEl)) {
        clearVnFinishedUnreadState();
        hideVnStatusHint('unread');

        const liveName = getVnSpeakerNameFromMessage(
            newestEl,
            typeof getVnLikelyReplyName === 'function' ? getVnLikelyReplyName() : 'AI'
        );

        if (isVnPendingThinkingBubble(newestEl)) {
            showVnThinkingHint(liveName, newestEl);
            return;
        }

        showVnTypingHint(liveName, newestEl);
        return;
    }

    const isCutsceneMessage =
        newestEl.classList.contains('cutscene') ||
        newestEl.dataset.role === 'cutscene';

    if (
        isCutsceneMessage &&
        typeof isCutsceneGenerating !== 'undefined' &&
        isCutsceneGenerating
    ) {
        showVnCutscenePreparingHint(newestEl);
        return;
    }

    if (markVnFinishedUnreadSeen()) return;
    if (markFinishedVnNewestSeen()) return;

    if (vnUnseenFinishedMessageEl) {
        showVnUnreadHint('New message', { force: true });
        return;
    }

    if (vnLiveReplyIndex >= 0 && markNewestFinishedVnUnread()) {
        showVnUnreadHint('New message', { force: true });
        return;
    }

    hideVnStatusHint();
}

window.refreshVnLiveStatusHint = refreshVnLiveStatusHint;

function hideVnStatusHint(kind = null, options = {}) {
    const hintEl = document.getElementById('vnTypingHint');
    if (!hintEl) return;

    const currentKind = hintEl.dataset.kind || '';
    if (kind && currentKind !== kind) return;

    // VN thinking is intentionally sticky. Generic checks, clicks, and normal
    // refresh paths cannot dismiss it. It only clears when real typing begins
    // or when the stop/abort path explicitly forces it.
    const forceThinking = options.forceThinking === true || options.force === true;
    if (currentKind === 'thinking' && !forceThinking) return;

    hintEl.style.opacity = '0';
    hintEl.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
    hintEl.onclick = null;
    hintEl.dataset.kind = '';
    hintEl.dataset.label = '';
}

function getFactoryWandTagFallback(savedTag) {
    if (arguments.length === 0) savedTag = DB.get('global-group-enhancer-tag');
    if (savedTag != null) return String(savedTag);

    const customized = [
        'global-group-enhancer-name',
        'global-group-enhancer-avatar',
        'global-group-enhancer-inst',
        'global-group-enhancer-profile'
    ].some(key => DB.get(key) != null);

    return customized ? '' : DEFAULT_WAND_HASH_TAG;
}

function generateUID(prefix = 'obj') {

}

// --- MIGRATION: UPGRADE OLD SAVES TO FLAT ARCHITECTURE ---
function applyFlatDataArchitecture() {
    // v42 Plus never fills character fields during startup migration.
    // A saved blank/missing field may be intentional, and origin markers alone
    // do not prove that a factory-derived character is still untouched.
    // Only exact v42 factory IDs receive ownership metadata; absent roles are
    // created from their complete mode factory at the point of use.
    for (const mode of ['researcher', 'prompter', 'story', 'maker']) {
        const key = `global-profile-${mode}`;
        try {
            const data = DB.get(key);
            const bot = data?.bots?.[0];
            if (!bot || String(bot.uid || '') !== String(FURAI_MODE_FACTORY_IDS[mode] || '')) continue;

            let changed = false;
            if (bot.factoryMode !== mode) { bot.factoryMode = mode; changed = true; }
            if (bot.sourceFactoryMode !== mode) { bot.sourceFactoryMode = mode; changed = true; }
            if (changed) DB.set(key, data);
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('Factory ownership migration skipped:', key, e);
        }
    }
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    // Note: We DO NOT load the playlist or audio engine here anymore.
    // It is completely dormant until the user asks for it.
    
    // Only setup the UI listeners
    setTimeout(() => {
        // Just visual slider setup, no logic
        if(document.getElementById('volSlider')) updateSliderFill(document.getElementById('volSlider')); 
    }, 500);

    window.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const modal = document.getElementById('musicPlayerModal');
        const btn = document.getElementById('musicBtn');
        if (modal && modal.style.display === 'flex' && !modal.contains(e.target) && !btn.contains(e.target)) {
            modal.style.display = 'none';
        }
    });
});

function toggleMusicModal() {
    // 1. Initialize AUDIO ONLY on first click (Just-in-Time)
    if (!globalAudio) {
        globalAudio = new Audio();
        
        // --- FIX 1: Turn on the Engine ---
        setupAudioListeners(); 
        
        // --- FIX 2: Load Data ---
        loadPlaylist(); 

        // --- FIX 3: ROBUST VOLUME LOADING (Use DB.get) ---
        // We MUST use DB.get because setMusicVolume saves compressed data
        let vol = DB.get('furai_music_volume');
        
        // Ensure it's a number (DB.get might return a string or number)
        vol = parseFloat(vol);
        
        // Validation: If invalid, reset to 0.5
        if (!Number.isFinite(vol) || vol < 0 || vol > 1) {
            vol = 0.5; 
        }
        
        globalAudio.volume = vol;
        
        const volSlider = document.getElementById('volSlider');
        if (volSlider) {
            volSlider.value = globalAudio.volume;
            updateSliderFill(volSlider);
        }

        // Initialize Engine & Data
        if (isShuffle) {
            document.getElementById('shuffleBtn').classList.add('active');
            generateShuffleOrder(); 
        }
        
        updateLoopButtonUI();
    }

    // 2. Standard toggle logic...
    const modal = document.getElementById('musicPlayerModal');
    const musicBtn = document.getElementById('musicBtn');
    const isOpening = modal.style.display !== 'flex';
    
    if (!isOpening) {
        modal.style.display = 'none';
        return;
    }
    
    // Prepare content while hidden, then show once.
    renderPlaylist();
    
    modal.style.display = 'flex';
    
    if (musicBtn) playLiteUiMotion(musicBtn, 'ui-lite-btn-nudge', 120);
    playLiteUiMotion(modal, 'ui-lite-pop-in', 130);
    
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        updateSliderFill(document.getElementById('seekSlider'));
        updateSliderFill(document.getElementById('volSlider'));
    });
}
