/* --- HELPER: Dynamic Slider Fill --- */
function updateSliderFill(slider) {
    if (!slider) return;
    const val = parseFloat(slider.value);
    const min = parseFloat(slider.min || 0);
    const max = parseFloat(slider.max || 100);
    const percentage = ((val - min) / (max - min)) * 100;
    
    // --- COLOR LOGIC ---
    // If it's the Volume slider, use white/grey (text-color).
    // If it's the Seeker, use Primary Color (Orange/Blue).
    const fillColor = (slider.id === 'volSlider') ? 'var(--text-color)' : 'var(--primary-color)';
    
    slider.style.background = `linear-gradient(to right, ${fillColor} 0%, ${fillColor} ${percentage}%, var(--border-color) ${percentage}%, var(--border-color) 100%)`;
}

// 4. AUDIO ENGINE (With 3s Loop Pause)
function setupAudioListeners() {
    // 1. Loading/Buffering States (RAM Free - Event Driven)
    const titleEl = document.getElementById('currentSongTitle');

    globalAudio.addEventListener('loadstart', () => {
        // Fires instantly when a new song is requested
        if (currentTrackIndex > -1) {
            titleEl.innerHTML = `<span style="opacity:0.8; font-size:0.95em;">Loading...</span>`;
            titleEl.style.justifyContent = 'center';
        }
    });

    globalAudio.addEventListener('waiting', () => {
        // Fires if internet drops mid-song
        if (currentTrackIndex > -1) {
            titleEl.innerHTML = `<span style="opacity:0.7; font-style:italic;">Buffering...</span>`;
            titleEl.style.justifyContent = 'center';
        }
    });

    globalAudio.addEventListener('playing', () => {
        // Fires when music actually starts -> Show Title
        updatePlayerUI(true);
    });

    // 2. Standard Events (Keep existing logic)
    globalAudio.addEventListener('ended', () => {
        if (loopMode === 2) {
            loopDelayTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                globalAudio.currentTime = 0;
                globalAudio.play();
            }, 3000);
        } else {
            playNextTrack(true);
        }
    });

    globalAudio.addEventListener('timeupdate', () => {
        if (!isDraggingSeek) {
            const currentTime = globalAudio.currentTime;
            const duration = globalAudio.duration || 0;
            document.getElementById('trackCurrentTime').textContent = formatTime(currentTime);
            document.getElementById('trackDuration').textContent = formatTime(duration);
            const slider = document.getElementById('seekSlider');
            if(slider) {
                const val = (duration > 0) ? (currentTime / duration) * 100 : 0;
                slider.value = val;
                updateSliderFill(slider); 
            }
        }
    });
    
    globalAudio.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => {
        document.getElementById('trackDuration').textContent = formatTime(globalAudio.duration);
    });

    globalAudio.addEventListener('error', () => {
        titleEl.textContent = "Error: Connection Failed";
    });
}

function setMusicIndicator(active) {
    const btn = document.getElementById('musicBtn');
    if (!btn) return;
    
    let dot = btn.querySelector('.music-status-dot');
    if (!dot) {
        dot = document.createElement('span');
        dot.className = 'music-status-dot';
        btn.appendChild(dot);
    }
    dot.style.display = active ? 'block' : 'none';
}

function seekAudio(percent) {
    clearTimeout(loopDelayTimeout); // Cancel loop wait if user seeks
    const duration = globalAudio.duration;
    if (duration) {
        globalAudio.currentTime = (percent / 100) * duration;
    }
    updateSliderFill(document.getElementById('seekSlider'));
}

function setMusicVolume(val) {
    globalAudio.volume = val;
    DB.set('furai_music_volume', val); // <--- Save to storage
    updateSliderFill(document.getElementById('volSlider'));
}

setTimeout(() => {
    const slider = document.getElementById('seekSlider');
    if (slider) {
        slider.addEventListener('mousedown', () => isDraggingSeek = true);
        slider.addEventListener('touchstart', () => isDraggingSeek = true);
        slider.addEventListener('mouseup', () => isDraggingSeek = false);
        slider.addEventListener('touchend', () => isDraggingSeek = false);
        slider.addEventListener('input', () => updateSliderFill(slider));
    }
    const vol = document.getElementById('volSlider');
    if (vol) vol.addEventListener('input', () => updateSliderFill(vol));
}, 1000);

// 5. PLAYLIST RENDERER
function loadPlaylist() {
    try {
        const saved = DB.get('furai_music_playlist');
        if (saved && Array.isArray(saved) && saved.length > 0) {
            currentPlaylist = saved;
        } else {
            currentPlaylist = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(FACTORY_PLAYLIST));
        }
    } catch(e) {
        currentPlaylist = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(FACTORY_PLAYLIST));
    }
}

function savePlaylist() {
    DB.set('furai_music_playlist', currentPlaylist);
    renderPlaylist();
}

function restoreFactoryPlaylist() {
    if(!confirm("Restore default song list? Custom songs will be lost.")) return;
    currentPlaylist = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(FACTORY_PLAYLIST));
    currentTrackIndex = -1;
    globalAudio.pause();
    updatePlayerUI(false);
    savePlaylist();
}

function renderPlaylist() {
    const container = document.getElementById('playlistContainer');
    container.innerHTML = '';

    currentPlaylist.forEach((track, index) => {
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        const isActive = index === currentTrackIndex;
        div.className = `track-item ${isActive ? 'playing' : ''}`;
          
        // --- DRAG AND DROP LOGIC ---
        if (isMusicEditing) {
            div.setAttribute('draggable', 'true');
            
            div.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => {
                window.draggedTrackIndex = index;
                e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
                e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', index);
                setTimeout(() => div.style.opacity = '0.4', 0);
            });
            
            div.addEventListener('dragend', (e) => {
                div.style.opacity = '1';
                document.querySelectorAll('.track-item').forEach(el => {
                    el.classList.remove('drag-over-top', 'drag-over-bottom');
                });
                window.draggedTrackIndex = null;
            });
            
            div.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
                const rect = div.getBoundingClientRect();
                const relY = e.clientY - rect.top;
                
                // Top or bottom half indicator
                if (relY < rect.height / 2) {
                    div.classList.add('drag-over-top');
                    div.classList.remove('drag-over-bottom');
                } else {
                    div.classList.add('drag-over-bottom');
                    div.classList.remove('drag-over-top');
                }
            });
            
            div.addEventListener('dragleave', () => {
                div.classList.remove('drag-over-top', 'drag-over-bottom');
            });
            
            div.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                div.classList.remove('drag-over-top', 'drag-over-bottom');
                const fromIndex = window.draggedTrackIndex;
                if (fromIndex === null || fromIndex === index) return;
                
                const rect = div.getBoundingClientRect();
                const relY = e.clientY - rect.top;
                let toIndex = index;
                
                if (relY >= rect.height / 2) toIndex++;
                if (fromIndex < toIndex) toIndex--;
                
                reorderPlaylist(fromIndex, toIndex);
            });
        }

        let iconHTML = `<span style="display:inline-block; font-family:inherit; width:20px; text-align:right; opacity:0.5; margin-right:12px;">${index + 1}.</span>`;
        
        if (isActive) {
            const iconClass = !globalAudio.paused ? 'fa-circle-play' : 'fa-circle-pause';
            iconHTML = `<i class="fa-solid ${iconClass}" style="display:inline-block; width:20px; text-align:center; margin-right:12px; font-size:15px; position:relative; top:1px;"></i>`;
        }

        let nameHTML = `<div style="flex:1; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; font-weight:${isActive?600:400};">${escapeHTML(track.name)}</div>`;
        if (isMusicEditing) {
            nameHTML = `<div style="flex:1; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; opacity:0.8;">${escapeHTML(track.name)}</div>`;
        }

        div.innerHTML = `
            ${iconHTML}
            ${nameHTML}
            <div class="track-actions">
                <div class="music-btn drag-handle" title="Drag to reorder">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-grip-lines" style="font-size:14px;"></i>
                </div>
                <button class="music-btn" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); renameTrack(${index})" title="Rename">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-pen" style="font-size:12px;"></i>
                </button>
                <button class="music-btn" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); deleteTrack(${index})" style="color:var(--danger-color);" title="Delete">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark" style="font-size:14px;"></i>
                </button>
            </div>
        `;

        div.onclick = (e) => {
            if (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT' || e.target.closest('button') || e.target.closest('.drag-handle')) return;
            
            if (!isMusicEditing) {
                if (index === currentTrackIndex) {
                    togglePlayPause();
                } else {
                    playTrack(index);
                }
            }
        };

        container.appendChild(div);
    });
}

// 6. CONTROLS
function playTrack(index) {
    if (index < 0 || index >= currentPlaylist.length) return;
    clearTimeout(loopDelayTimeout);

    // 1. Force "Loading..." and MAKE IT VISIBLE
    const titleEl = document.getElementById('currentSongTitle');
    titleEl.innerHTML = `<span style="opacity:0.8; font-size:0.95em;">Loading...</span>`;
    titleEl.style.justifyContent = 'center';
    titleEl.style.opacity = '1'; // <--- THIS WAS MISSING

    // Shuffle Sync Logic
    if (isShuffle) {
        if (shuffleOrder.length !== currentPlaylist.length) {
            currentTrackIndex = index;
            generateShuffleOrder();
        } 
        const ptr = shuffleOrder.indexOf(index);
        if (ptr > -1) shufflePtr = ptr;
    }

    if (currentTrackIndex !== index) {
        currentTrackIndex = index;
        globalAudio.src = currentPlaylist[index].url;
        globalAudio.load();
    }

    document.getElementById('playPauseBtn').innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-pause"></i>`;
    setMusicIndicator(true);
    renderPlaylist(); 

    const playPromise = globalAudio.play();
    if (playPromise !== undefined) {
        playPromise.catch(error => {
            if (error.name !== 'AbortError') {
                console.error("Play failed:", error);
                titleEl.textContent = "Error: Playback Failed";
                updatePlayerUI(false); 
            }
        });
    }
}

function togglePlayPause() {
    clearTimeout(loopDelayTimeout);
    
    if (globalAudio.paused) {
        if (globalAudio.src) {
            // 1. Force "Loading..." and VISIBILITY on Resume
            const titleEl = document.getElementById('currentSongTitle');
            titleEl.innerHTML = `<span style="opacity:0.8; font-size:0.95em;">Loading...</span>`;
            titleEl.style.justifyContent = 'center';
            titleEl.style.opacity = '1'; // <--- THIS WAS MISSING
            
            document.getElementById('playPauseBtn').innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-pause"></i>`;
            
            setMusicIndicator(true);
            
            const playPromise = globalAudio.play();
            if (playPromise !== undefined) {
                playPromise.catch(error => {
                    if (error.name !== 'AbortError') {
                        console.error("Playback failed:", error);
                        updatePlayerUI(false); 
                    }
                });
            }
        } else {
            playTrack(0); 
        }
    } else {
        globalAudio.pause();
        updatePlayerUI(false); 
    }
    renderPlaylist(); 
}

function generateShuffleOrder() {
    // 1. Create a list of all indexes: [0, 1, 2, ... length-1]
    shuffleOrder = Array.from({length: currentPlaylist.length}, (_, i) => i);
    
    // 2. Fisher-Yates Algorithm (The gold standard for randomness)
    for (let i = shuffleOrder.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
        [shuffleOrder[i], shuffleOrder[j]] = [shuffleOrder[j], shuffleOrder[i]];
    }

    // 3. Smart Sync: If a song is currently playing, move it to the start 
    // so we don't accidentally skip it or play it again immediately.
    if (currentTrackIndex > -1) {
        const currentPos = shuffleOrder.indexOf(currentTrackIndex);
        if (currentPos > -1) {
            // Swap current song to index 0
            [shuffleOrder[0], shuffleOrder[currentPos]] = [shuffleOrder[currentPos], shuffleOrder[0]];
            shufflePtr = 0;
        }
    } else {
        shufflePtr = -1; // Ready to start
    }
}

function playNextTrack(autoAdvance = false) {
    clearTimeout(loopDelayTimeout);
    let nextIndex;

    if (isShuffle) {
        // A. Validity Check: If added/removed songs, regenerate
        if (shuffleOrder.length !== currentPlaylist.length) generateShuffleOrder();

        // B. Move Pointer
        shufflePtr++;

        // C. End of Shuffle Queue?
        if (shufflePtr >= shuffleOrder.length) {
            if (loopMode === 1 || loopMode === 2) {
                // Loop On: Reshuffle and start over
                generateShuffleOrder();
                shufflePtr = 0; 
                // Note: generateShuffleOrder automatically puts current song at 0, 
                // so we actually want the NEXT one (index 1) to avoid immediate repeat?
                // Actually, just reshuffling fully is fairer.
                // Let's force a pure random reshuffle here since we finished the list.
                shuffleOrder.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5); 
                shufflePtr = 0;
            } else if (autoAdvance) {
                // Loop Off: Stop playing
                return; 
            } else {
                // Manual Click at end: Circle back
                generateShuffleOrder();
                shufflePtr = 0;
            }
        }
        nextIndex = shuffleOrder[shufflePtr];

    } else {
        // Standard Linear Logic
        nextIndex = currentTrackIndex + 1;
        if (nextIndex >= currentPlaylist.length) {
            if (loopMode === 1 || loopMode === 2) nextIndex = 0; 
            else if (autoAdvance) return; 
            else nextIndex = 0; 
        }
    }
    playTrack(nextIndex);
}

function playPrevTrack() {
    clearTimeout(loopDelayTimeout);
    let prevIndex;

    if (isShuffle) {
        if (shuffleOrder.length !== currentPlaylist.length) generateShuffleOrder();
        
        shufflePtr--;
        
        // Wrap around to the LAST song in the shuffle bag
        if (shufflePtr < 0) shufflePtr = shuffleOrder.length - 1;
        
        prevIndex = shuffleOrder[shufflePtr];
    } else {
        prevIndex = currentTrackIndex - 1;
        if (prevIndex < 0) prevIndex = currentPlaylist.length - 1;
    }
    
    playTrack(prevIndex);
}

function toggleShuffle() {
    isShuffle = !isShuffle;
    
    // --- SAVE SETTING ---
    DB.set('furai_music_shuffle', isShuffle);

    const btn = document.getElementById('shuffleBtn');
    if (isShuffle) {
        btn.classList.add('active');
        btn.title = "Shuffle: Smart (No Repeats)";
        generateShuffleOrder();
    } else {
        btn.classList.remove('active');
        btn.title = "Shuffle: Off";
        shuffleOrder = [];
    }
}

function updatePlayerUI(isPlaying) {
    setMusicIndicator(isPlaying);
    const icon = isPlaying ? 'fa-circle-pause' : 'fa-circle-play';
    document.getElementById('playPauseBtn').innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid ${icon}"></i>`;
    
    if (currentTrackIndex > -1 && currentPlaylist[currentTrackIndex]) {
        const container = document.getElementById('currentSongTitle');
        const titleText = currentPlaylist[currentTrackIndex].name;
        
        // --- FIX: Prevent Double-Render Flicker ---
        // If the title is already on screen, DO NOT redraw it. 
        // This stops the animation from resetting (flicking) when the audio confirms playback.
        if (container.textContent === titleText) {
            container.style.opacity = '1'; 
            return;
        }

        // --- Standard Draw Logic ---
        container.style.transition = 'none'; 
        container.style.opacity = '1';

        // 1. Insert text invisibly to measure it
        container.innerHTML = `<span style="visibility: hidden;">${escapeHTML(titleText)}</span>`;
        const span = container.querySelector('span');
        
        // 2. Reset Alignment
        container.style.justifyContent = 'center'; 

        // 3. Measure & Apply Scroll Class
        if (container.clientWidth > 0 && span.scrollWidth > container.clientWidth) {
            span.classList.add('scrolling');
            container.style.justifyContent = 'flex-start'; // Snap left for marquee
        }
        
        // 4. Reveal instantly
        span.style.visibility = 'visible';
    }
    renderPlaylist(); 
}

function formatTime(seconds) {
    if (isNaN(seconds)) return "0:00";
    const m = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    const s = Math.floor(seconds % 60);
    return `${m}:${s < 10 ? '0' + s : s}`;
}

// 7. PANELS & BATCH
function toggleMusicEditMode() {
    isMusicEditing = !isMusicEditing;
    const container = document.getElementById('playlistContainer');
    const btn = document.getElementById('editListBtn');
    
    document.getElementById('musicAddArea').classList.remove('show');
    document.getElementById('addSongsBtn').classList.remove('active');
    
    if(isMusicEditing) {
        container.classList.add('editing');
        btn.classList.add('active'); 
    } else {
        container.classList.remove('editing');
        btn.classList.remove('active');
    }
    renderPlaylist(); 
}

function toggleMusicAddArea() {
    const area = document.getElementById('musicAddArea');
    const btn = document.getElementById('addSongsBtn');
    
    if (isMusicEditing) toggleMusicEditMode();

    if (area.classList.contains('show')) {
        area.classList.remove('show');
        btn.classList.remove('active');
    } else {
        area.classList.add('show');
        btn.classList.add('active');
    }
}

function renameTrack(index) {
    const track = currentPlaylist[index];
    const newName = prompt("Rename song:", track.name);
    if (newName && newName.trim()) {
        currentPlaylist[index].name = newName.trim();
        savePlaylist();
        if (index === currentTrackIndex) {
            document.getElementById('currentSongTitle').textContent = newName.trim();
        }
    }
}

function deleteTrack(index) {
    if (!confirm("Remove this song?")) return;
    currentPlaylist.splice(index, 1);
    if (index < currentTrackIndex) currentTrackIndex--;
    else if (index === currentTrackIndex) {
        globalAudio.pause();
        globalAudio.src = "";
        currentTrackIndex = -1;
        updatePlayerUI(false);
    }
    savePlaylist();
}

function reorderPlaylist(fromIndex, toIndex) {
    if (fromIndex === toIndex) return;

    // Pull the track out and inject it at the new target
    const track = currentPlaylist.splice(fromIndex, 1)[0];
    currentPlaylist.splice(toIndex, 0, track);

    // Keep the audio engine's currentTrackIndex fully in sync
    if (currentTrackIndex === fromIndex) {
        currentTrackIndex = toIndex;
    } else {
        if (fromIndex < currentTrackIndex && toIndex >= currentTrackIndex) {
            currentTrackIndex--;
        } else if (fromIndex > currentTrackIndex && toIndex <= currentTrackIndex) {
            currentTrackIndex++;
        }
    }

    savePlaylist(); // Saves the array and triggers a re-render
}

function batchImportSongs() {
    const input = document.getElementById('musicImportInput');
    const raw = input.value.trim();
    if (!raw) return;
    const lines = raw.split(/\r?\n/);
    let count = 0;
    lines.forEach(line => {
        line = line.trim();
        if (!line) return;
        let name, url;
        const eqIndex = line.indexOf('=');
        if (eqIndex > -1) {
            name = line.substring(0, eqIndex).trim();
            url = line.substring(eqIndex + 1).trim();
        } else {
            url = line;
            name = "Track " + (currentPlaylist.length + 1);
        }
        if (url.match(/^https?:\/\/.+/)) {
            currentPlaylist.push({ name, url });
            count++;
        }
    });
    if (count > 0) {
        input.value = "";
        savePlaylist();
        toggleMusicAddArea(); 
        alert(`Added ${count} songs!`);
    } else {
        showToast("No valid URLs found.");
    }
}

// --- 1. FACTORY SPRITE DATABASE (IMPORTED FROM YOUR LIST) ---
function getFactorySprites() {
    // Parsed from your provided list
    return {

// --- 2. SHARED PUNCTUATION-SAFE PHRASE MATCHING ---
function getFuraiBoundaryPhrases(source) {
    const values = Array.isArray(source) ? source : String(source || '').split(/[\n,]+/);
    const seen = new Set();
    const phrases = [];

    for (const value of values) {
        const phrase = String(value || '').trim();
        const key = phrase.toLowerCase();
        if (!phrase || seen.has(key)) continue;
        seen.add(key);
        phrases.push(phrase);
    }

    return phrases;
}

function buildFuraiBoundaryPhrasePattern(source) {
    const escaped = getFuraiBoundaryPhrases(source)
        .sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length)
        .map(phrase => phrase.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'));

    return escaped.length
        ? new RegExp(`(^|[^a-zA-Z0-9_])(${escaped.join('|')})(?![a-zA-Z0-9_])`, 'gi')
        : null;
}

function findLastFuraiBoundaryPhrase(text, source) {
    const value = String(text || '');
    const pattern = buildFuraiBoundaryPhrasePattern(source);
    if (!value || !pattern) return null;

    let best = null;
    let match;

    while ((match = pattern.exec(value)) !== null) {
        const candidate = {
            index: match.index + match[1].length,
            length: match[2].length,
            phrase: match[2]
        };

        if (!best || candidate.index > best.index || (candidate.index === best.index && candidate.length > best.length)) {
            best = candidate;
        }
    }

    return best;
}

function removeFuraiBoundaryPhrases(text, source) {
    const value = String(text || '');
    const pattern = buildFuraiBoundaryPhrasePattern(source);
    if (!value || !pattern) return value;

    return value
        .replace(pattern, '$1')
        .replace(/[ \t]{2,}/g, ' ')
        .replace(/[ \t]+\n|\n[ \t]+/g, '\n')
        .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
        .replace(/\s+([,.;:!?])/g, '$1')
        .trim();
}

// --- 3. EMOTION DETECTION ---
function detectBotEmotion(text, botData) {
    if (!text || !botData) return null;

    const keywordsMap = botData.customEmotions || DEFAULT_EMOTION_KEYWORDS;
    let bestEmotion = null;
    let maxIndex = -1;
    let maxLen = 0;

    for (const [emotion, wordsStr] of Object.entries(keywordsMap)) {
        const match = findLastFuraiBoundaryPhrase(text, wordsStr);
        if (!match) continue;

        if (match.index > maxIndex || (match.index === maxIndex && match.length > maxLen)) {
            maxIndex = match.index;
            maxLen = match.length;
            bestEmotion = emotion;
        }
    }

    const symbolMap = { '?!': 'surprise', '!?': 'surprise', '~': 'mischief', '💢': 'angry' };
    for (const [symbol, emotion] of Object.entries(symbolMap)) {
        const index = text.lastIndexOf(symbol);
        if (index > maxIndex) {
            maxIndex = index;
            bestEmotion = emotion;
        }
    }

    return bestEmotion;
}


// Temporary emotion Status belongs only to the live page session for one chat actor.
// It is never written into character profiles, exports, imports, or Character Library data.
const furaiChatEmotionStatus = new Map();

function getFuraiChatEmotionActorKey(chatId, role, actor = {}, index = null) {
    const safeChatId = String(chatId || '').trim();
    const safeRole = role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'ai';
    const actorUid = String(actor?.uid || actor?.characterUid || '').trim();
    const fallbackIndex = String(index ?? '').trim() || 'none';
    return `${safeChatId}|${safeRole}|${actorUid || `index:${fallbackIndex}`}`;
}

function getFuraiEmotionVisualKeys(actor = {}) {
    const keys = new Set([
        ...Object.keys(actor?.emotionAvatars || {}),
        ...Object.keys(actor?.emotionSprites || {})
    ]);

    keys.delete('default');
    return [...keys].filter(key =>
        String(actor?.emotionAvatars?.[key] || '').trim() ||
        String(actor?.emotionSprites?.[key] || '').trim()
    );
}

function getFuraiChatEmotionStatus(chatId, role, actor = {}, index = null) {
    const key = getFuraiChatEmotionActorKey(chatId, role, actor, index);
    const selected = String(furaiChatEmotionStatus.get(key) || '').trim();
    if (!selected || selected === 'default') return 'default';
    return getFuraiEmotionVisualKeys(actor).includes(selected) ? selected : 'default';
}

function setFuraiChatEmotionStatus(chatId, role, actor = {}, index = null, emotion = 'default') {
    const key = getFuraiChatEmotionActorKey(chatId, role, actor, index);
    const selected = String(emotion || '').trim();

    if (!selected || selected === 'default') {
        furaiChatEmotionStatus.delete(key);
        return 'default';
    }

    if (!getFuraiEmotionVisualKeys(actor).includes(selected)) {
        furaiChatEmotionStatus.delete(key);
        return 'default';
    }

    furaiChatEmotionStatus.set(key, selected);
    return selected;
}

function applyFuraiEditorAvatarPreview(previewId, value) {
    const preview = document.getElementById(previewId);
    if (!preview) return;

    const url = String(value || '').trim();
    if (!url) {
        preview.removeAttribute('src');
        preview.style.display = 'none';
        return;
    }

    preview.src = url;
    preview.style.display = 'block';
}

function applyFuraiVisualPickerStatusPreview(config, emotion = 'default') {
    if (!config?.preview) return;

    const selected = String(emotion || '').trim() || 'default';
    const actor = config.actor || {};
    const baseAvatar = String(config.input?.value || actor.avatar || '').trim();
    const baseSprite = String(config.spriteInput?.value || actor.defaultSprite || '').trim();
    const avatarUrl = selected === 'default'
        ? baseAvatar
        : String(actor.emotionAvatars?.[selected] || baseAvatar).trim();
    const spriteUrl = selected === 'default'
        ? baseSprite
        : String(actor.emotionSprites?.[selected] || baseSprite).trim();

    applyFuraiEditorAvatarPreview(config.preview.id, avatarUrl);
    if (config.spritePreview) {
        applyFuraiEditorAvatarPreview(config.spritePreview.id, spriteUrl);
    }
}

function getFuraiVisualPickerEditorConfig(kind, index = '') {
    const configs = {
        'local-user': ['userAvatarInput', 'userAvatarPreview', 'userSpriteInput', 'userSpritePreview'],
        'local-bot': ['botAvatarInput', 'botAvatarPreview', 'botSpriteInput', 'botSpritePreview'],
        'maker': ['makerAvatarInput', 'makerAvatarPreview', 'makerSpriteInput', 'makerSpritePreview'],
        'global-user': ['globalUserAvatar', 'globalUserAvatarPreview', 'globalUserSprite', 'globalUserSpritePreview'],
        'global-bot': ['globalBotAvatar', 'globalBotAvatarPreview', 'globalBotSprite', 'globalBotSpritePreview'],
        'global-wand': ['globalWandAvatar', 'globalWandAvatarPreview', 'globalWandSprite', 'globalWandSpritePreview'],
        'local-wand': ['enhancerAvatarInput', 'localWandAvatarPreview'],
        'global-roster-bot': ['editGlobalBotAvatar', 'editGlobalBotAvatarPreview', 'editGlobalBotSprite', 'editGlobalBotSpritePreview']
    };

    const ids = configs[kind];
    if (!ids) return null;

    const input = document.getElementById(ids[0]);
    const preview = document.getElementById(ids[1]);
    const spriteInput = ids[2] ? document.getElementById(ids[2]) : null;
    const spritePreview = ids[3] ? document.getElementById(ids[3]) : null;
    if (!input || !preview) return null;

    let actor = { avatar: input.value || '' };
    let canSetStatus = false;
    let role = 'ai';
    let actorIndex = null;

    if (kind === 'local-user' && !furaiHistoricalProfileEditContext) {
        actor = getChatProfile(currentChatId)?.user || actor;
        canSetStatus = true;
        role = 'user';
    } else if (kind === 'local-bot' && !furaiHistoricalProfileEditContext) {
        const parsedIndex = Number.parseInt(index || document.getElementById('editingBotIndex')?.value, 10);
        const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
        const storedBot = profile?.bots?.[parsedIndex] || null;
        actor = chatPersonalities[currentChatId] === 'group' && storedBot?.rosterStub === true
            ? resolveGroupRosterStubForDisplay(storedBot, parsedIndex)
            : (storedBot || actor);
        canSetStatus = !!actor;
        role = 'ai';
        actorIndex = parsedIndex;
    } else if (kind === 'maker') {
        actor = {
            name: document.getElementById('makerNameInput')?.value || 'New Character',
            avatar: input.value || '',
            defaultSprite: document.getElementById('makerSpriteInput')?.value || '',
            customEmotions: window.makerTempEmotions || {},
            emotionAvatars: window.makerTempAvatars || {},
            emotionSprites: window.makerTempSprites || {}
        };
    } else if (kind === 'global-user') {
        actor = DB.get(`global-user-${currentGlobalTab}`) || createFuraiDefaultUser(currentGlobalTab);
    } else if (kind === 'global-bot') {
        actor = DB.get(`global-profile-${currentGlobalTab}`)?.bots?.[0] || createFuraiModeFactoryBot(currentGlobalTab);
    } else if (kind === 'global-wand') {
        actor = getFuraiGlobalWandProfile();
    } else if (kind === 'local-wand') {
        actor = getResolvedWandProfileForChat(currentChatId);
        canSetStatus = true;
        role = 'ai';
        actorIndex = 'wand';
    } else if (kind === 'global-roster-bot') {
        const parsedIndex = Number.parseInt(index, 10);
        const roster = DB.get('globalBotRoster') || defaultBots;
        actor = roster?.[parsedIndex] || actor;
        actorIndex = parsedIndex;
    }

    actor = { ...actor, avatar: String(input.value || '').trim() };

    return {
        kind,
        index,
        input,
        preview,
        spriteInput,
        spritePreview,
        actor,
        canSetStatus,
        role,
        actorIndex
    };
}

function refreshFuraiVisualPickerButton(previewId, kind, index = '') {
    const preview = document.getElementById(previewId);
    const button = preview?.closest('.furai-avatar-picker-anchor')?.querySelector('.furai-visual-picker-btn');
    const config = getFuraiVisualPickerEditorConfig(kind, index);
    if (!button || !config) return;

    const avatar = String(config.input.value || '').trim();
    const hasAvatarPicker = !avatar || isFuraiStarterAvatar(avatar);
    const hasEmotionStatus = config.canSetStatus && getFuraiEmotionVisualKeys(config.actor).length > 0;
    button.hidden = !hasAvatarPicker && !hasEmotionStatus;
}

function mountFuraiVisualPickerButton(previewId, kind, index = '') {
    const preview = document.getElementById(previewId);
    const config = getFuraiVisualPickerEditorConfig(kind, index);
    if (!preview || !config) return;

    let anchor = preview.closest('.furai-avatar-picker-anchor');
    if (!anchor) {
        anchor = document.createElement('span');
        anchor.className = 'furai-avatar-picker-anchor';
        preview.parentNode.insertBefore(anchor, preview);
        anchor.appendChild(preview);
    }

    let button = anchor.querySelector('.furai-visual-picker-btn');
    if (!button) {
        button = document.createElement('button');
        button.type = 'button';
        button.className = 'furai-visual-picker-btn';
        button.title = 'Avatar & Emotion';
        button.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Open avatar and emotion choices');
        button.innerHTML = '<span aria-hidden="true"></span>';
        anchor.appendChild(button);
    }

    button.onclick = event => openFuraiVisualPicker(
        event,
        button.dataset.furaiVisualPickerKind || kind,
        button.dataset.furaiVisualPickerIndex || ''
    );
    button.dataset.furaiVisualPickerKind = kind;
    button.dataset.furaiVisualPickerIndex = String(index ?? '');

    config.input.dataset.furaiVisualPickerPreviewId = previewId;
    config.input.dataset.furaiVisualPickerKind = kind;
    config.input.dataset.furaiVisualPickerIndex = String(index ?? '');

    if (config.input.dataset.furaiVisualPickerBound !== 'true') {
        config.input.dataset.furaiVisualPickerBound = 'true';
        config.input.addEventListener('input', event => {
            const activeInput = event.currentTarget;
            const activePreviewId = activeInput.dataset.furaiVisualPickerPreviewId || '';
            const activeKind = activeInput.dataset.furaiVisualPickerKind || '';
            const activeIndex = activeInput.dataset.furaiVisualPickerIndex || '';
            applyFuraiEditorAvatarPreview(activePreviewId, activeInput.value);
            refreshFuraiVisualPickerButton(activePreviewId, activeKind, activeIndex);
        });
    }

    const currentStatus = config.canSetStatus
        ? getFuraiChatEmotionStatus(currentChatId, config.role, config.actor, config.actorIndex)
        : 'default';
    applyFuraiVisualPickerStatusPreview(config, currentStatus);
    refreshFuraiVisualPickerButton(previewId, kind, index);
}

function ensureFuraiVisualPickerPopover() {
    let popover = document.getElementById('furaiVisualPickerPopover');
    if (popover) return popover;

    popover = document.createElement('div');
    popover.id = 'furaiVisualPickerPopover';
    popover.className = 'furai-visual-picker-popover';
    popover.hidden = true;
    popover.addEventListener('click', event => {
        const option = event.target.closest('[data-furai-visual-choice]');
        const config = popover._furaiConfig;
        if (!option || !config) return;

        const action = option.dataset.furaiVisualChoice;
        if (action === 'status') {
            const emotion = option.dataset.emotion || 'default';
            const selected = setFuraiChatEmotionStatus(
                currentChatId,
                config.role,
                config.actor,
                config.actorIndex,
                emotion
            );
            applyFuraiVisualPickerStatusPreview(config, selected);
            showToast(`Emotion Status: ${selected === 'default' ? 'Default' : capitalize(selected)}`, 'success');
        } else if (action === 'avatar') {
            const url = option.dataset.avatarUrl || '';
            config.input.value = url;
            config.input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
        }

        popover.hidden = true;
    });

    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
        if (popover.hidden) return;
        if (popover.contains(event.target) || event.target.closest('.furai-visual-picker-btn')) return;
        popover.hidden = true;
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
        if (event.key === 'Escape' && !popover.hidden) popover.hidden = true;
    });

    document.body.appendChild(popover);
    return popover;
}

function renderFuraiVisualPickerPopover(popover, config) {
    const avatar = String(config.input.value || '').trim();
    const emotionKeys = config.canSetStatus ? getFuraiEmotionVisualKeys(config.actor) : [];
    const currentStatus = config.canSetStatus
        ? getFuraiChatEmotionStatus(currentChatId, config.role, config.actor, config.actorIndex)
        : 'default';

    const statusHtml = config.canSetStatus && emotionKeys.length
        ? `
            <section class="furai-visual-picker-section">
              <div class="furai-visual-picker-title">Emotion Status</div>
              <div class="furai-visual-picker-grid furai-emotion-status-grid">
                ${['default', ...emotionKeys].map(key => {
                    const isDefault = key === 'default';
                    const imageUrl = isDefault
                        ? String(config.actor.avatar || '')
                        : String(config.actor.emotionAvatars?.[key] || config.actor.emotionSprites?.[key] || '');
                    const checked = currentStatus === key;
                    return `<button type="button" class="furai-visual-choice${checked ? ' is-selected' : ''}" data-furai-visual-choice="status" data-emotion="${escapeHTML(key)}" title="${escapeHTML(isDefault ? 'Default' : capitalize(key))}">
                        <span class="furai-visual-choice-image">${imageUrl ? `<img src="${escapeHTML(imageUrl)}" loading="lazy" decoding="async" onerror="this.style.display='none'">` : '<i class="fa-regular fa-circle-user"></i>'}</span>
                        <span>${escapeHTML(isDefault ? 'Default' : capitalize(key))}</span>
                    </button>`;
                }).join('')}
              </div>
            </section>`
        : '';

    const avatarHtml = (!avatar || isFuraiStarterAvatar(avatar))
        ? `
            <section class="furai-visual-picker-section">
              <div class="furai-visual-picker-title">Avatar</div>
              <div class="furai-visual-picker-grid furai-avatar-choice-grid">
                <button type="button" class="furai-visual-choice${!avatar ? ' is-selected' : ''}" data-furai-visual-choice="avatar" data-avatar-url="" title="No Avatar" aria-label="No Avatar">
                  <span class="furai-visual-choice-image"><i class="fa-solid fa-user-slash"></i></span>
                </button>
                ${FURAI_STARTER_AVATAR_POOL.map(url => `<button type="button" class="furai-visual-choice${avatar === url ? ' is-selected' : ''}" data-furai-visual-choice="avatar" data-avatar-url="${escapeHTML(url)}" title="Choose starter avatar">
                    <span class="furai-visual-choice-image"><img src="${escapeHTML(url)}" loading="lazy" decoding="async" onerror="this.style.display='none'"></span>
                </button>`).join('')}
              </div>
            </section>`
        : '';

    popover.innerHTML = statusHtml + avatarHtml;
}

function openFuraiVisualPicker(event, kind, index = '') {
    event?.preventDefault();
    event?.stopPropagation();

    const config = getFuraiVisualPickerEditorConfig(kind, index);
    if (!config) return;

    const avatar = String(config.input.value || '').trim();
    const hasAvatarPicker = !avatar || isFuraiStarterAvatar(avatar);
    const hasEmotionStatus = config.canSetStatus && getFuraiEmotionVisualKeys(config.actor).length > 0;
    if (!hasAvatarPicker && !hasEmotionStatus) return;

    const popover = ensureFuraiVisualPickerPopover();
    popover._furaiConfig = config;
    renderFuraiVisualPickerPopover(popover, config);
    popover.hidden = false;

    const rect = event?.currentTarget?.getBoundingClientRect?.();
    const width = Math.max(180, Math.min(360, window.innerWidth - 24));
    const left = rect ? Math.min(window.innerWidth - width - 12, Math.max(12, rect.right - width)) : 12;
    const belowTop = rect ? rect.bottom + 8 : 80;
    const top = belowTop + Math.min(popover.scrollHeight, window.innerHeight - 24) > window.innerHeight - 12
        ? 12
        : belowTop;
    popover.style.width = `${width}px`;
    popover.style.left = `${left}px`;
    popover.style.top = `${Math.max(12, top)}px`;
}

// --- 3. DYNAMIC EDITOR (GLOBAL + LOCAL + USER + FACTORY) ---
function openEmotionEditor(index, context = 'local') {
    document.getElementById('emotionEditorContext').value = context;
    document.getElementById('emotionEditorBotIndex').value = index;

    let targetData = {};

    if (context === 'historical') {
        const record = findFuraiHistoricalActorRecord(
            furaiHistoricalEmotionContext || { actorUid: String(index || '') }
        );
        targetData = record?.actor || {};
    }
    else if (context === 'local') {
        const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
        if (index === 'user') targetData = profile.user;
        else if (index === 'wand') {
             try { targetData = DB.get(currentChatId) || {}; } catch(e) { targetData = {}; }
        
             targetData = {
                 name: targetData.enhancerName || DEFAULT_WAND_DISPLAY_NAME,
                 avatar: targetData.enhancerAvatar || '',
                 defaultSprite: targetData.enhancerSprite || '',
                 customEmotions: targetData.enhancerCustomEmotions || JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_EMOTION_KEYWORDS)),
                 emotionAvatars: targetData.enhancerEmotionAvatars || {},
                 emotionSprites: targetData.enhancerEmotionSprites || {}
             };
        }
        else {
            const botIndex = Number(index);
            const storedBot = profile.bots[botIndex];

            targetData =
                chatPersonalities[currentChatId] === 'group' &&
                storedBot?.rosterStub === true
                    ? resolveGroupRosterStubForDisplay(storedBot, botIndex)
                    : storedBot;
        }
    } 
    // --- NEW: Add Support for Maker Mode ---
    else if (context === 'maker') {
        targetData = {
            name: document.getElementById('makerNameInput').value || "New Character",
            avatar: document.getElementById('makerAvatarInput')?.value || '',
            defaultSprite: document.getElementById('makerSpriteInput')?.value || '',
            customEmotions: window.makerTempEmotions || JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_EMOTION_KEYWORDS)),
            emotionAvatars: window.makerTempAvatars || {},
            emotionSprites: window.makerTempSprites || {}
        };
    }
    else if (context === 'livestream') {
        targetData = window.FuraiLivestream && typeof window.FuraiLivestream.getSpeakerSnapshot === "function"
            ? window.FuraiLivestream.getSpeakerSnapshot()
            : {};

        if (!targetData.name) targetData.name = "Livestream Character";
        if (!targetData.customEmotions) targetData.customEmotions = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_EMOTION_KEYWORDS));
        if (!targetData.emotionAvatars) targetData.emotionAvatars = {};
        if (!targetData.emotionSprites) targetData.emotionSprites = {};
    } 
    else {
        if (index === 'user') {
            try { targetData = DB.get(`global-user-${currentGlobalTab}`) || {}; } catch(e){}
            if(!targetData.name) targetData = { name: 'User' };
        } else if (index === 'wand') {
             targetData = getFuraiGlobalWandProfile();
        } else if (currentGlobalTab === 'group') {
             let roster = [];
             try { roster = DB.get('globalBotRoster'); } catch(e){}
             if (!roster || roster.length === 0) roster = defaultBots;
             targetData = roster[index] || {};
        } else {
             let storedBot = null;
             try {
                 const p = DB.get(`global-profile-${currentGlobalTab}`);
                 if (p && Array.isArray(p.bots) && p.bots[0]) storedBot = p.bots[0];
             } catch(e){}

             if (storedBot) {
                 targetData = cloneFuraiData(storedBot);
                 if (!targetData.name) targetData.name = 'Character';
                 if (!targetData.customEmotions) targetData.customEmotions = {};
                 if (!targetData.emotionAvatars) targetData.emotionAvatars = {};
                 if (!targetData.emotionSprites) targetData.emotionSprites = {};
             } else {
                 targetData = createFuraiModeFactoryBot(currentGlobalTab);
             }
        }
    }

    const container = document.getElementById('emotionInputsContainer');
    container.innerHTML = '';
    const currentKeywords = targetData.customEmotions || JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_EMOTION_KEYWORDS));
    const emotionModal = document.getElementById('emotionEditorModal');

    emotionModal._furaiDefaultAvatar = String(targetData.avatar || '');
    emotionModal._furaiDefaultSprite = String(targetData.defaultSprite || '');
    emotionModal._furaiLegacyDefaultAvatar = String(targetData.emotionAvatars?.default || '');
    emotionModal._furaiLegacyDefaultSprite = String(targetData.emotionSprites?.default || '');

    addEmotionRowHTML(
        'default',
        emotionModal._furaiDefaultAvatar,
        emotionModal._furaiDefaultSprite,
        currentKeywords.default || '',
        true,
        { linkedDefault: true }
    );

    Object.keys(currentKeywords).forEach(key => {
        if (key === 'default') return;
        const isStandard = DEFAULT_EMOTION_KEYWORDS.hasOwnProperty(key);
        const avatarUrl = String(targetData.emotionAvatars?.[key] || '');
        const spriteUrl = String(targetData.emotionSprites?.[key] || '');

        addEmotionRowHTML(key, avatarUrl, spriteUrl, currentKeywords[key], isStandard);
    });

    emotionModal.style.zIndex = context === 'historical' ? '4585' : '4320';
    emotionModal.style.display = 'flex';
}

function addCustomEmotionRow() {
    addEmotionRowHTML("", "", "", "", false);
}

// --- 5. EMOTION ROW RENDERER (FIXED VARIABLE ORDER) ---
// This was the source of the mix-up bug. The order of arguments is now strictly followed.
// **BUG FIX CONFIRMATION**: Definition now matches the call above.
function addEmotionRowHTML(key, avatarUrl, spriteUrl, keywords, isStandard, options = {}) {
    const container = document.getElementById('emotionInputsContainer');
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = 'emotion-row';
    if (options.linkedDefault === true) div.dataset.furaiDefaultEmotion = 'true';
    div.style.marginBottom = "20px";
    div.style.paddingBottom = "20px";
    div.style.borderBottom = "1px solid var(--border-color)";
    
    let titleHtml = '';
    if (isStandard) {
        titleHtml = `
            <label style="text-transform:capitalize; font-weight:700; font-size:1.1em; display:block; margin-bottom:8px; color:var(--primary-color);">
                ${key}
            </label>
            <input type="hidden" class="emo-key-input" value="${key}">`;
    } else {
        titleHtml = `
            <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-bottom:8px;">
                <input type="text" class="emo-key-input" placeholder="Emotion Name" value="${key}" 
                       style="flex:1; min-width: 120px; font-weight:700; border:1px solid var(--border-color); background:var(--input-bg); color:var(--text-color); padding:8px; border-radius:4px;">
                <button onclick="this.closest('.emotion-row').remove()" title="Delete"
                        style="color:var(--danger-color); background:var(--sidebar-hover); border:1px solid var(--border-color); cursor:pointer; width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:4px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-shrink:0;">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-trash"></i>
                </button>
            </div>`;
    }

    div.innerHTML = `
        <div style="display:flex; gap:16px; align-items:flex-start;">
            
            <div style="flex-shrink:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; width:60px;">
                <img src="${avatarUrl}" class="emo-preview-avatar" 
                     title="Avatar"
                     style="width:60px; height:60px; border-radius:50%; object-fit:cover; border:2px solid var(--border-color); background:var(--input-bg); cursor:zoom-in;" 
                     onclick="openLightbox(this.src)" onerror="this.style.display='none'">
                     
                <img src="${spriteUrl}" class="emo-preview-sprite" 
                     title="Sprite"
                     style="width:60px; height:80px; border-radius:4px; object-fit:contain; border:1px solid var(--border-color); background:var(--input-bg); cursor:zoom-in;" 
                     onclick="openLightbox(this.src)" onerror="this.style.display='none'">
            </div>

            <div style="flex:1; min-width:0;">
                ${titleHtml}

                <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap:8px; margin-bottom:8px;">
                    <div>
                        <label style="font-size:0.8em; opacity:0.6; display:block; margin-bottom:4px;">${options.linkedDefault === true ? 'Linked Avatar' : 'Avatar URL'}</label>
                        <div style="display:flex; gap:4px;">
                            <input type="text" class="emo-url-input" value="${avatarUrl}" ${options.linkedDefault === true ? 'readonly aria-readonly="true"' : ''} style="flex:1; width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; border:1px solid var(--border-color); background:var(--input-bg); color:var(--text-color); padding:4px; ${options.linkedDefault === true ? 'opacity:.65;' : ''}">
                            ${options.linkedDefault === true ? '' : '<button onclick="openUploader()" class="upload-btn" style="height:auto; width:32px; padding:0;"><span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size:16px;">upload_file</span></button>'}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <label style="font-size:0.8em; opacity:0.6; display:block; margin-bottom:4px;">${options.linkedDefault === true ? 'Linked Sprite' : 'Sprite URL'}</label>
                        <div style="display:flex; gap:4px;">
                            <input type="text" class="emo-sprite-input" value="${spriteUrl}" ${options.linkedDefault === true ? 'readonly aria-readonly="true"' : ''} style="flex:1; width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; border:1px solid var(--border-color); background:var(--input-bg); color:var(--text-color); padding:4px; ${options.linkedDefault === true ? 'opacity:.65;' : ''}">
                            ${options.linkedDefault === true ? '' : '<button onclick="openUploader()" class="upload-btn" style="height:auto; width:32px; padding:0;"><span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size:16px;">upload_file</span></button>'}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                    <label style="font-size:0.8em; opacity:0.6; display:block; margin-bottom:4px;">Keywords (comma separated)</label>
                    <textarea class="emo-keywords-input" rows="2" style="width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px; line-height:1.4;">${keywords}</textarea>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    `;
    
    // Bind Live Previews
    const urlInput = div.querySelector('.emo-url-input');
    const spriteInput = div.querySelector('.emo-sprite-input');
    const avPreview = div.querySelector('.emo-preview-avatar');
    const spPreview = div.querySelector('.emo-preview-sprite');

    // Init visibility
    if(!avatarUrl) avPreview.style.display='none';
    if(!spriteUrl) spPreview.style.display='none';

    if (options.linkedDefault !== true) {
        urlInput.oninput = () => {
            avPreview.src = urlInput.value;
            avPreview.style.display = urlInput.value ? 'block' : 'none';
        };
        spriteInput.oninput = () => {
            spPreview.src = spriteInput.value;
            spPreview.style.display = spriteInput.value ? 'block' : 'none';
        };
    }

    container.appendChild(div);
}

function saveEmotionKeywords() {
    const context = document.getElementById('emotionEditorContext').value;
    const indexStr = document.getElementById('emotionEditorBotIndex').value;
    
    const newEmotions = {};
    const newAvatars = {};
    const newSprites = {}; 
    
    document.querySelectorAll('#emotionInputsContainer .emotion-row').forEach(row => {
        const key = row.querySelector('.emo-key-input').value.trim();
        const url = row.querySelector('.emo-url-input').value.trim();
        const sprite = row.querySelector('.emo-sprite-input').value.trim();
        const keywords = row.querySelector('.emo-keywords-input').value.trim();
        if (!key) return;

        if (row.dataset.furaiDefaultEmotion === 'true') {
            if (keywords) newEmotions.default = keywords;
            return;
        }

        if (key.toLowerCase() === 'default') return;

        newEmotions[key] = keywords;
        if (url) newAvatars[key] = url;
        if (sprite) newSprites[key] = sprite;
    });

    const emotionModal = document.getElementById('emotionEditorModal');
    if (emotionModal?._furaiLegacyDefaultAvatar) {
        newAvatars.default = emotionModal._furaiLegacyDefaultAvatar;
    }
    if (emotionModal?._furaiLegacyDefaultSprite) {
        newSprites.default = emotionModal._furaiLegacyDefaultSprite;
    }

    // --- NEW: Support Maker Mode Saving ---
    if (context === 'maker') {
        window.makerTempEmotions = newEmotions;
        window.makerTempAvatars = newAvatars;
        window.makerTempSprites = newSprites;
        closeEmotionEditor();
        return;
    }

    if (context === 'livestream') {
        if (window.FuraiLivestream && typeof window.FuraiLivestream.saveSpeakerEmotions === "function") {
            window.FuraiLivestream.saveSpeakerEmotions(newEmotions, newAvatars, newSprites);
        }

        closeEmotionEditor();
        return;
    }

    if (context === 'historical') {
        const record = findFuraiHistoricalActorRecord(furaiHistoricalEmotionContext || {});
        if (!record) {
            showToast('Historical character data is unavailable.', 'error');
            return;
        }

        record.actor.customEmotions = newEmotions;
        record.actor.emotionAvatars = newAvatars;
        record.actor.emotionSprites = newSprites;
        DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, record.profile);
        closeEmotionEditor();
        rerenderVisibleMessagesFromDatabase({ preserveScroll: true, preserveVnTarget: true });
        showToast('Historical emotion set updated.', 'success');
        return;
    }

    if (context === 'local') {
        if (indexStr === 'wand') {
            try {
                const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
                if (chatData) {
                    chatData.enhancerCustomEmotions = newEmotions;
                    chatData.enhancerEmotionAvatars = newAvatars;
                    chatData.enhancerEmotionSprites = newSprites;
                    DB.set(currentChatId, chatData);
                }
            } catch(e) {}
        } else {
            const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
            if (indexStr === 'user') {
                profile.user.customEmotions = newEmotions;
                profile.user.emotionAvatars = newAvatars;
                profile.user.emotionSprites = newSprites;
            } else {
                const idx = parseInt(indexStr);
                let targetBot = profile.bots[idx];

                if (
                    chatPersonalities[currentChatId] === 'group' &&
                    targetBot?.rosterStub === true
                ) {
                    targetBot = hydrateGroupRosterStub(profile, idx);
                }

                if (!targetBot) return;

                targetBot.customEmotions = newEmotions;
                targetBot.emotionAvatars = newAvatars;
                targetBot.emotionSprites = newSprites;
            }
            profile.profileCustomized = true;
            // [FIX] Use DB.set
            DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, profile); 
        }
    } 
    else { // Global
        if (indexStr === 'user') {
            const key = `global-user-${currentGlobalTab}`;
            // [FIX] Use DB.get
            let data = DB.get(key) || {}; 
            data.customEmotions = newEmotions;
            data.emotionAvatars = newAvatars;
            data.emotionSprites = newSprites;
            DB.set(key, data);

        } else if (indexStr === 'wand') {
            DB.set('global-group-enhancer-custom-emotions', newEmotions);
            DB.set('global-group-enhancer-emotion-avatars', newAvatars);
            DB.set('global-group-enhancer-emotion-sprites', newSprites);

        } else if (currentGlobalTab === 'group') {
            // [FIX] Use DB.get
            let roster = DB.get('globalBotRoster'); 
            if(roster && roster[indexStr]) {
                roster[indexStr].customEmotions = newEmotions;
                roster[indexStr].emotionAvatars = newAvatars;
                roster[indexStr].emotionSprites = newSprites;
                DB.set('globalBotRoster', roster);
            }

        } else {
            const key = `global-profile-${currentGlobalTab}`;
            // [FIX] Use DB.get
            let data = DB.get(key); 
            if(data && data.bots && data.bots[0]) {
                data.bots[0].customEmotions = newEmotions;
                data.bots[0].emotionAvatars = newAvatars;
                data.bots[0].emotionSprites = newSprites;
                DB.set(key, data);
            }
        }
    }
    closeEmotionEditor();
}

function closeEmotionEditor() { document.getElementById('emotionEditorModal').style.display = 'none'; }

function resetEmotionKeywords() {
    if (!confirm('Reset keywords to defaults?')) return;

    const container = document.getElementById('emotionInputsContainer');
    if (!container) return;
    container.innerHTML = '';

    const indexStr = document.getElementById('emotionEditorBotIndex').value;
    const context = document.getElementById('emotionEditorContext').value;
    let currentAvatars = {};
    let currentSprites = {};

    if (context === 'historical') {
        const record = findFuraiHistoricalActorRecord(furaiHistoricalEmotionContext || {});
        currentAvatars = record?.actor?.emotionAvatars || {};
        currentSprites = record?.actor?.emotionSprites || {};
    } else if (context === 'maker') {
        currentAvatars = window.makerTempAvatars || {};
        currentSprites = window.makerTempSprites || {};
    } else if (indexStr === 'wand') {
        if (context === 'local') {
            const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId) || {};
            currentAvatars = chatData.enhancerEmotionAvatars || {};
            currentSprites = chatData.enhancerEmotionSprites || {};
        } else {
            currentAvatars = DB.get('global-group-enhancer-emotion-avatars') || {};
            currentSprites = DB.get('global-group-enhancer-emotion-sprites') || {};
        }
    } else if (indexStr === 'user') {
        const user = context === 'local'
            ? getChatProfile(currentChatId)?.user
            : DB.get(`global-user-${currentGlobalTab}`);
        currentAvatars = user?.emotionAvatars || {};
        currentSprites = user?.emotionSprites || {};
    } else {
        const idx = Number.parseInt(indexStr, 10);
        let bot = null;

        if (context === 'local') {
            const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
            const storedBot = profile?.bots?.[idx];
            bot = chatPersonalities[currentChatId] === 'group' && storedBot?.rosterStub === true
                ? resolveGroupRosterStubForDisplay(storedBot, idx)
                : storedBot;
        } else if (currentGlobalTab === 'group') {
            const roster = DB.get('globalBotRoster') || defaultBots;
            bot = roster?.[idx] || null;
        } else {
            bot = DB.get(`global-profile-${currentGlobalTab}`)?.bots?.[0] || null;
        }

        currentAvatars = bot?.emotionAvatars || {};
        currentSprites = bot?.emotionSprites || {};
    }

    const emotionModal = document.getElementById('emotionEditorModal');
    addEmotionRowHTML(
        'default',
        String(emotionModal?._furaiDefaultAvatar || ''),
        String(emotionModal?._furaiDefaultSprite || ''),
        '',
        true,
        { linkedDefault: true }
    );

    Object.keys(DEFAULT_EMOTION_KEYWORDS).forEach(key => {
        addEmotionRowHTML(
            key,
            currentAvatars[key] || '',
            currentSprites[key] || '',
            DEFAULT_EMOTION_KEYWORDS[key],
            true
        );
    });
}

  };

function cloneFuraiData(value) {
    return value == null ? value : JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
}

function createFuraiModeFactoryBot(mode, options = {}) {
    const normalizedMode = ['researcher', 'prompter', 'story', 'maker'].includes(mode)
        ? mode
        : 'researcher';

    const [catalogTitle, hashTag] = FURAI_MODE_FACTORY_META[normalizedMode];
    const bot = {
        uid: FURAI_MODE_FACTORY_IDS[normalizedMode],
        factoryMode: normalizedMode,
        sourceFactoryMode: normalizedMode,
        name: 'FurAI',
        catalogTitle,
        hashTag,
        avatar: FURAI_MODE_FACTORY_AVATARS.default,
        defaultSprite: FURAI_MODE_FACTORY_SPRITES.default,
        instruction: personalityInstructions[normalizedMode],
        isActive: true,
        inActiveCast: true,
        replyMode: 'auto',
        customEmotions: cloneFuraiData(DEFAULT_EMOTION_KEYWORDS),
        emotionAvatars: cloneFuraiData(FURAI_MODE_FACTORY_AVATARS),
        emotionSprites: cloneFuraiData(FURAI_MODE_FACTORY_SPRITES)
    };

    if (normalizedMode === 'story') bot.storyNarratorMain = true;
    if (options.newActor === true) bot.uid = generateUID(`actor_${normalizedMode}`);
    return bot;
}
