function resolveFactoryInstruction(instruction, mode) {
    const raw = String(instruction || '').trim();
    const factory = personalityInstructions[mode] || '';
    const legacyGroupFactoryInstruction = 'You are in a group chat. The user is one member, and you control multiple AI bots. Respond as the most appropriate bot based on the conversation.';

    // A blank custom instruction is valid. Only explicit legacy factory markers
    // are expanded; missing role records are created from their own factories
    // before this helper is reached.
    if (raw.toLowerCase() === 'default') return factory;
    if (mode === 'group' && raw === legacyGroupFactoryInstruction) return factory;
    return instruction;
}

function groupChatOrchestrator() {
    // Honest fixed probabilities. Randomizing a probability range before one
    // roll only collapses to the range average, so keep the actual behavior clear.
    const BASE_ADDITIONAL_REPLY_CHANCE = 0.25;
    const WEAK_MENTION_ADDITIONAL_REPLY_CHANCE = 0.33;
    const WEAK_MENTION_PRIMARY_WEIGHT = 1.4;

    // Random/Open Reply batches stay compact. Explicit named @mentions are kept
    // ahead of this limit so a deliberate ping is never silently sliced away.
    const BASE_MAX_REPLIES = 3;

    const prob = chance => Math.random() < chance;

    const pickOne = list => {
        if (!Array.isArray(list) || list.length === 0) return null;
        return list[Math.floor(Math.random() * list.length)] || null;
    };

    const weightedPick = (list, getWeight) => {
        if (!Array.isArray(list) || list.length === 0) return null;

        const weighted = list.map(item => ({
            item,
            weight: Math.max(0, Number(getWeight(item)) || 0)
        }));

        const total = weighted.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.weight, 0);
        if (total <= 0) return pickOne(list);

        let roll = Math.random() * total;
        for (const entry of weighted) {
            roll -= entry.weight;
            if (roll < 0) return entry.item;
        }

        return weighted[weighted.length - 1].item;
    };

    const shuffledCopy = list => {
        const out = Array.isArray(list) ? list.slice() : [];

        for (let i = out.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
            const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
            [out[i], out[j]] = [out[j], out[i]];
        }

        return out;
    };

    const isSpeakable = ai => ai && ai.isActive;
    const filterSpeakable = list => (Array.isArray(list) ? list : []).filter(isSpeakable);

    // Weak mentions are exact, case-insensitive whole words taken only from the
    // character's displayed name and parenthetical aliases.
    const WEAK_MENTION_STOP_WORDS = new Set([
        'the', 'and', 'for', 'from', 'with', 'into', 'onto',
        'this', 'that', 'a', 'an', 'of', 'to', 'in', 'on', 'at', 'by'
    ]);

    const normalizeWeakMentionText = value => {
        let out = String(value || '');

        try {
            out = out.normalize('NFKC');
        } catch (error) {}

        return out.toLowerCase();
    };

    const getWeakMentionTerms = ai => {
        const sources = [ai?.name];

        if (Array.isArray(ai?.weakMentionAliases)) {
            sources.push(...ai.weakMentionAliases);
        }

        const terms = new Set();

        for (const source of sources) {
            const normalized = normalizeWeakMentionText(source);
            const tokens = normalized.match(/[a-z0-9]+/g) || [];

            for (const token of tokens) {
                if (token.length < 3) continue;
                if (WEAK_MENTION_STOP_WORDS.has(token)) continue;
                terms.add(token);
            }
        }

        return Array.from(terms);
    };

    const containsExactWeakTerm = (text, term) => {
        const normalizedText = normalizeWeakMentionText(text);
        const normalizedTerm = normalizeWeakMentionText(term).trim();

        if (!normalizedText || !normalizedTerm) return false;

        const pattern = new RegExp(
            `(^|[^a-z0-9_])${escapeRegex(normalizedTerm)}(?=$|[^a-z0-9_])`,
            'i'
        );

        return pattern.test(normalizedText);
    };

    const isWeaklyMentioned = (ai, userMessage) => {
        const text = String(userMessage?.text || '');
        if (!text) return false;

        return getWeakMentionTerms(ai).some(term => containsExactWeakTerm(text, term));
    };

    const chanceForAdditional = (ai, userMessage) => {
        // Reply policy and direct @mentions stay above weak mentions.
        if (ai.replyMode === 'always') return 1.0;

        const mentionUids = userMessage?.mentionUids instanceof Set
            ? userMessage.mentionUids
            : new Set(Array.isArray(userMessage?.mentionUids) ? userMessage.mentionUids : []);
        const mentions = Array.isArray(userMessage?.mentions) ? userMessage.mentions : [];

        if (
            mentionUids.has(String(ai?.uid || '')) ||
            mentions.includes(ai.name) ||
            mentions.includes('everyone') ||
            mentions.includes('all')
        ) {
            return 1.0;
        }

        if (isWeaklyMentioned(ai, userMessage)) {
            return WEAK_MENTION_ADDITIONAL_REPLY_CHANCE;
        }

        return BASE_ADDITIONAL_REPLY_CHANCE;
    };

    const makeMentionRegex = name => {
        const escaped = escapeRegex(String(name || ''));

        try {
            // Unicode-aware boundary: names may end in emoji, punctuation, or
            // non-Latin letters. Do not let @Ann match the start of @Anna.
            return new RegExp(`@${escaped}(?![\\p{L}\\p{N}_-])`, 'iu');
        } catch (error) {
            return new RegExp(`@${escaped}(?![\\w-])`, 'i');
        }
    };

    const parseMentionMatches = (text, bots, preferredActorUids = []) => {
        const value = String(text || '');
        const botList = Array.isArray(bots) ? bots : [];
        const preferredUidSet = new Set(
            (Array.isArray(preferredActorUids) ? preferredActorUids : [])
                .map(uid => String(uid || '').trim())
                .filter(Boolean)
        );
        const found = [];
        const groupedByName = new Map();

        botList.forEach((bot, botIndex) => {
            const name = String(bot?.name || '').trim();
            if (!name) return;

            const key = name.toLocaleLowerCase();
            if (!groupedByName.has(key)) groupedByName.set(key, []);
            groupedByName.get(key).push({ bot, botIndex, name });
        });

        for (const group of groupedByName.values()) {
            const name = group[0]?.name || '';
            const match = value.match(makeMentionRegex(name));
            if (!match) continue;

            const preferred = group.filter(entry =>
                preferredUidSet.has(String(entry.bot?.uid || ''))
            );
            const fallback = group.find(entry =>
                entry.bot?.isActive &&
                entry.bot?.inActiveCast &&
                entry.bot?.replyMode !== 'mute'
            ) || group[0];
            const selected = preferred.length > 0 ? preferred : [fallback];

            for (const entry of selected) {
                found.push({
                    kind: 'bot',
                    name: entry.name,
                    uid: String(entry.bot?.uid || ''),
                    botIndex: entry.botIndex,
                    index: Number(match.index) || 0
                });
            }
        }

        let everyoneMatch = null;
        try {
            everyoneMatch = value.match(/@(everyone|all)(?![\p{L}\p{N}_-])/iu);
        } catch (error) {
            everyoneMatch = value.match(/@(everyone|all)(?![\w-])/i);
        }

        if (everyoneMatch) {
            found.push({
                kind: 'broadcast',
                name: String(everyoneMatch[1] || '').toLowerCase(),
                uid: '',
                botIndex: -1,
                index: Number(everyoneMatch.index) || 0
            });
        }

        found.sort((a, b) => (a.index - b.index) || (a.botIndex - b.botIndex));
        return found;
    };

    const parseMentions = (text, bots, preferredActorUids = []) =>
        parseMentionMatches(text, bots, preferredActorUids).map(entry => entry.name);

    const choosePrimaryResponder = (ais, userMessage) => {
        const speakable = filterSpeakable(ais);
        if (speakable.length === 0) return null;

        const orderedMentionUids = Array.isArray(userMessage?.orderedMentionUids)
            ? userMessage.orderedMentionUids
            : [];

        // A direct @mention is deterministic and remains the highest priority.
        for (const uid of orderedMentionUids) {
            const found = speakable.find(ai => String(ai?.uid || '') === String(uid || ''));
            if (found) return found;
        }

        const mentions = Array.isArray(userMessage?.mentions) ? userMessage.mentions : [];
        for (const mention of mentions) {
            if (mention === 'everyone' || mention === 'all') continue;

            const found = speakable.find(ai => ai.name === mention);
            if (found) return found;
        }

        // Always Reply still forms its own higher-priority pool. Weak mentions
        // only weight characters against peers within the same pool.
        const alwaysBots = speakable.filter(ai => ai.replyMode === 'always');
        const pool = alwaysBots.length > 0 ? alwaysBots : speakable;

        return weightedPick(
            pool,
            ai => isWeaklyMentioned(ai, userMessage)
                ? WEAK_MENTION_PRIMARY_WEIGHT
                : 1
        );
    };

    const chooseAdditionalResponders = (ais, primary, userMessage) => {
        const primaryUid = String(primary?.uid || '');

        // Shuffle before rolling so later batch slicing never favors roster order.
        const candidates = shuffledCopy(
            filterSpeakable(ais).filter(ai => {
                const uid = String(ai?.uid || '');
                if (primaryUid && uid) return uid !== primaryUid;
                return ai.name !== primary?.name;
            })
        );

        const responders = [];

        for (const ai of candidates) {
            if (prob(chanceForAdditional(ai, userMessage))) {
                responders.push(ai);
            }
        }

        return responders;
    };

    return {
        choosePrimaryResponder,
        chooseAdditionalResponders,
        parseMentions,
        parseMentionMatches,
        isWeaklyMentioned,
        getWeakMentionTerms,
        BASE_MAX_REPLIES
    };
  }
    
  function escapeHTML(str) {
      return str.replace(/[&<>'"]/g, 
        tag => ({
            '&': '&amp;',
            '<': '&lt;',
            '>': '&gt;',
            "'": '&#39;',
            '"': '&quot;'
        }[tag] || tag)
      );
  }

/* --- GLOSSARY / WORLD INFO ENGINE (High Performance) --- */
function getGlossaryContext(textToScan, glossaryText) {
    if (!glossaryText || !textToScan) return "";
    
    const lines = glossaryText.split('\n');
    const dictionary = {};
    const allKeywords = [];

    // 1. Fast Parse: O(N) string manipulation
    for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
        const line = lines[i];
        const eqIndex = line.indexOf('=');
        if (eqIndex === -1) continue;

        const keysPart = line.substring(0, eqIndex);
        const valPart = line.substring(eqIndex + 1).trim();
        if (!valPart) continue;

        const keys = keysPart.split(',');
        const primaryKey = keys[0].trim(); // The first word is the definitive name
        
        for (let j = 0; j < keys.length; j++) {
            const k = keys[j].trim();
            if (k) {
                const lowerK = k.toLowerCase();
                dictionary[lowerK] = { primary: primaryKey, val: valPart };
                
                // Escape symbols so things like "Mr. Smith" don't break the regex
                allKeywords.push(k.replace(/[-\/\\^$*+?.()|[\]{}]/g, '\\$&'));
            }
        }
    }

    if (allKeywords.length === 0) return "";

    // 2. Sort by length descending (Catches "Red Dragon" before "Dragon")
    allKeywords.sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length);
    
    // 3. Build ONE massive regex tree for a single-pass scan
    const giantRegex = new RegExp(`(?:^|[^a-zA-Z0-9_])(${allKeywords.join('|')})(?![a-zA-Z0-9_])`, 'gi');
    
    const foundEntries = new Set();
    let match;
    
    while ((match = giantRegex.exec(textToScan)) !== null) {
        const matchedWord = match[1].toLowerCase();
        const data = dictionary[matchedWord];
        if (data) {
            foundEntries.add(`- ${data.primary}: ${data.val}`);
        }
    }

    if (foundEntries.size === 0) return "";
    return `\n[DYNAMIC GLOSSARY (World Info)]\n${Array.from(foundEntries).join('\n')}\n`;
}

// =========================================================================
// Dynamic Plugin Loader + Concept Board
// =========================================================================
function hardUnloadFuraiDynamicModuleCache(generatorName) {
    try {
        const space = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.moduleSpace : null;
        const name = String(generatorName || '').trim();
        if (space && name && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(space, name)) {
            delete space[name];
        }
    } catch (e) {}
}

async function importFuraiDynamicPluginFunction(generatorName, label = 'plugin') {
    const loader = typeof getFuraiDynamicImportLoader === 'function'
        ? getFuraiDynamicImportLoader()
        : null;

    if (!loader) {
        throw new Error('dynamic-import-plugin is missing. Add this to the Perchance lists editor: dynamicImport = {import:dynamic-import-plugin}');
    }

    const imported = await awaitFuraiMaybePromise(loader(generatorName, 'async'));

    if (typeof imported === 'function') return imported;

    const containers = [
        imported,
        imported && imported.$output,
        imported && imported.output,
        imported && imported.default
    ];

    for (const c of containers) {
        const value = await awaitFuraiMaybePromise(c);
        if (typeof value === 'function') return value;
        if (value && typeof value[label] === 'function') return value[label];
        if (value && typeof value.$output === 'function') return value.$output;
        if (value && typeof value.default === 'function') return value.default;
    }

    throw new Error(`Dynamic import '${generatorName}' did not return a callable ${label}.`);
}

let furaiConceptBoardCreateLoading = null;

async function getFuraiConceptBoard() {
    if (window.furaiConceptBoard) return window.furaiConceptBoard;

    if (!furaiConceptBoardCreateLoading) {
        furaiConceptBoardCreateLoading = (async () => {
            const createBoard = typeof createMediaGalleryPlugin === 'function'
                ? createMediaGalleryPlugin
                : await importFuraiDynamicPluginFunction('furry-concept-board', 'createMediaGalleryPlugin');

            const board = createBoard();
            window.furaiConceptBoard = board;

            // The board instance is now created. Drop the dynamic-import module tree so the
            // static plugin payload does not remain as a separate cache entry.
            hardUnloadFuraiDynamicModuleCache('furry-concept-board');

            return board;
        })().finally(() => {
            furaiConceptBoardCreateLoading = null;
        });
    }

    return await furaiConceptBoardCreateLoading;
}

async function openFuraiConceptBoard() {
    try {
        const board = await getFuraiConceptBoard();
        if (board && typeof board.show === 'function') {
            board.show();
            if (typeof markFuraiConceptBoardUiForTranslation === 'function') {
                requestAnimationFrame(() => markFuraiConceptBoardUiForTranslation(document));
            }
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
        showToast?.("Concept Board plugin not found.");
    }
}


const FURAI_CONCEPT_BOARD_IMPORT_ACTIONS = Object.freeze({
    'furai-chat': Object.freeze({ label: 'Import Chat', icon: 'fa-solid fa-file-import' }),
    'furai-backup': Object.freeze({ label: 'Restore Backup', icon: 'fa-solid fa-rotate-left' }),
    'furai-character': Object.freeze({ label: 'Add Character', icon: 'fa-solid fa-user-plus' }),
    'furai-lorebook': Object.freeze({ label: 'Add to Bookshelf', icon: 'fa-solid fa-book-medical' }),
    'furai-glossary': Object.freeze({ label: 'Add to Bookshelf', icon: 'fa-solid fa-book-medical' })
});

function getFuraiConceptBoardImportAction(viewer) {
    const action = FURAI_CONCEPT_BOARD_IMPORT_ACTIONS[String(viewer || '').trim()];
    return action ? { ...action } : null;
}

function getUniqueFuraiLibraryImportTitle(library, type, requestedTitle) {
    const fallback = type === 'glossary' ? 'Imported Glossary' : 'Imported Lorebook';
    const base = String(requestedTitle || fallback).trim() || fallback;
    const used = new Set((Array.isArray(library) ? library : [])
        .filter(item => item?.type === type)
        .map(item => String(item?.title || '').trim().toLowerCase())
        .filter(Boolean));

    if (!used.has(base.toLowerCase())) return base;

    let suffix = 1;
    let candidate = `${base} (Imported)`;
    while (used.has(candidate.toLowerCase())) {
        suffix += 1;
        candidate = `${base} (Imported ${suffix})`;
    }
    return candidate;
}

async function importFuraiConceptBoardArtifact(request = {}) {
    const info = request?.info && typeof request.info === 'object' ? request.info : {};
    const viewer = String(request?.viewer || info.viewer || '').trim();
    const action = getFuraiConceptBoardImportAction(viewer);
    const blob = request?.blob;

    if (!action) throw new Error('This Concept Board item cannot be imported into FurAI.');
    if (!blob || typeof blob.text !== 'function') throw new Error('The original Concept Board file is unavailable.');

    await new Promise(resolve => requestAnimationFrame(resolve));

    if (viewer === 'furai-chat') {
        const json = await parseFuraiArtifactJsonBlob(blob);
        if (!json?.chat || !json.chat.id) throw new Error('Invalid FurAI chat file.');

        const newChatId = 'chat-' + Date.now();
        const newChatData = cloneFuraiData(json.chat);
        const sourceChatId = String(newChatData.id || '');

        newChatData.id = newChatId;
        remapFuraiDeepMemoryAuthorityForNewChat(newChatData, sourceChatId, newChatId);
        newChatData.timestamp = Date.now();

        DB.set(newChatId, newChatData);
        if (json.profile && typeof json.profile === 'object') {
            DB.set(`profile-${newChatId}`, cloneFuraiData(json.profile));
        }
        if (newChatData.background) addToBackgroundHistory(newChatData.background);

        loadChat(newChatId);
        showToast('Chat imported from Concept Board!', 'success');
        return {
            ok: true,
            message: 'Chat imported into FurAI.',
            closeViewer: true,
            closeBoard: true
        };
    }

    if (viewer === 'furai-backup') {
        showBackupProgress('Loading backup...', 'Reading Concept Board file...', 10);
        await waitForBackupProgressFrame();

        let json;
        try {
            json = await parseFuraiArtifactJsonBlob(blob);
        } catch (error) {
            hideBackupProgress(0);
            throw new Error('Invalid FurAI backup file.');
        }

        setBackupProgress(34, 'Checking backup contents...');
        await waitForBackupProgressFrame();

        try {
            const restored = await restoreGlobalBackup(json);
            if (restored === false) {
                return {
                    ok: false,
                    cancelled: true,
                    message: 'Restore cancelled.'
                };
            }

            return {
                ok: true,
                message: 'Backup restored in FurAI.',
                closeViewer: true,
                closeBoard: true
            };
        } catch (error) {
            hideBackupProgress(0);
            throw error;
        }
    }

    if (viewer === 'furai-character') {
        const parsed = await parseFuraiCharacterJsonBlob(blob);
        const charData = normalizeImportData(parsed);

        if (typeof expHasGlobalCharacterDuplicate === 'function' && expHasGlobalCharacterDuplicate(charData)) {
            showToast(`${charData.name || 'Character'} is already in the Character Library.`, 'info');
            return {
                ok: true,
                alreadyExists: true,
                message: 'Already in the Character Library.',
                closeViewer: false,
                closeBoard: false
            };
        }

        const added = addToGlobalRoster(charData, { silentToast: true });
        if (added === false) throw new Error('Character Library limit reached.');

        if (typeof refreshCharactersGridIfOpen === 'function') refreshCharactersGridIfOpen();
        showToast(`${charData.name || 'Character'} added to the Character Library!`, 'success');
        return {
            ok: true,
            message: 'Added to the Character Library.',
            closeViewer: false,
            closeBoard: false
        };
    }

    if (viewer === 'furai-lorebook' || viewer === 'furai-glossary') {
        const fallbackType = viewer === 'furai-glossary' ? 'glossary' : 'lorebook';
        const artifact = parseFuraiLibraryArtifactText(
            await readFuraiArtifactTextBlob(blob, { maxBytes: FURAI_MAX_LIBRARY_ARTIFACT_BYTES }),
            {
                type: fallbackType,
                title: request?.title || info.title || info.type,
                hashTag: info.hashTag,
                cover: info.cover
            }
        );
        const type = artifact.type;
        const content = String(artifact.content || '').trim();
        if (!content) throw new Error(`This ${type} is empty.`);

        const storedLibrary = DB.get('furai_lorebook_library');
        const library = Array.isArray(storedLibrary) ? storedLibrary : [];
        const duplicate = library.find(item =>
            item?.type === type && String(item?.content || '').trim() === content
        );

        if (duplicate) {
            showToast(`Already in Bookshelf as “${duplicate.title || 'Untitled'}”.`, 'info');
            return {
                ok: true,
                alreadyExists: true,
                message: `Already in Bookshelf as “${duplicate.title || 'Untitled'}”.`,
                closeViewer: false,
                closeBoard: false
            };
        }

        const title = getUniqueFuraiLibraryImportTitle(
            library,
            type,
            request?.title || info.title || info.type
        );
        const defaultCover = 'https://aigc.uploads.dev/image/43116958b5f56c72831461750228a3500c7f471bd9499de482c01ee66e62be24.jpeg';

        library.unshift({
            id: `${type === 'glossary' ? 'glos' : 'lb'}_board_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`,
            type,
            title,
            hashTag: String(artifact.hashTag || info.hashTag || '').trim(),
            cover: String(artifact.cover || info.cover || '').trim() || defaultCover,
            content,
            timestamp: Date.now(),
            viewCount: 0,
            useCount: 0,
            lastViewedAt: 0,
            lastUsedAt: 0,
            isDefault: false
        });

        DB.set('furai_lorebook_library', library);

        if (typeof LorebookManager !== 'undefined') {
            LorebookManager.updateTabLabels?.();
            const libraryModal = document.getElementById('lorebookLibraryModal');
            if (libraryModal && getComputedStyle(libraryModal).display !== 'none') {
                LorebookManager.currentViewTab = type;
                LorebookManager.render?.();
            }
        }

        showToast(`${title} added to Bookshelf!`, 'success');
        return {
            ok: true,
            message: 'Added to FurAI Bookshelf.',
            closeViewer: false,
            closeBoard: false
        };
    }

    throw new Error('Unsupported Concept Board artifact.');
}

window.FuraiConceptBoardBridge = {
    ...(window.FuraiConceptBoardBridge || {}),
    version: 2,
    supports(viewer) {
        return !!getFuraiConceptBoardImportAction(viewer);
    },
    getAction(viewer) {
        return getFuraiConceptBoardImportAction(viewer);
    },
    importArtifact: importFuraiConceptBoardArtifact,
    prepareArtifactExport(data, options = {}) {
        return prepareFuraiArtifactForExternalCopy(data, {
            actionLabel: options.actionLabel || 'download this Concept Board item',
            announcePg13: options.announcePg13 !== false
        });
    },
    sanitizeArtifactView(data) {
        return sanitizeFuraiArtifactView(data);
    },
    isAdultTagViewUnlocked() {
        return isFuraiAdultTagView();
    }
};

function furaiBoardBlink() {
    const btn = document.getElementById('conceptBoardBtn');
    if (!btn) return;

    btn.classList.remove('furai-board-blink');
    void btn.offsetWidth;
    btn.classList.add('furai-board-blink');

    setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('furai-board-blink'), 500);
}

function isFuraiSidebarPresent() {
    const sidebar = document.getElementById('menuSidebarEl');
    if (!sidebar) return false;

    const rect = sidebar.getBoundingClientRect();
    const style = getComputedStyle(sidebar);

    return (
        style.display !== 'none' &&
        style.visibility !== 'hidden' &&
        rect.width > 40 &&
        rect.right > 20 &&
        rect.left < window.innerWidth
    );
}

function getFuraiBoardTargetRect() {
    const target = document.getElementById('conceptBoardBtn');

    if (target && isFuraiSidebarPresent()) {
        const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();

        if (rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0) {
            return rect;
        }
    }

    return {
        left: 18,
        top: 18,
        width: 32,
        height: 32
    };
}

function furaiBoardFly(sourceEl, previewUrl = "") {
    const srcRect = sourceEl?.getBoundingClientRect?.();

    if (!srcRect) {
        furaiBoardBlink();
        return;
    }

    const targetRect = getFuraiBoardTargetRect();

    const ghost = document.createElement('div');
    ghost.className = 'furai-board-fly';

    const startW = Math.min(srcRect.width || 180, 260);
    const startH = Math.min(srcRect.height || 90, 160);

    ghost.style.cssText = `
        left:${srcRect.left}px;
        top:${srcRect.top}px;
        width:${startW}px;
        height:${startH}px;
    `;

    if (previewUrl) {
        const preview = document.createElement('img');
        preview.src = String(previewUrl);
        preview.alt = '';
        ghost.replaceChildren(preview);
    } else {
        const text = sourceEl.querySelector?.('.content')?.innerText || sourceEl.innerText || "Saved";
        ghost.innerHTML = `
            <div style="padding:12px; font-size:13px; line-height:1.35;">
                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; margin-bottom:6px; font-weight:700;">
                    <span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size:18px;">note_stack_add</span>
                    Concept Board
                </div>
                <div style="opacity:0.82;">${escapeHTMLForBoard(text).slice(0, 160)}</div>
            </div>
        `;
    }

    document.body.appendChild(ghost);

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        ghost.style.left = `${targetRect.left + targetRect.width / 2}px`;
        ghost.style.top = `${targetRect.top + targetRect.height / 2}px`;
        ghost.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.08)';
        ghost.style.opacity = '0';
    });

    setTimeout(() => {
        ghost.remove();
        furaiBoardBlink();
    }, 560);
}

function escapeHTMLForBoard(text) {
    return String(text || '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, ch => ({
        '&': '&amp;',
        '<': '&lt;',
        '>': '&gt;',
        '"': '&quot;',
        "'": '&#39;'
    }[ch]));
}

function setFuraiBoardActionBusy(trigger, busy) {
    if (!trigger) return;

    if (busy) {
        trigger.dataset.furaiBoardSaving = '1';
        trigger.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
        trigger.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
        trigger.style.opacity = '0.65';
        if ('disabled' in trigger) trigger.disabled = true;
        return;
    }

    delete trigger.dataset.furaiBoardSaving;
    trigger.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
    trigger.style.pointerEvents = '';
    trigger.style.opacity = '';
    if ('disabled' in trigger) trigger.disabled = false;
}

async function hasFuraiConceptBoardStorageRoom(blobSize) {
    if (!navigator.storage?.estimate || !Number.isFinite(blobSize) || blobSize <= 0) return true;

    try {
        const estimate = await navigator.storage.estimate();
        const quota = Number(estimate?.quota);
        const usage = Number(estimate?.usage);
        if (!Number.isFinite(quota) || !Number.isFinite(usage)) return true;

        const remaining = Math.max(0, quota - usage);
        const reserve = Math.max(1024 * 1024, Math.ceil(blobSize * 0.25));
        return remaining >= blobSize + reserve;
    } catch (error) {
        console.warn('Concept Board storage estimate unavailable.', error);
        return true;
    }
}

async function saveFuraiArtifactToConceptBoard({
    trigger = null,
    sourceEl = null,
    folder,
    title,
    payload,
    mimeType = 'application/json',
    extension = 'json',
    fileName = '',
    previewUrl = '',
    info = {}
}) {
    if (!folder || trigger?.dataset?.furaiBoardSaving === '1') return false;

    setFuraiBoardActionBusy(trigger, true);

    try {
        // Let the pressed state paint before a large chat or backup is serialized.
        await new Promise(resolve => requestAnimationFrame(resolve));

        const blob = payload instanceof Blob
            ? payload
            : new Blob([
                typeof payload === 'string' ? payload : JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)
            ], { type: mimeType });

        if (!blob.size) throw new Error('Nothing to save.');

        const hasRoom = await hasFuraiConceptBoardStorageRoom(blob.size);
        if (!hasRoom) {
            showToast?.('Not enough browser storage for this Concept Board item. Download the file instead.', 'error');
            return false;
        }

        const board = await getFuraiConceptBoard();
        if (!board || typeof board.add !== 'function') throw new Error('Concept Board is unavailable.');

        const safeBaseName = String(title || folder)
            .trim()
            .replace(/[\/:*?"<>|]+/g, '')
            .replace(/\s+/g, '_')
            .slice(0, 80) || `FurAI-${folder}`;
        const resolvedFileName = String(fileName || `${safeBaseName}.${extension}`).trim();

        await board.add(blob, {
            folder,
            info: {
                title: title || folder,
                viewer: info.viewer || '',
                category: folder,
                fileName: resolvedFileName,
                contentType: blob.type || mimeType,
                size: blob.size,
                date: new Date().toLocaleString(),
                artifactVersion: 2,
                type: info.type || folder,
                ...info
            }
        });

        furaiBoardFly(sourceEl || trigger, previewUrl);
        showToast?.(`${title || folder} saved to Concept Board.`, 'success');
        return true;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Concept Board artifact save failed:', error);
        showToast?.(`Could not save ${String(folder).toLowerCase()} to Concept Board.`, 'error');
        return false;
    } finally {
        setFuraiBoardActionBusy(trigger, false);
    }
}

function wrapCanvasText(ctx, text, maxWidth, maxLines) {
    const words = String(text || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().split(' ');
    const lines = [];
    let line = '';

    for (const word of words) {
        const test = line ? `${line} ${word}` : word;

        if (ctx.measureText(test).width > maxWidth && line) {
            lines.push(line);
            line = word;
            if (lines.length >= maxLines) break;
        } else {
            line = test;
        }
    }

    if (line && lines.length < maxLines) lines.push(line);
    return lines;
}

function makeChatlogImageBlob(info) {
    return new Promise(resolve => {
        const w = 900;
        const h = 520;
        const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);

        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width = w * dpr;
        canvas.height = h * dpr;

        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

        ctx.fillStyle = '#1f1f24';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

        ctx.fillStyle = '#2b2b34';
        ctx.fillRect(32, 32, w - 64, h - 64);

        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
        ctx.font = '700 26px system-ui, sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText(info.speaker || 'Unknown', 58, 82);

        ctx.font = '400 15px system-ui, sans-serif';
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.68)';
        ctx.fillText(`${info.chatTitle || 'Chat'} • ${info.mode || 'unknown'} • ${info.date || ''}`, 58, 112);

        ctx.font = '400 25px system-ui, sans-serif';
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';

        const lines = wrapCanvasText(ctx, info.content || '', w - 116, 11);
        let y = 168;

        for (const line of lines) {
            ctx.fillText(line, 58, y);
            y += 36;
        }

        if ((info.content || '').length > lines.join(' ').length) {
            ctx.fillText('…', 58, y);
        }

        canvas.toBlob(blob => resolve(blob), 'image/png', 0.92);
    });
}

function getCurrentChatModeName() {
    const chatId = window.currentChatId;
    const fromMemory = chatId && window.chatPersonalities ? window.chatPersonalities[chatId] : "";
    if (fromMemory) return fromMemory;

    try {
        const chatData = chatId ? DB.get(chatId) : null;
        return chatData?.personality || "unknown";
    } catch(e) {
        return "unknown";
    }
}

async function saveChatBubbleToConceptBoard(btn, messageEl) {
    const board = await getFuraiConceptBoard();
    if (!board || !messageEl) return;

    btn.disabled = true;

    try {
        const chatId = window.currentChatId || "";
        let chatData = null;

        try { chatData = chatId ? DB.get(chatId) : null; } catch(e) {}

        const content = messageEl.querySelector('.content')?.innerText || '';
        const speaker =
            messageEl.querySelector('.chat-username')?.innerText?.trim() ||
            (messageEl.classList.contains('user') ? 'User' :
            messageEl.classList.contains('ai') ? 'FurAI' :
            messageEl.classList.contains('system') ? '' :
            messageEl.classList.contains('narrator') ? '' : 'Unknown');

        const info = {
            type: 'Chatlog',
            chatTitle: chatData?.title || document.getElementById('chatTitleEl')?.innerText || 'New Chat',
            speaker,
            role: messageEl.classList.contains('user') ? 'user' :
                  messageEl.classList.contains('ai') ? 'ai' :
                  messageEl.classList.contains('system') ? 'system' :
                  isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(messageEl.dataset.role) ? messageEl.dataset.role :
                  messageEl.classList.contains('narrator') ? 'narrator' : 'message',
            mode: getCurrentChatModeName(),
            date: new Date().toLocaleString(),
            content
        };

        const blob = await makeChatlogImageBlob(info);

        await board.add(blob, {
            folder: 'Chatlog',
            info
        });

        furaiBoardFly(messageEl);
    } catch(e) {
        console.error(e);
        showToast?.("Could not save chatlog.");
    }

    setTimeout(() => {
        btn.disabled = false;
    }, 600);
}

function furaiBlobToDataUrl(blob) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const reader = new FileReader();

        reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result || '');
        reader.onerror = () => reject(reader.error);

        reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
    });
}

async function saveGeneratedImageToConceptBoard(btn, cardEl, imageUrl, imageInfo = {}) {
    const board = await getFuraiConceptBoard();
    if (!board || !imageUrl) return false;

    const {
        conceptBoardFolder = 'Image',
        ...storedImageInfo
    } = imageInfo;

    if (btn) btn.disabled = true;

    try {
        const res = await fetch(imageUrl);
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Image request failed (${res.status}).`);

        const blob = await res.blob();

        // Store one media payload only. Concept Board derives temporary
        // copyable data:image text from this Blob when Info is opened.
        const info = {
            ...storedImageInfo,
            title: storedImageInfo.title || 'Generated Image',
            description: storedImageInfo.description || '',
            prompt: storedImageInfo.prompt || '',
            negativePrompt: storedImageInfo.negativePrompt || '',
            seed: storedImageInfo.seed || '',
            guidanceScale: storedImageInfo.guidanceScale || '',
            date: storedImageInfo.date || new Date().toLocaleString(),
            chatTitle:
                storedImageInfo.chatTitle ||
                document.getElementById('chatTitleEl')?.innerText ||
                'New Chat',
            mode: storedImageInfo.mode || getCurrentChatModeName()
        };

        await board.add(blob, {
            folder: conceptBoardFolder,
            info
        });

        furaiBoardFly(cardEl || btn, imageUrl);
        return true;
    } catch(e) {
        console.error(e);
        showToast?.("Could not save image.", 'error');
        return false;
    } finally {
        if (btn) {
            setTimeout(() => {
                btn.disabled = false;
            }, 600);
        }
    }
}

function readFuraiGalleryConceptValue(...values) {
    for (const raw of values) {
        if (raw == null) continue;

        const value = typeof raw === 'object'
            ? raw.evaluateItem ?? raw.value ?? raw.getName
            : raw;

        if (!['string', 'number', 'boolean'].includes(typeof value)) continue;

        const text = String(value).trim();
        if (text && text !== '[object Object]') return text;
    }

    return '';
}

function readFuraiGalleryHttpUrl(...values) {
    for (const raw of values) {
        const value = readFuraiGalleryConceptValue(raw);
        if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(value)) return value;
    }

    return '';
}

function readFuraiGalleryPromptField(prompt, name) {
    const source = String(prompt || '');
    const prefix = `(${name}:::`;
    const start = source.toLowerCase().indexOf(prefix.toLowerCase());

    if (start < 0) return '';

    const valueStart = start + prefix.length;
    const end = source.indexOf(')', valueStart);
    return end < 0 ? '' : source.slice(valueStart, end).trim();
}

function formatFuraiGalleryConceptDate(value) {
    if (value == null || value === '') return new Date().toLocaleString();

    if (typeof value === 'string' && !/^\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(value.trim())) {
        const parsed = new Date(value);
        return Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) ? value.trim() : parsed.toLocaleString();
    }

    const numeric = Number(value);
    const parsed = new Date(numeric < 1e12 ? numeric * 1000 : numeric);
    return Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())
        ? new Date().toLocaleString()
        : parsed.toLocaleString();
}

function buildFuraiGalleryConceptBoardInfo(data = {}) {
    const inputs = data.inputs && typeof data.inputs === 'object' ? data.inputs : {};
    const meta = data.meta && typeof data.meta === 'object' ? data.meta : {};

    const prompt = readFuraiGalleryConceptValue(
        data.prompt,
        inputs.prompt,
        meta.prompt
    );

    const title = readFuraiGalleryConceptValue(
        data.postTitle,
        data.title,
        data.saveTitle,
        data.imageTitle,
        inputs.postTitle,
        inputs.title,
        inputs.saveTitle,
        meta.postTitle,
        meta.title,
        meta.saveTitle,
        readFuraiGalleryPromptField(prompt, 'saveTitle')
    ) || 'Gallery Image';

    const description = readFuraiGalleryConceptValue(
        data.postDescription,
        data.description,
        data.saveDescription,
        data.comment,
        inputs.postDescription,
        inputs.description,
        inputs.saveDescription,
        meta.postDescription,
        meta.description,
        meta.saveDescription,
        readFuraiGalleryPromptField(prompt, 'saveDescription')
    );

    const style = readFuraiGalleryConceptValue(
        data.styleName,
        data.style,
        data.artStyleName,
        data.artStyle,
        inputs.styleName,
        inputs.style,
        inputs.artStyleName,
        inputs.artStyle,
        meta.styleName,
        meta.style,
        meta.artStyleName,
        meta.artStyle
    );

    const negativePrompt = readFuraiGalleryConceptValue(
        data.negativePrompt,
        inputs.negativePrompt,
        meta.negativePrompt
    );

    const seed = readFuraiGalleryConceptValue(
        data.seed,
        inputs.seed,
        meta.seed
    );

    const guidanceScale = readFuraiGalleryConceptValue(
        data.guidanceScale,
        inputs.guidanceScale,
        meta.guidanceScale
    );

    const date = formatFuraiGalleryConceptDate(
        readFuraiGalleryConceptValue(
            data.createdAt,
            data.timestamp,
            data.postedAt,
            data.date,
            data.time,
            inputs.createdAt,
            inputs.timestamp,
            inputs.date,
            meta.createdAt,
            meta.timestamp,
            meta.postedAt,
            meta.date,
            meta.time
        )
    );

    const imageUrl = readFuraiGalleryHttpUrl(
        data.imageUrl,
        meta.imageUrl,
        data.dataUrl
    );

    return {
        title,
        description,
        style,
        prompt,
        negativePrompt,
        seed,
        guidanceScale,
        date,
        chatTitle: 'Gallery',
        mode: 'gallery',
        source: 'Gallery',
        galleryImageId: readFuraiGalleryConceptValue(data.imageId),
        galleryUserId: readFuraiGalleryConceptValue(data.userId),
        'Post Title': title,
        'Post Description': description,
        'Style': style,
        'Date / Time': date,
        'Image URL': imageUrl
    };
}

async function saveFuraiGalleryPostToConceptBoard(data = {}) {
    const meta = data.meta && typeof data.meta === 'object' ? data.meta : {};
    const imageUrl = readFuraiGalleryHttpUrl(
        data.imageUrl,
        meta.imageUrl,
        data.dataUrl
    );

    // Gallery posts already have a hosted image link. Keep that one link as the
    // only media payload: no fetch, Blob copy, or data:image/base64 copy.
    if (!imageUrl) {
        showToast?.('Could not save gallery link.', 'error');
        return false;
    }

    try {
        const board = await getFuraiConceptBoard();
        if (!board || typeof board.add !== 'function') {
            throw new Error('Concept Board is unavailable.');
        }

        const info = buildFuraiGalleryConceptBoardInfo({
            ...data,
            imageUrl,
            dataUrl: ''
        });

        await board.add(null, {
            folder: 'Gallery',
            info
        });

        furaiBoardBlink();
        showToast?.(`${info.title} link saved to Concept Board.`, 'success');
        return true;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Gallery Concept Board link save failed:', error);
        showToast?.('Could not save gallery link to Concept Board.', 'error');
        return false;
    }
}

window.saveFuraiGalleryPostToConceptBoard = saveFuraiGalleryPostToConceptBoard;


// =========================================================================
// CAPACITY-NATIVE SUMMARY: fullness, source input, and output room stay separate.
// =========================================================================
const FURAI_SUMMARY_TRIGGER_RATIO = 0.88, FURAI_SUMMARY_TARGET_RATIO = 0.68, FURAI_SUMMARY_COMPRESSION_RATIO = 0.5;
function buildFuraiSegmentSummaryPrompt(source = '') {
    return `Task: Summarize this chronological chat segment.
Rules:
1. Compress it to roughly half its original length.
2. Preserve key events, character actions, relationships, decisions, and important lore.
3. Keep it objective and information-dense. Do not recreate dialogue.
4. Output ONLY the summary paragraph.

Chat Segment:
${source}`;
}
function buildFuraiLayerSummaryPrompt(source = '') {
    return `Task: Combine and condense these chronological summaries into one cohesive master summary.
Rules:
1. Compress them to roughly half their total length.
2. Preserve chronology, character development, relationships, and world lore.
3. Output ONLY the master summary paragraph.

Summaries:
${source}`;
}
function getFuraiSummarySourceLimit(contextWindow = getFuraiContextWindow(), promptBuilder = buildFuraiSegmentSummaryPrompt) {
    contextWindow = Math.max(1, Number(contextWindow) || getFuraiContextWindow());
    const outputReserve = getFuraiReplyReserve(contextWindow);
    const inputCapacity = Math.max(1, contextWindow - outputReserve - getFuraiSafetyReserve(contextWindow) - estimateTokens(promptBuilder('')));
    const outputBound = Math.max(1, Math.floor(outputReserve / FURAI_SUMMARY_COMPRESSION_RATIO));
    return Math.max(1, Math.min(inputCapacity, outputBound));
}
function getFuraiSummaryModeScope(chatData, activeMode = chatData?.personality) {
    if (!chatData?.morph?.enabled) return '';
    const mode = String(activeMode || chatData.personality || 'researcher');
    return isFuraiNarrativeMode(mode) ? 'narrative' : mode;
}
function getFuraiSummaryBlockScope(chatData, block) {
    if (!chatData?.morph?.enabled) return '';
    const explicit = String(block?.modeScope || '').trim();
    if (explicit) return explicit;
    const originalMode = String(chatData.morph.originalMode || chatData.personality || 'researcher');
    return isFuraiNarrativeMode(originalMode) ? 'narrative' : originalMode;
}
function getFuraiScopedSummaryBlocks(chatData, activeMode = chatData?.personality) {
    const scope = getFuraiSummaryModeScope(chatData, activeMode);
    const blocks = Array.isArray(chatData?.summaryBlocks)
        ? chatData.summaryBlocks.filter(block => !block?.stale && String(block?.text || '').trim())
        : [];
    return chatData?.morph?.enabled
        ? blocks.filter(block => getFuraiSummaryBlockScope(chatData, block) === scope)
        : blocks;
}
function isFuraiMessageInSummaryScope(chatData, message, scope = getFuraiSummaryModeScope(chatData)) {
    if (!chatData?.morph?.enabled) return true;
    const mode = getFuraiMessageMode(chatData, message);
    return scope === 'narrative' ? isFuraiNarrativeMode(mode) : mode === scope;
}
function getFuraiSummaryAnchorIndex(chatData, messages = chatData?.messages || [], activeMode = chatData?.personality) {
    const fullMessages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : messages;
    if (typeof validateFuraiSummaryBlocks === 'function') validateFuraiSummaryBlocks(chatData, fullMessages);
    const blocks = getFuraiScopedSummaryBlocks(chatData, activeMode);
    const last = blocks[blocks.length - 1];
    if (!last) return -1;

    let index = last.endMessageUid ? messages.findIndex(message => message?.uid === last.endMessageUid) : -1;
    const canUseFallback = messages === fullMessages || !chatData?.morph?.enabled;
    const fallback = Number(last.endIndex);
    if (index === -1 && canUseFallback && Number.isInteger(fallback) && fallback >= 0 && fallback < messages.length) {
        index = fallback;
    }
    return index >= 0 && index < messages.length ? index : -1;
}
function getFuraiSummaryPrefix(chatData, activeMode = chatData?.personality) {
    const blocks = getFuraiScopedSummaryBlocks(chatData, activeMode);
    return blocks.length ? `[STORY SO FAR]\n${blocks.map(block => block.text.trim()).join('\n\n')}\n\n[RECENT EVENTS]\n` : '';
}
function getFuraiManualSummaryOverride(chatData) {
    return String(chatData?.manualSummaryOverride || '').trim();
}
function getFuraiAuthoritativeMemoryText(chatData) {
    const facts = String(chatData?.timelessFacts || chatData?.manualTimelessFacts || '').trim();
    const override = getFuraiManualSummaryOverride(chatData);
    const parts = [];
    if (facts) parts.push(facts);
    if (override) parts.push(`[USER SUMMARY OVERRIDE]\n${override}`);
    return parts.join('\n\n');
}
function getFuraiSummaryHistoryBudget(chatId, withoutSummary = false) {
    if (chatId === currentChatId) {
        const tokens = calculateContextTokens(), room = withoutSummary ? tokens.historyRoomWithoutSummary : tokens.historyRoom;
        return Math.max(1, Math.floor(room || 1));
    }
    const contextWindow = getFuraiContextWindow();
    const fit = getFuraiContextFitMeta(chatId);
    if (!withoutSummary && fit?.historyBudget > 0 && (!fit.contextWindow || fit.contextWindow === contextWindow)) return fit.historyBudget;
    const budget = getFuraiContextBudget();
    return Math.max(1, budget.usablePrompt - FURAI_CONTEXT_CORE_RESERVE);
}
function getFuraiSummaryMessageLine(msg, profile, chatId = currentChatId) {
    const actor = resolveFuraiActorForMessage(chatId, msg, profile);
    const modePrefix = msg?.mode && typeof getFuraiSwitchModeLabel === 'function'
        ? `[${getFuraiSwitchModeLabel(msg.mode)}] `
        : '';

    if (msg?.role === 'system') return `${modePrefix}${msg.content || ''}\n`;
    if (msg?.role === 'user') return `${modePrefix}${actor?.name || msg.userNameSnapshot || 'User'}: ${msg.content || ''}\n`;
    if (isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(msg?.role)) return `${modePrefix}${msg.content || ''}\n`;
    if (msg?.role === 'ai') return `${modePrefix}${actor?.name || msg.botNameSnapshot || 'AI'}: ${msg.content || ''}\n`;
    return `${modePrefix}${String(msg?.role || 'Event').toUpperCase()}: ${msg?.content || ''}\n`;
}
function getFuraiSummaryPlan(chatId, force = false) {
    const chatData = DB.get(chatId);
    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    if (typeof validateFuraiSummaryBlocks === 'function' && validateFuraiSummaryBlocks(chatData, messages)) {
        DB.set(chatId, chatData);
    }

    const memoryScope = getFuraiSummaryModeScope(chatData);
    // Workshops keep their own visible history and normal token-window behavior.
    // Automatic memory ingestion remains narrative-only, preventing work chatter
    // from ever returning to Group Chat or Story through a summary.
    if (chatData?.morph?.enabled && memoryScope !== 'narrative') return null;

    const scopedBlocks = getFuraiScopedSummaryBlocks(chatData);
    const hasStoredSummary = scopedBlocks.length > 0;
    const anchorIndex = getFuraiSummaryAnchorIndex(chatData, messages);
    const eligibleIndexes = [];

    for (let index = anchorIndex + 1; index < messages.length; index++) {
        const message = messages[index];
        if (
            !shouldSkipAiContextMessageRole(message?.role) &&
            isFuraiMessageInSummaryScope(chatData, message, memoryScope)
        ) {
            eligibleIndexes.push(index);
        }
    }

    if (!eligibleIndexes.length) return null;

    const historyBudget = getFuraiSummaryHistoryBudget(chatId);
    if (!force) {
        const fullHistoryBudget = getFuraiSummaryHistoryBudget(chatId, true);
        if (getFuraiFullHistoryTokenEstimate(chatId, messages, chatData) <= fullHistoryBudget) return null;
    }

    const profile = getChatProfile(chatId);
    const historyTokens = estimateTokens(
        eligibleIndexes.map(index => getFuraiSummaryMessageLine(messages[index], profile, chatId)).join('')
    );
    if (!force && historyTokens < Math.floor(historyBudget * FURAI_SUMMARY_TRIGGER_RATIO)) return null;

    const candidateIndexes = force
        ? eligibleIndexes
        : eligibleIndexes.slice(0, Math.max(0, eligibleIndexes.length - 4));
    if (!candidateIndexes.length) return null;

    const sourceLimit = getFuraiSummarySourceLimit();
    const targetTokens = Math.floor(historyBudget * FURAI_SUMMARY_TARGET_RATIO);
    const excessTokens = Math.max(1, historyTokens - targetTokens);
    const desiredSourceTokens = force
        ? sourceLimit
        : Math.ceil(excessTokens / Math.max(0.01, 1 - FURAI_SUMMARY_COMPRESSION_RATIO));
    const batchTarget = Math.min(sourceLimit, desiredSourceTokens);

    let startIndex = -1;
    let endIndex = -1;
    let sourceTokens = 0;

    for (const index of candidateIndexes) {
        const nextTokens = estimateTokens(getFuraiSummaryMessageLine(messages[index], profile, chatId));
        if (!sourceTokens && nextTokens > sourceLimit) return { blocked: true, sourceLimit };
        if (sourceTokens > 0 && sourceTokens + nextTokens > sourceLimit) break;
        if (startIndex < 0) startIndex = index;
        sourceTokens += nextTokens;
        endIndex = index;
        if (sourceTokens >= batchTarget) break;
    }

    if (startIndex < 0 || endIndex < startIndex || !sourceTokens) return null;

    return {
        chatData,
        messages,
        profile,
        startIndex,
        endIndex,
        sourceTokens,
        sourceLimit,
        historyTokens,
        historyBudget,
        targetTokens,
        memoryScope,
        sourceFingerprint: getFuraiSourceRangeFingerprint(messages, startIndex, endIndex),
        sourceStartUid: messages[startIndex]?.uid || '',
        sourceEndUid: messages[endIndex]?.uid || '',
        memoryRevision: Number(chatData.memoryRevision) || 0,
        replaceOrphanedSummary: hasStoredSummary && anchorIndex < 0
    };
}
function getFuraiMappedChatHistory(chatId, messages) {
    const chatData = DB.get(chatId) || {};
    const profile = getChatProfile(chatId);
    if (!profile) return [];
    const personality = chatPersonalities?.[chatId] || chatData.personality || 'researcher';
    const groupLike = personality === 'group' || personality === 'maker';
    const bot = profile.bots?.[0] || { name: 'AI' };
    const scopedMessages = typeof getFuraiModeScopedMessages === 'function'
        ? getFuraiModeScopedMessages(chatData, messages || [], personality)
        : (messages || []);
    return scopedMessages.filter(msg => !shouldSkipAiContextMessageRole(msg?.role))
        .map(msg => groupLike ? mapGroupContextMessage(msg, profile) : mapSoloContextMessage(msg, profile, bot)).filter(Boolean);
}
function estimateFuraiMappedHistoryTokens(mappedMessages) {
    return (mappedMessages || []).reduce((sum, msg) => sum + estimateTokens(`${msg}\n`), 0);
}
function clearFuraiFullHistoryEstimateCache(chatId = '') {
    if (chatId) furaiFullHistoryEstimateCache.delete(chatId);
    else furaiFullHistoryEstimateCache.clear();
    window.furaiFullHistoryTokenEstimateCache = null;
}

function getFuraiFullHistoryTokenEstimate(chatId, messages, providedChatData = null) {
    const chatData = providedChatData || DB.get(chatId) || {};
    const list = Array.isArray(messages) ? messages : [];
    const revision = Math.max(0, Number(chatData.memoryRevision) || 0);
    const personality = String(chatData.personality || chatPersonalities?.[chatId] || 'researcher');
    const lastUid = String(list[list.length - 1]?.uid || '');
    const cached = furaiFullHistoryEstimateCache.get(chatId);

    if (cached && cached.personality === personality) {
        if (cached.revision === revision && cached.messageCount === list.length && cached.lastUid === lastUid) {
            return cached.value;
        }

        const appendedCount = list.length - cached.messageCount;
        const prefixStillMatches = appendedCount > 0 &&
            String(list[cached.messageCount - 1]?.uid || '') === cached.lastUid;
        const onlyAppends = prefixStillMatches && revision - cached.revision === appendedCount;

        if (onlyAppends) {
            const appended = list.slice(cached.messageCount);
            const addedTokens = estimateFuraiMappedHistoryTokens(getFuraiMappedChatHistory(chatId, appended));
            const value = cached.value + addedTokens;
            furaiFullHistoryEstimateCache.delete(chatId);
            furaiFullHistoryEstimateCache.set(chatId, {
                personality,
                revision,
                messageCount: list.length,
                lastUid,
                value
            });
            return value;
        }
    }

    const value = estimateFuraiMappedHistoryTokens(getFuraiMappedChatHistory(chatId, list));
    furaiFullHistoryEstimateCache.delete(chatId);
    furaiFullHistoryEstimateCache.set(chatId, {
        personality,
        revision,
        messageCount: list.length,
        lastUid,
        value
    });
    while (furaiFullHistoryEstimateCache.size > FURAI_FULL_HISTORY_ESTIMATE_CACHE_MAX) {
        furaiFullHistoryEstimateCache.delete(furaiFullHistoryEstimateCache.keys().next().value);
    }
    return value;
}
function canFuraiHistoryFitWithoutSummary(mappedMessages, promptWithoutHistory) {
    return estimateFuraiMappedHistoryTokens(mappedMessages) <= getFuraiRemainingHistoryTokens(promptWithoutHistory, '');
}

// =========================================================================
// FURAI MEMORY MODES + DEEP MEMORY V2 — v36 PRIME PREMIUM PLUS
// Standard Summary remains the default and never loads the semantic subsystem.
// Deep Memory combines source-linked hierarchy, exact-term precision, and its
// consent-gated on-device recall engine in a Worker.
// Mode checks are constant-time; both runtime indexes are bounded and disposable.
// =========================================================================
const FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_STANDARD = 'standard';
const FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP = 'deep';
const FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_DB_NAME = 'FurAI_DeepMemory';
const FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_DB_VERSION = 2;
const FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_SCHEMA_VERSION = 3;
const FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_KEEP_RECENT_MESSAGES = 4;
const FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_BATCH_TARGET_TOKENS = 1400;
const FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_BATCH_MIN_TOKENS = 700;
const FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_BATCH_MAX_TOKENS = 2200;
const FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_MIN_BATCH_MESSAGES = 6;
const FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_MAX_BATCH_MESSAGES = 32;
const FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_ARC_SEGMENT_COUNT = 8;
const FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_MAX_RECORDS_PER_CHAT = 1200;
const FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_MAX_MEMORY_RECORDS = 900;
const FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_MAX_SEGMENT_RECORDS = 240;
const FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_MAX_ARC_RECORDS = 80;
const FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_CONTEXT_TOKEN_CAP = 420;
const FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_MAX_AUTO_RETRIES = 5;
const FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_MIRROR_PREFIX = 'furai_memory_mode:';
const FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_CACHE_MAX = 256;
const FURAI_DEEP_RUNTIME_INDEX_BUILD_CHUNK = 120;
const FURAI_DEEP_RUNTIME_INDEX_IDLE_MS = 2 * 60 * 1000;
const FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_SOURCE_MODES = new Set(['researcher', 'prompter', 'group', 'story', 'maker']);

function normalizeFuraiDeepMemorySourceMode(mode, fallback = '') {
    const value = String(mode || '').trim();
    if (FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_SOURCE_MODES.has(value)) return value;
    const fallbackValue = String(fallback || '').trim();
    return FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_SOURCE_MODES.has(fallbackValue) ? fallbackValue : '';
}

function getFuraiDeepMemoryMessageSourceMode(chatData, message) {
    return normalizeFuraiDeepMemorySourceMode(
        getFuraiMessageMode(chatData, message),
        chatData?.morph?.originalMode || chatData?.personality || 'researcher'
    );
}

function addFuraiDeepMemoryModeRange(target, mode, startIndex = 0, endIndex = Infinity) {
    const normalized = normalizeFuraiDeepMemorySourceMode(mode);
    if (!normalized) return;

    const start = Math.max(0, Number(startIndex) || 0);
    const numericEnd = Number(endIndex);
    const end = Number.isFinite(numericEnd)
        ? Math.max(start, Math.floor(numericEnd))
        : Infinity;
    const exactModes = isFuraiNarrativeMode(normalized)
        ? ['story', 'group']
        : [normalized];

    exactModes.forEach(exactMode => {
        const ranges = target.get(exactMode) || [];
        if (!ranges.some(range => range.startIndex === start && range.endIndex === end)) {
            ranges.push({ startIndex: start, endIndex: end });
            target.set(exactMode, ranges);
        }
    });
}

function addFuraiLegacyBridgeModeRanges(target, chatData, messages, bridgeMessageUids) {
    const selectedIds = new Set(
        (bridgeMessageUids || [])
            .map(value => String(value || '').trim())
            .filter(Boolean)
    );
    if (!selectedIds.size) return;

    let runMode = '';
    let runStart = -1;
    let runEnd = -1;
    const flush = () => {
        if (runMode && runStart >= 0 && runEnd >= runStart) {
            addFuraiDeepMemoryModeRange(target, runMode, runStart, runEnd);
        }
        runMode = '';
        runStart = -1;
        runEnd = -1;
    };

    messages.forEach((message, index) => {
        if (!message || shouldSkipAiContextMessageRole(message.role)) return;
        const uid = String(message.uid || '').trim();
        const mode = getFuraiDeepMemoryMessageSourceMode(chatData, message);
        if (!selectedIds.has(uid) || !mode) {
            flush();
            return;
        }
        if (runMode !== mode) {
            flush();
            runMode = mode;
            runStart = index;
        }
        runEnd = index;
    });
    flush();
}

function getFuraiDeepMemoryModeAccess(chatData, activeMode = chatData?.personality) {
    const normalizedActiveMode = normalizeFuraiDeepMemorySourceMode(
        activeMode,
        chatData?.personality || chatData?.morph?.originalMode || 'researcher'
    );
    const access = new Map();
    addFuraiDeepMemoryModeRange(access, normalizedActiveMode);

    if (!chatData?.morph?.enabled || !normalizedActiveMode || isFuraiNarrativeMode(normalizedActiveMode)) {
        return access;
    }

    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    const state = chatData.morph.modeStates?.[normalizedActiveMode] || {};
    addFuraiLegacyBridgeModeRanges(access, chatData, messages, state.bridgeMessageUids);

    // A workshop bridge is valid only through its saved source boundary. Merely
    // retaining a sourceMode string must never unlock later or unrelated history.
    const bridge = state.bridge && typeof state.bridge === 'object' ? state.bridge : null;
    const bridgeSourceMode = normalizeFuraiDeepMemorySourceMode(bridge?.sourceMode);
    const boundaryUid = String(bridge?.throughMessageUid || '').trim();
    const savedBoundaryIndex = Number(bridge?.throughMessageIndex);
    const boundaryIndex = Number.isInteger(savedBoundaryIndex) &&
        savedBoundaryIndex >= 0 &&
        savedBoundaryIndex < messages.length &&
        String(messages[savedBoundaryIndex]?.uid || '') === boundaryUid
            ? savedBoundaryIndex
            : (boundaryUid
                ? messages.findIndex(message => String(message?.uid || '') === boundaryUid)
                : -1);

    if (bridgeSourceMode && boundaryIndex >= 0) {
        const boundaryMode = getFuraiDeepMemoryMessageSourceMode(chatData, messages[boundaryIndex]);
        const boundaryMatchesSource = isFuraiNarrativeMode(bridgeSourceMode)
            ? isFuraiNarrativeMode(boundaryMode)
            : boundaryMode === bridgeSourceMode;
        if (boundaryMatchesSource) {
            addFuraiDeepMemoryModeRange(access, bridgeSourceMode, 0, boundaryIndex);
        }
    }

    return access;
}

function isFuraiDeepMemoryRecordModeAccessible(record, modeAccess) {
    const mode = normalizeFuraiDeepMemorySourceMode(record?.sourceMode);
    const startIndex = Number(record?.sourceStartIndex);
    const endIndex = Number(record?.sourceEndIndex);
    if (!mode || !Number.isInteger(startIndex) || !Number.isInteger(endIndex)) return false;

    return (modeAccess?.get(mode) || []).some(range =>
        startIndex >= range.startIndex && endIndex <= range.endIndex
    );
}

function getFuraiDeepMemoryModeAccessCacheKey(modeAccess) {
    return [...(modeAccess || new Map()).entries()]
        .sort(([left], [right]) => left.localeCompare(right))
        .map(([mode, ranges]) => `${mode}:${ranges
            .map(range => `${range.startIndex}-${Number.isFinite(range.endIndex) ? range.endIndex : '*'}`)
            .sort()
            .join(',')}`)
        .join('|');
}

function getFuraiDeepMemoryRecordModeKey(record) {
    return record?.legacyNarrativeMixed === true
        ? 'story+group:legacy'
        : normalizeFuraiDeepMemorySourceMode(record?.sourceMode);
}

function getFuraiDeepMemorySegmentGroupKey(record) {
    return `${String(record?.branchId || 'main')}\u0000${getFuraiDeepMemoryRecordModeKey(record)}`;
}

function resolveFuraiDeepMemoryRecordSourceMode(record, chatData, messageIndexByUid = null) {
    const explicit = normalizeFuraiDeepMemorySourceMode(record?.sourceMode);
    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    if (!messages.length) {
        return {
            sourceMode: explicit,
            legacyNarrativeMixed: explicit ? record?.legacyNarrativeMixed === true : false
        };
    }

    let startIndex = Number(record?.sourceStartIndex);
    let endIndex = Number(record?.sourceEndIndex);
    const startUid = String(record?.sourceStartUid || '').trim();
    const endUid = String(record?.sourceEndUid || '').trim();

    const findMessageIndex = uid => {
        if (!uid) return -1;
        if (messageIndexByUid instanceof Map) {
            const indexed = messageIndexByUid.get(uid);
            return Number.isInteger(indexed) ? indexed : -1;
        }
        return messages.findIndex(message => String(message?.uid || '') === uid);
    };

    if (startUid) {
        const found = findMessageIndex(startUid);
        if (found === -1) return { sourceMode: '', legacyNarrativeMixed: false };
        startIndex = found;
    }
    if (endUid) {
        const found = findMessageIndex(endUid);
        if (found === -1) return { sourceMode: '', legacyNarrativeMixed: false };
        endIndex = found;
    }

    if (
        !Number.isInteger(startIndex) ||
        !Number.isInteger(endIndex) ||
        startIndex < 0 ||
        endIndex < startIndex ||
        endIndex >= messages.length
    ) return { sourceMode: '', legacyNarrativeMixed: false };

    const expectedFingerprint = String(record?.sourceFingerprint || '').trim();
    if (
        expectedFingerprint &&
        getFuraiSourceRangeFingerprint(messages, startIndex, endIndex) !== expectedFingerprint
    ) {
        return { sourceMode: '', legacyNarrativeMixed: false };
    }

    const modes = [];
    const modeSet = new Set();
    for (let index = startIndex; index <= endIndex; index++) {
        const message = messages[index];
        if (!message || shouldSkipAiContextMessageRole(message.role)) continue;
        const mode = getFuraiDeepMemoryMessageSourceMode(chatData, message);
        if (!mode) return { sourceMode: '', legacyNarrativeMixed: false };
        if (!modeSet.has(mode)) {
            modeSet.add(mode);
            modes.push(mode);
        }
    }

    if (modes.length === 1) {
        return { sourceMode: modes[0], legacyNarrativeMixed: false };
    }
    if (modes.length > 1 && modes.every(isFuraiNarrativeMode)) {
        return { sourceMode: modes[0], legacyNarrativeMixed: true };
    }
    if (!modes.length && !chatData?.morph?.enabled) {
        return {
            sourceMode: normalizeFuraiDeepMemorySourceMode(chatData?.personality, 'researcher'),
            legacyNarrativeMixed: false
        };
    }
    return { sourceMode: '', legacyNarrativeMixed: false };
}

function markFuraiForegroundActivity() {
    furaiLastForegroundActivityAt = Date.now();
}

function markFuraiContinuousForegroundActivity() {
    if (furaiContinuousActivityRaf) return;

    // Record the first event immediately, then collapse the rest of this frame.
    furaiLastForegroundActivityAt = Date.now();
    furaiContinuousActivityRaf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        furaiContinuousActivityRaf = 0;
    });
}

function isFuraiForegroundRecentlyActive(quietMs = 1000) {
    return !document.hidden && (Date.now() - furaiLastForegroundActivityAt) < quietMs;
}

function bindFuraiForegroundActivityTracking() {
    if (window.furaiForegroundActivityTrackingBound) return;
    window.furaiForegroundActivityTrackingBound = true;

    const passiveCapture = { capture: true, passive: true };
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', markFuraiForegroundActivity, passiveCapture);
    document.addEventListener('wheel', markFuraiContinuousForegroundActivity, passiveCapture);
    document.addEventListener('scroll', markFuraiContinuousForegroundActivity, passiveCapture);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', markFuraiForegroundActivity, true);
    document.addEventListener('input', markFuraiForegroundActivity, true);
}

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', bindFuraiForegroundActivityTracking, { once: true });
} else {
    bindFuraiForegroundActivityTracking();
}

const furaiFullHistoryEstimateCache = new Map();

function getFuraiDeepMemoryRunToken(chatId) {
    return `${furaiDeepMemoryGlobalEpoch}:${furaiDeepMemoryChatEpochs.get(chatId) || 0}`;
}

function bumpFuraiDeepMemoryChatEpoch(chatId) {
    if (!chatId) return;
    furaiDeepMemoryChatEpochs.set(chatId, (furaiDeepMemoryChatEpochs.get(chatId) || 0) + 1);

    const controller = furaiDeepMemoryAbortControllers.get(chatId);
    if (controller && !controller.signal.aborted) controller.abort();
    furaiDeepMemoryAbortControllers.delete(chatId);
}

function isFuraiDeepMemoryRunCurrent(chatId, token) {
    return token === getFuraiDeepMemoryRunToken(chatId);
}

function normalizeFuraiMemoryMode(value) {
    return value === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP
        ? FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP
        : FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_STANDARD;
}

function getFuraiMemoryModeMirrorKey(chatId) {
    return `${FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_MIRROR_PREFIX}${chatId}`;
}

function cacheFuraiMemoryMode(chatId, value, options = {}) {
    if (!chatId) return FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_STANDARD;
    const mode = normalizeFuraiMemoryMode(value);
    furaiMemoryModeCache.delete(chatId);
    furaiMemoryModeCache.set(chatId, mode);
    while (furaiMemoryModeCache.size > FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_CACHE_MAX) {
        furaiMemoryModeCache.delete(furaiMemoryModeCache.keys().next().value);
    }
    if (options.persist !== false) {
        try {
            const key = getFuraiMemoryModeMirrorKey(chatId);
            if (localStorage.getItem(key) !== mode) localStorage.setItem(key, mode);
        } catch (error) {}
    }
    return mode;
}

function clearFuraiMemoryModeCache(chatId = '', options = {}) {
    if (chatId) {
        furaiMemoryModeCache.delete(chatId);
        if (options.removeMirror !== false) {
            try { localStorage.removeItem(getFuraiMemoryModeMirrorKey(chatId)); } catch (error) {}
        }
        return;
    }
    furaiMemoryModeCache.clear();
    if (options.removeMirror === false) return;
    try {
        for (let i = localStorage.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            const key = localStorage.key(i);
            if (key?.startsWith(FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_MIRROR_PREFIX)) localStorage.removeItem(key);
        }
    } catch (error) {}
}

function getFuraiMemoryMode(chatId = currentChatId, chatData = null) {
    if (!chatId) return FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_STANDARD;

    if (chatData && (chatData.memoryMode === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_STANDARD || chatData.memoryMode === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP)) {
        return cacheFuraiMemoryMode(chatId, chatData.memoryMode);
    }

    if (furaiMemoryModeCache.has(chatId)) return furaiMemoryModeCache.get(chatId);

    try {
        const mirrored = localStorage.getItem(getFuraiMemoryModeMirrorKey(chatId));
        if (mirrored === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_STANDARD || mirrored === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP) {
            return cacheFuraiMemoryMode(chatId, mirrored, { persist: false });
        }
    } catch (error) {}

    // Legacy chats pay one full read once. Chat loading/default initialization then
    // keeps all normal mode checks constant-time for the rest of the session.
    const data = DB.get(chatId) || {};
    if (data.memoryMode === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_STANDARD || data.memoryMode === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP) {
        return cacheFuraiMemoryMode(chatId, data.memoryMode);
    }

    const personality = chatPersonalities?.[chatId] || data.personality || 'researcher';
    return cacheFuraiMemoryMode(chatId, DB.get(`global_memory_mode_${personality}`));
}

function isFuraiDeepMemoryEnabled(chatId = currentChatId, chatData = null) {
    return getFuraiMemoryMode(chatId, chatData) === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP;
}

function ensureFuraiChatMemoryDefaults(chatData, personality = chatData?.personality || 'researcher') {
    if (!chatData || personality === 'home') return false;

    let changed = false;
    if (chatData.memoryMode !== FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_STANDARD && chatData.memoryMode !== FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP) {
        chatData.memoryMode = normalizeFuraiMemoryMode(DB.get(`global_memory_mode_${personality}`));
        changed = true;
    }

    if (chatData.autoSummary === undefined) {
        chatData.autoSummary = chatData.memoryMode === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP
            ? true
            : DB.get(`global_auto_summary_${personality}`) !== false;
        changed = true;
    } else if (chatData.memoryMode === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP && chatData.autoSummary !== true) {
        chatData.autoSummary = true;
        changed = true;
    }

    if (chatData.id) cacheFuraiMemoryMode(chatData.id, chatData.memoryMode);
    return changed;
}

function furaiHashString(value = '') {
    const text = String(value || '');
    let hash = 2166136261;
    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
        hash ^= text.charCodeAt(i);
        hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619);
    }
    return (hash >>> 0).toString(36);
}

function getFuraiMessageRevision(message) {
    const revision = Number(message?.revision);
    return Number.isInteger(revision) && revision > 0 ? revision : 1;
}

function getFuraiActiveVariantId(message) {
    if (!message || message.role !== 'ai' || !Array.isArray(message.variants) || !message.variants.length) return '';
    const index = typeof getSafeMessageVariantIndex === 'function'
        ? getSafeMessageVariantIndex(message)
        : Math.max(0, Math.min(message.variants.length - 1, Number(message.activeVariantIndex) || 0));
    return String(message.variants[index]?.id || index);
}

function bumpFuraiMessageRevision(message) {
    if (!message) return 0;
    const next = getFuraiMessageRevision(message) + 1;
    message.revision = next;
    if (!message.branchId) message.branchId = 'main';
    return next;
}

function getFuraiMessageSourceSignature(message, index = -1) {
    if (!message) return `${index}:missing`;
    return [
        index,
        message.uid || '',
        getFuraiMessageRevision(message),
        message.branchId || 'main',
        getFuraiActiveVariantId(message),
        message.role || '',
        furaiHashString(getAiMessageContentText(message) || message.content || '')
    ].join('|');
}

function getFuraiSourceRangeFingerprint(messages, startIndex, endIndex) {
    const list = Array.isArray(messages) ? messages : [];
    const start = Math.max(0, Number(startIndex) || 0);
    const end = Math.min(list.length - 1, Number(endIndex));
    if (end < start) return '';

    let signature = '';
    for (let i = start; i <= end; i++) {
        signature += `${getFuraiMessageSourceSignature(list[i], i)}\n`;
    }
    return furaiHashString(signature);
}

function getFuraiSummaryBlockRange(block, messages, fallbackStartIndex = 0) {
    const list = Array.isArray(messages) ? messages : [];
    let startIndex = Number(block?.startIndex);
    let endIndex = -1;

    if (!Number.isInteger(startIndex) || startIndex < 0 || startIndex >= list.length) {
        startIndex = Math.max(0, fallbackStartIndex);
    }

    if (block?.startMessageUid) {
        const uidIndex = list.findIndex(message => message?.uid === block.startMessageUid);
        if (uidIndex !== -1) startIndex = uidIndex;
    }

    if (block?.endMessageUid) {
        endIndex = list.findIndex(message => message?.uid === block.endMessageUid);
    }

    if (endIndex === -1) {
        const fallbackEnd = Number(block?.endIndex);
        if (Number.isInteger(fallbackEnd) && fallbackEnd >= 0 && fallbackEnd < list.length) endIndex = fallbackEnd;
    }

    return { startIndex, endIndex };
}

function migrateFuraiLegacyManualSummaryOverride(chatData) {
    if (!chatData || !Array.isArray(chatData.summaryBlocks)) return false;
    const legacyManualBlocks = chatData.summaryBlocks
        .filter(block => block?.manual === true && String(block?.text || '').trim());
    if (!legacyManualBlocks.length) return false;

    if (!getFuraiManualSummaryOverride(chatData)) {
        chatData.manualSummaryOverride = legacyManualBlocks
            .map(block => String(block.text || '').trim())
            .filter(Boolean)
            .join('\n\n');
    }
    chatData.summaryBlocks = chatData.summaryBlocks.filter(block => block?.manual !== true);
    return true;
}

function validateFuraiSummaryBlocks(chatData, messages = chatData?.messages || []) {
    let changed = migrateFuraiLegacyManualSummaryOverride(chatData);
    const blocks = Array.isArray(chatData?.summaryBlocks) ? chatData.summaryBlocks : [];
    if (!blocks.length) return changed;

    let previousEnd = -1;

    for (const block of blocks) {
        const range = getFuraiSummaryBlockRange(block, messages, previousEnd + 1);
        previousEnd = Math.max(previousEnd, range.endIndex);

        if (range.endIndex < range.startIndex || range.endIndex < 0) {
            if (!block.stale) {
                block.stale = true;
                block.staleReason = 'source_missing';
                changed = true;
            }
            continue;
        }

        if (block.sourceFingerprint) {
            const liveFingerprint = getFuraiSourceRangeFingerprint(messages, range.startIndex, range.endIndex);
            if (liveFingerprint !== block.sourceFingerprint && !block.stale) {
                block.stale = true;
                block.staleReason = 'source_changed';
                changed = true;
            }
        }
    }

    return changed;
}

function invalidateFuraiSummaryFromIndex(chatData, affectedIndex, reason = 'message_changed') {
    if (!chatData || !Array.isArray(chatData.summaryBlocks) || !chatData.summaryBlocks.length) return false;

    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    const index = Math.max(0, Number(affectedIndex) || 0);
    let previousEnd = -1;
    let changed = false;

    for (const block of chatData.summaryBlocks) {
        const range = getFuraiSummaryBlockRange(block, messages, previousEnd + 1);
        previousEnd = Math.max(previousEnd, range.endIndex);
        if (range.endIndex >= index && !block.stale) {
            block.stale = true;
            block.staleReason = reason;
            changed = true;
        }
    }

    if (changed) {
        chatData.summaryInvalidatedAt = Date.now();
        chatData.summaryInvalidatedFromIndex = index;
    }
    return changed;
}

function applyFuraiMessageMutationToChatData(chatData, affectedIndex, kind = 'append') {
    if (!chatData) return;
    chatData.memoryRevision = Math.max(0, Number(chatData.memoryRevision) || 0) + 1;
    chatData.memorySchemaVersion = FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_SCHEMA_VERSION;
