    if (kind !== 'append') {
        invalidateFuraiSummaryFromIndex(chatData, affectedIndex, kind);
        pruneFuraiDeepMemoryUserAuthorityFromIndex(chatData, affectedIndex);

        // Deep Memory must remain completely dormant while Standard Summary is active.
        // Record only a tiny source-range marker in the chat blob; the separate Deep DB
        // is not opened until the user enables Deep Memory again.
        if (chatData.deepMemoryInitialized && normalizeFuraiMemoryMode(chatData.memoryMode) !== FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP) {
            const index = Math.max(0, Number(affectedIndex) || 0);
            const previous = Number(chatData.deepMemoryPendingInvalidationFromIndex);
            chatData.deepMemoryPendingInvalidationFromIndex = Number.isFinite(previous)
                ? Math.min(previous, index)
                : index;
            chatData.deepMemoryPendingInvalidationReason = kind;
        }
    }
}

function openFuraiDeepMemoryDb() {
    if (furaiDeepMemoryDbPromise) return furaiDeepMemoryDbPromise;

    furaiDeepMemoryDbPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        if (!window.indexedDB) {
            reject(new Error('IndexedDB is unavailable.'));
            return;
        }

        const request = indexedDB.open(FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_DB_NAME, FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_DB_VERSION);

        request.onupgradeneeded = event => {
            const db = event.target.result;

            if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains('records')) {
                const records = db.createObjectStore('records', { keyPath: 'id' });
                records.createIndex('chatId', 'chatId', { unique: false });
                records.createIndex('chatKind', ['chatId', 'kind'], { unique: false });
            }

            if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains('meta')) {
                db.createObjectStore('meta', { keyPath: 'chatId' });
            }

            if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains('vectors')) {
                const vectors = db.createObjectStore('vectors', { keyPath: 'id' });
                vectors.createIndex('chatId', 'chatId', { unique: false });
                vectors.createIndex('chatModel', ['chatId', 'modelName'], { unique: false });
            }
        };

        let settled = false;
        request.onsuccess = () => {
            const db = request.result;
            if (settled) {
                db.close();
                return;
            }
            settled = true;
            db.onversionchange = () => {
                db.close();
                furaiDeepMemoryDbPromise = null;
            };
            resolve(db);
        };
        request.onerror = () => {
            if (settled) return;
            settled = true;
            reject(request.error || new Error('Could not open Deep Memory storage.'));
        };
        request.onblocked = () => {
            if (settled) return;
            settled = true;
            reject(new Error('Deep Memory storage is open in another FurAI tab. Close that tab and retry.'));
        };
    }).catch(error => {
        furaiDeepMemoryDbPromise = null;
        throw error;
    });

    return furaiDeepMemoryDbPromise;
}

function furaiIdbRequest(request) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error || new Error('Deep Memory storage request failed.'));
    });
}

function furaiIdbTransactionDone(transaction, errorMessage) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve();
        transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error || new Error(errorMessage));
        transaction.onabort = () => reject(transaction.error || new Error(errorMessage));
    });
}

async function getFuraiDeepMemoryMeta(chatId) {
    const db = await openFuraiDeepMemoryDb();
    const tx = db.transaction('meta', 'readonly');
    return (await furaiIdbRequest(tx.objectStore('meta').get(chatId))) || null;
}

async function putFuraiDeepMemoryMeta(meta) {
    const db = await openFuraiDeepMemoryDb();
    const tx = db.transaction('meta', 'readwrite');
    const txDone = furaiIdbTransactionDone(tx, 'Could not save Deep Memory status.');
    await furaiIdbRequest(tx.objectStore('meta').put(meta));
    await txDone;
    return meta;
}

async function getFuraiDeepMemoryRecords(chatId) {
    const db = await openFuraiDeepMemoryDb();
    const tx = db.transaction('records', 'readonly');
    return await furaiIdbRequest(tx.objectStore('records').index('chatId').getAll(IDBKeyRange.only(chatId)));
}

async function getFuraiDeepMemoryRecordCounts(chatId) {
    const db = await openFuraiDeepMemoryDb();
    const tx = db.transaction('records', 'readonly');
    const index = tx.objectStore('records').index('chatKind');
    const kinds = ['memory', 'segment', 'arc'];
    const values = await Promise.all(kinds.map(kind => furaiIdbRequest(index.count(IDBKeyRange.only([chatId, kind])))));
    return { memory: values[0] || 0, segment: values[1] || 0, arc: values[2] || 0 };
}

async function getFuraiDeepMemoryRecordsByKinds(chatId, kinds = []) {
    const requestedKinds = [...new Set((Array.isArray(kinds) ? kinds : [kinds])
        .map(kind => String(kind || '').trim())
        .filter(Boolean))];
    if (!chatId || !requestedKinds.length) return [];

    const db = await openFuraiDeepMemoryDb();
    const tx = db.transaction('records', 'readonly');
    const index = tx.objectStore('records').index('chatKind');
    const groups = await Promise.all(requestedKinds.map(kind =>
        furaiIdbRequest(index.getAll(IDBKeyRange.only([chatId, kind])))
    ));
    return groups.flat();
}

async function getFuraiDeepMemoryRecordDirect(chatId, recordId) {
    const db = await openFuraiDeepMemoryDb();
    const tx = db.transaction('records', 'readonly');
    const record = await furaiIdbRequest(tx.objectStore('records').get(recordId));
    return record?.chatId === chatId ? record : null;
}

const furaiDeepMemoryModeSchemaJobs = new Map();
const furaiDeepMemoryModeSchemaReadyChats = new Set();

async function ensureFuraiDeepMemoryModeSchema(chatId, providedChatData = null, providedMeta = null) {
    if (!chatId) return providedMeta || null;
    if (furaiDeepMemoryModeSchemaReadyChats.has(chatId)) return providedMeta || await getFuraiDeepMemoryMeta(chatId);
    if (furaiDeepMemoryModeSchemaJobs.has(chatId)) return furaiDeepMemoryModeSchemaJobs.get(chatId);

    const runToken = getFuraiDeepMemoryRunToken(chatId);
    const job = (async () => {
        const chatData = providedChatData || DB.get(chatId) || {};
        const records = await getFuraiDeepMemoryRecords(chatId);
        const meta = providedMeta || await getFuraiDeepMemoryMeta(chatId);
        if (!isFuraiDeepMemoryRunCurrent(chatId, runToken)) return meta || null;

        const previousSchemaVersion = Number(meta?.schemaVersion) || 0;
        const needsReplay = !!chatData?.morph?.enabled && previousSchemaVersion < FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_SCHEMA_VERSION;
        const resolvedModes = new Map();
        const resolvedLegacyMixed = new Map();
        const messageIndexByUid = new Map();
        (Array.isArray(chatData.messages) ? chatData.messages : []).forEach((message, index) => {
            const uid = String(message?.uid || '').trim();
            if (uid && !messageIndexByUid.has(uid)) messageIndexByUid.set(uid, index);
        });
        const updates = [];
        const deleteIds = new Set();

        const nonArcRecords = records.filter(record => record?.kind !== 'arc');
        const arcRecords = records.filter(record => record?.kind === 'arc');

        for (const record of nonArcRecords) {
            const resolved = resolveFuraiDeepMemoryRecordSourceMode(record, chatData, messageIndexByUid);
            if (!resolved.sourceMode) {
                deleteIds.add(record.id);
                continue;
            }
            resolvedModes.set(record.id, resolved.sourceMode);
            resolvedLegacyMixed.set(record.id, resolved.legacyNarrativeMixed === true);
            if (
                record.sourceMode !== resolved.sourceMode ||
                (record.legacyNarrativeMixed === true) !== (resolved.legacyNarrativeMixed === true) ||
                Number(record.schemaVersion) !== FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_SCHEMA_VERSION
            ) {
                updates.push({
                    ...record,
                    sourceMode: resolved.sourceMode,
                    legacyNarrativeMixed: resolved.legacyNarrativeMixed === true,
                    schemaVersion: FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_SCHEMA_VERSION,
                    updatedAt: Date.now()
                });
            }
        }

        for (const record of arcRecords) {
            const childSegmentIds = [...new Set(
                (record.childSegmentIds || [])
                    .map(id => String(id || '').trim())
                    .filter(Boolean)
            )];
            const childModeList = childSegmentIds.map(id => resolvedModes.get(id)).filter(Boolean);
            const childModes = new Set(childModeList);
            const allChildrenResolved = childSegmentIds.length > 0 && childModeList.length === childSegmentIds.length;
            const allChildrenNarrative = allChildrenResolved && childModeList.every(isFuraiNarrativeMode);
            const sourceMode = allChildrenResolved && (childModes.size === 1 || allChildrenNarrative)
                ? childModeList[0]
                : '';
            const legacyNarrativeMixed = !!sourceMode && (
                childModes.size > 1 ||
                childSegmentIds.some(id => resolvedLegacyMixed.get(id) === true)
            );

            if (!sourceMode) {
                deleteIds.add(record.id);
                continue;
            }
            resolvedModes.set(record.id, sourceMode);
            resolvedLegacyMixed.set(record.id, legacyNarrativeMixed);
            if (
                record.sourceMode !== sourceMode ||
                (record.legacyNarrativeMixed === true) !== legacyNarrativeMixed ||
                Number(record.schemaVersion) !== FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_SCHEMA_VERSION
            ) {
                updates.push({
                    ...record,
                    sourceMode,
                    legacyNarrativeMixed,
                    schemaVersion: FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_SCHEMA_VERSION,
                    updatedAt: Date.now()
                });
            }
        }

        const hasMetaWork = !!meta || records.length > 0;
        const needsMetaUpdate = hasMetaWork && (
            previousSchemaVersion !== FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_SCHEMA_VERSION ||
            needsReplay ||
            deleteIds.size > 0
        );
        const nextMeta = needsMetaUpdate
            ? {
                ...(meta || {}),
                chatId,
                schemaVersion: FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_SCHEMA_VERSION,
                nextIndex: needsReplay ? 0 : Math.max(0, Number(meta?.nextIndex) || 0),
                status: needsReplay || deleteIds.size ? 'stale' : (meta?.status || 'waiting'),
                staleReason: needsReplay || deleteIds.size ? 'mode_schema_upgrade' : meta?.staleReason,
                errorCount: 0,
                updatedAt: Date.now()
            }
            : meta || null;

        if (!isFuraiDeepMemoryRunCurrent(chatId, runToken)) return meta || null;

        if (updates.length || deleteIds.size || needsMetaUpdate) {
            const db = await openFuraiDeepMemoryDb();
            const tx = db.transaction(['records', 'meta', 'vectors'], 'readwrite');
            const txDone = furaiIdbTransactionDone(tx, 'Could not upgrade Deep Memory mode indexing.');
            const recordStore = tx.objectStore('records');
            const vectorStore = tx.objectStore('vectors');

            updates.forEach(record => recordStore.put(record));
            deleteIds.forEach(id => {
                recordStore.delete(id);
                vectorStore.delete(getFuraiSemanticVectorId(id));
            });
            if (needsMetaUpdate && nextMeta) tx.objectStore('meta').put(nextMeta);
            await txDone;

            releaseFuraiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex(chatId);
            if (nextMeta) furaiDeepMemoryStatusCache.set(chatId, nextMeta);
        }

        if (!isFuraiDeepMemoryRunCurrent(chatId, runToken)) return nextMeta;
        furaiDeepMemoryModeSchemaReadyChats.add(chatId);
        return nextMeta;
    })().finally(() => furaiDeepMemoryModeSchemaJobs.delete(chatId));

    furaiDeepMemoryModeSchemaJobs.set(chatId, job);
    return job;
}

function getFuraiDeepMemoryUserAuthority(chatData, create = false) {
    if (!chatData) return null;
    const current = chatData.deepMemoryUserAuthority;
    if (current && typeof current === 'object' && !Array.isArray(current)) {
        if (!current.entries || typeof current.entries !== 'object' || Array.isArray(current.entries)) current.entries = {};
        if (!current.version) current.version = 1;
        return current;
    }
    if (!create) return null;
    chatData.deepMemoryUserAuthority = { version: 1, entries: {} };
    return chatData.deepMemoryUserAuthority;
}

function remapFuraiDeepMemoryAuthorityForNewChat(chatData, sourceChatId, targetChatId) {
    if (!chatData || !sourceChatId || !targetChatId || sourceChatId === targetChatId) return chatData;
    const authority = getFuraiDeepMemoryUserAuthority(chatData, false);
    if (!authority) return chatData;

    const remapId = value => {
        const id = String(value || '');
        const marker = `:${sourceChatId}:`;
        return id.includes(marker) ? id.replace(marker, `:${targetChatId}:`) : id;
    };

    const nextEntries = {};
    for (const [entryKey, rawEntry] of Object.entries(authority.entries || {})) {
        if (!rawEntry || typeof rawEntry !== 'object') continue;
        const entry = { ...rawEntry };
        const sourceRecordId = remapId(entry.sourceRecordId || entryKey);
        entry.sourceRecordId = sourceRecordId;

        if (entry.record && typeof entry.record === 'object') {
            entry.record = {
                ...entry.record,
                id: remapId(entry.record.id || sourceRecordId),
                chatId: targetChatId
            };
            if (Array.isArray(entry.record.childSegmentIds)) {
                entry.record.childSegmentIds = entry.record.childSegmentIds.map(remapId);
            }
        }

        nextEntries[sourceRecordId] = entry;
    }

    authority.entries = nextEntries;
    return chatData;
}

function getFuraiDeepMemoryAuthorityMatch(record, originalTextHash = '') {
    return {
        kind: String(record?.kind || ''),
        type: String(record?.type || ''),
        sourceFingerprint: String(record?.sourceFingerprint || ''),
        sourceStartUid: String(record?.sourceStartUid || ''),
        sourceEndUid: String(record?.sourceEndUid || ''),
        sourceStartIndex: Number(record?.sourceStartIndex) || 0,
        sourceEndIndex: Number(record?.sourceEndIndex) || 0,
        originalTextHash: originalTextHash || furaiHashString(normalizeFuraiDeepMemoryText(record?.text || ''))
    };
}

function doesFuraiDeepMemoryAuthorityMatch(entry, record) {
    if (!entry || !record) return false;
    if (entry.sourceRecordId === record.id) return true;
    const match = entry.match || {};
    if (!match.sourceFingerprint || match.sourceFingerprint !== String(record.sourceFingerprint || '')) return false;
    if (match.kind && match.kind !== String(record.kind || '')) return false;
    if (match.type && match.type !== String(record.type || '')) return false;
    const textHash = furaiHashString(normalizeFuraiDeepMemoryText(record.text || ''));
    return !match.originalTextHash || match.originalTextHash === textHash;
}

function findFuraiDeepMemoryAuthorityEntry(chatData, record) {
    const authority = getFuraiDeepMemoryUserAuthority(chatData, false);
    if (!authority) return null;
    const exact = authority.entries?.[record?.id];
    if (exact) return exact;
    return Object.values(authority.entries || {}).find(entry => doesFuraiDeepMemoryAuthorityMatch(entry, record)) || null;
}

function applyFuraiDeepMemoryUserAuthority(chatId, records) {
    const list = Array.isArray(records) ? records : [];
    if (!chatId || !list.length) return list;
    const chatData = DB.get(chatId) || {};
    const output = [];
    for (const record of list) {
        const entry = findFuraiDeepMemoryAuthorityEntry(chatData, record);
        if (entry?.action === 'delete') continue;
        if (entry?.action === 'override' && entry.record) {
            const saved = entry.record;
            output.push({
                ...record,
                text: String(saved.text || record.text || ''),
                normalizedText: normalizeFuraiDeepMemoryText(saved.text || record.text || ''),
                keywords: Array.isArray(saved.keywords) ? [...saved.keywords] : record.keywords,
                entities: Array.isArray(saved.entities) ? [...saved.entities] : record.entities,
                importance: Math.max(0.1, Math.min(1, Number(saved.importance) || Number(record.importance) || 0.5)),
                userEdited: saved.userEdited === true,
                userImportant: saved.userImportant === true,
                importanceBeforeUser: saved.importanceBeforeUser,
                updatedAt: Math.max(Number(saved.updatedAt) || 0, Number(record.updatedAt) || 0)
            });
            continue;
        }
        output.push(record);
    }
    return output;
}

function saveFuraiDeepMemoryUserAuthority(chatId, record, action = 'override', options = {}) {
    if (!chatId || !record?.id) return false;
    const chatData = DB.get(chatId) || {};
    const authority = getFuraiDeepMemoryUserAuthority(chatData, true);
    const originalTextHash = String(options.originalTextHash || record.userOriginalTextHash || '');
    authority.entries[record.id] = {
        action: action === 'delete' ? 'delete' : 'override',
        sourceRecordId: record.id,
        match: getFuraiDeepMemoryAuthorityMatch(record, originalTextHash),
        record: action === 'delete' ? null : {
            ...record,
            userOriginalTextHash: originalTextHash || furaiHashString(normalizeFuraiDeepMemoryText(record.text || ''))
        },
        updatedAt: Date.now()
    };
    DB.set(chatId, chatData);
    return true;
}

function isFuraiDeepMemoryAuthoritySourceCurrent(chatData, entry) {
    if (!entry?.record || entry.record.kind === 'arc') return true;
    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    const match = entry.match || {};
    if (!messages.length || !match.sourceFingerprint) return false;

    let startIndex = Number(match.sourceStartIndex);
    let endIndex = Number(match.sourceEndIndex);
    if (match.sourceStartUid) {
        const found = messages.findIndex(message => message?.uid === match.sourceStartUid);
        if (found !== -1) startIndex = found;
    }
    if (match.sourceEndUid) {
        const found = messages.findIndex(message => message?.uid === match.sourceEndUid);
        if (found !== -1) endIndex = found;
    }
    if (!Number.isInteger(startIndex) || !Number.isInteger(endIndex) || startIndex < 0 || endIndex < startIndex || endIndex >= messages.length) {
        return false;
    }
    return getFuraiSourceRangeFingerprint(messages, startIndex, endIndex) === match.sourceFingerprint;
}

function pruneFuraiDeepMemoryUserAuthorityFromIndex(chatData, affectedIndex) {
    const authority = getFuraiDeepMemoryUserAuthority(chatData, false);
    if (!authority) return false;
    const index = Math.max(0, Number(affectedIndex) || 0);
    let changed = false;
    for (const [key, entry] of Object.entries(authority.entries || {})) {
        const endIndex = Number(entry?.match?.sourceEndIndex);
        if (Number.isFinite(endIndex) && endIndex >= index) {
            delete authority.entries[key];
            changed = true;
        }
    }
    if (changed && !Object.keys(authority.entries).length) delete chatData.deepMemoryUserAuthority;
    return changed;
}

async function restoreFuraiDeepMemoryUserAuthority(chatId) {
    if (!chatId || furaiDeepMemoryAuthorityHydratedChats.has(chatId)) return 0;
    const chatData = DB.get(chatId) || {};
    const authority = getFuraiDeepMemoryUserAuthority(chatData, false);
    let authorityChanged = false;
    const records = [];
    for (const [key, entry] of Object.entries(authority?.entries || {})) {
        if (!isFuraiDeepMemoryAuthoritySourceCurrent(chatData, entry)) {
            delete authority.entries[key];
            authorityChanged = true;
            continue;
        }
        if (entry?.action === 'override' && entry.record) {
            records.push({ ...entry.record, chatId, status: 'active' });
        }
    }
    if (authorityChanged) {
        if (!Object.keys(authority.entries || {}).length) delete chatData.deepMemoryUserAuthority;
        DB.set(chatId, chatData);
    }
    if (!records.length) {
        furaiDeepMemoryAuthorityHydratedChats.add(chatId);
        return 0;
    }

    // Restored authority records may come from an older record schema. Do not let
    // an in-flight migration finish from an older snapshot and mark them as ready.
    const activeModeSchemaJob = furaiDeepMemoryModeSchemaJobs.get(chatId);
    if (activeModeSchemaJob) await activeModeSchemaJob.catch(() => {});
    furaiDeepMemoryModeSchemaReadyChats.delete(chatId);
    const db = await openFuraiDeepMemoryDb();
    const tx = db.transaction('records', 'readwrite');
    const done = furaiIdbTransactionDone(tx, 'Could not restore corrected Deep Memory records.');
    const store = tx.objectStore('records');
    records.forEach(record => store.put(record));
    await done;
    furaiDeepMemoryAuthorityHydratedChats.add(chatId);
    releaseFuraiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex(chatId);
    return records.length;
}

function readFuraiSemanticFlag(key) {
    try { return localStorage.getItem(key) === 'true'; } catch (error) { return false; }
}

function writeFuraiSemanticFlag(key, value) {
    try {
        if (value) localStorage.setItem(key, 'true');
        else localStorage.removeItem(key);
    } catch (error) {}
}

function hasFuraiSemanticRecallConsent() {
    return readFuraiSemanticFlag(FURAI_SEMANTIC_CONSENT_KEY);
}

function hasFuraiSemanticRecallBeenOffered() {
    return readFuraiSemanticFlag(FURAI_SEMANTIC_PROMPTED_KEY);
}

// Deep Memory is one complete engine. The on-device model, exact-term recall,
// episode archive, and story-arc recall are enabled together after consent.
function isFuraiSemanticRecallEnabled(chatId = currentChatId, chatData = null) {
    return hasFuraiSemanticRecallConsent() &&
        Boolean(chatId) &&
        chatId === currentChatId &&
        isFuraiDeepMemoryEnabled(chatId, chatData);
}

function isFuraiSemanticCrashProneBrowser() {
    const userAgent = String(navigator?.userAgent || '');
    const likelySafariWebKit = /^((?!chrome|android).)*safari/i.test(userAgent);
    const coarsePointer = Boolean(window.matchMedia?.('(pointer: coarse)')?.matches);
    const compactDevice = Number(window.innerWidth) > 0 && Number(window.innerWidth) < 1100;
    // Matches the safeguard used by ACC for older mobile Safari/WebKit builds
    // known to crash while initializing Transformers.js.
    return !window.OffscreenCanvas && likelySafariWebKit && coarsePointer && compactDevice;
}

function canFuraiSemanticRecallRun() {
    return Boolean(
        window.Worker &&
        window.indexedDB &&
        window.WebAssembly &&
        window.Float32Array &&
        !isFuraiSemanticCrashProneBrowser()
    );
}

function setFuraiSemanticStatus(state, message = '', progress = 0) {
    furaiSemanticStatus = {
        state: String(state || 'off'),
        message: String(message || ''),
        progress: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(progress) || 0))
    };
    renderFuraiSemanticRecallUi();
}

function renderFuraiSemanticRecallUi() {
    if (!currentChatId || !isFuraiDeepMemoryEnabled(currentChatId)) return;

    const statusEl = document.getElementById('furaiDeepMemoryStatusText');
    const progressEl = document.getElementById('furaiDeepMemoryProgress');
    if (!statusEl) return;

    if (!hasFuraiSemanticRecallConsent()) {
        statusEl.textContent = 'Deep Memory permission is required';
        if (progressEl) progressEl.textContent = '';
        return;
    }

    const state = furaiSemanticStatus.state;
    if (state === 'loading' || state === 'indexing') {
        statusEl.textContent = furaiSemanticStatus.message || 'Preparing Deep Memory…';
        return;
    }

    if (state === 'error') {
        statusEl.textContent = 'Deep Memory needs attention — use Refresh';
        if (progressEl) progressEl.textContent = '';
        return;
    }

    if (state === 'unsupported') {
        statusEl.textContent = 'Deep Memory is unavailable in this browser';
        if (progressEl) progressEl.textContent = '';
    }
}

function setFuraiSemanticPendingActivation(activation = null) {
    furaiSemanticPendingActivation = activation && typeof activation === 'object'
        ? { ...activation }
        : null;
}

function openFuraiSemanticConsentModal(activation = null) {
    if (activation) setFuraiSemanticPendingActivation(activation);
    writeFuraiSemanticFlag(FURAI_SEMANTIC_PROMPTED_KEY, true);
    const modal = document.getElementById('furaiSemanticConsentModal');
    if (modal) modal.style.display = 'flex';
}

function closeFuraiSemanticConsentModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('furaiSemanticConsentModal');
    if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
}

function requestFuraiGlobalMemoryMode(requestedMode) {
    const mode = normalizeFuraiMemoryMode(
        typeof requestedMode === 'string' ? requestedMode : requestedMode?.value
    );

    if (mode === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP && !canFuraiSemanticRecallRun()) {
        syncFuraiGlobalMemoryModeControls(FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_STANDARD);
        setFuraiSemanticStatus('unsupported');
        showToast?.('Deep Memory is unavailable in this browser.', 'error');
        return;
    }

    if (mode === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP && !hasFuraiSemanticRecallConsent()) {
        syncFuraiGlobalMemoryModeControls(FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_STANDARD);
        openFuraiSemanticConsentModal({ type: 'global-select', elementId: 'globalMemoryModeValue' });
        return;
    }

    syncFuraiGlobalMemoryModeControls(mode);
}

function declineFuraiSemanticRecall() {
    const pending = furaiSemanticPendingActivation;
    setFuraiSemanticPendingActivation(null);
    closeFuraiSemanticConsentModal();

    if (pending?.type === 'global-select') {
        const select = document.getElementById(pending.elementId || 'globalMemoryModeValue');
        if (select) select.value = FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_STANDARD;
        syncFuraiGlobalMemoryModeControls(FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_STANDARD);
    } else if (pending?.type === 'chat' && pending.chatId) {
        const chatData = DB.get(pending.chatId) || {};
        const personality = chatData.personality || chatPersonalities?.[pending.chatId] || 'researcher';
        if (normalizeFuraiMemoryMode(DB.get(`global_memory_mode_${personality}`)) === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP) {
            DB.set(`global_memory_mode_${personality}`, FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_STANDARD);
        }
        if (pending.chatId === currentChatId) renderFuraiMemoryModeUi(FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_STANDARD);
    }

    setFuraiSemanticStatus(canFuraiSemanticRecallRun() ? 'off' : 'unsupported');
}

async function acceptFuraiSemanticRecall() {
    const pending = furaiSemanticPendingActivation;
    setFuraiSemanticPendingActivation(null);
    closeFuraiSemanticConsentModal();

    if (!canFuraiSemanticRecallRun()) {
        if (pending?.type === 'global-select') {
            const select = document.getElementById(pending.elementId || 'globalMemoryModeValue');
            if (select) select.value = FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_STANDARD;
            syncFuraiGlobalMemoryModeControls(FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_STANDARD);
        }
        setFuraiSemanticStatus('unsupported');
        showToast?.('Deep Memory is unavailable in this browser. Standard Summary remains active.', 'error');
        return;
    }

    writeFuraiSemanticFlag(FURAI_SEMANTIC_CONSENT_KEY, true);
    writeFuraiSemanticFlag(FURAI_SEMANTIC_PROMPTED_KEY, true);
    writeFuraiSemanticFlag(FURAI_SEMANTIC_LEGACY_ENABLED_KEY, false);

    if (pending?.type === 'global-select') {
        const select = document.getElementById(pending.elementId || 'globalMemoryModeValue');
        if (select) select.value = FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP;
        syncFuraiGlobalMemoryModeControls(FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP);
    } else if (pending?.type === 'chat' && pending.chatId) {
        applyFuraiMemoryMode(pending.chatId, FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP, { silent: true });
    }

    renderFuraiSemanticRecallUi();
    const activeDeepChat = Boolean(currentChatId && isFuraiDeepMemoryEnabled(currentChatId));
    if (pending?.silent !== true) {
        showToast?.(
            activeDeepChat
                ? 'Deep Memory enabled. Preparing older memories…'
                : 'Deep Memory will prepare when a Deep Memory chat opens.',
            'success'
        );
    }

    try {
        if (activeDeepChat) {
            await ensureFuraiSemanticEngine();
            scheduleFuraiSemanticIndexing(currentChatId, { delay: 50 });
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.warn('Deep Memory setup failed:', error);
        if (activeDeepChat) {
            void refreshFuraiDeepMemoryPanel(currentChatId);
            showToast?.('Deep Memory needs attention. Open Memory and use Refresh.', 'error');
        }
    }
}

function retryFuraiSemanticRecall() {
    if (!currentChatId || !isFuraiSemanticRecallEnabled(currentChatId)) return;
    disposeFuraiSemanticEngine({ preserveConsent: true });
    void ensureFuraiSemanticEngine().then(() => {
        if (currentChatId && isFuraiDeepMemoryEnabled(currentChatId)) {
            scheduleFuraiSemanticIndexing(currentChatId, { delay: 50 });
        }
    }).catch(error => console.warn('Deep Memory retry failed:', error));
}

function createFuraiSemanticWorkerSource() {
    return `
let extractor = null;
let loadingPromise = null;
let activeVectorChatId = '';
const vectorIndex = new Map();
const queue = [];
const cancelled = new Set();
let queueSequence = 0;
let processing = false;
let activeJobId = '';

const safeProgress = info => {
  try {
    self.postMessage({
      type: 'model-progress',
      status: String(info?.status || ''),
      file: String(info?.file || info?.name || ''),
      progress: Number(info?.progress) || 0,
      loaded: Number(info?.loaded) || 0,
      total: Number(info?.total) || 0
    });
  } catch (error) {}
};

async function loadModel(modelName) {
  if (extractor) return true;
  if (loadingPromise) return loadingPromise;
  loadingPromise = (async () => {
    const { pipeline, env } = await import('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@xenova/transformers@2.17.1');
    env.allowLocalModels = false;
    env.useBrowserCache = true;
    extractor = await pipeline('feature-extraction', modelName, {
      quantized: true,
      progress_callback: safeProgress
    });
    await extractor('warm up', { pooling: 'mean', normalize: true });
    return true;
  })();
  try { return await loadingPromise; }
  catch (error) { loadingPromise = null; throw error; }
}

async function embedOne(text, modelName) {
  await loadModel(modelName);
  const output = await extractor(String(text || ''), { pooling: 'mean', normalize: true });
  return new Float32Array(output.data);
}

function dotVectors(a, b) {
  const length = Math.min(a?.length || 0, b?.length || 0);
  let sum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) sum += a[i] * b[i];
  return sum;
}

function enqueue(job) {
  queue.push({ ...job, sequence: ++queueSequence });
  queue.sort((a, b) => Number(b.priority || 0) - Number(a.priority || 0) || a.sequence - b.sequence);
  void drainQueue();
}

async function runJob(job) {
  const { id, type, modelName } = job;
  if (type === 'load') {
    await loadModel(modelName);
    self.postMessage({ id, ok: true, result: true });
    return;
  }
  if (type === 'embed') {
    const texts = Array.isArray(job.texts) ? job.texts : [];
    const vectors = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < texts.length; i++) {
      if (cancelled.has(id)) throw new Error('Semantic operation cancelled.');
      vectors.push(await embedOne(texts[i], modelName));
      if (cancelled.has(id)) throw new Error('Semantic operation cancelled.');
    }
    self.postMessage({ id, ok: true, result: vectors }, vectors.map(vector => vector.buffer));
    return;
  }
  if (type === 'set-index') {
    activeVectorChatId = String(job.chatId || '');
    vectorIndex.clear();
    for (const entry of Array.isArray(job.entries) ? job.entries : []) {
      const vector = entry?.vector instanceof Float32Array ? entry.vector : new Float32Array(entry?.vector || []);
      if (entry?.recordId && vector.length) vectorIndex.set(String(entry.recordId), vector);
    }
    self.postMessage({ id, ok: true, result: vectorIndex.size });
    return;
  }
  if (type === 'upsert-index') {
    if (String(job.chatId || '') !== activeVectorChatId) {
      activeVectorChatId = String(job.chatId || '');
      vectorIndex.clear();
    }
    for (const entry of Array.isArray(job.entries) ? job.entries : []) {
      const vector = entry?.vector instanceof Float32Array ? entry.vector : new Float32Array(entry?.vector || []);
      if (entry?.recordId && vector.length) vectorIndex.set(String(entry.recordId), vector);
    }
    self.postMessage({ id, ok: true, result: vectorIndex.size });
    return;
  }
  if (type === 'remove-index') {
    for (const recordId of Array.isArray(job.recordIds) ? job.recordIds : []) vectorIndex.delete(String(recordId));
    self.postMessage({ id, ok: true, result: vectorIndex.size });
    return;
  }
  if (type === 'clear-index') {
    activeVectorChatId = '';
    vectorIndex.clear();
    self.postMessage({ id, ok: true, result: true });
    return;
  }
  if (type === 'query-score') {
    if (String(job.chatId || '') !== activeVectorChatId) {
      self.postMessage({ id, ok: true, result: [] });
      return;
    }
    const queryVector = await embedOne(job.text, modelName);
    if (cancelled.has(id)) throw new Error('Semantic operation cancelled.');
    const allowed = Array.isArray(job.allowedIds) ? job.allowedIds : [...vectorIndex.keys()];
    const threshold = Number(job.minSimilarity) || 0.43;
    const topK = Math.max(1, Number(job.topK) || 80);
    const scored = [];
    for (const recordId of allowed) {
      const vector = vectorIndex.get(String(recordId));
      if (!vector) continue;
      const similarity = dotVectors(queryVector, vector);
      if (similarity >= threshold) scored.push({ recordId: String(recordId), similarity });
    }
    scored.sort((a, b) => b.similarity - a.similarity);
    self.postMessage({ id, ok: true, result: scored.slice(0, topK) });
    return;
  }
  throw new Error('Unknown semantic worker request.');
}

async function drainQueue() {
  if (processing) return;
  processing = true;
  while (queue.length) {
    const job = queue.shift();
    if (cancelled.delete(job.id)) continue;
    activeJobId = job.id;
    try {
      await runJob(job);
    } catch (error) {
      self.postMessage({ id: job.id, ok: false, error: String(error?.message || error || 'Semantic worker failed.') });
    } finally {
      cancelled.delete(job.id);
      activeJobId = '';
    }
  }
  processing = false;
}

self.onmessage = event => {
  const job = event.data || {};
  if (job.type === 'cancel') {
    const targetId = String(job.targetId || '');
    if (targetId === activeJobId) {
      cancelled.add(targetId);
    } else {
      let removed = false;
      for (let i = queue.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (queue[i].id === targetId) {
          queue.splice(i, 1);
          removed = true;
        }
      }
      cancelled.delete(targetId);
      if (removed) self.postMessage({ id: targetId, ok: false, error: 'Semantic operation cancelled.' });
    }
    return;
  }
  enqueue(job);
};`;
}

function handleFuraiSemanticWorkerMessage(event) {
    const data = event.data || {};
    if (data.type === 'model-progress') {
        const now = typeof performance !== 'undefined' ? performance.now() : Date.now();
        if (now - furaiSemanticLastProgressUiAt < 200) return;
        furaiSemanticLastProgressUiAt = now;
        const stage = String(data.status || '').toLowerCase();
        const message = stage.includes('download') ? 'Downloading Deep Memory…' : 'Preparing Deep Memory…';
        setFuraiSemanticStatus('loading', message);
        return;
    }
    const pending = furaiSemanticWorkerRequests.get(data.id);
    if (!pending) return;
    furaiSemanticWorkerRequests.delete(data.id);
    clearTimeout(pending.timer);
    if (data.ok) pending.resolve(data.result);
    else pending.reject(new Error(data.error || 'Semantic worker failed.'));
}

function requestFuraiSemanticWorker(type, payload = {}, timeoutMs = 180000, options = {}) {
    if (!furaiSemanticWorker) return Promise.reject(new Error('Semantic worker is not available.'));
    const id = `sem-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${(++furaiSemanticWorkerRequestId).toString(36)}`;
    const promise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
            furaiSemanticWorkerRequests.delete(id);
            try { furaiSemanticWorker?.postMessage({ type: 'cancel', targetId: id }); } catch (error) {}
            reject(new Error(type === 'load' ? 'Semantic model setup timed out.' : 'Semantic operation timed out.'));
        }, timeoutMs);
        furaiSemanticWorkerRequests.set(id, { resolve, reject, timer, type });
        const message = {
            id,
            type,
            priority: Number(options.priority) || 0,
            modelName: FURAI_SEMANTIC_MODEL_NAME,
            ...payload
        };
        furaiSemanticWorker.postMessage(message, Array.isArray(options.transfer) ? options.transfer : []);
    });
    promise.furaiRequestId = id;
    return promise;
}

function cancelFuraiSemanticWorkerRequest(requestId, reason = 'Semantic operation cancelled.') {
    const id = String(requestId || '');
    if (!id) return false;
    const pending = furaiSemanticWorkerRequests.get(id);
    if (pending) {
        furaiSemanticWorkerRequests.delete(id);
        clearTimeout(pending.timer);
        pending.reject(new Error(reason));
    }
    try { furaiSemanticWorker?.postMessage({ type: 'cancel', targetId: id }); } catch (error) {}
    return Boolean(pending);
}

function readFuraiSemanticRuntimeLock() {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(FURAI_SEMANTIC_RUNTIME_LOCK_KEY) || 'null'); }
    catch (error) { return null; }
}

function refreshFuraiSemanticRuntimeLock() {
    try {
        localStorage.setItem(FURAI_SEMANTIC_RUNTIME_LOCK_KEY, JSON.stringify({
            owner: furaiSemanticRuntimeOwnerId,
            expiresAt: Date.now() + 30000
        }));
    } catch (error) {}
}

function acquireFuraiSemanticRuntimeLock() {
    const current = readFuraiSemanticRuntimeLock();
    if (current?.owner && current.owner !== furaiSemanticRuntimeOwnerId && Number(current.expiresAt) > Date.now()) {
        throw new Error('Semantic Recall is active in another FurAI tab. Close that tab or retry after it is inactive.');
    }
    refreshFuraiSemanticRuntimeLock();
    const verified = readFuraiSemanticRuntimeLock();
    if (verified?.owner !== furaiSemanticRuntimeOwnerId) {
        throw new Error('Another FurAI tab acquired the local semantic model first.');
    }
    if (furaiSemanticRuntimeLockTimer) clearInterval(furaiSemanticRuntimeLockTimer);
    furaiSemanticRuntimeLockTimer = setInterval(refreshFuraiSemanticRuntimeLock, 10000);
}

function releaseFuraiSemanticRuntimeLock() {
    if (furaiSemanticRuntimeLockTimer) clearInterval(furaiSemanticRuntimeLockTimer);
    furaiSemanticRuntimeLockTimer = null;
    try {
        const current = readFuraiSemanticRuntimeLock();
        if (current?.owner === furaiSemanticRuntimeOwnerId) localStorage.removeItem(FURAI_SEMANTIC_RUNTIME_LOCK_KEY);
    } catch (error) {}
}

window.addEventListener('pagehide', releaseFuraiSemanticRuntimeLock);

function cancelFuraiSemanticWorkerIdleRelease() {
    if (furaiSemanticWorkerIdleTimer) clearTimeout(furaiSemanticWorkerIdleTimer);
    furaiSemanticWorkerIdleTimer = null;
}

function scheduleFuraiSemanticWorkerIdleRelease(delay = 250, options = {}) {
    cancelFuraiSemanticWorkerIdleRelease();
    if (!furaiSemanticWorker) return;
    const allowActiveDeep = options.allowActiveDeep === true;

    furaiSemanticWorkerIdleTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        furaiSemanticWorkerIdleTimer = null;
        const busy = Boolean(
            furaiSemanticWorkerRequests.size ||
            furaiSemanticForegroundQuery ||
            furaiSemanticIndexingChatId ||
            furaiSemanticIndexTimer
        );
        if (busy) {
            scheduleFuraiSemanticWorkerIdleRelease(60000, { allowActiveDeep });
            return;
        }
        if (!allowActiveDeep && currentChatId && isFuraiDeepMemoryEnabled(currentChatId)) return;
        disposeFuraiSemanticEngine({ preserveConsent: true });
    }, Math.max(0, Number(delay) || 0));
}

function disposeFuraiSemanticEngine(options = {}) {
    furaiSemanticEpoch++;
    cancelFuraiSemanticWorkerIdleRelease();
    if (furaiSemanticIndexTimer) clearTimeout(furaiSemanticIndexTimer);
    furaiSemanticIndexTimer = null;
    furaiSemanticIndexingChatId = '';
    furaiSemanticForegroundQuery = null;
    furaiSemanticWorkerRequests.forEach(pending => {
        clearTimeout(pending.timer);
        pending.reject(new Error('Semantic engine was reset.'));
    });
    furaiSemanticWorkerRequests.clear();
    if (furaiSemanticWorker) furaiSemanticWorker.terminate();
    furaiSemanticWorker = null;
    furaiSemanticWorkerReadyPromise = null;
    if (furaiSemanticWorkerUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(furaiSemanticWorkerUrl);
    furaiSemanticWorkerUrl = '';
    furaiSemanticQueryCache.clear();
    releaseFuraiSemanticRuntimeIndex();
    releaseFuraiSemanticRuntimeLock();
    if (!options.preserveConsent) writeFuraiSemanticFlag(FURAI_SEMANTIC_CONSENT_KEY, false);
    setFuraiSemanticStatus('off');
}

async function ensureFuraiSemanticEngine(chatId = currentChatId) {
    if (!isFuraiSemanticRecallEnabled(chatId)) return false;
    cancelFuraiSemanticWorkerIdleRelease();
    if (!canFuraiSemanticRecallRun()) {
        setFuraiSemanticStatus('unsupported');
        throw new Error('This browser cannot run the local semantic model.');
    }
    if (furaiSemanticWorkerReadyPromise) return furaiSemanticWorkerReadyPromise;

    acquireFuraiSemanticRuntimeLock();
    setFuraiSemanticStatus('loading', 'Preparing Deep Memory…');
    const blob = new Blob([createFuraiSemanticWorkerSource()], { type: 'text/javascript' });
    furaiSemanticWorkerUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    furaiSemanticWorker = new Worker(furaiSemanticWorkerUrl);
    furaiSemanticWorker.onmessage = handleFuraiSemanticWorkerMessage;
    furaiSemanticWorker.onerror = event => {
        const error = new Error(event?.message || 'Semantic worker crashed.');
        furaiSemanticWorkerRequests.forEach(pending => {
            clearTimeout(pending.timer);
            pending.reject(error);
        });
        furaiSemanticWorkerRequests.clear();
        furaiSemanticWorker?.terminate();
        furaiSemanticWorker = null;
        furaiSemanticWorkerReadyPromise = null;
        if (furaiSemanticWorkerUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(furaiSemanticWorkerUrl);
        furaiSemanticWorkerUrl = '';
        furaiSemanticQueryCache.clear();
        furaiSemanticRuntimeIndex = null;
        releaseFuraiSemanticRuntimeLock();
        setFuraiSemanticStatus('error', error.message);
    };

    furaiSemanticWorkerReadyPromise = requestFuraiSemanticWorker('load', {}, 180000, { priority: 1000 })
        .then(() => {
            setFuraiSemanticStatus('ready');
            return true;
        })
        .catch(error => {
            const message = String(error?.message || error || 'Local semantic model failed to load.');
            furaiSemanticWorker?.terminate();
            furaiSemanticWorker = null;
            furaiSemanticWorkerReadyPromise = null;
            if (furaiSemanticWorkerUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(furaiSemanticWorkerUrl);
            furaiSemanticWorkerUrl = '';
            furaiSemanticQueryCache.clear();
            furaiSemanticRuntimeIndex = null;
            releaseFuraiSemanticRuntimeLock();
            setFuraiSemanticStatus('error', message);
            throw error;
        });
    return furaiSemanticWorkerReadyPromise;
}

function getFuraiSemanticVectorId(recordId) {
    return `${recordId}::${FURAI_SEMANTIC_MODEL_NAME}`;
}

function buildFuraiSemanticRecordText(record) {
    return [
        record?.kind === 'arc' ? 'Past story arc' : (record?.kind === 'segment' ? 'Past episode' : String(record?.type || 'memory').replaceAll('_', ' ')),
        String(record?.text || '').trim(),
        (record?.entities || []).length ? `Entities: ${(record.entities || []).join(', ')}` : '',
        (record?.keywords || []).length ? `Keywords: ${(record.keywords || []).join(', ')}` : ''
    ].filter(Boolean).join('\n').slice(0, 2200);
}

function getFuraiSemanticRecordTextHash(record) {
    return furaiHashString(`${FURAI_SEMANTIC_MODEL_NAME}\n${buildFuraiSemanticRecordText(record)}`);
}

function getFuraiSemanticIntentText(queryText = '') {
    const lines = String(queryText || '')
        .split(/\n+/)
        .map(line => line.trim())
        .filter(Boolean);
    return String(lines[lines.length - 1] || '').slice(0, 1200);
}

async function getFuraiSemanticVectors(chatId) {
    const db = await openFuraiDeepMemoryDb();
    const tx = db.transaction('vectors', 'readonly');
    return await furaiIdbRequest(tx.objectStore('vectors').index('chatModel').getAll(IDBKeyRange.only([chatId, FURAI_SEMANTIC_MODEL_NAME])));
}

async function countFuraiSemanticVectors(chatId) {
    const db = await openFuraiDeepMemoryDb();
    const tx = db.transaction('vectors', 'readonly');
    return await furaiIdbRequest(tx.objectStore('vectors').index('chatModel').count(IDBKeyRange.only([chatId, FURAI_SEMANTIC_MODEL_NAME])));
}

async function putFuraiSemanticVectors(entries) {
    if (!Array.isArray(entries) || !entries.length) return;
    const db = await openFuraiDeepMemoryDb();
    const tx = db.transaction('vectors', 'readwrite');
    const done = furaiIdbTransactionDone(tx, 'Could not save semantic vectors.');
    const store = tx.objectStore('vectors');
    entries.forEach(entry => store.put(entry));
    try {
        await done;
    } catch (error) {
        if (error?.name === 'QuotaExceededError' || /quota|storage/i.test(String(error?.message || error))) {
            throw new Error('Browser storage is full. Free site storage, then retry Deep Memory.');
        }
        throw error;
    }

    furaiSemanticQueryCache.clear();
    const chatId = entries[0].chatId;
    if (furaiSemanticRuntimeIndex?.chatId === chatId) {
        const workerEntries = [];
        const transfers = [];
        for (const entry of entries) {
            furaiSemanticRuntimeIndex.byRecordId.set(entry.recordId, {
                recordId: entry.recordId,
                textHash: entry.textHash,
                dimensions: entry.dimensions,
                updatedAt: entry.updatedAt
            });
            const vector = entry.vector instanceof Float32Array ? entry.vector : new Float32Array(entry.vector || []);
            if (vector.length) {
                workerEntries.push({ recordId: entry.recordId, vector });
                transfers.push(vector.buffer);
            }
        }
        if (workerEntries.length && furaiSemanticWorker) {
            try {
                await requestFuraiSemanticWorker('upsert-index', {
                    chatId,
                    entries: workerEntries
                }, 30000, { priority: 40, transfer: transfers });
            } catch (error) {
                releaseFuraiSemanticRuntimeIndex(chatId);
                throw error;
            }
        }
    }
}

async function deleteFuraiSemanticVectorIds(recordIds) {
    const ids = [...new Set((recordIds || []).map(id => String(id || '')).filter(Boolean))];
    if (!ids.length) return;
    const db = await openFuraiDeepMemoryDb();
    const tx = db.transaction('vectors', 'readwrite');
    const done = furaiIdbTransactionDone(tx, 'Could not remove semantic vectors.');
    const store = tx.objectStore('vectors');
    ids.forEach(recordId => store.delete(getFuraiSemanticVectorId(recordId)));
    await done;
    furaiSemanticQueryCache.clear();
    if (furaiSemanticRuntimeIndex) ids.forEach(recordId => furaiSemanticRuntimeIndex.byRecordId.delete(recordId));
    if (furaiSemanticWorker) {
        void requestFuraiSemanticWorker('remove-index', { recordIds: ids }, 15000, { priority: 80 }).catch(() => {});
    }
}

function releaseFuraiSemanticRuntimeIndex(chatId = '') {
    if (chatId && furaiSemanticRuntimeIndex?.chatId !== chatId) return;
    furaiSemanticRuntimeIndex = null;
    furaiSemanticQueryCache.clear();
    if (furaiSemanticWorker) {
        void requestFuraiSemanticWorker('clear-index', {}, 15000, { priority: 90 }).catch(() => {});
    }
}

async function getFuraiSemanticRuntimeIndex(chatId, lexicalIndex = null) {
    if (furaiSemanticRuntimeIndex?.chatId === chatId) return furaiSemanticRuntimeIndex;
    await ensureFuraiSemanticEngine(chatId);
    const recordsIndex = lexicalIndex || await getFuraiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex(chatId);
    const vectors = await getFuraiSemanticVectors(chatId);
    const byRecordId = new Map();
    const workerEntries = [];
    const transfers = [];

    for (const entry of vectors) {
        const record = recordsIndex.byId.get(entry.recordId)?.record;
        if (!record || record.status !== 'active') continue;
        if (entry.textHash !== getFuraiSemanticRecordTextHash(record)) continue;
        const vector = entry.vector instanceof Float32Array ? entry.vector : new Float32Array(entry.vector || []);
        if (!vector.length) continue;
        byRecordId.set(entry.recordId, {
            recordId: entry.recordId,
            textHash: entry.textHash,
            dimensions: vector.length,
            updatedAt: entry.updatedAt
        });
        workerEntries.push({ recordId: entry.recordId, vector });
        transfers.push(vector.buffer);
    }

    const pendingRecordIds = [];
    for (const { record } of recordsIndex.byId.values()) {
        if (record.status !== 'active') continue;
        const existing = byRecordId.get(record.id);
        if (!existing || existing.textHash !== getFuraiSemanticRecordTextHash(record)) pendingRecordIds.push(record.id);
    }

    await requestFuraiSemanticWorker('set-index', {
        chatId,
        entries: workerEntries
    }, 60000, { priority: 70, transfer: transfers });

    furaiSemanticRuntimeIndex = {
        chatId,
        byRecordId,
        pendingRecordIds,
        targetCount: byRecordId.size + pendingRecordIds.length,
        createdAt: Date.now()
    };
    return furaiSemanticRuntimeIndex;
}

function scheduleFuraiSemanticIndexing(chatId = currentChatId, options = {}) {
    if (!chatId || chatId !== currentChatId || !isFuraiSemanticRecallEnabled(chatId)) return;

    if (furaiSemanticIndexTimer) clearTimeout(furaiSemanticIndexTimer);
    if (furaiSemanticIndexIdleRequestId && window.cancelIdleCallback) {
        cancelIdleCallback(furaiSemanticIndexIdleRequestId);
        furaiSemanticIndexIdleRequestId = 0;
    }

    const delay = Math.max(25, Number(options.delay) || FURAI_SEMANTIC_INDEX_DELAY_MS);
    furaiSemanticIndexTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        furaiSemanticIndexTimer = null;

        const startIndexing = deadline => {
            furaiSemanticIndexIdleRequestId = 0;

            if (!chatId || chatId !== currentChatId || !isFuraiSemanticRecallEnabled(chatId)) return;

            const lacksIdleBudget = deadline && !deadline.didTimeout && deadline.timeRemaining() < 6;
            if (isFuraiForegroundRecentlyActive(1100) || lacksIdleBudget) {
                scheduleFuraiSemanticIndexing(chatId, { delay: 900 });
                return;
            }

            void runFuraiSemanticIndexing(chatId);
        };

        if (window.requestIdleCallback) {
            furaiSemanticIndexIdleRequestId = requestIdleCallback(startIndexing, { timeout: 4000 });
        } else {
            startIndexing(null);
        }
    }, delay);
}

async function runFuraiSemanticIndexing(chatId) {
    if (!chatId || chatId !== currentChatId || !isFuraiSemanticRecallEnabled(chatId)) return;
    if (furaiSemanticIndexingChatId) {
        scheduleFuraiSemanticIndexing(chatId, { delay: 700 });
        return;
    }
    const foregroundBusy =
        furaiSemanticForegroundQuery ||
        (typeof isGenerating !== 'undefined' && isGenerating) ||
        (typeof isCutsceneGenerating !== 'undefined' && isCutsceneGenerating) ||
        Boolean(window.FuraiLivestream?.isGenerating?.());
    if (foregroundBusy) {
        scheduleFuraiSemanticIndexing(chatId, { delay: 1200 });
        return;
    }

    furaiSemanticIndexingChatId = chatId;
    try {
        await ensureFuraiSemanticEngine(chatId);
        if (!isFuraiSemanticRecallEnabled(chatId)) return;
        const lexicalIndex = await getFuraiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex(chatId);
        const semanticIndex = await getFuraiSemanticRuntimeIndex(chatId, lexicalIndex);
        const epoch = furaiSemanticEpoch;
        const recordId = semanticIndex.pendingRecordIds.shift();
        if (!recordId) {
            setFuraiSemanticStatus('ready');
            scheduleFuraiSemanticWorkerIdleRelease(FURAI_SEMANTIC_WORKER_IDLE_MS, { allowActiveDeep: true });
            return;
        }

        const record = lexicalIndex.byId.get(recordId)?.record;
        if (!record || record.status !== 'active') {
            scheduleFuraiSemanticIndexing(chatId, { delay: 50 });
            return;
        }

        const total = Math.max(semanticIndex.targetCount, lexicalIndex.recordCount);
        const indexed = Math.max(0, total - semanticIndex.pendingRecordIds.length - 1);
        setFuraiSemanticStatus('indexing', `Preparing Deep Memory · ${indexed}/${total}`);
        const result = await requestFuraiSemanticWorker('embed', {
            texts: [buildFuraiSemanticRecordText(record)]
        }, 60000, { priority: 5 });
        if (epoch !== furaiSemanticEpoch || !isFuraiSemanticRecallEnabled(chatId)) return;

        const vector = result?.[0] instanceof Float32Array ? result[0] : new Float32Array(result?.[0] || []);
        if (!vector.length) throw new Error('The local model returned an empty embedding.');
        const entry = {
            id: getFuraiSemanticVectorId(record.id),
            recordId: record.id,
            chatId,
            modelName: FURAI_SEMANTIC_MODEL_NAME,
            schemaVersion: FURAI_SEMANTIC_VECTOR_SCHEMA_VERSION,
            textHash: getFuraiSemanticRecordTextHash(record),
            dimensions: vector.length,
            vector,
            updatedAt: Date.now()
        };
        await putFuraiSemanticVectors([entry]);
        setFuraiSemanticStatus('indexing', `Preparing Deep Memory · ${Math.min(total, indexed + 1)}/${total}`);
        scheduleFuraiSemanticIndexing(chatId, { delay: 90 });
    } catch (error) {
        console.warn('Semantic memory indexing paused:', error);
        setFuraiSemanticStatus('error', String(error?.message || error || 'Semantic indexing failed.'));
    } finally {
        if (furaiSemanticIndexingChatId === chatId) furaiSemanticIndexingChatId = '';
    }
}

async function getFuraiSemanticScores(chatId, queryText, lexicalIndex, compatibleBranches, recentCutoff, modeAccess) {
    const emptyScores = new Map();
    if (!isFuraiSemanticRecallEnabled(chatId)) return emptyScores;
    if (!['ready', 'indexing'].includes(furaiSemanticStatus.state)) {
        void ensureFuraiSemanticEngine(chatId)
            .then(() => scheduleFuraiSemanticIndexing(chatId, { delay: 50 }))
            .catch(() => {});
        return emptyScores;
    }

    const intent = getFuraiSemanticIntentText(queryText);
    if (!intent) return emptyScores;
    const modeAccessCacheKey = getFuraiDeepMemoryModeAccessCacheKey(modeAccess);
    const cacheKey = `${chatId}:${modeAccessCacheKey}:${furaiHashString(intent)}`;
    const cached = furaiSemanticQueryCache.get(cacheKey);
    if (cached) {
        return new Map(cached.map(item => [item.recordId, Number(item.similarity) || 0]));
    }

    // The complete semantic path—including cold vector-index hydration—has one
    // soft deadline. A slow first turn continues warming in the background while
    // lexical recall answers immediately, and repeated sends never stack jobs.
    if (furaiSemanticForegroundQuery) return emptyScores;

    const foregroundState = {
        key: cacheKey,
        epoch: 0,
        requestId: '',
        promise: null
    };

    const task = (async () => {
        const semanticIndex = await getFuraiSemanticRuntimeIndex(chatId, lexicalIndex);
        if (chatId !== currentChatId || !isFuraiSemanticRecallEnabled(chatId)) return [];
        foregroundState.epoch = furaiSemanticEpoch;

        const allowedIds = [];
        for (const [recordId] of semanticIndex.byRecordId) {
            const record = lexicalIndex.byId.get(recordId)?.record;
            if (!record || record.status !== 'active') continue;
            if (!compatibleBranches.has(record.branchId || 'main')) continue;
            if (!isFuraiDeepMemoryRecordModeAccessible(record, modeAccess)) continue;
            if (Number(record.sourceEndIndex) >= recentCutoff) continue;
            allowedIds.push(recordId);
        }
        if (!allowedIds.length) return [];

        const request = requestFuraiSemanticWorker('query-score', {
            chatId,
            text: `${FURAI_SEMANTIC_QUERY_PREFIX}${intent}`,
            allowedIds,
            minSimilarity: 0.43,
            topK: 90
        }, 30000, { priority: 100 });
        foregroundState.requestId = request.furaiRequestId || '';
        const result = await request;
        if (foregroundState.epoch !== furaiSemanticEpoch || chatId !== currentChatId) return [];

        const rows = Array.isArray(result) ? result : [];
        furaiSemanticQueryCache.set(cacheKey, rows);
        while (furaiSemanticQueryCache.size > FURAI_SEMANTIC_QUERY_CACHE_MAX) {
            furaiSemanticQueryCache.delete(furaiSemanticQueryCache.keys().next().value);
        }
        return rows;
    })();

    const completion = task
        .catch(error => {
            console.warn('Semantic query skipped for this turn:', error);
            return [];
        })
        .finally(() => {
            if (furaiSemanticForegroundQuery === foregroundState) furaiSemanticForegroundQuery = null;
            if (!furaiSemanticIndexTimer && !furaiSemanticIndexingChatId) {
                scheduleFuraiSemanticWorkerIdleRelease(FURAI_SEMANTIC_WORKER_IDLE_MS, { allowActiveDeep: true });
            }
        });
    foregroundState.promise = completion;
    furaiSemanticForegroundQuery = foregroundState;

    const result = await Promise.race([
        completion,
        new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(() => resolve(null), FURAI_SEMANTIC_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS))
    ]);
    if (!result) return emptyScores;
    return new Map(result.map(item => [item.recordId, Number(item.similarity) || 0]));
}

function releaseFuraiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex(chatId = '') {
    if (chatId && furaiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex?.chatId !== chatId) return;
    // Any record-set change invalidates in-flight semantic results. Background
    // work is only one record at a time, so it may finish safely but cannot
    // commit stale vectors or stale recall after this epoch changes.
    furaiSemanticEpoch++;
    furaiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex = null;
    releaseFuraiSemanticRuntimeIndex(chatId);
    if (furaiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndexReleaseTimer) clearTimeout(furaiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndexReleaseTimer);
    furaiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndexReleaseTimer = null;
}

function touchFuraiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex(chatId) {
    if (!furaiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex || furaiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex.chatId !== chatId) return;
    if (furaiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndexReleaseTimer) clearTimeout(furaiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndexReleaseTimer);
    furaiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndexReleaseTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        if (currentChatId === chatId && isFuraiDeepMemoryEnabled(chatId)) return;
        if (furaiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex?.chatId === chatId) releaseFuraiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex(chatId);
    }, FURAI_DEEP_RUNTIME_INDEX_IDLE_MS);
}

function yieldFuraiDeepRuntimeIndexBuild() {
    if (globalThis.scheduler?.yield) return globalThis.scheduler.yield();
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 0));
}

async function getFuraiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex(chatId) {
    await restoreFuraiDeepMemoryUserAuthority(chatId);
    await ensureFuraiDeepMemoryModeSchema(chatId);
    const cached = furaiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex;
    if (cached?.chatId === chatId) {
        touchFuraiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex(chatId);
        return cached;
    }

    const records = await getFuraiDeepMemoryRecords(chatId);
    const byId = new Map();
    const tokenPostings = new Map();
    const tokenDocumentFrequency = new Map();
    const branchSegments = new Map();

    for (let i = 0; i < records.length; i++) {
        const record = records[i];
        const tokens = [...new Set(tokenizeFuraiDeepMemory([
            record.text,
            ...(record.keywords || []),
            ...(record.entities || [])
        ].filter(Boolean).join(' ')))];
        const tokenSet = new Set(tokens);
        const entry = {
            record,
            tokenSet,
            normalizedText: record.normalizedText || normalizeFuraiDeepMemoryText(record.text)
        };
        byId.set(record.id, entry);

        for (const token of tokens) {
            let posting = tokenPostings.get(token);
            if (!posting) tokenPostings.set(token, posting = []);
            posting.push(entry);
            tokenDocumentFrequency.set(token, (tokenDocumentFrequency.get(token) || 0) + 1);
        }

        if (record.kind === 'segment') {
            const segmentGroupKey = getFuraiDeepMemorySegmentGroupKey(record);
            let segments = branchSegments.get(segmentGroupKey);
            if (!segments) branchSegments.set(segmentGroupKey, segments = []);
            segments.push(record);
        }

        if (i > 0 && i % FURAI_DEEP_RUNTIME_INDEX_BUILD_CHUNK === 0) {
            await yieldFuraiDeepRuntimeIndexBuild();
        }
    }

    branchSegments.forEach(segments => segments.sort((a, b) => Number(a.sourceStartIndex) - Number(b.sourceStartIndex)));

    const index = {
        chatId,
        recordCount: records.length,
        byId,
        tokenPostings,
        tokenDocumentFrequency,
        branchSegments,
        createdAt: Date.now()
    };
    furaiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex = index;
    touchFuraiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex(chatId);
    return index;
}

async function putFuraiDeepMemoryRecords(records) {
    if (!Array.isArray(records) || !records.length) return;
    const chatId = records[0]?.chatId || '';
    const effectiveRecords = applyFuraiDeepMemoryUserAuthority(chatId, records);
    if (!effectiveRecords.length) return;
    const db = await openFuraiDeepMemoryDb();
    const tx = db.transaction('records', 'readwrite');
    const txDone = furaiIdbTransactionDone(tx, 'Could not save Deep Memory records.');
    const store = tx.objectStore('records');
    for (const record of effectiveRecords) store.put(record);
    await txDone;
    releaseFuraiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex(chatId);
    if (chatId && isFuraiSemanticRecallEnabled(chatId)) scheduleFuraiSemanticIndexing(chatId, { delay: 120 });
}

async function deleteFuraiDeepMemoryRecordIds(recordIds) {
    const ids = [...new Set((recordIds || []).map(id => String(id || '').trim()).filter(Boolean))];
    if (!ids.length) return;

    const db = await openFuraiDeepMemoryDb();
    const tx = db.transaction(['records', 'vectors'], 'readwrite');
    const txDone = furaiIdbTransactionDone(tx, 'Could not remove interrupted Deep Memory records.');
    const store = tx.objectStore('records');
    const vectorStore = tx.objectStore('vectors');
    ids.forEach(id => {
        store.delete(id);
        vectorStore.delete(getFuraiSemanticVectorId(id));
    });
    await txDone;
    releaseFuraiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex();
}

async function commitFuraiDeepMemoryBatch(records, meta) {
    const chatId = meta?.chatId || records?.[0]?.chatId || '';
    const effectiveRecords = applyFuraiDeepMemoryUserAuthority(chatId, records || []);
    const db = await openFuraiDeepMemoryDb();
    const tx = db.transaction(['records', 'meta'], 'readwrite');
    const txDone = furaiIdbTransactionDone(tx, 'Could not commit Deep Memory batch.');
    const recordStore = tx.objectStore('records');
    for (const record of effectiveRecords) recordStore.put(record);
    tx.objectStore('meta').put(meta);
    await txDone;
    releaseFuraiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex(chatId);
    if (chatId && effectiveRecords.length && isFuraiSemanticRecallEnabled(chatId)) scheduleFuraiSemanticIndexing(chatId, { delay: 120 });
}

async function clearFuraiDeepMemoryRecords(chatId) {
    if (!chatId) return;
    bumpFuraiDeepMemoryChatEpoch(chatId);
    const timer = furaiDeepMemoryTimers.get(chatId);
    if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
    furaiDeepMemoryTimers.delete(chatId);
    furaiDeepMemoryStatusCache.delete(chatId);
    furaiDeepMemoryAuthorityHydratedChats.delete(chatId);
    furaiDeepMemoryModeSchemaReadyChats.delete(chatId);
    const modeSchemaJob = furaiDeepMemoryModeSchemaJobs.get(chatId);
    if (modeSchemaJob) await modeSchemaJob.catch(() => {});
    furaiDeepMemoryModeSchemaJobs.delete(chatId);
    releaseFuraiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex(chatId);
    clearFuraiFullHistoryEstimateCache(chatId);

    const db = await openFuraiDeepMemoryDb();
    const tx = db.transaction(['records', 'meta', 'vectors'], 'readwrite');
    const txDone = furaiIdbTransactionDone(tx, 'Could not finish clearing Deep Memory.');
    tx.objectStore('meta').delete(chatId);
    const recordRequest = tx.objectStore('records').index('chatId').openCursor(IDBKeyRange.only(chatId));
    const vectorRequest = tx.objectStore('vectors').index('chatId').openCursor(IDBKeyRange.only(chatId));
    const clearCursor = (request, message) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        request.onsuccess = () => {
            const cursor = request.result;
            if (!cursor) { resolve(); return; }
            cursor.delete();
            cursor.continue();
        };
        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error || new Error(message));
    });

    await Promise.all([
        clearCursor(recordRequest, 'Could not clear Deep Memory records.'),
        clearCursor(vectorRequest, 'Could not clear semantic vectors.')
    ]);
    await txDone;
    if (window.furaiDeepMemoryLastContext?.chatId === chatId) {
        window.furaiDeepMemoryLastContext = null;
    }
    furaiDeepMemoryAbortControllers.delete(chatId);
    if (!furaiDeepMemoryInvalidationChains.has(chatId)) furaiDeepMemoryChatEpochs.delete(chatId);
}

async function deleteFuraiDeepMemoryDatabase() {
    furaiDeepMemoryGlobalEpoch++;
    disposeFuraiSemanticEngine({ preserveConsent: true });
    furaiDeepMemoryChatEpochs.clear();
    furaiDeepMemoryAbortControllers.forEach(controller => {
        if (controller && !controller.signal.aborted) controller.abort();
    });
    furaiDeepMemoryAbortControllers.clear();
    furaiDeepMemoryTimers.forEach(timer => clearTimeout(timer));
    furaiDeepMemoryTimers.clear();
    furaiDeepMemoryStatusCache.clear();
    furaiDeepMemoryModeSchemaReadyChats.clear();
    furaiDeepMemoryModeSchemaJobs.clear();
    furaiDeepMemoryInvalidationChains.clear();
    furaiDeepMemoryAuthorityHydratedChats.clear();
    furaiDeepMemoryRunningChatId = '';
    if (furaiSemanticIndexTimer) clearTimeout(furaiSemanticIndexTimer);
    furaiSemanticIndexTimer = null;
    furaiSemanticIndexingChatId = '';
    releaseFuraiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex();
    clearFuraiFullHistoryEstimateCache();
    clearFuraiMemoryModeCache('', { removeMirror: false });
    window.furaiDeepMemoryLastContext = null;

    const existingPromise = furaiDeepMemoryDbPromise;
    furaiDeepMemoryDbPromise = null;

    if (existingPromise) {
        try {
            const db = await existingPromise;
            db.close();
        } catch (error) {}
    }

    if (!window.indexedDB) return;

    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const request = indexedDB.deleteDatabase(FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_DB_NAME);
        request.onsuccess = () => resolve();
        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error || new Error('Could not delete Deep Memory storage.'));
        request.onblocked = () => {
            reject(new Error('Deep Memory storage is open in another FurAI tab. Close the other tab and try again.'));
        };
    });
}

async function performFuraiDeepMemoryInvalidation(chatId, affectedIndex, reason = 'message_changed', globalEpoch = furaiDeepMemoryGlobalEpoch) {
    if (globalEpoch !== furaiDeepMemoryGlobalEpoch) return false;

    const chatData = DB.get(chatId) || {};
    const enabled = isFuraiDeepMemoryEnabled(chatId, chatData);
    if (!enabled && !chatData.deepMemoryInitialized) return true;

    const index = Math.max(0, Number(affectedIndex) || 0);
    try {
        const existingRecords = await getFuraiDeepMemoryRecords(chatId);
        const containingSegmentStarts = existingRecords
            .filter(record =>
                record.kind === 'segment' &&
                Number(record.sourceStartIndex) <= index &&
                Number(record.sourceEndIndex) >= index
            )
            .map(record => Number(record.sourceStartIndex))
            .filter(Number.isFinite);
        const rebuildIndex = containingSegmentStarts.length
            ? Math.max(0, Math.min(index, ...containingSegmentStarts))
            : index;

        const currentMeta = await getFuraiDeepMemoryMeta(chatId);
        if (globalEpoch !== furaiDeepMemoryGlobalEpoch) return false;
        const currentNextIndex = Number(currentMeta?.nextIndex);
        const nextMeta = {
            ...(currentMeta || {}),
            chatId,
            schemaVersion: FURAI_DEEP_MEMORY_SCHEMA_VERSION,
            nextIndex: Number.isFinite(currentNextIndex)
                ? Math.min(currentNextIndex, rebuildIndex)
                : rebuildIndex,
            status: 'stale',
            staleReason: reason,
            staleFromIndex: rebuildIndex,
            errorCount: 0,
            updatedAt: Date.now()
        };

        const db = await openFuraiDeepMemoryDb();
        const tx = db.transaction(['records', 'meta', 'vectors'], 'readwrite');
        const txDone = furaiIdbTransactionDone(tx, 'Could not finish Deep Memory invalidation.');
        tx.objectStore('meta').put(nextMeta);
        const vectorStore = tx.objectStore('vectors');
        const records = tx.objectStore('records').index('chatId');
        const request = records.openCursor(IDBKeyRange.only(chatId));

        await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            request.onsuccess = () => {
                const cursor = request.result;
                if (!cursor) {
                    resolve();
                    return;
                }
                const record = cursor.value;
                if (Number(record?.sourceEndIndex) >= rebuildIndex) {
                    cursor.delete();
                    vectorStore.delete(getFuraiSemanticVectorId(record.id));
                }
                cursor.continue();
            };
            request.onerror = () => reject(request.error || new Error('Could not invalidate Deep Memory records.'));
        });

        await txDone;
        releaseFuraiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex(chatId);

        furaiDeepMemoryStatusCache.set(chatId, nextMeta);
        if (window.furaiDeepMemoryLastContext?.chatId === chatId) {
            window.furaiDeepMemoryLastContext = null;
        }
        if (enabled) furaiScheduleDeepMemory(chatId, { delay: 800 });
        return true;
    } catch (error) {
        console.warn('Deep Memory invalidation failed:', error);
        return false;
    }
}

function invalidateFuraiDeepMemoryFromIndex(chatId, affectedIndex, reason = 'message_changed') {
    if (!chatId) return Promise.resolve(false);

    // Abort any in-flight extraction immediately, then serialize every invalidation
    // for this chat. This prevents a slower older edit from overwriting the rebuild
    // boundary chosen by a newer edit/delete.
    bumpFuraiDeepMemoryChatEpoch(chatId);
    const globalEpoch = furaiDeepMemoryGlobalEpoch;
    const previous = furaiDeepMemoryInvalidationChains.get(chatId) || Promise.resolve(true);
    const task = previous
        .catch(() => false)
        .then(() => performFuraiDeepMemoryInvalidation(chatId, affectedIndex, reason, globalEpoch));

    furaiDeepMemoryInvalidationChains.set(chatId, task);
    task.finally(() => {
        if (furaiDeepMemoryInvalidationChains.get(chatId) === task) {
            furaiDeepMemoryInvalidationChains.delete(chatId);
        }
    });
    return task;
}


const furaiPendingDeepMemoryInvalidationJobs = new Map();

function clearFuraiLegacyModeScopeInvalidation(chatId, chatData) {
    if (!chatId || !chatData) return false;
    if (String(chatData.deepMemoryPendingInvalidationReason || '') !== 'mode_scope_upgrade') return false;
    delete chatData.deepMemoryPendingInvalidationFromIndex;
    delete chatData.deepMemoryPendingInvalidationReason;
    DB.set(chatId, chatData);
    return true;
}

function flushFuraiPendingDeepMemoryInvalidation(chatId, providedChatData = null) {
    const chatData = providedChatData || (chatId ? DB.get(chatId) : null);
    if (clearFuraiLegacyModeScopeInvalidation(chatId, chatData)) {
        if (isFuraiDeepMemoryEnabled(chatId, chatData)) furaiScheduleDeepMemory(chatId, { delay: 120 });
        return Promise.resolve(true);
    }
    const pendingIndex = Number(chatData?.deepMemoryPendingInvalidationFromIndex);
    if (!chatId || !Number.isFinite(pendingIndex)) return Promise.resolve(false);
    if (furaiPendingDeepMemoryInvalidationJobs.has(chatId)) {
        return furaiPendingDeepMemoryInvalidationJobs.get(chatId);
    }

    const reason = String(chatData.deepMemoryPendingInvalidationReason || 'mode_scope_upgrade');
    const job = invalidateFuraiDeepMemoryFromIndex(chatId, pendingIndex, reason)
        .then(success => {
            if (!success) return false;
            const latest = DB.get(chatId);
            if (!latest) return true;
            delete latest.deepMemoryPendingInvalidationFromIndex;
            delete latest.deepMemoryPendingInvalidationReason;
            DB.set(chatId, latest);
            return true;
        })
        .finally(() => furaiPendingDeepMemoryInvalidationJobs.delete(chatId));

    furaiPendingDeepMemoryInvalidationJobs.set(chatId, job);
    return job;
}

function notifyFuraiMessageMutation(chatId, affectedIndex, kind = 'append') {
    if (!chatId || !isFuraiDeepMemoryEnabled(chatId)) return;

    // The mode mirror/cache makes this a constant-time exit for Standard users.
    // No chat decompression and no Deep IndexedDB access occurs here.

    if (kind === 'append') {
        furaiScheduleDeepMemory(chatId, { delay: 1500 });
        return;
    }
    void invalidateFuraiDeepMemoryFromIndex(chatId, affectedIndex, kind);
}

function applyFuraiMemoryMode(chatId, mode, options = {}) {
    if (!chatId) return false;
    const nextMode = normalizeFuraiMemoryMode(mode);
    const chatData = DB.get(chatId);
    if (!chatData) return false;

    const pendingInvalidationReason = String(chatData.deepMemoryPendingInvalidationReason || 'changed_while_disabled');
    const ignoreLegacyModeScopeInvalidation = pendingInvalidationReason === 'mode_scope_upgrade';
    const pendingInvalidationIndex = ignoreLegacyModeScopeInvalidation
        ? NaN
        : Number(chatData.deepMemoryPendingInvalidationFromIndex);
    if (ignoreLegacyModeScopeInvalidation) {
        delete chatData.deepMemoryPendingInvalidationFromIndex;
        delete chatData.deepMemoryPendingInvalidationReason;
    }

    chatData.memoryMode = nextMode;
    if (nextMode === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP) {
        chatData.autoSummary = true;
        chatData.deepMemoryInitialized = true;
    }
    DB.set(chatId, chatData);
    cacheFuraiMemoryMode(chatId, nextMode);

    if (nextMode === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP) {
        cancelFuraiSemanticWorkerIdleRelease();
        if (!localStorage.getItem('furai_deep_memory_first_enable_hint')) {
            localStorage.setItem('furai_deep_memory_first_enable_hint', 'true');
        }
        void ensureFuraiSemanticEngine(chatId)
            .then(() => scheduleFuraiSemanticIndexing(chatId, { delay: 80 }))
            .catch(error => console.warn('Deep Memory setup paused:', error));

        if (Number.isFinite(pendingInvalidationIndex)) {
            void invalidateFuraiDeepMemoryFromIndex(chatId, pendingInvalidationIndex, pendingInvalidationReason)
                .then(success => {
                    if (!success) return;
                    const latest = DB.get(chatId);
                    if (!latest) return;
                    delete latest.deepMemoryPendingInvalidationFromIndex;
                    delete latest.deepMemoryPendingInvalidationReason;
                    DB.set(chatId, latest);
                });
        } else {
            furaiScheduleDeepMemory(chatId, { delay: 250 });
        }
    } else {
        bumpFuraiDeepMemoryChatEpoch(chatId);
        const timer = furaiDeepMemoryTimers.get(chatId);
        if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
        furaiDeepMemoryTimers.delete(chatId);
        releaseFuraiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex(chatId);
        if (chatId === currentChatId) scheduleFuraiSemanticWorkerIdleRelease(250);
        furaiDeepMemoryStatusCache.delete(chatId);
        if (!furaiDeepMemoryInvalidationChains.has(chatId)) furaiDeepMemoryChatEpochs.delete(chatId);
        if (window.furaiDeepMemoryLastContext?.chatId === chatId) window.furaiDeepMemoryLastContext = null;
    }

    if (chatId === currentChatId) {
        renderFuraiMemoryModeUi(nextMode);
        void refreshFuraiDeepMemoryPanel(chatId);
    }

    if (!options.silent) {
        showToast?.(nextMode === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP ? 'Deep Memory enabled for this chat.' : 'Standard Summary enabled for this chat.', 'success');
    }
    return true;
}

function setFuraiMemoryMode(mode, options = {}) {
    if (!currentChatId) return false;
    const nextMode = normalizeFuraiMemoryMode(mode);

    if (nextMode === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP && !canFuraiSemanticRecallRun()) {
        renderFuraiMemoryModeUi(getFuraiMemoryMode(currentChatId));
        setFuraiSemanticStatus('unsupported');
        showToast?.('Deep Memory is unavailable in this browser.', 'error');
        return false;
    }

    if (nextMode === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP && !hasFuraiSemanticRecallConsent()) {
        openFuraiSemanticConsentModal({
            type: 'chat',
            chatId: currentChatId,
            silent: options.silent === true
        });
        renderFuraiMemoryModeUi(getFuraiMemoryMode(currentChatId));
        return false;
    }

    return applyFuraiMemoryMode(currentChatId, nextMode, options);
}

function handleFuraiSemanticChatActivation(chatId, chatData) {
    if (!chatId || !chatData) return;
