function furaiGetValidMessageEls() {
    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    if (!chatMessagesEl) return [];

    return Array.from(chatMessagesEl.querySelectorAll('.message')).filter(m =>
        !m.id.startsWith('typing-') &&
        m.id !== 'personality-selector-message'
    );
}

function furaiEnsureManualKeyFacts(chatData) {
    if (!chatData) return;

    if (chatData.manualTimelessFacts === undefined) {
        let legacyFacts = (chatData.timelessFacts || '').trim();

        if (Array.isArray(chatData.pinnedFacts)) {
            const pinnedLines = chatData.pinnedFacts
                .map(p => (p.factText || '').trim())
                .filter(Boolean);

            legacyFacts = legacyFacts
                .split('\n')
                .filter(line => !pinnedLines.includes(line.trim()))
                .join('\n')
                .trim();
        }

        chatData.manualTimelessFacts = legacyFacts;
    }

    if (!Array.isArray(chatData.pinnedFacts)) {
        chatData.pinnedFacts = [];
    }
}

function furaiRebuildTimelessFacts(chatData) {
    if (!chatData) return;

    furaiEnsureManualKeyFacts(chatData);

    const manualText = (chatData.manualTimelessFacts || '').trim();
    const pinnedText = chatData.pinnedFacts
        .map(pin => (pin.factText || '').trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join('\n');

    const combined = [manualText, pinnedText].filter(Boolean).join('\n').trim();

    if (combined) {
        chatData.timelessFacts = combined;
    } else {
        delete chatData.timelessFacts;
    }
}

function furaiFlattenFactText(text) {
    return String(text || '')
        .replace(/```[\s\S]*?```/g, ' ')
        .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '$1')
        .replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]+\)/g, '$1')
        .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ')
        .replace(/[*_~>#]+/g, '')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim()
        .slice(0, 900);
}

function furaiGetMessageDisplayName(msg, messageEl) {
    const role = String(msg?.role || messageEl?.dataset?.role || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const domName = messageEl?.querySelector('.chat-username')?.innerText?.trim() || '';

    // Public announcements and real system notices are intentionally nameless.
    // Never let the generic FurAI fallback leak into pinned facts or AI memory.
    if (isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(role) || role === 'system') return '';

    if (role === 'muted-note') {
        return String(
            msg?.silentNoteSpeakerName ||
            msg?.userNameSnapshot ||
            msg?.botNameSnapshot ||
            msg?.wandNameSnapshot ||
            domName ||
            'Silent Note'
        ).trim();
    }

    if (role === 'cutscene') return domName || 'Cutscene';

    return String(
        msg?.userNameSnapshot ||
        msg?.botNameSnapshot ||
        domName ||
        (role === 'user' ? 'User' : 'FurAI')
    ).trim();
}

function furaiFormatPinnedFactText(name, flatText) {
    const safeName = String(name || '').trim();
    const safeText = String(flatText || '').trim();
    return safeName ? `${safeName}: ${safeText}` : safeText;
}

function furaiGetMessageAtDomElement(messageEl) {
    if (!currentChatId || !messageEl) return null;

    const index = typeof getRenderedDbMessageIndex === 'function'
        ? getRenderedDbMessageIndex(messageEl)
        : furaiGetValidMessageEls().indexOf(messageEl);

    if (!Number.isInteger(index) || index < 0) return null;

    const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
    if (!chatData || !Array.isArray(chatData.messages) || !chatData.messages[index]) return null;

    return {
        chatData,
        msg: chatData.messages[index],
        index
    };
}

function furaiFindPinnedIndex(chatData, msg) {
    if (!chatData || !msg || !Array.isArray(chatData.pinnedFacts)) return -1;

    if (msg.uid) {
        return chatData.pinnedFacts.findIndex(pin => pin.messageUid === msg.uid);
    }

    return chatData.pinnedFacts.findIndex(pin =>
        pin.role === msg.role &&
        pin.sourceText === msg.content
    );
}

function furaiMakePinnedFact(chatData, msg, messageEl) {
    if (!msg.uid) {
        msg.uid = generateUID('msg');
    }

    const name = furaiGetMessageDisplayName(msg, messageEl);
    const flatText = furaiFlattenFactText(msg.content);

    return {
        id: generateUID('pin'),
        messageUid: msg.uid,
        role: msg.role,
        name,
        sourceText: msg.content,
        factText: furaiFormatPinnedFactText(name, flatText),
        createdAt: Date.now()
    };
}

function furaiRefreshPinnedFactForMessage(chatData, msg, messageEl, knownPinIndex = -1) {
    if (!chatData || !msg || !Array.isArray(chatData.pinnedFacts)) return false;

    const pinIndex = Number.isInteger(knownPinIndex) && knownPinIndex >= 0
        ? knownPinIndex
        : furaiFindPinnedIndex(chatData, msg);

    if (pinIndex < 0) return false;

    if (!msg.uid) {
        msg.uid = chatData.pinnedFacts[pinIndex].messageUid || generateUID('msg');
    }

    const name = furaiGetMessageDisplayName(msg, messageEl);
    const flatText = furaiFlattenFactText(msg.content);

    chatData.pinnedFacts[pinIndex] = {
        ...chatData.pinnedFacts[pinIndex],
        messageUid: msg.uid,
        role: msg.role,
        name,
        sourceText: msg.content,
        factText: furaiFormatPinnedFactText(name, flatText),
        updatedAt: Date.now()
    };

    furaiRebuildTimelessFacts(chatData);
    return true;
}

window.togglePinnedFactForMessage = function(messageEl) {
    const found = furaiGetMessageAtDomElement(messageEl);
    if (!found) return;

    const { chatData, msg } = found;
    furaiEnsureManualKeyFacts(chatData);

    const pinIndex = furaiFindPinnedIndex(chatData, msg);
    const willPin = pinIndex === -1;

    if (willPin) {
        chatData.pinnedFacts.push(furaiMakePinnedFact(chatData, msg, messageEl));

        if (!localStorage.getItem('furai_hint_pinned_key_facts')) {
            localStorage.setItem('furai_hint_pinned_key_facts', 'true');

            if (typeof showOverlayHint === 'function') {
            showOverlayHint(`
                <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; text-align:left;">
                    <strong style="font-size:13px;">Saved to Key Facts</strong>
                    <span style="font-size:12px; opacity:0.86; line-height:1.35; margin-top:4px;">
                        Pinned messages are sent to memory. The original chat stays the same.
                    </span>
                </div>
            `, 0);
            }
        }

        if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Saved to Key Facts.');
    } else {
        chatData.pinnedFacts.splice(pinIndex, 1);
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Unpinned from Key Facts.');
    }
    
    furaiRebuildTimelessFacts(chatData);
    DB.set(currentChatId, chatData);
    
    updatePinnedFactsUI();
    
    const summaryModal = document.getElementById('summaryModalEl');
    const summaryOpen = summaryModal && summaryModal.style.display !== 'none';
    
    if (summaryOpen) {
        if (typeof renderPinnedFactsEditorList === 'function') renderPinnedFactsEditorList();
        if (typeof updateKeyFactsWordCountUI === 'function') updateKeyFactsWordCountUI();
    }
};

function unpinPinnedFact(pinId) {
    if (!currentChatId || !pinId) return;

    const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
    if (!chatData) return;

    furaiEnsureManualKeyFacts(chatData);

    chatData.pinnedFacts = chatData.pinnedFacts.filter(pin => pin.id !== pinId);

    furaiRebuildTimelessFacts(chatData);
    DB.set(currentChatId, chatData);

    updatePinnedFactsUI();
    renderPinnedFactsEditorList();
    if (typeof updateKeyFactsWordCountUI === 'function') updateKeyFactsWordCountUI();
    
    if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Unpinned from Key Facts.');
    }

function unpinLatestPinnedFact() {
    if (!currentChatId) return;

    const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
    if (!chatData) return;

    furaiEnsureManualKeyFacts(chatData);

    const latest = chatData.pinnedFacts[chatData.pinnedFacts.length - 1];
    if (!latest) return;

    unpinPinnedFact(latest.id);
}

function updatePinnedFactText(pinId, value) {
    if (!currentChatId || !pinId) return;

    const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
    if (!chatData) return;

    furaiEnsureManualKeyFacts(chatData);

    const pin = chatData.pinnedFacts.find(p => p.id === pinId);
    if (!pin) return;

    pin.factText = String(value || '');

    furaiRebuildTimelessFacts(chatData);
    DB.set(currentChatId, chatData);
    
    updatePinnedFactsUI();
    if (typeof updateKeyFactsWordCountUI === 'function') updateKeyFactsWordCountUI();
}

function renderPinnedFactsEditorList() {
    const listEl = document.getElementById('pinnedFactsEditorList');
    if (!listEl) return;

    listEl.innerHTML = '';

    const chatData = currentChatId ? DB.get(currentChatId) : null;
    if (!chatData) return;

    furaiEnsureManualKeyFacts(chatData);

    if (!chatData.pinnedFacts.length) return;

    const titleEl = document.createElement('div');
    titleEl.className = 'pinned-facts-editor-title';
    titleEl.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined">push_pin</span><span>Pinned Messages</span>';
    listEl.appendChild(titleEl);

    chatData.pinnedFacts.forEach(pin => {
        const itemEl = document.createElement('div');
        itemEl.className = 'pinned-facts-editor-item';
        itemEl.dataset.pinId = pin.id;

        const textEl = document.createElement('textarea');
        textEl.className = 'pinned-facts-editor-text';
        textEl.rows = 2;
        textEl.value = pin.factText || '';
        textEl.placeholder = 'Edit pinned message memory...';
        textEl.oninput = () => updatePinnedFactText(pin.id, textEl.value);

        const unpinBtn = document.createElement('button');
        unpinBtn.type = 'button';
        unpinBtn.className = 'pinned-facts-editor-unpin';
        unpinBtn.title = 'Unpin';
        unpinBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined">close</span>';
        unpinBtn.onclick = () => unpinPinnedFact(pin.id);

        itemEl.appendChild(textEl);
        itemEl.appendChild(unpinBtn);
        listEl.appendChild(itemEl);
    });
}

function openPinnedFactsEditor() {
    if (typeof openSummaryModal === 'function') openSummaryModal();

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        const target =
            document.getElementById('pinnedFactsEditorList') ||
            document.getElementById('timelessFactsInput');

        if (target) {
            target.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        const input = document.getElementById('timelessFactsInput');
        if (input) input.focus();
    });
}

function updatePinnedFactsUI() {
    const headerBtn = document.getElementById('pinnedFactsHeaderBtn');
    const headerCount = document.getElementById('pinnedFactsHeaderCount');
    const toast = document.getElementById('pinnedFactsToast');
    const toastText = document.getElementById('pinnedFactsToastText');
    const toastCount = document.getElementById('pinnedFactsToastCount');

    const chatData = currentChatId ? DB.get(currentChatId) : null;

    if (!chatData) {
        if (headerBtn) headerBtn.style.display = 'none';
        if (headerCount) headerCount.textContent = '0';
        if (toast) toast.style.display = 'none';
        if (toastText) toastText.textContent = '';
        return;
    }

    furaiEnsureManualKeyFacts(chatData);

    const pins = chatData.pinnedFacts || [];
    const latest = pins[pins.length - 1] || null;
    const isVn = document.body.classList.contains('vn-active');
    const isHome = typeof isHomeScreenActive === 'function' && isHomeScreenActive();

    if (headerBtn && headerCount) {
        headerBtn.style.display = pins.length && isVn && !isHome ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
        headerCount.textContent = String(pins.length);
    }

    if (toast && toastText) {
        if (pins.length && !isVn && !isHome) {
            toast.style.display = 'flex';
            toastText.textContent = latest.factText || '';
            if (toastCount) toastCount.textContent = String(pins.length);
        } else {
            toast.style.display = 'none';
            toastText.textContent = '';
            if (toastCount) toastCount.textContent = '0';
        }
    }

    const validMessages = furaiGetValidMessageEls();
    validMessages.forEach((messageEl, index) => {
        const msg = chatData.messages?.[index];
        const btn = messageEl.querySelector('.pin-fact-btn');
        if (!msg || !btn) return;

        const isPinned = furaiFindPinnedIndex(chatData, msg) !== -1;

        btn.classList.toggle('is-pinned', isPinned);
        btn.title = isPinned ? 'Unpin from Key Facts' : 'Pin to Key Facts';
        btn.innerHTML = `<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size: 18px; vertical-align: middle;">${isPinned ? 'keep' : 'push_pin'}</span>`;
    });

    const vnBtn = document.getElementById('vnPinBtn');
    if (vnBtn && Array.isArray(chatData.messages)) {
        const msg = chatData.messages[vnCurrentIndex];
        const isPinned = msg && furaiFindPinnedIndex(chatData, msg) !== -1;

        vnBtn.classList.toggle('is-pinned', !!isPinned);
        vnBtn.title = isPinned ? 'Unpin from Key Facts' : 'Pin to Key Facts';

        const icon = vnBtn.querySelector('.material-symbols-outlined');
        const label = vnBtn.querySelector('span:last-child');

        if (icon) icon.textContent = isPinned ? 'keep' : 'push_pin';
        if (label) label.textContent = isPinned ? 'Pinned' : 'Pin';
    }
}

function toggleVnPin() {
    if (!currentChatId) return;

    const sourceMsgEl = typeof getVnCurrentMessageElement === 'function'
        ? getVnCurrentMessageElement()
        : null;

    if (!sourceMsgEl || isLiveTypingMessage(sourceMsgEl)) {
        showToast?.("No finished VN message to pin.");
        return;
    }

    if (window.togglePinnedFactForMessage) {
        window.togglePinnedFactForMessage(sourceMsgEl);
    }

    if (typeof syncVnData === 'function') syncVnData();
    if (typeof renderVnMessage === 'function') renderVnMessage('preserve');
}

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        if (typeof updatePinnedFactsUI === 'function') updatePinnedFactsUI();
    });
});

window.isGeneratingSummary = false;
window.furaiSummaryJobs = window.furaiSummaryJobs || new Set();

let furaiMemoryModalHydrateToken = 0;

function openSummaryModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('summaryModalEl');
    if (!modal) return;

    const chatId = currentChatId;
    const hydrateToken = ++furaiMemoryModalHydrateToken;

    // First frame: open the shell and mode cards immediately. Compressed chat
    // reads, summary rendering, Key Facts, context boundary work, and IndexedDB
    // status checks happen only after the modal is already visible.
    modal.style.display = 'flex';
    const immediateMode = furaiMemoryModeCache.get(chatId) || FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_STANDARD;
    renderFuraiMemoryModeUi(immediateMode);

    const summaryInput = document.getElementById('summaryTextInput');
    const timelessInput = document.getElementById('timelessFactsInput');
    const pinnedList = document.getElementById('pinnedFactsEditorList');
    if (summaryInput) summaryInput.value = '';
    if (timelessInput) timelessInput.value = '';
    if (pinnedList) pinnedList.textContent = '';

    const generatedPreview = document.getElementById('generatedSummaryPreview');
    if (generatedPreview) generatedPreview.textContent = 'Loading memory details…';

    const menu = document.getElementById('settingsMenu');
    if (menu && menu.classList.contains('show')) menu.classList.remove('show');

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        setTimeout(() => hydrateFuraiMemoryModal(chatId, hydrateToken), 0);
    });
}

function hydrateFuraiMemoryModal(chatId, hydrateToken) {
    const modal = document.getElementById('summaryModalEl');
    if (!modal || modal.style.display !== 'flex') return;
    if (!chatId || chatId !== currentChatId || hydrateToken !== furaiMemoryModalHydrateToken) return;

    let currentAuto = true;
    let blocks = [];
    let timelessFacts = '';
    let manualSummaryOverride = '';
    let currentHint = false;
    let chatData = {};

    try {
        chatData = DB.get(chatId) || {};

        if (chatData.autoSummary !== undefined) {
            currentAuto = chatData.autoSummary;
        } else {
            const personality = chatPersonalities[chatId] || 'researcher';
            const globalAuto = DB.get(`global_auto_summary_${personality}`);
            currentAuto = globalAuto !== false;
        }

        const migratedLegacySummary = migrateFuraiLegacyManualSummaryOverride(chatData);
        if (Array.isArray(chatData.summaryBlocks)) {
            blocks = chatData.summaryBlocks.filter(block => !block?.stale && String(block?.text || '').trim());
        }
        if (migratedLegacySummary) DB.set(chatId, chatData);

        if (typeof furaiEnsureManualKeyFacts === 'function') furaiEnsureManualKeyFacts(chatData);
        timelessFacts = chatData.manualTimelessFacts || '';
        manualSummaryOverride = getFuraiManualSummaryOverride(chatData);
        currentHint = chatData.showSummaryHint !== undefined
            ? chatData.showSummaryHint
            : localStorage.getItem('furai_show_summary_hint') === 'true';
    } catch (error) {
        console.warn('Memory modal hydration failed:', error);
    }

    if (chatId !== currentChatId || hydrateToken !== furaiMemoryModalHydrateToken || modal.style.display !== 'flex') return;

    const autoToggle = document.getElementById('localAutoSummaryToggle');
    if (autoToggle) autoToggle.checked = currentAuto;

    const memoryMode = getFuraiMemoryMode(chatId, chatData);
    renderFuraiMemoryModeUi(memoryMode);

    const timelessInput = document.getElementById('timelessFactsInput');
    if (timelessInput) {
        timelessInput.value = timelessFacts;
        if (window.renderPinnedFactsEditorList) renderPinnedFactsEditorList();
        if (window.updateKeyFactsWordCountUI) updateKeyFactsWordCountUI();
    }

    let combinedText = blocks.map((block, index) => `[Summary ${index + 1}]\n${block.text}`).join('\n\n');
    if (!combinedText) combinedText = 'No summaries generated yet.';
    const generatedPreview = document.getElementById('generatedSummaryPreview');
    if (generatedPreview) generatedPreview.textContent = combinedText;

    const summaryInput = document.getElementById('summaryTextInput');
    if (summaryInput) summaryInput.value = manualSummaryOverride;
    if (window.updateWordCountUI) updateWordCountUI('summaryTextInput', 'summaryWordCount', 500);

    const localHintToggle = document.getElementById('localShowSummaryHintToggle');
    if (localHintToggle) localHintToggle.checked = currentHint;

    // Boundary estimation can scan long history, so it stays after visible content.
    setTimeout(() => {
        if (chatId !== currentChatId || hydrateToken !== furaiMemoryModalHydrateToken || modal.style.display !== 'flex') return;
        if (typeof renderFuraiContextJumpButtonInto === 'function') {
            renderFuraiContextJumpButtonInto('summaryContextJumpSlot');
        }
    }, 0);

    if (memoryMode === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (chatId === currentChatId && hydrateToken === furaiMemoryModalHydrateToken && modal.style.display === 'flex') {
                void refreshFuraiDeepMemoryPanel(chatId);
            }
        }, 0);
    }
}
function closeSummaryModal() {
    furaiMemoryModalHydrateToken++;
    document.getElementById('summaryModalEl').style.display = 'none';
}

function saveSummary() {
    if (!currentChatId) return;
    try {
        let chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
        if (chatData) {
            chatData.autoSummary = isFuraiDeepMemoryEnabled(currentChatId, chatData)
                ? true
                : document.getElementById('localAutoSummaryToggle').checked;
            
            const editedText = document.getElementById('summaryTextInput').value.trim();
            if (editedText) {
                chatData.manualSummaryOverride = editedText;
            } else {
                delete chatData.manualSummaryOverride;
            }

            const timelessInput = document.getElementById('timelessFactsInput');
            if (timelessInput) {
                const factsText = timelessInput.value.trim();
            
                if (typeof furaiEnsureManualKeyFacts === 'function') {
                    furaiEnsureManualKeyFacts(chatData);
                }
            
                if (factsText) {
                    chatData.manualTimelessFacts = factsText;
                } else {
                    chatData.manualTimelessFacts = "";
                }
            
                if (typeof furaiRebuildTimelessFacts === 'function') {
                    furaiRebuildTimelessFacts(chatData);
                } else if (factsText) {
                    chatData.timelessFacts = factsText;
                } else {
                    delete chatData.timelessFacts;
                }
            }

            // Save the hint toggle state locally to this chat
            const localHintToggle = document.getElementById('localShowSummaryHintToggle');
            if (localHintToggle) {
                chatData.showSummaryHint = localHintToggle.checked;
            }

            DB.set(currentChatId, chatData);
            if (typeof invalidateFuraiContextMetaCache === 'function') invalidateFuraiContextMetaCache(currentChatId);
            if (typeof invalidateFuraiContextMetaCountCache === 'function') invalidateFuraiContextMetaCountCache(currentChatId);
        }
    } catch(e) { console.error("Error saving summary:", e); }
    
    closeSummaryModal();
}

async function triggerManualSummary() {
    if (!currentChatId) return;
    const btn = document.getElementById('manualSummaryBtn');
    const originalHtml = btn.innerHTML;
    btn.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Generating...`;
    btn.disabled = true;
    
    await performSummaryGeneration(currentChatId, true);
    
    btn.innerHTML = originalHtml;
    btn.disabled = false;
    
    try {
        const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
        if (chatData && Array.isArray(chatData.summaryBlocks)) {
            const activeBlocks = chatData.summaryBlocks.filter(block => !block?.stale && String(block?.text || '').trim());
            const combinedText = activeBlocks.length
                ? activeBlocks.map((b, i) => `[Summary ${i+1}]\n${b.text}`).join('\n\n')
                : "No summaries generated yet.";
            const generatedPreview = document.getElementById('generatedSummaryPreview');
            if (generatedPreview) generatedPreview.textContent = combinedText;
        }
    } catch(e) {}
}

function checkRosterSizeHint(activeCount) {
    // Hint 2: Exceeding 10 characters
    if (activeCount > 10 && !localStorage.getItem('furai_hint_roster_11')) {
        localStorage.setItem('furai_hint_roster_11', 'true');
        showOverlayHint(`
            <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; text-align:left;">
                <strong style="font-size:13px;">Pinned to Key Facts</strong>
                <span style="font-size:12px; opacity:0.86; line-height:1.35; margin-top:4px;">
                    Pinned messages are sent to memory. The original chat stays the same.
                </span>
            </div>
        `, 0);
    } 
    // Hint 1: Exceeding 5 characters
    else if (activeCount > 5 && !localStorage.getItem('furai_hint_roster_6')) {
        localStorage.setItem('furai_hint_roster_6', 'true');
        showOverlayHint(`
            <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; text-align:left;">
                <span style="font-size:12px; opacity:0.9; line-height:1.3; margin-top:2px;">
                    More characters mean more lore for the AI to read. To keep the chat fast and smart, consider setting characters Offline when they are not in the scene.
                </span>
            </div>
        `, 0); // <-- 0 means it will stay until manually closed
    }
}

function checkAndTriggerAutoSummary(chatId) {
    if (window.furaiSummaryJobs?.has(chatId)) return;
    const chatData = DB.get(chatId);
    if (!chatData) return;

    // Check local first, fallback to Global Setting
    let isAuto = true; // Default is now ON
    if (chatData.autoSummary !== undefined) {
        isAuto = chatData.autoSummary;
    } else {
        const personality = chatPersonalities[chatId] || 'researcher';
        const globalAuto = DB.get(`global_auto_summary_${personality}`);
        isAuto = (globalAuto !== false); // True unless explicitly saved as false
    }

    if (isFuraiDeepMemoryEnabled(chatId, chatData)) isAuto = true;
    if (!isAuto) return;

    // Fire in background (does not block chat)
    performSummaryGeneration(chatId, false);
}

async function collapseFuraiSummaryLayers(chatId, freshData, showHint = false, modeScope = getFuraiSummaryModeScope(freshData)) {
    const allBlocks = Array.isArray(freshData?.summaryBlocks)
        ? freshData.summaryBlocks.filter(block => !block?.stale && String(block?.text || '').trim())
        : [];
    freshData.summaryBlocks = allBlocks;

    const blocks = freshData?.morph?.enabled
        ? allBlocks.filter(block => getFuraiSummaryBlockScope(freshData, block) === modeScope)
        : allBlocks;
    if (blocks.length < 2) return { applied: false, stale: false };

    const sourceLimit = getFuraiSummarySourceLimit(getFuraiContextWindow(), buildFuraiLayerSummaryPrompt);
    if (blocks.reduce((sum, block) => sum + estimateTokens(String(block?.text || '')), 0) <= sourceLimit) {
        return { applied: false, stale: false };
    }

    let take = 0;
    let sourceTokens = 0;
    for (let index = 0; index < blocks.length - 1; index++) {
        const next = estimateTokens(String(blocks[index]?.text || ''));
        if (sourceTokens + next > sourceLimit) break;
        sourceTokens += next;
        take++;
    }
    if (take < 2) return { applied: false, stale: false };

    if (showHint) showOverlayHint(`
        <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-layer-group fa-fade"></i>
            <span>Updating saved summaries...</span>
        </div>
    `, 10000);

    const selected = blocks.slice(0, take);
    const selectedSet = new Set(selected);
    const first = selected[0];
    const last = selected[selected.length - 1];
    const sourceStartIndex = Number.isInteger(Number(first.startIndex)) ? Number(first.startIndex) : 0;
    const sourceEndIndex = Number(last.endIndex);
    const expectedFingerprint = getFuraiSourceRangeFingerprint(
        freshData.messages || [],
        sourceStartIndex,
        sourceEndIndex
    );
    const combined = selected.map((block, index) => `Part ${index + 1}:\n${block.text}`).join('\n\n');
    let responseText = '';
    await generateText({
        instruction: buildFuraiLayerSummaryPrompt(combined),
        onChunk: data => { responseText += data.textChunk; }
    });
    const master = responseText.trim().replace(/^Summary:\s*/i, '');
    if (!master) return { applied: false, stale: false };

    const latestData = DB.get(chatId) || {};
    const latestMessages = Array.isArray(latestData.messages) ? latestData.messages : [];
    const liveFingerprint = getFuraiSourceRangeFingerprint(latestMessages, sourceStartIndex, sourceEndIndex);
    if (liveFingerprint !== expectedFingerprint) {
        console.warn('Discarded stale summary-layer result because covered source messages changed.');
        return { applied: false, stale: true };
    }

    const insertionIndex = freshData.summaryBlocks.findIndex(block => block === first);
    freshData.summaryBlocks = freshData.summaryBlocks.filter(block => !selectedSet.has(block));
    freshData.summaryBlocks.splice(Math.max(0, insertionIndex), 0, {
        startMessageUid: first.startMessageUid || '',
        startIndex: sourceStartIndex,
        endMessageUid: last.endMessageUid,
        endIndex: sourceEndIndex,
        sourceFingerprint: liveFingerprint,
        schemaVersion: 2,
        modeScope,
        stale: false,
        text: master
    });
    return { applied: true, stale: false };
}

async function performSummaryGeneration(chatId, force = false) {
    window.furaiSummaryJobs = window.furaiSummaryJobs || new Set();
    if (window.furaiSummaryJobs.has(chatId)) return;

    const plan = getFuraiSummaryPlan(chatId, force);
    if (!plan || plan.blocked) {
        if (force) showToast(plan?.blocked ? 'The oldest message is too long to summarize safely in one step.' : 'No summary is needed yet.', 'info');
        return;
    }

    const { messages, profile, startIndex, endIndex, memoryScope } = plan;
    yieldFuraiDeepMemoryToForeground(chatId);
    window.furaiSummaryJobs.add(chatId);
    window.isGeneratingSummary = window.furaiSummaryJobs.size > 0;

    const latestData = DB.get(chatId) || {};
    const showHint = latestData.showSummaryHint !== undefined
        ? latestData.showSummaryHint
        : localStorage.getItem('furai_show_summary_hint') === 'true';

    if (showHint) showOverlayHint(`
        <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i>
            <span>Summarizing...</span>
        </div>
    `, 10000);

    try {
        const sourceMessages = messages
            .slice(startIndex, endIndex + 1)
            .filter(message =>
                !shouldSkipAiContextMessageRole(message?.role) &&
                isFuraiMessageInSummaryScope(plan.chatData, message, memoryScope)
            );
        const chatLogText = sourceMessages.map(message => getFuraiSummaryMessageLine(message, profile, chatId)).join('');
        let responseText = '';
        await generateText({
            instruction: buildFuraiSegmentSummaryPrompt(chatLogText),
            onChunk: data => { responseText += data.textChunk; }
        });
        const summaryText = responseText.trim().replace(/^Summary:\s*/i, '');
        if (!summaryText) throw new Error('Empty summary response');

        const freshData = DB.get(chatId) || {};
        const freshMessages = Array.isArray(freshData.messages) ? freshData.messages : [];
        const liveFingerprint = getFuraiSourceRangeFingerprint(freshMessages, startIndex, endIndex);
        if (liveFingerprint !== plan.sourceFingerprint) {
            console.warn('Discarded stale summary result because its source messages changed.');
            if (showHint) showToast('The conversation changed, so the summary is being updated again.', 'info');
            return;
        }

        if (!Array.isArray(freshData.summaryBlocks)) freshData.summaryBlocks = [];
        if (plan.replaceOrphanedSummary) {
            freshData.summaryBlocks = freshData.summaryBlocks.filter(block =>
                getFuraiSummaryBlockScope(freshData, block) !== memoryScope
            );
        }
        freshData.summaryBlocks = freshData.summaryBlocks.filter(block => !block?.stale);
        freshData.summaryBlocks.push({
            startMessageUid: freshMessages[startIndex]?.uid || plan.sourceStartUid,
            startIndex,
            endMessageUid: freshMessages[endIndex]?.uid || plan.sourceEndUid,
            endIndex,
            sourceFingerprint: liveFingerprint,
            sourceStartRevision: getFuraiMessageRevision(freshMessages[startIndex]),
            sourceEndRevision: getFuraiMessageRevision(freshMessages[endIndex]),
            schemaVersion: 2,
            modeScope: memoryScope,
            stale: false,
            text: summaryText
        });

        try {
            const layerResult = await collapseFuraiSummaryLayers(chatId, freshData, showHint, memoryScope);
            if (layerResult?.stale) {
                if (showHint) showToast('The conversation changed, so the summary is being updated again.', 'info');
                return;
            }
        } catch (layerError) {
            console.warn('Summary layer optimization skipped:', layerError);
        }

        const commitData = DB.get(chatId) || {};
        const commitMessages = Array.isArray(commitData.messages) ? commitData.messages : [];
        const commitFingerprint = getFuraiSourceRangeFingerprint(commitMessages, startIndex, endIndex);
        if (commitFingerprint !== plan.sourceFingerprint) {
            console.warn('Discarded summary commit because its source range changed during summary-layer processing.');
            if (showHint) showToast('The conversation changed, so the summary is being updated again.', 'info');
            return;
        }

        const candidateData = {
            messages: commitMessages,
            summaryBlocks: Array.isArray(freshData.summaryBlocks)
                ? freshData.summaryBlocks.map(block => ({ ...block }))
                : []
        };
        if (validateFuraiSummaryBlocks(candidateData, commitMessages)) {
            console.warn('Discarded summary commit because one or more candidate blocks became stale.');
            if (showHint) showToast('The conversation changed, so the summary is being updated again.', 'info');
            return;
        }

        commitData.summaryBlocks = candidateData.summaryBlocks;
        DB.set(chatId, commitData);
        if (showHint) showToast('Summary saved.', 'success');
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Summary Generation Error:', error);
        if (showHint) showToast('Could not create the summary.', 'error');
    } finally {
        window.furaiSummaryJobs.delete(chatId);
        window.isGeneratingSummary = window.furaiSummaryJobs.size > 0;
        const hint = document.getElementById('globalOverlayHint');
        if (hint) hint.classList.remove('visible');
    }
}
