  function categorizeChatDate(timestamp) {
    const date = new Date(timestamp);
    const now = new Date();
    const today = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
    const yesterday = new Date(today);
    yesterday.setDate(yesterday.getDate() - 1);
    const thirtyDaysAgo = new Date(today);
    thirtyDaysAgo.setDate(thirtyDaysAgo.getDate() - 30);
    
    if (date >= today) return "Today";
    if (date >= yesterday) return "Yesterday";
    if (date >= thirtyDaysAgo) return "Previous 30 Days";
    return date.toLocaleDateString(document.documentElement.lang || navigator.language || 'en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
  }
  
  function formatDateTime(timestamp) {
    return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleString();
  }
  
  function updateColorScheme() {
    const isLightTheme = document.body.classList.contains('light-theme');
    const colorScheme = isLightTheme ? 'light' : 'dark';
    document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = colorScheme;
    let meta = document.querySelector('meta[name="color-scheme"]');
    if (!meta) {
      meta = document.createElement('meta');
      meta.name = 'color-scheme';
      document.head.appendChild(meta);
    }
    meta.content = colorScheme;
  }

function retargetFuraiRoleHistoryBeforeMessageDelete(chatId, chatData, deletedIndex) {
    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    const index = Number.parseInt(deletedIndex, 10);

    if (
        !chatId ||
        !Number.isInteger(index) ||
        index < 0 ||
        index >= messages.length
    ) {
        return false;
    }

    const deletedUid = String(messages[index]?.uid || '').trim();
    if (!deletedUid) return false;

    const replacementUid = String(messages[index - 1]?.uid || '').trim();
    const profile = DB.get(`profile-${chatId}`);
    if (!profile?.roleHistory) return false;

    let changed = false;

    const retargetActiveActor = (actor) => {
        if (!actor || typeof actor !== 'object') return;

        if (String(actor.actorStartAfterMessageUid || '').trim() === deletedUid) {
            actor.actorStartAfterMessageUid = replacementUid;
            changed = true;
        }
    };

    const retargetRetiredLane = (lane) => {
        if (!lane || !Array.isArray(lane.retired) || !lane.retired.length) return;

        const retained = [];

        for (const actor of lane.retired) {
            if (!actor || typeof actor !== 'object') {
                retained.push(actor);
                continue;
            }

            let startUid = String(actor.startAfterMessageUid || '').trim();
            let endUid = String(actor.endAfterMessageUid || '').trim();
            const startMatched = startUid === deletedUid;
            const endMatched = endUid === deletedUid;

            if (startMatched) {
                actor.startAfterMessageUid = replacementUid;
                startUid = replacementUid;
                changed = true;
            }

            if (endMatched) {
                actor.endAfterMessageUid = replacementUid;
                endUid = replacementUid;
                changed = true;
            }

            // An empty end anchor means "open-ended" to the role resolver.
            // When deletion removes the retired phase's final surviving message,
            // discard that now-empty snapshot instead of leaking it forward.
            if (endMatched && (!replacementUid || startUid === endUid)) {
                changed = true;
                continue;
            }

            retained.push(actor);
        }

        if (retained.length !== lane.retired.length) {
            lane.retired = retained;
        }
    };

    retargetActiveActor(profile.user);
    (profile.bots || []).forEach(retargetActiveActor);
    retargetRetiredLane(profile.roleHistory.user);
    Object.values(profile.roleHistory.bots || {}).forEach(retargetRetiredLane);

    if (!changed) return false;

    DB.set(`profile-${chatId}`, profile);

    if (typeof furaiRoleTimelinePositionCache !== 'undefined') {
        furaiRoleTimelinePositionCache.delete(String(chatId));
    }

    return true;
}

function deleteMessage(messageEl) {
    if (window.isFuraiActiveAiMessageElement?.(messageEl)) return false;

    try {
        const found = typeof furaiGetMessageAtDomElement === 'function'
            ? furaiGetMessageAtDomElement(messageEl)
            : null;

        if (!found) return false;

        const { chatData, msg, index } = found;

        if (!chatData || !Array.isArray(chatData.messages) || !chatData.messages[index]) {
            return false;
        }

        if (typeof furaiEnsureManualKeyFacts === 'function') {
            furaiEnsureManualKeyFacts(chatData);
        }

        if (typeof furaiFindPinnedIndex === 'function' && Array.isArray(chatData.pinnedFacts)) {
            const pinnedIndex = furaiFindPinnedIndex(chatData, msg);
            if (pinnedIndex !== -1) {
                chatData.pinnedFacts.splice(pinnedIndex, 1);
            }
        }

        retargetFuraiRoleHistoryBeforeMessageDelete(currentChatId, chatData, index);

        applyFuraiMessageMutationToChatData(chatData, index, 'delete');
        chatData.messages.splice(index, 1);
        chatData.timestamp = Date.now();

        if (typeof furaiRebuildTimelessFacts === 'function') {
            furaiRebuildTimelessFacts(chatData);
        }

        DB.set(currentChatId, chatData);
        notifyFuraiMessageMutation(currentChatId, index, 'delete');
        if (typeof invalidateFuraiContextMetaCountCache === 'function') invalidateFuraiContextMetaCountCache(currentChatId);

        if (messageEl && document.body.contains(messageEl)) {
            messageEl.remove();
        }

        if (typeof refreshVisibleMessageDomIndexes === 'function') {
            refreshVisibleMessageDomIndexes(index, -1);
        }

        if (document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) {
            if (typeof syncVnData === 'function') syncVnData();
            if (typeof renderVnMessage === 'function') renderVnMessage('preserve');
        }

        if (typeof updatePinnedFactsUI === 'function') updatePinnedFactsUI();

        return true;
    } catch(e) {
        console.error("Error deleting message:", e);
        return false;
    }
}

function getEditWordCountText(text) {
    const trimmed = String(text || '').trim();
    const count = trimmed ? trimmed.split(/\s+/).length : 0;
    return count + (count === 1 ? ' word' : ' words');
}

function editMessage(messageEl) {
    if (window.isFuraiActiveAiMessageElement?.(messageEl)) return;

    const contentEl = messageEl.querySelector('.content');
    const controlsEl = messageEl.querySelector('.message-controls');
    if (!contentEl || messageEl.classList.contains('editing')) return;

    if (!localStorage.getItem('furai_hint_edit_message')) {
        showOverlayHint(`
            <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; text-align:left;">
                <span style="font-size:12px; opacity:0.9; margin-top:4px;">Actively guide and edit the character responses to maintain quality and consistency.</span>
            </div>
        `, 0);
        localStorage.setItem('furai_hint_edit_message', 'true');
    }

    const messageIndex = getRenderedDbMessageIndex(messageEl);
    const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
    const originalText = chatData?.messages?.[messageIndex]?.content || contentEl.innerText || '';

    contentEl.style.display = 'none';
    if (controlsEl) controlsEl.style.display = 'none';
    messageEl.classList.add('editing');

    const editContainer = document.createElement('div');
    editContainer.className = 'edit-container';

    const originalContentHeight = Math.ceil(contentEl.getBoundingClientRect().height);

    const editTextArea = document.createElement('textarea');
    editTextArea.value = originalText;
    editTextArea.rows = 1;
    editTextArea.style.width = '100%';

    const editWordCount = document.createElement('span');
    editWordCount.className = 'edit-word-count';

    const syncEditUi = () => {
        editTextArea.style.height = 'auto';
        editTextArea.style.height = Math.max(originalContentHeight, editTextArea.scrollHeight) + 'px';
        editWordCount.textContent = getEditWordCountText(editTextArea.value);
    };

    editTextArea.addEventListener('input', syncEditUi);

    const editFooter = document.createElement('div');
    editFooter.className = 'edit-footer';

    const editButtons = document.createElement('div');
    editButtons.className = 'edit-buttons';

    const saveButton = document.createElement('button');
    saveButton.textContent = 'Save';

    const saveEdit = () => {
        const newContent = editTextArea.value;
        const currentIndex = getRenderedDbMessageIndex(messageEl);

        if (currentIndex > -1) {
            try {
                const currentChatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
                const currentMsg = currentChatData?.messages?.[currentIndex];

                if (currentMsg) {
                    const pinnedIndex = typeof furaiFindPinnedIndex === 'function'
                        ? furaiFindPinnedIndex(currentChatData, currentMsg)
                        : -1;

                    if (typeof updateAiMessageActiveVariantContent === 'function') {
                        updateAiMessageActiveVariantContent(currentMsg, newContent);
                    } else {
                        currentMsg.content = newContent;
                    }
                    bumpFuraiMessageRevision(currentMsg);
                    applyFuraiMessageMutationToChatData(currentChatData, currentIndex, 'edit');

                    currentChatData.timestamp = Date.now();

                    if (pinnedIndex !== -1 && typeof furaiRefreshPinnedFactForMessage === 'function') {
                        furaiRefreshPinnedFactForMessage(currentChatData, currentMsg, messageEl, pinnedIndex);
                    } else if (typeof furaiRebuildTimelessFacts === 'function') {
                        furaiRebuildTimelessFacts(currentChatData);
                    }

                    DB.set(currentChatId, currentChatData);
                    notifyFuraiMessageMutation(currentChatId, currentIndex, 'edit');
                    if (typeof invalidateFuraiContextMetaCountCache === 'function') invalidateFuraiContextMetaCountCache(currentChatId);
                    contentEl.innerHTML = formatMessageContent(newContent);

                    if (document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) {
                        if (typeof syncVnData === 'function') syncVnData();
                        if (typeof renderVnMessage === 'function') renderVnMessage('preserve');
                    }

                    if (typeof updatePinnedFactsUI === 'function') updatePinnedFactsUI();
                }
            } catch(e) {
                console.error("Error saving edited message:", e);
            }
        }

        editContainer.remove();
        contentEl.style.display = 'block';
        if (controlsEl) controlsEl.style.display = '';
        messageEl.classList.remove('editing');
    };

    saveButton.onclick = saveEdit;

    // Match the main chat composer: Ctrl+Enter confirms the edit.
    // Plain Enter must remain available for line breaks, and IME composition
    // must finish before any keyboard shortcut is handled.
    editTextArea.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if (event.key !== 'Enter' || !event.ctrlKey || event.isComposing) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        saveEdit();
    });

    const cancelButton = document.createElement('button');
    cancelButton.textContent = 'Cancel';
    cancelButton.onclick = () => {
        editContainer.remove();
        contentEl.style.display = 'block';
        if (controlsEl) controlsEl.style.display = '';
        messageEl.classList.remove('editing');
    };

    editButtons.appendChild(saveButton);
    editButtons.appendChild(cancelButton);
    editFooter.appendChild(editWordCount);
    editFooter.appendChild(editButtons);

    editContainer.appendChild(editTextArea);
    editContainer.appendChild(editFooter);

    const wrapper = messageEl.querySelector('.message-content-wrapper');
    if (wrapper) wrapper.appendChild(editContainer);
    else messageEl.appendChild(editContainer);

    editTextArea.focus();
    syncEditUi();
}
  
/* --- OPTIMIZED: Named + frame-coalesced resize handler --- */
let furaiAppResizeRaf = 0;

function handleAppResize() {
    if (furaiAppResizeRaf) return;

    furaiAppResizeRaf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        furaiAppResizeRaf = 0;
        if (typeof handleResponsiveLayout === 'function') handleResponsiveLayout();
    });
}

function abortCurrentGeneration(options = {}) {
    clearFuraiGenerationThinkingUI();
    if (furaiAiRequestPending && !isGenerating) {
        cancelFuraiAiRequestPreflight();
        hideFuraiRecallPreflightHint();

        if (typeof updateEnhancerButton === 'function') {
            updateEnhancerButton();
        }
        return;
    }

    if (!isGenerating) return;

    const preserveQueue = options?.preserveQueue === true;
    const preserveInput = options?.preserveInput === true;
    const preserveEmptyBubble = options?.preserveEmptyBubble === true;

    if (!preserveQueue) {
        generationQueue = [];
    }

    if (preserveEmptyBubble) {
        const activeGeneration =
            ongoingGenerations[currentChatId] ||
            Object.values(ongoingGenerations).find(Boolean);

        if (activeGeneration) {
            activeGeneration.preserveEmptyOnAbort = true;
        }
    }

    const controller = currentAbortController;

    if (controller) {
        try {
            controller.abort();
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    isGenerating = false;
    currentAbortController = null;

    if (!preserveInput) {
        const messageInputEl = document.getElementById('messageInputEl');
        if (messageInputEl) {
            clearSmoothInputText(messageInputEl, true);
        }
    }

    updateSendButtonUI();

    if (typeof updateEnhancerButton === 'function') {
        updateEnhancerButton();
    }
}

/* --- LOREBOOK & GLOSSARY LIBRARY MANAGER --- */
let lorebookRenderTimeout = null;

function queueLorebookRender() {
    if (lorebookRenderTimeout) clearTimeout(lorebookRenderTimeout);

    lorebookRenderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        LorebookManager.render();
    }, 160);
}
      
const LorebookManager = {
    targetInput: null, 
    sortMode: localStorage.getItem('furai_lb_sort') || 'date_desc',
    context: 'global',
    currentViewTab: 'lorebook', // Tracks which tab is currently active

    getSortStorageKey: function(type = this.currentViewTab) {
        return type === 'glossary' ? 'furai_lb_sort_glossary' : 'furai_lb_sort_lorebook';
    },

    getSortMode: function(type = this.currentViewTab) {
        const savedMode = localStorage.getItem(this.getSortStorageKey(type)) || this.sortMode || 'date_desc';
    
        const legacyModeMap = {
            used_desc: 'activity_desc',
            viewed_desc: 'activity_desc',
            used_asc: 'activity_asc',
            unused_first: 'inactive_first',
            unseen_first: 'inactive_first'
        };
    
        return legacyModeMap[savedMode] || savedMode;
    },

    compareTitle: function(a, b) {
        return String(a?.title || '').localeCompare(String(b?.title || ''), undefined, {
            sensitivity: 'base',
            numeric: true
        });
    },

    getBookActivityCount: function(book) {
        return (Number(book?.viewCount) || 0) + (Number(book?.useCount) || 0);
    },
    
    getBookInactiveScore: function(book) {
        const hasViewed = (Number(book?.viewCount) || 0) > 0;
        const hasUsed = (Number(book?.useCount) || 0) > 0;
    
        return Number(hasViewed || hasUsed);
    },
    
    ensureBookMeta: function(book) {
        if (!book) return false;

        let changed = false;

        if (!book.timestamp) {
            book.timestamp = Date.now();
            changed = true;
        }

        if (!book.type) {
            book.type = 'lorebook';
            changed = true;
        }

        if (!Number.isFinite(Number(book.viewCount))) {
            book.viewCount = 0;
            changed = true;
        }

        if (!Number.isFinite(Number(book.useCount))) {
            book.useCount = 0;
            changed = true;
        }

        if (!Number.isFinite(Number(book.lastViewedAt))) {
            book.lastViewedAt = 0;
            changed = true;
        }

        if (!Number.isFinite(Number(book.lastUsedAt))) {
            book.lastUsedAt = 0;
            changed = true;
        }

        return changed;
    },

    normalizeLibraryMeta: function(fullLib) {
        let needsSave = false;

        fullLib.forEach(book => {
            if (this.ensureBookMeta(book)) needsSave = true;
        });

        if (needsSave) DB.set('furai_lorebook_library', fullLib);

        return fullLib;
    },

    getTabStats: function(type) {
        const fullLib = this.normalizeLibraryMeta(DB.get('furai_lorebook_library') || []);
        const items = fullLib.filter(book => book.type === type);

        return {
            total: items.length,
            unseen: items.filter(book => !book.viewCount).length,
            unused: items.filter(book => !book.useCount).length
        };
    },

    updateTabLabels: function() {
        const loreBtn = document.getElementById('libTabLore');
        const glossaryBtn = document.getElementById('libTabGlossary');
        const newLabel = document.querySelector('#lorebookLibraryModal .lorebook-new-content-btn span');
        if (!loreBtn || !glossaryBtn) return;
    
        loreBtn.textContent = 'Lorebooks';
        glossaryBtn.textContent = 'Glossaries';
        if (newLabel) newLabel.textContent = this.currentViewTab === 'glossary' ? 'New Glossary' : 'New Lorebook';
    },

    recordBookViewed: function(id) {
        if (!id) return;

        const fullLib = DB.get('furai_lorebook_library') || [];
        const book = fullLib.find(item => item.id === id);
        if (!book) return;

        this.ensureBookMeta(book);
        book.viewCount = (book.viewCount || 0) + 1;
        book.lastViewedAt = Date.now();

        DB.set('furai_lorebook_library', fullLib);
        this.updateTabLabels();
    },

    recordBookUsed: function(id) {
        if (!id) return;

        const fullLib = DB.get('furai_lorebook_library') || [];
        const book = fullLib.find(item => item.id === id);
        if (!book) return;

        this.ensureBookMeta(book);
        book.useCount = (book.useCount || 0) + 1;
        book.lastUsedAt = Date.now();

        DB.set('furai_lorebook_library', fullLib);
        this.updateTabLabels();
    },

    sortLibraryItems: function(lib) {
        const mode = this.getSortMode();
    
        lib.sort((a, b) => {
            if (mode === 'date_desc') {
                return (b.timestamp || 0) - (a.timestamp || 0) || this.compareTitle(a, b);
            }
    
            if (mode === 'date_asc') {
                return (a.timestamp || 0) - (b.timestamp || 0) || this.compareTitle(a, b);
            }
    
            if (mode === 'alpha_asc') {
                return this.compareTitle(a, b);
            }
    
            if (mode === 'alpha_desc') {
                return this.compareTitle(b, a);
            }
    
            if (mode === 'activity_desc') {
                return this.getBookActivityCount(b) - this.getBookActivityCount(a) || this.compareTitle(a, b);
            }
    
            if (mode === 'activity_asc') {
                return this.getBookActivityCount(a) - this.getBookActivityCount(b) || this.compareTitle(a, b);
            }
    
            if (mode === 'recent_used') {
                return (b.lastUsedAt || 0) - (a.lastUsedAt || 0) || this.compareTitle(a, b);
            }
    
            if (mode === 'inactive_first') {
                return this.getBookInactiveScore(a) - this.getBookInactiveScore(b) || this.compareTitle(a, b);
            }
    
            return 0;
        });
    
        return lib;
    },

    init: function() {
        let lib = DB.get('furai_lorebook_library');
    
        const defaultCover = 'https://aigc.uploads.dev/image/43116958b5f56c72831461750228a3500c7f471bd9499de482c01ee66e62be24.jpeg';
    
        const defaults = [
            { id: 'lb_def_group', title: 'Default Group Mode Reference', mode: 'group', hashTag: 'Lorebook', sourceUrl: 'https://user.uploads.dev/file/fed8d7ce35c8866b212c0f9b56b448cd.txt' },
            { id: 'lb_def_story', title: 'Default Story Mode Reference', mode: 'story', hashTag: 'Lorebook, Productive', sourceUrl: 'https://user.uploads.dev/file/273207d3e8d0fb1733075a8a007c9218.txt' },
            { id: 'lb_def_prompter', title: 'Default Prompt Mode Reference', mode: 'prompter', hashTag: 'Lorebook, Productive', sourceUrl: 'https://user.uploads.dev/file/99bf8ca3a67bb4939be434dca168e486.txt' },
            { id: 'lb_def_maker', title: 'Default Character Maker Reference', mode: 'maker', hashTag: 'Lorebook, Productive', sourceUrl: 'https://user.uploads.dev/file/a5ebe78bbb6f417f8c47edec66d983df.txt' },
            { id: 'lb_def_researcher', title: 'Default Research Mode Reference', mode: 'researcher', hashTag: 'Lorebook, Productive', sourceUrl: 'https://user.uploads.dev/file/819e16d198b83d60567e58babd8d5f1c.txt' }
        ];
    
        const defaultGlossaries = [
            { id: 'glos_def_group', title: 'Default: Group Chat Glossary', mode: 'group', type: 'glossary' },
            { id: 'glos_def_story', title: 'Default: Story Glossary', mode: 'story', type: 'glossary' },
            { id: 'glos_def_prompter', title: 'Default: Prompt Glossary', mode: 'prompter', type: 'glossary' },
            { id: 'glos_def_maker', title: 'Default: Character Maker Glossary', mode: 'maker', type: 'glossary' },
            { id: 'glos_def_researcher', title: 'Default: Research Glossary', mode: 'researcher', type: 'glossary' }
        ];
    
        let changed = false;
    
        const hasLibraryItem = (id, title, type) =>
            lib.some(item =>
                item &&
                item.type === type &&
                (
                    item.id === id ||
                    item.title === title
                )
            );
    
        const addDefaultGlossaryIfMissing = (d) => {
            if (hasLibraryItem(d.id, d.title, 'glossary')) return;
    
            lib.push({
                id: d.id,
                title: d.title,
                type: d.type,
                cover: defaultCover,
                content: DB.get(`global_glossary_${d.mode}`) || "",
                timestamp: Date.now(),
                isDefault: true
            });
    
            changed = true;
        };
    
        // Fresh new user / completely new library.
        if (!Array.isArray(lib)) {
            lib = [];
    
            defaults.forEach(d => {
                lib.push({
                    id: d.id,
                    title: d.title,
                    hashTag: d.hashTag,
                    type: 'lorebook',
                    cover: defaultCover,
                    content: DB.get(`ref_text_${d.mode}`) || defaultReferences[d.mode] || "",
                    sourceUrl: d.sourceUrl,
                    expansionUrl: d.sourceUrl,
                    timestamp: Date.now(),
                    isDefault: true
                });
            });
    
            defaultGlossaries.forEach(addDefaultGlossaryIfMissing);
            changed = true;
        } else {
            // Old user migration: if they had no glossary system yet, add the normal default glossary set.
            const hasAnyGlossary = lib.some(item => item && item.type === 'glossary');
    
            if (!hasAnyGlossary) {
                defaultGlossaries.forEach(addDefaultGlossaryIfMissing);
            }
    
            // Story Glossary upgrade:
            // If the default Story Glossary card exists, preserve its content.
            // If it is missing, create it from the user's stored Story glossary setting.
            let storyGlossary = lib.find(item =>
                item &&
                item.type === 'glossary' &&
                (
                    item.id === 'glos_def_story' ||
                    item.title === 'Default: Story Glossary'
                )
            );
    
            if (storyGlossary) {
                if (storyGlossary.id !== 'glos_def_story') {
                    storyGlossary.id = 'glos_def_story';
                    changed = true;
                }
    
                if (storyGlossary.title !== 'Default: Story Glossary') {
                    storyGlossary.title = 'Default: Story Glossary';
                    changed = true;
                }
    
                if (storyGlossary.type !== 'glossary') {
                    storyGlossary.type = 'glossary';
                    changed = true;
                }
    
                if (storyGlossary.isDefault !== true) {
                    storyGlossary.isDefault = true;
                    changed = true;
                }
    
                if (!storyGlossary.cover) {
                    storyGlossary.cover = defaultCover;
                    changed = true;
                }
    
                if (!storyGlossary.timestamp) {
                    storyGlossary.timestamp = Date.now();
                    changed = true;
                }
    
                if (storyGlossary.content === undefined || storyGlossary.content === null) {
                    storyGlossary.content = DB.get('global_glossary_story') || "";
                    changed = true;
                }
            } else {
                lib.push({
                    id: 'glos_def_story',
                    title: 'Default: Story Glossary',
                    type: 'glossary',
                    cover: defaultCover,
                    content: DB.get('global_glossary_story') || "",
                    timestamp: Date.now(),
                    isDefault: true
                });
    
                changed = true;
            }
        }
    
        if (changed) {
            DB.set('furai_lorebook_library', lib);
        }
    },

    switchTab: function(tab) {
        this.currentViewTab = tab;
    
        document.getElementById('libTabLore').classList.toggle('active', tab === 'lorebook');
        document.getElementById('libTabGlossary').classList.toggle('active', tab === 'glossary');
    
        const sortSelect = document.getElementById('lorebookSortSelect');
        if (sortSelect) sortSelect.value = this.getSortMode(tab);
    
        this.updateTabLabels();
        this.render();
    },

    openLibrary: function(targetInputId, forcedContext = null) {
        this.targetInput = targetInputId;
    
        if (targetInputId && (targetInputId.includes('glos') || targetInputId.includes('Glossary'))) {
            this.currentViewTab = 'glossary';
        } else {
            this.currentViewTab = 'lorebook';
        }
    
        document.getElementById('libTabLore').classList.toggle('active', this.currentViewTab === 'lorebook');
        document.getElementById('libTabGlossary').classList.toggle('active', this.currentViewTab === 'glossary');
    
        this.context = forcedContext || (
            targetInputId === 'globalRefText' || targetInputId === 'globalGlossaryText'
                ? 'global'
                : 'local'
        );
    
        document.getElementById('lorebookSearchInput').value = '';
    
        const sortSelect = document.getElementById('lorebookSortSelect');
        if (sortSelect) sortSelect.value = this.getSortMode();
    
        const newBtn = document.querySelector('#lorebookLibraryModal .modal-header button[onclick*="openEditor"]');
        if (newBtn) newBtn.style.display = this.context === 'local' ? 'none' : 'flex';
    
        this.updateTabLabels();
        this.render();
        document.getElementById('lorebookLibraryModal').style.display = 'flex';
    },

    setSortMode: function(mode) {
        this.sortMode = mode || 'date_desc';
        localStorage.setItem(this.getSortStorageKey(), this.sortMode);
        localStorage.setItem('furai_lb_sort', this.sortMode);
        this.render();
    },

    render: function() {
        const grid = document.getElementById('lorebookGrid');
        const searchInput = document.getElementById('lorebookSearchInput');
        const query = searchInput ? searchInput.value.trim() : '';
        let fullLib = DB.get('furai_lorebook_library') || [];
    
        grid.innerHTML = '';
    
        fullLib = this.normalizeLibraryMeta(fullLib);
    
        let lib = fullLib.filter(book => book.type === this.currentViewTab);
    
        if (query) {
            lib = lib.filter(book =>
                smartSearchMatch(`${book.title || ''} ${getFuraiVisibleTagText(book.hashTag)} ${book.content || ''}`, query)
            );
        }
    
        this.sortLibraryItems(lib);
        this.updateTabLabels();
    
        lib.forEach(book => {
            const div = document.createElement('div');
            div.className = 'lorebook-item';
            div.onclick = () => LorebookManager.openEditor(book.id);
            
            const lockIcon = book.isDefault ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-lock" style="color:var(--primary-color);" title="Core Book"></i> ' : '';
            const tagHtml = createFuraiTagChipsHTML(book.hashTag, {
                searchKind: 'library',
                className: 'furai-library-card-tags'
            });
            const dateStr = new Date(book.timestamp).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
            
            div.innerHTML = `
                <div class="lorebook-cover-container">
                    <img src="${escapeHTML(book.cover || '')}" onerror="this.src='https://aigc.uploads.dev/image/43116958b5f56c72831461750228a3500c7f471bd9499de482c01ee66e62be24.jpeg'">
                </div>
                <div class="lorebook-info">
                    <div class="lorebook-title" title="${escapeHTML(book.title || '')}">${escapeHTML(book.title || 'Untitled')}</div>
                    ${tagHtml}
                    <div class="lorebook-badge">${lockIcon}Edited: ${dateStr}</div>
                </div>
            `;
    
            grid.appendChild(div);
        });
        
        if (grid.innerHTML === '') {
            grid.innerHTML = `<div style="grid-column: 1 / -1; text-align:center; padding:20px; opacity:0.5;">No items found.</div>`;
        }

        initFuraiDynamicTagLayouts(grid);
    },

    syncHiddenInstructionsField: function(type = null) {
        const selectedType = type || document.getElementById('lbEditType')?.value || 'lorebook';
        const group = document.getElementById('lbHiddenInstructionsGroup');
        if (group) group.style.display = selectedType === 'lorebook' ? 'block' : 'none';
    },

    openEditor: function(id = null) {
        if (id) this.recordBookViewed(id);
    
        let lib = DB.get('furai_lorebook_library') || [];
        let book = id ? lib.find(b => b.id === id) : null;
        
        const isLocal = this.context === 'local';
        const contentType = book ? (book.type || 'lorebook') : this.currentViewTab;
        const contentName = contentType === 'glossary' ? 'Glossary' : 'Lorebook';

        document.getElementById('lbEditHeaderTitle').textContent = book 
            ? (isLocal ? `View ${contentName}` : `Edit ${contentName}`) 
            : `New ${contentName}`;
            
        document.getElementById('lbEditId').value = book ? book.id : '';
        
        // CRITICAL FIX: Set the Type Dropdown correctly and hide if read-only
        const typeSelect = document.getElementById('lbEditType');
        if (typeSelect) {
            typeSelect.value = contentType;
            // Hides the entire flex container (Label + Dropdown) in local mode
            typeSelect.parentNode.style.display = isLocal ? 'none' : 'flex'; 
        }
        
        const titleInput = document.getElementById('lbEditTitleInput');
        const tagInput = document.getElementById('lbEditTagInput');
        const coverInput = document.getElementById('lbEditCoverInput');
        const contentInput = document.getElementById('lbEditContentInput');
        const hiddenInstructionsInput = document.getElementById('lbEditHiddenInstructionsInput');
        const loreParts = splitFuraiLoreInstructions(book ? book.content : '');

        titleInput.value = book ? book.title : '';
        setFuraiTagInputValue(tagInput, book && book.hashTag ? book.hashTag : ''); 
        coverInput.value = book ? book.cover : '';
        contentInput.value = loreParts.publicText;
        if (hiddenInstructionsInput) hiddenInstructionsInput.value = loreParts.hiddenText;
        document.getElementById('lbEditCoverPreview').src = book ? book.cover : 'https://aigc.uploads.dev/image/43116958b5f56c72831461750228a3500c7f471bd9499de482c01ee66e62be24.jpeg';
        
        titleInput.readOnly = isLocal;
        tagInput.readOnly = isLocal;
        coverInput.readOnly = isLocal;
        contentInput.readOnly = isLocal;
        if (hiddenInstructionsInput) hiddenInstructionsInput.readOnly = isLocal;
        this.syncHiddenInstructionsField(contentType);

        const coverUploader = coverInput.nextElementSibling;
        if (coverUploader && coverUploader.tagName === 'BUTTON') {
            coverUploader.style.display = isLocal ? 'none' : 'block';
        }
        
        const delBtn = document.getElementById('lbDeleteBtn');
        const shareBtn = document.getElementById('lbShareBtn');
        const saveBtn = document.getElementById('lbSaveBtn') || document.querySelector('#lorebookEditModal button[onclick*="saveBook"]');
        const loadBtn = document.getElementById('lbLoadBtn');
        
        const canLoad = !!this.targetInput && this.context !== 'library';
        if (loadBtn) loadBtn.style.display = canLoad ? 'flex' : 'none';
        
        if (isLocal) {
            if (delBtn) delBtn.style.display = 'none';
            if (shareBtn) shareBtn.style.display = 'none';
            if (saveBtn) saveBtn.style.display = 'none';
        } else {
            if (saveBtn) saveBtn.style.display = 'flex';
            if (shareBtn) shareBtn.style.display = 'flex';
            if (delBtn) {
                delBtn.style.display = 'block';
                if (!book || book.isDefault) {
                    delBtn.disabled = true;
                    delBtn.style.opacity = '0.3';
                    delBtn.style.cursor = 'not-allowed';
                    delBtn.title = 'Core Content (Cannot Delete)';
                    delBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-lock"></i>';
                } else {
                    delBtn.disabled = false;
                    delBtn.style.opacity = '1';
                    delBtn.style.cursor = 'pointer';
                    delBtn.title = 'Delete Item';
                    delBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-trash"></i>';
                }
            }
        }

        updateWordCountUI(['lbEditContentInput', 'lbEditHiddenInstructionsInput'], 'lbEditWordCount', 500);
        document.getElementById('lorebookEditModal').style.display = 'flex';
    },

    loadFromEditor: function() {
        const id = document.getElementById('lbEditId').value;
        const title = document.getElementById('lbEditTitleInput').value.trim() || "Content";
        const publicContent = document.getElementById('lbEditContentInput').value.trim();
        const type = document.getElementById('lbEditType') ? document.getElementById('lbEditType').value : 'lorebook';
        const hiddenInstructions = type === 'lorebook'
            ? (document.getElementById('lbEditHiddenInstructionsInput')?.value.trim() || '')
            : '';
        const content = type === 'lorebook'
            ? joinFuraiLoreInstructions(publicContent, hiddenInstructions)
            : publicContent;

        if (id && this.context === 'global') {
             let lib = DB.get('furai_lorebook_library') || [];
             const index = lib.findIndex(b => b.id === id);
             if (index !== -1) {
                 lib[index].title = title;
                 lib[index].type = type; // Ensure type change saves globally
                 lib[index].cover = document.getElementById('lbEditCoverInput').value.trim();
                 lib[index].content = content;
                 lib[index].timestamp = Date.now(); 
                 DB.set('furai_lorebook_library', lib);
             }
        }

        if (id) this.recordBookUsed(id);
        
        const targetEl = document.getElementById(this.targetInput);
        if (targetEl) {
            const hiddenTargetId = {
                refTextInput: 'refHiddenInstructionsInput',
                globalRefText: 'globalRefHiddenInstructions'
            }[this.targetInput] || (String(this.targetInput || '').endsWith('OpeningLorebook')
                ? String(this.targetInput).replace(/OpeningLorebook$/, 'OpeningLoreInstructions')
                : '');
            const hiddenTargetEl = hiddenTargetId ? document.getElementById(hiddenTargetId) : null;

            if (type === 'lorebook' && hiddenTargetEl) {
                const loreParts = splitFuraiLoreInstructions(content);
                targetEl.value = loreParts.publicText;
                hiddenTargetEl.value = loreParts.hiddenText;
                hiddenTargetEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
            } else {
                targetEl.value = content;
            }

            targetEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); 
            showToast(`Loaded "${title}"`, "success");
        }
        
        document.getElementById('lorebookEditModal').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('lorebookLibraryModal').style.display = 'none';
    },

    saveBook: function() {
        const id = document.getElementById('lbEditId').value;
        
        // CRITICAL FIX: Capture the dropdown type
        const typeSelect = document.getElementById('lbEditType');
        const type = typeSelect ? typeSelect.value : 'lorebook';
        
        const title = document.getElementById('lbEditTitleInput').value.trim();
        const hashTag = getFuraiTagInputValue('lbEditTagInput'); 
        const cover = document.getElementById('lbEditCoverInput').value.trim();
        const publicContent = document.getElementById('lbEditContentInput').value.trim();
        const hiddenInstructions = type === 'lorebook'
            ? (document.getElementById('lbEditHiddenInstructionsInput')?.value.trim() || '')
            : '';
        const content = type === 'lorebook'
            ? joinFuraiLoreInstructions(publicContent, hiddenInstructions)
            : publicContent;

        if (!title || !content) { showToast("Title and Content are required.", "error"); return; }

        let lib = DB.get('furai_lorebook_library') || [];
        
        if (id) {
            const index = lib.findIndex(b => b.id === id);
            if (index !== -1) {
                lib[index].type = type; // <-- THIS ENSURES THE MOVE HAPPENS
                lib[index].title = title;
                lib[index].hashTag = hashTag; 
                lib[index].cover = cover;
                lib[index].content = content;
                lib[index].timestamp = Date.now();
            }
        } else {
            lib.unshift({ 
                id: 'lb_' + Date.now(),
                type: type, // <-- THIS SAVES IT TO THE RIGHT CATEGORY
                title: title,
                hashTag: hashTag, 
                cover: cover || 'https://aigc.uploads.dev/image/43116958b5f56c72831461750228a3500c7f471bd9499de482c01ee66e62be24.jpeg',
                content: content,
                timestamp: Date.now(),
                isDefault: false
            });
        }

        DB.set('furai_lorebook_library', lib);
        document.getElementById('lorebookEditModal').style.display = 'none';
        
        // Auto-switch to the tab of the item we just saved!
        this.switchTab(type);
        
        showToast("Saved to Bookshelf!", "success");
    },

    shareBook: function() {
        const type = document.getElementById('lbEditType')?.value === 'glossary' ? 'glossary' : 'lorebook';
        const publicContent = document.getElementById('lbEditContentInput').value.trim();
        const hiddenInstructions = type === 'lorebook'
            ? (document.getElementById('lbEditHiddenInstructionsInput')?.value.trim() || '')
            : '';
        const content = type === 'lorebook'
            ? joinFuraiLoreInstructions(publicContent, hiddenInstructions)
            : publicContent;
        if (!content) { showToast("Cannot share an empty item.", "error"); return; }

        openShareMenu(document.getElementById('lbShareBtn'), '', '', '', {
            type,
            title: document.getElementById('lbEditTitleInput').value.trim() || (type === 'glossary' ? 'Glossary' : 'Lorebook'),
            hashTag: getFuraiTagInputValue('lbEditTagInput'),
            cover: document.getElementById('lbEditCoverInput')?.value.trim() || '',
            content
        });
    },
    
    deleteBook: function(idToDel = null) {
        const id = idToDel || document.getElementById('lbEditId').value;
        if (!id) return;
        
        if (!confirm("Delete this item permanently?")) return;

        let lib = DB.get('furai_lorebook_library') || [];
        lib = lib.filter(b => b.id !== id);
        DB.set('furai_lorebook_library', lib);
        
        document.getElementById('lorebookEditModal').style.display = 'none';
        this.render();
        showToast("Item deleted.", "success");
    },

    importArtifactData: function(artifact, fallback = {}) {
        const type = artifact?.type === 'glossary' ? 'glossary' : (fallback.type === 'glossary' ? 'glossary' : 'lorebook');
        const content = String(artifact?.content || '').trim();
        if (!content) throw new Error(`This ${type} is empty.`);

        const lib = DB.get('furai_lorebook_library') || [];
        const duplicate = lib.find(item => item?.type === type && String(item?.content || '').trim() === content);
        if (duplicate) {
            showToast(`Already in Bookshelf as “${duplicate.title || 'Untitled'}”.`, 'info');
            return duplicate;
        }

        const title = getUniqueFuraiLibraryImportTitle(
            lib,
            type,
            artifact?.title || fallback.title || (type === 'glossary' ? 'Imported Glossary' : 'Imported Lorebook')
        );
        const defaultCover = 'https://aigc.uploads.dev/image/43116958b5f56c72831461750228a3500c7f471bd9499de482c01ee66e62be24.jpeg';
        const imported = {
            id: `${type === 'glossary' ? 'glos' : 'lb'}_import_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`,
            type,
            title,
            hashTag: String(artifact?.hashTag || fallback.hashTag || ''),
            cover: String(artifact?.cover || fallback.cover || '') || defaultCover,
            content,
            timestamp: Date.now(),
            viewCount: 0,
            useCount: 0,
            lastViewedAt: 0,
            lastUsedAt: 0,
            isDefault: false
        };

        lib.unshift(imported);
        DB.set('furai_lorebook_library', lib);
        this.switchTab(type);
        showToast(`${title} added to Bookshelf!`, 'success');
        return imported;
    },

    importFile: async function() {
        showToast('Lorebook and Glossary file import is unavailable. Use Import Link instead.', 'info');
    },

    importLink: async function(suppliedUrl = '') {
        const rawUrl = String(suppliedUrl || '').trim() || prompt('Paste a FurAI lorebook or glossary link:');
        if (!rawUrl || !rawUrl.trim()) return;
        try {
            const parsedUrl = new URL(rawUrl.trim(), window.location.href);
            const explicitType = parsedUrl.searchParams.has('glossary') ? 'glossary' : (this.currentViewTab === 'glossary' ? 'glossary' : 'lorebook');
            const sourceValue = parsedUrl.searchParams.get('lorebook') || parsedUrl.searchParams.get('glossary') || rawUrl.trim();
            const fetchUrl = resolveFuraiUploadFileUrl(sourceValue);
            const fetcher = window.root?.superFetch ? window.root.superFetch : fetch;
            const response = await fetcher(fetchUrl);
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Could not fetch the shared file.');
            const artifact = await readFuraiLibraryArtifactResponse(response, {
                type: explicitType,
                title: String(parsedUrl.searchParams.get('name') || '').replace(/_/g, ' ')
            });
            this.importArtifactData(artifact, { type: explicitType });
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Lorebook link import failed:', error);
            showToast(`Import failed: ${error.message || error}`, 'error');
        }
    },

    importFromExpansion: async function(encodedItem) {
        const item = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(encodedItem));
        showToast("Downloading item...", "info");
        try {
            const fetcher = window.root?.superFetch ? window.root.superFetch : fetch;
            const contentUrl = resolveFuraiUploadFileUrl(item.content);
            const res = await fetcher(contentUrl);
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch file");
            const artifact = await readFuraiLibraryArtifactResponse(res, {
                type: item.type === 'glossary' ? 'glossary' : 'lorebook',
                title: item.title,
                cover: item.img
            });
            const text = String(artifact.content || '');

            let lib = DB.get('furai_lorebook_library') || [];
            
            if (lib.some(b => b.title === item.title)) {
                showToast("This item is already in your Library.", "error");
                return;
            }

            lib.unshift({ 
                id: 'lb_' + Date.now(),
                type: artifact.type,
                title: artifact.title || item.title,
                hashTag: artifact.hashTag || item.hashTag || '',
                cover: artifact.cover || item.img,
                content: text,
                timestamp: Date.now(), 
                isDefault: false
            });
            
            DB.set('furai_lorebook_library', lib);
            showToast(`"${item.title}" added to Bookshelf!`, "success");
        } catch(e) {
            console.error(e);
            showToast("Failed to import item", "error");
        }
    }
};

// Inline HTML calls LorebookManager.* from outside Perchance's wrapped script scope.
// Keep this explicit public object export beside the declaration.
window.LorebookManager = LorebookManager;

function resolveFuraiCharacterImportUrl(value) {
    return resolveFuraiUploadFileUrl(value);
}

function getFuraiCharacterImportId(value) {
    return getFuraiUploadFileId(value);
}

function getFuraiCharacterImportValue(value) {
    const raw = String(value || '').trim();
    if (!raw) return '';

    try {
        const parsedUrl = new URL(raw, window.location.href);
        return (
            parsedUrl.searchParams.get('char') ||
            parsedUrl.searchParams.get('char_import') ||
            ''
        );
    } catch (e) {
        return '';
    }
}

function isFuraiCharacterImportLink(value) {
    return !!getFuraiCharacterImportValue(value);
}

async function importFuraiCharacterLinkAsChat(rawUrl) {
    const importUrl = resolveFuraiCharacterImportUrl(rawUrl);
    const fetcher = window.root?.superFetch ? window.root.superFetch : fetch;
    const res = await fetcher(importUrl);

    if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error("Could not fetch character data. Link may be expired.");
    }

    const rawData = await parseFuraiCharacterJsonResponse(res);
    const charData = normalizeImportData(rawData);

    // Source URL viewMode should win for shared links like ?viewMode=vn.
    charData.viewMode = resolveSharedOrInheritedViewMode(charData.viewMode, rawUrl);

    createTempChat(charData);
    return charData;
}

/* --- FIXED: ROBUST CHARACTER IMPORT --- */
async function importFuraiLibraryLinkFromUrl(rawUrl, type) {
    const parsedUrl = new URL(rawUrl, window.location.href);
    const sourceValue = parsedUrl.searchParams.get(type);
    if (!sourceValue) throw new Error(`Missing ${type} link data.`);

    const fetchUrl = resolveFuraiUploadFileUrl(sourceValue);
    const fetcher = window.root?.superFetch ? window.root.superFetch : fetch;
    const response = await fetcher(fetchUrl);
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Could not fetch ${type} data. Link may be expired.`);

    const artifact = await readFuraiLibraryArtifactResponse(response, {
        type,
        title: String(parsedUrl.searchParams.get('name') || '').replace(/_/g, ' ')
    });
    return LorebookManager.importArtifactData(artifact, { type });
}

/* --- ROBUST CHARACTER / LOREBOOK / GLOSSARY LINK IMPORT --- */
async function checkForCharacterImport() {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const characterValue = params.get('char') || params.get('char_import');
    const libraryType = params.get('glossary') ? 'glossary' : (params.get('lorebook') ? 'lorebook' : '');

    if (!characterValue && !libraryType) return;

    const loader = document.getElementById('globalLoader');
    if (loader) {
        loader.style.display = 'flex';
        loader.style.opacity = '1';
        loader.querySelector('.loading-text').textContent = characterValue
            ? 'Importing Character...'
            : `Importing ${libraryType === 'glossary' ? 'Glossary' : 'Lorebook'}...`;
    }

    try {
        if (characterValue) {
            await importFuraiCharacterLinkAsChat(window.location.href);
        } else {
            await importFuraiLibraryLinkFromUrl(window.location.href, libraryType);

            // A Bookshelf link still needs a real app/home surface behind its modal.
            if (typeof startNewChat === 'function') startNewChat();
            setTimeout(() => {
                try {
                    LorebookManager.openLibrary(null, 'library');
                    LorebookManager.switchTab(libraryType);
                } catch (error) {}
            }, 0);
        }
        window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
    } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
        alert(`Failed to import ${characterValue ? 'character' : libraryType}: ${error.message}`);
        if (typeof startNewChat === 'function') startNewChat();
    } finally {
        if (loader) {
            loader.style.opacity = '0';
            setTimeout(() => loader.remove(), 250);
        }
    }
}

/* --- MULTI-TAB EVENT LISTENER --- */
let furaiRemoteChatReloadTimer = null;
let furaiRemoteChatReloadId = '';

function didFuraiRemoteMessagesChange(previousChatData, incomingChatData) {
    const previousMessages = Array.isArray(previousChatData?.messages) ? previousChatData.messages : [];
    const incomingMessages = Array.isArray(incomingChatData?.messages) ? incomingChatData.messages : [];
    const previousRevision = Math.max(0, Number(previousChatData?.memoryRevision) || 0);
    const incomingRevision = Math.max(0, Number(incomingChatData?.memoryRevision) || 0);

    if (previousMessages.length !== incomingMessages.length) return true;
    if (previousRevision !== incomingRevision) return true;
    if (!previousMessages.length) return false;

    const messageSignature = message => [
        String(message?.uid || ''),
        String(message?.role || ''),
        String(message?.content || ''),
        Number(message?.activeVariantIndex) || 0,
        Number(message?.revision) || 0
    ].join('|');

    return (
        messageSignature(previousMessages[0]) !== messageSignature(incomingMessages[0]) ||
        messageSignature(previousMessages[previousMessages.length - 1]) !== messageSignature(incomingMessages[incomingMessages.length - 1])
    );
}

function scheduleFuraiRemoteChatReload(chatId) {
    if (!chatId) return;

    furaiRemoteChatReloadId = chatId;
    if (furaiRemoteChatReloadTimer) clearTimeout(furaiRemoteChatReloadTimer);

    furaiRemoteChatReloadTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        furaiRemoteChatReloadTimer = null;

        if (furaiRemoteChatReloadId !== chatId || currentChatId !== chatId) return;

        const inputEl = document.getElementById('messageInputEl');
        const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
        const isTyping = !!inputEl?.value.trim();
        const isReadingOlderMessages = !!chatMessagesEl && (
            chatMessagesEl.scrollHeight - chatMessagesEl.scrollTop - chatMessagesEl.clientHeight > 80
        );

        if (isGenerating || furaiAiRequestPending || isTyping || isReadingOlderMessages) {
            showToast('New messages received in another tab. Reopen this chat when ready to refresh.', 'info');
            return;
        }

        loadChat(chatId, { refreshSidebar: false });
    }, 140);
}

furaiSyncChannel.onmessage = (event) => {
    const { action, key, payload } = event.data;
    const previousChatData = action === 'set' && key === currentChatId && key.startsWith('chat-')
        ? DB.get(key)
        : null;

    // 1. Instantly sync the RAM cache (Zero CPU cost, avoids IndexedDB read)
    if (action === 'set') {
        StorageEngine.cache[key] = payload;

        if (key.startsWith('global-image-trigger-') || key.startsWith('global-cutscene-trigger-')) delete furaiVisualTriggerRuntimeCache[key];
    
        if (typeof syncChatSidebarMetaFromRemoteSet === 'function') {
            syncChatSidebarMetaFromRemoteSet(key);
        }
    } else if (action === 'remove') {
        delete StorageEngine.cache[key];

        if (key.startsWith('global-image-trigger-') || key.startsWith('global-cutscene-trigger-')) delete furaiVisualTriggerRuntimeCache[key];
    
        if (typeof syncChatSidebarMetaFromRemove === 'function') {
            syncChatSidebarMetaFromRemove(key);
        }
    }

    // Font inheritance is live across tabs. Refresh the visible chat without
    // reloading messages when either its mode font or Interface fallback changes.
    if (key === 'furai_ui_font') {
        void restoreSavedAppFont();
        refreshCurrentChatFontIfInheritsGlobal();
    } else if (key === 'furai_chat_avatar_size') {
        applyFuraiAvatarSize(getSavedFuraiAvatarSize(), { updateControls: false });
    } else if (key.startsWith('global-font-')) {
        refreshCurrentChatFontIfInheritsGlobal(key.slice('global-font-'.length));
    }

    // 2. Intelligent UI Updates
    if (key.startsWith('chat-')) {
        debouncedSidebarUpdate(); // Safely refresh the history list

        // Refresh the visible room only when message history actually changed.
        // Metadata/profile repairs no longer tear down and rebuild an older chat.
        if (key === currentChatId) {
            const incomingChatData = DB.get(key);

            if (didFuraiRemoteMessagesChange(previousChatData, incomingChatData)) {
                scheduleFuraiRemoteChatReload(key);
            }
        }
    } 
    else if (key.startsWith('profile-') || key.startsWith('global')) {
        // Refresh menus if they are open
        if (key === `profile-${currentChatId}`) {
            if (typeof updateMenuProfiles === 'function') updateMenuProfiles();
            if (chatPersonalities[currentChatId] === 'group' || chatPersonalities[currentChatId] === 'maker') {
                if (typeof renderGroupBotMenu === 'function') renderGroupBotMenu();
                
                const onlineModal = document.getElementById('onlineListModal');
                if (onlineModal && onlineModal.style.display === 'block') {
                    toggleOnlineList(true); // Refresh online list in place
                }
            }
        }
    }
};

/* --- FIXED INITIALIZATION GUARD --- */
let appInitialized = false;
let globalLoaderFallbackTimer = null;

function dismissGlobalLoader(delay = 0) {
    if (globalLoaderFallbackTimer) {
        clearTimeout(globalLoaderFallbackTimer);
        globalLoaderFallbackTimer = null;
    }

    setTimeout(() => {
        const loader = document.getElementById('globalLoader');
        if (!loader || loader.dataset.hiding === '1') return;

        loader.dataset.hiding = '1';
        loader.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
        loader.style.opacity = '0';

        setTimeout(() => {
            if (loader && loader.parentNode) loader.remove();
        }, 100);
    }, delay);
}

function dismissGlobalLoaderFallback(delay = 15000) {
    if (globalLoaderFallbackTimer) clearTimeout(globalLoaderFallbackTimer);
    globalLoaderFallbackTimer = setTimeout(() => dismissGlobalLoader(0), delay);
}

async function initApp() {
    if (appInitialized) return;
    appInitialized = true;
    dismissGlobalLoaderFallback(15000);

    // 1. INIT STORAGE (Async Wait)
    await StorageEngine.init();
    ensureFuraiVisualTriggerSeeds();
    initFuraiContextMetaSetting();
    applyFuraiAvatarSize(getSavedFuraiAvatarSize(), { updateControls: false });
    await restoreSavedAppFont();
    ensureHistoryInit();

    // --- NEW: RUN FLATTENING MIGRATION ---
    applyFlatDataArchitecture();
    LorebookManager.init(); // <--- ADD THIS LINE
    
    // 2. Visuals
    restoreSavedThemeMode();

    try {
        // 2. ROUTING LOGIC
        const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        
        if (
            params.has('char') ||
            params.has('char_import') ||
            params.has('lorebook') ||
            params.has('glossary')
        ) {
            // A. Character / Bookshelf import mode
            if (typeof checkForCharacterImport === 'function') checkForCharacterImport();
        
        } else if (params.has('chat') || params.has('chat_share') || params.has('backup') || params.has('backup_share')) {
            // B. Shared chat / backup import mode
            if (typeof checkForChatImport === 'function') checkForChatImport();
        
        } else {
            // C. Standard Mode (Always start at Lobby)
            startNewChat();
        }

        // 3. EVENT LISTENERS
        const messageInputEl = document.getElementById('messageInputEl');
        const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
        const initialHeight = messageInputEl ? messageInputEl.clientHeight : 40;
   
        if (chatMessagesEl) {
            let chatBottomStateRaf = 0;

            chatMessagesEl.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                if (e.deltaY < -1) brakeCrBottomStick();
            }, { passive: true });

            chatMessagesEl.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
                if (chatBottomStateRaf) return;

                chatBottomStateRaf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    chatBottomStateRaf = 0;
                    autoScroll = canCrBottomStick() && isNearScrollBottom(chatMessagesEl);

                    if (autoScroll) {
                        hideCrBottomStatusPill();
                    }
                });
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
            const mentionSuggestionsEl = document.getElementById('mentionSuggestions');
            if (mentionSuggestionsEl && !mentionSuggestionsEl.contains(event.target) && event.target !== messageInputEl) {
                mentionSuggestionsEl.style.display = 'none';
            }
        });

        if (messageInputEl) {
            let messageInputLayoutRaf = 0;

            const syncMessageInputLayout = () => {
                messageInputLayoutRaf = 0;

                const container = document.querySelector('.chat-input-container');
                const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 768;
                const hasValue = messageInputEl.value !== '';
                const wasExpanded = !!container?.classList.contains('input-expanded');

                messageInputEl.style.height = 'auto';
                let measuredHeight = messageInputEl.scrollHeight;
                let shouldExpand = wasExpanded;

                if (container) {
                    if (isMobile) {
                        shouldExpand = hasValue;
                    } else if (measuredHeight > 70) {
                        shouldExpand = true;
                    } else if (measuredHeight < 55) {
                        shouldExpand = false;
                    }

                    if (shouldExpand !== wasExpanded) {
                        container.classList.toggle('input-expanded', shouldExpand);

                        // Width changes when the expanded layout toggles, so only
                        // this uncommon transition needs one fresh measurement.
                        messageInputEl.style.height = 'auto';
                        measuredHeight = messageInputEl.scrollHeight;
                    }
                }

                if (!hasValue || measuredHeight <= initialHeight) {
                    messageInputEl.style.height = '';
                } else {
                    messageInputEl.style.height = `${measuredHeight}px`;
                }

                messageInputEl.style.overflowY = measuredHeight > 160 ? 'auto' : 'hidden';
            };

            messageInputEl.addEventListener('input', function(e) {
                if (typeof handleMentionInput === 'function') handleMentionInput(e);

                // Draft capture remains immediate. Layout reads are coalesced to
                // one animation frame instead of forcing the whole chat to reflow
                // several times for every keyboard event.
                if (currentChatId) chatDrafts[currentChatId] = this.value;

                if (!messageInputLayoutRaf) {
                    messageInputLayoutRaf = requestAnimationFrame(syncMessageInputLayout);
                }
            });

            messageInputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if(typeof handleMentionKeydown === 'function') handleMentionKeydown(e);
                if (e.key === 'Enter' && e.ctrlKey) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    handleSendOrStop();
                }
            });
        }

        window.removeEventListener('resize', handleAppResize);
        window.addEventListener('resize', handleAppResize); 

        const backupInput = document.getElementById('backupFileInput');
        if(backupInput) backupInput.onchange = handleBackupFile;
        
        bindLightboxInteractions();

        // Do not block first visible frame with sidebar/history work.
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (typeof debouncedSidebarUpdate === 'function') {
                    debouncedSidebarUpdate();
                } else if (typeof updateChatList === 'function') {
                    updateChatList();
                }
        
                if (typeof loadPrivateChannels === 'function') {
                    loadPrivateChannels();
                }
        
                const galleryIframe = document.querySelector('#galleryBody iframe');
                if (galleryIframe) {
                    galleryIframe.setAttribute('allow', 'clipboard-read *; clipboard-write *; fullscreen *');
                }
        
                if (typeof scheduleMobileSidebarWarmup === 'function') {
                    scheduleMobileSidebarWarmup();
                }
            }, 120);
        });

    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Critical Init Error:", e);
    }

    // 4. CLEANUP LOADER
    const cleanupParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const hasImportParams = ['char', 'char_import', 'chat', 'chat_share', 'backup', 'backup_share']
        .some(key => cleanupParams.has(key));
    
    if (!hasImportParams) {
        dismissGlobalLoader(0);
    }
    
    if(typeof checkPrivacyLock === 'function') checkPrivacyLock();
    if(typeof updateSidebarSiteName === 'function') updateSidebarSiteName();

} // <--- This is the end of initApp()
