// Font restore is triggered later, after StorageEngine.init() finishes.
  
function handleTouchStart(chatId, e) {
    touchStartTime = Date.now();
    touchedChatId = chatId;
    isLongPress = false; // Reset
    
    if (longPressTimer) clearTimeout(longPressTimer);
    
    longPressTimer = setTimeout(() => { 
        isLongPress = true; // Flag this as a hold
        openChatOptionsModal(chatId); // Open menu directly
        longPressTimer = null; 
    }, longPressThreshold);
}
  
  function handleTouchEnd(e) {
    if (longPressTimer) clearTimeout(longPressTimer);
    longPressTimer = null;
    touchedChatId = null;
  }
  
  function handleTouchMove(e) {
    if (longPressTimer) clearTimeout(longPressTimer);
    longPressTimer = null;
  }

/* ==========================================================================
   SIDEBAR FIX: GHOST CLICK IMMUNITY
   Prevents the sidebar from closing when a button is clicked and destroyed.
   ========================================================================== */

/* 1. GLOBAL IMMUNITY FLAG */
window.sidebarImmunityLock = false;

/* 1. TOGGLE MENU (The Fixed Version) */
function isMobileSidebarMode() {
    return (
        window.innerWidth <= 768 ||
        document.body.classList.contains('vn-active') ||
        document.body.classList.contains('home-vn-mode')
    );
}

let mobileSidebarAnimationTimer = null;
let mobileSidebarPrimePromise = null;
let mobileSidebarWarmupScheduled = false;
let mobileSidebarFirstOpenPending = false;
let mobileSidebarDeferredRefreshPending = false;
let mobileSidebarDeferredRefreshQuery = null;

function flushDeferredMobileSidebarRefresh() {
    if (!mobileSidebarDeferredRefreshPending) return;

    const query = mobileSidebarDeferredRefreshQuery;
    mobileSidebarDeferredRefreshPending = false;
    mobileSidebarDeferredRefreshQuery = null;

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        if (typeof updateChatList === 'function') updateChatList(query);
    });
}

function markMobileSidebarAnimating(sidebar) {
    if (!sidebar) return;

    if (mobileSidebarAnimationTimer) clearTimeout(mobileSidebarAnimationTimer);
    sidebar.classList.add('sidebar-animating');

    mobileSidebarAnimationTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        mobileSidebarAnimationTimer = null;
        sidebar.classList.remove('sidebar-animating', 'sidebar-layer-warm', 'sidebar-preparing');
        flushDeferredMobileSidebarRefresh();
    }, 220);
}

function primeMobileSidebarForFirstOpen(confirmCurrentPaint = false) {
    const sidebar = document.getElementById('menuSidebarEl');
    if (!sidebar || !isMobileSidebarMode()) return Promise.resolve(false);
    if (sidebar.dataset.slideUsed === 'true') return Promise.resolve(true);
    if (sidebar.dataset.slidePrimed === 'true' && !confirmCurrentPaint) {
        return Promise.resolve(true);
    }
    if (mobileSidebarPrimePromise) return mobileSidebarPrimePromise;

    sidebar.classList.add('sidebar-layer-warm', 'sidebar-preparing');
    sidebar.dataset.slidePriming = 'true';

    mobileSidebarPrimePromise = new Promise(resolve => {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            // Commit the complete off-screen sidebar once. This happens during idle
            // when possible, or after the first tap before the slide begins.
            void sidebar.getBoundingClientRect();

            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                sidebar.dataset.slidePrimed = 'true';
                delete sidebar.dataset.slidePriming;
                resolve(true);
            });
        });
    }).finally(() => {
        mobileSidebarPrimePromise = null;
    });

    return mobileSidebarPrimePromise;
}

function prepareMobileSidebarContent() {
    const chatListEl = document.getElementById('chatListEl');
    if (!chatListEl || typeof updateChatList !== 'function') return;

    const stillInitial = !!chatListEl.querySelector('.sidebar-chat-loading');
    if (!stillInitial || Date.now() < furaiBlockSidebarUntil) return;

    // The sidebar index is lightweight. Promote this one lazy render only when
    // the user is about to open the sidebar; old chat logs remain untouched.
    updateChatList(getActiveSidebarSearchQuery());
}

function scheduleMobileSidebarWarmup() {
    if (mobileSidebarWarmupScheduled || !isMobileSidebarMode()) return;

    mobileSidebarWarmupScheduled = true;

    const run = () => {
        mobileSidebarWarmupScheduled = false;
        // Keep startup lazy: prepare only the lightweight chat-list content.
        // The compositor layer is created just in time on the first real tap.
        prepareMobileSidebarContent();
    };

    if (window.requestIdleCallback) {
        requestIdleCallback(run, { timeout: 1200 });
    } else {
        setTimeout(run, 700);
    }
}

function openPreparedMobileSidebar(sidebar, menuBtn) {
    if (!sidebar || sidebar.classList.contains('open')) return;

    mobileSidebarFirstOpenPending = false;
    sidebar.dataset.slideUsed = 'true';
    sidebar.classList.remove('sidebar-preparing');
    markMobileSidebarAnimating(sidebar);
    sidebar.classList.add('open');

    if (menuBtn) playLiteUiMotion(menuBtn, 'ui-lite-btn-nudge', 240);
}

function toggleMenu() {
    closeOnlineList();

    const sidebar = document.getElementById('menuSidebarEl');
    const menuBtn = document.getElementById('menuToggleBtn');
    if (!sidebar) return;

    const shouldOpen = !sidebar.classList.contains('open');
    const isMobile = isMobileSidebarMode();

    if (!isMobile) {
        sidebar.classList.toggle('open', shouldOpen);
        return;
    }

    // A second tap before the first prepared open acts as a cancel, not a queued
    // double-toggle. The prepared layer remains available for the next tap.
    if (mobileSidebarFirstOpenPending && shouldOpen) {
        mobileSidebarFirstOpenPending = false;
        sidebar.classList.remove('sidebar-layer-warm', 'sidebar-preparing');
        delete sidebar.dataset.slidePrimed;
        delete sidebar.dataset.slidePriming;
        return;
    }

    if (shouldOpen && sidebar.dataset.slideUsed !== 'true') {
        mobileSidebarFirstOpenPending = true;
        prepareMobileSidebarContent();

        // Confirm the current sidebar DOM on the next paint even when idle warm-up
        // already ran. This catches a chat-list render that finished after warm-up.
        primeMobileSidebarForFirstOpen(true).then(ready => {
            if (!ready || !mobileSidebarFirstOpenPending) return;

            if (!isMobileSidebarMode() || sidebar.classList.contains('open')) {
                mobileSidebarFirstOpenPending = false;
                sidebar.classList.remove('sidebar-layer-warm', 'sidebar-preparing');
                return;
            }

            openPreparedMobileSidebar(sidebar, menuBtn);
        });

        return;
    }

    markMobileSidebarAnimating(sidebar);
    sidebar.classList.toggle('open', shouldOpen);

    if (shouldOpen && menuBtn) {
        playLiteUiMotion(menuBtn, 'ui-lite-btn-nudge', 240);
    }
}

/* 2. HANDLE CHAT CLICK */
function handleChatClick(event, chatId) {
    if (event) event.stopPropagation();

    mobileSelectedId = chatId;
    updateSelectionUI(chatId);

    window.pendingSidebarLoadId = chatId;

    const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 768;
    const shouldShowImmediately = isLikelyHeavyChatLoad(chatId);
    const delayedRevealMs = shouldShowImmediately ? 0 : 360;
    const minVisibleTime = 360;

    const loadingStartedAt = Date.now();

    setSidebarLoadingStatus(chatId, true, {
        delayed: !shouldShowImmediately
    });

    const clearLoading = () => {
        const visibleFrom = loadingStartedAt + delayedRevealMs;
        const visibleElapsed = Date.now() - visibleFrom;

        const remaining = visibleElapsed > 0
            ? Math.max(0, minVisibleTime - visibleElapsed)
            : 0;

        setTimeout(() => {
            setSidebarLoadingStatus(chatId, false);
        }, remaining);
    };

    const loadSelectedChat = () => {
        if (window.pendingSidebarLoadId !== chatId) {
            clearLoading();
            return;
        }

        try {
            loadChat(chatId, { refreshSidebar: false });
        } finally {
            clearLoading();

            if (window.pendingSidebarLoadId === chatId) {
                window.pendingSidebarLoadId = null;
            }
        }
    };

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            setTimeout(loadSelectedChat, shouldShowImmediately ? (isMobile ? 120 : 40) : 0);
        });
    });
}

function getViewModeFromUrl(rawUrl = '') {
    try {
        const params = rawUrl
            ? new URL(String(rawUrl), window.location.href).searchParams
            : new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);

        const mode = params.get('viewMode');
        return (mode === 'vn' || mode === 'chat') ? mode : null;
    } catch (e) {
        const match = String(rawUrl || '').match(/[?&]viewMode=(vn|chat)\b/);
        return match ? match[1] : null;
    }
}

function getHomeViewMode() {
    try {
        const mode = DB.get('furai_home_view_mode');
        if (mode === 'vn' || mode === 'chat') return mode;
    } catch (e) {}

    if (currentChatId) {
        try {
            const legacy = DB.get(currentChatId);
            if (legacy?.personality === 'home' && (legacy.viewMode === 'vn' || legacy.viewMode === 'chat')) {
                DB.set('furai_home_view_mode', legacy.viewMode);
                return legacy.viewMode;
            }
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    return 'chat';
}

function setHomeViewMode(mode, options = {}) {
    const normalized = mode === 'vn' ? 'vn' : 'chat';
    DB.set('furai_home_view_mode', normalized);

    if (options.mirrorChat !== false && currentChatId) {
        try {
            const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
            if (chatData?.personality === 'home') {
                chatData.viewMode = normalized;
                DB.set(currentChatId, chatData);
            }
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    return normalized;
}

function getHomeSeedViewMode() {
    return getHomeViewMode();
}

function refreshHomeMascot(options = {}) {
    const mascot = options.mascot || getHomeMascotSnapshot();
    const avatarEl = document.getElementById('homeSelectorBotAvatar');
    const nameEl = document.getElementById('homeSelectorBotName');
    const layer = document.getElementById('homeVnSpiritLayer');

    if (avatarEl) refreshFuraiHomeGreetingPortrait(mascot);

    if (nameEl) nameEl.textContent = mascot?.name || 'FurAI';

    if (layer) {
        const sprite = String(mascot?.defaultSprite || mascot?.emotionSprites?.default || '').trim();
        if (getHomeViewMode() === 'vn' && sprite) {
            layer.innerHTML = `
              <img
                src="${escapeHTML(sprite)}"
                alt="${escapeHTML(mascot?.name || 'Research AI')}"
                class="home-vn-spirit"
                onclick="openHomeGreetingSourceEditor()"
                title="Edit Research AI"
                onerror="this.remove()"
              >`;
        } else {
            layer.innerHTML = '';
        }
    }
}

function renderHomeScreen(options = {}) {
    if (typeof clearFuraiIdleAnnouncementTimer === 'function') {
        clearFuraiIdleAnnouncementTimer();
    }

    const mode = setHomeViewMode(options.mode || getHomeViewMode());
    const isHomeVn = mode === 'vn';
    const body = document.body;
    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    const vnOverlay = document.getElementById('vnOverlay');
    const inputContainer = document.querySelector('.chat-input-container');

    isVnMode = false;
    body.classList.add('furai-home-screen-active');
    body.classList.remove('vn-active', 'vn-fullscreen', 'vn-no-input');
    body.classList.toggle('home-vn-mode', isHomeVn);
    if (vnOverlay) vnOverlay.style.display = 'none';

    syncHomeModeToggleButtons(isHomeVn);

    if (chatMessagesEl) {
        chatMessagesEl.innerHTML = '';
        chatMessagesEl.style.paddingTop = isHomeVn ? '44px' : '16px';
        chatMessagesEl.scrollTop = 0;
    }

    const titleEl = document.getElementById('chatTitleEl');
    if (titleEl) {
        titleEl.textContent = 'Home';
        titleEl.setAttribute('data-furai-ui-translate', '');
        if (typeof scheduleFuraiUiScan === 'function') scheduleFuraiUiScan(titleEl);
    }
    const onlineCountEl = document.getElementById('onlineCountEl');
    if (onlineCountEl) onlineCountEl.style.display = 'none';
    const castSwitchBtn = document.getElementById('castSwitchBtn');
    if (castSwitchBtn) castSwitchBtn.style.display = 'none';

    createPersonalitySelectorMessage();
    refreshHomeMascot({ mascot: options.mascot });
    if (inputContainer) inputContainer.style.display = 'none';

    applyBackground(currentChatId);
    refreshVnPromoState();
    if (typeof updatePinnedFactsUI === 'function') updatePinnedFactsUI();
    if (chatMessagesEl) chatMessagesEl.scrollTop = 0;
}


function resolveSharedOrInheritedViewMode(savedMode = null, sourceUrl = '') {
    const urlMode = getViewModeFromUrl(sourceUrl);

    if (urlMode === 'vn' || urlMode === 'chat') {
        return urlMode;
    }

    if (savedMode === 'vn' || savedMode === 'chat') {
        return savedMode;
    }

    return getHomeSeedViewMode();
}

function clearHomeVnSpiritState() {
    document.body.classList.remove('furai-home-screen-active', 'home-vn-mode', 'vn-no-input');

    const homeSpiritLayer = document.getElementById('homeVnSpiritLayer');
    if (homeSpiritLayer && homeSpiritLayer.innerHTML) {
        homeSpiritLayer.innerHTML = '';
    }
}

/* 3. LOAD CHAT (Standard Logic) */
window.loadChat = function(chatId, options = {}) {

    let chatData = null;

    try {
        chatData = chatId ? DB.get(chatId) : null;
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn("loadChat failed to read chat:", chatId, e);
    }

    // Missing chat data is normal during first session, Home rebuild, New Chat,
    // stale sidebar rows, or deleted chats. Never show a toast here.
    // Also, do not close Livestream until a real destination chat is confirmed.
    if (!chatData) {
        if (options.refreshSidebar !== false && typeof updateChatList === "function") {
            updateChatList();
        }

        return false;
    }

    let currentPersonalityBeforeLoad = '';
    try {
        currentPersonalityBeforeLoad = currentChatId
            ? String(chatPersonalities?.[currentChatId] || DB.get(currentChatId)?.personality || '')
            : '';
    } catch (e) {}

    const nextPersonalityForLoad = String(chatData.personality || 'researcher');
    if (currentChatId !== chatId || currentPersonalityBeforeLoad !== nextPersonalityForLoad) {
        window.FuraiUiContextLifecycle?.transition('load-chat');
    }

    if (document.body.classList.contains("furai-livestream-active") && typeof FuraiLivestream !== "undefined") {
        FuraiLivestream.close({ restoreHome: false });
    }

    if (window.FuraiWorkspaceSurfaceManager?.isActive() && typeof closeExpansionModal === 'function') {
        closeExpansionModal({ restoreHome: false });
    }

    abortCurrentGeneration();
    closeOnlineList();
    if (typeof clearFuraiIdleAnnouncementTimer === 'function') {
        clearFuraiIdleAnnouncementTimer();
    }
    
    const messageInputEl = document.getElementById('messageInputEl');

    if (chatData.personality === 'home') {
        if (currentChatId && messageInputEl) chatDrafts[currentChatId] = messageInputEl.value;
        currentChatId = chatId;
        window.currentChatId = chatId;
        chatPersonalities[chatId] = 'home';
        window.chatPersonalities = chatPersonalities;
        // The legacy Home record seeds the canonical setting only once inside
        // getHomeViewMode(). After that, the canonical Home state always wins.
        setHomeViewMode(getHomeViewMode(), { mirrorChat: true });
        renderHomeScreen();
        updateSelectionUI(chatId);
        if (options.refreshSidebar !== false && typeof updateChatList === 'function') updateChatList();
        return true;
    }
    if (currentChatId && messageInputEl) chatDrafts[currentChatId] = messageInputEl.value;
    if (typeof window.closeFuraiModeSwitcher === 'function') window.closeFuraiModeSwitcher();
    
    const normalizedMessageStorage =
        typeof normalizeChatMessageStorage === 'function' &&
        normalizeChatMessageStorage(chatData);
    const initializedMemoryDefaults = ensureFuraiChatMemoryDefaults(chatData, chatData.personality || 'researcher');
    const normalizedFontState = normalizeChatFontState(chatData);

    if (normalizedMessageStorage || initializedMemoryDefaults || normalizedFontState) {
        DB.set(chatId, chatData);
    }
    if (normalizedMessageStorage) {
        notifyFuraiMessageMutation(chatId, 0, 'repair');
    }

    if (currentChatId !== chatId) {
        const previousChatId = currentChatId;
        furaiSemanticEpoch++;
        if (furaiSemanticForegroundQuery?.requestId) {
            cancelFuraiSemanticWorkerRequest(
                furaiSemanticForegroundQuery.requestId,
                'Semantic query superseded by chat navigation.'
            );
        }
        furaiSemanticForegroundQuery = null;
        releaseFuraiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex();
        if (previousChatId) {
            const previousTimer = furaiDeepMemoryTimers.get(previousChatId);
            if (previousTimer) clearTimeout(previousTimer);
            furaiDeepMemoryTimers.delete(previousChatId);
            bumpFuraiDeepMemoryChatEpoch(previousChatId);
        }
        if (furaiSemanticIndexTimer) clearTimeout(furaiSemanticIndexTimer);
        furaiSemanticIndexTimer = null;
        furaiSemanticIndexingChatId = '';
    }
    currentChatId = chatId;
    window.currentChatId = currentChatId;
    cacheFuraiMemoryMode(chatId, chatData.memoryMode);
    handleFuraiSemanticChatActivation(chatId, chatData);
    chatData = DB.get(chatId) || chatData;
    if (typeof cacheFuraiMorphModeMeta === 'function') {
        cacheFuraiMorphModeMeta(chatId, chatData);
    }

    // Loading a real chat/character should never keep the fake Home VN spirit behind it
    if (chatData.personality !== 'home') {
        clearHomeVnSpiritState();
    }

    const savedMode = resolveSharedOrInheritedViewMode(chatData.viewMode);
    isVnMode = (savedMode === 'vn');
    
    const inputContainer = document.querySelector('.chat-input-container');
    if (inputContainer) {
        inputContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
        inputContainer.classList.remove('input-expanded');
        if (inputContainer.style.display === 'none') inputContainer.style.display = ''; 
    }
    document.body.classList.remove('vn-no-input');    

    if (isVnMode) {
        document.body.classList.add('vn-active');
        document.getElementById('vnOverlay').style.display = 'flex';
        document.getElementById('vnToggleBtn').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('chatModeToggleBtn').style.display = 'flex';
    } else {
        document.body.classList.remove('vn-active');
        document.getElementById('vnOverlay').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('vnToggleBtn').style.display = 'flex';
        document.getElementById('chatModeToggleBtn').style.display = 'none';
    }

    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    chatMessagesEl.innerHTML = ''; 
    const hydrateToken = ++furaiChatHydrateToken;
    
    chatPersonalities[chatId] = chatData.personality || 'researcher';
    window.chatPersonalities = chatPersonalities;
    furaiScheduleDeepMemory(chatId, { delay: 1400 });
    
    void applyChatRenderFontForData(chatData);
    applyTextColorsForChatData(chatData);

    cleanupOlderMessageLoader(chatMessagesEl);

    const uiProfile = (chatData.personality === 'group' || chatData.personality === 'maker')
        ? getChatProfile(chatId)
        : null;
    
    if (chatData.messages && chatData.messages.length > 0) {
        const messages = chatData.messages;
        const fastOpen = !isVnMode && messages.length > FURAI_FAST_OPEN_TAIL_LIMIT;
        const startIndex = fastOpen ? Math.max(0, messages.length - FURAI_FAST_OPEN_TAIL_LIMIT) : 0;
        const fragment = renderMessageSliceToFragment(messages, startIndex, messages.length);
    
        chatMessagesEl.appendChild(fragment);

        if (typeof normalizeRenderedMessageOrder === 'function') {
            normalizeRenderedMessageOrder(chatMessagesEl);
        }

        if (typeof queueFuraiContextMetaRender === 'function') {
            queueFuraiContextMetaRender();
        }
    
        if(messageInputEl) messageInputEl.value = chatDrafts[chatId] || '';
        updateUIForPersonality(chatData.personality, messageInputEl, uiProfile);
        
        if (!isVnMode) {
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                chatMessagesEl.scrollTop = chatMessagesEl.scrollHeight;
            });
        }
    
        if (fastOpen) {
            bindOlderMessageLoader(chatId, messages, startIndex, hydrateToken);
        }
    } else {
        createPersonalitySelectorMessage();
        updateUIForPersonality(chatData.personality, messageInputEl, uiProfile);
    }
    
    if (isVnMode) {
        syncVnData();
        vnCurrentIndex = (vnMessagesCache.length > 0) ? vnMessagesCache.length - 1 : 0;
        renderVnMessage(); 
    }
    
    const bgBtn = document.getElementById('bgSettingsBtn');
    applyBackground(chatId); 
    if (bgBtn) bgBtn.style.display = 'flex'; 

    const chatTitleEl = document.getElementById('chatTitleEl');
    if (chatTitleEl) {
        chatTitleEl.removeAttribute('data-furai-ui-translate');
        chatTitleEl.textContent = chatData.title;
    }
    
    isFirstUserMessage = !chatData.messages || !chatData.messages.some(msg => msg.role === 'user');

    if (options.refreshSidebar === false) {
        updateSelectionUI(chatId);
    } else {
        updateChatList();
    }

    // Refresh pinned message UI after old chats finish loading.
    // This lets the VN header pin button or Chat Room toast appear immediately.
    if (typeof updatePinnedFactsUI === 'function') {
        updatePinnedFactsUI();

        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            updatePinnedFactsUI();
        });
    }

    if (typeof syncFuraiIdleAnnouncementTimer === 'function') {
        syncFuraiIdleAnnouncementTimer(chatId, chatData);
    }

};


function toggleMainMenu() {
    const dropdown = document.getElementById('mainMenuDropdown');
    const btn = document.getElementById('mainMenuBtn');
    const willOpen = !dropdown.classList.contains('show');

    dropdown.classList.toggle('show');

    if (dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
        if (btn) playLiteUiMotion(btn, 'ui-lite-btn-nudge', 240);
        if (willOpen) playLiteUiMotion(dropdown, 'ui-lite-pop-in', 220);
        window.addEventListener('click', closeMenuOutside, { once: true });
    }
}

  function closeMenuOutside(event) {
      const menuContainer = document.querySelector('.main-menu-container');
      if (menuContainer && !menuContainer.contains(event.target)) {
          document.getElementById('mainMenuDropdown').classList.remove('show');
      } else {
          window.addEventListener('click', closeMenuOutside, { once: true });
      }
  }

function playLiteUiMotion(target, className = 'ui-lite-pop-in', duration = 150) {
    const el = typeof target === 'string' ? document.querySelector(target) : target;
    if (!el) return;

    if (el._uiLiteAnim) {
        el._uiLiteAnim.cancel();
        el._uiLiteAnim = null;
    }

    const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')?.matches;
    if (reduceMotion) return;

    let keyframes = null;
    let options = {
        duration,
        easing: 'cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)',
        fill: 'none'
    };

    if (className === 'ui-lite-btn-nudge') {
        keyframes = [
            { transform: 'scale(1)' },
            { transform: 'scale(1.045)', offset: 0.45 },
            { transform: 'scale(1)' }
        ];
        options.duration = 120;
    } else if (className === 'ui-lite-sidebar-in') {
        keyframes = [
            { opacity: 0, transform: 'translate3d(-8px,0,0)' },
            { opacity: 1, transform: 'translate3d(0,0,0)' }
        ];
        options.duration = 140;
    } else if (className === 'ui-lite-glow') {
        keyframes = [
            { boxShadow: '0 0 0 0 rgba(var(--primary-color-rgb), 0)' },
            { boxShadow: '0 0 0 6px rgba(var(--primary-color-rgb), 0.12)', offset: 0.45 },
            { boxShadow: '0 0 0 0 rgba(var(--primary-color-rgb), 0)' }
        ];
        options.duration = 420;
    } else {
        keyframes = [
            { opacity: 0, transform: 'translate3d(0,4px,0) scale(.985)' },
            { opacity: 1, transform: 'translate3d(0,0,0) scale(1)' }
        ];
        options.duration = 130;
    }

    if (typeof el.animate === 'function') {
        el._uiLiteAnim = el.animate(keyframes, options);
        el._uiLiteAnim.onfinish = () => { el._uiLiteAnim = null; };
        el._uiLiteAnim.oncancel = () => { el._uiLiteAnim = null; };
        return;
    }

    el.classList.remove(className);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        el.classList.add(className);
        setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove(className), duration);
    });
}

function nudgeFreshHomeScreen() {
    const selector = document.getElementById('personality-selector-message');
    const sidebarNewChatBtn = document.querySelector('.sidebar-actions-group .sidebar-action-row[onclick="startNewChatFromSidebar()"]');
    const title = document.getElementById('chatTitleEl');
    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');

    if (sidebarNewChatBtn) playLiteUiMotion(sidebarNewChatBtn, 'ui-lite-btn-nudge', 240);
    if (title) playLiteUiMotion(title, 'ui-lite-btn-nudge', 240);

    const target = selector || chatMessagesEl;
    if (target) {
        if (typeof target.scrollIntoView === 'function') {
            target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
        }
        playLiteUiMotion(target, 'ui-lite-glow', 560);
    }

    if (typeof showOverlayHint === 'function') {
        showOverlayHint('You are already on the Home screen. Pick a mode to begin.', 1800);
    }
}

/* --- FIXED: FORCE MENU REFRESH ON OPEN --- */
let settingsMenuOriginalParent = null;

function mountSettingsMenuForVn() {
    const menu = document.getElementById('settingsMenu');
    const btn = document.getElementById('settingsBtn');
    if (!menu || !btn || !document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return;

    if (!settingsMenuOriginalParent) {
        settingsMenuOriginalParent = menu.parentElement;
    }

    if (menu.parentElement !== document.body) {
        document.body.appendChild(menu);
    }

    menu.classList.add('vn-floating-menu');

    const rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
    const menuWidth = menu.offsetWidth || 220;
    const gap = 12;

    let left = rect.left;
    left = Math.max(gap, Math.min(left, window.innerWidth - menuWidth - gap));

    menu.style.position = 'fixed';
    menu.style.left = `${left}px`;
    menu.style.top = 'auto';
    menu.style.right = 'auto';
    menu.style.bottom = `${window.innerHeight - rect.top + gap}px`;
    menu.style.zIndex = '3205';
}

function restoreSettingsMenuFromVn() {
    const menu = document.getElementById('settingsMenu');
    if (!menu) return;

    menu.classList.remove('vn-floating-menu');
    menu.style.position = '';
    menu.style.left = '';
    menu.style.top = '';
    menu.style.right = '';
    menu.style.bottom = '';
    menu.style.zIndex = '';

    if (settingsMenuOriginalParent && menu.parentElement !== settingsMenuOriginalParent) {
        settingsMenuOriginalParent.appendChild(menu);
    }
}

let settingsMenuPositionRaf = 0;

function scheduleSettingsMenuForVn() {
    if (settingsMenuPositionRaf) return;

    settingsMenuPositionRaf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        settingsMenuPositionRaf = 0;

        const menu = document.getElementById('settingsMenu');
        if (!menu?.classList.contains('show')) return;
        if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return;

        mountSettingsMenuForVn();
    });
}

function stopSettingsMenuPositionTracking() {
    window.removeEventListener('resize', scheduleSettingsMenuForVn);
    window.removeEventListener('scroll', scheduleSettingsMenuForVn, true);

    if (settingsMenuPositionRaf) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(settingsMenuPositionRaf);
        settingsMenuPositionRaf = 0;
    }
}

function toggleSettingsMenu() {
    const menu = document.getElementById('settingsMenu');
    const btn = document.getElementById('settingsBtn');
    const willOpen = !menu.classList.contains('show');

    if (willOpen) updateMenuProfiles();
    menu.classList.toggle('show');

    if (menu.classList.contains('show')) {
        if (btn) playLiteUiMotion(btn, 'ui-lite-btn-nudge', 240);
        if (window.updatePinnedFactsUI) updatePinnedFactsUI();
        if (document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) {
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                mountSettingsMenuForVn();
                if (willOpen) playLiteUiMotion(menu, 'ui-lite-pop-in', 220);
            });
            window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleSettingsMenuForVn);
            window.addEventListener('scroll', scheduleSettingsMenuForVn, true);
        } else if (willOpen) {
            playLiteUiMotion(menu, 'ui-lite-pop-in', 220);
        }
        document.addEventListener('pointerdown', closeSettingsMenuOutside, true);
    } else {
        document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', closeSettingsMenuOutside, true);
        restoreSettingsMenuFromVn();
        stopSettingsMenuPositionTracking();
    }
}

function closeSettingsMenuOutside(event) {
    const settingsContainer = document.querySelector('.settings-container');
    const menu = document.getElementById('settingsMenu');
    if (!menu?.classList.contains('show')) return;
    if (settingsContainer?.contains(event.target) || menu.contains(event.target)) return;

    menu.classList.remove('show');
    document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', closeSettingsMenuOutside, true);
    restoreSettingsMenuFromVn();
    stopSettingsMenuPositionTracking();
}

  function closeOnlineList() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('onlineListModal');
    if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
    window.removeEventListener('click', closeOnlineListOutside);
  }

  function rearmOnlineListOutsideClose() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('onlineListModal');
    window.removeEventListener('click', closeOnlineListOutside);
    if (!modal || modal.style.display !== 'block') return;

    // Re-arm after the current click finishes so a child layer can close by itself
    // without the same click falling through and dismissing this parent popover.
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (modal.style.display === 'block') {
        window.addEventListener('click', closeOnlineListOutside, { once: true });
      }
    }, 0);
  }
  
  function closeOnlineListOutside(event) {
    const modal = document.getElementById('onlineListModal');
    const onlineCountEl = document.getElementById('onlineCountEl');
    if (!modal || modal.style.display !== 'block') return;

    const target = event.target;
    const clickedParent = modal.contains(target) || onlineCountEl?.contains(target);

    // Modal/profile/lightbox layers opened from this popover are children.
    // Closing a child must never dismiss the still-open Online parent.
    const clickedChildLayer = target?.closest?.(
      '.modal, .profile-card-overlay, .lightbox-modal, [data-stack-layer="true"]'
    );

    if (clickedParent || clickedChildLayer) {
      rearmOnlineListOutsideClose();
      return;
    }

    closeOnlineList();
  }

const FURAI_GROUP_RANDOM_START_KEY = 'furai_group_random_start';
const FURAI_GROUP_RANDOM_START_LAST_KEY = 'furai_group_random_start_last';
const FURAI_GROUP_RANDOM_START_COUNT = 3;

const FURAI_GROUP_CAST_ANNOUNCEMENTS_KEY = 'furai_group_cast_announcements_enabled';
const FURAI_GROUP_IDLE_ANNOUNCEMENT_TARGET_KEY = 'furai_group_idle_announcement_target';
const FURAI_GROUP_IDLE_ANNOUNCEMENT_MINUTES_KEY = 'furai_group_idle_announcement_minutes';
const FURAI_IDLE_ANNOUNCEMENT_INTERVALS = Object.freeze([
    { minutes: 0, label: 'Never' },
    { minutes: 3, label: '3 minutes' },
    { minutes: 5, label: '5 minutes' },
    { minutes: 10, label: '10 minutes' },
    { minutes: 15, label: '15 minutes' },
    { minutes: 30, label: '30 minutes' },
    { minutes: 60, label: '1 hour' }
]);

function normalizeFuraiIdleAnnouncementTarget(value) {
    return value === 'user' ? 'user' : 'everyone';
}

function normalizeFuraiIdleAnnouncementMinutes(value) {
    const minutes = Math.floor(Number(value));
    return FURAI_IDLE_ANNOUNCEMENT_INTERVALS.some(item => item.minutes === minutes)
        ? minutes
        : 0;
}

function getFuraiIdleAnnouncementTargetOptionsHtml(value) {
    const selected = normalizeFuraiIdleAnnouncementTarget(value);
    return [
        `<option value="user" ${selected === 'user' ? 'selected' : ''}>You (User)</option>`,
        `<option value="everyone" ${selected === 'everyone' ? 'selected' : ''}>Everyone</option>`
    ].join('');
}

function getFuraiIdleAnnouncementIntervalOptionsHtml(value) {
    const selected = normalizeFuraiIdleAnnouncementMinutes(value);
    return FURAI_IDLE_ANNOUNCEMENT_INTERVALS
        .map(item => `<option value="${item.minutes}" ${selected === item.minutes ? 'selected' : ''}>${item.label}</option>`)
        .join('');
}

function normalizeRosterText(value) {
    return String(value || '').trim();
}

function isUneditedGlobalFreeSlot(bot, index = -1) {
    if (!bot) return true;

    const legacyFallbackAvatar = FURAI_DEFAULT_AVATAR_URL;
    const name = normalizeRosterText(bot.name);
    const avatar = normalizeRosterText(bot.avatar);
    const sprite = normalizeRosterText(bot.defaultSprite);
    const instruction = normalizeRosterText(bot.instruction);

    const hasCustomMeta =
        normalizeRosterText(bot.hashTag) ||
        normalizeRosterText(bot.openingMessage) ||
        normalizeRosterText(bot.customGreeting) ||
        normalizeRosterText(bot.greeting) ||
        normalizeRosterText(bot.initialMessage) ||
        hasFuraiProtectedInstructions(bot);

    const factoryBot = Array.isArray(defaultBots) ? defaultBots[index] : null;

    const hasFactoryStarterAvatar =
        !avatar ||
        avatar === legacyFallbackAvatar ||
        isFuraiStarterAvatar(avatar);

    if (factoryBot && /^sys_slot_/i.test(String(factoryBot.uid || ''))) {
        return (
            name === normalizeRosterText(factoryBot.name) &&
            hasFactoryStarterAvatar &&
            sprite === normalizeRosterText(factoryBot.defaultSprite) &&
            instruction === normalizeRosterText(factoryBot.instruction) &&
            !hasCustomMeta
        );
    }

    const looksLikeEmptySlotName = /^(Free|Extra) Slot \d+$/i.test(name);
    const hasBlankAvatar = hasFactoryStarterAvatar;
    const hasBlankSprite = !sprite;
    const hasBlankInstruction =
        !instruction ||
        instruction === 'This is an extra character slot.' ||
        instruction === 'This is an empty slot.' ||
        instruction.startsWith('This is an empty slot. Edit to create a new character.');

    return looksLikeEmptySlotName && hasBlankAvatar && hasBlankSprite && hasBlankInstruction && !hasCustomMeta;
}

function getGroupRandomCharacterKey(bot, index = -1) {
    if (!bot) return `slot:${index}`;

    const name = normalizeRosterText(bot.name).toLowerCase();
    if (name) return `name:${name}`;

    const uid = normalizeRosterText(bot.uid);
    if (uid) return `uid:${uid}`;

    return `slot:${index}`;
}

function shuffleRandomStartPool(pool) {
    const shuffled = [...pool];

    for (let i = shuffled.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
        const temp = shuffled[i];
        shuffled[i] = shuffled[j];
        shuffled[j] = temp;
    }

    return shuffled;
}

function getUniqueEligibleGroupRandomPool(roster) {
    const usedCharacterKeys = new Set();
    const uniquePool = [];

    roster.forEach((bot, index) => {
        if (!bot || isUneditedGlobalFreeSlot(bot, index)) return;

        const characterKey = getGroupRandomCharacterKey(bot, index);
        if (usedCharacterKeys.has(characterKey)) return;

        usedCharacterKeys.add(characterKey);
        uniquePool.push({ bot, index, characterKey });
    });

    return uniquePool;
}

const FURAI_DEFAULT_AVATAR_URL = 'https://user.uploads.dev/file/747a06387749000a4ac0f4c14f1911f0.jpg';

function isFuraiBlankFactoryUser(user) {
    if (!user || typeof user !== 'object') return false;

    const name = String(user.name || 'User').trim();
    const avatar = String(user.avatar || '').trim();
    const sprite = String(user.defaultSprite || '').trim();
    const hashTag = String(user.hashTag || '').trim();
    const hasCustomInstruction =
        String(user.instruction || '').trim() ||
        Object.values(user.instructions || {}).some(value => String(value || '').trim());
    const hasCustomOpening = [
        user.openingSystemMessage,
        user.openingMessage,
        user.openingBackground,
        user.openingLorebook
    ].some(value => String(value || '').trim());
    const hasCustomEmotions =
        Object.keys(user.customEmotions || {}).length > 0 ||
        Object.keys(user.emotionAvatars || {}).length > 0 ||
        Object.keys(user.emotionSprites || {}).length > 0;

    return name === 'User' &&
        !avatar &&
        !sprite &&
        !hashTag &&
        !hasCustomInstruction &&
        !hasCustomOpening &&
        !hasCustomEmotions;
}

function preserveFuraiLegacyDefaultUserAvatar(chatId, profile, options = {}) {
    if (!chatId || !profile || profile.profileCustomized === true) return false;
    if (!isFuraiBlankFactoryUser(profile.user)) return false;

    const isIntentionalBlankDefault =
        profile.user.defaultAvatarPolicy === FURAI_BLANK_DEFAULT_USER_POLICY;

    if (isIntentionalBlankDefault && options.userRecordWasMissing !== true && options.profileWasMissing !== true) {
        return false;
    }

    let chatData = null;
    try { chatData = DB.get(chatId); } catch (e) {}

    const hasLegacyUserMessages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) &&
        chatData.messages.some(message => message?.role === 'user');

    if (!hasLegacyUserMessages) return false;

    profile.user.avatar = FURAI_DEFAULT_AVATAR_URL;
    profile.user.legacyDefaultAvatarPreserved = true;
    delete profile.user.defaultAvatarPolicy;
    return true;
}

function getGroupRosterSourceUid(bot) {
    if (!bot || typeof bot !== 'object') return '';

    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(bot, 'groupRosterSourceUid')) {
        return String(bot.groupRosterSourceUid || '').trim();
    }

    // Legacy lightweight stubs used a synthetic uid such as "stub_4".
    // When a source index exists, that synthetic uid is not a library identity.
    if (
        bot.rosterStub === true &&
        Number.isInteger(Number(bot.groupRosterSourceIndex))
    ) {
        return '';
    }

    return String(bot.uid || bot.characterUid || '').trim();
}

function cloneGroupBotSnapshot(bot, index, patch = {}) {
    const cloned = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(bot || {}));

    if (!cloned.uid) cloned.uid = generateUID('roster_bot');
    if (!cloned.name) cloned.name = `Character ${index + 1}`;

    delete cloned.rosterStub;

    return Object.assign(cloned, patch);
}

function makeGroupRosterStub(bot, index, patch = {}) {
    const sourceUid = getGroupRosterSourceUid(bot);

    return Object.assign({
        uid: sourceUid || `stub_${index}`,
        name: String(bot?.name || '').trim(),
        groupRosterSourceUid: sourceUid,
        groupRosterSourceIndex: index,
        inActiveCast: false,
        isActive: false,
        rosterStub: true
    }, patch);
}

function getCurrentGroupRosterSource() {
    let roster = null;

    try {
        roster = DB.get('globalBotRoster');
    } catch(e) {}

    if (!Array.isArray(roster) || roster.length === 0) {
        roster = Array.isArray(defaultBots) ? defaultBots : [];
    }

    return roster;
}

function ensureGlobalRosterBotUids() {
    let roster = null;

    try {
        roster = DB.get('globalBotRoster');
    } catch(e) {}

    if (!Array.isArray(roster) || roster.length === 0) {
        roster = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(Array.isArray(defaultBots) ? defaultBots : []));
    }

    const usedUids = new Set();
    let changed = false;

    roster.forEach(bot => {
        if (!bot) return;

        let uid = String(bot.uid || '').trim();

        if (!uid || usedUids.has(uid)) {
            uid = generateUID('roster_bot');
            bot.uid = uid;
            changed = true;
        }

        usedUids.add(uid);
    });

    if (changed) DB.set('globalBotRoster', roster);
    return roster;
}

function getGroupRosterSourceBot(refBot, fallbackIndex, sourceRoster = null) {
    const roster = Array.isArray(sourceRoster)
        ? sourceRoster
        : getCurrentGroupRosterSource();

    const sourceUid = getGroupRosterSourceUid(refBot);

    if (sourceUid) {
        const foundIndex = roster.findIndex(bot =>
            String(bot?.uid || '').trim() === sourceUid
        );

        if (foundIndex !== -1) {
            return { bot: roster[foundIndex], index: foundIndex };
        }

        return null;
    }

    const sourceIndex = Number.isInteger(Number(refBot?.groupRosterSourceIndex))
        ? Number(refBot.groupRosterSourceIndex)
        : fallbackIndex;

    if (roster[sourceIndex]) {
        return { bot: roster[sourceIndex], index: sourceIndex };
    }

    return null;
}

function resolveGroupRosterStubForDisplay(bot, index, sourceRoster = null) {
    if (!bot || bot.rosterStub !== true) return bot;

    const found = getGroupRosterSourceBot(bot, index, sourceRoster);
    const source = found?.bot;

    if (!source) {
        return {
            ...bot,
            name: String(bot.name || '').trim() || 'Missing Character',
            avatar: bot.avatar || '',
            hashTag: bot.hashTag || '',
            defaultSprite: bot.defaultSprite || '',
            instruction: bot.instruction || ''
        };
    }

    return {
        ...source,
        ...bot,
        uid: source.uid || bot.uid || `stub_${index}`,
        name: source.name || `Character ${index + 1}`,
        hashTag: source.hashTag || '',
        avatar: source.avatar || '',
        defaultSprite: source.defaultSprite || '',
        groupRosterSourceUid: source.uid || bot.groupRosterSourceUid || '',
        groupRosterSourceIndex: found.index
    };
}

function hydrateGroupRosterStub(profile, index, options = {}) {
    if (!profile || !Array.isArray(profile.bots)) return null;

    const oldBot = profile.bots[index];
    if (!oldBot) return null;

    if (oldBot.rosterStub !== true) return oldBot;

    const found = getGroupRosterSourceBot(oldBot, index, options.sourceRoster);

    if (!found || !found.bot) {
        if (!options.silent && typeof showToast === 'function') {
            showToast(`${oldBot.name || 'This character'} is missing from the Character Library.`, "error");
        }
        return null;
    }

    const hydrated = cloneGroupBotSnapshot(found.bot, found.index, {
        groupRosterSourceUid: found.bot.uid || oldBot.groupRosterSourceUid || '',
        groupRosterSourceIndex: found.index,
        inActiveCast: oldBot.inActiveCast === true,
        isActive: oldBot.isActive === true,
        silentNote: oldBot.silentNote === true,
        chatStatus: oldBot.chatStatus === 'announcement' ? 'announcement' : undefined,
        replyMode:
            oldBot.replyMode ||
            profile.masterReplyMode ||
            found.bot.replyMode ||
            getGlobalCastMode(),
        activeTimestamp: oldBot.activeTimestamp,
        localRosterDeleted: oldBot.localRosterDeleted === true
    });

    profile.bots[index] = hydrated;
    return hydrated;
}

function buildLinkedGroupRoster(roster, options = {}) {
    const sourceRoster = Array.isArray(roster) ? roster : [];
    const masterMode = options.masterMode || getGlobalCastMode();
    const activeEntries = options.activeEntries instanceof Map ? options.activeEntries : null;
    const now = Date.now();

    return sourceRoster.map((bot, index) => {
        if (!bot) return makeGroupRosterStub(null, index);

        const forcedActive = activeEntries ? activeEntries.get(index) : null;
        const shouldBeActive = activeEntries
            ? !!forcedActive
            : bot.inActiveCast === true;

        if (shouldBeActive) {
            const order = forcedActive?.order || 0;

            return cloneGroupBotSnapshot(bot, index, {
                groupRosterSourceUid: getGroupRosterSourceUid(bot),
                groupRosterSourceIndex: index,
                inActiveCast: true,
                isActive: forcedActive ? true : bot.isActive === true,
                replyMode: masterMode,
                activeTimestamp: bot.activeTimestamp || now + order
            });
        }

        return makeGroupRosterStub(bot, index);
    });
}

function materializeGroupRosterForSnapshot(profile, options = {}) {
    const clone = options.clone === true;
    const target = clone ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(profile || {})) : profile;

    if (!target || !Array.isArray(target.bots)) {
        return { profile: target, changed: false, missingCount: 0 };
    }

    const sourceRoster = getCurrentGroupRosterSource();
    let changed = false;
    let missingCount = 0;

    target.bots = target.bots.map((bot, index) => {
        if (!bot) return bot;

        if (bot.rosterStub !== true) {
            const full = cloneGroupBotSnapshot(bot, index, {
                groupRosterSourceUid: bot.groupRosterSourceUid || bot.uid || '',
                groupRosterSourceIndex: Number.isInteger(Number(bot.groupRosterSourceIndex))
                    ? Number(bot.groupRosterSourceIndex)
                    : index,
                inActiveCast: bot.inActiveCast === true,
                isActive: bot.isActive === true,
                silentNote: bot.silentNote === true,
                chatStatus: bot.chatStatus === 'announcement' ? 'announcement' : undefined,
                replyMode: bot.replyMode,
                activeTimestamp: bot.activeTimestamp,
                localRosterDeleted: bot.localRosterDeleted === true
            });

            changed = true;
            return full;
        }

        const found = getGroupRosterSourceBot(bot, index, sourceRoster);

        if (!found || !found.bot) {
            missingCount++;
            changed = true;

            return {
                uid: bot.uid || `missing_${index}`,
                name: bot.name || 'Missing Character',
                hashTag: bot.hashTag || '',
                avatar: bot.avatar || '',
                defaultSprite: bot.defaultSprite || '',
                instruction: '',
                groupRosterSourceUid: bot.groupRosterSourceUid || '',
                groupRosterSourceIndex: bot.groupRosterSourceIndex ?? index,
                inActiveCast: false,
                isActive: false,
                localRosterDeleted: bot.localRosterDeleted === true,
                rosterMissing: true
            };
        }

        changed = true;

        return cloneGroupBotSnapshot(found.bot, found.index, {
            groupRosterSourceUid: found.bot.uid || bot.groupRosterSourceUid || '',
            groupRosterSourceIndex: found.index,
            inActiveCast: bot.inActiveCast === true,
            isActive: bot.isActive === true,
            silentNote: bot.silentNote === true,
            chatStatus: bot.chatStatus === 'announcement' ? 'announcement' : undefined,
            replyMode: bot.replyMode,
            activeTimestamp: bot.activeTimestamp,
            localRosterDeleted: bot.localRosterDeleted === true
        });
    });

    if (options.markSnapshot === true) {
        target.rosterMode = 'snapshot';
        target.rosterSnapshotSavedAt = Date.now();
        delete target.pendingGroupRosterSnapshot;
    }

    if (options.markExport === true) {
        target.rosterMode = 'snapshot';
        target.rosterExportSnapshot = true;
        target.rosterSnapshotSavedAt = target.rosterSnapshotSavedAt || Date.now();
        delete target.pendingGroupRosterSnapshot;
    }

    return { profile: target, changed, missingCount };
}

function saveRosterSnapshotForChat(chatId = null) {
    const targetId = chatId || optionsTargetChatId || currentChatId;
    if (!targetId) return;

    const chatData = DB.get(targetId);
    const personality = chatPersonalities[targetId] || chatData?.personality;

    if (personality !== 'group') {
        showToast("Roster snapshot is only for Group chats.", "error");
        return;
    }

    const profile = DB.get(`profile-${targetId}`) || getChatProfile(targetId);
    const result = materializeGroupRosterForSnapshot(profile, { markSnapshot: true });

    DB.set(`profile-${targetId}`, result.profile);

    if (targetId === currentChatId) {
        renderGroupBotMenu();
        updateOnlineCount();
        if (typeof updateTokenButtonUI === 'function') updateTokenButtonUI();
    }

    openChatOptionsModal(targetId);

    const missingText = result.missingCount ? ` ${result.missingCount} missing character(s) saved as placeholders.` : '';
    showToast(`Roster snapshot saved.${missingText}`, "success");
}

function removeRosterSnapshotForChat(chatId = null) {
    const targetId = chatId || optionsTargetChatId || currentChatId;
    if (!targetId) return;

    const profile = DB.get(`profile-${targetId}`);
    if (!profile || !Array.isArray(profile.bots)) return;

    if (!confirm("Use linked roster again? Offline snapshot characters will follow your current Character Library. Active characters stay saved in this chat.")) {
        return;
    }

    const sourceRoster = getCurrentGroupRosterSource();
    const chatData = DB.get(targetId) || {};
    const usedBotUids = new Set();
    const usedBotIndexes = new Set();

    (Array.isArray(chatData.messages) ? chatData.messages : []).forEach(message => {
        if (!message || message.role !== 'ai') return;

        const messageUid = String(message.botUid || '').trim();
        if (messageUid) usedBotUids.add(messageUid);

        const messageIndex = Number(message.botIndex);
        if (Number.isInteger(messageIndex) && messageIndex >= 0) {
            usedBotIndexes.add(messageIndex);
        }
    });

    profile.bots = profile.bots.map((bot, index) => {
        if (!bot) return bot;

        if (bot.inActiveCast === true) return bot;

        const hasHistoricalMessages =
            (bot.uid && usedBotUids.has(String(bot.uid))) ||
            usedBotIndexes.has(index);

        if (hasHistoricalMessages) return bot;

        const found = getGroupRosterSourceBot(bot, index, sourceRoster);

        if (!found || !found.bot) {
            return bot;
        }

        return makeGroupRosterStub(found.bot, found.index, {
            localRosterDeleted: bot.localRosterDeleted === true
        });
    });

    profile.rosterMode = 'linked';
    delete profile.rosterSnapshotSavedAt;
    delete profile.rosterExportSnapshot;

    DB.set(`profile-${targetId}`, profile);

    if (targetId === currentChatId) {
        renderGroupBotMenu();
        updateOnlineCount();
        if (typeof updateTokenButtonUI === 'function') updateTokenButtonUI();
    }

    openChatOptionsModal(targetId);
    showToast("This chat now uses linked offline roster.", "success");
}

function getRosterSnapshotStateForChat(chatId = null) {
    const targetId = chatId || optionsTargetChatId || currentChatId;
    const chatData = targetId ? DB.get(targetId) : null;
    const personality = chatPersonalities[targetId] || chatData?.personality;
    const profile = targetId ? DB.get(`profile-${targetId}`) : null;

    if (personality !== 'group' || !profile || !Array.isArray(profile.bots)) {
        return {
            isGroup: false,
            saved: false,
            linkedCount: 0,
            fullCount: 0,
            total: 0,
            savedAt: null
        };
    }

    const linkedCount = profile.bots.filter(bot => bot && bot.rosterStub === true).length;
    const total = profile.bots.filter(Boolean).length;

    return {
        isGroup: true,
        saved: profile.rosterMode === 'snapshot' || !!profile.rosterSnapshotSavedAt,
        linkedCount,
        fullCount: total - linkedCount,
        total,
        savedAt: profile.rosterSnapshotSavedAt || null
    };
}

function buildSingleChatExportData(chatId) {
    const chatData = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DB.get(chatId) || {}));
    let profileData = DB.get(`profile-${chatId}`);

    if (profileData) {
        profileData = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(profileData));

        const personality = chatPersonalities[chatId] || chatData?.personality;
        if (personality === 'group') {
            profileData = materializeGroupRosterForSnapshot(profileData, {
                clone: false,
                markExport: true
            }).profile;
        }
    }

    const artifactData = {
        chat: chatData,
        profile: profileData
    };
    const plan = createFuraiHiddenExportPlan();
    collectFuraiChatHiddenEntries(chatData, plan);
    collectFuraiProfileHiddenEntries(profileData, plan);
    attachFuraiHiddenExportPlan(artifactData, plan);
    return artifactData;
}


function getRandomizedGroupStartRoster(roster, count = FURAI_GROUP_RANDOM_START_COUNT) {
    const sourceRoster = Array.isArray(roster) ? roster : [];
    const masterMode = getGlobalCastMode();
    const eligibleBots = getUniqueEligibleGroupRandomPool(sourceRoster);

    if (eligibleBots.length === 0) {
        return buildLinkedGroupRoster(sourceRoster, { masterMode });
    }

    const targetCount = Math.min(count, eligibleBots.length);
    const lastSignature = normalizeRosterText(DB.get(FURAI_GROUP_RANDOM_START_LAST_KEY));
    let pickedBots = [];

    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 6; attempt++) {
        pickedBots = shuffleRandomStartPool(eligibleBots).slice(0, targetCount);

        const signature = pickedBots
            .map(item => item.characterKey)
            .sort()
            .join('|');

        if (eligibleBots.length <= targetCount || signature !== lastSignature) break;
    }

    const activeEntries = new Map(
        pickedBots.map((item, order) => [item.index, { order }])
    );

    DB.set(
        FURAI_GROUP_RANDOM_START_LAST_KEY,
        pickedBots.map(item => item.characterKey).sort().join('|')
    );

    return buildLinkedGroupRoster(sourceRoster, {
        masterMode,
        activeEntries
    });
}

// Migration helper to get current mode
function getGlobalCastMode() {
    // CHANGE: Use DB.get instead of localStorage.getItem
    let mode = DB.get('furai_cast_mode'); 
    
    // BUG FIX: Added " || mode === 'always' " to the check below.
    if (mode === 'auto' || mode === 'mention' || mode === 'mute' || mode === 'always') {
        return mode;
    }

    // Migration check (keep this)
    const oldBool = localStorage.getItem('furai_bot_auto_reply');
    if (oldBool === 'false') return 'mention';
    
    return 'auto'; 
}

// --- LOCAL MASTER TOGGLE (Fixed: Saves to Chat Profile) ---
function cycleGlobalCastMode(event) {
    if (event) event.stopPropagation();
    
    // 1. Load Local Profile
    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    
    // 2. Determine Current Mode (Check Local first, then Global fallback)
    let current = profile.masterReplyMode || getGlobalCastMode(); 
    
    // 3. Calculate Next Mode
    let next = 'auto';
    if (current === 'auto') next = 'mention';
    else if (current === 'mention') next = 'mute';
    else if (current === 'mute') next = 'always';
    else next = 'auto';

    // 4. SAVE TO LOCAL PROFILE (This fixes the issue!)
    profile.masterReplyMode = next; 

    // 5. Apply to currently active bots
    profile.bots.forEach(bot => {
        if (bot.inActiveCast) {
            bot.replyMode = next;
        }
    });
    
    profile.profileCustomized = true;
    DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, profile);

    // Refresh UI
    toggleOnlineList(true); 
}

// ADD this function to your script (it was missing):
function updateAutoReplyToggleUI() {
    const btn = document.getElementById('botAutoReplyBtn');
    if (!btn) return; // Exit if button doesn't exist (prevents errors)

    const isEnabled = localStorage.getItem('furai_bot_auto_reply') !== 'false';
    if (isEnabled) {
        // ON (Open Replies)
        btn.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-comments furai-reply-policy-icon"></i><span>Cast: Open Reply</span>`;
        btn.style.opacity = '1';
        btn.title = "Characters will reply to context automatically";
    } else {
        // OFF (Mention Only)
        btn.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-at furai-reply-policy-icon"></i><span>Cast: Mention Only</span>`;
        btn.style.opacity = '0.6'; 
        btn.title = "Characters will only speak when you @mention them or tap them";
    }
}

function toggleOnlineList(forceOpen = false) {
    const modal = document.getElementById('onlineListModal');
    if (!modal) return;

    if (modal.style.display === 'block' && !forceOpen) {
        closeOnlineList();
        return;
    }

    modal.style.width = '250px';
    modal.innerHTML = '';

    try {
        const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);

        // [THE FIX] Read Local Setting -> Fallback to Global.
        // User Auto Reply policy is intentionally separate and is not changed by this master toggle.
        const globalMode = profile.masterReplyMode || getGlobalCastMode();

        let globalText = 'All Characters: Open Reply';
        let globalOpacity = '1';
        let globalWeight = '500';

        if (globalMode === 'mention') { globalText = 'All Characters: Mention Only'; globalOpacity = '1'; }
        else if (globalMode === 'mute') { globalText = 'All Characters: Muted'; globalOpacity = '1'; }
        else if (globalMode === 'always') { globalText = 'All Characters: Always Reply'; globalOpacity = '1'; }

        modal.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `
        <button onclick="cycleGlobalCastMode(event)" 
                title="Tap to cycle characters only: Open ➜ Mention ➜ Mute ➜ Always"
                style="width:100%; padding:12px 20px; background:none; border:none; cursor:pointer; 
                       font-size:14px; font-weight:${globalWeight}; color:var(--text-color); opacity:${globalOpacity}; 
                       border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-color); text-align:left; transition:opacity 0.2s;">
            ${globalText}
        </button>
    `);

        const items = [];

        const userPolicy = getUserReplyMode(profile);
        const userStatus = getUserChatStatus(profile);

        // User is always top. User reply policy is independent from the character master toggle.
        items.push({
            type: 'user',
            name: (profile.user.name || 'User') + ' (You)',
            hashTag: profile.user.hashTag || '',
            avatar: profile.user.avatar,
            index: null,
            mode: userPolicy,
            status: userStatus
        });

        // Presence order is visual only; saved roster order remains untouched.
        // Online first, then Idle, Announcement, and Ghost Mode lurkers.
        const statusRank = { online: 0, idle: 1, announcement: 2, silent: 3 };
        const activeBots = profile.bots
            .map((bot, i) => ({ ...bot, index: i, status: getBotChatStatus(bot) }))
            .filter(bot => bot.inActiveCast)
            .sort((a, b) =>
                (statusRank[a.status] - statusRank[b.status]) ||
                ((a.activeTimestamp || 0) - (b.activeTimestamp || 0)) ||
                (a.index - b.index)
            );

        activeBots.forEach(bot => {
            items.push({
                type: 'bot',
                name: bot.name,
                hashTag: bot.hashTag || '',
                avatar: bot.avatar,
                index: bot.index,
                mode: bot.replyMode || 'auto',
                status: bot.status,
                isActive: bot.isActive,
                silentNote: bot.silentNote === true
            });
        });

        const ALWAYS_REPLY_SVG = `<svg class="furai-reply-policy-icon is-always-policy" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path fill="currentColor" d="M23 9q0 1.725-.612 3.288t-1.663 2.837q-.3.35-.75.375t-.8-.325q-.325-.325-.3-.775t.3-.825q.75-.95 1.163-2.125T20.75 9t-.412-2.425t-1.163-2.1q-.3-.375-.312-.825t.312-.8t.788-.338t.762.363q1.05 1.275 1.663 2.838T23 9m-4.55 0q0 .8-.25 1.538t-.7 1.362q-.275.375-.737.388t-.813-.338q-.325-.325-.337-.787t.212-.888q.15-.275.238-.6T16.15 9t-.088-.675t-.237-.625q-.225-.425-.213-.875t.338-.775q.35-.35.813-.338t.737.388q.45.625.7 1.363T18.45 9M9 13q-1.65 0-2.825-1.175T5 9t1.175-2.825T9 5t2.825 1.175T13 9t-1.175 2.825T9 13m-8 6v-.8q0-.825.425-1.55t1.175-1.1q1.275-.65 2.875-1.1T9 14t3.525.45t2.875 1.1q.75.375 1.175 1.1T17 18.2v.8q0 .825-.587 1.413T15 21H3q-.825 0-1.412-.587T1 19"/></svg>`;

        items.forEach(item => {
            let iconHtml = '<i class="fa-regular fa-comment-dots fa-fw furai-reply-policy-icon"></i>';
            let color = 'var(--text-color)';
            let opacity = '1';
            let cursor = 'pointer';
            let title = 'Mode: Open Reply';
            let disabledAttr = '';
            let rightOnclick = '';
            let leftOnClick = '';
            let leftTitle = '';
            let avatarOnClick = '';

            if (item.type === 'user') {
                const userMode = getUserReplyModeMeta(item.mode);
                iconHtml = userMode.icon;
                opacity = userMode.opacity;
                title = userMode.title;
                rightOnclick = 'cycleUserReplyMode(event)';
                leftOnClick = item.status === 'idle'
                    ? ''
                    : "handleOnlineUserClick('user')";
                leftTitle = item.status === 'idle'
                    ? 'User is Idle'
                    : (item.mode === 'manual' ? 'Tap to write as you now' : 'Tap to write as you now; policy may also auto-reply');
                avatarOnClick = "openOnlineProfileCard('user', null, event)";

                if (item.status !== 'online') {
                    const statusMeta = getFuraiChatStatusMeta(item.status, 'user');
                    title += ` (${statusMeta.label})`;
                }
            } else {
                avatarOnClick = `openOnlineProfileCard('bot', ${item.index}, event)`;

                if (item.status === 'idle') {
                    iconHtml = '<i class="fa-solid fa-moon fa-fw furai-reply-policy-icon is-idle-policy"></i>';
                    opacity = '0.4'; title = 'Mode: Idle';
                    rightOnclick = '';
                    leftOnClick = '';
                    cursor = 'not-allowed';
                    leftTitle = 'Character is Idle';
                    disabledAttr = 'disabled';
                } else {
                    rightOnclick = `toggleBotReplyMode(${item.index}, event)`;
                    leftOnClick = `handleOnlineUserClick('bot', ${item.index})`;
                    leftTitle = item.status === 'silent'
                        ? 'Tap to speak as Silent Note'
                        : item.status === 'announcement'
                            ? 'Tap to speak as Announcement'
                            : 'Tap to speak';

                    if (item.mode === 'mention') { iconHtml = '<i class="fa-solid fa-at fa-fw furai-reply-policy-icon"></i>'; opacity = '0.5'; title = 'Mode: Mention Only'; }
                    else if (item.mode === 'mute') { iconHtml = '<i class="fa-solid fa-comment-slash fa-fw furai-reply-policy-icon is-muted-policy"></i>'; opacity = '0.5'; title = 'Mode: Muted'; }
                    else if (item.mode === 'always') { iconHtml = ALWAYS_REPLY_SVG; opacity = '1'; title = 'Mode: Always Reply'; }

                    if (item.status === 'announcement') {
                        title += ' + Announcement';
                    } else if (item.status === 'silent') {
                        title += ' + Silent Note';
                    }
                }
            }

            const tagHtml = createFuraiTagChipsHTML(item.hashTag, {
                className: 'furai-compact-row-tags furai-long-row-tags',
                maxVisible: 2
            });
            const avatarStatusHtml = getFuraiAvatarStatusBadgeHTML(item.status);
            const mainActionAttrs = leftOnClick
                ? `role="button" tabindex="0" onclick="${leftOnClick}" onkeydown="if(event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' '){ event.preventDefault(); this.click(); }"`
                : 'aria-disabled="true"';

            modal.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `
        <div class="online-list-item" style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:30px minmax(0,1fr) 34px; column-gap:6px; min-height:46px; margin-bottom:1px; border-radius:4px; overflow:hidden;">
          <button class="furai-online-avatar-btn" onclick="${avatarOnClick}" title="Open profile card">
            <span class="furai-online-avatar-wrap">
              ${item.avatar ? `<img src="${escapeHTML(item.avatar)}" onerror="this.style.display='none'">` : ''}
              ${avatarStatusHtml}
            </span>
          </button>
          <!--
            Keep this as a div, not a button. Tag overflow uses its own +N button.
            Nesting that button inside another button makes the browser reparent
            controls and can push the reply-policy action onto a second row.
          -->
          <div class="furai-online-member-main"
               ${mainActionAttrs}
               title="${leftTitle}"
               style="display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-start; gap:8px; padding-right:4px; cursor:${leftOnClick ? 'pointer' : 'default'}; width:100%; height:100%; box-sizing:border-box; opacity:${item.type === 'user' ? '1' : opacity}; min-width:0; overflow:hidden;">
            <div class="furai-tagged-row-name-line furai-long-row-name-line" style="width:100%; text-align:left; font-size:13px; line-height:normal;">
              <span class="furai-tagged-row-name">${escapeHTML(item.name)}</span>
              ${tagHtml}
            </div>
          </div>
          <button ${disabledAttr} onclick="${rightOnclick}" title="${title}" style="all:unset; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:100%; height:100%; cursor:${cursor}; color:${color}; opacity:${opacity}; flex-shrink:0;">
            ${iconHtml}
          </button>
        </div>
      `);
        });

        modal.style.display = 'block';
        window.removeEventListener('click', closeOnlineListOutside);
        window.addEventListener('click', closeOnlineListOutside, { once: true });

    } catch (e) { console.error('Error building online list:', e); }
}

function openCurrentChatOptionsFromMenu() {
    const menu = document.getElementById('settingsMenu');
    if (menu) menu.classList.remove('show');

    if (!currentChatId) {
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
            showToast('Open a chat first.', 'error');
        }
        return;
    }

    openChatOptionsModal(currentChatId);
}

function confirmRestartChat() {
    const menu = document.getElementById('settingsMenu');

    if (!currentChatId) {
        if (menu) menu.classList.remove('show');
        showToast("Open a chat first.", "error");
        return;
    }

    let chatData = null;

    try {
        chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
    } catch (e) {
        chatData = null;
    }

    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    const deleteCount = Math.max(0, messages.length - 1);

    if (!chatData || !messages.length || deleteCount <= 0) {
        if (menu) menu.classList.remove('show');
        showToast("Nothing to restart.", "info");
        return;
    }

    const msg = [
        "Restart this chat?",
        "",
        `This will delete ${deleteCount} message${deleteCount === 1 ? "" : "s"} after the opening message.`,
        "",
        "Keeps:",
        "- Character settings",
        "- Chat options",
        "- Lorebook / glossary / memo",
        "- Background and mode settings",
        "",
        "This cannot be undone. Export first if needed."
    ].join("\n");

    if (!confirm(msg)) {
        if (menu) menu.classList.remove('show');
        return;
    }

    resetChat();
}

function resetChat() {
    window.FuraiUiContextLifecycle?.transition('restart-chat');
    abortCurrentGeneration();

    try {
        const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
        if (!chatData || !Array.isArray(chatData.messages)) return;

        const shouldClearDeepMemory = Boolean(
            chatData.deepMemoryInitialized ||
            chatData.memoryMode === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP
        );

        const restartPersonality = getStoredChatPersonality(currentChatId);
        const originalMessages = chatData.messages.slice();
        const openingActorMessage = originalMessages.find((msg, index) =>
            index < 2 && (msg?.role === 'user' || msg?.role === 'ai')
        );
        const canRebuildLaunchOpening = !!openingActorMessage && (
            originalMessages[0]?.openingSystem === true ||
            chatData.groupStartPath === 'character' ||
            restartPersonality !== 'group'
        );

        chatData.messages = canRebuildLaunchOpening
            ? [openingActorMessage]
            : (originalMessages.length > 0 ? [originalMessages[0]] : []);
        chatData.summaryBlocks = [];
        chatData.pinnedFacts = [];
        chatData.manualTimelessFacts = '';
        delete chatData.timelessFacts;
        delete chatData.manualSummaryOverride;
        delete chatData.deepMemoryUserAuthority;
        delete chatData.summaryInvalidatedAt;
        delete chatData.summaryInvalidatedFromIndex;
        applyFuraiMessageMutationToChatData(chatData, 0, 'restart');
        chatData.timestamp = Date.now();

        DB.set(currentChatId, chatData);

        const profile = DB.get(`profile-${currentChatId}`);
        if (profile) {
            delete profile.roleHistory;
            if (profile.user) profile.user.actorStartAfterMessageUid = '';
            (profile.bots || []).forEach(bot => {
                if (bot) bot.actorStartAfterMessageUid = '';
            });

            const openingMessage = chatData.messages.find(msg => msg?.role === 'user' || msg?.role === 'ai');
            const personality = restartPersonality;
            let openingActor = null;
            if (openingMessage) {
                openingMessage.uid = openingMessage.uid || generateUID('msg');
                openingMessage.sortKey = 0;
                if (chatData.morph?.enabled) openingMessage.mode = personality;
            }

            if (openingMessage?.role === 'user' && profile.user) {
                openingActor = profile.user;
                openingMessage.userUid = profile.user.uid || openingMessage.userUid;
                openingMessage.userNameSnapshot = profile.user.name || openingMessage.userNameSnapshot;
                openingMessage.content = getCharacterOpeningMessage(profile.user, personality, profile.user.name || 'User');
                const emotion = detectBotEmotion(openingMessage.content, profile.user) || '';
                if (emotion) openingMessage.emotion = emotion;
                else delete openingMessage.emotion;
            } else if (openingMessage?.role === 'ai') {
                const openingBotIndex = Number.parseInt(openingMessage.botIndex, 10);
                const safeOpeningBotIndex = Number.isInteger(openingBotIndex) ? openingBotIndex : 0;
                const openingBot = profile.bots?.[safeOpeningBotIndex];
                if (openingBot) {
                    openingActor = openingBot;
                    openingMessage.botIndex = safeOpeningBotIndex;
                    openingMessage.botUid = openingBot.uid || openingMessage.botUid;
                    openingMessage.botNameSnapshot = openingBot.name || openingMessage.botNameSnapshot;
                    openingMessage.content = getCharacterOpeningMessage(openingBot, personality, openingBot.name || 'Character');
                    const emotion = detectBotEmotion(openingMessage.content, openingBot) || '';
                    if (emotion) openingMessage.emotion = emotion;
                    else delete openingMessage.emotion;
                }
            }

            if (openingActor && openingMessage) {
                chatData.messages = chatData.messages.filter(msg => msg?.openingSystem !== true);
                const openingSystemText = getCharacterOpeningSystemMessage(openingActor);

                if (openingSystemText) {
                    chatData.messages.unshift({
                        uid: generateUID('msg'),
                        role: 'system',
                        content: openingSystemText,
                        openingSystem: true,
                        ...(chatData.morph?.enabled ? { mode: personality } : {}),
                        timestamp: Date.now(),
                        sortKey: 0
                    });
                }

                chatData.messages.forEach((message, index) => {
                    message.sortKey = index;
                });
            }

            DB.set(currentChatId, chatData);
            DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, profile);
        }

        if (shouldClearDeepMemory) {
            void clearFuraiDeepMemoryRecords(currentChatId)
                .then(() => {
                    if (isFuraiDeepMemoryEnabled(currentChatId)) {
                        furaiScheduleDeepMemory(currentChatId, { delay: 500 });
                    }
                })
                .catch(error => console.warn('Could not clear Deep Memory during restart:', error));
        }

        loadChat(currentChatId);
        showToast("Chat restarted. Settings preserved.", "success");
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Error resetting chat:", e);
        showToast("Error resetting chat", "error");
    }

    const menu = document.getElementById('settingsMenu');
    if (menu) menu.classList.remove('show');
}

function getSystemThemeMode() {
    return window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)').matches ? 'light' : 'dark';
}

function getCurrentThemeMode() {
    return document.body.classList.contains('light-theme') ? 'light' : 'dark';
}

function getCurrentThemeSetting() {
    return document.body.dataset.themeSetting || getCurrentThemeMode();
}

function applyThemeMode(mode, options = {}) {
    const { refreshForum = true } = options;
    const themeSetting = ['light', 'dark', 'system'].includes(mode) ? mode : 'system';
    const nextMode = themeSetting === 'system' ? getSystemThemeMode() : themeSetting;

    document.body.dataset.themeSetting = themeSetting;
    document.body.classList.toggle('light-theme', nextMode === 'light');
    updateColorScheme();
    updateThemeButtonUI();

    applyTextColorsForCurrentChat();
    renderGlobalTextColorsEditor();

    const forum = document.getElementById('forumOverlayEl');
    if (refreshForum && forum && forum.style.display === 'flex' && typeof renderForumIframe === 'function') {
        renderForumIframe();
    }
}

function updateThemeButtonUI() {
    const isLightTheme = document.body.classList.contains('light-theme');
    const themeSetting = getCurrentThemeSetting();

    // Legacy main-menu support.
    const themeOptionLight = document.getElementById('themeOptionLight');
    const themeOptionDark = document.getElementById('themeOptionDark');

    if (themeOptionLight) themeOptionLight.style.display = isLightTheme ? 'none' : 'flex';
    if (themeOptionDark) themeOptionDark.style.display = isLightTheme ? 'flex' : 'none';

    document.getElementById('themeModeLightBtn')?.classList.toggle('is-active', themeSetting === 'light');
    document.getElementById('themeModeDarkBtn')?.classList.toggle('is-active', themeSetting === 'dark');
    document.getElementById('themeModeSystemBtn')?.classList.toggle('is-active', themeSetting === 'system');
}

function previewAccountTheme(mode) {
    captureGlobalTextColorsDraftFromEditor();

    accountThemePreviewCommitted = false;
    applyThemeMode(mode || 'system');
}

function revertAccountThemePreview() {
    if (!accountThemePreviewOriginal) return;
    applyThemeMode(accountThemePreviewOriginal);
}

function toggleTheme() {
    captureGlobalTextColorsDraftFromEditor();

    const nextMode = getCurrentThemeMode() === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light';

    applyThemeMode(nextMode);
}

function restoreSavedThemeMode() {
    let savedTheme = null;

    try {
        savedTheme = DB.get('furai_ui_theme');
    } catch (e) {
        savedTheme = null;
    }

    if (['light', 'dark', 'system'].includes(savedTheme)) {
        applyThemeMode(savedTheme, { refreshForum: false });
        return;
    }

    applyThemeMode('system', { refreshForum: false });
}

function updateOnlineCount(profileOverride = null) {
    const personality = getStoredChatPersonality(currentChatId);

    if (personality !== 'group' && personality !== 'maker') {
        const numberEl = document.getElementById('onlineCountNumber');
        if (numberEl) numberEl.textContent = '';
        return;
    }

    const profile = profileOverride || getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    if (!profile || !Array.isArray(profile.bots)) return;

    // Online count includes every visible presence state: Online, Idle, and
    // Announcement. Ghost Mode lurkers stay listed but remain invisible here.
    const visibleUserCount = getUserChatStatus(profile) === 'silent' ? 0 : 1;
    const visibleBotCount = profile.bots.filter(bot =>
        bot && bot.inActiveCast && getBotChatStatus(bot) !== 'silent'
    ).length;
    const totalOnline = visibleUserCount + visibleBotCount;

    const numberEl = document.getElementById('onlineCountNumber');
    if (numberEl) numberEl.textContent = totalOnline;

    const onlineCountEl = document.getElementById('onlineCountEl');
    if (onlineCountEl) {
        onlineCountEl.title = 'Online, Idle, and Announcement members. Ghost Mode lurkers are hidden from this count.';
    }
}

// FurAI Livestream v0: clean standalone module
const FuraiLivestream = (() => {
    const state = {
            com: null,
            room: "lobby",
            isAdult: false,
            comments: [],
            bots: [],
            selectedBotIndex: 0,
            selectedSpeakerKey: "",
            speakerSnapshot: null,
            speakerSnapshots: {},
            speakerSearch: "",
            editCollapsed: true,
            panelCollapsed: false,
            lastAutoSendAt: 0,
            previousTitle: "",
            isGenerating: false,
            stopRequested: false,
            currentGeneration: null,
            commentsMountToken: 0
        };

    const fallbackAvatar = "";

    const livestreamStorageKeys = {
        selectedSpeaker: "furaiLivestreamSelectedSpeakerKey",
        speakerSnapshots: "furaiLivestreamSpeakerSnapshots",
        speakerSnapshotLegacy: "furaiLivestreamSpeakerSnapshot",
        memo: "furaiLivestreamMemo",
        cue: "furaiLivestreamCue",
        rooms: "furaiLivestreamRooms",
        guideSeen: "furaiLivestreamGuideSeen"
    };

    function readLivestreamJson(key, fallback = null) {
        try {
            const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
