        const raw = window.LZString?.decompressFromUTF16
            ? (window.LZString.decompressFromUTF16(String(packed)) || String(packed))
            : String(packed);
        return JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch (error) {
        console.warn('Could not read paused mode data:', error);
        return null;
    }
}

function getFuraiStoredModeProfile(state) {
    return unpackFuraiSwitchValue(state?.profilePacked, state?.profile);
}

function setFuraiStoredModeProfile(state, profile) {
    const hiddenInstructionCount = countFuraiProfileHiddenInstructions(profile);
    const adultTagCount = countFuraiProfileAdultTags(profile);
    state.profilePacked = packFuraiSwitchValue(profile);
    delete state.profile;

    state.hiddenInstructionCount = hiddenInstructionCount;
    state.hiddenInstructionSafetyVersion = FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION;
    state.adultTagCount = adultTagCount;
    state.adultTagSafetyVersion = FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION;

    return !!state.profilePacked;
}

function getFuraiStoredMakerDraft(state) {
    return unpackFuraiSwitchValue(state?.makerDraftPacked, state?.makerDraft);
}

function getFuraiMakerDraftHiddenInstructionCount(draft) {
    return hasFuraiProtectedInstructions(draft?.protected) ? 1 : 0;
}

function setFuraiStoredMakerDraft(state, draft) {
    if (!draft) {
        delete state.makerDraft;
        delete state.makerDraftPacked;
        delete state.makerDraftHiddenInstructionCount;
        delete state.makerDraftHiddenInstructionSafetyVersion;
        delete state.makerDraftAdultTagCount;
        delete state.makerDraftAdultTagSafetyVersion;
        return;
    }

    state.makerDraftPacked = packFuraiSwitchValue(draft);
    delete state.makerDraft;
    state.makerDraftHiddenInstructionCount =
        getFuraiMakerDraftHiddenInstructionCount(draft);
    state.makerDraftHiddenInstructionSafetyVersion = FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION;
    state.makerDraftAdultTagCount = getFuraiMakerDraftAdultTagCount(draft);
    state.makerDraftAdultTagSafetyVersion = FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION;
}

function getFuraiSwitchModeMeta(mode) {
    return FURAI_SWITCH_MODES[mode] || FURAI_SWITCH_MODES.researcher;
}

function getFuraiSwitchModeLabel(mode) {
    return getFuraiSwitchModeMeta(mode).label;
}

function isFuraiNarrativeMode(mode) {
    return mode === 'group' || mode === 'story';
}

function isFuraiRosterMode(mode) {
    return mode === 'group' || mode === 'story';
}

function getFuraiActiveMode(chatId = currentChatId) {
    if (!chatId) return 'researcher';
    try {
        return String(chatPersonalities?.[chatId] || DB.get(chatId)?.personality || 'researcher');
    } catch (error) {
        return String(chatPersonalities?.[chatId] || 'researcher');
    }
}

function getFuraiMessageMode(chatData, message) {
    return String(
        message?.mode ||
        chatData?.morph?.originalMode ||
        chatData?.personality ||
        'researcher'
    );
}

function getFuraiModeState(chatData, mode, create = false) {
    if (!chatData?.morph?.enabled) return null;
    if (!chatData.morph.modeStates || typeof chatData.morph.modeStates !== 'object') {
        if (!create) return null;
        chatData.morph.modeStates = {};
    }
    if (!chatData.morph.modeStates[mode] && create) {
        chatData.morph.modeStates[mode] = {};
    }
    return chatData.morph.modeStates[mode] || null;
}

function getFuraiDefaultModeMemo(mode) {
    try {
        return String(DB.get(`global_memo_${mode}`) || '').trim();
    } catch (error) {
        return '';
    }
}

function getFuraiModeDraftValue() {
    return String(document.getElementById('messageInputEl')?.value || '');
}

function isFuraiModeSwitchBusy() {
    return furaiModeSwitchInProgress ||
        (typeof isFuraiForegroundAiBusy === 'function' && isFuraiForegroundAiBusy()) ||
        window.isGeneratingSummary === true ||
        (Array.isArray(generationQueue) && generationQueue.length > 0);
}

function isValidFuraiModeProfile(profile) {
    return !!profile && typeof profile === 'object' && !!profile.user && Array.isArray(profile.bots);
}

function collectFuraiMakerDraft() {
    if (String(window.furaiMakerDraftOwnerChatId || '') !== String(currentChatId || '')) return null;
    const read = id => String(document.getElementById(id)?.value || '');
    const draft = {
        name: read('makerNameInput'),
        tags: typeof getFuraiTagInputValue === 'function' ? getFuraiTagInputValue('makerTagInput') : read('makerTagInput'),
        avatar: read('makerAvatarInput'),
        sprite: read('makerSpriteInput'),
        instruction: read('makerInstInput'),
        secret: read('makerSecretInput'),
        protected: getFuraiProtectedInstructionEditorSnapshot('makerProtectedInstructionHost'),
        openingSystemMessage: read('makerOpeningSystemMessage'),
        openingMessage: read('makerOpeningInput'),
        openingBackground: read('makerOpeningBackground'),
        openingBackgroundOpacity: read('makerOpeningBackgroundOpacity') || '1',
        openingBackgroundBlur: read('makerOpeningBackgroundBlur') || '0',
        openingLorebook: read('makerOpeningLorebook'),
        openingLoreInstructions: read('makerOpeningLoreInstructions'),
        creatorNotes: read('makerCreatorNotes'),
        openingExpanded: document.getElementById('makerOpeningSetupDetails')?.open === true,
        creatorNotesExpanded: document.getElementById('makerCreatorNotesDetails')?.open === true,
        emotions: cloneFuraiSwitchValue(window.makerTempEmotions || {}),
        avatars: cloneFuraiSwitchValue(window.makerTempAvatars || {}),
        sprites: cloneFuraiSwitchValue(window.makerTempSprites || {})
    };

    const hasCustomEmotionRules = JSON.stringify(draft.emotions || {}) !== JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_EMOTION_KEYWORDS || {});
    const hasWork = [
        draft.name, draft.tags, draft.sprite, draft.instruction, draft.secret,
        draft.protected?.instruction, draft.protected?.secret,
        draft.openingSystemMessage, draft.openingMessage, draft.openingBackground,
        draft.openingLorebook, draft.openingLoreInstructions, draft.creatorNotes
    ].some(value => String(value || '').trim()) ||
        String(draft.avatar || '').trim() ||
        hasCustomEmotionRules ||
        Object.keys(draft.avatars || {}).length > 0 ||
        Object.keys(draft.sprites || {}).length > 0;

    return hasWork ? draft : null;
}

function applyFuraiMakerDraft(draft) {
    if (!draft || typeof draft !== 'object') return false;

    const write = (id, value) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.value = value == null ? '' : String(value);
    };

    write('makerNameInput', draft.name);
    if (typeof setFuraiTagInputValue === 'function') setFuraiTagInputValue('makerTagInput', draft.tags || '');
    else write('makerTagInput', draft.tags);
    write('makerAvatarInput', draft.avatar);
    write('makerSpriteInput', draft.sprite);
    write('makerInstInput', draft.instruction);
    write('makerSecretInput', draft.secret);
    mountFuraiProtectedInstructionEditor(
        'makerProtectedInstructionHost',
        document.getElementById('makerSecretInput')?.closest('.form-group'),
        draft.protected || {}
    );
    write('makerOpeningSystemMessage', draft.openingSystemMessage);
    write('makerOpeningInput', draft.openingMessage);
    write('makerOpeningBackground', draft.openingBackground);
    write('makerOpeningBackgroundOpacity', draft.openingBackgroundOpacity || '1');
    write('makerOpeningBackgroundBlur', draft.openingBackgroundBlur || '0');
    write('makerOpeningLorebook', draft.openingLorebook);
    write('makerOpeningLoreInstructions', draft.openingLoreInstructions);
    write('makerCreatorNotes', draft.creatorNotes);

    const openingDetails = document.getElementById('makerOpeningSetupDetails');
    if (openingDetails) openingDetails.open = draft.openingExpanded === true;
    const creatorDetails = document.getElementById('makerCreatorNotesDetails');
    if (creatorDetails) creatorDetails.open = draft.creatorNotesExpanded === true;

    window.makerTempEmotions = cloneFuraiSwitchValue(draft.emotions || DEFAULT_EMOTION_KEYWORDS || {});
    window.makerTempAvatars = cloneFuraiSwitchValue(draft.avatars || {});
    window.makerTempSprites = cloneFuraiSwitchValue(draft.sprites || {});

    applyFuraiEditorAvatarPreview('makerAvatarPreview', draft.avatar || '');

    const spritePreview = document.getElementById('makerSpritePreview');
    if (spritePreview) {
        spritePreview.src = String(draft.sprite || '');
        spritePreview.style.display = draft.sprite ? 'block' : 'none';
    }

    if (typeof updateOpeningBackgroundOpacityDisplay === 'function') {
        updateOpeningBackgroundOpacityDisplay('maker', draft.openingBackgroundOpacity || '1');
    }
    if (typeof updateOpeningBackgroundBlurDisplay === 'function') {
        updateOpeningBackgroundBlurDisplay('maker', draft.openingBackgroundBlur || '0');
    }
    if (typeof updateWordCountUI === 'function') {
        updateWordCountUI(['makerInstInput', 'makerSecretInput'], 'makerInstCount', 500);
    }

    return true;
}

function getFuraiSavedMakerDraft(chatId = currentChatId) {
    if (!chatId) return null;
    try {
        const chatData = DB.get(chatId);
        if (!chatData?.morph?.enabled || chatData.personality !== 'maker') return null;
        return cloneFuraiSwitchValue(getFuraiStoredMakerDraft(getFuraiModeState(chatData, 'maker')));
    } catch (error) {
        return null;
    }
}

function buildFuraiModeBridge(chatData, sourceMode, targetMode) {
    if (!chatData?.morph?.enabled || isFuraiNarrativeMode(targetMode)) return null;

    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    for (let index = messages.length - 1; index >= 0; index--) {
        const message = messages[index];
        const messageMode = getFuraiMessageMode(chatData, message);
        const belongsToSource = isFuraiNarrativeMode(sourceMode)
            ? isFuraiNarrativeMode(messageMode)
            : messageMode === sourceMode;

        if (!belongsToSource || shouldSkipAiContextMessageRole(message?.role) || !message?.uid) continue;
        return {
            sourceMode: String(sourceMode || ''),
            throughMessageUid: String(message.uid),
            throughMessageIndex: index
        };
    }

    return null;
}

function getFuraiModeScopedMessages(chatData, messages, activeMode = chatData?.personality) {
    const list = Array.isArray(messages) ? messages : [];
    if (!chatData?.morph?.enabled) return list.slice();

    const mode = String(activeMode || chatData.personality || 'researcher');
    if (isFuraiNarrativeMode(mode)) {
        return list.filter(message => isFuraiNarrativeMode(getFuraiMessageMode(chatData, message)));
    }

    const state = getFuraiModeState(chatData, mode) || {};
    const legacyBridgeIds = new Set(
        (state.bridgeMessageUids || [])
            .map(value => String(value || ''))
            .filter(Boolean)
    );
    const bridge = state.bridge && typeof state.bridge === 'object'
        ? state.bridge
        : null;
    const bridgeSourceMode = String(bridge?.sourceMode || '').trim();
    const bridgeBoundaryUid = String(bridge?.throughMessageUid || '').trim();
    const savedBoundaryIndex = Number(bridge?.throughMessageIndex);
    const bridgeBoundaryIndex = Number.isInteger(savedBoundaryIndex) &&
        savedBoundaryIndex >= 0 &&
        savedBoundaryIndex < list.length &&
        String(list[savedBoundaryIndex]?.uid || '') === bridgeBoundaryUid
            ? savedBoundaryIndex
            : (bridgeBoundaryUid
                ? list.findIndex(message => String(message?.uid || '') === bridgeBoundaryUid)
                : -1);

    return list.filter((message, index) => {
        const messageMode = getFuraiMessageMode(chatData, message);
        if (messageMode === mode) return true;
        if (legacyBridgeIds.has(String(message?.uid || ''))) return true;
        if (!bridgeSourceMode || bridgeBoundaryIndex < 0 || index > bridgeBoundaryIndex) return false;

        return isFuraiNarrativeMode(bridgeSourceMode)
            ? isFuraiNarrativeMode(messageMode)
            : messageMode === bridgeSourceMode;
    });
}

function getFuraiSwitchActorIdentityKeys(actor) {
    if (!actor || typeof actor !== 'object') return [];
    return [
        actor.uid,
        actor.userUid,
        actor.sourceLibraryUid,
        actor.groupRosterSourceUid,
        actor.storySourceLibraryUid
    ].map(value => String(value || '').trim()).filter(Boolean);
}

function getFuraiStoredModeBotIndex(actor, mode) {
    const raw = actor?.furaiModeBotIndexes?.[mode];
    if (raw === undefined || raw === null || raw === '') return null;

    const index = Number(raw);
    return Number.isInteger(index) && index >= 0 ? index : null;
}

function isFuraiSwitchSameActor(left, right) {
    if (!left || !right) return false;

    const leftKeys = new Set(getFuraiSwitchActorIdentityKeys(left));
    return getFuraiSwitchActorIdentityKeys(right).some(key => leftKeys.has(key));
}

function isFuraiSwitchUserActor(actor, user) {
    if (!actor || !user) return false;
    if (actor.role === 'user' || actor.isUser === true) return true;
    return isFuraiSwitchSameActor(actor, user);
}

function stampFuraiModeActorIdentitySnapshots(chatId, chatData, mode, profile) {
    if (!chatId || !chatData || !isValidFuraiModeProfile(profile)) return false;

    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    let firstChangedIndex = -1;
    const markChanged = messageIndex => {
        if (firstChangedIndex < 0 || messageIndex < firstChangedIndex) {
            firstChangedIndex = messageIndex;
        }
    };

    messages.forEach((message, messageIndex) => {
        if (!message || getFuraiMessageMode(chatData, message) !== mode) return;

        if (message.role === 'user') {
            if (message.userUid && message.userNameSnapshot) return;

            const actor = (message.userUid
                ? resolveFuraiActorByUid(profile, message.userUid, 'user', null)
                : null) || resolveFuraiLaneActorAtMessage(
                    chatId,
                    profile,
                    'user',
                    null,
                    message.uid,
                    messageIndex
                );

            const actorUid = String(actor?.uid || '').trim();
            const actorName = String(actor?.name || '').trim();
            if (!message.userUid && actorUid) {
                message.userUid = actorUid;
                markChanged(messageIndex);
            }
            if (!message.userNameSnapshot && actorName) {
                message.userNameSnapshot = actorName;
                markChanged(messageIndex);
            }
            return;
        }

        if (message.role !== 'ai' && message.role !== 'muted-note') return;
        if (
            message.botUid &&
            message.botNameSnapshot &&
            (message.role !== 'muted-note' || message.silentNoteSpeakerName)
        ) return;

        const botIndex = Number.parseInt(message.botIndex, 10);
        if (!Number.isInteger(botIndex) || botIndex < 0) return;

        let actor = (message.botUid
            ? resolveFuraiActorByUid(profile, message.botUid, 'ai', botIndex)
            : null) || resolveFuraiActorByModeBotIndexAtMessage(
                chatId,
                profile,
                mode,
                botIndex,
                message.uid,
                messageIndex
            );

        if (actor?.rosterStub === true) {
            actor = resolveGroupRosterStubForDisplay(actor, botIndex) || actor;
        }

        const actorUid = String(actor?.uid || actor?.groupRosterSourceUid || '').trim();
        const actorName = String(actor?.name || '').trim();

        if (!message.botUid && actorUid) {
            message.botUid = actorUid;
            markChanged(messageIndex);
        }
        if (!message.botNameSnapshot && actorName) {
            message.botNameSnapshot = actorName;
            markChanged(messageIndex);
        }
        if (message.role === 'muted-note' && !message.silentNoteSpeakerName && actorName) {
            message.silentNoteSpeakerName = actorName;
            markChanged(messageIndex);
        }
    });

    return firstChangedIndex;
}

function applyFuraiChatUserToModeProfile(targetProfile, chatUser, targetMode) {
    if (!isValidFuraiModeProfile(targetProfile) || !chatUser) return targetProfile;

    const preparedUser = cloneFuraiSwitchValue(targetProfile.user || {});
    const sharedUser = cloneFuraiSwitchValue(chatUser || {});
    const sharedInstructions = sharedUser.instructions && typeof sharedUser.instructions === 'object'
        ? sharedUser.instructions
        : {};

    // The chat owns the entire user profile. Switching rooms must not create,
    // replace, or infer any mode-specific user data.
    targetProfile.user = {
        ...sharedUser,
        uid: String(sharedUser.uid || preparedUser.uid || '').trim() || generateUID('actor_user'),
        instructions: {
            ...sharedInstructions
        }
    };

    delete targetProfile.user.instruction;
    return targetProfile;
}

function suppressFuraiSharedUserFromStoryCast(profile) {
    if (!isValidFuraiModeProfile(profile) || !profile.user) return false;

    let changed = false;
    profile.bots.forEach((bot, index) => {
        if (
            index === 0 ||
            !bot ||
            bot.localRosterDeleted === true ||
            !isFuraiSwitchUserActor(bot, profile.user)
        ) return;

        // Keep the lane index for historical messages, but remove an accidental
        // user duplicate from all future Story Cast UI and AI context.
        bot.localRosterDeleted = true;
        bot.storyContextMode = 'offstage';
        bot.inActiveCast = false;
        bot.isActive = false;
        delete bot.replyMode;
        delete bot.activeTimestamp;
        changed = true;
    });

    if (changed) profile.profileCustomized = true;
    return changed;
}

function createFuraiSwitchProfile(mode, sourceMode, sourceProfile) {
    const user = createFuraiDefaultUser(mode, { newActor: true });
    let profile = null;

    if (mode === 'story') {
        const narrator = normalizeFuraiSelectedCharacterForRole(buildStoryNarratorBot(), {
            role: 'ai',
            mode: 'story',
            botIndex: 0,
            replyMode: 'auto',
            startAfterMessageUid: ''
        });
        narrator.storyNarratorMain = true;

        profile = {
            user,
            bots: [narrator],
            profileCustomized: false,
            storyProfile: true
        };
    } else if (mode === 'group') {
        // Mode switching never injects the global/random Group template.
        // The per-chat shared roster is applied below, including an intentional empty roster.
        profile = {
            user,
            bots: [],
            profileCustomized: false,
            rosterMode: 'snapshot',
            singleCharacterGroup: false
        };
    } else if (mode === 'maker') {
        const sourceBot = DB.get(getGlobalProfileKey('maker'))?.bots?.[0] || createFuraiModeFactoryBot('maker');
        const maker = normalizeFuraiSelectedCharacterForRole(sourceBot, {
            role: 'ai',
            mode: 'maker',
            botIndex: 0,
            replyMode: 'auto',
            startAfterMessageUid: ''
        });
        maker.makerWorkshopMain = true;

        profile = {
            user,
            bots: [maker],
            profileCustomized: false,
            rosterMode: 'snapshot'
        };
    } else {
        const globalModeProfile = DB.get(getGlobalProfileKey(mode));
        const sourceBot = globalModeProfile?.bots?.[0] || createFuraiModeFactoryBot(mode);
        const bot = normalizeFuraiSelectedCharacterForRole(sourceBot, {
            role: 'ai',
            mode,
            botIndex: 0,
            replyMode: 'auto',
            startAfterMessageUid: ''
        });

        profile = {
            user,
            bots: [bot],
            profileCustomized: false
        };
    }

    if (!isValidFuraiModeProfile(profile)) {
        throw new Error(`Could not prepare ${mode} profile.`);
    }

    return profile;
}

function getFuraiSharedRoster(chatData) {
    if (!chatData?.morph?.enabled) return null;

    const roster = unpackFuraiSwitchValue(
        chatData.morph.sharedRosterPacked,
        chatData.morph.sharedRoster
    );

    if (!Array.isArray(roster)) return null;

    // Legacy shared rosters did not retain the original Group botIndex. Recover
    // it from the stable library UID so old messages can still resolve by lane.
    const groupIndexByUid = new Map();
    getCurrentGroupRosterSource().forEach((actor, index) => {
        getFuraiSwitchActorIdentityKeys(actor).forEach(uid => {
            if (!groupIndexByUid.has(uid)) {
                groupIndexByUid.set(uid, index);
            } else if (groupIndexByUid.get(uid) !== index) {
                groupIndexByUid.set(uid, null);
            }
        });
    });

    roster.forEach(actor => {
        if (!actor || typeof actor !== 'object') return;
        const indexes = { ...(actor.furaiModeBotIndexes || {}) };
        if (getFuraiStoredModeBotIndex(actor, 'group') === null) {
            const candidates = new Set(
                getFuraiSwitchActorIdentityKeys(actor)
                    .map(uid => groupIndexByUid.get(uid))
                    .filter(Number.isInteger)
            );
            if (candidates.size === 1) indexes.group = candidates.values().next().value;
            else delete indexes.group;
        }
        if (Object.keys(indexes).length) actor.furaiModeBotIndexes = indexes;
        else delete actor.furaiModeBotIndexes;
    });

    return roster;
}

function setFuraiSharedRoster(chatData, roster) {
    if (!chatData?.morph) return false;

    const normalizedRoster = Array.isArray(roster) ? roster : [];
    const hiddenInstructionCount =
        countFuraiCharacterArrayHiddenInstructions(normalizedRoster);
    const adultTagCount = countFuraiCharacterArrayAdultTags(normalizedRoster);

    chatData.morph.sharedRosterPacked = packFuraiSwitchValue(normalizedRoster);
    delete chatData.morph.sharedRoster;

    chatData.morph.sharedRosterHiddenInstructionCount = hiddenInstructionCount;
    chatData.morph.sharedRosterHiddenInstructionSafetyVersion = FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION;
    chatData.morph.sharedRosterAdultTagCount = adultTagCount;
    chatData.morph.sharedRosterAdultTagSafetyVersion = FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION;

    return !!chatData.morph.sharedRosterPacked;
}

function resolveFuraiSharedRosterActorForMessage(chatData, actorUid, mode, botIndex) {
    const roster = getFuraiSharedRoster(chatData);
    if (!Array.isArray(roster) || roster.length === 0) return null;

    const uid = String(actorUid || '').trim();
    let matches = [];

    if (uid) {
        matches = roster.filter(actor =>
            getFuraiSwitchActorIdentityKeys(actor).includes(uid)
        );
    } else {
        const index = Number(botIndex);
        const normalizedMode = String(mode || '').trim();
        if (!normalizedMode || !Number.isInteger(index) || index < 0) return null;

        matches = roster.filter(actor =>
            getFuraiStoredModeBotIndex(actor, normalizedMode) === index
        );
    }

    return matches.length === 1 ? matches[0] : null;
}

function getFuraiHistoricalVisualFallbackActor(actor) {
    if (!actor || typeof actor !== 'object') return actor;

    const hasVisual = !!(
        String(actor.avatar || '').trim() ||
        String(actor.defaultSprite || '').trim() ||
        Object.values(actor.emotionAvatars || {}).some(value => String(value || '').trim()) ||
        Object.values(actor.emotionSprites || {}).some(value => String(value || '').trim())
    );
    if (hasVisual) return actor;

    const identityKeys = getFuraiSwitchActorIdentityKeys(actor);
    if (identityKeys.length === 0) return actor;

    const identitySet = new Set(identityKeys);
    const matches = getCurrentGroupRosterSource().filter(source =>
        getFuraiSwitchActorIdentityKeys(source).some(uid => identitySet.has(uid))
    );
    if (matches.length !== 1) return actor;

    const visualSource = matches[0];
    return {
        ...cloneFuraiSwitchValue(actor),
        avatar: String(visualSource.avatar || ''),
        defaultSprite: String(visualSource.defaultSprite || ''),
        customEmotions: cloneFuraiSwitchValue(visualSource.customEmotions || {}),
        emotionAvatars: cloneFuraiSwitchValue(visualSource.emotionAvatars || {}),
        emotionSprites: cloneFuraiSwitchValue(visualSource.emotionSprites || {})
    };
}

function isFuraiStoryNarratorActor(bot, index) {
    if (!bot || index !== 0) return false;

    return bot.storyNarratorMain === true ||
        bot.sourceFactoryMode === 'story' ||
        bot.factoryMode === 'story' ||
        bot.sourceLibraryUid === FURAI_MODE_FACTORY_IDS.story;
}

function isFuraiMakerWorkshopActor(bot, index) {
    if (!bot || index !== 0) return false;

    return bot.makerWorkshopMain === true ||
        bot.sourceFactoryMode === 'maker' ||
        bot.factoryMode === 'maker' ||
        bot.sourceLibraryUid === FURAI_MODE_FACTORY_IDS.maker;
}

function getFuraiRosterActorsFromProfile(mode, profile) {
    if (!isValidFuraiModeProfile(profile) || !isFuraiRosterMode(mode)) return [];

    let workingProfile = profile;

    if (mode === 'group') {
        const materialized = materializeGroupRosterForSnapshot(profile, { clone: true });
        if (isValidFuraiModeProfile(materialized?.profile)) {
            workingProfile = materialized.profile;
        }
    }

    return (workingProfile.bots || []).map((bot, index) => {
        if (
            !bot ||
            bot.localRosterDeleted === true ||
            bot.role === 'user' ||
            bot.isUser === true ||
            isFuraiSwitchUserActor(bot, workingProfile.user) ||
            isUneditedGlobalFreeSlot(bot, index)
        ) {
            return null;
        }

        if (mode === 'story' && isFuraiStoryNarratorActor(bot, index)) return null;
        if (mode === 'maker' && isFuraiMakerWorkshopActor(bot, index)) return null;

        const actor = cloneFuraiSwitchValue(bot);
        actor.furaiModeBotIndexes = {
            ...(actor.furaiModeBotIndexes || {}),
            [mode]: index
        };
        return actor;
    }).filter(Boolean);
}

function findFuraiSharedRosterActor(roster, actor) {
    if (!Array.isArray(roster) || !actor) return null;
    return roster.find(item => isFuraiSwitchSameActor(item, actor)) || null;
}

function sanitizeFuraiMakerModeProfile(profile) {
    const stored = cloneFuraiSwitchValue(profile);
    if (!isValidFuraiModeProfile(stored)) return stored;

    const maker = stored.bots.find((bot, index) =>
        isFuraiMakerWorkshopActor(bot, index)
    ) || stored.bots[0] || null;

    stored.bots = maker ? [maker] : [];
    stored.rosterMode = 'snapshot';
    return stored;
}

function getFuraiModeProfileForStorage(mode, profile) {
    const stored = cloneFuraiSwitchValue(profile);

    if (!isValidFuraiModeProfile(stored)) return stored;
    if (mode === 'maker') return sanitizeFuraiMakerModeProfile(stored);
    if (!isFuraiRosterMode(mode)) return stored;

    if (mode === 'group') {
        stored.bots = [];
    } else if (mode === 'story') {
        const narrator = stored.bots.find((bot, index) =>
            isFuraiStoryNarratorActor(bot, index)
        ) || stored.bots[0];

        stored.bots = narrator ? [narrator] : [];
    }

    return stored;
}


function normalizeFuraiSharedRosterActor(actor, sourceMode, existingActor = null) {
    const next = cloneFuraiSwitchValue(actor || {});
    const existing = existingActor && typeof existingActor === 'object'
        ? existingActor
        : null;
    const sourceVisualsIncomplete = next.rosterStub === true || next.rosterMissing === true;

    // A linked/offline character may temporarily materialize as a lightweight
    // or missing-library placeholder. Never let that placeholder erase the
    // durable portrait data already owned by this chat's shared roster.
    if (sourceVisualsIncomplete && existing) {
        ['name', 'hashTag', 'avatar', 'defaultSprite', 'instruction'].forEach(key => {
            if (!String(next[key] || '').trim() && String(existing[key] || '').trim()) {
                next[key] = cloneFuraiSwitchValue(existing[key]);
            }
        });

        ['customEmotions', 'emotionAvatars', 'emotionSprites'].forEach(key => {
            const nextMap = next[key] && typeof next[key] === 'object' ? next[key] : {};
            if (Object.keys(nextMap).length === 0 && existing[key] && typeof existing[key] === 'object') {
                next[key] = cloneFuraiSwitchValue(existing[key]);
            }
        });
    }

    const mergedModeBotIndexes = {
        ...(existing?.furaiModeBotIndexes || {}),
        ...(next.furaiModeBotIndexes || {})
    };
    const cleanModeBotIndexes = {};
    Object.entries(mergedModeBotIndexes).forEach(([mode, rawIndex]) => {
        if (rawIndex === undefined || rawIndex === null || rawIndex === '') return;
        const index = Number(rawIndex);
        if (Number.isInteger(index) && index >= 0) cleanModeBotIndexes[mode] = index;
    });
    if (Object.keys(cleanModeBotIndexes).length) {
        next.furaiModeBotIndexes = cleanModeBotIndexes;
    } else {
        delete next.furaiModeBotIndexes;
    }

    const stableUid = String(
        next.uid ||
        existing?.uid ||
        next.sourceLibraryUid ||
        next.groupRosterSourceUid ||
        next.storySourceLibraryUid ||
        ''
    ).trim();

    next.uid = stableUid || generateUID('actor_shared');
    next.sourceLibraryUid = String(
        next.sourceLibraryUid ||
        existing?.sourceLibraryUid ||
        next.groupRosterSourceUid ||
        next.storySourceLibraryUid ||
        next.uid
    ).trim();

    delete next.storyNarratorMain;
    delete next.makerWorkshopMain;
    delete next.rosterStub;
    delete next.rosterMissing;
    delete next.localRosterDeleted;

    const storyKeys = [
        'storyRolePreset',
        'storyCustomRole',
        'storyRoleNote',
        'storyRoleType',
        'storyContextMode'
    ];

    if (existing) {
        storyKeys.forEach(key => {
            if ((next[key] === undefined || next[key] === null || next[key] === '') &&
                existing[key] !== undefined) {
                next[key] = cloneFuraiSwitchValue(existing[key]);
            }
        });
    }

    if (typeof next.inActiveCast !== 'boolean') {
        next.inActiveCast = true;
    }

    if (sourceMode === 'story') {
        // Story runtime intentionally keeps actors non-live. Preserve the last
        // Group/Maker online state, while new Story cast members come alive once.
        next.isActive = next.inActiveCast
            ? (existing ? existing.isActive !== false : true)
            : false;

        next.replyMode = existing?.replyMode || next.replyMode || getGlobalCastMode();

        if (existing?.silentNote !== undefined) {
            next.silentNote = existing.silentNote === true;
        }
        if (existing?.chatStatus === 'announcement' && next.chatStatus !== 'announcement') {
            next.chatStatus = 'announcement';
        }
        if (existing?.activeTimestamp !== undefined) {
            next.activeTimestamp = existing.activeTimestamp;
        }
    } else {
        next.isActive = next.inActiveCast ? next.isActive !== false : false;
        next.replyMode = next.replyMode || existing?.replyMode || getGlobalCastMode();
    }

    if (!next.inActiveCast) {
        next.isActive = false;
        next.silentNote = false;
        delete next.activeTimestamp;
    }

    next.customEmotions = cloneFuraiSwitchValue(next.customEmotions || {});
    next.emotionAvatars = cloneFuraiSwitchValue(next.emotionAvatars || {});
    next.emotionSprites = cloneFuraiSwitchValue(next.emotionSprites || {});

    return next;
}

function captureFuraiSharedRoster(chatData, sourceMode, sourceProfile) {
    if (!chatData?.morph || !isFuraiRosterMode(sourceMode)) {
        return getFuraiSharedRoster(chatData);
    }

    const previousRoster = getFuraiSharedRoster(chatData) || [];
    const sourceActors = getFuraiRosterActorsFromProfile(sourceMode, sourceProfile);

    const nextRoster = sourceActors.map(actor => normalizeFuraiSharedRosterActor(
        actor,
        sourceMode,
        findFuraiSharedRosterActor(previousRoster, actor)
    ));

    if (!setFuraiSharedRoster(chatData, nextRoster)) {
        throw new Error('The shared character roster could not be saved.');
    }

    return nextRoster;
}

function getFuraiLegacyRosterSeed(chatData, targetMode, targetProfile, hasSavedTargetProfile) {
    if (hasSavedTargetProfile && isValidFuraiModeProfile(targetProfile)) {
        return { mode: targetMode, profile: targetProfile };
    }

    const preferredModes = [
        chatData?.morph?.lastMode,
        chatData?.morph?.originalMode,
        'group',
        'story'
    ];
    const checkedModes = new Set();

    for (const mode of preferredModes) {
        if (!isFuraiRosterMode(mode) || checkedModes.has(mode)) continue;
        checkedModes.add(mode);

        const state = chatData?.morph?.modeStates?.[mode];
        const profile = state ? getFuraiStoredModeProfile(state) : null;
        if (isValidFuraiModeProfile(profile)) {
            return { mode, profile };
        }
    }

    return { mode: targetMode, profile: targetProfile };
}

function createFuraiStoryActorFromShared(actor, index) {
    const next = cloneFuraiSwitchValue(actor || {});

    next.storyNarratorMain = false;
    next.inActiveCast = actor?.inActiveCast === true;
    next.storyContextMode = next.inActiveCast
        ? (next.storyContextMode || 'present')
        : 'offstage';
    next.isActive = false;

    if (next.inActiveCast) {
        next.replyMode = next.replyMode || getSavedGlobalCastMode('story') || 'auto';
    } else {
        delete next.replyMode;
        delete next.activeTimestamp;
        next.silentNote = false;
    }

    next.actorStartAfterMessageUid = next.actorStartAfterMessageUid || '';
    return normalizeStoryCastBot(next);
}

function createFuraiLiveRosterActorFromShared(actor) {
    const next = cloneFuraiSwitchValue(actor || {});

    delete next.storyNarratorMain;
    delete next.makerWorkshopMain;
    next.inActiveCast = actor?.inActiveCast === true;
    next.isActive = next.inActiveCast
        ? getBotChatStatus(next) !== 'idle'
        : false;
    next.replyMode = next.replyMode || getGlobalCastMode();

    if (!next.inActiveCast) {
        next.silentNote = false;
        delete next.activeTimestamp;
    }

    next.actorStartAfterMessageUid = next.actorStartAfterMessageUid || '';
    return next;
}

function applyFuraiSharedRosterToModeProfile(targetProfile, targetMode, sharedRoster) {
    if (!isValidFuraiModeProfile(targetProfile) || !isFuraiRosterMode(targetMode)) {
        return 0;
    }

    const roster = Array.isArray(sharedRoster) ? sharedRoster : [];

    if (targetMode === 'story') {
        let narrator = targetProfile.bots.find((bot, index) =>
            isFuraiStoryNarratorActor(bot, index)
        );

        if (!narrator) {
            narrator = normalizeFuraiSelectedCharacterForRole(buildStoryNarratorBot(), {
                role: 'ai',
                mode: 'story',
                botIndex: 0,
                replyMode: 'auto',
                startAfterMessageUid: ''
            });
        }

        narrator.storyNarratorMain = true;
        targetProfile.bots = [
            narrator,
            ...roster.map(createFuraiStoryActorFromShared)
        ];
        targetProfile.storyProfile = true;
    } else {
        targetProfile.bots = roster.map(createFuraiLiveRosterActorFromShared);
        targetProfile.rosterMode = 'snapshot';
        targetProfile.singleCharacterGroup = false;
    }

    if (roster.length > 0) {
        targetProfile.profileCustomized = true;
    }

    return roster.length;
}

function getFuraiModeSwitchToast(sourceMode, targetMode, resumed, hasBridge = false, seededStoryCount = 0) {
    const targetLabel = getFuraiSwitchModeLabel(targetMode);

    if (targetMode === 'group') {
        return resumed
            ? 'Back to Group Chat — your roster is right where you left it.'
            : 'Group Chat is ready.';
    }

    if (targetMode === 'story') {
        if (seededStoryCount > 0) {
            return resumed
                ? "Story resumed — Story Cast matches this chat's roster."
                : "Story is ready — Story Cast matches this chat's roster.";
        }
        return resumed ? 'Story resumed.' : 'Story is ready.';
    }

    if (hasBridge) {
        const sourceWasNarrative = isFuraiNarrativeMode(sourceMode);
        return `${targetLabel} ${resumed ? 'resumed' : 'is ready'} — your ${sourceWasNarrative ? 'recent scene' : 'latest work'} came with you.`;
    }

    return `${targetLabel} ${resumed ? 'resumed' : 'is ready'}.`;
}

function updateFuraiModeMenuLabel(mode = getFuraiActiveMode()) {
    const value = document.getElementById('furaiChatOptionsModeValue');
    if (value) value.textContent = getFuraiSwitchModeLabel(mode);
}

function renderFuraiModeSwitcher() {
    const body = document.getElementById('furaiModeSwitcherBody');
    if (!body || !currentChatId) return;

    const currentMode = getFuraiActiveMode(currentChatId);

    const sections = [
        {
            key: 'narrative',
            title: 'Group Chat & Story',
            subtitle: 'Continue the same conversation.',
            icon: 'fa-solid fa-book-open',
            modes: ['group', 'story']
        },
        {
            key: 'tools',
            title: 'Workshops',
            subtitle: 'Research, create, and refine with context from this chat.',
            icon: 'fa-solid fa-hammer',
            modes: ['researcher', 'prompter', 'maker']
        }
    ];

    const renderSection = section => {
        const cards = section.modes.map(mode => {
            const meta = FURAI_SWITCH_MODES[mode];
            const isCurrent = mode === currentMode;
            const isSwitching = furaiModeSwitchInProgress && furaiModeSwitchTarget === mode;
            const isDisabled = isCurrent || furaiModeSwitchInProgress;
            const statusHtml = isSwitching
                ? '<span class="furai-mode-switch-status"><span class="furai-mini-spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>'
                : (isCurrent
                    ? '<span class="furai-mode-switch-status" data-furai-ui-translate>Current</span>'
                    : '');

            const iconClass = meta.icon.includes(' ')
                ? meta.icon
                : `fa-solid ${meta.icon}`;

            return `
                <button type="button"
                        class="furai-mode-switch-card${isCurrent ? ' is-current' : ''}${isSwitching ? ' is-switching' : ''}"
                        onclick="window.switchFuraiChatMode('${mode}')"
                        ${isCurrent ? 'aria-current="true"' : ''}
                        ${isSwitching ? 'aria-busy="true"' : ''}
                        ${isDisabled ? 'disabled' : ''}>
                    <span class="furai-mode-switch-icon">
                        <i class="${iconClass}"></i>
                    </span>

                    <span class="furai-mode-switch-copy">
                        <span class="furai-mode-switch-name"
                              data-furai-ui-translate>
                            ${meta.label}
                        </span>

                        <span class="furai-mode-switch-description"
                              data-furai-ui-translate>
                            ${meta.description}
                        </span>
                    </span>

                    ${statusHtml}
                </button>
            `;
        }).join('');

        return `
            <section class="furai-mode-switch-section is-${section.key}">
                <div class="furai-mode-switch-section-header">
                    <span class="furai-mode-switch-section-icon">
                        <i class="${section.icon}"></i>
                    </span>

                    <span class="furai-mode-switch-section-heading">
                        <span class="furai-mode-switch-section-title"
                              data-furai-ui-translate>
                            ${section.title}
                        </span>

                        <span class="furai-mode-switch-section-subtitle"
                              data-furai-ui-translate>
                            ${section.subtitle}
                        </span>
                    </span>
                </div>

                <div class="furai-mode-switch-grid">
                    ${cards}
                </div>
            </section>
        `;
    };

    const intro = `
        <p class="furai-mode-switch-intro"
           data-furai-ui-translate>
            Switch anytime without losing your place. All messages stay saved and visible.
        </p>
    `;

    const workshopContextNote = `
        <div class="furai-mode-history-flow is-compact">
            <small data-furai-ui-translate>
                Workshops can use this chat's context and memory. The character roster stays with the chat while workshop conversations remain separate.
            </small>
        </div>
    `;

    body.innerHTML =
        intro +
        renderSection(sections[0]) +
        workshopContextNote +
        renderSection(sections[1]);

    if (typeof scheduleFuraiUiScan === 'function') {
        scheduleFuraiUiScan(body);
    }
}

window.openFuraiModeSwitcher = function openFuraiModeSwitcher() {
    const mode = getFuraiActiveMode();
    const chatData = currentChatId ? DB.get(currentChatId) : null;
    if (!currentChatId || !FURAI_SWITCH_MODES[mode] || !Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) || chatData.messages.length === 0) return;

    const chatOptionsModal = document.getElementById('chatOptionsModalEl');
    if (chatOptionsModal && getComputedStyle(chatOptionsModal).display !== 'none' && typeof closeChatOptionsModal === 'function') {
        closeChatOptionsModal();
    }

    renderFuraiModeSwitcher();
    const modal = document.getElementById('furaiModeSwitcherModal');
    if (modal) modal.style.display = 'flex';
};

window.closeFuraiModeSwitcher = function closeFuraiModeSwitcher(event = null) {
    if (event && event.target?.id !== 'furaiModeSwitcherModal') return;
    const modal = document.getElementById('furaiModeSwitcherModal');
    if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
};

window.switchFuraiChatMode = async function switchFuraiChatMode(targetMode) {
    if (!currentChatId || !FURAI_SWITCH_MODES[targetMode]) return false;

    const chatId = currentChatId;
    const sourceMode = getFuraiActiveMode(chatId);
    if (sourceMode === targetMode) {
        window.closeFuraiModeSwitcher();
        return true;
    }

    if (isFuraiModeSwitchBusy()) {
        showToast?.('Finish or stop the current task before switching modes.', 'info');
        renderFuraiModeSwitcher();
        return false;
    }

    furaiModeSwitchInProgress = true;
    furaiModeSwitchTarget = targetMode;
    renderFuraiModeSwitcher();
    await new Promise(resolve => {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(resolve));
    });

    const sourceChatData = DB.get(chatId);
    const sourceProfile = getChatProfile(chatId);
    const sourceDraft = getFuraiModeDraftValue();
    const originalChatData = cloneFuraiSwitchValue(sourceChatData);
    const originalProfile = cloneFuraiSwitchValue(sourceProfile);
    const originalPersonality = sourceMode;

    try {
        if (!sourceChatData || !isValidFuraiModeProfile(sourceProfile)) {
            throw new Error('The current mode could not be saved safely.');
        }

        const nextChatData = cloneFuraiSwitchValue(sourceChatData);
        const firstModeSwitch = !nextChatData.morph?.enabled;
        const previousMorphSchema = Number(nextChatData.morph?.schemaVersion) || 0;
        const needsSummaryScopeUpgrade = firstModeSwitch || previousMorphSchema < 2;

        if (!nextChatData.morph || typeof nextChatData.morph !== 'object') {
            nextChatData.morph = {
                enabled: true,
                schemaVersion: 2,
                originalMode: sourceMode,
                historyPolicy: 'hybrid',
                modeStates: {}
            };
        }

        nextChatData.morph.enabled = true;
        nextChatData.morph.schemaVersion = 2;
        nextChatData.morph.originalMode = nextChatData.morph.originalMode || sourceMode;
        nextChatData.morph.historyPolicy = 'hybrid';
        nextChatData.morph.modeStates = nextChatData.morph.modeStates || {};

        if (Array.isArray(nextChatData.summaryBlocks) && needsSummaryScopeUpgrade) {
            const sourceScope = isFuraiNarrativeMode(sourceMode) ? 'narrative' : sourceMode;
            nextChatData.summaryBlocks.forEach(block => {
                if (!block || block.modeScope) return;
                if (firstModeSwitch) block.modeScope = sourceScope;
                else {
                    block.stale = true;
                    block.staleReason = 'mode_scope_upgrade';
                }
            });
        }

        if (String(nextChatData.deepMemoryPendingInvalidationReason || '') === 'mode_scope_upgrade') {
            delete nextChatData.deepMemoryPendingInvalidationFromIndex;
            delete nextChatData.deepMemoryPendingInvalidationReason;
        }

        // The active chat profile is the source of the shared user. Mode templates
        // supply workers, cast rules, controls, and workflow—not another user.
        const chatUser = cloneFuraiSwitchValue(sourceProfile.user);
        delete nextChatData.morph.chatUser;
        delete nextChatData.morph.chatUserPacked;

        // Repair legacy messages before the source profile is reduced to its
        // paused-mode form. This preserves exact names and actor UIDs even when
        // an offline linked-roster slot later moves, disappears, or is compacted.
        const identityRepairIndex = stampFuraiModeActorIdentitySnapshots(
            chatId,
            nextChatData,
            sourceMode,
            sourceProfile
        );

        if (identityRepairIndex >= 0) {
            nextChatData.memoryRevision = Math.max(0, Number(nextChatData.memoryRevision) || 0) + 1;
            invalidateFuraiSummaryFromIndex(
                nextChatData,
                identityRepairIndex,
                'actor_identity_repaired'
            );

            if (nextChatData.deepMemoryInitialized) {
                const previousInvalidationIndex = Number(
                    nextChatData.deepMemoryPendingInvalidationFromIndex
                );
                nextChatData.deepMemoryPendingInvalidationFromIndex =
                    Number.isFinite(previousInvalidationIndex)
                        ? Math.min(previousInvalidationIndex, identityRepairIndex)
                        : identityRepairIndex;
                nextChatData.deepMemoryPendingInvalidationReason = 'actor_identity_repaired';
            }
        }

        const previousSourceState = nextChatData.morph.modeStates[sourceMode] || {};
        const sourceState = {
            ...previousSourceState,
            memo: String(sourceChatData.memo || ''),
            draft: sourceDraft,
            viewMode: resolveSharedOrInheritedViewMode(sourceChatData.viewMode)
        };

        const sourceProfileForStorage = getFuraiModeProfileForStorage(
            sourceMode,
            sourceProfile
        );

        if (!setFuraiStoredModeProfile(sourceState, sourceProfileForStorage)) {
            throw new Error('The current mode could not be packed safely.');
        }

        if (sourceMode === 'maker') {
            const makerDraft = collectFuraiMakerDraft() || getFuraiStoredMakerDraft(previousSourceState);
            setFuraiStoredMakerDraft(sourceState, makerDraft);
        }

        nextChatData.morph.modeStates[sourceMode] = sourceState;

        const hadTargetState = !!nextChatData.morph.modeStates[targetMode];
        const targetState = {
            ...(nextChatData.morph.modeStates[targetMode] || {})
        };

        const storedTargetProfile = getFuraiStoredModeProfile(targetState);
        const targetClaimsSavedProfile = !!targetState.profilePacked || !!targetState.profile;
        if (targetClaimsSavedProfile && !isValidFuraiModeProfile(storedTargetProfile)) {
            throw new Error('The saved mode state is damaged.');
        }

        let targetProfile = isValidFuraiModeProfile(storedTargetProfile)
            ? storedTargetProfile
            : createFuraiSwitchProfile(
                targetMode,
                hadTargetState ? '' : sourceMode,
                hadTargetState ? null : sourceProfile
            );

        if (targetMode === 'maker') {
            targetProfile = sanitizeFuraiMakerModeProfile(targetProfile);
        }

        let sharedRoster = getFuraiSharedRoster(nextChatData);

        if (isFuraiRosterMode(sourceMode)) {
            // The mode the user is leaving is authoritative, including an empty
            // roster and every manual online/offline choice.
            sharedRoster = captureFuraiSharedRoster(
                nextChatData,
                sourceMode,
                sourceProfile
            );
        } else if (sharedRoster === null && isFuraiRosterMode(targetMode)) {
            // Migrate one existing legacy roster before falling back to the new
            // target's intentional empty roster. Never inject global/random cast.
            const legacySeed = getFuraiLegacyRosterSeed(
                nextChatData,
                targetMode,
                targetProfile,
                isValidFuraiModeProfile(storedTargetProfile)
            );

            sharedRoster = captureFuraiSharedRoster(
                nextChatData,
                legacySeed.mode,
                legacySeed.profile
            );
        }

        const sharedRosterCount = isFuraiRosterMode(targetMode)
            ? applyFuraiSharedRosterToModeProfile(
                targetProfile,
                targetMode,
                sharedRoster || []
            )
            : 0;

        targetProfile = applyFuraiChatUserToModeProfile(targetProfile, chatUser, targetMode);
        if (targetMode === 'story') suppressFuraiSharedUserFromStoryCast(targetProfile);

        if (!isValidFuraiModeProfile(targetProfile)) {
            throw new Error('The selected mode could not be prepared safely.');
        }

        targetState.memo = targetState.memo !== undefined
            ? String(targetState.memo || '')
            : getFuraiDefaultModeMemo(targetMode);
        targetState.draft = String(targetState.draft || '');
        targetState.viewMode = resolveSharedOrInheritedViewMode(
            targetState.viewMode || sourceChatData.viewMode
        );
        targetState.bridge = buildFuraiModeBridge(
            nextChatData,
            sourceMode,
            targetMode
        );
        delete targetState.bridgeMessageUids;
        delete targetState.profile;
        delete targetState.profilePacked;
        nextChatData.morph.modeStates[targetMode] = targetState;
        nextChatData.morph.lastMode = sourceMode;
        nextChatData.morph.lastSwitchedAt = Date.now();

        nextChatData.personality = targetMode;
        nextChatData.memo = targetState.memo;
        nextChatData.viewMode = targetState.viewMode;
        nextChatData.timestamp = Date.now();

        if (targetMode === 'group') nextChatData.groupStartPath = 'main-menu';
        else delete nextChatData.groupStartPath;

        ensureFuraiChatMemoryDefaults(nextChatData, targetMode);

        // Close stale profile/cast editors only after the target has been prepared.
        window.FuraiUiContextLifecycle?.transition('switch-mode');

        // Commit only after both the saved source and prepared target are valid.
        DB.set(chatId, nextChatData);
        DB.set(`profile-${chatId}`, targetProfile);

        const persistedChat = DB.get(chatId);
        const persistedProfile = DB.get(`profile-${chatId}`);
        if (
            persistedChat?.personality !== targetMode ||
            JSON.stringify(persistedProfile) !== JSON.stringify(targetProfile)
        ) {
            throw new Error('The selected mode could not be saved.');
        }

        chatPersonalities[chatId] = targetMode;
        window.chatPersonalities = chatPersonalities;
        clearFuraiModeRuntimeCaches(chatId);

        if (Number.isFinite(Number(nextChatData.deepMemoryPendingInvalidationFromIndex))) {
            void flushFuraiPendingDeepMemoryInvalidation(chatId, nextChatData);
        }

        if (typeof chatDrafts !== 'undefined') chatDrafts[chatId] = targetState.draft;
        const input = document.getElementById('messageInputEl');
        if (input) input.value = targetState.draft;

        document.getElementById('makerStudioModalEl')?.style &&
            (document.getElementById('makerStudioModalEl').style.display = 'none');

        // loadChat reads the newly committed personality/profile, so the target
        // mode owns the visible controls and its image/cutscene workflow immediately.
        const loaded = window.loadChat(chatId, { refreshSidebar: false });
        if (loaded === false) throw new Error('The selected mode could not be opened.');
        window.closeFuraiModeSwitcher();

        updateFuraiModeMenuLabel(targetMode);
        const rosterCountForToast = targetMode === 'story' ? sharedRosterCount : 0;
        const hasBridge = !!targetState.bridge?.throughMessageUid;
        showToast?.(
            getFuraiModeSwitchToast(sourceMode, targetMode, hadTargetState, hasBridge, rosterCountForToast),
            'success'
        );
        if (typeof debouncedSidebarUpdate === 'function') debouncedSidebarUpdate();
        return true;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Mode switch failed:', error);

        try {
            DB.set(chatId, originalChatData);
            DB.set(`profile-${chatId}`, originalProfile);
            chatPersonalities[chatId] = originalPersonality;
            window.chatPersonalities = chatPersonalities;
            clearFuraiModeRuntimeCaches(chatId);
            if (typeof chatDrafts !== 'undefined') chatDrafts[chatId] = sourceDraft;
            const input = document.getElementById('messageInputEl');
            if (input) input.value = sourceDraft;
            window.loadChat(chatId, { refreshSidebar: false });
        } catch (rollbackError) {
            console.error('Mode switch rollback failed:', rollbackError);
        }

        showToast?.("Couldn't switch modes. This chat stayed exactly as it was.", 'error');
        return false;
    } finally {
        furaiModeSwitchInProgress = false;
        furaiModeSwitchTarget = '';
        renderFuraiModeSwitcher();
    }
};

function canFuraiRegenerateMessageInCurrentMode(message, chatData = null) {
    const data = chatData || (currentChatId ? DB.get(currentChatId) : null) || {};
    if (!data?.morph?.enabled) return true;

    const messageMode = getFuraiMessageMode(data, message);
    const activeMode = String(data.personality || getFuraiActiveMode());
    if (messageMode === activeMode) return true;

    showToast?.(`Switch back to ${getFuraiSwitchModeLabel(messageMode)} to redo this reply.`, 'info');
    return false;
}


function isFuraiTrueNamelessSystemMessage(msg, messageEl = null) {
    const role = String(
        msg?.role ||
        getFuraiMessageFrameRole(messageEl) ||
        ''
    ).trim().toLowerCase();

    if (role !== 'system') return false;

    const identityFields = [
        msg?.userUid,
        msg?.botUid,
        msg?.userNameSnapshot,
        msg?.botNameSnapshot,
        msg?.wandNameSnapshot,
        msg?.silentNoteSpeakerName,
        msg?.speakerName,
        messageEl?.dataset?.userUid,
        messageEl?.dataset?.botUid,
        messageEl?.dataset?.speakerName,
        getCleanTimestampSpeakerName(messageEl?.querySelector?.('.chat-username'))
    ];

    return !identityFields.some(value => String(value || '').trim()) &&
        msg?.syntheticWandRetry !== true;
}

function getFuraiMessageRetryKind(msg, messageEl = null, chatId = currentChatId) {
    const role = String(
        msg?.role ||
        getFuraiMessageFrameRole(messageEl) ||
        ''
    ).trim().toLowerCase();

    if (role === 'cutscene') return 'cutscene';
    if (role === 'user') return 'user';
    if (role === 'ai') return 'ai';
    if (isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(role)) return 'wand';

    if (role === 'muted-note') {
        const botIndex = Number(msg?.botIndex ?? messageEl?.dataset?.botIndex);
        if (
            String(msg?.botUid || messageEl?.dataset?.botUid || '').trim() ||
            String(msg?.botNameSnapshot || '').trim() ||
            (Number.isInteger(botIndex) && botIndex >= 0)
        ) {
            return 'ai';
        }

        if (
            msg?.syntheticUserAutoReply === true ||
            String(msg?.userUid || messageEl?.dataset?.userUid || '').trim() ||
            String(msg?.userNameSnapshot || '').trim()
        ) {
            return 'user';
        }

        const noteName = String(
            msg?.silentNoteSpeakerName ||
            msg?.speakerName ||
            messageEl?.dataset?.speakerName ||
            getCleanTimestampSpeakerName(messageEl?.querySelector?.('.chat-username')) ||
            ''
        ).trim();

        try {
            const profile = getChatProfile(chatId);
            const userName = String(profile?.user?.name || '').trim();
            if (noteName && userName && noteName.localeCompare(userName, undefined, { sensitivity: 'accent' }) === 0) {
                return 'user';
            }

            const wandName = String(
                getResolvedWandProfileForChat(chatId)?.name ||
                DEFAULT_WAND_DISPLAY_NAME ||
                ''
            ).trim();

            if (noteName && wandName && noteName.localeCompare(wandName, undefined, { sensitivity: 'accent' }) === 0) {
                return 'wand';
            }
        } catch(e) {}

        return 'wand';
    }

    if (role === 'system') {
        return isFuraiTrueNamelessSystemMessage(msg, messageEl) ? 'none' : 'wand';
    }

    return role ? 'wand' : 'none';
}

function getFuraiRetryButtonTitle(msg, messageEl = null) {
    const kind = getFuraiMessageRetryKind(msg, messageEl);

    if (kind === 'cutscene') return 'Redo Cutscene';
    if (kind === 'user') return 'Retry as AI User';
    if (kind === 'wand') return 'Retry with Magic Wand';
    return 'Try again';
}

function buildFuraiRetryHistoryText(chatId, endIndex, profile, options = {}) {
    const personality = chatPersonalities[chatId] || DB.get(chatId)?.personality || 'researcher';
    const includeSystem = options.includeSystem === true;

    return getChatContextMessages(chatId, endIndex)
        .filter(msg => !shouldSkipAiContextMessageRole(msg?.role))
        .filter(msg => includeSystem || msg?.role !== 'system')
        .map(msg => (
            personality === 'group' || personality === 'maker'
                ? mapGroupContextMessage(msg, profile)
                : mapSoloContextMessage(msg, profile, profile?.bots?.[0] || createFuraiModeFactoryBot(personality))
        ))
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join('\n');
}

function beginFuraiInlineMessageRetry(messageEl, typingId) {
    if (!messageEl) return null;

    const contentEl = messageEl.querySelector('.content');
    const snapshot = {
        messageEl,
        contentEl,
        className: messageEl.className,
        id: messageEl.id || '',
        ariaHidden: messageEl.getAttribute('aria-hidden'),
        contentHtml: contentEl?.innerHTML || ''
    };

    messageEl.id = typingId;
    messageEl.classList.add('furai-active-ai-message');
    messageEl.classList.remove('is-regenerating-replaced');
    messageEl.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');

    if (contentEl) {
        clearSmoothTypingIndicator(messageEl);
        setFuraiMessageThinkingIndicator(contentEl);
    }

    return snapshot;
}

function restoreFuraiInlineMessageRetry(snapshot) {
    const messageEl = snapshot?.messageEl;
    if (!messageEl || !document.body.contains(messageEl)) return;

    clearSmoothTypingIndicator(messageEl);
    messageEl.className = snapshot.className;

    if (snapshot.id) messageEl.id = snapshot.id;
    else messageEl.removeAttribute('id');

    if (snapshot.ariaHidden === null) messageEl.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
    else messageEl.setAttribute('aria-hidden', snapshot.ariaHidden);

    if (snapshot.contentEl && document.body.contains(snapshot.contentEl)) {
        snapshot.contentEl.className = 'content';
        snapshot.contentEl.innerHTML = snapshot.contentHtml;
    }

    const oldControls = messageEl.querySelector('.message-controls');
    if (oldControls) oldControls.remove();
    window.addMessageControls?.(messageEl);
}

async function retryFuraiWandMessage(record) {
    const { chatData, msg, index, messageEl } = record || {};
    if (!msg || !messageEl || !currentChatId) return false;

    if (!canFuraiRegenerateMessageInCurrentMode(msg, chatData)) return false;
    if (isFuraiForegroundAiBusy()) return false;

    const role = String(msg.role || getFuraiMessageFrameRole(messageEl) || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (role === 'system' && isFuraiTrueNamelessSystemMessage(msg, messageEl)) return false;

    const aiRequestToken = beginFuraiAiRequestPreflight();
    if (!aiRequestToken) return false;

    const thisChatId = currentChatId;
    const typingId = `typing-wand-retry-${Date.now()}`;
    const retrySnapshot = beginFuraiInlineMessageRetry(messageEl, typingId);

    yieldFuraiDeepMemoryToForeground(thisChatId);
    const requestController = promoteFuraiAiRequestPreflight(aiRequestToken);
    if (!requestController) {
        restoreFuraiInlineMessageRetry(retrySnapshot);
        return false;
    }

    const abortSignal = requestController.signal;
    let streamedText = '';

    try {
        const profile = getChatProfile(thisChatId);
        const personality = chatPersonalities[thisChatId] || chatData?.personality || 'researcher';
        const history = buildFuraiRetryHistoryText(thisChatId, index, profile, { includeSystem: true });
        const originalText = getAiMessageContentText(msg).trim();

        const referenceBlock = await getResolvedReference(personality, {
            includeHiddenInstructions: true
        });

        const latestChatData = DB.get(thisChatId) || chatData || {};
        const localGlossary = latestChatData.glossary || '';
        const globalGlossary = DB.get(`global_glossary_${personality}`) || '';
        const glossaryBlock = getGlossaryContext(history, `${globalGlossary}\n${localGlossary}`);
        const keyFactsBlock = getFuraiAuthoritativeMemoryText(latestChatData);
        const memoBlock = getFuraiEffectiveMemoText(latestChatData, personality);

        const summaryBlock = Array.isArray(latestChatData.summaryBlocks)
            ? latestChatData.summaryBlocks
                .filter(block => !block?.stale && String(block?.text || '').trim())
                .map((block, summaryIndex) => `[Summary ${summaryIndex + 1}]\n${String(block.text).trim()}`)
                .join('\n\n')
            : '';

        let deepMemoryBlock = '';
        try {
            deepMemoryBlock = await getFuraiDeepMemoryContextBlock(
                thisChatId,
                buildFuraiDeepMemoryQueryText(originalText, history),
                latestChatData
            );
        } catch (error) {
            console.warn('Magic Wand retry Deep Memory retrieval skipped:', error);
        }

        const wandProfile = getResolvedWandProfileForChat(thisChatId);
        const wandName = String(wandProfile?.name || DEFAULT_WAND_DISPLAY_NAME || 'Magic Wand').trim();
        const userStatus = getUserChatStatus(profile);
        const userName = String(profile?.user?.name || 'User').trim() || 'User';
        const visibleUserName = userStatus === 'silent' ? 'Hidden participant' : userName;
        const userInstruction = getFuraiContextInstructionForStatus(
            getFuraiEffectiveModeCharacterInstruction(profile?.user || {}, personality),
            userStatus
        );

        const activeBots = (profile?.bots || [])
            .filter(bot => personality !== 'group' || bot.inActiveCast)
            .map(bot => getFuraiCastKnowledgeLine(bot, personality))
            .filter(Boolean)
            .join('\n') || 'None';

        const retryCommand = [
            'Create a fresh alternative message for the same point in the conversation.',
            originalText ? `Use this previous human-written version only as intent reference:\n${originalText}` : '',
            isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(role) || role === 'system'
                ? 'The rendered result is an anonymous system-style broadcast. Output only its body with no name, speaker label, timestamp, or role prefix.'
                : role === 'muted-note'
                    ? `The rendered result is a Silent Note owned by ${wandName}. Output only the note body with no prefix.`
                    : 'Output only the replacement message body with no prefix.'
        ].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n');

        const template = getFuraiEffectiveCharacterInstruction(wandProfile) || DEFAULT_ENHANCER_TEMPLATE;
        const profileInstruction = String(template || '')
            .replace(/{{USER_NAME}}/g, visibleUserName)
            .replace(/{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}/g, userInstruction)
            .replace(/{{ACTIVE_BOTS}}/g, activeBots)
            .replace(/{{MEMO_BLOCK}}/g, memoBlock)
            .replace(/{{REFERENCE_BLOCK}}/g, referenceBlock)
            .replace(/{{CHAT_HISTORY}}/g, history)
            .replace(/{{USER_INPUT}}/g, retryCommand)
            .trim() || DEFAULT_ENHANCER_TEMPLATE;

        const instruction = `
[YOUR PROFILE]
${profileInstruction}

[ACTIVE CAST]
${activeBots}

[KEY FACTS]
${keyFactsBlock || '(none)'}

[SUMMARY]
${summaryBlock || '(none)'}

[DEEP MEMORY]
${deepMemoryBlock || '(none)'}

[LORE / REFERENCE]
${referenceBlock || '(none)'}

[GLOSSARY]
${glossaryBlock || '(none)'}

[MEMO / CURRENT GOAL]
${memoBlock || '(none)'}

[CHAT BEFORE THIS MESSAGE]
${history || '(empty)'}

[RETRY TASK]
${retryCommand}

[OUTPUT]
Return only the replacement message text:
`.trim();

        const generatedText = await generateText({
            instruction,
            signal: abortSignal,
            onChunk: data => {
                if (abortSignal.aborted) return;

                let chunk = data.textChunk || '';
                if (!streamedText) chunk = chunk.trimStart();
                if (!chunk) return;

                streamedText += chunk;
                const visibleText = stripAiTranscriptPrefix(streamedText, wandName)
                    .replace(/^(?:system|announcement|broadcast)\s*:\s*/i, '');

                queueSmoothTypingIndicator(typingId, visibleText, true);
            }
        });

        if (abortSignal.aborted) {
            restoreFuraiInlineMessageRetry(retrySnapshot);
            return false;
        }

        const finalText = stripAiTranscriptPrefix(
            String(generatedText || streamedText || '').trim(),
            wandName
        )
            .replace(/^(?:system|announcement|broadcast)\s*:\s*/i, '')
            .trim();

        if (!finalText) {
            restoreFuraiInlineMessageRetry(retrySnapshot);
            return false;
        }

        const speakerName = role === 'muted-note' ? wandName : '';
        const saveMeta = {
            createdAt: msg.createdAt || messageEl.dataset.createdAt || '',
            replaceMessageUid: String(msg.uid || messageEl.dataset.messageUid || '').trim(),
            speakerName,
            silentNoteSpeakerName: speakerName,
            wandNameSnapshot: wandName,
            syntheticWandRetry: true
        };

        const saveResult = saveMessage(
            thisChatId,
            role,
            finalText,
            null,
            null,
            saveMeta
        );

        if (!saveResult) {
            restoreFuraiInlineMessageRetry(retrySnapshot);
            showToast?.('Could not save the retried message.', 'error');
            return false;
        }

        clearSmoothTypingIndicator(messageEl);
        updateRenderedMessageFromSave(
            messageEl,
            role,
            finalText,
            null,
            saveResult.message,
            saveResult.index,
            saveMeta
        );
        renderPinnedGeneratedImagesForMessage(messageEl, saveResult.message?.pinnedGeneratedImages);

        const visualTrigger = resolveFuraiAutoVisualTrigger(finalText, personality);
        if (
            visualTrigger.matched &&
            queueFuraiAutoVisualTrigger(visualTrigger, messageEl, thisChatId)
        ) {
            await processFuraiAutoVisualTriggerQueue({
                allowWhileGenerating: true,
                resumeQueue: false
            });
        }

        return true;
    } catch (error) {
        restoreFuraiInlineMessageRetry(retrySnapshot);

        if (error.name !== 'AbortError') {
            console.error('Magic Wand message retry failed:', error);
            showToast?.('Magic Wand could not retry this message.', 'error');
        }

        return false;
    } finally {
        if (currentAbortController === requestController) {
            isGenerating = false;
            currentAbortController = null;
            updateEnhancerButton();
            updateSendButtonUI();
            processGenerationQueue();
        }
    }
}

async function retryFuraiMessageFromElement(messageEl) {
    const record = typeof furaiGetMessageAtDomElement === 'function'
        ? furaiGetMessageAtDomElement(messageEl)
        : null;

    if (!record?.msg) return false;
    record.messageEl = messageEl;

    const { chatData, msg, index } = record;
    if (!canFuraiRegenerateMessageInCurrentMode(msg, chatData)) return false;

    const retryKind = getFuraiMessageRetryKind(msg, messageEl);

    if (retryKind === 'none') return false;

    if (retryKind === 'cutscene') {
        const replaceMessageUid = String(msg.uid || messageEl.dataset.messageUid || '').trim();
        if (!replaceMessageUid) return false;

        messageEl.dataset.messageUid = replaceMessageUid;
        messageEl.dataset.messageIndex = String(index);
        markMessageRegenerating(messageEl, replaceMessageUid);

        window.generateCutscene?.({
            insertIndex: index,
            replaceMessageUid
        });

        return true;
    }

    if (retryKind === 'user') {
        return autoReply({
            retryMessageUid: String(msg.uid || messageEl.dataset.messageUid || '').trim(),
            retryMessageIndex: index,
            retryMessageEl: messageEl
        });
    }

    if (retryKind === 'wand') {
        return retryFuraiWandMessage(record);
    }

    let forcedIndex = Number(msg.botIndex);
    if (!Number.isInteger(forcedIndex) || forcedIndex < 0) {
        forcedIndex = null;

        try {
            const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
            const botUid = String(msg.botUid || messageEl.dataset.botUid || '').trim();
            const botName = String(
                msg.botNameSnapshot ||
                getCleanTimestampSpeakerName(messageEl.querySelector('.chat-username')) ||
                ''
            ).trim();

            if (botUid) {
                const uidIndex = profile?.bots?.findIndex(bot => String(bot?.uid || '') === botUid);
                if (Number.isInteger(uidIndex) && uidIndex >= 0) forcedIndex = uidIndex;
            }

            if (forcedIndex === null && botName) {
                const nameIndex = profile?.bots?.findIndex(bot => String(bot?.name || '').trim() === botName);
                if (Number.isInteger(nameIndex) && nameIndex >= 0) forcedIndex = nameIndex;
            }
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    const replaceMessageUid = String(msg.uid || messageEl.dataset.messageUid || '').trim();
    if (!replaceMessageUid) return false;

    messageEl.dataset.messageUid = replaceMessageUid;
    messageEl.dataset.messageIndex = String(index);
    markMessageRegenerating(messageEl, replaceMessageUid);

    window.sendMessage?.({
        regenerate: true,
        insertIndex: index,
        forceBotIndex: forcedIndex,
        forceActorUid: msg.botUid || messageEl.dataset.botUid || '',
        replaceMessageUid
    });

    return true;
}

window.updateFuraiModeMenuLabel = updateFuraiModeMenuLabel;


/* --- MESSAGE SENDING HANDLERS --- */
let furaiWebImportBusy = false;

function updateSendButtonUI() {
    const sendBtn = document.getElementById('sendBtn');
    const sendIcon = document.getElementById('sendIcon');
    const stopIcon = document.getElementById('stopIcon');
    const isPreparingImagePrompt = !!window.furaiActiveMessageImagePromptJobId;
    const showStop = isGenerating || furaiAiRequestPending || isPreparingImagePrompt;
    const isNonCancelableForegroundWork = isCutsceneGenerating || furaiAutoVisualTriggerBusy || furaiWebImportBusy;

    if (sendIcon && stopIcon) {
        sendIcon.style.display = showStop ? 'none' : 'flex';
        stopIcon.style.display = showStop ? 'flex' : 'none';
    }

    if (sendBtn) {
        sendBtn.disabled = isNonCancelableForegroundWork && !showStop;
        sendBtn.title = isPreparingImagePrompt
            ? 'Stop Image Button AI Prompting and use partial prompt + message text'
            : (showStop
                ? 'Stop Generating'
                : (isCutsceneGenerating
                    ? 'Generating cutscene'
                    : (furaiWebImportBusy
                        ? 'Importing website'
                        : (furaiAutoVisualTriggerBusy ? 'Generating triggered visual' : 'Send Message'))));
    }
}

// --- NEW: Slash Command Processor ---
function processSlashCommands(text, mode) {
    let processed = text;

    if (mode === 'prompter') {
        let tags = [];
        if (/\/(portrait|tall|phone)/i.test(processed)) { tags.push('(resolution:::512x768)'); processed = processed.replace(/\/(portrait|tall|phone)\b/gi, ''); }
        if (/\/(landscape|wide|desktop)/i.test(processed)) { tags.push('(resolution:::768x512)'); processed = processed.replace(/\/(landscape|wide|desktop)\b/gi, ''); }
        if (/\/(square)/i.test(processed)) { tags.push('(resolution:::768x768)'); processed = processed.replace(/\/(square)\b/gi, ''); }

        let negMatch = processed.match(/\/negative\s+([^/]+)/i);
        if (negMatch) { tags.push(`(negativePrompt:::${negMatch[1].trim()})`); processed = processed.replace(negMatch[0], ''); }

        let seedMatch = processed.match(/\/seed(?:\s+(\d+))?\b/i);
        if (seedMatch) {
            const seedValue = seedMatch[1] || createRandomPromptSeed();
            tags.push(`(seed:::${seedValue})`);
            processed = processed.replace(seedMatch[0], '');
        }

        let guidMatch = processed.match(/\/(guidance|cfg)\s+([\d.]+)/i);
        if (guidMatch) { tags.push(`(guidanceScale:::${guidMatch[2]})`); processed = processed.replace(guidMatch[0], ''); }

        let titleMatch = processed.match(/\/title\s+([^/]+)/i);
        if (titleMatch) { tags.push(`(saveTitle:::${titleMatch[1].trim()})`); processed = processed.replace(titleMatch[0], ''); }

        processed = processed.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
        if (tags.length > 0) processed += ' ' + tags.join('');
    }
    else if (mode === 'story') {
        if (!/(?:^|\s)\//.test(processed)) {
            return { text: processed.trim(), isSystem: false };
        }
    
        const storyRules = [
            // Core commands
            { regex: /\/continue\b/gi, directive: 'Continue the story naturally from the current point.' },
            { regex: /\/expand\b|\/scene\b/gi, directive: 'Treat the user text as an outline, beats, or rough notes and expand it into a full story scene in prose.' },
            { regex: /\/revise\b/gi, directive: 'Rewrite the user text into cleaner story prose while preserving its meaning.' },
            { regex: /\/outline\b/gi, directive: 'Turn the user text into a short story outline with clear beats or bullet points, not full prose.' },
            { regex: /\/brainstorm\b/gi, directive: 'Give several possible next directions, twists, or scene ideas for the story without fully writing them out.' },
            { regex: /\/worldbuild\b/gi, directive: 'Expand the world around the current story: setting, history, culture, factions, rules, myths, locations, atmosphere, and worldview when relevant.' },
            { regex: /\/character\b/gi, directive: 'Deepen a character through backstory, personality, motivation, secrets, relationships, visual identity, speech style, and story role.' },
            { regex: /\/commentary\b/gi, directive: 'Step out of the story and give brief writing commentary, craft notes, or scene feedback in plain language.' },
            { regex: /\/explain\b/gi, directive: 'Step out of the story and explain the scene, character logic, or plot direction plainly.' },
            { regex: /\/immersive\b|\/plain\b/gi, directive: 'Return to immersive story prose. Stay in-universe, do not break the fourth wall, do not speak like an assistant, and do not add meta commentary or explanation unless explicitly asked.' },
            { regex: /\/summarize\b/gi, directive: 'Summarize the current story progress briefly.' },
        
            // Perspective
            { regex: /\/perspective\s+1st\b/gi, directive: 'Write in first person.' },
            { regex: /\/perspective\s+2nd\b/gi, directive: 'Write in second person.' },
            { regex: /\/perspective\s+3rd\b/gi, directive: 'Write in third person.' },
        
            // Pacing
            { regex: /\/pace\s+slow\b/gi, directive: 'Use slower narrative pacing with more atmosphere, pauses, and detail. Let moments breathe.' },
            { regex: /\/pace\s+fast\b|\/pace\s+action\b/gi, directive: 'Use faster narrative pacing with quicker progression, tighter beats, and stronger forward momentum.' },
            { regex: /\/pace\s+dense\b|\/pace\s+brief\b/gi, directive: 'Compress more events, information, or progression into the same space without necessarily making the response longer.' },
        
            // Tone
            { regex: /\/tone\s+dark\b/gi, directive: 'Use a darker and more serious tone.' },
            { regex: /\/tone\s+light\b/gi, directive: 'Use a lighter and warmer tone.' },
            { regex: /\/tone\s+romantic\b/gi, directive: 'Use a romantic and intimate tone.' },
            { regex: /\/tone\s+horror\b/gi, directive: 'Use a tense horror tone.' },
        
            // Style
            { regex: /\/style\s+fantasy\b/gi, directive: 'Use fantasy-style storytelling language.' },
            { regex: /\/style\s+noir\b/gi, directive: 'Use noir-style storytelling language.' },
            { regex: /\/style\s+poetic\b/gi, directive: 'Use more poetic, lyrical, and descriptive language.' },
            { regex: /\/style\s+simple\b/gi, directive: 'Use simple, clear, and readable storytelling language.' },
