            { regex: /\/style\s+fairy\s+tale\b/gi, directive: 'Use a fairy-tale style with mythic simplicity, storybook phrasing, and a slightly magical tone.' },
            { regex: /\/style\s+classic\s+literature\b/gi, directive: 'Use a classic literature style with more formal, textured, and old-fashioned prose.' },
            { regex: /\/style\s+journalistic\b/gi, directive: 'Use a journalistic or reporter-like style with clear observational language, factual framing, and a slightly detached tone.' },
            { regex: /\/style\s+stream\s+of\s+consciousness\b/gi, directive: 'Use a stream-of-consciousness style with flowing inner thoughts, associative narration, and emotionally immediate phrasing.' },
            { regex: /\/style\s+diary\b/gi, directive: 'Use a diary or journal-entry style with personal reflection, subjective detail, and a more intimate first-person voice.' },
            { regex: /\/style\s+sci(?:\s+|-)?fi\b/gi, directive: 'Use science-fiction storytelling language with futuristic atmosphere, speculative details, and genre-appropriate wording.' },
            { regex: /\/style\s+comedic\b/gi, directive: 'Use a comedic style with wit, playful humor, and lighter phrasing while still staying coherent to the scene.' },
        ];

        let storyDirectives = [];

        storyRules.forEach(rule => {
            if (rule.regex.test(processed)) {
                storyDirectives.push(rule.directive);
                processed = processed.replace(rule.regex, '');
            }
        });

        processed = processed
            .replace(/[ \t]{2,}/g, ' ')
            .replace(/[ \t]+\n/g, '\n')
            .replace(/\n[ \t]+/g, '\n')
            .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
            .trim();

            if (storyDirectives.length > 0) {
                processed = `${storyDirectives.map(d => `- ${d}`).join('\n')}\n\n${processed}`;
            }
    }

    return { text: processed, isSystem: false };
}

// --- GLOBAL MESSAGE / VISUAL ACTION QUEUES ---
// generationQueue is reserved for FurAI-controlled follow-up turns only.
// User sends are never placed here: one foreground AI request, zero queued user prompts.
let generationQueue = [];
const FURAI_MAX_AUTO_MENTION_CHAIN_TURNS = 6;
const FURAI_MAX_EXPLICIT_MENTION_REPLIES = 12;
const furaiAutoVisualTriggerQueue = [];

function getFuraiQueuedTaskSourceState(task) {
    const chatId = String(task?.chatId || '').trim();
    const sourceMessageUid = String(task?.sourceMessageUid || '').trim();

    if (!chatId || !sourceMessageUid) return { valid: true, chatData: null, sourceIndex: -1 };
    if (chatId !== currentChatId) return { valid: false, chatData: null, sourceIndex: -1 };

    const expectedPersonality = String(task?.sourcePersonality || '').trim();
    const currentPersonality = String(chatPersonalities[chatId] || '').trim();
    if (expectedPersonality && currentPersonality && expectedPersonality !== currentPersonality) {
        return { valid: false, chatData: null, sourceIndex: -1 };
    }

    try {
        const chatData = DB.get(chatId) || {};
        const messages = Array.isArray(chatData.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
        const sourceIndex = messages.findIndex(message => String(message?.uid || '') === sourceMessageUid);

        if (sourceIndex < 0) return { valid: false, chatData, sourceIndex };

        // New AI/system bubbles do not invalidate an already promised mention reply.
        // A newer user turn or public announcement does: the old queued reply must
        // never wake up later and answer the wrong conversation state.
        for (let index = sourceIndex + 1; index < messages.length; index++) {
            const role = String(messages[index]?.role || '');
            if (role === 'user' || isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(role)) {
                return { valid: false, chatData, sourceIndex };
            }
        }

        return { valid: true, chatData, sourceIndex, sourceMessage: messages[sourceIndex] || null };
    } catch (error) {
        return { valid: false, chatData: null, sourceIndex: -1 };
    }
}

function normalizeFuraiQueuedActorUids(values) {
    const seen = new Set();
    const out = [];

    for (const value of Array.isArray(values) ? values : []) {
        const uid = String(value || '').trim();
        if (!uid || seen.has(uid)) continue;
        seen.add(uid);
        out.push(uid);
    }

    return out;
}

function enqueueFuraiBotMentionTask(task) {
    const chatId = String(task?.chatId || '').trim();
    const targetActorUids = normalizeFuraiQueuedActorUids(task?.forceActorUids);
    const alreadyQueued = new Set();

    for (const queued of generationQueue) {
        if (queued?.__furaiBotMentionReply !== true) continue;
        if (chatId && String(queued.chatId || '') !== chatId) continue;

        normalizeFuraiQueuedActorUids(queued.forceActorUids).forEach(uid => alreadyQueued.add(uid));
    }

    const freshTargetActorUids = targetActorUids.filter(uid => !alreadyQueued.has(uid));
    const isBroadcast = task?.forceBroadcastMention === true;
    const broadcastAlreadyQueued = isBroadcast && generationQueue.some(queued =>
        queued?.__furaiBotMentionReply === true &&
        queued?.forceBroadcastMention === true &&
        (!chatId || String(queued.chatId || '') === chatId)
    );

    if (broadcastAlreadyQueued) return false;
    if (!isBroadcast && freshTargetActorUids.length === 0) return false;

    const queuedTask = {
        ...task,
        forceActorUids: freshTargetActorUids
    };

    // Explicit character pings stay ahead of User Auto Reply. This prevents a
    // generated user turn from invalidating a character reply that was already promised.
    const firstUserAutoReplyIndex = generationQueue.findIndex(queued =>
        queued?.__furaiUserAutoReply === true &&
        (!chatId || String(queued.chatId || '') === chatId)
    );

    if (firstUserAutoReplyIndex >= 0) {
        generationQueue.splice(firstUserAutoReplyIndex, 0, queuedTask);
    } else {
        generationQueue.push(queuedTask);
    }

    return true;
}

let furaiAutoVisualTriggerBusy = false;
let isCutsceneGenerating = false;

function isFuraiCancelableAiRequestActive() {
    return isGenerating || furaiAiRequestPending || !!window.furaiActiveMessageImagePromptJobId;
}

function isFuraiForegroundAiBusy() {
    return isFuraiCancelableAiRequestActive() || isCutsceneGenerating || furaiAutoVisualTriggerBusy || furaiWebImportBusy;
}

function beginFuraiAiRequestPreflight() {
    if (isFuraiForegroundAiBusy()) return 0;

    furaiAiRequestPending = true;
    const token = ++furaiAiRequestEpoch;
    updateSendButtonUI();
    return token;
}

function isFuraiAiRequestPreflightCurrent(token) {
    return !!token && furaiAiRequestPending && token === furaiAiRequestEpoch;
}

function finishFuraiAiRequestPreflight(token) {
    if (!isFuraiAiRequestPreflightCurrent(token)) return false;

    furaiAiRequestPending = false;
    updateSendButtonUI();
    return true;
}

function cancelFuraiAiRequestPreflight() {
    if (!furaiAiRequestPending) return false;

    furaiAiRequestPending = false;
    furaiAiRequestEpoch += 1;
    updateSendButtonUI();
    return true;
}

function promoteFuraiAiRequestPreflight(token) {
    if (!isFuraiAiRequestPreflightCurrent(token)) return null;

    furaiAiRequestPending = false;
    isGenerating = true;
    currentAbortController = new AbortController();
    updateSendButtonUI();
    return currentAbortController;
}

function getFuraiOneTimeCueTarget(profile, role = 'ai', actorUid = '', botIndex = null) {
    if (!profile) return null;
    if (role === 'user') return profile.user || null;

    const uid = String(actorUid || '').trim();
    if (uid) {
        return profile.bots?.find(bot => String(bot?.uid || '').trim() === uid) || null;
    }

    const index = Number(botIndex);
    return Number.isInteger(index) && index >= 0 ? profile.bots?.[index] || null : null;
}

function readFuraiOneTimeCue(profile, role = 'ai', actorUid = '', botIndex = null) {
    const target = getFuraiOneTimeCueTarget(profile, role, actorUid, botIndex);
    return String(target?.tempCue || '').trim();
}

function consumeFuraiOneTimeCue(chatId, role = 'ai', actorUid = '', botIndex = null, expectedCue = '') {
    const expected = String(expectedCue || '').trim();
    if (!chatId || !expected) return false;

    const latestProfile = getChatProfile(chatId);
    const target = getFuraiOneTimeCueTarget(latestProfile, role, actorUid, botIndex);
    if (!target || String(target.tempCue || '').trim() !== expected) return false;

    delete target.tempCue;
    DB.set(`profile-${chatId}`, latestProfile);

    if (chatId === currentChatId) {
        const cardModal = document.getElementById('profileCardModal');
        const cueInput = document.getElementById('pCardCueInput');
        const visibleActorUid = String(cardModal?.dataset.actorUid || '').trim();
        const consumedActorUid = String(target.uid || actorUid || '').trim();

        if (cueInput && visibleActorUid && visibleActorUid === consumedActorUid) {
            cueInput.value = '';
            setProfileCardCueSaveState('clean');
        }
    }

    return true;
}

function processGenerationQueue() {
    if (
        isGenerating ||
        furaiAiRequestPending ||
        isCutsceneGenerating ||
        furaiAutoVisualTriggerBusy ||
        window.furaiActiveMessageImagePromptJobId
    ) {
        return;
    }

    // A triggered visual action belongs to the message that just finished, so run it
    // before starting the next chronological chat turn.
    if (furaiAutoVisualTriggerQueue.length > 0) {
        void processFuraiAutoVisualTriggerQueue();
        return;
    }

    while (generationQueue.length > 0) {
        const nextTask = generationQueue.shift();
        if (!nextTask) continue;

        const taskChatId = String(nextTask.chatId || '').trim();
        if (taskChatId && taskChatId !== currentChatId) continue;

        const sourceState = getFuraiQueuedTaskSourceState(nextTask);
        if (!sourceState.valid) continue;

        if (nextTask.__furaiUserAutoReply === true) {
            autoReply({
                autoTriggered: true,
                chainDepth: nextTask.chainDepth || 0
            });
            return;
        }

        // The queued task carries the exact actor UIDs and source message that
        // created it. It does not re-interpret a newer user message as an old ping.
        void sendMessage({ ...nextTask, isAutoReply: true });
        return;
    }
}

// Stop Button: keep partial or empty replies as manually editable bubbles
function handleSendOrStop() {
    let stoppedAiWork = false;

    if (window.furaiActiveMessageImagePromptJobId && window.cancelBubbleImageAiPrompt) {
        window.cancelBubbleImageAiPrompt(window.furaiActiveMessageImagePromptJobId);
        stoppedAiWork = true;
    }

    if (isGenerating || furaiAiRequestPending) {
        abortCurrentGeneration({ preserveEmptyBubble: true });
        return;
    }

    if (stoppedAiWork) return;

    if (expandVisiblePromptSlashBeforeSend()) {
        return;
    }

    sendMessage();
}


// Removes transcript imitation only when an AI reply begins with the
// expected speaker name and a transcript-style timestamp. Supported forms:
// [10:17 AM] FurAI:
// [10:17 AM] FurAI
// 10:17 AM: Reply text
// FurAI [10:17 AM]:
// [2026-07-09 10:17 AM] FurAI:
function stripAiTranscriptPrefix(text, speakerName = '') {
    const output = String(text ?? '');
    const name = String(speakerName || '').trim();
    if (!name) return output;

    const escapedName = name.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
    const clock = String.raw`\d{1,2}[:.]\d{2}(?:\s*[AP]\.?M\.?)?`;
    const date = String.raw`\d{4}[-/.]\d{1,2}[-/.]\d{1,2}`;
    const bareTimestamp = String.raw`(?:(?:${date})(?:\s+${clock})?|${clock})`;
    const bracketedTimestamp = String.raw`\[${bareTimestamp}\]`;

    const sameLinePrefix = new RegExp(
        String.raw`^\s*(?:${bracketedTimestamp}\s*${escapedName}|${escapedName}\s*${bracketedTimestamp})\s*:\s*`,
        'i'
    );
    const headerLinePrefix = new RegExp(
        String.raw`^\s*${bracketedTimestamp}\s*${escapedName}\s*(?:\r?\n|$)`,
        'i'
    );
    const speakerLinePrefix = new RegExp(
        String.raw`^\s*${escapedName}\s*(?:\r?\n)\s*${bracketedTimestamp}\s*:\s*`,
        'i'
    );

    let cleaned = output;
    let removedTranscriptHeader = false;

    for (const pattern of [sameLinePrefix, headerLinePrefix, speakerLinePrefix]) {
        if (!pattern.test(cleaned)) continue;
        cleaned = cleaned.replace(pattern, '');
        removedTranscriptHeader = true;
        break;
    }

    if (!removedTranscriptHeader) return output;

    // Some models repeat the time on the next line after already writing the
    // bracketed speaker header. Remove only this directly-associated remainder.
    return cleaned.replace(
        new RegExp(String.raw`^\s*(?:${bareTimestamp}|${bracketedTimestamp})\s*:\s*`, 'i'),
        ''
    );
}

// ============================================================================
// CRITICAL AI GENERATION ERROR BOUNDARY — DO NOT REMOVE OR WEAKEN THIS CONTRACT
// ============================================================================
// A transport, provider, timeout, parsing, or runtime failure is APPLICATION UI
// state. It is NEVER dialogue, narration, a system announcement, or chat history.
//
// Why this regression happens:
// completeGeneration(), saveMessage(), addMessage(), and addMessageDOM() correctly
// trust their text argument as real model output. Passing fallback copy such as
// "Sorry, I encountered an error." from a catch block therefore makes the active
// character literally speak it, saves it to the transcript, exposes it to VN and
// regeneration, and may feed it back into Summary / Deep Memory on later turns.
//
// NEVER do any of the following from a generation catch/failure path:
//   completeGeneration(chatId, UI_ERROR_TEXT, ...)
//   saveMessage(chatId, 'ai', UI_ERROR_TEXT, ...)
//   addMessage('ai', UI_ERROR_TEXT, ...)
//   addMessageDOM('ai', UI_ERROR_TEXT, ...)
//
// Correct failure handling is centralized below: log the real error, restore any
// message hidden for regeneration, remove the unfinished typing bubble, release the
// generation state, and show a non-conversation toast. Only genuine model-produced
// text may enter completeGeneration() or any chat persistence/rendering function.
function failFuraiGeneration(chatId, error, options = {}) {
    const genData = ongoingGenerations[chatId];
    const replaceMessageUid = String(genData?.replaceMessageUid || '').trim();

    // A retry hides the original bubble while the replacement is generated.
    // Restore it before removing the pending bubble so CR/VN resync sees valid data.
    if (replaceMessageUid && typeof findRenderedMessageByUid === 'function') {
        const originalMessageEl = findRenderedMessageByUid(replaceMessageUid);
        if (originalMessageEl) {
            originalMessageEl.classList.remove('is-regenerating-replaced');
            originalMessageEl.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
        }
    }

    if (genData?.typingId && typeof removeTypingIndicator === 'function') {
        removeTypingIndicator(genData.typingId);
    }

    delete ongoingGenerations[chatId];

    if (options.releaseGlobalState !== false) {
        isGenerating = false;
        currentAbortController = null;
        hideFuraiRecallPreflightHint();

        if (document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) {
            hideVnStatusHint('thinking', { forceThinking: true });
        } else {
            hideCrBottomStatusPill('typing');
        }

        updateSendButtonUI();
        if (typeof updateEnhancerButton === 'function') updateEnhancerButton();
        if (typeof finalizeFuraiContextTrimNotice === 'function') finalizeFuraiContextTrimNotice();
    }

    if (options.showToast !== false && chatId === currentChatId && typeof showToast === 'function') {
        showToast(
            options.message || 'Reply generation failed. Nothing was added to the chat. Try again.',
            'error'
        );
    }

    if (options.continueQueue === true) {
        processGenerationQueue();
    }

    return error;
}

// --- FIXED: Cleanup & Final Scroll ---
// --- FINALIZED: NO FLICKER, NO JUMP, CLEAN EXIT, CLEAN INPUT ---
function completeGeneration(chatId, finalContent, botIndex, insertIndex = null) {
    const genData = ongoingGenerations[chatId];
    if (!genData) return;

    finalContent = String(finalContent ?? '');
    finalContent = stripAiTranscriptPrefix(
        finalContent,
        genData.actorProfile?.name || genData.speakerName || ''
    );

    const personality = chatPersonalities[chatId] || 'researcher';
    const autoVisualTrigger = resolveFuraiAutoVisualTrigger(finalContent, personality);
    finalContent = autoVisualTrigger.text;

    const hasFinalContent = finalContent.trim().length > 0;
    const preserveEmptyBubble = genData.preserveEmptyOnAbort === true;
    const shouldSaveMessage = !autoVisualTrigger.imageOnly && (hasFinalContent || preserveEmptyBubble);

    // --- CONTEXT SAFETY ---
    // If we switched rooms (chatId mismatch), we ONLY save to file.
    if (chatId !== currentChatId) {
        if (shouldSaveMessage) {
            // Saves partial text, or an intentionally preserved empty stopped reply,
            // into the OLD chat file without rendering it in the current room.
            const saveResult = saveMessage(chatId, 'ai', finalContent, botIndex, genData.insertIndex ?? insertIndex, {
                actorUid: genData.actorUid || '',
                actorProfile: genData.actorProfile || null,
                botUid: genData.actorUid || ''
            });

            if (saveResult && hasFinalContent && genData.oneTimeCue) {
                consumeFuraiOneTimeCue(
                    chatId,
                    genData.oneTimeCueRole || 'ai',
                    genData.oneTimeCueActorUid || genData.actorUid || '',
                    genData.oneTimeCueBotIndex ?? botIndex,
                    genData.oneTimeCue
                );
            }
        }
        delete ongoingGenerations[chatId];
        discardFuraiAutoVisualTriggersForChat(chatId);
        return; // <--- STOP. Do not render to current screen.
    }
    
    // 1. Capture scroll state before final DOM changes
    const isVnNow = document.body.classList.contains('vn-active');
    const shouldStickFinalToCr = !isVnNow && autoScroll;
    let shouldStickFinalToVn = false;

    if (isVnNow) {
        hideVnStatusHint('thinking');
    } else {
        hideCrBottomStatusPill('typing');
    }

    const timestampMeta = genData.timestampMeta || makeMessageTimestampMeta(chatId);
    const typingEl = document.getElementById(genData.typingId);
    if (isVnNow && typingEl && genData.vnLiveDetachedByUser !== true && (genData.vnLiveAttached === true || typingEl.dataset.vnLiveAttached === 'true')) {
        pinVnMessageElement(typingEl, { autoScroll: true });
    }

    const vnIsStillViewingTypingBubble = !!(
        isVnNow &&
        typingEl &&
        isVnViewingMessageElement(typingEl)
    );

    const vnSceneTargetWasTypingBubble = !!(
        isVnNow &&
        typingEl &&
        typeof isVnSceneTargetElement === 'function' &&
        isVnSceneTargetElement(typingEl)
    );

    const generationStayedOnVnLiveTarget = !!(
        typingEl &&
        genData.vnLiveDetachedByUser !== true &&
        (
            genData.vnLiveAttached === true ||
            typingEl.dataset.vnLiveAttached === 'true' ||
            vnIsStillViewingTypingBubble ||
            vnSceneTargetWasTypingBubble
        ) &&
        (!genData.vnLiveTargetTypingId || genData.vnLiveTargetTypingId === genData.typingId)
    );

    shouldStickFinalToVn = isVnNow && (
        typingEl
            ? generationStayedOnVnLiveTarget
            : shouldVnAutoFollowReply()
    );

    const effectiveInsertIndex = insertIndex !== null && insertIndex !== undefined
        ? insertIndex
        : (genData.insertIndex !== undefined ? genData.insertIndex : null);
    const finalInsertIndex = Number(effectiveInsertIndex);
    let finalMessageIndex = null;

    const replaceMessageUid = String(genData.replaceMessageUid || '').trim();
    const replacedDomTarget = replaceMessageUid
        ? findRenderedMessageByUid(replaceMessageUid)
        : null;

    let finalEmotion = String(typingEl?.dataset.vnAvatarEmotion || typingEl?.dataset.vnEmotion || '').trim();

    if (!finalEmotion) {
        try {
            const profile = getChatProfile(chatId);
            const bot = genData.actorProfile ||
                resolveFuraiActorByUid(profile, genData.actorUid, 'ai', parseInt(botIndex, 10)) ||
                profile?.bots?.[parseInt(botIndex, 10)];
            finalEmotion = detectBotEmotion(finalContent, bot) || '';
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    const finalMeta = {
        ...timestampMeta,
        emotion: finalEmotion,
        actorUid: genData.actorUid || '',
        actorProfile: genData.actorProfile || null,
        botUid: genData.actorUid || ''
    };
    
    // 2. SAVE DATA (Background)
    let saveResult = null;
    let savedMessage = null;

    if (shouldSaveMessage) {
        const saveMeta = replaceMessageUid
            ? { ...finalMeta, replaceMessageUid, addAsVariant: true }
            : finalMeta;

        saveResult = saveMessage(chatId, 'ai', finalContent, botIndex, effectiveInsertIndex, saveMeta);
    
        if (saveResult?.message) {
            savedMessage = saveResult.message;
        }

        if (Number.isInteger(saveResult?.index) && saveResult.index >= 0) {
            finalMessageIndex = saveResult.index;
        } else {
            try {
                const savedMessages = Array.isArray(saveResult?.chatData?.messages)
                    ? saveResult.chatData.messages
                    : null;
                const fallbackChatData = savedMessages ? null : DB.get(chatId);
                const messages = savedMessages || (
                    Array.isArray(fallbackChatData?.messages) ? fallbackChatData.messages : []
                );

                finalMessageIndex =
                    Number.isInteger(finalInsertIndex) && finalInsertIndex >= 0
                        ? finalInsertIndex
                        : messages.length - 1;

                if (!savedMessage && Number.isInteger(finalMessageIndex) && finalMessageIndex >= 0) {
                    savedMessage = messages[finalMessageIndex] || null;
                }
            } catch(e) {}
        }
       
        if (chatId === currentChatId) {
            isFirstUserMessage = false;
        }

        if (saveResult && hasFinalContent && genData.oneTimeCue) {
            consumeFuraiOneTimeCue(
                chatId,
                genData.oneTimeCueRole || 'ai',
                genData.oneTimeCueActorUid || genData.actorUid || '',
                genData.oneTimeCueBotIndex ?? botIndex,
                genData.oneTimeCue
            );
        }
    }

    // 3. BACKGROUND DOM MORPH (Silent)
    let finalRenderedMessageEl = null;

    if (autoVisualTrigger.imageOnly) {
        if (typingEl) {
            clearSmoothTypingIndicator(typingEl);
            typingEl.remove();
        }

        finalRenderedMessageEl = getFuraiLatestAutoImageAnchor(typingEl);
    } else if (typingEl) {
        clearSmoothTypingIndicator(typingEl);
        typingEl.removeAttribute('id');
    
        if (Number.isInteger(finalMessageIndex) && finalMessageIndex >= 0) {
            if (!replaceMessageUid && Number.isInteger(finalInsertIndex) && finalInsertIndex >= 0) {
                refreshVisibleMessageDomIndexes(finalMessageIndex - 1, 1);
            }
    
            typingEl.dataset.messageIndex = String(finalMessageIndex);
    
            try {
                const savedMsg = savedMessage || saveResult?.chatData?.messages?.[finalMessageIndex];

                if (savedMsg?.uid) typingEl.dataset.messageUid = savedMsg.uid;
                if (savedMsg?.botUid) typingEl.dataset.botUid = savedMsg.botUid;
                if (savedMsg?.emotion) typingEl.dataset.vnEmotion = savedMsg.emotion;
            } catch(e) {}
        }
    
        const contentEl = typingEl.querySelector('.content');

        if (finalMeta.createdAt) {
            typingEl.dataset.createdAt = finalMeta.createdAt;
        }

        if (finalMeta.emotion) {
            typingEl.dataset.vnEmotion = finalMeta.emotion;
        }

        if (contentEl) {
            clearFuraiMessageThinkingIndicator(contentEl);
            contentEl.classList.remove('typing');
            setFuraiLiveContentHtml(contentEl, formatMessageContent(finalContent));
        }

        typingEl.classList.remove('furai-active-ai-message');

        const staleControls = typingEl.querySelector('.message-controls');
        if (staleControls) staleControls.remove();

        if (isVnNow && shouldStickFinalToVn) {
            promoteVnLiveSceneTargetToFinalMessage(genData.typingId, typingEl);
            pinVnMessageElement(typingEl, { autoScroll: true });
        }

        const finalVisualRole = typingEl.dataset.announcementAgent === 'true'
            ? 'announcement'
            : typingEl.dataset.role === 'muted-note' || typingEl.classList.contains('muted-note')
                ? 'muted-note'
                : typingEl.dataset.role === 'cutscene' || typingEl.classList.contains('cutscene')
                    ? 'cutscene'
                    : '';

        if (finalVisualRole) {
            placeFuraiAnnouncementHeaderInsideBubble(
                typingEl,
                finalVisualRole,
                finalMeta.createdAt,
                typingEl.dataset.speakerName || ''
            );
        } else {
            appendTimestampToMessageHeader(
                typingEl.querySelector('.message-content-wrapper'),
                finalMeta.createdAt
            );
        }

        if (window.addMessageControls) window.addMessageControls(typingEl);
        finalRenderedMessageEl = typingEl;
        
        if (
            replacedDomTarget &&
            replacedDomTarget !== typingEl &&
            document.body.contains(replacedDomTarget)
        ) {
            replacedDomTarget.remove();
        }
        
    } else {
        finalRenderedMessageEl = addMessageDOM('ai', finalContent, botIndex, insertIndex, {
            ...finalMeta,
            mode: savedMessage?.mode || finalMeta?.mode || '',
            messageIndex: finalMessageIndex,
            messageUid: (() => {
                if (savedMessage?.uid) return savedMessage.uid;

                try {
                    return saveResult?.chatData?.messages?.[finalMessageIndex]?.uid ||
                        DB.get(chatId)?.messages?.[finalMessageIndex]?.uid || '';
                } catch(e) {
                    return '';
                }
            })()
        });
    }

    // 4. Final scroll / unread state
    if (document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) {
         syncVnData();

         const finalVnMessageEl =
             (typingEl && document.body.contains(typingEl))
                 ? typingEl
                 : getNewestFinishedVnMessageEl();

         let targetIdx = finalVnMessageEl ? getVnMessageIndex(finalVnMessageEl) : -1;
         if (targetIdx < 0) targetIdx = getLastReadableMessageIndex();

         if (shouldStickFinalToVn) {
             if (finalVnMessageEl) {
                 pinVnMessageElement(finalVnMessageEl, { autoScroll: true });
             } else {
                 vnAutoScroll = true;
                 vnCurrentIndex = targetIdx;
             }

             vnUserMovedAwayThisSession = false;
             clearVnFinishedUnreadState();
             clearVnLiveReplyState();
             hideVnStatusHint();
             renderVnMessage('bottom');
         } else {
             const finishedVnMessageEl = typingEl || getNewestFinishedVnMessageEl();

             vnAutoScroll = false;
             hideVnStatusHint('typing');

             showFinishedVnUnreadForMessage(finishedVnMessageEl);

             requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                 if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return;

                 showFinishedVnUnreadForMessage(finishedVnMessageEl);
             });
         }
    } else {
         const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');

         if (shouldStickFinalToCr) {
             autoScroll = true;
             hideCrBottomStatusPill();
             scrollElementToBottom(chatMessagesEl);

             requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                 scrollElementToBottom(chatMessagesEl, { respectUserBrake: true });
             });
         } else {
             autoScroll = false;
             hideCrBottomStatusPill('typing');
             showCrUnreadHint('New message');
         }
    }

    // 5. RESET STATE
    delete ongoingGenerations[chatId];
    isGenerating = false;
    currentAbortController = null;
    
    updateSendButtonUI();
    if (typeof updateEnhancerButton === 'function') updateEnhancerButton();
    if (typeof finalizeFuraiContextTrimNotice === 'function') finalizeFuraiContextTrimNotice();

    if (autoVisualTrigger.matched && finalRenderedMessageEl) {
        queueFuraiAutoVisualTrigger(autoVisualTrigger, finalRenderedMessageEl, chatId);
    }

    // [FIX] Reset Mobile Input Expansion State
    const input = document.getElementById('messageInputEl');
    if (input && input.value === '') {
        input.style.height = '';
        const container = document.querySelector('.chat-input-container');
        if(container) {
            container.classList.remove('input-expanded');
            container.classList.remove('input-tall');
        }
    }

    // --- ACC AUTO SUMMARY TRIGGER ---
    checkAndTriggerAutoSummary(chatId);

    // 6. PROCESS NEXT
    processGenerationQueue();
}

function getLocalStoryCastForPrompt(chatId = currentChatId, profileOverride = null) {
    const profile = profileOverride || getChatProfile(chatId);
    return Array.isArray(profile?.bots) ? profile.bots.slice(1).filter(Boolean) : [];
}

function splitStoryLoreForPrompt(text = '') {
    const raw = String(text || '').trim();
    if (!raw) {
        return {
            publicText: '',
            secretText: ''
        };
    }

    const secretMatches = Array.from(
        raw.matchAll(/\[SECRET\]([\s\S]*?)\[\/SECRET\]/gi)
    );

    const secretText = secretMatches
        .map(match => (match[1] || '').trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(' | ');

    const publicText = raw
        .replace(/\[SECRET\]([\s\S]*?)\[\/SECRET\]/gi, '')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim();

    return {
        publicText,
        secretText
    };
}

function splitStoryLoreForEditor(text = '') {
    const raw = String(text || '');

    const secretMatches = Array.from(
        raw.matchAll(/\[SECRET\]([\s\S]*?)\[\/SECRET\]/gi)
    );

    const secretText = secretMatches
        .map(match => (match[1] || '').trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join('\n\n');

    const publicText = raw
        .replace(/\[SECRET\]([\s\S]*?)\[\/SECRET\]/gi, '')
        .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
        .trim();

    return {
        publicText,
        secretText
    };
}

function joinStoryLoreFromEditor(publicText = '', secretText = '') {
    const publicPart = String(publicText || '').trim();
    const secretPart = String(secretText || '').trim();

    if (publicPart && secretPart) {
        return `${publicPart}\n\n[SECRET]\n${secretPart}\n[/SECRET]`;
    }

    if (secretPart) {
        return `[SECRET]\n${secretPart}\n[/SECRET]`;
    }

    return publicPart;
}

function getLocalStoryCast(chatId = currentChatId) {
    const profile = getChatProfile(chatId);
    if (!profile || !Array.isArray(profile.bots)) return [];
    return profile.bots.slice(1); // skip narrator at index 0
}

function buildStoryCastContextBlock(chatId = currentChatId, profileOverride = null) {
    const cast = getLocalStoryCastForPrompt(chatId, profileOverride);
    if (!cast.length) return '';

    const lines = [];

    cast.forEach((bot, idx) => {
        if (!bot) return;

        const contextMode = bot.storyContextMode || 'present';
        if (contextMode === 'offstage' || bot.silentNote === true) return;

        const name = (bot.name || `Role ${idx + 1}`).trim();
        const isAnnouncement = bot.chatStatus === 'announcement';

        // Story Mode keeps the shared roster status while using its own cast controls.
        // Announcement actors expose only their name to the Storyteller; Ghost actors
        // are omitted above. This prevents a mode switch from reintroducing profiles.
        if (isAnnouncement) {
            lines.push(`- Name: ${name} (Announcement)`);
            return;
        }

        const role = getStoryRoleLabel(bot);
        const note = (bot.storyRoleNote || '').trim();
        
        const parts = [
            `- Name: ${name}`,
            `Role: ${role}`,
            note ? `Role Note: ${note}` : ''
        ].filter(Boolean);

        if (contextMode === 'present') {
            const rawLore = bot.storySummary && bot.storySummary.trim()
                ? bot.storySummary.trim()
                : (getFuraiEffectiveCharacterInstruction(bot) || bot.description || '');

            const lore = splitStoryLoreForPrompt(rawLore);

            if (lore.publicText) {
                parts.push(`Public Profile: ${lore.publicText.slice(0, 260)}`);
            }

            if (lore.secretText) {
                parts.push(`Hidden Secret (storyteller-only): ${lore.secretText.slice(0, 220)}`);
            }
        }

        lines.push(parts.join(' | '));
    });

    return lines.length ? `[STORY CAST]\n${lines.join('\n')}` : '';
}

function shouldSkipAiContextMessageRole(role) {
    return role === 'muted-note' || role === 'cutscene';
}

function shouldSkipAiContextMessageEl(el) {
    return el?.classList?.contains('muted-note') || el?.classList?.contains('cutscene');
}

function isSilentGhostUser(profile) {
    return normalizeFuraiChatStatus(profile?.user?.chatStatus) === 'silent';
}

function shouldHideSilentGhostBotFromContext(bot, personality) {
    return (personality === 'group' || personality === 'maker') && getBotChatStatus(bot) === 'silent';
}

function getChatContextMessages(chatId, insertIndex = null) {
    let chatData = null;
    try { chatData = DB.get(chatId); } catch(e) {}

    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    let boundedMessages = messages;

    if (insertIndex !== null && insertIndex !== undefined && insertIndex !== '') {
        const targetIndex = Number(insertIndex);
        if (Number.isInteger(targetIndex) && targetIndex >= 0) {
            boundedMessages = messages.slice(0, Math.min(targetIndex, messages.length));
        }
    }

    return typeof getFuraiModeScopedMessages === 'function'
        ? getFuraiModeScopedMessages(chatData, boundedMessages, chatData?.personality)
        : boundedMessages.slice();
}

function getAiMessageContentText(msg) {
    const raw = String(msg?.content || '');
    if (!/[<&]/.test(raw)) return raw;

    const temp = document.createElement('div');
    temp.innerHTML = raw.replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
    return temp.innerText || temp.textContent || raw;
}

function getFuraiMessageFetchContext(msg) {
    if (!msg || shouldSkipAiContextMessageRole(msg.role)) return '';
    const context = String(msg.fetchContext || '').trim();
    return context ? `

${context}` : '';
}

function formatTimestampPrefixForMessageData(msg) {
    const stamp = formatMessageTimestampForAi(msg?.createdAt || '');
    return stamp ? `${stamp} ` : '';
}

function mapSoloContextMessage(msg, profile, botProfile) {
    if (!msg || shouldSkipAiContextMessageRole(msg.role)) return null;

    const ts = formatTimestampPrefixForMessageData(msg);
    const content = `${getAiMessageContentText(msg)}${getFuraiMessageFetchContext(msg)}`;
    const historicalActor = resolveFuraiActorForMessage(currentChatId, msg, profile);

    if (msg.role === 'user') return `${ts}${historicalActor?.name || msg.userNameSnapshot || profile.user.name}: ${content}`;
    if (msg.role === 'ai') return `${ts}${historicalActor?.name || msg.botNameSnapshot || botProfile.name}: ${content}`;
    if (isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(msg.role)) return `${ts}${content}`;
    if (msg.role === 'system') return `${ts}${content}`;

    return `${ts}${content}`;
}

function getGroupContextSpeakerName(msg, profile) {
    const actor = resolveFuraiActorForMessage(currentChatId, msg, profile);
    if (actor?.name) return actor.name;
    return msg?.botNameSnapshot || 'AI';
}

function mapGroupContextMessage(msg, profile) {
    if (!msg || shouldSkipAiContextMessageRole(msg.role)) return null;

    const ts = formatTimestampPrefixForMessageData(msg);
    const content = `${getAiMessageContentText(msg)}${getFuraiMessageFetchContext(msg)}`;

    if (msg.role === 'system') return `${ts}${content}`;
    if (msg.role === 'user') {
        const actor = resolveFuraiActorForMessage(currentChatId, msg, profile);
        return `${ts}${actor?.name || msg.userNameSnapshot || profile.user.name}: ${content}`;
    }
    if (msg.role === 'ai') return `${ts}${getGroupContextSpeakerName(msg, profile)}: ${content}`;
    if (isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(msg.role)) return `${ts}${content}`;

    return `${ts}${content}`;
}

function expandVisiblePromptSlashBeforeSend() {
    const inputEl = document.getElementById('messageInputEl');
    if (!inputEl) return false;

    const personality = chatPersonalities[currentChatId] || 'researcher';
    if (personality !== 'prompter') return false;

    const rawText = inputEl.value.trim();
    if (!rawText || !/(?:^|\s)\//.test(rawText)) return false;

    const modeData = processSlashCommands(rawText, 'prompter');
    const expandedText = (modeData && modeData.text ? modeData.text : rawText).trim();

    if (!expandedText || expandedText === rawText) return false;

    inputEl.value = expandedText;
    inputEl.focus();
    inputEl.setSelectionRange(expandedText.length, expandedText.length);
    inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));

    const suggestions = document.getElementById('mentionSuggestions');
    if (suggestions) suggestions.style.display = 'none';

    return true;
}

function furaiAfterPaint() {
    return new Promise(resolve => {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(resolve));
    });
}


function forceVnSubmittedUserTurnFocus(messageUid = '', messageIndex = null) {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return false;

    const uid = String(messageUid || '').trim();
    const numericIndex = Number(messageIndex);

    let messageEl = null;

    if (uid && typeof findRenderedMessageByUid === 'function') {
        messageEl = findRenderedMessageByUid(uid);
    }

    if (!messageEl && Number.isInteger(numericIndex) && numericIndex >= 0) {
        const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
        messageEl = Array.from(chatMessagesEl?.querySelectorAll('.message.user') || [])
            .find(el => Number(el.dataset.messageIndex) === numericIndex) || null;
    }

    if (!messageEl || !document.body.contains(messageEl) || !messageEl.classList.contains('user')) {
        return false;
    }

    if (typeof syncVnData === 'function') {
        syncVnData();
    }

    const messages = typeof getVnRenderableMessages === 'function'
        ? getVnRenderableMessages()
        : [];

    const targetIndex = messages.indexOf(messageEl);
    if (targetIndex === -1) return false;

    // This is a direct submit action. It beats old reading anchors and old
    // scene targets, but still leaves the new user bubble as the pending
    // turn anchor so the later thinking bubble cannot steal the camera.
    if (typeof clearVnPinnedMessageElement === 'function') clearVnPinnedMessageElement();
    if (typeof clearVnFinishedUnreadState === 'function') clearVnFinishedUnreadState();
    if (typeof clearVnLiveReplyState === 'function') clearVnLiveReplyState();

    vnAutoScroll = true;
    vnCurrentIndex = targetIndex;
    vnUserMovedAwayThisSession = false;
    window.vnDeferredNewMessage = false;

    if (typeof setVnSceneTargetFromElement === 'function') {
        setVnSceneTargetFromElement(messageEl, {
            autoScroll: true,
            userLocked: false
        });
    }

    if (typeof setVnPendingTurnAnchor === 'function') {
        setVnPendingTurnAnchor(messageEl);
    }

    if (typeof hideVnStatusHint === 'function') {
        hideVnStatusHint('thinking');
        hideVnStatusHint('typing');
        hideVnStatusHint('unread');
    }

    if (typeof renderVnMessage === 'function') {
        renderVnMessage('bottom');
    }

    return true;
}

async function sendMessage(options = {}) {
    const inputEl = document.getElementById('messageInputEl');
    const sourceChatId = currentChatId;
    const originalInput = String(inputEl?.value || '');
    const beforeMessageCount = (() => {
        try {
            const data = sourceChatId ? DB.get(sourceChatId) : null;
            return Array.isArray(data?.messages) ? data.messages.length : 0;
        } catch (e) {
            return 0;
        }
    })();

    try {
        return await sendMessageCore(options);
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Unexpected send failure:', error);
        hideFuraiRecallPreflightHint();

        if (furaiAiRequestPending) cancelFuraiAiRequestPreflight();
        if (isGenerating) {
            abortCurrentGeneration({
                preserveEmptyBubble: true,
                preserveInput: true
            });
        }

        const afterMessageCount = (() => {
            try {
                const data = sourceChatId ? DB.get(sourceChatId) : null;
                return Array.isArray(data?.messages) ? data.messages.length : 0;
            } catch (e) {
                return beforeMessageCount;
            }
        })();

        if (
            inputEl &&
            currentChatId === sourceChatId &&
            originalInput.trim() &&
            !inputEl.value.trim() &&
            afterMessageCount === beforeMessageCount
        ) {
            inputEl.value = originalInput;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
        }

        updateSendButtonUI();
        showToast?.('The send action recovered from an error. Please try again.', 'error');
        return null;
    } finally {
        if (furaiAiRequestPending && !isGenerating && !currentAbortController) {
            cancelFuraiAiRequestPreflight();
        }
    }
}

async function sendMessageCore(options = {}) {
    const isRegenerate = options.regenerate || false;
    let isNarrator = options.asNarrator || false;
    let announcementPingedUser = false;
    const isAutoReply = options.isAutoReply || false;
    const insertIndex = options.insertIndex !== undefined ? options.insertIndex : null;
    const forceBotIndex = options.forceBotIndex !== undefined ? options.forceBotIndex : null;
    const forceActorUid = String(options.forceActorUid || '').trim();
    const forceActorUids = normalizeFuraiQueuedActorUids(options.forceActorUids);
    const forceBroadcastMention = options.forceBroadcastMention === true;
    const inheritedChainVisitedActorUids = normalizeFuraiQueuedActorUids(options.chainVisitedActorUids);
    const replaceMessageUid = String(options.replaceMessageUid || '').trim();

    // One foreground AI request owns the conversation. User sends are blocked, never queued.
    if (isFuraiForegroundAiBusy()) return;

    let aiRequestToken = 0;
    if (isRegenerate || isAutoReply || forceBotIndex !== null) {
        aiRequestToken = beginFuraiAiRequestPreflight();
        if (!aiRequestToken) return;
    }
    
    // AI-to-AI mention chains are source-bound and actor-visited. This allows a
    // useful A → B → C handoff while preventing stale turns and A ↔ B ping-pong.
    const currentChainDepth = Math.max(0, Number(options.chainDepth) || 0);
    const MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH = FURAI_MAX_AUTO_MENTION_CHAIN_TURNS;
    let immediateAutoVisualQueued = false;

    // 1. UI & INPUT HANDLING
    if (!isRegenerate && forceBotIndex === null && !isAutoReply) {
        const messageInputEl = document.getElementById('messageInputEl');
        let userInput = messageInputEl.value.trim();
        const webImportOriginalInput = userInput;
        let webImportContext = '';
        
        if (!userInput) return; 

        // Announcement mode needs the chat's broadcast/mute setting. Normal user
        // messages deliberately defer the compressed chat read until after paint.
        let chatDataForMode = null;
        let isMutedMode = false;

        messageInputEl.value = '';
        messageInputEl.style.height = '';
        
        const container = document.querySelector('.chat-input-container');
        if (container) {
            container.classList.remove('input-expanded');
            container.classList.remove('input-tall'); 
        }

        updateEnhancerButton(); 
        if (currentChatId) delete chatDrafts[currentChatId];
        
        const thisChatId = currentChatId;
        const personality = chatPersonalities[thisChatId] || 'researcher';
        const selectedMentionActorUids = collectFuraiSelectedMentionActorUids(
            userInput,
            messageInputEl,
            getChatProfile(thisChatId)
        );

        const webImportResult = await prepareFuraiWebImportForSend(userInput, personality, thisChatId);
        if (webImportResult?.handled) {
            if (!webImportResult.ok) {
                if (currentChatId === thisChatId && messageInputEl) {
                    messageInputEl.value = webImportOriginalInput;
                    messageInputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
                }
                return;
            }
            userInput = webImportResult.text;
            webImportContext = String(webImportResult.context || '').trim();
        }

        const modeData = processSlashCommands(userInput, personality);
        userInput = modeData.text;

        const userVisualTrigger = resolveFuraiAutoVisualTrigger(userInput, personality);
        userInput = userVisualTrigger.text;

        if (userVisualTrigger.imageOnly) {
            const anchorEl = getFuraiLatestAutoImageAnchor();
            if (queueFuraiAutoVisualTrigger(userVisualTrigger, anchorEl, thisChatId)) {
                await processFuraiAutoVisualTriggerQueue({ resumeQueue: false });
            }
            processGenerationQueue();
            return;
        }

        if (isNarrator) {
            chatDataForMode = DB.get(thisChatId);
            isMutedMode = chatDataForMode && chatDataForMode.enhancerMuted === true;
            // New public announcements use the semantic role. Legacy 'narrator'
            // records remain readable and are never rewritten in place.
            const role = isMutedMode ? 'muted-note' : 'announcement';

            // Self-mentions in normal user messages never trigger User Auto Reply.
            // Announcements are the intentional way to ping the user's auto-reply profile.
            if (isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(role)) {
                announcementPingedUser = textMentionsUser(
                    userInput,
                    getChatProfile(thisChatId)
                );
            }
            
            const timestampMeta = makeMessageTimestampMeta(thisChatId);

            if (Array.isArray(chatDataForMode?.messages)) {
                timestampMeta.messageIndex = chatDataForMode.messages.length;
            }
            
            const wandProfile = getResolvedWandProfileForChat(thisChatId);
            const speakerName = isMutedMode
                ? (String(wandProfile?.name || '').trim() || DEFAULT_WAND_DISPLAY_NAME)
                : '';
            const saveMeta = {
                ...timestampMeta,
                speakerName,
                ...(isMutedMode ? { silentNoteSpeakerName: speakerName } : {}),
                mentionActorUids: selectedMentionActorUids,
                fetchContext: webImportContext
            };
            const saveResult = saveMessage(thisChatId, role, userInput, null, null, saveMeta);

            // saveMessage reports storage failures with null instead of throwing.
            // Stop here so a failed announcement never becomes an unsaved ghost bubble
            // and never triggers AI replies from data that was not committed.
            if (!saveResult) {
                hideFuraiRecallPreflightHint();

                if (currentChatId === thisChatId && messageInputEl) {
                    messageInputEl.value = userInput;
                    messageInputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
                }

                showToast?.('Could not save the announcement. Your text was restored.', 'error');
                return;
            }

            clearFuraiPendingMentionSelections(messageInputEl);

            const announcementMessageEl = addMessage(role, userInput, null, null, {
                ...saveMeta,
                messageIndex: saveResult?.index,
                messageUid: saveResult?.message?.uid || ''
            });

            if (userVisualTrigger.matched) {
                immediateAutoVisualQueued = queueFuraiAutoVisualTrigger(
                    userVisualTrigger,
                    announcementMessageEl,
                    thisChatId
                );
            }

            await furaiAfterPaint();
            
            if (role === 'muted-note') {
                if (immediateAutoVisualQueued) {
                    await processFuraiAutoVisualTriggerQueue({ resumeQueue: false });
                }
                return;
            }
        } else {
            // Render-first user send: paint the submitted bubble before compressing and
            // saving the long chat. Deep Memory bookkeeping happens after the user can
            // already see their response, removing the "dead click" feeling.
            const profileForUserStatus = getChatProfile(thisChatId);
            const userChatStatus = getUserChatStatus(profileForUserStatus);
            const userOutputRole = userChatStatus === 'silent' ? 'muted-note' : 'user';

            if (userOutputRole === 'user') {
                aiRequestToken = beginFuraiAiRequestPreflight();
                if (!aiRequestToken) {
                    messageInputEl.value = userInput;
                    messageInputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
                    return;
                }
            }

            const timestampMeta = makeMessageTimestampMeta(thisChatId);
            const submittedUserMessageUid = generateUID('msg');
            const userSpeakerName = profileForUserStatus?.user?.name || 'User';
            const saveMeta = {
                ...timestampMeta,
                messageUid: submittedUserMessageUid,
                speakerName: userSpeakerName,
                silentNoteSpeakerName: userSpeakerName,
                vnTurnBoundary: true,
                actorUid: profileForUserStatus?.user?.uid || '',
                actorProfile: profileForUserStatus?.user || null,
                userUid: profileForUserStatus?.user?.uid || '',
                mentionActorUids: selectedMentionActorUids,
                fetchContext: webImportContext
            };

            const optimisticMessageEl = addMessageDOM(userOutputRole, userInput, null, null, saveMeta);
            if (userOutputRole === 'user') forceVnSubmittedUserTurnFocus(submittedUserMessageUid);

            await furaiAfterPaint();
            if (userOutputRole === 'user') {
                forceVnSubmittedUserTurnFocus(submittedUserMessageUid);
            }

            const saveResult = saveMessage(thisChatId, userOutputRole, userInput, null, null, saveMeta);
            if (!saveResult) {
                hideFuraiRecallPreflightHint();
                finishFuraiAiRequestPreflight(aiRequestToken);
                optimisticMessageEl?.remove();
                messageInputEl.value = userInput;
                messageInputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
                showToast?.('Could not save the message. Your text was restored.', 'error');
                return;
            }

            clearFuraiPendingMentionSelections(messageInputEl);

            if (optimisticMessageEl) {
                optimisticMessageEl.dataset.messageIndex = String(saveResult.index);
                optimisticMessageEl.dataset.messageUid = submittedUserMessageUid;
                if (Number.isFinite(Number(saveResult.message?.sortKey))) {
                    optimisticMessageEl.dataset.sortKey = String(saveResult.message.sortKey);
                }
            }

            if (typeof queueFuraiContextMetaRender === 'function') queueFuraiContextMetaRender();

            if (userVisualTrigger.matched) {
                immediateAutoVisualQueued = queueFuraiAutoVisualTrigger(
                    userVisualTrigger,
                    optimisticMessageEl,
                    thisChatId
                );
            }

            if (userOutputRole === 'user') {
                forceVnSubmittedUserTurnFocus(submittedUserMessageUid, saveResult.index);
            }

            if (userOutputRole === 'muted-note') {
                if (immediateAutoVisualQueued) {
                    await processFuraiAutoVisualTriggerQueue({ resumeQueue: false });
                }
                hideFuraiRecallPreflightHint();
                return;
            }

            if (isFirstUserMessage) isFirstUserMessage = false;
        }
    }

    if (immediateAutoVisualQueued) {
        await processFuraiAutoVisualTriggerQueue({ resumeQueue: false });
    }

    // 2. FOREGROUND REQUEST OWNERSHIP
    if (!aiRequestToken) {
        aiRequestToken = beginFuraiAiRequestPreflight();
        if (!aiRequestToken) {
            hideFuraiRecallPreflightHint();
            return;
        }
    }

    // 3. AI GENERATION LOGIC
    const thisChatId = currentChatId;
    yieldFuraiDeepMemoryToForeground(thisChatId);

    const queuedSourceMessageUid = String(options.sourceMessageUid || '').trim();

    function getContextMessagesThroughMessageUid(messageUid = '') {
        const uid = String(messageUid || '').trim();
        if (!uid) return getChatContextMessages(thisChatId, insertIndex);

        try {
            const chatData = DB.get(thisChatId) || {};
            const messages = Array.isArray(chatData.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
            const sourceIndex = messages.findIndex(message => String(message?.uid || '') === uid);
            if (sourceIndex >= 0) {
                return getChatContextMessages(thisChatId, sourceIndex + 1);
            }
        } catch (error) {}

        return getChatContextMessages(thisChatId, insertIndex);
    }

    function getContextMessages() {
        return queuedSourceMessageUid
            ? getContextMessagesThroughMessageUid(queuedSourceMessageUid)
            : getChatContextMessages(thisChatId, insertIndex);
    }

    const personality = chatPersonalities[thisChatId];
    if (!isAutoReply) refreshFuraiTextPluginMeta();
    let referenceBlock = '';
    let godViewReferenceBlock = '';
    try {
        referenceBlock = await getResolvedReference(personality, {
            includeHiddenInstructions: personality === 'story'
        });
        godViewReferenceBlock = (personality === 'group' || personality === 'maker')
            ? await getResolvedReference(personality, { includeHiddenInstructions: true })
            : referenceBlock;
    } catch (error) {
        console.warn('Reference preflight failed; continuing without it.', error);
    }

    // --- GLOSSARY / MEMORY INJECTION ---
    let contextChatData = {};
    try { contextChatData = DB.get(thisChatId) || {}; } catch(e) {}
    const localGlossary = contextChatData.glossary || "";
    const globalGlossary = DB.get(`global_glossary_${personality}`) || "";
    const combinedGlossary = globalGlossary + "\n" + localGlossary;

    // CPU/Token Saver: Only scan the last 8 messages!
    const recentContextMsgs = getContextMessages()
        .filter(msg => !shouldSkipAiContextMessageRole(msg?.role))
        .slice(-8);
    
    const scanText = recentContextMsgs
        .map(getAiMessageContentText)
        .join('\n');

    let glossaryBlock = getGlossaryContext(scanText, combinedGlossary);
    const recentUserMessage = [...recentContextMsgs].reverse().find(message => message?.role === 'user');
    const deepCurrentText = getAiMessageContentText(recentUserMessage || recentContextMsgs[recentContextMsgs.length - 1]);
    const deepQueryText = buildFuraiDeepMemoryQueryText(
        deepCurrentText,
        recentContextMsgs.slice(-4).map(getAiMessageContentText).join('\n')
    );
    let deepMemoryBlock = '';
    scheduleFuraiRecallPreflightHint(thisChatId);
    try {
        deepMemoryBlock = await getFuraiDeepMemoryContextBlock(thisChatId, deepQueryText, contextChatData);
    } catch (error) {
        console.warn('Deep Memory preflight failed; continuing without recalled memories.', error);
    } finally {
        hideFuraiRecallPreflightHint();
    }

    if (!isFuraiAiRequestPreflightCurrent(aiRequestToken)) return;

    // --- NEW: TIMELESS FACTS INJECTION ---
    let timelessBlock = "";
    const authoritativeMemory = getFuraiAuthoritativeMemoryText(contextChatData);
    if (authoritativeMemory) {
        timelessBlock = `\n[TIMELESS FACTS & MEMORIES]\n${authoritativeMemory}\n`;
    }

    // Fit all real non-empty sections together after each complete prompt is known.
    resetFuraiContextTrimEvents();

    // =========================================================================
    // BRANCH A: SOLO MODES
    // =========================================================================
    if (chatPersonalities[thisChatId] !== 'group' && chatPersonalities[thisChatId] !== 'maker') {
        if (isNarrator) {
            finishFuraiAiRequestPreflight(aiRequestToken);
            return;
        }

        const requestController = promoteFuraiAiRequestPreflight(aiRequestToken);
        if (!requestController) return;

        const abortSignal = requestController.signal;

        abortSignal.addEventListener('abort', () => {
            if (ongoingGenerations[thisChatId]) {
                completeGeneration(
                    thisChatId, 
                    ongoingGenerations[thisChatId].responseText,
                    0, 
                    ongoingGenerations[thisChatId].insertIndex
                );
            }
        });

        const profile = getChatProfile(thisChatId);
        const sceneBoundaryIndex = Number.isInteger(Number(insertIndex))
            ? Number(insertIndex)
            : (DB.get(thisChatId)?.messages?.length || 0);
        const generationProfile = replaceMessageUid
            ? buildFuraiProfileAtBoundary(thisChatId, profile, sceneBoundaryIndex)
            : profile;
        const botProfile = (forceActorUid
            ? resolveFuraiActorByUid(profile, forceActorUid, 'ai', 0)
            : null) || generationProfile.bots?.[0] || profile.bots[0] || createFuraiModeFactoryBot(personality);
        const typingId = 'typing-' + Date.now();
        const timestampMeta = makeMessageTimestampMeta(thisChatId);
        const reservedInsertIndex = addTypingIndicator(
            typingId,
            0,
            insertIndex,
            replaceMessageUid,
            botProfile,
            timestampMeta.createdAt
        );
        
        ongoingGenerations[thisChatId] = {
            typingId,
            responseText: '',
            botIndex: 0,
            actorUid: botProfile.uid || forceActorUid || '',
            actorProfile: cloneFuraiData(botProfile),
            insertIndex: reservedInsertIndex,
            replaceMessageUid,
            timestampMeta
        };
        
        try {
            
            const userInstructions = generationProfile.user?.instructions || {};
            const userStatus = getUserChatStatus(generationProfile);
            const userPromptName = userStatus === 'silent'
                ? 'the hidden participant'
                : (generationProfile.user?.name || 'User');
            const modeSpecificInstruction = getFuraiContextInstructionForStatus(
                getFuraiEffectiveModeCharacterInstruction(generationProfile.user, personality),
                userStatus
            );
            
            let userContextBlock = '';
            if (userStatus !== 'silent') {
                userContextBlock = `
<participant_profile role="USER">
    <name>${generationProfile.user?.name || 'User'}</name>
    ${modeSpecificInstruction ? `<description>
    ${modeSpecificInstruction}
    </description>` : ''}
    <instruction_for_ai>
    This data describes your conversation partner.
    Use it to understand them, but NEVER adopt these traits for yourself.
    </instruction_for_ai>
</participant_profile>`;
            }

            let aiContextBlock = `
<participant_profile role="ASSISTANT">
    <name>${botProfile.name}</name>
    <core_identity>
    ${getFuraiEffectiveCharacterInstruction(botProfile)}
    </core_identity>
    <strict_command>
    You are ${botProfile.name}. You are NOT ${userPromptName}.
    Maintain your own identity defined in <core_identity> at all times.
    </strict_command>
</participant_profile>`;
          
            let storyCastBlock = personality === 'story'
                ? `\n${buildStoryCastContextBlock(thisChatId, generationProfile)}\n`
                : '';


            // =====================================================================
            // SOLO/GROUP SCOPE FIREWALL — DO NOT COPY GROUP RESPONDER LOCALS HERE
            // =====================================================================
            // This branch runs for Story, Research, Prompt, and other solo modes.
            // `responderBot`, `responders`, and `responderCursor` are created only
            // later inside the Group Chat branch and DO NOT exist here.
            //
            // A previous AI edit copied Group Chat source-message logic into this
            // solo branch and referenced `responderBot.__furaiSourceMessageUid`.
            // JavaScript still parsed, but every solo reply then threw a runtime
            // ReferenceError before generateText() was reached. The generic error
            // bubble/toast only exposed that failure; it was not the root cause.
            //
            // NEVER reference Group Chat loop variables from the solo branch.
            // getContextMessages() already honors queuedSourceMessageUid safely.
            const allContextMsgs = getContextMessages();
            const cData = DB.get(thisChatId) || {};
            const lastSummarizedIndex = getFuraiSummaryAnchorIndex(cData, allContextMsgs);
            let historyPrefix = lastSummarizedIndex >= 0 ? getFuraiSummaryPrefix(cData) : '';
            let startIndex = Math.min(allContextMsgs.length, lastSummarizedIndex + 1);
            const fullSoloContextMsgs = allContextMsgs.filter(msg => !shouldSkipAiContextMessageRole(msg?.role));
            let soloContextMsgs = allContextMsgs.slice(startIndex).filter(msg => !shouldSkipAiContextMessageRole(msg?.role));
            let mappedSoloMsgs = soloContextMsgs.map(msg => mapSoloContextMessage(msg, generationProfile, botProfile)).filter(Boolean);

            const effectiveMemoText = getFuraiEffectiveMemoText(cData, personality);
            let memoInstruction = effectiveMemoText ? `\n[CURRENT OBJECTIVE]\n${effectiveMemoText}\n` : '';
            const activeCueText = readFuraiOneTimeCue(profile, 'ai', botProfile.uid, 0);
            const tempCueInstruction = activeCueText
                ? `\n[OOC INSTRUCTION]\nFollow this command for this reply:\n"${activeCueText}"\n`
                : '';

            const contextEntries = [
                { key: 'reference', section: 'lorebook', label: 'Lorebook', text: ['announcement', 'silent'].includes(getBotChatStatus(botProfile)) ? godViewReferenceBlock : referenceBlock },
                { key: 'glossary', section: 'glossary', label: 'Glossary', text: glossaryBlock },
                { key: 'facts', section: 'facts', label: 'Timeless Facts', text: timelessBlock },
                { key: 'deepMemory', section: 'deepMemory', label: 'Deep Memory', text: deepMemoryBlock },
                { key: 'identity', section: 'primaryCharacter', label: `${botProfile.name || 'Assistant'} Identity`, text: aiContextBlock },
                { key: 'user', section: 'userProfile', label: 'User Profile', text: userContextBlock },
                { key: 'cast', section: 'storyCast', label: 'Story Cast', text: storyCastBlock },
                { key: 'summary', section: 'summary', label: 'Story Summary', text: historyPrefix, keepTail: true },
                { key: 'memo', section: 'memo', label: 'Memo', text: memoInstruction },
                { key: 'cue', section: 'cue', label: 'One-Time Cue', text: tempCueInstruction }
            ];
            const makePromptWithoutHistory = fitted => `
[SCENARIO CONFIGURATION]
The following is a conversation between two distinct entities:
1. ${userPromptName} (The User)
2. ${botProfile.name} (The Assistant/You)

${fitted.user}

${fitted.identity}
${fitted.cast}

${fitted.reference}${fitted.glossary}${fitted.facts}${fitted.deepMemory}${fitted.memo}${fitted.cue}

[TRANSCRIPT]

[RESPONSE]
Generate the next response for ${botProfile.name}:`;

            let fittedContext = fitFuraiContextSections(contextEntries);
            let promptWithoutHistory = makePromptWithoutHistory(fittedContext);
            if (historyPrefix) {
                const fullMapped = fullSoloContextMsgs.map(msg => mapSoloContextMessage(msg, generationProfile, botProfile)).filter(Boolean);
                const noSummaryContext = fitFuraiContextSections(contextEntries.map(entry => entry.key === 'summary' ? { ...entry, text: '' } : entry));
                const noSummaryPrompt = makePromptWithoutHistory(noSummaryContext);
                if (canFuraiHistoryFitWithoutSummary(fullMapped, noSummaryPrompt)) {
                    historyPrefix = '';
                    fittedContext = noSummaryContext;
                    promptWithoutHistory = noSummaryPrompt;
                }
                startIndex = 0;
                soloContextMsgs = fullSoloContextMsgs;
                mappedSoloMsgs = fullMapped;
            }

            const historyText = buildFuraiBudgetedHistory(mappedSoloMsgs, fittedContext.summary, promptWithoutHistory, {
                chatId: thisChatId,
                baseStartIndex: startIndex,
                summaryAnchorIndex: historyPrefix ? lastSummarizedIndex : -1,
                totalMessages: allContextMsgs.length,
                sourceMessages: soloContextMsgs
            });
            const finalInstruction = promptWithoutHistory.replace('[TRANSCRIPT]\n\n[RESPONSE]', `[TRANSCRIPT]\n${historyText}\n\n[RESPONSE]`);

            let responseText = ''; 
            const aiResponse = await generateText({
                instruction: finalInstruction,
                onChunk: (data) => {
                    if (abortSignal.aborted) return;
                    let chunk = data.textChunk;
                    if (responseText === '') chunk = chunk.trimStart(); 
                    if (chunk === '') return;

                    responseText += chunk;
                    const visibleResponseText = stripAiTranscriptPrefix(
                        responseText,
                        botProfile.name || ''
                    );
                    if(ongoingGenerations[thisChatId]) ongoingGenerations[thisChatId].responseText = visibleResponseText;
                    if (currentChatId === thisChatId) queueSmoothTypingIndicator(typingId, visibleResponseText, true);
                },
                signal: abortSignal
            });
            if (!abortSignal.aborted) {
                const genData = ongoingGenerations[thisChatId];

                if (genData) {
                    genData.responseText = aiResponse.trim();
                    genData.botIndex = 0;
                    genData.insertIndex = genData.insertIndex ?? insertIndex;
                    genData.oneTimeCue = activeCueText;
                    genData.oneTimeCueRole = 'ai';
                    genData.oneTimeCueActorUid = botProfile.uid || '';
                    genData.oneTimeCueBotIndex = 0;

                    const liveTypingEl = document.getElementById(genData.typingId);
                    if (
                        document.body.classList.contains('vn-active') &&
                        liveTypingEl &&
                        genData.vnLiveDetachedByUser !== true
                    ) {
                        genData.vnLiveAttached = true;
                        genData.vnLiveTargetTypingId = genData.typingId;
                        liveTypingEl.dataset.vnLiveAttached = 'true';
                    }

                    // Normal success now exits through the same finalization path as the Stop button.
                    // The visible live bubble is marked attached first, because Stop works by preserving
                    // the current bubble instead of re-deciding camera state after the full save.
                    abortCurrentGeneration({
                        preserveEmptyBubble: true,
                        preserveQueue: true,
                        preserveInput: true
                    });
                } else {
                    completeGeneration(thisChatId, aiResponse.trim(), 0, insertIndex);
                }
            }
        } catch (error) {
            if (error.name !== 'AbortError') {
                console.error('Error generating response:', error);

                // APPLICATION ERROR ONLY. Never turn catch text into character dialogue.
                // failFuraiGeneration() removes the unfinished bubble without saving it.
                failFuraiGeneration(thisChatId, error, {
                    continueQueue: true
                });
            }
        }
        return;
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // BRANCH B: GROUP CHAT MODE
    // =========================================================================
    const requestController = promoteFuraiAiRequestPreflight(aiRequestToken);
    if (!requestController) return;

    const abortSignal = requestController.signal;

    abortSignal.addEventListener('abort', () => {
        if (ongoingGenerations[thisChatId]) {
            completeGeneration(
                thisChatId, 
                ongoingGenerations[thisChatId].responseText, 
                ongoingGenerations[thisChatId].botIndex, 
                ongoingGenerations[thisChatId].insertIndex
            );
        } else {
            isGenerating = false;
            currentAbortController = null;
            updateSendButtonUI();
            processGenerationQueue(); 
        }
    });

    const profile = getChatProfile(thisChatId);
    const sceneBoundaryIndex = Number.isInteger(Number(insertIndex))
        ? Number(insertIndex)
        : (DB.get(thisChatId)?.messages?.length || 0);
    const generationProfile = replaceMessageUid
        ? buildFuraiProfileAtBoundary(thisChatId, profile, sceneBoundaryIndex)
        : profile;
    const orchestrator = groupChatOrchestrator();
    let responders = [];
    
    let lastMsg = null;
    let lastMsgText = '';
    const contextMsgs = getContextMessages();
    if (contextMsgs.length > 0) {
        lastMsg = contextMsgs[contextMsgs.length - 1];
        lastMsgText = getAiMessageContentText(lastMsg);
    }

    const mentionMatches = orchestrator.parseMentionMatches(
        lastMsgText,
        profile.bots,
        lastMsg?.mentionActorUids
    );
    const selectionSourceMessageUid = String(lastMsg?.uid || queuedSourceMessageUid || '').trim();
    const mentions = mentionMatches.map(entry => entry.name);
    const mentionMap = new Set(mentions);
    const directMentionMatches = mentionMatches.filter(entry => entry.kind === 'bot');
    const directMentionUids = normalizeFuraiQueuedActorUids(
        directMentionMatches.map(entry => entry.uid)
    );
    const directMentionUidSet = new Set(directMentionUids);
    const hasDirectBotMention = directMentionUids.length > 0;
    
    const availableBots = profile.bots.filter(b => {
        if (!b.inActiveCast || getBotChatStatus(b) === 'idle') return false;
        if (b.replyMode === 'mute') return false;

        const uid = String(b.uid || '');

        if (forceBroadcastMention && inheritedChainVisitedActorUids.includes(uid)) {
            return false;
        }
    
        if (hasDirectBotMention) {
            return directMentionUidSet.has(uid) || b.replyMode === 'always';
        }
    
        if (b.replyMode === 'mention') {
            return mentionMap.has(b.name) || mentionMap.has('everyone') || mentionMap.has('all');
        }
    
        return true;
    });

    const availableByUid = new Map(
        availableBots.map(bot => [String(bot.uid || ''), bot])
    );
    const explicitMentionBots = directMentionUids
        .map(uid => availableByUid.get(uid))
        .filter(Boolean);
    const explicitMentionUidSet = new Set(
        explicitMentionBots.map(bot => String(bot.uid || ''))
    );

    const userMessage = {
        text: lastMsgText,
        mentions,
        mentionUids: explicitMentionUidSet,
        orderedMentionUids: directMentionUids
    };

    const dedupeResponders = list => {
        const seen = new Set();
        const out = [];

        for (const bot of Array.isArray(list) ? list : []) {
            if (!bot) continue;
            const uid = String(bot.uid || '');
            const key = uid || `name:${String(bot.name || '')}`;
            if (!key || seen.has(key)) continue;
            seen.add(key);
            out.push(bot);
        }

        return out;
    };

    if (forceActorUids.length > 0) {
        const forced = forceActorUids
            .map(uid => availableByUid.get(uid))
            .filter(Boolean);
        const forcedUidSet = new Set(forced.map(bot => String(bot.uid || '')));
        const alwaysFollowers = availableBots.filter(bot =>
            bot.replyMode === 'always' && !forcedUidSet.has(String(bot.uid || ''))
        );

        responders = [
            ...forced.map(bot => ({
                ...bot,
                __furaiExplicitMention: true,
                __furaiSourceMessageUid: selectionSourceMessageUid
            })),
            ...alwaysFollowers
        ];
    } else if (forceBotIndex !== null) {
        const laneIndex = Number.parseInt(forceBotIndex, 10);
        const historicalPrimary = forceActorUid
            ? resolveFuraiActorByUid(profile, forceActorUid, 'ai', laneIndex)
            : null;
        const primary = historicalPrimary || profile.bots[laneIndex];
        if (primary && (historicalPrimary || (primary.inActiveCast && getBotChatStatus(primary) !== 'idle'))) {
            const forcedPrimary = {
                ...cloneFuraiData(primary),
                __furaiLaneIndex: laneIndex,
                __furaiExplicitMention: true
            };
            // Regeneration replaces exactly one historical bubble. Additional active-cast
            // replies would contaminate the old insertion point with the present-day cast.
            const additional = replaceMessageUid
                ? []
                : orchestrator.chooseAdditionalResponders(
                    availableBots.filter(bot => String(bot?.uid || '') !== String(forcedPrimary.uid || '')),
                    forcedPrimary,
                    userMessage
                );
            responders = [forcedPrimary, ...additional];
        }
    } else if (isNarrator) {
        const mentionedBots = explicitMentionBots.map(bot => ({
            ...bot,
            __furaiExplicitMention: true,
            __furaiSourceMessageUid: selectionSourceMessageUid
        }));
        const otherBots = availableBots.filter(ai => !explicitMentionUidSet.has(String(ai.uid || '')));
        const additional = orchestrator.chooseAdditionalResponders(otherBots, { name: null, uid: '' }, userMessage);
        responders = [...mentionedBots, ...additional];
    } else {
        const primary = explicitMentionBots[0] || orchestrator.choosePrimaryResponder(availableBots, userMessage);

        if (primary) {
            const primaryUid = String(primary.uid || '');
            const explicitFollowers = explicitMentionBots
                .filter(ai => String(ai.uid || '') !== primaryUid)
                .map(bot => ({
                    ...bot,
                    __furaiExplicitMention: true,
                    __furaiSourceMessageUid: selectionSourceMessageUid
                }));
            const leftoverBots = availableBots.filter(ai => {
                const uid = String(ai.uid || '');
                return uid !== primaryUid && !explicitMentionUidSet.has(uid);
            });
            const rngFollowers = orchestrator.chooseAdditionalResponders(leftoverBots, primary, userMessage);
            const markedPrimary = explicitMentionUidSet.has(primaryUid)
                ? {
                    ...primary,
                    __furaiExplicitMention: true,
                    __furaiSourceMessageUid: selectionSourceMessageUid
                }
                : primary;

            responders = [markedPrimary, ...explicitFollowers, ...rngFollowers];
        }
    }

    responders = dedupeResponders(responders);

    const hasAlwaysBot = responders.some(r => {
        if (r.replyMode === 'always') return true;
        if (!r.replyMode) return getGlobalCastMode() === 'always';
        return false;
    });
    const normalBatchLimit = hasAlwaysBot ? 6 : orchestrator.BASE_MAX_REPLIES;
    const explicitResponders = responders
        .filter(bot => bot.__furaiExplicitMention === true)
        .slice(0, FURAI_MAX_EXPLICIT_MENTION_REPLIES);
    const nonExplicitResponders = responders.filter(bot => bot.__furaiExplicitMention !== true);
    const batchLimit = Math.min(
        FURAI_MAX_EXPLICIT_MENTION_REPLIES,
        Math.max(normalBatchLimit, explicitResponders.length)
    );

    // Deliberate named pings are never displaced by random/Open/Always extras.
    // @all/@everyone remains bounded by the normal anti-flood batch size.
    responders = [
        ...explicitResponders,
        ...nonExplicitResponders.slice(0, Math.max(0, batchLimit - explicitResponders.length))
    ];

    if (responders.length === 0) {
        isGenerating = false;
        currentAbortController = null;
        updateSendButtonUI();
        maybeQueueUserAutoReplyAfterGroupTurn(currentChainDepth + 1, {
            forcePing: announcementPingedUser
        });
        processGenerationQueue();
        return;
    }

    let currentInsertIndex = insertIndex;
    let replaceMessageUidForNext = replaceMessageUid;
    const scheduledResponderUids = new Set(
        responders.map(bot => String(bot?.uid || '')).filter(Boolean)
    );
    const chainVisitedActorUidSet = new Set(inheritedChainVisitedActorUids);
    const queuedChainTargetUids = new Set();
    const pendingChainTasks = [];
    let inBatchHandoffCount = 0;
