    for (let responderCursor = 0; responderCursor < responders.length; responderCursor++) {
        const responderBot = responders[responderCursor];
        let botIndex = Number.isInteger(Number(responderBot.__furaiLaneIndex))
            ? Number(responderBot.__furaiLaneIndex)
            : -1;
        if (botIndex < 0 && responderBot.uid) {
            botIndex = profile.bots.findIndex(b => b.uid === responderBot.uid);
        } else if (botIndex < 0) {
            botIndex = profile.bots.indexOf(responderBot);
        }
        if (botIndex === -1 || abortSignal.aborted) continue;

        const typingId = 'typing-' + Date.now() + '-' + botIndex;
        const timestampMeta = makeMessageTimestampMeta(thisChatId);
        const reservedInsertIndex = addTypingIndicator(
            typingId,
            botIndex,
            currentInsertIndex,
            replaceMessageUidForNext,
            responderBot,
            timestampMeta.createdAt
        );
        const generationInsertIndex = currentInsertIndex !== null && currentInsertIndex !== undefined
            ? currentInsertIndex
            : reservedInsertIndex;
        
        ongoingGenerations[thisChatId] = {
            typingId,
            responseText: '',
            botIndex,
            actorUid: responderBot.uid || '',
            actorProfile: cloneFuraiData(responderBot),
            insertIndex: generationInsertIndex,
            replaceMessageUid: replaceMessageUidForNext,
            timestampMeta
        };

        try {
            const allContextMsgs = getContextMessages();
            const cData = DB.get(thisChatId) || {};
            const lastSummarizedIndex = getFuraiSummaryAnchorIndex(cData, allContextMsgs);
            let historyPrefix = lastSummarizedIndex >= 0 ? getFuraiSummaryPrefix(cData) : '';
            let startIndex = Math.min(allContextMsgs.length, lastSummarizedIndex + 1);
            const fullGroupContextMsgs = allContextMsgs.filter(msg => !shouldSkipAiContextMessageRole(msg?.role));
            let groupContextMsgs = allContextMsgs.slice(startIndex).filter(msg => !shouldSkipAiContextMessageRole(msg?.role));
            let mappedGroupMsgs = groupContextMsgs.map(msg => mapGroupContextMessage(msg, generationProfile)).filter(Boolean);

            const responderStatus = getBotChatStatus(responderBot);
            const responderReferenceBlock = responderStatus === 'announcement' || responderStatus === 'silent'
                ? godViewReferenceBlock
                : referenceBlock;

            const castKnowledge = generationProfile.bots
                .filter(b => b.inActiveCast && b.uid !== responderBot.uid && b !== responderBot)
                .map(b => getFuraiCastKnowledgeLine(b, personality))
                .filter(Boolean)
                .join('\n');

            const userStatus = getUserChatStatus(generationProfile);
            const userInstructions = generationProfile.user?.instructions || {};
            const modeSpecificInstruction = getFuraiContextInstructionForStatus(
                getFuraiEffectiveModeCharacterInstruction(generationProfile.user, personality),
                userStatus
            );
            const visibleUserName = generationProfile.user?.name || 'User';
            const userInstructionString = userStatus !== 'silent'
                ? `User Info: The user is named '${visibleUserName}'.${modeSpecificInstruction ? ` Bio: "${modeSpecificInstruction}".` : ''}\n\n`
                : '';
            const participantNames = [
                ...generationProfile.bots
                    .filter(b => b.inActiveCast)
                    .map(b => getFuraiParticipantLabel(b.name, getBotChatStatus(b)))
                    .filter(Boolean),
                ...(userStatus === 'silent'
                    ? []
                    : [getFuraiParticipantLabel(visibleUserName, userStatus)])
            ].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
            const effectiveMemoText = getFuraiEffectiveMemoText(cData, personality);
            const memoInstruction = effectiveMemoText ? `\n[DIRECTOR'S MEMO (Current Goal)]\n${effectiveMemoText}\n` : '';
            const activeCueText = readFuraiOneTimeCue(
                profile,
                'ai',
                responderBot.uid || '',
                botIndex
            );

            const contextEntries = [
                { key: 'reference', section: 'lorebook', label: 'Lorebook', text: responderReferenceBlock },
                { key: 'glossary', section: 'glossary', label: 'Glossary', text: glossaryBlock },
                { key: 'facts', section: 'facts', label: 'Timeless Facts', text: timelessBlock },
                { key: 'deepMemory', section: 'deepMemory', label: 'Deep Memory', text: deepMemoryBlock },
                { key: 'identity', section: 'primaryCharacter', label: `${responderBot.name || 'Responder'} Identity`, text: getFuraiEffectiveCharacterInstruction(responderBot) },
                { key: 'user', section: 'userProfile', label: 'User Profile', text: userInstructionString },
                { key: 'cast', section: 'castKnowledge', label: 'Cast Knowledge', text: castKnowledge },
                { key: 'summary', section: 'summary', label: 'Story Summary', text: historyPrefix, keepTail: true },
                { key: 'memo', section: 'memo', label: 'Memo', text: memoInstruction },
                { key: 'cue', section: 'cue', label: 'One-Time Cue', text: activeCueText }
            ];
            const makePromptWithoutHistory = fitted => `${fitted.user}You are ${responderBot.name}.
[YOUR IDENTITY]
${fitted.identity}

[CAST KNOWLEDGE (What you know about others)]
${fitted.cast}

[SCENE CONTEXT]
Participants: ${participantNames || responderBot.name || 'Character'}.
Mention syntax: @Name.
${fitted.reference}${fitted.glossary}${fitted.facts}${fitted.deepMemory}${fitted.memo}

[SYSTEM RULES]
- If a dice result appears, react to the result.

Respond to the last message based on the history:

${fitted.cue ? `\n[OOC INSTRUCTION FOR ${responderBot.name}]\nFollow this command for this reply:\n"${fitted.cue}"` : ''}

  Your response (as ${responderBot.name}, no prefix):`;

            let fittedContext = fitFuraiContextSections(contextEntries);
            let promptWithoutHistory = makePromptWithoutHistory(fittedContext);
            if (historyPrefix) {
                const fullMapped = fullGroupContextMsgs.map(msg => mapGroupContextMessage(msg, generationProfile)).filter(Boolean);
                const noSummaryContext = fitFuraiContextSections(contextEntries.map(entry => entry.key === 'summary' ? { ...entry, text: '' } : entry));
                const noSummaryPrompt = makePromptWithoutHistory(noSummaryContext);
                if (canFuraiHistoryFitWithoutSummary(fullMapped, noSummaryPrompt)) {
                    historyPrefix = '';
                    fittedContext = noSummaryContext;
                    promptWithoutHistory = noSummaryPrompt;
                }
                startIndex = 0;
                groupContextMsgs = fullGroupContextMsgs;
                mappedGroupMsgs = fullMapped;
            }

            const history = buildFuraiBudgetedHistory(mappedGroupMsgs, fittedContext.summary, promptWithoutHistory, {
                chatId: thisChatId,
                baseStartIndex: startIndex,
                summaryAnchorIndex: historyPrefix ? lastSummarizedIndex : -1,
                totalMessages: allContextMsgs.length,
                sourceMessages: groupContextMsgs
            });
            const instruction = promptWithoutHistory.replace('Respond to the last message based on the history:\n\n', `Respond to the last message based on the history:\n${history}\n`);
    
            let responseText = '';
            const finalContent = await generateText({
                instruction,
                onChunk: (data) => {
                    if (abortSignal.aborted) return;
                    let chunk = data.textChunk;
                    if (responseText === '') chunk = chunk.trimStart();
                    if (chunk === '') return;
                    responseText += chunk;
                    const visibleResponseText = stripAiTranscriptPrefix(
                        responseText,
                        responderBot.name || ''
                    );
                    if (ongoingGenerations[thisChatId]) ongoingGenerations[thisChatId].responseText = visibleResponseText;
                    queueSmoothTypingIndicator(typingId, visibleResponseText, true);
                },
                signal: abortSignal
            });
            
            if (!abortSignal.aborted) {
                const trimmedFinalContent = stripAiTranscriptPrefix(
                    finalContent,
                    responderBot.name || ''
                ).trim();
                const timestampMeta = ongoingGenerations[thisChatId]?.timestampMeta || makeMessageTimestampMeta(thisChatId);
                const currentReplaceUid = String(replaceMessageUidForNext || '').trim();

                const responseRole = responderStatus === 'silent' ? 'muted-note' : 'ai';
                const responseVisualTrigger = resolveFuraiAutoVisualTrigger(trimmedFinalContent, personality);
                const responseContent = responseVisualTrigger.text;
                const responseBotIndex = botIndex;
                const saveMetaBase = {
                    ...timestampMeta,
                    speakerName: responderBot.name || 'AI',
                    silentNoteSpeakerName: responderBot.name || 'AI',
                    actorUid: responderBot.uid || '',
                    actorProfile: cloneFuraiData(responderBot),
                    botUid: responderBot.uid || '',
                    announcementAgent: responderStatus === 'announcement'
                };

                if (responseVisualTrigger.imageOnly) {
                    removeTypingIndicator(typingId);
                    delete ongoingGenerations[thisChatId];

                    const anchorEl = getFuraiLatestAutoImageAnchor();
                    if (queueFuraiAutoVisualTrigger(responseVisualTrigger, anchorEl, thisChatId)) {
                        await processFuraiAutoVisualTriggerQueue({ allowWhileGenerating: true, resumeQueue: false });
                    }

                    replaceMessageUidForNext = '';
                    continue;
                }

                if (responseRole === 'muted-note') {
                    const saveMeta = currentReplaceUid
                        ? { ...saveMetaBase, replaceMessageUid: currentReplaceUid }
                        : saveMetaBase;
                    const saveResult = saveMessage(
                        thisChatId,
                        responseRole,
                        responseContent,
                        responseBotIndex,
                        generationInsertIndex,
                        saveMeta
                    );

                    const noteEl = document.getElementById(typingId);
                    const replacedTargetEl = currentReplaceUid && typeof findRenderedMessageByUid === 'function'
                        ? findRenderedMessageByUid(currentReplaceUid)
                        : null;
                    let finalNoteEl = null;

                    if (noteEl && typeof updateRenderedMessageFromSave === 'function') {
                        const shouldStickFinalToVn = typeof shouldVnKeepMorphedTypingBubble === 'function'
                            ? shouldVnKeepMorphedTypingBubble(noteEl)
                            : false;

                        updateRenderedMessageFromSave(
                            noteEl,
                            responseRole,
                            responseContent,
                            responseBotIndex,
                            saveResult?.message || null,
                            saveResult?.index,
                            saveMeta
                        );

                        if (
                            replacedTargetEl &&
                            replacedTargetEl !== noteEl &&
                            document.body.contains(replacedTargetEl)
                        ) {
                            replacedTargetEl.remove();
                        }

                        if (typeof finalizeVnMorphedTypingBubble === 'function') {
                            finalizeVnMorphedTypingBubble(noteEl, {
                                liveId: typingId,
                                shouldStick: shouldStickFinalToVn,
                                unreadLabel: 'New message'
                            });
                        }

                        finalNoteEl = noteEl;
                    } else {
                        removeTypingIndicator(typingId);

                        if (currentReplaceUid) {
                            const targetEl = typeof findRenderedMessageByUid === 'function'
                                ? findRenderedMessageByUid(currentReplaceUid)
                                : null;

                            if (targetEl && typeof updateRenderedMessageFromSave === 'function') {
                                updateRenderedMessageFromSave(
                                    targetEl,
                                    responseRole,
                                    responseContent,
                                    responseBotIndex,
                                    saveResult?.message || null,
                                    saveResult?.index,
                                    saveMeta
                                );
                                finalNoteEl = targetEl;
                            } else {
                                finalNoteEl = addMessage(responseRole, responseContent, responseBotIndex, null, {
                                    ...saveMetaBase,
                                    messageIndex: saveResult?.index,
                                    messageUid: saveResult?.message?.uid || currentReplaceUid
                                });
                            }
                        } else {
                            finalNoteEl = addMessage(responseRole, responseContent, responseBotIndex, generationInsertIndex, {
                                ...saveMetaBase,
                                messageIndex: saveResult?.index,
                                messageUid: saveResult?.message?.uid || ''
                            });
                        }
                    }

                    delete ongoingGenerations[thisChatId];

                    if (saveResult && responseContent.trim() && activeCueText) {
                        consumeFuraiOneTimeCue(
                            thisChatId,
                            'ai',
                            responderBot.uid || '',
                            responseBotIndex,
                            activeCueText
                        );
                    }

                    if (
                        responseVisualTrigger.matched &&
                        finalNoteEl &&
                        queueFuraiAutoVisualTrigger(responseVisualTrigger, finalNoteEl, thisChatId)
                    ) {
                        await processFuraiAutoVisualTriggerQueue({ allowWhileGenerating: true, resumeQueue: false });
                    }

                    replaceMessageUidForNext = '';
                    continue;
                }

                const saveMeta = currentReplaceUid
                    ? { ...saveMetaBase, replaceMessageUid: currentReplaceUid, addAsVariant: true }
                    : saveMetaBase;

                const saveResult = saveMessage(
                    thisChatId,
                    responseRole,
                    responseContent,
                    responseBotIndex,
                    generationInsertIndex,
                    saveMeta
                );

                const typingEl = document.getElementById(typingId);
                const replacedTargetEl = currentReplaceUid && typeof findRenderedMessageByUid === 'function'
                    ? findRenderedMessageByUid(currentReplaceUid)
                    : null;
                const shouldStickFinalToVn = typeof shouldVnKeepMorphedTypingBubble === 'function'
                    ? shouldVnKeepMorphedTypingBubble(typingEl)
                    : false;
                let finalResponseEl = null;

                if (typingEl && typeof updateRenderedMessageFromSave === 'function') {
                    updateRenderedMessageFromSave(
                        typingEl,
                        responseRole,
                        responseContent,
                        responseBotIndex,
                        saveResult?.message || null,
                        saveResult?.index,
                        saveMeta
                    );

                    if (
                        replacedTargetEl &&
                        replacedTargetEl !== typingEl &&
                        document.body.contains(replacedTargetEl)
                    ) {
                        replacedTargetEl.remove();
                    }

                    if (typeof finalizeVnMorphedTypingBubble === 'function') {
                        finalizeVnMorphedTypingBubble(typingEl, {
                            liveId: typingId,
                            shouldStick: shouldStickFinalToVn,
                            unreadLabel: 'New message'
                        });
                    }

                    finalResponseEl = typingEl;
                } else {
                    removeTypingIndicator(typingId);

                    if (currentReplaceUid) {
                        const targetEl = typeof findRenderedMessageByUid === 'function'
                            ? findRenderedMessageByUid(currentReplaceUid)
                            : null;

                        if (targetEl && typeof updateRenderedMessageFromSave === 'function') {
                            updateRenderedMessageFromSave(
                                targetEl,
                                responseRole,
                                responseContent,
                                responseBotIndex,
                                saveResult?.message || null,
                                saveResult?.index,
                                saveMeta
                            );
                            finalResponseEl = targetEl;
                        } else {
                            finalResponseEl = addMessage(responseRole, responseContent, responseBotIndex, null, {
                                ...saveMetaBase,
                                messageIndex: saveResult?.index,
                                messageUid: saveResult?.message?.uid || currentReplaceUid,
                                emotion: saveResult?.message?.emotion || '',
                                announcementAgent: saveResult?.message?.announcementAgent === true
                            });
                        }
                    } else {
                        finalResponseEl = addMessage(responseRole, responseContent, responseBotIndex, generationInsertIndex, {
                            ...saveMetaBase,
                            messageIndex: saveResult?.index,
                            messageUid: saveResult?.message?.uid || '',
                            emotion: saveResult?.message?.emotion || '',
                            announcementAgent: saveResult?.message?.announcementAgent === true
                        });
                    }
                }

                delete ongoingGenerations[thisChatId];

                if (saveResult && responseContent.trim() && activeCueText) {
                    consumeFuraiOneTimeCue(
                        thisChatId,
                        'ai',
                        responderBot.uid || '',
                        responseBotIndex,
                        activeCueText
                    );
                }

                if (
                    responseVisualTrigger.matched &&
                    finalResponseEl &&
                    queueFuraiAutoVisualTrigger(responseVisualTrigger, finalResponseEl, thisChatId)
                ) {
                    await processFuraiAutoVisualTriggerQueue({ allowWhileGenerating: true, resumeQueue: false });
                }

                if (generationInsertIndex !== null && generationInsertIndex !== undefined && !currentReplaceUid) {
                    currentInsertIndex = generationInsertIndex + 1;
                }

                replaceMessageUidForNext = '';

                const responseMessageUid = String(saveResult?.message?.uid || '').trim();
                const allNewMentionMatches = orchestrator.parseMentionMatches(responseContent, profile.bots);
                const newMentionMatches = allNewMentionMatches.filter(entry => entry.kind === 'bot');
                const hasBroadcastMention = allNewMentionMatches.some(entry => entry.kind === 'broadcast');
                const responderUid = String(responderBot.uid || '');

                if (responderUid) chainVisitedActorUidSet.add(responderUid);

                // A generated direct @mention is an immediate handoff. Move an
                // already-scheduled target next, or insert it next if it was not in
                // the random batch. The target keeps the exact source-message UID,
                // so Mention Only policy and prompt history cannot drift to a newer turn.
                let nextInsertOffset = 1;
                for (const mention of newMentionMatches) {
                    if (currentChainDepth + inBatchHandoffCount >= MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH) break;

                    const targetUid = String(mention.uid || '').trim();
                    const target = profile.bots.find(bot => String(bot?.uid || '') === targetUid);

                    if (!targetUid || !target) continue;
                    if (targetUid === responderUid) continue;
                    if (!target.inActiveCast || getBotChatStatus(target) === 'idle' || target.replyMode === 'mute') continue;
                    if (chainVisitedActorUidSet.has(targetUid)) continue;
                    if (queuedChainTargetUids.has(targetUid)) continue;

                    const existingIndex = responders.findIndex((bot, index) =>
                        index > responderCursor && String(bot?.uid || '') === targetUid
                    );
                    if (
                        existingIndex < 0 &&
                        responders.length >= FURAI_MAX_EXPLICIT_MENTION_REPLIES
                    ) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    const existing = existingIndex >= 0
                        ? responders.splice(existingIndex, 1)[0]
                        : target;
                    const promotedTarget = {
                        ...existing,
                        __furaiExplicitMention: true,
                        __furaiSourceMessageUid: responseMessageUid
                    };

                    responders.splice(responderCursor + nextInsertOffset, 0, promotedTarget);
                    scheduledResponderUids.add(targetUid);
                    queuedChainTargetUids.add(targetUid);
                    nextInsertOffset += 1;
                    inBatchHandoffCount += 1;
                }

                const hasBroadcastTarget = hasBroadcastMention && profile.bots.some(target => {
                    const targetUid = String(target?.uid || '').trim();
                    return !!targetUid &&
                        targetUid !== responderUid &&
                        target.inActiveCast &&
                        getBotChatStatus(target) !== 'idle' &&
                        target.replyMode !== 'mute' &&
                        !scheduledResponderUids.has(targetUid) &&
                        !chainVisitedActorUidSet.has(targetUid);
                });

                if (
                    responseMessageUid &&
                    hasBroadcastTarget &&
                    currentChainDepth + inBatchHandoffCount < MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH
                ) {
                    pendingChainTasks.push({
                        sourceMessageUid: responseMessageUid,
                        targetActorUids: [],
                        forceBroadcastMention: true,
                        chainDepth: currentChainDepth + inBatchHandoffCount + 1
                    });
                }
            }
        } catch (error) {
            if (error.name === 'AbortError') break;

            console.error(`Error with ${responderBot.name}'s response:`, error);
            failFuraiGeneration(thisChatId, error, {
                releaseGlobalState: false,
                message: `${responderBot.name || 'Character'} could not generate a reply. Nothing was added to the chat.`
            });
            continue;
        }
    }
    
    if (!abortSignal.aborted) {
        isGenerating = false;
        currentAbortController = null;
        updateSendButtonUI();
        if (typeof finalizeFuraiContextTrimNotice === 'function') finalizeFuraiContextTrimNotice();

        let queuedBotMentionReply = false;

        if (pendingChainTasks.length > 0 && currentChainDepth < MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH) {
            const sharedVisitedActorUids = normalizeFuraiQueuedActorUids([
                ...chainVisitedActorUidSet
            ]);

            for (const task of pendingChainTasks) {
                const queued = enqueueFuraiBotMentionTask({
                    __furaiBotMentionReply: true,
                    chatId: thisChatId,
                    sourceMessageUid: task.sourceMessageUid,
                    sourcePersonality: personality,
                    forceActorUids: task.targetActorUids,
                    forceBroadcastMention: task.forceBroadcastMention === true,
                    chainVisitedActorUids: sharedVisitedActorUids,
                    chainDepth: Math.max(
                        currentChainDepth + 1,
                        Number(task.chainDepth) || 0
                    )
                });
                if (queued) queuedBotMentionReply = true;
            }
        }

        // User Auto Reply is independent from the character master toggle. It no
        // longer suppresses an explicit character ping; both promises can queue.
        maybeQueueUserAutoReplyAfterGroupTurn(currentChainDepth + 1, {
            forcePing: announcementPingedUser,
            suppressRandom: queuedBotMentionReply
        });
        
        processGenerationQueue();
    }
}

/* --- MESSAGE TIMESTAMPS: lightweight createdAt system --- */

const FURAI_TIMESTAMP_GLOBAL_KEY = 'furai_message_timestamps_enabled';
const FURAI_TIMESTAMP_DEFAULT_TEMPLATE = '[{{timestamp_display}}]';

function getGlobalTimestampEnabled() {
    return localStorage.getItem(FURAI_TIMESTAMP_GLOBAL_KEY) !== 'false';
}

function getGlobalTimestampTemplate() {
    return FURAI_TIMESTAMP_DEFAULT_TEMPLATE;
}

function getSeededTimestampPreference() {
    return getGlobalTimestampEnabled() ? 'on' : 'off';
}

function getTimestampPreferenceForChat(chatId) {
    if (!chatId) return getSeededTimestampPreference();

    try {
        const chatData = DB.get(chatId);
        const pref = chatData?.timestampPreference;

        return pref === 'off' ? 'off' : pref === 'on' ? 'on' : getSeededTimestampPreference();
    } catch(e) {
        return getSeededTimestampPreference();
    }
}

function getEffectiveTimestampEnabled(chatId = currentChatId) {
    return getTimestampPreferenceForChat(chatId) === 'on';
}

function padTimestampPart(value) {
    return String(value).padStart(2, '0');
}

function toLocalIsoWithOffset(date = new Date()) {
    const offsetMinutes = -date.getTimezoneOffset();
    const sign = offsetMinutes >= 0 ? '+' : '-';
    const absOffset = Math.abs(offsetMinutes);
    const offsetHours = padTimestampPart(Math.floor(absOffset / 60));
    const offsetMins = padTimestampPart(absOffset % 60);

    return [
        date.getFullYear(),
        '-',
        padTimestampPart(date.getMonth() + 1),
        '-',
        padTimestampPart(date.getDate()),
        'T',
        padTimestampPart(date.getHours()),
        ':',
        padTimestampPart(date.getMinutes()),
        ':',
        padTimestampPart(date.getSeconds()),
        sign,
        offsetHours,
        ':',
        offsetMins
    ].join('');
}

function makeMessageTimestampMeta(chatId = currentChatId) {
    return {
        createdAt: toLocalIsoWithOffset(new Date())
    };
}

function isSameTimestampDay(a, b) {
    return (
        a.getFullYear() === b.getFullYear() &&
        a.getMonth() === b.getMonth() &&
        a.getDate() === b.getDate()
    );
}

function formatTimestampClock(date) {
    let hours = date.getHours();
    const minutes = padTimestampPart(date.getMinutes());
    const suffix = hours >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';

    hours = hours % 12;
    if (hours === 0) hours = 12;

    return `${hours}:${minutes} ${suffix}`;
}

function formatMessageTimestampDisplay(createdAt, now = new Date()) {
    if (!createdAt) return '';

    const date = new Date(createdAt);
    if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return '';

    const clock = formatTimestampClock(date);

    if (isSameTimestampDay(date, now)) {
        return clock;
    }

    const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
    const day = date.getDate();

    if (date.getFullYear() === now.getFullYear()) {
        return `${month}/${day}, ${clock}`;
    }

    return `${month}/${day}/${String(date.getFullYear()).slice(-2)}, ${clock}`;
}

function formatMessageTimestampForAi(createdAt) {
    if (!createdAt || !getEffectiveTimestampEnabled(currentChatId)) return '';

    const display = formatMessageTimestampDisplay(createdAt);
    if (!display) return '';

    return getGlobalTimestampTemplate()
        .replace(/\{\{timestamp_raw\}\}/g, createdAt)
        .replace(/\{\{timestamp_display\}\}/g, display);
}

function getCleanTimestampSpeakerName(nameEl) {
    if (!nameEl) return '';

    const clone = nameEl.cloneNode(true);
    clone.querySelectorAll('.chat-timestamp').forEach(el => el.remove());

    return (clone.textContent || '').trim();
}

function getFuraiMessageFrameRole(messageEl, explicitRole = '') {
    const requested = String(explicitRole || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (requested) return requested;
    if (!messageEl) return '';
    if (messageEl.dataset.announcementAgent === 'true') return 'announcement';
    if (messageEl.dataset.role) return String(messageEl.dataset.role).trim().toLowerCase();
    if (messageEl.classList.contains('cutscene')) return 'cutscene';
    if (messageEl.classList.contains('muted-note')) return 'muted-note';
    if (messageEl.classList.contains('system')) return 'system';
    if (messageEl.classList.contains('narrator')) return 'narrator';
    if (messageEl.classList.contains('user')) return 'user';
    if (messageEl.classList.contains('ai')) return 'ai';
    return '';
}

function isFuraiCompactMessageFrame(messageEl, role = '') {
    const resolvedRole = getFuraiMessageFrameRole(messageEl, role);
    return messageEl?.dataset?.announcementAgent === 'true' ||
        resolvedRole === 'announcement' ||
        resolvedRole === 'narrator' ||
        resolvedRole === 'system' ||
        resolvedRole === 'muted-note' ||
        resolvedRole === 'cutscene';
}

function syncFuraiMessageFrameHeader(messageEl, options = {}) {
    if (!messageEl) return null;

    const wrapper = messageEl.querySelector('.message-content-wrapper');
    const contentEl = wrapper?.querySelector(':scope > .content');
    if (!wrapper) return null;

    const oldHeader = wrapper.querySelector('.chat-username');
    const oldSpeakerName = getCleanTimestampSpeakerName(oldHeader);
    const hasExplicitSpeaker = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(options, 'speakerName');
    const speakerName = String(
        hasExplicitSpeaker
            ? (options.speakerName || '')
            : (messageEl.dataset.speakerName || oldSpeakerName || '')
    ).trim();
    const createdAt = String(options.createdAt || messageEl.dataset.createdAt || '').trim();
    const role = getFuraiMessageFrameRole(messageEl, options.role || '');
    const showTimestamp = !!createdAt && getEffectiveTimestampEnabled(currentChatId);
    const timestampText = showTimestamp ? formatMessageTimestampDisplay(createdAt) : '';

    if (createdAt) messageEl.dataset.createdAt = createdAt;
    if (speakerName) messageEl.dataset.speakerName = speakerName;
    else if (hasExplicitSpeaker) delete messageEl.dataset.speakerName;

    wrapper.querySelectorAll(':scope > .chat-username, :scope > .chat-timestamp-row').forEach(el => el.remove());
    contentEl?.querySelectorAll(':scope > .chat-username, :scope > .chat-timestamp-row').forEach(el => el.remove());

    const compact = isFuraiCompactMessageFrame(messageEl, role);
    messageEl.classList.toggle('furai-message-frame-announcement', compact);

    const host = compact && contentEl ? contentEl : wrapper;
    const beforeNode = compact && contentEl
        ? contentEl.firstChild
        : (contentEl || wrapper.firstChild);

    if (speakerName) {
        const header = document.createElement('div');
        header.className = 'chat-username furai-message-frame-header';

        const speaker = document.createElement('span');
        speaker.className = 'chat-speaker-label';
        speaker.textContent = speakerName;

        const stamp = timestampText ? document.createElement('span') : null;
        if (stamp) {
            stamp.className = 'chat-timestamp';
            stamp.textContent = timestampText;
            stamp.title = createdAt;
        }

        const timeFirst = role === 'user' || messageEl.classList.contains('user');
        header.classList.toggle('timestamp-time-first', timeFirst);
        header.classList.toggle('timestamp-name-first', !timeFirst);

        if (timeFirst && stamp) header.append(stamp, speaker);
        else if (stamp) header.append(speaker, stamp);
        else header.append(speaker);

        host.insertBefore(header, beforeNode || null);
        return header;
    }

    if (timestampText) {
        const row = document.createElement('div');
        row.className = 'chat-timestamp-row furai-message-frame-header';
        row.textContent = timestampText;
        row.title = createdAt;
        host.insertBefore(row, beforeNode || null);
        return row;
    }

    return null;
}

function appendTimestampToMessageHeader(wrapper, createdAt) {
    const messageEl = wrapper?.closest('.message');
    if (!messageEl) return null;
    return syncFuraiMessageFrameHeader(messageEl, { createdAt });
}

// =====================================================================
// LIVE AI TIMESTAMP CONTRACT — SHOW FROM THE FIRST PLACEHOLDER FRAME
// =====================================================================
function ensureFuraiLiveMessageTimestamp(messageEl, createdAt = '') {
    if (!messageEl) return '';

    const resolvedCreatedAt = String(
        createdAt ||
        messageEl.dataset.createdAt ||
        ''
    ).trim();

    if (resolvedCreatedAt) messageEl.dataset.createdAt = resolvedCreatedAt;
    syncFuraiMessageFrameHeader(messageEl, { createdAt: resolvedCreatedAt });
    return resolvedCreatedAt;
}

function isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(role) {
    return role === 'announcement' || role === 'narrator';
}

function isFuraiAnnouncementMessageRole(role) {
    return isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(role) || role === 'system' || role === 'muted-note' || role === 'cutscene';
}

function getFuraiAnnouncementSpeakerName(role, meta = null, botIndex = null, chatId = currentChatId) {
    if (role === 'muted-note') return getFuraiMutedNoteSpeakerName(meta, botIndex, chatId);
    if (role === 'cutscene') return 'Cutscene';

    if (meta?.announcementAgent === true) {
        const explicitName = String(
            meta?.speakerName ||
            meta?.botNameSnapshot ||
            ''
        ).trim();

        if (explicitName) return explicitName;

        try {
            const profile = getChatProfile(chatId);
            const idx = Number(botIndex);
            if (Number.isInteger(idx) && idx >= 0 && profile?.bots?.[idx]?.name) {
                return String(profile.bots[idx].name).trim();
            }
        } catch(e) {}

        return 'AI';
    }

    if (isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(role) || role === 'system') return '';
    return String(meta?.speakerName || '').trim();
}

function placeFuraiAnnouncementHeaderInsideBubble(messageEl, role, createdAt = '', speakerName = '') {
    if (!messageEl || !isFuraiAnnouncementMessageRole(role)) return;

    const isNamedAnnouncementAgent = messageEl.dataset.announcementAgent === 'true';
    const isNameless = !isNamedAnnouncementAgent &&
        (isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(role) || role === 'system');
    const safeName = isNameless
        ? ''
        : String(speakerName || getFuraiAnnouncementSpeakerName(role)).trim();

    syncFuraiMessageFrameHeader(messageEl, {
        role,
        createdAt,
        speakerName: safeName
    });
}

function getMessageTimestampFromEl(messageEl) {
    return messageEl?.dataset?.createdAt || '';
}

function formatTimestampPrefixForMessageEl(messageEl) {
    const createdAt = getMessageTimestampFromEl(messageEl);
    const stamp = formatMessageTimestampForAi(createdAt);

    return stamp ? `${stamp} ` : '';
}

function getValidTimestampMessageEls() {
    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');

    // Active typing bubbles are real turns with a reserved createdAt. Include
    // them so toggling timestamps while generation is active updates them too.
    return Array.from(chatMessagesEl?.querySelectorAll('.message') || [])
        .filter(m => m.id !== 'personality-selector-message');
}

function refreshVisibleMessageTimestamps() {
    if (!currentChatId) return;

    let chatData = null;
    try { chatData = DB.get(currentChatId); } catch(e) {}

    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    const messageEls = getValidTimestampMessageEls();

    messageEls.forEach((messageEl, index) => {
        const isLivePlaceholder =
            messageEl.classList.contains('furai-active-ai-message') ||
            String(messageEl.id || '').startsWith('typing-');
        const dbIndex = getRenderedDbMessageIndex(messageEl);
        const msg = isLivePlaceholder ? null : (messages[dbIndex] || messages[index]);
        const createdAt = String(
            msg?.createdAt ||
            messageEl.dataset.createdAt ||
            ''
        ).trim();

        if (createdAt) {
            messageEl.dataset.createdAt = createdAt;
        } else if (!isLivePlaceholder) {
            delete messageEl.dataset.createdAt;
        }

        ensureFuraiLiveMessageTimestamp(messageEl, createdAt);
    });

    if (document.body.classList.contains('vn-active') && typeof renderVnMessage === 'function') {
        renderVnMessage('preserve');
    }
}

function saveChatTimestampPreference(chatId, value) {
    const targetId = chatId || optionsTargetChatId || currentChatId;
    if (!targetId) return;

    try {
        const chatData = DB.get(targetId);
        if (!chatData) return;

        if (value === 'on' || value === 'off') {
            chatData.timestampPreference = value;
        } else {
            delete chatData.timestampPreference;
        }

        DB.set(targetId, chatData);

        if (targetId === currentChatId) {
            refreshVisibleMessageTimestamps();
        }
    } catch(e) {
        console.error('Error saving timestamp preference:', e);
    }
}

function setGlobalTimestampPreferenceFromButton(value) {
    const enabled = value === 'on';

    localStorage.setItem(FURAI_TIMESTAMP_GLOBAL_KEY, enabled ? 'true' : 'false');

    document.querySelectorAll('[data-global-timestamp-pref]').forEach(btn => {
        btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.globalTimestampPref === value);
    });
    
    const checkbox = document.getElementById('globalMessageTimestamps');
    if (checkbox) checkbox.checked = enabled;

    if (currentChatId) {
        refreshVisibleMessageTimestamps();
    }
}

function injectGlobalTimestampSettingsUI() {
    if (document.getElementById('globalTimestampToggleWrap')) return;

    const anchor =
        document.getElementById('globalAutoSummary')?.closest('.form-group') ||
        document.getElementById('globalGlossaryText')?.closest('.form-group') ||
        document.getElementById('globalRefText')?.closest('.form-group');

    if (!anchor) return;

    const value = getGlobalTimestampEnabled() ? 'on' : 'off';
    anchor.insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin', `
        <div id="globalTimestampToggleWrap"
             class="form-group"
             style="border-top:1px dashed var(--border-color); padding-top:12px; margin-top:12px;">
            <label class="furai-switch-row" for="globalMessageTimestamps">
                <span>Message Timestamps</span>
                <span class="furai-switch"><input type="checkbox" role="switch" id="globalMessageTimestamps" onchange="setGlobalTimestampPreferenceFromButton(this.checked ? 'on' : 'off')" ${value === 'on' ? 'checked' : ''}><span class="furai-switch-track" aria-hidden="true"><span class="furai-switch-knob"></span></span></span>
            </label>
            <p style="font-size:0.8em; opacity:0.7; margin-top:0; line-height:1.4;">
                Saves and shows message time.
            </p>
        </div>
    `);
}
                                                             
// --- UPDATED: Handle Array Splice & Universal Auto-Naming ---
function saveMessage(chatId, role, content, botIndex = null, insertIndex = null, meta = null) {
    try {
        let chatData = DB.get(chatId);
        if (!chatData) return null;

        if (!Array.isArray(chatData.messages)) {
            chatData.messages = [];
        }

        const profile = getChatProfile(chatId);
        const replaceMessageUid = String(meta?.replaceMessageUid || '').trim();
        const addAsVariant = meta?.addAsVariant === true;

        const message = { uid: String(meta?.messageUid || '').trim() || generateUID('msg'), role, content, revision: 1, branchId: 'main' };
        if (chatData.morph?.enabled) {
            message.mode = String(meta?.mode || chatData.personality || chatPersonalities?.[chatId] || 'researcher');
        }
        const forcedActorUid = String(meta?.actorUid || meta?.userUid || meta?.botUid || '').trim();
        const forcedActor = meta?.actorProfile && typeof meta.actorProfile === 'object'
            ? cloneFuraiData(meta.actorProfile)
            : null;

        // Always keep hidden createdAt metadata for ordering/repair.
        // Display is still controlled by getEffectiveTimestampEnabled().
        const timestampMeta = meta || makeMessageTimestampMeta(chatId);

        let savedEmotion = String(meta?.emotion || '').trim();

        if (timestampMeta.createdAt) {
            message.createdAt = timestampMeta.createdAt;
        }

        const fetchContext = String(timestampMeta.fetchContext || '').trim();
        if (fetchContext) message.fetchContext = fetchContext;

        const mentionActorUids = normalizeFuraiQueuedActorUids(timestampMeta.mentionActorUids);
        if (mentionActorUids.length > 0) message.mentionActorUids = mentionActorUids;

        if (timestampMeta.idleAnnouncement === true) {
            // Marker only: excludes this generated notice from member activity.
            // Do not attach target/source/presence metadata to chat messages.
            message.idleAnnouncement = true;
        }

        if (timestampMeta.syntheticUserAutoReply === true) {
            message.syntheticUserAutoReply = true;
        }

        if (timestampMeta.syntheticWandRetry === true) {
            message.syntheticWandRetry = true;
        }

        const wandNameSnapshot = String(timestampMeta.wandNameSnapshot || '').trim();
        if (wandNameSnapshot) {
            message.wandNameSnapshot = wandNameSnapshot;
        }

        if (role === 'ai' && timestampMeta.announcementAgent === true) {
            // Presentation-only marker. Keep role=ai so actor attribution,
            // regeneration, variants, summaries, and chat context remain normal.
            message.announcementAgent = true;
        }

        if (role === 'muted-note') {
            message.silentNote = true;

            const silentName = String(
                timestampMeta.silentNoteSpeakerName ||
                timestampMeta.speakerName ||
                timestampMeta.userNameSnapshot ||
                timestampMeta.botNameSnapshot ||
                timestampMeta.wandNameSnapshot ||
                ''
            ).trim();

            if (silentName) message.silentNoteSpeakerName = silentName;
        }

        if (role === 'user') {
            const userActor = forcedActor ||
                (forcedActorUid ? resolveFuraiActorByUid(profile, forcedActorUid, 'user', null) : null) ||
                profile?.user || null;
            const userUid = forcedActorUid || String(userActor?.uid || '').trim();
            if (userUid) message.userUid = userUid;
            if (userActor?.name) message.userNameSnapshot = userActor.name;

            if (!savedEmotion && userActor) {
                savedEmotion = detectBotEmotion(content, userActor) ||
                    getFuraiChatEmotionStatus(chatId, 'user', userActor, null);
            }
        }

        if ((role === 'ai' || role === 'muted-note') && botIndex !== null) {
            const idx = parseInt(botIndex, 10);
            message.botIndex = idx;

            const bot = forcedActor ||
                (forcedActorUid ? resolveFuraiActorByUid(profile, forcedActorUid, 'ai', idx) : null) ||
                profile?.bots?.[idx] || null;
            const botUid = forcedActorUid || String(bot?.uid || '').trim();
            if (botUid) message.botUid = botUid;
            if (bot?.name) {
                message.botNameSnapshot = bot.name;
                if (role === 'muted-note' && !message.silentNoteSpeakerName) {
                    message.silentNoteSpeakerName = bot.name;
                }
            }

            if (role === 'ai' && !savedEmotion && bot) {
                savedEmotion = detectBotEmotion(content, bot) ||
                    getFuraiChatEmotionStatus(chatId, 'ai', bot, idx);
            }
        }

        if (savedEmotion) {
            message.emotion = savedEmotion;
        }

        let savedIndex = -1;
        let replaced = false;

        if (replaceMessageUid) {
            const replaceIndex = chatData.messages.findIndex(msg => msg?.uid === replaceMessageUid);
        
            if (replaceIndex !== -1) {
                const oldMessage = chatData.messages[replaceIndex] || {};
                const replacementCreatedAt = message.createdAt || '';

                message.uid = replaceMessageUid;
                message.revision = getFuraiMessageRevision(oldMessage) + 1;
                message.branchId = oldMessage.branchId || 'main';
                message.createdAt = oldMessage.createdAt || replacementCreatedAt;
                message.sortKey = Number.isFinite(Number(oldMessage.sortKey))
                    ? Number(oldMessage.sortKey)
                    : replaceIndex;

                if (oldMessage.mode) message.mode = oldMessage.mode;
                if (oldMessage.userUid && !forcedActorUid) message.userUid = oldMessage.userUid;
                if (oldMessage.botUid && !forcedActorUid) message.botUid = oldMessage.botUid;
                if (oldMessage.userNameSnapshot && !message.userNameSnapshot) message.userNameSnapshot = oldMessage.userNameSnapshot;
                if (oldMessage.botNameSnapshot && !message.botNameSnapshot) message.botNameSnapshot = oldMessage.botNameSnapshot;
                if (oldMessage.botIndex !== undefined && oldMessage.botIndex !== null) message.botIndex = oldMessage.botIndex;
                if (oldMessage.fetchContext && !message.fetchContext) message.fetchContext = oldMessage.fetchContext;
                if (oldMessage.announcementAgent === true && timestampMeta.announcementAgent !== false) {
                    message.announcementAgent = true;
                }
        
                if (Array.isArray(oldMessage.pinnedGeneratedImages) && oldMessage.pinnedGeneratedImages.length) {
                    message.pinnedGeneratedImages = oldMessage.pinnedGeneratedImages.map(item => ({ ...item }));
                }
                if (addAsVariant && role === 'ai' && oldMessage.role === 'ai') {
                    const oldVariants = Array.isArray(oldMessage.variants) && oldMessage.variants.length > 0
                        ? oldMessage.variants.map(v => ({ ...v }))
                        : [{
                            id: generateUID('var'),
                            content: oldMessage.content || '',
                            createdAt: oldMessage.createdAt || '',
                            emotion: oldMessage.emotion || ''
                        }];
        
                    oldVariants.push({
                        id: generateUID('var'),
                        content,
                        createdAt: replacementCreatedAt || message.createdAt || '',
                        emotion: message.emotion || ''
                    });
        
                    message.variants = oldVariants;
                    message.activeVariantIndex = oldVariants.length - 1;
                } else if (Array.isArray(oldMessage.variants) && oldMessage.variants.length > 0) {
                    const oldVariants = oldMessage.variants.map(v => ({ ...v }));
                    const oldActiveIndex = Number(oldMessage.activeVariantIndex);
                    const safeActiveIndex =
                        Number.isInteger(oldActiveIndex) &&
                        oldActiveIndex >= 0 &&
                        oldActiveIndex < oldVariants.length
                            ? oldActiveIndex
                            : oldVariants.length - 1;
        
                    oldVariants[safeActiveIndex] = {
                        ...oldVariants[safeActiveIndex],
                        content,
                        createdAt: replacementCreatedAt || oldVariants[safeActiveIndex].createdAt || message.createdAt || '',
                        emotion: message.emotion || oldVariants[safeActiveIndex].emotion || ''
                    };
        
                    message.variants = oldVariants;
                    message.activeVariantIndex = safeActiveIndex;
                }
        
                chatData.messages[replaceIndex] = message;
                savedIndex = replaceIndex;
                replaced = true;
            }
        }

        if (!replaced) {
            const numericInsertIndex = getValidMessageInsertIndex(insertIndex, chatData.messages.length);

            message.sortKey = numericInsertIndex === null
                ? getNextMessageSortKey(chatData.messages)
                : getInsertedMessageSortKey(chatData.messages, numericInsertIndex);

            if (numericInsertIndex !== null) {
                chatData.messages.splice(numericInsertIndex, 0, message);
                savedIndex = numericInsertIndex;
            } else {
                chatData.messages.push(message);
                savedIndex = chatData.messages.length - 1;
            }
        }

        let repairedMessageOrder = false;
        if (typeof repairFullyReversedMessageArray === 'function') {
            repairedMessageOrder = repairFullyReversedMessageArray(chatData);
            savedIndex = chatData.messages.findIndex(msg => msg?.uid === message.uid);
        }

        chatData.timestamp = Date.now();
        const mutationKind = repairedMessageOrder
            ? 'repair'
            : (replaced
                ? 'regenerate'
                : (savedIndex < chatData.messages.length - 1 ? 'insert' : 'append'));
        const mutationIndex = repairedMessageOrder ? 0 : savedIndex;
        applyFuraiMessageMutationToChatData(chatData, mutationIndex, mutationKind);

        const isDefaultChatTitle = title => {
            const value = String(title || '').trim();

            return (
                value === '' ||
                value === 'New Chat' ||
                value === 'Home' ||
                value.startsWith('Chat with ')
            );
        };

        const cleanAutoTitleText = text => String(text || '')
            .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ')
            .replace(/https?:\/\/\S+/gi, ' ')
            .replace(/[*"“”_~`#]/g, '')
            .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
            .trim();

        const isBadAutoTitleText = text => {
            const value = cleanAutoTitleText(text).toLowerCase();
            const cjkCount = (value.match(/[\u3400-\u9fff]/g) || []).length;

            if (!value) return true;
            if (value.startsWith('/')) return true;
            if (value.length < 8 && cjkCount < 4) return true;

            return /^(hi|hii|hiii|hello|hey|yo|ok|okay|yes|no|thanks|thank you|test|lol|lmao|start|continue|new chat|hello there)[.!?。！？，,\s]*$/i.test(value);
        };

        const trimAutoTitle = text => {
            const value = cleanAutoTitleText(text);
            return value.length > 32 ? value.slice(0, 32).trim() + '...' : value;
        };

        if (
            role === 'user' &&
            chatData.manualTitle !== true &&
            isDefaultChatTitle(chatData.title) &&
            !isBadAutoTitleText(content)
        ) {
            const newTitle = trimAutoTitle(content);

            if (newTitle && chatData.title !== newTitle) {
                chatData.title = newTitle;
                chatData.titleSource = 'auto';

                if (typeof chatTitles !== 'undefined') {
                    chatTitles[chatId] = newTitle;
                }

                if (chatId === window.currentChatId) {
                    const titleEl = document.getElementById('chatTitleEl');
                    if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = newTitle;
                    if (typeof isFirstUserMessage !== 'undefined') isFirstUserMessage = false;
                }
            }
        }

        if (typeof updateFuraiIdleAnnouncementStateForSavedMessage === 'function') {
            updateFuraiIdleAnnouncementStateForSavedMessage(
                chatId,
                chatData,
                message,
                role,
                timestampMeta,
                mutationKind
            );
        }

        DB.set(chatId, chatData);

        if (chatId === currentChatId && typeof syncFuraiIdleAnnouncementTimer === 'function') {
            syncFuraiIdleAnnouncementTimer(chatId, chatData);
        }

        if (chatId === currentChatId && chatData.messages.length === 1 && typeof updateFuraiModeMenuLabel === 'function') {
            updateFuraiModeMenuLabel(chatData.personality || getFuraiActiveMode(chatId));
        }
        notifyFuraiMessageMutation(chatId, mutationIndex, mutationKind);
        if (typeof invalidateFuraiContextMetaCountCache === 'function') invalidateFuraiContextMetaCountCache(chatId);

        if (!isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(role) && role !== 'system' && role !== 'cutscene') {
            if (typeof debouncedSidebarUpdate === 'function') debouncedSidebarUpdate();
            else updateChatList();
        }

        return {
            chatData,
            message,
            index: savedIndex,
            replaced
        };
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Error saving message:', e);
        return null;
    }
}
  
// 1. THE VISUAL BUILDER (Renamed to addMessageDOM)
window.lastUserActionTime = 0;
let furaiBulkLoadingChat = false;
let furaiMessageRenderTarget = null;
let furaiBulkRenderContext = null;

function buildMentionRegexFromProfile(profile) {
    const participants = [];

    if (profile?.user?.name) {
        participants.push(profile.user.name);
    }

    if (Array.isArray(profile?.bots)) {
        participants.push(...profile.bots.map(b => b?.name).filter(Boolean));
    }

    participants.push('all', 'everyone');

    const uniqueParticipants = [...new Set(participants.map(name => String(name || '').trim()).filter(Boolean))];

    if (!uniqueParticipants.length) return null;

    return new RegExp(`@(${uniqueParticipants.map(escapeRegex).join('|')})(?![\\w-])`, 'gi');
}

function getFastRenderProfile(chatId = currentChatId) {
    if (
        furaiBulkRenderContext &&
        furaiBulkRenderContext.chatId === chatId &&
        furaiBulkRenderContext.profile
    ) {
        return furaiBulkRenderContext.profile;
    }

    return typeof getChatProfile === 'function' ? getChatProfile(chatId) : null;
}

function getFastMentionRegex(chatId = currentChatId) {
    if (
        furaiBulkRenderContext &&
        furaiBulkRenderContext.chatId === chatId
    ) {
        return furaiBulkRenderContext.mentionRegex || null;
    }

    const profile = getFastRenderProfile(chatId);
    return buildMentionRegexFromProfile(profile);
}

const FURAI_FAST_OPEN_TAIL_LIMIT = 30;
const FURAI_OLDER_LOAD_CHUNK_SIZE = 60;
const FURAI_OLDER_LOAD_TOP_EDGE = 90;

let furaiChatHydrateToken = 0;

function renderMessageSliceToFragment(messages, startIndex, endIndex) {
    const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
    const previousRenderContext = furaiBulkRenderContext;

    const profile = getFastRenderProfile(currentChatId);

    furaiBulkLoadingChat = true;
    furaiMessageRenderTarget = fragment;
    furaiBulkRenderContext = {
        chatId: currentChatId,
        profile,
        mentionRegex: buildMentionRegexFromProfile(profile)
    };

    try {
        for (let i = startIndex; i < endIndex; i++) {
            const msg = messages[i];
            if (!msg) continue;

            addMessageDOM(msg.role, msg.content, msg.botIndex, null, {
                createdAt: msg.createdAt || '',
                messageIndex: i,
                messageUid: msg.uid || '',
                mode: msg.mode || '',
                sortKey: msg.sortKey,
                emotion: msg.emotion || '',
                speakerName: msg.silentNoteSpeakerName || msg.userNameSnapshot || msg.botNameSnapshot || msg.wandNameSnapshot || '',
                silentNoteSpeakerName: msg.silentNoteSpeakerName || '',
                userNameSnapshot: msg.userNameSnapshot || '',
                botNameSnapshot: msg.botNameSnapshot || '',
                userUid: msg.userUid || '',
                botUid: msg.botUid || '',
                wandNameSnapshot: msg.wandNameSnapshot || '',
                announcementAgent: msg.announcementAgent === true,
                pinnedGeneratedImages: Array.isArray(msg.pinnedGeneratedImages)
                    ? msg.pinnedGeneratedImages
                    : []
            });
        }
    } finally {
        furaiMessageRenderTarget = null;
        furaiBulkLoadingChat = false;
        furaiBulkRenderContext = previousRenderContext;
    }

    return fragment;
}

function getRenderedDbMessageIndex(messageEl) {
    if (!messageEl) return -1;

    if (typeof isLiveTypingMessage === 'function' && isLiveTypingMessage(messageEl)) {
        return -1;
    }

    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    const chatData = currentChatId ? DB.get(currentChatId) : null;
    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];

    const messageUid = String(messageEl.dataset.messageUid || '').trim();

    // Primary identity: UID. This survives refresh, pagination, insert/delete, and regen.
    if (messageUid && messages.length) {
        const uidIndex = messages.findIndex(msg => msg?.uid === messageUid);
        if (uidIndex !== -1) return uidIndex;

        // A DOM bubble with a UID that no longer exists is stale.
        return -1;
    }

    // Secondary identity: explicit DB index, only when it points at a real message.
    const directIndex = Number(messageEl.dataset.messageIndex);
    if (Number.isInteger(directIndex) && directIndex >= 0) {
        if (!messages.length || messages[directIndex]) return directIndex;
        return -1;
    }

    // Last-resort legacy fallback.
    // Important: fast-open renders only the tail, so visible index 0 may actually be DB index 200+.
    const visibleMessages = Array.from(chatMessagesEl?.querySelectorAll('.message') || [])
        .filter(m => !m.id.startsWith('typing-') && m.id !== 'personality-selector-message');

    const visibleIndex = visibleMessages.indexOf(messageEl);
    if (visibleIndex === -1) return -1;

    const loadedStartIndex = Number(chatMessagesEl?.dataset.loadedStartIndex);
    const fallbackIndex = Number.isInteger(loadedStartIndex) && loadedStartIndex >= 0
        ? loadedStartIndex + visibleIndex
        : visibleIndex;

    return messages[fallbackIndex] ? fallbackIndex : -1;
}

function findRenderedMessageByUid(messageUid) {
    const uid = String(messageUid || '').trim();
    if (!uid) return null;

    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    if (!chatMessagesEl) return null;

    return Array.from(chatMessagesEl.querySelectorAll('.message'))
        .find(messageEl => messageEl.dataset.messageUid === uid) || null;
}


function getFuraiChatUserDisplayName(chatId = currentChatId) {
    try {
        const profile = getChatProfile(chatId);
        const name = String(profile?.user?.name || '').trim();
        return name || 'User';
    } catch(e) {
        return 'User';
    }
}

function getFuraiMutedNoteSpeakerName(meta = {}, botIndex = null, chatId = currentChatId) {
    const explicitName = String(
        meta?.speakerName ||
        meta?.silentNoteSpeakerName ||
        meta?.userNameSnapshot ||
        meta?.botNameSnapshot ||
        ''
    ).trim();

    if (explicitName) return explicitName;

    try {
        const profile = getChatProfile(chatId);
        const idx = Number(botIndex);

        if (Number.isInteger(idx) && idx >= 0 && profile?.bots?.[idx]?.name) {
            return profile.bots[idx].name;
        }

        const userName = String(profile?.user?.name || '').trim();
        if (userName) return userName;
    } catch(e) {}

    return 'User';
}

function upsertFuraiMessageSpeakerName(messageEl, speakerName) {
    if (!messageEl) return null;

    const safeName = String(speakerName || '').trim() || 'User';
    messageEl.dataset.speakerName = safeName;

    return syncFuraiMessageFrameHeader(messageEl, {
        createdAt: messageEl.dataset.createdAt || '',
        speakerName: safeName
    });
}

function removeFuraiMessageAvatars(messageEl) {
    messageEl?.querySelectorAll?.('.furai-chat-portrait-slot, .chat-avatar')?.forEach(el => el.remove());
}

function updateRenderedMessageFromSave(messageEl, role, content, botIndex = null, savedMsg = null, savedIndex = null, meta = null) {
    if (!messageEl) return;

    const isAnnouncementAgent = role === 'ai' && (
        savedMsg?.announcementAgent === true ||
        meta?.announcementAgent === true ||
        messageEl.dataset.announcementAgent === 'true'
    );
    const visualRole = role === 'cutscene' ? 'muted-note' : role;
    messageEl.className = `message ${visualRole}`;
    if (isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(role) || isAnnouncementAgent) messageEl.classList.add('narrator');
    messageEl.classList.toggle('furai-announcement-agent', isAnnouncementAgent);

    if (isAnnouncementAgent) messageEl.dataset.announcementAgent = 'true';
    else delete messageEl.dataset.announcementAgent;

    if ((messageEl.id || '').startsWith('typing-')) {
        messageEl.removeAttribute('id');
    }

    if (role === 'cutscene') {
        messageEl.classList.add('cutscene');
        messageEl.dataset.role = 'cutscene';
    } else if (role === 'muted-note') {
        messageEl.dataset.role = 'muted-note';
    } else if (isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(role)) {
        messageEl.dataset.role = role;
    } else {
        delete messageEl.dataset.role;
    }

    const numericIndex = Number(savedIndex);
    if (Number.isInteger(numericIndex) && numericIndex >= 0) {
        messageEl.dataset.messageIndex = String(numericIndex);
    }

    const uid = savedMsg?.uid || meta?.messageUid || meta?.replaceMessageUid || '';
    if (uid) {
        messageEl.dataset.messageUid = uid;
    }
    const savedMode = String(savedMsg?.mode || meta?.mode || '').trim();
    if (savedMode) messageEl.dataset.mode = savedMode;
    if (savedMsg?.userUid || meta?.userUid) messageEl.dataset.userUid = String(savedMsg?.userUid || meta?.userUid);
    else delete messageEl.dataset.userUid;
    if (savedMsg?.botUid || meta?.botUid || meta?.actorUid) messageEl.dataset.botUid = String(savedMsg?.botUid || meta?.botUid || meta?.actorUid);
    else delete messageEl.dataset.botUid;

    if ((role === 'ai' || role === 'muted-note') && botIndex !== null) {
        messageEl.dataset.botIndex = String(botIndex);
    } else if (role !== 'muted-note') {
        delete messageEl.dataset.botIndex;
    }

    const createdAt = savedMsg?.createdAt || meta?.createdAt || '';
    if (createdAt) {
        messageEl.dataset.createdAt = createdAt;
    } else {
        delete messageEl.dataset.createdAt;
    }

    const emotion = role === 'muted-note' ? '' : (savedMsg?.emotion || meta?.emotion || '');
    if (emotion) {
        messageEl.dataset.vnEmotion = emotion;
    } else {
        delete messageEl.dataset.vnEmotion;
    }

    if (role === 'muted-note') {
        removeFuraiMessageAvatars(messageEl);
        upsertFuraiMessageSpeakerName(
            messageEl,
            getFuraiMutedNoteSpeakerName(meta, botIndex, currentChatId)
        );
    } else if (isAnnouncementAgent) {
        removeFuraiMessageAvatars(messageEl);
        upsertFuraiMessageSpeakerName(
            messageEl,
            getFuraiAnnouncementSpeakerName('announcement', {
                ...(meta || {}),
                ...(savedMsg || {}),
                announcementAgent: true
            }, botIndex, currentChatId)
        );
    }

    const contentEl = messageEl.querySelector('.content');
    if (contentEl) {
        clearFuraiMessageThinkingIndicator(contentEl);
        contentEl.classList.remove('typing');
        contentEl.innerHTML = formatMessageContent(content);
    }

    const announcementVisualRole = isAnnouncementAgent ? 'announcement' : role;
    if (isFuraiAnnouncementMessageRole(announcementVisualRole)) {
        const announcementMeta = isAnnouncementAgent
            ? { ...(meta || {}), ...(savedMsg || {}), announcementAgent: true }
            : meta;

        placeFuraiAnnouncementHeaderInsideBubble(
            messageEl,
            announcementVisualRole,
            createdAt,
            getFuraiAnnouncementSpeakerName(announcementVisualRole, announcementMeta, botIndex, currentChatId)
        );
    } else {
        appendTimestampToMessageHeader(
            messageEl.querySelector('.message-content-wrapper'),
            createdAt
        );
    }

    const oldControls = messageEl.querySelector('.message-controls');
    if (oldControls) oldControls.remove();

    if (window.addMessageControls) {
        window.addMessageControls(messageEl);
    }

    if (typeof queueFuraiContextMetaRender === 'function') queueFuraiContextMetaRender();
}

function getChatMessageByUid(chatId, messageUid) {
    const uid = String(messageUid || '').trim();
    if (!chatId || !uid) return null;

    const chatData = DB.get(chatId);
    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    const index = messages.findIndex(msg => msg?.uid === uid);

    if (index === -1) return null;

    return {
        chatData,
        messages,
        msg: messages[index],
        index
    };
}

function getSafeMessageVariantIndex(msg) {
    const variants = Array.isArray(msg?.variants) ? msg.variants : [];
    const rawIndex = Number(msg?.activeVariantIndex);

    if (
        Number.isInteger(rawIndex) &&
        rawIndex >= 0 &&
        rawIndex < variants.length
    ) {
        return rawIndex;
    }

    return Math.max(variants.length - 1, 0);
}

function updateAiMessageActiveVariantContent(msg, newContent) {
    if (!msg) return;

    msg.content = newContent;

    if (msg.role !== 'ai') return;

    const variants = Array.isArray(msg.variants) ? msg.variants : [];
    if (variants.length <= 0) return;

    const activeIndex = getSafeMessageVariantIndex(msg);
    const activeVariant = variants[activeIndex];

    if (!activeVariant) return;

    activeVariant.content = newContent;

    if (msg.createdAt) activeVariant.createdAt = msg.createdAt;
    if (msg.emotion) activeVariant.emotion = msg.emotion;

    msg.activeVariantIndex = activeIndex;
}

function getMessageVariantState(msg) {
    if (!msg || msg.role !== 'ai') {
        return null;
    }

    const variants = Array.isArray(msg.variants) ? msg.variants : [];

    if (variants.length <= 1) {
        return null;
    }

    const activeIndex = getSafeMessageVariantIndex(msg);

    return {
        variants,
        activeIndex,
        total: variants.length
    };
}

function createMessageVariantNav(messageEl) {
    const uid = String(messageEl?.dataset?.messageUid || '').trim();
    if (!uid || !currentChatId) return null;

    const found = getChatMessageByUid(currentChatId, uid);
    const state = getMessageVariantState(found?.msg);

    if (!state) return null;

    const nav = document.createElement('span');
    nav.className = 'message-variant-nav';

    const makeBtn = (direction, delta, title) => {
        const button = document.createElement('button');
        button.type = 'button';
        button.className = 'variant-arrow-btn';
        button.innerHTML = `<span class="material-symbols-outlined" aria-hidden="true">${
            direction === 'prev' ? 'chevron_left' : 'chevron_right'
        }</span>`;
        button.title = title;
    
        button.onclick = (event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();
            switchAiMessageVariant(uid, delta);
        };
    
        return button;
    };

    const label = document.createElement('span');
    label.className = 'message-variant-count';
    label.textContent = `${state.activeIndex + 1}/${state.total}`;

    nav.appendChild(makeBtn('prev', -1, 'Previous version'));
    nav.appendChild(label);
    nav.appendChild(makeBtn('next', 1, 'Next version'));

    return nav;
}

function renderVnMessageVariantNav(messageEl = null) {
    const nav = document.getElementById('vnVariantNav');
    if (!nav) return;

    nav.innerHTML = '';
    nav.style.display = 'none';

    const targetEl = messageEl || (
        typeof getVnCurrentMessageElement === 'function'
            ? getVnCurrentMessageElement()
            : null
    );

    const uid = String(targetEl?.dataset?.messageUid || '').trim();
    if (!uid || !currentChatId) return;

    const found = getChatMessageByUid(currentChatId, uid);
    const state = getMessageVariantState(found?.msg);

    if (!state) return;

    const makeBtn = (direction, delta, title) => {
        const button = document.createElement('button');
        button.type = 'button';
        button.className = 'variant-arrow-btn';
        button.innerHTML = direction === 'prev'
            ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-left" aria-hidden="true"></i>'
            : '<i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>';
        button.title = title;
    
        button.onclick = (event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();
            switchAiMessageVariant(uid, delta);
        };
    
        return button;
    };

    const label = document.createElement('span');
    label.className = 'vn-variant-count';
    label.textContent = `${state.activeIndex + 1}/${state.total}`;

    nav.appendChild(makeBtn('prev', -1, 'Previous version'));
    nav.appendChild(label);
    nav.appendChild(makeBtn('next', 1, 'Next version'));

    nav.style.display = 'inline-flex';
}

function switchAiMessageVariant(messageUid, delta) {
    const uid = String(messageUid || '').trim();
    if (!uid || !currentChatId) return false;

    const found = getChatMessageByUid(currentChatId, uid);
    if (!found || found.msg?.role !== 'ai') return false;

    const msg = found.msg;
    const variants = Array.isArray(msg.variants) ? msg.variants : [];

    if (variants.length <= 1) return false;

    const safeOldIndex = getSafeMessageVariantIndex(msg);
    const nextIndex = (safeOldIndex + delta + variants.length) % variants.length;
    const nextVariant = variants[nextIndex];

    msg.activeVariantIndex = nextIndex;
    msg.content = nextVariant.content || '';
    msg.createdAt = nextVariant.createdAt || msg.createdAt || '';

    if (nextVariant.emotion) {
        msg.emotion = nextVariant.emotion;
    } else {
        delete msg.emotion;
    }

    bumpFuraiMessageRevision(msg);
    applyFuraiMessageMutationToChatData(found.chatData, found.index, 'variant');
    found.chatData.timestamp = Date.now();
    DB.set(currentChatId, found.chatData);
    notifyFuraiMessageMutation(currentChatId, found.index, 'variant');

    const messageEl = findRenderedMessageByUid(uid);

    if (messageEl) {
        updateRenderedMessageFromSave(
            messageEl,
            msg.role,
            msg.content,
            msg.botIndex,
            msg,
            found.index,
            {
                createdAt: msg.createdAt || '',
                emotion: msg.emotion || '',
                replaceMessageUid: uid
            }
        );
    }

    if (document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) {
        if (typeof syncVnData === 'function') syncVnData();
        if (typeof renderVnMessage === 'function') renderVnMessage('preserve');
    }

    return true;
}

window.updateAiMessageActiveVariantContent = updateAiMessageActiveVariantContent;

function markMessageRegenerating(messageEl, replaceMessageUid = '') {
    if (!messageEl) return;

    const uid = String(replaceMessageUid || messageEl.dataset.messageUid || '').trim();
    if (uid) messageEl.dataset.messageUid = uid;

    messageEl.classList.add('is-regenerating-replaced');
    messageEl.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
}

function normalizeRenderedMessageOrder(chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl')) {
    if (!chatMessagesEl) return;

    const messages = Array.from(chatMessagesEl.querySelectorAll('.message'))
        .filter(m => !m.id.startsWith('typing-') && m.id !== 'personality-selector-message');

    if (messages.length <= 1) return;

    const sortable = messages
        .map((el, domIndex) => ({
            el,
            domIndex,
            dbIndex: Number(el.dataset.messageIndex)
        }))
        .filter(item => Number.isInteger(item.dbIndex) && item.dbIndex >= 0);

    if (sortable.length !== messages.length) return;

    const sorted = [...sortable].sort((a, b) => {
        if (a.dbIndex !== b.dbIndex) return a.dbIndex - b.dbIndex;
        return a.domIndex - b.domIndex;
    });

    const alreadySorted = sorted.every((item, index) => item.el === messages[index]);
    if (alreadySorted) return;

    const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
    sorted.forEach(item => fragment.appendChild(item.el));
    chatMessagesEl.appendChild(fragment);
}

function getMessageUidTimeKey(msg) {
    const uid = String(msg?.uid || '');
    const match = uid.match(/^msg_([a-z0-9]+)_/i);
    if (!match) return null;

    const time = parseInt(match[1], 36);
    return Number.isFinite(time) ? time : null;
}

function getValidMessageInsertIndex(insertIndex, maxLength = Infinity) {
    if (insertIndex === null || insertIndex === undefined || insertIndex === '') return null;

    const numericIndex = Number(insertIndex);
    if (!Number.isInteger(numericIndex) || numericIndex < 0) return null;

    if (Number.isFinite(maxLength) && numericIndex > maxLength) return null;

    return numericIndex;
}

function getMessageCreatedTimeKey(msg) {
    const createdTime = Date.parse(msg?.createdAt || '');
    return Number.isFinite(createdTime) ? createdTime : null;
}

function getMessageChronologyRepairKey(msg) {
    const createdTime = getMessageCreatedTimeKey(msg);
    if (Number.isFinite(createdTime)) return createdTime;

    const uidTime = getMessageUidTimeKey(msg);
    if (Number.isFinite(uidTime)) return uidTime;

    const explicitKey = Number(msg?.sortKey);
    if (Number.isFinite(explicitKey)) return explicitKey;

    return null;
}

function compareMessageEntriesByChronology(a, b) {
    const aCreated = getMessageCreatedTimeKey(a.msg);
    const bCreated = getMessageCreatedTimeKey(b.msg);

    if (Number.isFinite(aCreated) && Number.isFinite(bCreated) && aCreated !== bCreated) {
        return aCreated - bCreated;
    }

    const aUidTime = getMessageUidTimeKey(a.msg);
    const bUidTime = getMessageUidTimeKey(b.msg);

    if (Number.isFinite(aUidTime) && Number.isFinite(bUidTime) && aUidTime !== bUidTime) {
        return aUidTime - bUidTime;
    }

    const aSortKey = Number(a.msg?.sortKey);
    const bSortKey = Number(b.msg?.sortKey);

    if (Number.isFinite(aSortKey) && Number.isFinite(bSortKey) && aSortKey !== bSortKey) {
        return aSortKey - bSortKey;
    }

    return a.index - b.index;
}

function getNextMessageSortKey(messages) {
    const keys = messages
        .map(msg => Number(msg?.sortKey))
        .filter(Number.isFinite);

    if (!keys.length) return messages.length;

    return Math.max(...keys) + 1;
}

function getInsertedMessageSortKey(messages, insertIndex) {
    const numericIndex = getValidMessageInsertIndex(insertIndex, messages.length);

    if (numericIndex === null || numericIndex >= messages.length) {
        return getNextMessageSortKey(messages);
    }

    const prevKey = Number(messages[numericIndex - 1]?.sortKey);
    const nextKey = Number(messages[numericIndex]?.sortKey);

    if (Number.isFinite(prevKey) && Number.isFinite(nextKey)) {
        return prevKey + ((nextKey - prevKey) / 2);
    }

    if (Number.isFinite(prevKey)) return prevKey + 1;
    if (Number.isFinite(nextKey)) return nextKey - 1;

    return numericIndex;
}

function reindexMessageSortKeys(messages) {
    let changed = false;

    messages.forEach((msg, index) => {
        if (Number(msg?.sortKey) !== index) {
            msg.sortKey = index;
            changed = true;
        }
    });

    return changed;
}

function repairFullyReversedMessageArray(chatData) {
    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    if (messages.length < 2) return false;

    let changed = false;
    let sorted = null;

    const entries = messages.map((msg, index) => ({ msg, index }));
    const chronologyKeys = entries.map(entry => getMessageChronologyRepairKey(entry.msg));
    const hasChronologyKeys = chronologyKeys.every(Number.isFinite);

    if (hasChronologyKeys) {
        sorted = [...entries]
            .sort(compareMessageEntriesByChronology)
            .map(entry => entry.msg);
    } else if (messages.every(msg => Number.isFinite(Number(msg?.sortKey)))) {
        sorted = [...messages].sort((a, b) => Number(a.sortKey) - Number(b.sortKey));
    }

    if (sorted) {
        const alreadySorted = sorted.every((msg, index) => msg === messages[index]);

        if (!alreadySorted) {
            messages.splice(0, messages.length, ...sorted);
            changed = true;
        }
    }

    if (reindexMessageSortKeys(messages)) {
        changed = true;
    }

    return changed;
}

function normalizeChatMessageStorage(chatData) {
