    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    if (!messages.length) return false;

    let changed = false;

    // First repair order using existing real evidence:
    // createdAt > old uid time > existing sortKey > current array order.
    if (
        typeof repairFullyReversedMessageArray === 'function' &&
        repairFullyReversedMessageArray(chatData)
    ) {
        changed = true;
    }

    // Then add missing UID after the order is stable.
    // This avoids newly-generated UIDs becoming fake chronology.
    messages.forEach(msg => {
        if (!msg.uid) {
            msg.uid = generateUID('msg');
            changed = true;
        }
    });

    // Final guarantee for ancient logs:
    // even if there was no date/uid/sortKey, keep current file order and give it stable indexes.
    messages.forEach((msg, index) => {
        if (Number(msg?.sortKey) !== index) {
            msg.sortKey = index;
            changed = true;
        }
    });

    if (changed) {
        applyFuraiMessageMutationToChatData(chatData, 0, 'repair');
    }
    return changed;
}

function findMessageInsertSiblingByDbIndex(insertIndex) {
    const targetIndex = Number(insertIndex);
    if (!Number.isInteger(targetIndex) || targetIndex < 0) return null;

    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    if (!chatMessagesEl) return null;

    const visibleMessages = Array.from(chatMessagesEl.querySelectorAll('.message'))
        .filter(m => !m.id.startsWith('typing-') && m.id !== 'personality-selector-message');

    return visibleMessages.find(messageEl => {
        const dbIndex = Number(messageEl.dataset.messageIndex);
        return Number.isInteger(dbIndex) && dbIndex >= targetIndex;
    }) || null;
}

function findMessageInsertSiblingByUid(messageUid) {
    const targetUid = String(messageUid || '').trim();
    if (!targetUid) return null;

    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    if (!chatMessagesEl) return null;

    const visibleMessages = Array.from(chatMessagesEl.querySelectorAll('.message'))
        .filter(m => !m.id.startsWith('typing-') && m.id !== 'personality-selector-message');

    return visibleMessages.find(messageEl => {
        return String(messageEl.dataset.messageUid || '').trim() === targetUid;
    }) || null;
}

function refreshVisibleMessageDomIndexes(startIndex = null, delta = 0) {
    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    if (!chatMessagesEl) return;

    const visibleMessages = Array.from(chatMessagesEl.querySelectorAll('.message'))
        .filter(m => !m.id.startsWith('typing-') && m.id !== 'personality-selector-message');

    visibleMessages.forEach(messageEl => {
        const currentIndex = Number(messageEl.dataset.messageIndex);
        if (!Number.isInteger(currentIndex)) return;
        if (startIndex === null || currentIndex > startIndex) {
            messageEl.dataset.messageIndex = String(currentIndex + delta);
        }
    });
}

function cleanupOlderMessageLoader(chatMessagesEl) {
    if (!chatMessagesEl) return;

    if (chatMessagesEl._furaiOlderLoadHandler) {
        chatMessagesEl.removeEventListener('scroll', chatMessagesEl._furaiOlderLoadHandler);
        chatMessagesEl._furaiOlderLoadHandler = null;
    }

    delete chatMessagesEl.dataset.loadedStartIndex;
    delete chatMessagesEl.dataset.loadingOlder;
}

function showOlderMessageLoadingNotice(chatMessagesEl) {
    if (!chatMessagesEl) return null;

    let notice = chatMessagesEl.querySelector('.furai-older-load-notice');
    if (notice) return notice;

    notice = document.createElement('div');
    notice.className = 'furai-older-load-notice';
    notice.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
    notice.innerHTML = `
        <span class="sidebar-load-spinner"></span>
        <span class="sidebar-load-text">Loading messages...</span>
    `;

    chatMessagesEl.insertBefore(notice, chatMessagesEl.firstChild);
    return notice;
}

function removeOlderMessageLoadingNotice(chatMessagesEl) {
    const notice = chatMessagesEl?.querySelector('.furai-older-load-notice');
    if (notice) notice.remove();
}

function bindOlderMessageLoader(chatId, messages, loadedStartIndex, token) {
    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    if (!chatMessagesEl) return;

    cleanupOlderMessageLoader(chatMessagesEl);

    if (loadedStartIndex <= 0) return;

    chatMessagesEl.dataset.loadedStartIndex = String(loadedStartIndex);

    chatMessagesEl._furaiOlderLoadHandler = () => {
        if (token !== furaiChatHydrateToken || chatId !== currentChatId) {
            cleanupOlderMessageLoader(chatMessagesEl);
            return;
        }

        if (chatMessagesEl.dataset.loadingOlder === '1') return;
        if (chatMessagesEl.scrollTop > FURAI_OLDER_LOAD_TOP_EDGE) return;

        chatMessagesEl.dataset.loadingOlder = '1';
        
        const loadingNotice = showOlderMessageLoadingNotice(chatMessagesEl);
        
        setTimeout(() => {
            const currentStart = Number(chatMessagesEl.dataset.loadedStartIndex);
            if (!Number.isInteger(currentStart) || currentStart <= 0) {
                removeOlderMessageLoadingNotice(chatMessagesEl);
                cleanupOlderMessageLoader(chatMessagesEl);
                return;
            }
        
            const nextStart = Math.max(0, currentStart - FURAI_OLDER_LOAD_CHUNK_SIZE);
            const oldScrollHeight = chatMessagesEl.scrollHeight;
            const oldScrollTop = chatMessagesEl.scrollTop;
            const firstMessage = chatMessagesEl.querySelector('.message');
            const fragment = renderMessageSliceToFragment(messages, nextStart, currentStart);
        
            if (loadingNotice) loadingNotice.remove();
        
            chatMessagesEl.insertBefore(fragment, firstMessage || chatMessagesEl.firstChild);

            if (typeof normalizeRenderedMessageOrder === 'function') {
                normalizeRenderedMessageOrder(chatMessagesEl);
            }

            chatMessagesEl.scrollTop = oldScrollTop + (chatMessagesEl.scrollHeight - oldScrollHeight);
            chatMessagesEl.dataset.loadedStartIndex = String(nextStart);
            chatMessagesEl.dataset.loadingOlder = '0';
            if (typeof queueFuraiContextMetaRender === 'function') queueFuraiContextMetaRender();
        
            if (nextStart <= 0) cleanupOlderMessageLoader(chatMessagesEl);
        }, 90);
    };

    chatMessagesEl.addEventListener('scroll', chatMessagesEl._furaiOlderLoadHandler, { passive: true });
}


const FURAI_CONTEXT_META_KEY = 'furai_context_meta_enabled_v1';

function getFuraiContextMetaEnabled() {
    try {
        const saved = DB.get(FURAI_CONTEXT_META_KEY);
        return saved === true || saved === 'true';
    } catch(e) {
        return localStorage.getItem(FURAI_CONTEXT_META_KEY) === 'true';
    }
}

function applyFuraiContextMetaState(enabled) {
    const value = !!enabled;

    document.body.classList.toggle('furai-context-meta-on', value);

    if (value) {
        queueFuraiContextMetaRender();
    } else {
        removeFuraiContextMetaUI();
    }

    return value;
}

function syncFuraiContextMetaState() {
    return applyFuraiContextMetaState(getFuraiContextMetaEnabled());
}

function setFuraiContextMetaEnabled(enabled) {
    const value = !!enabled;

    try { DB.set(FURAI_CONTEXT_META_KEY, value); }
    catch(e) { localStorage.setItem(FURAI_CONTEXT_META_KEY, value ? 'true' : 'false'); }

    applyFuraiContextMetaState(value);
}

function previewFuraiContextMetaSetting(enabled) {
    applyFuraiContextMetaState(enabled);
}

function initFuraiContextMetaSetting() {
    syncFuraiContextMetaState();
}

function isFuraiCountableMessageData(msg) {
    return !!(msg && typeof msg === 'object' && String(msg.content || '').trim());
}

function invalidateFuraiContextMetaCountCache(chatId = currentChatId) {
    const cached = window.furaiContextMetaCountCache;
    if (!chatId || !cached || cached.chatId === chatId) {
        window.furaiContextMetaCountCache = null;
    }
}

function getFuraiContextMetaCountCache(chatId = currentChatId) {
    if (!chatId) return { total: 0, byIndex: new Map(), byUid: new Map() };

    let chatData = null;
    try { chatData = DB.get(chatId); } catch(e) {}

    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    const first = messages[0] || null;
    const middle = messages[Math.floor(messages.length / 2)] || null;
    const last = messages[messages.length - 1] || null;
    const sig = [
        messages.length,
        chatData?.timestamp || chatData?.updatedAt || chatData?.lastUpdated || '',
        first?.uid || '',
        middle?.uid || '',
        last?.uid || '',
        String(last?.content || '').length
    ].join('|');

    const cached = window.furaiContextMetaCountCache;
    if (cached && cached.chatId === chatId && cached.sig === sig) return cached;

    const byIndex = new Map();
    const byUid = new Map();
    let total = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < messages.length; i++) {
        const msg = messages[i];
        if (!isFuraiCountableMessageData(msg)) continue;
        total++;
        byIndex.set(i, total);
        if (msg?.uid) byUid.set(String(msg.uid), total);
    }

    const next = { chatId, sig, total, byIndex, byUid };
    window.furaiContextMetaCountCache = next;
    return next;
}

function getFuraiCountableMessageDataCount(chatData) {
    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    let count = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < messages.length; i++) {
        if (isFuraiCountableMessageData(messages[i])) count++;
    }
    return count;
}

function getFuraiCountableDbTotal(chatId = currentChatId) {
    return getFuraiContextMetaCountCache(chatId).total || 0;
}

function getFuraiMessageDisplayOrdinal(messageEl, fallbackOrdinal = 0) {
    const cache = getFuraiContextMetaCountCache(currentChatId);
    const rawUid = String(messageEl?.dataset?.messageUid || '').trim();
    if (rawUid && cache.byUid.has(rawUid)) return cache.byUid.get(rawUid);

    const rawIndex = Number(messageEl?.dataset?.messageIndex);
    if (Number.isInteger(rawIndex) && rawIndex >= 0 && cache.byIndex.has(rawIndex)) {
        return cache.byIndex.get(rawIndex);
    }

    return fallbackOrdinal;
}

function getFuraiCountableRenderedMessageEls() {
    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    if (!chatMessagesEl) return [];

    return Array.from(chatMessagesEl.querySelectorAll('.message')).filter(m =>
        m.id !== 'personality-selector-message' &&
        !m.id.startsWith('typing-') &&
        !m.classList.contains('is-regenerating-replaced') &&
        !m.classList.contains('furai-context-boundary-divider')
    );
}

function removeFuraiContextMetaUI() {
    document.querySelectorAll('#chatMessagesEl .content[data-furai-message-count]').forEach(el => {
        delete el.dataset.furaiMessageCount;
        el.removeAttribute('title');
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.furai-message-count-chip').forEach(el => el.remove());
    document.querySelectorAll('.furai-context-boundary-divider').forEach(el => el.remove());
    const vnBoundaryLabel = document.getElementById('vnContextBoundaryLabel');
    if (vnBoundaryLabel) vnBoundaryLabel.style.display = 'none';
}

function updateFuraiMessageCountBadges() {
    if (!getFuraiContextMetaEnabled()) return;

    const rendered = getFuraiCountableRenderedMessageEls();
    const total = getFuraiCountableDbTotal(currentChatId) || rendered.length;

    rendered.forEach((messageEl, i) => {
        if (isLiveTypingMessage(messageEl)) return;

        const content = messageEl.querySelector('.content');
        if (!content) return;

        const ordinal = getFuraiMessageDisplayOrdinal(messageEl, i + 1);
        content.dataset.furaiMessageCount = `#${ordinal}`;
        content.title = total ? `Message ${ordinal} of ${total}` : `Message ${ordinal}`;
    });
}

const FURAI_CONTEXT_FIT_META_PREFIX = 'furai_context_fit_';

function getFuraiContextFitMetaKey(chatId = currentChatId) {
    return chatId ? `${FURAI_CONTEXT_FIT_META_PREFIX}${chatId}` : '';
}

function saveFuraiContextFitMeta(meta = {}) {
    const chatId = meta.chatId || currentChatId;
    const key = getFuraiContextFitMetaKey(chatId);
    if (!key) return null;

    const clean = {
        version: 2,
        chatId,
        generatedAt: Number(meta.generatedAt) || Date.now(),
        contextWindow: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(meta.contextWindow) || 0)),
        historyBudget: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(meta.historyBudget) || 0)),
        historyUsed: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(meta.historyUsed) || 0)),
        sourceCount: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(meta.sourceCount) || 0)),
        keptCount: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(meta.keptCount) || 0)),
        droppedCount: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(meta.droppedCount) || 0)),
        firstLiveIndex: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(meta.firstLiveIndex) || 0)),
        firstLiveUid: String(meta.firstLiveUid || '').trim(),
        totalMessages: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(meta.totalMessages) || 0)),
        summarizedBeforeIndex: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(meta.summarizedBeforeIndex) || 0)),
        trimmed: meta.trimmed === true,
        hasBoundary: meta.hasBoundary === true || meta.trimmed === true || Number(meta.summarizedBeforeIndex) > 0,
        boundaryMode: String(meta.boundaryMode || (meta.trimmed === true ? 'trim' : 'summary'))
    };

    window.furaiLastContextFitMeta = clean;
    try { DB.set(key, clean); } catch(e) {}
    return clean;
}

function getFuraiContextFitMeta(chatId = currentChatId) {
    if (!chatId) return null;

    const cached = window.furaiLastContextFitMeta;
    if (cached && cached.chatId === chatId) return cached;

    const key = getFuraiContextFitMetaKey(chatId);
    if (!key) return null;

    try {
        const saved = DB.get(key);
        if (saved && saved.chatId === chatId) {
            window.furaiLastContextFitMeta = saved;
            return saved;
        }
    } catch(e) {}

    return null;
}

function clearFuraiPromptContextBoundary(chatId = currentChatId) {
    if (!window.furaiPromptContextBoundary) return;
    if (!chatId || window.furaiPromptContextBoundary.chatId === chatId) {
        window.furaiPromptContextBoundary = null;
    }
}

function getFuraiContextBoundaryText(mode) {
    return mode === 'summary' ? 'Full-detail context starts here' : 'Context Window';
}

function setFuraiPromptContextBoundary(meta = {}) {
    const chatId = meta.chatId || currentChatId;
    if (!chatId) return;

    const firstLiveIndex = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(meta.firstLiveIndex) || 0));
    const totalMessages = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(meta.totalMessages) || 0));
    if (!totalMessages || firstLiveIndex <= 0 || firstLiveIndex >= totalMessages) {
        clearFuraiPromptContextBoundary(chatId);
        return;
    }

    const mode = String(meta.mode || 'trim');
    window.furaiPromptContextBoundary = {
        chatId, firstLiveIndex,
        firstLiveUid: String(meta.firstLiveUid || '').trim(),
        totalMessages, mode,
        text: getFuraiContextBoundaryText(mode),
        dropped: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(meta.dropped) || firstLiveIndex)),
        updatedAt: Date.now()
    };
}

function getFuraiPromptContextBoundary(chatId = currentChatId) {
    const boundary = window.furaiPromptContextBoundary;
    if (boundary?.chatId === chatId) return boundary;

    const fit = getFuraiContextFitMeta(chatId);
    const hasBoundary = fit?.hasBoundary === true || fit?.trimmed === true || Number(fit?.summarizedBeforeIndex) > 0;
    if (!fit || !hasBoundary || !fit.firstLiveUid || fit.firstLiveIndex <= 0) return null;

    const mode = fit.boundaryMode || (fit.trimmed === true ? 'trim' : 'summary');
    const restored = {
        chatId,
        firstLiveIndex: fit.firstLiveIndex,
        firstLiveUid: fit.firstLiveUid,
        totalMessages: fit.totalMessages,
        mode,
        text: getFuraiContextBoundaryText(mode),
        dropped: fit.droppedCount,
        updatedAt: fit.generatedAt
    };
    window.furaiPromptContextBoundary = restored;
    return restored;
}

function getFuraiPreviewContextBoundary(chatId = currentChatId) {
    if (!chatId) return null;
    const chatData = DB.get(chatId);
    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    const profile = typeof getChatProfile === 'function' ? getChatProfile(chatId) : null;
    if (!messages.length || !profile) return null;

    const personality = chatPersonalities?.[chatId] || chatData?.personality || 'researcher';
    const isGroupLike = personality === 'group' || personality === 'maker';
    const botProfile = profile?.bots?.[0] || { name: 'AI' };
    const mapMessage = msg => isGroupLike
        ? mapGroupContextMessage(msg, profile)
        : mapSoloContextMessage(msg, profile, botProfile);
    const sourceMessages = messages.filter(msg => !shouldSkipAiContextMessageRole(msg?.role));
    const mappedMessages = sourceMessages.map(mapMessage).filter(Boolean);
    const tokens = calculateContextTokens();
    const historyBudget = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(tokens?.historyRoom) || 1));
    const noSummaryBudget = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(tokens?.historyRoomWithoutSummary) || historyBudget));
    const summaryBlocks = Array.isArray(chatData.summaryBlocks)
        ? chatData.summaryBlocks.filter(block => !block?.stale && String(block?.text || '').trim())
        : [];
    const lastBlock = summaryBlocks[summaryBlocks.length - 1];
    const lastSummarizedIndex = getFuraiSummaryAnchorIndex(chatData, messages);
    const lastMessageUid = String(messages[messages.length - 1]?.uid || '');
    const summarySignature = `${lastBlock?.endMessageUid || ''}:${lastBlock?.endIndex ?? ''}:${summaryBlocks.length}`;
    const cacheKey = `${chatId}|${messages.length}|${lastMessageUid}|${historyBudget}|${noSummaryBudget}|${personality}|${summarySignature}`;
    const cached = window.furaiPreviewContextBoundaryCache;
    if (cached?.key === cacheKey) return cached.value || null;

    const previousFitStats = window.furaiLastHistoryFitStats;
    buildTruncatedHistoryByTokens(mappedMessages, noSummaryBudget);
    const fullFit = { ...(window.furaiLastHistoryFitStats || {}) };
    if (!Number(fullFit.droppedCount)) {
        window.furaiLastHistoryFitStats = previousFitStats;
        window.furaiPreviewContextBoundaryCache = { key: cacheKey, value: null };
        return null;
    }

    buildTruncatedHistoryByTokens(mappedMessages, historyBudget);
    const fitStats = { ...(window.furaiLastHistoryFitStats || {}) };
    window.furaiLastHistoryFitStats = previousFitStats;

    const firstKeptIndex = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(fitStats.firstKeptIndex) || 0));
    const firstLiveSource = sourceMessages[firstKeptIndex] || null;
    const firstLiveUid = String(firstLiveSource?.uid || '').trim();
    let firstLiveIndex = firstKeptIndex;
    if (firstLiveUid) {
        const uidIndex = messages.findIndex(msg => String(msg?.uid || '') === firstLiveUid);
        if (uidIndex !== -1) firstLiveIndex = uidIndex;
    }

    const summaryCoversDropped = lastSummarizedIndex >= 0 && firstLiveIndex <= lastSummarizedIndex + 1;
    const mode = summaryCoversDropped ? 'summary' : 'trim';
    const value = {
        chatId, firstLiveIndex, firstLiveUid,
        totalMessages: messages.length,
        mode,
        text: getFuraiContextBoundaryText(mode),
        dropped: firstLiveIndex,
        updatedAt: Date.now(),
        estimated: true
    };
    window.furaiPreviewContextBoundaryCache = { key: cacheKey, value };
    return value;
}

function getFuraiAvailableContextBoundary(chatId = currentChatId) {
    const exact = getFuraiPromptContextBoundary(chatId);
    if (exact) {
        const chatData = DB.get(chatId) || {};
        const fit = getFuraiContextFitMeta(chatId);
        const currentTotal = Array.isArray(chatData.messages) ? chatData.messages.length : 0;
        const sameWindow = !fit?.contextWindow || fit.contextWindow === getFuraiContextWindow();
        const legacySummaryBoundary = Number(fit?.version || 1) < 2 && chatId === currentChatId && calculateContextTokens().summaryDormant;
        if (!legacySummaryBoundary && sameWindow && (!currentTotal || exact.totalMessages === currentTotal)) return exact;
    }
    return getFuraiPreviewContextBoundary(chatId);
}

function getFuraiContextJumpButtonHtml() {
    const boundary = getFuraiAvailableContextBoundary();
    if (!boundary) return '';
    const title = boundary.mode === 'summary'
        ? 'Jump to the first message kept in full detail; earlier chat is represented by Summary'
        : 'Jump to the first message inside the current AI context window';

    return `<button type="button"
                   onclick="jumpToFuraiContextWindow()"
                   title="${title}"
                   style="width:100%; padding:9px 11px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--border-color); background:var(--input-bg); color:var(--text-color); cursor:pointer; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:7px; font-size:13px; font-weight:500;">
               <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right-to-bracket"></i>
               <span>Jump to Context Window</span>
           </button>`;
}

function renderFuraiContextJumpButtonInto(targetId) {
    const target = document.getElementById(targetId);
    if (!target) return;

    const html = getFuraiContextJumpButtonHtml();
    target.innerHTML = html;
    target.style.display = html ? '' : 'none';
}

function getFuraiBoundaryTargetMessageEl() {
    const boundary = getFuraiAvailableContextBoundary();
    if (!boundary) return null;

    if (boundary.firstLiveUid && typeof findRenderedMessageByUid === 'function') {
        const byUid = findRenderedMessageByUid(boundary.firstLiveUid);
        if (byUid) return byUid;
    }

    const rendered = getFuraiCountableRenderedMessageEls();
    for (let i = 0; i < rendered.length; i++) {
        const idx = Number(rendered[i].dataset.messageIndex);
        // Only show the divider when the exact first live-context message is currently rendered.
        // This prevents confusing it with unloaded old-history hydration at the top of long chats.
        if (Number.isInteger(idx) && idx === boundary.firstLiveIndex) return rendered[i];
    }

    return null;
}

async function ensureFuraiContextBoundaryTargetRendered(boundary = getFuraiAvailableContextBoundary()) {
    if (!boundary || !currentChatId) return null;

    let target = getFuraiBoundaryTargetMessageEl();
    if (target) return target;

    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId) || {};
    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    if (!chatMessagesEl || !messages.length) return null;

    let targetIndex = Number(boundary.firstLiveIndex);
    if (boundary.firstLiveUid) {
        const uidIndex = messages.findIndex(msg => String(msg?.uid || '') === boundary.firstLiveUid);
        if (uidIndex !== -1) targetIndex = uidIndex;
    }

    if (!Number.isInteger(targetIndex) || targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= messages.length) return null;

    let loadedStart = Number(chatMessagesEl.dataset.loadedStartIndex);
    if (!Number.isInteger(loadedStart) || loadedStart <= targetIndex) return getFuraiBoundaryTargetMessageEl();

    while (loadedStart > targetIndex && currentChatId === boundary.chatId) {
        const nextStart = Math.max(targetIndex, loadedStart - FURAI_OLDER_LOAD_CHUNK_SIZE);
        const firstMessage = chatMessagesEl.querySelector('.message');
        const fragment = renderMessageSliceToFragment(messages, nextStart, loadedStart);
        chatMessagesEl.insertBefore(fragment, firstMessage || chatMessagesEl.firstChild);
        loadedStart = nextStart;
        chatMessagesEl.dataset.loadedStartIndex = String(loadedStart);
        await new Promise(resolve => requestAnimationFrame(resolve));
    }

    if (typeof normalizeRenderedMessageOrder === 'function') {
        normalizeRenderedMessageOrder(chatMessagesEl);
    }
    if (typeof queueFuraiContextMetaRender === 'function') queueFuraiContextMetaRender();

    return getFuraiBoundaryTargetMessageEl();
}

async function jumpToFuraiContextWindow() {
    const boundary = getFuraiAvailableContextBoundary();
    if (!boundary) {
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('All recent history currently fits in the context window.', 'info');
        return;
    }

    const target = await ensureFuraiContextBoundaryTargetRendered(boundary);
    if (!target) {
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Context Window marker is not available in the loaded chat.', 'warning');
        return;
    }

    const tokenModal = document.getElementById('tokenModalEl');
    if (tokenModal?.style.display !== 'none' && typeof closeTokenModal === 'function') closeTokenModal();

    const summaryModal = document.getElementById('summaryModalEl');
    if (summaryModal?.style.display !== 'none' && typeof closeSummaryModal === 'function') closeSummaryModal();

    setVnSceneTargetFromElement(target, { autoScroll: false, userLocked: true });

    if (document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) {
        renderVnMessage('top');
    } else {
        renderFuraiContextBoundaryDivider(true);
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            const divider = document.querySelector('.furai-context-boundary-divider');
            scrollFuraiMessageIntoCrView(divider || target, 'center');
        });
    }
}

function renderFuraiContextBoundaryDivider(force = false) {
    // The CR divider is mode-specific. Clear any stale instance before
    // deciding whether CR is currently visible.
    document.querySelectorAll('.furai-context-boundary-divider').forEach(el => el.remove());

    if (document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return;
    if (!force && !getFuraiContextMetaEnabled()) return;

    const boundary = getFuraiAvailableContextBoundary();
    if (!boundary) return;

    const target = getFuraiBoundaryTargetMessageEl();
    if (!target || !target.parentNode) return;

    const divider = document.createElement('div');
    divider.className = 'furai-context-boundary-divider';
    divider.dataset.contextBoundary = 'true';
    divider.innerHTML = `<span class="furai-context-boundary-label">${boundary.text || getFuraiContextBoundaryText(boundary.mode)}</span>`;

    target.parentNode.insertBefore(divider, target);
}

function getFuraiVnMessageOrdinal(messageEl) {
    if (!getFuraiContextMetaEnabled() || !messageEl) return 0;
    return getFuraiMessageDisplayOrdinal(messageEl, 0) || 0;
}

function isFuraiVnContextBoundaryMessage(messageEl) {
    if (!getFuraiContextMetaEnabled() || !messageEl) return false;

    const boundary = getFuraiAvailableContextBoundary();
    if (!boundary || boundary.chatId !== currentChatId) return false;

    const uid = String(messageEl.dataset?.messageUid || '').trim();
    if (boundary.firstLiveUid && uid) {
        return uid === boundary.firstLiveUid;
    }

    const messageIndex = Number(messageEl.dataset?.messageIndex);
    return Number.isInteger(messageIndex) && messageIndex === boundary.firstLiveIndex;
}

function renderFuraiVnContextBoundaryLabel(messageEl = null) {
    const label = document.getElementById('vnContextBoundaryLabel');
    if (!label) return;

    const target = messageEl || (
        typeof getVnCurrentMessageElement === 'function'
            ? getVnCurrentMessageElement()
            : null
    );

    const visible = document.body.classList.contains('vn-active') &&
        isFuraiVnContextBoundaryMessage(target);
    const boundary = visible ? getFuraiAvailableContextBoundary() : null;
    if (boundary) label.textContent = boundary.text || getFuraiContextBoundaryText(boundary.mode);
    label.style.display = visible ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
}

function queueFuraiContextMetaRender() {
    if (window.furaiContextMetaRenderQueued) return;
    window.furaiContextMetaRenderQueued = true;

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        window.furaiContextMetaRenderQueued = false;
        if (!syncFuraiContextMetaState()) {
            removeFuraiContextMetaUI();
            return;
        }

        updateFuraiMessageCountBadges();

        if (document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) {
            renderFuraiContextBoundaryDivider();
            renderFuraiVnContextBoundaryLabel();
        } else {
            const vnBoundaryLabel = document.getElementById('vnContextBoundaryLabel');
            if (vnBoundaryLabel) vnBoundaryLabel.style.display = 'none';
            renderFuraiContextBoundaryDivider();
        }
    });
}

function addMessageDOM(role, content, botIndex = null, insertIndex = null, meta = null) {
    const messageEl = document.createElement('div');

    const isAnnouncementAgent = role === 'ai' && meta?.announcementAgent === true;
    const visualRole = role === 'cutscene' ? 'muted-note' : role;
    messageEl.className = `message ${visualRole}`;
    if (isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(role) || isAnnouncementAgent) messageEl.classList.add('narrator');
    messageEl.classList.toggle('furai-announcement-agent', isAnnouncementAgent);

    if (isAnnouncementAgent) messageEl.dataset.announcementAgent = 'true';

    const messageIndex = Number(meta?.messageIndex);
    if (Number.isInteger(messageIndex) && messageIndex >= 0) {
        messageEl.dataset.messageIndex = String(messageIndex);
    }

    const sortKey = Number(meta?.sortKey);
    if (Number.isFinite(sortKey)) {
        messageEl.dataset.sortKey = String(sortKey);
    }
    
    if (meta?.messageUid) {
        messageEl.dataset.messageUid = meta.messageUid;
    }
    if (meta?.userUid) messageEl.dataset.userUid = String(meta.userUid);
    if (meta?.botUid) messageEl.dataset.botUid = String(meta.botUid);
    
    if (role === 'ai' && botIndex !== null) {
        messageEl.dataset.botIndex = String(botIndex);
    }
    
    const createdAt = String(meta?.createdAt || '').trim();

    if (createdAt) {
        messageEl.dataset.createdAt = createdAt;
    }

    if (role === 'cutscene') {
        messageEl.classList.add('cutscene');
        messageEl.dataset.role = 'cutscene';
    } else if (role === 'muted-note') {
        messageEl.dataset.role = 'muted-note';
    } else if (isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(role)) {
        messageEl.dataset.role = role;
    }
    
    const profile = getFastRenderProfile(currentChatId);
    let profileData = null;
    let messageEmotion = String(meta?.emotion || '').trim();
    const mutedNoteSpeakerName = role === 'muted-note'
        ? getFuraiMutedNoteSpeakerName(meta, botIndex, currentChatId)
        : '';

    let showProfile = true; 
    if (chatPersonalities[currentChatId] !== 'group' && !profile.profileCustomized) {
        showProfile = true; 
    }

    if (role === 'user' || role === 'ai' || role === 'muted-note') {
        const messageMode = String(
            meta?.mode ||
            DB.get(currentChatId)?.personality ||
            chatPersonalities?.[currentChatId] ||
            'researcher'
        );
        messageEl.dataset.mode = messageMode;

        const messageRecord = {
            uid: meta?.messageUid || '',
            mode: messageMode,
            role,
            botIndex,
            userUid: meta?.userUid || '',
            botUid: meta?.botUid || '',
            userNameSnapshot: meta?.userNameSnapshot || '',
            botNameSnapshot: meta?.botNameSnapshot || '',
            silentNoteSpeakerName: meta?.silentNoteSpeakerName || ''
        };
        profileData = resolveFuraiActorForMessage(currentChatId, messageRecord, profile, messageIndex);
    }

    if (!messageEmotion && profileData) {
        messageEmotion = detectBotEmotion(content, profileData) || '';
    }

    if (messageEmotion) {
        messageEl.dataset.vnEmotion = messageEmotion;
    }
    
    if (profileData && !furaiBulkLoadingChat) {
        setTimeout(() => checkCollectionUnlock(profileData, content), 10);
    }
    
    const avatarEl = role !== 'muted-note' && !isAnnouncementAgent && showProfile && profileData
        ? createFuraiChatPortraitImage(profileData, messageEmotion)
        : null;

    if (avatarEl) {
        let description = "";
        if (role === 'user') {
            const mode = chatPersonalities[currentChatId] || 'researcher';
            if (profileData.instructions && profileData.instructions[mode]) {
                description = profileData.instructions[mode];
            } else {
                description = profileData.instruction || "User"; 
            }
        } else {
            description = profileData.instruction || "AI Character";
        }

        avatarEl.onclick = (e) => { 
            e.stopPropagation(); 
            const activeActor = getFuraiActiveRoleActor(profile, role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'ai', botIndex);
            const isActiveBlock = !!(activeActor?.uid && profileData?.uid && activeActor.uid === profileData.uid);
            const targetIdx = isActiveBlock ? ((role === 'user') ? 'user' : botIndex) : null;
            openProfileCard(profileData.name, avatarEl.currentSrc || avatarEl.src || profileData.avatar || '', description, profileData.hashTag, profileData.historicalFallback ? null : targetIdx, "", {
                preferFallbackAvatar: !!messageEmotion,
                portraitEmotion: messageEmotion || '',
                historicalActor: cloneFuraiData(profileData),
                historicalActorTarget: !isActiveBlock && !profileData.historicalFallback ? {
                    role: role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'ai',
                    botIndex,
                    actorUid: profileData.uid || ''
                } : null,
                ...getFuraiRenderedPortraitOptions(avatarEl)
            });
        };

        appendFuraiChatPortrait(messageEl, avatarEl);
    }
    
    const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
    wrapper.className = 'message-content-wrapper';

    if (role === 'muted-note') {
        const nameEl = document.createElement('div');
        nameEl.className = 'chat-username';
        nameEl.textContent = mutedNoteSpeakerName;
        wrapper.appendChild(nameEl);
        messageEl.dataset.speakerName = mutedNoteSpeakerName;
        messageEl.dataset.role = 'muted-note';
    } else if (!isAnnouncementAgent && showProfile && profileData && profileData.name) {
        const nameEl = document.createElement('div');
        nameEl.className = 'chat-username';
        nameEl.textContent = profileData.name;
        wrapper.appendChild(nameEl);
    } else if (role === 'cutscene') {
        const nameEl = document.createElement('div');
        nameEl.className = 'chat-username';
        nameEl.textContent = 'Cutscene';
        wrapper.appendChild(nameEl);
    }

    messageEl.appendChild(wrapper);
    appendTimestampToMessageHeader(wrapper, createdAt);

    const contentEl = document.createElement('div');
    contentEl.className = 'content';
    contentEl.innerHTML = formatMessageContent(content);
    wrapper.appendChild(contentEl);

    const announcementVisualRole = isAnnouncementAgent ? 'announcement' : role;
    if (isFuraiAnnouncementMessageRole(announcementVisualRole)) {
        placeFuraiAnnouncementHeaderInsideBubble(
            messageEl,
            announcementVisualRole,
            createdAt,
            getFuraiAnnouncementSpeakerName(announcementVisualRole, meta, botIndex, currentChatId)
        );
    }

    renderPinnedGeneratedImagesForMessage(messageEl, meta?.pinnedGeneratedImages);

    if (window.addMessageControls) window.addMessageControls(messageEl);

    if (typeof queueFuraiContextMetaRender === 'function') queueFuraiContextMetaRender();

    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    const vnBody = document.getElementById('vnMessageBody');
    const isBulkLoad = furaiBulkLoadingChat === true;
    const renderTarget = furaiMessageRenderTarget || chatMessagesEl;
    const isVnNow = document.body.classList.contains('vn-active');
    const isVnTurnBoundaryMessage = role === 'user' || meta?.vnTurnBoundary === true;

    const shouldForceSubmittedTurnToCr =
        !isBulkLoad &&
        insertIndex === null &&
        !isVnNow &&
        isVnTurnBoundaryMessage;

    const shouldStickMessageToCr =
        !isBulkLoad &&
        insertIndex === null &&
        !isVnNow &&
        (autoScroll || shouldForceSubmittedTurnToCr);

    const vnMessagesBeforeAdd = isVnNow && !isBulkLoad ? getVnRenderableMessages() : [];
    const vnNewestBeforeAdd = vnMessagesBeforeAdd[vnMessagesBeforeAdd.length - 1];
    const vnNewestBeforeAddIsTyping = isLiveTypingMessage(vnNewestBeforeAdd);
    const vnViewingLiveTypingBubble =
        vnNewestBeforeAddIsTyping &&
        isVnViewingMessageElement(vnNewestBeforeAdd);
    
    const shouldStickMessageToVn =
        !isBulkLoad &&
        insertIndex === null &&
        isVnNow &&
        (
            isVnTurnBoundaryMessage ||
            (
                vnAutoScroll &&
                isNearScrollBottom(vnBody) &&
                (
                    vnViewingLiveTypingBubble ||
                    (
                        !vnNewestBeforeAddIsTyping &&
                        isVnViewingNewestMessage()
                    )
                )
            )
        );
    
    const targetInsertIndex = getValidMessageInsertIndex(insertIndex);
    
    if (!isBulkLoad && targetInsertIndex !== null) {
        refreshVisibleMessageDomIndexes(targetInsertIndex - 1, 1);
    }
    
    const targetSibling = !isBulkLoad && targetInsertIndex !== null
        ? findMessageInsertSiblingByDbIndex(targetInsertIndex)
        : null;
    
    if (targetSibling) {
        chatMessagesEl.insertBefore(messageEl, targetSibling);
    } else {
        renderTarget.appendChild(messageEl);

        if (shouldStickMessageToCr) {
            autoScroll = true;
            scrollElementToBottom(chatMessagesEl);

            if (shouldForceSubmittedTurnToCr) {
                requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    scrollElementToBottom(chatMessagesEl);
                });
            }
        } else if (!isBulkLoad && !isVnNow) {
            showCrUnreadHint('New message');
        }
    }

    // User-sent turn boundary in VN mode. This is not normal auto-scroll;
    // it is the user's explicit submit action, so the VN camera must land on
    // this bubble before the AI thinking placeholder is allowed to exist.
    if (isVnNow && !isBulkLoad && insertIndex === null && isVnTurnBoundaryMessage) {
        syncVnData();
        setVnSceneTargetFromElement(messageEl, {
            autoScroll: true,
            userLocked: false
        });
        setVnPendingTurnAnchor(messageEl);
        vnUserMovedAwayThisSession = false;
        clearVnFinishedUnreadState();
        clearVnLiveReplyState();
        hideVnStatusHint('unread');
        renderVnMessage('bottom');
    }

    if (isVnNow && !isBulkLoad) {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            syncVnData();

            let targetIndex = getVnMessageIndex(messageEl);
            if (targetIndex < 0) targetIndex = getLastReadableMessageIndex();

            if (isVnTurnBoundaryMessage || isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(role) || role === 'system' || role === 'ai' || role === 'cutscene') {
                if (shouldStickMessageToVn) {
                    setVnSceneTargetFromElement(messageEl, {
                        autoScroll: true,
                        userLocked: false
                    });
                    vnUserMovedAwayThisSession = false;
                    renderVnMessage('bottom');

                    if (role !== 'user') hideVnStatusHint();
                } else {
                    vnAutoScroll = false;

                    const shouldUseFinishedVnUnread =
                        role === 'ai' ||
                        isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(role) ||
                        role === 'cutscene';

                    const didShowFinishedVnUnread =
                        shouldUseFinishedVnUnread &&
                        typeof showFinishedVnUnreadForMessage === 'function' &&
                        showFinishedVnUnreadForMessage(messageEl, 'New message');

                    if (!didShowFinishedVnUnread) showVnUnreadHint('New message');
                }
            
                window.lastUserActionTime = Date.now();
            }
        });
    }

    return messageEl;
}

// 2. THE WRAPPER (This intercepts calls to 'addMessage')
window.addMessage = function(role, content, botIndex = null, insertIndex = null, meta = null) {
    const liveMeta = { ...(meta || makeMessageTimestampMeta(currentChatId)) };
    if (!liveMeta.mode) {
        liveMeta.mode = String(
            DB.get(currentChatId)?.personality ||
            chatPersonalities?.[currentChatId] ||
            'researcher'
        );
    }

    if (!Number.isInteger(Number(liveMeta.messageIndex))) {
        try {
            const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
            const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
            const targetIndex = getValidMessageInsertIndex(insertIndex, messages.length);

            liveMeta.messageIndex = targetIndex !== null
                ? targetIndex
                : messages.length;
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    return addMessageDOM(role, content, botIndex, insertIndex, liveMeta);
};
  
function addTypingIndicator(id, botIndex, insertIndex = null, replaceMessageUid = '', actorProfile = null, createdAt = '') {
    hideFuraiRecallPreflightHint();
    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    const liveCreatedAt = String(createdAt || makeMessageTimestampMeta(currentChatId).createdAt || '').trim();
    const botProfile = actorProfile || profile?.bots?.[botIndex];
    const botStatus = getBotChatStatus(botProfile);
    const isMutedNote = botStatus === 'silent';
    const isAnnouncementAgent = botStatus === 'announcement';
    const speakerName = botProfile?.name || 'AI';

    const messageEl = document.createElement('div');
    messageEl.className = `message ${isMutedNote ? 'muted-note' : 'ai'}${isAnnouncementAgent ? ' narrator furai-announcement-agent' : ''} furai-active-ai-message`;
    messageEl.id = id;
    messageEl.dataset.botIndex = String(botIndex);
    if (botProfile?.uid) messageEl.dataset.botUid = String(botProfile.uid);
    messageEl.dataset.speakerName = speakerName;
    if (liveCreatedAt) messageEl.dataset.createdAt = liveCreatedAt;
    if (isMutedNote) messageEl.dataset.role = 'muted-note';
    if (isAnnouncementAgent) messageEl.dataset.announcementAgent = 'true';

    let pendingIndex = getValidMessageInsertIndex(insertIndex);
    if (pendingIndex === null) {
        try {
            const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
            const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
            pendingIndex = messages.length;
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    if (pendingIndex !== null && pendingIndex !== undefined) {
        messageEl.dataset.messageIndex = String(pendingIndex);
    }

    const pendingReplaceUid = String(replaceMessageUid || '').trim();
    if (pendingReplaceUid) {
        messageEl.dataset.replaceMessageUid = pendingReplaceUid;
    }

    // Avatar stays visible for ordinary AI typing so emotion switching still works.
    // Silent Note and Announcement agents use their final low-profile layouts
    // from the first rendered frame; Announcement still keeps its actor name.
    let showProfile = !isMutedNote && !isAnnouncementAgent;
    if (chatPersonalities[currentChatId] === 'group') {
        if (getBotChatStatus(botProfile) === 'idle') return;
    }

    const turnStartEmotion = botProfile
      ? getFuraiChatEmotionStatus(currentChatId, 'ai', botProfile, botIndex)
      : 'default';

    if (turnStartEmotion) {
      messageEl.dataset.vnEmotion = turnStartEmotion;
      messageEl.dataset.vnAvatarEmotion = turnStartEmotion;
    }

    const avatarEl = showProfile && botProfile
      ? createFuraiChatPortraitImage(botProfile, turnStartEmotion)
      : null;

    if (avatarEl) {
      avatarEl.onclick = (e) => { 
          e.stopPropagation(); 
          openProfileCard(
              botProfile.name,
              botProfile.avatar,
              botProfile.instruction || "AI Character",
              botProfile.hashTag,
              botIndex,
              "",
              getFuraiRenderedPortraitOptions(avatarEl)
          );
      };
      
      appendFuraiChatPortrait(messageEl, avatarEl);
    }

    const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
    wrapper.className = 'message-content-wrapper';
    
    if ((showProfile || isMutedNote || isAnnouncementAgent) && botProfile && botProfile.name) {
      const nameEl = document.createElement('div');
      nameEl.className = 'chat-username';
      nameEl.textContent = botProfile.name;
      wrapper.appendChild(nameEl);
    }
    
    const contentEl = document.createElement('div');
    contentEl.className = 'content';
    setFuraiMessageThinkingIndicator(contentEl);
    
    wrapper.appendChild(contentEl);
    messageEl.appendChild(wrapper);

    if (isMutedNote) {
        placeFuraiAnnouncementHeaderInsideBubble(messageEl, 'muted-note', liveCreatedAt, speakerName);
    } else if (isAnnouncementAgent) {
        placeFuraiAnnouncementHeaderInsideBubble(messageEl, 'announcement', liveCreatedAt, speakerName);
    }

    // Normal AI, Announcement agents, and Ghost/Silent Note all receive the
    // timestamp before the placeholder enters the document.
    ensureFuraiLiveMessageTimestamp(messageEl, liveCreatedAt);

    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');

    const isVnActive = document.body.classList.contains('vn-active');

    const shouldStickToBottom =
        !isVnActive &&
        autoScroll;

    const pendingVnTurnAnchorEl = isVnActive
        ? getVnPendingTurnAnchorElement()
        : null;

    const shouldFollowVnLiveBubble =
        isVnActive &&
        (
            (
                pendingVnTurnAnchorEl &&
                isVnViewingMessageElement(pendingVnTurnAnchorEl)
            ) ||
            shouldVnAutoFollowMessage()
        );
    
    const pendingVnAnchorIndex = pendingVnTurnAnchorEl
        ? getVnMessageIndex(pendingVnTurnAnchorEl)
        : (isVnActive ? vnCurrentIndex : -1);
    
    // Retry must anchor to the old message UID first.
    // insertIndex can be stale/zero during some retry paths, but the UID still points to the exact old bubble.
    const targetSibling =
        findMessageInsertSiblingByUid(pendingReplaceUid) ||
        (insertIndex !== null ? findMessageInsertSiblingByDbIndex(insertIndex) : null);
    
    if (targetSibling) {
        chatMessagesEl.insertBefore(messageEl, targetSibling);
    } else {
        chatMessagesEl.appendChild(messageEl);
        
        if (shouldStickToBottom) {
             autoScroll = true;
             hideCrBottomStatusPill();
             scrollElementToBottom(chatMessagesEl);
             requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                 scrollElementToBottom(chatMessagesEl, { respectUserBrake: true });
             });
        } else if (!isVnActive) {
             autoScroll = false;
             showCrTypingHint(speakerName);
        }
    }
    
    // Reassert after insertion so theme/layout observers cannot leave the live
    // header without its timestamp during the first painted frame.
    ensureFuraiLiveMessageTimestamp(messageEl, liveCreatedAt);

    // VN Mode Logic
    if (isVnActive) {
        syncVnData();
    
        const renderableMessages = getVnRenderableMessages();
        const msgIndex = renderableMessages.indexOf(messageEl);
        const botName = getVnSpeakerNameFromMessage(messageEl, speakerName);
    
        messageEl.dataset.vnPendingAutoFollow = shouldFollowVnLiveBubble && msgIndex !== -1 ? 'true' : 'false';
        messageEl.dataset.vnLiveAttached = 'false';
        messageEl.dataset.vnPendingAnchorIndex = String(pendingVnAnchorIndex);

        if (pendingVnTurnAnchorEl) {
            const pendingTurnUid = String(pendingVnTurnAnchorEl.dataset?.messageUid || '').trim();
            if (pendingTurnUid) messageEl.dataset.vnPendingTurnAnchorUid = pendingTurnUid;
        }

        // Thinking is a clickable hint/target, not an automatic camera handoff.
        // The VN camera remains on the user turn boundary until real streamed
        // text starts, then updateTypingIndicator() promotes this live bubble.
        showVnThinkingHint(botName, messageEl);
    }

    return pendingIndex;
}
  
function updateTypingIndicator(id, text, withTypingEffect = false, plainStreaming = false) {
    const messageEl = document.getElementById(id);
    if (messageEl) {
        let contentEl = messageEl.querySelector('.content');
        const isStartingToTalk = contentEl.classList.contains('furai-message-thinking');

        if (isStartingToTalk) {
            clearFuraiMessageThinkingIndicator(contentEl);
        }
        
        if (withTypingEffect && !contentEl.classList.contains('typing')) contentEl.classList.add('typing');

        const liveHtml = plainStreaming
            ? formatLiveTypingContent(text)
            : formatMessageContent(text);
        const preservedHeaderCount = setFuraiLiveContentHtml(contentEl, liveHtml);

        if (preservedHeaderCount === 0) {
            const liveRole = messageEl.dataset.announcementAgent === 'true'
                ? 'announcement'
                : messageEl.dataset.role === 'cutscene' || messageEl.classList.contains('cutscene')
                    ? 'cutscene'
                    : messageEl.dataset.role === 'muted-note' || messageEl.classList.contains('muted-note')
                        ? 'muted-note'
                        : '';

            if (liveRole) {
                placeFuraiAnnouncementHeaderInsideBubble(
                    messageEl,
                    liveRole,
                    messageEl.dataset.createdAt || '',
                    messageEl.dataset.speakerName || ''
                );
            }
        }

        // Streaming may replace the body, but never the timestamp contract.
        ensureFuraiLiveMessageTimestamp(
            messageEl,
            messageEl.dataset.createdAt || ''
        );
        
        const botIndex = messageEl.dataset.botIndex;
        const avatarEl = messageEl.querySelector('.chat-avatar');
        let activeTypingName = messageEl.dataset.speakerName || 'AI';
        
        if (botIndex !== undefined) {
            const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
            const parsedBotIndex = Number.parseInt(botIndex, 10);
            const actorUid = String(messageEl.dataset.botUid || '').trim();
            const botData = actorUid
                ? (resolveFuraiActorByUid(profile, actorUid, 'ai', parsedBotIndex) || profile?.bots?.[parsedBotIndex])
                : profile?.bots?.[parsedBotIndex];

            if (botData && botData.name) activeTypingName = botData.name;

            const previousEmotion = String(messageEl.dataset.vnEmotion || '').trim();
            const emotion = detectBotEmotion(text, botData);

            if (emotion) {
                messageEl.dataset.vnEmotion = emotion;
                messageEl.dataset.vnAvatarEmotion = emotion;

                const emotionAvatarUrl = emotion === 'default'
                    ? String(botData?.avatar || '')
                    : String(botData?.emotionAvatars?.[emotion] || botData?.avatar || '');

                if (avatarEl) {
                    applyFuraiChatPortrait(avatarEl, botData, emotion);
                    avatarEl.onclick = (e) => { 
                        e.stopPropagation(); 
                        openProfileCard(botData.name, emotionAvatarUrl, botData.instruction || "AI Character", botData.hashTag, parsedBotIndex, "", {
                            preferFallbackAvatar: true,
                            portraitEmotion: emotion,
                            ...getFuraiRenderedPortraitOptions(avatarEl)
                        });
                    };
                }

                if (
                    document.body.classList.contains('vn-active') &&
                    typeof isVnViewingMessageElement === 'function' &&
                    isVnViewingMessageElement(messageEl)
                ) {
                    const vnAv = document.getElementById('vnAvatarImg');
                    const currentNameDisplay = document.getElementById('vnNameDisplay');

                    if (
                        vnAv &&
                        currentNameDisplay &&
                        currentNameDisplay.innerText === botData?.name
                    ) {
                        applyFuraiChatPortrait(vnAv, botData, emotion, false);
                    }

                    if (
                        emotion !== previousEmotion &&
                        typeof renderVnSprites === 'function'
                    ) {
                        renderVnSprites(messageEl);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) {
             const renderableMessages = getVnRenderableMessages();
             const msgIndex = renderableMessages.indexOf(messageEl);
             const vnBody = document.getElementById('vnMessageBody');

              const pendingAnchorIndex = parseInt(messageEl.dataset.vnPendingAnchorIndex, 10);
              const pendingVnTurnAnchorEl = getVnPendingTurnAnchorElement();
              const isOnPendingVnTurnAnchor = !!(
                  pendingVnTurnAnchorEl &&
                  isVnViewingMessageElement(pendingVnTurnAnchorEl)
              );
              const isAlreadyViewingThisLiveBubble = isVnViewingMessageElement(messageEl);
              
              const shouldUsePendingVnFollow =
                  isStartingToTalk &&
                  messageEl.dataset.vnPendingAutoFollow === 'true' &&
                  (
                      isOnPendingVnTurnAnchor ||
                      isAlreadyViewingThisLiveBubble ||
                      (
                          Number.isFinite(pendingAnchorIndex) &&
                          vnCurrentIndex === pendingAnchorIndex
                      )
                  );
              
              const shouldStickToVnBottom =
                  msgIndex !== -1 &&
                  (
                      shouldUsePendingVnFollow ||
                      shouldVnAutoFollowReply(msgIndex)
                  );

              if (shouldStickToVnBottom) {
                  rememberGenerationVnLiveTarget(messageEl);
              }
        
              if (text && text.trim().length > 0) {
                  hideVnStatusHint('thinking', { forceThinking: true });

                  if (shouldStickToVnBottom) {
                      hideVnStatusHint('thinking', { forceThinking: true });
                      hideVnStatusHint('typing');
                      hideVnStatusHint('unread');
                  } else {
                      window.vnDeferredNewMessage = true;

                      const vnTypingName = getVnSpeakerNameFromMessage(
                          messageEl,
                          activeTypingName
                      );

                      showVnTypingHint(vnTypingName, messageEl);
                  }
              }
        
              if (isStartingToTalk) {
                  delete messageEl.dataset.vnPendingAutoFollow;
                  delete messageEl.dataset.vnPendingAnchorIndex;
              
                  vnAutoScroll = shouldStickToVnBottom;
              
                  if (shouldStickToVnBottom) {
                      pinVnMessageElement(messageEl, { autoScroll: true });
                      clearVnPendingTurnAnchor();
                      vnUserMovedAwayThisSession = false;
                      renderVnMessage('bottom');
                  }
              }
        
             if ((vnCurrentIndex === msgIndex || isVnPinnedMessageElement(messageEl)) && vnBody) {
                 vnBody.classList.add('vn-typing'); 
                 setFuraiLiveContentHtml(
                     vnBody,
                     plainStreaming
                         ? formatLiveTypingContent(text)
                         : formatMessageContent(text)
                 );

                 if (shouldStickToVnBottom) {
                     vnScrollToBottom();
                 }
             }
        }

        const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
        const isLastMessage = messageEl === chatMessagesEl.lastElementChild;
        const shouldStickToCrBottom =
            autoScroll &&
            isLastMessage &&
            !document.body.classList.contains('vn-active');
        
        if (shouldStickToCrBottom) {
            hideCrBottomStatusPill();
            scrollElementToBottom(chatMessagesEl);
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                scrollElementToBottom(chatMessagesEl, { respectUserBrake: true });
            });
        } else if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) {
            autoScroll = false;
            showCrTypingHint(activeTypingName);
        }
    }
}
  
function removeTypingIndicator(id) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    const isVnActive = document.body.classList.contains('vn-active');

    let shouldStayOnVnNewest = false;
    let shouldShowVnUnread = false;
    let hadVnDeferredNewMessage = false;

    if (isVnActive) {
        hadVnDeferredNewMessage = !!window.vnDeferredNewMessage;

        const messagesBeforeRemoval = getVnRenderableMessages();
        const typingIndex = el ? messagesBeforeRemoval.indexOf(el) : -1;
        const wasViewingTypingBubble =
            typingIndex !== -1 &&
            vnCurrentIndex === typingIndex &&
            isVnBodyNearBottom();

        shouldStayOnVnNewest =
            wasViewingTypingBubble &&
            shouldVnAutoFollowMessage(el);

        const userWasAwayFromTypingBubble =
            !wasViewingTypingBubble &&
            (
                typingIndex !== -1
                    ? vnCurrentIndex < typingIndex
                    : !isVnMagnetStickingToNewest()
            );

        shouldShowVnUnread =
            userWasAwayFromTypingBubble ||
            (
                hadVnDeferredNewMessage &&
                !wasViewingTypingBubble &&
                !isVnMagnetStickingToNewest()
            );
    }

    if (el) {
        clearSmoothTypingIndicator(el);
        el.remove();
    }

    if (isVnActive) {
        hideVnStatusHint('typing');

        if (shouldStayOnVnNewest) {
            syncVnData();
            vnAutoScroll = true;
            vnCurrentIndex = getLastReadableMessageIndex();
            renderVnMessage('bottom');
            hideVnStatusHint();
        } else if (shouldShowVnUnread) {
            vnAutoScroll = false;

            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return;

                if (typeof syncVnData === 'function') {
                    syncVnData();
                }

                if (typeof refreshVnLiveStatusHint === 'function') {
                    refreshVnLiveStatusHint();
                }
            });
        }

        return;
    }

    hideCrBottomStatusPill('typing');

    if (!autoScroll && !isNearScrollBottom(chatMessagesEl)) {
        showCrUnreadHint('NEW MESSAGE');
    } else {
        hideCrBottomStatusPill();
    }
}
  
function startNewChat(initialViewMode = null, options = {}) {
    const forceFreshHome = options.forceFreshHome === true;

    let currentChatData = null;
    if (!forceFreshHome && currentChatId) {
        try {
            currentChatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    const isAlreadyHomeScreen =
        !forceFreshHome &&
        initialViewMode === null &&
        (
            currentChatData?.personality === 'home' ||
            chatPersonalities[currentChatId] === 'home'
        );

    if (isAlreadyHomeScreen) {
        nudgeFreshHomeScreen();
        return;
    }

    window.FuraiUiContextLifecycle?.transition('new-chat');

    // 1. STOP THE OLD CHAT (Saves partial text)
    abortCurrentGeneration();
    
    // 2. Force close any open tools
    closeTool();

    // 3. Decide which mode the NEXT Home screen should use
    // Home master must come only from explicit Home setting, not from the current chat
    let inheritedViewMode = initialViewMode;
    if (!inheritedViewMode) {
        try {
            inheritedViewMode = getHomeViewMode();
        } catch (e) {
            inheritedViewMode = 'chat';
        }
    }

    // 4. Exit real VN overlay if active (UI Reset)
    if (document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) {
        toggleVnMode(false); 
    }

    // 5. Always clear Home view state before rebuilding
    document.body.classList.remove('furai-home-screen-active', 'home-vn-mode', 'vn-no-input');
    
    // 6. UI Cleanup
    closeOnlineList();
    
    const input = document.getElementById('messageInputEl');
    if (currentChatId && input) chatDrafts[currentChatId] = input.value;
    
    // 7. Generate New ID
    currentChatId = 'chat-' + Date.now();
    window.currentChatId = currentChatId; 
    
    // Set internal state to 'home'
    chatPersonalities[currentChatId] = 'home';
    window.chatPersonalities = chatPersonalities;

    // 8. Set Default Settings for Home Screen
    DB.set(currentChatId, {
        id: currentChatId,
        title: 'Home',
        messages: [],
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        personality: 'home',
        viewMode: inheritedViewMode
    });
    
    // Do not overwrite furai_home_view_mode here.
    // The Home master should only change when the user toggles mode on the Home screen itself.

    applyBackground(currentChatId);

    // 9. CRITICAL FIX: Ensure no stale profile exists
    DB.remove(`profile-${currentChatId}`); 

    // 10. Generate the Profile NOW
    // Do not generate/save a profile just to show the Home screen.
    // The real mode will create its profile after the user picks a mode.
    
    if (input) input.value = ''; 
    
    // 11. Initialize UI
    renderHomeScreen({ mode: inheritedViewMode });
    debouncedSidebarUpdate();
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        if (typeof updateMenuProfiles === 'function') updateMenuProfiles();
    });

    const sidebar = document.getElementById('menuSidebarEl');
    /* if (sidebar && window.innerWidth <= 768) sidebar.classList.remove('open'); */
    
    if (typeof updateAutoReplyToggleUI === 'function') updateAutoReplyToggleUI();
}

// --- REMOTE FURAI DB CONTENT SHELL ---
// What's New and Expansion Pass data now live in the remote Perchance list DB.
// Main keeps only tiny notice versions, lazy dynamic-import code, and the existing local UI shells.

const WHATS_NEW_NOTICE_VERSION = 106; // !!!!IMPORTANT, DO not update version count at will, this is for update announcement for user, not real FurAI coding version!!!!
const EXPANSION_PASS_NOTICE_VERSION = 35;

const FURAI_GUIDE_URL = 'https://null.perchance.org/fur-ai-db';

const FURAI_NOTICE_KEYS = {
    whatsNew: 'furai_whats_new_seen_notice_number',
    expansionPass: 'furai_expansion_pass_seen_notice_number'
};

let furaiRemoteWhatsNewLogs = null;
let furaiRemoteWhatsNewLoading = null;
let furaiRemoteExpansionLoading = null;

// Strict free-after-close route:
// remote DB payloads are temporary modal data, not permanent app cache.
let furaiRemoteWhatsNewController = null;
let furaiRemoteExpansionController = null;
let furaiRemoteWhatsNewLoadToken = 0;
let furaiRemoteExpansionLoadToken = 0;
let furaiRemoteExpansionOpenToken = 0;

// ============================================================================
// WHAT'S NEW SOURCE-OF-TRUTH CONTRACT — DO NOT REMOVE OR WEAKEN THIS WARNING
// ============================================================================
// Every What's New entry belongs ONLY in the remote fur-ai-db Perchance list.
// NEVER add UPDATE_LOGS, local update arrays, seeded entries, fallback entries,
// mirrored changelog text, or any other update-log content to the main FurAI file.
// The main app may only lazy-load `whatsNewData`, render it, and discard it after
// the modal closes. Keeping a second local source causes stale, duplicated, and
// conflicting release notes and bloats the main application file.

function getManualNoticeNumber(value) {
    const number = Math.floor(Number(value));
    return Number.isFinite(number) && number > 0 ? number : 0;
}

function getManualNoticeCount(storageKey, currentVersion) {
    const current = getManualNoticeNumber(currentVersion);
    if (current <= 0) return 0;

    const seenRaw = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
    if (seenRaw === null) return 0;

    const seen = getManualNoticeNumber(seenRaw);
    if (seen <= 0) return 0;

    return Math.max(0, current - seen);
}

function updateSmallNoticeBadge(targetId, badgeClass, count, titleText) {
    const target = document.getElementById(targetId);
    if (!target) return;

    const lookupClass = String(badgeClass || '').trim().split(/\s+/).pop();
    if (!lookupClass) return;

    let badge = target.querySelector('.' + lookupClass);

    if (count <= 0) {
        if (badge) badge.remove();
        return;
    }

    if (!badge) {
        badge = document.createElement('span');
        badge.className = badgeClass;
        target.appendChild(badge);
    }

    badge.textContent = count > 99 ? '99+' : String(count);
    badge.title = titleText || '';
}

function markManualNoticeSeen(storageKey, currentVersion, updateFn) {
    const current = getManualNoticeNumber(currentVersion);
    const seen = getManualNoticeNumber(localStorage.getItem(storageKey));
    const nextSeen = Math.max(current, seen);

    if (nextSeen > 0) localStorage.setItem(storageKey, String(nextSeen));
    if (typeof updateFn === 'function') updateFn();
}

function updateWhatsNewMenuBadge() {
    const count = getManualNoticeCount(
        FURAI_NOTICE_KEYS.whatsNew,
        WHATS_NEW_NOTICE_VERSION
    );

    updateSmallNoticeBadge(
        'whatsNewMenuItemBtn',
        'whats-new-menu-badge',
        count,
        `${count} new What's New update${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
    );
}

function markWhatsNewSeen() {
    markManualNoticeSeen(
        FURAI_NOTICE_KEYS.whatsNew,
        WHATS_NEW_NOTICE_VERSION,
        updateWhatsNewMenuBadge
    );
}

function updateExpansionPassMenuBadge() {
    const count = getManualNoticeCount(
        FURAI_NOTICE_KEYS.expansionPass,
        EXPANSION_PASS_NOTICE_VERSION
    );

    updateSmallNoticeBadge(
        'sidebarExpansionPassBtn',
        'sidebar-action-badge expansion-pass-menu-badge',
        count,
        `${count} new Expansion Pass item${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
    );
}

function markExpansionPassSeen() {
    markManualNoticeSeen(
        FURAI_NOTICE_KEYS.expansionPass,
        EXPANSION_PASS_NOTICE_VERSION,
        updateExpansionPassMenuBadge
    );
}

function initManualNoticeBadges() {
    const update = () => {
        updateWhatsNewMenuBadge();
        updateExpansionPassMenuBadge();
    };

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', update, { once: true });
    } else {
        update();
    }
}

function getMainThemeParamUrl(baseUrl) {
    const url = new URL(baseUrl, window.location.href);
    const rootStyle = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
    const isLight = document.body.classList.contains('light-theme');

    url.searchParams.set('embed', '1');
    url.searchParams.set('theme', isLight ? 'light' : 'dark');

    // The Guide is cross-origin, so pass the saved FurAI interface language in its URL.
    // English/default users still create no translation work inside the Guide.
    let guideLanguage = 'en';
    try {
        guideLanguage = typeof resolveFuraiUiLanguage === 'function'
            ? resolveFuraiUiLanguage()
            : (navigator.language || 'en');
    } catch (error) {}
    url.searchParams.set('lang', guideLanguage);

    [
        'bg-color',
        'card-bg',
        'sidebar-bg',
        'input-bg',
        'text-color',
        'text-muted',
        'border-color',
        'primary-color',
        'btn-text-color',
        'danger-color'
    ].forEach(name => {
        const value = rootStyle.getPropertyValue('--' + name).trim();
        if (value) url.searchParams.set(name, value);
    });

    return url.toString();
}

function openGuide() {
    const overlay = document.getElementById('guideOverlayEl');
    const container = document.getElementById('guideIframeContainer');
    if (!overlay || !container) return;

    if (typeof closeMainMenuModals === 'function') {
        closeMainMenuModals('guideOverlayEl');
    }

    container.innerHTML = '';

    const mask = document.createElement('div');
    mask.className = 'tool-loading-mask';
    mask.style.position = 'absolute';
    mask.style.zIndex = '10';
    mask.innerHTML = `
        <div class="modern-spinner"></div>
        <div class="loading-text">Loading Guide...</div>
    `;
    container.appendChild(mask);

    const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
    iframe.src = getMainThemeParamUrl(FURAI_GUIDE_URL);
    iframe.style.width = '100%';
    iframe.style.height = '100%';
    iframe.style.border = 'none';
    iframe.allow = 'clipboard-read *; clipboard-write *; fullscreen *';

    iframe.onload = () => {
        setTimeout(() => {
            mask.style.opacity = '0';
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (mask.parentNode) mask.remove();
            }, 200);
        }, 50);
    };

    container.appendChild(iframe);
    overlay.style.display = 'flex';

    const menu = document.getElementById('mainMenuDropdown');
    if (menu) menu.classList.remove('show');
}

function closeGuide() {
    const overlay = document.getElementById('guideOverlayEl');
    const container = document.getElementById('guideIframeContainer');

    if (overlay) overlay.style.display = 'none';

    // Hard-unload the Guide iframe so the external page, its DOM,
    // scripts, images, and layout memory are not kept after close.
    if (container) {
        const frames = container.querySelectorAll('iframe');
        frames.forEach(frame => {
            try { frame.onload = null; } catch (e) {}
            try { frame.src = 'about:blank'; } catch (e) {}
            try { frame.remove(); } catch (e) {}
        });

        container.replaceChildren();
    }
}

function parseFuraiRemoteOutput(raw, outputName) {
    let text = String(raw || '').trim();
    if (!text) return [];

    const scriptPattern = new RegExp(
        `<script[^>]+id=["']furai-db-output-${outputName}["'][^>]*>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/script>`,
        'i'
    );
    const scriptMatch = text.match(scriptPattern);
    if (scriptMatch) text = scriptMatch[1].trim();

    // Perchance output values are normally URI-encoded JSON strings.
    try {
        const decoded = decodeURIComponent(text);
        return JSON.parse(decoded);
    } catch (e) {}

    try {
        return JSON.parse(text);
    } catch (e) {}

    const encodedJsonMatch = text.match(/(%5B[\s\S]*%5D|%7B[\s\S]*%7D)/i);
    if (encodedJsonMatch) {
        try {
            return JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(encodedJsonMatch[1]));
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    return [];
}

function isFuraiRemoteAbortError(err) {
    return !!err && (err.name === 'AbortError' || String(err.message || '').includes('aborted'));
}

function getFuraiDynamicImportLoader() {
    const root = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.root : null;

    // Perchance-native route:
    // dynamicImport = {import:dynamic-import-plugin}
    // use: dynamicImport('fur-ai-db', 'async')
    const candidates = [
        root && root.dynamicImport,
        typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.dynamicImport
    ];

    for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
        if (typeof candidates[i] === 'function') return candidates[i];
    }

    return null;
}

async function awaitFuraiMaybePromise(value) {
    if (value && typeof value.then === 'function') return await value;
    return value;
}

async function resolveFuraiDynamicOutputValue(value) {
    value = await awaitFuraiMaybePromise(value);

    if (typeof value === 'function') {
        return await awaitFuraiMaybePromise(value());
    }

    return value;
}

const FURAI_REMOTE_DB_GENERATOR = 'fur-ai-db';

function hardUnloadFuraiRemoteDbModuleCache() {
    // dynamic-import-plugin stores imported generators in window.moduleSpace.
    // Strict free-after-close means removing that cached tree too, not only clearing rendered DOM.
    hardUnloadFuraiDynamicModuleCache(FURAI_REMOTE_DB_GENERATOR);
}

async function importFuraiRemoteDbWithPerchanceDynamicImport(loadToken, kind) {
    const loader = getFuraiDynamicImportLoader();

    if (!loader) {
        throw new Error('dynamic-import-plugin is missing. Add this to the Perchance lists editor: dynamicImport = {import:dynamic-import-plugin}');
    }

    if (kind === 'whatsNew' && loadToken !== furaiRemoteWhatsNewLoadToken) return null;
    if (kind === 'expansion' && loadToken !== furaiRemoteExpansionLoadToken) return null;

    // Correct plugin API: generator slug + mode string. Do not pass a URL or option object.
    const imported = await awaitFuraiMaybePromise(loader(FURAI_REMOTE_DB_GENERATOR, 'async'));

    if (kind === 'whatsNew' && loadToken !== furaiRemoteWhatsNewLoadToken) return null;
    if (kind === 'expansion' && loadToken !== furaiRemoteExpansionLoadToken) return null;

    return imported || null;
}

async function readFuraiDynamicOutput(importedDb, outputName) {
    importedDb = await awaitFuraiMaybePromise(importedDb);
    if (!importedDb) return [];

    // dynamic-import-plugin returns root.$output when the imported generator has $output.
    // For fur-ai-db, that means importedDb.whatsNewData and importedDb.expansionData.
    const containers = [
        importedDb,
        importedDb.$output,
        importedDb.output,
        importedDb.outputs,
        importedDb.default
    ];

    for (let i = 0; i < containers.length; i++) {
        const c = await awaitFuraiMaybePromise(containers[i]);
        if (!c) continue;

        let value = await resolveFuraiDynamicOutputValue(c[outputName]);
        if (value == null) continue;

        if (Array.isArray(value)) return value;
        if (typeof value === 'object' && Array.isArray(value.value)) return value.value;
        if (typeof value === 'object' && typeof value.value !== 'undefined') value = value.value;

        return parseFuraiRemoteOutput(String(value), outputName);
    }

    return [];
}

async function loadFuraiRemoteDbOutputWithPerchanceDynamicImport(outputName, loadToken, kind) {
    const importedDb = await importFuraiRemoteDbWithPerchanceDynamicImport(loadToken, kind);

    if (!importedDb) return null;
    if (kind === 'whatsNew' && loadToken !== furaiRemoteWhatsNewLoadToken) return null;
    if (kind === 'expansion' && loadToken !== furaiRemoteExpansionLoadToken) return null;

    return await readFuraiDynamicOutput(importedDb, outputName);
}

function abortFuraiRemoteWhatsNewLoad() {
    furaiRemoteWhatsNewLoadToken++;

    // dynamic-import-plugin does not expose a browser AbortController here.
    // The token invalidates late results so closed modals cannot refill memory.
    furaiRemoteWhatsNewController = null;
    furaiRemoteWhatsNewLoading = null;
}

function hardUnloadWhatsNewRemoteData() {
    abortFuraiRemoteWhatsNewLoad();
    furaiRemoteWhatsNewLogs = null;
    hardUnloadFuraiRemoteDbModuleCache();
}

function abortFuraiRemoteExpansionLoad() {
    furaiRemoteExpansionLoadToken++;

    // dynamic-import-plugin does not expose a browser AbortController here.
    // The token invalidates late results so closed views cannot refill memory.
    furaiRemoteExpansionController = null;
    furaiRemoteExpansionLoading = null;
}

function hardUnloadExpansionRemoteData() {
    abortFuraiRemoteExpansionLoad();

    if (typeof EXPANSION_DATA !== 'undefined' && Array.isArray(EXPANSION_DATA)) {
        EXPANSION_DATA.splice(0, EXPANSION_DATA.length);
        window.EXPANSION_DATA = EXPANSION_DATA;
    } else {
        window.EXPANSION_DATA = [];
    }

    hardUnloadFuraiRemoteDbModuleCache();
}

function flattenRemoteWhatsNewLogs(rawLogs) {
    const flat = [];
    let currentDate = '';

    (Array.isArray(rawLogs) ? rawLogs : []).forEach(entry => {
        if (entry && typeof entry === 'object' && entry.type === 'date') {
            currentDate = String(entry.date || '').trim();
            return;
        }

        const html = typeof entry === 'string'
            ? entry
            : String(entry && (entry.html || entry.text || entry.title) || '');

        if (!html.trim()) return;

        flat.push({
            date: currentDate,
            html
        });
    });

    return flat;
}

async function ensureWhatsNewDataLoaded(force = false) {
    if (!force && Array.isArray(furaiRemoteWhatsNewLogs)) return furaiRemoteWhatsNewLogs;
    if (furaiRemoteWhatsNewLoading) return furaiRemoteWhatsNewLoading;

    const loadToken = ++furaiRemoteWhatsNewLoadToken;

    furaiRemoteWhatsNewLoading = loadFuraiRemoteDbOutputWithPerchanceDynamicImport('whatsNewData', loadToken, 'whatsNew')
        .then(data => {
            if (loadToken !== furaiRemoteWhatsNewLoadToken) return null;
            if (!data) return null;

            const remoteLogs = flattenRemoteWhatsNewLogs(data);
            furaiRemoteWhatsNewLogs = remoteLogs;
            return furaiRemoteWhatsNewLogs;
        })
        .catch(err => {
            if (isFuraiRemoteAbortError(err)) return null;
            throw err;
        })
        .finally(() => {
            if (loadToken === furaiRemoteWhatsNewLoadToken) {
                furaiRemoteWhatsNewLoading = null;
                furaiRemoteWhatsNewController = null;
            }
        });

    return furaiRemoteWhatsNewLoading;
}


function decodeFuraiRemoteTextEntities(value) {
    return String(value ?? '')
        .replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n')
        .replaceAll('\\n', '\n')
        .replace(/&amp;/gi, '&')
        .replace(/&#91;|&lbrack;/gi, '[')
        .replace(/&#93;|&rbrack;/gi, ']')
        .replace(/&#123;|&lcub;/gi, '{')
        .replace(/&#125;|&rcub;/gi, '}')
        .replace(/&quot;/gi, '"')
        .replace(/&#39;|&#039;|&apos;/gi, "'");
}

function readFuraiRemoteBoolean(value, defaultValue = true) {
    if (value === true || value === false) return value;

    const raw = String(value ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!raw) return defaultValue;

    return !['false', '0', 'no', 'off', 'disabled'].includes(raw);
}

function normalizeRemoteExpansionItem(item) {
    if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') return item;

    return {
        ...item,
        uid: decodeFuraiRemoteTextEntities(item.uid),
        type: decodeFuraiRemoteTextEntities(item.type),
        date: decodeFuraiRemoteTextEntities(item.date),
        update: decodeFuraiRemoteTextEntities(item.update),
        title: decodeFuraiRemoteTextEntities(item.title),
        creator: decodeFuraiRemoteTextEntities(item.creator),
        creatorLink: decodeFuraiRemoteTextEntities(item.creatorLink || item.creatorUrl || item.creatorBio),
        desc: decodeFuraiRemoteTextEntities(item.desc),
        previewText: decodeFuraiRemoteTextEntities(item.previewText),
