        img: decodeFuraiRemoteTextEntities(item.img),
        content: decodeFuraiRemoteTextEntities(item.content),
        presetKind: decodeFuraiRemoteTextEntities(item.presetKind),
        orderIndex: Number(item.orderIndex || item.sourceIndex || 0),
        sourceKind: decodeFuraiRemoteTextEntities(item.sourceKind || item.type),
        allowComments: readFuraiRemoteBoolean(item.allowComments, true),
        tags: Array.isArray(item.tags)
            ? item.tags.map(decodeFuraiRemoteTextEntities).map(tag => tag.trim()).filter(Boolean)
            : []
    };
}

async function ensureExpansionPassDataLoaded(force = false) {
    if (!force && Array.isArray(window.EXPANSION_DATA) && window.EXPANSION_DATA.length) {
        return window.EXPANSION_DATA;
    }

    if (!force && typeof EXPANSION_DATA !== 'undefined' && EXPANSION_DATA.length) {
        return EXPANSION_DATA;
    }

    if (furaiRemoteExpansionLoading) return furaiRemoteExpansionLoading;

    const loadToken = ++furaiRemoteExpansionLoadToken;

    furaiRemoteExpansionLoading = loadFuraiRemoteDbOutputWithPerchanceDynamicImport('expansionData', loadToken, 'expansion')
        .then(data => {
            if (loadToken !== furaiRemoteExpansionLoadToken) return null;
            if (!data) return null;

            const items = (Array.isArray(data) ? data : []).map(normalizeRemoteExpansionItem);

            if (typeof EXPANSION_DATA !== 'undefined' && Array.isArray(EXPANSION_DATA)) {
                EXPANSION_DATA.splice(0, EXPANSION_DATA.length, ...items);
                window.EXPANSION_DATA = EXPANSION_DATA;
                return EXPANSION_DATA;
            }

            window.EXPANSION_DATA = items;
            return items;
        })
        .catch(err => {
            if (isFuraiRemoteAbortError(err)) return null;
            throw err;
        })
        .finally(() => {
            if (loadToken === furaiRemoteExpansionLoadToken) {
                furaiRemoteExpansionLoading = null;
                furaiRemoteExpansionController = null;
            }
        });

    return furaiRemoteExpansionLoading;
}

function escapeWhatsNewHtml(value) {
    return escapeStatusText(value);
}

function getWhatsNewRawText(log) {
    if (typeof log === 'string') return log;
    if (!log || typeof log !== 'object') return '';
    return String(log.html || log.content || log.text || '');
}

function normalizeWhatsNewLog(log) {
    const value = getWhatsNewRawText(log);
    const trimmed = value.trim();

    if (!trimmed) return '';

    // Custom entries can provide their own <li>. Do not wrap them again.
    if (trimmed.startsWith('<li')) return value;

    return `<li class="whats-new-log">${value}</li>`;
}

function isWhatsNewSpoilerLog(log) {
    const value = getWhatsNewRawText(log).toLowerCase();

    return value.indexOf('data-whats-new-spoiler="true"') !== -1 ||
           value.indexOf("data-whats-new-spoiler='true'") !== -1 ||
           value.indexOf('data-spoiler="nsfw"') !== -1 ||
           value.indexOf("data-spoiler='nsfw'") !== -1;
}

function isWhatsNewNsfwUnlocked() {
    return window.isExpNsfw === true || localStorage.getItem('furai_exp_nsfw_unlocked') === 'true';
}

function addWhatsNewLiClass(value, className) {
    if (value.indexOf(className) !== -1) return value;

    if (value.indexOf('<li class="') !== -1) {
        return value.replace('<li class="', `<li class="${className} `);
    }

    if (value.indexOf("<li class='") !== -1) {
        return value.replace("<li class='", `<li class='${className} `);
    }

    if (value.indexOf('<li ') !== -1) {
        return value.replace('<li ', `<li class="${className}" `);
    }

    if (value.indexOf('<li>') !== -1) {
        return value.replace('<li>', `<li class="${className}">`);
    }

    return value;
}

function addWhatsNewDateMetadata(value, date, showDate) {
    const safeDate = String(date || '').trim().replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
    if (!safeDate || value.indexOf('<li') === -1) return value;

    let output = value;
    const isDefaultLog = output.indexOf('whats-new-log') !== -1;

    if (showDate && isDefaultLog && output.indexOf('whats-new-log-date') === -1) {
        output = addWhatsNewLiClass(output, 'whats-new-date-break');
    }

    if (output.indexOf('data-whats-new-date=') === -1) {
        output = output.replace('<li', `<li data-whats-new-date="${safeDate}"`);
    }

    if (!showDate || output.indexOf('whats-new-log-date') !== -1) {
        return output;
    }

    if (!isDefaultLog) {
        const dateRow = `<li class="whats-new-card-date-row whats-new-date-break" data-whats-new-date="${safeDate}"><span class="whats-new-log-date whats-new-card-date-label" title="Update date">${safeDate}</span></li>`;
        return dateRow + output;
    }

    const openEndIndex = output.indexOf('>');
    if (openEndIndex === -1) return output;

    const badge = `<span class="whats-new-log-date" title="Update date">${safeDate}</span>`;
    return output.slice(0, openEndIndex + 1) + badge + output.slice(openEndIndex + 1);
}

function decorateWhatsNewVisibleLog(log) {
    let value = normalizeWhatsNewLog(log);

    if (!isWhatsNewSpoilerLog(log)) {
        return value;
    }

    value = addWhatsNewLiClass(value, 'whats-new-spoiler-log');

    if (value.indexOf('whats-new-spoiler-badge') === -1) {
        const closeIndex = value.lastIndexOf('</li>');
        const badge = ' <span class="whats-new-spoiler-badge">18+</span>';

        if (closeIndex !== -1) {
            value = value.slice(0, closeIndex) + badge + value.slice(closeIndex);
        }
    }

    return value;
}

function renderWhatsNewEntryRemote(entry, showDate) {
    return addWhatsNewDateMetadata(
        decorateWhatsNewVisibleLog(entry),
        entry && entry.date ? entry.date : '',
        showDate
    );
}

let whatsNewSearchTextEl = null;

function parseWhatsNewSearchQuery(rawQuery) {
    const result = {
        phrases: [],
        tokens: []
    };

    const query = String(rawQuery || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!query) return result;

    let normalText = '';
    let phraseText = '';
    let inQuote = false;

    for (let i = 0; i < query.length; i++) {
        const ch = query.charAt(i);

        if (ch === '"') {
            if (inQuote && phraseText.trim()) {
                result.phrases.push(phraseText.trim());
                phraseText = '';
            }

            inQuote = !inQuote;
            continue;
        }

        if (inQuote) {
            phraseText += ch;
        } else {
            normalText += ch;
        }
    }

    if (phraseText.trim()) {
        result.phrases.push(phraseText.trim());
    }

    const parts = normalText.split(' ');
    for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
        const token = parts[i].trim();
        if (token) result.tokens.push(token);
    }

    return result;
}

function getWhatsNewSearchText(log) {
    if (!whatsNewSearchTextEl) {
        whatsNewSearchTextEl = document.createElement('div');
    }

    whatsNewSearchTextEl.innerHTML = normalizeWhatsNewLog(log);
    const text = whatsNewSearchTextEl.textContent || whatsNewSearchTextEl.innerText || '';
    whatsNewSearchTextEl.textContent = '';

    const dateText = log && log.date ? String(log.date) + ' ' : '';
    return (dateText + text).toLowerCase();
}

function whatsNewLogMatchesSearch(log, searchParts) {
    if (!searchParts) return true;

    const hasPhrases = searchParts.phrases.length > 0;
    const hasTokens = searchParts.tokens.length > 0;

    if (!hasPhrases && !hasTokens) return true;

    const text = getWhatsNewSearchText(log);

    for (let i = 0; i < searchParts.phrases.length; i++) {
        if (text.indexOf(searchParts.phrases[i]) === -1) return false;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < searchParts.tokens.length; i++) {
        if (text.indexOf(searchParts.tokens[i]) === -1) return false;
    }

    return true;
}

function getFilteredRemoteWhatsNewLogs() {
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('whatsNewSearchInput');
    const searchParts = parseWhatsNewSearchQuery(searchInput ? searchInput.value : '');
    const nsfwUnlocked = isWhatsNewNsfwUnlocked();
    const isSearching = searchParts.phrases.length > 0 || searchParts.tokens.length > 0;
    const entries = Array.isArray(furaiRemoteWhatsNewLogs) ? furaiRemoteWhatsNewLogs : [];
    const filteredLogs = [];
    let lastRenderedDate = '';

    for (let i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
        const entry = entries[i];

        if (isWhatsNewSpoilerLog(entry) && !nsfwUnlocked) continue;
        if (isSearching && !whatsNewLogMatchesSearch(entry, searchParts)) continue;

        const entryDate = entry && entry.date ? entry.date : '';
        const showDate = !!entryDate && (isSearching || entryDate !== lastRenderedDate);

        filteredLogs.push(renderWhatsNewEntryRemote(entry, showDate));

        if (entryDate) {
            lastRenderedDate = entryDate;
        }
    }

    return filteredLogs;
}

function bindWhatsNewLightbox() {
    const list = document.getElementById('whatsNewList');
    if (!list || list.dataset.lightboxBound === 'true') return;

    list.dataset.lightboxBound = 'true';

    const openTargetImage = (target) => {
        const img = target.closest('.whats-new-lightbox-img');
        if (!img || !list.contains(img)) return false;

        const src = img.dataset.lightboxSrc || img.currentSrc || img.src;
        if (!src || typeof openLightbox !== 'function') return false;

        openLightbox(src);
        return true;
    };

    list.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (!openTargetImage(event.target)) return;

        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
    });

    list.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if (event.key !== 'Enter' && event.key !== ' ') return;
        if (!openTargetImage(event.target)) return;

        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
    });
}

function renderWhatsNewModal() {
    const list = document.getElementById('whatsNewList');
    if (!list) return;

    if (!Array.isArray(furaiRemoteWhatsNewLogs)) {
        list.innerHTML = '<li class="whats-new-log"><span class="furai-mini-spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span> Loading updates...</li>';
        bindWhatsNewLightbox();
        return;
    }

    const html = getFilteredRemoteWhatsNewLogs().join('');

    list.innerHTML = html || '<li class="whats-new-log">No updates found.</li>';
    bindWhatsNewLightbox();
}

window.openWhatsNewModal = async function openWhatsNewModal() {
    if (typeof closeMainMenuModals === 'function') {
        closeMainMenuModals('whatsNewModalEl');
    }

    const modal = document.getElementById('whatsNewModalEl');
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('whatsNewSearchInput');
    if (!modal) return;

    if (searchInput) searchInput.value = '';

    modal.style.display = 'flex';
    renderWhatsNewModal();
    markWhatsNewSeen();

    const menu = document.getElementById('mainMenuDropdown');
    if (menu) menu.classList.remove('show');

    try {
        const loaded = await ensureWhatsNewDataLoaded();
        if (loaded === null || modal.style.display !== 'flex') return;
    } catch (err) {
        if (isFuraiRemoteAbortError(err)) return;
        console.error(err);
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Could not load What\'s New.', 'error');
        return;
    }

    renderWhatsNewModal();
};

window.closeWhatsNewModal = function closeWhatsNewModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('whatsNewModalEl');
    const list = document.getElementById('whatsNewList');
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('whatsNewSearchInput');

    if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
    if (list) list.replaceChildren();
    if (searchInput) searchInput.value = '';

    // Strict free-after-close: discard remote update logs and abort any late load.
    hardUnloadWhatsNewRemoteData();
};

    if (textSpan) textSpan.textContent = 'SAFE';

  /*** Returns the HTML for a personality icon based on the personality type.*/  
  function getPersonalityIcon(personality) {
      switch (personality) {
          case 'researcher':
              return '<i class="fa-regular fa-lightbulb"></i>';
          case 'guide':
              return '<i class="fa-regular fa-circle-question"></i>';
          case 'prompter':
              return '<i class="fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles"></i>';
          case 'group':
              return '<i class="fa-solid fa-people-group"></i>';
          case 'story':
              return '<i class="fa-solid fa-feather"></i>';
          case 'maker':
              return '<i class="fa-solid fa-person-walking-arrow-right"></i>';
          case 'home':
              return ''; // No icon for the Home screen
          default:
              return ''; // Return nothing if personality is not set or unknown
      }
  }

// --- MOBILE SELECTION STATE ---
let mobileSelectedId = null; // Tracks the currently highlighted ID (Chat or Folder)

let pendingSidebarLoadId = null;

function isLikelyHeavyChatLoad(chatId) {
    let chatData = null;

    try {
        chatData = DB.get(chatId);
    } catch (e) {}

    const messageCount = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages.length : 0;
    const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 768;

    return messageCount >= (isMobile ? 24 : 48);
}

function ensureSidebarLoadStatus() {
    let status = document.getElementById('sidebarLoadStatus');
    if (status) return status;

    status = document.createElement('div');
    status.id = 'sidebarLoadStatus';
    status.className = 'sidebar-load-status';
    status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
    status.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
    status.innerHTML = `
        <span class="sidebar-load-spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <span class="sidebar-load-text">Loading chat...</span>
    `;

    document.body.appendChild(status);
    return status;
}

function syncSidebarLoadStatusPosition() {
    const sidebar = document.getElementById('menuSidebarEl');
    const status = document.getElementById('sidebarLoadStatus');
    if (!sidebar || !status) return;

    const rect = sidebar.getBoundingClientRect();
    const left = Math.max(12, rect.left + 12);
    const width = Math.max(160, rect.width - 24);

    status.style.left = `${left}px`;
    status.style.width = `${width}px`;
}

function setSidebarLoadingStatus(chatId, isLoading, options = {}) {
    const sidebar = document.getElementById('menuSidebarEl');
    const status = ensureSidebarLoadStatus();
    if (!sidebar || !status) return;

    if (isLoading) {
        window.sidebarLoadingChatId = chatId;
        syncSidebarLoadStatusPosition();

        status.classList.toggle('is-delayed-visible', !!options.delayed);
        status.classList.add('is-visible');

        return;
    }

    if (chatId && window.sidebarLoadingChatId && window.sidebarLoadingChatId !== chatId) return;

    window.sidebarLoadingChatId = null;
    status.classList.remove('is-visible', 'is-delayed-visible');
}

function handleFolderClick(event, folderId) {
    if (event) event.stopPropagation();

    // 1. Desktop: Instant Toggle
    if (window.innerWidth > 768) {
        FolderManager.toggle(folderId);
        return;
    }

    // 2. Mobile Logic
    if (mobileSelectedId === folderId) {
        // Second Tap -> Toggle Folder
        // Note: We don't reset mobileSelectedId here so it stays highlighted while open
        FolderManager.toggle(folderId);
    } else {
        // First Tap -> Select (Show options button)
        mobileSelectedId = folderId;
        updateSelectionUI(folderId);
    }
}

// Visual Helper: Applies .active class to the selected item ONLY
function updateSelectionUI(targetId) {
    // Remove .active from ALL chats and folders
    document.querySelectorAll('.chat-item, .folder-header-row').forEach(el => {
        el.classList.remove('active');
    });

    // Add .active to the specific target (using data attributes)
    const target = document.querySelector(`.chat-item[data-id="${targetId}"], .folder-header-row[data-id="${targetId}"]`);
    if (target) {
        target.classList.add('active');
    }
}

function getSidebarMode() {
    const select = document.getElementById('sidebarModeSelect');
    const modalOpen = document.getElementById('accountModalEl')?.style.display === 'flex';
    if (modalOpen && select) return select.value || 'rich';
    return DB.get('furai_sidebar_mode') || 'rich';
}

function formatSidebarLastActive(timestamp) {
    return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString(document.documentElement.lang || navigator.language || 'en-US', {
        year: 'numeric',
        month: 'short',
        day: 'numeric'
    });
}

function getSidebarPresenceData(chat) {
    const profile = chat._sidebarProfile || {};
    const bots = Array.isArray(profile.bots) ? profile.bots : [];
    const isGroup = chat.personality === 'group';
    const isMaker = chat.personality === 'maker';

    const activeBots = (isGroup || isMaker)
        ? bots.filter(bot => bot && bot.inActiveCast !== false)
        : bots;

    const activeCount = Number.isFinite(Number(profile.activeCount))
        ? Number(profile.activeCount)
        : activeBots.length;

    const totalOnline = (isGroup || isMaker)
        ? (1 + activeCount)
        : (profile.hasBots || bots.length > 0 ? 2 : 1);

    const showUserAvatarInStack = totalOnline >= 3;

    const stackAvatars = [
        ...(showUserAvatarInStack && profile?.user?.avatar ? [profile.user.avatar] : []),
        ...activeBots.map(bot => bot.avatar).filter(Boolean)
    ].filter(Boolean).slice(0, 3);

    const extraCount = totalOnline > 3 ? (totalOnline - 3) : 0;
    const primaryAvatar = profile.primaryAvatar || activeBots[0]?.avatar || profile?.user?.avatar || DEFAULT_GEN_IMG;
    const shouldShowMemberText = isGroup || (isMaker && totalOnline > 2);

    return {
        isGroup,
        isMaker,
        totalOnline,
        stackAvatars,
        extraCount,
        primaryAvatar,
        shouldShowMemberText
    };
}

function buildSidebarAvatarStack(avatars, extraCount = 0, variant = 'balanced') {
    const isRich = variant === 'rich';
    const size = isRich ? 30 : 22;
    const step = isRich ? 12 : 12;
    const border = isRich ? 2 : 1.5;
    const emptyWidth = isRich ? 50 : 36;
    const showExtraCount = !isRich && extraCount > 0;

    if (!avatars || avatars.length === 0) {
        return `<div style="width:${emptyWidth}px; min-width:${emptyWidth}px; flex-shrink:0;"></div>`;
    }

    const width = showExtraCount
        ? (avatars.length * step + 26)
        : ((avatars.length - 1) * step + size);

    return `
      <div style="
        width:${width}px;
        min-width:${width}px;
        height:${size}px;
        position:relative;
        flex-shrink:0;
        margin-right:${isRich ? 10 : 8}px;
      ">
        ${avatars.map((avatar, i) => `
          <img src="${escapeHTML(avatar)}"
               style="
                 position:absolute;
                 left:${i * step}px;
                 top:0;
                 width:${size}px;
                 height:${size}px;
                 border-radius:50%;
                 object-fit:cover;
                 border:${border}px solid var(--sidebar-bg);
                 background:var(--input-bg);
               "
               onerror="this.style.display='none'">
        `).join('')}
        ${showExtraCount ? `
          <span style="
            position:absolute;
            left:${avatars.length * step + 8}px;
            top:50%;
            transform:translateY(-50%);
            font-size:11px;
            font-weight:600;
            opacity:0.82;
            white-space:nowrap;
            line-height:1;
          ">+${extraCount}</span>
        ` : ''}
      </div>
    `;
}

    const isOpen = localStorage.getItem('furai_pinned_chats_open') !== 'false';
    localStorage.setItem('furai_pinned_chats_open', isOpen ? 'false' : 'true');

    const searchInput = document.getElementById('chatSearchInput');
    updateChatList(searchInput ? searchInput.value : '');
}

function getActiveSidebarSearchQuery() {
    const input = document.getElementById('chatSearchInput');
    return input ? String(input.value || '') : '';
}

function updateChatList(searchQuery = null) {
    const chatListEl = document.getElementById('chatListEl');
    if (!chatListEl) return;

    const sidebar = document.getElementById('menuSidebarEl');
    if (
        isMobileSidebarMode() &&
        sidebar &&
        sidebar.classList.contains('sidebar-animating')
    ) {
        mobileSidebarDeferredRefreshPending = true;
        mobileSidebarDeferredRefreshQuery = searchQuery;
        return;
    }

    // Preserve live sidebar search on normal refreshes. Explicit '' still clears.
    if (searchQuery === null || typeof searchQuery === 'undefined') {
        searchQuery = getActiveSidebarSearchQuery();
    }

    const isSearch = String(searchQuery || '').trim() !== '';

    // Fast-start path: opening a fresh chat/mode should not touch old huge logs.
    // Search now uses the lightweight sidebar index too.
    if (!isSearch && Date.now() < furaiBlockSidebarUntil) {
        return;
    }

    const rows = getSidebarMetaRowsForList(searchQuery);

    // Sidebar rendering is read-only. Home launchers and untouched shells stay hidden,
    // while actual deletion remains inside the explicit cleanup commands.
    const allChats = rows.filter(chat => (
        chat.personality !== 'home' &&
        !isSidebarMetaUntouched(chat)
    ));

    if (
        allChats.length === 0 &&
        furaiSidebarMetaRebuildQueued &&
        Object.keys(StorageEngine.cache).some(isChatStorageKey)
    ) {
        chatListEl.innerHTML = `
          <div class="sidebar-chat-loading" aria-label="Loading chats">
            <span class="furai-mini-spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          </div>
        `;
        chatListEl.dataset.sidebarRenderState = 'loading';
        return;
    }

    allChats.sort((a, b) => (b.timestamp || 0) - (a.timestamp || 0));

    const sidebarMode = getSidebarMode();
    const folders = FolderManager.getFolders();
    const folderNameById = Object.fromEntries(folders.map(f => [f.id, f.name]));
    const folderChatsById = new Map();
    const renderParts = [];

    allChats.forEach(chat => {
        const folderChats = folderChatsById.get(chat.folderId);
        if (folderChats) folderChats.push(chat);
        else folderChatsById.set(chat.folderId, [chat]);
    });

    // --- RENDERER HELPER ---
    const renderItem = (chat, hidePinnedStatus = false) => {
        const iconHTML = getPersonalityIcon(chat.personality);
        const displayTitle = escapeHTML(chat.title);
        const lastActiveText = formatSidebarLastActive(chat.timestamp);
        const presence = getSidebarPresenceData(chat);
    
        const isActive = (chat.id === currentChatId) || (chat.id === mobileSelectedId);
        const activeClass = isActive ? 'active' : '';
    
        const isActuallyPinned = chat.isPinned && !hidePinnedStatus;
        const pinnedClass = isActuallyPinned ? 'pinned' : '';
        const pinnedIcon = isActuallyPinned ? `<span class="material-symbols-outlined pinned-icon">keep</span>` : '';
        const isGenerating = ongoingGenerations[chat.id] ? '<span class="typing-dot">...</span>' : '';
    
        let folderTag = '';
        if (!hidePinnedStatus && chat.folderId) {
            const fName = folderNameById[chat.folderId];
            if (fName) {
                folderTag = `<span style="font-size:10px; opacity:0.5; margin-left:6px; border:1px solid var(--border-color); padding:0 3px; border-radius:3px;">${escapeHTML(fName)}</span>`;
            }
        }
    
        if (sidebarMode === 'normal') {
            return `
              <div class="chat-item ${activeClass} ${pinnedClass}" data-id="${chat.id}" onclick="handleChatClick(event, '${chat.id}')">
                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; flex:1; overflow:hidden;">
                  ${pinnedIcon}
                  ${isGenerating}
                  <span class="chat-title" style="white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;">${displayTitle}</span>
                  ${folderTag}
                  <span class="chat-item-icon">${iconHTML}</span>
                </div>
                <button class="options-btn" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); openChatOptionsModal('${chat.id}')">⋮</button>
              </div>`;
        }
    
        if (sidebarMode === 'balanced') {
            const leftAvatar = presence.isGroup
                ? buildSidebarAvatarStack(presence.stackAvatars, presence.extraCount, 'balanced')
                : '';
    
            return `
              <div class="chat-item chat-item-balanced ${activeClass} ${pinnedClass}" data-id="${chat.id}" onclick="handleChatClick(event, '${chat.id}')">
                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; flex:1; overflow:hidden;">
                  ${leftAvatar}
                  <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; flex:1; overflow:hidden; min-width:0;">
                    ${pinnedIcon}
                    ${isGenerating}
                    <span class="chat-title" style="white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;">${displayTitle}</span>
                    ${folderTag}
                    <span class="chat-item-icon">${iconHTML}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <button class="options-btn" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); openChatOptionsModal('${chat.id}')">⋮</button>
              </div>`;
        }
    
        const richAvatar = (presence.isGroup || presence.isMaker)
            ? buildSidebarAvatarStack(presence.stackAvatars, presence.extraCount, 'rich')
            : `
              <img src="${escapeHTML(presence.primaryAvatar)}"
                   style="
                     width:32px;
                     height:32px;
                     border-radius:50%;
                     object-fit:cover;
                     flex-shrink:0;
                     margin-right:10px;
                     background:var(--input-bg);
                     border:2px solid var(--sidebar-bg);
                   "
                   onerror="this.style.display='none'">
            `;
        
        const richMeta = presence.shouldShowMemberText
            ? `<div class="chat-item-meta"><span>${presence.totalOnline} <span data-furai-ui-translate>members</span></span><span>${lastActiveText}</span></div>`
            : `<div class="chat-item-meta solo"><span>${lastActiveText}</span></div>`;
        
        return `
          <div class="chat-item chat-item-rich ${activeClass} ${pinnedClass}" data-id="${chat.id}" onclick="handleChatClick(event, '${chat.id}')">
            <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; flex:1; min-width:0;">
              ${richAvatar}
              <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; min-width:0; flex:1;">
                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; min-width:0; overflow:hidden;">
                  ${pinnedIcon}
                  ${isGenerating}
                  <span class="chat-title" style="white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;">${displayTitle}</span>
                  ${folderTag}
                  <span class="chat-item-icon">${iconHTML}</span>
                </div>
                ${richMeta}
              </div>
            </div>
            <button class="options-btn" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); openChatOptionsModal('${chat.id}')">⋮</button>
          </div>`;
    };

    // --- 1. PINNED ---
    const pinnedChats = allChats.filter(c => c.isPinned);
    if (pinnedChats.length > 0) {
        const pinnedOpen = localStorage.getItem('furai_pinned_chats_open') !== 'false';
        const pinnedIcon = pinnedOpen ? 'fa-chevron-down' : 'fa-chevron-right';

        renderParts.push(`
            <div class="date-category-header" onclick="togglePinnedChatsSection()" style="cursor:pointer; display:flex; align-items:center;">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-thumbtack" style="font-size:0.8em; margin-right:6px;"></i>
                <span data-furai-ui-translate>Pinned</span>
                <span style="font-size:11px; opacity:0.4; margin-left:4px;">(${pinnedChats.length})</span>
                <i class="fa-solid ${pinnedIcon}" style="font-size:0.7em; margin-left:auto; opacity:0.5;"></i>
            </div>
        `);

        if (pinnedOpen) {
            pinnedChats.forEach(chat => renderParts.push(renderItem(chat, false)));
        }
    }

    // --- 2. FOLDERS ---
    if (folders.length > 0) {
        const masterOpen = localStorage.getItem('furai_folders_master_open') !== 'false';
        const masterIcon = masterOpen ? 'fa-chevron-down' : 'fa-chevron-right';

        renderParts.push(`
            <div class="date-category-header" onclick="FolderManager.toggleMaster()" style="cursor:pointer; display:flex; align-items:center;">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-folder" style="font-size:0.8em; margin-right:6px;"></i>
                <span data-furai-ui-translate>Folders</span>
                <i class="fa-solid ${masterIcon}" style="font-size:0.7em; margin-left:auto; opacity:0.5;"></i>
            </div>
        `);

        if (masterOpen) {
            folders.forEach(folder => {
                const folderChats = folderChatsById.get(folder.id) || [];
                const count = folderChats.length;
                const folderIcon = folder.isOpen ? 'fa-regular fa-folder-open fa-xs' : 'fa-regular fa-folder fa-xs';

                // [FIX] Active class logic for mobile selection
                const activeClass = (folder.id === mobileSelectedId) ? 'active' : '';

                // [FIX] Using 'folder-header-row', data-id, and handleFolderClick
                renderParts.push(`
                    <div class="folder-header-row ${activeClass}" data-id="${folder.id}" onclick="handleFolderClick(event, '${folder.id}')">
                        <div style="flex:1; display:flex; align-items:center; font-weight:500; font-size:14px;">
                            <i class="${folderIcon}" style="margin-right:8px; opacity:0.7;"></i>
                            <span style="opacity:0.9;">${escapeHTML(folder.name)}</span>
                            <span style="font-size:11px; opacity:0.4; margin-left:6px;">(${count})</span>
                        </div>
                        <button class="folder-options-btn" onclick="openFolderOptions('${folder.id}', event)">⋮</button>
                    </div>
                `);

                if (folder.isOpen) {
                    if (folderChats.length === 0) {
                        renderParts.push(`<div style="padding:8px 24px; font-size:12px; opacity:0.4; font-style:italic;"><span data-furai-ui-translate>Empty folder</span></div>`);
                    } else {
                        folderChats.forEach(chat => {
                            const itemHTML = renderItem(chat, true); // Hide pinned status
                            const indented = itemHTML.replace('class="chat-item', 'style="margin-left:12px; width:calc(100% - 12px);" class="chat-item');
                            renderParts.push(indented);
                        });
                    }
                }
            });
        }
    }

    // --- 3. HISTORY ---
    const historyChats = allChats.filter(c => !c.folderId && !c.isPinned);
    if (historyChats.length > 0) {
        const chatsByCategory = historyChats.reduce((acc, chat) => {
            const category = categorizeChatDate(chat.timestamp);
            (acc[category] = acc[category] || []).push(chat);
            return acc;
        }, {});

        Object.keys(chatsByCategory).forEach(category => {
            renderParts.push(`<div class="date-category-header"><span data-furai-ui-translate>${escapeHTML(category)}</span></div>`);
            chatsByCategory[category].forEach(chat => renderParts.push(renderItem(chat, false)));
        });
    } else if (allChats.length === 0 && !searchQuery) {
        renderParts.push(`
            <div style="padding:20px; color:var(--rename-color); font-size:0.9em; opacity:0.7;">
                <div style="text-align:center;">No history yet.</div>
                <div style="margin:8px auto 0 auto; max-width:250px; font-size:12px; line-height:1.45; opacity:0.72; text-align:left;">
                    Local-only storage: clearing browser data can erase chats and characters. Export backups regularly.
                </div>
            </div>
        `);
    }

    // Commit the complete sidebar in one DOM write. Existing IDs, classes, ordering,
    // and inline interaction routes remain unchanged.
    chatListEl.innerHTML = renderParts.join('');
    chatListEl.dataset.sidebarRenderState = 'ready';

    // NOTE: Listeners for swipe/touch gestures are still handled by your existing code if needed,
    // but the main click/tap logic is now handled inline by handleChatClick/handleFolderClick.
}

  function triggerOnlineRipple() {
      const dot = document.querySelector('.online-dot');
      if (dot) {
          dot.classList.remove('rippling');
          void dot.offsetWidth; // Force reflow to restart animation
          dot.classList.add('rippling');
          // Auto-cleanup to save resources
          setTimeout(() => { if(dot) dot.classList.remove('rippling'); }, 1250); 
      }
  }

// Helper to keep loadChat clean (Optimization)
function updateUIForPersonality(personality, inputEl, profileOverride = null) {
    if (typeof updateFuraiModeMenuLabel === 'function') updateFuraiModeMenuLabel(personality);

    const directBtn = document.getElementById('singleToolBtn');
    const menuContainer = document.getElementById('toolsMenuContainer');
    const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('botAutoReplyBtn'); 
    const makerBtn = document.getElementById('makerBtn');
    const storyBtn = document.getElementById('storyBtn');

    // Real chat identity owns input visibility; selector DOM is only rendered output.
    const isLobby = isHomeScreenActive();
    const inputContainer = document.querySelector('.chat-input-container');
    
    if (!isLobby && inputContainer) {
        if (inputContainer.style.display === 'none') {
            inputContainer.style.display = 'flex';
        }
        inputContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
        document.body.classList.remove('vn-no-input');
    }
    // --- FIX END ---
    
    // Reset all buttons
    document.getElementById('narratorSendBtn').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('enhancerBtn').style.display = 'none';
    if (storyBtn) storyBtn.style.display = 'none';
    if (toggleBtn) toggleBtn.style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('singleBotProfileContainer').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('groupBotProfilesContainer').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('onlineCountEl').style.display = 'none';
    
    const castBtn = document.getElementById('castSwitchBtn');
    const castBtnLabel = document.getElementById('castSwitchBtnLabel') || document.querySelector('#castSwitchBtn span');
    const castBtnIcon = document.getElementById('castSwitchBtnIcon');
    
    if (castBtn) {
        castBtn.style.display = 'none';
        castBtn.setAttribute('onclick', 'openCastSwitchingModal()');
    }
    
    if (castBtnLabel) castBtnLabel.textContent = 'Manage Group';
    if (castBtnIcon) castBtnIcon.className = 'fa-solid fa-users-viewfinder fa-sm';
    
    if (makerBtn) makerBtn.style.display = 'none';

    if (personality === 'researcher') {
        directBtn.style.display = 'none';
        menuContainer.style.display = 'none';
        inputEl.placeholder = 'Ask anything';
    } 
    else if (personality === 'prompter') {
        directBtn.style.display = 'none';
        menuContainer.style.display = 'block';
        inputEl.placeholder = 'Enhance prompt... (Type / for commands)';
    } 
    else if (personality === 'story') {
        directBtn.style.display = 'none';
        menuContainer.style.display = 'none';
        inputEl.placeholder = 'Guide the story... (Type / for commands)';

        document.getElementById('narratorSendBtn').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('enhancerBtn').style.display = 'none';
        if (storyBtn) storyBtn.style.display = 'flex';

        document.getElementById('singleBotProfileContainer').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('groupBotProfilesContainer').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('onlineCountEl').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('castSwitchBtn').style.display = 'flex';

        const castBtn = document.getElementById('castSwitchBtn');
        const castBtnLabel = document.getElementById('castSwitchBtnLabel');
        const castBtnIcon = document.getElementById('castSwitchBtnIcon');
        
        if (castBtn) castBtn.setAttribute('onclick', 'openStoryChatCastModal()');
        if (castBtnLabel) castBtnLabel.textContent = 'Story Cast';
        if (castBtnIcon) castBtnIcon.className = 'fa-solid fa-people-pulling fa-sm';

        const singleBotLabel = document.getElementById('singleBotProfileLabel');
        if (singleBotLabel) singleBotLabel.textContent = 'Story FurAI Profile';

        if (!localStorage.getItem('furai_story_continue_hint_seen')) {
            setTimeout(() => {
                showOverlayHint(`
                    <strong><i class="fa-solid fa-feather" style="margin-right:6px; color:var(--primary-color);"></i>Story Mode</strong><br>
                    <strong>Feather Button</strong> makes FurAI continue the story directly.<br>
                    If text is in the box, it becomes a <strong>one-time cue</strong> for the next continuation only.<br><br>
                    You can also open <strong>Chat Settings → Story Cast</strong> to add characters into this story.
                `, 0);
                localStorage.setItem('furai_story_continue_hint_seen', 'true');
            }, 800);
        }
    }
    else if (personality === 'maker') {
        directBtn.style.display = 'none';
        menuContainer.style.display = 'none';
        if (makerBtn) makerBtn.style.display = 'flex';
        inputEl.placeholder = 'Describe the character... (Type @ to interact with them)';

        // ACT LIKE GROUP MODE: Show Roster, Online Count, and Mentions
        document.getElementById('narratorSendBtn').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('enhancerBtn').style.display = 'none';
        if (storyBtn) storyBtn.style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('singleBotProfileContainer').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('groupBotProfilesContainer').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('onlineCountEl').style.display = 'flex';
        document.getElementById('castSwitchBtn').style.display = 'flex';

        updateOnlineCount(profileOverride);
        renderGroupBotMenu(profileOverride);
        triggerOnlineRipple();
    }
    else if (personality === 'group') {
        directBtn.style.display = 'none';
        menuContainer.style.display = 'none';
        inputEl.placeholder = 'Type @ to mention, / for commands';
        
        document.getElementById('narratorSendBtn').style.display = 'flex';
        document.getElementById('enhancerBtn').style.display = 'flex';
        if (storyBtn) storyBtn.style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('singleBotProfileContainer').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('groupBotProfilesContainer').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('onlineCountEl').style.display = 'flex';
        document.getElementById('castSwitchBtn').style.display = 'flex';

        const singleBotLabel = document.getElementById('singleBotProfileLabel');
        if (singleBotLabel) singleBotLabel.textContent = 'FurAI Profile';
        
        if (!localStorage.getItem('furai_group_hint_seen')) {
            setTimeout(() => {
                showOverlayHint(`
                    Click the <i class="fa-solid fa-circle" style="color:#00e676; font-size:10px; margin:0 4px;"></i> Online Count to make characters speak
                `, 4500);
                localStorage.setItem('furai_group_hint_seen', 'true');
            }, 800);
        }
        
        updateOnlineCount(profileOverride);
        renderGroupBotMenu(profileOverride);
        triggerOnlineRipple();
        if (typeof updateEnhancerButton === 'function') updateEnhancerButton();
        if (typeof updateEnhancerButtonUI === 'function') updateEnhancerButtonUI();
    }
}

window.toggleChatPin = function(chatId = null) {
    const targetChatId = chatId || optionsTargetChatId || currentChatId;
    if (!targetChatId) return;

    let chatData = null;

    try {
        chatData = DB.get(targetChatId);
    } catch(e) {}

    if (!chatData) return;

    chatData.isPinned = !chatData.isPinned;
    DB.set(targetChatId, chatData);

    if (typeof updateChatList === 'function') {
        updateChatList(document.getElementById('chatSearchInput')?.value || '');
    }

    if (typeof updateSelectionUI === 'function' && currentChatId) {
        updateSelectionUI(currentChatId);
    }

    const modal = document.getElementById('chatOptionsModalEl');
    if (modal && modal.style.display !== 'none' && typeof openChatOptionsModal === 'function') {
        openChatOptionsModal(targetChatId);
    }

    if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
        showToast(chatData.isPinned ? 'Chat pinned.' : 'Chat unpinned.');
    }
};

function openChatOptionsModal(chatId = null) {
    restoreChatOptionsFontPreview();

    // 1. Determine target
    optionsTargetChatId = chatId || currentChatId;

    // 2. Load data
    let chatData = null;
    try { 
        chatData = DB.get(optionsTargetChatId); 
    } catch(e) {}

    if (chatData) {
        if (chatData.personality) {
            chatPersonalities[optionsTargetChatId] = chatData.personality;
            window.chatPersonalities = chatPersonalities;
        }

        const isPinned = chatData.isPinned || false;
        const pinBtnIcon = isPinned ? 'keep_off' : 'keep'; 
        
        // --- HEADER ---
        const modalHeader = document.querySelector('#chatOptionsModalEl .modal-header');
        modalHeader.innerHTML = `
            <h3 style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0;">Chat Options</h3>
            <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;">
                <button onclick="toggleChatPin('${optionsTargetChatId}')" title="${isPinned ? 'Unpin' : 'Pin'}" 
                        style="padding: 6px; border: none; background: none; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 50%;">
                    <span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size: 20px; color: var(--text-color);">${pinBtnIcon}</span>
                </button>
                <button onclick="closeChatOptionsModal()" title="Close" 
                        style="padding: 6px; border: none; background: none; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 50%;">
                    <span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size: 24px; color: var(--text-color);">close</span>
                </button>
            </div>
        `;

        const modalBody = document.querySelector('#chatOptionsModalEl .modal-body');
        modalBody.innerHTML = ''; // Clear old content

        // --- 1. RENDER FOLDER SELECTOR ---
        const folders = FolderManager.getFolders();
        let folderOptionsHTML = `<option value="">(No Folder)</option>`;
        
        folders.forEach(f => {
            const selected = (chatData.folderId === f.id) ? 'selected' : '';
            folderOptionsHTML += `<option value="${f.id}" ${selected}>${escapeHTML(f.name)}</option>`;
        });

        // Folder Dropdown UI
        const folderUI = `
            <div class="form-group" style="margin-bottom:15px;">
                <label style="font-size:12px; font-weight:600; opacity:0.7;">Folder</label>
                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;">
                    <select id="folderSelect" onchange="moveChatToFolder('${optionsTargetChatId}', this.value)" 
                        style="flex:1; padding:10px; background:var(--sidebar-bg); color:var(--text-color); border:1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius:6px; font-size:14px; outline:none;">
                        ${folderOptionsHTML}
                    </select>
                    <button onclick="createNewFolderPrompt('${optionsTargetChatId}')" title="Create New Folder" style="background:var(--sidebar-hover); border:1px solid var(--border-color); color:var(--text-color); border-radius:6px; width:42px; height:42px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; cursor:pointer; flex-shrink:0;">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-plus"></i>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;

        // --- 2. RENDER NAME INPUT ---
        const nameUI = `
            <div class="form-group" style="margin-bottom:15px;">
                <label for="chatNameInput" style="font-size:12px; font-weight:600; opacity:0.7;">Chat Name</label>
                <input type="text"
                       id="chatNameInput"
                       value="${escapeHTML(chatData.title)}"
                       style="width:100%; padding:10px; background:var(--sidebar-bg); color:var(--text-color); border:1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius:6px; font-size:14px; outline:none; box-sizing:border-box;">
            </div>
        `;

        const timestampPreference = getTimestampPreferenceForChat(optionsTargetChatId);
        const optionsPersonality = chatPersonalities[optionsTargetChatId] || chatData.personality || 'researcher';
        const messageImagePromptingEnabled = getBubbleImageAiEnabledForChat(optionsTargetChatId, optionsPersonality);
        const toggleCardsUI = `
            <div class="form-group" style="margin-bottom:15px;">
                <div class="chat-options-toggle-grid">
                    <label class="furai-switch-row chat-options-toggle-card" for="chatTimestampPreferenceToggle">
                        <span>Timestamp</span>
                        <span class="furai-switch">
                            <input id="chatTimestampPreferenceToggle" type="checkbox" role="switch" ${timestampPreference === 'on' ? 'checked' : ''}>
                            <span class="furai-switch-track" aria-hidden="true">
                                <span class="furai-switch-knob"></span>
                            </span>
                        </span>
                    </label>

                    <label class="furai-switch-row chat-options-toggle-card" for="chatMessageImageAiToggle">
                        <span>Image Button AI Prompting</span>
                        <span class="furai-switch">
                            <input id="chatMessageImageAiToggle" type="checkbox" role="switch" ${messageImagePromptingEnabled ? 'checked' : ''}>
                            <span class="furai-switch-track" aria-hidden="true">
                                <span class="furai-switch-knob"></span>
                            </span>
                        </span>
                    </label>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
        
        const chatFontStyle = getChatFontSelectValue(chatData);
        const chatFontUI = `
            <div class="form-group">
                <label for="chatFontStyleSelect" style="font-size:12px; font-weight:600; opacity:0.7;">Font Style</label>
        
                <select id="chatFontStyleSelect"
                        onchange="previewChatOptionsFont(this.value)"
                        style="width:100%; padding:10px; background:var(--sidebar-bg); color:var(--text-color); border:1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius:6px; font-size:14px; outline:none;">
                    ${buildFontOptionsHtml(chatFontStyle, {
                        includeGlobal: true,
                        globalLabel: 'Follow Mode Font',
                        includeMain: true,
                        mainLabel: 'Follow Main Font',
                        defaultLabel: 'Default'
                    })}
                </select>
            </div>
        `;


        const bubbleImageUI = '';

        const chatOptionsMode = String(chatPersonalities[optionsTargetChatId] || chatData.personality || 'researcher');
        const chatOptionsModeMeta = typeof getFuraiSwitchModeMeta === 'function'
            ? getFuraiSwitchModeMeta(chatOptionsMode)
            : null;
        const canChangeChatMode = optionsTargetChatId === currentChatId &&
            !!chatOptionsModeMeta &&
            Array.isArray(chatData.messages) &&
            chatData.messages.length > 0;
        const chatOptionsModeIcon = chatOptionsModeMeta
            ? (chatOptionsModeMeta.icon.includes(' ') ? chatOptionsModeMeta.icon : `fa-solid ${chatOptionsModeMeta.icon}`)
            : 'fa-solid fa-comments';
        const modeUI = !canChangeChatMode ? '' : `
            <div class="chat-options-mode-card">
                <span class="chat-options-mode-card-icon"><i class="${chatOptionsModeIcon}"></i></span>
                <span class="chat-options-mode-card-copy">
                    <small data-furai-ui-translate>Mode</small>
                    <strong id="furaiChatOptionsModeValue" data-furai-ui-translate>${escapeHTML(chatOptionsModeMeta.label)}</strong>
                </span>
                <button type="button"
                        class="chat-options-mode-change"
                        onclick="window.openFuraiModeSwitcher()">
                    <span data-furai-ui-translate>Change</span>
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                </button>
            </div>
        `;

        const dateTimeFormatOptions = { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: 'numeric', minute: 'numeric', hour12: true };
        
        // Calculate Word Count (Optimized: Counts per message to prevent RAM spikes on massive chats)
        let chatWordCount = 0;
        const chatMessageCount = getFuraiCountableMessageDataCount(chatData);
        if (chatData.messages && Array.isArray(chatData.messages)) {
            for (let i = 0; i < chatData.messages.length; i++) {
                const text = chatData.messages[i].content;
                if (text) {
                    // match(/\S+/g) finds all words without creating empty array slots
                    const words = text.match(/\S+/g); 
                    if (words) chatWordCount += words.length;
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Member preview (User + all bot slots in this chat)
        const profile = getChatProfile(optionsTargetChatId);
        const bots = Array.isArray(profile?.bots) ? profile.bots : [];
        const isLivingRosterMode = chatData.personality === 'group' || chatData.personality === 'maker';
        
        const livingBots = isLivingRosterMode
            ? bots.filter(b => b.inActiveCast)
            : bots.slice(0, 1);
        
        const memberAvatars = [
            profile?.user?.avatar,
            ...livingBots.map(b => b.avatar)
        ].filter(Boolean);
        
        const memberCount = 1 + livingBots.length;

        const isGroupChat = (chatPersonalities[optionsTargetChatId] || chatData.personality) === 'group';
        const rosterSnapshotSaved = isGroupChat && (
            profile?.rosterMode === 'snapshot' ||
            !!profile?.rosterSnapshotSavedAt
        );

        const rosterSnapshotUI = !isGroupChat ? '' : `
            <div style="margin:15px 0; padding:13px 14px; border:1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius:8px; background:var(--sidebar-bg);">
                <div style="display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px;">
                    <div style="min-width:0;">
                        <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; font-size:13px; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:5px;">
                            <span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size:19px; color:var(--primary-color);">${rosterSnapshotSaved ? 'inventory_2' : 'sync'}</span>
                            <span>${rosterSnapshotSaved ? 'Roster Snapshot Saved' : 'Linked to Character Library'}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div style="font-size:12px; line-height:1.45; opacity:0.72;">
                            ${rosterSnapshotSaved
                                ? 'All current offline characters are stored in this chat and stay unchanged even if your Character Library is edited or characters are deleted.'
                                : 'Offline characters follow your Character Library and may change or disappear if edited or deleted. Save a snapshot to preserve their current versions in this chat.'}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <button type="button"
                            onclick="${rosterSnapshotSaved ? 'removeRosterSnapshotForChat' : 'saveRosterSnapshotForChat'}('${optionsTargetChatId}')"
                            style="flex-shrink:0; align-self:center; min-height:36px; padding:8px 11px; border-radius:7px; border:1px solid var(--border-color); background:${rosterSnapshotSaved ? 'var(--input-bg)' : 'var(--primary-color)'}; color:${rosterSnapshotSaved ? 'var(--text-color)' : 'var(--btn-text-color)'}; cursor:pointer; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; white-space:normal; line-height:1.2; max-width:126px;">
                        ${rosterSnapshotSaved ? 'Use Linked Roster' : 'Save Roster Snapshot'}
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
        
        const visibleMemberAvatars = memberAvatars.slice(0, 6);
        
        const memberPreviewHTML = visibleMemberAvatars.map((avatar, i) => `
            <img src="${escapeHTML(avatar)}"
                 style="
                    width:22px;
                    height:22px;
                    border-radius:50%;
                    object-fit:cover;
                    border:1.5px solid var(--sidebar-bg);
                    margin-left:${i === 0 ? '0' : '-7px'};
                    background:var(--input-bg);
                    flex-shrink:0;
                 "
                 onerror="this.style.display='none'">
        `).join('') + (memberCount > 6 ? `
            <span style="
                margin-left:2px;
                font-size:12px;
                opacity:0.7;
                white-space:nowrap;
                flex-shrink:0;
            ">...</span>
        ` : '');

        const infoUI = `
            <div class="chat-date-info">
              <p style="margin: 6px 0 4px 0; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;">
                <strong style="flex-shrink:0;">Member:</strong>
                <span style="display:flex; align-items:center; min-width:0;">
                  <span style="display:flex; align-items:center; margin-right:8px;">
                    ${memberPreviewHTML}
                  </span>
                  <span style="opacity:0.85; white-space:nowrap;">${memberCount.toLocaleString()} ${memberCount === 1 ? 'member' : 'members'}</span>
                </span>
              </p>
              <p style="margin: 4px 0;"><strong>Created:</strong> <span id="chatCreationTime">${new Date(parseInt(optionsTargetChatId.replace('chat-', ''))).toLocaleString('en-US', dateTimeFormatOptions)}</span></p>
              <p style="margin: 4px 0;"><strong>Last Active:</strong> <span id="chatLastActiveTime">${new Date(chatData.timestamp).toLocaleString('en-US', dateTimeFormatOptions)}</span></p>
              <p style="margin: 4px 0;"><strong>Chat Length:</strong> <span>${chatWordCount.toLocaleString()} words · ${chatMessageCount.toLocaleString()} ${chatMessageCount === 1 ? 'message' : 'messages'}</span></p>
            </div>
        `;

        // --- 4. RENDER BUTTON GRID ---
        const gridUI = `
            <div class="options-grid">
                <button onclick="openExportModal()">
                    <span class="material-symbols-outlined">ios_share</span> <span>Share</span>
                </button>
                <button onclick="duplicateCurrentChat()">
                  <span class="material-symbols-outlined">graph_8</span> <span>Duplicate</span>
                </button>
                <button onclick="deleteCurrentChat()" class="delete-btn">
                  <span class="material-symbols-outlined">delete</span> <span>Delete</span>
                </button>
                <button onclick="saveChatOptionsModal()">
                  <span class="material-symbols-outlined">save</span> <span>Save</span>
                </button>
            </div>
        `;

        // Assemble
        modalBody.innerHTML = folderUI + nameUI + modeUI + toggleCardsUI + chatFontUI + bubbleImageUI + rosterSnapshotUI + infoUI + gridUI;
        document.getElementById('chatOptionsModalEl').style.display = 'flex';
    }
}

// Helper to save folder change instantly
function moveChatToFolder(chatId, folderId) {
    try {
        let chatData = DB.get(chatId);
        if (folderId) chatData.folderId = folderId;
        else delete chatData.folderId; // Remove property to send back to history
        
        DB.set(chatId, chatData);
        updateChatList();
    } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
}

/* --- INLINE FOLDER CREATOR --- */
window.inlineCreateFolder = function(chatId) {
    const name = prompt("Enter new folder name:");
    if (name && name.trim()) {
        const newName = name.trim();
        const newId = 'f_' + Date.now();
        
        // 1. Create the folder
        const list = FolderManager.getFolders();
        list.push({ id: newId, name: newName, isOpen: true });
        FolderManager.saveFolders(list);
        
        // 2. Instantly assign the chat to the new folder
        moveChatToFolder(chatId, newId);
        
        // 3. Refresh the modal so the dropdown updates
        openChatOptionsModal(chatId);
        showToast(`Folder "${newName}" created!`, "success");
    }
};
  
function previewChatOptionsFont(fontKey) {
    const targetId = optionsTargetChatId || currentChatId;

    // Chat Options can be opened for a different sidebar chat.
    // Only preview on the chat that is actually visible.
    if (!targetId || targetId !== currentChatId) return;

    try {
        const savedChatData = DB.get(targetId);
        if (!savedChatData) return;

        const previewChatData = { ...savedChatData };
        writeChatFontChoice(previewChatData, fontKey);

        const previewState = resolveChatFontState(previewChatData);

        chatOptionsFontPreviewChatId = targetId;
        void applyChatRenderFontForData(previewChatData, {
            previewState: {
                source: previewState.source === 'chat'
                    ? 'chat-preview'
                    : previewState.source === 'main' ? 'main-preview' : 'mode-preview',
                mode: previewState.mode,
                fontKey: previewState.fontKey
            }
        });
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Chat font preview failed:', e);
    }
}

function previewGlobalChatFont(mode, fontKey) {
    const normalizedMode = String(mode || '').trim();
    if (!normalizedMode || !currentChatId) return;

    try {
        const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
        if (
            !chatData ||
            getChatFontChoice(chatData) !== FURAI_CHAT_FONT_GLOBAL_VALUE ||
            getChatPersonalityForFontData(chatData) !== normalizedMode
        ) {
            return;
        }

        const modeFont = normalizeOptionalFontKey(fontKey);

        globalFontPreviewChatId = currentChatId;
        globalFontPreviewMode = normalizedMode;

        void applyChatRenderFontForData(chatData, {
            previewState: {
                source: 'global-preview',
                mode: normalizedMode,
                fontKey: modeFont || getSavedInterfaceFont()
            }
        });
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Global chat font preview failed:', e);
    }
}

function clearGlobalChatFontPreview(mode = '') {
    if (mode && globalFontPreviewMode && globalFontPreviewMode !== mode) return;

    globalFontPreviewChatId = null;
    globalFontPreviewMode = '';
}

function restoreGlobalChatFontPreview() {
    const previewChatId = globalFontPreviewChatId;
    clearGlobalChatFontPreview();

    if (!previewChatId || previewChatId !== currentChatId) return;

    try {
        const savedChatData = DB.get(previewChatId);
        if (savedChatData) {
            void applyChatRenderFontForData(savedChatData);
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Global chat font preview restore failed:', e);
    }
}

function restoreChatOptionsFontPreview() {
    const previewChatId = chatOptionsFontPreviewChatId;
    chatOptionsFontPreviewChatId = null;

    if (!previewChatId || previewChatId !== currentChatId) return;

    try {
        const savedChatData = DB.get(previewChatId);

        if (savedChatData) {
            void applyChatRenderFontForData(savedChatData);
        } else {
            clearChatRenderFont();
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Chat font preview restore failed:', e);
    }
}

function closeChatOptionsModal() {
    restoreChatOptionsFontPreview();

    const modal = document.getElementById('chatOptionsModalEl');
    if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
}

function saveChatOptionsModal() {
    const targetId = optionsTargetChatId || currentChatId;
    if (!targetId) return;

    const nameInput = document.getElementById('chatNameInput');
    const timestampToggle = document.getElementById('chatTimestampPreferenceToggle');
    const fontSelect = document.getElementById('chatFontStyleSelect');
    const messageImageAiToggle = document.getElementById('chatMessageImageAiToggle');

    const newName = nameInput ? nameInput.value.trim() : '';
    const timestampValue = timestampToggle && timestampToggle.checked ? 'on' : 'off';
    const bubbleImageAiValue = messageImageAiToggle && messageImageAiToggle.checked ? 'on' : 'off';

    if (!newName) {
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast("Chat name is empty.", "error");
        return;
    }

    try {
        const chatData = DB.get(targetId);
        if (!chatData) return;

        chatData.title = newName;
        chatData.name = newName;

        if (timestampValue === 'on' || timestampValue === 'off') {
            chatData.timestampPreference = timestampValue;
        } else {
            delete chatData.timestampPreference;
        }

        writeChatFontChoice(
            chatData,
            fontSelect ? fontSelect.value : getChatFontSelectValue(chatData)
        );

        if (bubbleImageAiValue === 'on' || bubbleImageAiValue === 'off') {
            chatData.bubbleImageAi = bubbleImageAiValue;
        } else {
            delete chatData.bubbleImageAi;
        }

        delete chatData.textColors;

        DB.set(targetId, chatData);

        if (typeof chatTitles !== 'undefined') {
            chatTitles[targetId] = newName;
        }

        if (targetId === currentChatId) {
            const titleEl = document.getElementById('chatTitleEl');
            if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = newName;

            refreshVisibleMessageTimestamps();
            void applyChatRenderFontForData(chatData);
            applyTextColorsForChatData(chatData);
        }

        updateChatList();
        closeChatOptionsModal();

        if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
            showToast("Chat options saved.", "success");
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Save chat options failed:", e);
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
            showToast("Save failed.", "error");
        }
    }
}

function saveRenamedChat() {
    saveChatOptionsModal();
}
  
function deleteCurrentChat() {
    const idToDelete = optionsTargetChatId || currentChatId;
    if (!idToDelete) return;

    const deletedChatData = DB.get(idToDelete) || null;
    const shouldClearDeepMemory = Boolean(
        deletedChatData?.deepMemoryInitialized ||
        deletedChatData?.memoryMode === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP
    );
    const wasActiveChat = idToDelete === currentChatId;
    const bareId = String(idToDelete).replace(/^chat-/, '');
    const idVariants = new Set([idToDelete, bareId, `chat-${bareId}`].filter(Boolean));

    idVariants.forEach(id => {
        clearFuraiMemoryModeCache(id);
        clearFuraiFullHistoryEstimateCache(id);
        releaseFuraiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex(id);
        if (typeof furaiRoleTimelinePositionCache !== 'undefined') {
            furaiRoleTimelinePositionCache.delete(String(id));
        }
        DB.remove(id, true);
        DB.remove(`profile-${id}`, true);
        delete chatTitles[id];
        delete chatDrafts[id];
        if (ongoingGenerations[id]) delete ongoingGenerations[id];
    });

    furaiSyncChannel.postMessage({ action: 'remove', key: idToDelete });

    if (shouldClearDeepMemory) {
        idVariants.forEach(id => {
            void clearFuraiDeepMemoryRecords(id).catch(error => console.warn('Could not clear deleted chat Deep Memory:', error));
        });
    }

    if (idVariants.has(mobileSelectedChatId)) mobileSelectedChatId = null;
    if (idVariants.has(optionsTargetChatId)) optionsTargetChatId = null;

    closeChatOptionsModal();

    if (wasActiveChat) {
        currentChatId = null;
        window.currentChatId = null;
        if (chatMessagesEl) chatMessagesEl.innerHTML = '';

        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            startNewChat();
            if (typeof debouncedSidebarUpdate === 'function') debouncedSidebarUpdate();
        });
    } else if (typeof debouncedSidebarUpdate === 'function') {
        debouncedSidebarUpdate();
    }
}

function duplicateCurrentChat() {
    const idToDupe = optionsTargetChatId || currentChatId; 
    
    if (!idToDupe) return;

    try {
        // 1. Get Data via DB (Returns Objects, not Strings)
        const sourceData = DB.get(idToDupe);
        const sourceProfileData = DB.get(`profile-${idToDupe}`);

        // 2. Check Objects, not the old string variables
        if (!sourceData) {
            console.error("Could not find chat data to duplicate.");
            return;
        }

        const newChatId = 'chat-' + Date.now();
        // 3. Deep Copy the Object
        const newChatData = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(sourceData));
        const sourceChatId = String(sourceData.id || idToDupe);

        newChatData.id = newChatId;
        newChatData.timestamp = Date.now();
        remapFuraiDeepMemoryAuthorityForNewChat(newChatData, sourceChatId, newChatId);
        newChatData.title = newChatData.title + " (copy)";

        DB.set(newChatId, newChatData);

        if (sourceProfileData) {
            // 4. Deep Copy Profile
            const newProfileData = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(sourceProfileData));
            DB.set(`profile-${newChatId}`, newProfileData);
        }

        closeChatOptionsModal();
        loadChat(newChatId); 

    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Error duplicating chat:", e);
        showToast("Failed to duplicate the chat.");
    }
}

  function startNewChatFromMenu() {
    startNewChat();
    const dropdown = document.getElementById('mainMenuDropdown');
    if (dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
        dropdown.classList.remove('show');
    }
  }
