// 1. Open Modal & Check Achievements
function openCharacterImportModal(options = {}) {
    const modalEl = document.getElementById('charImportModalEl');
    const expansionModal = document.getElementById('expansionModalEl');
    const expansionRouteActive =
        window.FuraiWorkspaceSurfaceManager?.isActive() ||
        expansionModal?.classList.contains('expansion-main-view') ||
        (expansionModal && getComputedStyle(expansionModal).display !== 'none');
    const forceShowExpansionButton = options.showExpansionButton === true;
    const hideExpansionButton = !forceShowExpansionButton && (
        !!options.hideExpansionButton || expansionRouteActive
    );
    const expPassBtn = document.getElementById('charImportExpPassBtn');
    const directSelectionTarget = getActiveLocalCharacterSelectionTarget();

    if (modalEl) {
        modalEl.classList.toggle('hide-exp-pass-entry', hideExpansionButton);
    }

    if (expPassBtn) {
        expPassBtn.hidden = hideExpansionButton;
        expPassBtn.setAttribute('aria-hidden', hideExpansionButton ? 'true' : 'false');

        if (hideExpansionButton) {
            expPassBtn.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
        } else {
            expPassBtn.style.removeProperty('display');
            expPassBtn.style.display = 'flex';
        }
    }

    document.getElementById('charImportText').value = '';
    document.getElementById('charImportFuraiLink').value = '';
    document.getElementById('charImportStandardLink').value = '';

    const openChatBtn = document.getElementById('charImportOpenChatBtn');
    const replaceBtn = document.getElementById('charImportReplaceBtn');
    const replaceBtnLabel = document.getElementById('charImportReplaceBtnLabel');
    const addBtn = document.getElementById('charImportAddSlotBtn');
    const localBtn = document.getElementById('charImportAddLocalBtn');
    const onlineBtn = document.getElementById('charImportAddOnlineBtn');
    const localLabel = document.getElementById('charImportAddLocalLabel');
    const onlineLabel = document.getElementById('charImportAddOnlineLabel');

    if (directSelectionTarget) {
        if (openChatBtn) openChatBtn.style.display = 'none';

        if (replaceBtn) {
            replaceBtn.style.display = 'flex';
            replaceBtn.onclick = () => processCharImport('replace_selection');
        }

        if (replaceBtnLabel) {
            replaceBtnLabel.textContent = directSelectionTarget.role === 'user'
                ? 'Replace Current User'
                : 'Replace Current Character';
        }

        if (addBtn) addBtn.style.display = 'none';
        if (localBtn) localBtn.style.display = 'none';
        if (onlineBtn) onlineBtn.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
        if (openChatBtn) openChatBtn.style.display = 'flex';

        if (replaceBtn) {
            replaceBtn.style.display = 'flex';
            replaceBtn.onclick = () => processCharImport('replace_global');
        }

        if (replaceBtnLabel) replaceBtnLabel.textContent = 'Replace Existing Character';
        if (addBtn) addBtn.style.display = 'flex';

        if (localBtn) {
            localBtn.style.display = 'none';
            localBtn.onclick = () => processCharImport('add_local_slot');
        }

        if (onlineBtn) {
            onlineBtn.style.display = 'none';
            onlineBtn.onclick = () => processCharImport('add_local_online');
        }

        if (localLabel) localLabel.textContent = 'Add to Offline List';
        if (onlineLabel) onlineLabel.textContent = 'Add to Online List';

        if (addBtn) {
            const canAddSlot = canAddGlobalCharacterSlot('group');

            addBtn.disabled = false;
            addBtn.title = canAddSlot
                ? 'Add New Character'
                : `Additional custom character limit reached (${FURAI_CHARACTER_SLOT_LIMIT}). Unlock Infinite Roster to remove the limit.`;
            addBtn.style.opacity = canAddSlot ? '1' : '0.55';
            addBtn.style.cursor = canAddSlot ? 'pointer' : 'not-allowed';
            addBtn.style.border = canAddSlot ? '1px solid var(--border-color)' : '1px dashed var(--border-color)';
            addBtn.onmouseover = canAddSlot ? function() { this.style.borderColor = 'var(--primary-color)'; this.style.background = 'var(--sidebar-hover)'; } : null;
            addBtn.onmouseout = canAddSlot ? function() { this.style.borderColor = 'var(--border-color)'; this.style.background = 'var(--input-bg)'; } : null;

            if (canAddSlot) {
                addBtn.removeAttribute('aria-disabled');
                addBtn.onclick = () => processCharImport('add_slot');
            } else {
                addBtn.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
                addBtn.onclick = () => showCharacterSlotLimitToast();
            }
        }
    }

    if (modalEl) {
        if (typeof openModalLayer === 'function') {
            openModalLayer(modalEl, {
                above: expansionRouteActive ? 'expansionModalEl' : 'charactersModalEl'
            });
        } else {
            modalEl.style.display = 'flex';
        }
    }

    const menu = document.getElementById('mainMenuDropdown');
    if (menu) menu.classList.remove('show');
}

function configureCharacterImportForCurrentCastRoute() {
    const personality = getStoredChatPersonality(currentChatId);
    const isStoryMode = personality === 'story';
    const isGroupMode = personality === 'group' || personality === 'maker';

    if (!currentChatId || (!isStoryMode && !isGroupMode)) return;

    const openChatBtn = document.getElementById('charImportOpenChatBtn');
    const replaceBtn = document.getElementById('charImportReplaceBtn');
    const replaceBtnLabel = document.getElementById('charImportReplaceBtnLabel');
    const addBtn = document.getElementById('charImportAddSlotBtn');
    const localBtn = document.getElementById('charImportAddLocalBtn');
    const onlineBtn = document.getElementById('charImportAddOnlineBtn');
    const localLabel = document.getElementById('charImportAddLocalLabel');
    const onlineLabel = document.getElementById('charImportAddOnlineLabel');

    if (openChatBtn) openChatBtn.style.display = 'none';
    if (addBtn) addBtn.style.display = 'none';

    if (isStoryMode) {
        if (replaceBtn) replaceBtn.style.display = 'none';
        if (localBtn) localBtn.style.display = 'none';

        if (onlineBtn) {
            onlineBtn.style.display = 'flex';
            onlineBtn.onclick = () => processCharImport('add_local_online_strict');
        }

        if (onlineLabel) onlineLabel.textContent = 'Add to Current Story Cast';
        return;
    }

    if (replaceBtn) {
        replaceBtn.style.display = 'flex';
        replaceBtn.onclick = () => processCharImport('replace_local');
    }

    if (replaceBtnLabel) replaceBtnLabel.textContent = 'Replace Existing Character';

    if (localBtn) {
        localBtn.style.display = 'flex';
        localBtn.onclick = () => processCharImport('add_local_slot');
    }

    if (onlineBtn) {
        onlineBtn.style.display = 'flex';
        onlineBtn.onclick = () => processCharImport('add_local_online');
    }

    if (localLabel) localLabel.textContent = 'Add to Offline List';
    if (onlineLabel) onlineLabel.textContent = 'Add to Online List';
}

function openManageLocalImportModal(options = {}) {
    openCharacterImportModal(options);
    configureCharacterImportForCurrentCastRoute();
}

function getActiveLocalCharacterSelectionTarget() {
    const target = furaiCharacterSelectionTarget;
    if (!currentChatId || target?.scope !== 'local') return null;

    if (target.role === 'user') {
        return { ...target, role: 'user', botIndex: null };
    }

    if (target.role === 'bot') {
        const botIndex = Number.parseInt(target.botIndex, 10);
        if (!Number.isInteger(botIndex) || botIndex < 0) return null;
        return { ...target, role: 'bot', botIndex };
    }

    return null;
}

function applyImportedCharacterToActiveSelection(charData) {
    const target = getActiveLocalCharacterSelectionTarget();
    if (!target) {
        showToast('The current chat selection is no longer available.', 'error');
        return false;
    }

    const role = target.role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'ai';
    const botIndex = role === 'ai' ? target.botIndex : null;
    const source = cloneFuraiData(charData || {});
    const ok = switchFuraiChatRoleActor(currentChatId, {
        role,
        botIndex,
        mode: getStoredChatPersonality(currentChatId)
    }, source);

    if (!ok) return false;

    const persistedProfile = DB.get(`profile-${currentChatId}`);
    const persistedActor = role === 'user'
        ? persistedProfile?.user
        : persistedProfile?.bots?.[botIndex];

    if (!doesFuraiSelectedActorMatchSource(persistedActor, source)) {
        console.error('Imported character does not match the saved chat role.', {
            chatId: currentChatId,
            role,
            botIndex,
            source,
            persistedActor
        });
        showToast('Character replacement could not be verified.', 'error');
        return false;
    }

    refreshAfterFuraiRoleSelection(target, persistedProfile);
    showToast(`${source.name || 'Imported character'} selected for this chat.`, 'success');
    return true;
}

async function fetchFuraiCharacterImportSource(url) {
    const sourceUrl = String(url || '').trim();
    if (!sourceUrl) throw new Error('Missing FurAI character link.');

    const importedViewMode = getViewModeFromUrl(sourceUrl);
    const importUrl = resolveFuraiCharacterImportUrl(sourceUrl);
    const response = await fetch(importUrl);

    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch FurAI data.');

    return {
        rawData: await parseFuraiCharacterJsonResponse(response),
        importedViewMode
    };
}

// 2. Tab Switching
function switchCharImportTab(mode, btn) {
    if (mode === 'file') {
        showToast('JSON/GZ file import is only available for full chats and full backups.', 'info');
        return;
    }

    const pane = document.getElementById(`charImport_${mode}`);
    if (!btn || !pane) return;

    // Buttons
    const parent = btn.parentNode;
    Array.from(parent.children).forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    btn.classList.add('active');

    // Panes
    document.querySelectorAll('.char-import-pane').forEach(p => p.style.display = 'none');
    pane.style.display = 'block';
}

// 3. MAIN PROCESSOR (Updated to accept Text Format)
async function processCharImport(target) {
    // A. Determine Source Mode
    const pastePane = document.getElementById('charImport_paste');
    const cardPane = document.getElementById('charImport_card');
    const furaiPane = document.getElementById('charImport_furai');
    const stdPane = document.getElementById('charImport_standard');
    
    let rawData = null;
    let importedViewMode = null;

    try {
        if (pastePane.style.display !== 'none') {
            const text = document.getElementById('charImportText').value.trim();
            if (!text) throw new Error("Please paste character data.");
            
            // --- FIX: DETECT FORMAT ---
            if (text.startsWith('{')) {
                // IT IS JSON
                try {
                    rawData = JSON.parse(text);
                } catch(e) {
                    throw new Error("Invalid format. Check for missing content");
                }
            } else {
                // IT IS HUMAN TEXT (Name: ... Avatar: ...)
                rawData = parseHumanReadableProfile(text);
                if (!rawData) throw new Error("Could not parse text data. Ensure it starts with 'Name:'.");
            }
        }
        else if (cardPane && cardPane.style.display !== 'none') {
            const input = document.getElementById('charCardV2FileInput');
            const files = Array.from(input?.files || []);
        
            if (!files.length) {
                throw new Error("Please choose one or more Character Card PNG files.");
            }
        
            const rawCards = await Promise.all(files.map(readCharacterCardV2FromPngFile));
            const charDataList = rawCards.map(card => normalizeImportData(card));
        
            if (charDataList.length > 1) {
                processMultipleCharacterImports(charDataList, target);
                document.getElementById('charImportModalEl').style.display = 'none';
                return;
            }
        
            rawData = rawCards[0];
        } 
        else if (furaiPane.style.display !== 'none') {
            const url = document.getElementById('charImportFuraiLink').value.trim();
            if (!url) throw new Error("Please enter a FurAI link.");

            const loadedSource = await fetchFuraiCharacterImportSource(url);
            rawData = loadedSource.rawData;
            importedViewMode = loadedSource.importedViewMode;
        }
        else if (stdPane.style.display !== 'none') {
            // ... (Standard Link logic remains the same) ...
            const url = document.getElementById('charImportStandardLink').value.trim();
            if (!url) throw new Error("Please enter a Standard Chat link.");
            const match = url.match(/data=([^~]+)~([^&]+)/);
            if (!match) throw new Error("Invalid Standard Link format.");
            const fileId = match[2];
            const fetchUrl = `https://user.uploads.dev/file/${fileId}`;
            const res = await fetch(fetchUrl);
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch Standard data.");
            const blob = await res.blob();
            const ds = new DecompressionStream("gzip");
            const stream = blob.stream().pipeThrough(ds);
            const response = await new Response(stream);
            const jsonText = await response.text();
            rawData = JSON.parse(jsonText);
        }

        // B. Normalize Data
        const charData = normalizeImportData(rawData);

        if ((importedViewMode === 'vn' || importedViewMode === 'chat') && !charData.viewMode) {
            charData.viewMode = importedViewMode;
        }

        // C. Execute Target Logic
        let importSucceeded = true;
        let localSelectionParentToRefresh = null;

        if (target === 'temp_chat') {
            createTempChat(charData);
        } else if (target === 'replace_global') {
            openGlobalReplacementSelector(charData);
        } else if (target === 'replace_local') {
            openLocalReplacementSelector(charData);
        } else if (target === 'replace_selection') {
            localSelectionParentToRefresh = getActiveLocalCharacterSelectionTarget();
            importSucceeded = applyImportedCharacterToActiveSelection(charData);
            if (importSucceeded) closeCharactersModal();
        } else if (target === 'replace') {
            // backward compatibility for older buttons / old imported UI
            if (currentChatId) {
                openLocalReplacementSelector(charData);
            } else {
                openGlobalReplacementSelector(charData);
            }
        } else if (target === 'add_slot') {
            importSucceeded = addToGlobalRoster(charData) !== false;
        } else if (target === 'add_local_slot') {
            importSucceeded = addToLocalRoster(charData) !== false;
        } else if (target === 'add_local_online') {
            importSucceeded = addToLocalRoster(charData, { activate: true }) !== false;
        } else if (target === 'add_local_online_strict') {
            importSucceeded = addToLocalRoster(charData, { activate: true, requireActivate: true }) !== false;
        }

        if (!importSucceeded) return;
        
        // Close on success, then return to the still-open parent profile.
        document.getElementById('charImportModalEl').style.display = 'none';
        if (localSelectionParentToRefresh) {
            refreshOpenFuraiLocalProfileEditor(localSelectionParentToRefresh);
        }

    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        alert("Import Error: " + e.message);
    }
}

// 4. DATA NORMALIZER (The Bridge)
function normalizeImportData(json) {
    if (!json) throw new Error("Import data is empty or corrupted.");

    // Character Card V2 PNG / JSON
    if (json.spec === 'chara_card_v2' && json.data) {
        return normalizeCharacterCardV2ToFurai(json);
    }

    // If it's already FurAI format, preserve it but normalize launch-only extras,
    // aliases, and the tiny hidden-instruction metadata flag.
    if (json.instruction && json.ver) {
        const normalized = copyCharacterOpeningExtras(json, json);
        return writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(normalized, normalized);
    }

    // If it's Standard Chat format (usually wrapper in 'addCharacter' or root)
    const source = json.addCharacter || json;
    const normalized = copyCharacterOpeningExtras({
        ver: "1.0",
        type: "character",
        name: source.name || "Imported Character",
        hashTag: source.hashTag || "",
        avatar: source.avatar?.url || source.avatar || "",
        instruction: source.description || source.roleInstruction || source.instruction || "",
        openingMessage:
            source.openingMessage ||
            source.customGreeting ||
            source.greeting ||
            source.initialMessage ||
            "",
        defaultSprite: source.defaultSprite || "",
        customEmotions: source.customEmotions || {},
        emotionAvatars: source.emotionAvatars || {},
        emotionSprites: source.emotionSprites || {},
        creatorNotes: mergeFuraiPublicTextAliases(source.creatorNotes, source.creator_notes, source.annotations),
        creator_notes: mergeFuraiPublicTextAliases(source.creatorNotes, source.creator_notes, source.annotations),
        viewMode: source.viewMode || json.viewMode || ""
    }, source);

    return writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(normalized, {
        protectedInstruction:
            source.protectedInstruction ||
            source.protectedInstructions?.instruction ||
            "",
        protectedSecret:
            source.protectedSecret ||
            source.protectedHiddenSecrets ||
            source.protectedInstructions?.secret ||
            source.protectedInstructions?.hiddenSecrets ||
            "",
        protectedEditCodeHash:
            source.protectedEditCodeHash ||
            source.protectedInstructions?.codeHash ||
            "",
        protectedInstructionVersion:
            source.protectedInstructionVersion ||
            source.protectedInstructions?.version ||
            FURAI_PROTECTED_INSTRUCTION_VERSION
    });
}

const FURAI_TAG_HINT_KEY = 'furai_hint_tags_v44';
const FURAI_HIDDEN_TAG_PREFIX = /^\s*\(nsfw\)\s*/i;
const FURAI_HIDDEN_TAG_MARKER = /\(nsfw\)/ig;

function isFuraiAdultTagView() {
    try {
        if (typeof isExpNsfw !== 'undefined' && isExpNsfw === true) return true;
    } catch (e) {}

    return localStorage.getItem('furai_exp_nsfw_unlocked') === 'true';
}

function parseFuraiTagLabels(value) {
    const raw = String(value || '').trim();
    if (!raw) return [];

    const seen = new Set();
    return raw
        .split(/[,#]+/)
        .map(tag => tag.trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
        .filter(tag => {
            const key = tag.toLocaleLowerCase();
            if (seen.has(key)) return false;
            seen.add(key);
            return true;
        });
}

function splitFuraiTagLabel(rawValue) {
    const raw = String(rawValue || '').trim();
    if (!raw) return [];

    const matches = Array.from(raw.matchAll(FURAI_HIDDEN_TAG_MARKER));
    if (!matches.length) {
        return [{
            raw,
            display: raw,
            key: raw.toLocaleLowerCase(),
            isHidden: false
        }];
    }

    const entries = [];
    const publicPrefix = raw.slice(0, matches[0].index).trim();
    if (publicPrefix) {
        entries.push({
            raw: publicPrefix,
            display: publicPrefix,
            key: publicPrefix.toLocaleLowerCase(),
            isHidden: false
        });
    }

    matches.forEach((match, index) => {
        const start = Number(match.index) + match[0].length;
        const end = index + 1 < matches.length ? Number(matches[index + 1].index) : raw.length;
        const display = raw.slice(start, end).trim();
        if (!display) return;

        entries.push({
            raw: `(nsfw)${display}`,
            display,
            key: display.toLocaleLowerCase(),
            isHidden: true
        });
    });

    return entries;
}

function parseFuraiTagEntries(value) {
    const seen = new Set();
    const entries = [];

    parseFuraiTagLabels(value).forEach(raw => {
        splitFuraiTagLabel(raw).forEach(entry => {
            const dedupeKey = `${entry.isHidden ? 'adult' : 'public'}:${entry.key}`;
            if (!entry.display || seen.has(dedupeKey)) return;
            seen.add(dedupeKey);
            entries.push(entry);
        });
    });

    return entries;
}

function getFuraiVisibleTagEntries(value) {
    const showAdultTags = isFuraiAdultTagView();
    return parseFuraiTagEntries(value).filter(entry => showAdultTags || !entry.isHidden);
}

function getFuraiVisibleTagText(value) {
    return getFuraiVisibleTagEntries(value)
        .map(entry => entry.display)
        .join(', ');
}

function getFuraiTagInputDisplayValue(value) {
    const raw = String(value || '').trim();
    if (!raw || isFuraiAdultTagView()) return raw;

    return parseFuraiTagEntries(raw)
        .filter(entry => !entry.isHidden)
        .map(entry => entry.raw)
        .join(', ');
}

function mergeFuraiTagEntries(entries) {
    const seen = new Set();
    const merged = [];

    entries.forEach(entry => {
        const raw = String(entry?.raw || entry || '').trim();
        if (!raw) return;

        const key = raw.toLocaleLowerCase();
        if (seen.has(key)) return;

        seen.add(key);
        merged.push(raw);
    });

    return merged.join(', ');
}

function setFuraiTagInputValue(inputOrId, rawValue) {
    const input = typeof inputOrId === 'string'
        ? document.getElementById(inputOrId)
        : inputOrId;

    if (!input) return;

    const source = String(rawValue || '').replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ').trim();
    input.dataset.furaiTagSource = source;
    input.value = getFuraiTagInputDisplayValue(source);
}

function getFuraiTagInputValue(inputOrId) {
    const input = typeof inputOrId === 'string'
        ? document.getElementById(inputOrId)
        : inputOrId;

    if (!input) return '';

    const current = String(input.value || '').replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ').trim();
    if (isFuraiAdultTagView()) return current;

    const source = String(input.dataset.furaiTagSource || '').trim();
    if (!source) return current;

    const originalVisible = getFuraiTagInputDisplayValue(source);
    if (current === originalVisible) return source;

    const visibleEntries = parseFuraiTagEntries(current).filter(entry => !entry.isHidden);
    const preservedHiddenEntries = parseFuraiTagEntries(source).filter(entry => entry.isHidden);

    return mergeFuraiTagEntries([...visibleEntries, ...preservedHiddenEntries]);
}

function syncFuraiTagInputForSafety(input) {
    if (!input) return;

    const current = String(input.value || '').replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ').trim();

    if (isFuraiAdultTagView()) {
        input.dataset.furaiTagSource = current;
        input.value = current;
        return;
    }

    const source = String(input.dataset.furaiTagSource || '').trim();
    const originalVisible = getFuraiTagInputDisplayValue(source);

    // Merely focusing an already-filtered field must not rewrite or reorder its stored tags.
    if (source && current === originalVisible) return;

    const currentEntries = parseFuraiTagEntries(current);
    const existingHiddenEntries = parseFuraiTagEntries(source)
        .filter(entry => entry.isHidden);
    const typedHiddenEntries = currentEntries.filter(entry => entry.isHidden);
    const visibleEntries = currentEntries.filter(entry => !entry.isHidden);

    input.dataset.furaiTagSource = mergeFuraiTagEntries([
        ...visibleEntries,
        ...existingHiddenEntries,
        ...typedHiddenEntries
    ]);
    input.value = mergeFuraiTagEntries(visibleEntries);
}

function showFuraiTagHintOnce() {
    if (localStorage.getItem(FURAI_TAG_HINT_KEY)) return;
    localStorage.setItem(FURAI_TAG_HINT_KEY, '1');

    showOverlayHint(`
        <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; text-align:left; gap:3px;">
            <b>Tags</b>
            <span style="font-size:12px; opacity:.9;">Multiple tags supported. Separate with <b>#</b> or commas. Phrases and symbols work, e.g. <b>“my persona”</b>.</span>
        </div>
    `, 6500);
}

// Keep tag typing natural. Commas and # remain visible while the user is editing;
// normalization and PG-13 hidden-tag preservation run only when the field is committed.
function sanitizeHashTag() {
    showFuraiTagHintOnce();
}

document.addEventListener('focusin', event => {
    if (event.target?.matches?.('input[oninput*="sanitizeHashTag"]')) {
        showFuraiTagHintOnce();
    }
});

document.addEventListener('focusout', event => {
    if (event.target?.matches?.('input[oninput*="sanitizeHashTag"]')) {
        syncFuraiTagInputForSafety(event.target);
    }
});

function searchFuraiTagLabel(kind, label, event) {
    if (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
    }

    showFuraiTagHintOnce();

    const clean = String(label || '').replace(/"/g, '').trim();
    if (!clean) return false;

    const isCharacter = kind === 'character';
    const input = document.getElementById(isCharacter ? 'charsSearchInput' : 'lorebookSearchInput');
    const modal = input?.closest('.modal');

    // Chips only become search actions inside a visible matching library.
    if (!input || input.getClientRects().length === 0 || (modal && getComputedStyle(modal).display === 'none')) return false;

    input.value = `"${clean}"`;

    if (isCharacter) {
        charsSearchQuery = input.value;
        renderCharactersGrid();
        if (typeof closeProfileCard === 'function') closeProfileCard();
    } else if (typeof LorebookManager !== 'undefined') {
        LorebookManager.render();
    }

    input.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    return true;
}

let furaiTagOverflowEl = null;
let furaiTagOverflowTrigger = null;
let furaiTagOverflowListenersBound = false;

function getFuraiTagChipLimit(options = {}) {
    const explicitLimit = Number(options.maxVisible);
    if (Number.isInteger(explicitLimit) && explicitLimit > 0) return explicitLimit;

    const className = String(options.className || '');

    if (className.includes('preview') || className.includes('lightbox')) return 6;

    return 4;
}

function getFuraiDynamicTagRows(options = {}) {
    const explicitRows = Number(options.dynamicRows);
    if (Number.isInteger(explicitRows) && explicitRows > 0) return explicitRows;

    const className = String(options.className || '');

    if (className.includes('card-tags')) return 1;
    if (className.includes('profile-tag') || className.includes('id-card')) return 2;

    return 0;
}

let furaiDynamicTagLayoutFrame = 0;
const furaiDynamicTagLayoutQueue = new Set();
const furaiDynamicTagResizeObserver = typeof ResizeObserver === 'function'
    ? new ResizeObserver(entries => {
        entries.forEach(entry => queueFuraiDynamicTagLayout(entry.target));
    })
    : null;

function getFuraiDynamicTagEntry(chip) {
    try {
        return JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(chip?.dataset?.furaiTagEntry || ''));
    } catch (error) {
        return null;
    }
}

function countFuraiTagRows(container) {
    const rowTops = [];
    const visibleChildren = Array.from(container.children).filter(child => !child.hidden);

    visibleChildren.forEach(child => {
        const top = child.offsetTop;
        const existingTop = rowTops.find(rowTop => Math.abs(rowTop - top) <= 2);

        if (existingTop === undefined) rowTops.push(top);
    });

    return rowTops.length;
}

function fitFuraiDynamicTagLayout(container) {
    if (!container?.isConnected || container.clientWidth <= 0) return;

    const maxRows = Math.max(1, Number(container.dataset.furaiTagRows) || 1);
    const sourceChips = Array.from(container.children).filter(child =>
        child.classList.contains('furai-tag-source')
    );

    if (!sourceChips.length) return;

    container.querySelector(':scope > .furai-tag-more')?.remove();
    sourceChips.forEach(chip => { chip.hidden = false; });

    if (countFuraiTagRows(container) <= maxRows) return;

    const searchKind = container.dataset.furaiTagSearchKind || '';

    for (let visibleCount = sourceChips.length - 1; visibleCount >= 0; visibleCount -= 1) {
        sourceChips.forEach((chip, index) => {
            chip.hidden = index >= visibleCount;
        });

        const overflowEntries = sourceChips
            .slice(visibleCount)
            .map(getFuraiDynamicTagEntry)
            .filter(Boolean);

        const overflowHtml = createFuraiTagOverflowButtonHTML(overflowEntries, { searchKind });
        if (!overflowHtml) return;

        const template = document.createElement('template');
        template.innerHTML = overflowHtml.trim();
        const overflowButton = template.content.firstElementChild;
        if (!overflowButton) return;

        container.appendChild(overflowButton);

        if (countFuraiTagRows(container) <= maxRows) return;

        overflowButton.remove();
    }
}

function flushFuraiDynamicTagLayouts() {
    furaiDynamicTagLayoutFrame = 0;
    const containers = Array.from(furaiDynamicTagLayoutQueue);
    furaiDynamicTagLayoutQueue.clear();
    containers.forEach(fitFuraiDynamicTagLayout);
}

function queueFuraiDynamicTagLayout(container) {
    if (!container) return;

    furaiDynamicTagLayoutQueue.add(container);

    if (!furaiDynamicTagLayoutFrame) {
        furaiDynamicTagLayoutFrame = requestAnimationFrame(flushFuraiDynamicTagLayouts);
    }
}

function initFuraiDynamicTagLayouts(root = document) {
    const containers = [];

    if (root?.matches?.('[data-furai-dynamic-tags="1"]')) {
        containers.push(root);
    }

    root?.querySelectorAll?.('[data-furai-dynamic-tags="1"]').forEach(container => {
        containers.push(container);
    });

    containers.forEach(container => {
        if (container.dataset.furaiDynamicTagsReady !== '1') {
            container.dataset.furaiDynamicTagsReady = '1';
            furaiDynamicTagResizeObserver?.observe(container);
        }

        queueFuraiDynamicTagLayout(container);
    });
}

function ensureFuraiTagOverflowPopover() {
    if (!furaiTagOverflowEl) {
        furaiTagOverflowEl = document.createElement('div');
        furaiTagOverflowEl.className = 'furai-tag-popover';
        furaiTagOverflowEl.setAttribute('role', 'dialog');
        furaiTagOverflowEl.setAttribute('aria-label', 'More tags');
        document.body.appendChild(furaiTagOverflowEl);
    }

    if (!furaiTagOverflowListenersBound) {
        furaiTagOverflowListenersBound = true;

        document.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
            if (!furaiTagOverflowEl?.classList.contains('is-open')) return;
            if (furaiTagOverflowEl.contains(event.target)) return;
            if (event.target.closest?.('.furai-tag-more')) return;
            closeFuraiTagOverflow();
        }, true);

        document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
            if (event.key === 'Escape') closeFuraiTagOverflow();
        });

        window.addEventListener('resize', closeFuraiTagOverflow, { passive: true });
        document.addEventListener('scroll', closeFuraiTagOverflow, true);
    }

    return furaiTagOverflowEl;
}

function closeFuraiTagOverflow() {
    if (furaiTagOverflowTrigger) {
        furaiTagOverflowTrigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    }

    if (furaiTagOverflowEl) {
        furaiTagOverflowEl.classList.remove('is-open');
        furaiTagOverflowEl.replaceChildren();
    }

    furaiTagOverflowTrigger = null;
}

function positionFuraiTagOverflow(trigger, popover) {
    const triggerRect = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
    const popoverRect = popover.getBoundingClientRect();
    const edgeGap = 10;
    const itemGap = 6;

    let left = triggerRect.left;
    if (left + popoverRect.width > window.innerWidth - edgeGap) {
        left = window.innerWidth - popoverRect.width - edgeGap;
    }
    left = Math.max(edgeGap, left);

    let top = triggerRect.bottom + itemGap;
    if (top + popoverRect.height > window.innerHeight - edgeGap) {
        top = triggerRect.top - popoverRect.height - itemGap;
    }
    top = Math.max(edgeGap, top);

    popover.style.left = `${Math.round(left)}px`;
    popover.style.top = `${Math.round(top)}px`;
}

function openFuraiTagOverflow(event, trigger) {
    event?.preventDefault?.();
    event?.stopPropagation?.();
    if (!trigger) return false;

    const isSameOpenTrigger =
        furaiTagOverflowTrigger === trigger &&
        furaiTagOverflowEl?.classList.contains('is-open');

    if (isSameOpenTrigger) {
        closeFuraiTagOverflow();
        return false;
    }

    let items = [];
    try {
        items = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(trigger.dataset.furaiTagOverflow || ''));
    } catch (error) {
        console.warn('Could not open tag overflow.', error);
        return false;
    }

    if (!Array.isArray(items) || !items.length) return false;

    closeFuraiTagOverflow();

    const popover = ensureFuraiTagOverflowPopover();
    const searchKind = String(trigger.dataset.furaiTagSearchKind || '');
    const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();

    items.forEach(item => {
        const label = String(item?.display || item || '').trim();
        if (!label) return;

        const canSearch = searchKind === 'character' || searchKind === 'library' || searchKind === 'exp';
        const chip = document.createElement(canSearch ? 'button' : 'span');

        if (canSearch) chip.type = 'button';
        chip.className = `exp-label-pill${item?.isNeutral ? ' is-neutral' : ''}`;
        if (searchKind === 'exp') chip.setAttribute('data-furai-ui-translate', '');
        chip.textContent = label;
        chip.title = canSearch ? `Search exact tag: ${label}` : label;

        if (canSearch) {
            chip.addEventListener('click', chipEvent => {
                chipEvent.preventDefault();
                chipEvent.stopPropagation();
                closeFuraiTagOverflow();

                if (searchKind === 'exp') {
                    expSearchByLabel(label);
                } else {
                    searchFuraiTagLabel(searchKind, label, chipEvent);
                }
            }, { once: true });
        }

        fragment.appendChild(chip);
    });

    popover.replaceChildren(fragment);
    popover.classList.add('is-open');
    trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    furaiTagOverflowTrigger = trigger;

    if (searchKind === 'exp' && furaiUiLanguage.language !== 'en') {
        scheduleFuraiUiScan(popover);
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(() => positionFuraiTagOverflow(trigger, popover));
    return false;
}

function createFuraiTagOverflowButtonHTML(entries, options = {}) {
    if (!Array.isArray(entries) || !entries.length) return '';

    const payload = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(entries)).replace(/'/g, '%27');
    const searchKind = options.searchKind === 'character' || options.searchKind === 'library' || options.searchKind === 'exp'
        ? options.searchKind
        : '';
    const count = entries.length;
    const title = `Show ${count} more tag${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;

    return `<button type="button"
                   class="exp-label-pill is-neutral furai-tag-more"
                   title="${escapeHTML(title)}"
                   aria-haspopup="dialog"
                   aria-expanded="false"
                   data-furai-tag-search-kind="${searchKind}"
                   data-furai-tag-overflow="${payload}"
                   onclick="openFuraiTagOverflow(event, this)">+${count}</button>`;
}

function createFuraiTagChipsHTML(value, options = {}) {
    // Display labels only. Commas and # are accepted by editors/importers but
    // must never leak into read-only Character/Lorebook tag presentation.
    const entries = getFuraiVisibleTagEntries(value);
    if (!entries.length) return '';

    const searchKind = options.searchKind === 'character' || options.searchKind === 'library'
        ? options.searchKind
        : '';
    const extraClass = options.className ? ` ${String(options.className)}` : '';
    const dynamicRows = getFuraiDynamicTagRows(options);

    let visibleEntries = entries;
    let overflowEntries = [];

    if (!dynamicRows) {
        const visibleLimit = getFuraiTagChipLimit(options);
        visibleEntries = entries.slice(0, visibleLimit);
        overflowEntries = entries.slice(visibleLimit).map(entry => ({
            display: entry.display,
            isNeutral: true
        }));
    }

    const chips = visibleEntries.map(entry => {
        const label = entry.display;
        const safeText = escapeHTML(label);
        const encoded = encodeURIComponent(label).replace(/'/g, '%27');
        const entryPayload = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({
            display: label,
            isNeutral: true
        })).replace(/'/g, '%27');
        const sourceClass = dynamicRows ? ' furai-tag-source' : '';
        const sourceData = dynamicRows ? ` data-furai-tag-entry="${entryPayload}"` : '';

        if (!searchKind) {
            return `<span class="exp-label-pill is-neutral${sourceClass}" title="${safeText}"${sourceData}>${safeText}</span>`;
        }

        return `<button type="button"
                       class="exp-label-pill is-neutral${sourceClass}"
                       title="Search exact tag: ${safeText}"
                       ${sourceData}
                       onclick="searchFuraiTagLabel('${searchKind}', decodeURIComponent('${encoded}'), event)">${safeText}</button>`;
    });

    if (overflowEntries.length) {
        chips.push(createFuraiTagOverflowButtonHTML(overflowEntries, { searchKind }));
    }

    const dynamicAttrs = dynamicRows
        ? ` data-furai-dynamic-tags="1" data-furai-tag-rows="${dynamicRows}" data-furai-tag-search-kind="${searchKind}"`
        : '';

    return `<div class="exp-label-pills furai-tag-chips${extraClass}"${dynamicAttrs}>${chips.join('')}</div>`;
}


// --- NEW HELPER: Text Format Parser ---
const FURAI_HUMAN_PROTECTED_JSON_START = '--- FURAI PROTECTED JSON ---';
const FURAI_HUMAN_PROTECTED_JSON_END = '--- END FURAI PROTECTED JSON ---';

function extractFuraiHumanProtectedJson(text) {
    const source = String(text || '');
    const startPattern = /(?:^|\r?\n)--- FURAI PROTECTED JSON ---[ \t]*(?:\r?\n|$)/g;
    const endPattern = /(?:^|\r?\n)--- END FURAI PROTECTED JSON ---[ \t]*(?:\r?\n|$)/g;
    const starts = Array.from(source.matchAll(startPattern));

    for (let index = starts.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
        const startMatch = starts[index];
        const contentStart = startMatch.index + startMatch[0].length;
        endPattern.lastIndex = contentStart;
        const endMatch = endPattern.exec(source);
        if (!endMatch) continue;

        try {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(source.slice(contentStart, endMatch.index).trim());
            if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object' || Array.isArray(parsed)) continue;

            const before = source.slice(0, startMatch.index).trimEnd();
            const after = source.slice(endMatch.index + endMatch[0].length).trimStart();
            return {
                text: [before, after].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n'),
                data: normalizeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(parsed)
            };
        } catch (error) {}
    }

    return { text: source, data: null };
}

function splitFuraiHumanVisualsBlock(text) {
    const source = String(text || '');
    const pattern = /(?:^|\r?\n)--- VISUALS ---[ \t]*(?:\r?\n|$)/ig;
    let match = null;
    let latest = null;

    while ((match = pattern.exec(source))) latest = match;
    if (!latest) return { mainBlock: source, visualsBlock: '' };

    return {
        mainBlock: source.slice(0, latest.index).trimEnd(),
        visualsBlock: source.slice(latest.index + latest[0].length).trimStart()
    };
}

function parseHumanReadableProfile(text) {
    const data = {
        customEmotions: {},
        emotionAvatars: {},
        emotionSprites: {}
    };

    const protectedBlock = extractFuraiHumanProtectedJson(text);
    const sections = splitFuraiHumanVisualsBlock(protectedBlock.text);
    const mainBlock = sections.mainBlock;
    const visualsBlock = sections.visualsBlock;

    const nameMatch = mainBlock.match(/^Name:\s*(.*)$/m);
    if (nameMatch) data.name = nameMatch[1].trim();

    const tagMatch = mainBlock.match(/^Hash Tag:\s*(#?.*)$/m);
    if (tagMatch) data.hashTag = tagMatch[1].trim();

    const avMatch = mainBlock.match(/^Avatar:\s*(.*)$/m);
    if (avMatch) data.avatar = avMatch[1].trim();

    const sprMatch = mainBlock.match(/^Default Sprite:\s*(.*)$/m);
    if (sprMatch) data.defaultSprite = sprMatch[1].trim();

    const openingSystemMatch = mainBlock.match(/Opening System Message:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=\nOpening Message:|\nOpening Background:|\nCustom Background:|\nOpening Lorebook:|\nDedicated Lorebook:|\nCreator Notes:|\nAnnotations:|\nProtected Instruction:|\nProtected Hidden Secrets:|\nProtected Edit Code Hash:|\nInstruction:|$)/i);
    if (openingSystemMatch) data.openingSystemMessage = openingSystemMatch[1].trim();

    const openingBoundary = /\n(?:Opening Background|Custom Background|Custom Background Opacity|Custom Background Blur|Opening Lorebook|Dedicated Lorebook|Creator Notes|Annotations):|\nProtected Instruction:|\nProtected Hidden Secrets:|\nProtected Edit Code Hash:|\nInstruction:|$/i;
    const openingMatch = mainBlock.match(new RegExp('Opening Message:\\s*([\\s\\S]*?)(?=' + openingBoundary.source + ')', 'i'));
    if (openingMatch) data.openingMessage = openingMatch[1].trim();

    const openingBackgroundMatch = mainBlock.match(/(?:Opening Background|Custom Background):\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=\nCustom Background Opacity:|\nCustom Background Blur:|\nOpening Lorebook:|\nDedicated Lorebook:|\nCreator Notes:|\nAnnotations:|\nProtected Instruction:|\nProtected Hidden Secrets:|\nProtected Edit Code Hash:|\nInstruction:|$)/i);
    if (openingBackgroundMatch) data.openingBackground = openingBackgroundMatch[1].trim();

    const openingBackgroundOpacityMatch = mainBlock.match(/Custom Background Opacity:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=\nCustom Background Blur:|\nOpening Lorebook:|\nDedicated Lorebook:|\nCreator Notes:|\nAnnotations:|\nProtected Instruction:|\nProtected Hidden Secrets:|\nProtected Edit Code Hash:|\nInstruction:|$)/i);
    if (openingBackgroundOpacityMatch) data.openingBackgroundOpacity = normalizeOpeningBackgroundOpacity(openingBackgroundOpacityMatch[1].trim());

    const openingBackgroundBlurMatch = mainBlock.match(/Custom Background Blur:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=\nOpening Lorebook:|\nDedicated Lorebook:|\nCreator Notes:|\nAnnotations:|\nProtected Instruction:|\nProtected Hidden Secrets:|\nProtected Edit Code Hash:|\nInstruction:|$)/i);
    if (openingBackgroundBlurMatch) data.openingBackgroundBlur = normalizeOpeningBackgroundBlur(openingBackgroundBlurMatch[1].trim());

    const openingLorebookMatch = mainBlock.match(/(?:Opening Lorebook|Dedicated Lorebook):\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=\nCreator Notes:|\nAnnotations:|\nProtected Instruction:|\nProtected Hidden Secrets:|\nProtected Edit Code Hash:|\nInstruction:|$)/i);
    if (openingLorebookMatch) data.openingLorebook = openingLorebookMatch[1].trim();

    const creatorNotesMatch = mainBlock.match(/(?:Creator Notes|Annotations):\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=\nProtected Instruction:|\nProtected Hidden Secrets:|\nProtected Edit Code Hash:|\nInstruction:|$)/i);
    if (creatorNotesMatch) data.creatorNotes = creatorNotesMatch[1].trim();

    // Legacy human-readable copies remain importable. New copies use the JSON
    // block below, which cannot be confused by Instruction: or VISUALS text.
    const protectedInstructionMatch = mainBlock.match(/Protected Instruction:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=\nProtected Hidden Secrets:|\nProtected Edit Code Hash:|\nInstruction:|$)/i);
    if (protectedInstructionMatch) data.protectedInstruction = protectedInstructionMatch[1].trim();

    const protectedSecretMatch = mainBlock.match(/Protected Hidden Secrets:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=\nProtected Edit Code Hash:|\nInstruction:|$)/i);
    if (protectedSecretMatch) data.protectedSecret = protectedSecretMatch[1].trim();

    const protectedCodeHashMatch = mainBlock.match(/Protected Edit Code Hash:\s*([^\n]*)/i);
    if (protectedCodeHashMatch) data.protectedEditCodeHash = protectedCodeHashMatch[1].trim();

    if (protectedBlock.data && hasFuraiProtectedInstructions(protectedBlock.data)) {
        data.protectedInstruction = protectedBlock.data.protectedInstruction;
        data.protectedSecret = protectedBlock.data.protectedSecret;
        data.protectedEditCodeHash = protectedBlock.data.protectedEditCodeHash;
        data.protectedInstructionVersion = protectedBlock.data.protectedInstructionVersion;
    } else if (data.protectedInstruction || data.protectedSecret) {
        data.protectedInstructionVersion = FURAI_PROTECTED_INSTRUCTION_VERSION;
    }

    const instMatch = mainBlock.match(/(?:^|\n)Instruction:\s*([\s\S]*)$/i);
    if (instMatch) data.instruction = instMatch[1].trim();

    if (visualsBlock) {
        const lines = visualsBlock.split('\n');
        let currentEmotion = null;

        lines.forEach(line => {
            const trimmed = line.trim();
            if (!trimmed) return;

            if (
                trimmed.endsWith(':') &&
                !trimmed.startsWith('Avatar:') &&
                !trimmed.startsWith('Sprite:') &&
                !trimmed.startsWith('Keywords:')
            ) {
                currentEmotion = trimmed.replace(/:$/, '').trim();
            } else if (currentEmotion) {
                if (/^Avatar:/i.test(trimmed)) {
                    data.emotionAvatars[currentEmotion] = trimmed.replace(/^Avatar:/i, '').trim();
                } else if (/^Sprite:/i.test(trimmed)) {
                    data.emotionSprites[currentEmotion] = trimmed.replace(/^Sprite:/i, '').trim();
                } else if (/^Keywords:/i.test(trimmed)) {
                    data.customEmotions[currentEmotion] = trimmed.replace(/^Keywords:/i, '').trim();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    if (!data.name) return null;
    return data;
}

          
/* --- TARGET HANDLERS --- */

function getDefaultOpeningMessageForMode(mode, name = 'FurAI') {
    const displayName = String(name || 'FurAI').trim() || 'FurAI';

    const defaults = {
        researcher: `Hello! I'm ${displayName}, your AI assistant. How can I help you today?`,
        prompter: `Hello! I'm ${displayName}, your image prompt expert. Let me help you craft the perfect prompt.\n\nYou can try random ideas like 'random clothes' or 'random places' — I'll automatically turn them into Perchance-style syntax, such as {beach|city|forest|cafe...}.`,
        story: `Hello! I'm ${displayName}, your storytelling companion. I can continue scenes, help shape pacing, revise lines, and build stories with you.\n\nYou can write a scene, describe what should happen next, or simply guide the tone and direction.`,
        maker: `Hello! I'm ${displayName}, your Character Creation assistant. Tell me your rough ideas, and I'll help you build a complete profile ready for roleplay!\n\nOnce done, click the "Add to Current Chat Roster" button in the Maker Studio to instantly test them here!`,
        group: `Hello! I'm ${displayName}.`
    };

    return defaults[mode] || `Hello! I'm ${displayName}.`;
}

function getProfileOpeningMessage(profileData, mode = 'group', fallbackName = 'FurAI') {
    const rawOpening =
        profileData?.openingMessage ??
        profileData?.customGreeting ??
        profileData?.greeting ??
        profileData?.initialMessage ??
        '';

    const opening = String(rawOpening).trim();
    return opening || getDefaultOpeningMessageForMode(mode, fallbackName);
}

function getCharacterOpeningSystemMessage(profileData = {}) {
    return String(
        profileData?.openingSystemMessage ??
        profileData?.systemOpeningMessage ??
        profileData?.preGreetingSystemMessage ??
        profileData?.enhancerOpeningSystemMessage ??
        ''
    ).trim();
}

function getCharacterOpeningMessage(profileData, mode = 'group', fallbackName = null) {
    const resolvedName =
        fallbackName ||
        profileData?.name ||
        profileData?.displayName ||
        'FurAI';

    return getProfileOpeningMessage(profileData, mode, resolvedName);
}

function buildCharacterOpeningMessages(profileData, actorData, mode = 'group', options = {}) {
    const timestamp = Number(options.timestamp) || Date.now();
    const role = options.role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'ai';
    const botIndex = Number.isInteger(Number(options.botIndex)) ? Number(options.botIndex) : 0;
    const systemText = getCharacterOpeningSystemMessage(profileData);
    const actorName = actorData?.name || profileData?.name || (role === 'user' ? 'User' : 'Character');
    const messages = [];
    let sortKey = 0;

    if (systemText) {
        messages.push({
            uid: generateUID('msg'),
            role: 'system',
            content: systemText,
            openingSystem: true,
            timestamp,
            sortKey: sortKey++
        });
    }

    const greeting = {
        uid: generateUID('msg'),
        role,
        content: getCharacterOpeningMessage(profileData, mode, actorName),
        timestamp,
        sortKey
    };

    if (role === 'user') {
        greeting.userUid = actorData?.uid || '';
        greeting.userNameSnapshot = actorName;
    } else {
        greeting.botIndex = botIndex;
        greeting.botUid = actorData?.uid || '';
        greeting.botNameSnapshot = actorName;
    }

    messages.push(greeting);
    return messages;
}

function normalizeOpeningBackgroundOpacity(value, fallback = '1') {
    const parsed = parseFloat(value);
    if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return fallback;

    return String(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, parsed)));
}

function normalizeOpeningBackgroundBlur(value, fallback = '0') {
    const parsed = parseFloat(value);
    if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return fallback;

    return String(Math.max(0, parsed));
}

function mergeFuraiPublicTextAliases(...values) {
    const merged = [];
    const seen = new Set();

    values.flat().forEach(value => {
        const text = String(value ?? '').trim();
        if (!text || seen.has(text)) return;
        seen.add(text);
        merged.push(text);
    });

    return merged.join('\n\n');
}

function getCharacterOpeningExtras(profileData = {}) {
    const isNormalizedExtras = profileData?.__openingExtras === true;

    const systemMessage = String(
        profileData?.openingSystemMessage ??
        profileData?.systemOpeningMessage ??
        profileData?.preGreetingSystemMessage ??
        profileData?.enhancerOpeningSystemMessage ??
        (isNormalizedExtras ? profileData?.systemMessage : '') ??
        ''
    ).trim();

    const background = String(
        profileData?.openingBackground ??
        profileData?.enhancerOpeningBackground ??
        profileData?.launchBackground ??
        profileData?.customBackground ??
        profileData?.backgroundOnOpen ??
        (isNormalizedExtras ? profileData?.background : '') ??
        ''
    ).trim();

    const backgroundOpacity = normalizeOpeningBackgroundOpacity(
        profileData?.openingBackgroundOpacity ??
        profileData?.enhancerOpeningBackgroundOpacity ??
        profileData?.launchBackgroundOpacity ??
        profileData?.customBackgroundOpacity ??
        profileData?.backgroundOpacityOnOpen ??
        (isNormalizedExtras ? profileData?.backgroundOpacity : '') ??
        '1'
    );

    const backgroundBlur = normalizeOpeningBackgroundBlur(
        profileData?.openingBackgroundBlur ??
        profileData?.enhancerOpeningBackgroundBlur ??
        profileData?.launchBackgroundBlur ??
        profileData?.customBackgroundBlur ??
        profileData?.backgroundBlurOnOpen ??
        (isNormalizedExtras ? profileData?.backgroundBlur : '') ??
        '0'
    );

    const lorebook = String(
        profileData?.openingLorebook ??
        profileData?.enhancerOpeningLorebook ??
        profileData?.launchLorebook ??
        profileData?.dedicatedLorebook ??
        profileData?.customLorebook ??
        profileData?.lorebookOnOpen ??
        profileData?.referenceOnOpen ??
        (isNormalizedExtras ? profileData?.lorebook : '') ??
        ''
    ).trim();

    const creatorNotes = mergeFuraiPublicTextAliases(
        profileData?.creatorNotes,
        profileData?.creator_notes,
        profileData?.creatorNote,
        profileData?.annotations,
        profileData?.metadataNotes,
        profileData?.notes,
        profileData?.data?.creator_notes,
        isNormalizedExtras ? profileData?.creatorNotes : ''
    );

    return {
        __openingExtras: true,
        systemMessage,
        background,
        backgroundOpacity,
        backgroundBlur,
        lorebook,
        creatorNotes
    };
}

function writeCharacterOpeningExtras(target, source = {}) {
    if (!target) return target;

    const extras = getCharacterOpeningExtras(source);

    if (extras.systemMessage) {
        target.openingSystemMessage = extras.systemMessage;
    } else {
        delete target.openingSystemMessage;
        delete target.systemOpeningMessage;
        delete target.preGreetingSystemMessage;
        delete target.enhancerOpeningSystemMessage;
    }

    if (extras.background) {
        target.openingBackground = extras.background;
        target.openingBackgroundOpacity = extras.backgroundOpacity;
        target.openingBackgroundBlur = extras.backgroundBlur;
    } else {
        delete target.openingBackground;
        delete target.openingBackgroundOpacity;
        delete target.openingBackgroundBlur;
    }

    if (extras.lorebook) {
        target.openingLorebook = extras.lorebook;
    } else {
        delete target.openingLorebook;
    }

    if (extras.creatorNotes) {
        target.creatorNotes = extras.creatorNotes;
        target.creator_notes = extras.creatorNotes;
    } else {
        delete target.creatorNotes;
        delete target.creator_notes;
        delete target.creatorNote;
        delete target.annotations;
        delete target.metadataNotes;
    }

    return target;
}

function copyCharacterOpeningExtras(target, source = {}) {
    return writeCharacterOpeningExtras(target, getCharacterOpeningExtras(source));
}

function writeEnhancerOpeningExtrasToChatData(chatData, source = {}) {
    if (!chatData) return chatData;

    const extras = getCharacterOpeningExtras(source);

    if (extras.systemMessage) {
        chatData.enhancerOpeningSystemMessage = extras.systemMessage;
    } else {
        delete chatData.enhancerOpeningSystemMessage;
    }

    if (extras.background) {
        chatData.enhancerOpeningBackground = extras.background;
        chatData.enhancerOpeningBackgroundOpacity = extras.backgroundOpacity;
        chatData.enhancerOpeningBackgroundBlur = extras.backgroundBlur;
    } else {
        delete chatData.enhancerOpeningBackground;
        delete chatData.enhancerOpeningBackgroundOpacity;
        delete chatData.enhancerOpeningBackgroundBlur;
    }

    if (extras.lorebook) {
        chatData.enhancerOpeningLorebook = extras.lorebook;
    } else {
        delete chatData.enhancerOpeningLorebook;
    }

    if (extras.creatorNotes) {
        chatData.enhancerCreatorNotes = extras.creatorNotes;
    } else {
        delete chatData.enhancerCreatorNotes;
    }

    return chatData;
}

function getGlobalWandOpeningExtrasData() {
    return {
        openingSystemMessage: DB.get('global-group-enhancer-opening-system-message') || '',
        openingBackground: DB.get('global-group-enhancer-opening-background') || '',
        openingBackgroundOpacity: DB.get('global-group-enhancer-opening-background-opacity') || '1',
        openingBackgroundBlur: DB.get('global-group-enhancer-opening-background-blur') || '0',
        openingLorebook: DB.get('global-group-enhancer-opening-lorebook') || '',
        creatorNotes: DB.get('global-group-enhancer-creator-notes') || ''
    };
}

function saveGlobalWandOpeningExtras(source = {}) {
    const extras = getCharacterOpeningExtras(source);

    if (extras.systemMessage) {
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-opening-system-message', extras.systemMessage);
    } else {
        DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-opening-system-message');
    }

    if (extras.background) {
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-opening-background', extras.background);
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-opening-background-opacity', extras.backgroundOpacity);
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-opening-background-blur', extras.backgroundBlur);
    } else {
        DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-opening-background');
        DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-opening-background-opacity');
        DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-opening-background-blur');
    }

    if (extras.lorebook) {
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-opening-lorebook', extras.lorebook);
    } else {
        DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-opening-lorebook');
    }

    if (extras.creatorNotes) {
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-creator-notes', extras.creatorNotes);
    } else {
        DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-creator-notes');
    }
}

function applyCharacterOpeningExtrasToChat(chatData, profileData = {}) {
    if (!chatData) return chatData;

    ensureFuraiChatMemoryDefaults(chatData, chatData.personality || 'researcher');
    const extras = getCharacterOpeningExtras(profileData);

    if (extras.background) {
        chatData.background = extras.background;
        chatData.backgroundOpacity = extras.backgroundOpacity;
        chatData.backgroundBlur = extras.backgroundBlur;
    }

    if (extras.lorebook) {
        chatData.reference = extras.lorebook;
    }

    return chatData;
}

function buildOpeningSetupFields(prefix, openingId, profileData = {}, options = {}) {
    const openingValue = String(options.openingValue ?? '');
    const openingPlaceholder = String(options.placeholder ?? 'Leave blank to use the default greeting.');
    const openingDescription = String(options.description ?? 'Optional. Used only when this character starts a new chat from import, library, share link, or Expansion Pass.');
    const subtitle = String(options.subtitle ?? 'Launch-only message, background, and lorebook');

    return `
        <details id="${prefix}OpeningSetupDetails" class="opening-setup-details">
            <summary class="opening-setup-summary">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-right opening-setup-chevron"></i>
                <span>Opening Setup</span>
                <span class="opening-setup-subtitle">${escapeHTML(subtitle)}</span>
            </summary>

            <div class="opening-setup-body">
                <div class="form-group" style="margin-bottom:12px;">
                    <label for="${prefix}OpeningSystemMessage" style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
                        Opening System Message
                    </label>
                    <p style="font-size:0.8em; opacity:0.7; margin-top:0; margin-bottom:8px;">
                        Optional visible system block shown before the opening greeting.
                    </p>
                    <textarea id="${prefix}OpeningSystemMessage"
                              rows="2"
                              placeholder="Example: The storm sirens begin as the shelter doors lock."
                              style="width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; resize:vertical;">${escapeHTML(getCharacterOpeningExtras(profileData).systemMessage)}</textarea>
                </div>

                <div class="form-group" style="border-top:1px dashed var(--border-color); padding-top:12px; margin-top:12px; margin-bottom:12px;">
                    <label for="${openingId}" style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
                        Opening Message
                    </label>
                    <p style="font-size:0.8em; opacity:0.7; margin-top:0; margin-bottom:8px;">
                        ${escapeHTML(openingDescription)}
                    </p>
                    <textarea id="${openingId}"
                              rows="2"
                              placeholder="${escapeHTML(openingPlaceholder)}"
                              style="width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; resize:vertical;">${escapeHTML(openingValue)}</textarea>
                </div>

                ${buildOpeningExtrasFields(prefix, profileData)}
            </div>
        </details>

        ${buildCreatorNotesFields(prefix, profileData)}
    `;
}
              
function getOpeningExtrasFieldPrefix(nameId) {
    const prefixMap = {
        userNameInput: 'user',
        botNameInput: 'bot',
        enhancerNameInput: 'enhancer',
        makerNameInput: 'maker',
        globalUserName: 'globalUser',
        globalBotName: 'globalBot',
        globalWandName: 'globalWand',
        editGlobalBotName: 'editGlobalBot',
        charsShareName: 'charsShare'
    };

    return prefixMap[nameId] || '';
}

function updateOpeningBackgroundOpacityDisplay(prefix, value) {
    const displayEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}OpeningBackgroundOpacityDisplay`);
    if (!displayEl) return;

    displayEl.textContent = parseFloat(normalizeOpeningBackgroundOpacity(value)).toFixed(2);
}

function updateOpeningBackgroundBlurDisplay(prefix, value) {
    const displayEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}OpeningBackgroundBlurDisplay`);
    if (!displayEl) return;

    displayEl.textContent = parseFloat(normalizeOpeningBackgroundBlur(value)).toFixed(1) + 'px';
}

function populateOpeningExtrasFields(prefix, profileData = {}) {
    const extras = getCharacterOpeningExtras(profileData);

    const systemEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}OpeningSystemMessage`);
    if (systemEl) systemEl.value = extras.systemMessage;

    const bgEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}OpeningBackground`);
    if (bgEl) bgEl.value = extras.background;

    const opacityEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}OpeningBackgroundOpacity`);
    if (opacityEl) opacityEl.value = normalizeOpeningBackgroundOpacity(extras.backgroundOpacity);

    const blurEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}OpeningBackgroundBlur`);
    if (blurEl) blurEl.value = normalizeOpeningBackgroundBlur(extras.backgroundBlur);

    updateOpeningBackgroundOpacityDisplay(prefix, extras.backgroundOpacity);
    updateOpeningBackgroundBlurDisplay(prefix, extras.backgroundBlur);

    const loreParts = splitFuraiLoreInstructions(extras.lorebook);
    const loreEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}OpeningLorebook`);
    if (loreEl) loreEl.value = loreParts.publicText;
    const hiddenLoreEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}OpeningLoreInstructions`);
    if (hiddenLoreEl) hiddenLoreEl.value = loreParts.hiddenText;

    const creatorNotesEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}CreatorNotes`);
    if (creatorNotesEl) creatorNotesEl.value = extras.creatorNotes;
}

function readCharacterOpeningExtrasFromDomOrProfile(nameId, profileData = {}) {
    const prefix = getOpeningExtrasFieldPrefix(nameId);
    const profileExtras = getCharacterOpeningExtras(profileData);

    if (!prefix) return profileExtras;

    const systemEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}OpeningSystemMessage`);
    const bgEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}OpeningBackground`);
    const opacityEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}OpeningBackgroundOpacity`);
    const blurEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}OpeningBackgroundBlur`);
    const loreEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}OpeningLorebook`);
    const hiddenLoreEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}OpeningLoreInstructions`);
    const creatorNotesEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}CreatorNotes`);

    return {
        __openingExtras: true,
        systemMessage: String(systemEl ? systemEl.value : profileExtras.systemMessage).trim(),
        background: String(bgEl ? bgEl.value : profileExtras.background).trim(),
        backgroundOpacity: normalizeOpeningBackgroundOpacity(opacityEl ? opacityEl.value : profileExtras.backgroundOpacity),
        backgroundBlur: normalizeOpeningBackgroundBlur(blurEl ? blurEl.value : profileExtras.backgroundBlur),
        lorebook: loreEl || hiddenLoreEl
            ? joinFuraiLoreInstructions(loreEl?.value || '', hiddenLoreEl?.value || '')
            : profileExtras.lorebook,
        creatorNotes: String(creatorNotesEl ? creatorNotesEl.value : profileExtras.creatorNotes).trim()
    };
}

// Target 1: Temp Chat
function createTempChat(charData) {
    const newChatId = 'chat-' + Date.now();
    const charName = charData.name || 'Character';
    const now = Date.now();

    const savedUser = DB.get('global-user-group') || DB.get('global-profile-user') || createFuraiDefaultUser('group');
    const userToUse = normalizeFuraiSelectedCharacterForRole(savedUser, {
        role: 'user',
        mode: 'group'
    });

    const launchedCharacter = normalizeFuraiSelectedCharacterForRole(charData, {
        role: 'ai',
        mode: 'group',
        botIndex: 0,
        replyMode: 'auto',
        startAfterMessageUid: ''
    });
    launchedCharacter.activeTimestamp = now;

    const newProfile = {
        user: userToUse,
        bots: [launchedCharacter],
        profileCustomized: true,
        rosterMode: 'snapshot',
        singleCharacterGroup: true
    };

    const newChat = applyCharacterOpeningExtrasToChat({
        id: newChatId,
        title: `Chat with ${charName}`,
        messages: buildCharacterOpeningMessages(charData, launchedCharacter, 'group', {
            role: 'ai',
            botIndex: 0,
            timestamp: now
        }),
        timestamp: now,
        personality: 'group',
        groupStartPath: 'character',
        viewMode: resolveSharedOrInheritedViewMode(charData.viewMode)
    }, charData);

    DB.set(newChatId, newChat);
    DB.set(`profile-${newChatId}`, newProfile);
    loadChat(newChatId);

    showToast(`Started chat with ${charName}!`, 'success');

    if (typeof closeExpansionModal === 'function') closeExpansionModal();
}

    openImportReplaceModal('global');
}

function openLocalReplacementSelector(charData) {
    if (!currentChatId || getStoredChatPersonality(currentChatId) === 'home') {
        showToast('Open a real chat first.', 'error');
        return;
    }

    window._pendingImportData = cloneFuraiData(charData);
    openImportReplaceModal('local');
}

// Target 3: Add New Character
function addToGlobalRoster(charData, options = {}) {
    let roster = DB.get('globalBotRoster') || [];
    if (!roster || roster.length === 0) roster = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaultBots));

    if (!canAddCharacterSlotToRoster(roster)) {
        if (!options.silentLimit) showCharacterSlotLimitToast();
        return false;
    }

    const masterMode = getGlobalCastMode();
    const newLibraryUid = generateUID('imported_roster');
    const libraryCreatedAt = Date.now();
    const newBot = {
        ...cloneFuraiData(charData),
        uid: newLibraryUid,
        sourceLibraryUid: newLibraryUid,
        libraryCreatedAt,
        timestamp: libraryCreatedAt,
        chatCount: 0,
        lastChattedAt: 0,
        isActive: false,
        inActiveCast: false,
        replyMode: masterMode
    };

    roster.push(newBot);
    DB.set('globalBotRoster', roster);

    if (!options.silentToast) {
        showToast(`${charData.name} added to Global Roster!`, "success");
    }

    if (!options.deferRefresh) {
        const charsModal = document.getElementById('charactersModalEl');
        if (charsModal && charsModal.style.display === 'flex') {
            renderCharactersGrid();
        }

        if (document.getElementById('globalSettingsModalEl').style.display === 'flex') {
            renderGlobalContent('group');
        }
    }

    return true;
}

// Target 4: Add directly to the CURRENT Chat's roster
function addToLocalRoster(charData, options = {}) {
    if (!currentChatId) return;

    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    if (!profile || !Array.isArray(profile.bots)) return;

    const personality = getStoredChatPersonality(currentChatId);
    const isStoryMode = personality === 'story';
    const shouldActivate = options.activate === true;

    if (!canAddCharacterSlotToRoster(profile.bots)) {
        showCharacterSlotLimitToast();
        return false;
    }

    const currentRoster = isStoryMode ? profile.bots.slice(1) : profile.bots;
    const activeCount = currentRoster.filter(bot => bot && bot.inActiveCast).length;
    const limit = AchievementManager.getGroupLimit();
    const canActivate = shouldActivate && (limit >= 9999 || activeCount < limit);

    if (shouldActivate && !canActivate) {
        if (options.requireActivate === true) {
            showToast(isStoryMode ? "Current Story Cast is full." : "Online list is full.", "error");
            return;
        }

        showToast("Online list is full. Added to the offline roster instead.", "error");
    }

    const masterMode = isStoryMode
        ? getSavedGlobalCastMode('story')
        : (profile.masterReplyMode || getGlobalCastMode());

    const newBot = normalizeFuraiSelectedCharacterForRole(charData, {
        role: 'ai',
        mode: isStoryMode ? 'story' : 'group',
        botIndex: profile.bots.length,
        replyMode: masterMode,
        startAfterMessageUid: getFuraiLastMessageUid(DB.get(currentChatId))
    });
    newBot.isActive = isStoryMode ? false : canActivate;
    newBot.inActiveCast = canActivate;

    if (isStoryMode) {
        newBot.storySnapshot = true;
        newBot.storyImportedAt = Date.now();
        newBot.storyRolePreset = newBot.storyRolePreset || 'support';
        newBot.storyCustomRole = newBot.storyCustomRole || '';
        newBot.storyRoleNote = newBot.storyRoleNote || '';
        newBot.storyRoleType = typeof getStoryRoleLabel === 'function' ? getStoryRoleLabel(newBot) : 'Support';
        newBot.storyContextMode = newBot.storyContextMode || 'present';

        delete newBot.replyMode;
        delete newBot.activeTimestamp;
    } else {
        newBot.replyMode = masterMode;
        if (canActivate) newBot.activeTimestamp = Date.now();
    }
    
    profile.bots.push(newBot);
    
    if (!isStoryMode) {
        markAddedGroupRosterCharacterAsChatted(newBot);
    }
    
    profile.profileCustomized = true;
    DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, profile);
    
    const addedName = charData.name || 'Character';
    const destination = canActivate
        ? (isStoryMode ? 'active cast' : 'online list')
        : (isStoryMode ? 'story cast' : "this chat's roster");

    showToast(`${addedName} added to ${destination}!`, "success");
    
    renderGroupBotMenu(profile);

    if (!isStoryMode) {
        updateOnlineCount(profile);
        triggerOnlineRipple();

        const onlineModal = document.getElementById('onlineListModal');
        if (onlineModal && onlineModal.style.display === 'block') {
            toggleOnlineList(true);
        }
    }

    const importModal = document.getElementById('charImportModalEl');
    if (importModal) importModal.style.display = 'none';

    if (isStoryMode && typeof renderStoryChatCastModal === 'function') {
        renderStoryChatCastModal();

        const storyCastModal = document.getElementById('storyChatCastModalEl');
        if (storyCastModal) storyCastModal.style.display = 'flex';
    } else {
        renderCastSwitchingModal();

        const castModal = document.getElementById('castSwitchingModalEl');
        if (castModal) castModal.style.display = 'flex';
    }

    return true;
}

function resetIoWarningBlock() {
    const warning = document.getElementById('ioWarningBlock');
    if (!warning) return;

    warning.innerHTML = `
        <strong><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-info"></i> Notification</strong><br>
        This uploads your backup to the <b>Perchance File Uploader</b>. We don’t actively scan your content.
    `;
    warning.style.display = 'none';
}

function getFuraiSharedLinkKind(value) {
    const raw = String(value || '').trim();
    if (!raw) return '';

    try {
        const parsedUrl = new URL(raw, window.location.href);
        const params = parsedUrl.searchParams;

        if (params.get('char') || params.get('char_import')) return 'character';
        if (params.get('backup') || params.get('backup_share')) return 'backup';
        if (params.get('chat') || params.get('chat_share')) return 'chat';
        if (params.get('glossary')) return 'glossary';
        if (params.get('lorebook')) return 'lorebook';
    } catch (e) {}

    return '';
}

function looksLikeFuraiCharacterData(data) {
    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || Array.isArray(data)) return false;
    if (data.spec === 'chara_card_v2' && data.data) return true;
    if (data.addCharacter && typeof data.addCharacter === 'object') return true;

    const source = data.data && typeof data.data === 'object' ? data.data : data;
    return !!(
        (source.instruction || source.description || source.roleInstruction || hasFuraiProtectedInstructions(source)) &&
        (source.name || source.avatar || source.defaultSprite || source.ver || source.type === 'character')
    );
}

function looksLikeFuraiBackupData(data) {
    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || Array.isArray(data)) return false;
    if (data.chat || data.profile || looksLikeFuraiCharacterData(data)) return false;

    const keys = Object.keys(data);
    return keys.some(key =>
        key === 'globalBotRoster' ||
        key === 'globalStoryBotRoster' ||
        key === 'furai_achievements' ||
        key === 'furai_storage_mode' ||
        key.startsWith('chat-') ||
        key.startsWith('profile-')
    );
}

function setIoActionButtonIdle(btn, label = 'Import') {
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.textContent = label;
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.style.background = '';
    btn.style.color = '';
    btn.style.borderColor = '';
}
