const FURAI_MAX_ARTIFACT_IMPORT_BYTES = 128 * 1024 * 1024;
const FURAI_MAX_CHARACTER_ARTIFACT_BYTES = 32 * 1024 * 1024;
const FURAI_MAX_LIBRARY_ARTIFACT_BYTES = 32 * 1024 * 1024;

// @FURAI_ARTIFACT_FORMAT_POLICY — CONTRACT FOR HUMAN AND AI EDITORS:
// - Create Link / Get Link always uploads gzip.
// - Direct JSON/GZ file upload and download are only exposed for complete chats and full backups.
// - Character, Lorebook, and Glossary sharing/import keep their text, card, and link workflows; gzip links remain supported.
// - Chat/backup Concept Board storage uses gzip; previews/imports accept both.
// - Every reader detects gzip by file signature, not by filename.
// - Legacy raw .json/.txt chat and backup files remain supported.
function canUseFuraiGzipCodec() {
    return (
        typeof CompressionStream === 'function' &&
        typeof DecompressionStream === 'function' &&
        typeof TransformStream === 'function'
    );
}

function getFuraiJsonText(value, pretty = false) {
    if (typeof value === 'string') return value;
    return JSON.stringify(value, null, pretty ? 2 : 0);
}

async function createFuraiGzipBlob(value, fileName = 'furai-artifact.json.gz', options = {}) {
    if (!canUseFuraiGzipCodec()) {
        throw new Error('This browser cannot create gzip files. Download JSON instead.');
    }

    const sourceBlob = value instanceof Blob
        ? value
        : new Blob([
            options.json === false ? String(value ?? '') : getFuraiJsonText(value, false)
        ], { type: options.sourceType || 'application/json;charset=utf-8' });

    const maxSourceBytes = Number(options.maxSourceBytes);
    if (Number.isFinite(maxSourceBytes) && maxSourceBytes > 0 && sourceBlob.size > maxSourceBytes) {
        throw new Error('FurAI export is too large for safe re-import.');
    }

    const compressed = await new Response(
        sourceBlob.stream().pipeThrough(new CompressionStream('gzip'))
    ).blob();

    const gzipBlob = new Blob([compressed], { type: 'application/gzip' });
    if (Number.isFinite(maxSourceBytes) && maxSourceBytes > 0 && gzipBlob.size > maxSourceBytes) {
        throw new Error('Compressed FurAI export is too large for safe re-import.');
    }

    return typeof File === 'function'
        ? new File([gzipBlob], fileName, { type: 'application/gzip' })
        : gzipBlob;
}

async function readFuraiArtifactTextBlob(blob, options = {}) {
    if (!blob || typeof blob.slice !== 'function' || typeof blob.text !== 'function') {
        throw new Error('Invalid FurAI file.');
    }

    const maxBytes = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxBytes) || FURAI_MAX_ARTIFACT_IMPORT_BYTES);
    if (blob.size > maxBytes) throw new Error('FurAI file is too large.');

    const signature = new Uint8Array(await blob.slice(0, 2).arrayBuffer());
    const isGzip = signature[0] === 0x1f && signature[1] === 0x8b;

    if (!isGzip) return blob.text();

    if (typeof DecompressionStream !== 'function' || typeof TransformStream !== 'function') {
        throw new Error('This browser cannot open gzip files.');
    }

    let decompressedBytes = 0;
    let exceededLimit = false;

    try {
        const limitedStream = blob.stream()
            .pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('gzip'))
            .pipeThrough(new TransformStream({
                transform(chunk, controller) {
                    decompressedBytes += chunk.byteLength;
                    if (decompressedBytes > maxBytes) {
                        exceededLimit = true;
                        throw new Error('FURAI_ARTIFACT_TOO_LARGE');
                    }
                    controller.enqueue(chunk);
                }
            }));

        return await new Response(limitedStream).text();
    } catch (error) {
        if (exceededLimit || error?.message === 'FURAI_ARTIFACT_TOO_LARGE') {
            throw new Error('FurAI gzip data is too large after decompression.');
        }
        throw new Error('Invalid or corrupted gzip file.');
    }
}

async function parseFuraiArtifactJsonBlob(blob, options = {}) {
    const text = await readFuraiArtifactTextBlob(blob, options);
    try {
        return JSON.parse(text);
    } catch (error) {
        throw new Error('Invalid FurAI JSON data.');
    }
}

async function readFuraiArtifactTextResponse(response, options = {}) {
    const maxBytes = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxBytes) || FURAI_MAX_ARTIFACT_IMPORT_BYTES);
    const declaredBytes = Number(response?.headers?.get?.('content-length'));
    if (Number.isFinite(declaredBytes) && declaredBytes > maxBytes) {
        throw new Error('Downloaded FurAI file is too large.');
    }
    return readFuraiArtifactTextBlob(await response.blob(), { ...options, maxBytes });
}

async function parseFuraiArtifactJsonResponse(response, options = {}) {
    const maxBytes = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxBytes) || FURAI_MAX_ARTIFACT_IMPORT_BYTES);
    const declaredBytes = Number(response?.headers?.get?.('content-length'));
    if (Number.isFinite(declaredBytes) && declaredBytes > maxBytes) {
        throw new Error('Downloaded FurAI file is too large.');
    }
    return parseFuraiArtifactJsonBlob(await response.blob(), { ...options, maxBytes });
}

async function parseFuraiCharacterJsonBlob(blob) {
    return parseFuraiArtifactJsonBlob(blob, { maxBytes: FURAI_MAX_CHARACTER_ARTIFACT_BYTES });
}

async function parseFuraiCharacterJsonResponse(response) {
    return parseFuraiArtifactJsonResponse(response, { maxBytes: FURAI_MAX_CHARACTER_ARTIFACT_BYTES });
}

function getFuraiLibraryArtifactPayload(source = {}) {
    const type = source.type === 'glossary' ? 'glossary' : 'lorebook';
    return {
        furaiArtifactVersion: 2,
        furaiArtifactType: type,
        type,
        title: String(source.title || (type === 'glossary' ? 'Glossary' : 'Lorebook')),
        hashTag: String(source.hashTag || ''),
        cover: String(source.cover || ''),
        content: String(source.content || '')
    };
}

function parseFuraiLibraryArtifactText(rawText, fallback = {}) {
    const raw = String(rawText || '');
    try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && typeof parsed.content === 'string') {
            return {
                type: parsed.type === 'glossary' || parsed.furaiArtifactType === 'glossary'
                    ? 'glossary'
                    : parsed.type === 'lorebook' || parsed.furaiArtifactType === 'lorebook'
                        ? 'lorebook'
                        : (fallback.type === 'glossary' ? 'glossary' : 'lorebook'),
                title: String(parsed.title || fallback.title || ''),
                hashTag: String(parsed.hashTag || fallback.hashTag || ''),
                cover: String(parsed.cover || fallback.cover || ''),
                content: parsed.content
            };
        }
    } catch (error) {}

    return {
        type: fallback.type === 'glossary' ? 'glossary' : 'lorebook',
        title: String(fallback.title || ''),
        hashTag: String(fallback.hashTag || ''),
        cover: String(fallback.cover || ''),
        content: raw
    };
}

async function readFuraiLibraryArtifactResponse(response, fallback = {}) {
    return parseFuraiLibraryArtifactText(
        await readFuraiArtifactTextResponse(response, { maxBytes: FURAI_MAX_LIBRARY_ARTIFACT_BYTES }),
        fallback
    );
}

async function createFuraiSharedUploadPayload(data, fileName = 'furai-share.gz') {
    // New links are always gzip. Failing visibly is safer than silently creating
    // a new legacy link that violates the current format contract.
    const payload = await createFuraiGzipBlob(data, fileName, {
        json: true,
        maxSourceBytes: FURAI_MAX_ARTIFACT_IMPORT_BYTES
    });
    return { payload, compressed: true };
}

// Backward-compatible names used by existing chat/backup import code.
const parseFuraiSharedJsonBlob = parseFuraiArtifactJsonBlob;
const parseFuraiSharedJsonResponse = parseFuraiArtifactJsonResponse;

/* --- EXPORT LOGIC --- */

function buildFuraiDownloadArtifact(chatId, scope = 'single') {
    let data;
    let fileName;
    let title;

    if (scope === 'global') {
        data = getGlobalBackupData();
        if (!data) return null;

        const date = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        title = `FurAI Full Backup ${date}`;
        fileName = `FurAI-FullBackup-${date}.json`;
    } else {
        data = buildSingleChatExportData(chatId);
        const chatData = data?.chat || {};
        title = String(chatData.title || 'Untitled Chat').trim() || 'Untitled Chat';
        const safeTitle = title.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '_').toLowerCase();
        fileName = `FurAI-${safeTitle}-${Date.now()}.json`;
    }

    return { data, title, fileName };
}

function getFuraiGzipFileName(jsonFileName) {
    return String(jsonFileName || 'FurAI-export.json').replace(/\.json$/i, '') + '.json.gz';
}

function downloadFuraiArtifactBlob(blob, fileName) {
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = fileName;
    a.style.display = 'none';
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    setTimeout(() => {
        a.remove();
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    }, 10000);
}

async function saveChatToConceptBoard(trigger, chatId) {
    try {
        let artifact = buildFuraiDownloadArtifact(chatId, 'single');
        if (!artifact) throw new Error('Chat export data is unavailable.');

        artifact = await prepareFuraiDownloadArtifactForExport(artifact, {
            actionLabel: 'save this chat to Concept Board'
        });
        if (!artifact) return;

        const gzipFileName = getFuraiGzipFileName(artifact.fileName);
        const gzipBlob = await createFuraiGzipBlob(artifact.data, gzipFileName, { json: true, maxSourceBytes: FURAI_MAX_ARTIFACT_IMPORT_BYTES });
        const chatData = artifact.data?.chat || {};
        const saved = await saveFuraiArtifactToConceptBoard({
            trigger,
            sourceEl: trigger,
            folder: 'Chat',
            title: artifact.title,
            payload: gzipBlob,
            mimeType: 'application/gzip',
            extension: 'json.gz',
            fileName: gzipFileName,
            info: {
                viewer: 'furai-chat',
                type: 'Chat',
                storageFormat: 'gzip',
                readableFileName: artifact.fileName,
                chatId: String(chatId || ''),
                messageCount: Array.isArray(chatData.messages) ? chatData.messages.length : 0,
                mode: chatData.personality || chatPersonalities[chatId] || 'unknown',
                ...getFuraiExportProtectionInfo(artifact.protection)
            }
        });

        if (saved) closeExportImportModal();
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Chat Concept Board save failed:', error);
        showToast(`Could not save chat to Concept Board: ${error.message || error}`, 'error');
    }
}

async function saveBackupToConceptBoard(trigger) {
    try {
        let artifact = buildFuraiDownloadArtifact(null, 'global');
        if (!artifact) {
            showToast('No data to back up.', 'error');
            return;
        }

        artifact = await prepareFuraiDownloadArtifactForExport(artifact, {
            actionLabel: 'save this full backup to Concept Board'
        });
        if (!artifact) return;

        const gzipFileName = getFuraiGzipFileName(artifact.fileName);
        const gzipBlob = await createFuraiGzipBlob(artifact.data, gzipFileName, { json: true, maxSourceBytes: FURAI_MAX_ARTIFACT_IMPORT_BYTES });
        const saved = await saveFuraiArtifactToConceptBoard({
            trigger,
            sourceEl: trigger,
            folder: 'Backup',
            title: artifact.title,
            payload: gzipBlob,
            mimeType: 'application/gzip',
            extension: 'json.gz',
            fileName: gzipFileName,
            info: {
                viewer: 'furai-backup',
                type: 'Backup',
                scope: 'global',
                storageFormat: 'gzip',
                readableFileName: artifact.fileName,
                ...getFuraiExportProtectionInfo(artifact.protection)
            }
        });

        if (saved) closeExportImportModal();
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Backup Concept Board save failed:', error);
        showToast(`Could not save backup to Concept Board: ${error.message || error}`, 'error');
    }
}

async function performLocalExport(chatId, scope = 'single', format = 'json') {
    try {
        let artifact = buildFuraiDownloadArtifact(chatId, scope);
        if (!artifact) {
            showToast(scope === 'global' ? 'No data to backup' : 'Chat export data is unavailable.', 'error');
            return;
        }

        artifact = await prepareFuraiDownloadArtifactForExport(artifact, {
            actionLabel: scope === 'global' ? 'download this full backup' : 'download this chat'
        });
        if (!artifact) return;

        const useGzip = String(format).toLowerCase() === 'gz';
        const fileName = useGzip ? getFuraiGzipFileName(artifact.fileName) : artifact.fileName;
        const blob = useGzip
            ? await createFuraiGzipBlob(artifact.data, fileName, {
                json: true,
                maxSourceBytes: FURAI_MAX_ARTIFACT_IMPORT_BYTES
            })
            : new Blob([JSON.stringify(artifact.data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });

        if (blob.size > FURAI_MAX_ARTIFACT_IMPORT_BYTES) {
            throw new Error('FurAI export is too large for safe re-import.');
        }

        downloadFuraiArtifactBlob(blob, fileName);
        closeExportImportModal();
        showToast(
            artifact.protection.mode === 'safe'
                ? 'Downloaded without protected instructions.'
                : useGzip ? 'Compressed file downloaded!' : 'JSON file downloaded!'
        );
    } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
        showToast(`Export failed: ${error.message || error}`, 'error');
    }
}

function cleanReadableChatText(value) {
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.innerHTML = String(value || '');
    return (div.textContent || div.innerText || '')
        .replace(/\u00a0/g, ' ')
        .replace(/[ \t]+\n/g, '\n')
        .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
        .trim();
}

function getReadableMessageName(msg, profile, chatId = currentChatId) {
    const role = String(msg?.role || '').toLowerCase();
    const actor = resolveFuraiActorForMessage(chatId, msg, profile);

    if (role === 'user') return actor?.name || msg.userNameSnapshot || 'User';
    if (role === 'ai' || role === 'assistant') return actor?.name || msg.botNameSnapshot || 'Unknown Character';
    if (role === 'muted-note') return msg.silentNoteSpeakerName || msg.userNameSnapshot || msg.botNameSnapshot || msg.wandNameSnapshot || 'Silent Note';
    if (isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(role) || role === 'system') return '';
    if (role === 'cutscene') return 'Cutscene';
    return role ? role.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + role.slice(1) : 'Message';
}

function formatReadableChatLog(chatId) {
    const chatData = DB.get(chatId);
    const profile = DB.get(`profile-${chatId}`) || {};

    if (!chatData || !Array.isArray(chatData.messages)) {
        return '';
    }

    const title = cleanReadableChatText(chatData.title || 'Untitled Chat');
    const lines = [
        title,
        'FurAI Chatlog',
        ''
    ];

    chatData.messages.forEach(msg => {
        const text = cleanReadableChatText(msg.content);
        if (!text) return;

        const role = String(msg.role || '').toLowerCase();
        const name = getReadableMessageName(msg, profile, chatId);

        if (msg.createdAt) {
            const time = new Date(msg.createdAt).toLocaleString();
            lines.push(name ? `[${time}] ${name}:` : `[${time}]`);
        } else if (name) {
            lines.push(`${name}:`);
        }

        lines.push(text);
        lines.push('');
    });

    return lines.join('\n').trim();
}

async function copyReadableChatLog(chatId) {
    try {
        const text = formatReadableChatLog(chatId);

        if (!text) {
            showToast("No chatlog to copy.", "error");
            return;
        }

        try {
            await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
        } catch (err) {
            const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
            textarea.value = text;
            textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
            textarea.style.left = '-9999px';
            textarea.style.top = '-9999px';
            document.body.appendChild(textarea);
            textarea.focus();
            textarea.select();
            document.execCommand('copy');
            textarea.remove();
        }

        showToast("Readable chatlog copied!");
    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        showToast("Copy chatlog failed.", "error");
    }
}

function getFuraiUploadFileId(value) {
    const raw = String(value || '').trim();

    try {
        const parsedUrl = new URL(raw, window.location.href);

        const directValue =
            parsedUrl.searchParams.get('char') ||
            parsedUrl.searchParams.get('chat') ||
            parsedUrl.searchParams.get('backup') ||
            parsedUrl.searchParams.get('lorebook') ||
            parsedUrl.searchParams.get('glossary');

        if (directValue) return getFuraiUploadFileId(directValue);

        const importValue =
            parsedUrl.searchParams.get('char_import') ||
            parsedUrl.searchParams.get('chat_share') ||
            parsedUrl.searchParams.get('backup_share');

        if (importValue) return getFuraiUploadFileId(decodeURIComponent(importValue));

        const pathMatch = parsedUrl.pathname.match(/\/file\/([^/?#]+)/i);
        if (pathMatch) return getFuraiUploadFileId(pathMatch[1]);
    } catch (e) {}

    const fileMatch = raw.match(/(?:^|\/file\/)([a-f0-9]{32})(?:\.(json\.gz|txt|json|gz))?$/i);
    if (fileMatch) {
        const extension = String(fileMatch[2] || '').toLowerCase();
        return extension && extension !== 'txt'
            ? `${fileMatch[1]}.${extension}`
            : fileMatch[1];
    }

    return raw.replace(/\.txt$/i, '');
}

function resolveFuraiUploadFileUrl(value) {
    const fileId = getFuraiUploadFileId(value);

    if (/^[a-f0-9]{32}\.(?:json\.gz|json|gz)$/i.test(fileId)) {
        return `https://user.uploads.dev/file/${fileId}`;
    }

    // Legacy FurAI links stored only the upload ID and referenced .txt JSON.
    if (/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/i.test(fileId)) {
        return `https://user.uploads.dev/file/${fileId}.txt`;
    }

    const raw = String(value || '').trim();
    if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(raw)) return raw;

    throw new Error("Invalid FurAI shared file link.");
}

async function performCloudUpload(chatId, scope = 'single') {
    const btn = document.getElementById('ioActionBtn');
    const input = document.getElementById('ioUrlInput');
    const uploadFn = (typeof window.root !== 'undefined' && window.root.upload) ? window.root.upload : (window.upload || null);

    if (!uploadFn) {
        showToast("Upload plugin not found!", "error");
        return;
    }

    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin fa-sm"></i>';
    btn.disabled = true;

    try {
        let artifact = buildFuraiDownloadArtifact(chatId, scope);
        if (!artifact) throw new Error("No data found");

        artifact = await prepareFuraiDownloadArtifactForExport(artifact, {
            actionLabel: scope === 'global' ? 'create this full-backup link' : 'create this chat link'
        });
        if (!artifact) {
            setIoActionButtonIdle(btn, 'Generate Link');
            return;
        }

        // Compress only the remote shared-link upload. No local export path enters here.
        const sharedUpload = await createFuraiSharedUploadPayload(
            artifact.data,
            scope === 'global' ? 'furai-full-backup.gz' : 'furai-chat.gz'
        );

        // --- Expiry Logic ---
        const expirySelect = document.getElementById('ioExpirySelect');
        const expiryVal = expirySelect ? expirySelect.value : '7';

        let uploadOpts = {};
        if (expiryVal === '7') {
            uploadOpts.expires = Date.now() + (7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
        }

        const { url, error } = await uploadFn(sharedUpload.payload, uploadOpts);
        if (error) throw new Error(error);

        const uploadId = getFuraiUploadFileId(url);
        if (sharedUpload.compressed && !/^[a-f0-9]{32}(?:\.json)?\.gz$/i.test(uploadId)) {
            throw new Error('Upload service did not preserve the gzip file type.');
        }

        const shareParam = scope === 'global' ? 'backup' : 'chat';
        const shareUrl = `https://perchance.org/fur-ai?${shareParam}=${encodeURIComponent(uploadId)}`;

        input.value = shareUrl;
        input.select();

        const ioShareModeRow = document.getElementById('ioShareModeRow');
        const ioShareModeDefaultBtn = document.getElementById('ioShareModeDefaultBtn');
        const ioShareModeChatBtn = document.getElementById('ioShareModeChatBtn');
        const ioShareModeVnBtn = document.getElementById('ioShareModeVnBtn');

        if (scope === 'single' && ioShareModeRow && ioShareModeDefaultBtn && ioShareModeChatBtn && ioShareModeVnBtn) {
            setupShareModePills({
                baseUrl: shareUrl,
                inputId: 'ioUrlInput',
                rowId: 'ioShareModeRow',
                defaultBtnId: 'ioShareModeDefaultBtn',
                chatBtnId: 'ioShareModeChatBtn',
                vnBtnId: 'ioShareModeVnBtn',
                defaultMode: 'default'
            });
        } else if (ioShareModeRow) {
            ioShareModeRow.style.display = 'none';
        }

        btn.textContent = "Copy Link";
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.style.backgroundColor = "#00e676";
        btn.style.color = "#000";
        btn.style.borderColor = "#00e676";

        btn.onclick = async () => {
            const copied = await copyTextSafely(input.value, input);

            if (copied) {
                showToast("Link copied!");
                closeExportImportModal();
                return;
            }

            showToast("Link selected. Press Ctrl+C to copy.", "info");
        };

        showToast(
            artifact.protection.mode === 'safe'
                ? 'Link ready without protected instructions!'
                : 'Compressed share link ready!'
        );

    } catch(e) {
        console.error(e);
        btn.textContent = "Retry";
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.style.background = "";
        showToast("Upload failed: " + (e.message || "Unknown error"), "error");
    }
}

                width: 0%;
                height: 100%;
                border-radius: inherit;
                background: var(--primary-color);
                transition: width 160ms ease;
            }

            .backup-progress-foot {
                display: flex;
                justify-content: space-between;
                align-items: center;
                margin-top: 9px;
                font-size: 12px;
                opacity: 0.68;
            }
        `;
        document.head.appendChild(style);
    }

    overlay = document.createElement('div');
    overlay.id = 'backupProgressOverlay';
    overlay.innerHTML = `
        <div class="backup-progress-card" role="status" aria-live="polite">
            <div class="backup-progress-head">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i>
                <span id="backupProgressTitle">Loading backup...</span>
            </div>
            <div id="backupProgressDetail" class="backup-progress-detail">Preparing...</div>
            <div class="backup-progress-track">
                <div id="backupProgressBar" class="backup-progress-bar"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="backup-progress-foot">
                <span>Do not close this page</span>
                <span id="backupProgressPercent">0%</span>
            </div>
        </div>
    `;

    document.body.appendChild(overlay);
    return overlay;
}

function showBackupProgress(title = 'Loading backup...', detail = 'Preparing...', percent = 5) {
    const overlay = ensureBackupProgressOverlay();
    overlay.classList.add('show');
    setBackupProgress(percent, detail, title);
}

function setBackupProgress(percent = 0, detail = '', title = '') {
    const overlay = ensureBackupProgressOverlay();
    const safePercent = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(percent)));

    const bar = overlay.querySelector('#backupProgressBar');
    const percentEl = overlay.querySelector('#backupProgressPercent');
    const detailEl = overlay.querySelector('#backupProgressDetail');
    const titleEl = overlay.querySelector('#backupProgressTitle');

    if (bar) bar.style.width = safePercent + '%';
    if (percentEl) percentEl.textContent = safePercent + '%';
    if (detailEl && detail) detailEl.textContent = detail;
    if (titleEl && title) titleEl.textContent = title;
}

function hideBackupProgress(delay = 250) {
    const overlay = document.getElementById('backupProgressOverlay');
    if (!overlay) return;

    setTimeout(() => {
        overlay.classList.remove('show');
    }, delay);
}

function waitForBackupProgressFrame() {
    return new Promise(resolve => {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => setTimeout(resolve, 0));
    });
}

/* --- IMPORT LOGIC --- */

function triggerLocalImport(scope = 'single') {
    const fileInput = document.getElementById('backupFileInput');

    fileInput.onchange = async (event) => {
        const file = event.target.files[0];
        if (!file) return;

        const isGlobalRestore = scope === 'global';
        const progressTitle = isGlobalRestore ? 'Loading backup...' : 'Importing chat...';

        showBackupProgress(progressTitle, `Reading ${file.name || 'file'}...`, 8);

        try {
            await waitForBackupProgressFrame();
            setBackupProgress(30, file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.gz') ? 'Decompressing file...' : 'Parsing JSON...');
            const json = await parseFuraiArtifactJsonBlob(file);

            if (isGlobalRestore) {
                setBackupProgress(42, 'Checking backup contents...');
                await waitForBackupProgressFrame();

                const proceed = await restoreGlobalBackup(json);
                if (proceed === false) {
                    hideBackupProgress(0);
                    return;
                }
            } else {
                setBackupProgress(50, 'Checking chat data...');
                await waitForBackupProgressFrame();

                if (!json.chat || !json.chat.id) throw new Error('Invalid chat data');

                const newChatId = 'chat-' + Date.now();
                const newChatData = json.chat;
                const sourceChatId = String(newChatData.id || '');
                newChatData.id = newChatId;
                remapFuraiDeepMemoryAuthorityForNewChat(newChatData, sourceChatId, newChatId);
                newChatData.timestamp = Date.now();

                setBackupProgress(68, 'Saving imported chat...');
                await waitForBackupProgressFrame();

                DB.set(newChatId, newChatData);
                if (json.profile) DB.set(`profile-${newChatId}`, json.profile);
                if (newChatData.background) addToBackgroundHistory(newChatData.background);

                setBackupProgress(86, 'Opening imported chat...');
                await waitForBackupProgressFrame();
                loadChat(newChatId);

                setBackupProgress(100, 'Chat imported.');
                hideBackupProgress(550);
                showToast('Chat imported!', 'success');
            }

            closeExportImportModal();
        } catch (error) {
            console.error(error);
            hideBackupProgress(0);
            showToast(`Import failed: ${error.message || 'Invalid file'}`, 'error');
        } finally {
            fileInput.value = '';
        }
    };

    fileInput.click();
}

function showCloudImportUI(scope = 'single') {
    const urlArea = document.getElementById('ioUrlArea');
    const input = document.getElementById('ioUrlInput');
    const actionBtn = document.getElementById('ioActionBtn');
    const label = document.getElementById('ioUrlLabel');
    
    document.getElementById('ioSelectionGrid').style.display = 'none';
    urlArea.style.display = 'block';
    
    // Hide the Expiry Dropdown for Imports
    const expiryCtn = document.getElementById('ioExpiryCtn');
    if (expiryCtn) expiryCtn.style.display = 'none';
    
    if(label) {
        label.textContent = "Paste Link:";
        label.style.opacity = "0.7";
        label.style.fontSize = "12px";
    }

    input.readOnly = false;
    input.value = "";
    input.placeholder = scope === 'global'
        ? "https://perchance.org/fur-ai?backup=..."
        : "https://perchance.org/fur-ai?chat=..., ?char=..., or ?lorebook=...";
    input.focus();
    
    // FIX: Reactivate the button in case it was stuck from a previous import
    actionBtn.style.background = "";
    actionBtn.style.color = "";
    actionBtn.textContent = "Import";
    actionBtn.disabled = false; 
    actionBtn.onclick = () => performCloudImport(scope); 
}

async function performCloudImport(scope = 'single') {
    const btn = document.getElementById('ioActionBtn');
    const rawUrl = document.getElementById('ioUrlInput').value.trim();

    if (!rawUrl) {
        showToast("Please enter a URL", "error");
        return;
    }

    const explicitKind = getFuraiSharedLinkKind(rawUrl);

    if (explicitKind === 'lorebook' || explicitKind === 'glossary') {
        setIoActionButtonIdle(btn);
        showIoWrongLinkHint(explicitKind, scope);
        return;
    }

    if (scope !== 'global' && (explicitKind === 'character' || explicitKind === 'backup')) {
        setIoActionButtonIdle(btn);
        showIoWrongLinkHint(explicitKind, scope);
        return;
    }

    if (scope === 'global' && (explicitKind === 'character' || explicitKind === 'chat')) {
        setIoActionButtonIdle(btn);
        showIoWrongLinkHint(explicitKind, scope);
        return;
    }

    resetIoWarningBlock();
    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin fa-sm"></i>';
    btn.disabled = true;

    try {
        let fetchUrl = rawUrl;
        const isBackupImport = scope === 'global';

        try {
            const parsedUrl = new URL(rawUrl, window.location.href);

            const backupValue =
                parsedUrl.searchParams.get('backup') ||
                parsedUrl.searchParams.get('backup_share');

            const chatValue =
                parsedUrl.searchParams.get('chat') ||
                parsedUrl.searchParams.get('chat_share');

            const scopedValue = isBackupImport ? backupValue : chatValue;

            if (scopedValue) {
                fetchUrl = resolveFuraiUploadFileUrl(scopedValue);
            }
        } catch (e) {}

        // Legacy Perchance data wrapper fallback.
        if (rawUrl.includes("data=")) {
            const cMatch = rawUrl.match(/data=([^~]+)~([^&]+)/);
            if (cMatch) fetchUrl = `https://user.uploads.dev/file/${cMatch[2]}`;
        }

        // Also support pasting only the upload ID.
        if (fetchUrl === rawUrl) {
            fetchUrl = resolveFuraiUploadFileUrl(rawUrl);
        }

        const fetcher = window.root?.superFetch ? window.root.superFetch : fetch;
        const res = await fetcher(fetchUrl);
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Network error or link expired");

        const json = await parseFuraiSharedJsonResponse(res);

        if (!isBackupImport && looksLikeFuraiCharacterData(json) && !json.chat) {
            setIoActionButtonIdle(btn);
            showIoWrongLinkHint('character', scope);
            return;
        }

        if (!isBackupImport && looksLikeFuraiBackupData(json)) {
            setIoActionButtonIdle(btn);
            showIoWrongLinkHint('backup', scope);
            return;
        }

        if (isBackupImport && json.chat) {
            setIoActionButtonIdle(btn);
            showIoWrongLinkHint('chat', scope);
            return;
        }

        if (isBackupImport && looksLikeFuraiCharacterData(json)) {
            setIoActionButtonIdle(btn);
            showIoWrongLinkHint('character', scope);
            return;
        }

        if (isBackupImport) {
            const proceed = await restoreGlobalBackup(json);
            if (proceed === false) {
                setIoActionButtonIdle(btn);
                return;
            }
        } else {
            if (!json.chat || !json.chat.id) throw new Error("Invalid chat data");

            const newChatId = 'chat-' + Date.now();
            const newChatData = json.chat;
            const sourceChatId = String(newChatData.id || '');
            newChatData.id = newChatId;
            remapFuraiDeepMemoryAuthorityForNewChat(newChatData, sourceChatId, newChatId);
            newChatData.timestamp = Date.now();

            if (!String(newChatData.title || '').endsWith("(Imported)")) {
                newChatData.title = `${newChatData.title || 'Imported Chat'} (Imported)`;
            }

            newChatData.viewMode = resolveSharedOrInheritedViewMode(newChatData.viewMode, rawUrl);

            DB.set(newChatId, newChatData);
            if (json.profile) DB.set(`profile-${newChatId}`, json.profile);
            if (newChatData.background) addToBackgroundHistory(newChatData.background);

            loadChat(newChatId);
            showToast("Chat imported successfully!", "success");
        }

        closeExportImportModal();

    } catch(e) {
        console.error(e);
        setIoActionButtonIdle(btn);
        showToast("Import failed: " + e.message, "error");
    }
}

/* --- NEW: Auto-Load Shared Chats from URL --- */
async function checkForChatImport() {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);

    const backupValue = params.get('backup') || params.get('backup_share');
    const chatValue = params.get('chat') || params.get('chat_share');
    const importValue = backupValue || chatValue;
    const isBackupImport = !!backupValue;

    if (!importValue) return;

    const importUrl = resolveFuraiUploadFileUrl(importValue);

    // Show Loading Screen
    const loader = document.getElementById('globalLoader');
    if (loader) {
        loader.style.display = 'flex';
        loader.style.opacity = '1';
        loader.querySelector('.loading-text').textContent = isBackupImport
            ? "Downloading Backup..."
            : "Downloading Shared Chat...";
    }

    try {
        const fetcher = window.root && window.root.superFetch ? window.root.superFetch : fetch;
        const res = await fetcher(importUrl);
        if (!res.ok) {
            throw new Error(isBackupImport ? "Could not fetch backup data. Link may be expired." : "Could not fetch chat data. Link may be expired.");
        }

        const json = await parseFuraiSharedJsonResponse(res);

        // Clean up the URL so refresh does not re-import/re-restore.
        window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);

        if (isBackupImport) {
            showBackupProgress('Loading backup...', 'Checking backup contents...', 35);
            const restored = await restoreGlobalBackup(json);

            if (restored === false && typeof startNewChat === 'function') {
                startNewChat();
            }

            return;
        }

        if (!json.chat || !json.chat.id) throw new Error("Invalid or corrupted chat data");

        // Clone the chat into a safe new container
        const newChatId = 'chat-' + Date.now();
        const newChatData = json.chat;
        const sourceChatId = String(newChatData.id || '');
        newChatData.id = newChatId;
        remapFuraiDeepMemoryAuthorityForNewChat(newChatData, sourceChatId, newChatId);
        newChatData.timestamp = Date.now();

        if (!newChatData.title.endsWith("(Imported)")) {
            newChatData.title += " (Imported)";
        }

        newChatData.viewMode = resolveSharedOrInheritedViewMode(newChatData.viewMode);

        if (typeof normalizeChatMessageStorage === 'function') {
            normalizeChatMessageStorage(newChatData);
        }

        DB.set(newChatId, newChatData);
        if (json.profile) {
            DB.set(`profile-${newChatId}`, json.profile);
        }

        if (newChatData.background) addToBackgroundHistory(newChatData.background);

        // Delay slightly to ensure DB indexing settles before drawing the UI
        setTimeout(() => {
            loadChat(newChatId);
            showToast("Shared chat imported successfully!", "success");
        }, 150);

    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        alert((isBackupImport ? "Failed to restore backup: " : "Failed to import chat: ") + e.message);
        if (typeof startNewChat === 'function') startNewChat();
    } finally {
        if (loader) {
            loader.style.opacity = '0';
            setTimeout(() => loader.remove(), 250);
        }
    }
}
          
function handleSingleChatFile(event) {
    // This logic is now handled inside 'performCloudImport' or 'triggerLocalImport'
    // but if an old file input triggers this, we redirect it:
    const file = event.target.files[0];
    if (!file) return;
    
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function(e) {
        try {
            const backupData = JSON.parse(e.target.result);
            if (!backupData.chat || !backupData.chat.id) throw new Error("Invalid chat data");
            
            const newChatId = 'chat-' + Date.now();
            const newChatData = backupData.chat;
            const sourceChatId = String(newChatData.id || '');
            newChatData.id = newChatId;
            remapFuraiDeepMemoryAuthorityForNewChat(newChatData, sourceChatId, newChatId);
            newChatData.timestamp = Date.now();

            if (typeof normalizeChatMessageStorage === 'function') {
                normalizeChatMessageStorage(newChatData);
            }
            
            DB.set(newChatId, newChatData);
            if (backupData.profile) {
                DB.set(`profile-${newChatId}`, backupData.profile);
            }
            loadChat(newChatId);
            showToast("Chat imported successfully!", "success");
        } catch(err) {
            console.error(err);
            showToast("Import failed", "error");
        }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
    event.target.value = ''; // Reset input
}

/* --- ROBUST DATA MANAGEMENT (Full Site Backup/Restore) --- */

const FURAI_DIRECT_LOCAL_BACKUP_KEYS = [
    'furaiLivestreamSelectedSpeakerKey',
    'furaiLivestreamSpeakerSnapshots',
    'furaiLivestreamSpeakerSnapshot'
];

// Define what defines "Site Data"
function isSiteDataKey(key) {
    const prefixes = [
        'chat-',          // Chat Histories
        'profile-',       // Local Chat Profiles
        'global-',        // Global Settings & Settings
        'global_glossary_', // Global Glossary
        'ref_text_',      // References
        'furai_'          // Account, Music, Forum, Folders, Configs
    ];
    const explicitKeys = [
        'globalBotRoster',
        'globalStoryBotRoster',
        ...FURAI_DIRECT_LOCAL_BACKUP_KEYS
    ];
    
    return prefixes.some(p => key.startsWith(p)) || explicitKeys.includes(key);
}

function getRawStoredValueFromAnySource(key) {
    // Livestream writes these snapshots directly to localStorage after startup,
    // so the StorageEngine cache can be older than the current character data.
    if (FURAI_DIRECT_LOCAL_BACKUP_KEYS.includes(String(key || ''))) {
        const directRaw = localStorage.getItem(key);
        return directRaw == null ? null : directRaw;
    }

    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(StorageEngine.cache, key)) {
        return StorageEngine.cache[key];
    }

    const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
    return raw == null ? null : raw;
}

function decodeStoredValue(raw) {
    if (raw == null) return null;

    const looksCompressedUtf16 = /[^\u0000-\u00ff]/.test(raw);
    if (looksCompressedUtf16) {
        const decompressed = LZString.decompressFromUTF16(raw);
        if (decompressed !== null && decompressed !== undefined) {
            try { return JSON.parse(decompressed); } catch (e) { return decompressed; }
        }
    }

    try { return JSON.parse(raw); } catch (e) { return raw; }
}

function getDecodedValueFromAnySource(key) {
    return decodeStoredValue(getRawStoredValueFromAnySource(key));
}

function isFuraiDeviceLocalSemanticKey(key) {
    return [
        FURAI_SEMANTIC_CONSENT_KEY,
        FURAI_SEMANTIC_PROMPTED_KEY,
        FURAI_SEMANTIC_LEGACY_ENABLED_KEY,
        FURAI_SEMANTIC_RUNTIME_LOCK_KEY
    ].includes(String(key || ''));
}

function collectAllSiteDataForBackup() {
    const allData = {};
    const seenKeys = new Set();
    const plan = createFuraiHiddenExportPlan();
    let count = 0;

    for (const key of Object.keys(StorageEngine.cache)) {
        seenKeys.add(key);
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
        seenKeys.add(localStorage.key(i));
    }

    seenKeys.forEach((key) => {
        if (!key || !isSiteDataKey(key) || isFuraiDeviceLocalSemanticKey(key)) return;

        try {
            const value = getDecodedValueFromAnySource(key);
            if (value !== null) {
                allData[key] = value;
                collectFuraiBackupStorageValueHiddenEntries(key, value, plan);
                count++;
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (e?.code === FURAI_HIDDEN_EXPORT_INSPECTION_ERROR) throw e;
            console.warn("Skipped key", key, e);
        }
    });

    if (!count) return null;
    attachFuraiHiddenExportPlan(allData, plan);
    return allData;
}


function normalizeImportedBackupValue(value) {
    if (typeof value !== 'string') return value;
    return decodeStoredValue(value);
}

function saveBackup() {
    return performLocalExport(null, 'global', 'json');
}

function loadBackup() {
    document.getElementById('backupFileInput').click();
    // Close menus if open
    const accModal = document.getElementById('accountModalEl');
    if (accModal) accModal.style.display = 'none';
}

function getGlobalBackupData() {
    return collectAllSiteDataForBackup();
}

function getBackupStorageMode(backupData) {
    if (!backupData || typeof backupData !== 'object') {
        return FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_LOCAL;
    }

    const decodedMode = normalizeImportedBackupValue(backupData[FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_KEY]);
    const normalizedMode = normalizeFuraiStorageMode(decodedMode);

    // Legacy backups did not store a mode flag. Keep them localStorage-compatible.
    return normalizedMode || FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_LOCAL;
}

function backupRequestsIndexedDB(backupData) {
    return getBackupStorageMode(backupData) === FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_INDEXEDDB;
}

async function prepareStorageModeBeforeRestore(backupData) {
    const targetMode = getBackupStorageMode(backupData);

    setFuraiStorageRuntimeMode(targetMode);

    if (targetMode !== FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_INDEXEDDB) {
        return FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_LOCAL;
    }

    const openedDb = await new Promise((resolve) => {
        StorageEngine.openDB((db) => resolve(db || null));
    });

    if (!openedDb) {
        console.warn("IndexedDB restore requested, but DB open failed. Falling back to localStorage.");
        return setFuraiStorageRuntimeMode(FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_LOCAL);
    }

    return FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_INDEXEDDB;
}

async function clearIndexedDBStoreForRestore() {
    await new Promise((resolve) => {
        StorageEngine.openDB((db) => {
            if (!db) {
                resolve();
                return;
            }

            try {
                const tx = db.transaction(StorageEngine.storeName, 'readwrite');
                tx.objectStore(StorageEngine.storeName).clear();
                tx.oncomplete = resolve;
                tx.onerror = resolve;
            } catch (e) {
                resolve();
            }
        });
    });
}
      
async function restoreGlobalBackup(backupData) {
    if (!backupData || typeof backupData !== 'object' || Array.isArray(backupData)) {
        hideBackupProgress(0);
        showToast("Invalid backup file.", "error");
        return false;
    }

    const prevAchievements = getDecodedValueFromAnySource('furai_achievements') || {};
    const preservedSemanticDeviceState = {
        consent: hasFuraiSemanticRecallConsent(),
        prompted: readFuraiSemanticFlag(FURAI_SEMANTIC_PROMPTED_KEY)
    };
    const backupKeys = Object.keys(backupData).filter(key =>
        key !== FURAI_ARTIFACT_META_KEY &&
        !isFuraiDeviceLocalSemanticKey(key)
    );
    const importantKeys = backupKeys.filter(key =>
        key.startsWith('chat-') ||
        key.startsWith('profile-') ||
        key === 'globalBotRoster' ||
        key === 'globalStoryBotRoster'
    );

    if (backupKeys.length === 0) {
        hideBackupProgress(0);
        showToast("Backup file is empty.", "error");
        return false;
    }

    setBackupProgress(45, `Found ${backupKeys.length} saved item(s). Waiting for confirmation...`);
    await waitForBackupProgressFrame();

    if (importantKeys.length === 0 && backupKeys.length <= 2) {
        const proceedTiny = confirm(
            "This backup looks incomplete or broken.\n\n" +
            `Found only ${backupKeys.length} key(s) and no chats / profiles.\n\n` +
            "Restoring it will likely wipe your current data with almost nothing.\n\n" +
            "Restore anyway?"
        );

        if (!proceedTiny) {
            hideBackupProgress(0);
            return false;
        }
    }

    if (!confirm(
        "Restore backup?\n\n" +
        "This will replace all current local data (chats, settings, characters, music, and account info) with the selected backup.\n\n" +
        "This action cannot be undone."
    )) {
        hideBackupProgress(0);
        return false;
    }

    setBackupProgress(50, 'Preparing storage...');
    await waitForBackupProgressFrame();
    
    let restoredStorageMode = getBackupStorageMode(backupData);
    const requestedIndexedDBRestore = restoredStorageMode === FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_INDEXEDDB;
    const shouldClearIndexedDB =
        StorageEngine.mode === FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_INDEXEDDB ||
        requestedIndexedDBRestore;

    restoredStorageMode = await prepareStorageModeBeforeRestore(backupData);
    const restoredNeedsIndexedDB = restoredStorageMode === FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_INDEXEDDB;

    setBackupProgress(54, 'Clearing old Deep Memory index...');
    await waitForBackupProgressFrame();
    try {
        await deleteFuraiDeepMemoryDatabase();
    } catch (error) {
        hideBackupProgress(0);
        console.error('Could not clear Deep Memory before restore:', error);
        showToast(error?.message || 'Could not clear Deep Memory before restore.', 'error');
        return false;
    }

    setBackupProgress(56, 'Clearing old local data...');
    await waitForBackupProgressFrame();
    
    for (let i = localStorage.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const key = localStorage.key(i);
        if (key === 'furai_storage_mode' && restoredNeedsIndexedDB) continue;
        if (isSiteDataKey(key)) localStorage.removeItem(key);

        if (i % 25 === 0) {
            await waitForBackupProgressFrame();
        }
    }

    writeFuraiSemanticFlag(FURAI_SEMANTIC_CONSENT_KEY, preservedSemanticDeviceState.consent);
    writeFuraiSemanticFlag(FURAI_SEMANTIC_PROMPTED_KEY, preservedSemanticDeviceState.prompted);
    writeFuraiSemanticFlag(FURAI_SEMANTIC_LEGACY_ENABLED_KEY, false);

    if (shouldClearIndexedDB) {
        setBackupProgress(62, 'Clearing local database...');
        await waitForBackupProgressFrame();

        await clearIndexedDBStoreForRestore();
    }

    if (typeof invalidateSidebarMetaIndexCache === 'function') {
        invalidateSidebarMetaIndexCache();
    }

    StorageEngine.cache = {};

    let latestTimestamp = 0;
    let latestChatId = null;
    const totalKeys = backupKeys.length;

    for (let index = 0; index < totalKeys; index++) {
        const key = backupKeys[index];
        if (isFuraiDeviceLocalSemanticKey(key)) continue;
        const value = normalizeImportedBackupValue(backupData[key]);

        if (FURAI_DIRECT_LOCAL_BACKUP_KEYS.includes(key)) {
            const rawOut = typeof value === 'string' ? value : JSON.stringify(value);
            localStorage.setItem(key, rawOut);
            StorageEngine.cache[key] = rawOut;
        } else if (isSiteDataKey(key)) {
            // Skip broadcast during full restore to avoid multi-tab message storms.
            DB.set(key, value, true);
        } else {
            const rawOut = typeof value === 'string' ? value : JSON.stringify(value);
            localStorage.setItem(key, rawOut);
            StorageEngine.cache[key] = rawOut;
        }

        if (key.startsWith('chat-') && value && typeof value === 'object') {
            const ts = value.timestamp;
            if (typeof ts === 'number' && ts > latestTimestamp) {
                latestTimestamp = ts;
                latestChatId = key;
            }
        }

        if (index % 20 === 0 || index === totalKeys - 1) {
            const restorePercent = 64 + ((index + 1) / totalKeys) * 28;
            setBackupProgress(
                restorePercent,
                `Restoring saved data... ${index + 1} / ${totalKeys}`
            );
            await waitForBackupProgressFrame();
        }
    }

    setFuraiStorageRuntimeMode(restoredStorageMode);
    try { FuraiLivestream?.reloadSavedState?.(); } catch (error) {
        console.warn('Could not refresh Livestream state after restore.', error);
    }
    clearFuraiVisualTriggerRuntimeCache();
    ensureFuraiVisualTriggerSeeds();

    setBackupProgress(94, 'Refreshing interface...');
    await waitForBackupProgressFrame();
      
    const nextAchievements = normalizeImportedBackupValue(backupData.furai_achievements) || {};
    if (typeof syncImportedAchievementCounts === 'function') {
        syncImportedAchievementCounts(prevAchievements, nextAchievements);
    }

    currentChatId = null;
    if (typeof loadPlaylist === 'function') loadPlaylist();
    if (typeof loadPrivateChannels === 'function') loadPrivateChannels();
    if (typeof updateAccPreview === 'function') updateAccPreview();
    if (typeof checkPrivacyLock === 'function') checkPrivacyLock();

    if (latestChatId) loadChat(latestChatId);
    else startNewChat();

    setBackupProgress(100, 'Restore complete.');
    hideBackupProgress(550);

    showToast("System restored successfully!", "success");
    return true;
}

function resetLiveUiAfterFactoryReset() {
    // Remove transient ripple DOM
    document.querySelectorAll('.btn-ripple-ink').forEach(ink => ink.remove());

    // Reset share/export mode pill rows
    ['shareModeRow', 'ioShareModeRow'].forEach(id => {
        const row = document.getElementById(id);
        if (row) row.style.display = 'none';
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.share-mode-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.style.background = 'transparent';
        btn.style.color = 'var(--text-color)';
        btn.style.borderColor = 'transparent';
    });

    // Close transient helper modals that reset should not leave floating
    [
        'exportImportModalEl',
        'shareOptionsModal',
        'uploaderModalEl',
        'directSubmitModal',
        'expCopyOptionsModal',
        'whatsNewModalEl',
        'privateChannelModalEl'
    ].forEach(id => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
    });

    // Clear generated modal content / stale fields where cheap and safe
    const whatsNewList = document.getElementById('whatsNewList');
    if (whatsNewList) whatsNewList.innerHTML = '';

    const ioUrlInput = document.getElementById('ioUrlInput');
    if (ioUrlInput) ioUrlInput.value = '';

    const shareLinkInput = document.getElementById('shareLinkInput');
    if (shareLinkInput) shareLinkInput.value = '';

    // Restore visual settings to factory/current DB-empty state
    if (typeof restoreSavedThemeMode === 'function') restoreSavedThemeMode();
    if (typeof applyAppFont === 'function') void applyAppFont('default');
    if (typeof updateSidebarSiteName === 'function') updateSidebarSiteName();
    if (typeof furaiSessionRandomHomeWallpaperUrl !== 'undefined') furaiSessionRandomHomeWallpaperUrl = '';
    if (typeof applyEntryGateBackground === 'function') applyEntryGateBackground();

    // Reset preview bookkeeping
    window.furaiEntryBgPreviewDirty = false;
    accountSidebarPreviewOriginal = null;
    accountSidebarPreviewCommitted = false;
    accountFontPreviewOriginal = null;
    accountFontPreviewCommitted = false;
    accountFontPreviewChatId = null;
    accountThemePreviewOriginal = null;
    accountThemePreviewCommitted = false;
}

function clearAllHistory() {
    void deleteFuraiDeepMemoryDatabase().catch(error => {
        console.warn('Could not delete Deep Memory storage during factory reset:', error);
    });

    // 1. Wipe Data
    for (const key of Object.keys(StorageEngine.cache)) {
        if (isSiteDataKey(key)) {
            DB.remove(key);
        }
    }

    // These character snapshots deliberately remain direct-local even when the
    // rest of FurAI uses IndexedDB, so remove their actual local bytes as well.
    FURAI_DIRECT_LOCAL_BACKUP_KEYS.forEach(key => {
        try { localStorage.removeItem(key); } catch (error) {}
        delete StorageEngine.cache[key];
    });
    try { FuraiLivestream?.reloadSavedState?.(); } catch (error) {}

    clearFuraiVisualTriggerRuntimeCache();
    ensureFuraiVisualTriggerSeeds();
    if (typeof furaiRoleTimelinePositionCache !== 'undefined') {
        furaiRoleTimelinePositionCache.clear();
    }

    // 2. Reset Memory State
    chatTitles = {};
    chatDrafts = {};
    currentChatId = null;

    // Reset first-time VN/CR mode toggle promo ripple
    try {
        localStorage.removeItem('furai_vn_toggle_seen');
    } catch (e) {}
    
    // 3. Reset UI / Sub-systems
    if (typeof restoreFactoryPlaylist === 'function') {
        // Manually reset music to factory logic without alert
        localStorage.removeItem('furai_music_playlist');
        if (typeof loadPlaylist === 'function') loadPlaylist();
    }
    
    if (typeof loadPrivateChannels === 'function') loadPrivateChannels();

    // 4. Reset live UI that is not automatically reset by DB wipe
    if (typeof resetLiveUiAfterFactoryReset === 'function') {
        resetLiveUiAfterFactoryReset();
    }

    // 5. Restart App Interface
    startNewChat();

    // Restore first-time VN/CR mode toggle promo ripple after the Home UI exists again
    if (typeof refreshVnPromoState === 'function') {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => refreshVnPromoState());
    }
    
    // 6. Close Modals
    const accModal = document.getElementById('accountModalEl');
    if (accModal) accModal.style.display = 'none';
    
    const menu = document.getElementById('mainMenuDropdown');
    if (menu) menu.classList.remove('show');

    showToast("Factory Reset Complete.");
}
  
function getGlobalProfileKey(personality) {
    if (personality === 'home') personality = 'researcher';
    if (personality === 'group') return 'globalBotRoster';
    if (['researcher', 'guide', 'prompter', 'story', 'maker'].includes(personality)) return `global-profile-${personality}`;
    return null;
}

window.toggleMakerMenu = function() {
    const menu = document.getElementById('makerMenu');
    menu.classList.toggle('show');
    if (menu.classList.contains('show')) {
        window.addEventListener('click', closeMakerMenuOutside, { once: true });
        
        // Auto-close other menus if open
        const settings = document.getElementById('settingsMenu');
        if(settings && settings.classList.contains('show')) settings.classList.remove('show');
        const tools = document.getElementById('toolsMenu');
        if(tools && tools.classList.contains('show')) tools.classList.remove('show');
    }
};

function closeMakerMenuOutside(event) {
    const container = document.getElementById('makerMenuContainer');
    if (container && !container.contains(event.target)) {
        const menu = document.getElementById('makerMenu');
        if (menu) menu.classList.remove('show');
    } else {
        window.addEventListener('click', closeMakerMenuOutside, { once: true });
    }
}

const FURAI_USER_REPLY_POLICY_HINT_KEY = 'furai_hint_user_reply_policy_v1';
const FURAI_GHOST_MODE_HINT_KEY = 'furai_hint_ghost_mode';
const FURAI_ANNOUNCEMENT_MODE_HINT_KEY = 'furai_hint_announcement_mode';
const FURAI_USER_AUTO_REPLY_BUSY_KEY = '_furaiUserAutoReplyBusy';
const FURAI_CHAT_STATUS_SEQUENCE = Object.freeze([
    'online',
    'idle',
    'announcement',
    'silent'
]);

function normalizeFuraiChatStatus(value) {
    return value === 'idle' || value === 'announcement' || value === 'silent'
        ? value
        : 'online';
}

function getUserChatStatus(profile = null) {
    const liveProfile = profile || getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    return normalizeFuraiChatStatus(liveProfile?.user?.chatStatus);
}

function getBotChatStatus(bot) {
    if (!bot) return 'idle';
    if (bot.chatStatus === 'announcement') return 'announcement';
    if (bot.silentNote === true) return 'silent';
    return bot.isActive ? 'online' : 'idle';
}

function setFuraiBotChatStatus(bot, status) {
    if (!bot) return 'idle';

    const safeStatus = normalizeFuraiChatStatus(status);
    bot.inActiveCast = true;

    if (safeStatus === 'announcement') {
        bot.chatStatus = 'announcement';
        bot.isActive = true;
        bot.silentNote = false;
        return safeStatus;
    }

    delete bot.chatStatus;
    bot.isActive = safeStatus !== 'idle';
    bot.silentNote = safeStatus === 'silent';
    return safeStatus;
}

function getNextFuraiChatStatus(status) {
    const safeStatus = normalizeFuraiChatStatus(status);
    const index = FURAI_CHAT_STATUS_SEQUENCE.indexOf(safeStatus);
    return FURAI_CHAT_STATUS_SEQUENCE[(index + 1) % FURAI_CHAT_STATUS_SEQUENCE.length];
}

function getFuraiContextInstructionForStatus(rawInstruction, status) {
    const safeStatus = normalizeFuraiChatStatus(status);
    const publicInstruction = getPublicDescription(rawInstruction || '')
        .replace(/\n/g, ' ')
        .trim();

    // Announcement and Ghost profiles are private to the actor that is currently
    // generating. Other AI participants receive no copy of those instructions.
    if (safeStatus === 'announcement' || safeStatus === 'silent') return '';
    if (!publicInstruction) return '';

    if (safeStatus === 'idle') {
        const words = publicInstruction.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
        const compact = words.slice(0, 15).join(' ');
        return `${compact}${words.length > 15 ? '...' : ''} (Idle/Quiet)`;
    }

    return publicInstruction;
}

function getFuraiParticipantLabel(name, status) {
    const safeName = String(name || 'Character').trim() || 'Character';
    const safeStatus = normalizeFuraiChatStatus(status);

    if (safeStatus === 'silent') return '';
    if (safeStatus === 'idle') return `${safeName} (Idle)`;
    if (safeStatus === 'announcement') return `${safeName} (Announcement)`;
    return safeName;
}

function getFuraiCastKnowledgeLine(bot, personality = 'group') {
    if (!bot) return '';

    const status = (personality === 'group' || personality === 'maker')
        ? getBotChatStatus(bot)
        : 'online';
    const label = getFuraiParticipantLabel(bot.name, status);
    if (!label) return '';

    const instruction = getFuraiContextInstructionForStatus(
        getFuraiEffectiveCharacterInstruction(bot),
        status
    );
    return instruction ? `- ${label}: ${instruction}` : `- ${label}`;
}

function getFuraiChatStatusMeta(status, type = 'character') {
    const safeStatus = normalizeFuraiChatStatus(status);
    const actorLabel = type === 'user' ? 'User' : 'Character';

    if (safeStatus === 'silent') {
        return {
            label: 'Ghost Mode',
            title: `${actorLabel}: Ghost Mode (hidden from AI cast context and Online count)`,
            icon: '<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-dot furai-chat-status-icon is-ghost"></i>'
        };
    }

    if (safeStatus === 'announcement') {
        return {
            label: 'Announcement',
            title: `${actorLabel}: Announcement (name visible; profile private to other AI participants)`,
            icon: '<i class="fa-solid fa-bullhorn furai-chat-status-icon is-announcement"></i>'
        };
    }

    if (safeStatus === 'idle') {
        return {
            label: 'Idle',
            title: `${actorLabel}: Idle`,
            icon: '<i class="fa-solid fa-moon furai-chat-status-icon is-idle"></i>'
        };
    }

    return {
        label: 'Online',
        title: `${actorLabel}: Online`,
        icon: '<i class="fa-solid fa-circle furai-chat-status-icon is-online"></i>'
    };
}

function getFuraiAvatarStatusBadgeHTML(status) {
    const safeStatus = normalizeFuraiChatStatus(status);
    const className = safeStatus === 'silent' ? 'ghost' : safeStatus;
    const icon = safeStatus === 'silent'
        ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-dot"></i>'
        : safeStatus === 'announcement'
            ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-bullhorn"></i>'
            : '';
    return `<span class="furai-online-avatar-status is-${className}" aria-hidden="true">${icon}</span>`;
}

function showFuraiAnnouncementModeHint(type, name) {
    if (typeof showOverlayHint !== 'function' || localStorage.getItem(FURAI_ANNOUNCEMENT_MODE_HINT_KEY)) return;

    const displayName = escapeHTML(String(name || (type === 'user' ? 'User' : 'Character')));
    const subject = type === 'user' ? 'The user' : 'The character';
    const possessive = type === 'user' ? 'their' : 'its';
    showOverlayHint(`
        <div style="display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px; text-align:left; max-width:520px;">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-bullhorn" style="margin-top:2px; opacity:0.78;"></i>
            <span style="font-size:12px; line-height:1.45;"><strong>${displayName} entered Announcement mode.</strong> Other AI participants can see the name but not the profile. ${subject} can still speak, and ${possessive} visible replies remain in conversation context.</span>
        </div>
    `, 0);
    localStorage.setItem(FURAI_ANNOUNCEMENT_MODE_HINT_KEY, 'true');
}

function showFuraiGhostModeHint(type, name) {
    if (typeof showOverlayHint !== 'function' || localStorage.getItem(FURAI_GHOST_MODE_HINT_KEY)) return;

    const actor = escapeHTML(String(name || (type === 'user' ? 'User' : 'Character')));
    showOverlayHint(`
        <div style="display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px; text-align:left; max-width:520px;">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-dot" style="color:var(--primary-color); margin-top:2px;"></i>
            <span style="font-size:12px; line-height:1.45;"><strong>${actor} entered Ghost Mode.</strong> The actor is removed from other AI participants’ cast context and from the Online count. It can still generate a private Silent Note using its own profile, but that note is never added to later AI history.</span>
        </div>
    `, 0);
    localStorage.setItem(FURAI_GHOST_MODE_HINT_KEY, 'true');
}

function showFuraiIdleModeHint() {
    if (typeof showOverlayHint !== 'function' || localStorage.getItem('furai_hint_idle_mode')) return;

    showOverlayHint(`
        <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; text-align:left;">
            <span style="font-size:12px; opacity:0.9; margin-top:4px;">Character is now Idle. Their profile is compacted to save tokens, and they cannot generate replies until their status changes.</span>
        </div>
    `, 0);
    localStorage.setItem('furai_hint_idle_mode', 'true');
}

const furaiDeferredChatStatusChanges = new Map();
let furaiDeferredChatStatusFlushQueued = false;

function applyFuraiMenuStatusVisual(button, status, type = 'character') {
    if (!button) return;

    const safeStatus = normalizeFuraiChatStatus(status);
    const statusMeta = getFuraiChatStatusMeta(safeStatus, type);
    const row = button.closest('.furai-menu-profile-row');

    button.dataset.furaiChatStatus = safeStatus;
    button.innerHTML = statusMeta.icon;
    button.title = statusMeta.title;

    if (row) {
        row.classList.toggle('is-furai-ghost-row', safeStatus === 'silent');
        row.classList.toggle('is-furai-announcement-row', safeStatus === 'announcement');
    }
}

function queueFuraiChatStatusPersistence(change) {
    if (!change?.chatId || !change.type) return;

    const actorKey = change.type === 'user'
        ? `${change.chatId}:user`
        : `${change.chatId}:bot:${change.actorUid || change.index}`;

    // Rapid repeated taps only persist the final visible state for this actor.
    furaiDeferredChatStatusChanges.set(actorKey, { ...change });
    if (furaiDeferredChatStatusFlushQueued) return;

    furaiDeferredChatStatusFlushQueued = true;

    const flushAfterPaint = () => {
        setTimeout(flushFuraiDeferredChatStatusChanges, 0);
    };

    if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === 'function') {
        requestAnimationFrame(flushAfterPaint);
    } else {
        setTimeout(flushFuraiDeferredChatStatusChanges, 0);
    }
}

function flushFuraiDeferredChatStatusChanges() {
    furaiDeferredChatStatusFlushQueued = false;

    const pending = Array.from(furaiDeferredChatStatusChanges.values());
    furaiDeferredChatStatusChanges.clear();
    if (!pending.length) return;

    const changesByChat = new Map();
    pending.forEach(change => {
        if (!changesByChat.has(change.chatId)) changesByChat.set(change.chatId, []);
        changesByChat.get(change.chatId).push(change);
    });

    let currentProfile = null;
    let currentChatChanged = false;

    changesByChat.forEach((changes, chatId) => {
        const profile = getChatProfile(chatId);
        if (!profile) return;

        changes.forEach(change => {
            if (change.type === 'user') {
                if (profile.user) profile.user.chatStatus = normalizeFuraiChatStatus(change.status);
                return;
            }

            let bot = null;
            if (change.actorUid) {
                bot = profile.bots?.find(item => String(item?.uid || '') === String(change.actorUid)) || null;
            }
            if (!bot && Number.isInteger(change.index)) bot = profile.bots?.[change.index] || null;
            if (bot) setFuraiBotChatStatus(bot, change.status);
        });

        profile.profileCustomized = true;

        try {
            DB.set(`profile-${chatId}`, profile);
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Could not save chat status:', error);
            if (chatId === currentChatId) {
                showToast?.('Could not save the status change.', 'error');
            }
            return;
        }

        if (chatId === currentChatId) {
            currentProfile = profile;
            currentChatChanged = true;
        }
    });

    if (!currentChatChanged || !currentProfile) return;

    if (typeof syncFuraiIdleAnnouncementTimer === 'function') {
        syncFuraiIdleAnnouncementTimer(currentChatId);
    }

    // Expensive dependent UI and token work happens only after the visible toggle
    // has already painted, and rapid taps are coalesced into this one refresh.
    refreshProfileDependentUI(currentProfile);
    triggerOnlineRipple();

    pending
        .filter(change => change.chatId === currentChatId)
        .forEach(change => {
            const name = change.name || (change.type === 'user' ? 'User' : 'Character');
            if (change.status === 'idle') showFuraiIdleModeHint();
            if (change.status === 'announcement') showFuraiAnnouncementModeHint(change.type, name);
            if (change.status === 'silent') showFuraiGhostModeHint(change.type, name);
        });
}

function cycleUserChatStatus(event) {
    if (event) event.stopPropagation();

    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    if (!profile?.user) return;

    const button = event?.currentTarget || document.getElementById('userChatStatusMenuBtn');
    const renderedStatus = button?.dataset?.furaiChatStatus;
    const next = getNextFuraiChatStatus(renderedStatus || getUserChatStatus(profile));

    // Render first. Persistence and broad dependent refresh happen after paint.
    profile.user.chatStatus = next;
    applyFuraiMenuStatusVisual(button, next, 'user');
    if (typeof updateOnlineCount === 'function') updateOnlineCount(profile);

    queueFuraiChatStatusPersistence({
        chatId: currentChatId,
        type: 'user',
        status: next,
        name: profile.user.name || 'User'
    });
}

function cycleBotChatStatus(index, event) {
    if (event) event.stopPropagation();

    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    const bot = profile?.bots?.[index];
    if (!bot) return;

    const button = event?.currentTarget || null;
    const renderedStatus = button?.dataset?.furaiChatStatus;
    const next = getNextFuraiChatStatus(renderedStatus || getBotChatStatus(bot));

    // Render first. Persistence and broad dependent refresh happen after paint.
    setFuraiBotChatStatus(bot, next);
    applyFuraiMenuStatusVisual(button, next, 'character');
    if (typeof updateOnlineCount === 'function') updateOnlineCount(profile);

    queueFuraiChatStatusPersistence({
        chatId: currentChatId,
        type: 'character',
        index,
        actorUid: bot.uid || '',
        status: next,
        name: bot.name || 'Character'
    });
}

function getUserReplyMode(profile = null) {
    const liveProfile = profile || getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    const mode = liveProfile?.user?.replyMode;
    return mode === 'auto' || mode === 'always' ? mode : 'manual';
}
