function showUserReplyPolicyHintIfNeeded() {
    if (localStorage.getItem(FURAI_USER_REPLY_POLICY_HINT_KEY)) return;

    localStorage.setItem(FURAI_USER_REPLY_POLICY_HINT_KEY, 'true');

    if (typeof showOverlayHint !== 'function') return;

    showOverlayHint(`
        <div style="display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px; text-align:left; max-width:520px;">
            <i class="fa-regular fa-comment-dots" style="color:var(--primary-color); font-size:16px; margin-top:2px; flex-shrink:0;"></i>
            <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:5px; min-width:0;">
                <span style="font-weight:700; font-size:13px; color:var(--primary-color);">User Reply Policy</span>
                <span style="font-size:12px; opacity:0.92; line-height:1.45;">
                    Manual keeps User Auto Reply as tap-to-write only. Open Reply auto-replies from context and answers @pings from characters or Announcements; your own message cannot ping itself. Always Reply answers every valid turn.
                </span>
            </div>
        </div>
    `, 0);
}

function cycleUserReplyMode(event) {
    if (event) event.stopPropagation();

    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    if (!profile?.user) return;

    const current = getUserReplyMode(profile);
    profile.user.replyMode = current === 'manual' ? 'auto' : current === 'auto' ? 'always' : 'manual';
    profile.profileCustomized = true;
    DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, profile);

    showUserReplyPolicyHintIfNeeded();
    toggleOnlineList(true);
}

function textMentionsUser(text, profile = null) {
    const liveProfile = profile || getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    const userName = String(liveProfile?.user?.name || '').trim();
    const value = String(text || '');

    if (!value) return false;

    try {
        if (/@(user|you|me)(?![\p{L}\p{N}_-])/iu.test(value)) return true;
    } catch (error) {
        if (/@(user|you|me)(?![\w-])/i.test(value)) return true;
    }

    if (!userName) return false;

    try {
        return new RegExp(`@${escapeRegex(userName)}(?![\\p{L}\\p{N}_-])`, 'iu').test(value);
    } catch (error) {
        return new RegExp(`@${escapeRegex(userName)}(?![\\w-])`, 'i').test(value);
    }
}

function getLatestSavedMessage(chatId = currentChatId) {
    try {
        const chatData = DB.get(chatId);
        const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
        for (let i = messages.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (messages[i]?.content && String(messages[i].content).trim()) {
                return messages[i];
            }
        }
    } catch(e) {}

    return null;
}

function maybeQueueUserAutoReplyAfterGroupTurn(chainDepth = 0, options = {}) {
    const personality = chatPersonalities[currentChatId] || 'researcher';
    const safeDepth = Math.max(0, Number(chainDepth) || 0);
    const forcePing = options.forcePing === true;
    const suppressRandom = options.suppressRandom === true;

    if (personality !== 'group' && personality !== 'maker') return false;
    if (safeDepth > FURAI_MAX_AUTO_MENTION_CHAIN_TURNS) return false;
    if (window[FURAI_USER_AUTO_REPLY_BUSY_KEY]) return false;

    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    if (!profile?.user) return false;
    if (getUserChatStatus(profile) === 'idle') return false;

    const mode = getUserReplyMode(profile);
    if (mode === 'manual') return false;

    const latest = getLatestSavedMessage(currentChatId);
    if (!latest || latest.role === 'user' || latest.role === 'muted-note') return false;

    const latestText = String(latest.content || '');
    const userWasPinged = forcePing || textMentionsUser(latestText, profile);

    // Manual: never auto-queue. Open Reply answers @pings and may join a normal
    // turn randomly. Random User Auto Reply waits when an explicit bot ping is
    // already queued; direct user pings and Always Reply still keep their promise.
    const shouldReply =
        mode === 'always' ||
        userWasPinged ||
        (!suppressRandom && mode === 'auto' && Math.random() < 0.28);

    if (!shouldReply) return false;

    const existingUserTask = generationQueue.find(task =>
        task?.__furaiUserAutoReply === true &&
        String(task.chatId || '') === String(currentChatId || '')
    );

    if (existingUserTask) {
        // One queued user turn is enough. Keep it attached to the newest valid
        // source so repeated AI messages cannot stack several synthetic user replies.
        existingUserTask.sourceMessageUid = String(latest.uid || existingUserTask.sourceMessageUid || '');
        existingUserTask.sourcePersonality = personality;
        existingUserTask.chainDepth = Math.min(
            Math.max(0, Number(existingUserTask.chainDepth) || 0),
            safeDepth
        );
        return true;
    }

    generationQueue.push({
        __furaiUserAutoReply: true,
        chatId: currentChatId,
        sourceMessageUid: String(latest.uid || ''),
        sourcePersonality: personality,
        chainDepth: safeDepth
    });

    return true;
}

function openOnlineProfileCard(type, index = null, event = null) {
    if (event) event.stopPropagation();

    const renderedPortrait = getFuraiRenderedPortraitOptions(event?.currentTarget);
    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    if (!profile) return;

    if (type === 'user') {
        const user = profile.user || {};
        const mode = chatPersonalities[currentChatId] || 'researcher';
        const desc = user.instructions?.[mode] || user.instruction || 'User';
        openProfileCard(
            user.name || 'User',
            user.avatar || '',
            desc,
            user.hashTag || '',
            'user',
            '',
            renderedPortrait
        );
        return;
    }

    if (type === 'wand') {
        const wand = getResolvedWandProfileForChat(currentChatId);
        openProfileCard(
            wand.name || DEFAULT_WAND_DISPLAY_NAME,
            wand.avatar || 'https://user.uploads.dev/file/dc15d2a3877ade6e7319206259852fc5.jpg',
            wand.instruction || DEFAULT_ENHANCER_TEMPLATE,
            wand.hashTag || '',
            'enhancer',
            '',
            renderedPortrait
        );
        return;
    }

    const bot = profile.bots?.[index];
    if (!bot) return;

    openProfileCard(
        bot.name || 'Character',
        bot.avatar || '',
        bot.instruction || 'AI Character',
        bot.hashTag || '',
        index,
        '',
        renderedPortrait
    );
}

function addUserTypingIndicator(id, role = 'user') {
    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    if (!chatMessagesEl) return null;

    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    const user = profile?.user || {};
    const userName = String(user.name || '').trim() || 'User';
    const isMutedNote = role === 'muted-note';

    const messageEl = document.createElement('div');
    messageEl.className = `message ${isMutedNote ? 'muted-note' : 'user'} furai-active-ai-message`;
    messageEl.id = id;
    messageEl.dataset.role = isMutedNote ? 'muted-note' : 'user';
    messageEl.dataset.speakerName = userName;

    const timestampMeta = makeMessageTimestampMeta(currentChatId);
    const liveCreatedAt = String(timestampMeta.createdAt || '').trim();
    if (liveCreatedAt) messageEl.dataset.createdAt = liveCreatedAt;

    if (!isMutedNote) {
        const avatarEl = createFuraiChatPortraitImage(user);
        if (avatarEl) {
            avatarEl.onclick = (e) => openOnlineProfileCard('user', null, e);
            appendFuraiChatPortrait(messageEl, avatarEl);
        }
    }

    const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
    wrapper.className = 'message-content-wrapper';

    const nameEl = document.createElement('div');
    nameEl.className = 'chat-username';
    nameEl.textContent = userName;
    wrapper.appendChild(nameEl);

    const contentEl = document.createElement('div');
    contentEl.className = 'content';
    setFuraiMessageThinkingIndicator(contentEl);
    wrapper.appendChild(contentEl);

    messageEl.appendChild(wrapper);

    if (isMutedNote) {
        placeFuraiAnnouncementHeaderInsideBubble(
            messageEl,
            'muted-note',
            liveCreatedAt,
            userName
        );
    }

    ensureFuraiLiveMessageTimestamp(messageEl, liveCreatedAt);
    chatMessagesEl.appendChild(messageEl);
    ensureFuraiLiveMessageTimestamp(messageEl, liveCreatedAt);

    if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active') && autoScroll) {
        scrollElementToBottom(chatMessagesEl);
    } else if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) {
        showCrTypingHint(userName);
    }

    if (document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) {
        syncVnData();
        showVnThinkingHint(userName, messageEl);
    }

    return messageEl;
}

function finalizeUserAutoReplyBubble(typingId, content, meta = {}) {
    const el = meta.messageEl || document.getElementById(typingId);
    const chatId = meta.chatId || currentChatId;
    const role = meta.role || 'user';
    const personality = chatPersonalities[chatId] || 'researcher';
    const autoVisualTrigger = resolveFuraiAutoVisualTrigger(content, personality);
    const finalText = String(autoVisualTrigger.text || '').trim();
    const replaceMessageUid = String(meta.replaceMessageUid || '').trim();

    if (!finalText) {
        if (el && !replaceMessageUid) {
            clearSmoothTypingIndicator(el);
            el.remove();
        }

        if (autoVisualTrigger.imageOnly && !replaceMessageUid) {
            const anchorEl = getFuraiLatestAutoImageAnchor(el);
            queueFuraiAutoVisualTrigger(autoVisualTrigger, anchorEl, chatId);
        }

        return null;
    }

    const speakerName = meta.speakerName || getFuraiChatUserDisplayName(chatId);
    const saveMeta = {
        ...(el?.dataset?.createdAt
            ? { createdAt: el.dataset.createdAt }
            : makeMessageTimestampMeta(chatId)),
        speakerName,
        silentNoteSpeakerName: speakerName,
        syntheticUserAutoReply: true,
        replaceMessageUid,
        actorUid: meta.actorUid || meta.userUid || '',
        actorProfile: meta.actorProfile || null,
        userUid: meta.userUid || meta.actorUid || ''
    };

    const saveResult = saveMessage(chatId, role, finalText, null, null, saveMeta);
    let finalMessageEl = null;

    if (el && chatId === currentChatId && saveResult) {
        clearSmoothTypingIndicator(el);
        updateRenderedMessageFromSave(
            el,
            role,
            finalText,
            null,
            saveResult.message || null,
            saveResult.index,
            saveMeta
        );
        renderPinnedGeneratedImagesForMessage(el, saveResult.message?.pinnedGeneratedImages);
        finalMessageEl = el;
    } else if (chatId === currentChatId && saveResult) {
        finalMessageEl = addMessage(role, finalText, null, null, {
            ...saveMeta,
            messageIndex: saveResult.index,
            messageUid: saveResult.message?.uid || replaceMessageUid,
            emotion: saveResult.message?.emotion || ''
        });
    }

    if (autoVisualTrigger.matched && finalMessageEl) {
        queueFuraiAutoVisualTrigger(autoVisualTrigger, finalMessageEl, chatId);
    }

    return saveResult;
}

// --- LOCAL TOGGLE (Chat) ---
function toggleBotReplyMode(index, event) {
    if (event) event.stopPropagation();
    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    const bot = profile.bots[index];
    if (!bot) return;

    // Cycle: Auto -> Mention -> Mute -> Always -> Auto
    if (!bot.replyMode || bot.replyMode === 'auto') bot.replyMode = 'mention';
    else if (bot.replyMode === 'mention') bot.replyMode = 'mute';
    else if (bot.replyMode === 'mute') bot.replyMode = 'always'; // [NEW]
    else bot.replyMode = 'auto';

    profile.profileCustomized = true;
    DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, profile);
    toggleOnlineList(true); 
}

// REPLACE your toggleBotAutoReply function with this:
function toggleBotAutoReply() {
      // 1. Get current "Global" state perception
      const isCurrentlyOpen = localStorage.getItem('furai_bot_auto_reply') !== 'false';
      const newGlobalState = !isCurrentlyOpen;
      
      // 2. Save Global Preference (This is okay, it's a UI preference)
      localStorage.setItem('furai_bot_auto_reply', newGlobalState);

      // 3. BULK UPDATE: Apply to ALL active bots
      const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
      const targetMode = newGlobalState ? 'auto' : 'mention';
      
      profile.bots.forEach(bot => {
          if (bot.inActiveCast) {
              bot.replyMode = targetMode;
          }
      });

      profile.profileCustomized = true;

      // 4. Save to CURRENT Chat ONLY
      DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, profile);
      
      // --- FIX: REMOVED Global Save ---

      // 5. Update UI
      updateAutoReplyToggleUI();
      const modal = document.getElementById('onlineListModal');
      if (modal && modal.style.display === 'block') {
           modal.style.display = 'none'; 
           toggleOnlineList();
      }
  }

function buildStoryNarratorBot() {
    const globalStoryProfile = DB.get(getGlobalProfileKey('story'));

    if (globalStoryProfile?.bots?.[0]) {
        const narratorBot = cloneFuraiData(globalStoryProfile.bots[0]);
        narratorBot.uid = narratorBot.uid || generateUID('actor_story');
        narratorBot.name = narratorBot.name || 'Narrator';
        if (narratorBot.instruction == null) narratorBot.instruction = '';
        narratorBot.isActive = true;
        narratorBot.inActiveCast = true;
        narratorBot.replyMode = 'auto';
        narratorBot.storyNarratorMain = true;
        return narratorBot;
    }

    return createFuraiModeFactoryBot('story');
}

function cloneGlobalStoryCastToLocalRoster() {
    const storyCast = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(loadGlobalStoryCastItems() || []));
    const storyMasterMode = getSavedGlobalCastMode('story');

    return storyCast.map((bot, index) => {
        const clonedBot = { ...bot };
        
        normalizeStoryCastBot(clonedBot);
        
        clonedBot.uid = generateUID(`story_local_${index}`);
        clonedBot.storySnapshot = true;
        clonedBot.storyImportedAt = clonedBot.storyImportedAt || Date.now();
        
        clonedBot.inActiveCast = clonedBot.inActiveCast !== false;
        clonedBot.replyMode = storyMasterMode;

        return clonedBot;
    });
}

const FURAI_ROLE_HISTORY_VERSION = 1;

function ensureFuraiRoleHistory(profile) {
    if (!profile || typeof profile !== 'object') return null;
    if (!profile.roleHistory || typeof profile.roleHistory !== 'object') {
        profile.roleHistory = { version: FURAI_ROLE_HISTORY_VERSION, user: null, bots: {} };
    }
    if (!profile.roleHistory.bots || typeof profile.roleHistory.bots !== 'object') {
        profile.roleHistory.bots = {};
    }
    profile.roleHistory.version = FURAI_ROLE_HISTORY_VERSION;
    return profile.roleHistory;
}

function getFuraiRoleLane(profile, role, botIndex = null, create = false) {
    const history = create ? ensureFuraiRoleHistory(profile) : profile?.roleHistory;
    if (!history) return null;

    if (role === 'user') {
        if (!history.user && create) history.user = { retired: [] };
        if (history.user && !Array.isArray(history.user.retired)) history.user.retired = [];
        return history.user || null;
    }

    const index = Number.parseInt(botIndex, 10);
    if (!Number.isInteger(index) || index < 0) return null;
    const key = String(index);
    if (!history.bots[key] && create) history.bots[key] = { retired: [] };
    if (history.bots[key] && !Array.isArray(history.bots[key].retired)) history.bots[key].retired = [];
    return history.bots[key] || null;
}

function getFuraiActiveRoleActor(profile, role, botIndex = null) {
    if (!profile) return null;
    if (role === 'user') return profile.user || null;
    const index = Number.parseInt(botIndex, 10);
    return Number.isInteger(index) && index >= 0 ? profile.bots?.[index] || null : null;
}

function makeFuraiActorSnapshot(actor, role, mode = 'researcher') {
    const source = actor || {};
    const snapshot = stripFuraiLibraryMetadataFromActor(cloneFuraiData(source)) || {};

    [
        'isActive', 'inActiveCast', 'replyMode', 'activeTimestamp',
        'rosterStub', 'groupRosterSourceUid', 'groupRosterSourceIndex',
        'localRosterDeleted', 'actorStartAfterMessageUid',
        'openingSystemMessage', 'systemOpeningMessage', 'preGreetingSystemMessage', 'enhancerOpeningSystemMessage',
        'openingMessage', 'customGreeting', 'greeting', 'initialMessage',
        'openingBackground', 'openingBackgroundOpacity', 'openingBackgroundBlur',
        'openingLorebook', 'viewMode'
    ].forEach(key => delete snapshot[key]);

    snapshot.uid = String(source.uid || '').trim() || generateUID(role === 'user' ? 'actor_user' : 'actor_bot');
    snapshot.sourceLibraryUid = String(
        source.sourceLibraryUid ||
        source.groupRosterSourceUid ||
        source.storySourceLibraryUid ||
        ''
    ).trim();
    snapshot.sourceFactoryMode = String(source.sourceFactoryMode || source.factoryMode || '').trim();
    snapshot.name = source.name || (role === 'user' ? 'User' : 'Character');
    snapshot.hashTag = source.hashTag || '';
    snapshot.avatar = source.avatar || '';
    snapshot.defaultSprite = source.defaultSprite || '';
    snapshot.customEmotions = cloneFuraiData(source.customEmotions || {});
    snapshot.emotionAvatars = cloneFuraiData(source.emotionAvatars || {});
    snapshot.emotionSprites = cloneFuraiData(source.emotionSprites || {});

    if (role === 'user') {
        snapshot.instructions = cloneFuraiData(source.instructions || {});
        if (source.instruction && !snapshot.instructions[mode]) snapshot.instructions[mode] = source.instruction;
        delete snapshot.instruction;
    } else {
        snapshot.instruction = source.instruction || '';
        delete snapshot.instructions;
    }

    return snapshot;
}

function getFuraiAllActorRecords(profile) {
    const records = [];
    if (!profile) return records;
    if (profile.user) records.push({ role: 'user', botIndex: null, actor: profile.user, active: true });
    (profile.bots || []).forEach((bot, index) => {
        if (bot) records.push({ role: 'ai', botIndex: index, actor: bot, active: true });
    });

    const history = profile.roleHistory;
    if (history?.user?.retired) {
        history.user.retired.forEach(actor => records.push({ role: 'user', botIndex: null, actor, active: false }));
    }
    Object.entries(history?.bots || {}).forEach(([index, lane]) => {
        (lane?.retired || []).forEach(actor => records.push({ role: 'ai', botIndex: Number(index), actor, active: false }));
    });
    return records;
}

function resolveFuraiLegacyActorByUid(actorUid, role = 'ai') {
    const uid = String(actorUid || '').trim();
    if (!uid) return null;

    const candidates = [];
    const library = getCurrentGroupRosterSource();
    if (Array.isArray(library)) {
        library
            .filter(actor => String(actor?.uid || '').trim() === uid)
            .forEach(actor => {
                const recovered = role === 'user'
                    ? normalizeFuraiSelectedCharacterForRole(actor, { role: 'user', mode: getStoredChatPersonality(currentChatId) })
                    : cloneFuraiData(actor);
                recovered.uid = uid;
                candidates.push(recovered);
            });
    }

    for (const mode of ['researcher', 'prompter', 'story', 'maker']) {
        const candidate = role === 'user'
            ? DB.get(`global-user-${mode}`)
            : DB.get(`global-profile-${mode}`)?.bots?.[0];
        if (String(candidate?.uid || '').trim() === uid) {
            candidates.push(cloneFuraiData(candidate));
        }
    }

    if (candidates.length !== 1) return null;
    candidates[0].uid = uid;
    candidates[0].legacyRecovered = true;
    return candidates[0];
}

function resolveFuraiActorByModeBotIndexAtMessage(
    chatId,
    profile,
    mode,
    botIndex,
    messageUid = '',
    messageIndex = null
) {
    const targetBotIndex = Number(botIndex);
    if (!profile || !mode || !Number.isInteger(targetBotIndex) || targetBotIndex < 0) return null;

    const chatData = chatId ? DB.get(chatId) : null;
    const positionMap = getFuraiMessagePositionMap(chatData, chatId);
    let targetMessageIndex = Number.isInteger(Number(messageIndex))
        ? Number(messageIndex)
        : -1;
    const uid = String(messageUid || '').trim();
    if (uid && positionMap.has(uid)) targetMessageIndex = positionMap.get(uid);
    if (targetMessageIndex < 0) return null;

    const records = getFuraiAllActorRecords(profile)
        .filter(record => record.role === 'ai');
    const hasModeIndexMetadata = records.some(record =>
        getFuraiStoredModeBotIndex(record.actor, mode) !== null
    );
    const matches = [];

    records.forEach(record => {
        const actor = record.actor;
        const savedModeIndex = getFuraiStoredModeBotIndex(actor, mode);
        const hasSavedModeIndex = savedModeIndex !== null;
        const isLegacyRetiredLane = !record.active &&
            !hasSavedModeIndex &&
            Number(record.botIndex) === targetBotIndex;

        if ((!hasSavedModeIndex || savedModeIndex !== targetBotIndex) && !isLegacyRetiredLane) return;

        if (record.active) {
            const startIndex = getFuraiStartBoundaryIndex(actor.actorStartAfterMessageUid, positionMap);
            if (targetMessageIndex > startIndex) matches.push(actor);
            return;
        }

        const startIndex = getFuraiStartBoundaryIndex(actor.startAfterMessageUid, positionMap);
        const endIndex = getFuraiEndBoundaryIndex(actor.endAfterMessageUid, positionMap);
        if (
            startIndex < endIndex &&
            targetMessageIndex > startIndex &&
            targetMessageIndex <= endIndex
        ) {
            matches.push(actor);
        }
    });

    const unique = [];
    matches.forEach(actor => {
        if (!unique.some(existing => existing === actor || isFuraiSwitchSameActor(existing, actor))) {
            unique.push(actor);
        }
    });

    if (unique.length === 1) return unique[0];
    if (unique.length > 1 || hasModeIndexMetadata) return null;

    return resolveFuraiLaneActorAtMessage(
        chatId,
        profile,
        'ai',
        targetBotIndex,
        messageUid,
        messageIndex
    );
}

function resolveFuraiActorByUid(profile, actorUid, role = null, botIndex = null) {
    const uid = String(actorUid || '').trim();
    if (!profile || !uid) return null;

    const active = getFuraiActiveRoleActor(profile, role, botIndex);
    if (active && String(active.uid || '').trim() === uid) return active;

    const lane = getFuraiRoleLane(profile, role, botIndex, false);
    const laneMatch = lane?.retired?.find(actor => String(actor?.uid || '').trim() === uid);
    if (laneMatch) return laneMatch;

    const records = getFuraiAllActorRecords(profile)
        .filter(record => String(record.actor?.uid || '').trim() === uid);
    const sameRoleRecords = role
        ? records.filter(record => record.role === role)
        : records;

    if (sameRoleRecords.length === 1) return sameRoleRecords[0].actor;
    if (sameRoleRecords.length === 0 && records.length === 1) return records[0].actor;
    if (records.length > 1) return null;

    return resolveFuraiLegacyActorByUid(uid, role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'ai');
}

const furaiRoleTimelinePositionCache = new Map();
const FURAI_ROLE_TIMELINE_CACHE_LIMIT = 4;

function getFuraiMessagePositionMap(chatData, chatId = '') {
    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    const cacheKey = String(chatId || chatData?.id || '').trim();
    const revision = Number(chatData?.memoryRevision) || 0;
    const firstUid = String(messages[0]?.uid || '');
    const lastUid = String(messages[messages.length - 1]?.uid || '');

    if (cacheKey) {
        const cached = furaiRoleTimelinePositionCache.get(cacheKey);
        if (
            cached &&
            cached.revision === revision &&
            cached.length === messages.length &&
            cached.firstUid === firstUid &&
            cached.lastUid === lastUid
        ) {
            furaiRoleTimelinePositionCache.delete(cacheKey);
            furaiRoleTimelinePositionCache.set(cacheKey, cached);
            return cached.map;
        }
    }

    const map = new Map();
    messages.forEach((msg, index) => {
        if (msg?.uid) map.set(String(msg.uid), index);
    });

    if (cacheKey) {
        furaiRoleTimelinePositionCache.delete(cacheKey);
        furaiRoleTimelinePositionCache.set(cacheKey, { revision, length: messages.length, firstUid, lastUid, map });
        while (furaiRoleTimelinePositionCache.size > FURAI_ROLE_TIMELINE_CACHE_LIMIT) {
            furaiRoleTimelinePositionCache.delete(furaiRoleTimelinePositionCache.keys().next().value);
        }
    }

    return map;
}

function getFuraiStartBoundaryIndex(anchorUid, positionMap) {
    const uid = String(anchorUid || '').trim();
    if (!uid) return -1;

    // A missing non-empty anchor must never make a later actor appear from the
    // beginning of the story. Message deletion normally retargets boundaries;
    // this strict fallback protects damaged or partially restored legacy data.
    return positionMap.has(uid) ? positionMap.get(uid) : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
}

function getFuraiEndBoundaryIndex(anchorUid, positionMap) {
    const uid = String(anchorUid || '').trim();
    if (!uid) return Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;

    // If a retired block loses its closing anchor, hiding that uncertain block
    // is safer than letting it overwrite later character phases.
    return positionMap.has(uid) ? positionMap.get(uid) : -1;
}

function resolveFuraiLaneActorAtMessage(chatId, profile, role, botIndex, messageUid = '', messageIndex = null) {
    const active = getFuraiActiveRoleActor(profile, role, botIndex);
    const lane = getFuraiRoleLane(profile, role, botIndex, false);
    const chatData = chatId ? DB.get(chatId) : null;
    const positionMap = getFuraiMessagePositionMap(chatData, chatId);
    let targetIndex = Number.isInteger(Number(messageIndex)) ? Number(messageIndex) : -1;
    const uid = String(messageUid || '').trim();
    if (uid && positionMap.has(uid)) targetIndex = positionMap.get(uid);
    if (targetIndex < 0) return active;

    for (const block of lane?.retired || []) {
        const startIndex = getFuraiStartBoundaryIndex(block.startAfterMessageUid, positionMap);
        const endIndex = getFuraiEndBoundaryIndex(block.endAfterMessageUid, positionMap);
        if (startIndex < endIndex && targetIndex > startIndex && targetIndex <= endIndex) return block;
    }

    if (!active) return null;
    const activeStartIndex = getFuraiStartBoundaryIndex(active.actorStartAfterMessageUid, positionMap);
    return targetIndex > activeStartIndex ? active : null;
}

function resolveFuraiLaneActorAtBoundary(chatId, profile, role, botIndex, boundaryIndex = null) {
    const active = getFuraiActiveRoleActor(profile, role, botIndex);
    const lane = getFuraiRoleLane(profile, role, botIndex, false);
    const chatData = chatId ? DB.get(chatId) : null;
    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    const positionMap = getFuraiMessagePositionMap(chatData, chatId);
    const targetBoundary = Number.isInteger(Number(boundaryIndex))
        ? Math.max(0, Math.min(Number(boundaryIndex), messages.length))
        : messages.length;

    for (const block of lane?.retired || []) {
        const startIndex = getFuraiStartBoundaryIndex(block.startAfterMessageUid, positionMap);
        const endIndex = getFuraiEndBoundaryIndex(block.endAfterMessageUid, positionMap);
        if (startIndex < endIndex && targetBoundary > startIndex && targetBoundary <= endIndex) return block;
    }

    if (!active) return null;

    // The latest boundary always owns the current role assignment. This also
    // keeps a newly added character available to speak before their first line,
    // while historical boundaries still require a valid join anchor.
    if (targetBoundary === messages.length) return active;

    const activeStartIndex = getFuraiStartBoundaryIndex(active.actorStartAfterMessageUid, positionMap);
    return targetBoundary > activeStartIndex ? active : null;
}

function createFuraiHistoricalAbsentActor(activeActor) {
    if (!activeActor) return null;
    return {
        ...cloneFuraiData(activeActor),
        isActive: false,
        inActiveCast: false,
        storyContextMode: 'offstage',
        silentNote: true,
        historicalAbsent: true
    };
}

function buildFuraiProfileAtBoundary(chatId, profile, boundaryIndex = null) {
    if (!profile) return profile;

    const sceneProfile = { ...profile };
    const sceneUser = resolveFuraiLaneActorAtBoundary(chatId, profile, 'user', null, boundaryIndex);
    sceneProfile.user = sceneUser
        ? cloneFuraiData(sceneUser)
        : createFuraiHistoricalAbsentActor(profile.user);

    sceneProfile.bots = (profile.bots || []).map((activeBot, botIndex) => {
        if (!activeBot) return activeBot;
        const actor = resolveFuraiLaneActorAtBoundary(chatId, profile, 'ai', botIndex, boundaryIndex);
        if (!actor) return createFuraiHistoricalAbsentActor(activeBot);
        if (actor === activeBot) return cloneFuraiData(activeBot);
        return {
            ...cloneFuraiData(activeBot),
            ...cloneFuraiData(actor),
            isActive: true,
            inActiveCast: true,
            historicalActor: true,
            historicalAbsent: false
        };
    });
    return sceneProfile;
}

function createFuraiHistoricalFallbackActor(msg, role = 'ai') {
    const name = String(
        role === 'user'
            ? (msg?.userNameSnapshot || msg?.speakerName || 'User')
            : (msg?.botNameSnapshot || msg?.silentNoteSpeakerName || msg?.speakerName || 'Unknown Character')
    ).trim();

    return {
        uid: String(role === 'user' ? msg?.userUid : msg?.botUid || '').trim(),
        name: name || (role === 'user' ? 'User' : 'Unknown Character'),
        avatar: '',
        defaultSprite: '',
        hashTag: '',
        instruction: '',
        instructions: {},
        customEmotions: {},
        emotionAvatars: {},
        emotionSprites: {},
        historicalFallback: true
    };
}

const furaiSavedModeProfileCache = new Map();
const furaiMorphModeMetaCache = new Map();
const FURAI_SAVED_MODE_PROFILE_CACHE_LIMIT = 5;

function clearFuraiModeRuntimeCaches(chatId = '') {
    const prefix = chatId ? `${chatId}|` : '';

    for (const key of [...furaiSavedModeProfileCache.keys()]) {
        if (!prefix || key.startsWith(prefix)) furaiSavedModeProfileCache.delete(key);
    }

    if (chatId) furaiMorphModeMetaCache.delete(String(chatId));
    else furaiMorphModeMetaCache.clear();
}

function cacheFuraiMorphModeMeta(chatId, data) {
    const key = String(chatId || '');
    if (!key) return null;

    for (const cachedKey of [...furaiMorphModeMetaCache.keys()]) {
        if (cachedKey !== key) furaiMorphModeMetaCache.delete(cachedKey);
    }
    for (const cachedKey of [...furaiSavedModeProfileCache.keys()]) {
        if (!cachedKey.startsWith(`${key}|`)) furaiSavedModeProfileCache.delete(cachedKey);
    }

    const meta = data?.morph?.enabled
        ? {
            originalMode: String(data.morph.originalMode || data.personality || 'researcher'),
            activeMode: String(data.personality || 'researcher'),
            lastSwitchedAt: Number(data.morph.lastSwitchedAt) || 0
        }
        : null;

    furaiMorphModeMetaCache.set(key, meta);
    return meta;
}

function getFuraiMorphModeMeta(chatId) {
    const key = String(chatId || '');
    if (!key) return null;
    if (furaiMorphModeMetaCache.has(key)) return furaiMorphModeMetaCache.get(key);
    return cacheFuraiMorphModeMeta(key, DB.get(key));
}

function getFuraiSavedProfileForMessageMode(chatId, mode, chatData = null) {
    const normalizedMode = String(mode || '').trim();
    if (!chatId || !normalizedMode) return null;

    const data = chatData || DB.get(chatId);
    if (!data?.morph?.enabled) return null;

    const activeMode = String(data.personality || chatPersonalities?.[chatId] || 'researcher');
    if (normalizedMode === activeMode) return getChatProfile(chatId);

    const prefix = `${chatId}|`;
    for (const key of [...furaiSavedModeProfileCache.keys()]) {
        if (!key.startsWith(prefix)) furaiSavedModeProfileCache.delete(key);
    }

    const signature = `${chatId}|${normalizedMode}|${Number(data.morph.lastSwitchedAt) || 0}`;
    if (furaiSavedModeProfileCache.has(signature)) {
        const cached = furaiSavedModeProfileCache.get(signature);
        furaiSavedModeProfileCache.delete(signature);
        furaiSavedModeProfileCache.set(signature, cached);
        return cached;
    }

    const state = data.morph.modeStates?.[normalizedMode] || null;
    const savedProfile = state ? getFuraiStoredModeProfile(state) : null;
    if (!isValidFuraiModeProfile(savedProfile)) return null;

    // Roster-mode profiles are stored without duplicate roster actors. Rehydrate
    // them from the chat's shared roster before resolving historical messages.
    // Legacy morph chats with no shared-roster record keep their saved profile intact.
    if (isFuraiRosterMode(normalizedMode)) {
        const sharedRoster = getFuraiSharedRoster(data);
        if (sharedRoster !== null) {
            applyFuraiSharedRosterToModeProfile(savedProfile, normalizedMode, sharedRoster);
        }
    }

    furaiSavedModeProfileCache.set(signature, savedProfile);
    while (furaiSavedModeProfileCache.size > FURAI_SAVED_MODE_PROFILE_CACHE_LIMIT) {
        furaiSavedModeProfileCache.delete(furaiSavedModeProfileCache.keys().next().value);
    }

    return savedProfile;
}

function resolveFuraiActorForMessage(chatId, msg, profile = null, messageIndex = null) {
    if (!msg) return null;

    const liveProfile = profile || getChatProfile(chatId);
    if (!liveProfile) return null;

    const activeMode = getStoredChatPersonality(chatId);
    const morphMeta = getFuraiMorphModeMeta(chatId);
    const messageMode = String(msg.mode || morphMeta?.originalMode || activeMode);
    const needsPausedProfile = !!morphMeta && messageMode !== activeMode;
    const chatData = needsPausedProfile ? DB.get(chatId) : null;
    const messageModeProfile = needsPausedProfile
        ? (getFuraiSavedProfileForMessageMode(chatId, messageMode, chatData) || liveProfile)
        : liveProfile;

    if (msg.role === 'user') {
        const explicitUid = String(msg.userUid || '').trim();
        if (explicitUid) {
            return resolveFuraiActorByUid(messageModeProfile, explicitUid, 'user', null) ||
                (messageModeProfile !== liveProfile
                    ? resolveFuraiActorByUid(liveProfile, explicitUid, 'user', null)
                    : null) ||
                createFuraiHistoricalFallbackActor(msg, 'user');
        }
        return resolveFuraiLaneActorAtMessage(chatId, messageModeProfile, 'user', null, msg.uid, messageIndex) ||
            createFuraiHistoricalFallbackActor(msg, 'user');
    }

    if (msg.role === 'ai' || msg.role === 'muted-note') {
        const botIndex = Number.parseInt(msg.botIndex, 10);
        const explicitUid = String(msg.botUid || '').trim();

        if (explicitUid) {
            const resolvedActor = resolveFuraiActorByUid(
                messageModeProfile,
                explicitUid,
                'ai',
                botIndex
            ) || (messageModeProfile !== liveProfile
                ? resolveFuraiActorByUid(liveProfile, explicitUid, 'ai', botIndex)
                : null);

            if (resolvedActor) {
                return needsPausedProfile
                    ? getFuraiHistoricalVisualFallbackActor(resolvedActor)
                    : resolvedActor;
            }

            const sharedChatData = chatData || (morphMeta ? DB.get(chatId) : null);
            const sharedActor = sharedChatData
                ? resolveFuraiSharedRosterActorForMessage(
                    sharedChatData,
                    explicitUid,
                    messageMode,
                    botIndex
                )
                : null;

            return sharedActor
                ? getFuraiHistoricalVisualFallbackActor(sharedActor)
                : createFuraiHistoricalFallbackActor(msg, 'ai');
        }

        const resolvedActor = resolveFuraiActorByModeBotIndexAtMessage(
            chatId,
            messageModeProfile,
            messageMode,
            botIndex,
            msg.uid,
            messageIndex
        );

        if (resolvedActor) {
            return needsPausedProfile
                ? getFuraiHistoricalVisualFallbackActor(resolvedActor)
                : resolvedActor;
        }

        const sharedChatData = chatData || (morphMeta ? DB.get(chatId) : null);
        const sharedActor = sharedChatData
            ? resolveFuraiSharedRosterActorForMessage(
                sharedChatData,
                '',
                messageMode,
                botIndex
            )
            : null;

        return sharedActor
            ? getFuraiHistoricalVisualFallbackActor(sharedActor)
            : createFuraiHistoricalFallbackActor(msg, 'ai');
    }

    return null;
}

function getFuraiLastMessageUid(chatData) {
    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    return String(messages[messages.length - 1]?.uid || '').trim();
}

function stampFuraiMissingActorUids(chatData, lane, role, botIndex, actorUid, actorName) {
    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    if (!messages.length || !actorUid) return false;

    let start = Number(lane?.legacyStampCount) || 0;
    const anchor = String(lane?.legacyStampThroughMessageUid || '');
    if (start > messages.length || (start && String(messages[start - 1]?.uid || '') !== anchor)) start = 0;

    const wantedName = String(actorName || '').trim();
    const normalizedName = wantedName.toLocaleLowerCase();
    let changed = false;

    for (let i = start; i < messages.length; i += 1) {
        const msg = messages[i];
        const matches = role === 'user'
            ? msg?.role === 'user'
            : ((msg?.role === 'ai' || msg?.role === 'muted-note') && Number(msg.botIndex) === Number(botIndex));
        if (!matches) continue;

        const uidKey = role === 'user' ? 'userUid' : 'botUid';
        const nameKey = role === 'user' ? 'userNameSnapshot' : 'botNameSnapshot';
        const savedName = String(msg[nameKey] || msg.speakerName || msg.silentNoteSpeakerName || '').trim();
        const safe = !savedName || !normalizedName || savedName.toLocaleLowerCase() === normalizedName;
        if (!msg[uidKey] && safe) { msg[uidKey] = actorUid; changed = true; }
        if (!msg[nameKey] && wantedName && safe) { msg[nameKey] = wantedName; changed = true; }
    }

    if (lane) {
        lane.legacyStampCount = messages.length;
        lane.legacyStampThroughMessageUid = String(messages.at(-1)?.uid || '');
    }
    return changed;
}

function stripFuraiLibraryMetadataFromActor(actor) {
    if (!actor || typeof actor !== 'object') return actor;
    const keys = [
        'timestamp','libraryCreatedAt','createdAt','updatedAt','date','chatCount','lastChattedAt','viewCount','useCount','usageCount','activityCount','lastUsedAt','activeTimestamp',
        'creator','creatorLink','creatorUrl','creatorBio','previewText','cardDesc','allowComments','submissionId','submissionUid',
        'storySnapshot','storyImportedAt','sourceLibraryIndex','libraryIndex'
    ];
    keys.forEach(key => delete actor[key]);
    return actor;
}

function normalizeFuraiSelectedCharacterForRole(source, target = {}) {
    const mode = target.mode || getStoredChatPersonality(currentChatId);
    const actor = cloneFuraiData(source || {});
    const sourceUid = String(actor.sourceLibraryUid || actor.groupRosterSourceUid || actor.storySourceLibraryUid || actor.uid || '').trim();

    if (target.role === 'user') {
        const instruction = actor.instructions?.[mode] ?? actor.instruction ?? '';
        stripFuraiLibraryMetadataFromActor(actor);
        ['isActive','inActiveCast','replyMode','activeTimestamp','rosterStub','groupRosterSourceUid','groupRosterSourceIndex','storySourceLibraryUid','localRosterDeleted','storySnapshot','storyImportedAt','storyNarratorMain']
            .forEach(key => delete actor[key]);
        actor.uid = generateUID('actor_user');
        actor.sourceLibraryUid = sourceUid;
        actor.sourceFactoryMode = actor.sourceFactoryMode || actor.factoryMode || '';
        actor.name ||= 'User';
        actor.avatar ||= '';
        actor.defaultSprite ||= '';
        actor.hashTag ||= '';
        actor.instructions = cloneFuraiData(actor.instructions || {});
        actor.instructions[mode] = instruction;
        delete actor.instruction;
        actor.customEmotions = cloneFuraiData(actor.customEmotions || {});
        actor.emotionAvatars = cloneFuraiData(actor.emotionAvatars || {});
        actor.emotionSprites = cloneFuraiData(actor.emotionSprites || {});
        actor.actorStartAfterMessageUid = target.startAfterMessageUid || '';
        copyCharacterOpeningExtras(actor, source || {});
        return actor;
    }

    actor.instruction = String(actor.instruction ?? '').trim() ? actor.instruction : (actor.instructions?.[mode] ?? '');
    delete actor.instructions;
    stripFuraiLibraryMetadataFromActor(actor);
    ['rosterStub','groupRosterSourceUid','groupRosterSourceIndex','storySourceLibraryUid','localRosterDeleted'].forEach(key => delete actor[key]);
    actor.uid = generateUID(`actor_${mode || 'bot'}`);
    actor.sourceLibraryUid = sourceUid;
    actor.isActive = true;
    actor.inActiveCast = true;
    actor.replyMode = target.replyMode || actor.replyMode || 'auto';
    actor.actorStartAfterMessageUid = target.startAfterMessageUid || '';
    actor.customEmotions = cloneFuraiData(actor.customEmotions || {});
    actor.emotionAvatars = cloneFuraiData(actor.emotionAvatars || {});
    actor.emotionSprites = cloneFuraiData(actor.emotionSprites || {});

    // Creator Notes are durable character metadata. Keep them through
    // library -> chat actor -> character switch while remaining prompt-inert.
    copyCharacterOpeningExtras(actor, source || {});

    return actor;
}

function switchFuraiChatRoleActor(chatId, target, sourceCharacter) {
    if (
        isGenerating ||
        isCutsceneGenerating ||
        window.furaiActiveMessageImagePromptJobId ||
        ongoingGenerations?.[chatId]
    ) {
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Finish or stop the current generation before switching characters.');
        return false;
    }

    const profile = getChatProfile(chatId);
    const chatData = DB.get(chatId);
    if (!profile || !chatData || !sourceCharacter) return false;

    const role = target.role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'ai';
    const botIndex = role === 'ai' ? Number.parseInt(target.botIndex, 10) : null;
    if (role === 'ai' && (!Number.isInteger(botIndex) || botIndex < 0 || !profile.bots?.[botIndex])) {
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('This chat role is unavailable.', 'error');
        return false;
    }

    const outgoing = getFuraiActiveRoleActor(profile, role, botIndex);
    if (!outgoing) return false;

    const lastMessageUid = getFuraiLastMessageUid(chatData);
    const startAfterMessageUid = String(outgoing.actorStartAfterMessageUid || '').trim();
    const hasStoryPhase = lastMessageUid !== startAfterMessageUid;
    const lane = getFuraiRoleLane(profile, role, botIndex, true);
    const chatChanged = stampFuraiMissingActorUids(chatData, lane, role, botIndex, outgoing.uid, outgoing.name);

    if (hasStoryPhase) {
        const retired = makeFuraiActorSnapshot(outgoing, role, target.mode || getStoredChatPersonality(chatId));
        retired.startAfterMessageUid = startAfterMessageUid;
        retired.endAfterMessageUid = lastMessageUid;
        lane.retired.push(retired);
    }

    const nextActor = normalizeFuraiSelectedCharacterForRole(sourceCharacter, {
        ...target,
        role,
        startAfterMessageUid: lastMessageUid
    });

    if (role === 'user') profile.user = nextActor;
    else profile.bots[botIndex] = nextActor;

    profile.profileCustomized = true;
    if (chatChanged) DB.set(chatId, chatData);
    DB.set(`profile-${chatId}`, cloneFuraiData(profile));

    if (typeof furaiRoleTimelinePositionCache !== 'undefined') {
        furaiRoleTimelinePositionCache.delete(String(chatId));
    }

    const persisted = DB.get(`profile-${chatId}`);
    const persistedActor = role === 'user' ? persisted?.user : persisted?.bots?.[botIndex];
    if (!persistedActor || String(persistedActor.uid || '') !== String(nextActor.uid || '')) {
        console.error('Character switch did not persist.', { chatId, role, botIndex });
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Character switch could not be saved.', 'error');
        return false;
    }

    return true;
}

function getStoredChatPersonality(chatId) {
    let personality = chatPersonalities[chatId] || '';
    if (!personality && chatId) {
        try { personality = DB.get(chatId)?.personality || ''; } catch (e) { personality = ''; }
    }
    return personality || 'researcher';
}

function getHomeMascotSnapshot() {
    const saved = DB.get('global-profile-researcher');
    if (saved?.bots?.[0]) return cloneFuraiData(saved.bots[0]);
    return createFuraiModeFactoryBot('researcher');
}

function getChatProfile(chatId) {
    const personality = getStoredChatPersonality(chatId);

    if (personality === 'home') {
        return {
            user: createFuraiDefaultUser('researcher'),
            bots: [getHomeMascotSnapshot()],
            profileCustomized: false,
            homePreview: true
        };
    }

    const globalKey = getGlobalProfileKey(personality);
    let profile = null;
    try { profile = DB.get('profile-' + chatId); } catch (e) {}

    if (profile) {
        let hasChanges = false;
        const userRecordWasMissing = !profile.user;
        if (userRecordWasMissing) { profile.user = createFuraiDefaultUser(personality, { newActor: true }); hasChanges = true; }
        if (!profile.user.uid) { profile.user.uid = generateUID('actor_user'); hasChanges = true; }
        if (!Array.isArray(profile.bots)) { profile.bots = []; hasChanges = true; }

        const profileChatData = personality === 'maker' ? DB.get(chatId) : null;
        if (
            personality === 'maker' &&
            profileChatData?.morph?.enabled &&
            profile.bots.length > 1
        ) {
            profile = sanitizeFuraiMakerModeProfile(profile);
            hasChanges = true;
        }

        if (preserveFuraiLegacyDefaultUserAvatar(chatId, profile, { userRecordWasMissing })) {
            hasChanges = true;
        }

        const groupSourceRoster = personality === 'group' && profile.bots.some(bot => bot?.rosterStub === true)
            ? getCurrentGroupRosterSource()
            : null;

        profile.bots.forEach((bot, index) => {
            if (!bot) return;
            if (!bot.uid) { bot.uid = generateUID('recovered_actor'); hasChanges = true; }
            if (bot.chatStatus === 'announcement' && (bot.isActive !== true || bot.silentNote === true)) {
                bot.isActive = true;
                bot.silentNote = false;
                hasChanges = true;
            }
            if (personality === 'group' && bot.rosterStub === true) {
                const found = getGroupRosterSourceBot(bot, index, groupSourceRoster);
                if (found?.bot) {
                    const sourceUid = String(found.bot.uid || '').trim();
                    if (bot.groupRosterSourceUid !== sourceUid) { bot.groupRosterSourceUid = sourceUid; hasChanges = true; }
                    if (Number(bot.groupRosterSourceIndex) !== found.index) { bot.groupRosterSourceIndex = found.index; hasChanges = true; }
                    if (sourceUid && String(bot.uid || '').startsWith('stub_')) { bot.uid = sourceUid; hasChanges = true; }
                }
                if (bot.inActiveCast === true && hydrateGroupRosterStub(profile, index, { silent: true, sourceRoster: groupSourceRoster })) {
                    hasChanges = true;
                }
            }
        });

        if (personality === 'story') {
            const hasNarrator = profile.bots.some(bot => bot?.storyNarratorMain === true);
            if (!hasNarrator) {
                // Never unshift an existing Story roster: old messages and lane history
                // use stable botIndex values. Legacy Story chats treat their existing
                // first bot as narrator; only an empty profile receives a new one.
                if (profile.bots[0]) {
                    profile.bots[0].storyNarratorMain = true;
                } else {
                    profile.bots.push(buildStoryNarratorBot());
                }
                hasChanges = true;
            }
            profile.bots.forEach((bot, index) => {
                if (!bot) return;
                if (index === 0 && bot.storyNarratorMain) {
                    bot.isActive = true; bot.inActiveCast = true; bot.replyMode = 'auto';
                } else {
                    normalizeStoryCastBot(bot);
                }
            });

            const storyChatData = DB.get(chatId);
            if (storyChatData?.morph?.enabled && suppressFuraiSharedUserFromStoryCast(profile)) {
                hasChanges = true;
            }
        }

        if (profile.roleHistory) ensureFuraiRoleHistory(profile);
        if (hasChanges) DB.set(`profile-${chatId}`, profile);
        return profile;
    }

    const modeUserKey = `global-user-${personality}`;
    const savedUser = DB.get(modeUserKey) || DB.get('global-profile-user') || createFuraiDefaultUser(personality);
    const userToUse = normalizeFuraiSelectedCharacterForRole(savedUser, {
        role: 'user',
        mode: personality
    });

    preserveFuraiLegacyDefaultUserAvatar(chatId, {
        user: userToUse,
        profileCustomized: false
    }, { profileWasMissing: true });

    const isCustomized = userToUse.name !== 'User';
    let newProfile;

    if (personality === 'story') {
        const narrator = normalizeFuraiSelectedCharacterForRole(buildStoryNarratorBot(), {
            role: 'ai', mode: 'story', botIndex: 0, replyMode: 'auto', startAfterMessageUid: ''
        });
        narrator.storyNarratorMain = true;
        newProfile = {
            user: userToUse,
            bots: [narrator, ...cloneGlobalStoryCastToLocalRoster()],
            profileCustomized: isCustomized,
            storyProfile: true
        };
    } else if (personality === 'group') {
        const chatData = DB.get(chatId) || {};
        const roster = getCurrentGroupRosterSource();
        let bots;

        if (chatData.groupStartPath === 'main-menu') {
            bots = isGlobalGroupRandomStartEnabled()
                ? getRandomizedGroupStartRoster(roster)
                : buildLinkedGroupRoster(roster);
        } else {
            const source = roster.find((bot, index) => bot && !isUneditedGlobalFreeSlot(bot, index)) || createFuraiModeFactoryBot('group');
            bots = [normalizeFuraiSelectedCharacterForRole(source, {
                role: 'ai', mode: 'group', botIndex: 0, replyMode: 'auto', startAfterMessageUid: ''
            })];
        }

        newProfile = {
            user: userToUse,
            bots,
            profileCustomized: isCustomized,
            rosterMode: chatData.groupStartPath === 'main-menu' ? 'linked' : 'snapshot',
            singleCharacterGroup: chatData.groupStartPath !== 'main-menu',
            disableCastAnnouncements: !getGlobalGroupCastAnnouncementsEnabled(),
            idleAnnouncementTarget: getGlobalGroupIdleAnnouncementTarget(),
            idleAnnouncementMinutes: getGlobalGroupIdleAnnouncementMinutes()
        };
    } else if (personality === 'maker') {
        const globalModeProfile = DB.get(globalKey);
        const sourceBot = globalModeProfile?.bots?.[0] || createFuraiModeFactoryBot('maker');
        const bot = normalizeFuraiSelectedCharacterForRole(sourceBot, {
            role: 'ai', mode: 'maker', botIndex: 0, replyMode: 'auto', startAfterMessageUid: ''
        });
        newProfile = { user: userToUse, bots: [bot], profileCustomized: isCustomized };
    } else {
        const globalModeProfile = DB.get(globalKey);
        const sourceBot = globalModeProfile?.bots?.[0] || createFuraiModeFactoryBot(personality);
        const bot = normalizeFuraiSelectedCharacterForRole(sourceBot, {
            role: 'ai', mode: personality, botIndex: 0, replyMode: 'auto', startAfterMessageUid: ''
        });
        newProfile = { user: userToUse, bots: [bot], profileCustomized: isCustomized };
    }

    DB.set(`profile-${chatId}`, newProfile);
    return newProfile;
}

function renderGroupBotMenu(profileOverride = null) {
    const container = document.getElementById('groupBotProfilesContainer');
    if (!container) return;

    const profile = profileOverride || getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    container.innerHTML = '';
    
    // --- 1. RENDER ACTIVE BOTS FIRST ---
    const allBots = profile.bots.map((b, i) => ({ ...b, originalIndex: i }));
    const activeCastBots = allBots
        .filter(b => b.inActiveCast)
        .sort((a, b) => (a.activeTimestamp || 0) - (b.activeTimestamp || 0));

    activeCastBots.forEach((bot) => {
        const originalIndex = bot.originalIndex;
        const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
        wrapper.className = 'settings-menu-item-wrapper furai-menu-profile-row';
        
        const button = document.createElement('button');
        button.className = 'settings-menu-item';
        button.onclick = () => openBotProfileModal(originalIndex);

        let iconHTML = bot.avatar 
            ? `<img src="${escapeHTML(bot.avatar)}" class="menu-avatar-tiny" onerror="this.style.display='none'">` 
            : `<i class="fa-solid fa-paw"></i>`;
        
        button.innerHTML = `
            <span class="furai-menu-card-icon" onclick="openOnlineProfileCard('bot', ${originalIndex}, event)" title="Open ID card">${iconHTML}</span>
            <span>${escapeHTML(bot.name)}</span>
        `;
        wrapper.appendChild(button);
        
        const status = getBotChatStatus(bot);
        wrapper.classList.toggle('is-furai-ghost-row', status === 'silent');
        wrapper.classList.toggle('is-furai-announcement-row', status === 'announcement');
        const statusMeta = getFuraiChatStatusMeta(status, 'character');
        const toggleBtn = document.createElement('button');
        toggleBtn.className = 'furai-menu-status-btn';
        toggleBtn.dataset.furaiChatStatus = status;
        toggleBtn.title = statusMeta.title;
        toggleBtn.innerHTML = statusMeta.icon;
        toggleBtn.onclick = (e) => cycleBotChatStatus(originalIndex, e);
        
        wrapper.appendChild(toggleBtn);
        container.appendChild(wrapper);
    });

    // --- 2. RENDER THE STATIC ACTION BUTTONS (IN THE RIGHT POSITION) ---

    // Magic Wand (Only show in actual Group mode, hide in Maker mode)
    if (chatPersonalities[currentChatId] === 'group') {
        const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId) || {};
        const wandProfile = getResolvedWandProfileForChat(currentChatId);
        const isWandMuted = chatData.enhancerMuted === true;
        const wandIcon = isWandMuted ? 'fa-volume-xmark' : 'fa-bullhorn';
        // Reuse the character status classes so the Wand glyph occupies the
        // exact same centered slot and visual scale as every character status.
        const wandStatusClass = isWandMuted ? 'is-ghost' : 'is-announcement';
        
        const wandName = String(wandProfile.name || '').trim() || 'Magic Wand';
        const wandAvatar = String(wandProfile.avatar || '').trim();
        
        const wandVisual = wandAvatar
            ? `<img src="${escapeHTML(wandAvatar)}" class="menu-avatar-tiny" onerror="this.style.display='none'">`
            : `<i class="fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles"></i>`;

        const enhancerWrapper = document.createElement('div');
        enhancerWrapper.className = 'settings-menu-item-wrapper furai-menu-profile-row';
        enhancerWrapper.classList.toggle('is-furai-silent-note-row', isWandMuted);
        enhancerWrapper.innerHTML = `
            <button class="settings-menu-item" onclick="openEnhancerSettingsModal()">
                <span class="furai-menu-card-icon" onclick="openOnlineProfileCard('wand', null, event)" title="Open ID card">${wandVisual}</span>
                <span>${escapeHTML(wandName)} (Wand)</span>
            </button>
            <button class="furai-menu-status-btn"
                    onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleLocalWandMute()"
                    title="${isWandMuted ? 'Magic Wand: Silent Note' : 'Magic Wand: Announcement'}">
                <i class="fa-solid ${wandIcon} furai-chat-status-icon ${wandStatusClass}"></i>
            </button>
        `;
        container.appendChild(enhancerWrapper);
    }
}

window.toggleLocalWandMute = function() {
    const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
    if (!chatData) return;

    chatData.enhancerMuted = chatData.enhancerMuted !== true;
    DB.set(currentChatId, chatData);
    updateEnhancerButtonUI();
    renderGroupBotMenu();
};
  
function toggleBotActive(index, isActive) {
    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    const bot = profile.bots[index];
    if (!bot) return;

    bot.isActive = isActive;
    profile.profileCustomized = true;
    DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, profile);
    
    refreshProfileDependentUI(profile);
    triggerOnlineRipple();
}

function openUserProfileModal(options = {}) {
    const requestedHistoricalContext = options?.historicalContext || null;
    furaiHistoricalProfileEditContext = requestedHistoricalContext ? { ...requestedHistoricalContext } : null;
    const historicalRecord = requestedHistoricalContext
        ? findFuraiHistoricalActorRecord(furaiHistoricalProfileEditContext)
        : null;

    if (requestedHistoricalContext && (!historicalRecord || historicalRecord.role !== 'user')) {
        furaiHistoricalProfileEditContext = null;
        showToast('Historical character data is unavailable.', 'error');
        return;
    }

    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    const profileUser = historicalRecord?.actor || profile.user;
    const editingHistorical = !!historicalRecord;
    const avatarInput = document.getElementById('userAvatarInput');
    const nameInput = document.getElementById('userNameInput');
    const previewEl = document.getElementById('userAvatarPreview');

    avatarInput.value = profileUser.avatar || '';
    nameInput.value = profileUser.name || '';

    const personality = chatPersonalities[currentChatId] || 'researcher';
    const instructions = profileUser.instructions || {};
    
    let fullInst = instructions[personality] ?? profileUser.instruction ?? '';
    let publicPart = fullInst;
    let secretPart = "";
    const secretMatch = fullInst.match(/\[SECRET\]([\s\S]*?)\[\/SECRET\]/i);
    
    if (secretMatch) {
        secretPart = secretMatch[1].trim(); 
        publicPart = fullInst.replace(secretMatch[0], "").trim(); 
    }

    // --- [UPDATE START] INJECT WORD COUNT UI ---
    const userTitle = document.getElementById('userProfileModalTitle');
    const resetBtn = document.getElementById('resetUserProfileBtn');
    const saveToLibraryBtn = document.getElementById('saveUserProfileToLibraryBtn');
    const shareBtn = document.getElementById('shareUserProfileBtn');
    const saveBtn = document.getElementById('saveUserProfileBtn');
    const emotionBtn = document.getElementById('userEmotionEditBtn');

    if (userTitle) userTitle.textContent = editingHistorical ? `Edit ${profileUser.name || 'Character'}` : 'User Profile';
    if (resetBtn) {
        resetBtn.textContent = 'Reset';
        resetBtn.setAttribute('onclick', 'resetUserProfile()');
        resetBtn.style.display = editingHistorical ? 'none' : '';
    }
    if (saveToLibraryBtn) {
        saveToLibraryBtn.style.display = '';
        saveToLibraryBtn.setAttribute('onclick', "saveFuraiProfileActorToLibrary('user')");
    }
    if (shareBtn) shareBtn.setAttribute('onclick', editingHistorical
        ? 'shareFuraiHistoricalActor(this)'
        : "openShareMenu(this, 'userNameInput', 'userAvatarInput', 'userInstructionInput')");
    if (saveBtn) saveBtn.setAttribute('onclick', 'saveUserProfile()');
    if (emotionBtn) emotionBtn.setAttribute('onclick', editingHistorical
        ? 'openFuraiHistoricalActorEmotionEditor()'
        : "openEmotionEditor('user')");

    const pubInput = document.getElementById('userInstructionInput');
    const pubLabel = document.getElementById('userInstructionLabel');

    pubInput.value = publicPart;
    pubLabel.textContent = `Your Introduction for ${personality.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + personality.slice(1)} Mode:`;

    // 1. Create Flex Header for Counter (Only if missing)
    if (!document.getElementById('userInstCount')) {
        const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
        wrapper.style.cssText = "display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-end; margin-bottom:6px;";
        
        // Move existing label into wrapper
        pubLabel.parentNode.insertBefore(wrapper, pubLabel);
        wrapper.appendChild(pubLabel);
        
        // Add Counter Span
        wrapper.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<span id="userInstCount" style="font-size:12px; opacity:0.5;">0 words</span>`);
        pubLabel.style.marginBottom = "0";
    }

    // 2. Attach Input Listener (Sums Public + Secret)
    pubInput.oninput = () => updateWordCountUI(['userInstructionInput', 'userSecretInput'], 'userInstCount', 500);
    // --- [UPDATE END] ---

    let secretInput = document.getElementById('userSecretInput');
    if (!secretInput) {
        const mainInstGroup = document.getElementById('userInstructionInput').parentNode;
        const secretGroup = document.createElement('div');
        secretGroup.className = 'form-group';
        secretGroup.style.marginTop = "12px";
        secretGroup.style.paddingTop = "12px";
        secretGroup.style.borderTop = "1px dashed var(--border-color)";
        
        // --- [UPDATE] Added oninput to Secret Textarea ---
        secretGroup.innerHTML = `

                Hidden Secrets
            </label>
            <textarea id="userSecretInput" rows="2" 
                      placeholder="Visible only to you and the Magic Wand. Hidden from other characters."
                      oninput="updateWordCountUI(['userInstructionInput', 'userSecretInput'], 'userInstCount', 500)"></textarea>

        // ------------------------------------------------
        
        mainInstGroup.parentNode.insertBefore(secretGroup, mainInstGroup.nextSibling);

    }

    mountFuraiProtectedInstructionEditor(
        'userProtectedInstructionHost',

    );

    let userOpeningInput = document.getElementById('userOpeningInput');

    if (!userOpeningInput) {

        secretGroup.parentNode.insertBefore(openingGroup, secretGroup.nextSibling);
        userOpeningInput = document.getElementById('userOpeningInput');
    }

    userOpeningInput.value =
        profileUser.openingMessage ||
        profileUser.customGreeting ||
        profileUser.greeting ||
        profileUser.initialMessage ||

    // --- SPRITE LOGIC (Unchanged) ---
    let spriteInput = document.getElementById('userSpriteInput');

        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.style.marginBottom = "8px";
        div.innerHTML = `
            <label style="margin-top:8px;">Character Sprite</label>
            <div style="display: flex; gap: 8px;">

        container.insertBefore(div, container.lastElementChild);

            spritePreviewEl.src = spriteInput.value; 
            spritePreviewEl.style.display = spriteInput.value ? 'block' : 'none';

    spriteInput.value = profileUser.defaultSprite || '';

    spritePreviewEl.style.display = spriteInput.value ? 'block' : 'none';

    // --- NAME / ROLE CONTROL ROW ---

    const existingGroup = wrapper.querySelector('.name-role-select-group');
    if(existingGroup) existingGroup.remove();
    nameInput.style.display = 'none'; 

    const group = document.createElement('div');
    group.className = 'name-role-select-group furai-name-tag-row';
    group.innerHTML = `
        <input type="text" id="userNameInputProxy" value="${escapeHTML(nameInput.value)}" placeholder="Your name" maxlength="54" style="flex:1; margin-bottom:0;" oninput="document.getElementById('userNameInput').value=this.value">
        <input type="text" id="userTagInput" value="${escapeHTML(getFuraiTagInputDisplayValue(profileUser.hashTag || ''))}" data-furai-tag-source="${escapeHTML(profileUser.hashTag || '')}" placeholder="#tag" oninput="sanitizeHashTag(this)" style="width:80px; margin-bottom:0; font-family:monospace; font-weight:bold;">
        ${editingHistorical ? '' : `<button onclick="openFuraiCharacterSelector('user', 'local')" class="upload-btn" title="Switch Character">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-masks-theater" style="font-size:16px;"></i>

    wrapper.insertBefore(group, wrapper.querySelector('label[for="userNameInput"]').nextSibling);

// --- UPDATED: Save User Profile (Saves to Mode-Specific Key) ---
function saveUserProfile() {
    if (furaiHistoricalProfileEditContext?.role === 'user') {
        const saved = saveFuraiHistoricalActorFromRegularEditor('user');
        if (saved) {
            document.getElementById('userProfileModalEl').style.display = 'none';
            furaiHistoricalProfileEditContext = null;
        }
        return;
    }

    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    const personality = chatPersonalities[currentChatId] || 'researcher';
    
    const newAvatar = document.getElementById('userAvatarInput').value.trim();
    const newSprite = document.getElementById('userSpriteInput').value.trim();
    const newName = escapeHTML(document.getElementById('userNameInput').value.trim());
    
    // --- MERGE LOGIC ---
    const publicInst = document.getElementById('userInstructionInput').value.trim();
    const secretInst = document.getElementById('userSecretInput') ? document.getElementById('userSecretInput').value.trim() : "";
    const protectedData = readFuraiProtectedInstructionEditorData(
        'userProtectedInstructionHost',
        profile.user
    );
    if (!protectedData) return;
    
    let finalInstruction = publicInst;
    if (secretInst) {
        finalInstruction += `\n\n[SECRET]\n${secretInst}\n[/SECRET]`;
    }
    // -------------------

    profile.user.avatar = newAvatar;
    profile.user.defaultSprite = newSprite;
    profile.user.name = newName;
    profile.user.hashTag = getFuraiTagInputValue('userTagInput');

    const userOpeningMessage = document.getElementById('userOpeningInput')?.value.trim() || "";
    if (userOpeningMessage) {
        profile.user.openingMessage = userOpeningMessage;
    } else {
        delete profile.user.openingMessage;
    }

    writeCharacterOpeningExtras(
        profile.user,
        readCharacterOpeningExtrasFromDomOrProfile('userNameInput', profile.user)
    );

    if (!profile.user.instructions) profile.user.instructions = {};
    profile.user.instructions[personality] = finalInstruction;
    writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(profile.user, protectedData);
    
    profile.profileCustomized = true; 
    DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, profile);

    refreshProfileDependentUI(profile);
    if (typeof rerenderVisibleMessagesFromDatabase === 'function') {
        rerenderVisibleMessagesFromDatabase({ preserveScroll: true, preserveVnTarget: true });
    }
    closeUserProfileModal();
}

/* --- LOCAL CHAT RESETS (Revert to User Global) --- */

function resetUserProfile() {
    const personality = chatPersonalities[currentChatId] || 'researcher';
    const currentName = document.getElementById('userNameInput').value.trim() || "User";

    // 1. Determine Source (Global Truth)
    const modeUserKey = `global-user-${personality}`;
    let globalUser = DB.get(modeUserKey);
    
    if (!globalUser) globalUser = DB.get('global-profile-user');
    if (!globalUser) globalUser = createFuraiDefaultUser(personality);

    const targetName = globalUser.name || "User";

    // 2. Smart Confirmation
    let msg = `Revert your profile to match your Global Defaults?`;

    if (currentName !== targetName) {
        msg = `⚠️ Sync Warning: This will replace "${currentName}" (Local) with "${targetName}" (Global).\n\nThis undoes any changes you made to your identity inside this specific chat.\n\nContinue?`;
    }

    if (!confirm(msg)) return;

    // 3. Apply
    document.getElementById('userAvatarInput').value = globalUser.avatar || '';
    document.getElementById('userNameInput').value = globalUser.name || '';
    
    let inst = globalUser.instruction || '';
    if (!inst && globalUser.instructions) inst = globalUser.instructions[personality] || '';
    const parts = splitStoryLoreFromEditor(inst);
    document.getElementById('userInstructionInput').value = parts.publicText;
    const secretInput = document.getElementById('userSecretInput');
    if (secretInput) secretInput.value = parts.secretText;
    mountFuraiProtectedInstructionEditor(
        'userProtectedInstructionHost',
        secretInput?.closest('.form-group') || document.getElementById('userInstructionInput')?.closest('.form-group'),
        globalUser
    );
    
    document.getElementById('userAvatarInput').dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
}

function resetBotProfile() {
    const index = parseInt(document.getElementById('editingBotIndex').value);
    const personality = chatPersonalities[currentChatId];
    const currentName = document.getElementById('botNameInput').value.trim() || "Character";
    
    // 1. Determine Source (Global Truth)
    let sourceBot = null;
    
    if (personality === 'group') {
        let globalRoster = [];
        try { globalRoster = DB.get('globalBotRoster'); } catch(e){}
        if (!Array.isArray(globalRoster) || globalRoster.length === 0) globalRoster = defaultBots;

        const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
        const storedBot = profile?.bots?.[index];
        const found = getGroupRosterSourceBot(storedBot, index, globalRoster);

        if (!found?.bot) {
            if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
                showToast('This character’s original Library source is unavailable. The current chat version was kept.', 'warning');
            }
            return;
        }

        sourceBot = found.bot;
    } else {
        const botKey = `global-profile-${personality}`;
        try { 
            const saved = DB.get(botKey);
            if(saved && saved.bots && saved.bots[0]) sourceBot = saved.bots[0];
        } catch(e){}
        
        if (!sourceBot) {
            sourceBot = createFuraiModeFactoryBot(personality);
        }
    }

    const targetName = sourceBot.name || "Unknown";

    // 2. Smart Confirmation
    let msg = `Revert this character to match your Global Profile settings?`;
    if (currentName !== targetName) {
        msg = `This will replace "${currentName}" (Local) with "${targetName}" (Global).\n\nThis undoes any changes you made inside this specific chat.\n\nContinue?`;
    }

    if (!confirm(msg)) return;

    // 3. Apply Visuals to Inputs
    document.getElementById('botAvatarInput').value = sourceBot.avatar || '';
    document.getElementById('botNameInput').value = sourceBot.name || '';
    const sourceInstructionParts = splitStoryLoreFromEditor(sourceBot.instruction || '');
    document.getElementById('botInstructionInput').value = sourceInstructionParts.publicText;
    const secretInput = document.getElementById('botSecretInput');
    if (secretInput) secretInput.value = sourceInstructionParts.secretText;
    mountFuraiProtectedInstructionEditor(
        'botProtectedInstructionHost',
        secretInput?.closest('.form-group') || document.getElementById('botInstructionInput')?.closest('.form-group'),
        sourceBot
    );
    
    const spriteInput = document.getElementById('botSpriteInput');
    if (spriteInput) {
        spriteInput.value = sourceBot.defaultSprite || '';
        spriteInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); 
    }
    
    document.getElementById('botAvatarInput').dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));

    // --- FIX: INJECT EMOTIONS DIRECTLY INTO LOCAL MEMORY ---
    // So when the user clicks 'Save', it captures the restored emotions
    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    let targetBot = profile?.bots?.[index];

    if (
        personality === 'group' &&
        targetBot?.rosterStub === true
    ) {
        targetBot = hydrateGroupRosterStub(profile, index);
    }

    if (targetBot) {
        targetBot.customEmotions = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(sourceBot.customEmotions || {}));
        targetBot.emotionAvatars = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(sourceBot.emotionAvatars || {}));
        targetBot.emotionSprites = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(sourceBot.emotionSprites || {}));
        DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, profile);
    }
}

function resetReference() {
    const personality = chatPersonalities[currentChatId] || 'researcher';
    
    try {
        let chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
        if (chatData) {
            delete chatData.reference;
            // Glossary deletion is removed from here
            DB.set(currentChatId, chatData);
        }
    } catch(e) {}

    // Reload Globals to UI instantly
    const loreParts = splitFuraiLoreInstructions(DB.get(`ref_text_${personality}`) || defaultReferences[personality] || "");
    document.getElementById('refTextInput').value = loreParts.publicText;
    const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('refHiddenInstructionsInput');
    if (hiddenInput) hiddenInput.value = loreParts.hiddenText;
    document.getElementById('refTextInput').dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
}

function saveBotProfile() {
    if (furaiHistoricalProfileEditContext?.role === 'ai') {
        const saved = saveFuraiHistoricalActorFromRegularEditor('ai');
        if (saved) {
            document.getElementById('botProfileModalEl').style.display = 'none';
            furaiHistoricalProfileEditContext = null;
        }
        return;
    }

    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    const index = parseInt(document.getElementById('editingBotIndex').value);

    if (
        chatPersonalities[currentChatId] === 'group' &&
        profile?.bots?.[index]?.rosterStub === true &&
        !hydrateGroupRosterStub(profile, index)
    ) {
        return;
    }
    
    const newAvatar = document.getElementById('botAvatarInput').value.trim();
    const newSprite = document.getElementById('botSpriteInput').value.trim();
    const newName = escapeHTML(document.getElementById('botNameInput').value.trim());
    const openingEl = document.getElementById('botOpeningInput');
    const newOpeningMessage = openingEl ? openingEl.value.trim() : "";
    
    // --- NEW: MERGE PUBLIC & SECRET ---
    const publicInst = document.getElementById('botInstructionInput').value.trim();
    
    // Check if the secret element exists
    const secretEl = document.getElementById('botSecretInput');
    const secretInst = secretEl ? secretEl.value.trim() : "";
    
    let finalInstruction = publicInst;
    if (secretInst) {
        finalInstruction += `\n\n[SECRET]\n${secretInst}\n[/SECRET]`;
    }
    // ---------------------------------

    if (profile.bots[index]) {
        const protectedData = readFuraiProtectedInstructionEditorData(
            'botProtectedInstructionHost',
            profile.bots[index]
        );
        if (!protectedData) return;

        if (!profile.bots[index].uid) {
            profile.bots[index].uid = generateUID('bot');
        }

        profile.bots[index].avatar = newAvatar;
        profile.bots[index].defaultSprite = newSprite;
        profile.bots[index].name = newName;
        profile.bots[index].hashTag = getFuraiTagInputValue('botTagInput');
        profile.bots[index].instruction = finalInstruction;
        writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(profile.bots[index], protectedData);
        
        if (newOpeningMessage) {
            profile.bots[index].openingMessage = newOpeningMessage;
        } else {
            delete profile.bots[index].openingMessage;
        }

        writeCharacterOpeningExtras(
            profile.bots[index],
            readCharacterOpeningExtrasFromDomOrProfile('botNameInput', profile.bots[index])
        );
    }
    
    profile.profileCustomized = true;
    DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, profile);

    refreshProfileDependentUI(profile);
    if (typeof rerenderVisibleMessagesFromDatabase === 'function') {
        rerenderVisibleMessagesFromDatabase({ preserveScroll: true, preserveVnTarget: true });
    }
    
    if (getStoredChatPersonality(currentChatId) === 'group') {
        renderCastSwitchingModal();
    }

    if (document.body.classList.contains('vn-active') && typeof renderVnSprites === 'function') {
        syncVnData(); 
        setTimeout(() => renderVnMessage('preserve'), 50); 
    }

    closeBotProfileModal();
}

    if (document.getElementById('settingsMenu').classList.contains('show')) {

                    Changes made here only affect <strong>this story chat</strong>. They do not change your global Story Cast template or other chats.<br><br>
                    <strong>Present</strong> = full lore used.<br>
                    <strong>Brief</strong> = only name, role, and role note used. Good for <strong>saving tokens</strong> while keeping the character in play.<br>
                    <strong>Offstage</strong> = not used in context.
