function closeStoryChatCastModal() {
    document.getElementById('storyChatCastModalEl').style.display = 'none';
}

function renderStoryChatCastModal() {
    const state = getStoryChatCastState();
    if (!state) return;

    renderStoryChatCastSections(state);
    filterStoryChatLibrary();
}

function getStoryChatCastState() {
    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    if (!profile) return null;

    const castListEl = document.getElementById('storyChatCastList');
    const poolListEl = document.getElementById('storyChatPoolList');
    if (!castListEl || !poolListEl) return null;

    const localCast = (profile.bots || []).slice(1).map((bot, i) => ({
        ...bot,
        originalIndex: i + 1
    })).filter(bot => bot.localRosterDeleted !== true);

    const globalPool = loadGlobalStoryCharacterLibrary();

    const inheritedUidSet = new Set(
        localCast
            .map(bot => bot.storySourceLibraryUid || '')
            .filter(Boolean)
    );

    return {
        profile,
        castListEl,
        poolListEl,
        localCast,
        globalPool,
        inheritedUidSet
    };
}

function renderStoryChatCastSections(state) {
    renderStoryChatCastList(state);
    renderStoryChatPoolList(state);
}

function renderStoryChatCastList(state) {
    const { castListEl, localCast } = state;

    if (!localCast.length) {
        castListEl.innerHTML = `
            <div style="padding:12px; border:1px dashed var(--border-color); border-radius:8px; opacity:0.6; font-size:13px;">
                No Story Cast yet.
            </div>
        `;
        return;
    }

    castListEl.innerHTML = localCast
        .map((bot, localIndex) => {
            const snapshot = {
                ...bot,
                storySourceIndex: typeof bot.storySourceIndex === 'number' ? bot.storySourceIndex : localIndex
            };

            return renderStoryCastItemHTML(snapshot, localIndex, true, 'chat');
        })
        .join('');
}

function renderStoryChatPoolList(state) {
    const { poolListEl, globalPool, inheritedUidSet } = state;

    const cardsHtml = globalPool.map((bot, sourceIndex) => {
        const cardHtml = renderStoryCastItemHTML(bot, sourceIndex, false, 'chat');
        const alreadyAdded = inheritedUidSet.has(bot.storyLibraryUid);

        if (!alreadyAdded) return cardHtml;

        return cardHtml.replace(
            /title="Import Role Snapshot"/,
            'title="Already in this story"'
        ).replace(
            /<i class="fa-solid fa-plus"><\/i>/,
            '<i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i>'
        ).replace(
            /class="story-character-action-btn"/,
            'class="story-character-action-btn" disabled'
        );
    }).join('');

    poolListEl.innerHTML = `
        <div style="margin-bottom:10px; position:relative;">
            <input type="text"
                   id="storyChatLibrarySearchInput"
                   placeholder="Search..."
                   oninput="filterStoryChatLibrary()"
                   style="width:100%; padding:10px 12px 10px 36px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--border-color); background:var(--input-bg); color:var(--text-color); box-sizing:border-box;">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass" style="position:absolute; left:12px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); opacity:0.5;"></i>
        </div>

        <div id="storyChatLibraryList">
            ${cardsHtml}
        </div>
    `;

    poolListEl.querySelectorAll('.story-character-action-btn[disabled]').forEach(btn => {
        btn.style.opacity = '0.45';
        btn.style.cursor = 'default';
        btn.onclick = event => event.stopPropagation();
    });
}

function filterStoryChatLibrary() {
    const input = document.getElementById('storyChatLibrarySearchInput');
    const query = (input?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();

    document.querySelectorAll('#storyChatLibraryList .story-library-item, #storyChatLibraryList .story-character-card').forEach(el => {
        const haystack = (el.dataset.storySearch || '').toLowerCase();
        el.style.display = !query || haystack.includes(query) ? '' : 'none';
    });
}

function addStoryChatCastFromLibrary(sourceIndex) {
    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    const library = loadGlobalStoryCharacterLibrary();
    const sourceBot = library[sourceIndex];
    if (!profile || !sourceBot) return;

    const alreadyExists = (profile.bots || []).slice(1).some(bot =>
        bot?.localRosterDeleted !== true &&
        (bot.storySourceLibraryUid || '') === (sourceBot.storyLibraryUid || '')
    );

    if (alreadyExists) {
        showToast(`${sourceBot.name || 'Character'} is already in this story.`);
        return;
    }

    const snapshot = buildGlobalStoryCastSnapshot(sourceBot, sourceIndex);
    snapshot.actorStartAfterMessageUid = getFuraiLastMessageUid(DB.get(currentChatId));
    profile.bots.push(snapshot);
    profile.profileCustomized = true;
    DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, profile);

    renderStoryChatCastModal();
    showToast(`${sourceBot.name || 'Character'} added to this story.`);
}

function removeStoryChatCast(botIndex) {
    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    const bot = profile?.bots?.[botIndex];
    if (!profile || !bot || bot.localRosterDeleted === true) return;

    const label = bot.name || 'Story Cast character';
    const retiredState = cloneFuraiData(bot);
    retiredState.sourceLibraryUid = retiredState.sourceLibraryUid || retiredState.storySourceLibraryUid || retiredState.uid;

    // A Story Cast removal is a lane boundary, not an array deletion. This keeps
    // old VN/cutscene scenes on the original character while future scenes treat
    // the lane as offstage. Stable bot indices are never shifted.
    const switched = switchFuraiChatRoleActor(currentChatId, {
        role: 'ai',
        botIndex,
        mode: 'story'
    }, retiredState);
    if (!switched) return;

    const updatedProfile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    const tombstone = updatedProfile?.bots?.[botIndex];
    if (tombstone) {
        tombstone.localRosterDeleted = true;
        tombstone.storyContextMode = 'offstage';
        tombstone.inActiveCast = false;
        tombstone.isActive = false;
        delete tombstone.replyMode;
        delete tombstone.activeTimestamp;
        updatedProfile.profileCustomized = true;
        DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, updatedProfile);
    }

    renderStoryChatCastModal();
    showToast(`${label} removed from this story.`);
}
  
function openCastSwitchingModal() {
    const personality = chatPersonalities[currentChatId];
    const isStoryMode = personality === 'story';

    const modalTitle = document.querySelector('#castSwitchingModalEl .modal-header h3');
    if (modalTitle) {
        modalTitle.textContent = isStoryMode ? 'Story Cast' : 'Manage Group';
    }

    renderCastSwitchingModal();
    document.getElementById('castSwitchingModalEl').style.display = 'flex';

    if (document.getElementById('settingsMenu').classList.contains('show')) {
        toggleSettingsMenu();
    }

    const hintKey = isStoryMode ? 'furai_story_manage_hint_seen' : 'furai_group_manage_hint_seen';

    if (!localStorage.getItem(hintKey)) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            showOverlayHint(
                isStoryMode
                    ? `
                        <strong><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-info" style="margin-right:6px; color:var(--primary-color);"></i>Story Cast</strong><br>
                        Changes made here only affect <strong>this story chat</strong>. They do not change your global Story Cast template or other chats.
                      `
                    : `
                        <strong><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-info" style="margin-right:6px; color:var(--primary-color);"></i>Manage Group</strong><br>
                        Changes made here only affect <strong>this chat</strong>. They do not change your global Character Library or other chats.
                      `,
                0
            );

            localStorage.setItem(hintKey, 'true');
        }, 120);
    }
}

    document.getElementById('castSwitchingModalEl').style.display = 'none';
  }

function areLocalCastAnnouncementsEnabled(profile = null) {
    const liveProfile = profile || getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    return liveProfile?.disableCastAnnouncements !== true;
}

function setLocalCastAnnouncementsEnabled(enabled) {
    if (!currentChatId) return;

    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    profile.disableCastAnnouncements = enabled !== true;
    profile.profileCustomized = true;
    DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, profile);
}

function getLocalIdleAnnouncementTarget(profile = null) {
    const liveProfile = profile || getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    return normalizeFuraiIdleAnnouncementTarget(liveProfile?.idleAnnouncementTarget);
}

function getLocalIdleAnnouncementMinutes(profile = null) {
    const liveProfile = profile || getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    return normalizeFuraiIdleAnnouncementMinutes(liveProfile?.idleAnnouncementMinutes);
}

function setLocalIdleAnnouncementSettings(target, minutes) {
    if (!currentChatId) return;

    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    if (!profile) return;

    profile.idleAnnouncementTarget = normalizeFuraiIdleAnnouncementTarget(target);
    profile.idleAnnouncementMinutes = normalizeFuraiIdleAnnouncementMinutes(minutes);
    profile.profileCustomized = true;
    DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, profile);

    // Recalculate the single nearest-due timer. No reset flag or second state
    // machine is needed; the saved message history remains the only clock source.
    syncFuraiIdleAnnouncementTimer(currentChatId);
}

    const targetSelect = document.getElementById('castSwitchIdleAnnouncementTarget');
    const intervalSelect = document.getElementById('castSwitchIdleAnnouncementMinutes');

    setLocalIdleAnnouncementSettings(
        targetSelect?.value || 'everyone',
        intervalSelect?.value || 0
    );
}

// ============================================================================
// IDLE ANNOUNCEMENT CONTRACT — ACTIVITY NOTICE ONLY
// ============================================================================
// This feature reads saved message times and may append "Name has been idle."
// It is NOT a presence controller. Never write chatStatus, isActive,
// inActiveCast, silentNote, chatStatus, activeTimestamp, Online, Idle, Announcement, Ghost Mode, or
// Offline here. "Everyone" means one independent watch per currently-online
// member, not @everyone and not one room-wide silence clock.
//
// Keep this lightweight: one activity record per member and one shared
// setTimeout for the nearest due record. Mouse, focus, scrolling, and clicks do
// not count as activity. Do not add polling, a setInterval, or per-member timers.
let furaiIdleAnnouncementTimer = 0;
let furaiIdleAnnouncementTimerChatId = '';

function clearFuraiIdleAnnouncementTimer() {
    if (furaiIdleAnnouncementTimer) clearTimeout(furaiIdleAnnouncementTimer);
    furaiIdleAnnouncementTimer = 0;
    furaiIdleAnnouncementTimerChatId = '';
}

function getFuraiIdleActorKey(actor) {
    if (!actor) return '';
    const role = actor.role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'ai';
    const uid = String(actor.uid || '').trim();
    return uid ? `${role}:${uid}` : '';
}

function getFuraiIdleSourceActor(message, profile) {
    if (!message || !profile) return null;

    const role = String(message.role || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const isManualAnnouncement =
        isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(role) &&
        message.idleAnnouncement !== true;

    if (
        (role === 'user' && message.syntheticUserAutoReply !== true) ||
        isManualAnnouncement
    ) {
        const user = profile.user || {};
        return {
            role: 'user',
            uid: String(message.userUid || user.uid || 'user').trim() || 'user',
            name: String(message.userNameSnapshot || user.name || 'User').trim() || 'User'
        };
    }

    if (role !== 'ai') return null;

    const botUid = String(message.botUid || '').trim();
    const botIndex = Number(message.botIndex);
    const bot =
        (botUid ? profile.bots?.find(item => String(item?.uid || '').trim() === botUid) : null) ||
        (Number.isInteger(botIndex) && botIndex >= 0 ? profile.bots?.[botIndex] : null) ||
        null;

    if (!bot && !botUid && !Number.isInteger(botIndex)) return null;

    return {
        role: 'ai',
        uid: botUid || String(bot?.uid || `bot-${botIndex}`).trim(),
        name: String(message.botNameSnapshot || bot?.name || 'Character').trim() || 'Character'
    };
}

function buildFuraiIdleActivityRecord(message) {
    return {
        messageUid: String(message?.uid || '').trim(),
        announced: false
    };
}

function rebuildFuraiIdleActivityMap(chatData, profile) {
    const activity = {};
    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];

    for (let index = messages.length - 1; index >= 0; index--) {
        const message = messages[index];
        const actor = getFuraiIdleSourceActor(message, profile);
        const key = getFuraiIdleActorKey(actor);
        if (!key || activity[key]) continue;
        activity[key] = buildFuraiIdleActivityRecord(message);
    }

    chatData.idleAnnouncementActivity = activity;
    delete chatData.idleAnnouncementState; // remove the abandoned room-wide prototype state
    return activity;
}

function ensureFuraiIdleActivityMap(chatData, profile) {
    const existing = chatData?.idleAnnouncementActivity;
    if (!existing || typeof existing !== 'object' || Array.isArray(existing)) {
        return rebuildFuraiIdleActivityMap(chatData, profile);
    }

    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    const messageUids = new Set(messages.map(message => String(message?.uid || '')).filter(Boolean));
    const normalized = {};

    for (const [key, record] of Object.entries(existing)) {
        const messageUid = String(record?.messageUid || '').trim();
        if (!messageUid || !messageUids.has(messageUid)) {
            return rebuildFuraiIdleActivityMap(chatData, profile);
        }

        // Migrate the earlier oversized record shape without preserving its
        // unused actor/presence fields.
        normalized[key] = {
            messageUid,
            announced:
                record?.announced === true ||
                String(record?.idleAnnouncedForMessageUid || '').trim() === messageUid
        };
    }

    chatData.idleAnnouncementActivity = normalized;
    delete chatData.idleAnnouncementState;
    return normalized;
}

function getFuraiIdleWatchedActors(profile, target) {
    const actors = [];
    const user = profile?.user || {};

    if (getUserChatStatus(profile) === 'online') {
        actors.push({
            role: 'user',
            uid: String(user.uid || 'user').trim() || 'user',
            name: String(user.name || 'User').trim() || 'User'
        });
    }

    if (normalizeFuraiIdleAnnouncementTarget(target) === 'user') return actors;

    (profile?.bots || []).forEach((bot, botIndex) => {
        if (
            !bot ||
            bot.localRosterDeleted === true ||
            bot.inActiveCast !== true ||
            getBotChatStatus(bot) !== 'online'
        ) return;

        actors.push({
            role: 'ai',
            uid: String(bot.uid || `bot-${botIndex}`).trim(),
            name: String(bot.name || 'Character').trim() || 'Character'
        });
    });

    return actors;
}

function getFuraiIdleMessageTime(message, chatData = null) {
    const createdAt = Date.parse(String(message?.createdAt || ''));
    if (Number.isFinite(createdAt)) return createdAt;

    const chatTimestamp = Number(chatData?.timestamp);
    return Number.isFinite(chatTimestamp) && chatTimestamp > 0
        ? chatTimestamp
        : Date.now();
}

function getFuraiIdleWatchEntries(chatData, profile, target) {
    const activity = ensureFuraiIdleActivityMap(chatData, profile);
    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    const messagesByUid = new Map(
        messages.map(message => [String(message?.uid || '').trim(), message])
    );

    return getFuraiIdleWatchedActors(profile, target)
        .map(actor => {
            const record = activity[getFuraiIdleActorKey(actor)];
            if (!record || record.announced === true) return null;

            const sourceMessage = messagesByUid.get(String(record.messageUid || '').trim());
            if (!sourceMessage) return null;

            return {
                actor,
                record,
                sourceMessage,
                lastMessageTime: getFuraiIdleMessageTime(sourceMessage, chatData)
            };
        })
        .filter(Boolean);
}

function updateFuraiIdleAnnouncementStateForSavedMessage(
    chatId,
    chatData,
    message,
    role,
    meta,
    mutationKind
) {
    if (mutationKind !== 'append') return;
    if (String(chatData?.personality || chatPersonalities?.[chatId] || '') !== 'group') return;
    if (meta?.idleAnnouncement === true) return;

    const profile = getChatProfile(chatId);
    const actor = getFuraiIdleSourceActor(message, profile);
    const actorKey = getFuraiIdleActorKey(actor);
    if (!profile || !actorKey) return;

    // Saved messages are the only activity signal. This resets only the
    // speaker's notice clock and never changes any presence setting.
    const activity = ensureFuraiIdleActivityMap(chatData, profile);
    activity[actorKey] = buildFuraiIdleActivityRecord(message);
    chatData.idleAnnouncementActivity = activity;
}

function syncFuraiIdleAnnouncementTimer(chatId = currentChatId, chatDataOverride = null) {
    clearFuraiIdleAnnouncementTimer();
    if (!chatId || chatId !== currentChatId) return;

    const chatData = chatDataOverride || DB.get(chatId);
    const personality = String(chatData?.personality || chatPersonalities?.[chatId] || '');
    const profile = getChatProfile(chatId);
    const minutes = getLocalIdleAnnouncementMinutes(profile);

    if (!chatData || personality !== 'group' || minutes <= 0 || !profile) return;

    const entries = getFuraiIdleWatchEntries(
        chatData,
        profile,
        getLocalIdleAnnouncementTarget(profile)
    );

    DB.set(chatId, chatData); // persists compact migration/rebuild data
    if (!entries.length) return;

    const thresholdMs = minutes * 60 * 1000;
    const nextDueAt = Math.min(...entries.map(entry => entry.lastMessageTime + thresholdMs));

    furaiIdleAnnouncementTimerChatId = chatId;
    furaiIdleAnnouncementTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        void fireFuraiIdleAnnouncements(furaiIdleAnnouncementTimerChatId);
    }, Math.max(100, nextDueAt - Date.now()));
}

async function fireFuraiIdleAnnouncements(chatId) {
    furaiIdleAnnouncementTimer = 0;
    furaiIdleAnnouncementTimerChatId = '';

    if (!chatId || chatId !== currentChatId) return;

    if (typeof isFuraiForegroundAiBusy === 'function' && isFuraiForegroundAiBusy()) {
        furaiIdleAnnouncementTimerChatId = chatId;
        furaiIdleAnnouncementTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            void fireFuraiIdleAnnouncements(chatId);
        }, 30000);
        return;
    }

    const chatData = DB.get(chatId);
    const profile = getChatProfile(chatId);
    const minutes = getLocalIdleAnnouncementMinutes(profile);

    if (!chatData || chatData.personality !== 'group' || minutes <= 0 || !profile) {
        syncFuraiIdleAnnouncementTimer(chatId, chatData);
        return;
    }

    const thresholdMs = minutes * 60 * 1000;
    const now = Date.now();
    const dueEntries = getFuraiIdleWatchEntries(
        chatData,
        profile,
        getLocalIdleAnnouncementTarget(profile)
    ).filter(entry => now - entry.lastMessageTime >= thresholdMs);

    if (!dueEntries.length) {
        syncFuraiIdleAnnouncementTimer(chatId, chatData);
        return;
    }

    // Mark first, then save. The announcement itself is excluded from activity,
    // so it cannot reset a participant or create a fake watched member.
    dueEntries.forEach(entry => {
        entry.record.announced = true;
    });
    DB.set(chatId, chatData);

    let savedCount = 0;

    for (const entry of dueEntries) {
        const text = `${entry.actor.name} has been idle.`;
        const timestampMeta = {
            ...makeMessageTimestampMeta(chatId),
            idleAnnouncement: true
        };
        const saveResult = saveMessage(chatId, 'announcement', text, null, null, timestampMeta);
        if (!saveResult) continue;

        savedCount++;
        addMessage('announcement', text, null, null, {
            ...timestampMeta,
            messageIndex: saveResult.index,
            messageUid: saveResult.message?.uid || ''
        });
    }

    syncFuraiIdleAnnouncementTimer(chatId, DB.get(chatId));

    // Give the normal Group reply selector one opportunity after this batch.
    // This is not a mention and does not target every bot.
    if (savedCount > 0) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (currentChatId !== chatId) return;
            sendMessage({ isAutoReply: true });
        }, 450);
    }
}

function renderCastSwitchingModal() {
    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    const personality = chatPersonalities[currentChatId];
    const isStoryMode = personality === 'story';
    const groupRosterSource = isStoryMode ? null : getCurrentGroupRosterSource();

    const activeListEl = document.getElementById('activeCastList');
    const storageListEl = document.getElementById('storageCastList');
    const addNewHostEl = document.getElementById('castSwitchAddNewHost');
    const announcementHostEl = document.getElementById('castSwitchAnnouncementHost');
    const footerEl = document.getElementById('castModalActions');

    activeListEl.innerHTML = '';
    storageListEl.innerHTML = '';
    if (addNewHostEl) addNewHostEl.innerHTML = '';
    if (announcementHostEl) announcementHostEl.innerHTML = '';
    if (footerEl) footerEl.innerHTML = '';

    const searchHost = document.getElementById('castSwitchSearchBarHost');
    if (searchHost) {
        searchHost.innerHTML = AchievementManager.isUnlocked('legion')
            ? getLegionSearchBarHTML('castSwitchingModalEl')
            : '';
    }

    if (!isStoryMode && announcementHostEl) {
        const isAnnouncementOn = areLocalCastAnnouncementsEnabled(profile);
        const idleTarget = getLocalIdleAnnouncementTarget(profile);
        const idleMinutes = getLocalIdleAnnouncementMinutes(profile);

        announcementHostEl.innerHTML = `
            <div class="furai-cast-announcement-settings">
                <label class="furai-switch-row" for="castSwitchAnnouncementToggle" title="Show online/offline roster announcements">
                    <span><i class="fa-solid fa-bullhorn"></i> Announce Online/Offline</span>
                    <span class="furai-switch"><input id="castSwitchAnnouncementToggle" type="checkbox" role="switch" onchange="setLocalCastAnnouncementsEnabled(this.checked)" ${isAnnouncementOn ? 'checked' : ''}><span class="furai-switch-track" aria-hidden="true"><span class="furai-switch-knob"></span></span></span>
                </label>

                <div class="furai-idle-announcement-row">
                    <span class="furai-idle-announcement-label">
                        <i class="fa-regular fa-clock"></i>
                        <span>Idle Announce</span>
                    </span>

                    <div class="furai-idle-announcement-controls">
                        <select id="castSwitchIdleAnnouncementTarget"
                                aria-label="Idle announcement target"
                                onchange="saveLocalIdleAnnouncementControls()">
                            ${getFuraiIdleAnnouncementTargetOptionsHtml(idleTarget)}
                        </select>

                        <select id="castSwitchIdleAnnouncementMinutes"
                                aria-label="Idle announcement interval"
                                onchange="saveLocalIdleAnnouncementControls()">
                            ${getFuraiIdleAnnouncementIntervalOptionsHtml(idleMinutes)}
                        </select>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>`;
    }

    const sourceBots = isStoryMode ? profile.bots.slice(1) : profile.bots;
    const allBots = sourceBots
        .map((bot, i) => {
            const displayBot = isStoryMode
                ? bot
                : resolveGroupRosterStubForDisplay(bot, i, groupRosterSource);

            return {
                ...displayBot,
                originalIndex: isStoryMode ? i + 1 : i
            };
        })
        .filter(bot => bot.localRosterDeleted !== true);

    const activeCast = allBots.filter(b => b.inActiveCast);
    const storageCast = allBots.filter(b => !b.inActiveCast);

    activeCast.sort((a, b) => (a.activeTimestamp || 0) - (b.activeTimestamp || 0));

    const activeCount = activeCast.length;
    const limit = AchievementManager.getGroupLimit();
    const limitDisplay = limit >= 9999 ? '∞' : limit;

    const activeHeader = document.querySelector('#castSwitchingModalEl .cast-panel:first-child h4');
    if (activeHeader) {
        activeHeader.innerHTML = isStoryMode
            ? `
                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;">
                    <span><i class="fa-solid fa-book-open" style="font-size:10px; margin-right:6px; opacity:0.8;"></i> Active Cast</span>
                    <span style="opacity:0.6; font-family:monospace; font-size:1.1em;">${activeCount}/${limitDisplay}</span>
                </div>`
            : `
                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;">
                    <span><i class="fa-solid fa-users" style="font-size:11px; margin-right:6px; opacity:0.8;"></i> Members</span>
                    <span style="opacity:0.6; font-family:monospace; font-size:1.1em;">${activeCount}/${limitDisplay}</span>
                </div>`;
    }

    const offlineHeader = document.querySelector('#castSwitchingModalEl .cast-panel:last-child h4');
    if (offlineHeader) {
        offlineHeader.innerHTML = isStoryMode
            ? `<div style="display:flex; align-items:center;"><i class="fa-solid fa-box-archive" style="margin-right:8px; opacity:0.6;"></i> <span>Standby / Offline</span></div>`
            : `<div style="display:flex; align-items:center;"><i class="fa-solid fa-box-archive" style="margin-right:8px; opacity:0.6;"></i> <span>Offline</span></div>`;
    }

    const renderItem = (bot, isOnline) => {
        const itemEl = document.createElement('div');
        itemEl.className = 'cast-item';

        const searchData = `${bot.name} ${getFuraiVisibleTagText(bot.hashTag)} ${bot.instruction || ''} ${bot.storyRoleType || ''} ${bot.storyRoleNote || ''}`.toLowerCase();
        itemEl.dataset.search = searchData;

        const iconClass = isOnline ? 'fa-minus' : 'fa-plus';
        const btnTitle = isStoryMode
            ? (isOnline ? 'Remove from Story Cast' : 'Add to Story Cast')
            : (isOnline ? 'Remove from Members' : 'Add to Members');

        const tagHtml = createFuraiTagChipsHTML(bot.hashTag, {
            className: 'furai-compact-row-tags furai-long-row-tags',
            maxVisible: 2
        });

        const roleHtml = isStoryMode && bot.storyRoleType
            ? `<span style="font-size:11px; opacity:0.72; margin-left:8px; padding:2px 7px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid var(--border-color); white-space:nowrap;">${escapeHTML(bot.storyRoleType)}</span>`
            : '';

        const noteHtml = isStoryMode && bot.storyRoleNote
            ? `<div style="font-size:11px; opacity:0.58; margin-top:2px; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;">${escapeHTML(bot.storyRoleNote)}</div>`
            : '';

        const deleteBtnHtml = canDeleteLocalGroupBot(bot)
            ? `
                <button class="cast-switch-btn"
                        onclick="event.stopPropagation(); deleteLocalGroupBot(${bot.originalIndex})"
                        title="Delete from this chat"
                        style="color:var(--danger-color);">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-trash"></i>
                </button>
              `
            : '';

        itemEl.innerHTML = `
            <div class="cast-item-info" onclick="openBotProfileModal(${bot.originalIndex})">
                <img src="${bot.avatar}" onerror="this.style.display='none'">
                <div class="furai-tagged-row-grid">
                    <div class="furai-tagged-row-name-line furai-long-row-name-line">
                        <span class="furai-tagged-row-name">${escapeHTML(bot.name)}</span>
                        ${roleHtml}
                        ${tagHtml}
                    </div>
                    ${noteHtml}
                </div>
            </div>

            <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; flex-shrink:0;">
                ${deleteBtnHtml}

                <button class="cast-switch-btn" onclick="switchBotCast(${bot.originalIndex})" title="${btnTitle}">
                    <i class="fa-solid ${iconClass}"></i>
                </button>
            </div>
        `;

        return itemEl;
    };

    activeCast.forEach(bot => activeListEl.appendChild(renderItem(bot, true)));

    const btnStyle = "flex: 1; height: 42px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); background: var(--input-bg); color: var(--text-color); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: all 0.2s;";

    const addBtn = document.createElement('button');
    addBtn.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-user-plus" style="margin-right:8px;"></i> Select from Character Library`;
    addBtn.title = isStoryMode ? "Create a blank story cast slot" : "Add a Character Library snapshot to this chat";
    addBtn.style.cssText = `${btnStyle} width:100%; margin-bottom:6px; flex-shrink:0;`;

    addBtn.onmouseover = function() {
        this.style.background = 'var(--sidebar-hover)';
        this.style.borderColor = 'var(--primary-color)';
    };
    addBtn.onmouseout = function() {
        this.style.background = 'var(--input-bg)';
        this.style.borderColor = 'var(--border-color)';
    };

    addBtn.onclick = isStoryMode ? addNewLocalSlot : () => openCharacterSelection({ scope: 'current-group-add' });
    storageListEl.appendChild(addBtn);

    storageCast.forEach(bot => storageListEl.appendChild(renderItem(bot, false)));

    const headerImportBtn = document.getElementById('castHeaderImportBtn');
    if (headerImportBtn) {
        headerImportBtn.title = isStoryMode
            ? "Import a character file or link directly into this story cast"
            : "Import a character file or link directly into this chat's roster";

        const headerImportLabel = headerImportBtn.querySelector('span');
        if (headerImportLabel) {
            headerImportLabel.textContent = isStoryMode ? 'Import to Story' : 'Import Character';
        }
    }
}

/* --- INFINITE ROSTER HELPERS --- */

const FURAI_CHARACTER_SLOT_LIMIT = 50;

function hasInfiniteRosterUnlock() {
    return typeof AchievementManager !== 'undefined'
        && typeof AchievementManager.isUnlocked === 'function'
        && AchievementManager.isUnlocked('infinite_roster');
}

function getCharacterSlotLimit() {
    return hasInfiniteRosterUnlock() ? 9999 : FURAI_CHARACTER_SLOT_LIMIT;
}

function isDefaultSystemCharacterSlot(bot) {
    if (!bot) return false;

    const uid = String(bot.uid || '').trim();
    if (uid.startsWith('sys_')) return true;

    return Array.isArray(defaultBots) && defaultBots.some(defaultBot =>
        defaultBot?.uid && String(defaultBot.uid).trim() === uid
    );
}

function getCharacterSlotCount(roster) {
    if (!Array.isArray(roster)) return 0;

    // Count only additional manually added/imported/duplicated custom characters.
    // Built-in system characters and old Free Slot placeholders do not consume the 50 additional-character cap.
    return roster.filter(bot =>
        bot &&
        bot.localRosterDeleted !== true &&
        !isDefaultSystemCharacterSlot(bot)
    ).length;
}

function canAddCharacterSlotToRoster(roster, addCount = 1) {
    if (hasInfiniteRosterUnlock()) return true;

    const incomingCount = Math.max(1, Number(addCount) || 1);
    return getCharacterSlotCount(roster) + incomingCount <= FURAI_CHARACTER_SLOT_LIMIT;
}

function showCharacterSlotLimitToast() {
    showToast(`Additional custom character limit reached (${FURAI_CHARACTER_SLOT_LIMIT}). Unlock Infinite Roster to remove the limit.`, "error");
}

function canAddGlobalCharacterSlot(mode = 'group', addCount = 1) {
    const targetMode = mode === 'story' ? 'story' : 'group';
    const rosterKey = typeof getGlobalCastRosterKey === 'function'
        ? getGlobalCastRosterKey(targetMode)
        : 'globalBotRoster';

    let roster = [];
    try { roster = DB.get(rosterKey); } catch(e) {}
    if (!roster || roster.length === 0) roster = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaultBots));

    return canAddCharacterSlotToRoster(roster, addCount);
}

function addNewGlobalSlot(mode = currentGlobalTab) {
    const targetMode = mode === 'story' ? 'story' : 'group';
    const rosterKey = getGlobalCastRosterKey(targetMode);

    let roster = [];
    try { roster = DB.get(rosterKey); } catch(e){}
    if (!roster || roster.length === 0) {
        roster = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaultBots));

        if (targetMode === 'story') {
            roster.forEach(bot => {
                bot.inActiveCast = false;
                bot.isActive = false;
                delete bot.replyMode;
                delete bot.activeTimestamp;
            });
        }
    }

    if (!canAddCharacterSlotToRoster(roster)) {
        showCharacterSlotLimitToast();
        return false;
    }

    const newIdx = roster.length + 1;
    const masterMode = getSavedGlobalCastMode(targetMode);
    const libraryCreatedAt = Date.now();

    const newBot = {
        uid: generateUID('extra_slot'),
        name: `Extra Slot ${newIdx}`,
        libraryCreatedAt,
        timestamp: libraryCreatedAt,
        chatCount: 0,
        lastChattedAt: 0,
        avatar: pickFuraiStarterAvatar(),
        defaultSprite: '',
        instruction: 'This is an extra character slot.',
        isActive: false,
        inActiveCast: false,
        replyMode: masterMode
    };

    roster.push(newBot);
    DB.set(rosterKey, roster);

    isGlobalOfflineExpanded = true;
    renderGlobalContent(targetMode);
    showToast(targetMode === 'story'
        ? "New slot added to Story Cast pool!"
        : "New slot added to Global Roster!");

    return true;
}

function addNewLocalSlot() {
    if (!currentChatId) return;
    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    
    const personality = chatPersonalities[currentChatId];
    const masterMode = personality === 'story'
        ? getSavedGlobalCastMode('story')
        : getGlobalCastMode();

    if (!canAddCharacterSlotToRoster(profile.bots)) {
        showCharacterSlotLimitToast();
        return false;
    }

    const newIdx = profile.bots.length + 1;
    const newBot = {
        uid: generateUID('extra_slot'),
        name: `Extra Slot ${newIdx}`,
        avatar: pickFuraiStarterAvatar(),
        defaultSprite: '',
        instruction: 'This is an extra character slot.',
        isActive: false, 
        inActiveCast: false,
        replyMode: masterMode, // [FIX] Use Master Mode
        actorStartAfterMessageUid: getFuraiLastMessageUid(DB.get(currentChatId))
    };

    profile.bots.push(newBot);
    profile.profileCustomized = true;
    DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, profile);

    renderCastSwitchingModal();
    showToast("New slot added to this chat!");

    return true;
}

function isGroupRosterRoleBot(bot) {
    if (!bot) return false;

    const uid = String(bot.uid || '');

    if (uid.startsWith('sys_')) return true;

    return Array.isArray(defaultBots) && defaultBots.some(defaultBot =>
        defaultBot?.uid && defaultBot.uid === uid
    );
}

function canDeleteLocalGroupBot(bot) {
    if (!currentChatId || !bot) return false;

    const personality = chatPersonalities[currentChatId];
    if (personality !== 'group') return false;

    // Per-chat rule: Offline characters can always be removed locally.
    // No Legion check here. Global roster protection belongs in deleteGlobalBot().
    return bot.inActiveCast !== true;
}

function deleteLocalGroupBot(botIndex) {
    if (!currentChatId) return;

    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    const personality = chatPersonalities[currentChatId];

    if (!profile || personality !== 'group') {
        showToast("Local character deletion is only available in Group mode.", "error");
        return;
    }

    const bot = profile.bots?.[botIndex];
    if (!bot) return;

    if (!canDeleteLocalGroupBot(bot)) {
        showToast("Set this character Offline before deleting.", "error");
        return;
    }

    const displayBot = bot.rosterStub === true
        ? resolveGroupRosterStubForDisplay(bot, botIndex)
        : bot;
    const botName = displayBot?.name || 'this character';

    // Soft-delete only. Do not splice profile.bots, because old messages store botIndex.
    bot.localRosterDeleted = true;
    bot.inActiveCast = false;
    bot.isActive = false;
    delete bot.activeTimestamp;
    delete bot.replyMode;

    profile.profileCustomized = true;
    DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, profile);
    if (typeof syncFuraiIdleAnnouncementTimer === 'function') {
        syncFuraiIdleAnnouncementTimer(currentChatId);
    }

    renderCastSwitchingModal();
    renderGroupBotMenu();
    updateOnlineCount();

    showToast(`${botName} deleted from this chat.`, "success");
}

/* --- LOCAL ADD TO CAST --- */
function switchBotCast(botIndex) {
    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    const personality = chatPersonalities[currentChatId];
    const isStoryMode = personality === 'story';

    let bot = profile.bots[botIndex];
    if (!bot) return;

    const countableBots = isStoryMode ? profile.bots.slice(1) : profile.bots;
    const activeCount = countableBots.filter(b => b.inActiveCast).length;
    const limit = AchievementManager.getGroupLimit();
    const allowCastAnnouncements = areLocalCastAnnouncementsEnabled(profile);
    const wasGhostLurker = !isStoryMode && getBotChatStatus(bot) === 'silent';

    if (bot.inActiveCast) {
        bot.inActiveCast = false;
        bot.isActive = false;
        delete bot.activeTimestamp;

        if (!isStoryMode) {
            delete bot.replyMode;

            if (allowCastAnnouncements && !wasGhostLurker) {
                const statusMessage = `${bot.name || 'A bot'} has left the chat.`;
                const timestampMeta = makeMessageTimestampMeta(currentChatId);

                addMessage('system', statusMessage, null, null, timestampMeta);
                saveMessage(currentChatId, 'system', statusMessage, null, null, timestampMeta);
                setTimeout(() => sendMessage({ isAutoReply: true }), 500);
            }
        } else {
            bot.replyMode = getSavedGlobalCastMode('story');
        }

    } else {
        if (activeCount >= limit) {
            showToast(isStoryMode
                ? `Max ${limit} active cast members allowed.`
                : `Max ${limit} members allowed.`);
            return;
        }

        if (!isStoryMode && bot.rosterStub === true) {
            const hydrated = hydrateGroupRosterStub(profile, botIndex);

            if (!hydrated) return;
            bot = hydrated;
        }

        bot.inActiveCast = true;
        bot.isActive = isStoryMode ? false : true;
        bot.activeTimestamp = Date.now();

        const roomState = isStoryMode
            ? getSavedGlobalCastMode('story')
            : (profile.masterReplyMode || getGlobalCastMode());

        bot.replyMode = roomState;

        if (!isStoryMode) {
            const isGhostLurker = getBotChatStatus(bot) === 'silent';

            if (allowCastAnnouncements && !isGhostLurker) {
                const statusMessage = `${bot.name || 'A bot'} has joined the chat.`;
                const timestampMeta = makeMessageTimestampMeta(currentChatId);

                addMessage('system', statusMessage, null, null, timestampMeta);
                saveMessage(currentChatId, 'system', statusMessage, null, null, timestampMeta);
                setTimeout(() => sendMessage({ isAutoReply: true }), 500);
            }

            checkRosterSizeHint(activeCount + 1);
        }
    }

    profile.profileCustomized = true;
    DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, profile);
    if (!isStoryMode && typeof syncFuraiIdleAnnouncementTimer === 'function') {
        syncFuraiIdleAnnouncementTimer(currentChatId);
    }

    renderCastSwitchingModal();

    if (!isStoryMode) {
        renderGroupBotMenu();
        updateOnlineCount();
    }
}

// --- Profile Card Logic ---

function getFuraiRenderedPortraitOptions(img) {
    if (!img) return {};

    const url = String(
        img.getAttribute('src') ||
        img.currentSrc ||
        img.src ||
        ''
    ).trim();
    if (!url) return {};

    const isSprite =
        img.classList.contains('furai-chat-sprite') ||
        img.classList.contains('furai-home-sprite');

    return {
        renderedPortraitUrl: url,
        renderedPortraitIsSprite: isSprite,
        renderedPortraitFlipX:
            isSprite &&
            img.classList.contains('furai-chat-sprite') &&
            !!img.closest('#chatMessagesEl .message.user') &&
            !document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')
    };
}

function syncOpenProfileCardToRenderedPortrait(img, actor = {}) {
    if (!img) return;

    const cardModal = document.getElementById('profileCardModal');
    const cardImg = document.getElementById('pCardImg');
    if (!cardModal || !cardImg || getComputedStyle(cardModal).display === 'none') return;

    const actorUid = String(actor?.uid || '').trim();
    const cardActorUid = String(cardModal.dataset.actorUid || '').trim();
    if (!actorUid || !cardActorUid || actorUid !== cardActorUid) return;

    const rendered = getFuraiRenderedPortraitOptions(img);
    if (!rendered.renderedPortraitUrl) return;

    cardModal.classList.toggle(
        'furai-profile-card-sprite',
        rendered.renderedPortraitIsSprite === true
    );
    cardModal.classList.toggle(
        'furai-profile-card-flip-x',
        rendered.renderedPortraitFlipX === true
    );

    cardImg.onerror = () => {
        cardImg.style.display = 'none';
    };
    cardImg.style.display = 'block';
    cardImg.style.visibility = 'visible';

    if (cardImg.getAttribute('src') !== rendered.renderedPortraitUrl) {
        cardImg.src = rendered.renderedPortraitUrl;
    }
}

function getFuraiGlobalWandProfile() {
    const read = key => {
        try { return DB.get(key); } catch (error) { return undefined; }
    };

    let saved = {};
    try { saved = cloneFuraiData(read('global-group-enhancer-profile') || {}); } catch (error) {}

    const emotionSprites = read('global-group-enhancer-emotion-sprites') || saved.emotionSprites || {};
    const savedTag = read('global-group-enhancer-tag');

    return {
        ...saved,
        uid: read('global-group-enhancer-uid') || saved.uid || 'wand_global',
        name: read('global-group-enhancer-name') || saved.name || DEFAULT_WAND_DISPLAY_NAME,
        catalogTitle: DEFAULT_WAND_DISPLAY_NAME,
        avatar: read('global-group-enhancer-avatar') || saved.avatar || DEFAULT_WAND_AVATAR_URL,
        defaultSprite: read('global-group-enhancer-sprite') || saved.defaultSprite || emotionSprites.default || Object.values(emotionSprites)[0] || '',
        instruction: read('global-group-enhancer-inst') || saved.instruction || DEFAULT_ENHANCER_TEMPLATE,
        hashTag: savedTag ?? saved.hashTag ?? getFactoryWandTagFallback(savedTag),
        openingSystemMessage: read('global-group-enhancer-opening-system-message') || saved.openingSystemMessage || '',
        openingMessage: read('global-group-enhancer-opening') || saved.openingMessage || '',
        openingBackground: read('global-group-enhancer-opening-background') || saved.openingBackground || '',
        openingBackgroundOpacity: read('global-group-enhancer-opening-background-opacity') || saved.openingBackgroundOpacity || '1',
        openingBackgroundBlur: read('global-group-enhancer-opening-background-blur') || saved.openingBackgroundBlur || '0',
        openingLorebook: read('global-group-enhancer-opening-lorebook') || saved.openingLorebook || '',
        creatorNotes: read('global-group-enhancer-creator-notes') || saved.creatorNotes || '',
        customEmotions: read('global-group-enhancer-custom-emotions') || saved.customEmotions || {},
        emotionAvatars: read('global-group-enhancer-emotion-avatars') || saved.emotionAvatars || {},
        emotionSprites,
        chatCount: read('global-group-enhancer-chatCount') || saved.chatCount || 0,
        lastChattedAt: read('global-group-enhancer-lastChattedAt') || saved.lastChattedAt || 0
    };
}

function getResolvedWandProfileForChat(chatId = currentChatId) {
    let chatData = {};

    try {
        chatData = chatId ? (DB.get(chatId) || {}) : {};
    } catch (error) {
        chatData = {};
    }

    const globalWand = getFuraiGlobalWandProfile();

    return writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData({
        ...globalWand,
        name: chatData.enhancerName || globalWand.name,
        avatar: chatData.enhancerAvatar || globalWand.avatar,
        hashTag: chatData.enhancerTag || globalWand.hashTag,
        instruction: chatData.enhancerInst || globalWand.instruction,
        openingSystemMessage: chatData.enhancerOpeningSystemMessage || globalWand.openingSystemMessage,
        openingMessage: chatData.enhancerOpening || globalWand.openingMessage,
        openingBackground: chatData.enhancerOpeningBackground || globalWand.openingBackground,
        openingBackgroundOpacity: chatData.enhancerOpeningBackgroundOpacity || globalWand.openingBackgroundOpacity,
        openingBackgroundBlur: chatData.enhancerOpeningBackgroundBlur || globalWand.openingBackgroundBlur,
        openingLorebook: chatData.enhancerOpeningLorebook || globalWand.openingLorebook,
        creatorNotes: chatData.enhancerCreatorNotes || globalWand.creatorNotes,
        customEmotions: chatData.enhancerCustomEmotions || globalWand.customEmotions,
        emotionAvatars: chatData.enhancerEmotionAvatars || globalWand.emotionAvatars,
        emotionSprites: chatData.enhancerEmotionSprites || globalWand.emotionSprites,
        muted: chatData.enhancerMuted === true
    }, getFuraiResolvedWandProtectedInstructionData(chatData));
}

function resolveFreshProfileCardData(targetIndex, fallback = {}, options = {}) {
    if (options?.historicalActor) {
        const actor = options.historicalActor;
        const mode = currentChatId ? getStoredChatPersonality(currentChatId) : 'researcher';
        return {
            name: actor.name || fallback.name || 'Character',
            avatar: actor.avatar || fallback.avatar || '',
            description: actor.instructions?.[mode] || actor.instruction || fallback.description || '',
            hashTag: actor.hashTag || fallback.hashTag || '',
            actorUid: actor.uid || ''
        };
    }
    if (options?.source === 'exp-character' || targetIndex === null || targetIndex === undefined || !currentChatId) {
        return fallback;
    }

    const preferFallbackAvatar = options?.preferFallbackAvatar === true && !!fallback.avatar;

    try {
        const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
        const mode = getStoredChatPersonality(currentChatId);

        if (targetIndex === 'user') {
            const user = profile?.user || {};
            return {
                name: user.name || fallback.name || 'User',
                avatar: preferFallbackAvatar ? fallback.avatar : (user.avatar || fallback.avatar || ''),
                description: user.instructions?.[mode] || user.instruction || fallback.description || 'User',
                hashTag: user.hashTag || fallback.hashTag || '',
                actorUid: user.uid || ''
            };
        }

        if (targetIndex === 'wand' || targetIndex === 'narrator' || targetIndex === 'enhancer') {
            const wand = getResolvedWandProfileForChat(currentChatId);
            return {
                name: wand.name || fallback.name || WAND_EMPTY_FALLBACK_NAME,
                avatar: preferFallbackAvatar ? fallback.avatar : (wand.avatar || fallback.avatar),
                description: wand.instruction || fallback.description || 'Magic Wand',
                hashTag: wand.hashTag || fallback.hashTag || ''
            };
        }

        const botIndex = Number.parseInt(targetIndex, 10);

        if (Number.isInteger(botIndex) && botIndex >= 0) {
            let bot = profile?.bots?.[botIndex] || null;

            if (mode === 'group' && bot?.rosterStub === true) {
                bot = hydrateGroupRosterStub(profile, botIndex, { silent: true }) || bot;
            }

            if (bot) {
                return {
                    name: bot.name || fallback.name || 'AI',
                    avatar: preferFallbackAvatar ? fallback.avatar : (bot.avatar || fallback.avatar || ''),
                    description: bot.instruction || fallback.description || 'AI Character',
                    hashTag: bot.hashTag || fallback.hashTag || '',
                    actorUid: bot.uid || ''
                };
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Profile card refresh failed:', e);
    }

    return fallback;
}

function refreshProfileDependentUI(profileOverride = null) {
    if (!currentChatId) return;

    const personality = getStoredChatPersonality(currentChatId);
    const profile = profileOverride || getChatProfile(currentChatId);

    if (typeof updateMenuProfiles === 'function') updateMenuProfiles();

    if (personality === 'group' || personality === 'maker') {
        if (typeof renderGroupBotMenu === 'function') renderGroupBotMenu(profile);
        if (typeof updateOnlineCount === 'function') updateOnlineCount(profile);

        const onlineModal = document.getElementById('onlineListModal');
        if (onlineModal && onlineModal.style.display === 'block') {
            toggleOnlineList(true);
        }
    }

    if (typeof updateTokenButtonUI === 'function') updateTokenButtonUI();
}

let currentProfileCardTarget = null;
let currentProfileCardContext = null;

function handleProfileCardEdit(e) {
    e.stopPropagation();

    const editTarget = currentProfileCardTarget;
    const editContext = currentProfileCardContext;

    // Profile editors/previews are children of the ID card.
    // Keep the card (and any live inline comments iframe) mounted underneath.
    if (editContext && editContext.source === 'character-select') {
        openFuraiCharacterProfilePreview(editContext.sourceId);
        return;
    }
    if (editContext && editContext.source === 'exp-character') {
        openExpCharacterProfilePreview(editContext.item || null);
        return;
    }
    if (editContext && editContext.source === 'historical-actor') {
        openFuraiHistoricalActorEditor(editContext);
        return;
    }

    if (editTarget === 'user') {
        openUserProfileModal();
    } else if (editTarget === 'enhancer') {
        openEnhancerSettingsModal();
    } else if (editTarget !== null && editTarget !== undefined) {
        openBotProfileModal(editTarget);
    }
}

let furaiHistoricalEmotionContext = null;
let furaiHistoricalProfileEditContext = null;

function getFuraiHistoricalActorModalContext() {
    return furaiHistoricalProfileEditContext ? { ...furaiHistoricalProfileEditContext } : {};
}

function findFuraiCurrentActorTargetByUid(profile, role, actorUid) {
    const uid = String(actorUid || '').trim();
    if (!profile || !uid) return null;

    if (role === 'user') {
        return String(profile.user?.uid || '').trim() === uid
            ? { actor: profile.user, role: 'user', botIndex: null }
            : null;
    }

    const matches = (profile.bots || [])
        .map((actor, botIndex) => ({ actor, role: 'ai', botIndex }))
        .filter(record =>
            record.actor &&
            record.actor.localRosterDeleted !== true &&
            String(record.actor.uid || '').trim() === uid
        );

    return matches.length === 1 ? matches[0] : null;
}

function findFuraiHistoricalActorRecord(context = {}) {
    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    const role = context.role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'ai';
    const requestedBotIndex = role === 'ai' ? Number.parseInt(context.botIndex, 10) : null;
    const actorUid = String(context.actorUid || '').trim();
    if (!profile || !actorUid) return null;

    const current = findFuraiCurrentActorTargetByUid(profile, role, actorUid);
    if (current) {
        return {
            profile,
            lane: getFuraiRoleLane(profile, role, current.botIndex, false),
            actor: current.actor,
            role,
            botIndex: current.botIndex,
            active: true
        };
    }

    const requestedLane = getFuraiRoleLane(profile, role, requestedBotIndex, false);
    const requestedActor = requestedLane?.retired?.find(
        item => String(item?.uid || '').trim() === actorUid
    ) || null;

    if (requestedActor) {
        return {
            profile,
            lane: requestedLane,
            actor: requestedActor,
            role,
            botIndex: requestedBotIndex,
            active: false
        };
    }

    const retiredMatches = [];
    if (role === 'user') {
        const lane = getFuraiRoleLane(profile, 'user', null, false);
        (lane?.retired || []).forEach(actor => {
            if (String(actor?.uid || '').trim() === actorUid) {
                retiredMatches.push({ lane, actor, botIndex: null });
            }
        });
    } else {
        Object.entries(profile.roleHistory?.bots || {}).forEach(([index, lane]) => {
            (lane?.retired || []).forEach(actor => {
                if (String(actor?.uid || '').trim() === actorUid) {
                    retiredMatches.push({ lane, actor, botIndex: Number(index) });
                }
            });
        });
    }

    if (retiredMatches.length !== 1) return null;
    return {
        profile,
        lane: retiredMatches[0].lane,
        actor: retiredMatches[0].actor,
        role,
        botIndex: retiredMatches[0].botIndex,
        active: false
    };
}

function applyFuraiProfileEditorFieldsToActor(sourceActor, role) {
    if (!sourceActor) return null;

    const actor = cloneFuraiData(sourceActor);
    const mode = getStoredChatPersonality(currentChatId);
    const isUser = role === 'user';
    const modalId = isUser ? 'userProfileModalEl' : 'botProfileModalEl';
    const modal = document.getElementById(modalId);

    if (!modal || modal.style.display === 'none') return actor;

    const prefix = isUser ? 'user' : 'bot';
    actor.name = document.getElementById(`${prefix}NameInput`)?.value.trim() || actor.name || (isUser ? 'User' : 'Character');
    actor.avatar = document.getElementById(`${prefix}AvatarInput`)?.value.trim() || '';
    actor.defaultSprite = document.getElementById(`${prefix}SpriteInput`)?.value.trim() || '';
    actor.hashTag = getFuraiTagInputValue(`${prefix}TagInput`);

    const publicInst = document.getElementById(`${prefix}InstructionInput`)?.value.trim() || '';
    const secretInst = document.getElementById(`${prefix}SecretInput`)?.value.trim() || '';
    const finalInstruction = secretInst
        ? `${publicInst}\n\n[SECRET]\n${secretInst}\n[/SECRET]`
        : publicInst;

    if (isUser) {
        actor.instructions = cloneFuraiData(actor.instructions || {});
        actor.instructions[mode] = finalInstruction;
        const protectedData = readFuraiProtectedInstructionEditorData(
            'userProtectedInstructionHost',
            actor
        );
        if (!protectedData) return null;
        writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(actor, protectedData);
    } else {
        actor.instruction = finalInstruction;
        const protectedData = readFuraiProtectedInstructionEditorData(
            'botProtectedInstructionHost',
            actor
        );
        if (!protectedData) return null;
        writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(actor, protectedData);
    }

    const opening = document.getElementById(`${prefix}OpeningInput`)?.value.trim() || '';
    if (opening) actor.openingMessage = opening;
    else delete actor.openingMessage;

    writeCharacterOpeningExtras(
        actor,
        readCharacterOpeningExtrasFromDomOrProfile(`${prefix}NameInput`, actor)
    );

    return actor;
}

function getFuraiHistoricalActorDraft(record) {
    if (!record?.actor) return null;
    return applyFuraiProfileEditorFieldsToActor(record.actor, record.role);
}

function getFuraiCurrentProfileActorDraft(role) {
    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    if (!profile) return null;

    if (role === 'user') {
        return applyFuraiProfileEditorFieldsToActor(profile.user, 'user');
    }

    const index = Number.parseInt(document.getElementById('editingBotIndex')?.value, 10);
    if (!Number.isInteger(index) || index < 0) return null;

    if (
        getStoredChatPersonality(currentChatId) === 'group' &&
        profile?.bots?.[index]?.rosterStub === true
    ) {
        hydrateGroupRosterStub(profile, index, { silent: true });
    }

    return applyFuraiProfileEditorFieldsToActor(profile?.bots?.[index], 'ai');
}

function saveFuraiHistoricalActorFromRegularEditor(expectedRole) {
    const context = getFuraiHistoricalActorModalContext();
    const record = findFuraiHistoricalActorRecord(context);
    if (!record || record.role !== expectedRole) return false;

    const draft = getFuraiHistoricalActorDraft(record);
    if (!draft) return false;

    const start = record.actor.startAfterMessageUid || '';
    const end = record.actor.endAfterMessageUid || '';
    Object.keys(record.actor).forEach(key => delete record.actor[key]);
    Object.assign(record.actor, draft, { startAfterMessageUid: start, endAfterMessageUid: end });

    DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, record.profile);
    rerenderVisibleMessagesFromDatabase({ preserveScroll: true, preserveVnTarget: true });
    showToast('Historical character version updated.', 'success');
    return true;
}

function openFuraiHistoricalActorEmotionEditor() {
    const context = getFuraiHistoricalActorModalContext();
    const record = findFuraiHistoricalActorRecord(context);
    if (!record) {
        showToast('Historical character data is unavailable.', 'error');
        return;
    }

    furaiHistoricalEmotionContext = context;
    openEmotionEditor(record.actor.uid || context.actorUid, 'historical');
}

function saveFuraiActorDraftToLibrary(actor, role) {
    if (!actor) {
        showToast('Character data is unavailable.', 'error');
        return false;
    }

    let roster = DB.get('globalBotRoster');
    if (!Array.isArray(roster) || roster.length === 0) roster = cloneFuraiData(defaultBots || []);
    if (!canAddCharacterSlotToRoster(roster)) {
        showCharacterSlotLimitToast();
        return false;
    }

    const mode = getStoredChatPersonality(currentChatId);
    const saved = cleanFuraiLibraryCardMetadata(actor);
    saved.instruction = role === 'user'
        ? (actor.instructions?.[mode] ?? actor.instruction ?? '')
        : (actor.instruction || '');
    delete saved.instructions;

    [
        'startAfterMessageUid', 'endAfterMessageUid', 'actorStartAfterMessageUid',
        'historicalActor', 'historicalFallback', 'historicalAbsent', 'localRosterDeleted',
        'rosterStub', 'sourceRosterIndex', 'sourceRosterUid'
    ].forEach(key => delete saved[key]);

    saved.uid = generateUID('roster_bot');
    saved.sourceLibraryUid = saved.uid;
    saved.libraryCreatedAt = Date.now();
    saved.chatCount = 0;
    saved.lastChattedAt = 0;
    saved.isActive = false;
    saved.inActiveCast = false;
    saved.replyMode = 'auto';

    roster.push(saved);
    DB.set('globalBotRoster', roster);
    refreshCharactersGridIfOpen();
    showToast(`${saved.name || 'Character'} saved to Character Library.`, 'success');
    return true;
}

function saveFuraiProfileActorToLibrary(role) {
    const normalizedRole = role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'ai';
    const context = getFuraiHistoricalActorModalContext();
    const historicalRecord = findFuraiHistoricalActorRecord(context);

    if (historicalRecord?.role === normalizedRole) {
        const historicalDraft = getFuraiHistoricalActorDraft(historicalRecord) || cloneFuraiData(historicalRecord.actor);
        return saveFuraiActorDraftToLibrary(historicalDraft, normalizedRole);
    }

    const currentDraft = getFuraiCurrentProfileActorDraft(normalizedRole);
    return saveFuraiActorDraftToLibrary(currentDraft, normalizedRole);
}

function saveFuraiHistoricalActorToLibrary() {
    const context = getFuraiHistoricalActorModalContext();
    const record = findFuraiHistoricalActorRecord(context);
    if (!record) {
        showToast('Historical character data is unavailable.', 'error');
        return false;
    }

    return saveFuraiProfileActorToLibrary(record.role);
}

function shareFuraiHistoricalActor(btnEl) {
    const context = getFuraiHistoricalActorModalContext();
    const record = findFuraiHistoricalActorRecord(context);
    if (!record) {
        showToast('Historical character data is unavailable.', 'error');
        return;
    }

    const actor = getFuraiHistoricalActorDraft(record) || cloneFuraiData(record.actor);
    const mode = getStoredChatPersonality(currentChatId);
    const instruction = record.role === 'user'
        ? (actor.instructions?.[mode] ?? actor.instruction ?? '')
        : (actor.instruction || '');

    const fields = {
        furaiHistoricalShareName: actor.name || 'Historical Character',
        furaiHistoricalShareTag: actor.hashTag || '',
        furaiHistoricalShareAvatar: actor.avatar || '',
        furaiHistoricalShareSprite: actor.defaultSprite || '',
        furaiHistoricalShareInst: instruction,
        furaiHistoricalShareOpening: actor.openingMessage || actor.customGreeting || actor.greeting || actor.initialMessage || ''
    };

    Object.entries(fields).forEach(([id, value]) => {
        let input = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!input) {
            input = id.endsWith('Inst') || id.endsWith('Opening')
                ? document.createElement('textarea')
                : document.createElement('input');
            input.id = id;
            input.style.display = 'none';
            document.body.appendChild(input);
        }
        input.value = value;
    });

    window.furaiHistoricalShareActor = actor;
    openShareMenu(btnEl, 'furaiHistoricalShareName', 'furaiHistoricalShareAvatar', 'furaiHistoricalShareInst');
    const shareModal = document.getElementById('shareOptionsModal');
    if (shareModal) shareModal.style.zIndex = '4580';
}

function openFuraiHistoricalActorEditor(context = {}) {
    const record = findFuraiHistoricalActorRecord(context);
    if (!record) {
        showToast('This historical version can be viewed, but its original profile data is unavailable.', 'error');
        return;
    }

    if (record.active) {
        if (record.role === 'user') openUserProfileModal();
        else openBotProfileModal(record.botIndex);
        return;
    }

    const normalizedContext = {
        actorUid: record.actor.uid || context.actorUid || '',
        role: record.role,
        botIndex: record.botIndex
    };

    if (record.role === 'user') openUserProfileModal({ historicalContext: normalizedContext });
    else openBotProfileModal(record.botIndex, { historicalContext: normalizedContext });
}

function normalizeProfileCardDescription(value) {
    return String(value || "")
        .replace(/&lt;br\s*\/?&gt;/gi, "\n")
        .replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, "\n")
        .replace(/\r\n/g, "\n")
        .replace(/\r/g, "\n")
        .replace(/\n[ \t]+\n/g, "\n\n")
        .replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n")
        .trim();
}


function resetProfileCardLayoutState() {
    const cardModal = document.getElementById('profileCardModal');
    const descEl = document.getElementById('pCardDesc');
    const contentEl = cardModal ? cardModal.querySelector('.p-card-content') : null;
    const cardEl = cardModal ? cardModal.querySelector('.profile-card') : null;

    const clearStyles = (el, props) => {
        if (!el) return;
        props.forEach(prop => {
            try { el.style[prop] = ''; } catch (e) {}
        });
    };

    clearStyles(cardEl, [
        'display',
        'flexDirection',
        'minHeight',
        'maxHeight',
        'height',
        'overflow',
        'overflowY',
        'overflowX'
    ]);

    clearStyles(contentEl, [
        'display',
        'flexDirection',
        'minHeight',
        'maxHeight',
        'height',
        'overflow',
        'overflowY',
        'overflowX'
    ]);

    clearStyles(descEl, [
        'display',
        'webkitLineClamp',
        'webkitBoxOrient',
        'overflow',
        'overflowY',
        'overflowX',
        'webkitOverflowScrolling',
        'overscrollBehavior',
        'touchAction',
        'minHeight',
        'maxHeight',
        'height',
        'flex',
        'paddingRight',
        'textOverflow'
    ]);
}

function repairExpCharacterIdCardScroll() {
    const cardModal = document.getElementById('profileCardModal');
    const descEl = document.getElementById('pCardDesc');
    const contentEl = cardModal ? cardModal.querySelector('.p-card-content') : null;
    const cardEl = cardModal ? cardModal.querySelector('.profile-card') : null;

    if (!cardModal || !descEl || !cardModal.classList.contains('exp-character-id-card')) return;

    if (cardEl) {
        cardEl.style.display = 'flex';
        cardEl.style.flexDirection = 'column';
        cardEl.style.minHeight = '0';
        cardEl.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }

    if (contentEl) {
        contentEl.style.display = 'flex';
        contentEl.style.flexDirection = 'column';
        contentEl.style.minHeight = '0';
        contentEl.style.maxHeight = '100%';
    }

    descEl.style.display = 'block';
    descEl.style.webkitLineClamp = 'unset';
    descEl.style.webkitBoxOrient = 'initial';
    descEl.style.overflowY = 'auto';
    descEl.style.overflowX = 'hidden';
    descEl.style.webkitOverflowScrolling = 'touch';
    descEl.style.overscrollBehavior = 'contain';
    descEl.style.touchAction = 'pan-y';
    descEl.style.minHeight = '0';

    if (cardModal.classList.contains('exp-inline-comments-active')) {
        descEl.style.flex = '1 1 auto';
        descEl.style.maxHeight = 'none';
    } else if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 768px)').matches) {
        descEl.style.flex = '0 1 auto';
        descEl.style.maxHeight = 'min(230px, 34dvh)';
    } else {
        descEl.style.flex = '0 1 auto';
        descEl.style.maxHeight = 'min(260px, 42dvh)';
    }
}

function setProfileCardCueSaveState(state = 'clean') {
    const saveBtn = document.getElementById('pCardCueSaveBtn');
    if (!saveBtn) return;

    const isDirty = state === 'dirty';
    const isSaved = state === 'saved';
    saveBtn.disabled = !isDirty;
    saveBtn.style.opacity = isDirty ? '1' : '0.62';
    saveBtn.style.cursor = isDirty ? 'pointer' : 'default';
    saveBtn.innerHTML = isSaved
        ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i><span>Saved</span>'
        : '<i class="fa-solid fa-floppy-disk"></i><span>Save Cue</span>';
}

function saveProfileCardOneTimeCue() {
    const cardModal = document.getElementById('profileCardModal');
    const cueInput = document.getElementById('pCardCueInput');
    if (!cardModal || !cueInput) return;

    const chatId = String(cardModal.dataset.cueChatId || '').trim();
    const cueRole = cardModal.dataset.cueRole === 'user' ? 'user' : 'ai';
    const actorUid = String(cardModal.dataset.cueActorUid || '').trim();
    const fallbackBotIndex = Number(cardModal.dataset.cueBotIndex);

    if (!chatId) return;

    const profile = getChatProfile(chatId);
    if (!profile) return;

    let targetEntity = null;
    let resolvedBotIndex = null;

    if (cueRole === 'user') {
        targetEntity = profile.user || null;
    } else {
        if (actorUid) {
            resolvedBotIndex = profile.bots?.findIndex(bot => String(bot?.uid || '').trim() === actorUid) ?? -1;
        }

        if (!Number.isInteger(resolvedBotIndex) || resolvedBotIndex < 0) {
            resolvedBotIndex = Number.isInteger(fallbackBotIndex) && fallbackBotIndex >= 0
                ? fallbackBotIndex
                : -1;
        }

        targetEntity = resolvedBotIndex >= 0 ? profile.bots?.[resolvedBotIndex] || null : null;

        if (
            targetEntity?.rosterStub === true &&
            getStoredChatPersonality(chatId) === 'group'
        ) {
            targetEntity = hydrateGroupRosterStub(profile, resolvedBotIndex);
        }
    }

    if (!targetEntity) {
        showToast('This character is no longer available.', 'error');
        return;
    }

    const cueText = cueInput.value;
    if (cueText.trim()) targetEntity.tempCue = cueText;
    else delete targetEntity.tempCue;

    DB.set(`profile-${chatId}`, profile);
    setProfileCardCueSaveState('saved');
    closeProfileCard();
}

function resolveFuraiProfileCardPortraitActor(targetIndex, options = {}) {
    if (options?.historicalActor) return options.historicalActor;
    if (!currentChatId || targetIndex === null || targetIndex === undefined) return null;

    try {
        const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
        if (!profile) return null;

        if (targetIndex === 'user') return profile.user || null;
        if (targetIndex === 'wand' || targetIndex === 'narrator' || targetIndex === 'enhancer') {
            return getResolvedWandProfileForChat(currentChatId);
        }

        const botIndex = Number.parseInt(targetIndex, 10);
        if (!Number.isInteger(botIndex) || botIndex < 0) return null;

        let bot = profile.bots?.[botIndex] || null;
        if (getStoredChatPersonality(currentChatId) === 'group' && bot?.rosterStub === true) {
            bot = hydrateGroupRosterStub(profile, botIndex, { silent: true }) || bot;
        }
        return bot;
    } catch (error) {
        console.warn('Profile card sprite lookup failed:', error);
        return null;
    }
}

function openProfileCard(name, avatar, description, hashTag = "", targetIndex = null, extraHtml = "", options = {}) {
    const cardModal = document.getElementById('profileCardModal');
    const imgEl = document.getElementById('pCardImg');
    const bgEl = document.getElementById('pCardBgImg');
    const nameEl = document.getElementById('pCardName');
    const descEl = document.getElementById('pCardDesc');
    const tagsEl = document.getElementById('pCardTags');
    const extraEl = document.getElementById('pCardExtra');
    const editBtn = document.getElementById('pCardEditBtn');
    const cueWrapper = document.getElementById('pCardCueWrapper');
    const cueInput = document.getElementById('pCardCueInput');
    if (!cardModal || !imgEl || !nameEl || !descEl) return;

    const isExpCharacterIdCard = options?.source === 'exp-character';
    const isSelectionCharacterIdCard = options?.source === 'character-select';
    const useExpandedCharacterIdCard = isExpCharacterIdCard || isSelectionCharacterIdCard;

    // Fresh open: clear old card state first, especially EXP inline layout and cue handlers.
    hideExpProfileInlineComments();
    resetProfileCardLayoutState();
    cardModal.classList.remove(
        'exp-character-id-card',
        'exp-inline-comments-active',
        'furai-profile-card-sprite',
        'furai-profile-card-flip-x'
    );
    imgEl.removeAttribute('src');
    imgEl.style.display = 'none';
    nameEl.textContent = '';
    if (tagsEl) tagsEl.innerHTML = '';
    descEl.textContent = '';
    descEl.classList.remove('p-card-desc-long');
    if (extraEl) {
        extraEl.innerHTML = '';
        extraEl.style.display = 'none';
    }
    if (cueWrapper) cueWrapper.style.display = 'none';
    delete cardModal.dataset.cueChatId;
    delete cardModal.dataset.cueRole;
    delete cardModal.dataset.cueActorUid;
    delete cardModal.dataset.cueBotIndex;
    if (cueInput) {
        cueInput.value = '';
        cueInput.oninput = null;
    }
    setProfileCardCueSaveState('clean');

    let historicalActorTarget = options?.historicalActorTarget || null;
    if ((targetIndex === null || targetIndex === undefined) && historicalActorTarget && currentChatId) {
        const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
        const currentActor = findFuraiCurrentActorTargetByUid(
            profile,
            historicalActorTarget.role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'ai',
            historicalActorTarget.actorUid
        );

        if (currentActor) {
            targetIndex = currentActor.role === 'user' ? 'user' : currentActor.botIndex;
            historicalActorTarget = null;
        } else if (!findFuraiHistoricalActorRecord(historicalActorTarget)) {
            // An off-mode snapshot can still be viewed, but it is not a live or
            // editable character in the current workspace. Hide Edit instead of
            // offering an action that can only fail with “original unavailable”.
            historicalActorTarget = null;
        }
    }

    const freshCardData = resolveFreshProfileCardData(targetIndex, {
        name,
        avatar,
        description,
        hashTag
    }, options);

    name = freshCardData.name;
    avatar = freshCardData.avatar;
    description = freshCardData.description;
    hashTag = freshCardData.hashTag;
    const nextActorUid = String(
        freshCardData.actorUid ||
        options?.historicalActor?.uid ||
        ''
    ).trim();
    cardModal.dataset.actorUid = nextActorUid;

    const renderedPortraitUrl = String(options?.renderedPortraitUrl || '').trim();
    const hasRenderedPortrait = !!renderedPortraitUrl;
    const profileCardActor = hasRenderedPortrait
        ? null
        : resolveFuraiProfileCardPortraitActor(targetIndex, options);
    const useSpriteCardPortrait =
        !hasRenderedPortrait &&
        !useExpandedCharacterIdCard &&
        !document.body.classList.contains('vn-active') &&
        furaiAvatarSizeMode === 'sprite' &&
        !!profileCardActor;

    const resolvedCardPortrait = hasRenderedPortrait
        ? {
            url: renderedPortraitUrl,
            fallbackUrl: '',
            isSprite: options?.renderedPortraitIsSprite === true,
            flipX: options?.renderedPortraitFlipX === true
        }
        : (useSpriteCardPortrait
            ? {
                ...getFuraiChatPortrait(profileCardActor, options?.portraitEmotion || ''),
                flipX: targetIndex === 'user'
            }
            : {
                url: avatar || '',
                fallbackUrl: '',
                isSprite: false,
                flipX: false
            });

    const cardAvatar = resolvedCardPortrait.url || '';

    cardModal.classList.toggle('exp-character-id-card', useExpandedCharacterIdCard);
    cardModal.classList.toggle('furai-profile-card-sprite', !!resolvedCardPortrait.isSprite);
    cardModal.classList.toggle(
        'furai-profile-card-flip-x',
        !!resolvedCardPortrait.isSprite && !!resolvedCardPortrait.flipX
    );
    currentProfileCardContext = isSelectionCharacterIdCard
        ? { source: 'character-select', sourceId: String(options?.sourceId ?? '') }
        : (isExpCharacterIdCard
            ? { source: 'exp-character', item: options?.expCommentItem || null }
            : (historicalActorTarget
                ? { source: 'historical-actor', ...historicalActorTarget }
                : null));

    if (isExpCharacterIdCard && options?.expCommentItem) {
        showExpProfileInlineComments(options.expCommentItem);
    }

    if (bgEl) {
        bgEl.src = useExpandedCharacterIdCard ? cardAvatar : "";
        bgEl.style.display = useExpandedCharacterIdCard ? 'block' : 'none';
    }

    // Store target for the Edit / Preview button.
    currentProfileCardTarget = targetIndex;
    if (editBtn) {
        const previewOnly = isExpCharacterIdCard || isSelectionCharacterIdCard;
        const canOpenProfileTool = previewOnly || currentProfileCardContext?.source === 'historical-actor' || (targetIndex !== null && targetIndex !== undefined);
        editBtn.style.display = canOpenProfileTool ? 'flex' : 'none';
        editBtn.title = previewOnly ? 'Preview Profile' : 'Edit Profile';
        editBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', editBtn.title);
        editBtn.innerHTML = previewOnly
            ? '<i class="fa-regular fa-address-card"></i>'
            : '<i class="fa-solid fa-pen"></i>';
    }

    // 1. Populate Data
    imgEl.style.visibility = 'visible';

    applyFuraiPreloadedPortraitSource(imgEl, cardAvatar, resolvedCardPortrait.fallbackUrl, {
        onPending: (hasCurrentImage) => {
            if (!hasCurrentImage) imgEl.style.display = 'none';
        },
        onShow: () => {
            imgEl.style.display = 'block';
        },
        onFail: () => {
            imgEl.style.display = 'none';
        }
    });

    // --- One-Time Cue LOGIC ---
    if (cueWrapper && cueInput) {
        if (targetIndex !== null && currentChatId) {
            const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
            let targetEntity = null;
            let targetBotIndex = null;

            // FIX: Support both 'user' string and numeric bot indexes
            if (targetIndex === 'user') {
                targetEntity = profile.user;
            } else {
                const parsedIndex = parseInt(targetIndex, 10);
                if (!isNaN(parsedIndex)) {
                    targetBotIndex = parsedIndex;
                    targetEntity = profile.bots[parsedIndex];
                }
            }

            if (targetEntity) {
                cueWrapper.style.display = 'block';
                cueInput.value = targetEntity.tempCue || "";

                cardModal.dataset.cueChatId = currentChatId;
                cardModal.dataset.cueRole = targetIndex === 'user' ? 'user' : 'ai';
                cardModal.dataset.cueActorUid = String(targetEntity.uid || '').trim();
                cardModal.dataset.cueBotIndex = targetBotIndex === null ? '' : String(targetBotIndex);

                // Keep typing entirely local. One DB write happens only when Save Cue is pressed.
                cueInput.oninput = () => setProfileCardCueSaveState('dirty');
                setProfileCardCueSaveState('clean');

                // Trigger the one-time hint
                if (!localStorage.getItem('furai_hint_temp_cue')) {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        showOverlayHint(`
                            <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; text-align:left;">
                                <span style="font-size:12px; opacity:0.9; margin-top:4px;">Type a one-time instruction here. It will guide this character's NEXT reply.</span>
                            </div>
                        `, 6000);
                        localStorage.setItem('furai_hint_temp_cue', 'true');
                    }, 400);
                }
            }
        }
