    }
    // ----------------------------

    nameEl.textContent = name || "Unknown";

    // The profile card is now a normal UI translation root so its controls,
    // labels, hints, and tooltips can be localized. Keep actual profile data
    // protected by default, then selectively expose Expansion Pass metadata.
    nameEl.setAttribute('data-furai-no-translate', '');

    if (tagsEl) {
        tagsEl.removeAttribute('data-furai-ui-translate');
        tagsEl.removeAttribute('data-furai-no-translate');
        tagsEl.setAttribute(
            isExpCharacterIdCard ? 'data-furai-ui-translate' : 'data-furai-no-translate',
            ''
        );
    }

    descEl.removeAttribute('data-furai-ui-translate-long');
    descEl.removeAttribute('data-furai-no-translate');
    descEl.setAttribute(
        isExpCharacterIdCard ? 'data-furai-ui-translate-long' : 'data-furai-no-translate',
        ''
    );

    if (extraEl) {
        extraEl.removeAttribute('data-furai-no-translate');
        if (!isExpCharacterIdCard) extraEl.setAttribute('data-furai-no-translate', '');
    }

    if (tagsEl) {
        const characterSearchInput = document.getElementById('charsSearchInput');
        const characterSearchAvailable = !!characterSearchInput && characterSearchInput.getClientRects().length > 0;
        tagsEl.innerHTML = createFuraiTagChipsHTML(hashTag, {
            searchKind: characterSearchAvailable ? 'character' : '',
            className: 'furai-profile-tag-chips'
        });
    }

    if (extraEl) {
        extraEl.innerHTML = extraHtml || "";
        extraEl.style.display = extraHtml ? 'block' : 'none';
    }

    // Fallback if description is empty
    const cleanProfileDesc = String(description || "").trim();
    const profileDescLines = cleanProfileDesc.split('\n').map(line => line.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    const hasRealParagraphBreaks = /\n\s*\n/.test(cleanProfileDesc);

    const isLongProfileDesc =
        cleanProfileDesc.length > 420 ||
        hasRealParagraphBreaks ||
        profileDescLines.length > 4;

    descEl.textContent = cleanProfileDesc || "No description available.";
    descEl.classList.toggle('p-card-desc-long', isLongProfileDesc);

    // 2. Show through the shared stack so callers inside another modal become children.
    if (typeof openModalLayer === 'function') {
        openModalLayer(cardModal, { parent: options?.parent || null });
    } else {
        cardModal.style.display = 'flex';
    }

    initFuraiDynamicTagLayouts(cardModal);

    if (furaiUiLanguage.language !== 'en') {
        // Scan the whole side card after it is opened. Expansion Pass metadata
        // is explicitly exposed above; comments and ordinary/local profile data
        // remain protected by data-furai-no-translate.
        requestAnimationFrame(() => scheduleFuraiUiScan(cardModal));
    }

    if (useExpandedCharacterIdCard) {
        repairExpCharacterIdCardScroll();
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            repairExpCharacterIdCardScroll();
            requestAnimationFrame(repairExpCharacterIdCardScroll);
        });
    }
}

function closeProfileCard() {
    const cardModal = document.getElementById('profileCardModal');
    if (!cardModal) return;

    currentProfileCardTarget = null;
    currentProfileCardContext = null;

    if (typeof closeModalLayer === 'function') {
        closeModalLayer(cardModal);
    } else {
        cardModal.style.display = 'none';
    }

    cardModal.classList.remove(
        'exp-character-id-card',
        'exp-inline-comments-active',
        'furai-profile-card-sprite',
        'furai-profile-card-flip-x'
    );
    const profileCardImg = document.getElementById('pCardImg');
    if (profileCardImg) {
        profileCardImg.removeAttribute('src');
        profileCardImg.style.display = 'none';
        profileCardImg.style.visibility = 'visible';
    }
    hideExpProfileInlineComments();
    resetProfileCardLayoutState();
}

let expProfilePreviewOpenToken = 0;
window.expProfilePreviewData = null;

function getExpCharacterPreviewFallbackData(item = {}) {
    return {
        name: item?.title || 'Character',
        hashTag: item?.hashTag || '',
        avatar: item?.img || '',
        defaultSprite: item?.defaultSprite || item?.sprite || '',
        instruction: item?.previewText || item?.desc || '',
        openingSystemMessage: '',
        openingMessage: '',
        openingBackground: '',
        creatorNotes: '',
        creator_notes: '',
        openingLorebook: item?.openingLorebook || '',
        customEmotions: {},
        emotionAvatars: {},
        emotionSprites: {}
    };
}

function setExpPreviewValue(id, value) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) el.value = id === 'expPreviewTagInput' ? getFuraiTagInputDisplayValue(value) : (value || '');
}

function setExpPreviewImage(id, url, fallbackUrl = '') {
    const img = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!img) return;

    const cleanUrl = String(url || '').trim();
    const displayUrl = cleanUrl || fallbackUrl || '';
    img.src = displayUrl;
    img.style.display = displayUrl ? 'block' : 'none';

    const slot = img.closest('[data-exp-preview-media-slot]');
    if (slot) slot.style.display = displayUrl ? 'flex' : 'none';
}

function splitExpPreviewSecretBlocks(text = '') {
    const raw = String(text || '');
    const secretMatches = Array.from(raw.matchAll(/\[SECRET\]([\s\S]*?)\[\/SECRET\]/gi));

    return {
        publicText: raw
            .replace(/\[SECRET\]([\s\S]*?)\[\/SECRET\]/gi, '')
            .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
            .trim(),
        secretText: secretMatches
            .map(match => (match[1] || '').trim())
            .filter(Boolean)
            .join('\n\n')
    };
}

function getExpProfileEmotionDisplayLabel(key) {
    const rawKey = String(key || '');
    const isDefaultEmotion =
        typeof DEFAULT_EMOTION_KEYWORDS !== 'undefined' &&
        Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(DEFAULT_EMOTION_KEYWORDS, rawKey);

    return isDefaultEmotion
        ? rawKey.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + rawKey.slice(1)
        : rawKey;
}

function renderExpProfilePreviewEmotionOptions(data) {
    const select = document.getElementById('expPreviewEmotionSelect');
    if (!select) return;

    const emotionKeys = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    const appendKeys = (source) => {
        Object.keys(source || {}).forEach(key => {
            if (key.toLowerCase() === 'default' || seen.has(key)) return;
            seen.add(key);
            emotionKeys.push(key);
        });
    };

    appendKeys(data?.customEmotions);
    appendKeys(data?.emotionAvatars);
    appendKeys(data?.emotionSprites);

    select.replaceChildren();

    const defaultOption = document.createElement('option');
    defaultOption.value = '';
    defaultOption.textContent = 'Default';
    select.appendChild(defaultOption);

    emotionKeys.forEach(key => {
        const option = document.createElement('option');
        option.value = key;
        option.textContent = getExpProfileEmotionDisplayLabel(key);
        select.appendChild(option);
    });

    select.value = '';
}
function populateExpProfilePreviewModal(data) {
    const profileData = data || getExpCharacterPreviewFallbackData();
    const avatarUrl = profileData.avatar || '';
    const spriteUrl = profileData.defaultSprite || '';
    const instructionParts = splitExpPreviewSecretBlocks(profileData.instruction || '');
    const instructionText = instructionParts.publicText;

    setExpPreviewImage('expPreviewAvatarPreview', avatarUrl);
    setExpPreviewImage('expPreviewSpritePreview', spriteUrl);

    setExpPreviewValue('expPreviewNameInput', profileData.name || 'Character');
    setExpPreviewValue('expPreviewTagInput', profileData.hashTag || '');
    setExpPreviewValue('expPreviewInstInput', instructionText);
    setExpPreviewValue('expPreviewSecretInput', instructionParts.secretText);
    renderFuraiProtectedInstructionPreview('expPreviewProtectedInstructionHost', profileData);
    setExpPreviewValue('expPreviewOpeningSystemInput', getCharacterOpeningSystemMessage(profileData));
    setExpPreviewValue('expPreviewOpeningInput', profileData.openingMessage || '');
    setExpPreviewImage('expPreviewOpeningBgPreview', profileData.openingBackground || profileData.customBackground || '');
    const openingLoreParts = splitFuraiLoreInstructions(
        profileData.openingLorebook || profileData.dedicatedLorebook || profileData.customLorebook || ''
    );
    setExpPreviewValue('expPreviewOpeningLorebookInput', openingLoreParts.publicText);
    setExpPreviewValue('expPreviewOpeningLoreInstructionsInput', openingLoreParts.hiddenText);
    setExpPreviewValue('expPreviewCreatorNotesInput', mergeFuraiPublicTextAliases(profileData.creatorNotes, profileData.creator_notes));

    const lorebookCountEl = document.getElementById('expPreviewOpeningLorebookCount');
    if (lorebookCountEl) {
        const lorebookWordCount = [openingLoreParts.publicText, openingLoreParts.hiddenText]
            .join(' ')
            .trim()
            .split(/\s+/)
            .filter(Boolean).length;
        lorebookCountEl.textContent = `${lorebookWordCount} words`;
    }

    const countEl = document.getElementById('expPreviewInstCount');
    if (countEl) {
        const wordCount = [instructionText, instructionParts.secretText]
            .join(' ')
            .trim()
            .split(/\s+/)
            .filter(Boolean)
            .length;
        countEl.textContent = `${wordCount} words`;
    }

    renderExpProfilePreviewEmotionOptions(profileData);
    resetExpCharacterEmotionPreview();

    if (furaiUiLanguage.language !== 'en') {
        scheduleFuraiUiScan(document.getElementById('expProfilePreviewModalEl'));
    }
}
function previewExpCharacterEmotion(emotionKey) {
    const data = window.expProfilePreviewData || getExpCharacterPreviewFallbackData();
    const key = String(emotionKey || '').trim();
    const avatarUrl = key && key !== 'default' ? (data.emotionAvatars?.[key] || '') : (data.avatar || '');
    const spriteUrl = key && key !== 'default' ? (data.emotionSprites?.[key] || '') : (data.defaultSprite || '');
    const hint = document.getElementById('expPreviewEmotionHint');

    setExpPreviewImage('expPreviewAvatarPreview', avatarUrl);
    setExpPreviewImage('expPreviewSpritePreview', spriteUrl);

    if (hint) {
        hint.textContent = key
            ? `${getExpProfileEmotionDisplayLabel(key)} preview.`
            : 'Default avatar / sprite preview.';
    }
}
function resetExpCharacterEmotionPreview() {
    const select = document.getElementById('expPreviewEmotionSelect');
    if (select) select.value = '';
    previewExpCharacterEmotion('');
}

function closeExpProfilePreviewModal() {
    expProfilePreviewOpenToken++;
    window.expProfilePreviewData = null;

    const modal = document.getElementById('expProfilePreviewModalEl');
    if (!modal) return;

    if (typeof closeModalLayer === 'function') {
        closeModalLayer(modal);
    } else {
        modal.style.display = 'none';
    }
}

async function openExpCharacterProfilePreview(item) {
    const openToken = ++expProfilePreviewOpenToken;
    const fallbackData = getExpCharacterPreviewFallbackData(item || {});
    const modal = document.getElementById('expProfilePreviewModalEl');

    window.expProfilePreviewData = fallbackData;
    populateExpProfilePreviewModal(fallbackData);

    if (modal) {
        if (typeof openModalLayer === 'function') {
            openModalLayer(modal);
        } else {
            modal.style.display = 'flex';
        }
    }

    if (!item || !item.content) return;

    try {
        const importUrl = resolveFuraiCharacterImportUrl(item.content);
        const response = await fetch(importUrl);

        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to load character profile.');

        const rawData = await parseFuraiCharacterJsonResponse(response);
        const charData = normalizeImportData(rawData);

        if (openToken !== expProfilePreviewOpenToken) return;

        const loadedData = {
            ...fallbackData,
            ...charData,
            avatar: charData.avatar || fallbackData.avatar,
            defaultSprite: charData.defaultSprite || fallbackData.defaultSprite,
            instruction: charData.instruction || fallbackData.instruction,
            openingLorebook: charData.openingLorebook || fallbackData.openingLorebook,
            customEmotions: charData.customEmotions || fallbackData.customEmotions,
            emotionAvatars: charData.emotionAvatars || fallbackData.emotionAvatars,
            emotionSprites: charData.emotionSprites || fallbackData.emotionSprites
        };

        window.expProfilePreviewData = loadedData;
        populateExpProfilePreviewModal(loadedData);
    } catch (err) {
        console.warn('EXP profile preview load failed:', err);
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
            showToast('Full profile could not load. Showing card preview.', 'info');
        }
    }
}

// Image lightbox is a child of the profile card; closing it returns to the card.
function transitionToLightbox(src) {
    openLightbox(src, { parent: 'profileCardModal' });
}


// Shared secondary zoom for every image opened in FurAI's lightbox.
const LIGHTBOX_SECONDARY_ZOOM_SCALE = 2;
let isZoomed = false;

function resetLightboxZoom() {
    const img = document.getElementById('lightboxImg');
    isZoomed = false;

    if (!img) return;

    img.classList.remove('is-secondary-zoomed');
    img.style.setProperty('--lightbox-zoom-scale', String(LIGHTBOX_SECONDARY_ZOOM_SCALE));
    img.style.setProperty('--lightbox-zoom-x', '50%');
    img.style.setProperty('--lightbox-zoom-y', '50%');
    img.style.removeProperty('cursor');
    img.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    img.title = 'Click to zoom to 200%';
}

function setLightboxZoomAtPoint(clientX, clientY) {
    const lightbox = document.getElementById('imageLightboxEl');
    const img = document.getElementById('lightboxImg');

    if (!img || lightbox?.classList.contains('video-mode')) return;

    const rect = img.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!rect.width || !rect.height) return;

    const xPercent = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, ((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100));
    const yPercent = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, ((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100));

    img.style.setProperty('--lightbox-zoom-x', `${xPercent}%`);
    img.style.setProperty('--lightbox-zoom-y', `${yPercent}%`);
    img.classList.add('is-secondary-zoomed');
    img.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
    img.title = 'Click to return to fit';
    isZoomed = true;
}

function toggleLightboxZoom(event) {
    event?.preventDefault?.();
    event?.stopPropagation?.();

    const lightbox = document.getElementById('imageLightboxEl');
    const img = document.getElementById('lightboxImg');

    if (!img || lightbox?.classList.contains('video-mode')) return;

    if (isZoomed) {
        resetLightboxZoom();
        return;
    }

    const rect = img.getBoundingClientRect();
    const clientX = Number.isFinite(event?.clientX) ? event.clientX : rect.left + (rect.width / 2);
    const clientY = Number.isFinite(event?.clientY) ? event.clientY : rect.top + (rect.height / 2);
    setLightboxZoomAtPoint(clientX, clientY);
}

function bindLightboxInteractions() {
    const lightbox = document.getElementById('imageLightboxEl');
    const img = document.getElementById('lightboxImg');

    if (!lightbox || !img || lightbox.dataset.zoomInteractionsBound === 'true') return;

    lightbox.dataset.zoomInteractionsBound = 'true';

    lightbox.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target === lightbox) closeLightbox();
    });

    img.addEventListener('click', toggleLightboxZoom);
    img.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if (event.key !== 'Enter' && event.key !== ' ') return;
        toggleLightboxZoom(event);
    });
}

function getLightboxVideoEl(lightbox) {
    let video = document.getElementById('lightboxVideo');

    if (!video) {
        video = document.createElement('video');
        video.id = 'lightboxVideo';
        video.muted = true;
        video.loop = true;
        video.autoplay = true;
        video.controls = true;
        video.playsInline = true;
        video.preload = 'auto';
        video.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Lightbox video preview');

        lightbox.appendChild(video);
    }

    return video;
}

function stopLightboxVideo() {
    const video = document.getElementById('lightboxVideo');
    if (!video) return;

    try {
        video.pause();
        video.removeAttribute('src');
        video.load();
    } catch (e) {}
}

function resetLightboxCopyButton() {
    const btn = document.getElementById('lightboxCopyLinkBtn');
    if (!btn) return;

    btn.classList.remove('is-copied');
    btn.title = 'Copy image link';
    btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined" aria-hidden="true">link</span><span class="lightbox-copy-link-label">Copy link</span>';
}

function copyTextWithFallback(text) {
    if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
        return navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    }

    const textArea = document.createElement('textarea');
    textArea.value = text;
    textArea.style.position = 'absolute';
    textArea.style.left = '-9999px';
    textArea.style.top = '0';
    document.body.appendChild(textArea);
    textArea.focus();
    textArea.select();

    try {
        document.execCommand('copy');
        return Promise.resolve();
    } catch (e) {
        return Promise.reject(e);
    } finally {
        document.body.removeChild(textArea);
    }
}

async function copyLightboxImageLink(event) {
    if (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
    }

    if (!document.body.classList.contains('furai-livestream-active')) return;

    const lightbox = document.getElementById('imageLightboxEl');
    const btn = document.getElementById('lightboxCopyLinkBtn');
    const img = document.getElementById('lightboxImg');
    const src = lightbox?.dataset.currentSrc || img?.currentSrc || img?.src || '';

    if (!src) return;

    try {
        await copyTextWithFallback(src);

        if (!btn) return;

        const copiedSrc = src;
        btn.classList.add('is-copied');
        btn.title = 'Copied image link';
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-check" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="lightbox-copy-link-label">Copied</span>';

        setTimeout(() => {
            if (!lightbox || lightbox.dataset.currentSrc === copiedSrc) {
                resetLightboxCopyButton();
            }
        }, 1000);
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Could not copy lightbox image link:', e);
    }
}
              
function openLightbox(src, options = {}) {
    const lightbox = document.getElementById('imageLightboxEl');
    const lightboxImg = document.getElementById('lightboxImg');

    if (!lightbox || !lightboxImg || !src) return;

    bindLightboxInteractions();

    const cleanSrc = String(src || '').trim();
    const videoEl = getLightboxVideoEl(lightbox);
    const isVideo = isExpVideoUrl(cleanSrc);
    const copyBtn = document.getElementById('lightboxCopyLinkBtn');
    const canShowCopyLink =
        !isVideo &&
        options.showCopyLink === true &&
        document.body.classList.contains('furai-livestream-active');

    lightbox.dataset.currentSrc = cleanSrc;
    if (copyBtn) copyBtn.style.display = canShowCopyLink ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    resetLightboxCopyButton();
    resetLightboxZoom();

    if (typeof openModalLayer === 'function') {
        openModalLayer(lightbox, { parent: options.parent || null });
    } else {
        lightbox.style.display = 'flex';
    }

    stopLightboxVideo();

    if (isVideo) {
        lightbox.classList.add('video-mode');
        lightboxImg.removeAttribute('src');
        lightboxImg.style.cursor = 'default';
        lightboxImg.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');

        videoEl.style.display = 'block';
        videoEl.src = cleanSrc;
        videoEl.load();
        videoEl.currentTime = 0;
        videoEl.play().catch(() => {});
        return;
    }

    lightbox.classList.remove('video-mode');
    lightboxImg.removeAttribute('aria-disabled');
    lightboxImg.style.removeProperty('cursor');

    videoEl.style.display = 'none';
    lightboxImg.src = cleanSrc;
}

function closeLightbox() {
    const lightbox = document.getElementById('imageLightboxEl');

    resetLightboxZoom();

    if (lightbox) {
        if (typeof closeModalLayer === 'function') {
            closeModalLayer(lightbox);
        } else {
            lightbox.style.display = 'none';
        }

        lightbox.classList.remove('video-mode');
        delete lightbox.dataset.currentSrc;
    }

    resetLightboxCopyButton();
    stopLightboxVideo();

    const img = document.getElementById('lightboxImg');
    if (img) {
        img.removeAttribute('src');
        img.removeAttribute('aria-disabled');
        img.style.removeProperty('cursor');
    }

    const overlay = document.getElementById('expWpOverlay');
    if (overlay) {
        overlay.innerHTML = '';
    }

    window.expWallpaperNav = null;
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleWallpaperLightboxKeydown);
    unbindExpWallpaperSwipe();

    if (expWallpaperLightboxObserver) {
        expWallpaperLightboxObserver.disconnect();
        expWallpaperLightboxObserver = null;
    }
}

  function escapeRegex(string) {
    return string.replace(/[-\/\\^$*+?.()|[\]{}]/g, '\\$&');
  }

function normalizeEscapedChatUrl(url) {
    return String(url || '')
        .trim()
        .replace(/&amp;/g, '&')
        .replace(/&#40;/g, '(')
        .replace(/&#41;/g, ')');
}

function isChatInlineImageUrl(url) {
    const cleanUrl = normalizeEscapedChatUrl(url);

    return /^https?:\/\/[^\s<>"']+\.(?:png|jpe?g|gif|webp|avif)(?:[?#][^\s<>"']*)?$/i.test(cleanUrl);
}

function buildInlineChatImageHtml(rawUrl, rawAlt = 'image') {
    const url = normalizeEscapedChatUrl(rawUrl);
    const alt = String(rawAlt || 'image').replace(/[<>"']/g, '').trim() || 'image';

    if (!isChatInlineImageUrl(url)) {
        return `![${escapeHTML(alt)}](${escapeHTML(url)})`;
    }

    const safeUrl = escapeHTML(url);
    const safeAlt = escapeHTML(alt);

    return `<img class="chat-inline-image"
                 src="${safeUrl}"
                 alt="${safeAlt}"
                 loading="lazy"
                 decoding="async"
                 onclick="event.stopPropagation(); if (typeof openLightbox === 'function') openLightbox(this.src);"
                 onerror="this.classList.add('chat-inline-image-broken'); this.alt='Image failed to load';">`;
}

// --- HELPER: PRIVACY FILTER ---
function getPublicDescription(text) {
    if (!text) return "";
    // Remove anything between [SECRET] tags (Case insensitive, across newlines)
    return text.replace(/\[SECRET\][\s\S]*?\[\/SECRET\]/gi, "").trim();
}

const FURAI_PROTECTED_INSTRUCTION_VERSION = 1;
const FURAI_PROTECTED_INSTRUCTION_MAX_WORDS = 500;
const FURAI_PROTECTED_HOST_BY_NAME_ID = Object.freeze({
    userNameInput: 'userProtectedInstructionHost',
    botNameInput: 'botProtectedInstructionHost',
    enhancerNameInput: 'enhancerProtectedInstructionHost',
    makerNameInput: 'makerProtectedInstructionHost',
    globalUserName: 'globalUserProtectedInstructionHost',
    globalBotName: 'globalBotProtectedInstructionHost',
    globalWandName: 'globalWandProtectedInstructionHost',
    editGlobalBotName: 'editGlobalBotProtectedInstructionHost'
});

function normalizeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(source = {}) {
    const nested = source?.protectedInstructions && typeof source.protectedInstructions === 'object'
        ? source.protectedInstructions
        : {};

    return {
        protectedInstruction: String(
            source?.protectedInstruction ?? nested.instruction ?? ''
        ).trim(),
        protectedSecret: String(
            source?.protectedSecret ??
            source?.protectedHiddenSecrets ??
            nested.secret ??
            nested.hiddenSecrets ??
            ''
        ).trim(),
        protectedEditCodeHash: String(
            source?.protectedEditCodeHash ?? nested.codeHash ?? ''
        ).trim(),
        protectedInstructionVersion: Number(
            source?.protectedInstructionVersion ??
            nested.version ??
            FURAI_PROTECTED_INSTRUCTION_VERSION
        ) || FURAI_PROTECTED_INSTRUCTION_VERSION
    };
}

function getFuraiProtectedInstructionDataFromEditorState(state = {}) {
    return normalizeFuraiProtectedInstructionData({
        protectedInstruction: state.instruction,
        protectedSecret: state.secret,
        protectedEditCodeHash: state.codeHash,
        protectedInstructionVersion: state.version
    });
}

function hasFuraiProtectedInstructions(source = {}) {
    const data = normalizeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(source);
    return !!(data.protectedInstruction || data.protectedSecret);
}

function getFuraiProtectedInstructionStats(source = {}) {
    const data = normalizeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(source);
    const text = [data.protectedInstruction, data.protectedSecret].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n').trim();
    const words = text ? text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length : 0;

    let percent = 0;
    try {
        const tokens = typeof estimateTokens === 'function' ? estimateTokens(text) : words;
        const contextWindow = typeof getFuraiContextWindow === 'function'
            ? getFuraiContextWindow()
            : FURAI_PROTECTED_INSTRUCTION_MAX_WORDS;
        percent = (tokens / Math.max(1, contextWindow)) * 100;
    } catch (error) {
        percent = (words / FURAI_PROTECTED_INSTRUCTION_MAX_WORDS) * 100;
    }

    const percentText = percent < 10 ? percent.toFixed(1) : Math.round(percent).toString();

    return {
        words,
        percent,
        label: `${words.toLocaleString()} word${words === 1 ? '' : 's'} · ${percentText}% context`
    };
}

function getFuraiEffectiveCharacterInstruction(source = {}) {
    const rawInstruction = String(source?.instruction || '');
    const protectedData = normalizeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(source);

    // Old character objects take the exact old path with no transformation.
    if (!protectedData.protectedInstruction && !protectedData.protectedSecret) return rawInstruction;

    const secretPattern = /\[SECRET\]([\s\S]*?)\[\/SECRET\]/gi;
    const existingSecrets = Array.from(
        rawInstruction.matchAll(secretPattern),
        match => String(match[1] || '').trim()
    ).filter(Boolean);

    const publicInstruction = rawInstruction
        .replace(secretPattern, '')
        .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
        .trim();

    const publicParts = [publicInstruction, protectedData.protectedInstruction].filter(Boolean);
    const secretParts = [...existingSecrets, protectedData.protectedSecret].filter(Boolean);
    let merged = publicParts.join('\n\n');

    if (secretParts.length) {
        const secretBlock = `[SECRET]\n${secretParts.join('\n\n')}\n[/SECRET]`;
        merged = merged ? `${merged}\n\n${secretBlock}` : secretBlock;
    }

    return merged;
}

function getFuraiEffectiveModeCharacterInstruction(source = {}, mode = '') {
    const rawInstruction = source?.instructions?.[mode] ?? source?.instruction ?? '';
    return getFuraiEffectiveCharacterInstruction({
        ...source,
        instruction: rawInstruction
    });
}

function writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(target, source = {}) {
    if (!target || typeof target !== 'object') return target;

    const data = normalizeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(source);

    if (data.protectedInstruction || data.protectedSecret) {
        target.protectedInstruction = data.protectedInstruction;
        target.protectedSecret = data.protectedSecret;
        target.protectedEditCodeHash = data.protectedEditCodeHash;
        target.protectedInstructionVersion = FURAI_PROTECTED_INSTRUCTION_VERSION;
        target.hiddenInstructions = 1;
    } else {
        delete target.protectedInstruction;
        delete target.protectedSecret;
        delete target.protectedHiddenSecrets;
        delete target.protectedEditCodeHash;
        delete target.protectedInstructionVersion;
        delete target.protectedInstructions;

        // Protection-free profiles keep the legacy data shape.
        delete target.hiddenInstructions;
    }

    return target;
}

function getFuraiLocalWandProtectedInstructionData(chatData = {}) {
    return normalizeFuraiProtectedInstructionData({
        protectedInstruction: chatData?.enhancerProtectedInstruction,
        protectedSecret: chatData?.enhancerProtectedSecret,
        protectedEditCodeHash: chatData?.enhancerProtectedEditCodeHash,
        protectedInstructionVersion: chatData?.enhancerProtectedInstructionVersion
    });
}

function hasFuraiLocalWandProtectedInstructionOverride(chatData = {}) {
    return !!(
        String(chatData?.enhancerProtectedInstruction || '').trim() ||
        String(chatData?.enhancerProtectedSecret || '').trim()
    );
}

function writeFuraiLocalWandProtectedInstructionData(chatData, source = {}) {
    if (!chatData || typeof chatData !== 'object') return chatData;

    const data = normalizeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(source);
    if (data.protectedInstruction || data.protectedSecret) {
        chatData.enhancerProtectedInstruction = data.protectedInstruction;
        chatData.enhancerProtectedSecret = data.protectedSecret;
        chatData.enhancerProtectedEditCodeHash = data.protectedEditCodeHash;
        chatData.enhancerProtectedInstructionVersion = FURAI_PROTECTED_INSTRUCTION_VERSION;
        chatData.enhancerHiddenInstructions = 1;
    } else {
        delete chatData.enhancerProtectedInstruction;
        delete chatData.enhancerProtectedSecret;
        delete chatData.enhancerProtectedEditCodeHash;
        delete chatData.enhancerProtectedInstructionVersion;
        delete chatData.enhancerHiddenInstructions;
    }

    return chatData;
}

function getFuraiGlobalWandProtectedInstructionData() {
    let saved = {};
    try { saved = DB.get('global-group-enhancer-profile') || {}; } catch (error) {}
    return normalizeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(saved);
}

function writeFuraiGlobalWandProtectedInstructionData(source = {}) {
    let saved = {};
    try { saved = cloneFuraiData(DB.get('global-group-enhancer-profile') || {}); } catch (error) {}

    writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(saved, source);
    if (Object.keys(saved).length) DB.set('global-group-enhancer-profile', saved);
    else DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-profile');
    return saved;
}

function getFuraiResolvedWandProtectedInstructionData(chatData = {}) {
    return hasFuraiLocalWandProtectedInstructionOverride(chatData)
        ? getFuraiLocalWandProtectedInstructionData(chatData)
        : getFuraiGlobalWandProtectedInstructionData();
}

const FURAI_PROTECTED_CODE_FORMAT = 'pbkdf2-v1';
const FURAI_PROTECTED_CODE_ITERATIONS = 120000;
const FURAI_PROTECTED_CODE_SALT_BYTES = 16;
const FURAI_PROTECTED_CODE_HASH_BYTES = 32;

function furaiProtectedCodeBytesToBase64Url(bytes) {
    let binary = '';
    const chunkSize = 0x8000;

    for (let offset = 0; offset < bytes.length; offset += chunkSize) {
        binary += String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(offset, offset + chunkSize));
    }

    return btoa(binary)
        .replace(/\+/g, '-')
        .replace(/\//g, '_')
        .replace(/=+$/g, '');
}

function furaiProtectedCodeBase64UrlToBytes(value) {
    const normalized = String(value || '')
        .replace(/-/g, '+')
        .replace(/_/g, '/');
    const padded = normalized + '='.repeat((4 - normalized.length % 4) % 4);
    const binary = atob(padded);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);

    for (let index = 0; index < binary.length; index += 1) {
        bytes[index] = binary.charCodeAt(index);
    }

    return bytes;
}

async function furaiDeriveProtectedEditCode(code, salt, iterations) {
    const subtle = globalThis.crypto?.subtle;
    if (!subtle || typeof TextEncoder !== 'function') {
        throw new Error('Secure unlock-code hashing is unavailable in this browser.');
    }

    const keyMaterial = await subtle.importKey(
        'raw',
        new TextEncoder().encode(String(code || '').trim()),
        'PBKDF2',
        false,
        ['deriveBits']
    );

    const bits = await subtle.deriveBits(
        {
            name: 'PBKDF2',
            hash: 'SHA-256',
            salt,
            iterations
        },
        keyMaterial,
        FURAI_PROTECTED_CODE_HASH_BYTES * 8
    );

    return new Uint8Array(bits);
}

async function furaiHashProtectedEditCode(code) {
    if (!globalThis.crypto?.getRandomValues) {
        throw new Error('Secure random values are unavailable in this browser.');
    }

    const salt = globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues(
        new Uint8Array(FURAI_PROTECTED_CODE_SALT_BYTES)
    );
    const derived = await furaiDeriveProtectedEditCode(
        code,
        salt,
        FURAI_PROTECTED_CODE_ITERATIONS
    );

    return [
        FURAI_PROTECTED_CODE_FORMAT,
        FURAI_PROTECTED_CODE_ITERATIONS,
        furaiProtectedCodeBytesToBase64Url(salt),
        furaiProtectedCodeBytesToBase64Url(derived)
    ].join(':');
}

function isFuraiProtectedEditCodeHashUsable(expectedHash) {
    const saved = String(expectedHash || '').trim();
    const match = saved.match(
        /^pbkdf2-v1:(\d{5,7}):([A-Za-z0-9_-]{22}):([A-Za-z0-9_-]{43})$/
    );
    if (!match) return false;

    const iterations = Number(match[1]);
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(iterations) || iterations < 10000 || iterations > 2000000) {
        return false;
    }

    try {
        return (
            furaiProtectedCodeBase64UrlToBytes(match[2]).length === FURAI_PROTECTED_CODE_SALT_BYTES &&
            furaiProtectedCodeBase64UrlToBytes(match[3]).length === FURAI_PROTECTED_CODE_HASH_BYTES
        );
    } catch (error) {
        return false;
    }
}

async function verifyFuraiProtectedEditCode(code, expectedHash) {
    const saved = String(expectedHash || '').trim();
    const match = saved.match(
        /^pbkdf2-v1:(\d{5,7}):([A-Za-z0-9_-]{22}):([A-Za-z0-9_-]{43})$/
    );
    if (!match) return false;

    const iterations = Number(match[1]);
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(iterations) || iterations < 10000 || iterations > 2000000) {
        return false;
    }

    let salt;
    let expected;
    try {
        salt = furaiProtectedCodeBase64UrlToBytes(match[2]);
        expected = furaiProtectedCodeBase64UrlToBytes(match[3]);
    } catch (error) {
        return false;
    }

    if (
        salt.length !== FURAI_PROTECTED_CODE_SALT_BYTES ||
        expected.length !== FURAI_PROTECTED_CODE_HASH_BYTES
    ) {
        return false;
    }

    const actual = await furaiDeriveProtectedEditCode(code, salt, iterations);
    if (actual.length !== expected.length) return false;

    let difference = 0;
    for (let index = 0; index < expected.length; index += 1) {
        difference |= actual[index] ^ expected[index];
    }

    return difference === 0;
}



/*
  EXTERNAL COPY RULE
  ------------------
  Hidden-instruction discovery is metadata-first and follows only known FurAI
  profile containers. It never walks chat messages or arbitrary artifact data.

  New profile saves keep a tiny hiddenInstructions flag. Chat and backup export
  builders also attach furaiArtifactMeta.hiddenInstructionCount plus a private
  direct-reference plan while they are already copying their data.

  The narrow raw-field checks below exist only because the currently published
  protected-instruction build predates this metadata. They inspect known profile
  objects only; there is no recursive safety scan.
*/
const FURAI_ARTIFACT_META_KEY = 'furaiArtifactMeta';
const FURAI_HIDDEN_EXPORT_PLAN = Symbol('furaiHiddenExportPlan');
const FURAI_ADULT_TAG_EXPORT_PLAN = Symbol('furaiAdultTagExportPlan');
const FURAI_HIDDEN_EXPORT_INSPECTION_ERROR = 'FURAI_HIDDEN_EXPORT_INSPECTION_FAILED';

function createFuraiHiddenExportInspectionError(message) {
    const error = new Error(String(message || 'Protected instructions could not be checked.'));
    error.code = FURAI_HIDDEN_EXPORT_INSPECTION_ERROR;
    return error;
}


function createFuraiHiddenExportPlan() {
    return {
        entries: [],
        commits: [],
        cleanups: [],
        metadataTargets: [],
        seenOwners: new WeakSet(),
        seenCommitTargets: new WeakSet(),
        seenMetadataTargets: new WeakSet()
    };
}

function addFuraiHiddenMetadataTarget(plan, data) {
    if (!plan || !data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
    if (plan.seenMetadataTargets.has(data)) return;

    plan.seenMetadataTargets.add(data);
    plan.metadataTargets.push(data);
}

function getFuraiCharacterHiddenInstructionFlag(source = {}) {
    if (!source || typeof source !== 'object') return 0;

    // Metadata locates packed/profile containers. Once a known profile object is
    // available, its constant-size raw fields are authority so stale metadata
    // cannot create a false lock or suppress real hidden setup.
    const data = normalizeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(source);
    return data.protectedInstruction || data.protectedSecret ? 1 : 0;
}

function getFuraiLocalWandHiddenInstructionFlag(chatData = {}) {
    if (!chatData || typeof chatData !== 'object') return 0;

    return String(chatData.enhancerProtectedInstruction || '').trim() ||
        String(chatData.enhancerProtectedSecret || '').trim()
        ? 1
        : 0;
}

function countFuraiProfileHiddenInstructions(profile = {}) {
    if (!profile || typeof profile !== 'object') return 0;

    let count = 0;
    const addCharacter = character => {
        if (getFuraiCharacterHiddenInstructionFlag(character)) count += 1;
    };

    addCharacter(profile.user);
    (Array.isArray(profile.bots) ? profile.bots : []).forEach(addCharacter);

    const roleHistory = profile.roleHistory;
    if (roleHistory && typeof roleHistory === 'object') {
        (Array.isArray(roleHistory.user?.retired) ? roleHistory.user.retired : [])
            .forEach(addCharacter);

        const botLanes = roleHistory.bots && typeof roleHistory.bots === 'object'
            ? Object.values(roleHistory.bots)
            : [];

        botLanes.forEach(lane => {
            (Array.isArray(lane?.retired) ? lane.retired : []).forEach(addCharacter);
        });
    }

    return count;
}

function countFuraiCharacterArrayHiddenInstructions(characters) {
    if (!Array.isArray(characters)) return 0;
    return characters.reduce(
        (count, character) => count + getFuraiCharacterHiddenInstructionFlag(character),
        0
    );
}

function setFuraiArtifactHiddenInstructionCount(data, count) {
    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;

    const normalizedCount = Math.max(0, Number(count) || 0);
    const current = data[FURAI_ARTIFACT_META_KEY] &&
        typeof data[FURAI_ARTIFACT_META_KEY] === 'object'
        ? data[FURAI_ARTIFACT_META_KEY]
        : {};

    data[FURAI_ARTIFACT_META_KEY] = {
        ...current,
        hiddenInstructionCount: normalizedCount
    };
}

function getFuraiArtifactHiddenInstructionCount(data) {
    const count = Number(
        data?.[FURAI_ARTIFACT_META_KEY]?.hiddenInstructionCount
    );
    return Number.isFinite(count) && count >= 0 ? count : null;
}

function attachFuraiHiddenExportPlan(data, plan, options = {}) {
    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || !plan) return plan;

    try {
        Object.defineProperty(data, FURAI_HIDDEN_EXPORT_PLAN, {
            value: plan,
            configurable: true
        });
    } catch (error) {}

    if (options.writeMetadata !== false) {
        setFuraiArtifactHiddenInstructionCount(data, plan.entries.length);
    }
    return plan;
}

function addFuraiHiddenCharacterEntry(plan, owner) {
    if (!plan || !owner || typeof owner !== 'object') return;
    if (!getFuraiCharacterHiddenInstructionFlag(owner)) return;
    if (plan.seenOwners.has(owner)) return;

    plan.seenOwners.add(owner);
    const nested = owner.protectedInstructions &&
        typeof owner.protectedInstructions === 'object'
        ? owner.protectedInstructions
        : null;

    plan.entries.push({
        owner,
        kind: 'character',
        hash: String(
            owner.protectedEditCodeHash ?? nested?.codeHash ?? ''
        ).trim()
    });
}

function addFuraiHiddenWandEntry(plan, chatData) {
    if (!plan || !chatData || typeof chatData !== 'object') return;
    if (!getFuraiLocalWandHiddenInstructionFlag(chatData)) return;
    if (plan.seenOwners.has(chatData)) return;

    plan.seenOwners.add(chatData);
    plan.entries.push({
        owner: chatData,
        kind: 'enhancer',
        hash: String(chatData.enhancerProtectedEditCodeHash || '').trim()
    });
}

function collectFuraiProfileHiddenEntries(profile, plan) {
    if (!profile || typeof profile !== 'object') return;

    addFuraiHiddenCharacterEntry(plan, profile.user);
    (Array.isArray(profile.bots) ? profile.bots : [])
        .forEach(character => addFuraiHiddenCharacterEntry(plan, character));

    const roleHistory = profile.roleHistory;
    if (!roleHistory || typeof roleHistory !== 'object') return;

    (Array.isArray(roleHistory.user?.retired) ? roleHistory.user.retired : [])
        .forEach(character => addFuraiHiddenCharacterEntry(plan, character));

    const botLanes = roleHistory.bots && typeof roleHistory.bots === 'object'
        ? Object.values(roleHistory.bots)
        : [];

    botLanes.forEach(lane => {
        (Array.isArray(lane?.retired) ? lane.retired : [])
            .forEach(character => addFuraiHiddenCharacterEntry(plan, character));
    });
}

function collectFuraiCharacterArrayHiddenEntries(characters, plan) {
    if (!Array.isArray(characters)) return;
    characters.forEach(character => addFuraiHiddenCharacterEntry(plan, character));
}

function collectFuraiPackedMakerDraftHiddenEntries(state, plan) {
    if (!state || typeof state !== 'object') return;

    const usesLegacyObject = !!(
        state.makerDraft &&
        typeof state.makerDraft === 'object'
    );
    const declaredCount = Number(state.makerDraftHiddenInstructionCount);

    const markerVersion = Number(state.makerDraftHiddenInstructionSafetyVersion);

    if (
        !usesLegacyObject &&
        markerVersion === FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION &&
        Number.isFinite(declaredCount) &&
        declaredCount <= 0
    ) return;
    const draft = usesLegacyObject
        ? state.makerDraft
        : getFuraiStoredMakerDraft(state);

    if (!draft || typeof draft !== 'object') {
        if (state.makerDraftPacked) {
            throw createFuraiHiddenExportInspectionError('A paused Character Maker draft could not be checked for protected instructions. Reload FurAI and try the export again.');
        }
        if (!Number.isFinite(declaredCount)) {
            state.makerDraftHiddenInstructionCount = 0;
            state.makerDraftHiddenInstructionSafetyVersion = FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION;
        }
        return;
    }

    const protectedOwner = draft.protected;
    const before = plan.entries.length;
    addFuraiHiddenCharacterEntry(plan, protectedOwner);
    const found = plan.entries.length - before;
    state.makerDraftHiddenInstructionCount = found;
    state.makerDraftHiddenInstructionSafetyVersion = FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION;

    if (!found || plan.seenCommitTargets.has(draft)) return;

    plan.seenCommitTargets.add(draft);
    plan.cleanups.push(() => {
        delete draft.protected;
        state.makerDraftHiddenInstructionCount = 0;
        state.makerDraftHiddenInstructionSafetyVersion = FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION;

        if (!usesLegacyObject) {
            setFuraiStoredMakerDraft(state, draft);
        }
    });
}

function collectFuraiPackedModeStateHiddenEntries(state, plan) {
    if (!state || typeof state !== 'object') return;

    const usesLegacyObject = !!(
        state.profile &&
        typeof state.profile === 'object'
    );
    const declaredCount = Number(state.hiddenInstructionCount);
    const markerVersion = Number(state.hiddenInstructionSafetyVersion);

    if (
        usesLegacyObject ||
        markerVersion !== FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION ||
        !(Number.isFinite(declaredCount) && declaredCount <= 0)
    ) {
        const profile = usesLegacyObject
            ? state.profile
            : getFuraiStoredModeProfile(state);

        if (!profile || typeof profile !== 'object') {
            if (state.profilePacked) {
                throw createFuraiHiddenExportInspectionError('A paused mode profile could not be checked for protected instructions. Reload FurAI and try the export again.');
            }
            if (!Number.isFinite(declaredCount)) state.hiddenInstructionCount = 0;
            state.hiddenInstructionSafetyVersion = FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION;
        } else {
            const before = plan.entries.length;
            collectFuraiProfileHiddenEntries(profile, plan);
            const found = plan.entries.length - before;
            state.hiddenInstructionCount = found;
            state.hiddenInstructionSafetyVersion = FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION;

            if (
                found &&
                usesLegacyObject &&
                !plan.seenCommitTargets.has(state)
            ) {
                plan.seenCommitTargets.add(state);
                plan.cleanups.push(() => {
                    state.hiddenInstructionCount = 0;
                    state.hiddenInstructionSafetyVersion = FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION;
                });
            } else if (
                !usesLegacyObject &&
                found &&
                !plan.seenCommitTargets.has(state)
            ) {
                plan.seenCommitTargets.add(state);
                plan.commits.push(() => setFuraiStoredModeProfile(state, profile));
            }
        }
    }

    collectFuraiPackedMakerDraftHiddenEntries(state, plan);
}

function collectFuraiPackedSharedRosterHiddenEntries(chatData, plan) {
    const morph = chatData?.morph;
    if (!morph || typeof morph !== 'object') return;

    const usesLegacyArray = Array.isArray(morph.sharedRoster);
    const declaredCount = Number(morph.sharedRosterHiddenInstructionCount);
    const markerVersion = Number(morph.sharedRosterHiddenInstructionSafetyVersion);

    if (
        !usesLegacyArray &&
        markerVersion === FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION &&
        Number.isFinite(declaredCount) &&
        declaredCount <= 0
    ) return;
    const roster = usesLegacyArray
        ? morph.sharedRoster
        : getFuraiSharedRoster(chatData);

    if (!Array.isArray(roster)) {
        if (morph.sharedRosterPacked) {
            throw createFuraiHiddenExportInspectionError('A shared roster could not be checked for protected instructions. Reload FurAI and try the export again.');
        }
        if (!Number.isFinite(declaredCount)) {
            morph.sharedRosterHiddenInstructionCount = 0;
            morph.sharedRosterHiddenInstructionSafetyVersion = FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION;
        }
        return;
    }

    const before = plan.entries.length;
    collectFuraiCharacterArrayHiddenEntries(roster, plan);
    const found = plan.entries.length - before;
    morph.sharedRosterHiddenInstructionCount = found;
    morph.sharedRosterHiddenInstructionSafetyVersion = FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION;

    if (!found || plan.seenCommitTargets.has(morph)) return;

    plan.seenCommitTargets.add(morph);

    if (usesLegacyArray) {
        plan.cleanups.push(() => {
            morph.sharedRosterHiddenInstructionCount = 0;
            morph.sharedRosterHiddenInstructionSafetyVersion = FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION;
        });
    } else {
        plan.commits.push(() => setFuraiSharedRoster(chatData, roster));
    }
}

function collectFuraiChatHiddenEntries(chatData, plan) {
    if (!chatData || typeof chatData !== 'object') return;

    addFuraiHiddenWandEntry(plan, chatData);

    const modeStates = chatData.morph?.modeStates;
    if (modeStates && typeof modeStates === 'object') {
        Object.values(modeStates).forEach(state =>
            collectFuraiPackedModeStateHiddenEntries(state, plan)
        );
    }

    collectFuraiPackedSharedRosterHiddenEntries(chatData, plan);
}

function collectFuraiBackupStorageValueHiddenEntries(key, value, plan) {
    const storageKey = String(key || '');

    if (storageKey.startsWith('chat-')) {
        collectFuraiChatHiddenEntries(value, plan);
        return;
    }

    if (
        storageKey === 'globalBotRoster' ||
        storageKey === 'globalStoryBotRoster'
    ) {
        collectFuraiCharacterArrayHiddenEntries(value, plan);
        return;
    }

    if (storageKey === 'global-group-enhancer-profile') {
        addFuraiHiddenCharacterEntry(plan, value);
        return;
    }

    if (storageKey === 'furaiLivestreamSpeakerSnapshots') {
        const snapshots = value && typeof value === 'object'
            ? Object.values(value)
            : [];
        snapshots.forEach(snapshot => addFuraiHiddenCharacterEntry(plan, snapshot));
        return;
    }

    if (storageKey === 'furaiLivestreamSpeakerSnapshot') {
        addFuraiHiddenCharacterEntry(plan, value);
        return;
    }

    if (storageKey.startsWith('global-user-')) {
        addFuraiHiddenCharacterEntry(plan, value);
        return;
    }

    if (storageKey === 'global-profile-user') {
        addFuraiHiddenCharacterEntry(plan, value);
        collectFuraiProfileHiddenEntries(value, plan);
        return;
    }

    if (
        storageKey.startsWith('profile-') ||
        storageKey.startsWith('global-profile-')
    ) {
        collectFuraiProfileHiddenEntries(value, plan);
    }
}

function getFuraiJsonValueEnd(text, startIndex) {
    let index = Math.max(0, Number(startIndex) || 0);
    while (index < text.length && /\s/.test(text[index])) index++;

    const first = text[index];
    if (first !== '{' && first !== '[') return -1;

    const stack = [first];
    let inString = false;
    let escaped = false;

    for (index += 1; index < text.length; index++) {
        const char = text[index];

        if (inString) {
            if (escaped) escaped = false;
            else if (char === '\\') escaped = true;
            else if (char === '"') inString = false;
            continue;
        }

        if (char === '"') {
            inString = true;
            continue;
        }

        if (char === '{' || char === '[') {
            stack.push(char);
            continue;
        }

        if (char === '}' || char === ']') {
            const expected = char === '}' ? '{' : '[';
            if (stack.pop() !== expected) return -1;
            if (!stack.length) return index + 1;
        }
    }

    return -1;
}

const FURAI_PROTECTED_METADATA_KEYS = new Set([
    'protectedinstruction',
    'protectedsecret',
    'protectedhiddensecrets',
    'protectededitcodehash',
    'protectedinstructionversion',
    'protectedinstructions',
    'hiddeninstructions',
    'hiddeninstructioncount',
    'enhancerprotectedinstruction',
    'enhancerprotectedsecret',
    'enhancerprotectededitcodehash',
    'enhancerprotectedinstructionversion',
    'enhancerhiddeninstructions'
]);

function sanitizeFuraiGeneratedMetadataValue(value) {
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        let removed = false;
        const next = value.map(item => {
            const result = sanitizeFuraiGeneratedMetadataValue(item);
            removed = removed || result.removed;
            return result.value;
        });
        return { value: next, removed };
    }

    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') {
        return { value, removed: false };
    }

    const next = {};
    let removed = false;

    Object.entries(value).forEach(([key, child]) => {
        if (FURAI_PROTECTED_METADATA_KEYS.has(String(key).toLowerCase())) {
            removed = true;
            return;
        }

        const result = sanitizeFuraiGeneratedMetadataValue(child);
        next[key] = result.value;
        removed = removed || result.removed;
    });

    return { value: next, removed };
}

function getFuraiNextMetadataHeadingIndex(text, startIndex) {
    const pattern = /(?:^|\r?\n)\[[^\]\r\n]+\]\s*(?:\r?\n|$)/g;
    pattern.lastIndex = Math.max(0, Number(startIndex) || 0);
    const match = pattern.exec(text);
    if (!match) return text.length;
    return match.index + (match[0].startsWith('\n') || match[0].startsWith('\r\n') ? match[0].indexOf('[') : 0);
}

function removeFuraiGeneratedExportMetadataNote(value) {
    const original = String(value || '');
    let text = original;
    let changed = false;
    let searchFrom = 0;
    const headingPattern = /\[FurAI Export Metadata\]\s*(?:\r?\n)?/ig;
    const protectedPattern = /(?:protectedInstruction|protectedSecret|protectedHiddenSecrets|protectedEditCodeHash|hiddenInstructions|hiddenInstructionCount)/i;

    while (searchFrom < text.length) {
        headingPattern.lastIndex = searchFrom;
        const match = headingPattern.exec(text);
        if (!match) break;

        const contentStart = headingPattern.lastIndex;
        const jsonEnd = getFuraiJsonValueEnd(text, contentStart);
        const fallbackEnd = getFuraiNextMetadataHeadingIndex(text, contentStart);
        const blockEnd = jsonEnd > contentStart ? jsonEnd : fallbackEnd;
        const metadataBlock = text.slice(contentStart, blockEnd);

        if (!protectedPattern.test(metadataBlock)) {
            searchFrom = Math.max(blockEnd, headingPattern.lastIndex);
            continue;
        }

        let replacement = '';
        if (jsonEnd > contentStart) {
            try {
                const parsed = JSON.parse(text.slice(contentStart, jsonEnd));
                const sanitized = sanitizeFuraiGeneratedMetadataValue(parsed);

                if (!sanitized.removed) {
                    searchFrom = jsonEnd;
                    continue;
                }

                const hasPublicData = Array.isArray(sanitized.value)
                    ? sanitized.value.length > 0
                    : sanitized.value && typeof sanitized.value === 'object'
                        ? Object.keys(sanitized.value).length > 0
                        : sanitized.value != null && sanitized.value !== '';

                if (hasPublicData) {
                    replacement = `[FurAI Export Metadata]\n${JSON.stringify(sanitized.value, null, 2)}`;
                }
            } catch (error) {
                replacement = '';
            }
        }

        const before = text.slice(0, match.index).trimEnd();
        const after = text.slice(blockEnd).trimStart();
        text = [before, replacement, after].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n');
        changed = true;
        searchFrom = Math.max(0, before.length + replacement.length - 1);
    }

    return changed ? text.trim() : original;
}

function collectFuraiCharacterCardHiddenEntries(card, plan) {
    const furai = card?.data?.extensions?.furai;
    if (!furai || typeof furai !== 'object') return;

    const before = plan.entries.length;
    addFuraiHiddenCharacterEntry(plan, furai);

    if (plan.entries.length > before) {
        plan.cleanups.push(() => {
            if (card?.data) {
                card.data.creator_notes = removeFuraiGeneratedExportMetadataNote(
                    card.data.creator_notes
                );
            }
        });
    }
}

function collectFuraiKnownArtifactHiddenEntries(data, plan) {
    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;

    // Serialized metadata is a trigger hint, not authority. The narrow
    // known-container check below protects against stale or assembled zeroes.
    getFuraiArtifactHiddenInstructionCount(data);

    const before = plan.entries.length;

    if (data.spec === 'chara_card_v2') {
        collectFuraiCharacterCardHiddenEntries(data, plan);
    } else if (
        data.type === 'character' ||
        data.ver === '1.0'
    ) {
        addFuraiHiddenCharacterEntry(plan, data);
    } else if (data.chat || data.profile) {
        collectFuraiChatHiddenEntries(data.chat, plan);
        collectFuraiProfileHiddenEntries(data.profile, plan);
    } else {
        Object.entries(data).forEach(([key, value]) => {
            if (key === FURAI_ARTIFACT_META_KEY || key === 'artifacts') return;
            collectFuraiBackupStorageValueHiddenEntries(key, value, plan);
        });
    }

    if (plan.entries.length > before) {
        addFuraiHiddenMetadataTarget(plan, data);
    }
}

function buildFuraiHiddenExportPlan(data) {
    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return createFuraiHiddenExportPlan();

    const attached = data[FURAI_HIDDEN_EXPORT_PLAN];
    if (attached?.entries) return attached;

    // Live builders already returned their private Symbol plan above.
    // Serialized/imported metadata receives the narrow known-container check.
    getFuraiArtifactHiddenInstructionCount(data);

    const plan = createFuraiHiddenExportPlan();
    addFuraiHiddenMetadataTarget(plan, data);

    if (Array.isArray(data.artifacts)) {
        data.artifacts.forEach(artifact =>
            collectFuraiKnownArtifactHiddenEntries(artifact, plan)
        );
    } else {
        collectFuraiKnownArtifactHiddenEntries(data, plan);
    }

    return attachFuraiHiddenExportPlan(
        data,
        plan,
        { writeMetadata: false }
    );
}

function shouldPersistFuraiArtifactCount(data) {
    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return false;
    if (data.spec === 'chara_card_v2') return false;
    if (data.type === 'character' || data.ver === '1.0') return false;
    return true;
}

function writeFuraiSafeArtifactCount(data) {
    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;

    if (shouldPersistFuraiArtifactCount(data)) {
        setFuraiArtifactHiddenInstructionCount(data, 0);
        return;
    }

    const current = data[FURAI_ARTIFACT_META_KEY];
    if (!current || typeof current !== 'object') return;

    const next = { ...current };
    delete next.hiddenInstructionCount;

    if (Object.keys(next).length) data[FURAI_ARTIFACT_META_KEY] = next;
    else delete data[FURAI_ARTIFACT_META_KEY];
}

function stripFuraiHiddenExportPlan(data, plan) {
    if (!plan) return 0;

    for (const entry of plan.entries) {
        const owner = entry?.owner;
        if (!owner || typeof owner !== 'object') continue;

        if (entry.kind === 'enhancer') {
            delete owner.enhancerProtectedInstruction;
            delete owner.enhancerProtectedSecret;
            delete owner.enhancerProtectedEditCodeHash;
            delete owner.enhancerProtectedInstructionVersion;
            delete owner.enhancerHiddenInstructions;
            continue;
        }

        delete owner.protectedInstruction;
        delete owner.protectedSecret;
        delete owner.protectedHiddenSecrets;
        delete owner.protectedEditCodeHash;
        delete owner.protectedInstructionVersion;
        delete owner.protectedInstructions;
        delete owner.hiddenInstructions;

        if (typeof owner.creatorNotes === 'string') {
            owner.creatorNotes = removeFuraiGeneratedExportMetadataNote(
                owner.creatorNotes
            );
        }
        if (typeof owner.creator_notes === 'string') {
            owner.creator_notes = removeFuraiGeneratedExportMetadataNote(
                owner.creator_notes
            );
        }
    }

    plan.cleanups.forEach(cleanup => cleanup());
    plan.commits.forEach(commit => commit());

    const metadataTargets = new Set(plan.metadataTargets);
    metadataTargets.add(data);
    metadataTargets.forEach(writeFuraiSafeArtifactCount);

    return plan.entries.length;
}



/*
  PG-13 COPY RULE
  ----------------
  Adult discovery labels use the same known-container export frame as hidden
  instructions, but never ask for confirmation. When the Expansion Pass 18+
  gate is locked, temporary copies and views are converted immediately to a
  PG-13 version. The original stored profile remains unchanged.
*/
function getFuraiAdultTagSanitization(value) {
    const entries = parseFuraiTagEntries(value);
    const hiddenEntries = entries.filter(entry => entry.isHidden);
    return {
        removedCount: hiddenEntries.length,
        value: mergeFuraiTagEntries(entries.filter(entry => !entry.isHidden))
    };
}

function getFuraiAdultTagArraySanitization(value) {
    const source = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    const entries = source.flatMap(parseFuraiTagEntries);
    const hiddenEntries = entries.filter(entry => entry.isHidden);
    const visible = [];
    const seen = new Set();

    entries.filter(entry => !entry.isHidden).forEach(entry => {
        const key = entry.key;
        if (!key || seen.has(key)) return;
        seen.add(key);
        visible.push(entry.raw);
    });

    return { removedCount: hiddenEntries.length, value: visible };
}

function getFuraiTagsCsvAdultTagSanitization(value) {
    const entries = String(value || '')
        .split('|')
        .flatMap(segment => parseFuraiTagEntries(segment));
    const hiddenEntries = entries.filter(entry => entry.isHidden);
    const visible = [];
    const seen = new Set();

    entries.filter(entry => !entry.isHidden).forEach(entry => {
        const key = entry.key;
        if (!key || seen.has(key)) return;
        seen.add(key);
        visible.push(entry.raw);
    });

    return {
        removedCount: hiddenEntries.length,
        value: visible.join('|')
    };
}

function getFuraiAdultTagFieldSanitization(key, value) {
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return getFuraiAdultTagArraySanitization(value);
    if (typeof value !== 'string') return { removedCount: 0, value };
    return key === 'tagsCsv'
        ? getFuraiTagsCsvAdultTagSanitization(value)
        : getFuraiAdultTagSanitization(value);
}

// Character Card V2 imports preserve unmapped source metadata in Creator Notes.
// Sanitize only the duplicated metadata.tags value in PG-13 artifact copies/views;
// never rewrite the owner's stored Creator Notes or unrelated prose.
function getFuraiImportedCardMetadataAdultTagSanitization(value) {
    const original = String(value || '');
    let text = original;
    let removedCount = 0;
    let searchFrom = 0;
    const headingPattern = /\[Imported Character Card V2 Metadata\]\s*(?:\r?\n)?/ig;

    while (searchFrom < text.length) {
        headingPattern.lastIndex = searchFrom;
        const match = headingPattern.exec(text);
        if (!match) break;

        const contentStart = headingPattern.lastIndex;
        const jsonEnd = getFuraiJsonValueEnd(text, contentStart);
        if (jsonEnd <= contentStart) {
            searchFrom = headingPattern.lastIndex;
            continue;
        }

        try {
            const metadata = JSON.parse(text.slice(contentStart, jsonEnd));
            if (!metadata || typeof metadata !== 'object' || Array.isArray(metadata)) {
                searchFrom = jsonEnd;
                continue;
            }

            const result = getFuraiAdultTagFieldSanitization('tags', metadata.tags);
            if (!result.removedCount) {
                searchFrom = jsonEnd;
                continue;
            }

            metadata.tags = result.value;
            const replacement = `[Imported Character Card V2 Metadata]\n${JSON.stringify(metadata, null, 2)}`;
            const before = text.slice(0, match.index).trimEnd();
            const after = text.slice(jsonEnd).trimStart();
            text = [before, replacement, after].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n');
            removedCount += result.removedCount;
            searchFrom = Math.max(0, before.length + replacement.length);
        } catch (error) {
            // Preserve malformed or hand-edited notes instead of deleting data.
            searchFrom = jsonEnd;
        }
    }

    return {
        removedCount,
        value: removedCount ? text.trim() : original
    };
}

function countFuraiImportedCardMetadataAdultTags(owner = {}) {
    if (!owner || typeof owner !== 'object') return 0;

    const seenValues = new Set();
    let count = 0;

    ['creatorNotes', 'creator_notes'].forEach(key => {
        if (typeof owner[key] !== 'string') return;
        const signature = owner[key];
        if (seenValues.has(signature)) return;
        seenValues.add(signature);
        count += getFuraiImportedCardMetadataAdultTagSanitization(owner[key]).removedCount;
    });

    return count;
}

function countFuraiCharacterAdultTags(character = {}) {
    if (!character || typeof character !== 'object') return 0;
    let count = 0;

    ['hashTag', 'tag', 'tagsCsv'].forEach(key => {
        if (typeof character[key] === 'string') {
            count += getFuraiAdultTagFieldSanitization(key, character[key]).removedCount;
        }
    });

    if (Array.isArray(character.tags)) {
        count += getFuraiAdultTagArraySanitization(character.tags).removedCount;
    } else if (typeof character.tags === 'string') {
        count += getFuraiAdultTagSanitization(character.tags).removedCount;
    }

    count += countFuraiImportedCardMetadataAdultTags(character);
    return count;
}

function countFuraiProfileAdultTags(profile = {}) {
    if (!profile || typeof profile !== 'object') return 0;
    let count = countFuraiCharacterAdultTags(profile.user);
    (Array.isArray(profile.bots) ? profile.bots : []).forEach(character => {
        count += countFuraiCharacterAdultTags(character);
    });

    const roleHistory = profile.roleHistory;
    if (roleHistory && typeof roleHistory === 'object') {
        (Array.isArray(roleHistory.user?.retired) ? roleHistory.user.retired : [])
            .forEach(character => { count += countFuraiCharacterAdultTags(character); });
        const botLanes = roleHistory.bots && typeof roleHistory.bots === 'object'
            ? Object.values(roleHistory.bots)
            : [];
        botLanes.forEach(lane => {
            (Array.isArray(lane?.retired) ? lane.retired : [])
                .forEach(character => { count += countFuraiCharacterAdultTags(character); });
        });
    }

    return count;
}

function countFuraiCharacterArrayAdultTags(characters) {
    if (!Array.isArray(characters)) return 0;
    return characters.reduce(
        (count, character) => count + countFuraiCharacterAdultTags(character),
        0
    );
}

function getFuraiMakerDraftAdultTagCount(draft = {}) {
    if (!draft || typeof draft !== 'object') return 0;
    const tagCount = ['tags', 'hashTag'].reduce((count, key) => {
        if (Array.isArray(draft[key])) {
            return count + getFuraiAdultTagArraySanitization(draft[key]).removedCount;
        }
        return count + getFuraiAdultTagSanitization(draft[key]).removedCount;
    }, 0);
    return tagCount + countFuraiImportedCardMetadataAdultTags(draft);
}

function createFuraiAdultTagExportPlan() {
    return {
        entries: [],
        commits: [],
        metadataTargets: [],
        seenFields: new WeakMap(),
        seenCommitTargets: new WeakSet(),
        seenMetadataTargets: new WeakSet()
    };
}

function addFuraiAdultTagMetadataTarget(plan, data) {
    if (!plan || !data || typeof data !== 'object' || plan.seenMetadataTargets.has(data)) return;
    plan.seenMetadataTargets.add(data);
    plan.metadataTargets.push(data);
}

function addFuraiAdultTagField(plan, owner, key) {
    if (!plan || !owner || typeof owner !== 'object') return;
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(owner, key)) return;

    let seenKeys = plan.seenFields.get(owner);
    if (!seenKeys) {
        seenKeys = new Set();
        plan.seenFields.set(owner, seenKeys);
    }
    if (seenKeys.has(key)) return;
    seenKeys.add(key);

    const original = owner[key];
    const result = getFuraiAdultTagFieldSanitization(key, original);

    if (!result.removedCount) return;
    plan.entries.push({ owner, key, value: result.value, removedCount: result.removedCount });
}

function addFuraiImportedCardMetadataNoteFields(plan, owner) {
    if (!plan || !owner || typeof owner !== 'object') return;

    const seenValues = new Set();

    ['creatorNotes', 'creator_notes'].forEach(key => {
        if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(owner, key)) return;

        let seenKeys = plan.seenFields.get(owner);
        if (!seenKeys) {
            seenKeys = new Set();
            plan.seenFields.set(owner, seenKeys);
        }
        if (seenKeys.has(key)) return;
        seenKeys.add(key);

        const original = owner[key];
        if (typeof original !== 'string') return;

        const result = getFuraiImportedCardMetadataAdultTagSanitization(original);
        if (!result.removedCount) return;

        const duplicateAlias = seenValues.has(original);
        seenValues.add(original);
        plan.entries.push({
            owner,
            key,
            value: result.value,
            removedCount: duplicateAlias ? 0 : result.removedCount
        });
    });
}

function addFuraiAdultCharacterEntries(plan, character) {
    if (!character || typeof character !== 'object') return;
    ['hashTag', 'tag', 'tagsCsv', 'tags'].forEach(key => addFuraiAdultTagField(plan, character, key));
    addFuraiImportedCardMetadataNoteFields(plan, character);
}

function collectFuraiProfileAdultTagEntries(profile, plan) {
    if (!profile || typeof profile !== 'object') return;
    addFuraiAdultCharacterEntries(plan, profile.user);
    (Array.isArray(profile.bots) ? profile.bots : [])
        .forEach(character => addFuraiAdultCharacterEntries(plan, character));

    const roleHistory = profile.roleHistory;
    if (!roleHistory || typeof roleHistory !== 'object') return;
    (Array.isArray(roleHistory.user?.retired) ? roleHistory.user.retired : [])
        .forEach(character => addFuraiAdultCharacterEntries(plan, character));
    const botLanes = roleHistory.bots && typeof roleHistory.bots === 'object'
        ? Object.values(roleHistory.bots)
        : [];
    botLanes.forEach(lane => {
        (Array.isArray(lane?.retired) ? lane.retired : [])
            .forEach(character => addFuraiAdultCharacterEntries(plan, character));
    });
}

function collectFuraiCharacterArrayAdultTagEntries(characters, plan) {
    if (!Array.isArray(characters)) return;
    characters.forEach(character => addFuraiAdultCharacterEntries(plan, character));
}

function collectFuraiPackedMakerDraftAdultTagEntries(state, plan) {
    if (!state || typeof state !== 'object') return;
    const usesLegacyObject = !!(state.makerDraft && typeof state.makerDraft === 'object');
    const declaredCount = Number(state.makerDraftAdultTagCount);
    const markerVersion = Number(state.makerDraftAdultTagSafetyVersion);

    if (
        !usesLegacyObject &&
        markerVersion === FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION &&
        Number.isFinite(declaredCount) &&
        declaredCount <= 0
    ) return;

    const draft = usesLegacyObject ? state.makerDraft : getFuraiStoredMakerDraft(state);
    if (!draft || typeof draft !== 'object') {
        if (state.makerDraftPacked) {
            throw createFuraiHiddenExportInspectionError('A paused Character Maker draft could not be checked for adult-only labels. Reload FurAI and try the export again.');
        }
        state.makerDraftAdultTagCount = 0;
        state.makerDraftAdultTagSafetyVersion = FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION;
        return;
    }

    const before = plan.entries.length;
    addFuraiAdultTagField(plan, draft, 'tags');
    addFuraiAdultTagField(plan, draft, 'hashTag');
    addFuraiImportedCardMetadataNoteFields(plan, draft);
    const found = plan.entries.slice(before).reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.removedCount, 0);
    state.makerDraftAdultTagCount = found;
    state.makerDraftAdultTagSafetyVersion = FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION;

    if (!found || usesLegacyObject || plan.seenCommitTargets.has(state)) return;
    plan.seenCommitTargets.add(state);
    plan.commits.push(() => setFuraiStoredMakerDraft(state, draft));
}

function collectFuraiPackedModeStateAdultTagEntries(state, plan) {
    if (!state || typeof state !== 'object') return;
    const usesLegacyObject = !!(state.profile && typeof state.profile === 'object');
    const declaredCount = Number(state.adultTagCount);
    const markerVersion = Number(state.adultTagSafetyVersion);

    if (
        usesLegacyObject ||
        markerVersion !== FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION ||
        !(Number.isFinite(declaredCount) && declaredCount <= 0)
    ) {
        const profile = usesLegacyObject ? state.profile : getFuraiStoredModeProfile(state);
        if (!profile || typeof profile !== 'object') {
            if (state.profilePacked) {
                throw createFuraiHiddenExportInspectionError('A paused mode profile could not be checked for adult-only labels. Reload FurAI and try the export again.');
            }
            state.adultTagCount = 0;
            state.adultTagSafetyVersion = FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION;
        } else {
            const before = plan.entries.length;
            collectFuraiProfileAdultTagEntries(profile, plan);
            const found = plan.entries.slice(before).reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.removedCount, 0);
            state.adultTagCount = found;
            state.adultTagSafetyVersion = FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION;

            if (found && !usesLegacyObject && !plan.seenCommitTargets.has(state)) {
                plan.seenCommitTargets.add(state);
                plan.commits.push(() => setFuraiStoredModeProfile(state, profile));
            }
        }
    }

    collectFuraiPackedMakerDraftAdultTagEntries(state, plan);
}

function collectFuraiPackedSharedRosterAdultTagEntries(chatData, plan) {
    const morph = chatData?.morph;
    if (!morph || typeof morph !== 'object') return;
    const usesLegacyArray = Array.isArray(morph.sharedRoster);
    const declaredCount = Number(morph.sharedRosterAdultTagCount);
    const markerVersion = Number(morph.sharedRosterAdultTagSafetyVersion);

    if (
        !usesLegacyArray &&
        markerVersion === FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION &&
        Number.isFinite(declaredCount) &&
        declaredCount <= 0
    ) return;

    const roster = usesLegacyArray ? morph.sharedRoster : getFuraiSharedRoster(chatData);
    if (!Array.isArray(roster)) {
        if (morph.sharedRosterPacked) {
            throw createFuraiHiddenExportInspectionError('A shared roster could not be checked for adult-only labels. Reload FurAI and try the export again.');
        }
        morph.sharedRosterAdultTagCount = 0;
        morph.sharedRosterAdultTagSafetyVersion = FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION;
        return;
    }

    const before = plan.entries.length;
    collectFuraiCharacterArrayAdultTagEntries(roster, plan);
    const found = plan.entries.slice(before).reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.removedCount, 0);
    morph.sharedRosterAdultTagCount = found;
    morph.sharedRosterAdultTagSafetyVersion = FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION;

    if (!found || usesLegacyArray || plan.seenCommitTargets.has(morph)) return;
    plan.seenCommitTargets.add(morph);
    plan.commits.push(() => setFuraiSharedRoster(chatData, roster));
}

function collectFuraiChatAdultTagEntries(chatData, plan) {
    if (!chatData || typeof chatData !== 'object') return;
    addFuraiAdultTagField(plan, chatData, 'enhancerTag');
    const modeStates = chatData.morph?.modeStates;
    if (modeStates && typeof modeStates === 'object') {
        Object.values(modeStates).forEach(state => collectFuraiPackedModeStateAdultTagEntries(state, plan));
    }
    collectFuraiPackedSharedRosterAdultTagEntries(chatData, plan);
}

function collectFuraiBackupStorageValueAdultTagEntries(key, value, plan) {
    const storageKey = String(key || '');
    if (storageKey.startsWith('chat-')) {
        collectFuraiChatAdultTagEntries(value, plan);
        return;
    }
    if (storageKey === 'globalBotRoster' || storageKey === 'globalStoryBotRoster') {
        collectFuraiCharacterArrayAdultTagEntries(value, plan);
        return;
    }
    if (storageKey === 'global-group-enhancer-tag') return;
    if (storageKey === 'global-group-enhancer-profile') {
        addFuraiAdultCharacterEntries(plan, value);
        return;
    }
    if (storageKey === 'furaiLivestreamSpeakerSnapshots') {
        const snapshots = value && typeof value === 'object' ? Object.values(value) : [];
        snapshots.forEach(snapshot => addFuraiAdultCharacterEntries(plan, snapshot));
        return;
    }
    if (storageKey === 'furaiLivestreamSpeakerSnapshot') {
        addFuraiAdultCharacterEntries(plan, value);
        return;
    }
    if (storageKey.startsWith('global-user-')) {
        addFuraiAdultCharacterEntries(plan, value);
        return;
    }
    if (storageKey === 'global-profile-user') {
        addFuraiAdultCharacterEntries(plan, value);
        collectFuraiProfileAdultTagEntries(value, plan);
        return;
    }
    if (storageKey.startsWith('profile-') || storageKey.startsWith('global-profile-')) {
        collectFuraiProfileAdultTagEntries(value, plan);
    }
}

function collectFuraiCharacterCardAdultTagEntries(card, plan) {
    const data = card?.data;
    const furai = data?.extensions?.furai;
    if (furai && typeof furai === 'object') addFuraiAdultCharacterEntries(plan, furai);
    if (data && typeof data === 'object') {
        addFuraiAdultTagField(plan, data, 'tags');
        addFuraiImportedCardMetadataNoteFields(plan, data);
    }
}

function collectFuraiKnownArtifactAdultTagEntries(data, plan) {
    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
    const before = plan.entries.length;

    if (data.spec === 'chara_card_v2') {
        collectFuraiCharacterCardAdultTagEntries(data, plan);
    } else if (data.type === 'character' || data.ver === '1.0') {
        addFuraiAdultCharacterEntries(plan, data);
    } else if (data.chat || data.profile) {
        collectFuraiChatAdultTagEntries(data.chat, plan);
        collectFuraiProfileAdultTagEntries(data.profile, plan);
    } else {
        Object.entries(data).forEach(([key, value]) => {
            if (key === FURAI_ARTIFACT_META_KEY || key === 'artifacts') return;
            if (key === 'global-group-enhancer-tag') {
                addFuraiAdultTagField(plan, data, key);
                return;
            }
            collectFuraiBackupStorageValueAdultTagEntries(key, value, plan);
        });
    }

    if (plan.entries.length > before) addFuraiAdultTagMetadataTarget(plan, data);
}

function setFuraiArtifactAdultTagMetadata(data, count, sanitized) {
    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;

    if (!shouldPersistFuraiArtifactCount(data)) {
        const current = data[FURAI_ARTIFACT_META_KEY];
        if (!current || typeof current !== 'object') return;
        const next = { ...current };
        delete next.adultTagCount;
        delete next.adultTagSafetyVersion;
        delete next.pg13Sanitized;
        if (Object.keys(next).length) data[FURAI_ARTIFACT_META_KEY] = next;
        else delete data[FURAI_ARTIFACT_META_KEY];
        return;
    }

    const current = data[FURAI_ARTIFACT_META_KEY] && typeof data[FURAI_ARTIFACT_META_KEY] === 'object'
        ? data[FURAI_ARTIFACT_META_KEY]
        : {};
    data[FURAI_ARTIFACT_META_KEY] = {
        ...current,
        adultTagCount: Math.max(0, Number(count) || 0),
        adultTagSafetyVersion: FURAI_PACKED_SAFETY_VERSION,
        pg13Sanitized: sanitized ? 1 : 0
    };
}

function buildFuraiAdultTagExportPlan(data) {
    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return createFuraiAdultTagExportPlan();
    const attached = data[FURAI_ADULT_TAG_EXPORT_PLAN];
    if (attached?.entries) return attached;

    const plan = createFuraiAdultTagExportPlan();
