function updateGlobalCutsceneInstructionPreview(mode) {
    const currentMode = mode || currentGlobalTab || 'researcher';
    const input = document.getElementById('globalCutsceneInst');
    const countEl = document.getElementById('gCutsceneCount');
    const preview = document.getElementById('globalCutsceneFullPreview');

    const adapterText = input ? input.value : getCutsceneModeAdapter(currentMode);
    const wordCount = countCutsceneInstructionWords(adapterText);

    if (countEl) {
        countEl.textContent = `${wordCount} words · cutscene only`;
        countEl.title = 'Used only when generating a Cutscene. Not included in normal chat context tokens.';
    }

    if (preview) {
        preview.value = buildGlobalCutsceneFullInstructionPreview(currentMode, adapterText);
    }
}

async function buildCutsceneInstruction(options = {}) {
    const thisChatId = currentChatId;
    const personality = chatPersonalities[thisChatId] || 'researcher';
    const profile = getChatProfile(thisChatId);
    const chatData = DB.get(thisChatId) || {};
    const history = buildCutsceneHistory(profile, personality, options.focusIndex);
    const deepMemoryBlock = await getFuraiDeepMemoryContextBlock(
        thisChatId,
        buildFuraiDeepMemoryQueryText('', history),
        chatData
    );

    const assignedDirective = String(options.assignedDirective || '').trim();
    const standaloneAssigned = assignedDirective && options.standaloneAssigned === true;
    const templateOverride = String(options.templateOverride || '').trim();
    let template = standaloneAssigned
        ? getCutsceneAssignedPromptInstructionTemplate(personality)
        : (templateOverride || getCutsceneInstructionTemplate(personality));

    if (assignedDirective) {
        if (standaloneAssigned) {
            // Assigned <cutscene> blocks use their own complete FLUX template.
            // They never inherit automatic Cutscene scene selection or staging.
            if (!template.includes('{{ASSIGNED_REQUEST}}')) {
                template = `${template}

[ASSIGNED REQUEST]
{{ASSIGNED_REQUEST}}`.trim();
            }
        } else {
            // AI Prompt Slots remain part of the normal Cutscene cycle.
            template = appendFuraiAssignedPromptDirective(
                template,
                `Use this additional direction while creating this prompt:
${assignedDirective}`,
                'AI PROMPT SLOT DIRECTION'
            );
        }
    }

    return renderCutsceneInstructionTemplate(template, {
        personality,
        assignedRequest: assignedDirective,
        participantData: buildCutsceneParticipantData(profile, personality, options.focusIndex),
        storyCastData: personality === 'story' ? buildCutsceneStoryCastData(profile, options.focusIndex) : '',
        makerDraftData: personality === 'maker' ? buildCutsceneMakerDraftData() : '',
        referenceBlock: await getResolvedReference(personality, { includeHiddenInstructions: true }),
        history,
        memoBlock: getFuraiEffectiveMemoText(chatData, personality),
        timelessBlock: getFuraiAuthoritativeMemoryText(chatData),
        deepMemoryBlock
    });
}

function clearSmoothCutsceneText(contentEl) {
    if (!contentEl) return;

    const state = contentEl._furaiCutsceneStreamState;

    if (state?.rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(state.rafId);
    delete contentEl._furaiCutsceneStreamState;
    clearFuraiMessageThinkingIndicator(contentEl);
    contentEl.classList.remove('typing');
}

function queueSmoothCutsceneText(contentEl, fullText, afterPaint) {
    if (!contentEl) return;

    clearFuraiMessageThinkingIndicator(contentEl);
    if (!contentEl.classList.contains('typing')) contentEl.classList.add('typing');

    const state = contentEl._furaiCutsceneStreamState || {
        fullText: '',
        visibleText: '',
        rafId: 0,
        lastFrameAt: 0
    };

    state.fullText = String(fullText || '');
    state.afterPaint = typeof afterPaint === 'function' ? afterPaint : null;
    contentEl._furaiCutsceneStreamState = state;

    if (state.rafId) return;

    const paint = (now) => {
        state.rafId = 0;

        if (!document.body.contains(contentEl)) {
            clearSmoothCutsceneText(contentEl);
            return;
        }

        const minFrameMs = typeof FURAI_STREAM_MIN_FRAME_MS === 'number' ? FURAI_STREAM_MIN_FRAME_MS : 28;

        if (now - state.lastFrameAt < minFrameMs) {
            state.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(paint);
            return;
        }

        state.lastFrameAt = now;

        if (
            state.visibleText.length > state.fullText.length ||
            state.fullText.slice(0, state.visibleText.length) !== state.visibleText
        ) {
            state.visibleText = '';
        }

        const lag = state.fullText.length - state.visibleText.length;

        if (lag > 0) {
            const step = typeof getSmoothStreamStep === 'function' ? getSmoothStreamStep(lag) : (lag > 60 ? 10 : 3);
            state.visibleText = state.fullText.slice(0, state.visibleText.length + step);
            const preservedHeaderCount = setFuraiLiveContentHtml(
                contentEl,
                typeof formatLiveTypingContent === 'function'
                    ? formatLiveTypingContent(state.visibleText)
                    : formatMessageContent(state.visibleText)
            );

            if (preservedHeaderCount === 0) {
                placeFuraiAnnouncementHeaderInsideBubble(
                    contentEl.closest('.message'),
                    'cutscene',
                    contentEl.closest('.message')?.dataset.createdAt || '',
                    'Cutscene'
                );
            }

            if (state.afterPaint) state.afterPaint();
        }

        if (state.visibleText.length < state.fullText.length) {
            state.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(paint);
        }
    };

    state.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(paint);
}


const FURAI_BUBBLE_IMAGE_AI_DEFAULTS = {
    researcher: false,
    prompter: false,
    group: true,
    story: true,
    maker: true
};

const FURAI_IMAGE_TRIGGER_DEFAULTS = {
    researcher: { keep: 'selfie', trim: '<append:image>' },
    prompter: { keep: 'aesthetic 11', trim: '<append:image>' },
    group: { keep: 'selfie', trim: '<append:image>' },
    story: {
        keep: 'selfie\nmirror\nportal\nepic\nfury\ntotal assault\nemotional breakdown',
        trim: '<append:image>'
    },
    maker: { keep: 'aesthetic 11', trim: '<append:image>' }
};

const FURAI_CUTSCENE_TRIGGER_DEFAULTS = {
    researcher: { keep: 'cutscene', trim: '<append:cutscene>' },
    prompter: { keep: 'cutscene', trim: '<append:cutscene>' },
    group: { keep: 'cutscene', trim: '<append:cutscene>' },
    story: { keep: 'cutscene', trim: '<append:cutscene>' },
    maker: { keep: 'cutscene', trim: '<append:cutscene>' }
};

const FURAI_IMAGE_TRIGGER_SEED_KEY = 'furai-image-trigger-seed-v1';
const FURAI_CUTSCENE_TRIGGER_SEED_KEY = 'furai-cutscene-trigger-seed-v1';
const FURAI_VISUAL_TRIGGER_FACTORY_V2_KEY = 'furai-visual-trigger-factory-v2';
const FURAI_VISUAL_TRIGGER_FACTORY_V3_KEY = 'furai-visual-trigger-factory-v3';
const furaiVisualTriggerRuntimeCache = Object.create(null);

function clearFuraiVisualTriggerRuntimeCache() {
    for (const key of Object.keys(furaiVisualTriggerRuntimeCache)) {
        delete furaiVisualTriggerRuntimeCache[key];
    }
}

function normalizeFuraiImageTriggerInput(value) {
    const seen = new Set();
    const lines = [];

    for (const rawLine of String(value || '').split(/\r?\n/)) {
        const line = rawLine.trim();
        const key = line.toLowerCase();
        if (!line || seen.has(key)) continue;
        seen.add(key);
        lines.push(line);
    }

    return lines.join('\n');
}

function seedFuraiVisualTriggerDefaults(target, defaultsByMode, seedKey) {
    if (DB.get(seedKey) === true) return;

    for (const [mode, defaults] of Object.entries(defaultsByMode)) {
        const keepKey = `global-${target}-trigger-keep-${mode}`;
        const trimKey = `global-${target}-trigger-trim-${mode}`;

        if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(StorageEngine.cache, keepKey)) {
            DB.set(keepKey, normalizeFuraiImageTriggerInput(defaults.keep));
        }
        if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(StorageEngine.cache, trimKey)) {
            DB.set(trimKey, normalizeFuraiImageTriggerInput(defaults.trim));
        }
    }

    DB.set(seedKey, true);
}

function furaiVisualTriggerConfigMatchesFactoryV1(target) {
    const isCutscene = target === 'cutscene';
    const legacyTrim = `<${target}>
/${target}`;

    return Object.keys(FURAI_IMAGE_TRIGGER_DEFAULTS).every(mode => {
        const legacyKeep = isCutscene
            ? (mode === 'group' || mode === 'story' ? 'cutscene' : '')
            : (
                mode === 'group'
                    ? 'selfie'
                    : (mode === 'story' ? FURAI_IMAGE_TRIGGER_DEFAULTS.story.keep : '')
            );
        const keep = normalizeFuraiImageTriggerInput(DB.get(`global-${target}-trigger-keep-${mode}`));
        const trim = normalizeFuraiImageTriggerInput(DB.get(`global-${target}-trigger-trim-${mode}`));
        return keep === normalizeFuraiImageTriggerInput(legacyKeep) &&
            trim === normalizeFuraiImageTriggerInput(legacyTrim);
    });
}

function applyFuraiVisualTriggerFactory(target, defaultsByMode) {
    for (const [mode, defaults] of Object.entries(defaultsByMode)) {
        DB.set(`global-${target}-trigger-keep-${mode}`, normalizeFuraiImageTriggerInput(defaults.keep));
        DB.set(`global-${target}-trigger-trim-${mode}`, normalizeFuraiImageTriggerInput(defaults.trim));
    }
}

function migrateFuraiVisualTriggerFactoryV2() {
    if (DB.get(FURAI_VISUAL_TRIGGER_FACTORY_V2_KEY) === true) return;

    // Only an untouched v1 factory is upgraded. Any custom trigger anywhere
    // preserves the user's complete trigger configuration exactly.
    if (furaiVisualTriggerConfigMatchesFactoryV1('image')) {
        applyFuraiVisualTriggerFactory('image', FURAI_IMAGE_TRIGGER_DEFAULTS);
    }

    const cutsceneAllEmpty = Object.keys(FURAI_CUTSCENE_TRIGGER_DEFAULTS).every(mode => {
        return !normalizeFuraiImageTriggerInput(DB.get(`global-cutscene-trigger-keep-${mode}`)) &&
            !normalizeFuraiImageTriggerInput(DB.get(`global-cutscene-trigger-trim-${mode}`));
    });

    if (
        cutsceneAllEmpty ||
        furaiVisualTriggerConfigMatchesFactoryV1('cutscene')
    ) {
        applyFuraiVisualTriggerFactory('cutscene', FURAI_CUTSCENE_TRIGGER_DEFAULTS);
    }

    clearFuraiVisualTriggerRuntimeCache();
    DB.set(FURAI_VISUAL_TRIGGER_FACTORY_V2_KEY, true);
}

function migrateFuraiVisualTriggerFactoryV3() {
    if (DB.get(FURAI_VISUAL_TRIGGER_FACTORY_V3_KEY) === true) return;

    const migrations = [
        {
            target: 'image',
            replacement: '<append:image>',
            legacy: new Set(['<image>', '/image'])
        },
        {
            target: 'cutscene',
            replacement: '<append:cutscene>',
            legacy: new Set(['<cutscene>', '/cutscene'])
        }
    ];

    for (const migration of migrations) {
        for (const mode of Object.keys(FURAI_IMAGE_TRIGGER_DEFAULTS)) {
            const key = `global-${migration.target}-trigger-trim-${mode}`;
            const currentLines = normalizeFuraiImageTriggerInput(DB.get(key))
                .split('\n')
                .filter(Boolean);
            let removedLegacy = false;

            const nextLines = currentLines.filter(line => {
                const isLegacy = migration.legacy.has(line.toLowerCase());
                if (isLegacy) removedLegacy = true;
                return !isLegacy;
            });

            if (removedLegacy && !nextLines.some(line => line.toLowerCase() === migration.replacement)) {
                nextLines.push(migration.replacement);
            }

            if (removedLegacy) {
                DB.set(key, normalizeFuraiImageTriggerInput(nextLines.join('\n')));
            }
        }
    }

    clearFuraiVisualTriggerRuntimeCache();
    DB.set(FURAI_VISUAL_TRIGGER_FACTORY_V3_KEY, true);
}

function ensureFuraiVisualTriggerSeeds() {
    seedFuraiVisualTriggerDefaults('image', FURAI_IMAGE_TRIGGER_DEFAULTS, FURAI_IMAGE_TRIGGER_SEED_KEY);
    seedFuraiVisualTriggerDefaults('cutscene', FURAI_CUTSCENE_TRIGGER_DEFAULTS, FURAI_CUTSCENE_TRIGGER_SEED_KEY);
    migrateFuraiVisualTriggerFactoryV2();
    migrateFuraiVisualTriggerFactoryV3();
}

function getGlobalFuraiVisualTriggers(mode, target, type) {
    const personality = mode || 'researcher';
    const triggerTarget = target === 'cutscene' ? 'cutscene' : 'image';
    const triggerType = type === 'trim' ? 'trim' : 'keep';
    const key = `global-${triggerTarget}-trigger-${triggerType}-${personality}`;

    if (!(key in furaiVisualTriggerRuntimeCache)) {
        const stored = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(StorageEngine.cache, key)
            ? DB.get(key)
            : '';
        furaiVisualTriggerRuntimeCache[key] = normalizeFuraiImageTriggerInput(stored);
    }

    return furaiVisualTriggerRuntimeCache[key];
}

function saveGlobalFuraiVisualTriggers(mode, target, type, value) {
    const triggerTarget = target === 'cutscene' ? 'cutscene' : 'image';
    const triggerType = type === 'trim' ? 'trim' : 'keep';
    const key = `global-${triggerTarget}-trigger-${triggerType}-${mode}`;
    const normalized = normalizeFuraiImageTriggerInput(value);

    DB.set(key, normalized);
    furaiVisualTriggerRuntimeCache[key] = normalized;
}

function parseFuraiAssignedPromptBlocks(text, tagName) {
    const original = String(text || '');
    const safeTag = tagName === 'cutscene' ? 'cutscene' : 'image';

    if (!original || !original.includes('<') || !original.toLowerCase().includes(`<${safeTag}`)) {
        return {
            matched: false,
            text: original,
            slots: [],
            entries: [],
            firstIndex: -1
        };
    }

    const entries = [];
    let firstIndex = -1;
    const blockRegex = new RegExp(
        `<\\s*${safeTag}\\s*>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\s*\\/\\s*${safeTag}\\s*>\\s*(?:\\[\\s*(?:number\\s*:\\s*)?(\\d+)\\s*\\])?`,
        'gi'
    );

    const visibleText = original.replace(blockRegex, (fullMatch, slotText, countText, offset) => {
        if (firstIndex === -1) firstIndex = Number(offset);
        entries.push({
            prompt: String(slotText || '').trim(),
            count: clampFuraiPromptRepeatCount(countText, 1, 1)
        });
        return '';
    });

    if (!entries.length) {
        return {
            matched: false,
            text: original,
            slots: [],
            entries: [],
            firstIndex: -1
        };
    }

    return {
        matched: true,
        text: visibleText
            .replace(/[ \t]{2,}/g, ' ')
            .replace(/\n[ \t]*\n[ \t]*\n+/g, '\n\n')
            .trim(),
        slots: entries.map(entry => entry.prompt),
        entries,
        firstIndex
    };
}

function normalizeFuraiAssignedPromptEntries(entries, fallbackSlots = null) {
    const source = Array.isArray(entries) && entries.length
        ? entries
        : (Array.isArray(fallbackSlots) ? fallbackSlots : []);

    return source
        .map(entry => {
            if (typeof entry === 'string') {
                return { prompt: entry.trim(), count: 1 };
            }

            return {
                prompt: String(entry?.prompt || '').trim(),
                count: clampFuraiPromptRepeatCount(entry?.count, 1, 1)
            };
        })
        .filter(entry => entry.prompt);
}

function resolveFuraiConfiguredVisualTrigger(text, mode, target) {
    const original = String(text || '');
    const triggerTarget = target === 'cutscene' ? 'cutscene' : 'image';
    const unchanged = {
        kind: triggerTarget,
        matched: false,
        text: original,
        prompt: original,
        imageOnly: false
    };
    const keep = getGlobalFuraiVisualTriggers(mode, triggerTarget, 'keep').split('\n').filter(Boolean);
    const trim = getGlobalFuraiVisualTriggers(mode, triggerTarget, 'trim').split('\n').filter(Boolean);
    if (!original || (!keep.length && !trim.length)) return unchanged;

    // Ordinary messages exit before any regex is built.
    const lower = original.toLowerCase();
    const keepCandidate = keep.some(phrase => lower.includes(phrase.toLowerCase()));
    const trimCandidate = trim.some(phrase => lower.includes(phrase.toLowerCase()));
    if (!keepCandidate && !trimCandidate) return unchanged;

    const keepMatch = keepCandidate ? findLastFuraiBoundaryPhrase(original, keep) : null;
    const trimMatch = trimCandidate ? findLastFuraiBoundaryPhrase(original, trim) : null;
    if (!keepMatch && !trimMatch) return unchanged;

    const visible = trimMatch ? removeFuraiBoundaryPhrases(original, trim) : original.trim();

    return {
        kind: triggerTarget,
        matched: true,
        text: visible,
        prompt: visible,
        imageOnly: !!trimMatch && !visible
    };
}

function resolveFuraiImageTrigger(text, mode) {
    const original = String(text || '');
    const assignedBlocks = parseFuraiAssignedPromptBlocks(original, 'image');

    if (assignedBlocks.matched) {
        if (!getFuraiAssignedImagePromptCommandEnabled(mode)) {
            return {
                kind: 'image',
                matched: false,
                text: original,
                prompt: original,
                imageOnly: false
            };
        }

        return {
            kind: 'image',
            matched: true,
            text: assignedBlocks.text,
            prompt: assignedBlocks.text,
            imageOnly: !String(assignedBlocks.text || '').trim(),
            assignedImageSlots: assignedBlocks.slots,
            assignedImageEntries: assignedBlocks.entries,
            assignedFirstIndex: assignedBlocks.firstIndex
        };
    }

    return resolveFuraiConfiguredVisualTrigger(original, mode, 'image');
}

function resolveFuraiCutsceneTrigger(text, mode) {
    const original = String(text || '');
    const assignedBlocks = parseFuraiAssignedPromptBlocks(original, 'cutscene');

    if (assignedBlocks.matched) {
        if (!getFuraiAssignedCutscenePromptCommandEnabled(mode)) {
            return {
                kind: 'cutscene',
                matched: false,
                text: original,
                prompt: original,
                imageOnly: false
            };
        }

        return {
            kind: 'cutscene',
            matched: true,
            text: assignedBlocks.text,
            prompt: assignedBlocks.text,
            imageOnly: !String(assignedBlocks.text || '').trim(),
            assignedPromptSlots: assignedBlocks.slots,
            assignedPromptEntries: assignedBlocks.entries,
            assignedFirstIndex: assignedBlocks.firstIndex
        };
    }

    return resolveFuraiConfiguredVisualTrigger(original, mode, 'cutscene');
}

function resolveFuraiAutoVisualTrigger(text, mode) {
    const original = String(text || '');
    const imageBlocks = parseFuraiAssignedPromptBlocks(original, 'image');
    const cutsceneBlocks = parseFuraiAssignedPromptBlocks(original, 'cutscene');
    const assignedActions = [];
    let visibleText = original;

    if (imageBlocks.matched && getFuraiAssignedImagePromptCommandEnabled(mode)) {
        visibleText = parseFuraiAssignedPromptBlocks(visibleText, 'image').text;
        assignedActions.push({
            kind: 'image',
            matched: true,
            assignedImageSlots: imageBlocks.slots,
            assignedImageEntries: imageBlocks.entries,
            assignedFirstIndex: imageBlocks.firstIndex
        });
    }

    if (cutsceneBlocks.matched && getFuraiAssignedCutscenePromptCommandEnabled(mode)) {
        visibleText = parseFuraiAssignedPromptBlocks(visibleText, 'cutscene').text;
        assignedActions.push({
            kind: 'cutscene',
            matched: true,
            assignedPromptSlots: cutsceneBlocks.slots,
            assignedPromptEntries: cutsceneBlocks.entries,
            assignedFirstIndex: cutsceneBlocks.firstIndex
        });
    }

    if (assignedActions.length) {
        assignedActions.sort((a, b) => a.assignedFirstIndex - b.assignedFirstIndex);

        const triggers = assignedActions.map(action => ({
            ...action,
            text: visibleText,
            prompt: visibleText,
            imageOnly: !String(visibleText || '').trim()
        }));

        return {
            kind: triggers.length > 1 ? 'multi' : triggers[0].kind,
            matched: true,
            text: visibleText,
            prompt: visibleText,
            imageOnly: !String(visibleText || '').trim(),
            triggers
        };
    }

    // Cutscene remains the higher-priority normal trigger when no complete assigned blocks exist.
    const cutsceneTrigger = resolveFuraiCutsceneTrigger(original, mode);
    if (cutsceneTrigger.matched) return cutsceneTrigger;

    return resolveFuraiImageTrigger(original, mode);
}

function getFuraiLatestAutoImageAnchor(excludeEl = null) {
    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    const messages = Array.from(chatMessagesEl?.children || []);

    for (let index = messages.length - 1; index >= 0; index--) {
        const messageEl = messages[index];
        if (!(messageEl instanceof HTMLElement) || messageEl === excludeEl) continue;
        if (!messageEl.classList.contains('message')) continue;
        if (messageEl.id === 'personality-selector-message') continue;
        if (messageEl.id?.startsWith('typing-')) continue;
        if (messageEl.classList.contains('system')) continue;
        if (typeof isLiveTypingMessage === 'function' && isLiveTypingMessage(messageEl)) continue;
        return messageEl;
    }

    return null;
}

function getFuraiAutoImageAnchorPrompt(messageEl) {
    const text = messageEl?.querySelector('.content')?.innerText?.trim() || '';
    return text || 'Illustrate the current scene.';
}

const furaiAutoCutsceneQueuedChats = new Set();

function getFuraiAutoCutsceneAnchorMeta(messageEl) {
    const targetEl = messageEl || getFuraiLatestAutoImageAnchor();
    const found = targetEl && typeof furaiGetMessageAtDomElement === 'function'
        ? furaiGetMessageAtDomElement(targetEl)
        : null;

    return {
        messageEl: targetEl || null,
        afterMessageUid: String(found?.msg?.uid || targetEl?.dataset?.messageUid || '').trim(),
        insertIndex: Number.isInteger(found?.index) ? found.index + 1 : null
    };
}

function resolveFuraiAutoCutsceneInsertIndex(job) {
    const uid = String(job?.afterMessageUid || '').trim();

    if (uid && job?.chatId) {
        try {
            const chatData = DB.get(job.chatId) || {};
            const messages = Array.isArray(chatData.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
            const index = messages.findIndex(msg => msg?.uid === uid);
            if (index !== -1) return index + 1;
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    return Number.isInteger(job?.insertIndex) ? job.insertIndex : null;
}

function queueFuraiAutoImageTrigger(messageEl, prompt, chatId = currentChatId, assignedImageSlots = null, assignedImageEntries = null) {
    const targetEl = messageEl || getFuraiLatestAutoImageAnchor();
    const basePrompt = String(prompt || '').trim();
    const fallbackPrompt = getFuraiAutoImageAnchorPrompt(targetEl);
    const hasAssignedBatch = Array.isArray(assignedImageEntries) || Array.isArray(assignedImageSlots);
    const normalizedEntries = normalizeFuraiAssignedPromptEntries(
        assignedImageEntries,
        assignedImageSlots
    );

    // Complete but empty assigned blocks are placeholders, not a request to
    // generate from the previous chat bubble.
    if (hasAssignedBatch && !normalizedEntries.length) return false;

    const safePrompt = basePrompt || normalizedEntries[0]?.prompt || fallbackPrompt;

    if (!targetEl || !safePrompt || targetEl.dataset.furaiAutoImageQueued === '1') return false;

    targetEl.dataset.furaiAutoImageQueued = '1';
    furaiAutoVisualTriggerQueue.push({
        kind: 'image',
        chatId,
        messageEl: targetEl,
        prompt: safePrompt,
        assignedPrompts: normalizedEntries.map(entry => entry.prompt),
        assignedPromptEntries: normalizedEntries
    });
    return true;
}

function queueFuraiAutoCutsceneTrigger(messageEl, chatId = currentChatId, assignedPromptSlots = null, assignedPromptEntries = null) {
    const safeChatId = chatId || currentChatId;
    if (!safeChatId || furaiAutoCutsceneQueuedChats.has(safeChatId)) return false;

    const anchor = getFuraiAutoCutsceneAnchorMeta(messageEl);
    const hasAssignedBatch = Array.isArray(assignedPromptEntries) || Array.isArray(assignedPromptSlots);
    const normalizedEntries = normalizeFuraiAssignedPromptEntries(
        assignedPromptEntries,
        assignedPromptSlots
    );

    // Empty paired tags are editable placeholders and should not fall back to
    // the automatic Cutscene planner.
    if (hasAssignedBatch && !normalizedEntries.length) return false;

    furaiAutoCutsceneQueuedChats.add(safeChatId);
    if (anchor.messageEl) anchor.messageEl.dataset.furaiAutoCutsceneQueued = '1';

    furaiAutoVisualTriggerQueue.push({
        kind: 'cutscene',
        chatId: safeChatId,
        messageEl: anchor.messageEl,
        afterMessageUid: anchor.afterMessageUid,
        insertIndex: anchor.insertIndex,
        assignedPrompts: normalizedEntries.map(entry => entry.prompt),
        assignedPromptEntries: normalizedEntries
    });
    return true;
}

function queueFuraiAutoVisualTrigger(trigger, messageEl, chatId = currentChatId) {
    if (!trigger?.matched) return false;

    if (Array.isArray(trigger.triggers) && trigger.triggers.length) {
        let queuedAny = false;

        for (const childTrigger of trigger.triggers) {
            queuedAny = queueFuraiAutoVisualTrigger(childTrigger, messageEl, chatId) || queuedAny;
        }

        return queuedAny;
    }

    if (trigger.kind === 'cutscene') {
        return queueFuraiAutoCutsceneTrigger(
            messageEl,
            chatId,
            trigger.assignedPromptSlots,
            trigger.assignedPromptEntries
        );
    }

    return queueFuraiAutoImageTrigger(
        messageEl,
        trigger.prompt,
        chatId,
        trigger.assignedImageSlots,
        trigger.assignedImageEntries
    );
}

function clearFuraiAutoVisualTriggerJobState(job) {
    if (!job) return;

    if (job.kind === 'cutscene') {
        furaiAutoCutsceneQueuedChats.delete(job.chatId);
        if (job.messageEl) delete job.messageEl.dataset.furaiAutoCutsceneQueued;
        return;
    }

    if (job.messageEl) delete job.messageEl.dataset.furaiAutoImageQueued;
}

function discardFuraiAutoVisualTriggersForChat(chatId) {
    for (let index = furaiAutoVisualTriggerQueue.length - 1; index >= 0; index--) {
        const job = furaiAutoVisualTriggerQueue[index];
        if (job?.chatId !== chatId) continue;

        clearFuraiAutoVisualTriggerJobState(job);
        furaiAutoVisualTriggerQueue.splice(index, 1);
    }

    furaiAutoCutsceneQueuedChats.delete(chatId);
}

async function processFuraiAutoVisualTriggerQueue(options = {}) {
    const allowWhileGenerating = options.allowWhileGenerating === true;
    const resumeQueue = options.resumeQueue !== false;

    if (
        furaiAutoVisualTriggerBusy ||
        (!allowWhileGenerating && isGenerating) ||
        isCutsceneGenerating ||
        window.furaiActiveMessageImagePromptJobId
    ) {
        return false;
    }

    furaiAutoVisualTriggerBusy = true;
    if (typeof updateSendButtonUI === 'function') updateSendButtonUI();

    try {
        while (furaiAutoVisualTriggerQueue.length) {
            const job = furaiAutoVisualTriggerQueue.shift();
            if (!job) continue;

            if (job.chatId !== currentChatId) {
                clearFuraiAutoVisualTriggerJobState(job);
                continue;
            }

            // A Cutscene is a full foreground generation. During a group batch,
            // leave it queued until the current reply finishes instead of dropping it.
            if (job.kind === 'cutscene' && (isGenerating || isCutsceneGenerating)) {
                furaiAutoVisualTriggerQueue.unshift(job);
                break;
            }

            if (job.kind === 'image' && !job.messageEl?.isConnected) {
                clearFuraiAutoVisualTriggerJobState(job);
                continue;
            }

            try {
                if (job.kind === 'cutscene') {
                    await generateCutscene({
                        insertIndex: resolveFuraiAutoCutsceneInsertIndex(job),
                        autoTriggered: true,
                        assignedPrompts: job.assignedPrompts,
                        assignedPromptEntries: job.assignedPromptEntries
                    });
                } else {
                    await generateImagesForMessage(job.messageEl, job.prompt, {
                        source: 'chat-bubble',
                        allowWhileReplyGenerating: allowWhileGenerating,
                        followChronology: true,
                        assignedPrompts: job.assignedPrompts,
                        assignedPromptEntries: job.assignedPromptEntries,
                        useAiPrompt: job.assignedPrompts.length ? true : undefined
                    });
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error(`Automatic ${job.kind === 'cutscene' ? 'cutscene' : 'image'} trigger failed:`, error);
            } finally {
                clearFuraiAutoVisualTriggerJobState(job);
            }

            if (isCutsceneGenerating || (!allowWhileGenerating && isGenerating)) break;
        }
    } finally {
        furaiAutoVisualTriggerBusy = false;
        if (typeof updateSendButtonUI === 'function') updateSendButtonUI();
    }

    if (
        resumeQueue &&
        !isGenerating &&
        !furaiAiRequestPending &&
        !isCutsceneGenerating &&
        !window.furaiActiveMessageImagePromptJobId
    ) {
        processGenerationQueue();
    }

    return true;
}

function normalizeFuraiCount(value, fallback, minimum) {
    const safeMinimum = Math.max(0, Number.isSafeInteger(minimum) ? minimum : 0);
    const safeFallback = Number.isSafeInteger(fallback)
        ? Math.max(safeMinimum, fallback)
        : safeMinimum;
    const parsed = Number(value);

    if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return safeFallback;

    const integer = Math.floor(parsed);
    return Number.isSafeInteger(integer) && integer >= safeMinimum
        ? integer
        : safeFallback;
}

function clampFuraiImageCount(value, fallback = 1) {
    return normalizeFuraiCount(value, fallback, 1);
}

function getGlobalCutsceneImageCount(mode) {
    const personality = mode || 'researcher';

    try {
        return clampFuraiImageCount(DB.get(`global-cutscene-image-count-${personality}`), 4);
    } catch(e) {
        return 4;
    }
}

function getGlobalBubbleImageCount(mode) {
    const personality = mode || 'researcher';

    try {
        return clampFuraiImageCount(DB.get(`global-bubble-image-count-${personality}`), 1);
    } catch(e) {
        return 1;
    }
}

function clampFuraiPromptRepeatCount(value, fallback = 0, minimum = 0) {
    return normalizeFuraiCount(value, fallback, minimum);
}

function normalizeFuraiExtraPromptSlots(value) {
    const source = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    const normalized = source.map(slot => {
        const prompt = String(slot?.prompt || slot?.instruction || '').trim();
        const savedMode = slot?.mode === 'template'
            ? 'template'
            : (slot?.mode === 'directive' ? 'directive' : '');
        const looksLikeFullTemplate = !!prompt && (
            (prompt.includes('[TASK]') && prompt.includes('[OUTPUT]')) ||
            prompt.includes('{{RECENT_CHAT_HISTORY}}') ||
            prompt.includes('{{FOCUSED_MESSAGE}}') ||
            prompt.includes('{{SCENE_PARTICIPANT_DATA}}')
        );

        const count = clampFuraiPromptRepeatCount(slot?.count, 0, 0);

        return {
            prompt,
            count,
            // Older saved slots were short additive directions. A short-lived build
            // saved copied full templates before adding an explicit mode flag, so
            // recognize those templates without changing genuine legacy directions.
            mode: savedMode || (looksLikeFullTemplate || !prompt ? 'template' : 'directive')
        };
    });

    return normalized.length ? normalized : [{ prompt: '', count: 0, mode: 'template' }];
}

function getFuraiPrimaryPromptTemplate(mode, target = 'image') {
    const personality = mode || 'researcher';
    return target === 'cutscene'
        ? getCutsceneInstructionTemplate(personality)
        : getBubbleImageInstructionTemplate(personality);
}

function hydrateFuraiDefaultPromptSlot(slots, primaryPrompt) {
    const normalized = normalizeFuraiExtraPromptSlots(slots);
    const firstSlot = normalized[0];
    const cleanPrimaryPrompt = String(primaryPrompt || '').trim();

    // Slot 2 is a prepared copy of Prompt 1, but Images 0 keeps it inactive.
    // Preserve legacy blank active slots because they intentionally inherit Prompt 1.
    if (
        firstSlot &&
        firstSlot.count === 0 &&
        firstSlot.mode === 'template' &&
        !firstSlot.prompt &&
        cleanPrimaryPrompt
    ) {
        const hydrated = normalized.slice();
        hydrated[0] = {
            ...firstSlot,
            prompt: cleanPrimaryPrompt
        };
        return hydrated;
    }

    return normalized;
}

function getFuraiVisualPromptBatchConfig(mode, target = 'image') {
    const personality = mode || 'researcher';
    const kind = target === 'cutscene' ? 'cutscene' : 'bubble';
    const primaryKey = `global-${kind}-prompt-primary-count-${personality}`;
    const commandsKey = `global-${kind}-prompt-command-toggle-${personality}`;
    const slotsKey = `global-${kind}-prompt-extra-slots-${personality}`;
    const primaryPrompt = getFuraiPrimaryPromptTemplate(personality, kind);

    const defaultPrimaryCount = kind === 'cutscene' ? 4 : 1;
    let primaryCount = defaultPrimaryCount;
    let assignedCommandsEnabled = true;
    let extraSlots = hydrateFuraiDefaultPromptSlot(null, primaryPrompt);

    try {
        const savedPrimaryCount = DB.get(primaryKey);
        assignedCommandsEnabled = DB.get(commandsKey) !== false;
        extraSlots = hydrateFuraiDefaultPromptSlot(DB.get(slotsKey), primaryPrompt);

        const hasActiveExtraSlot = extraSlots.some(slot => slot.count > 0);

        // The previous Cutscene default was 1. Quietly present the new default of 4
        // when no real slot-cycle customization exists, while preserving custom cycles.
        if (
            kind === 'cutscene' &&
            Number(savedPrimaryCount) === 1 &&
            !hasActiveExtraSlot
        ) {
            primaryCount = 4;
        } else {
            primaryCount = clampFuraiPromptRepeatCount(
                savedPrimaryCount,
                defaultPrimaryCount,
                1
            );
        }
    } catch(e) {}

    return {
        primaryCount,
        assignedCommandsEnabled,
        extraSlots
    };
}

function saveFuraiVisualPromptBatchConfig(mode, target, config = {}) {
    const personality = mode || 'researcher';
    const kind = target === 'cutscene' ? 'cutscene' : 'bubble';
    const defaultPrimaryCount = kind === 'cutscene' ? 4 : 1;

    DB.set(
        `global-${kind}-prompt-primary-count-${personality}`,
        clampFuraiPromptRepeatCount(config.primaryCount, defaultPrimaryCount, 1)
    );
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(config, 'assignedCommandsEnabled')) {
        DB.set(
            `global-${kind}-prompt-command-toggle-${personality}`,
            config.assignedCommandsEnabled !== false
        );
    }
    DB.set(
        `global-${kind}-prompt-extra-slots-${personality}`,
        normalizeFuraiExtraPromptSlots(config.extraSlots)
    );
}

function makeFuraiPromptBatchPlan(totalCount, slots) {
    const total = clampFuraiImageCount(totalCount, 1);
    const source = Array.isArray(slots) ? slots : [];
    const active = source
        .map((slot, index) => ({
            ...slot,
            sourceIndex: Number.isInteger(slot?.sourceIndex) ? slot.sourceIndex : index,
            count: clampFuraiPromptRepeatCount(slot?.count, index === 0 ? 1 : 0, index === 0 ? 1 : 0)
        }))
        .filter(slot => slot.count > 0);

    const safeActive = active.length
        ? active
        : [{ sourceIndex: 0, prompt: '', instruction: '', count: 1, isPrimary: true }];
    const cycle = [];

    for (const slot of safeActive) {
        for (let repeat = 0; repeat < slot.count; repeat++) {
            cycle.push(slot.sourceIndex);
        }
    }

    if (!cycle.length) cycle.push(safeActive[0].sourceIndex);

    const cycleLength = Math.max(1, cycle.length);

    return {
        total,
        slots: safeActive,
        cycleLength,
        order: Array.from({ length: total }, (_, index) => {
            const cycleIndex = Math.floor(index / cycleLength);
            const sourceIndex = cycle[index % cycleLength];
            return {
                sourceIndex,
                cycleIndex,
                key: `${cycleIndex}:${sourceIndex}`
            };
        })
    };
}

function getFuraiPromptBatchUniqueEntries(plan) {
    const unique = [];
    const seen = new Set();

    for (const rawEntry of (plan?.order || [])) {
        const entry = (rawEntry && typeof rawEntry === 'object')
            ? rawEntry
            : {
                sourceIndex: Number.isInteger(rawEntry) ? rawEntry : 0,
                cycleIndex: 0,
                key: `0:${Number.isInteger(rawEntry) ? rawEntry : 0}`
            };
        const sourceIndex = Number.isInteger(entry.sourceIndex) ? entry.sourceIndex : 0;
        const cycleIndex = Number.isInteger(entry.cycleIndex) ? entry.cycleIndex : 0;
        const key = String(entry.key || `${cycleIndex}:${sourceIndex}`);

        if (seen.has(key)) continue;
        seen.add(key);
        unique.push({ sourceIndex, cycleIndex, key });
    }

    return unique;
}

function getFuraiPromptBatchEntryCounts(plan) {
    const counts = new Map();

    for (const rawEntry of (plan?.order || [])) {
        const entry = (rawEntry && typeof rawEntry === 'object')
            ? rawEntry
            : {
                sourceIndex: Number.isInteger(rawEntry) ? rawEntry : 0,
                cycleIndex: 0,
                key: `0:${Number.isInteger(rawEntry) ? rawEntry : 0}`
            };
        const sourceIndex = Number.isInteger(entry.sourceIndex) ? entry.sourceIndex : 0;
        const cycleIndex = Number.isInteger(entry.cycleIndex) ? entry.cycleIndex : 0;
        const key = String(entry.key || `${cycleIndex}:${sourceIndex}`);

        counts.set(key, (counts.get(key) || 0) + 1);
    }

    return counts;
}

function buildFuraiPromptListFromResolvedSlots(plan, resolvedByIndex) {
    const fallback = String(
        resolvedByIndex?.get?.('0:0') ||
        resolvedByIndex?.get?.(0) ||
        ''
    ).trim();

    return (plan?.order || []).map(rawEntry => {
        const entry = (rawEntry && typeof rawEntry === 'object')
            ? rawEntry
            : {
                sourceIndex: Number.isInteger(rawEntry) ? rawEntry : 0,
                cycleIndex: 0,
                key: `0:${Number.isInteger(rawEntry) ? rawEntry : 0}`
            };
        const sourceIndex = Number.isInteger(entry.sourceIndex) ? entry.sourceIndex : 0;
        const cycleIndex = Number.isInteger(entry.cycleIndex) ? entry.cycleIndex : 0;
        const key = String(entry.key || `${cycleIndex}:${sourceIndex}`);

        return String(
            resolvedByIndex?.get?.(key) ||
            resolvedByIndex?.get?.(`${cycleIndex}:0`) ||
            resolvedByIndex?.get?.(sourceIndex) ||
            resolvedByIndex?.get?.(0) ||
            fallback ||
            ''
        ).trim();
    }).filter(Boolean);
}

function appendFuraiAssignedPromptDirective(template, directive, label = 'ASSIGNED IMAGE PROMPT') {
    const cleanTemplate = String(template || '').trim();
    const cleanDirective = String(directive || '').trim();
    if (!cleanDirective) return cleanTemplate;

    const block = `[${label}]
${cleanDirective}`;
    const outputIndex = cleanTemplate.lastIndexOf('[OUTPUT]');

    if (outputIndex === -1) {
        return `${cleanTemplate}

${block}`.trim();
    }

    return `${cleanTemplate.slice(0, outputIndex).trimEnd()}

${block}

${cleanTemplate.slice(outputIndex)}`.trim();
}

function renderFuraiPromptSlotRows(target, slots) {
    const safeTarget = target === 'cutscene' ? 'cutscene' : 'bubble';
    const safeSlots = normalizeFuraiExtraPromptSlots(slots);

    return safeSlots.map((slot, index) => {
        const slotNumber = index + 2;
        return `
            <div class="furai-assigned-prompt-slot"
                 data-furai-prompt-target="${safeTarget}"
                 data-furai-prompt-slot-mode="${slot.mode === 'template' ? 'template' : 'directive'}"
                 style="padding:10px; border:1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius:7px; background:var(--input-bg); display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; min-width:0;">
                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px 10px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                    <strong data-furai-prompt-slot-label style="font-size:12px;">AI Prompt Slot ${slotNumber}</strong>
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; max-width:100%;">
                        <label style="font-size:11px; opacity:.68; white-space:nowrap;">Images</label>
                        <input class="furai-assigned-prompt-count"
                               type="number"
                               min="0"
                               step="1"
                               value="${slot.count}"
                               style="width:66px; padding:5px 7px; border-radius:6px; border:1px solid var(--border-color); background:var(--sidebar-bg); color:var(--text-color);">
                        <button type="button"
                                onclick="removeFuraiAssignedPromptSlot(this)"
                                title="Remove prompt slot"
                                style="border:0; background:none; color:var(--text-muted); cursor:pointer; padding:4px; display:flex; align-items:center;">
                            <span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size:18px;">close</span>
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <textarea class="furai-assigned-prompt-text"
                          rows="${slot.mode === 'template' && slot.prompt ? 12 : 6}"
                          style="width:100%; min-height:112px; box-sizing:border-box; resize:vertical; padding:8px 9px; background:var(--sidebar-bg); color:var(--text-color); border:1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius:6px; font-size:12px; line-height:1.4; font-family:inherit;">${escapeHTML(slot.prompt)}</textarea>
            </div>`;
    }).join('');
}

function syncFuraiAssignedPromptSlotLabels(target) {
    const safeTarget = target === 'cutscene' ? 'cutscene' : 'bubble';
    const container = document.getElementById(
        safeTarget === 'cutscene'
            ? 'globalCutsceneAdvancedPromptSlots'
            : 'globalBubbleAdvancedPromptSlots'
    );
    if (!container) return;

    Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('.furai-assigned-prompt-slot')).forEach((row, index) => {
        const label = row.querySelector('[data-furai-prompt-slot-label]');
        if (label) label.textContent = `AI Prompt Slot ${index + 2}`;
    });
}

function getFuraiPrimaryPromptValueFromDom(target) {
    const safeTarget = target === 'cutscene' ? 'cutscene' : 'bubble';
    const primaryPromptTextarea = document.getElementById(
        safeTarget === 'cutscene'
            ? 'globalCutsceneInst'
            : 'globalBubbleImageInst'
    );
    const currentValue = String(primaryPromptTextarea?.value || '').trim();

    if (currentValue) return currentValue;

    return getFuraiPrimaryPromptTemplate(
        currentGlobalTab || 'researcher',
        safeTarget
    );
}

function addFuraiAssignedPromptSlot(target) {
    const safeTarget = target === 'cutscene' ? 'cutscene' : 'bubble';
    const container = document.getElementById(
        safeTarget === 'cutscene'
            ? 'globalCutsceneAdvancedPromptSlots'
            : 'globalBubbleAdvancedPromptSlots'
    );
    if (!container) return;

    const inheritedPrompt = getFuraiPrimaryPromptValueFromDom(safeTarget);

    // Every visible slot is real. Add Prompt always appends the next slot instead
    // of reusing or overwriting the prepared zero-count Slot 2.
    container.insertAdjacentHTML(
        'beforeend',
        renderFuraiPromptSlotRows(safeTarget, [{
            prompt: inheritedPrompt,
            count: 1,
            mode: 'template'
        }])
    );
    const newRow = container.lastElementChild;

    syncFuraiAssignedPromptSlotLabels(safeTarget);

    if (safeTarget === 'bubble') {
        const aiHelperToggle = document.getElementById('globalBubbleImageAiToggle');
        if (aiHelperToggle) aiHelperToggle.checked = true;
    }

    // A new slot should participate immediately. Expand the total to include
    // the complete active cycle; there is no arbitrary image-count ceiling.
    const totalInput = document.getElementById(
        safeTarget === 'cutscene' ? 'globalCutsceneImageCount' : 'globalBubbleImageCount'
    );
    const primaryCountInput = document.getElementById(
        safeTarget === 'cutscene' ? 'globalCutscenePrimaryPromptCount' : 'globalBubblePrimaryPromptCount'
    );
    const primaryCount = clampFuraiPromptRepeatCount(primaryCountInput?.value, 1, 1);
    const extraCount = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('.furai-assigned-prompt-count'))
        .reduce((sum, input) => sum + clampFuraiPromptRepeatCount(input.value, 0, 0), 0);
    const requiredTotal = primaryCount + extraCount;

    if (totalInput) {
        const currentTotal = clampFuraiImageCount(totalInput.value, 1);
        totalInput.value = String(Math.max(currentTotal, requiredTotal));
    }

    const newTextarea = newRow?.querySelector?.('.furai-assigned-prompt-text');
    if (newTextarea && typeof newTextarea.focus === 'function') {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            try {
                newTextarea.focus({ preventScroll: true });
                const end = newTextarea.value.length;
                if (typeof newTextarea.setSelectionRange === 'function') {
                    newTextarea.setSelectionRange(end, end);
                }
            } catch (_) {}
        });
    }
}

function removeFuraiAssignedPromptSlot(button) {
    const row = button?.closest?.('.furai-assigned-prompt-slot');
    const target = row?.dataset?.furaiPromptTarget === 'cutscene' ? 'cutscene' : 'bubble';
    const container = row?.parentElement;
    if (!row || !container) return;

    const rows = container.querySelectorAll('.furai-assigned-prompt-slot');
    if (rows.length <= 1) {
        const textInput = row.querySelector('.furai-assigned-prompt-text');
        const countInput = row.querySelector('.furai-assigned-prompt-count');
        const inheritedPrompt = getFuraiPrimaryPromptValueFromDom(target);

        row.dataset.furaiPromptSlotMode = 'template';
        if (textInput) {
            textInput.value = inheritedPrompt;
            textInput.rows = 12;
        }
        if (countInput) countInput.value = '0';
        return;
    }

    row.remove();
    syncFuraiAssignedPromptSlotLabels(target);
}

function readFuraiAssignedPromptSlotsFromDom(target) {
    const safeTarget = target === 'cutscene' ? 'cutscene' : 'bubble';
    const container = document.getElementById(
        safeTarget === 'cutscene'
            ? 'globalCutsceneAdvancedPromptSlots'
            : 'globalBubbleAdvancedPromptSlots'
    );
    if (!container) return [{ prompt: '', count: 0 }];

    const slots = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('.furai-assigned-prompt-slot')).map(row => ({
        prompt: row.querySelector('.furai-assigned-prompt-text')?.value || '',
        count: row.querySelector('.furai-assigned-prompt-count')?.value || 0,
        mode: row.dataset.furaiPromptSlotMode === 'template' ? 'template' : 'directive'
    }));

    return normalizeFuraiExtraPromptSlots(slots);
}

function getBubbleImageAiDefault(mode) {
    return FURAI_BUBBLE_IMAGE_AI_DEFAULTS[mode || 'researcher'] === true;
}

function getGlobalBubbleImageAiEnabled(mode) {
    const personality = mode || 'researcher';

    try {
        const saved = DB.get(`global-bubble-image-ai-${personality}`);
        if (saved === true || saved === false) return saved;
    } catch(e) {}

    return getBubbleImageAiDefault(personality);
}

function getBubbleImageAiPreferenceForChat(chatId) {
    if (!chatId) return '';

    try {
        const chatData = DB.get(chatId) || {};
        const saved = chatData.bubbleImageAi;

        if (saved === 'on' || saved === 'off') return saved;
    } catch(e) {}

    return '';
}

function getBubbleImageAiEnabledForChat(chatId, mode) {
    const localPreference = getBubbleImageAiPreferenceForChat(chatId);

    if (localPreference === 'on') return true;
    if (localPreference === 'off') return false;

    return getGlobalBubbleImageAiEnabled(mode);
}

function getBubbleImageModeAdapter(personality) {
    const adapters = {
        group: `
[GROUP MODE]
The focused message is the visual target.
Create a solo square image of that message's speaker performing the implied action, emotion, pose, or reaction.
Make the speaker the visible subject. The camera/audience sees that character solo, rather than looking through their eyes.
Use context only to preserve identity, outfit, species, body shape, markings, accessories, setting, and emotional continuity.
Do not turn this into a group poster. Include other characters only as vague context when absolutely necessary.
End with (resolution:::768x768).`,

        story: `
[STORY MODE]
The focused message is the story beat to illustrate.
Use nearby story history, lore, memo, and key facts to preserve continuity, but do not drift to a different latest scene.
Create a readable cinematic story illustration centered on the focused action, reaction, setting, or reveal.`,

        maker: `
[CHARACTER MAKER MODE]
The focused message and current maker draft are the character-design source.
Create a square 768x768 avatar headshot / bust prompt.
Focus on face, expression, species, hair/fur/skin markings, key accessories, personality vibe, clean readable silhouette, and simple background.
Do not create a random full-body action scene unless the focused message explicitly asks for it.
End with (resolution:::768x768).`,

        prompter: `
[PROMPT MODE]
The focused message is already visual prompt material.
Polish only enough to make it stable for FLUX.1 image generation.
Preserve literal subject, colors, outfit, body traits, pose, composition, and requested style. Do not add unrelated story context.`,

        researcher: `
[RESEARCH MODE]
The focused message is the topic to visualize.
When it is not roleplay, create a clean illustrative concept image, editorial illustration, diagram-like scene, or symbolic visual based on the focused message.`
    };

    return (adapters[personality] || adapters.researcher).trim();
}
