function getActiveMessageText(msg) {
    if (!msg) return '';

    if (msg.role === 'ai' && Array.isArray(msg.variants) && msg.variants.length > 0) {
        const activeIndex = typeof getSafeMessageVariantIndex === 'function'
            ? getSafeMessageVariantIndex(msg)
            : Number(msg.activeVariantIndex);

        const safeIndex =
            Number.isInteger(activeIndex) &&
            activeIndex >= 0 &&
            activeIndex < msg.variants.length
                ? activeIndex
                : msg.variants.length - 1;

        const variant = msg.variants[safeIndex];
        return String(variant?.content || msg.content || '').trim();
    }

    return String(msg.content || '').trim();
}

function getBubbleImageSpeakerName(msg, profile, personality) {
    if (!msg) return '';

    if (msg.role === 'user') {
        const actor = resolveFuraiActorForMessage(currentChatId, msg, profile);
        return actor?.name || msg.userNameSnapshot || profile?.user?.name || 'User';
    }

    if (isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(msg.role) || msg.role === 'system') {
        return '';
    }

    if (msg.role === 'cutscene') {
        return 'Cutscene';
    }

    if (msg.role !== 'ai') {
        return msg.role || 'Message';
    }

    if (personality === 'group' && typeof getGroupContextSpeakerName === 'function') {
        const groupName = getGroupContextSpeakerName(msg, profile);
        if (groupName && groupName !== 'AI') return groupName;
    }

    const actor = resolveFuraiActorForMessage(currentChatId, msg, profile);
    return actor?.name || msg.botNameSnapshot || 'Unknown Character';
}

function buildFocusedChatBubbleBlock(messageEl, rawPrompt, found, profile, personality) {
    const msg = found?.msg || null;
    const role = msg?.role || messageEl?.dataset?.role || 'message';
    const content = (rawPrompt || getActiveMessageText(msg) || messageEl?.querySelector('.content')?.innerText || '').trim();

    // A nameless announcement enters image-prompt context as raw event text only.
    if (isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(role) || role === 'system') return content;

    const speaker = getBubbleImageSpeakerName(msg, profile, personality) || messageEl?.querySelector('.chat-username')?.innerText?.trim() || 'Unknown Speaker';
    const lines = [
        `Role: ${role}`,
        `Speaker: ${speaker}`,
        `Text: ${content}`
    ];

    if (Number.isInteger(found?.index)) {
        lines.unshift(`Message Index: ${found.index}`);
    }

    if (msg?.uid) {
        lines.unshift(`Message UID: ${msg.uid}`);
    }

    return lines.join('\n');
}

window.furaiMessageImagePromptJobs = window.furaiMessageImagePromptJobs || {};

function combineStoppedMessageImagePrompt(partialText = '', rawPrompt = '') {
    const partial = String(partialText || '').trim();
    const raw = String(rawPrompt || '').trim();

    if (partial && raw) {
        return normalizeCutscenePrompt(`${raw}

${partial}`);
    }

    return normalizeCutscenePrompt(partial || raw);
}

function createMessageImagePromptJob(messageEl, chatId, rawPrompt = '') {
    const id = `message-image-prompt-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;

    window.furaiMessageImagePromptJobs[id] = {
        id,
        messageEl,
        chatId,
        rawPrompt: String(rawPrompt || ''),
        partialText: '',
        abortController: typeof AbortController !== 'undefined' ? new AbortController() : null,
        cancelled: false,
        resolveCancel: null
    };

    return id;
}

window.cancelBubbleImageAiPrompt = function(requestId) {
    const id = String(requestId || '').trim();
    const job = window.furaiMessageImagePromptJobs?.[id];
    if (!job) return;

    job.cancelled = true;

    try {
        if (job.abortController && typeof job.abortController.abort === 'function') {
            job.abortController.abort();
        }
    } catch(e) {}

    const stoppedPrompt = combineStoppedMessageImagePrompt(job.partialText, job.rawPrompt);

    if (typeof job.resolveCancel === 'function') {
        job.resolveCancel(stoppedPrompt);
    }

    if (window.furaiActiveMessageImagePromptJobId === id) {
        window.furaiActiveMessageImagePromptJobId = '';
    }

    hideBubbleImageAiPromptHint(id);

    if (typeof updateSendButtonUI === 'function') {
        updateSendButtonUI();
    }

    if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
        showToast(job.partialText && job.partialText.trim()
            ? 'Using partial prompt + message text.'
            : 'Using message text.');
    }
};

function showBubbleImageAiPromptHint(requestId = '') {
    const text = 'Preparing image prompt…';
    const safeRequestId = String(requestId || '').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '');

    const html = `
        <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-width:0;">
            <span style="white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;">${text}</span>
        </div>
    `;

    if (typeof showOverlayHint === 'function') {
        showOverlayHint(html, 0);

        setTimeout(() => {
            const hintEl = document.getElementById('globalOverlayHint');
            if (!hintEl) return;

            hintEl.dataset.furaiHintKind = 'message-image-prompt';
            if (safeRequestId) hintEl.dataset.furaiHintRequestId = safeRequestId;
        }, 60);
    } else if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
        showToast(text, 'info');
    }
}

function hideBubbleImageAiPromptHint(requestId = '') {
    const hintEl = document.getElementById('globalOverlayHint');
    if (!hintEl || hintEl.dataset.furaiHintKind !== 'message-image-prompt') return;

    const safeRequestId = String(requestId || '').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '');
    if (safeRequestId && hintEl.dataset.furaiHintRequestId && hintEl.dataset.furaiHintRequestId !== safeRequestId) return;

    hintEl.classList.remove('visible');
    delete hintEl.dataset.furaiHintKind;
    delete hintEl.dataset.furaiHintRequestId;

    if (window.overlayHintTimeout) {
        clearTimeout(window.overlayHintTimeout);
        window.overlayHintTimeout = null;
    }
}

async function buildBubbleImagePrompt(messageEl, rawPrompt, jobId = '', options = {}) {
    const thisChatId = currentChatId;
    const personality = chatPersonalities[thisChatId] || 'researcher';
    const profile = getChatProfile(thisChatId);
    const chatData = DB.get(thisChatId) || {};
    const found = typeof furaiGetMessageAtDomElement === 'function'
        ? furaiGetMessageAtDomElement(messageEl)
        : null;

    const promptJobId = String(jobId || '').trim();
    const promptJob = promptJobId ? window.furaiMessageImagePromptJobs?.[promptJobId] : null;
    const focusedIndex = Number.isInteger(found?.index) ? found.index + 1 : null;
    const assignedDirective = String(options.assignedDirective || '').trim();
    const baseTemplate = String(options.templateOverride || getBubbleImageInstructionTemplate(personality)).trim();
    const template = assignedDirective && !baseTemplate.includes('{{ASSIGNED_REQUEST}}')
        ? appendFuraiAssignedPromptDirective(
            baseTemplate,
            assignedDirective,
            'ASSIGNED IMAGE PROMPT'
        )
        : baseTemplate;

    const instruction = renderCutsceneInstructionTemplate(template, {
        personality,
        assignedRequest: assignedDirective,
        focusedBubble: buildFocusedChatBubbleBlock(messageEl, rawPrompt, found, profile, personality),
        participantData: buildCutsceneParticipantData(profile, personality, focusedIndex),
        storyCastData: personality === 'story' ? buildCutsceneStoryCastData(profile, focusedIndex) : '',
        makerDraftData: personality === 'maker' ? buildCutsceneMakerDraftData() : '',
        referenceBlock: await getResolvedReference(personality, { includeHiddenInstructions: true }),
        history: buildCutsceneHistory(profile, personality, focusedIndex),
        memoBlock: getFuraiEffectiveMemoText(chatData, personality),
        timelessBlock: getFuraiAuthoritativeMemoryText(chatData)
    });

    let generatedDraft = '';

    try {
        const generated = await generateText({
            instruction,
            signal: promptJob?.abortController?.signal,
            onChunk: (data) => {
                if (promptJob?.cancelled || data?.isFromStartWith) return;

                const chunk = data?.textChunk || '';
                if (!chunk) return;

                generatedDraft += chunk;

                if (promptJob) {
                    promptJob.partialText = generatedDraft;
                }
            }
        });

        return normalizeCutscenePrompt(generated || generatedDraft || rawPrompt);
    } catch (error) {
        if (promptJob?.cancelled || error?.name === 'AbortError') {
            return null;
        }

        throw error;
    }
}

async function generateCutscene(options = {}) {
    if (!currentChatId) return;

    const thisChatId = currentChatId;
    const personality = chatPersonalities[thisChatId] || 'researcher';
    const replaceMessageUid = String(options.replaceMessageUid || '').trim();
    const autoTriggered = options.autoTriggered === true;
    const assignedCutsceneEntries = normalizeFuraiAssignedPromptEntries(
        options.assignedPromptEntries,
        options.assignedPrompts
    );

    let insertIndex = Number.isInteger(options.insertIndex) ? options.insertIndex : null;
    let messageCountAtStart = 0;

    try {
        const chatData = DB.get(thisChatId) || {};
        const messages = Array.isArray(chatData.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
        messageCountAtStart = messages.length;

        if (replaceMessageUid) {
            const replaceIndex = messages.findIndex(msg => msg?.uid === replaceMessageUid);
            if (replaceIndex !== -1) insertIndex = replaceIndex;
        }
    } catch(e) {}

    const isHistoricalAutoInsert =
        autoTriggered &&
        Number.isInteger(insertIndex) &&
        insertIndex >= 0 &&
        insertIndex < messageCountAtStart;

    const isRedoInsert =
        !!replaceMessageUid ||
        (!autoTriggered && insertIndex !== null) ||
        isHistoricalAutoInsert;

    const menu = document.getElementById('settingsMenu');
    if (menu && menu.classList.contains('show')) menu.classList.remove('show');

    const ownsAutoVisualQueue = autoTriggered && furaiAutoVisualTriggerBusy;
    const cutsceneBlocked =
        isGenerating ||
        isCutsceneGenerating ||
        !!window.furaiActiveMessageImagePromptJobId ||
        (!ownsAutoVisualQueue && (furaiAiRequestPending || furaiAutoVisualTriggerBusy));

    if (cutsceneBlocked) {
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
            showToast('A reply or cutscene is already generating.');
        } else if (typeof showOverlayHint === 'function') {
            showOverlayHint('A reply or cutscene is already generating.', 2500);
        }
        return;
    }

    yieldFuraiDeepMemoryToForeground(thisChatId);
    isCutsceneGenerating = true;
    setCutsceneButtonBusy(true);
    updateSendButtonUI();

    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    const cutsceneTimestampMeta = {
        ...makeMessageTimestampMeta(thisChatId),
        ...(replaceMessageUid ? { replaceMessageUid } : {})
    };
    
    const bubble = addCutsceneBubble(
        null,
        insertIndex,
        cutsceneTimestampMeta,
        replaceMessageUid
    );
    const contentEl = bubble?.querySelector('.content');

    const scrollCrToBottom = () => {
        if (!chatMessagesEl) return;

        if (typeof scrollElementToBottom === 'function') {
            scrollElementToBottom(chatMessagesEl);
        } else {
            chatMessagesEl.scrollTop = chatMessagesEl.scrollHeight;
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            if (typeof scrollElementToBottom === 'function') {
                scrollElementToBottom(chatMessagesEl);
            } else {
                chatMessagesEl.scrollTop = chatMessagesEl.scrollHeight;
            }
        });
    };

    const getCutsceneLiveIndex = (targetBubble = bubble) => {
        const validMessages = Array.from(chatMessagesEl?.querySelectorAll('.message') || [])
            .filter(m => !m.id.startsWith('typing-') && m.id !== 'personality-selector-message');

        return validMessages.indexOf(targetBubble);
    };

    const updateCutsceneBottomState = (phase = 'typing', targetBubble = bubble) => {
        if (isRedoInsert) return;

        const isVn = document.body.classList.contains('vn-active');

        if (!isVn) {
            if (autoScroll) {
                if (typeof hideCrBottomStatusPill === 'function') {
                    hideCrBottomStatusPill();
                }

                scrollCrToBottom();
                return;
            }

            if (phase === 'done') {
                if (typeof hideCrBottomStatusPill === 'function') {
                    hideCrBottomStatusPill('typing');
                }

                autoScroll = false;

                if (typeof showCrUnreadHint === 'function') {
                    showCrUnreadHint('New cutscene');
                }

                return;
            }

            if (typeof showCrCutscenePreparingHint === 'function') {
                showCrCutscenePreparingHint(bubble);
            } else if (typeof showCrTypingHint === 'function') {
                showCrTypingHint('Cutscene');
            }

            return;
        }

        if (typeof syncVnData === 'function') {
            syncVnData();
        }

        if (typeof shouldVnAutoFollowMessage === 'function' && shouldVnAutoFollowMessage(targetBubble)) {
            if (typeof hideVnStatusHint === 'function') {
                hideVnStatusHint();
            }

            const liveIndex = getCutsceneLiveIndex(targetBubble);
            if (liveIndex !== -1) vnCurrentIndex = liveIndex;

            if (typeof renderVnMessage === 'function') {
                renderVnMessage('bottom');
            }

            return;
        }

        if (phase === 'done') {
            if (typeof hideVnStatusHint === 'function') {
                hideVnStatusHint('typing');
            }

            vnAutoScroll = false;

            if (typeof showVnUnreadHint === 'function') {
                showVnUnreadHint('New cutscene');
            }

            return;
        }

        if (typeof showVnCutscenePreparingHint === 'function') {
            showVnCutscenePreparingHint(targetBubble);
        } else if (typeof showVnTypingHint === 'function') {
            showVnTypingHint('Cutscene');
        }
    };

    updateCutsceneBottomState('typing');

    let responseText = '';
    let nextInsertIndex = insertIndex;

    const advanceInsertIndex = (savedIndex) => {
        if (Number.isInteger(savedIndex)) {
            nextInsertIndex = savedIndex + 1;
        } else if (Number.isInteger(nextInsertIndex)) {
            nextInsertIndex += 1;
        } else {
            nextInsertIndex = null;
        }
    };

    const renderSavedCutsceneBubble = (targetBubble, promptText, savedPayload, fallbackMeta, fallbackIndex) => {
        if (!targetBubble) return;
        if (typeof updateRenderedMessageFromSave === 'function') {
            updateRenderedMessageFromSave(
                targetBubble,
                'cutscene',
                promptText,
                null,
                savedPayload?.message || null,
                savedPayload?.index ?? fallbackIndex,
                fallbackMeta
            );
        } else {
            const bubbleContent = targetBubble.querySelector('.content');
            if (bubbleContent) {
                bubbleContent.innerHTML = formatMessageContent(promptText);
                placeFuraiAnnouncementHeaderInsideBubble(
                    targetBubble,
                    'cutscene',
                    targetBubble.dataset.createdAt || fallbackMeta?.createdAt || '',
                    'Cutscene'
                );
            }
        }
    };

    const commitCutscenePrompt = ({ promptText, existingBubble = null, meta = null, preserveTypingState = false }) => {
        const finalCutscenePrompt = normalizeCutscenePrompt(promptText);
        const commitMeta = meta || makeMessageTimestampMeta(thisChatId);
        const commitIndex = nextInsertIndex;

        if (currentChatId !== thisChatId) {
            const saved = saveMessage(thisChatId, 'cutscene', finalCutscenePrompt, null, commitIndex, commitMeta);
            advanceInsertIndex(saved?.index ?? commitIndex);
            return { bubble: null, prompt: finalCutscenePrompt, saved };
        }

        const targetBubble = existingBubble || addCutsceneBubble(finalCutscenePrompt, commitIndex, commitMeta);
        const saved = saveMessage(thisChatId, 'cutscene', finalCutscenePrompt, null, commitIndex, commitMeta);

        if (preserveTypingState) {
            clearSmoothCutsceneText(contentEl);
        }

        renderSavedCutsceneBubble(
            targetBubble,
            finalCutscenePrompt,
            saved,
            commitMeta,
            commitIndex
        );

        advanceInsertIndex(saved?.index ?? commitIndex);
        updateCutsceneBottomState('done', targetBubble);

        return { bubble: targetBubble, prompt: finalCutscenePrompt, saved };
    };

    try {
        if (assignedCutsceneEntries.length) {
            const assignedImageTasks = [];

            for (let assignedIndex = 0; assignedIndex < assignedCutsceneEntries.length; assignedIndex++) {
                const entry = assignedCutsceneEntries[assignedIndex];
                const directive = String(entry?.prompt || '').trim();
                const repeatCount = clampFuraiPromptRepeatCount(entry?.count, 1, 1);
                let assignedResponseText = '';
                let assignedPrompt = '';

                try {
                    const assignedInstruction = await buildCutsceneInstruction({
                        focusIndex: nextInsertIndex,
                        assignedDirective: directive,
                        standaloneAssigned: true
                    });
                    const assignedGenerated = await generateText({
                        instruction: assignedInstruction,
                        onChunk: assignedIndex === 0
                            ? (data) => {
                                if (currentChatId !== thisChatId) return;

                                let chunk = data.textChunk || '';
                                if (assignedResponseText === '') chunk = chunk.trimStart();
                                if (!chunk) return;

                                assignedResponseText += chunk;
                                if (contentEl) {
                                    queueSmoothCutsceneText(
                                        contentEl,
                                        assignedResponseText,
                                        () => updateCutsceneBottomState('typing')
                                    );
                                }
                            }
                            : undefined
                    });

                    assignedPrompt = normalizeCutscenePrompt(
                        assignedGenerated || assignedResponseText || directive
                    );
                } catch (assignedError) {
                    console.error('Assigned cutscene prompt failed; using the assigned request directly.', assignedError);
                    assignedPrompt = normalizeCutscenePrompt(directive);
                }

                const commitResult = commitCutscenePrompt({
                    promptText: assignedPrompt,
                    existingBubble: assignedIndex === 0 ? bubble : null,
                    meta: assignedIndex === 0 ? cutsceneTimestampMeta : makeMessageTimestampMeta(thisChatId),
                    preserveTypingState: assignedIndex === 0
                });

                if (currentChatId !== thisChatId) return;

                const renderBubble = commitResult.bubble || bubble;
                assignedImageTasks.push(startFuraiImageRenderBatch(
                    renderBubble,
                    Array.from({ length: repeatCount }, () => assignedPrompt),
                    {
                        source: 'cutscene',
                        followChronology: true,
                        usesAssignedPromptBatch: assignedCutsceneEntries.length > 1
                    }
                ));

            }

            await Promise.allSettled(assignedImageTasks);
            return;
        }

        const instruction = await buildCutsceneInstruction({
            focusIndex: nextInsertIndex
        });

        const generated = await generateText({
            instruction,
            onChunk: (data) => {
                if (currentChatId !== thisChatId) return;

                let chunk = data.textChunk || '';
                if (responseText === '') chunk = chunk.trimStart();
                if (!chunk) return;

                responseText += chunk;

                if (contentEl) {
                    queueSmoothCutsceneText(contentEl, responseText, () => updateCutsceneBottomState('typing'));
                }
            }
        });

        const finalPrompt = normalizeCutscenePrompt(generated || responseText);
        const firstCommit = commitCutscenePrompt({
            promptText: finalPrompt,
            existingBubble: bubble,
            meta: cutsceneTimestampMeta,
            preserveTypingState: true
        });

        if (currentChatId !== thisChatId) return;

        const cutsceneTotalCount = getGlobalCutsceneImageCount(personality);
        const cutsceneBatchConfig = getFuraiVisualPromptBatchConfig(personality, 'cutscene');
        const cutsceneSlotDefinitions = [{
            sourceIndex: 0,
            instruction: '',
            count: cutsceneBatchConfig.primaryCount,
            isPrimary: true
        }];

        cutsceneBatchConfig.extraSlots.forEach((slot, index) => {
            const slotPrompt = String(slot.prompt || '').trim();
            const isTemplateSlot = slot.mode === 'template';

            cutsceneSlotDefinitions.push({
                sourceIndex: index + 1,
                instruction: isTemplateSlot ? '' : slotPrompt,
                template: isTemplateSlot ? slotPrompt : '',
                count: slot.count,
                isPrimary: false
            });
        });

        const cutsceneBatchPlan = makeFuraiPromptBatchPlan(
            cutsceneTotalCount,
            cutsceneSlotDefinitions
        );
        const cutsceneSlotByIndex = new Map(
            cutsceneSlotDefinitions.map(slot => [slot.sourceIndex, slot])
        );
        const cutsceneResolvedPrompts = new Map();
        const cutsceneNeededEntries = getFuraiPromptBatchUniqueEntries(cutsceneBatchPlan);
        const cutsceneEntryCounts = getFuraiPromptBatchEntryCounts(cutsceneBatchPlan);
        const cutsceneImageTasks = [];
        const launchCutsceneEntry = (entry, promptValue, entryBubble) => {
            const cleanPrompt = normalizeCutscenePrompt(promptValue);
            const count = cutsceneEntryCounts.get(entry.key) || 0;
            if (!cleanPrompt || count < 1 || !entryBubble) return;

            cutsceneImageTasks.push(startFuraiImageRenderBatch(
                entryBubble,
                Array.from({ length: count }, () => cleanPrompt),
                {
                    source: 'cutscene',
                    followChronology: true,
                    usesAssignedPromptBatch: cutsceneNeededEntries.length > 1
                }
            ));
        };

        for (const entry of cutsceneNeededEntries) {
            const sourceIndex = entry.sourceIndex;
            const cycleKey = entry.key;
            const primaryCycleKey = `${entry.cycleIndex}:0`;
            const slot = cutsceneSlotByIndex.get(sourceIndex) || cutsceneSlotDefinitions[0];
            const directive = String(slot?.instruction || '').trim();
            const templateOverride = String(slot?.template || '').trim();

            if (sourceIndex !== 0 && !directive && !templateOverride) {
                const inheritedPrompt = cutsceneResolvedPrompts.get(primaryCycleKey) || finalPrompt;
                cutsceneResolvedPrompts.set(cycleKey, inheritedPrompt);
                const inheritedCommit = commitCutscenePrompt({
                    promptText: inheritedPrompt,
                    meta: makeMessageTimestampMeta(thisChatId)
                });
                launchCutsceneEntry(entry, inheritedPrompt, inheritedCommit.bubble);
                continue;
            }

            if (entry.cycleIndex === 0 && sourceIndex === 0) {
                cutsceneResolvedPrompts.set(cycleKey, finalPrompt);
                launchCutsceneEntry(entry, finalPrompt, firstCommit.bubble || bubble);
                continue;
            }

            try {
                const slotInstruction = await buildCutsceneInstruction({
                    focusIndex: nextInsertIndex,
                    assignedDirective: directive,
                    templateOverride
                });
                const slotGenerated = await generateText({ instruction: slotInstruction });
                const fallback = directive
                    ? `${cutsceneResolvedPrompts.get(primaryCycleKey) || finalPrompt}

${directive}`
                    : (cutsceneResolvedPrompts.get(primaryCycleKey) || finalPrompt);
                const resolvedPrompt = normalizeCutscenePrompt(slotGenerated || fallback);
                cutsceneResolvedPrompts.set(cycleKey, resolvedPrompt);
                const slotCommit = commitCutscenePrompt({
                    promptText: resolvedPrompt,
                    meta: makeMessageTimestampMeta(thisChatId)
                });
                launchCutsceneEntry(entry, resolvedPrompt, slotCommit.bubble);
            } catch (slotError) {
                console.error('Cutscene prompt slot failed; using the current cycle fallback.', slotError);
                const fallback = directive
                    ? `${cutsceneResolvedPrompts.get(primaryCycleKey) || finalPrompt}

${directive}`
                    : finalPrompt;
                const resolvedPrompt = normalizeCutscenePrompt(fallback);
                cutsceneResolvedPrompts.set(cycleKey, resolvedPrompt);
                const slotCommit = commitCutscenePrompt({
                    promptText: resolvedPrompt,
                    meta: makeMessageTimestampMeta(thisChatId)
                });
                launchCutsceneEntry(entry, resolvedPrompt, slotCommit.bubble);
            }

            if (currentChatId !== thisChatId) return;
        }

        await Promise.allSettled(cutsceneImageTasks);
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Cutscene generation failed:', error);

        clearSmoothCutsceneText(contentEl);

        if (contentEl) {
            contentEl.innerHTML = formatMessageContent('Cutscene generation failed.');
            placeFuraiAnnouncementHeaderInsideBubble(
                bubble,
                'cutscene',
                bubble?.dataset.createdAt || cutsceneTimestampMeta.createdAt || '',
                'Cutscene'
            );
        }

        updateCutsceneBottomState('done');

        if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
            showToast('Cutscene generation failed.');
        }
    } finally {
        isCutsceneGenerating = false;
        setCutsceneButtonBusy(false);
        updateSendButtonUI();
        processGenerationQueue();
    }
}

function updateEnhancerButton() {
    const enhancerBtn = document.getElementById('enhancerBtn');
    const personality = chatPersonalities[currentChatId];

    if (!enhancerBtn || personality !== 'group') {
        return;
    }

    const isWandBusy = isGenerating && !!enhancerBtn.dataset.furaiWandBusy;

    if (isWandBusy) {
        if (enhancerBtn.dataset.furaiWandBusy === 'waiting') {
            enhancerBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i>';
        } else {
            enhancerBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size: 20px;">pause_circle</span>';
        }

        enhancerBtn.onclick = abortCurrentGeneration;
        enhancerBtn.title = 'Pause / Stop Magic Wand';
        enhancerBtn.disabled = false;
        return;
    }

    if (!isGenerating) {
        delete enhancerBtn.dataset.furaiWandBusy;
    }

    enhancerBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles"></i>';
    enhancerBtn.onclick = enhanceText;
    enhancerBtn.title = isGenerating ? 'Magic Wand unavailable while another reply is generating' : 'Enhance / Auto-Write';
    enhancerBtn.disabled = isGenerating;
}

// State tracking for active tools
const toolManager = {
    // Structure: { 'caption': { element: div, timeout: timerID, src: url }, ... }
    active: {},
    currentVisible: null
};

async function openTool(type) {
    const menu = document.getElementById('toolsMenu');
    if (menu) menu.classList.remove('show');

    const toolEl = document.getElementById('toolContainerEl');
    const toolContent = document.getElementById('toolContentEl');
    const toolTitle = document.getElementById('toolTitleEl');

    const aiTools = ['caption', 'edit', 'finegrain', 'bg-remove', 'video'];
    if (aiTools.includes(type) && !localStorage.getItem('furai_zerogpu_hint_seen')) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            showOverlayHint(`
                <i class="fa-solid fa-bolt" style="color:#ffca28; margin-right:8px;"></i>
                <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; text-align:left;">
                    <span style="font-weight:600; font-size:13px;">ZeroGPU Limit</span>
                    <span style="font-size:12px; opacity:0.9;">Shared between all AI tools. Resets daily.</span>
                </div>
            `, 6000);
            localStorage.setItem('furai_zerogpu_hint_seen', 'true');
        }, 600);
    }

    let title = "Tool";
    let src = "";

    if (type === 'caption') {
        title = "AI Image to Text Prompt";
        src = "https://fancyfeast-joy-caption-beta-one.hf.space";
    } else if (type === 'edit') {
        title = "AI Image to Image Editor";
        src = "https://selfit-camera-omni-image-editor.hf.space";
    } else if (type === 'finegrain') {
        title = "Image Enhancer";
        src = "https://finegrain-finegrain-image-enhancer.hf.space";
    } else if (type === 'bg-remove') {
        title = "AI Background Remover";
        src = "https://not-lain-background-removal.hf.space";
    } else if (type === 'video') {
        title = "AI Image to Video Generator";
        src = "https://kulkas2pintu-wan555.hf.space";
    } else if (type === 'compressor') {
        title = "Image Compressor & Resizer";
        src = "https://squoosh.app/";
    } else if (type === 'file-upload') {
        title = "Perchance File Uploader";
        src = "https://null.perchance.org/upload";
    }

    if (!src) return;

    toolTitle.textContent = title;
    toolEl.style.display = 'flex';

    if (toolManager.currentVisible && toolManager.active[toolManager.currentVisible]) {
        toolManager.active[toolManager.currentVisible].element.style.display = 'none';
    }

    if (toolManager.active[type]) {
        const instance = toolManager.active[type];
        if (instance.timeout) {
            clearTimeout(instance.timeout);
            instance.timeout = null;
        }
        instance.element.style.display = 'flex';
        toolManager.currentVisible = type;
        return;
    }

    const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
    wrapper.style.cssText = "width:100%; height:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; position:relative;";
    wrapper.id = `tool-instance-${type}`;

    const mask = document.createElement('div');
    mask.className = 'tool-loading-mask';
    mask.innerHTML = `
        <div class="modern-spinner"></div>
        <div class="loading-text">Loading ${title}...</div>
    `;
    wrapper.appendChild(mask);

    const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
    iframe.style.width = "100%";
    iframe.style.height = "100%";
    iframe.style.border = "none";
    iframe.allow = "accelerometer; clipboard-read *; clipboard-write *; camera; microphone; fullscreen *";

    const removeMask = () => {
        if (mask && mask.parentNode) {
            mask.style.opacity = '0';
            setTimeout(() => { if (mask.parentNode) mask.remove(); }, 500);
        }
    };
    iframe.onload = () => setTimeout(removeMask, 1000);
    setTimeout(removeMask, 15000);

    iframe.src = src;
    wrapper.appendChild(iframe);
    toolContent.appendChild(wrapper);

    toolManager.active[type] = {
        element: wrapper,
        timeout: null,
        src: src,
        title: title
    };
    toolManager.currentVisible = type;
}

function closeTool() {
    const toolEl = document.getElementById('toolContainerEl');
    toolEl.style.display = 'none';

    const type = toolManager.currentVisible;
    if (type && toolManager.active[type]) {
        const instance = toolManager.active[type];
        instance.element.style.display = 'none';

        const specificTitle = instance.title;

        if (instance.timeout) clearTimeout(instance.timeout);

        instance.timeout = setTimeout(() => {
            // Verify the tool is still inactive
            if (toolManager.active[type] && toolManager.active[type].timeout !== null) {
                
                if (instance.element) {
                    instance.element.remove();
                }
                
                delete toolManager.active[type];

                // Show the specific notification with the X button
                showOverlayHint(`
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;">
                        <span>${specificTitle} was closed to free memory.</span>
                    </div>
                `, 5000);

                if (toolManager.currentVisible === type) {
                    toolManager.currentVisible = null;
                }
            }
        }, 180000);
    }
    toolManager.currentVisible = null;
}
// --- FORCE KILL (Used by New Chat) ---
function killAllTools() {
    // Loop through all active tools and destroy them immediately
    Object.keys(toolManager.active).forEach(type => {
        const instance = toolManager.active[type];
        if (instance.timeout) clearTimeout(instance.timeout);
        if (instance.element) instance.element.remove();
    });
    toolManager.active = {};
    toolManager.currentVisible = null;
    document.getElementById('toolContainerEl').style.display = 'none';
}

      openTool('caption');

      openTool('edit');
  }

  function openVideoGenModal() {
    openTool('video');
  }

function toggleLocalBgPreviewFooter() {
    const footer = document.getElementById('backgroundStickyPreviewFooter');
    if (!footer) return;

    const isFolded = footer.classList.toggle('is-preview-folded');
    footer.dataset.previewExpanded = isFolded ? '0' : '1';

    const label = document.getElementById('localBgPreviewToggleLabel');
    if (label) label.textContent = isFolded ? 'Show Preview' : 'Hide Preview';

    const button = document.getElementById('localBgPreviewToggleBtn');
    if (button) {
        button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isFolded ? 'false' : 'true');
        button.title = isFolded ? 'Show background preview' : 'Hide background preview';
    }
}

    };

    // 4. HISTORY CLICK HANDLER
    renderLocalBgHistory();

    document.getElementById('backgroundModalEl').style.display = 'flex';
    toggleSettingsMenu(); 
}

function saveBackground() {
    // 1. Read from the PREVIEW LAYER (The Source of Truth)
    // This allows the input box to be empty without deleting the background.
    const previewLayer = document.getElementById('localBgPreviewLayer');
    const activeUrl = previewLayer ? previewLayer.dataset.url : '';

    const opacity = document.getElementById('bgOpacityInput').value;
    const blur = document.getElementById('bgBlurInput').value; 
    
    if (!currentChatId) return;

    try {
        let chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
        if (chatData) {
            if (activeUrl) {
                chatData.background = activeUrl;
                chatData.backgroundOpacity = opacity;
                chatData.backgroundBlur = blur;
            
                const rawInput = document.getElementById('bgUrlInput')?.value || '';
                const parsedFirstLine = parseBackgroundArchiveLine(getFirstBgInputLine(rawInput));
                addToBackgroundHistory(parsedFirstLine || activeUrl);
            } else {
                // If data-url is empty (e.g., user clicked "No Background" in history)
                delete chatData.background;
                delete chatData.backgroundOpacity;
                delete chatData.backgroundBlur;
            }
            DB.set(currentChatId, chatData);
            applyBackground(currentChatId);
        }
    } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
    
    closeBackgroundModal();
}

function markGeneratedBgButtonSuccess(buttonEl) {
    if (!buttonEl) return;

    const originalHTML = buttonEl.dataset.originalHtml || buttonEl.innerHTML;
    buttonEl.dataset.originalHtml = originalHTML;
    buttonEl.style.color = 'var(--primary-color)';
    buttonEl.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i>';

    setTimeout(() => {
        if (!buttonEl.isConnected) return;
        buttonEl.innerHTML = originalHTML;
        buttonEl.style.color = '';
    }, 900);
}

function readBlobAsDataUrl(blob) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const reader = new FileReader();

        reader.onload = () => resolve(String(reader.result || ''));
        reader.onerror = () => reject(reader.error || new Error('Failed to read image blob.'));
        reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
    });
}

async function normalizeGeneratedBackgroundSource(imageUrl) {
    const cleanUrl = String(imageUrl || '').trim();

    if (!cleanUrl) return '';

    if (/^data:image\/[a-z0-9.+-]+;base64,/i.test(cleanUrl)) {
        return cleanUrl;
    }

    if (/^blob:/i.test(cleanUrl)) {
        const response = await fetch(cleanUrl);
        const blob = await response.blob();

        if (!blob || !blob.type || !/^image\//i.test(blob.type)) {
            throw new Error('Blob background is not an image.');
        }

        return await readBlobAsDataUrl(blob);
    }

    if (/^https?:\/\/.{5,}/i.test(cleanUrl)) {
        return cleanUrl;
    }

    return '';
}

function saveGeneratedImageToBackgroundArchive(imageUrl) {
    const cleanUrl = String(imageUrl || '').trim();
    if (!cleanUrl) return false;

    try {
        const entry = {
            url: cleanUrl,
            name: 'Generated Image',
            aliases: ['generated']
        };

        const history = addToBackgroundHistory(entry) || [];
        const saved = history.some(item => getBackgroundArchiveUrl(item) === cleanUrl);

        if (!saved) return false;

        renderAllBackgroundHistories();

        return true;
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Generated image archive save failed:', e);
        return false;
    }
}

async function applyGeneratedImageAsChatBackground(imageUrl, options = {}) {
    if (!currentChatId) return { ok: false, archived: false };

    try {
        const cleanUrl = await normalizeGeneratedBackgroundSource(imageUrl);
        if (!cleanUrl) return { ok: false, archived: false };

        const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId) || {};

        chatData.background = cleanUrl;
        chatData.backgroundOpacity = '1';
        chatData.backgroundBlur = '0';

        DB.set(currentChatId, chatData);
        applyBackground(currentChatId);

        let archived = false;
        if (options.alsoArchive) {
            archived = saveGeneratedImageToBackgroundArchive(cleanUrl);
        }

        return { ok: true, archived };
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Failed to set generated image as background:', e);
        return { ok: false, archived: false };
    }
}

function closeGeneratedBackgroundChoiceToast() {
    const oldToast = document.getElementById('generatedBgChoiceToast');
    if (oldToast) oldToast.remove();
}

function openGeneratedBackgroundChoiceToast(buttonEl, imageUrl) {
    const cleanUrl = String(imageUrl || '').trim();

    if (!cleanUrl || !currentChatId) {
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('No generated image is ready yet.', 'error');
        return;
    }

    closeGeneratedBackgroundChoiceToast();

    const toast = document.createElement('div');
    toast.id = 'generatedBgChoiceToast';
    toast.className = 'generated-bg-choice-toast';

    toast.innerHTML = `
        <button class="generated-bg-choice-close" type="button" title="Close">
            <span class="material-symbols-outlined">close</span>
        </button>

        <div class="generated-bg-choice-head">
            <span class="material-symbols-outlined generated-bg-choice-icon">wallpaper</span>
            <div class="generated-bg-choice-copy">
                <div class="generated-bg-choice-title">Set as background?</div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="generated-bg-choice-actions">
            <button class="generated-bg-choice-btn primary" type="button" data-action="set">
                <span class="material-symbols-outlined">image</span>
                <span>Set</span>
            </button>

            <button class="generated-bg-choice-btn secondary" type="button" data-action="set-archive">
                <span class="material-symbols-outlined">library_add</span>
                <span>Set + Archive</span>
            </button>
        </div>
    `;

    document.body.appendChild(toast);

    const closeBtn = toast.querySelector('.generated-bg-choice-close');
    const setBtn = toast.querySelector('[data-action="set"]');
    const setArchiveBtn = toast.querySelector('[data-action="set-archive"]');
    const canArchiveGeneratedBg = true;

    closeBtn.onclick = e => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        closeGeneratedBackgroundChoiceToast();
    };

    setBtn.onclick = async e => {
        e.stopPropagation();

        const result = await applyGeneratedImageAsChatBackground(cleanUrl, { alsoArchive: false });
        if (result.ok) {
            markGeneratedBgButtonSuccess(buttonEl);
            if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Background set.', 'success');
            closeGeneratedBackgroundChoiceToast();
        } else {
            if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Background failed.', 'error');
        }
    };

    setArchiveBtn.onclick = async e => {
        e.stopPropagation();

        const result = await applyGeneratedImageAsChatBackground(cleanUrl, { alsoArchive: true });

        if (result.ok && result.archived) {
            markGeneratedBgButtonSuccess(buttonEl);
            if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Background set + archived.', 'success');
            closeGeneratedBackgroundChoiceToast();
            return;
        }

        if (result.ok) {
            markGeneratedBgButtonSuccess(buttonEl);
            if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Background set. Archive failed.', 'error');
            closeGeneratedBackgroundChoiceToast();
            return;
        }

        if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Background failed.', 'error');
    };
}

function closeBackgroundModal() {
    applyBackground(currentChatId); // revert unsaved preview back to real saved state
    document.getElementById('backgroundModalEl').style.display = 'none';
}

let opacityRafLock = false;

function updateOpacityPreview(val) {
    // 1. Update text immediately (cheap)
    const display = document.getElementById('globalBgOpacityDisplay') || document.getElementById('bgOpacityDisplay');
    if (display) display.textContent = val;

    // 2. Throttle visual update (expensive)
    if (!opacityRafLock) {
        window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            const bgCtn = document.getElementById('chatBackgroundCtn');
            if (bgCtn) {
                bgCtn.style.opacity = val;
            }
            opacityRafLock = false;
        });
        opacityRafLock = true;
    }
}

const FURAI_BG_VIDEO_URL_RE = /\.(mp4|webm|mov|m4v|ogv)(?:[?#].*)?$/i;
const furaiBackgroundBlurStates = new WeakMap();

function isBackgroundVideoUrl(url) {
    return FURAI_BG_VIDEO_URL_RE.test(String(url || '').trim());
}

function stopBackgroundVideo(bgCtn) {
    if (!bgCtn) return;

    bgCtn.querySelectorAll('video').forEach(video => {
        try {
            video.pause();
            video.removeAttribute('src');
            video.load();
        } catch (e) {}
    });
}

function revealBackgroundVideoWhenReady(video) {
    if (!video) return;

    const reveal = () => {
        if (!video.isConnected) return;

        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            if (video.isConnected) {
                video.classList.add('is-ready');
            }
        });
    };

    if (video.readyState >= 2) {
        reveal();
        return;
    }

    video.addEventListener('loadeddata', reveal, { once: true });
    video.addEventListener('canplay', reveal, { once: true });
}

function hardenBackgroundVideoInteraction(video) {
    if (!video) return;

    video.controls = false;
    video.disablePictureInPicture = true;
    video.setAttribute('draggable', 'false');
    video.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
    video.setAttribute('controlsList', 'nodownload nofullscreen noremoteplayback');
}

function applyBackgroundVisual(bgCtn, url) {
    if (!bgCtn) return;

    const cleanUrl = String(url || '').trim();
    const savedBlur = Number.parseFloat(bgCtn.dataset.blur) || 0;

    stopFuraiBackgroundBitmapBlur(bgCtn, {
        removeCanvas: true,
        restoreSource: false
    });

    if (bgCtn.id === 'chatBackgroundCtn') {
        document.body.classList.toggle('chat-bg-active', !!cleanUrl);
    }

    stopBackgroundVideo(bgCtn);
    bgCtn.classList.remove('bg-video-loading');
    bgCtn.dataset.furaiBgUrl = cleanUrl;
    bgCtn.dataset.furaiBgType = cleanUrl
        ? (isBackgroundVideoUrl(cleanUrl) ? 'video' : 'image')
        : '';

    if (!cleanUrl) {
        bgCtn.style.backgroundImage = '';
        return;
    }

    if (!isBackgroundVideoUrl(cleanUrl)) {
        bgCtn.style.backgroundImage = `url('${cleanUrl.replace(/'/g, "%27")}')`;
        bgCtn.style.backgroundSize = 'cover';
        bgCtn.style.backgroundPosition = 'center';
        bgCtn.style.backgroundRepeat = 'no-repeat';

        if (savedBlur > 0) applyBackgroundBlurToLayer(bgCtn, savedBlur);
        return;
    }

    bgCtn.style.backgroundImage = '';
    
    const video = document.createElement('video');
    video.className = 'furai-bg-video';
    bgCtn.classList.add('bg-video-loading');
    video.src = cleanUrl;
    video.muted = true;
    video.loop = true;
    video.autoplay = true;
    video.playsInline = true;
    video.preload = 'auto';
    video.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Muted video background');
    hardenBackgroundVideoInteraction(video);

    video.addEventListener('loadeddata', () => {
        bgCtn.classList.remove('bg-video-loading');
        if ((Number.parseFloat(bgCtn.dataset.blur) || 0) > 0) {
            applyBackgroundBlurToLayer(bgCtn, bgCtn.dataset.blur);
        }
    }, { once: true });
    video.addEventListener('canplay', () => bgCtn.classList.remove('bg-video-loading'), { once: true });
    video.addEventListener('error', () => bgCtn.classList.remove('bg-video-loading'), { once: true });
    
    revealBackgroundVideoWhenReady(video);
    
    bgCtn.appendChild(video);
    video.play().catch(() => bgCtn.classList.remove('bg-video-loading'));
}

function applyBackgroundPreviewVisual(layer, url) {
    if (!layer) return;

    const cleanUrl = String(url || '').trim();
    const savedBlur = Number.parseFloat(layer.dataset.blur) || 0;

    stopFuraiBackgroundBitmapBlur(layer, {
        removeCanvas: true,
        restoreSource: false
    });
    stopBackgroundVideo(layer);
    layer.innerHTML = '';
    layer.dataset.url = cleanUrl;
    layer.dataset.furaiBgUrl = cleanUrl;
    layer.dataset.furaiBgType = cleanUrl
        ? (isBackgroundVideoUrl(cleanUrl) ? 'video' : 'image')
        : '';

    if (!cleanUrl) {
        layer.style.backgroundImage = '';
        return;
    }

    if (!isBackgroundVideoUrl(cleanUrl)) {
        layer.style.backgroundImage = `url('${cleanUrl.replace(/'/g, "%27")}')`;
        layer.style.backgroundSize = 'cover';
        layer.style.backgroundPosition = 'center';
        layer.style.backgroundRepeat = 'no-repeat';

        if (savedBlur > 0) applyBackgroundBlurToLayer(layer, savedBlur);
        return;
    }

    layer.style.backgroundImage = '';

    const video = document.createElement('video');
    video.className = 'bg-video-preview';
    video.src = cleanUrl;
    video.muted = true;
    video.loop = true;
    video.autoplay = true;
    video.playsInline = true;
    video.preload = 'auto';
    video.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Muted video background preview');
    hardenBackgroundVideoInteraction(video);

    video.addEventListener('loadeddata', () => {
        if ((Number.parseFloat(layer.dataset.blur) || 0) > 0) {
            applyBackgroundBlurToLayer(layer, layer.dataset.blur);
        }
    }, { once: true });

    revealBackgroundVideoWhenReady(video);

    layer.appendChild(video);
    video.play().catch(() => {});
}

function updateBackgroundPreview(rawValue) {
    const bgCtn = document.getElementById('chatBackgroundCtn');
    if (!bgCtn) return;

    const url = getBackgroundPreviewUrlFromInput(rawValue);

    if (url) {
        applyBackgroundVisual(bgCtn, url);
    }
}
  

function applyBackground(chatId) {
    const bgCtn = document.getElementById('chatBackgroundCtn');
    document.body.style.backgroundImage = '';

    if (!bgCtn) return;

    let bgUrl = '';
    let bgOpacity = '0.2';
    let bgBlur = '0';
    let chatData = null;

    if (chatId) {
        try {
            chatData = DB.get(chatId);
            if (chatData) {
                bgUrl = chatData.background || '';
                bgOpacity = chatData.backgroundOpacity || '1';
                bgBlur = chatData.backgroundBlur || '0';
            }
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    // Home screen now uses Entry Gate & Home Screen background.
    // This applies to BOTH VN and CR home modes.
    // It no longer depends on Research mode background.
    if (chatData && chatData.personality === 'home') {
        const entryBg = getEntryHomeBackgroundData();

        bgUrl = entryBg.bgUrl;
        bgOpacity = entryBg.bgOpacity;
        bgBlur = entryBg.bgBlur;
    }

    applyBackgroundStateToLayer(bgCtn, bgUrl, bgOpacity, bgBlur);
}
