/* --- REFERENCE LOGIC --- */
function saveReference() {
    if (!currentChatId) return;
    try {
        let chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
        if (chatData) {
            chatData.reference = joinFuraiLoreInstructions(
                document.getElementById('refTextInput').value,
                document.getElementById('refHiddenInstructionsInput')?.value || ''
            );
            DB.set(currentChatId, chatData);
        }
    } catch(e) { console.error("Error saving reference:", e); }
    closeReferenceModal();
    if (typeof updateTokenButtonUI === 'function') updateTokenButtonUI(); // <-- ADD THIS
}

function splitFuraiLoreInstructions(text = '') {
    const raw = String(text || '');
    const secretPattern = /\[SECRET\]([\s\S]*?)\[\/SECRET\]/gi;
    const hiddenText = Array.from(
        raw.matchAll(secretPattern),
        match => String(match[1] || '').trim()
    ).filter(Boolean).join('\n\n');

    return {
        publicText: raw
            .replace(secretPattern, '')
            .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
            .trim(),
        hiddenText
    };
}

function joinFuraiLoreInstructions(publicText = '', hiddenText = '') {
    // Hidden Lore Instructions are only a Lorebook-facing UX view of the
    // existing [SECRET] block. Keep one combined stored text value.
    return joinStoryLoreFromEditor(publicText, hiddenText);
}

async function getResolvedReference(personality, options = {}) {
    let content = "";
    
    try {
        let chatData = DB.get(currentChatId) || {};
        
        // FIX: Check if it's strictly !== undefined. 
        // This ensures if it's intentionally saved as "", it stays empty!
        content = chatData.reference !== undefined 
            ? chatData.reference 
            : (DB.get(`ref_text_${personality}`) || defaultReferences[personality] || "");
        
    } catch(e) {}

    const storedLore = splitFuraiLoreInstructions(content);
    let publicLore = storedLore.publicText;

    // Resolve legacy text links and new JSON/gzip lorebook links.
    const linkedLoreKind = getFuraiSharedLinkKind(publicLore);
    if (publicLore && (
        /^https?:\/\/.+(?:\.txt|\.json|\.gz|\/file\/[a-f0-9]{32})(?:[?#].*)?$/i.test(publicLore) ||
        linkedLoreKind === 'lorebook' ||
        linkedLoreKind === 'glossary'
    )) {
        try {
            const fetcher = window.root?.superFetch ? window.root.superFetch : fetch;
            const res = await fetcher(resolveFuraiUploadFileUrl(publicLore));
            if (res.ok) {
                const artifact = await readFuraiLibraryArtifactResponse(res, { type: 'lorebook' });
                publicLore = artifact.content;
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.warn('Could not resolve linked lorebook.', error);
        }
    }

    const lore = { publicText: publicLore, hiddenText: storedLore.hiddenText };
    const blocks = [];

    if (lore.publicText) {
        blocks.push(`### REFERENCE MATERIAL / LORE:\n${lore.publicText}`);
    }

    if (options.includeHiddenInstructions === true && lore.hiddenText) {
        blocks.push(`### HIDDEN LORE INSTRUCTIONS (GOD VIEW ONLY):\n${lore.hiddenText}`);
    }
    
    return blocks.length ? `\n\n${blocks.join('\n\n')}\n` : "";
}

// Update openReferenceModal to show ONLY Reference data
function openReferenceModal() {
    const personality = chatPersonalities[currentChatId] || 'researcher';
    let currentRef = "";

    try {
        let chatData = DB.get(currentChatId) || {};
        currentRef = chatData.reference !== undefined ? chatData.reference : (DB.get(`ref_text_${personality}`) || defaultReferences[personality] || "");
    } catch(e) {
        currentRef = defaultReferences[personality] || "";
    }
    
    const loreParts = splitFuraiLoreInstructions(currentRef);
    document.getElementById('refTextInput').value = loreParts.publicText;
    const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('refHiddenInstructionsInput');
    if (hiddenInput) hiddenInput.value = loreParts.hiddenText;
    
    if (window.updateWordCountUI) updateWordCountUI(['refTextInput', 'refHiddenInstructionsInput'], 'refWordCount', 500);
    document.getElementById('referenceModalEl').style.display = 'flex';
    
    const menu = document.getElementById('settingsMenu');
    if (menu && menu.classList.contains('show')) menu.classList.remove('show');
}

  // --- Image Generation Logic ---
window.showGenerateImageCutsceneHint = function() {
    const hintKey = 'furai_hint_generate_image_cutscene';
    const chatId = typeof currentChatId !== 'undefined' ? currentChatId : null;
    const modeMap = typeof chatPersonalities !== 'undefined' ? chatPersonalities : {};
    const mode = chatId ? (modeMap[chatId] || 'researcher') : 'researcher';

    if (mode === 'prompter') return;

    try {
        if (localStorage.getItem(hintKey)) return;
        localStorage.setItem(hintKey, 'true');
    } catch(e) {
        return;
    }

    if (typeof showOverlayHint === 'function') {
        showOverlayHint('Tip: Use Cutscene for a smarter image prompt from the current scene.', 6500);
    } else if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
        showToast('Tip: Use Cutscene for a smarter image prompt from the current scene.', 'info');
    }
};
  
function startFuraiImageRenderBatch(messageEl, promptList, options = {}) {
    const prompts = Array.isArray(promptList)
        ? promptList.map(value => String(value || '').trim()).filter(Boolean)
        : [];
    if (!messageEl || !prompts.length) return Promise.resolve([]);

    const source = options.source || (messageEl.classList?.contains('cutscene') ? 'cutscene' : 'chat-bubble');
    const usesAssignedPromptBatch = options.usesAssignedPromptBatch === true;

    messageEl.classList.add('has-images');

    let grid = messageEl.querySelector('.image-grid-container');
    if (!grid) {
        grid = document.createElement('div');
        grid.className = 'image-grid-container';
        const wrapper = messageEl.querySelector('.message-content-wrapper') || messageEl;
        wrapper.appendChild(grid);
    }

    if (window.placeMessageControls) {
        window.placeMessageControls(messageEl);
    }

    if (document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) {
        const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
        const validMessages = typeof getVnRenderableMessages === 'function'
            ? getVnRenderableMessages()
            : [];

        if (window.furaiVnCurrentGeneratedImagesEl && window.furaiVnCurrentGeneratedImagesEl !== messageEl) {
            window.furaiVnCurrentGeneratedImagesEl.classList.remove('vn-current-generated-images');
        }

        if (validMessages[vnCurrentIndex] === messageEl && messageEl.querySelector('.image-grid-container')) {
            messageEl.classList.add('vn-current-generated-images');
            window.furaiVnCurrentGeneratedImagesEl = messageEl;
            document.body.classList.add('vn-generated-images-visible');

            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                chatMessagesEl.scrollTop = 0;
            });
        }
    }

    const dateStr = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
        month: 'long',
        day: 'numeric',
        year: 'numeric'
    });
    const titleString = dateStr;
    const pluginResolution = normalizeFuraiResolutionValue(options.resolution);
    const resolutionMatch = String(pluginResolution).match(/^\s*(\d+)\s*x\s*(\d+)\s*$/i);
    const imageAspectRatio = resolutionMatch
        ? `${resolutionMatch[1]} / ${resolutionMatch[2]}`
        : '';
    const startSlotIndex = grid.querySelectorAll('.gen-card').length;
    const imageTasks = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < prompts.length; i++) {
        if (startSlotIndex === 0 && i === 0) hideBubbleImageAiPromptHint();

        const slotPrompt = prompts[i];
        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = 'gen-card';
        if (usesAssignedPromptBatch) {
            card.dataset.assignedImageSlot = String(startSlotIndex + i + 1);
        }
        grid.appendChild(card);
        scheduleVnGeneratedImageLayoutSync();

        const imgArea = document.createElement('div');
        imgArea.className = 'gen-image-area';
        if (imageAspectRatio) imgArea.style.aspectRatio = imageAspectRatio;
        card.appendChild(imgArea);

        imageTasks.push((async () => {
            try {
                const pluginOptions = {
                    prompt: slotPrompt,
                    saveTitle: titleString
                };

                if (pluginResolution) {
                    pluginOptions.resolution = pluginResolution;
                }

                const pluginOutput = textToImagePlugin(pluginOptions);
                imgArea.innerHTML = pluginOutput.iframeHtml || pluginOutput;

                if (pluginOutput.onFinishPromise) {
                    const result = await pluginOutput.onFinishPromise;

                    let finalUrl = '';
                    try {
                        finalUrl = result.canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.9);
                    } catch(e) {
                        console.warn('No data URL', e);
                    }

                    const finalWidth = Number(result?.canvas?.width || result?.width || 0);
                    const finalHeight = Number(result?.canvas?.height || result?.height || 0);
                    if (finalWidth > 0 && finalHeight > 0) {
                        imgArea.style.aspectRatio = `${finalWidth} / ${finalHeight}`;
                        scheduleVnGeneratedImageLayoutSync();
                    }

                    const resultInputs = result?.inputs || pluginOutput?.inputs || {};
                    const imageInfo = {
                        title: pluginOptions.saveTitle,
                        description: `${source === 'cutscene' ? 'Generated from cutscene' : 'Generated from message'} in ${document.getElementById('chatTitleEl')?.innerText || 'New Chat'}`,
                        prompt: resultInputs.prompt || pluginOptions.prompt || slotPrompt || '',
                        negativePrompt: resultInputs.negativePrompt || resultInputs.negative || pluginOptions.negativePrompt || '',
                        seed: resultInputs.seed || result?.seed || '',
                        guidanceScale: resultInputs.guidanceScale || resultInputs.guidance || '',
                        date: new Date().toLocaleString()
                    };

                    addBottomControls(card, finalUrl, pluginOptions.saveTitle, imageInfo);
                }
            } catch (e) {
                imgArea.innerHTML = '<div style="color:red; font-size:0.8em; padding:10px;">Error</div>';
                console.error(e);
            }
        })());

        if (options.followChronology === true && !document.body.classList.contains('vn-active') && autoScroll) {
            scrollElementToBottom(document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl'));
        }
    }

    return Promise.allSettled(imageTasks).then(results => {
        if (options.followChronology === true && !document.body.classList.contains('vn-active') && autoScroll) {
            scrollElementToBottom(document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl'), { respectUserBrake: true });
        }
        return results;
    });
}

  async function generateImagesForMessage(messageEl, prompt, options = {}) {
    const source = options.source || (messageEl?.classList?.contains('cutscene') ? 'cutscene' : 'chat-bubble');
    const thisChatId = currentChatId;
    const personality = chatPersonalities[thisChatId] || 'researcher';

    const rawPrompt = String(prompt || '').trim();
    const totalImageCount = clampFuraiImageCount(
        options.count ?? (
            source === 'cutscene'
                ? getGlobalCutsceneImageCount(personality)
                : getGlobalBubbleImageCount(personality)
        ),
        1
    );
    const exactPromptList = Array.isArray(options.renderPromptList)
        ? options.renderPromptList.slice(0, totalImageCount)
        : [];
    const assignedPromptEntries = normalizeFuraiAssignedPromptEntries(
        options.assignedPromptEntries,
        options.assignedPrompts
    );
    let workingPrompt = rawPrompt;

    if (!messageEl || (!workingPrompt && !assignedPromptEntries.length && !exactPromptList.length)) return;

    const normalizePrompt = value => {
        const cleanPrompt = String(value || '').trim();
        if (!cleanPrompt) return '';

        return typeof normalizeImagePromptForPerchance === 'function'
            ? normalizeImagePromptForPerchance(cleanPrompt)
            : cleanPrompt;
    };

    let promptList = [];
    let usesAssignedPromptBatch = false;
    let assignedPromptParallelMode = false;
    let streamedPromptBatch = false;
    const streamedImageTasks = [];

    if (exactPromptList.length) {
        promptList = exactPromptList.map(normalizePrompt).filter(Boolean);
        usesAssignedPromptBatch = promptList.length > 1;
    } else if (assignedPromptEntries.length) {
        const rawAssignedEntries = assignedPromptEntries;
        const shouldUseAiPrompt = typeof options.useAiPrompt === 'boolean'
            ? options.useAiPrompt
            : getBubbleImageAiEnabledForChat(thisChatId, personality);

        assignedPromptParallelMode = true;
        usesAssignedPromptBatch = rawAssignedEntries.length > 1 ||
            rawAssignedEntries.some(entry => entry.count > 1);

        if (shouldUseAiPrompt) {
            if ((isGenerating && options.allowWhileReplyGenerating !== true) || isCutsceneGenerating) {
                if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
                    showToast('A reply or cutscene is already generating.');
                }
                return;
            }

            if (messageEl.dataset.furaiImagePromptBusy === '1') return;
            messageEl.dataset.furaiImagePromptBusy = '1';

            try {
                const assignedTemplate = getAssignedPromptInstructionTemplate(personality);

                for (const entry of rawAssignedEntries) {
                    const directive = entry.prompt;
                    const repeatCount = clampFuraiPromptRepeatCount(entry.count, 1, 1);
                    const imagePromptJobId = createMessageImagePromptJob(messageEl, thisChatId, workingPrompt || directive);
                    const imagePromptJob = window.furaiMessageImagePromptJobs[imagePromptJobId];
                    window.furaiActiveMessageImagePromptJobId = imagePromptJobId;
                    if (typeof updateSendButtonUI === 'function') updateSendButtonUI();

                    try {
                        showBubbleImageAiPromptHint(imagePromptJobId);
                        const helperPromise = buildBubbleImagePrompt(
                            messageEl,
                            workingPrompt || directive,
                            imagePromptJobId,
                            {
                                assignedDirective: directive,
                                templateOverride: assignedTemplate
                            }
                        ).catch(error => {
                            if (imagePromptJob?.cancelled) return null;
                            throw error;
                        });
                        const cancelPromise = new Promise(resolve => {
                            imagePromptJob.resolveCancel = resolve;
                        });
                        const generatedPrompt = await Promise.race([helperPromise, cancelPromise]);
                        const resolvedPrompt = normalizePrompt(generatedPrompt || directive);

                        if (resolvedPrompt) {
                            streamedPromptBatch = true;
                            streamedImageTasks.push(startFuraiImageRenderBatch(
                                messageEl,
                                Array.from({ length: repeatCount }, () => resolvedPrompt),
                                {
                                    source,
                                    followChronology: options.followChronology === true,
                                    resolution: options.resolution,
                                    usesAssignedPromptBatch
                                }
                            ));
                        }
                    } catch (error) {
                        console.error('Assigned image prompt helper failed; using direct assigned prompt text instead.', error);
                        const fallbackPrompt = normalizePrompt(directive);

                        if (fallbackPrompt) {
                            streamedPromptBatch = true;
                            streamedImageTasks.push(startFuraiImageRenderBatch(
                                messageEl,
                                Array.from({ length: repeatCount }, () => fallbackPrompt),
                                {
                                    source,
                                    followChronology: options.followChronology === true,
                                    resolution: options.resolution,
                                    usesAssignedPromptBatch
                                }
                            ));
                        }

                        if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
                            showToast('Assigned prompt helper failed. Using direct prompt text.', 'error');
                        }
                    } finally {
                        delete window.furaiMessageImagePromptJobs[imagePromptJobId];

                        if (window.furaiActiveMessageImagePromptJobId === imagePromptJobId) {
                            window.furaiActiveMessageImagePromptJobId = '';
                            if (typeof updateSendButtonUI === 'function') updateSendButtonUI();
                        }
                    }

                    if (currentChatId !== thisChatId || !messageEl.isConnected) {
                        hideBubbleImageAiPromptHint(imagePromptJobId);
                        return;
                    }
                }
            } finally {
                delete messageEl.dataset.furaiImagePromptBusy;
                queueMicrotask(processGenerationQueue);
            }
        } else {
            promptList = rawAssignedEntries.flatMap(entry => {
                const cleanPrompt = normalizePrompt(entry.prompt);
                return cleanPrompt
                    ? Array.from({ length: clampFuraiPromptRepeatCount(entry.count, 1, 1) }, () => cleanPrompt)
                    : [];
            });
        }
    } else if (source === 'chat-bubble') {
        const batchConfig = getFuraiVisualPromptBatchConfig(personality, 'image');
        const slotDefinitions = [{
            sourceIndex: 0,
            instruction: '',
            count: batchConfig.primaryCount,
            isPrimary: true
        }];

        batchConfig.extraSlots.forEach((slot, index) => {
            const slotPrompt = String(slot.prompt || '').trim();
            const isTemplateSlot = slot.mode === 'template';

            slotDefinitions.push({
                sourceIndex: index + 1,
                instruction: isTemplateSlot ? '' : slotPrompt,
                template: isTemplateSlot ? slotPrompt : '',
                count: slot.count,
                isPrimary: false
            });
        });

        const batchPlan = makeFuraiPromptBatchPlan(totalImageCount, slotDefinitions);
        const neededEntries = getFuraiPromptBatchUniqueEntries(batchPlan);
        const entryCounts = getFuraiPromptBatchEntryCounts(batchPlan);
        const slotByIndex = new Map(slotDefinitions.map(slot => [slot.sourceIndex, slot]));
        const resolvedByIndex = new Map();
        const launchResolvedEntry = (entry, promptValue) => {
            const cleanPrompt = normalizePrompt(promptValue);
            const count = entryCounts.get(entry.key) || 0;
            if (!cleanPrompt || count < 1) return;

            streamedPromptBatch = true;
            streamedImageTasks.push(startFuraiImageRenderBatch(
                messageEl,
                Array.from({ length: count }, () => cleanPrompt),
                {
                    source,
                    followChronology: options.followChronology === true,
                    resolution: options.resolution,
                    usesAssignedPromptBatch: neededEntries.length > 1
                }
            ));
        };
        const shouldUseAiPrompt = typeof options.useAiPrompt === 'boolean'
            ? options.useAiPrompt
            : getBubbleImageAiEnabledForChat(thisChatId, personality);

        usesAssignedPromptBatch = neededEntries.length > 1;

        if (shouldUseAiPrompt) {
            if ((isGenerating && options.allowWhileReplyGenerating !== true) || isCutsceneGenerating) {
                if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
                    showToast('A reply or cutscene is already generating.');
                }
                return;
            }

            if (messageEl.dataset.furaiImagePromptBusy === '1') return;
            messageEl.dataset.furaiImagePromptBusy = '1';
            let skipRemainingAi = false;

            try {
                for (const entry of neededEntries) {
                    const sourceIndex = entry.sourceIndex;
                    const resolveKey = entry.key;
                    const primaryCycleKey = `${entry.cycleIndex}:0`;
                    const slot = slotByIndex.get(sourceIndex) || slotDefinitions[0];
                    const directive = String(slot?.instruction || '').trim();
                    const templateOverride = String(slot?.template || '').trim();

                    // A deliberately blank slot inherits Prompt 1 from the same cycle.
                    if (sourceIndex !== 0 && !directive && !templateOverride) {
                        const inheritedPrompt = resolvedByIndex.get(primaryCycleKey) || workingPrompt;
                        resolvedByIndex.set(resolveKey, inheritedPrompt);
                        launchResolvedEntry(entry, inheritedPrompt);
                        continue;
                    }

                    if (skipRemainingAi) {
                        const fallbackPrompt = directive ? `${workingPrompt}

${directive}` : workingPrompt;
                        resolvedByIndex.set(resolveKey, fallbackPrompt);
                        launchResolvedEntry(entry, fallbackPrompt);
                        continue;
                    }

                    const imagePromptJobId = createMessageImagePromptJob(messageEl, thisChatId, workingPrompt);
                    const imagePromptJob = window.furaiMessageImagePromptJobs[imagePromptJobId];
                    window.furaiActiveMessageImagePromptJobId = imagePromptJobId;
                    if (typeof updateSendButtonUI === 'function') updateSendButtonUI();

                    try {
                        showBubbleImageAiPromptHint(imagePromptJobId);

                        const helperPromise = buildBubbleImagePrompt(
                            messageEl,
                            workingPrompt,
                            imagePromptJobId,
                            {
                                assignedDirective: directive,
                                templateOverride
                            }
                        ).catch(error => {
                            if (imagePromptJob?.cancelled) return null;
                            throw error;
                        });
                        const cancelPromise = new Promise(resolve => {
                            imagePromptJob.resolveCancel = resolve;
                        });
                        const generatedPrompt = await Promise.race([helperPromise, cancelPromise]);
                        const fallbackPrompt = directive
                            ? `${workingPrompt}

${directive}`
                            : workingPrompt;

                        const resolvedPrompt = generatedPrompt || fallbackPrompt;
                        resolvedByIndex.set(resolveKey, resolvedPrompt);
                        launchResolvedEntry(entry, resolvedPrompt);
                        if (imagePromptJob?.cancelled) skipRemainingAi = true;
                    } catch (error) {
                        console.error('Message image prompt helper failed; using raw message text instead.', error);
                        const fallbackPrompt = directive ? `${workingPrompt}

${directive}` : workingPrompt;
                        resolvedByIndex.set(resolveKey, fallbackPrompt);
                        launchResolvedEntry(entry, fallbackPrompt);

                        if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
                            showToast('Image prompt helper failed. Using message text.', 'error');
                        }
                    } finally {
                        delete window.furaiMessageImagePromptJobs[imagePromptJobId];

                        if (window.furaiActiveMessageImagePromptJobId === imagePromptJobId) {
                            window.furaiActiveMessageImagePromptJobId = '';
                            if (typeof updateSendButtonUI === 'function') updateSendButtonUI();
                        }
                    }

                    if (currentChatId !== thisChatId || !messageEl.isConnected) {
                        hideBubbleImageAiPromptHint(imagePromptJobId);
                        return;
                    }
                }
            } finally {
                delete messageEl.dataset.furaiImagePromptBusy;
                queueMicrotask(processGenerationQueue);
            }
        } else {
            for (const entry of neededEntries) {
                const sourceIndex = entry.sourceIndex;
                const resolveKey = entry.key;
                const slot = slotByIndex.get(sourceIndex) || slotDefinitions[0];
                const directive = String(slot?.instruction || '').trim();
                const templateOverride = String(slot?.template || '').trim();
                const primaryPrompt = resolvedByIndex.get(`${entry.cycleIndex}:0`) || workingPrompt;

                resolvedByIndex.set(
                    resolveKey,
                    sourceIndex !== 0 && !directive && !templateOverride
                        ? primaryPrompt
                        : (directive ? `${workingPrompt}

${directive}` : workingPrompt)
                );
            }
        }

        promptList = buildFuraiPromptListFromResolvedSlots(batchPlan, resolvedByIndex)
            .map(normalizePrompt)
            .filter(Boolean);
    } else {
        const safePrompt = normalizePrompt(workingPrompt);
        if (safePrompt) {
            promptList = Array.from({ length: totalImageCount }, () => safePrompt);
        }
    }

    if (streamedPromptBatch) {
        hideBubbleImageAiPromptHint();
        await Promise.allSettled(streamedImageTasks);
        return;
    }

    if (!promptList.length) {
        hideBubbleImageAiPromptHint();
        return;
    }

    // The normal image-count batch only applies to the normal workflow.
    // Assigned <image>...</image> prompts are a parallel one-block-one-image system.
    if (!assignedPromptParallelMode) {
        if (promptList.length < totalImageCount) {
            const sourcePrompts = promptList.slice();
            promptList = Array.from(
                { length: totalImageCount },
                (_, index) => sourcePrompts[index % sourcePrompts.length]
            );
        } else if (promptList.length > totalImageCount) {
            promptList = promptList.slice(0, totalImageCount);
        }
    }

    await startFuraiImageRenderBatch(messageEl, promptList, {
        source,
        followChronology: options.followChronology === true,
        resolution: options.resolution,
        usesAssignedPromptBatch
    });
}

function setGeneratedImagePinButtonState(button, pinned) {
    if (!button) return;

    button.classList.toggle('is-pinned', !!pinned);
    button.title = pinned ? 'Unpin image from chat' : 'Pin image in chat';
    button.setAttribute('aria-label', button.title);

    const icon = button.querySelector('.material-symbols-outlined');
    if (icon) {
        icon.style.fontVariationSettings = pinned ? "'FILL' 1" : "";
    }
}

function getPinnedGeneratedImageId(cardEl) {
    return String(cardEl?.dataset?.pinnedGeneratedImageId || '').trim();
}

function makePinnedGeneratedImageInfo(imageInfo = {}) {
    return {
        title: String(imageInfo.title || ''),
        description: String(imageInfo.description || ''),
        prompt: String(imageInfo.prompt || ''),
        negativePrompt: String(imageInfo.negativePrompt || ''),
        seed: String(imageInfo.seed || ''),
        guidanceScale: String(imageInfo.guidanceScale || ''),
        date: String(imageInfo.date || '')
    };
}

async function getSelfContainedPinnedImageSource(imageUrl) {
    const source = String(imageUrl || '').trim();
    if (!source) throw new Error('Image source is missing.');

    if (/^data:image\//i.test(source)) return source;

    const response = await fetch(source);
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Could not read this image.');

    const blob = await response.blob();
    if (!String(blob.type || '').startsWith('image/')) {
        throw new Error('The selected source is not an image.');
    }

    return furaiBlobToDataUrl(blob);
}

function removePinnedGeneratedImageFromChat(cardEl, options = {}) {
    const imageId = getPinnedGeneratedImageId(cardEl);
    const messageEl = cardEl?.closest('.message');

    if (!imageId || !messageEl) return false;

    const found = furaiGetMessageAtDomElement(messageEl);
    if (!found) return false;

    const { chatData, msg } = found;
    const pinnedImages = Array.isArray(msg.pinnedGeneratedImages)
        ? msg.pinnedGeneratedImages
        : [];

    const imageIndex = pinnedImages.findIndex(item => String(item?.id || '') === imageId);
    if (imageIndex === -1) return false;

    pinnedImages.splice(imageIndex, 1);

    if (pinnedImages.length) {
        msg.pinnedGeneratedImages = pinnedImages;
    } else {
        delete msg.pinnedGeneratedImages;
    }

    chatData.timestamp = Date.now();
    DB.set(currentChatId, chatData);

    delete cardEl.dataset.pinnedGeneratedImageId;
    cardEl.classList.remove('is-pinned-image');

    const pinButton = cardEl.querySelector('.gen-pin-btn');
    setGeneratedImagePinButtonState(pinButton, false);

    if (!options.silent && typeof showToast === 'function') {
        showToast('Image unpinned from chat.');
    }

    return true;
}

async function togglePinnedGeneratedImageInChat(button, cardEl, imageUrl, title, imageInfo = {}) {
    if (!button || !cardEl) return;

    if (getPinnedGeneratedImageId(cardEl)) {
        removePinnedGeneratedImageFromChat(cardEl);
        return;
    }

    const messageEl = cardEl.closest('.message');
    const found = furaiGetMessageAtDomElement(messageEl);

    if (!found) {
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
            showToast('Wait until the message is saved before pinning its image.', 'error');
        }
        return;
    }

    // Pinned images are self-contained chat data. Keep that payload out of
    // legacy 5 MB localStorage mode so a quota failure cannot silently lose it.
    if (
        typeof StorageEngine !== 'undefined' &&
        StorageEngine.mode !== FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_INDEXEDDB
    ) {
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
            showToast('Pinning images requires Memory Expansion. Upgrade storage in Settings & Data.', 'error');
        }
        return;
    }

    button.disabled = true;

    try {
        const { chatData, msg } = found;

        if (!msg.uid) {
            msg.uid = generateUID('msg');
            messageEl.dataset.messageUid = msg.uid;
        }

        const selfContainedSource = await getSelfContainedPinnedImageSource(imageUrl);
        const imageId = generateUID('pimg');

        if (!Array.isArray(msg.pinnedGeneratedImages)) {
            msg.pinnedGeneratedImages = [];
        }

        msg.pinnedGeneratedImages.push({
            schema: 1,
            id: imageId,
            src: selfContainedSource,
            title: String(title || imageInfo.title || 'Generated Image'),
            info: makePinnedGeneratedImageInfo(imageInfo),
            createdAt: Date.now()
        });

        chatData.timestamp = Date.now();
        DB.set(currentChatId, chatData);

        cardEl.dataset.pinnedGeneratedImageId = imageId;
        cardEl.classList.add('is-pinned-image');
        setGeneratedImagePinButtonState(button, true);

        if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
            showToast('Image pinned in chat.');
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Could not pin generated image:', error);

        if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
            showToast(error?.message || 'Could not pin image.', 'error');
        }
    } finally {
        button.disabled = false;
    }
}

function renderPinnedGeneratedImagesForMessage(messageEl, pinnedImages) {
    if (!messageEl || !Array.isArray(pinnedImages) || !pinnedImages.length) return;

    const records = pinnedImages.filter(item =>
        item &&
        String(item.id || '').trim() &&
        String(item.src || '').trim()
    );

    if (!records.length) return;

    messageEl.classList.add('has-images');

    const wrapper = messageEl.querySelector('.message-content-wrapper') || messageEl;
    let grid = wrapper.querySelector('.image-grid-container');

    if (!grid) {
        grid = document.createElement('div');
        grid.className = 'image-grid-container';
        wrapper.appendChild(grid);
    }

    records.forEach(record => {
        const imageId = String(record.id || '').trim();
        if (grid.querySelector(`[data-pinned-generated-image-id="${CSS.escape(imageId)}"]`)) return;

        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = 'gen-card is-pinned-image';
        card.dataset.pinnedGeneratedImageId = imageId;

        const imgArea = document.createElement('div');
        imgArea.className = 'gen-image-area';

        const image = document.createElement('img');
        image.src = String(record.src || '');
        image.alt = String(record.title || 'Pinned generated image');
        image.loading = 'lazy';
        image.decoding = 'async';

        imgArea.appendChild(image);
        card.appendChild(imgArea);
        grid.appendChild(card);

        addBottomControls(
            card,
            String(record.src || ''),
            String(record.title || 'Generated Image'),
            record.info && typeof record.info === 'object' ? record.info : {}
        );
    });

    scheduleVnGeneratedImageLayoutSync();
}

window.FuraiGeneratedImageControls = (() => {
    let menu = null;
    let context = null;

    const download = imageUrl => {
        if (!imageUrl) return;

        const link = document.createElement('a');
        link.href = imageUrl;
        link.download = `FurAI-${Date.now()}.jpg`;
        document.body.appendChild(link);
        link.click();
        link.remove();
    };

    const saveConcept = async (trigger, active) => {
        if (!active || typeof window.saveGeneratedImageToConceptBoard !== 'function') return;

        await window.saveGeneratedImageToConceptBoard(trigger, active.cardEl, active.imageUrl, {
            ...active.imageInfo,
            title: active.imageInfo?.title || active.title || 'Generated Image'
        });
    };

    const deleteImage = active => {
        const cardEl = active?.cardEl;
        if (!cardEl) return;

        removePinnedGeneratedImageFromChat(cardEl, { silent: true });

        const grid = cardEl.closest('.image-grid-container');
        const messageEl = cardEl.closest('.message');
        const wasCurrentVnImage = !!messageEl && (
            messageEl.classList.contains('vn-current-generated-images') ||
            window.furaiVnCurrentGeneratedImagesEl === messageEl
        );

        cardEl.remove();

        if (!grid || grid.querySelector('.gen-card')) return;

        grid.remove();

        if (messageEl) {
            messageEl.classList.remove('has-images', 'vn-current-generated-images');
            if (typeof window.placeMessageControls === 'function') {
                window.placeMessageControls(messageEl);
            }
        }

        if (window.furaiVnCurrentGeneratedImagesEl === messageEl) {
            window.furaiVnCurrentGeneratedImagesEl = null;
        }

        if (wasCurrentVnImage) {
            document.body.classList.remove(
                'vn-generated-images-visible',
                'vn-generated-images-single-row'
            );
        }

        scheduleVnGeneratedImageLayoutSync();
    };

    const getMenu = () => {
        if (menu) return menu;
        menu = document.getElementById('generatedImageMoreMenu');
        if (!menu) return null;

        menu.addEventListener('click', async event => {
            const item = event.target.closest('[data-image-action]');
            const active = context;
            if (!item || !active) return;
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();

            const action = item.dataset.imageAction;
            if (action !== 'copy-link') close();

            if (action === 'upscale') {
                if (active.imageUrl) FuraiImageTools.open('upscale', active.imageUrl);
                return;
            }

            if (action === 'remove-background') {
                if (active.imageUrl) FuraiImageTools.open('remove-background', active.imageUrl);
                return;
            }

            if (action === 'background') {
                openGeneratedBackgroundChoiceToast(active.trigger, active.imageUrl);
                return;
            }

            if (action === 'delete') {
                deleteImage(active);
                return;
            }

            if (action !== 'copy-link' || active.cardEl._furaiImageUploadBusy) return;

            const uploadFn = typeof getFuraiUploadPluginFunction === 'function'
                ? getFuraiUploadPluginFunction()
                : ((typeof window.root !== 'undefined' && window.root.upload) || window.upload || null);

            if (typeof uploadFn !== 'function') {
                if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Upload plugin not found.', 'error');
                return;
            }

            active.cardEl._furaiImageUploadBusy = true;
            item.disabled = true;
            item.innerHTML = '<span class="furai-mini-spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span><span>Uploading…</span>';

            try {
                if (!active.cardEl._furaiUploadedImageUrl) {
                    const response = await fetch(active.imageUrl);
                    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Could not read the generated image.');
                    const blob = await response.blob();
                    const { url, error } = await uploadFn(blob);
                    if (error || !url) throw new Error(error || 'Image upload failed.');
                    active.cardEl._furaiUploadedImageUrl = url;
                }

                const copyFn = typeof copyTextWithFallback === 'function'
                    ? copyTextWithFallback
                    : text => navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
                await copyFn(active.cardEl._furaiUploadedImageUrl);
                if (context?.cardEl === active.cardEl) {
                    item.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined">check</span><span>Copied</span>';
                    if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Image link copied.');
                    close();
                }
            } catch (error) {
                if (context?.cardEl === active.cardEl) {
                    item.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined">link_2</span><span>Copy image link</span>';
                    if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast(`Upload failed: ${error.message || error}`, 'error');
                    else console.error(error);
                }
            } finally {
                active.cardEl._furaiImageUploadBusy = false;
                if (context?.cardEl === active.cardEl) item.disabled = false;
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
            if (!menu.classList.contains('show')) return;
            if (menu.contains(event.target) || event.target.closest('.gen-more-btn')) return;
            close();
        });
        window.addEventListener('resize', close, { passive: true });
        return menu;
    };

    const close = () => {
        const current = getMenu();
        if (!current) return;
        if (context?.trigger) context.trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        current.classList.remove('show');
        current.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        context = null;
    };

    const open = (trigger, nextContext) => {
        const current = getMenu();
        if (!current || !trigger) return;
        if (current.classList.contains('show') && context?.trigger === trigger) {
            close();
            return;
        }

        if (context?.trigger && context.trigger !== trigger) context.trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        context = { ...nextContext, trigger };
        trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        const copyItem = current.querySelector('[data-image-action="copy-link"]');
        if (copyItem) {
            copyItem.disabled = !!nextContext.cardEl._furaiImageUploadBusy;
            copyItem.innerHTML = nextContext.cardEl._furaiImageUploadBusy
                ? '<span class="furai-mini-spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span><span>Uploading…</span>'
                : '<span class="material-symbols-outlined">link_2</span><span>Copy image link</span>';
        }

        current.style.visibility = 'hidden';
        current.classList.add('show');
        current.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');

        const triggerRect = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
        const menuRect = current.getBoundingClientRect();
        const left = Math.max(8, Math.min(window.innerWidth - menuRect.width - 8, triggerRect.right - menuRect.width));
        let top = triggerRect.top - menuRect.height - 8;
        if (top < 8) top = Math.min(window.innerHeight - menuRect.height - 8, triggerRect.bottom + 8);

        current.style.left = `${left}px`;
        current.style.top = `${Math.max(8, top)}px`;
        current.style.visibility = '';
    };

    return { open, close, download, saveConcept };
})();

// Local browser image tools. Background-removal workflow credit: BlackYT.
window.FuraiImageTools = (() => {
    let ui = null;
    let job = null;

    const getUi = () => {
        if (ui) return ui;
        ui = {
            modal: document.getElementById('furaiImageToolModal'),
            title: document.getElementById('furaiImageToolTitle'),
            close: document.getElementById('furaiImageToolCloseBtn'),
            stage: document.getElementById('furaiImageToolStage'),
            progress: document.getElementById('furaiImageToolProgress'),
            spinner: document.getElementById('furaiImageToolSpinner'),
            status: document.getElementById('furaiImageToolStatus'),
            hint: document.getElementById('furaiImageToolHint'),
            bar: document.getElementById('furaiImageToolBar'),
            fill: document.getElementById('furaiImageToolFill'),
            preview: document.getElementById('furaiImageToolPreview'),
            secondary: document.getElementById('furaiImageToolSecondaryBtn'),
            next: document.getElementById('furaiImageToolNextBtn'),
            copy: document.getElementById('furaiImageToolCopyBtn'),
            download: document.getElementById('furaiImageToolDownloadBtn')
        };

        if (!ui.modal) return null;
        ui.close.onclick = () => cleanup(true);
        ui.secondary.onclick = () => cleanup(true);
        ui.preview.onclick = () => job?.finished && ui.stage.classList.toggle('is-zoomed');
        ui.next.onclick = () => {
            if (!job?.finished || !job.resultBlob) return;
            run(job.task === 'upscale' ? 'remove-background' : 'upscale', job.resultBlob, job.transparent);
        };
        ui.download.onclick = () => {
            if (!job?.resultUrl) return;
            const link = document.createElement('a');
            link.href = job.resultUrl;
            link.download = job.filename;
            document.body.appendChild(link);
            link.click();
            link.remove();
        };
        ui.copy.onclick = copyResultLink;
        return ui;
    };

    const stopWorker = () => {
        if (!job) return;
        if (job.worker) {
            job.worker.onmessage = job.worker.onerror = null;
            job.worker.terminate();
            job.worker = null;
        }
        if (job.workerUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(job.workerUrl);
        job.workerUrl = null;
    };

    const releaseInput = () => {
        if (!job) return;
        if (job.ownsInput && job.inputUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(job.inputUrl);
        job.inputUrl = null;
        job.ownsInput = false;
    };

    const resetUi = hide => {
        const current = getUi();
        if (!current) return;
        current.stage.classList.remove('is-zoomed', 'is-transparent');
        current.progress.hidden = false;
        current.spinner.className = 'furai-mini-spinner';
        current.spinner.textContent = '';
        current.status.textContent = 'Please wait…';
        current.hint.hidden = true;
        current.bar.hidden = true;
        current.fill.style.width = '0%';
        current.preview.removeAttribute('src');
        current.preview.hidden = true;
        current.secondary.hidden = false;
        current.secondary.textContent = 'Abort';
        current.next.hidden = current.copy.hidden = current.download.hidden = true;
        current.copy.disabled = false;
        current.copy.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined">link_2</span><span>Copy image link</span>';
        current.close.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Abort and close');
        if (hide) current.modal.style.display = 'none';
    };

    const cleanup = (hide = true) => {
        if (job) {
            job.uploadId++;
            stopWorker();
            releaseInput();
            if (job.resultUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(job.resultUrl);
            job.resultBlob = job.resultUrl = job.shareUrl = null;
            job = null;
        }
        resetUi(hide);
    };

    const openModal = () => {
        const current = getUi();
        if (!current) return;
        if (typeof openModalLayer === 'function') openModalLayer(current.modal);
        else current.modal.style.display = 'flex';
    };

    const setProgress = (text, percent) => {
        const current = getUi();
        if (!current) return;
        current.spinner.className = 'furai-mini-spinner';
        current.spinner.textContent = '';
        current.status.textContent = text;
        current.hint.hidden = job?.task !== 'upscale' || !!job?.finished;
        const valid = Number.isFinite(percent);
        current.bar.hidden = !valid;
        current.fill.style.width = valid ? `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(percent)))}%` : '0%';
    };

    const createWorker = () => {
        const source = `
self.onmessage=async({data:{task,imageUrl,backend}})=>{
 let pipe,bitmap,finalCanvas,result,error,retry=false;
 const post=(type,text,percent)=>self.postMessage({type,text,percent});
 const release=canvas=>{if(canvas)try{canvas.width=canvas.height=1}catch(_){}};
 let last=-1;
 const progress=p=>{let n=Number(p?.progress);if(!Number.isFinite(n)&&Number(p?.total)>0)n=Number(p.loaded)/Number(p.total)*100;if(!Number.isFinite(n))return;if(n<=1)n*=100;n=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Math.round(n)));if(n!==last){last=n;post('progress','Loading model '+n+'%',n)}};
 const toCanvas=image=>{if(!image)throw Error('The image model returned no result.');const rgba=image.channels===4?image:image.rgba();const canvas=new OffscreenCanvas(rgba.width,rgba.height),context=canvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:true});if(!context)throw Error('Image processing is unavailable in this browser.');const frame=context.createImageData(rgba.width,rgba.height);frame.data.set(rgba.data);context.putImageData(frame,0,0);return canvas};
 const upscale=async transformers=>{post('progress','Preparing image…',0);const response=await fetch(imageUrl);if(!response.ok)throw Error('Could not read the generated image.');bitmap=await createImageBitmap(await response.blob());const scale=2,core=384,overlap=32,align=8,columns=Math.ceil(bitmap.width/core),rows=Math.ceil(bitmap.height/core),total=columns*rows;finalCanvas=new OffscreenCanvas(bitmap.width*scale,bitmap.height*scale);const finalContext=finalCanvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:true});if(!finalContext)throw Error('Image processing is unavailable in this browser.');let done=0;for(let row=0;row<rows;row++)for(let column=0;column<columns;column++){const x=column*core,y=row*core,width=Math.min(core,bitmap.width-x),height=Math.min(core,bitmap.height-y),sourceX=Math.max(0,x-overlap),sourceY=Math.max(0,y-overlap),sourceRight=Math.min(bitmap.width,x+width+overlap),sourceBottom=Math.min(bitmap.height,y+height+overlap),sourceWidth=sourceRight-sourceX,sourceHeight=sourceBottom-sourceY,tileWidth=Math.ceil(sourceWidth/align)*align,tileHeight=Math.ceil(sourceHeight/align)*align;post('progress','Upscaling… '+(done+1)+' of '+total,done/total*100);let tile=new OffscreenCanvas(tileWidth,tileHeight),tileContext=tile.getContext('2d',{alpha:true});if(!tileContext)throw Error('Image processing is unavailable in this browser.');tileContext.drawImage(bitmap,sourceX,sourceY,sourceWidth,sourceHeight,0,0,sourceWidth,sourceHeight);if(tileWidth>sourceWidth)tileContext.drawImage(tile,sourceWidth-1,0,1,sourceHeight,sourceWidth,0,tileWidth-sourceWidth,sourceHeight);if(tileHeight>sourceHeight)tileContext.drawImage(tile,0,sourceHeight-1,tileWidth,1,0,sourceHeight,tileWidth,tileHeight-sourceHeight);let output=await pipe(transformers.RawImage.fromCanvas(tile));if(Array.isArray(output))output=output[0];let outputCanvas=toCanvas(output),outputContext=outputCanvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:true});outputContext.globalCompositeOperation='destination-in';outputContext.drawImage(tile,0,0,tileWidth,tileHeight,0,0,outputCanvas.width,outputCanvas.height);finalContext.drawImage(outputCanvas,(x-sourceX)*scale,(y-sourceY)*scale,width*scale,height*scale,x*scale,y*scale,width*scale,height*scale);release(outputCanvas);release(tile);outputCanvas=tile=tileContext=output=null;done++;post('progress','Upscaling… '+done+' of '+total,done/total*100)}bitmap.close();bitmap=null;post('progress','Preparing image…',100);const blob=await finalCanvas.convertToBlob({type:'image/png'});release(finalCanvas);finalCanvas=null;return blob};
 try{post('progress','Loading tools…');const transformers=await import('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@huggingface/transformers@4.2.0');transformers.env.allowLocalModels=false;transformers.env.useWasmCache=true;transformers.env.backends.onnx.wasm.proxy=false;if(task==='remove-background'){pipe=await transformers.pipeline('background-removal','onnx-community/ormbg-ONNX',{progress_callback:progress});post('processing','Removing background…');let output=await pipe([imageUrl]),image=Array.isArray(output)?output[0]:output;if(!image?.toBlob)throw Error('The image model returned no result.');post('progress','Preparing image…');result=await image.toBlob();output=image=null}else{pipe=await transformers.pipeline('image-to-image','Xenova/swin2SR-classical-sr-x2-64',backend==='webgpu'?{device:'webgpu',dtype:'fp16',progress_callback:progress}:{dtype:'q8',progress_callback:progress});result=await upscale(transformers)}}catch(reason){if(task==='upscale'&&backend==='webgpu')retry=true;else error=reason?.message||String(reason)}finally{if(bitmap)try{bitmap.close()}catch(_){}release(finalCanvas);if(pipe?.dispose)try{await pipe.dispose()}catch(_){}}self.postMessage(retry?{type:'retry'}:error?{type:'error',message:error}:{type:'result',blob:result})};`;
        const workerUrl = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([source], { type: 'text/javascript' }));
        return { worker: new Worker(workerUrl, { type: 'module' }), workerUrl };
    };

    const friendlyError = raw => {
        const text = String(raw || '').toLowerCase();
        if (/bad_alloc|out of memory|not enough memory|failed to allocate|allocation failed/.test(text)) {
            return job?.task === 'upscale'
                ? 'This image is too large for the browser to upscale safely. Try a smaller image or close other apps.'
                : 'Your device ran out of memory while processing this image. Try a smaller image or close other apps.';
        }
        if (/failed to fetch|network|download|load failed/.test(text)) return 'The image tool could not finish loading. Check your connection and try again.';
        return job?.task === 'upscale'
            ? 'This image could not be upscaled. Try again or use a smaller image.'
            : 'The background could not be removed. Try again with another image.';
    };

    const showError = raw => {
        if (!job) return;
        const current = getUi();
        stopWorker();
        releaseInput();
        job.finished = job.failed = true;
        current.title.textContent = job.task === 'upscale' ? 'Upscale failed' : 'Background removal failed';
        current.spinner.className = 'material-symbols-outlined';
        current.spinner.textContent = 'warning';
        current.status.textContent = friendlyError(raw);
        current.hint.hidden = current.bar.hidden = true;
        current.secondary.hidden = false;
        current.secondary.textContent = 'Dismiss';
        current.next.hidden = current.copy.hidden = current.download.hidden = true;
        current.close.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Dismiss');
    };

    const copyResultLink = async () => {
        if (!job?.finished || !job.resultBlob) return;
        const current = getUi();
        const active = job;
        const uploadFn = typeof getFuraiUploadPluginFunction === 'function'
            ? getFuraiUploadPluginFunction()
            : ((typeof window.root !== 'undefined' && window.root.upload) || window.upload || null);

        if (typeof uploadFn !== 'function') {
            if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Upload plugin not found.', 'error');
            return;
        }

        current.copy.disabled = true;
        try {
            if (!active.shareUrl) {
                const uploadId = ++active.uploadId;
                current.copy.innerHTML = '<span class="furai-mini-spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span><span>Uploading…</span>';
                const { url, error } = await uploadFn(active.resultBlob);
                if (job !== active || active.uploadId !== uploadId) return;
                if (error || !url) throw new Error(error || 'Image upload failed.');
                active.shareUrl = url;
            }

            const copyFn = typeof copyTextWithFallback === 'function'
                ? copyTextWithFallback
                : text => navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
            await copyFn(active.shareUrl);
            if (job !== active) return;
            current.copy.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined">check</span><span>Copied</span>';
            if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Processed image link copied.');
        } catch (error) {
            if (job !== active) return;
            current.copy.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined">link_2</span><span>Copy image link</span>';
            if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast(`Upload failed: ${error.message || error}`, 'error');
        } finally {
            if (job === active) current.copy.disabled = false;
        }
    };

    const startWorker = backend => {
        if (!job) return;
        stopWorker();
        const active = job;
        const created = createWorker();
        active.worker = created.worker;
        active.workerUrl = created.workerUrl;
        active.backend = backend;

        active.worker.onmessage = ({ data = {} }) => {
            if (job !== active) return;
            if (data.type === 'progress') return setProgress(data.text || 'Processing…', Number(data.percent));
            if (data.type === 'processing') return setProgress(data.text || 'Processing…');
            if (data.type === 'retry') {
                setProgress('GPU unavailable, switching to CPU…');
                startWorker('wasm');
                return;
            }
            if (data.type === 'error') {
                console.error(`${active.title} failed:`, data.message);
                showError(data.message);
                return;
            }
            if (data.type !== 'result') return;

            const current = getUi();
            stopWorker();
            releaseInput();
            active.finished = true;
            active.transparent = active.transparent || active.task === 'remove-background';
            active.resultBlob = data.blob;
            active.resultUrl = URL.createObjectURL(data.blob);
            active.filename = makeFilename(active.suffix);

            current.title.textContent = active.doneTitle;
            current.progress.hidden = true;
            current.stage.classList.remove('is-zoomed');
            current.stage.classList.toggle('is-transparent', active.transparent);
            current.preview.src = active.resultUrl;
            current.preview.alt = active.doneTitle;
            current.preview.title = 'Tap to zoom';
            current.preview.hidden = false;
            current.secondary.hidden = true;
            current.next.hidden = current.copy.hidden = current.download.hidden = false;
            current.next.innerHTML = active.task === 'upscale'
                ? '<span class="material-symbols-outlined">background_replace</span><span>Remove background</span>'
                : '<span class="material-symbols-outlined">photo_size_select_large</span><span>Upscale 2×</span>';
            current.close.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Close');
        };

        active.worker.onerror = error => {
            if (job !== active) return;
            console.error(`${active.title} worker failed:`, error);
            if (active.task === 'upscale' && active.backend === 'webgpu') {
                setProgress('GPU unavailable, switching to CPU…');
                startWorker('wasm');
            } else {
                showError(error?.message || 'Worker stopped.');
            }
        };

        active.worker.postMessage({ task: active.task, imageUrl: active.inputUrl, backend });
    };

    const makeFilename = suffix => {
        const now = new Date();
        const pad = value => String(value).padStart(2, '0');
        return `FurAI-${pad(now.getFullYear() % 100)}${pad(now.getMonth() + 1)}${pad(now.getDate())}-${pad(now.getHours())}${pad(now.getMinutes())}${suffix}.png`;
    };

    const run = (task, source, sourceTransparent = false) => {
        if (!source) return;
        if (job && !job.finished) {
            openModal();
            return;
        }

        const ownsInput = source instanceof Blob;
        const inputUrl = ownsInput ? URL.createObjectURL(source) : String(source);
        cleanup(false);

        const current = getUi();
        if (!current) return;
        const config = task === 'upscale'
            ? { title: 'Upscaling image 2×', doneTitle: 'Image upscaled 2×', suffix: '-2x' }
            : { title: 'Removing background', doneTitle: 'Background removed', suffix: '-nobg' };

        job = {
            task,
            ...config,
            inputUrl,
            ownsInput,
            transparent: sourceTransparent || task === 'remove-background',
            worker: null,
            workerUrl: null,
            resultBlob: null,
            resultUrl: null,
            shareUrl: null,
            uploadId: 0,
            backend: 'wasm',
            finished: false,
            failed: false
        };

        current.title.textContent = config.title;
        current.stage.classList.toggle('is-transparent', job.transparent);
        current.progress.hidden = false;
        current.secondary.hidden = false;
        current.close.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Abort and close');
        openModal();
        setProgress('Loading tools…');
        startWorker(task === 'upscale' && navigator.gpu ? 'webgpu' : 'wasm');
    };

    window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => cleanup(true), { once: true });
    return {
        open: (task, imageUrl) => run(task, imageUrl, false),
        close: () => cleanup(true)
    };
})();

function addBottomControls(cardEl, imageUrl, title, imageInfo = {}) {
    const controls = document.createElement('div');
    controls.className = 'gen-controls';

    const addButton = (titleText, icon, handler, extraClass = '') => {
        const button = document.createElement('button');
        button.type = 'button';
        button.className = `gen-btn-small${extraClass ? ` ${extraClass}` : ''}`;
        button.title = titleText;
        button.setAttribute('aria-label', titleText);
        button.innerHTML = icon.startsWith('fa-')
            ? `<i class="fa-solid ${icon}"></i>`
            : `<span class="material-symbols-outlined">${icon}</span>`;
        button.onclick = event => {
            event.stopPropagation();
            handler(event, button);
        };
        controls.appendChild(button);
        return button;
    };

    addButton('Zoom', 'zoom_in', () => {
        if (imageUrl) openLightbox(imageUrl);
    });

    const pinButton = addButton('Pin image in chat', 'push_pin', (_event, button) => {
        void togglePinnedGeneratedImageInChat(button, cardEl, imageUrl, title, imageInfo);
    }, 'gen-pin-btn');
    setGeneratedImagePinButtonState(pinButton, !!getPinnedGeneratedImageId(cardEl));

    addButton('Download', 'download', () => {
        FuraiGeneratedImageControls.download(imageUrl);
    });

    addButton('Save to Concept Board', 'note_stack_add', (_event, button) => {
        void FuraiGeneratedImageControls.saveConcept(button, {
            cardEl,
            imageUrl,
            title,
            imageInfo
        });
    });

    const moreButton = addButton('More image actions', 'more_horiz', () => {
        FuraiGeneratedImageControls.open(moreButton, {
            cardEl,
            imageUrl,
            title,
            imageInfo
        });
    }, 'gen-more-btn');
    moreButton.setAttribute('aria-haspopup', 'menu');
    moreButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');

    cardEl.appendChild(controls);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   MAIN MENU MODAL GROUP
   Only one root modal opened from the main menu can exist at a time.
   ========================================================================== */

function closeMainMenuModals(exceptId = '') {
    const exceptIds = new Set(
        Array.isArray(exceptId)
            ? exceptId.filter(Boolean)
            : [exceptId].filter(Boolean)
    );

    const modalIds = [
        'panelCtn',
        'forumOverlayEl',
        'guideOverlayEl',
        'expansionModalEl',
        'globalSettingsModalEl',
        'charactersModalEl',
        'lorebookLibraryModal',
        'exportImportModalEl',
        'accountModalEl',
        'whatsNewModalEl',
        'furaiModeSwitcherModal'
    ];

    modalIds.forEach(id => {
        if (exceptIds.has(id)) return;

        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!el) return;

        if (id === 'expansionModalEl') {
            const isExpansionMainScreen =
                document.body.classList.contains('expansion-pass-main-active') ||
                el.classList.contains('expansion-main-view');

            if (isExpansionMainScreen) return;

            if (typeof closeExpansionModal === 'function') {
                closeExpansionModal();
            } else {
                el.style.display = 'none';
            }
            return;
        }

        el.style.display = 'none';
    });

    // RAM cleanup for heavy iframe/content modals
    const galleryBody = document.getElementById('galleryBody');
    if (!exceptIds.has('panelCtn') && galleryBody) {
        galleryBody.innerHTML = '';
    }

    if (!exceptIds.has('whatsNewModalEl')) {
        if (typeof window.closeWhatsNewModal === 'function') {
            window.closeWhatsNewModal();
        } else {
            const whatsNewList = document.getElementById('whatsNewList');
            if (whatsNewList) whatsNewList.innerHTML = '';
            hardUnloadWhatsNewRemoteData?.();
        }
    }
      
    const forumFrame = document.getElementById('forumIframeContainer');
    if (!exceptIds.has('forumOverlayEl') && forumFrame) {
        forumFrame.innerHTML = '';
    }

    if (!exceptIds.has('guideOverlayEl')) {
        if (typeof closeGuide === 'function') {
            closeGuide();
        } else {
            const guideFrame = document.getElementById('guideIframeContainer');
            if (guideFrame) guideFrame.innerHTML = '';
        }
    }

    const globalTab = document.getElementById('globalTabContent');
    if (!exceptIds.has('globalSettingsModalEl') && globalTab) {
        globalTab.innerHTML = '';
    }

    const charsGrid = document.getElementById('charsGridContainer');
    if (!exceptIds.has('charactersModalEl') && charsGrid) {
        charsGrid.innerHTML = '';
    }

    const menu = document.getElementById('mainMenuDropdown');
    if (menu) menu.classList.remove('show');
}

/* Modal stack manager */
const ModalStackManager = (() => {
    const BASE_Z = 2000;
    const STEP_Z = 20;

    const STACK_LAYER_IDS = [
        'panelCtn',
        'forumOverlayEl',
        'guideOverlayEl',
        'expansionModalEl',
        'globalSettingsModalEl',
        'charactersModalEl',
        'lorebookLibraryModal',
        'exportImportModalEl',
        'accountModalEl',
        'whatsNewModalEl',
        'furaiModeSwitcherModal',

        'chatOptionsModalEl',
        'userProfileModalEl',
        'botProfileModalEl',
        'referenceModalEl',
        'glossaryModalEl',
        'summaryModalEl',
        'tokenModalEl',
        'memoModalEl',
        'enhancerSettingsModalEl',
        'charImportModalEl',
        'shareLinkWarningModal',

        'profileCardModal',
        'imageLightboxEl',

        'backgroundModalEl',
        'conceptBoardModalEl',
        'musicPlayerModal'
    ];

    const layerIdSet = new Set(STACK_LAYER_IDS);
    const watched = new WeakSet();
    const visibleState = new WeakMap();
    const parentLayers = new WeakMap();

    const isWorkspaceSurface = el =>
        !!el && el.classList.contains('furai-workspace-surface');

    const shouldPortalLayer = el => {
        if (!el || el === document.body || isWorkspaceSurface(el)) return false;

        return (
            el.classList.contains('modal') ||
            el.classList.contains('lightbox-modal') ||
            el.classList.contains('profile-card-overlay')
        );
    };

    const portalLayer = layer => {
        if (!shouldPortalLayer(layer) || layer.parentElement === document.body) return;

        document.body.appendChild(layer);
    };
    
    const getLayer = layerOrId => {
        if (!layerOrId) return null;

        return typeof layerOrId === 'string'
            ? document.getElementById(layerOrId)
            : layerOrId;
    };

    const isLayerCandidate = el => {
        if (!el || el.nodeType !== 1 || isWorkspaceSurface(el)) return false;

        return (
            el.classList.contains('modal') ||
            el.dataset.stackLayer === 'true' ||
            layerIdSet.has(el.id)
        );
    };

    const isVisible = el => {
        if (!el) return false;

        const style = getComputedStyle(el);

        return (
            style.display !== 'none' &&
            style.visibility !== 'hidden' &&
            style.opacity !== '0'
        );
    };

    const readZ = el => {
        if (!el) return BASE_Z;

        const inlineZ = parseInt(el.style.zIndex, 10);
        if (Number.isFinite(inlineZ)) return inlineZ;

        const computedZ = parseInt(getComputedStyle(el).zIndex, 10);
        if (Number.isFinite(computedZ)) return computedZ;

        return BASE_Z;
    };

    const getAllLayers = () => {
        const layers = new Set();

        document.querySelectorAll('.modal, [data-stack-layer="true"]').forEach(el => {
            if (!isWorkspaceSurface(el)) layers.add(el);
        });

        STACK_LAYER_IDS.forEach(id => {
            const el = document.getElementById(id);
            if (el && !isWorkspaceSurface(el)) layers.add(el);
        });

        return Array.from(layers);
    };

    const getHighestOpenZ = exceptEl => {
        let highest = BASE_Z;

        getAllLayers().forEach(el => {
            if (el === exceptEl || !isVisible(el)) return;
            highest = Math.max(highest, readZ(el));
        });

        return highest;
    };

    const getTopVisibleLayer = exceptEl => {
        let topLayer = null;
        let topZ = -Infinity;

        getAllLayers().forEach(el => {
            if (el === exceptEl || !isVisible(el)) return;
            const z = readZ(el);
            if (z >= topZ) {
                topZ = z;
                topLayer = el;
            }
        });

        return topLayer;
    };

    const bringToFront = (layerOrId, options = {}) => {
        const layer = getLayer(layerOrId);
        if (!layer || !isVisible(layer) || isWorkspaceSurface(layer)) return null;

        layer.dataset.stackLayer = 'true';
        portalLayer(layer);

        const anchor = getLayer(options.above);
        const ownZ = readZ(layer);
        const openTopZ = getHighestOpenZ(layer);
        const anchorZ = anchor && isVisible(anchor) ? readZ(anchor) : BASE_Z;

        const nextZ = Math.max(
            BASE_Z,
            ownZ,
            openTopZ + STEP_Z,
            anchorZ + STEP_Z
        );

        const nextZText = String(nextZ);

        if (layer.style.zIndex !== nextZText) {
            layer.style.setProperty('z-index', nextZText, 'important');
        }

        return nextZ;
    };

    const open = (layerOrId, options = {}) => {
        const layer = getLayer(layerOrId);
        if (!layer || isWorkspaceSurface(layer)) return null;

        const parent = getLayer(options.parent) || getTopVisibleLayer(layer);
        if (parent) parentLayers.set(layer, parent);

        layer.dataset.stackLayer = 'true';
        portalLayer(layer);
        watchLayer(layer);

        layer.style.display = options.display || 'flex';
        visibleState.set(layer, true);

        if (typeof scheduleFuraiUiScan === 'function') scheduleFuraiUiScan(layer);
        bringToFront(layer, options);

        return layer;
    };

    const close = layerOrId => {
        const layer = getLayer(layerOrId);
        if (!layer) return null;

        layer.style.display = 'none';
        layer.style.removeProperty('z-index');
        visibleState.set(layer, false);

        const parent = parentLayers.get(layer);
        if (parent && isVisible(parent)) bringToFront(parent);

        return parent || null;
    };

    const getVisibleParents = layerOrId => {
        const parents = [];
        const seen = new Set();
        let parent = parentLayers.get(getLayer(layerOrId));

        while (parent && !seen.has(parent)) {
            seen.add(parent);
            if (isVisible(parent)) parents.push(parent);
            parent = parentLayers.get(parent);
        }

        return parents;
    };

    const restoreParents = parents => {
        (parents || []).slice().reverse().forEach(parent => {
            if (!parent || isVisible(parent)) return;
            parent.style.display = 'flex';
            visibleState.set(parent, true);
            if (typeof scheduleFuraiUiScan === 'function') scheduleFuraiUiScan(parent);
            bringToFront(parent);
        });
    };

    const watchLayer = layer => {
        if (!layer || watched.has(layer)) return;

        watched.add(layer);
        visibleState.set(layer, isVisible(layer));

        const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
            const wasVisible = visibleState.get(layer) === true;
            const nowVisible = isVisible(layer);

            visibleState.set(layer, nowVisible);

            if (isWorkspaceSurface(layer)) {
                layer.style.removeProperty('z-index');
                delete layer.dataset.stackLayer;
                return;
            }

            if (nowVisible && !wasVisible) {
                if (typeof scheduleFuraiUiScan === 'function') scheduleFuraiUiScan(layer);

                if (!parentLayers.has(layer)) {
                    const parent = getTopVisibleLayer(layer);
                    if (parent) parentLayers.set(layer, parent);
                }
                bringToFront(layer);
            } else if (!nowVisible && wasVisible) {
                const parent = parentLayers.get(layer);
                if (parent && isVisible(parent)) bringToFront(parent);
            }
        });

        observer.observe(layer, {
            attributes: true,
            attributeFilter: ['style', 'class']
        });
    };

    const scanAndWatch = root => {
        if (!root || root.nodeType !== 1) return;

        if (isLayerCandidate(root)) {
            watchLayer(root);
            if (isVisible(root)) bringToFront(root);
        }

        root.querySelectorAll?.('.modal, [data-stack-layer="true"]').forEach(layer => {
            if (isWorkspaceSurface(layer)) return;
            watchLayer(layer);
            if (isVisible(layer)) bringToFront(layer);
        });

        STACK_LAYER_IDS.forEach(id => {
            const found = root.querySelector?.(`#${id}`);
            if (!found || isWorkspaceSurface(found)) return;

            watchLayer(found);
            if (isVisible(found)) bringToFront(found);
        });
    };

    const init = () => {
        getAllLayers().forEach(layer => {
            watchLayer(layer);
            if (isVisible(layer)) bringToFront(layer);
        });

        const bodyObserver = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
            mutations.forEach(mutation => {
                mutation.addedNodes.forEach(scanAndWatch);
            });
        });

        bodyObserver.observe(document.body, {
            childList: true,
            subtree: true
        });
    };

    return {
        init,
        open,
        close,
        bringToFront,
        getVisibleParents,
        restoreParents
    };
})();

window.ModalStackManager = ModalStackManager;

window.openModalLayer = ModalStackManager.open;
window.closeModalLayer = ModalStackManager.close;
window.bringModalToFront = ModalStackManager.bringToFront;
window.watchModalLayer = ModalStackManager.watchLayer;

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', ModalStackManager.init, { once: true });
} else {
    ModalStackManager.init();
}

function toggleGallery() {
    const panel = document.getElementById('panelCtn');
    const body = document.getElementById('galleryBody');
    
    if (!panel || !body) return;

    const isHidden = panel.style.display === 'none' || panel.style.display === '';

    if (isHidden) {
        closeMainMenuModals('panelCtn');

        panel.style.display = 'flex';

        if (!body.innerHTML.trim()) {
            try {
                const content = (typeof textToImagePlugin === 'function') 
                    ? textToImagePlugin(typeof galleryOptions !== 'undefined' ? galleryOptions : {}) 
                    : "Error: plugin not found";

                body.innerHTML = content.iframeHtml || content;

                const iframe = body.querySelector('iframe');
                if (iframe) {
                    iframe.setAttribute('allow', 'clipboard-read *; clipboard-write *; fullscreen *');
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.error("Gallery Load Error:", e);
                body.innerHTML = '<iframe src="https://perchance.org/text-to-image-plugin" style="width:100%;height:100%;border:none;" allow="clipboard-read *; clipboard-write *; fullscreen *"></iframe>';
            }
        }
    } else {
        panel.style.display = 'none';

        setTimeout(() => {
            body.innerHTML = '';
        }, 300);
    }
}
