function toggleForum() {
    const forum = document.getElementById('forumOverlayEl');
    const container = document.getElementById('forumIframeContainer');
    
    if (!forum) return;

    const isHidden = forum.style.display === 'none' || forum.style.display === '';

    if (isHidden) {
        closeMainMenuModals('forumOverlayEl');

        forum.style.display = 'flex';

        if (typeof loadPrivateChannels === 'function') loadPrivateChannels();

        const hideGeneralRules = localStorage.getItem('hide_rules_general') === 'true';
        const modal = document.getElementById('rulesModalGeneral');
        if (!hideGeneralRules && modal) modal.style.display = 'flex';

        renderForumIframe();
    } else {
        forum.style.display = 'none';
        if (container) container.innerHTML = '';
    }
}

  function switchForumTab(tabId, btn) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.forum-tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      if(btn) btn.classList.add('active');
      currentForumTabId = tabId;
      renderForumIframe();
  }

  function renderForumIframe() {
      const container = document.getElementById('forumIframeContainer');
      container.innerHTML = ''; 

      // --- 1. INJECT LOADING MASK ---
      const mask = document.createElement('div');
      mask.className = 'tool-loading-mask';
      mask.style.position = 'absolute';
      mask.style.zIndex = '10';
      mask.innerHTML = `
          <div class="modern-spinner"></div>
          <div class="loading-text">Loading Channel...</div>
      `;
      container.appendChild(mask);
      // ------------------------------

      const mode = isForumNsfw ? 'nsfw' : 'safe';
      
      // --- DYNAMIC ID CHECK (FIXED) ---
      let channelConfig = {};
      
      // 1. Check if it's a standard static tab
      if (forumData[mode][currentForumTabId]) {
          const info = forumData[mode][currentForumTabId];
          channelConfig = {
              channel: info.channel,
              placeholder: info.placeholder,
              submitText: info.submitText,
              allowBots: info.allowBots
          };
      } 
      // 2. Check if it's a Custom Private Channel (Check BOTH prefixes)
      else if (currentForumTabId.startsWith('furai-safe-') || currentForumTabId.startsWith('furai-18-adult-')) {
          channelConfig = {
              channel: currentForumTabId,
              placeholder: "🔒 This is a Private Channel.",
              submitText: "submit",
              allowBots: false 
          };
      } 
      // 3. Fallback
      else {
          return; 
      }

      const isLight = document.body.classList.contains('light-theme');
      const themeColor = isLight ? 'light' : 'dark';

      let config = { 
          ...baseForumConfig,
          commentPlaceholderText: channelConfig.placeholder,
          forceColorScheme: themeColor
      };
      
      if (channelConfig.channel) config.channel = channelConfig.channel;
      if (channelConfig.submitText) config.submitButtonText = channelConfig.submitText;
      if (channelConfig.allowBots === false) config.allowBots = false;
      
      const commentEmbedName = channelConfig.channel
          ? `ai-furry-generator+${channelConfig.channel}`
          : "ai-furry-generator";
      
      const baseUrl = `https://comments-plugin.perchance.org/embed/${commentEmbedName}`;
      const encodedConfig = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(config));
      const fullUrl = `${baseUrl}?adminPasswordHash=${baseForumConfig.adminPasswordHash}#${encodedConfig}`;

      const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
      iframe.src = fullUrl;
      iframe.style.width = "100%";
      iframe.style.height = "100%";
      iframe.style.border = "none";
      iframe.allow = "clipboard-read *; clipboard-write *";
      
      iframe.onload = () => {
          setTimeout(() => {
              mask.style.opacity = '0';
              setTimeout(() => mask.remove(), 200); 
          }, 50);
      };

      container.appendChild(iframe);
  }

// --- SAFETY & AGE LOGIC ---
function toggleForumSafety() {
    const btn = document.getElementById('forumSafetyBtn');
    const icon = btn ? btn.querySelector('i') : null;
    const textSpan = document.getElementById('safetyBtnText');

    if (!isForumNsfw) {
        openAdultAccessGate('forum');
        return;
    }

    isForumNsfw = false;

    if (btn) {
        btn.style.borderColor = "var(--border-color)";
        btn.style.color = "var(--primary-color)";
        btn.title = "Safety Protocols: Active";
    }

    if (icon) icon.className = "fa-solid fa-user-shield";
    if (textSpan) textSpan.textContent = "SAFE";

    loadPrivateChannels();
    switchForumTab('general', document.querySelector('.forum-tab-btn'));
}

function activateNsfwMode() {
    isForumNsfw = true;

    const btn = document.getElementById('forumSafetyBtn');
    const icon = btn ? btn.querySelector('i') : null;
    const textSpan = document.getElementById('safetyBtnText');

    if (btn) {
        btn.style.borderColor = "var(--danger-color)";
        btn.style.color = "var(--danger-color)";
        btn.title = "18+ Mode Active";
    }

    if (icon) icon.className = "fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation";
    if (textSpan) textSpan.textContent = "18+";

    loadPrivateChannels();
    switchForumTab('general', document.querySelector('.forum-tab-btn'));
    renderForumIframe();
}

function continueAfterAdultAccess(source) {
    if (source === "livestream" && window.FuraiLivestream?.enterAdultAfterGate) {
        window.FuraiLivestream.enterAdultAfterGate();
        return;
    }

    if (source === "exp-submit" && typeof openDirectSubmitIframe === "function") {
        openDirectSubmitIframe('nsfw');
    }
}

function openAdultAccessGate(source = 'forum') {
    const shouldSyncForum = source === 'forum';
    const hide18Rules = localStorage.getItem('hide_rules_18') === 'true';

    if (hasVerifiedAge && hide18Rules) {
        syncAdultUnlockState({
            syncForum: shouldSyncForum,
            syncExpansion: true,
            renderExpansion: true
        });

        continueAfterAdultAccess(source);
        return;
    }

    const modal18 = document.getElementById('rulesModal18');

    if (!modal18) {
        syncAdultUnlockState({
            syncForum: shouldSyncForum,
            syncExpansion: true,
            renderExpansion: true
        });

        continueAfterAdultAccess(source);
        return;
    }

    modal18.dataset.pendingSource = source;

    const title = document.getElementById('adultGateTitle');
    const ageBlock = document.getElementById('adultAgeVerifyBlock');
    const ageInput = document.getElementById('adultAgeInput');
    const verifiedNote = document.getElementById('adultAlreadyVerifiedNote');
    const confirmBtn = document.getElementById('adultGateConfirmBtn');

    if (title) {
        title.textContent = (source === 'expansion' || source === 'exp-submit')
            ? '18+ Expansion Access'
            : '18+ Community Access';
    }

    if (ageBlock) ageBlock.style.display = hasVerifiedAge ? 'none' : 'block';
    if (verifiedNote) verifiedNote.style.display = hasVerifiedAge ? 'block' : 'none';
    if (confirmBtn) confirmBtn.textContent = hasVerifiedAge ? 'I Understand & Enter' : 'Verify & Enter';

    if (ageInput && !hasVerifiedAge) {
        ageInput.value = '';
    }

    modal18.style.display = 'flex';

    if (ageInput && !hasVerifiedAge) {
        setTimeout(() => ageInput.focus(), 50);
    }
}

function closeAdultAccessGate() {
    const modal18 = document.getElementById('rulesModal18');
    const ageInput = document.getElementById('adultAgeInput');

    if (modal18) modal18.style.display = 'none';
    if (ageInput) ageInput.value = '';
}

function acceptGeneralRules() {
    const checkbox = document.getElementById('dontShowRulesGeneral');
    if (checkbox && checkbox.checked) localStorage.setItem('hide_rules_general', 'true');

    const modal = document.getElementById('rulesModalGeneral');
    if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
}

function accept18Rules() {
    const modal18 = document.getElementById('rulesModal18');
    const source = modal18 ? modal18.dataset.pendingSource || 'forum' : 'forum';
    const shouldSyncForum = source === 'forum';

    if (!hasVerifiedAge) {
        const ageInput = document.getElementById('adultAgeInput');
        const age = parseInt(ageInput ? ageInput.value : '', 10);

        if (!Number.isInteger(age) || age < 18) {
            showToast("Access denied. You must be 18 or older.", "error");
            if (ageInput) ageInput.focus();
            return;
        }
    }

    const checkbox = document.getElementById('dontShowRules18');
    if (checkbox && checkbox.checked) localStorage.setItem('hide_rules_18', 'true');

    if (modal18) modal18.style.display = 'none';

    syncAdultUnlockState({
        syncForum: shouldSyncForum,
        syncExpansion: true,
        renderExpansion: true
    });

    continueAfterAdultAccess(source);
}
                
/* --- Gallery View Toggle Logic --- */
const GALLERY_VIEW_PERCENT = Object.freeze({
    large: 100,
    regular: 75,
    smaller: 50,
    smallest: 25
});

let galleryViewMode = localStorage.getItem("furai_gallery_view") || "regular";
if (!Object.hasOwn(GALLERY_VIEW_PERCENT, galleryViewMode)) galleryViewMode = "regular";

function cycleGalleryView(event) {
    if (event) event.stopPropagation();

    if (galleryViewMode === "regular") galleryViewMode = "smaller";
    else if (galleryViewMode === "smaller") galleryViewMode = "smallest";
    else if (galleryViewMode === "smallest") galleryViewMode = "large";
    else galleryViewMode = "regular";

    localStorage.setItem("furai_gallery_view", galleryViewMode);
    applyGalleryView();
}

function applyGalleryView() {
    const btn = document.getElementById("galleryViewBtn");
    const body = document.getElementById("galleryBody");
    if (!btn || !body) return;

    const percent = GALLERY_VIEW_PERCENT[galleryViewMode];
    btn.textContent = `${percent}%`;
    btn.setAttribute("aria-label", `Gallery scale: ${percent}%`);

    body.classList.remove("view-large", "view-regular", "view-smaller", "view-smallest");
    body.classList.add(`view-${galleryViewMode}`);
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', applyGalleryView);


/* --- RAM-Optimized Uploader Logic --- */

function openUploader() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('uploaderModalEl');
    const container = document.getElementById('uploaderContainer');
    
    // 1. Show Modal
    modal.style.display = 'flex';

    // 2. Inject Spinner (Reusing your "Modern Spinner" styles)
    // We add the mask first so it's visible while the iframe loads
    container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="tool-loading-mask" id="uploaderMask">
            <div class="modern-spinner"></div>
            <div class="loading-text">Loading Uploader...</div>
        </div>
    `;

    // 3. Create Iframe Dynamically (This prevents background memory usage)
    const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
    iframe.src = "https://perchance.org/upload";
    
    // 4. KEY REQUIREMENT: Enable Clipboard for Copy/Paste
    iframe.allow = "clipboard-read *; clipboard-write *";
    
    // 5. Append Iframe
    container.appendChild(iframe);

    // 6. Fade out the spinner after a short delay (smooth transition)
    const mask = document.getElementById('uploaderMask');
    setTimeout(() => {
        if(mask) {
            mask.style.opacity = '0';
            setTimeout(() => mask.remove(), 500);
        }
    }, 1500);
}

function closeUploader() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('uploaderModalEl');
    const container = document.getElementById('uploaderContainer');

    // 1. Hide Modal
    modal.style.display = 'none';

    // 2. KILL PROCESS: Completely wipe the DOM content
    // This forces the browser to garbage collect the iframe and free the RAM immediately.
    container.innerHTML = '';
}

function getFuraiUploadPluginFunction() {
    if (typeof window.root !== 'undefined' && typeof window.root.upload === 'function') {
        return window.root.upload.bind(window.root);
    }

    if (typeof window.upload === 'function') {
        return window.upload;
    }

    return null;
}

function furaiDirectUploadToast(message, type = 'info') {
    if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
        showToast(message, type);
        return;
    }

    if (type === 'error') console.error(message);
    else console.log(message);
}

function getDirectVisualUploadFileInput() {
    if (window.furaiDirectVisualUploadFileInput) {
        return window.furaiDirectVisualUploadFileInput;
    }

    const input = document.createElement('input');
    input.type = 'file';
    input.accept = 'image/*,video/mp4,video/webm,video/quicktime,video/x-m4v,video/ogg,.jpg,.jpeg,.png,.gif,.webp,.avif,.svg,.mp4,.webm,.mov,.m4v,.ogv';
    input.style.width = '1px';
    input.style.height = '1px';
    input.style.opacity = '0';
    input.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
    input.style.position = 'absolute';
    input.style.left = '-9999px';

    document.body.appendChild(input);
    window.furaiDirectVisualUploadFileInput = input;

    return input;
}

function isDirectBackgroundUploadInput(input) {
    if (!input) return false;

    const id = String(input.id || '');
    return (
        id === 'bgUrlInput' ||
        id === 'globalBgUrl' ||
        id === 'entryBgUrl' ||
        id === 'makerOpeningBackground'
    );
}

function isDirectUploadAllowedForInput(file, input) {
    const fileType = String(file?.type || '');
    const fileName = String(file?.name || '');
    const isBackground = isDirectBackgroundUploadInput(input);

    const isImage =
        fileType.startsWith('image/') ||
        /\.(png|jpe?g|gif|webp|avif|svg)$/i.test(fileName);

    if (!isBackground) return isImage;

    const isVideo =
        fileType.startsWith('video/') ||
        /\.(mp4|webm|mov|m4v|ogv)$/i.test(fileName);

    return isImage || isVideo;
}

async function directUploadVisualToInput(inputOrId, triggerBtn = null) {
    const targetInput = typeof inputOrId === 'string'
        ? document.getElementById(inputOrId)
        : inputOrId;

    if (!targetInput) {
        furaiDirectUploadToast('Upload target not found.', 'error');
        return;
    }

    const isBackground = isDirectBackgroundUploadInput(targetInput);
    const filePicker = getDirectVisualUploadFileInput();

    filePicker.accept = isBackground
        ? 'image/*,video/mp4,video/webm,video/quicktime,video/x-m4v,video/ogg,.jpg,.jpeg,.png,.gif,.webp,.avif,.svg,.mp4,.webm,.mov,.m4v,.ogv'
        : 'image/*,.jpg,.jpeg,.png,.gif,.webp,.avif,.svg';

    filePicker.value = '';
    filePicker.onchange = async () => {
        const file = filePicker.files && filePicker.files[0];
        if (!file) return;

        if (!isDirectUploadAllowedForInput(file, targetInput)) {
            furaiDirectUploadToast(
                isBackground
                    ? 'Please select an image or supported muted video background file.'
                    : 'Please select an image file.',
                'error'
            );
            return;
        }

        const uploadFn = getFuraiUploadPluginFunction();

        if (!uploadFn) {
            furaiDirectUploadToast('Upload plugin not found. Add upload = {import:upload-plugin} to the lists editor.', 'error');
            return;
        }

        const oldHtml = triggerBtn ? triggerBtn.innerHTML : '';
        const oldTitle = triggerBtn ? triggerBtn.title : '';

        if (triggerBtn) {
            triggerBtn.disabled = true;
            triggerBtn.title = 'Uploading...';
            triggerBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i>';
        }

        try {
            const result = await uploadFn(file);
            const url = result && result.url;
            const error = result && result.error;

            if (error) throw new Error(error);
            if (!url) throw new Error('Upload finished without a URL.');

            targetInput.value = url;
            targetInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            targetInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));

            furaiDirectUploadToast(
                isBackground ? 'Background uploaded and linked.' : 'Image uploaded and linked.',
                'success'
            );
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('Direct upload failed:', err);
            furaiDirectUploadToast(`Upload failed: ${err.message || err}`, 'error');
        } finally {
            filePicker.value = '';
            filePicker.onchange = null;

            if (triggerBtn) {
                triggerBtn.disabled = false;
                triggerBtn.title = oldTitle || getDirectVisualUploadTitle(targetInput);
                triggerBtn.innerHTML = oldHtml || getDirectUploadButtonIconHtml(targetInput);
            }
        }
    };

    filePicker.click();
}

window.directUploadVisualToInput = directUploadVisualToInput;

const FURAI_DIRECT_VISUAL_UPLOAD_SELECTORS = [
    '#furaiLivestreamAvatarInput',
    '#makerAvatarInput',
    '#makerSpriteInput',
    '#userAvatarInput',
    '#botAvatarInput',
    '#storyCastLoreAvatarInput',
    '#userSpriteInput',
    '#botSpriteInput',
    '#globalUserAvatar',
    '#globalUserSprite',
    '#globalWandAvatar',
    '#globalWandSprite',
    '#globalBotAvatar',
    '#globalBotSprite',
    '#editGlobalBotAvatar',
    '#editGlobalBotSprite',
    '#enhancerAvatarInput',

    // Background slots: direct file picker -> upload -> URL fill.
    '#bgUrlInput',
    '#globalBgUrl',
    '#entryBgUrl',
    
    // Lorebook / Glossary cover slot: direct file picker -> upload -> URL fill.
    '#lbEditCoverInput',
    
    '.emo-url-input',
    '.emo-sprite-input'
];

function getDirectVisualUploadInputs(root) {
    if (!root || root.nodeType !== 1) return [];

    const selector = FURAI_DIRECT_VISUAL_UPLOAD_SELECTORS.join(',');
    const inputs = [];

    if (root.matches && root.matches(selector)) {
        inputs.push(root);
    }

    inputs.push(...root.querySelectorAll(selector));

    return inputs;
}

function getDirectVisualUploadTitle(input) {
    const id = String(input.id || '').toLowerCase();
    
    if (isDirectCoverUploadInput(input)) {
        return 'Add Cover Image';
    }
    
    if (isDirectBackgroundUploadInput(input)) {
        return 'Add Background';
    }

    if (id.includes('sprite') || input.classList.contains('emo-sprite-input')) {
        return 'Add Sprite Image';
    }

    return 'Add Avatar Image';
}

function isDirectCoverUploadInput(input) {
    return input && input.id === 'lbEditCoverInput';
}

function getDirectUploadButtonIconHtml(input) {
    const iconSize = input.classList.contains('emo-url-input') || input.classList.contains('emo-sprite-input')
        ? 16
        : 20;

    return `<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size:${iconSize}px;">add_photo_alternate</span>`;
}

function setupDirectVisualUploadButtons(root = document) {
    const inputs = getDirectVisualUploadInputs(root);

    inputs.forEach(input => {
        const row = input.parentElement;
        if (!row) return;

        const button = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button')).find(btn => {
            const oldClick = String(btn.getAttribute('onclick') || '');
            return oldClick.includes('openUploader') || btn.classList.contains('direct-visual-upload-btn');
        });

        if (!button || button.dataset.directVisualUploadReady === '1') return;

        button.dataset.directVisualUploadReady = '1';
        button.type = 'button';
        button.classList.add('direct-visual-upload-btn');
        button.title = getDirectVisualUploadTitle(input);
        button.setAttribute('aria-label', button.title);
        button.removeAttribute('onclick');
        button.innerHTML = getDirectUploadButtonIconHtml(input);

        button.onclick = event => {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();
            directUploadVisualToInput(input, button);
        };
    });
}

function initDirectVisualUploadButtons() {
    if (window.furaiDirectVisualUploadObserverReady) return;
    window.furaiDirectVisualUploadObserverReady = true;

    setupDirectVisualUploadButtons(document);

    const observer = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
        mutations.forEach(mutation => {
            mutation.addedNodes.forEach(node => {
                if (node.nodeType === 1) setupDirectVisualUploadButtons(node);
            });
        });
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    window.furaiDirectVisualUploadObserver = observer;
}

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initDirectVisualUploadButtons, { once: true });
} else {
    setTimeout(initDirectVisualUploadButtons, 0);
}

// --- Global Director's Memo Functions ---

window.openMemoModal = function() {
    const memoInput = document.getElementById('memoInput');
    const languageSelect = document.getElementById('memoChatLanguageSelect');
    let chatData = null;

    if (!memoInput) return;
    memoInput.value = '';

    try {
        if (typeof currentChatId !== 'undefined' && currentChatId) {
            chatData = DB.get(currentChatId) || null;
            if (chatData?.memo) memoInput.value = chatData.memo;
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Memo Load Error:', error);
    }

    populateFuraiChatLanguageSelect(
        languageSelect,
        'chat',
        normalizeFuraiChatLanguagePreference(chatData?.chatLanguage, 'chat')
    );

    document.getElementById('memoModalEl').style.display = 'flex';
    window.syncFuraiMemoLanguageUI();

    const menu = document.getElementById('settingsMenu');
    if (menu?.classList.contains('show')) menu.classList.remove('show');

    setTimeout(() => memoInput.focus(), 50);
};

window.closeMemoModal = function() {
    document.getElementById('memoModalEl').style.display = 'none';
    if (typeof updateTokenButtonUI === 'function') updateTokenButtonUI();
};

window.saveMemo = function() {
    const memoInput = document.getElementById('memoInput');
    const languageSelect = document.getElementById('memoChatLanguageSelect');
    const text = memoInput?.value.trim() || '';
    const languagePreference = normalizeFuraiChatLanguagePreference(languageSelect?.value, 'chat');

    if (typeof currentChatId === 'undefined' || !currentChatId) return;

    try {
        const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
        if (chatData) {
            if (text) chatData.memo = text;
            else delete chatData.memo;

            if (languagePreference === 'mode') delete chatData.chatLanguage;
            else chatData.chatLanguage = languagePreference;

            chatData.timestamp = Date.now();
            DB.set(currentChatId, chatData);
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error saving memo', error);
    }

    window.closeMemoModal();
    if (typeof updateTokenButtonUI === 'function') updateTokenButtonUI();
};

// --- Tools Menu Logic ---
let toolsMenuOriginalParent = null;

function shouldFloatToolsMenu() {
    return window.matchMedia('(max-width: 768px)').matches || document.body.classList.contains('vn-active');
}

function mountToolsMenuFloating() {
    const menu = document.getElementById('toolsMenu');
    const btn = document.getElementById('toolsMenuBtn');
    if (!menu || !btn || !shouldFloatToolsMenu()) return;

    if (!toolsMenuOriginalParent) {
        toolsMenuOriginalParent = menu.parentElement;
    }

    if (menu.parentElement !== document.body) {
        document.body.appendChild(menu);
    }

    menu.classList.add('tools-floating-menu');

    const rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
    const gap = 12;
    const menuWidth = menu.offsetWidth || 220;

    let left = rect.left;
    left = Math.max(gap, Math.min(left, window.innerWidth - menuWidth - gap));

    menu.style.left = `${left}px`;
    menu.style.bottom = `${window.innerHeight - rect.top + gap}px`;
}

function restoreToolsMenuFloating() {
    const menu = document.getElementById('toolsMenu');
    if (!menu) return;

    menu.classList.remove('tools-floating-menu');
    menu.style.left = '';
    menu.style.bottom = '';

    if (toolsMenuOriginalParent && menu.parentElement !== toolsMenuOriginalParent) {
        toolsMenuOriginalParent.appendChild(menu);
    }
}

let toolsMenuPositionRaf = 0;

function scheduleToolsMenuFloating() {
    if (toolsMenuPositionRaf) return;

    toolsMenuPositionRaf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        toolsMenuPositionRaf = 0;

        const menu = document.getElementById('toolsMenu');
        if (!menu?.classList.contains('show')) return;
        if (!shouldFloatToolsMenu()) return;

        mountToolsMenuFloating();
    });
}

function stopToolsMenuPositionTracking() {
    window.removeEventListener('resize', scheduleToolsMenuFloating);
    window.removeEventListener('scroll', scheduleToolsMenuFloating, true);

    if (toolsMenuPositionRaf) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(toolsMenuPositionRaf);
        toolsMenuPositionRaf = 0;
    }
}

/* Backward compatible aliases */
function mountToolsMenuForVn() {
    mountToolsMenuFloating();
}

function restoreToolsMenuFromVn() {
    restoreToolsMenuFloating();
}

function toggleToolsMenu() {
    const menu = document.getElementById('toolsMenu');
    const btn = document.getElementById('toolsMenuBtn');
    if (!menu) return;

    const willOpen = !menu.classList.contains('show');

    if (willOpen) {
        const settings = document.getElementById('settingsMenu');
        if (settings && settings.classList.contains('show')) {
            settings.classList.remove('show');
            document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', closeSettingsMenuOutside, true);
            restoreSettingsMenuFromVn();
            stopSettingsMenuPositionTracking();
        }

        if (btn) playLiteUiMotion(btn, 'ui-lite-btn-nudge', 240);

        menu.style.visibility = 'hidden';
        menu.classList.add('show');

        if (shouldFloatToolsMenu()) {
            mountToolsMenuFloating();
            window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleToolsMenuFloating);
            window.addEventListener('scroll', scheduleToolsMenuFloating, true);
        }

        menu.offsetHeight;
        menu.style.visibility = '';

        playLiteUiMotion(menu, 'ui-lite-pop-in', 220);
        window.addEventListener('click', closeToolsMenuOutside, { once: true });
        return;
    }

    menu.classList.remove('show');
    restoreToolsMenuFloating();
    stopToolsMenuPositionTracking();
}

function closeToolsMenuOutside(event) {
    const container = document.getElementById('toolsMenuContainer');
    const menu = document.getElementById('toolsMenu');

    const clickedInsideAnchor = container && container.contains(event.target);
    const clickedInsideMenu = menu && menu.contains(event.target);

    if (clickedInsideAnchor || clickedInsideMenu) {
        window.addEventListener('click', closeToolsMenuOutside, { once: true });
        return;
    }

    if (event.target.closest('.modal')) return;

    if (menu) menu.classList.remove('show');
    restoreToolsMenuFloating();
    stopToolsMenuPositionTracking();
}

/* --- Scroll Button Logic (Smart before appear, instant after appear) --- */
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  let lastScrollTop = 0;
  let accumulatedScroll = 0;
  let isScrollingUp = false;
  let scrollTimeout = null;
  let ticking = false;

  const SCROLL_THRESHOLD = 600;
  const HIDE_DELAY = 2000;

  const scrollBtn = document.getElementById("scrollBtn");
  const scrollIcon = document.getElementById("scrollIcon");
  const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById("chatMessagesEl");

  if (!chatMessagesEl || !scrollBtn || !scrollIcon) return;

  let scrollBtnPositionRaf = 0;

  function updateScrollBtnPosition() {
    scrollBtnPositionRaf = 0;
    if (!chatMessagesEl.offsetParent || chatMessagesEl.clientWidth === 0) return;

    const rect = chatMessagesEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    scrollBtn.style.left = `${rect.left + rect.width / 2}px`;
  }

  function scheduleScrollBtnPosition() {
    if (scrollBtnPositionRaf) return;
    scrollBtnPositionRaf = requestAnimationFrame(updateScrollBtnPosition);
  }

  window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleScrollBtnPosition, { passive: true });

  const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(scheduleScrollBtnPosition);
  resizeObserver.observe(chatMessagesEl);

  setTimeout(scheduleScrollBtnPosition, 100);

  function setScrollBtnVisible(isVisible) {
    scrollBtn.style.opacity = isVisible ? "1" : "0";
    scrollBtn.style.pointerEvents = isVisible ? "auto" : "none";
    scrollBtn.dataset.visible = isVisible ? "1" : "0";
  }

  function setScrollBtnDirection(goUp) {
    const newIcon = goUp ? "fa-solid fa-arrow-up" : "fa-solid fa-arrow-down";
    if (scrollIcon.className !== newIcon) {
      scrollIcon.className = newIcon;
    }
  }

  function refreshHideTimer() {
    clearTimeout(scrollTimeout);
    scrollTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      setScrollBtnVisible(false);
      accumulatedScroll = 0;
    }, HIDE_DELAY);
  }

  scrollBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const target = scrollIcon.classList.contains("fa-arrow-up") ? 0 : chatMessagesEl.scrollHeight;
    chatMessagesEl.scrollTo({ top: target, behavior: "smooth" });
    refreshHideTimer();
  });

  function onScroll() {
    const currentScroll = chatMessagesEl.scrollTop;
    const scrollDiff = currentScroll - lastScrollTop;

    if (scrollDiff === 0) {
      ticking = false;
      return;
    }

    const nowScrollingUp = scrollDiff < 0;
    const isVisible = scrollBtn.dataset.visible === "1";

    // Already visible = instant sensitive mode
    if (isVisible) {
      isScrollingUp = nowScrollingUp;
      setScrollBtnDirection(isScrollingUp);
      refreshHideTimer();
      lastScrollTop = currentScroll;
      ticking = false;
      return;
    }

    // Still hidden = smart threshold mode
    if ((scrollDiff > 0 && isScrollingUp) || (scrollDiff < 0 && !isScrollingUp)) {
      accumulatedScroll = 0;
    }

    accumulatedScroll += Math.abs(scrollDiff);
    isScrollingUp = nowScrollingUp;

    if (accumulatedScroll >= SCROLL_THRESHOLD) {
      updateScrollBtnPosition();
      setScrollBtnDirection(isScrollingUp);
      setScrollBtnVisible(true);
      refreshHideTimer();
      accumulatedScroll = 0;
    }

    lastScrollTop = currentScroll;
    ticking = false;
  }

  chatMessagesEl.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
    if (!ticking) {
      window.requestAnimationFrame(onScroll);
      ticking = true;
    }
  }, { passive: true });
});

function clonePromptBoosterGroups(source = FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_GROUPS) {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(source).map(([group, items]) => [
      String(group),
      items.map(item => [String(item[0]), String(item[1])])
    ])
  );
}

function normalizePromptBoosterGroups(source) {
  if (!source || typeof source !== 'object' || Array.isArray(source)) return {};

  const normalized = {};

  Object.entries(source).forEach(([rawGroup, rawItems]) => {
    const group = String(rawGroup || '').trim();
    if (!group || !Array.isArray(rawItems)) return;

    const items = rawItems
      .map(item => Array.isArray(item)
        ? [String(item[0] || '').trim(), String(item[1] || '').trim()]
        : null)
      .filter(item => item && item[0] && item[1]);

    if (items.length) normalized[group] = items;
  });

  return normalized;
}

const FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_OFFICIAL_UPDATES = [
  {
    version: 2,
    group: FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_RECOMMENDED_GROUP,
    insert: 'first',
    items: [["Default RP Style", FURAI_DEFAULT_RP_STYLE_PROMPT]]
  }
];

function readPromptBoosterLibraryVersion() {
  const version = Number(DB.get(FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_VERSION_KEY) || 0);
  return Number.isFinite(version) && version > 0 ? version : 0;
}

function addMissingOfficialPromptBoosterItems(groups, fromVersion = 0) {
  const merged = clonePromptBoosterGroups(normalizePromptBoosterGroups(groups));

  FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_OFFICIAL_UPDATES
    .filter(update => update.version > fromVersion && update.version <= FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_LIBRARY_VERSION)
    .forEach(update => {
      const group = String(update.group || '').trim();
      if (!group || !Array.isArray(update.items)) return;

      if (!merged[group]) merged[group] = [];

      update.items.forEach(item => {
        const name = String(item?.[0] || '').trim();
        const body = String(item?.[1] || '').trim();
        if (!name || !body) return;

        const alreadyExists = merged[group].some(existing =>
          String(existing?.[0] || '').trim().toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase()
        );

        // Do not overwrite user-edited presets with the same name.
        if (alreadyExists) return;

        if (update.insert === 'first') {
          merged[group].unshift([name, body]);
        } else {
          merged[group].push([name, body]);
        }
      });
    });

  return merged;
}

function upgradePromptBoosterLibraryIfNeeded() {
  const savedVersion = readPromptBoosterLibraryVersion();
  if (savedVersion >= FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_LIBRARY_VERSION) return;

  const saved = DB.get(FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_STORAGE_KEY);

  // Default users read the live built-in library, so no saved list needs to be written.
  if (saved === null) {
    DB.set(FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_VERSION_KEY, FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_LIBRARY_VERSION);
    return;
  }

  const upgraded = addMissingOfficialPromptBoosterItems(saved, savedVersion);
  DB.set(FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_STORAGE_KEY, upgraded);
  DB.set(FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_VERSION_KEY, FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_LIBRARY_VERSION);
}

function getPromptBoosterGroups() {
  upgradePromptBoosterLibraryIfNeeded();

  const saved = DB.get(FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_STORAGE_KEY);
  return saved === null
    ? clonePromptBoosterGroups()
    : normalizePromptBoosterGroups(saved);
}

function getOrderedPromptBoosterGroupEntries(groups = getPromptBoosterGroups()) {
  const entries = Object.entries(groups);
  const recommended = entries.filter(([group]) => group === FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_RECOMMENDED_GROUP);
  const others = entries.filter(([group]) => group !== FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_RECOMMENDED_GROUP);
  return [...recommended, ...others];
}

function savePromptBoosterGroups(groups) {
  DB.set(FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_STORAGE_KEY, normalizePromptBoosterGroups(groups));
  DB.set(FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_VERSION_KEY, FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_LIBRARY_VERSION);
  refreshAllPromptBoosterDropdowns();
}

function promptBoosterOptionsHtml() {
  const groups = getPromptBoosterGroups();
  const customizeHtml = `
    <optgroup label="Customize">
      <option value="${FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_MANAGE_VALUE}">Customize Quick Ideas...</option>
    </optgroup>`;

  const groupHtml = getOrderedPromptBoosterGroupEntries(groups).map(([group, items], groupIndex) => `
    <optgroup label="${escapeHTML(group)}">
      ${items.map((item, itemIndex) => `<option value="qi:${groupIndex}:${itemIndex}">${escapeHTML(item[0])}</option>`).join('')}
    </optgroup>`
  ).join('');

  return `${customizeHtml}${groupHtml}`;
}

function promptBoosterMenuHtml() {
  const groups = getOrderedPromptBoosterGroupEntries(getPromptBoosterGroups());
  const manageButton = `
    <button type="button"
            class="furai-language-option furai-quick-ideas-option furai-quick-ideas-manage"
            role="menuitem"
            data-furai-prompt-booster-value="${FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_MANAGE_VALUE}"
            onclick="window.selectPromptBoosterOption(this)">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-sliders" aria-hidden="true"></i>
      <span>Customize Quick Ideas...</span>
    </button>`;

  const groupHtml = groups.map(([group, items], groupIndex) => `
    <div class="furai-quick-ideas-group-label" role="presentation">${escapeHTML(group)}</div>
    ${items.map((item, itemIndex) => `
      <button type="button"
              class="furai-language-option furai-quick-ideas-option"
              role="menuitem"
              data-furai-prompt-booster-value="qi:${groupIndex}:${itemIndex}"
              onclick="window.selectPromptBoosterOption(this)">
        <span>${escapeHTML(item[0])}</span>
      </button>`).join('')}`
  ).join('');

  return `${manageButton}${groupHtml}`;
}

function refreshPromptBoosterDropdown(picker) {
  const target = picker?.matches?.('[data-furai-quick-ideas="1"]')
    ? picker
    : picker?.closest?.('[data-furai-quick-ideas="1"]');
  const menu = target?.querySelector?.('.furai-quick-ideas-menu');
  if (!menu) return;

  menu.innerHTML = promptBoosterMenuHtml();
  menu.dataset.ready = '1';
}

function refreshAllPromptBoosterDropdowns() {
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-furai-quick-ideas="1"]').forEach(refreshPromptBoosterDropdown);
}

const furaiOpenModalRiderMenus = new Set();
let furaiModalRiderListenersReady = false;

function clearFuraiModalRider(menu, trigger = null) {
  if (!menu) return;

  const linkedTrigger = trigger || menu._furaiModalRiderTrigger || null;
  linkedTrigger?.classList?.remove('furai-modal-rider-below', 'furai-modal-rider-above');

  menu.classList.remove('furai-modal-rider', 'is-upward');
  menu.style.removeProperty('left');
  menu.style.removeProperty('right');
  menu.style.removeProperty('top');
  menu.style.removeProperty('bottom');
  menu.style.removeProperty('width');
  menu.style.removeProperty('max-height');
  menu._furaiModalRiderTrigger = null;
  furaiOpenModalRiderMenus.delete(menu);
}

function positionFuraiModalRider(menu, trigger) {
  if (!menu || !trigger || menu.hidden) return false;

  const modalContent = trigger.closest?.('.modal-content');
  if (!modalContent) {
    clearFuraiModalRider(menu, trigger);
    return false;
  }

  const modalRect = modalContent.getBoundingClientRect();
  const triggerRect = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
  const edge = 4;

  const triggerVisible =
    triggerRect.bottom > modalRect.top + edge &&
    triggerRect.top < modalRect.bottom - edge &&
    triggerRect.right > modalRect.left + edge &&
    triggerRect.left < modalRect.right - edge;

  if (!triggerVisible) {
    menu.hidden = true;
    trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    clearFuraiModalRider(menu, trigger);
    return false;
  }

  const roomBelow = Math.max(0, modalRect.bottom - triggerRect.bottom - edge);
  const roomAbove = Math.max(0, triggerRect.top - modalRect.top - edge);
  const naturalHeight = Math.min(menu.scrollHeight || 360, window.innerHeight * 0.52);
  const openUpward = roomBelow < Math.min(naturalHeight, 180) && roomAbove > roomBelow;
  const availableHeight = Math.max(72, openUpward ? roomAbove : roomBelow);
  const maxHeight = Math.max(72, Math.min(naturalHeight, availableHeight));

  const isQuickIdeas = menu.classList.contains('furai-quick-ideas-menu');
  const desiredWidth = isQuickIdeas
    ? Math.min(Math.max(triggerRect.width, 300), Math.max(180, modalRect.width - 16))
    : triggerRect.width;

  let left = triggerRect.left;
  if (left + desiredWidth > modalRect.right - edge) {
    left = modalRect.right - edge - desiredWidth;
  }
  left = Math.max(modalRect.left + edge, left);

  trigger.classList.toggle('furai-modal-rider-above', openUpward);
  trigger.classList.toggle('furai-modal-rider-below', !openUpward);

  menu.classList.add('furai-modal-rider');
  menu.classList.toggle('is-upward', openUpward);
  menu._furaiModalRiderTrigger = trigger;
  furaiOpenModalRiderMenus.add(menu);

  menu.style.left = `${Math.round(left)}px`;
  menu.style.right = 'auto';
  menu.style.width = `${Math.round(desiredWidth)}px`;
  menu.style.maxHeight = `${Math.floor(maxHeight)}px`;

  if (openUpward) {
    menu.style.top = 'auto';
    menu.style.bottom = `${Math.round(window.innerHeight - triggerRect.top - 1)}px`;
  } else {
    menu.style.bottom = 'auto';
    menu.style.top = `${Math.round(triggerRect.bottom - 1)}px`;
  }

  return true;
}

function refreshFuraiModalRiderMenus() {
  [...furaiOpenModalRiderMenus].forEach(menu => {
    const trigger = menu?._furaiModalRiderTrigger;
    if (!menu?.isConnected || !trigger?.isConnected || menu.hidden) {
      clearFuraiModalRider(menu, trigger);
      return;
    }
    positionFuraiModalRider(menu, trigger);
  });
}

function ensureFuraiModalRiderListeners() {
  if (furaiModalRiderListenersReady) return;
  furaiModalRiderListenersReady = true;

  document.addEventListener('scroll', refreshFuraiModalRiderMenus, true);
  window.addEventListener('resize', refreshFuraiModalRiderMenus, { passive: true });
}

function openFuraiModalRider(menu, trigger) {
  if (!menu || !trigger) return false;
  ensureFuraiModalRiderListeners();
  return positionFuraiModalRider(menu, trigger);
}

function closeFuraiModalRider(menu, trigger = null) {
  clearFuraiModalRider(menu, trigger);
}

function closePromptBoosterMenus(exceptPicker = null) {
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-furai-quick-ideas="1"]').forEach(picker => {
    if (picker === exceptPicker) return;
    const menu = picker.querySelector('.furai-quick-ideas-menu');
    const trigger = picker.querySelector('.furai-quick-ideas-trigger');
    if (menu) {
      menu.hidden = true;
      closeFuraiModalRider(menu, trigger);
    }
    if (trigger) trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  });
}

let furaiPromptBoosterDropdownListenersReady = false;
function ensurePromptBoosterDropdownListeners() {
  if (furaiPromptBoosterDropdownListenersReady) return;
  furaiPromptBoosterDropdownListenersReady = true;

  document.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
    if (!event.target.closest('[data-furai-quick-ideas="1"]')) {
      closePromptBoosterMenus();
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    if (event.key === 'Escape') closePromptBoosterMenus();
  });
}

// Inline HTML calls this handler, so it must remain explicitly exposed on window.
window.togglePromptBoosterMenu = function(trigger, event) {
  event?.preventDefault?.();
  event?.stopPropagation?.();

  const picker = trigger?.closest?.('[data-furai-quick-ideas="1"]');
  const menu = picker?.querySelector?.('.furai-quick-ideas-menu');
  if (!picker || !menu) return;

  ensurePromptBoosterDropdownListeners();
  closePromptBoosterMenus(picker);
  if (typeof closeFuraiChatLanguageMenus === 'function') closeFuraiChatLanguageMenus();
  if (typeof closeFuraiUiLanguageMenu === 'function') closeFuraiUiLanguageMenu();

  if (menu.dataset.ready !== '1') refreshPromptBoosterDropdown(picker);

  const shouldOpen = menu.hidden;
  menu.hidden = !shouldOpen;
  trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', shouldOpen ? 'true' : 'false');
  closeFuraiModalRider(menu, trigger);

  if (shouldOpen) {
    openFuraiModalRider(menu, trigger);
    menu.querySelector('[role="menuitem"]')?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }
};

function applyPromptBoosterValue(inputId, rawValue) {
  const value = String(rawValue || '');
  if (!value) return;

  if (value === FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_MANAGE_VALUE) {
    openPromptBoosterManager();
    return;
  }

  const match = value.match(/^qi:(\d+):(\d+)$/);
  const groups = getOrderedPromptBoosterGroupEntries(getPromptBoosterGroups());
  const text = match
    ? String(groups[Number(match[1])]?.[1]?.[Number(match[2])]?.[1] || '').trim()
    : '';
  const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
  if (!input || !text) return;

  const start = input.selectionStart ?? input.value.length;
  const end = input.selectionEnd ?? input.value.length;
  const before = input.value.slice(0, start);
  const after = input.value.slice(end);
  const prefix = before && !/\s$/.test(before) ? ' ' : '';
  const nextValue = before + prefix + text + ' ' + after;

  input.value = nextValue;
  input.focus({ preventScroll: true });

  const insertedStart = before.length + prefix.length;
  const insertedEnd = insertedStart + text.length;
  input.setSelectionRange(insertedStart, insertedEnd);
  input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
}

// Inline menu items call this handler, so it must remain explicitly exposed on window.
window.selectPromptBoosterOption = function(button) {
  const picker = button?.closest?.('[data-furai-quick-ideas="1"]');
  const inputId = String(picker?.dataset?.furaiInputId || '').trim();
  const value = String(button?.dataset?.furaiPromptBoosterValue || '');
  if (!picker || !inputId || !value) return;

  closePromptBoosterMenus();
  applyPromptBoosterValue(inputId, value);
};

// Backward-compatible native-select helpers for older imported HTML fragments.
function refreshPromptBoosterSelect(selectEl) {
  if (!selectEl) return;
  if (selectEl.matches?.('[data-furai-quick-ideas="1"]') && selectEl.tagName !== 'SELECT') {
    refreshPromptBoosterDropdown(selectEl);
    return;
  }
  selectEl.innerHTML = `<option value="">Quick Ideas...</option>${promptBoosterOptionsHtml()}`;
}

function refreshAllPromptBoosterSelects() {
  refreshAllPromptBoosterDropdowns();
  document.querySelectorAll('select[data-furai-quick-ideas="1"]').forEach(refreshPromptBoosterSelect);
}

function insertPromptBooster(inputId, selectEl) {
  const value = String(selectEl?.value || '');
  if (!selectEl || !value) return;
  selectEl.value = '';
  applyPromptBoosterValue(inputId, value);
}

function ensurePromptBoosterManagerModal() {
  let modal = document.getElementById('promptBoosterManagerModal');
  if (modal) return modal;

  modal = document.createElement('div');
  modal.id = 'promptBoosterManagerModal';
  modal.className = 'modal';
  modal.style.zIndex = '4400';
  modal.innerHTML = `
    <div class="modal-content modal-workspace" style="--modal-w:820px;overflow:hidden;">
      <div class="modal-header" style="flex-shrink:0;">
        <h3 style="margin:0; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px;">
          <i class="fa-regular fa-lightbulb" style="color:var(--primary-color);"></i>
          Quick Ideas
        </h3>

        <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-left:auto;">
          <button type="button"
                  data-quick-idea-action="reset"
                  title="Restore Defaults"
                  style="width:34px; height:34px; padding:0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; background:var(--input-bg); border:1px solid var(--border-color); color:var(--text-color); border-radius:7px; cursor:pointer;">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-rotate-left"></i>
          </button>

          <button type="button"
                  data-quick-idea-action="new"
                  style="height:34px; padding:0 12px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:7px; background:var(--primary-color); border:1px solid var(--primary-color); color:var(--btn-text-color); border-radius:7px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:700;">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-plus"></i>
            New Idea
          </button>

          <button type="button" data-quick-idea-action="close">×</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="modal-body" style="padding:0; display:flex; flex:1; min-height:0; flex-direction:column; overflow:hidden;">
        <div style="position:relative; flex-shrink:0; padding:16px 16px 12px;">
          <input id="promptBoosterManagerSearch"
                 type="text"
                 placeholder="Search Quick Ideas..."
                 autocomplete="off"
                 oninput="renderPromptBoosterManagerList()"
                 style="width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; padding:10px 12px 10px 36px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--border-color); background:var(--input-bg); color:var(--text-color); font-size:14px;">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass"
             style="position:absolute; left:28px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); opacity:0.5; pointer-events:none;"></i>
        </div>

        <div id="promptBoosterManagerScroll"
             style="flex:1; min-height:0; overflow-y:scroll; scrollbar-gutter:stable; padding:0 16px 16px; box-sizing:border-box;">
          <div id="promptBoosterManagerEditor"
               style="display:none; padding:16px; margin-bottom:12px; border:1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius:9px; background:var(--sidebar-bg);">
            <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; margin-bottom:12px;">
              <h4 id="promptBoosterEditorTitle" style="margin:0; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-size:15px;">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-pen-to-square" style="color:var(--primary-color);"></i>
                New Quick Idea
              </h4>
            </div>

            <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap:12px;">
              <div style="min-width:0;">
                <label for="promptBoosterGroupInput" style="display:block; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:5px; opacity:0.78;">Group</label>
                <input id="promptBoosterGroupInput" list="promptBoosterGroupList" type="text" maxlength="40" style="width:100%; box-sizing:border-box;">
                <datalist id="promptBoosterGroupList"></datalist>
              </div>

              <div style="min-width:0;">
                <label for="promptBoosterNameInput" style="display:block; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:5px; opacity:0.78;">Name</label>
                <input id="promptBoosterNameInput" type="text" maxlength="80" style="width:100%; box-sizing:border-box;">
              </div>
            </div>

            <label for="promptBoosterTextInput" style="display:block; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; margin:12px 0 5px; opacity:0.78;">Preset Instruction</label>
            <textarea id="promptBoosterTextInput" rows="7" style="width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; resize:vertical;"></textarea>
            <div id="promptBoosterManagerError" style="display:none; color:var(--danger-color); font-size:12px; margin-top:7px;"></div>

            <div style="display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; gap:8px; margin-top:12px;">
              <button type="button"
                      data-quick-idea-action="cancel-edit"
                      style="padding:8px 13px; border-radius:7px; border:1px solid var(--border-color); background:var(--input-bg); color:var(--text-color); cursor:pointer;">
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button type="button"
                      data-quick-idea-action="save-edit"
                      style="padding:8px 15px; border-radius:7px; border:1px solid var(--primary-color); background:var(--primary-color); color:var(--btn-text-color); cursor:pointer; font-weight:700;">
                Save
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div id="promptBoosterManagerList"
               style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px;"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`;

  modal.addEventListener('click', event => {
    if (event.target === modal) {
      closePromptBoosterManager();
      return;
    }

    const button = event.target.closest('[data-quick-idea-action]');
    if (!button) return;

    const action = button.dataset.quickIdeaAction;
    if (action === 'close') closePromptBoosterManager();
    else if (action === 'new') openPromptBoosterEditor();
    else if (action === 'cancel-edit') closePromptBoosterEditor();
    else if (action === 'save-edit') savePromptBoosterEditor();
    else if (action === 'reset') resetPromptBoosterLibrary();
    else if (action === 'toggle-group') togglePromptBoosterManagerGroup(button.dataset.group);
    else if (action === 'edit') openPromptBoosterEditor(button.dataset.group, Number(button.dataset.index));
    else if (action === 'delete') deletePromptBoosterItem(button.dataset.group, Number(button.dataset.index));
  });

  document.body.appendChild(modal);
  return modal;
}

function renderPromptBoosterGroupList() {
  const datalist = document.getElementById('promptBoosterGroupList');
  if (!datalist) return;

  datalist.textContent = '';
  getOrderedPromptBoosterGroupEntries(getPromptBoosterGroups()).forEach(([group]) => {
    const option = document.createElement('option');
    option.value = group;
    datalist.appendChild(option);
  });
}

function togglePromptBoosterManagerGroup(group) {
  const key = String(group || '').trim();
  if (!key) return;

  if (furaiPromptBoosterCollapsedGroups.has(key)) {
    furaiPromptBoosterCollapsedGroups.delete(key);
  } else {
    furaiPromptBoosterCollapsedGroups.add(key);
  }

  renderPromptBoosterManagerList();
}

function renderPromptBoosterManagerList() {
  const list = document.getElementById('promptBoosterManagerList');
  if (!list) return;

  list.textContent = '';
  const query = String(document.getElementById('promptBoosterManagerSearch')?.value || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();
  const groups = getOrderedPromptBoosterGroupEntries(getPromptBoosterGroups());
  let visibleItemCount = 0;

  groups.forEach(([group, items]) => {
    const groupMatches = group.toLowerCase().includes(query);
    const visibleItems = items
      .map((item, index) => ({ item, index }))
      .filter(({ item }) => {
        if (!query || groupMatches) return true;
        return `${item[0]}\n${item[1]}`.toLowerCase().includes(query);
      });

    if (!visibleItems.length) return;
    visibleItemCount += visibleItems.length;

    const isCollapsed = !query && furaiPromptBoosterCollapsedGroups.has(group);
    const section = document.createElement('section');
    section.style.cssText = 'overflow:hidden; border-radius:9px; border:1px solid var(--border-color); background:var(--sidebar-bg);';

    const sectionHeader = document.createElement('button');
    sectionHeader.type = 'button';
    sectionHeader.dataset.quickIdeaAction = 'toggle-group';
    sectionHeader.dataset.group = group;
    sectionHeader.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!isCollapsed));
    sectionHeader.title = isCollapsed ? 'Expand group' : 'Collapse group';
    sectionHeader.style.cssText = [
      'width:100%',
      'display:flex',
      'align-items:center',
      'gap:8px',
      'padding:10px 12px',
      'border:0',
      isCollapsed ? '' : 'border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-color)',
      'background:var(--sidebar-hover)',
      'color:var(--text-color)',
      'font:inherit',
      'text-align:left',
      'cursor:pointer'
    ].filter(Boolean).join(';');

    const chevron = document.createElement('i');
    chevron.className = isCollapsed ? 'fa-solid fa-chevron-right' : 'fa-solid fa-chevron-down';
    chevron.style.cssText = 'width:14px; text-align:center; font-size:11px; opacity:0.62; flex-shrink:0;';

    const icon = document.createElement('i');
    icon.className = 'fa-regular fa-folder-open';
    icon.style.cssText = 'font-size:14px; opacity:0.58; flex-shrink:0;';

    const title = document.createElement('strong');
    title.textContent = group;
    title.style.cssText = 'min-width:0; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; font-size:14px; color:var(--text-color);';

    const count = document.createElement('span');
    count.textContent = String(visibleItems.length);
    count.style.cssText = 'margin-left:auto; min-width:22px; height:20px; padding:0 6px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border-radius:999px; background:var(--input-bg); border:1px solid var(--border-color); font-size:11px; opacity:0.72; box-sizing:border-box; flex-shrink:0;';

    sectionHeader.append(chevron, icon, title, count);
    section.appendChild(sectionHeader);

    if (!isCollapsed) {
      const rows = document.createElement('div');
      rows.style.cssText = 'display:flex; flex-direction:column;';

      visibleItems.forEach(({ item, index }, visibleIndex) => {
        const row = document.createElement('div');
        row.style.cssText = [
          'display:flex',
          'align-items:center',
          'gap:12px',
          'padding:12px',
          visibleIndex ? 'border-top:1px solid var(--border-color)' : '',
          'background:var(--input-bg)'
        ].filter(Boolean).join(';');

        const copy = document.createElement('div');
        copy.style.cssText = 'flex:1; min-width:0;';

        const name = document.createElement('div');
        name.textContent = item[0];
        name.style.cssText = 'font-size:14px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.3; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap;';

        const preview = document.createElement('div');
        preview.textContent = item[1];
        preview.style.cssText = 'margin-top:4px; font-size:12px; line-height:1.45; opacity:0.68; display:-webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp:2; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; overflow:hidden; white-space:pre-wrap;';

        copy.append(name, preview);

        const actions = document.createElement('div');
        actions.style.cssText = 'display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; flex-shrink:0;';

        const editButton = document.createElement('button');
        editButton.type = 'button';
        editButton.title = 'Edit';
        editButton.dataset.quickIdeaAction = 'edit';
        editButton.dataset.group = group;
        editButton.dataset.index = String(index);
        editButton.style.cssText = 'width:34px; height:34px; padding:0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius:7px; background:var(--sidebar-bg); color:var(--text-color); cursor:pointer;';
        editButton.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size:18px;">stylus</span>';

        const deleteButton = document.createElement('button');
        deleteButton.type = 'button';
        deleteButton.title = 'Delete';
        deleteButton.dataset.quickIdeaAction = 'delete';
        deleteButton.dataset.group = group;
        deleteButton.dataset.index = String(index);
        deleteButton.style.cssText = 'width:34px; height:34px; padding:0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius:7px; background:var(--sidebar-bg); color:var(--danger-color); cursor:pointer;';
        deleteButton.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size:18px;">delete</span>';

        actions.append(editButton, deleteButton);
        row.append(copy, actions);
        rows.appendChild(row);
      });

      section.appendChild(rows);
    }

    list.appendChild(section);
  });

  if (visibleItemCount) return;

  const empty = document.createElement('div');
  empty.textContent = query ? 'No matching Quick Ideas.' : 'No Quick Ideas yet.';
  empty.style.cssText = 'padding:32px 20px; text-align:center; opacity:0.62; border:1px dashed var(--border-color); border-radius:9px; background:var(--sidebar-bg);';
  list.appendChild(empty);
}

function openPromptBoosterManager() {
  const modal = ensurePromptBoosterManagerModal();
  const searchInput = document.getElementById('promptBoosterManagerSearch');
  if (searchInput) searchInput.value = '';
  closePromptBoosterEditor();
  renderPromptBoosterGroupList();
  renderPromptBoosterManagerList();

  const scroll = document.getElementById('promptBoosterManagerScroll');
  if (scroll) scroll.scrollTop = 0;

  modal.style.display = 'flex';
}

function closePromptBoosterManager() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('promptBoosterManagerModal');
  if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';

  const list = document.getElementById('promptBoosterManagerList');
  if (list) list.textContent = '';
}

function setPromptBoosterManagerError(message = '') {
  const error = document.getElementById('promptBoosterManagerError');
  if (!error) return;
  error.textContent = message;
  error.style.display = message ? 'block' : 'none';
}

function openPromptBoosterEditor(group = '', index = -1) {
  const editor = document.getElementById('promptBoosterManagerEditor');
  const editorTitle = document.getElementById('promptBoosterEditorTitle');
  const groupInput = document.getElementById('promptBoosterGroupInput');
  const nameInput = document.getElementById('promptBoosterNameInput');
  const textInput = document.getElementById('promptBoosterTextInput');
  if (!editor || !groupInput || !nameInput || !textInput) return;

  const item = getPromptBoosterGroups()[group]?.[index] || null;
  editor.dataset.editingGroup = item ? group : '';
  editor.dataset.editingIndex = item ? String(index) : '-1';
  groupInput.value = item ? group : 'Custom';
  nameInput.value = item?.[0] || '';
  textInput.value = item?.[1] || '';
  if (editorTitle) {
    editorTitle.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-pen-to-square" style="color:var(--primary-color);"></i>${item ? 'Edit Quick Idea' : 'New Quick Idea'}`;
  }
  setPromptBoosterManagerError('');
  renderPromptBoosterGroupList();
  editor.style.display = 'block';

  const scroll = document.getElementById('promptBoosterManagerScroll');
  if (scroll) scroll.scrollTop = 0;

  nameInput.focus({ preventScroll: true });
}

function closePromptBoosterEditor() {
  const editor = document.getElementById('promptBoosterManagerEditor');
  if (editor) editor.style.display = 'none';
  setPromptBoosterManagerError('');
}

function savePromptBoosterEditor() {
  const editor = document.getElementById('promptBoosterManagerEditor');
  const group = String(document.getElementById('promptBoosterGroupInput')?.value || '').trim();
  const name = String(document.getElementById('promptBoosterNameInput')?.value || '').trim();
  const text = String(document.getElementById('promptBoosterTextInput')?.value || '').trim();
  if (!editor) return;

  if (!group || !name || !text) {
    setPromptBoosterManagerError('Group, name, and preset instruction are required.');
    return;
  }

  const groups = getPromptBoosterGroups();
  const oldGroup = editor.dataset.editingGroup || '';
  const oldIndex = Number(editor.dataset.editingIndex);
  const editingExisting = Number.isInteger(oldIndex) && oldIndex >= 0 && groups[oldGroup]?.[oldIndex];
  const duplicateIndex = groups[group]?.findIndex((item, index) =>
    item[0].toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase() && !(editingExisting && group === oldGroup && index === oldIndex)
  ) ?? -1;

  if (duplicateIndex !== -1) {
    setPromptBoosterManagerError('That group already has a Quick Idea with the same name.');
    return;
  }

  if (editingExisting && group === oldGroup) {
    groups[group][oldIndex] = [name, text];
  } else {
    if (editingExisting) {
      groups[oldGroup].splice(oldIndex, 1);
      if (!groups[oldGroup].length) delete groups[oldGroup];
    }

    if (!groups[group]) groups[group] = [];
    groups[group].push([name, text]);
  }

  savePromptBoosterGroups(groups);
  closePromptBoosterEditor();
  renderPromptBoosterGroupList();
  renderPromptBoosterManagerList();
}

function deletePromptBoosterItem(group, index) {
  const groups = getPromptBoosterGroups();
  const item = groups[group]?.[index];
  if (!item || !confirm(`Delete “${item[0]}”?`)) return;

  groups[group].splice(index, 1);
  if (!groups[group].length) delete groups[group];
  savePromptBoosterGroups(groups);
  closePromptBoosterEditor();
  renderPromptBoosterGroupList();
  renderPromptBoosterManagerList();
}

function resetPromptBoosterLibrary() {
  if (!confirm('Restore every Quick Idea to the current FurAI defaults? Custom ideas and edits will be removed.')) return;

  DB.remove(FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_STORAGE_KEY);
  DB.set(FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_VERSION_KEY, FURAI_PROMPT_BOOSTER_LIBRARY_VERSION);
  refreshAllPromptBoosterDropdowns();
  closePromptBoosterEditor();
  renderPromptBoosterGroupList();
  renderPromptBoosterManagerList();
}

function setGlobalSaveFooterForMode(mode = currentGlobalTab) {
    const btn = document.getElementById('globalSaveBtn');
    if (!btn) return;

    btn.style.display = '';
    btn.onclick = () => saveGlobalSettings(mode);
    btn.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-floppy-disk"></i> Save ${capitalize(mode)} Defaults`;
}

function setGlobalSaveFooterForGlobalBot(index) {
    const btn = document.getElementById('globalSaveBtn');
    if (!btn) return;

    btn.style.display = '';
    btn.onclick = () => saveGlobalBot(index);
    btn.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-floppy-disk"></i> Save Character`;
}

function openGlobalSettingsModal(options = {}) {
    const keepCharacterLibrary = options.keepCharacterLibrary === true;
    const targetTab = options.initialTab || currentGlobalTab;

    closeMainMenuModals(
        keepCharacterLibrary
            ? ['globalSettingsModalEl', 'charactersModalEl']
            : 'globalSettingsModalEl'
    );

    let modal = document.getElementById('globalSettingsModalEl');
    
    if (!modal) {
        modal = document.createElement('div');
        modal.id = 'globalSettingsModalEl';
        modal.className = 'modal';
        document.body.appendChild(modal);
    }
    
    modal.classList.toggle('global-settings-over-character-library', keepCharacterLibrary);
    modal.dataset.returnToCharacterLibrary = keepCharacterLibrary ? '1' : '0';

    openModalLayer(modal, keepCharacterLibrary
        ? { above: 'charactersModalEl' }
        : {}
    );
    
    if (keepCharacterLibrary) {
        bringCharacterLibraryEditorToFront();
    }
    
    switchGlobalTab(targetTab);
    
    if (keepCharacterLibrary) {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            bringCharacterLibraryEditorToFront();
            requestAnimationFrame(bringCharacterLibraryEditorToFront);
        });
    }
}

function closeGlobalSettingsModal() {
    restoreGlobalChatFontPreview();

    const modal = document.getElementById('globalSettingsModalEl');
    if (modal) {
        modal.style.display = 'none';
        modal.style.zIndex = '';
        modal.classList.remove('global-settings-over-character-library');
    }
    
    document.getElementById('globalTabContent').innerHTML = ''; 
}

function switchGlobalTab(mode) {
    if (globalFontPreviewMode) {
        restoreGlobalChatFontPreview();
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('#globalSettingsModalEl .global-tabs > .global-tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.mode === mode);
    });

    renderGlobalContent(mode);
}

function getGlobalSettingsSectionTitle(titleEl) {
    const clone = titleEl.cloneNode(true);

    clone.querySelectorAll('button, input, textarea, select').forEach(el => el.remove());

    return clone.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() || 'Section';
}

function getGlobalSettingsSectionIcon(title) {
    const lower = String(title || '').toLowerCase();

    if (lower.includes('story cast') || lower.includes('cast')) return 'fa-solid fa-people-pulling';
    if (lower.includes('user')) return 'fa-regular fa-circle-user';
    if (lower.includes('character')) return 'fa-solid fa-people-group';
    if (lower.includes('wand') || lower.includes('narrator')) return 'fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles';
    if (lower.includes('reference') || lower.includes('lore')) return 'fa-solid fa-book-open';
    if (lower.includes('glossary')) return 'fa-solid fa-language';
    if (lower.includes('summary')) return 'fa-solid fa-layer-group';
    if (lower.includes('appearance')) return 'fa-solid fa-palette';
    if (lower.includes('background') || lower.includes('wallpaper')) return 'fa-regular fa-image';

    return 'fa-solid fa-sliders';
}

function makeGlobalSettingsSectionId(title, index) {
    const slug = String(title || 'section')
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
        .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');

    return `global-section-${index}-${slug || 'section'}`;
}

function setActiveGlobalSettingsSection(sectionId) {
    const root = document.getElementById('globalTabContent');
    if (!root || !sectionId) return;

    globalSettingsSectionByMode[currentGlobalTab] = sectionId;

    root.querySelectorAll('.global-settings-side-tab').forEach(btn => {
        btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.sectionId === sectionId);
    });

    root.querySelectorAll('.global-settings-section').forEach(section => {
        const isTarget = section.dataset.sectionId === sectionId;
        section.classList.toggle('is-active', isTarget);
        section.classList.toggle('is-open', isTarget);
    });
}

function getGlobalSettingsSectionInnerByTitle(title) {
    const root = document.getElementById('globalTabContent');
    if (!root) return null;

    const sections = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.global-settings-section'));

    const targetSection = sections.find(section => {
        const label = section.querySelector('.global-settings-mobile-section-label span');
        return label && label.textContent.trim() === title;
    });

    if (!targetSection) return null;

    setActiveGlobalSettingsSection(targetSection.dataset.sectionId);
    return targetSection.querySelector('.global-settings-section-inner') || targetSection;
}

function reopenGlobalGroupCharacterSettings() {
    renderGlobalContent('group', { preserveSection: true });

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        getGlobalSettingsSectionInnerByTitle('Character Settings');
    });
}

function getCurrentGlobalSettingsSectionId() {
    const root = document.getElementById('globalTabContent');
    if (!root) return '';

    return (
        root.querySelector('.global-settings-side-tab.active')?.dataset.sectionId ||
        root.querySelector('.global-settings-section.is-active')?.dataset.sectionId ||
        root.querySelector('.global-settings-section.is-open')?.dataset.sectionId ||
        ''
    );
}

function toggleGlobalSettingsMobileSection(sectionId) {
    const root = document.getElementById('globalTabContent');
    const section = root?.querySelector(`.global-settings-section[data-section-id="${sectionId}"]`);
    if (!section) return;

    if (section.classList.contains('is-open')) {
        section.classList.remove('is-open');
    } else {
        setActiveGlobalSettingsSection(sectionId);
    }
}

function createGlobalSettingsSectionShell(title, sectionId) {
    const section = document.createElement('section');
    section.className = 'global-settings-section';
    section.dataset.sectionId = sectionId;

    const mobileBtn = document.createElement('button');
    mobileBtn.type = 'button';
    mobileBtn.className = 'global-settings-mobile-section-btn';
    mobileBtn.onclick = () => toggleGlobalSettingsMobileSection(sectionId);
    mobileBtn.innerHTML = `
        <span class="global-settings-mobile-section-label">
            <i class="${getGlobalSettingsSectionIcon(title)}"></i>
            <span>${escapeHTML(title)}</span>
        </span>
        <i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-down global-settings-mobile-section-chevron"></i>
    `;

    const inner = document.createElement('div');
    inner.className = 'global-settings-section-inner';

    section.appendChild(mobileBtn);
    section.appendChild(inner);

    return {
        id: sectionId,
        title,
        section,
        inner
    };
}

function cloneGlobalSettingsRange(container, startNode, endNode) {
    const range = document.createRange();

    if (startNode) {
        range.setStartBefore(startNode);
    } else {
        range.setStart(container, 0);
    }

    if (endNode) {
        range.setEndBefore(endNode);
    } else {
        range.setEnd(container, container.childNodes.length);
    }

    const fragment = range.cloneContents();
    range.detach();

    return fragment;
}

function enhanceGlobalSettingsLayout(mode, preferredSectionId = '') {
    const container = document.getElementById('globalTabContent');
    if (!container || container.querySelector('.global-settings-layout')) return;

    const titleEls = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('.global-section-title'));
    if (!titleEls.length) return;

    const sections = [];

    const introFragment = cloneGlobalSettingsRange(container, null, titleEls[0]);

    titleEls.forEach((titleEl, index) => {
        const title = getGlobalSettingsSectionTitle(titleEl);
        const sectionId = makeGlobalSettingsSectionId(title, index);
        const sectionData = createGlobalSettingsSectionShell(title, sectionId);
        const nextTitleEl = titleEls[index + 1] || null;
        const sectionFragment = cloneGlobalSettingsRange(container, titleEl, nextTitleEl);

        sectionData.inner.appendChild(sectionFragment);
        sections.push(sectionData);
    });

    if (introFragment.childNodes.length && sections[0]) {
        sections[0].inner.insertBefore(introFragment, sections[0].inner.firstChild);
    }

    const layout = document.createElement('div');
    layout.className = 'global-settings-layout';
    layout.dataset.mode = mode;

    const nav = document.createElement('div');
    nav.className = 'global-settings-section-nav';

    const main = document.createElement('div');
    main.className = 'global-settings-section-main';

    sections.forEach(sectionData => {
        const btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.type = 'button';
        btn.className = 'global-settings-side-tab';
        btn.dataset.sectionId = sectionData.id;
        btn.onclick = () => setActiveGlobalSettingsSection(sectionData.id);
        btn.innerHTML = `
            <i class="${getGlobalSettingsSectionIcon(sectionData.title)}"></i>
            <span>${escapeHTML(sectionData.title)}</span>
        `;

        nav.appendChild(btn);
        main.appendChild(sectionData.section);
    });

    layout.appendChild(nav);
    layout.appendChild(main);

    container.textContent = '';
    container.appendChild(layout);

    const targetSection =
        sections.find(sectionData => sectionData.id === preferredSectionId) ||
        sections[0];

    if (targetSection) {
        setActiveGlobalSettingsSection(targetSection.id);
    }
}

function captureGlobalSettingsViewState(container) {
    if (!container) return null;

    const main = container.querySelector('.global-settings-section-main');
    const nav = container.querySelector('.global-settings-section-nav');

    return {
        rootScrollTop: container.scrollTop,
        mainScrollTop: main?.scrollTop || 0,
        navScrollTop: nav?.scrollTop || 0
    };
}

function restoreGlobalSettingsViewState(container, state) {
    if (!container || !state) return;

    const apply = () => {
        container.scrollTop = state.rootScrollTop;

        const main = container.querySelector('.global-settings-section-main');
        const nav = container.querySelector('.global-settings-section-nav');
        if (main) main.scrollTop = state.mainScrollTop;
        if (nav) nav.scrollTop = state.navScrollTop;
    };

    // Restore synchronously before paint, then once more after layout settles.
    apply();
    if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === 'function') requestAnimationFrame(apply);
}

/* --- RENDER GLOBAL CONTENT (Fixed: Removed Duplicate/Broken HTML) --- */
function syncFuraiGlobalMemoryModeControls(mode) {
    const normalized = normalizeFuraiMemoryMode(mode);
    const autoSummary = document.getElementById('globalAutoSummary');
    const valueInput = document.getElementById('globalMemoryModeValue');
    const standardCard = document.getElementById('globalMemoryModeStandard');
    const deepCard = document.getElementById('globalMemoryModeDeep');
    const standardControls = document.getElementById('globalStandardSummaryControls');

    if (valueInput) valueInput.value = normalized;
    if (standardCard) standardCard.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(normalized === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_STANDARD));
    if (deepCard) deepCard.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(normalized === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP));

    const isDeep = normalized === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP;
    if (standardControls) standardControls.style.display = 'block';
    if (!autoSummary) return;
    if (isDeep) autoSummary.checked = true;
    autoSummary.disabled = isDeep;
    autoSummary.title = isDeep ? 'Deep Memory includes Standard Summary.' : '';
}
