        window.syncFuraiGlobalMemoLanguageUI(mode);
        updateWordCountUI(['globalRefText', 'globalRefHiddenInstructions'], 'gRefCount', 500);
        if(document.getElementById('globalBotInst')) updateWordCountUI(['globalBotInst', 'globalBotSecret'], 'gBotCount', 500);
        if(document.getElementById('globalWandInst')) updateWordCountUI(['globalWandInst', 'globalWandSecret'], 'gWandCount', 500);
    }, 50);
}
      
function saveGlobalSettings(mode) {
    try {
        // --- 1. USER PROFILE ---
        const userKey = `global-user-${mode}`;
        let userData = {};
        try { userData = DB.get(userKey) || {}; } catch(e){}

        userData.name = document.getElementById('globalUserName').value.trim();
        userData.avatar = document.getElementById('globalUserAvatar').value.trim();
        userData.defaultSprite = document.getElementById('globalUserSprite').value.trim();
        
        // [NEW] SAVE USER TAG
        userData.hashTag = getFuraiTagInputValue('globalUserTag');

        const userOpening = document.getElementById('globalUserOpening')?.value.trim() || "";
        if (userOpening) {
            userData.openingMessage = userOpening;
        } else {
            delete userData.openingMessage;
        }

        writeCharacterOpeningExtras(
            userData,
            readCharacterOpeningExtrasFromDomOrProfile('globalUserName', userData)
        );
        
        // Merge User Inst
        let uPub = document.getElementById('globalUserInst').value.trim();
        let uSec = document.getElementById('globalUserSecret').value.trim();
        const userProtectedData = readFuraiProtectedInstructionEditorData(
            'globalUserProtectedInstructionHost',
            userData
        );
        if (!userProtectedData) return;
        if(uSec) uPub += `\n\n[SECRET]\n${uSec}\n[/SECRET]`;
        if (!userData.instructions || typeof userData.instructions !== 'object') {
            userData.instructions = {};
        }
        userData.instructions[mode] = uPub;
        delete userData.instruction;
        writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(userData, userProtectedData);
        
        DB.set(userKey, userData);

        // ... (Middle part: References & Backgrounds - Keep existing) ...
        const globalMemoText = document.getElementById('globalMemoText')?.value.trim() || "";
        if (globalMemoText) DB.set(`global_memo_${mode}`, globalMemoText);
        else DB.remove(`global_memo_${mode}`);

        const globalChatLanguage = normalizeFuraiChatLanguagePreference(
            document.getElementById('globalMemoChatLanguageSelect')?.value,
            'mode'
        );
        if (globalChatLanguage === 'global') DB.remove(getFuraiModeChatLanguageKey(mode));
        else DB.set(getFuraiModeChatLanguageKey(mode), globalChatLanguage);

        const refText = joinFuraiLoreInstructions(
            document.getElementById('globalRefText').value,
            document.getElementById('globalRefHiddenInstructions')?.value || ''
        );
        DB.set(`ref_text_${mode}`, refText); 

        const gloGlossaryText = document.getElementById('globalGlossaryText').value.trim();
        DB.set(`global_glossary_${mode}`, gloGlossaryText);

        if (mode === 'group') {
            setGlobalGroupCastAnnouncementsEnabled(
                document.getElementById('globalCastAnnouncementToggle')?.checked !== false
            );
            setGlobalGroupIdleAnnouncementTarget(
                document.getElementById('globalIdleAnnouncementTarget')?.value || 'everyone'
            );
            setGlobalGroupIdleAnnouncementMinutes(
                document.getElementById('globalIdleAnnouncementMinutes')?.value || 0
            );
        }

        const cutsceneInput = document.getElementById('globalCutsceneInst');
        const cutsceneTemplate = cutsceneInput ? cutsceneInput.value.trim() : '';
        const defaultCutsceneTemplate = buildDefaultCutsceneInstructionTemplate(mode);

        if (cutsceneTemplate && cutsceneTemplate !== defaultCutsceneTemplate) {
            DB.set(`global-cutscene-template-${mode}`, cutsceneTemplate);
        } else {
            DB.remove(`global-cutscene-template-${mode}`);
        }

        // Clear legacy adapter-only save slot so it cannot override the full template later.
        DB.remove(`global-cutscene-inst-${mode}`);

        const cutsceneAssignedPromptInput = document.getElementById('globalCutsceneAssignedPromptInst');
        const cutsceneAssignedPromptTemplate = cutsceneAssignedPromptInput
            ? cutsceneAssignedPromptInput.value.trim()
            : '';
        const defaultCutsceneAssignedPromptTemplate = buildDefaultCutsceneAssignedPromptInstruction();

        if (
            cutsceneAssignedPromptTemplate &&
            cutsceneAssignedPromptTemplate !== defaultCutsceneAssignedPromptTemplate
        ) {
            DB.set(
                `global-cutscene-assigned-prompt-inst-${mode}`,
                cutsceneAssignedPromptTemplate
            );
        } else {
            DB.remove(`global-cutscene-assigned-prompt-inst-${mode}`);
        }

        const cutsceneImageCountInput = document.getElementById('globalCutsceneImageCount');
        DB.set(
            `global-cutscene-image-count-${mode}`,
            clampFuraiImageCount(cutsceneImageCountInput?.value, 1)
        );
        saveFuraiVisualPromptBatchConfig(mode, 'cutscene', {
            primaryCount: document.getElementById('globalCutscenePrimaryPromptCount')?.value,
            assignedCommandsEnabled: document.getElementById('globalCutsceneAssignedCommandToggle')?.checked !== false,
            extraSlots: readFuraiAssignedPromptSlotsFromDom('cutscene')
        });

        const bubbleImageInput = document.getElementById('globalBubbleImageInst');
        const bubbleImageTemplate = bubbleImageInput ? bubbleImageInput.value.trim() : '';
        const defaultBubbleImageTemplate = buildDefaultBubbleImageInstructionTemplate(mode);

        if (bubbleImageTemplate && bubbleImageTemplate !== defaultBubbleImageTemplate) {
            DB.set(`global-bubble-image-template-${mode}`, bubbleImageTemplate);
        } else {
            DB.remove(`global-bubble-image-template-${mode}`);
        }

        const bubbleAssignedPromptInput = document.getElementById('globalBubbleAssignedPromptInst');
        const bubbleAssignedPromptTemplate = bubbleAssignedPromptInput
            ? bubbleAssignedPromptInput.value.trim()
            : '';
        const defaultBubbleAssignedPromptTemplate = buildDefaultAssignedPromptInstructionTemplate(mode);

        if (
            bubbleAssignedPromptTemplate &&
            bubbleAssignedPromptTemplate !== defaultBubbleAssignedPromptTemplate
        ) {
            DB.set(`global-bubble-assigned-template-${mode}`, bubbleAssignedPromptTemplate);
        } else {
            DB.remove(`global-bubble-assigned-template-${mode}`);
        }

        const bubbleImageAiToggle = document.getElementById('globalBubbleImageAiToggle');
        if (bubbleImageAiToggle) {
            DB.set(`global-bubble-image-ai-${mode}`, bubbleImageAiToggle.checked === true);
        }

        const bubbleImageCountInput = document.getElementById('globalBubbleImageCount');
        DB.set(
            `global-bubble-image-count-${mode}`,
            clampFuraiImageCount(bubbleImageCountInput?.value, 1)
        );
        saveFuraiVisualPromptBatchConfig(mode, 'image', {
            primaryCount: document.getElementById('globalBubblePrimaryPromptCount')?.value,
            assignedCommandsEnabled: document.getElementById('globalBubbleAssignedCommandToggle')?.checked !== false,
            extraSlots: readFuraiAssignedPromptSlotsFromDom('bubble')
        });

        saveGlobalFuraiVisualTriggers(mode, 'image', 'keep', document.getElementById('globalImageTriggerKeep')?.value || '');
        saveGlobalFuraiVisualTriggers(mode, 'image', 'trim', document.getElementById('globalImageTriggerTrim')?.value || '');
        saveGlobalFuraiVisualTriggers(mode, 'cutscene', 'keep', document.getElementById('globalCutsceneTriggerKeep')?.value || '');
        saveGlobalFuraiVisualTriggers(mode, 'cutscene', 'trim', document.getElementById('globalCutsceneTriggerTrim')?.value || '');
        
        const globalFontStyle = normalizeOptionalFontKey(
            document.getElementById('globalFontStyleSelect')?.value
        );

        if (globalFontStyle) {
            DB.set(`global-font-${mode}`, globalFontStyle);
        } else {
            DB.remove(`global-font-${mode}`);
        }

        clearGlobalChatFontPreview(mode);
        refreshCurrentChatFontIfInheritsGlobal(mode);

        const timestampToggle = document.getElementById('globalTimestampToggle');
        if (timestampToggle) {
            localStorage.setItem(FURAI_TIMESTAMP_GLOBAL_KEY, timestampToggle.checked ? 'true' : 'false');
        }

        const globalMemoryModeValueInput = document.getElementById('globalMemoryModeValue');
        const selectedMemoryMode = normalizeFuraiMemoryMode(globalMemoryModeValueInput?.value);
        if (globalMemoryModeValueInput) {
            DB.set(`global_memory_mode_${mode}`, selectedMemoryMode);
        }

        const autoSum = selectedMemoryMode === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP
            ? true
            : document.getElementById('globalAutoSummary').checked;
        DB.set(`global_auto_summary_${mode}`, autoSum);

        if (typeof refreshVisibleMessageTimestamps === 'function') {
            refreshVisibleMessageTimestamps();
        }
       
        // --- NEW: Save Global Visual Hint Toggle ---
        const globalHintToggle = document.getElementById('showSummaryHintToggle');
        if (globalHintToggle) {
            localStorage.setItem('furai_show_summary_hint', globalHintToggle.checked);
        }
        // ------------------------------------------

        const bgRandomToggle = document.getElementById('globalBgRandomToggle');
        DB.set(`global-bg-random-${mode}`, bgRandomToggle?.checked === true);

        const bgLayer = document.getElementById('globalBgPreviewLayer');
        const rawBgInput = document.getElementById('globalBgUrl').value;
        const typedBgUrls = rawBgInput.split(/\r?\n/).map(u => u.trim()).filter(u => u);
        const bgUrl = bgLayer ? (bgLayer.dataset.url || '') : '';
        const bgOpacity = document.getElementById('globalBgOpacity').value;
        const bgBlur = document.getElementById('globalBgBlur').value;
        
        if (bgUrl) {
            DB.set(`global-bg-${mode}`, bgUrl);
            DB.set(`global-bg-opacity-${mode}`, bgOpacity);
            DB.set(`global-bg-blur-${mode}`, bgBlur);
        
            if (typedBgUrls.length > 0) {
                [...typedBgUrls].reverse().forEach(url => addToBackgroundHistory(url));
            } else {
                addToBackgroundHistory(bgUrl);
            }
        } else {
            DB.remove(`global-bg-${mode}`);
            DB.remove(`global-bg-opacity-${mode}`);
            DB.remove(`global-bg-blur-${mode}`);
        }

        // --- 4. BOT PROFILES ---
        if (mode !== 'group') {
            const botKey = `global-profile-${mode}`;
            let fullProfile = null;
            try { fullProfile = DB.get(botKey) || null; } catch(e){}
            if (!fullProfile || typeof fullProfile !== 'object') fullProfile = {};
            if (!Array.isArray(fullProfile.bots) || !fullProfile.bots[0]) {
                fullProfile.bots = [createFuraiModeFactoryBot(mode)];
            }
        
            const bot = fullProfile.bots[0];
            const protectedData = readFuraiProtectedInstructionEditorData(
                'globalBotProtectedInstructionHost',
                bot
            );
            if (!protectedData) return;

            bot.name = document.getElementById('globalBotName').value.trim();
            bot.avatar = document.getElementById('globalBotAvatar').value.trim();
            bot.defaultSprite = document.getElementById('globalBotSprite').value.trim();
            
            // [NEW] SAVE SINGLE BOT TAG
            bot.hashTag = getFuraiTagInputValue('globalBotTag');
            
            // Merge Bot Inst
            let bPub = document.getElementById('globalBotInst').value.trim();
            let bSec = document.getElementById('globalBotSecret').value.trim();
            if(bSec) bPub += `\n\n[SECRET]\n${bSec}\n[/SECRET]`;
            bot.instruction = bPub;
            writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(bot, protectedData);

            const globalBotOpening = document.getElementById('globalBotOpening')?.value.trim() || "";
            if (globalBotOpening) {
                bot.openingMessage = globalBotOpening;
            } else {
                delete bot.openingMessage;
            }

            writeCharacterOpeningExtras(
                bot,
                readCharacterOpeningExtrasFromDomOrProfile('globalBotName', bot)
            );
            
            bot.isActive = true;
        
            // Existing selected/custom characters keep missing emotion fields empty.
            // Only a genuinely absent role record was created from its own factory above.
            if (!bot.customEmotions) bot.customEmotions = {};
            if (!bot.emotionAvatars) bot.emotionAvatars = {};
            if (!bot.emotionSprites) bot.emotionSprites = {};
        
            fullProfile.profileCustomized = true;
            DB.set(botKey, fullProfile);
        
            // Refresh current screen immediately AFTER saving the new bot data
            if (currentChatId) {
                let currentChatData = null;
                try { currentChatData = DB.get(currentChatId); } catch (e) {}
            
                const isHomeNow = currentChatData?.personality === 'home';
            
                if (isHomeNow && mode === 'researcher') {
                    refreshHomeMascot();
                } else {
                    applyBackground(currentChatId);
                }
            }
        } else {
            // --- GROUP SAVE (MAGIC WAND) ---
            const wandName = document.getElementById('globalWandName').value.trim();
            const wandAvatar = document.getElementById('globalWandAvatar').value.trim();
            const wandSprite = document.getElementById('globalWandSprite').value.trim();
            
            // [NEW] SAVE WAND TAG
            const wandTag = getFuraiTagInputValue('globalWandTag');
            if (wandTag) DB.set('global-group-enhancer-tag', wandTag); else DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-tag');

            // Merge Wand Inst
            let wPub = document.getElementById('globalWandInst').value.trim();
            let wSec = document.getElementById('globalWandSecret').value.trim();
            const wandProtectedData = readFuraiProtectedInstructionEditorData(
                'globalWandProtectedInstructionHost',
                getFuraiGlobalWandProtectedInstructionData()
            );
            if (!wandProtectedData) return;
            if(wSec) wPub += `\n\n[SECRET]\n${wSec}\n[/SECRET]`;
            
            const wandOpening = document.getElementById('globalWandOpening')?.value.trim() || "";

            if (wandName) DB.set('global-group-enhancer-name', wandName); else DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-name');
            if (wandAvatar) DB.set('global-group-enhancer-avatar', wandAvatar); else DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-avatar');
            if (wPub) DB.set('global-group-enhancer-inst', wPub); else DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-inst');
            if (wandOpening) DB.set('global-group-enhancer-opening', wandOpening); else DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-opening');
            writeFuraiGlobalWandProtectedInstructionData(wandProtectedData);

            saveGlobalWandOpeningExtras(
                readCharacterOpeningExtrasFromDomOrProfile('globalWandName', getGlobalWandOpeningExtrasData())
            );
            
            let wandSprites = {};
            try { wandSprites = DB.get('global-group-enhancer-emotion-sprites') || {}; } catch(e){}
            if (wandSprite) {
                wandSprites['default'] = wandSprite;
                DB.set('global-group-enhancer-emotion-sprites', wandSprites);
            }
        }

        const btn = document.getElementById('globalSaveBtn');
        if (btn) {
            const originalHTML = btn.innerHTML;
            btn.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Saved!`;
            setTimeout(() => { btn.innerHTML = originalHTML; }, 1500);
        }
        renderBackgroundHistoryUI('globalBgHistory', 'globalBgUrl', updateBackgroundPreview);

        // If Character Library is open behind this editor, refresh its cards immediately.
        const charactersModalEl = document.getElementById('charactersModalEl');
        const charactersGridEl = document.getElementById('charsGridContainer');

        if (
            charactersModalEl &&
            charactersGridEl &&
            getComputedStyle(charactersModalEl).display !== 'none' &&
            typeof renderCharactersGrid === 'function'
        ) {
            renderCharactersGrid();
        }
        
    } catch(e) {
        console.error("Global Save Error", e);
        showToast("Error saving settings.", "error");
    }
}

function capitalize(str) {
  if (!str) return '';
  return str.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + str.slice(1);
}

/* --- HELPER: EDIT GLOBAL BOT --- */
function editGlobalBot(index) {
    let roster = DB.get('globalBotRoster');
    if (!roster) roster = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaultBots));

    const bot = roster[index];
    if (!bot) return;

    const container =
        getGlobalSettingsSectionInnerByTitle('Character Settings') ||
        document.getElementById('globalTabContent');
    
    // [NEW] Load Tag
    const botTag = bot.hashTag || ''; 

    // --- SPLIT LOGIC ---
    let fullInst = bot.instruction || '';
    let publicPart = fullInst;
    let secretPart = "";
    const match = fullInst.match(/\[SECRET\]([\s\S]*?)\[\/SECRET\]/i);
    if(match) {
        secretPart = match[1].trim();
        publicPart = fullInst.replace(match[0], "").trim();
    }

    const visualStackStyle = "display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; align-items:center; width:60px; margin-right:16px; flex-shrink:0;";
    const spriteImgStyle = "width:60px; height:80px; border-radius:4px; object-fit:contain; border:1px solid var(--border-color); background:var(--input-bg); cursor:zoom-in;";

    // --- Define Delete Button HTML BEFORE building the template ---
    // Legion keeps roster deletion as a prestige cleanup tool.
    // Non-Legion users can still edit, overwrite, or set slots Offline.
    const canDeleteThisSlot = hasLegionUnlock();

    const deleteBtnHtml = canDeleteThisSlot
        ? `<button onclick="deleteGlobalBot(${index})" class="delete-btn" style="background:var(--danger-color); color:white; border:none; padding:10px 16px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s;" onmouseover="this.style.opacity=0.8" onmouseout="this.style.opacity=1"><i class="fa-solid fa-trash"></i> Delete Slot</button>`
        : `<button disabled title="Legion unlock is required to delete Group Roster slots. You can still edit, overwrite, or set this slot Offline." style="background:rgba(244, 67, 54, 0.1); color:var(--text-color); opacity:0.5; border:1px dashed var(--danger-color); padding:10px 16px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:600; cursor:not-allowed;"><i class="fa-solid fa-lock"></i> Delete Slot (Legion)</button>`;

    // --- BUILD THE HTML ---
    container.innerHTML = `
        <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; margin-bottom:16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-color); padding-bottom:12px;">
            <button onclick="reopenGlobalGroupCharacterSettings()" style="background:none; border:none; font-size:18px; cursor:pointer; color:var(--text-color); margin-right:12px;">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-left"></i>
            </button>
            <h3 style="margin:0; font-size:16px;">Edit #${index + 1}</h3>
        </div>

        <div class="form-group avatar-form-group">
            <div class="profile-visuals-container" style="${visualStackStyle}">
                <img id="editGlobalBotAvatarPreview" class="profile-avatar-preview" src="${bot.avatar || ''}" 
                     onclick="openLightbox(this.src)" onerror="this.style.display='none'" style="margin-bottom:0;">
                
                <img id="editGlobalBotSpritePreview" src="${bot.defaultSprite || ''}" style="${spriteImgStyle} ${bot.defaultSprite?'':'display:none;'}"
                     onclick="openLightbox(this.src)" onerror="this.style.display='none'">
            </div>

            <div class="avatar-input-wrapper">
                <label>Character Name & Tags</label>
                <div class="furai-name-tag-row">
                    <input type="text" id="editGlobalBotName" data-index="${index}" value="${escapeHTML(bot.name || '')}" style="flex:1; margin-bottom:0;">
                    
                    <input type="text" id="editGlobalBotTag" value="${escapeHTML(getFuraiTagInputDisplayValue(botTag))}" data-furai-tag-source="${escapeHTML(botTag)}" placeholder="#tag" 
                           oninput="sanitizeHashTag(this)"
                           style="width:80px; margin-bottom:0; font-family:monospace; color:var(--text-color); font-weight:bold;">
                </div>
                
                <label>Avatar</label>
                <div style="display:flex; gap:8px;">
                    <input type="text" id="editGlobalBotAvatar" value="${escapeHTML(bot.avatar || '')}"
                           oninput="applyFuraiEditorAvatarPreview('editGlobalBotAvatarPreview', this.value)">
                    <button onclick="openUploader()" class="upload-btn" title="Upload"><span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size:20px;">upload_file</span></button>
                </div>

                <label style="margin-top:8px;">Default Sprite</label>
                <div style="display:flex; gap:8px;">
                    <input type="text" id="editGlobalBotSprite" value="${escapeHTML(bot.defaultSprite || '')}"
                           oninput="document.getElementById('editGlobalBotSpritePreview').src=this.value; document.getElementById('editGlobalBotSpritePreview').style.display=this.value?'block':'none'">
                    <button onclick="openUploader()" class="upload-btn" title="Upload"><span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size:20px;">upload_file</span></button>
                </div>

                <button onclick="openEmotionEditor(${index}, 'global')" class="settings-menu-item" style="margin-top:8px; justify-content:center; border:1px solid var(--border-color); width:100%;">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-face-smile"></i> Edit Emotion Keywords
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-group">
            <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-end; margin-bottom:6px;">
                <label style="margin-bottom:0;">Instruction / Personality</label>
                <span id="editGBotCount" style="font-size:12px; opacity:0.5;">0 words</span>
            </div>
            <textarea id="editGlobalBotInst" rows="8" placeholder="Default instruction for the character. Token guidance adapts to the active AI model."
                      oninput="updateWordCountUI(['editGlobalBotInst', 'editGlobalBotSecret'], 'editGBotCount', 500)">${escapeHTML(publicPart)}</textarea>
        </div>
        
        <div class="form-group" style="border-top:1px dashed var(--border-color); padding-top:12px; margin-top:12px;">
             <label style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
                Hidden Secrets
             </label>
             <p style="font-size:0.8em; opacity:0.7; margin-bottom:8px;">Visible only to this character and the Narrator.</p>
             <textarea id="editGlobalBotSecret" rows="3" placeholder="e.g. Is actually a spy. Hates chocolate."
                       oninput="updateWordCountUI(['editGlobalBotInst', 'editGlobalBotSecret'], 'editGBotCount', 500)">${escapeHTML(secretPart)}</textarea>
        </div>

        <div id="editGlobalBotProtectedInstructionHost" class="furai-protected-instruction-host"></div>

        ${buildOpeningSetupFields('editGlobalBot', 'editGlobalBotOpening', bot, {
            openingValue: bot.openingMessage || bot.customGreeting || bot.greeting || bot.initialMessage || '',
            description: 'Optional first message when this character is opened from import, library, share link, or Expansion Pass.',
            placeholder: 'Leave blank to use the default greeting.'
        })}
        
        <div class="button-group" style="margin-top:20px; display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; width:100%;">
            <button onclick="openShareMenu(this, 'editGlobalBotName', 'editGlobalBotAvatar', 'editGlobalBotInst')"
                    title="Copy Profile"
                    style="background:var(--input-bg); color:var(--text-color); border:1px solid var(--border-color); padding:10px 16px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer;">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-share-nodes"></i> Share
            </button>
            <button onclick="resetSingleGlobalBot(${index}, event)"
                    title="Reset this character to its default slot"
                    style="background:var(--input-bg); color:var(--text-color); border:1px solid var(--border-color); padding:10px 16px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer;">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-rotate-left"></i> Reset
            </button>
            ${deleteBtnHtml}
        </div>
    `;

    mountFuraiProtectedInstructionEditor(
        'editGlobalBotProtectedInstructionHost',
        document.getElementById('editGlobalBotSecret')?.closest('.form-group'),
        bot
    );
    mountFuraiVisualPickerButton('editGlobalBotAvatarPreview', 'global-roster-bot', index);

    setGlobalSaveFooterForGlobalBot(index);
    
    setTimeout(() => updateWordCountUI(['editGlobalBotInst', 'editGlobalBotSecret'], 'editGBotCount', 500), 50);
}

function saveGlobalBot(index) {
    let roster = [];
    try { roster = DB.get('globalBotRoster'); } catch(e){}
    if (!roster || roster.length === 0) {
        roster = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaultBots));
    }

    const existingInActive = roster[index].inActiveCast;
    const existingIsActive = roster[index].isActive;
    const existingReplyMode = roster[index].replyMode || 'auto';
    
    let currentUid = roster[index].uid;
    if (!currentUid) {
        if (defaultBots[index]) currentUid = defaultBots[index].uid;
        else currentUid = generateUID('roster_bot');
    }

    // --- MERGE LOGIC ---
    const publicInst = document.getElementById('editGlobalBotInst').value.trim();
    const secretInst = document.getElementById('editGlobalBotSecret').value.trim();
    const openingMessage = document.getElementById('editGlobalBotOpening')?.value.trim() || "";
    let finalInst = publicInst;
    if(secretInst) finalInst += `\n\n[SECRET]\n${secretInst}\n[/SECRET]`;
    // -------------------

    const protectedData = readFuraiProtectedInstructionEditorData(
        'editGlobalBotProtectedInstructionHost',
        roster[index]
    );
    if (!protectedData) return;

    const updatedBot = writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData({
        // Preserve library/activity metadata and compatible extension fields.
        // Editing a character must not rebuild it as a smaller object.
        ...roster[index],

        uid: currentUid, 
        name: document.getElementById('editGlobalBotName').value.trim(),
        avatar: document.getElementById('editGlobalBotAvatar').value.trim(),
        defaultSprite: document.getElementById('editGlobalBotSprite').value.trim(),
        instruction: finalInst,
        openingMessage: openingMessage,
        
        // [NEW] SAVE ROSTER TAG
        hashTag: getFuraiTagInputValue('editGlobalBotTag'),
        
        inActiveCast: existingInActive,
        isActive: existingIsActive, 
        replyMode: existingReplyMode,
        
        customEmotions: roster[index].customEmotions,
        emotionAvatars: roster[index].emotionAvatars,
        emotionSprites: roster[index].emotionSprites
    }, protectedData);

    roster[index] = writeCharacterOpeningExtras(
        updatedBot,
        readCharacterOpeningExtrasFromDomOrProfile('editGlobalBotName', roster[index])
    );

    const globalSettingsModal = document.getElementById('globalSettingsModalEl');
    const returnToCharacterLibrary =
        globalSettingsModal?.dataset.returnToCharacterLibrary === '1';

    DB.set('globalBotRoster', roster);
    refreshCharactersGridIfOpen();

    if (returnToCharacterLibrary) {
        const savedName = roster[index]?.name || 'Character';
        closeGlobalSettingsModal();
        showToast(`Saved "${savedName}".`, "success");
        return;
    }

    reopenGlobalGroupCharacterSettings();
}

/* --- HELPER: DELETE GLOBAL GROUP BOT --- */
function hasLegionUnlock() {
    return typeof AchievementManager !== 'undefined'
        && typeof AchievementManager.isUnlocked === 'function'
        && AchievementManager.isUnlocked('legion');
}

function isGlobalGroupRosterRoleBot(bot, index = -1) {
    if (!bot) return false;

    // Primary rule: a default/core Group roster role is defined by its slot position.
    // This still catches edited core slots like Oakteeth.
    if (index >= 0 && index < defaultBots.length) return true;

    // Fallback for legacy data where a default bot may have moved but kept its UID.
    const uid = String(bot.uid || '');

    return Array.isArray(defaultBots) && defaultBots.some(defaultBot =>
        defaultBot?.uid && defaultBot.uid === uid
    );
}

function deleteGlobalBot(index) {
    let roster = DB.get('globalBotRoster');
    if (!roster || !roster[index]) return;

    const bot = roster[index];
    const botName = bot.name || "this character";
    const isRosterRole = isGlobalGroupRosterRoleBot(bot, index);

    if (!hasLegionUnlock()) {
        showToast("Legion unlock is required to delete Group Roster slots.", "error");
        return;
    }

    const confirmText = isRosterRole
        ? `Delete character "${botName}"?\nExisting chats will not be changed.`
        : `Are you sure you want to permanently delete "${botName}"?\n\nThis cannot be undone.`;

    if (!confirm(confirmText)) return;

    roster.splice(index, 1);
    DB.set('globalBotRoster', roster);
    showToast(`${botName} slot deleted`, "success");

    reopenGlobalGroupCharacterSettings();
    refreshCharactersGridIfOpen();
}

/* --- HELPER: RESET SINGLE GLOBAL BOT (Fixed UID Logic) --- */
function resetSingleGlobalBot(index, event) {
    if(event) event.stopPropagation();

    let roster = DB.get('globalBotRoster') || [];
    if (roster.length === 0) roster = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaultBots));

    const factoryDefault = defaultBots[index] || {
        uid: generateUID('roster_slot_reset'),
        name: `Free Slot ${index + 1}`,
        avatar: pickFuraiStarterAvatar(),
        defaultSprite: '',
        instruction: 'This is an empty slot.',
        customEmotions: {},
        emotionAvatars: {},
        emotionSprites: {}
    };

    const currentName = roster[index] ? roster[index].name : "Unknown";
    const targetName = factoryDefault.name;
    
    let msg = `Reset "${currentName}" to factory defaults?`;
    if (currentName !== targetName) {
        msg = `This will overwrite "${currentName}" with the factory default "${targetName}".\n\nContinue?`;
    }

    if(!confirm(msg)) return;

    if (roster[index]) {
        roster[index].uid = factoryDefault.uid || generateUID('roster_slot_reset');
        roster[index].name = factoryDefault.name;
        roster[index].avatar = factoryDefault.avatar;
        roster[index].defaultSprite = factoryDefault.defaultSprite || '';
        roster[index].instruction = factoryDefault.instruction;
        writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(roster[index], factoryDefault);
    
        if (factoryDefault.openingSystemMessage) {
            roster[index].openingSystemMessage = factoryDefault.openingSystemMessage;
        } else {
            delete roster[index].openingSystemMessage;
        }

        if (factoryDefault.openingMessage) {
            roster[index].openingMessage = factoryDefault.openingMessage;
        } else {
            delete roster[index].openingMessage;
        }
    
        if (factoryDefault.openingBackground) {
            roster[index].openingBackground = factoryDefault.openingBackground;
            roster[index].openingBackgroundOpacity = factoryDefault.openingBackgroundOpacity || "1";
            roster[index].openingBackgroundBlur = factoryDefault.openingBackgroundBlur || "0";
        } else {
            delete roster[index].openingBackground;
            delete roster[index].openingBackgroundOpacity;
            delete roster[index].openingBackgroundBlur;
        }
    
        if (factoryDefault.openingLorebook) {
            roster[index].openingLorebook = factoryDefault.openingLorebook;
        } else {
            delete roster[index].openingLorebook;
        }
    
        roster[index].customEmotions = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(factoryDefault.customEmotions || {}));
        roster[index].emotionAvatars = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(factoryDefault.emotionAvatars || {}));
        roster[index].emotionSprites = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(factoryDefault.emotionSprites || {}));
    }

    DB.set('globalBotRoster', roster);
    reopenGlobalGroupCharacterSettings();
}

// --- GLOBAL SETTINGS RENDERER HELPER ---
function renderRosterItemHTML(bot, index, isActive, isMaxed) {
    const actionIcon = isActive ? 'fa-minus' : 'fa-plus';
    const disabledStyle = (!isActive && isMaxed) ? 'opacity:0.3; cursor:not-allowed;' : 'cursor:pointer;';
    const disabledAttr = (!isActive && isMaxed) ? 'disabled' : '';
    const tagHtml = createFuraiTagChipsHTML(bot.hashTag, {
        className: 'furai-compact-row-tags furai-long-row-tags',
        maxVisible: 2
    });
    
    const status = getBotChatStatus(bot);
    const statusMeta = getFuraiChatStatusMeta(status, 'character');
    const statusToggleBtn = isActive ? `
        <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); cycleGlobalBotChatStatus(${index}, event)"
                data-furai-chat-status="${status}"
                title="${statusMeta.title}"
                style="background:none; border:1px solid transparent; color:var(--text-color); border-radius:4px; width:28px; height:28px; padding:0; display:grid; place-items:center; flex-shrink:0; transition:all 0.2s;"
                onmouseover="this.style.borderColor='var(--border-color)'"
                onmouseout="this.style.borderColor='transparent'">
            ${statusMeta.icon}
        </button>
    ` : '';

    // Reply policy remains independent from Online / Idle / Announcement / Ghost status.
    let replyToggleBtn = '';
    if (isActive) {
        const replyMeta = getFuraiGlobalReplyPolicyMeta(bot.replyMode);

        replyToggleBtn = `
            <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleGlobalBotReplyMode(${index}, event)"
                    data-furai-global-reply-index="${index}"
                    data-furai-reply-mode="${replyMeta.mode}"
                    title="${replyMeta.title}"
                    style="background:none; border:1px solid transparent; color:var(--text-color); border-radius:4px; width:28px; height:28px; padding:0; display:grid; place-items:center; flex-shrink:0; transition:all 0.2s; opacity:${replyMeta.opacity};"
                    onmouseover="this.style.borderColor='var(--border-color)'"
                    onmouseout="this.style.borderColor='transparent'">
                ${replyMeta.icon}
            </button>
        `;
    }
    // [NEW] Search Data
    const searchData = `${bot.name} ${getFuraiVisibleTagText(bot.hashTag)} ${bot.instruction || ''}`.toLowerCase();
    
    return `
        <div class="settings-menu-item" 
             onclick="editGlobalBot(${index})"
             data-search="${escapeHTML(searchData)}" 
             style="border:1px solid var(--border-color); margin-bottom:6px; justify-content:space-between; background:var(--sidebar-bg); cursor:pointer; padding: 8px 12px;">
            
            <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; flex:1; overflow:hidden;">
                ${bot.avatar ? `<img src="${escapeHTML(bot.avatar)}" style="width:32px; height:32px; border-radius:50%; object-fit:cover; margin-right:12px; flex-shrink:0;" onerror="this.style.display='none'">` : ''}
                <div class="furai-tagged-row-name-line furai-long-row-name-line">
                    <span class="furai-tagged-row-name" style="font-weight:500;">${escapeHTML(bot.name)}</span>
                    ${tagHtml}
                </div>
            </div>

            <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;">
                ${statusToggleBtn}
                ${replyToggleBtn}

                <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleGlobalCastState(${index})" 
                        title="${isActive ? 'Remove from Members' : 'Add to Members'}" ${disabledAttr}
                        style="background:none; border:1px solid var(--border-color); color:var(--text-color); border-radius:50%; width:28px; height:28px; padding:0; display:grid; place-items:center; flex-shrink:0; transition:background-color 0.2s; ${disabledStyle}"
                        onmouseover="this.style.backgroundColor='var(--border-color)'" 
                        onmouseout="this.style.backgroundColor='transparent'">
                    <i class="fa-solid ${actionIcon}" style="font-size:12px; margin:0 !important; width:auto !important;"></i>
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    `;
}

function getGlobalCastRosterKey(mode = currentGlobalTab) {
    return mode === 'story' ? 'globalStoryBotRoster' : 'globalBotRoster';
}

function getGlobalCastModeKey(mode = currentGlobalTab) {
    return mode === 'story' ? 'furai_story_cast_mode' : 'furai_cast_mode';
}

function getGlobalCastRenderTab(mode = currentGlobalTab) {
    return mode === 'story' ? 'story' : 'group';
}

function getGlobalCastLimit(mode = currentGlobalTab) {
    return mode === 'story' ? 9999 : AchievementManager.getGroupLimit();
}

function loadGlobalCastRoster(mode = currentGlobalTab) {
    const rosterKey = getGlobalCastRosterKey(mode);
    let roster = [];
    try { roster = DB.get(rosterKey); } catch (e) {}

    if (!roster || roster.length === 0) {
        roster = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaultBots));

        // Story starts with nobody in factory cast by default
        if (mode === 'story') {
            roster.forEach(bot => {
                bot.inActiveCast = false;
                bot.isActive = false;
                delete bot.replyMode;
                delete bot.activeTimestamp;
            });
        }
    }

    return roster;
}

function saveGlobalCastRoster(roster, mode = currentGlobalTab) {
    DB.set(getGlobalCastRosterKey(mode), roster);
    renderGlobalContent(getGlobalCastRenderTab(mode), { preserveSection: true });
}

function getSavedGlobalCastMode(mode = currentGlobalTab) {
    const key = getGlobalCastModeKey(mode);
    let saved = 'auto';
    try { saved = DB.get(key) || 'auto'; } catch (e) {}
    return saved;
}

/* --- GLOBAL REPLY MODE TOGGLES --- */

const FURAI_GLOBAL_ALWAYS_REPLY_SVG = `<svg class="furai-reply-policy-icon is-always-policy" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path fill="currentColor" d="M23 9q0 1.725-.612 3.288t-1.663 2.837q-.3.35-.75.375t-.8-.325q-.325-.325-.3-.775t.3-.825q.75-.95 1.163-2.125T20.75 9t-.412-2.425t-1.163-2.1q-.3-.375-.312-.825t.312-.8t.788-.338t.762.363q1.05 1.275 1.663 2.838T23 9m-4.55 0q0 .8-.25 1.538t-.7 1.362q-.275.375-.737.388t-.813-.338q-.325-.325-.337-.787t.212-.888q.15-.275.238-.6T16.15 9t-.088-.675t-.237-.625q-.225-.425-.213-.875t.338-.775q.35-.35.813-.338t.737.388q.45.625.7 1.363T18.45 9M9 13q-1.65 0-2.825-1.175T5 9t1.175-2.825T9 5t2.825 1.175T13 9t-1.175 2.825T9 13m-8 6v-.8q0-.825.425-1.55t1.175-1.1q1.275-.65 2.875-1.1T9 14t3.525.45t2.875 1.1q.75.375 1.175 1.1T17 18.2v.8q0 .825-.587 1.413T15 21H3q-.825 0-1.412-.587T1 19"/></svg>`;

function normalizeFuraiGlobalReplyMode(mode) {
    return ['auto', 'mention', 'mute', 'always'].includes(mode) ? mode : 'auto';
}

function getNextFuraiGlobalReplyMode(mode) {
    const current = normalizeFuraiGlobalReplyMode(mode);
    if (current === 'auto') return 'mention';
    if (current === 'mention') return 'mute';
    if (current === 'mute') return 'always';
    return 'auto';
}

function getFuraiGlobalReplyPolicyMeta(mode, alwaysReplySvg = FURAI_GLOBAL_ALWAYS_REPLY_SVG) {
    const safeMode = normalizeFuraiGlobalReplyMode(mode);

    if (safeMode === 'mention') {
        return {
            mode: safeMode,
            label: 'Mention',
            title: 'Mode: Mention Only',
            opacity: '0.5',
            icon: '<i class="fa-solid fa-at fa-fw furai-reply-policy-icon"></i>'
        };
    }

    if (safeMode === 'mute') {
        return {
            mode: safeMode,
            label: 'Muted',
            title: 'Mode: Muted',
            opacity: '0.5',
            icon: '<i class="fa-solid fa-comment-slash fa-fw furai-reply-policy-icon is-muted-policy"></i>'
        };
    }

    if (safeMode === 'always') {
        return {
            mode: safeMode,
            label: 'Always Reply',
            title: 'Mode: Always Reply',
            opacity: '1',
            icon: alwaysReplySvg
        };
    }

    return {
        mode: 'auto',
        label: 'Open Reply',
        title: 'Mode: Open Reply',
        opacity: '1',
        icon: '<i class="fa-regular fa-comment-dots fa-fw furai-reply-policy-icon"></i>'
    };
}

function applyFuraiGlobalReplyPolicyVisual(button, mode) {
    if (!button) return;

    const meta = getFuraiGlobalReplyPolicyMeta(mode);
    button.dataset.furaiReplyMode = meta.mode;
    button.title = meta.title;
    button.style.opacity = meta.opacity;
    button.innerHTML = meta.icon;
}

function applyFuraiGlobalMasterReplyPolicyVisual(button, mode) {
    if (!button) return;

    const meta = getFuraiGlobalReplyPolicyMeta(mode);
    button.dataset.furaiReplyMode = meta.mode;

    const label = button.querySelector('[data-furai-master-reply-label]');
    if (label) label.textContent = `(Status: ${meta.label})`;
}

const furaiDeferredGlobalReplyPolicyChanges = new Map();
let furaiDeferredGlobalReplyPolicyFlushQueued = false;
let furaiDeferredGlobalReplyPolicySequence = 0;

function queueGlobalReplyPolicyPersistence(change) {
    if (!change) return;

    const mode = change.mode === 'story' ? 'story' : 'group';
    const key = change.type === 'master'
        ? `${mode}:master`
        : `${mode}:bot:${change.index}`;

    furaiDeferredGlobalReplyPolicyChanges.set(key, {
        ...change,
        mode,
        sequence: ++furaiDeferredGlobalReplyPolicySequence
    });

    if (furaiDeferredGlobalReplyPolicyFlushQueued) return;
    furaiDeferredGlobalReplyPolicyFlushQueued = true;

    const flushAfterPaint = () => setTimeout(flushGlobalReplyPolicyChanges, 0);
    if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === 'function') {
        requestAnimationFrame(flushAfterPaint);
    } else {
        flushAfterPaint();
    }
}

function flushGlobalReplyPolicyChanges() {
    furaiDeferredGlobalReplyPolicyFlushQueued = false;

    const pending = Array.from(furaiDeferredGlobalReplyPolicyChanges.values())
        .sort((a, b) => a.sequence - b.sequence);
    furaiDeferredGlobalReplyPolicyChanges.clear();
    if (!pending.length) return;

    const changesByMode = new Map();
    pending.forEach(change => {
        if (!changesByMode.has(change.mode)) changesByMode.set(change.mode, []);
        changesByMode.get(change.mode).push(change);
    });

    changesByMode.forEach((changes, mode) => {
        const roster = loadGlobalCastRoster(mode);
        let masterMode = getSavedGlobalCastMode(mode);
        let masterChanged = false;

        changes.forEach(change => {
            const nextMode = normalizeFuraiGlobalReplyMode(change.replyMode);

            if (change.type === 'master') {
                masterMode = nextMode;
                masterChanged = true;
                roster.forEach(bot => {
                    if (bot.inActiveCast) bot.replyMode = nextMode;
                });
                return;
            }

            const bot = roster[change.index];
            if (bot?.inActiveCast) bot.replyMode = nextMode;
        });

        try {
            DB.set(getGlobalCastRosterKey(mode), roster);

            if (masterChanged) {
                DB.set(getGlobalCastModeKey(mode), masterMode);
                if (mode === 'group') {
                    localStorage.setItem('furai_bot_auto_reply', masterMode === 'auto');
                }
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Could not save global talking policy:', error);
            if (currentGlobalTab === mode) {
                renderGlobalContent(getGlobalCastRenderTab(mode), {
                    preserveSection: true,
                    preserveScroll: true
                });
            }
            showToast?.('Could not save the talking policy.', 'error');
        }
    });
}

// --- GLOBAL MASTER TOGGLE ---
function cycleGlobalDefaultReplyMode(event) {
    if (event) event.stopPropagation();

    const mode = currentGlobalTab === 'story' ? 'story' : 'group';
    const button = event?.currentTarget || document.getElementById('globalDefaultReplyModeBtn');
    const currentMode = normalizeFuraiGlobalReplyMode(
        button?.dataset?.furaiReplyMode || getSavedGlobalCastMode(mode)
    );
    const nextMode = getNextFuraiGlobalReplyMode(currentMode);

    // Update the header and every visible member policy before any storage work.
    applyFuraiGlobalMasterReplyPolicyVisual(button, nextMode);
    document.querySelectorAll(
        '#globalTabContent [data-furai-global-reply-index]'
    ).forEach(policyButton => {
        applyFuraiGlobalReplyPolicyVisual(policyButton, nextMode);
    });

    queueGlobalReplyPolicyPersistence({
        type: 'master',
        mode,
        replyMode: nextMode
    });
}

const furaiDeferredGlobalChatStatusChanges = new Map();
let furaiDeferredGlobalChatStatusFlushQueued = false;

function queueGlobalBotChatStatusPersistence(change) {
    if (!change || !Number.isInteger(change.index)) return;

    const mode = change.mode === 'story' ? 'story' : 'group';
    const key = `${mode}:${change.index}`;
    const pending = furaiDeferredGlobalChatStatusChanges.get(key);

    furaiDeferredGlobalChatStatusChanges.set(key, {
        ...change,
        mode,
        previousStatus: pending?.previousStatus || change.previousStatus
    });

    if (furaiDeferredGlobalChatStatusFlushQueued) return;
    furaiDeferredGlobalChatStatusFlushQueued = true;

    const flushAfterPaint = () => setTimeout(flushGlobalBotChatStatusChanges, 0);
    if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === 'function') {
        requestAnimationFrame(flushAfterPaint);
    } else {
        flushAfterPaint();
    }
}

function flushGlobalBotChatStatusChanges() {
    furaiDeferredGlobalChatStatusFlushQueued = false;

    const pending = Array.from(furaiDeferredGlobalChatStatusChanges.values());
    furaiDeferredGlobalChatStatusChanges.clear();
    if (!pending.length) return;

    const changesByMode = new Map();
    pending.forEach(change => {
        if (!changesByMode.has(change.mode)) changesByMode.set(change.mode, []);
        changesByMode.get(change.mode).push(change);
    });

    changesByMode.forEach((changes, mode) => {
        const roster = loadGlobalCastRoster(mode);

        changes.forEach(change => {
            const bot = roster[change.index];
            if (bot?.inActiveCast) setFuraiBotChatStatus(bot, change.status);
        });

        try {
            DB.set(getGlobalCastRosterKey(mode), roster);
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Could not save global character status:', error);

            changes.forEach(change => {
                const button = change.button;
                if (
                    button?.isConnected &&
                    button.dataset.furaiChatStatus === normalizeFuraiChatStatus(change.status)
                ) {
                    applyFuraiMenuStatusVisual(
                        button,
                        change.previousStatus || 'online',
                        'character'
                    );
                }
            });

            showToast?.('Could not save the status change.', 'error');
            return;
        }

        changes.forEach(change => {
            if (change.status === 'idle') showFuraiIdleModeHint();
            if (change.status === 'announcement') {
                showFuraiAnnouncementModeHint('character', change.name);
            }
            if (change.status === 'silent') {
                showFuraiGhostModeHint('character', change.name);
            }
        });
    });
}

function cycleGlobalBotChatStatus(index, event) {
    if (event) event.stopPropagation();

    const mode = currentGlobalTab === 'story' ? 'story' : 'group';
    const roster = loadGlobalCastRoster(mode);
    const bot = roster[index];
    if (!bot || !bot.inActiveCast) return;

    const button = event?.currentTarget || null;
    const renderedStatus = button?.dataset?.furaiChatStatus;
    const previousStatus = normalizeFuraiChatStatus(renderedStatus || getBotChatStatus(bot));
    const next = getNextFuraiChatStatus(previousStatus);

    // Update only the assigned status control now. Rebuilding Global Chat Settings
    // here resets the active section scroller and makes the panel jump upward.
    applyFuraiMenuStatusVisual(button, next, 'character');

    // Persist after the visible change has painted. Rapid taps are coalesced so
    // only the final selected status is written, without rerendering the panel.
    queueGlobalBotChatStatusPersistence({
        mode,
        index,
        status: next,
        previousStatus,
        name: bot.name || 'Character',
        button
    });
}

// --- GLOBAL INDIVIDUAL TOGGLE ---
function toggleGlobalBotReplyMode(index, event) {
    if (event) event.stopPropagation();

    const mode = currentGlobalTab === 'story' ? 'story' : 'group';
    const roster = loadGlobalCastRoster(mode);
    const bot = roster[index];
    if (!bot?.inActiveCast) return;

    const button = event?.currentTarget || null;
    const currentMode = normalizeFuraiGlobalReplyMode(
        button?.dataset?.furaiReplyMode || bot.replyMode
    );
    const nextMode = getNextFuraiGlobalReplyMode(currentMode);

    applyFuraiGlobalReplyPolicyVisual(button, nextMode);
    queueGlobalReplyPolicyPersistence({
        type: 'bot',
        mode,
        index,
        replyMode: nextMode
    });
}

function toggleGlobalOfflineList() {
    isGlobalOfflineExpanded = true;

    const content = document.getElementById('globalOfflineListContent');
    const icon = document.getElementById('globalOfflineToggleIcon');

    if (content) content.style.display = 'block';
    if (icon) icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-chevron-up';
}

// --- GLOBAL STORY CAST CARD ---
function loadGlobalStoryCharacterLibrary() {
    const library = [];
    const modeDefs = [
        { key: 'researcher', userLabel: 'User · Research', botLabel: 'Researcher AI', botFallbackName: 'FurAI' },
        { key: 'prompter',   userLabel: 'User · Prompt',   botLabel: 'Prompter AI',  botFallbackName: 'FurAI' },
        { key: 'group',      userLabel: 'User · Group',    botLabel: 'Group AI',      botFallbackName: 'FurAI' },
        { key: 'story',      userLabel: 'User · Story',    botLabel: 'Story AI',      botFallbackName: 'FurAI' },
        { key: 'maker',      userLabel: 'User · Character',botLabel: 'Maker AI',      botFallbackName: 'FurAI' }
    ];

    const addEntry = (profile, meta = {}) => {
        if (!profile) return;

        const clone = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(profile));
        clone.storyLibraryUid = meta.uid || `story_lib_${library.length}`;
        clone.storySourceType = meta.type || 'profile';
        clone.storySourceLabel = meta.label || '';
        clone.storySourceIndex = typeof meta.index === 'number' ? meta.index : null;

        if (!clone.name) clone.name = meta.fallbackName || 'Untitled';

        library.push(clone);
    };

    modeDefs.forEach(modeDef => {
        let savedUser = null;
        try { savedUser = DB.get(`global-user-${modeDef.key}`); } catch(e) {}

        addEntry(
            savedUser && Object.keys(savedUser).length ? savedUser : {
                name: 'User',
                avatar: '',
                defaultSprite: '',
                instruction: ''
            },
            {
                uid: `story_user_${modeDef.key}`,
                type: 'user',
                label: modeDef.userLabel,
                fallbackName: 'User'
            }
        );

        let savedBotWrap = null;
        try { savedBotWrap = DB.get(`global-profile-${modeDef.key}`); } catch(e) {}
        const savedBot = savedBotWrap && savedBotWrap.bots && savedBotWrap.bots[0] ? savedBotWrap.bots[0] : null;

        const fallbackBot = modeDef.key === 'group'
            ? cloneFuraiData(defaultBots.find(bot => bot?.uid === 'sys_furai_001') || createFuraiBlankLibraryCharacter())
            : createFuraiModeFactoryBot(modeDef.key);

        addEntry(
            savedBot || fallbackBot,
            {
                uid: `story_bot_${modeDef.key}`,
                type: 'bot',
                label: modeDef.botLabel,
                fallbackName: modeDef.botFallbackName
            }
        );
    });

    let roster = [];
    try { roster = DB.get('globalBotRoster'); } catch(e) {}
    if (!roster || roster.length === 0) roster = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaultBots));

    roster.forEach((bot, idx) => {
        addEntry(bot, {
            uid: `story_roster_${bot.uid || idx}`,
            type: 'roster',
            label: `#${idx + 1}`,
            index: idx,
            fallbackName: `#${idx + 1}`
        });
    });

    addEntry(getFuraiGlobalWandProfile(), {
        uid: 'story_magic_wand',
        type: 'wand',
        label: 'Magic Wand',
        fallbackName: 'Magic Wand'
    });

    return library;
}

function loadGlobalStoryCastItems() {
    let cast = [];
    try { cast = DB.get('globalStoryBotRoster') || []; } catch(e) {}
    if (!Array.isArray(cast)) cast = [];
    return cast;
}

function saveGlobalStoryCastItems(cast, options = {}) {
    DB.set('globalStoryBotRoster', cast);

    if (options.render !== false) {
        renderGlobalContent('story', { preserveSection: true });
    }
}

const STORY_ROLE_PRESETS = [
    { value: 'protagonist', label: 'Protagonist' },
    { value: 'deuteragonist', label: 'Deuteragonist' },
