const STORY_CONTEXT_MODES = [
    {
        value: 'present',
        label: 'Present',
        icon: 'fa-user-check',
        description: 'Full lore used'
    },
    {
        value: 'brief',
        label: 'Brief',
        icon: 'fa-user-tag',
        description: 'Only name, role, and role note used — saves tokens'
    },
    {
        value: 'offstage',
        label: 'Offstage',
        icon: 'fa-user-slash',
        description: 'Not used in context'
    }
];

function getStoryContextModeMeta(bot) {
    const value = bot?.storyContextMode || 'present';
    return STORY_CONTEXT_MODES.find(m => m.value === value) || STORY_CONTEXT_MODES[0];
}

function cycleStoryCastContextMode(scope, castIndex) {
    const adapter = getStoryCastAdapter(scope);
    const cast = adapter.loadCast();
    const item = cast[castIndex];
    if (!item) return;

    const currentValue = item.storyContextMode || 'present';
    const currentIndex = STORY_CONTEXT_MODES.findIndex(m => m.value === currentValue);
    const nextIndex = currentIndex >= 0 ? (currentIndex + 1) % STORY_CONTEXT_MODES.length : 0;
    const nextMode = STORY_CONTEXT_MODES[nextIndex];

    item.storyContextMode = nextMode.value;
    cast[castIndex] = item;

    adapter.saveCast(cast);
    adapter.refresh();
    showToast(`${item.name || 'Story Cast character'} → ${nextMode.label}`);
}

function getStoryRoleLabel(bot) {
    if (!bot) return 'Support';

    if (bot.storyRolePreset === 'custom') {
        const custom = (bot.storyCustomRole || '').trim();
        return custom || 'Custom Role';
    }

    const match = STORY_ROLE_PRESETS.find(item => item.value === bot.storyRolePreset);
    return match ? match.label : (bot.storyRoleType || 'Support');
}

function normalizeStoryCastBot(bot) {
    if (!bot) return bot;

    bot.storyRolePreset = bot.storyRolePreset || 'support';
    bot.storyCustomRole = typeof bot.storyCustomRole === 'string' ? bot.storyCustomRole : '';
    bot.storyRoleNote = typeof bot.storyRoleNote === 'string' ? bot.storyRoleNote : '';

    const validContextMode = STORY_CONTEXT_MODES.some(mode => mode.value === bot.storyContextMode);
    bot.storyContextMode = validContextMode ? bot.storyContextMode : 'present';

    bot.storyRoleType = getStoryRoleLabel(bot);

    if (typeof bot.inActiveCast !== 'boolean') {
        bot.inActiveCast = true;
    }

    bot.isActive = false;
    return bot;
}

function getStoryCastAdapter(scope = 'global') {
    if (scope === 'chat') {
        return {
            loadCast() {
                const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
                if (!profile) return [];
                return (profile.bots || []).slice(1);
            },

            saveCast(cast) {
                const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
                if (!profile) return;

                const userBot = profile.bots?.[0] || null;
                profile.bots = userBot ? [userBot, ...cast] : cast;
                profile.profileCustomized = true;
                DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, profile);
            },

            loadPool() {
                return loadGlobalStoryCharacterLibrary();
            },

            refresh() {
                if (typeof renderStoryChatCastModal === 'function') {
                    renderStoryChatCastModal();
                }
            },

            openProfile(isImported, index, event) {
                if (event) event.stopPropagation();

                            const bot = isImported
                    ? this.loadCast()[index]
                    : this.loadPool()[index];

                if (!bot) return;

                const rawDesc = (bot.instruction || bot.description || 'No profile text.').trim();
                
                openProfileCard(
                    bot.name || `Story Cast ${index + 1}`,
                    bot.avatar || '',
                    rawDesc,
                    bot.hashTag || '',
                    null
                );
            }
        };
    }

    return {
        loadCast() {
            return loadGlobalStoryCastItems();
        },

        saveCast(cast) {
            saveGlobalStoryCastItems(cast, { render: false });
        },

        loadPool() {
            return loadGlobalStoryCharacterLibrary();
        },

        refresh() {
            renderGlobalContent('story', { preserveSection: true });
        },

        openProfile(isImported, index, event) {
            openStoryCastProfileCard(isImported, index, event);
        }
    };
}

function buildGlobalStoryCastSnapshot(sourceBot, sourceIndex) {
    const clone = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(sourceBot || {}));

    clone.uid = generateUID('story_cast');
    clone.storySnapshot = true;
    clone.storyImportedAt = Date.now();
    clone.storySourceLibraryUid = sourceBot.storyLibraryUid || `story_lib_${sourceIndex}`;
    clone.storySourceLabel = sourceBot.storySourceLabel || `#${sourceIndex + 1}`;
    clone.storySourceIndex = typeof sourceBot.storySourceIndex === 'number' ? sourceBot.storySourceIndex : sourceIndex;

    clone.storyRolePreset = clone.storyRolePreset || 'support';
    clone.storyCustomRole = clone.storyCustomRole || '';
    clone.storyRoleNote = clone.storyRoleNote || '';
    clone.storyRoleType = getStoryRoleLabel(clone);
    clone.storyContextMode = clone.storyContextMode || 'present';

    clone.inActiveCast = true;
    clone.isActive = false;
    delete clone.replyMode;
    delete clone.activeTimestamp;

    return clone;
}

function importStoryCast(scope, sourceIndex) {
    const adapter = getStoryCastAdapter(scope);
    const pool = adapter.loadPool();
    const sourceBot = pool[sourceIndex];
    if (!sourceBot) return;

    const keepStoryLibraryOpen = scope === 'global'
        && document.getElementById('storyLibraryFoldBody')
        && document.getElementById('storyLibraryFoldBody').style.display !== 'none';

    const storyLibrarySearchValue = document.getElementById('storyLibrarySearchInput')?.value || '';

    const cast = adapter.loadCast();
    cast.push(buildGlobalStoryCastSnapshot(sourceBot, sourceIndex));
    adapter.saveCast(cast);
    adapter.refresh();

    if (keepStoryLibraryOpen) {
        const body = document.getElementById('storyLibraryFoldBody');
        const icon = document.getElementById('storyLibraryFoldIcon');
        const searchInput = document.getElementById('storyLibrarySearchInput');

        if (body) body.style.display = 'block';
        if (icon) icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-chevron-up';

        if (searchInput) {
            searchInput.value = storyLibrarySearchValue;
            filterGlobalStoryLibrary();
        }
    }

    showToast(`${sourceBot.name || 'Character'} imported to Story Cast.`);
}

function removeStoryCast(scope, castIndex) {
    const adapter = getStoryCastAdapter(scope);
    const cast = adapter.loadCast();
    const item = cast[castIndex];
    if (!item) return;

    const label = item.name || 'Story role';
    cast.splice(castIndex, 1);
    adapter.saveCast(cast);
    adapter.refresh();

    showToast(`${label} removed from Story Cast.`);
}

function saveStoryCastField(scope, castIndex, field, value) {
    const adapter = getStoryCastAdapter(scope);
    const cast = adapter.loadCast();
    const item = cast[castIndex];
    if (!item) return;

    if (field === 'storyContextMode') {
        const safeMode = STORY_CONTEXT_MODES.find(mode => mode.value === value)?.value || 'present';
        item.storyContextMode = safeMode;
    } else {
        item[field] = value;
    }

    if (field === 'storyRolePreset' && value !== 'custom') {
        item.storyCustomRole = '';
    }

    if (field === 'storyRolePreset' || field === 'storyCustomRole') {
        item.storyRoleType = getStoryRoleLabel(item);
    }

    cast[castIndex] = item;
    adapter.saveCast(cast);
}

function updateStoryCastRole(scope, castIndex, field, value) {
    saveStoryCastField(scope, castIndex, field, value);
    getStoryCastAdapter(scope).refresh();
}

function openStoryCastProfileCard(isImported, index, event) {
    if (event) event.stopPropagation();

    const bot = isImported
        ? loadGlobalStoryCastItems()[index]
        : loadGlobalStoryCharacterLibrary()[index];

    if (!bot) return;

    const rawDesc = (bot.instruction || bot.description || 'No profile text.').trim();
    
    openProfileCard(
        bot.name || `#${index + 1}`,
        bot.avatar || '',
        rawDesc,
        bot.hashTag || '',
        null
    );
}

window.openStoryCastLoreEditor = function(scope, castIndex) {
    const adapter = getStoryCastAdapter(scope);
    const cast = adapter.loadCast();
    const item = cast[castIndex];
    if (!item) return;

    const currentName = item.name || `Story Cast ${castIndex + 1}`;
    const currentTag = item.hashTag || '';
    const currentAvatar = item.avatar || '';
    const currentLore = item.instruction || item.description || '';
    const loreParts = splitStoryLoreForEditor(currentLore);
    
    const indexEl = document.getElementById('storyCastLoreIndex');
    const avatarEl = document.getElementById('storyCastLoreAvatar');
    const avatarInputEl = document.getElementById('storyCastLoreAvatarInput');
    const nameInputEl = document.getElementById('storyCastLoreNameInput');
    const tagInputEl = document.getElementById('storyCastLoreTagInput');
    const loreInputEl = document.getElementById('storyCastLoreInput');
    const secretInputEl = document.getElementById('storyCastSecretInput');
    const modalEl = document.getElementById('storyCastLoreModalEl');
    
    if (!indexEl || !avatarEl || !loreInputEl || !modalEl) return;
    
    indexEl.value = castIndex;
    indexEl.dataset.storyScope = scope;
    applyFuraiEditorAvatarPreview('storyCastLoreAvatar', currentAvatar);
    loreInputEl.value = loreParts.publicText;
    
    if (secretInputEl) secretInputEl.value = loreParts.secretText;
    if (avatarInputEl) avatarInputEl.value = item.avatar || '';
    if (nameInputEl) nameInputEl.value = currentName;
    if (tagInputEl) setFuraiTagInputValue(tagInputEl, currentTag);
    
    updateWordCountUI(['storyCastLoreInput', 'storyCastSecretInput'], 'storyCastLoreCount', 500);
    modalEl.style.display = 'flex';
};

window.closeStoryCastLoreEditor = function() {
    const modalEl = document.getElementById('storyCastLoreModalEl');
    if (modalEl) modalEl.style.display = 'none';
};

window.saveStoryCastLoreEditor = function() {
    const indexEl = document.getElementById('storyCastLoreIndex');
    const loreInputEl = document.getElementById('storyCastLoreInput');
    const secretInputEl = document.getElementById('storyCastSecretInput');
    if (!indexEl || !loreInputEl) return;
    
    const scope = indexEl.dataset.storyScope || 'global';
    const castIndex = parseInt(indexEl.value, 10);
    if (Number.isNaN(castIndex)) return;
    
    const adapter = getStoryCastAdapter(scope);
    const cast = adapter.loadCast();
    const item = cast[castIndex];
    if (!item) return;
    
    const nameInputEl = document.getElementById('storyCastLoreNameInput');
    const tagInputEl = document.getElementById('storyCastLoreTagInput');
    const avatarInputEl = document.getElementById('storyCastLoreAvatarInput');
    
    item.name = nameInputEl ? nameInputEl.value.trim() || item.name : item.name;
    item.hashTag = tagInputEl ? getFuraiTagInputValue(tagInputEl) : item.hashTag;
    item.avatar = avatarInputEl ? avatarInputEl.value.trim() : item.avatar;
    
    const mergedLore = joinStoryLoreFromEditor(
        loreInputEl.value,
        secretInputEl ? secretInputEl.value : ''
    );
    
    item.instruction = mergedLore;
    item.description = item.instruction;

    cast[castIndex] = item;
    adapter.saveCast(cast);
    adapter.refresh();

    window.closeStoryCastLoreEditor();
    showToast(`${item.name || 'Story Cast character'} updated.`);
};

function filterGlobalStoryLibrary() {
    const input = document.getElementById('storyLibrarySearchInput');
    const query = (input?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();

    document.querySelectorAll('#storyLibraryList .story-library-item').forEach(el => {
        const haystack = (el.dataset.storySearch || '').toLowerCase();
        const shouldShow = !query || haystack.includes(query);

        el.style.display = shouldShow ? 'flex' : 'none';
    });
}

window.toggleStoryLibraryPanel = function() {
    const body = document.getElementById('storyLibraryFoldBody');
    const icon = document.getElementById('storyLibraryFoldIcon');
    if (!body || !icon) return;

    const isOpen = body.style.display !== 'none';
    body.style.display = isOpen ? 'none' : 'block';
    icon.className = isOpen ? 'fa-solid fa-chevron-down' : 'fa-solid fa-chevron-up';
};

function renderStoryCastItemHTML(bot, index, isImported, scope = 'global') {

    const tagHtml = createFuraiTagChipsHTML(bot.hashTag, {
        className: 'furai-compact-row-tags furai-long-row-tags',
        maxVisible: 3
    });

    const roleBadge = '';
    
    const slotLabel = bot.storySourceLabel || (typeof bot.storySourceIndex === 'number' ? `#${bot.storySourceIndex + 1}` : `#${index + 1}`);
    
    const sourceMetaHtml = !isImported
        ? `
            <div style="font-size:12px; opacity:0.6; margin-top:2px; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;">
                ${escapeHTML(slotLabel)}
            </div>
          `
        : '';
    const actionIcon = isImported ? 'fa-xmark' : 'fa-plus';
    const actionTitle = isImported ? 'Remove from Story Cast' : 'Import Role Snapshot';
    const actionHandler = isImported
        ? `removeStoryCast('${scope}', ${index})`
        : `importStoryCast('${scope}', ${index})`;

    const searchText = [
        bot.name || '',
        getFuraiVisibleTagText(bot.hashTag),
        slotLabel || '',
        bot.storySourceType || '',
        bot.storyRolePreset || '',
        bot.storyCustomRole || '',
        bot.storyRoleType || '',
        bot.storyRoleNote || '',
        bot.storyContextMode || ''
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

    const roleOptionsHtml = STORY_ROLE_PRESETS.map(role =>
        `<option value="${role.value}" ${bot.storyRolePreset === role.value ? 'selected' : ''}>${role.label}</option>`
    ).join('');

    const customRoleInputHtml = isImported && bot.storyRolePreset === 'custom'
        ? `
            <input type="text"
                   value="${escapeHTML(bot.storyCustomRole || '')}"
                   placeholder="Enter custom role..."
                   onclick="event.stopPropagation()"
                   oninput="saveStoryCastField('${scope}', ${index}, 'storyCustomRole', this.value)"
                   onblur="updateStoryCastRole('${scope}', ${index}, 'storyCustomRole', this.value)"
                   style="width:100%; margin-top:0; padding:7px 10px; border-radius:6px; border:1px solid var(--border-color); background:var(--bg-color); color:var(--text-color); box-sizing:border-box; font-size:12px;">
        `
        : '';
    
    const roleNoteHtml = isImported
        ? `
            <input type="text"
                   value="${escapeHTML(bot.storyRoleNote || '')}"
                   placeholder="Optional short role note..."
                   onclick="event.stopPropagation()"
                   oninput="saveStoryCastField('${scope}', ${index}, 'storyRoleNote', this.value)"
                   style="width:100%; margin-top:0; padding:7px 10px; border-radius:6px; border:1px solid var(--border-color); background:var(--bg-color); color:var(--text-color); box-sizing:border-box; font-size:12px;">
        `
        : '';

    const roleEditorHtml = isImported
        ? `
            <div style="margin-top:6px; display:grid; gap:6px;">
                <select onclick="event.stopPropagation()"
                        onchange="updateStoryCastRole('${scope}', ${index}, 'storyRolePreset', this.value)"
                        style="width:100%; padding:7px 10px; border-radius:6px; border:1px solid var(--border-color); background:var(--bg-color); color:var(--text-color); box-sizing:border-box; font-size:12px; cursor:pointer;">
                    ${roleOptionsHtml}
                </select>
                ${customRoleInputHtml}
                ${roleNoteHtml}
            </div>
        `
        : '';

const contextModeMeta = getStoryContextModeMeta(bot);

const modeBtnHtml = isImported
    ? `
        <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); cycleStoryCastContextMode('${scope}', ${index})"
                title="Context Mode: ${contextModeMeta.label} — ${contextModeMeta.description}"
                style="background:none; border:1px solid var(--border-color); color:var(--text-color); border-radius:50%; width:28px; height:28px; padding:0; display:grid; place-items:center; flex-shrink:0; transition:background-color 0.2s; cursor:pointer;"
                onmouseover="this.style.backgroundColor='var(--border-color)'"
                onmouseout="this.style.backgroundColor='transparent'">
            <i class="fa-solid ${contextModeMeta.icon} story-context-mode-icon is-${contextModeMeta.value}" style="font-size:11px; margin:0 !important; width:auto !important;"></i>
        </button>
      `
    : '';

const editBtnHtml = isImported
    ? `
        <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); window.openStoryCastLoreEditor('${scope}', ${index})"
                title="Edit story lore"
                style="background:none; border:1px solid var(--border-color); color:var(--text-color); border-radius:50%; width:28px; height:28px; padding:0; display:grid; place-items:center; flex-shrink:0; transition:background-color 0.2s; cursor:pointer;"
                onmouseover="this.style.backgroundColor='var(--border-color)'"
                onmouseout="this.style.backgroundColor='transparent'">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-pen" style="font-size:11px; margin:0 !important; width:auto !important;"></i>
        </button>
      `
    : '';

    return `
        <div class="${isImported ? 'story-cast-item' : 'story-library-item'} story-character-card"
             data-story-search="${escapeHTML(searchText)}">
    
            ${bot.avatar ? `<img src="${escapeHTML(bot.avatar)}"
                 class="story-character-avatar"
                 onclick="openScopedStoryCastProfileCard('${scope}', ${isImported ? 'true' : 'false'}, ${index}, event)"
                 title="Open profile card"
                 onerror="this.style.display='none'">` : ''}
    
            <div class="story-character-main">
                <div class="story-character-top">
                    <div class="story-character-name-wrap furai-long-row-name-line">
                        <div class="story-character-name" title="${escapeHTML(bot.name || `Character ${index + 1}`)}">
                            ${escapeHTML(bot.name || `Character ${index + 1}`)}
                        </div>
                        ${tagHtml}
                    </div>
    
                    <div class="story-character-actions">
                        ${modeBtnHtml}
                        ${editBtnHtml}
                        <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); ${actionHandler}"
                                title="${actionTitle}"
                                class="story-character-action-btn">
                            <i class="fa-solid ${actionIcon}"></i>
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
    
                ${sourceMetaHtml}   
                ${roleEditorHtml}
            </div>
        </div>
    `;
}

function openScopedStoryCastProfileCard(scope, isImported, index, event) {
    getStoryCastAdapter(scope).openProfile(isImported, index, event);
}

/* --- GLOBAL ADD TO CAST --- */
function toggleGlobalCastState(index) {
    const mode = currentGlobalTab === 'story' ? 'story' : 'group';

    // 1. Load roster from the correct mode key
    let roster = loadGlobalCastRoster(mode);

    const bot = roster[index];
    if (!bot) return;

    const activeCount = roster.filter(b => b.inActiveCast).length;
    const limit = getGlobalCastLimit(mode);

    // 2. Perform toggle
    if (bot.inActiveCast) {
        bot.inActiveCast = false;
        bot.isActive = false;
        delete bot.replyMode;
        delete bot.activeTimestamp;
    } else {
        if (activeCount >= limit) {
            showToast(mode === 'story'
                ? `Max ${limit} active cast members allowed.`
                : `Max ${limit} members allowed.`);
            return;
        }

        bot.inActiveCast = true;
        bot.isActive = true;
        bot.activeTimestamp = Date.now();

        if (!bot.replyMode) {
            const masterMode = getSavedGlobalCastMode(mode);
            bot.replyMode = masterMode;
        }

        if (mode === 'group') {
            checkRosterSizeHint(activeCount + 1);
        }
    }

    // 3. Save & render correct tab
    saveGlobalCastRoster(roster, mode);
}

/* --- GLOBAL SYSTEM RESET HANDLERS --- */

function resetGlobalUserToSystem(mode) {
    const factoryUser = createFuraiDefaultUser(mode);
    const currentName = document.getElementById('globalUserName').value.trim() || 'User';
    const targetName = factoryUser.name || 'User';

    let msg = 'Revert User Profile to system default?';
    if (currentName !== targetName) {
        msg = `⚠️ Warning: This will overwrite "${currentName}" with the system default "${targetName}".\n\nAll custom avatar and instruction data for this mode will be lost.\n\nContinue?`;
    }

    if (!confirm(msg)) return;

    document.getElementById('globalUserAvatar').value = factoryUser.avatar || '';
    document.getElementById('globalUserName').value = factoryUser.name || 'User';
    document.getElementById('globalUserInst').value = factoryUser.instructions?.[mode] || '';

    const spriteEl = document.getElementById('globalUserSprite');
    if (spriteEl) {
        spriteEl.value = factoryUser.defaultSprite || '';
        spriteEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
    }

    const userOpeningEl = document.getElementById('globalUserOpening');
    if (userOpeningEl) userOpeningEl.value = '';
    const userSecretEl = document.getElementById('globalUserSecret');
    if (userSecretEl) userSecretEl.value = '';
    mountFuraiProtectedInstructionEditor(
        'globalUserProtectedInstructionHost',
        userSecretEl?.closest('.form-group') || document.getElementById('globalUserInst')?.closest('.form-group'),
        factoryUser
    );

    document.getElementById('globalUserAvatar').dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
}

function resetGlobalWandToDefault() {
    const currentName = document.getElementById('globalWandName').value.trim() || DEFAULT_WAND_DISPLAY_NAME;
    const targetName = DEFAULT_WAND_DISPLAY_NAME;

    let msg = "Reset Magic Wand & instruction to default?";

    if (currentName !== targetName) {
        msg = `This will overwrite "${currentName}" with the system default "${targetName}".\n\nThis resets only this role to factory settings. It does not change any other role.\n\nContinue?`;
    }

    if(!confirm(msg)) return;

    document.getElementById('globalWandName').value = DEFAULT_WAND_DISPLAY_NAME;
    document.getElementById('globalWandAvatar').value = "https://user.uploads.dev/file/dc15d2a3877ade6e7319206259852fc5.jpg";
    document.getElementById('globalWandSprite').value = ""; 
    document.getElementById('globalWandInst').value = DEFAULT_ENHANCER_TEMPLATE;
    
    // Reset Tag and Secret
    setFuraiTagInputValue('globalWandTag', DEFAULT_WAND_HASH_TAG);
    document.getElementById('globalWandSecret').value = "";

    const wandOpeningEl = document.getElementById('globalWandOpening');
    if (wandOpeningEl) wandOpeningEl.value = "";
    
    // Update visual previews
    document.getElementById('globalWandAvatar').dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
    document.getElementById('globalWandSprite').dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
    
    // Wipe Database Entries
    DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-name');
    DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-avatar');
    DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-inst');
    DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-tag');
    DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-opening');
    DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-opening-background');
    DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-opening-background-opacity');
    DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-opening-background-blur');
    DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-opening-lorebook');
    DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-creator-notes');
    DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-custom-emotions');
    DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-emotion-avatars');
    DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-emotion-sprites');
    DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-muted');
    DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-profile');
    mountFuraiProtectedInstructionEditor(
        'globalWandProtectedInstructionHost',
        document.getElementById('globalWandSecret')?.closest('.form-group'),
        {}
    );
    
    syncGlobalWandMuteButton();
    
    showToast("Magic Wand reset to default.", "success");
}

function resetGlobalBotsToSystem(mode) {
    if(!confirm("Revert Character Settings to system default?")) return;
    
    if (mode === 'group') {
        const factoryRoster = cloneFuraiData(defaultBots);
        DB.set('globalBotRoster', factoryRoster);
        setGlobalGroupRandomStartEnabled(true);
        setGlobalGroupCastAnnouncementsEnabled(true);
        setGlobalGroupIdleAnnouncementTarget('everyone');
        setGlobalGroupIdleAnnouncementMinutes(0);
        reopenGlobalGroupCharacterSettings();
    } else {
        const freshSoloBot = createFuraiModeFactoryBot(mode);
        const botKey = `global-profile-${mode}`;
        let fullProfile = { bots: [freshSoloBot] };
        
        // Try to preserve global user if it exists in that profile
        try { 
            const existing = DB.get(botKey);
            if (existing && existing.user) fullProfile.user = existing.user;
        } catch(e){}
        
        fullProfile.profileCustomized = true;
        DB.set(botKey, fullProfile);
        
        renderGlobalContent(mode, { preserveSection: true });
        showToast("System defaults restored.", "success");
    }
}

function resetGlobalRefToSystem(mode) {
    if(!confirm("Revert Reference to system default?")) return;
    const defaultText = defaultReferences[mode] || "";
    
    const loreParts = splitFuraiLoreInstructions(defaultText);
    const textInput = document.getElementById('globalRefText');
    textInput.value = loreParts.publicText;
    const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('globalRefHiddenInstructions');
    if (hiddenInput) hiddenInput.value = loreParts.hiddenText;
    
    // Trigger the word counter update
    textInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
}

function getPendingFuraiShareFileBase(payload = {}) {
    const fallback = pendingShareData.kind === 'glossary'
        ? 'FurAI-Glossary'
        : pendingShareData.kind === 'lorebook'
            ? 'FurAI-Lorebook'
            : 'FurAI-Character';
    return sanitizeDownloadFilename(payload.name || payload.title || fallback) || fallback;
}

window.triggerShareDownloadAction = async function triggerShareDownloadAction(format = 'json') {
    if (['character', 'lorebook', 'glossary'].includes(pendingShareData?.kind)) {
        showToast('JSON/GZ file download is only available for full chats and full backups.', 'info');
        return;
    }

    try {
        const payload = getPendingFuraiShareJsonPayload();
        const baseName = getPendingFuraiShareFileBase(payload);
        const useGzip = String(format).toLowerCase() === 'gz';
        const fileName = `${baseName}.json${useGzip ? '.gz' : ''}`;
        const blob = useGzip
            ? await createFuraiGzipBlob(payload, fileName, {
                json: true,
                maxSourceBytes: FURAI_MAX_CHARACTER_ARTIFACT_BYTES
            })
            : new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });

        if (blob.size > FURAI_MAX_CHARACTER_ARTIFACT_BYTES) {
            throw new Error('Character or Bookshelf export is too large for safe re-import.');
        }

        downloadFuraiArtifactBlob(blob, fileName);
        showToast(useGzip ? 'Compressed file downloaded!' : 'JSON file downloaded!', 'success');
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Share download failed:', error);
        showToast(`Download failed: ${error.message || error}`, 'error');
    }
};

    const label = kind === 'glossary' ? 'Glossary' : kind === 'lorebook' ? 'Lorebook' : 'Profile';

    document.getElementById('shareLinkHint').textContent = kind === 'character'

    document.getElementById('shareModeRow').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('shareOptionsModal').style.display = 'flex';

}

function buildFuraiCharacterCopyText(payload = {}) {
    const parts = [];
    const name = String(payload.name || 'FurAI Character').trim();
    const hashTag = String(payload.hashTag || '').trim();
    const instruction = String(payload.instruction || '').trim();
    const openingSystemMessage = String(payload.openingSystemMessage || '').trim();
    const openingMessage = String(payload.openingMessage || '').trim();
    const openingBackground = String(payload.openingBackground || '').trim();
    const openingLorebook = String(payload.openingLorebook || '').trim();
    const creatorNotes = mergeFuraiPublicTextAliases(payload.creatorNotes, payload.creator_notes);
    const protectedData = normalizeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(payload);

    parts.push(`Name: ${name}`);
    if (hashTag) parts.push(`Hash Tag: ${hashTag}`);
    parts.push(`Avatar: ${String(payload.avatar || '').trim()}`);
    parts.push(`Default Sprite: ${String(payload.defaultSprite || '').trim()}`);
    if (openingSystemMessage) parts.push(`Opening System Message:\n${openingSystemMessage}`);
    if (openingMessage) parts.push(`Opening Message:\n${openingMessage}`);

    if (openingBackground) {
        parts.push(`Opening Background:\n${openingBackground}`);
        if (String(payload.openingBackgroundOpacity || '').trim() && String(payload.openingBackgroundOpacity) !== '1') {
            parts.push(`Custom Background Opacity: ${payload.openingBackgroundOpacity}`);
        }
        if (String(payload.openingBackgroundBlur || '').trim() && String(payload.openingBackgroundBlur) !== '0') {
            parts.push(`Custom Background Blur: ${payload.openingBackgroundBlur}`);
        }
    }

    if (openingLorebook) parts.push(`Opening Lorebook:\n${openingLorebook}`);
    if (creatorNotes) parts.push(`Creator Notes:\n${creatorNotes}`);

    parts.push(`Instruction:\n${instruction}`);
    parts.push('\n--- VISUALS ---');

    const customEmotions = payload.customEmotions || {};
    const emotionAvatars = payload.emotionAvatars || {};
    const emotionSprites = payload.emotionSprites || {};
    const emotionNames = new Set([
        ...Object.keys(DEFAULT_EMOTION_KEYWORDS || {}),
        ...Object.keys(customEmotions),
        ...Object.keys(emotionAvatars),
        ...Object.keys(emotionSprites)
    ]);
    const visualLines = [];

    emotionNames.forEach(emotion => {
        const avatar = String(emotionAvatars[emotion] || '').trim();
        const sprite = String(emotionSprites[emotion] || '').trim();
        const keywords = String(customEmotions[emotion] || '').trim();
        if (!avatar && !sprite && !keywords) return;

        visualLines.push(`${capitalize(emotion)}:`);
        if (avatar) visualLines.push(`  Avatar: ${avatar}`);
        if (sprite) visualLines.push(`  Sprite: ${sprite}`);
        if (keywords) visualLines.push(`  Keywords: ${keywords}`);
    });

    parts.push(visualLines.join('\n'));

    if (hasFuraiProtectedInstructions(protectedData)) {
        parts.push(FURAI_HUMAN_PROTECTED_JSON_START);
        parts.push(JSON.stringify({
            protectedInstruction: protectedData.protectedInstruction,
            protectedSecret: protectedData.protectedSecret,
            protectedEditCodeHash: protectedData.protectedEditCodeHash,
            protectedInstructionVersion: protectedData.protectedInstructionVersion
        }, null, 2));
        parts.push(FURAI_HUMAN_PROTECTED_JSON_END);
    }

    return parts.join('\n').trim();
}

window.triggerCopyTextAction = async function triggerCopyTextAction() {
    if (pendingShareData.kind === 'character') {
        try {
            const prepared = await getPreparedPendingFuraiCharacterShare('copy this character');
            if (!prepared) return;

            const copied = await copyTextSafely(buildFuraiCharacterCopyText(prepared.data));
            showToast(
                copied
                    ? prepared.mode === 'safe' ? 'Character copied without protected instructions.' : 'Character copied.'
                    : 'Copy failed.',
                copied ? 'success' : 'error'
            );
            if (copied) document.getElementById('shareOptionsModal').style.display = 'none';
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Character copy failed:', error);
            showToast(`Copy failed: ${error.message || error}`, 'error');
        }
        return;
    }

    const copied = await copyTextSafely(pendingShareData.content);
    showToast(copied ? `${pendingShareData.kind === 'glossary' ? 'Glossary' : 'Lorebook'} text copied.` : 'Copy failed.', copied ? 'success' : 'error');
    if (copied) document.getElementById('shareOptionsModal').style.display = 'none';
};

};

window.triggerShareConceptBoardAction = async function triggerShareConceptBoardAction(trigger) {
    const isCharacter = pendingShareData.kind === 'character';
    const kindLabel = pendingShareData.kind === 'glossary' ? 'Glossary' : pendingShareData.kind === 'lorebook' ? 'Lorebook' : 'Character';

    let title;
    let payload;
    let mimeType;
    let extension;
    let previewUrl = '';
    let protection = { mode: 'unchanged', protectedCount: 0 };
    let info = {
        viewer: isCharacter ? 'furai-character' : pendingShareData.kind === 'glossary' ? 'furai-glossary' : 'furai-lorebook',
        type: kindLabel
    };

    if (isCharacter) {
        const prepared = await getPreparedPendingFuraiCharacterShare('save this character to Concept Board');
        if (!prepared) return;

        payload = prepared.data;
        protection = prepared;
        title = payload.name || 'FurAI Character';
        mimeType = 'application/json';
        extension = 'json';
        previewUrl = payload.avatar || '';
        info = {
            ...info,
            hashTag: payload.hashTag || '',
            avatar: payload.avatar || '',
            ...getFuraiExportProtectionInfo(protection)
        };
    } else {
        title = pendingShareData.title || kindLabel;
        payload = pendingShareData.content || '';
        mimeType = 'text/plain;charset=utf-8';
        extension = 'txt';
        previewUrl = pendingShareData.cover || '';
        info = {
            ...info,
            hashTag: pendingShareData.hashTag || '',
            cover: pendingShareData.cover || ''
        };
    }

    const saved = await saveFuraiArtifactToConceptBoard({
        trigger,
        sourceEl: pendingShareData.btn || trigger,
        folder: kindLabel,
        title,
        payload,
        mimeType,
        extension,
        previewUrl,
        info
    });

    if (saved) document.getElementById('shareOptionsModal').style.display = 'none';
};

let currentShareBaseUrl = '';

async function copyTextSafely(text, sourceInput = null) {
    const value = String(text || '');
    if (!value) return false;

    try {
        if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext && document.hasFocus()) {
            await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
            return true;
        }

        throw new Error('Clipboard API unavailable or document not focused.');
    } catch (err) {
        const textArea = document.createElement('textarea');
        textArea.value = value;
        textArea.setAttribute('readonly', '');
        textArea.style.position = 'absolute';
        textArea.style.left = '-9999px';
        textArea.style.top = '0';

        document.body.appendChild(textArea);

        const selection = document.getSelection();
        const savedRange = selection && selection.rangeCount ? selection.getRangeAt(0) : null;

        textArea.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        textArea.select();

        let copied = false;

        try {
            copied = document.execCommand('copy');
        } catch (copyErr) {
            copied = false;
        }

        document.body.removeChild(textArea);

        if (savedRange && selection) {
            selection.removeAllRanges();
            selection.addRange(savedRange);
        } else if (selection) {
            selection.removeAllRanges();
        }

        if (!copied && sourceInput) {
            sourceInput.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            sourceInput.select();
        }

        return copied;
    }
}

/* --- CHARACTER CARD V2 PNG IMPORT / EXPORT --- */

const FURAI_CC_V2_TEXT_CHUNKS = ['chara', 'Chara'];

window.updateCharCardV2FileHint = function updateCharCardV2FileHint(files) {
    const hint = document.getElementById('charCardV2FileHint');
    if (!hint) return;

    const count = files ? files.length : 0;
    hint.innerHTML = count
        ? `<i class="fa-solid fa-file-image"></i> ${count} PNG file${count === 1 ? '' : 's'} selected.`
        : `<i class="fa-solid fa-file-image"></i> Select one or more Character Card PNG files from your device.`;
};

function utf8ToBase64(text) {
    const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(String(text || ''));
    let binary = '';

    bytes.forEach(byte => {
        binary += String.fromCharCode(byte);
    });

    return btoa(binary);
}

function base64ToUtf8(base64) {
    const normalized = String(base64 || '').trim().replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
    const binary = atob(normalized);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);

    for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) {
        bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
    }

    return new TextDecoder().decode(bytes);
}

function safeJsonStringify(value, fallback = '') {
    try {
        return JSON.stringify(value, null, 2);
    } catch (err) {
        return fallback;
    }
}

function appendMetadataNote(existingNotes, title, value) {
    const cleanExisting = String(existingNotes || '').trim();
    const cleanValue = typeof value === 'string'
        ? value.trim()
        : safeJsonStringify(value).trim();

    if (!cleanValue) return cleanExisting;

    const block = `[${title}]\n${cleanValue}`;
    return cleanExisting ? `${cleanExisting}\n\n${block}` : block;
}

function flattenCharacterBookToText(book) {
    if (!book || typeof book !== 'object') return '';

    const lines = [];

    if (book.name) lines.push(`# ${book.name}`);
    if (book.description) lines.push(String(book.description).trim());

    const entries = Array.isArray(book.entries) ? book.entries : [];
    entries.forEach((entry, index) => {
        if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object') return;

        const title = entry.name || entry.comment || `Entry ${index + 1}`;
        const keys = Array.isArray(entry.keys) ? entry.keys.join(', ') : '';
        const content = String(entry.content || '').trim();

        if (!content) return;

        lines.push(`\n## ${title}`);
        if (keys) lines.push(`Keys: ${keys}`);
        lines.push(content);
    });

    return lines.join('\n').trim();
}

function buildFuraiInstructionFromCardV2Data(data) {
    const parts = [];

    if (data.description) parts.push(String(data.description).trim());
    if (data.personality) parts.push(`[Personality]\n${String(data.personality).trim()}`);
    if (data.scenario) parts.push(`[Scenario]\n${String(data.scenario).trim()}`);
    if (data.system_prompt) parts.push(`[System Prompt]\n${String(data.system_prompt).trim()}`);
    if (data.post_history_instructions) parts.push(`[Post-History Instructions]\n${String(data.post_history_instructions).trim()}`);
    if (data.mes_example) parts.push(`[Example Messages]\n${String(data.mes_example).trim()}`);

    return parts.filter(Boolean).join('\n\n').trim();
}

function normalizeCharacterCardV2ToFurai(card) {
    const data = card?.data || {};
    const extensions = data.extensions || {};
    const furai = extensions.furai || {};
    const importedCardAvatar = String(card?.__furaiImportedCardAvatar || '').trim();

    let creatorNotes = String(data.creator_notes || '').trim();

    const safeMetadata = {
        creator: data.creator || '',
        character_version: data.character_version || '',
        tags: Array.isArray(data.tags) ? data.tags : [],
        alternate_greetings: Array.isArray(data.alternate_greetings) ? data.alternate_greetings : [],
        unmapped_extensions: extensions && typeof extensions === 'object'
            ? Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(extensions).filter(([key]) => key !== 'furai'))
            : {}
    };

    creatorNotes = appendMetadataNote(
        creatorNotes,
        'Imported Character Card V2 Metadata',
        safeMetadata
    );

    const normalized = copyCharacterOpeningExtras({
        ver: '1.0',
        type: 'character',
        name: data.name || 'Imported Character',
        hashTag: furai.hashTag || '',
        avatar: furai.avatar || importedCardAvatar || '',
        defaultSprite: furai.defaultSprite || '',
        instruction: furai.instruction || buildFuraiInstructionFromCardV2Data(data),
        openingSystemMessage: furai.openingSystemMessage || '',
        openingMessage: furai.openingMessage || data.first_mes || '',
        openingBackground: furai.openingBackground || '',
        openingBackgroundOpacity: furai.openingBackgroundOpacity || '1',
        openingBackgroundBlur: furai.openingBackgroundBlur || '0',
        openingLorebook: furai.openingLorebook || flattenCharacterBookToText(data.character_book),
        creatorNotes,
        creator_notes: creatorNotes,
        customEmotions: furai.customEmotions || {},
        emotionAvatars: furai.emotionAvatars || {},
        emotionSprites: furai.emotionSprites || {},
        viewMode: furai.viewMode || ''
    }, {
        openingSystemMessage: furai.openingSystemMessage || '',
        openingBackground: furai.openingBackground || '',
        openingBackgroundOpacity: furai.openingBackgroundOpacity || '1',
        openingBackgroundBlur: furai.openingBackgroundBlur || '0',
        openingLorebook: furai.openingLorebook || flattenCharacterBookToText(data.character_book),
        creatorNotes,
        creator_notes: creatorNotes
    });

    return writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(normalized, {
        protectedInstruction: furai.protectedInstruction || '',
        protectedSecret: furai.protectedSecret || furai.protectedHiddenSecrets || '',
        protectedEditCodeHash: furai.protectedEditCodeHash || '',
        protectedInstructionVersion:
            furai.protectedInstructionVersion ||
            FURAI_PROTECTED_INSTRUCTION_VERSION
    });
}

function buildCharacterCardV2FromFurai(charData = {}) {
    const extras = getCharacterOpeningExtras(charData);
    const protectedData = normalizeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(charData);
    const hiddenInstructionCount = hasFuraiProtectedInstructions(charData) ? 1 : 0;
    const furaiExtension = {
        app: 'FurAI',
        exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        hashTag: charData.hashTag || '',
        avatar: charData.avatar || '',
        defaultSprite: charData.defaultSprite || '',
        instruction: charData.instruction || '',
        protectedInstruction: protectedData.protectedInstruction,
        protectedSecret: protectedData.protectedSecret,
        protectedEditCodeHash: protectedData.protectedEditCodeHash,
        protectedInstructionVersion: hiddenInstructionCount
            ? FURAI_PROTECTED_INSTRUCTION_VERSION
            : 0,
        openingSystemMessage: extras.systemMessage || '',
        openingMessage: charData.openingMessage || '',
        openingBackground: extras.background || '',
        openingBackgroundOpacity: extras.backgroundOpacity || '1',
        openingBackgroundBlur: extras.backgroundBlur || '0',
        openingLorebook: extras.lorebook || '',
        creatorNotes: mergeFuraiPublicTextAliases(extras.creatorNotes, charData.creatorNotes, charData.creator_notes),
        customEmotions: charData.customEmotions || {},
        emotionAvatars: charData.emotionAvatars || {},
        emotionSprites: charData.emotionSprites || {},
        viewMode: charData.viewMode || ''
    };

    if (hiddenInstructionCount) {
        furaiExtension.hiddenInstructions = 1;
    }

    // Creator Notes keep only the public compatibility copy. Hidden fields live
    // once in extensions.furai, so protected-instruction exclusion can remove them without string parsing.
    const publicFuraiMetadata = {
        ...furaiExtension,
        protectedInstruction: undefined,
        protectedSecret: undefined,
        protectedEditCodeHash: undefined,
        protectedInstructionVersion: undefined,
        hiddenInstructions: undefined
    };
    Object.keys(publicFuraiMetadata).forEach(key => {
        if (publicFuraiMetadata[key] === undefined) delete publicFuraiMetadata[key];
    });

    let creatorNotes = mergeFuraiPublicTextAliases(extras.creatorNotes, charData.creatorNotes, charData.creator_notes);
    creatorNotes = appendMetadataNote(
        creatorNotes,
        'FurAI Export Metadata',
        publicFuraiMetadata
    );

    const card = {
        spec: 'chara_card_v2',
        spec_version: '2.0',
        data: {
            name: charData.name || 'FurAI Character',
            description: charData.instruction || '',
            personality: '',
            scenario: '',
            first_mes: charData.openingMessage || '',
            mes_example: '',
            creator_notes: creatorNotes,
            system_prompt: '',
            post_history_instructions: '',
            alternate_greetings: [],
            tags: parseFuraiTagLabels(charData.hashTag),
            creator: '',
            character_version: '',
            extensions: {
                furai: furaiExtension
            }
        }
    };

    return card;
}

function parseCharacterCardV2Payload(rawText) {
    const text = String(rawText || '').trim();
    if (!text) throw new Error('Empty character card metadata.');

    try {
        return JSON.parse(text);
    } catch (jsonErr) {
        return JSON.parse(base64ToUtf8(text));
    }
}

function makePngCrcTable() {
    const table = new Uint32Array(256);

    for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++) {
        let c = n;

        for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
            c = (c & 1) ? (0xedb88320 ^ (c >>> 1)) : (c >>> 1);
        }

        table[n] = c >>> 0;
    }

    return table;
}

const FURAI_PNG_CRC_TABLE = makePngCrcTable();

function crc32(bytes) {
    let c = 0xffffffff;

    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
        c = FURAI_PNG_CRC_TABLE[(c ^ bytes[i]) & 0xff] ^ (c >>> 8);
    }

    return (c ^ 0xffffffff) >>> 0;
}

function writeUint32(value) {
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(4);
    const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer);
    view.setUint32(0, value >>> 0);
    return bytes;
}

function concatUint8Arrays(arrays) {
    const total = arrays.reduce((sum, arr) => sum + arr.length, 0);
    const merged = new Uint8Array(total);
    let offset = 0;

    arrays.forEach(arr => {
        merged.set(arr, offset);
        offset += arr.length;
    });

    return merged;
}

function makePngTextChunk(keyword, text) {
    const typeBytes = new TextEncoder().encode('tEXt');
    const keywordBytes = new TextEncoder().encode(keyword);
    const textBytes = new TextEncoder().encode(text);
    const dataBytes = concatUint8Arrays([keywordBytes, new Uint8Array([0]), textBytes]);
    const crcBytes = writeUint32(crc32(concatUint8Arrays([typeBytes, dataBytes])));

    return concatUint8Arrays([
        writeUint32(dataBytes.length),
        typeBytes,
        dataBytes,
        crcBytes
    ]);
}

function validatePngSignature(bytes) {
    const sig = [137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10];
    return sig.every((value, index) => bytes[index] === value);
}

function insertCharacterCardV2IntoPng(pngArrayBuffer, cardJson) {
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(pngArrayBuffer);

    if (!validatePngSignature(bytes)) {
        throw new Error('Export base is not a valid PNG.');
    }

    const payload = utf8ToBase64(JSON.stringify(cardJson));
    const chunksToInsert = FURAI_CC_V2_TEXT_CHUNKS.map(name => makePngTextChunk(name, payload));

    let offset = 8;

    while (offset < bytes.length) {
        const length = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset + offset, 4).getUint32(0);
        const type = new TextDecoder().decode(bytes.slice(offset + 4, offset + 8));

        if (type === 'IEND') {
            return concatUint8Arrays([
                bytes.slice(0, offset),
                ...chunksToInsert,
                bytes.slice(offset)
            ]).buffer;
        }

        offset += 12 + length;
    }

    throw new Error('Invalid PNG: missing IEND chunk.');
}

function extractPngTextChunks(arrayBuffer) {
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(arrayBuffer);

    if (!validatePngSignature(bytes)) {
        throw new Error('Not a valid PNG file.');
    }

    const chunks = {};
    let offset = 8;

    while (offset < bytes.length) {
        const length = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset + offset, 4).getUint32(0);
        const type = new TextDecoder().decode(bytes.slice(offset + 4, offset + 8));
        const data = bytes.slice(offset + 8, offset + 8 + length);

        if (type === 'tEXt') {
            const splitIndex = data.indexOf(0);

            if (splitIndex > 0) {
                const key = new TextDecoder().decode(data.slice(0, splitIndex));
                const value = new TextDecoder().decode(data.slice(splitIndex + 1));
                chunks[key] = value;
            }
        } else if (type === 'iTXt') {
            const readNullTerminated = (bytes, start) => {
                const end = bytes.indexOf(0, start);
                if (end < 0) return null;

                return {
                    text: new TextDecoder().decode(bytes.slice(start, end)),
                    next: end + 1
                };
            };

            const keywordPart = readNullTerminated(data, 0);

            if (keywordPart && keywordPart.text) {
                let cursor = keywordPart.next;

                const compressionFlag = data[cursor++];
                cursor++; // compression method

                const languagePart = readNullTerminated(data, cursor);
                if (!languagePart) {
                    offset += 12 + length;
                    continue;
                }

                cursor = languagePart.next;

                const translatedKeywordPart = readNullTerminated(data, cursor);
                if (!translatedKeywordPart) {
                    offset += 12 + length;
                    continue;
                }

                cursor = translatedKeywordPart.next;

                if (compressionFlag === 0) {
                    chunks[keywordPart.text] = new TextDecoder().decode(data.slice(cursor));
                }
            }
        }

        offset += 12 + length;
    }

    return chunks;
}

async function createCharacterCardAvatarDataUrl(file, size = 320) {
    if (!file) return '';

    return new Promise(resolve => {
        const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
        const img = new Image();

        img.onload = () => {
            try {
                const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                canvas.width = size;
                canvas.height = size;

                const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

                const sourceSize = Math.min(img.naturalWidth, img.naturalHeight);
                const sourceX = Math.max(0, (img.naturalWidth - sourceSize) / 2);
                const sourceY = Math.max(0, (img.naturalHeight - sourceSize) / 2);

                ctx.drawImage(
                    img,
                    sourceX,
                    sourceY,
                    sourceSize,
                    sourceSize,
                    0,
                    0,
                    size,
                    size
                );

                canvas.toBlob(blob => {
                    URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);

                    if (!blob) {
                        resolve('');
                        return;
                    }

                    const reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = () => resolve(String(reader.result || ''));
                    reader.onerror = () => resolve('');
                    reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
                }, 'image/webp', 0.82);
            } catch (err) {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
                resolve('');
            }
        };

        img.onerror = () => {
            URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
            resolve('');
        };

        img.src = objectUrl;
    });
}

async function readCharacterCardV2FromPngFile(file) {
    const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const chunks = extractPngTextChunks(arrayBuffer);
    const payload = FURAI_CC_V2_TEXT_CHUNKS.map(key => chunks[key]).find(Boolean);

    if (!payload) {
        throw new Error(`${file.name} does not contain Character Card V2 metadata.`);
    }

    const card = parseCharacterCardV2Payload(payload);

    if (card?.spec !== 'chara_card_v2' || !card?.data) {
        throw new Error(`${file.name} is not a Character Card V2 PNG.`);
    }

    card.__furaiImportedCardAvatar = await createCharacterCardAvatarDataUrl(file);

    return card;
}

async function createCharacterCardBasePng(name, avatarUrl) {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = 512;
    canvas.height = 768;

    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    ctx.fillStyle = '#151820';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    let imageDrawn = false;

    if (avatarUrl) {
        try {
            const img = new Image();
            img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
            img.referrerPolicy = 'no-referrer';
            img.src = avatarUrl;

            await img.decode();

            const scale = Math.max(canvas.width / img.naturalWidth, canvas.height / img.naturalHeight);
            const width = img.naturalWidth * scale;
            const height = img.naturalHeight * scale;
            const x = (canvas.width - width) / 2;
            const y = (canvas.height - height) / 2;

            ctx.drawImage(img, x, y, width, height);
            imageDrawn = true;
        } catch (err) {
            imageDrawn = false;
        }
    }

    if (!imageDrawn) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#252b38';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
        ctx.font = '700 54px sans-serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.fillText(String(name || 'FurAI').slice(0, 12), canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.52)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, canvas.height - 96, canvas.width, 96);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '700 28px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(String(name || 'FurAI Character').slice(0, 28), canvas.width / 2, canvas.height - 48);

    const blob = await new Promise(resolve => canvas.toBlob(resolve, 'image/png'));
    return blob.arrayBuffer();
}

function sanitizeDownloadFilename(name) {
    return String(name || 'furai-character')
        .trim()
        .replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]+/g, '')
        .replace(/\s+/g, '_')
        .slice(0, 80) || 'furai-character';
}

function downloadArrayBuffer(arrayBuffer, filename, mimeType = 'image/png') {
    const blob = new Blob([arrayBuffer], { type: mimeType });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');

    link.href = url;
    link.download = filename;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();

    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
}

function getFuraiSharePayloadFromDom() {
    const { nameId, avatarId, instId } = pendingShareData;

    const tagIdMap = {
        userNameInput: 'userTagInput',
        botNameInput: 'botTagInput',
        enhancerNameInput: 'enhancerTagInput',
        globalUserName: 'globalUserTag',
        globalBotName: 'globalBotTag',
        globalWandName: 'globalWandTag',
        editGlobalBotName: 'editGlobalBotTag',
        charsShareName: 'charsShareTag',
        furaiHistoricalShareName: 'furaiHistoricalShareTag'
    };

    const secretIdMap = {
        userNameInput: 'userSecretInput',
        botNameInput: 'botSecretInput',
        enhancerNameInput: 'enhancerSecretInput',
        globalUserName: 'globalUserSecret',
        globalBotName: 'globalBotSecret',
        globalWandName: 'globalWandSecret',
        editGlobalBotName: 'editGlobalBotSecret'
    };

    const name = document.getElementById(nameId)?.value.trim() || 'FurAI Character';
    const avatar = document.getElementById(avatarId)?.value.trim() || '';
    let inst = document.getElementById(instId)?.value.trim() || '';

    const secretEl = document.getElementById(secretIdMap[nameId]);
    if (secretEl && secretEl.value.trim()) {
        inst += `\n\n[SECRET]\n${secretEl.value.trim()}\n[/SECRET]`;
    }

    let profileData = {};

    try {
        if (nameId === 'userNameInput') {
            profileData = getChatProfile(currentChatId).user;
        } else if (nameId === 'botNameInput') {
            const idx = document.getElementById('editingBotIndex').value;
            profileData = getChatProfile(currentChatId).bots[idx];
        } else if (nameId === 'enhancerNameInput') {
            profileData = getResolvedWandProfileForChat(currentChatId);
        } else if (nameId === 'furaiHistoricalShareName') {
            profileData = cloneFuraiData(window.furaiHistoricalShareActor || {});
        } else if (nameId === 'charsShareName') {
            const id = document.getElementById('charsShareIndex').value;

            if (id === 'wand') {
                profileData = getFuraiGlobalWandProfile();
            } else if (String(id).startsWith('user_')) {
                const mode = String(id).replace('user_', '');
                profileData = DB.get(`global-user-${mode}`) || createFuraiDefaultUser(mode);
            } else if (String(id).startsWith('solo_')) {
                const mode = String(id).replace('solo_', '');
                profileData = DB.get(`global-profile-${mode}`)?.bots?.[0] || {};
            } else {
                const roster = DB.get('globalBotRoster') || JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaultBots));
                profileData = roster[parseInt(id, 10)] || {};
            }
        } else if (nameId === 'globalUserName') {
            profileData = DB.get(`global-user-${currentGlobalTab}`) || {};
        } else if (nameId === 'globalWandName') {
            profileData = getFuraiGlobalWandProfile();
        } else if (nameId === 'globalBotName') {
            profileData = DB.get(`global-profile-${currentGlobalTab}`)?.bots?.[0] || {};
        } else if (nameId === 'editGlobalBotName') {
            const roster = DB.get('globalBotRoster') || [];
            const editEl = document.getElementById('editGlobalBotName');
            const idx = editEl?.dataset?.index !== undefined ? parseInt(editEl.dataset.index, 10) : -1;
            profileData = roster[idx] || roster.find(bot => bot.name === name) || {};
        }
    } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Share profile resolution failed.', err);
    }

    const protectedData = readFuraiProtectedInstructionForShare(nameId, profileData);
    if (!protectedData) {
        throw new Error('Finish the hidden-instruction unlock code before sharing.');
    }

    const openingExtras = readCharacterOpeningExtrasFromDomOrProfile(nameId, profileData);

    return writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData({
        ver: '1.0',
        type: 'character',
        name,
        hashTag: getFuraiTagInputValue(tagIdMap[nameId]),
        avatar,
        instruction: inst,
        openingSystemMessage: openingExtras.systemMessage,
        openingMessage: readCharacterOpeningMessageFromDomOrProfile(nameId, profileData),
        openingBackground: openingExtras.background,
        openingBackgroundOpacity: openingExtras.backgroundOpacity,
        openingBackgroundBlur: openingExtras.backgroundBlur,
        openingLorebook: openingExtras.lorebook,
        creatorNotes: mergeFuraiPublicTextAliases(openingExtras.creatorNotes, profileData.creatorNotes, profileData.creator_notes),
        creator_notes: mergeFuraiPublicTextAliases(openingExtras.creatorNotes, profileData.creatorNotes, profileData.creator_notes),
        defaultSprite: document.getElementById(avatarId.replace('Avatar', 'Sprite'))?.value || '',
        customEmotions: profileData.customEmotions || {},
        emotionAvatars: profileData.emotionAvatars || {},
        emotionSprites: profileData.emotionSprites || {}
    }, protectedData);
}

window.triggerExportCharacterCardPngAction = async function triggerExportCharacterCardPngAction() {
    const btn = document.getElementById('shareCharacterCardOption');
    const originalHtml = btn ? btn.innerHTML : '';

    try {
        if (btn) btn.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i><strong>Exporting...</strong><span>Building PNG card</span>`;

        const prepared = await getPreparedPendingFuraiCharacterShare('export this PNG character card');
        if (!prepared) return;

        const furaiPayload = prepared.data;
        const cardV2 = buildCharacterCardV2FromFurai(furaiPayload);
        const basePng = await createCharacterCardBasePng(furaiPayload.name, furaiPayload.avatar);
        const cardPng = insertCharacterCardV2IntoPng(basePng, cardV2);

        downloadArrayBuffer(cardPng, `${sanitizeDownloadFilename(furaiPayload.name)}.card.v2.png`);
        showToast(
            prepared.mode === 'safe'
                ? 'Character Card PNG exported without protected instructions.'
                : 'Character Card V2 PNG exported.',
            'success'
        );
    } catch (err) {
        console.error(err);
        showToast(`PNG export failed: ${err.message}`, 'error');
    } finally {
        if (btn) btn.innerHTML = originalHtml;
    }
};

function processMultipleCharacterImports(charDataList, target) {
    const supportedBulkTargets = ['add_slot', 'add_local_slot', 'add_local_online', 'add_local_online_strict'];

    if (!supportedBulkTargets.includes(target)) {
        createTempChat(charDataList[0]);
        showToast(`Opened the first card. Use Add to roster/cast to import multiple cards at once.`, 'info');
        return;
    }

    let importedCount = 0;

    charDataList.forEach(charData => {
        let ok = true;

        if (target === 'add_slot') {
            ok = addToGlobalRoster(charData) !== false;
        } else if (target === 'add_local_slot') {
            ok = addToLocalRoster(charData) !== false;
        } else if (target === 'add_local_online') {
            ok = addToLocalRoster(charData, { activate: true }) !== false;
        } else if (target === 'add_local_online_strict') {
            ok = addToLocalRoster(charData, { activate: true, requireActivate: true }) !== false;
        }

        if (ok) importedCount++;
    });

    if (importedCount > 0) {
        showToast(`Imported ${importedCount} Character Card V2 PNG file${importedCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}.`, 'success');
    }
}
      
function attachButtonRipple(btn) {
    if (!btn || btn.dataset.rippleBound === '1') return;

    btn.dataset.rippleBound = '1';

    btn.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e) {
        if (btn.disabled) return;

        const rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
        const oldInk = btn.querySelector('.btn-ripple-ink');
        if (oldInk) oldInk.remove();

        const ink = document.createElement('span');
        ink.className = 'btn-ripple-ink';

        const isMiniModeBtn = btn.id === 'vnToggleBtn' || btn.id === 'chatModeToggleBtn';
        const size = Math.max(rect.width, rect.height) * (isMiniModeBtn ? 1.5 : 1.8);
        const x = isMiniModeBtn ? rect.width / 2 : (e.clientX - rect.left);
        const y = isMiniModeBtn ? rect.height / 2 : (e.clientY - rect.top);

        ink.style.width = size + 'px';
        ink.style.height = size + 'px';
        ink.style.left = x + 'px';
        ink.style.top = y + 'px';

        btn.appendChild(ink);
        ink.addEventListener('animationend', () => ink.remove(), { once: true });
    }, { passive: true });
}

function bindShareModeRipples(root = document) {
    root.querySelectorAll('.share-mode-btn').forEach(attachButtonRipple);
}

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        bindShareModeRipples(document);
    }, { once: true });
} else {
    bindShareModeRipples(document);
}
          
function setupShareModePills({
    baseUrl,
    inputId,
    rowId,
    defaultBtnId,
    chatBtnId,
    vnBtnId,
    defaultMode = 'default'
}) {
    const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
    const row = document.getElementById(rowId);
    const defaultBtn = defaultBtnId ? document.getElementById(defaultBtnId) : null;
    const chatBtn = document.getElementById(chatBtnId);
    const vnBtn = document.getElementById(vnBtnId);

    if (!baseUrl || !input || !row || !chatBtn || !vnBtn) return;

    const buttons = [
        { el: defaultBtn, mode: 'default' },
        { el: chatBtn, mode: 'chat' },
        { el: vnBtn, mode: 'vn' }
    ].filter(item => item.el);

    const applyMode = (mode) => {
        input.value = mode === 'default' ? baseUrl : `${baseUrl}&viewMode=${mode}`;

        buttons.forEach(item => {
            const active = item.mode === mode;
            item.el.style.background = active ? 'var(--primary-color)' : 'transparent';
            item.el.style.color = active ? 'var(--btn-text-color)' : 'var(--text-color)';
            item.el.style.borderColor = 'transparent';
        });
    };

    row.style.display = 'grid';

    if (defaultBtn) defaultBtn.onclick = () => applyMode('default');
    chatBtn.onclick = () => applyMode('chat');
    vnBtn.onclick = () => applyMode('vn');

    applyMode(defaultMode);
    bindShareModeRipples(row);
}

function readCharacterOpeningMessageFromDomOrProfile(nameId, profileData = {}) {
    const openingIdMap = {
        'userNameInput': 'userOpeningInput',
        'botNameInput': 'botOpeningInput',
        'enhancerNameInput': 'enhancerOpeningInput',
        'makerNameInput': 'makerOpeningInput',
        'globalUserName': 'globalUserOpening',
        'globalBotName': 'globalBotOpening',
        'globalWandName': 'globalWandOpening',
        'editGlobalBotName': 'editGlobalBotOpening',
        'charsShareName': 'charsShareOpening'
    };

    const inputId = openingIdMap[nameId];
    const inputEl = inputId ? document.getElementById(inputId) : null;

    const rawOpening =
        inputEl?.value ||
        profileData?.openingMessage ||
        profileData?.customGreeting ||
        profileData?.greeting ||
        profileData?.initialMessage ||
        "";

    return String(rawOpening).trim();
}

async function generateShareLink() {
    const isCharacter = pendingShareData.kind === 'character';
    const btn = document.getElementById('shareCreateLinkCard');
    const originalHtml = btn.innerHTML;
    btn.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i><strong>Compressing...</strong><span>Please wait</span>`;

    try {
        const uploadFn = window.root?.upload || window.upload;
        if (!uploadFn) throw new Error('Upload plugin missing');

        let payload;
        let protection = { mode: 'unchanged', protectedCount: 0 };

        if (isCharacter) {
            const prepared = await getPreparedPendingFuraiCharacterShare('create this character link');
            if (!prepared) return;
            payload = prepared.data;
            protection = prepared;
        } else {
            payload = getPendingFuraiShareJsonPayload();
        }

        const baseName = getPendingFuraiShareFileBase(payload);
        const gzipFile = await createFuraiGzipBlob(payload, `${baseName}.gz`, {
            json: true,
            maxSourceBytes: FURAI_MAX_CHARACTER_ARTIFACT_BYTES
        });
        const { url, error } = await uploadFn(gzipFile);
        if (error) throw new Error(error);

        const importId = getFuraiUploadFileId(url);
        if (!/^[a-f0-9]{32}(?:\.json)?\.gz$/i.test(importId)) {
            throw new Error('Upload service did not preserve the gzip file type.');
        }

        const shareParam = isCharacter ? 'char' : (pendingShareData.kind === 'glossary' ? 'glossary' : 'lorebook');
        const shareName = String(payload.name || payload.title || (isCharacter ? 'Character' : 'Lorebook')).replace(/\s+/g, '_');
        const shareUrl = `https://perchance.org/fur-ai?${shareParam}=${encodeURIComponent(importId)}&name=${encodeURIComponent(shareName)}`;

        const resultArea = document.getElementById('shareLinkResultArea');
        const input = document.getElementById('shareLinkInput');
        const copyBtn = document.getElementById('shareLinkCopyBtn');
        const modeRow = document.getElementById('shareModeRow');

        resultArea.style.display = 'block';
        currentShareBaseUrl = shareUrl;

        if (isCharacter) {
            setupShareModePills({
                baseUrl: shareUrl,
                inputId: 'shareLinkInput',
                rowId: 'shareModeRow',
                defaultBtnId: 'shareModeDefaultBtn',
                chatBtnId: 'shareModeChatBtn',
                vnBtnId: 'shareModeVnBtn',
                defaultMode: 'default'
            });
        } else {
            modeRow.style.display = 'none';
            input.value = shareUrl;
        }

        copyBtn.onclick = async () => {
            const copied = await copyTextSafely(input.value, input);
            copyBtn.textContent = copied ? 'Copied!' : 'Select & Copy';
            if (!copied) showToast('Link selected. Press Ctrl+C to copy.', 'info');
            setTimeout(() => copyBtn.textContent = 'Copy', 1500);
        };

        showToast(
            isCharacter && protection.mode === 'safe'
                ? 'Link ready without protected instructions!'
                : 'Compressed share link ready!',
            'success'
        );
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Share link error:', error);
        showToast(`Link creation failed: ${error.message}`, 'error');
    } finally {
        btn.innerHTML = originalHtml;
    }
}

function handleOnlineUserClick(type, index) {
    // 1. Close the menu so the user can see the chat
    closeOnlineList(); 

    if (type === 'user') {
        // Option A: Clicked "User (You)" -> Trigger User Auto Reply
        autoReply();
    } else if (type === 'bot') {
        // Option C: Clicked a Character -> Force them to speak immediately
        sendMessage({ forceBotIndex: index });
    }
}

// --- DYNAMIC PRIVATE CHANNEL LOGIC (NSFW SEPARATED) ---

  function getPCStorageKey() {
      return isForumNsfw ? 'furai_private_channels_nsfw' : 'furai_private_channels_safe';
  }

  function getPCPrefix() {
      return isForumNsfw ? 'furai-18-adult-' : 'furai-safe-';
  }

  // 1. Load tabs based on current safety mode
  function loadPrivateChannels() {
      // 1. Clear ONLY the dynamic private tabs (keep the static ones)
      document.querySelectorAll('.private-tab').forEach(t => t.remove());
      
      // 2. Get the correct list based on current mode
      const storageKey = getPCStorageKey(); 
      const saved = DB.get(storageKey) || [];
      
      // 3. Render them
      saved.forEach(channel => {
          addPrivateTabToUI(channel.id, channel.displayName);
      });
  }

  // 2. Open Modal with Dynamic Prefix
  function openPrivateChannelModal() {
      const prefix = getPCPrefix();
      // Update the visual label in the modal
      const labelSpan = document.querySelector('#privateChannelModalEl .form-group span[style*="opacity:0.6"]');
      if(labelSpan) labelSpan.textContent = prefix;
      
      document.getElementById('pcNameInput').value = '';
      document.getElementById('pcCollabInput').value = '';
      document.getElementById('privateChannelModalEl').style.display = 'flex';
  }

  // 3. Create Logic
  function createPrivateChannel() {
      const nameInput = document.getElementById('pcNameInput').value.trim().toLowerCase();
      const collabInput = document.getElementById('pcCollabInput').value.trim();

      if (!/^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(nameInput)) {
          showToast("Invalid Name: Use lowercase English letters, numbers, and hyphens only.");
          return;
      }

      const fullId = getPCPrefix() + nameInput + (collabInput ? `+u:${collabInput}` : '');
      const storageKey = getPCStorageKey();
      const saved = DB.get(storageKey) || [];
      
      // Check duplicate
      if (saved.some(c => c.id === fullId)) {
          showToast("This channel is already in your list.");
          // Fix: If it's in the list but not showing, force a reload now
          loadPrivateChannels(); 
          document.getElementById('privateChannelModalEl').style.display = 'none';
          return;
      }

      // Save
      saved.push({ id: fullId, displayName: nameInput });
      DB.set(storageKey, saved);

      // Render
      addPrivateTabToUI(fullId, nameInput);
      document.getElementById('privateChannelModalEl').style.display = 'none';
      
      // Switch to new tab
      const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.private-tab');
      if(tabs.length > 0) tabs[tabs.length - 1].click();
  }

function addPrivateTabToUI(fullId, displayName) {
    const container = document.getElementById('forumTabsContainer');
    const addBtn = document.getElementById('addNewTabBtn');
    const btn = document.createElement('button');
    
    btn.className = 'forum-tab-btn private-tab';
    btn.dataset.channelId = fullId;
    btn.onclick = function() { switchForumTab(fullId, this); };
    
    // --- UPDATED HTML STRUCTURE ---
    // We add a span around the name with ellipsis styles
    btn.innerHTML = `
        <span style="overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;">
            ${escapeHTML(displayName)}
        </span>
        <span class="private-tab-close" onclick="deletePrivateTab('${fullId}', event)">✕</span>
    `;
    
    container.insertBefore(btn, addBtn);
}

  function deletePrivateTab(fullId, event) {
      if(event) event.stopPropagation();
      if(!confirm("Remove from your list? Data on server stays, but tab disappears.")) return;

      const storageKey = getPCStorageKey();
      let saved = DB.get(storageKey) || [];
      saved = saved.filter(c => c.id !== fullId);
      DB.set(storageKey, saved);

      loadPrivateChannels(); // Refresh list
      if (currentForumTabId === fullId) {
          switchForumTab('general', document.querySelector('.forum-tab-btn'));
      }
  }

function handleResponsiveLayout() {
    // Resets sidebar state when switching from mobile to desktop
    if (window.innerWidth > 768) {
        const sidebar = document.getElementById('menuSidebarEl');
        if (sidebar) sidebar.classList.remove('open');
    }
}

// --- ENHANCER SETTINGS MODAL LOGIC ---

function openEnhancerSettingsModal() {
    let currentInst = "";
    let currentName = "";
    let currentAvatar = "";
    let currentTag = "";
    let chatData = null;

    try {
        chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
        if (chatData) {
            const wandProfile = getResolvedWandProfileForChat(currentChatId);

            currentInst = chatData.enhancerInst !== undefined
                ? chatData.enhancerInst
                : (DB.get('global-group-enhancer-inst') || "");
            currentName = wandProfile.name || DEFAULT_WAND_DISPLAY_NAME;
            currentAvatar = wandProfile.avatar || "https://user.uploads.dev/file/dc15d2a3877ade6e7319206259852fc5.jpg";
            currentTag = wandProfile.hashTag || "";
        }
    } catch(e) { console.error("Enhancer Load Error:", e); }

    let publicPart = currentInst || DEFAULT_ENHANCER_TEMPLATE;
    let secretPart = "";
    const secretMatch = publicPart.match(/\[SECRET\]([\s\S]*?)\[\/SECRET\]/i);
    if (secretMatch) {
        secretPart = secretMatch[1].trim(); 
        publicPart = publicPart.replace(secretMatch[0], "").trim(); 
    }

    const modalBody = document.querySelector('#enhancerSettingsModalEl .modal-body');
    if (!modalBody) return;

    modalBody.innerHTML = `
        <div class="form-group avatar-form-group">
            <div class="profile-visuals-container" style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; align-items:center; width:60px; margin-right:16px; flex-shrink:0;">
                <img id="localWandAvatarPreview" class="profile-avatar-preview" src="${currentAvatar}" onclick="openLightbox(this.src)" onerror="this.style.display='none'" style="margin-bottom:0;">
            </div>
            <div class="avatar-input-wrapper">
                <label>Name</label>
                <div class="furai-name-tag-row">
