function updateEnhancerButtonUI() {
    const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
    const mainBroadcastBtn = document.getElementById('narratorSendBtn');
    if (!mainBroadcastBtn) return;

    if (chatData && chatData.enhancerMuted === true) {
        mainBroadcastBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-volume-xmark" style="opacity:1;"></i>';
        mainBroadcastBtn.title = "Silent (Hidden Notes)";
    } else {
        mainBroadcastBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-bullhorn" style="opacity:1;"></i>';
        mainBroadcastBtn.title = "Announcement (Broadcast)";
    }
}

function closeEnhancerSettingsModal() {
    document.getElementById('enhancerSettingsModalEl').style.display = 'none';
}

function saveEnhancerSettings() {
    const name = document.getElementById('enhancerNameInput').value.trim();
    const avatar = document.getElementById('enhancerAvatarInput').value.trim();
    const tag = getFuraiTagInputValue('enhancerTagInput');

    const publicInst = document.getElementById('enhancerInstInput').value.trim();
    const secretInst = document.getElementById('enhancerSecretInput').value.trim();
    const protectedData = readFuraiProtectedInstructionEditorData(
        'enhancerProtectedInstructionHost',
        getResolvedWandProfileForChat(currentChatId)
    );
    if (!protectedData) return;
    const opening = document.getElementById('enhancerOpeningInput')?.value.trim() || "";
    let text = publicInst;
    if(secretInst) text += `\n\n[SECRET]\n${secretInst}\n[/SECRET]`;
    
    if (!currentChatId) return;

    try {
        const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
        if (chatData) {
            // Update profile fields
            if (text) chatData.enhancerInst = text; else delete chatData.enhancerInst;
            if (name) chatData.enhancerName = name; else delete chatData.enhancerName;
            if (tag) chatData.enhancerTag = tag; else delete chatData.enhancerTag;
            if (avatar) chatData.enhancerAvatar = avatar; else delete chatData.enhancerAvatar;
            if (opening) chatData.enhancerOpening = opening;
            else delete chatData.enhancerOpening;

            writeEnhancerOpeningExtrasToChatData(
                chatData,
                readCharacterOpeningExtrasFromDomOrProfile('enhancerNameInput', chatData)
            );
            writeFuraiLocalWandProtectedInstructionData(chatData, protectedData);
            // Note: enhancerMuted state is NOT changed here anymore,
            // as it is handled exclusively by the toggleLocalWandMute button in the menu.
            
            DB.set(currentChatId, chatData);
            updateEnhancerButtonUI();
            refreshProfileDependentUI();
        }
    } catch(e) { console.error("Error saving enhancer settings", e); }
    
    closeEnhancerSettingsModal();
}

function resetEnhancerSettings() {
    const globalWand = getFuraiGlobalWandProfile();
    const parts = splitStoryLoreFromEditor(globalWand.instruction);
    document.getElementById('enhancerInstInput').value = parts.publicText;
    const secretInput = document.getElementById('enhancerSecretInput');
    if (secretInput) secretInput.value = parts.secretText;
    document.getElementById('enhancerNameInput').value = globalWand.name;
    document.getElementById('enhancerAvatarInput').value = globalWand.avatar;
    mountFuraiProtectedInstructionEditor(
        'enhancerProtectedInstructionHost',
        secretInput?.closest('.form-group') || document.getElementById('enhancerInstInput')?.closest('.form-group'),
        globalWand
    );

    const openingInput = document.getElementById('enhancerOpeningInput');
    if (openingInput) openingInput.value = globalWand.openingMessage || '';

    document.getElementById('enhancerAvatarInput').dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
}

function updateMenuProfiles() {
    // Safety check
    if (!currentChatId) return;
    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    if (!profile) return;

    // --- 1. USER BUTTON UPDATE ---
    const userLabel = document.getElementById('userMenuLabel');
    const userIconSlot = document.getElementById('userMenuIconSlot');
    
    if (userLabel && userIconSlot) {
        // Name Logic
        const userName = profile.user.name || "User";
        userLabel.textContent = `${userName} (You)`;

        // Icon Logic (PFP vs Default)
        if (profile.user.avatar) {
            userIconSlot.innerHTML = `<img src="${escapeHTML(profile.user.avatar)}" class="menu-avatar-tiny" onerror="this.style.display='none'">`;
        } else {
            // Fallback to FontAwesome
            userIconSlot.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-regular fa-circle-user"></i>`;
        }

        userIconSlot.classList.add('furai-menu-card-icon');
        userIconSlot.title = 'Open ID card';
        userIconSlot.onclick = (event) => openOnlineProfileCard('user', null, event);

        const userBtn = userLabel.closest('button.settings-menu-item');
        if (userBtn && !userBtn.closest('.furai-menu-profile-row')) {
            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.className = 'furai-menu-profile-row settings-menu-item-wrapper';
            userBtn.parentNode.insertBefore(row, userBtn);
            row.appendChild(userBtn);
        }

        const userRow = userBtn ? userBtn.closest('.furai-menu-profile-row') : null;
        if (userRow) {
            let statusBtn = document.getElementById('userChatStatusMenuBtn');
            if (!statusBtn) {
                statusBtn = document.createElement('button');
                statusBtn.id = 'userChatStatusMenuBtn';
                statusBtn.type = 'button';
                statusBtn.className = 'furai-menu-status-btn';
                statusBtn.onclick = cycleUserChatStatus;
                userRow.appendChild(statusBtn);
            }

            const userChatStatus = getUserChatStatus(profile);
            userRow.classList.toggle('is-furai-ghost-row', userChatStatus === 'silent');
            userRow.classList.toggle('is-furai-announcement-row', userChatStatus === 'announcement');
            const statusMeta = getFuraiChatStatusMeta(userChatStatus, 'user');
            statusBtn.dataset.furaiChatStatus = userChatStatus;
            statusBtn.innerHTML = statusMeta.icon;
            statusBtn.title = statusMeta.title;
        }
    }

    // --- 2. BOT BUTTON UPDATE (Single Mode Only) ---
    // We only update this if the container is actually visible/relevant
    const botLabel = document.getElementById('singleBotProfileLabel');
    const botIconSlot = document.getElementById('botMenuIconSlot');

    if (botLabel && botIconSlot) {
        // In Single Mode, we always look at the first bot (index 0)
        const bot = profile.bots[0] || { name: 'FurAI', avatar: '' };
        
        // Name Logic
        botLabel.textContent = `${bot.name} Profile`;

        // Icon Logic (PFP vs Default)
        if (bot.avatar) {
            botIconSlot.innerHTML = `<img src="${escapeHTML(bot.avatar)}" class="menu-avatar-tiny" onerror="this.style.display='none'">`;
        } else {
            // Fallback to FontAwesome
            botIconSlot.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-paw"></i>`;
        }

        botIconSlot.classList.add('furai-menu-card-icon');
        botIconSlot.title = 'Open ID card';
        botIconSlot.onclick = (event) => openOnlineProfileCard('bot', 0, event);
    }

    if (typeof updateTokenButtonUI === 'function') updateTokenButtonUI();
}

function getFactoryBackgroundSeedEntries() {
    return getFactoryBackgroundSeedLines()
        .map(parseBackgroundArchiveLine)
        .filter(Boolean);
}

/* --- HISTORY LOGIC (Fixed: No Re-ordering) --- */
function ensureHistoryInit() {
    let history = null;

    try {
        history = DB.get('furai_background_history');
    } catch (e) {}

    if (Array.isArray(history) && history.length > 0) {
        return history;
    }

    let legacyHistory = null;
    try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem('furai_background_history');
        if (raw) legacyHistory = JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch (e) {}

    const seed = Array.isArray(legacyHistory) && legacyHistory.length > 0
        ? legacyHistory
        : getFactoryBackgroundSeedEntries();

    DB.set('furai_background_history', seed);

    try {
        localStorage.setItem('furai_background_history', JSON.stringify(seed));
    } catch (e) {}

    return seed;
}

function isSupportedBackgroundArchiveUrl(value) {
    const url = String(value || '').trim();

    return (
        /^https?:\/\/.{5,}/i.test(url) ||
        /^data:image\/[a-z0-9.+-]+;base64,/i.test(url) ||
        /^blob:/i.test(url)
    );
}

function getReadableBackgroundArchiveUrl(value) {
    const url = String(value || '').trim();

    if (/^data:image\//i.test(url)) return 'embedded image';
    if (/^blob:/i.test(url)) return 'temporary image';

    return url;
}

function parseBackgroundArchiveLine(line) {
    const raw = (line || '').trim();
    if (!raw) return null;

    if (isSupportedBackgroundArchiveUrl(raw)) return raw;

    const eqIndex = raw.lastIndexOf('=');
    if (eqIndex === -1) return null;

    const left = raw.slice(0, eqIndex).trim();
    const url = raw.slice(eqIndex + 1).trim();

    if (!isSupportedBackgroundArchiveUrl(url)) return null;
    if (!left) return url;

    const parts = left.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (parts.length === 0) return url;

    return {
        url,
        name: parts[0],
        aliases: parts.slice(1)
    };
}

function getFirstBgInputLine(value) {
    return String(value || '').split(/\r?\n/)[0].trim();
}

function getBackgroundPreviewUrlFromInput(value) {
    const firstLine = getFirstBgInputLine(value);
    if (!firstLine) return '';

    const parsed = parseBackgroundArchiveLine(firstLine);
    return getBackgroundArchiveUrl(parsed);
}

function uniqCleanStrings(list) {
    return Array.from(
        new Set(
            (Array.isArray(list) ? list : [list])
                .map(v => String(v || '').trim())
                .filter(Boolean)
        )
    );
}

function normalizeBackgroundArchiveEntry(entry) {
    if (!entry) return null;

    if (typeof entry === 'string') {
        const url = entry.trim();
        return isSupportedBackgroundArchiveUrl(url) ? url : null;
    }

    if (typeof entry !== 'object') return null;

    const url = String(entry.url || entry.img || '').trim();
    if (!isSupportedBackgroundArchiveUrl(url)) return null;

    const name = String(entry.name || entry.title || '').trim();
    const aliases = uniqCleanStrings(entry.aliases || entry.tags || []);
    const creator = String(entry.creator || '').trim();
    const desc = String(entry.desc || entry.description || '').trim();

    if (!name && aliases.length === 0 && !creator && !desc) return url;

    return { url, name, aliases, creator, desc };
}

function mergeBackgroundArchiveEntries(existingEntry, incomingEntry) {
    const a = normalizeBackgroundArchiveEntry(existingEntry);
    const b = normalizeBackgroundArchiveEntry(incomingEntry);

    if (!a) return b;
    if (!b) return a;

    if (typeof a === 'string' && typeof b === 'string') return a;
    if (typeof a === 'string') return b;
    if (typeof b === 'string') return a;

    return {
        url: b.url || a.url,
        name: b.name || a.name || '',
        aliases: uniqCleanStrings([...(a.aliases || []), ...(b.aliases || [])]),
        creator: b.creator || a.creator || '',
        desc: b.desc || a.desc || ''
    };
}

function getExpansionStyleSearchTerms(query) {
    return String(query || '').toLowerCase().trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
}

function matchesExpansionStyleSearch(query, searchableText) {
    const terms = getExpansionStyleSearchTerms(query);
    if (terms.length === 0) return true;

    const haystack = String(searchableText || '').toLowerCase();
    return terms.every(term => haystack.includes(term));
}

function makeBackgroundArchiveEntryFromExpansion(item) {
    if (!item || !item.img) return null;

    return normalizeBackgroundArchiveEntry({
        url: item.img,
        name: item.title || '',
        aliases: Array.isArray(item.tags) ? item.tags : [],
        creator: item.creator || '',
        desc: item.desc || item.description || ''
    });
}

function archiveExpansionWallpaper(safeObj) {
    try {
        const item = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(safeObj));
        const entry = makeBackgroundArchiveEntryFromExpansion(item);
        if (!entry) {
            showToast('Failed to add wallpaper.', 'error');
            return;
        }

        const history = addToBackgroundHistory(entry);
        if (history) renderAllBackgroundHistories(history);
        showToast('Added to Backgrounds', 'success');
    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        showToast('Failed to add wallpaper.', 'error');
    }
}

function getBackgroundArchiveUrl(entry) {
    if (!entry) return '';
    if (typeof entry === 'string') return entry.trim();
    if (typeof entry === 'object' && typeof entry.url === 'string') return entry.url.trim();
    return '';
}

function getBackgroundArchiveName(entry) {
    if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object') return '';
    return String(entry.name || '').trim();
}

function getBackgroundArchiveAliases(entry) {
    if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object') return [];
    return uniqCleanStrings(entry.aliases || []);
}

function getBackgroundArchiveCreator(entry) {
    if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object') return '';
    return String(entry.creator || '').trim();
}

function getBackgroundArchiveDesc(entry) {
    if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object') return '';
    return String(entry.desc || '').trim();
}

function getBackgroundArchiveSearchText(entry) {
    if (typeof entry === 'string') return entry.toLowerCase();

    const url = getBackgroundArchiveUrl(entry);
    const name = getBackgroundArchiveName(entry);
    const aliases = getBackgroundArchiveAliases(entry);
    const creator = getBackgroundArchiveCreator(entry);
    const desc = getBackgroundArchiveDesc(entry);

    return [name, ...aliases, creator, desc, url].join(' ').toLowerCase();
}

function getBackgroundArchiveTooltip(entry) {
    const name = getBackgroundArchiveName(entry);
    const aliases = getBackgroundArchiveAliases(entry);
    const creator = getBackgroundArchiveCreator(entry);
    const url = getBackgroundArchiveUrl(entry);

    if (!name && aliases.length === 0 && !creator) return 'Click to Apply';

    return [
        'Click to Apply',
        name || '',
        creator ? `by ${creator}` : '',
        aliases.length ? aliases.join(', ') : '',
        getReadableBackgroundArchiveUrl(url)
    ].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
}
          
function addToBackgroundHistory(entry) {
    const normalized = normalizeBackgroundArchiveEntry(entry);
    const url = getBackgroundArchiveUrl(normalized);
    if (!url) return null;

    return batchAddToHistory([normalized]);
}

function removeFromBackgroundHistory(url, containerId, inputId, previewFunc) {
    if (!confirm("Delete this background?")) return;

    let history = [];
    try { history = DB.get('furai_background_history') || []; } catch (e) {}

    history = history.filter(entry => getBackgroundArchiveUrl(entry) !== url);
    DB.set('furai_background_history', history);

    if (containerId === 'localBgHistory') renderLocalBgHistory();
    else renderGlobalBgHistory();
}

function restoreFactoryBackgrounds(containerId, inputId, previewFunc) {
    if (!confirm("Revive the factory default backgrounds? (Your custom ones will stay)")) return;

    let history = [];
    try { history = DB.get('furai_background_history') || []; } catch (e) {}

    const seen = new Set(history.map(getBackgroundArchiveUrl).filter(Boolean));
    const merged = [...history];

    getFactoryBackgroundSeedEntries().forEach(entry => {
        const url = getBackgroundArchiveUrl(entry);
        if (!url || seen.has(url)) return;

        merged.push(entry);
        seen.add(url);
    });

    DB.set('furai_background_history', merged);

    if (containerId === 'localBgHistory') renderLocalBgHistory();
    else renderGlobalBgHistory();
}

// 0. MAIN HANDLER: Called on every keystroke/paste
let bgInputDebounce = null;

// 1. MAIN HANDLER: Called on every keystroke/paste
function handleBackgroundInput(value) {
    updateBackgroundPreview(value);

    if (bgInputDebounce) clearTimeout(bgInputDebounce);

    bgInputDebounce = setTimeout(() => {
        const rawLines = value.split(/\r?\n/);
        const parsedEntries = rawLines
            .map(parseBackgroundArchiveLine)
            .filter(Boolean);

        if (parsedEntries.length > 0) {
            const history = batchAddToHistory(parsedEntries);
            if (history) renderAllBackgroundHistories(history);
        }
    }, 350);
}

function handleGlobalBackgroundInput(value) {
    if (bgInputDebounce) clearTimeout(bgInputDebounce);

    bgInputDebounce = setTimeout(() => {
        const rawLines = value.split(/\r?\n/);
        const parsedEntries = rawLines
            .map(parseBackgroundArchiveLine)
            .filter(Boolean);

        if (parsedEntries.length > 0) {
            const history = batchAddToHistory(parsedEntries);
            if (history) renderAllBackgroundHistories(history);
        }
    }, 350);
}

// 2. OPTIMIZED STORAGE HELPER
function batchAddToHistory(newEntries) {
    if (!newEntries || newEntries.length === 0) return null;

    const history = ensureHistoryInit();

    [...newEntries].reverse().forEach(rawEntry => {
        const entry = normalizeBackgroundArchiveEntry(rawEntry);
        const url = getBackgroundArchiveUrl(entry);
        if (!url) return;

        const existingIndex = history.findIndex(item => getBackgroundArchiveUrl(item) === url);

        if (existingIndex !== -1) {
            history[existingIndex] = mergeBackgroundArchiveEntries(history[existingIndex], entry);
            return;
        }

        history.unshift(entry);
    });

    DB.set('furai_background_history', history);
    return history;
}

function syncGlobalBgPreviewToHomeVn() {
    if (!currentChatId) return;

    let chatData = null;
    try { chatData = DB.get(currentChatId); } catch (e) {}

    const isHomeResearcherVn =
        chatData &&
        chatData.personality === 'home' &&
        chatData.viewMode === 'vn';

    if (!isHomeResearcherVn) return;

    const bgCtn = document.getElementById('chatBackgroundCtn');
    const bgLayer = document.getElementById('globalBgPreviewLayer');

    if (!bgCtn || !bgLayer) return;

    const bgUrl = bgLayer.dataset.url || '';
    const bgOpacity = bgLayer.style.opacity || '1';
    const bgBlur = bgLayer.dataset.blur || '0';

    if (bgUrl) {
        applyBackgroundVisual(bgCtn, bgUrl);

        bgCtn.style.opacity = bgOpacity;
        applyBackgroundBlurToLayer(bgCtn, bgBlur);
    } else {
        applyBackgroundVisual(bgCtn, '');

        bgCtn.style.opacity = '';
        applyBackgroundBlurToLayer(bgCtn, 0);
    }
}

const backgroundHistorySearchFrames = new Map();


// Shared gallery media loader: stable card shells first, media near the viewport second.
// Loaded media stays mounted so scrolling back does not recreate or flash it again.
const FuraiGalleryMedia = (() => {
    const observers = new Map();
    const mediaObservers = new WeakMap();
    const videoPauseTimers = new WeakMap();
    const VIDEO_WARM_RETENTION_MS = 45000;

    const cancelDelayedVideoPause = (media) => {
        const timer = videoPauseTimers.get(media);
        if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
        videoPauseTimers.delete(media);
    };

    const scheduleDelayedVideoPause = (media) => {
        if (!media || media.tagName !== 'VIDEO' || media.paused) return;

        cancelDelayedVideoPause(media);
        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
            videoPauseTimers.delete(media);
            if (media.isConnected) media.pause();
        }, VIDEO_WARM_RETENTION_MS);
        videoPauseTimers.set(media, timer);
    };

    const ensure = (media) => {
        if (!media || media.dataset.furaiMediaLoaded === '1') return;

        const src = String(media.dataset.furaiMediaSrc || '').trim();
        if (!src) return;

        media.dataset.furaiMediaLoaded = '1';

        if (media.tagName === 'IMG') {
            // Once a wallpaper enters the generous warm band, keep it eager and mounted.
            // This discourages browser lazy heuristics from making short reverse scrolls feel cold.
            media.loading = 'eager';
        }

        media.src = src;

        if (media.tagName === 'VIDEO') {
            media.load();
        }
    };

    const normalizeRoot = (root) => {
        if (
            !root ||
            root === document.scrollingElement ||
            root === document.documentElement ||
            root === document.body
        ) {
            return null;
        }

        return root;
    };

    const getObserver = (requestedRoot) => {
        if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return null;

        const root = normalizeRoot(requestedRoot);
        if (observers.has(root)) return observers.get(root);

        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                const media = entry.target;

                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    cancelDelayedVideoPause(media);
                    ensure(media);

                    // Images remain loaded and no longer need observation.
                    if (media.tagName !== 'VIDEO') {
                        observer.unobserve(media);
                        mediaObservers.delete(media);
                    }
                    return;
                }

                // Keep recently warmed video previews alive through ordinary reverse scrolling.
                // Pause only after a long grace period outside the expanded retention band.
                scheduleDelayedVideoPause(media);
            });
        }, {
            root,
            // Keep several extra viewports warm in both directions.
            // Reverse scrolling should usually revisit already-decoded wallpaper media.
            rootMargin: '3600px 0px 2800px 0px',
            threshold: 0.01
        });

        observers.set(root, observer);
        return observer;
    };

    const observe = (media, root = null) => {
        if (!media || !media.dataset.furaiMediaSrc || media.dataset.furaiMediaObserved === '1') return;

        media.dataset.furaiMediaObserved = '1';

        const observer = getObserver(root);
        if (observer) {
            observer.observe(media);
            mediaObservers.set(media, observer);
        } else {
            ensure(media);
        }
    };

    const releaseWithin = (container) => {
        if (!container) return;

        container.querySelectorAll('[data-furai-media-src]').forEach(media => {
            const observer = mediaObservers.get(media);
            if (observer) observer.unobserve(media);
            mediaObservers.delete(media);
            delete media.dataset.furaiMediaObserved;
            cancelDelayedVideoPause(media);
            if (media.tagName === 'VIDEO') media.pause();
        });
    };

    const revealImage = (img, card) => {
        if (!img || !card || card.dataset.furaiImageRevealed === '1') return;
        card.dataset.furaiImageRevealed = '1';

        const reveal = () => {
            if (img.isConnected && card.isConnected) card.classList.add('is-loaded');
        };

        if (typeof img.decode === 'function') {
            img.decode().catch(() => {}).then(reveal);
        } else {
            reveal();
        }
    };

    const bindSurface = (container, options = {}) => {
        if (!container) return;

        const bindKey = String(options.bindKey || 'default');
        const bindings = container.__furaiGalleryMediaBindings || new Set();
        if (bindings.has(bindKey)) return;

        bindings.add(bindKey);
        container.__furaiGalleryMediaBindings = bindings;

        const mediaSelector = options.mediaSelector || '[data-furai-media-src]';
        const cardSelector = options.cardSelector || '.exp-wall-item, .bg-history-item';
        const hideBroken = options.hideBroken === true;

        const handleReady = event => {
            const media = event.target;
            if (!media.matches?.(mediaSelector)) return;

            const card = media.closest(cardSelector);
            if (!card) return;

            if (media.tagName === 'IMG') revealImage(media, card);
            else card.classList.add('is-loaded');
        };

        container.addEventListener('load', handleReady, true);
        container.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', handleReady, true);

        container.addEventListener('error', event => {
            const media = event.target;
            if (!media.matches?.(mediaSelector)) return;

            const card = media.closest(cardSelector);
            if (!card) return;

            card.classList.add('is-broken');
            if (hideBroken) card.hidden = true;
        }, true);

        container.addEventListener('pointerover', event => {
            const video = event.target.closest?.(`video${mediaSelector}`);
            if (!video || !container.contains(video)) return;

            cancelDelayedVideoPause(video);
            ensure(video);
            video.play().catch(() => {});
        });

        container.addEventListener('pointerout', event => {
            const video = event.target.closest?.(`video${mediaSelector}`);
            if (!video || !container.contains(video)) return;

            const card = video.closest(cardSelector);
            if (card?.contains(event.relatedTarget)) return;
            video.pause();
        });
    };

    return { observe, ensure, releaseWithin, revealImage, bindSurface };
})();

window.FuraiGalleryMedia = FuraiGalleryMedia;

// Shared bounded feed for wallpaper surfaces.
// It creates only a few rows, then appends more before the user reaches the end.
const FuraiGalleryFeed = (() => {
    const states = new WeakMap();

    const normalizeObserverRoot = root => {
        if (
            !root ||
            root === document.scrollingElement ||
            root === document.documentElement ||
            root === document.body
        ) {
            return null;
        }
        return root;
    };

    const stop = grid => {
        const state = grid ? states.get(grid) : null;
        if (!state) return;

        if (state.observer) state.observer.disconnect();
        if (state.frame) cancelAnimationFrame(state.frame);
        state.sentinel?.remove();
        states.delete(grid);
    };

    const getColumnCount = (grid, options) => {
        const width = Math.max(
            280,
            grid.clientWidth || grid.parentElement?.clientWidth || window.innerWidth || 280
        );
        const breakpoint = Number(options.mobileBreakpoint) || 640;
        const mobileColumns = Math.max(1, Number(options.mobileColumns) || 2);
        if (width <= breakpoint) return mobileColumns;

        const minCardWidth = Math.max(80, Number(options.minCardWidth) || 210);
        const gap = Math.max(0, Number(options.gap) || 0);
        return Math.max(1, Math.floor((width + gap) / (minCardWidth + gap)));
    };

    const render = options => {
        const grid = options?.grid;
        const items = Array.isArray(options?.items) ? options.items : [];
        const createItem = options?.createItem;

        if (!grid || typeof createItem !== 'function') return;
        stop(grid);
        if (!grid.isConnected || !items.length) return;

        let index = 0;
        const state = { observer: null, frame: 0, sentinel: null };
        states.set(grid, state);

        const scrollRoot = options.scrollRoot || getGalleryScrollOwner(grid);
        const observerRoot = normalizeObserverRoot(scrollRoot);
        const isValid = () => (
            grid.isConnected &&
            states.get(grid) === state &&
            (typeof options.renderValid !== 'function' || options.renderValid())
        );

        const appendBatch = () => {
            if (!isValid()) return false;

            const initial = index === 0;
            const columns = getColumnCount(grid, options);
            const rows = initial
                ? Math.max(1, Number(options.initialRows) || 4)
                : Math.max(1, Number(options.nextRows) || 3);
            const cap = initial
                ? Math.max(columns, Number(options.maxInitial) || 32)
                : Math.max(columns, Number(options.maxNext) || 24);
            const ordinaryBatchSize = Math.min(columns * rows, cap);
            const requestedInitialCount = initial
                ? Math.max(0, Number(options.initialCount) || 0)
                : 0;
            const batchSize = initial
                ? Math.max(ordinaryBatchSize, requestedInitialCount)
                : ordinaryBatchSize;
            const end = Math.min(index + batchSize, items.length);
            const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
            const mediaToObserve = [];

            for (; index < end; index++) {
                const card = createItem(items[index], index);
                if (!card) continue;

                card.querySelectorAll?.('[data-furai-media-src]').forEach(media => {
                    mediaToObserve.push(media);
                });
                fragment.appendChild(card);
            }

            grid.appendChild(fragment);
            mediaToObserve.forEach(media => FuraiGalleryMedia.observe(media, scrollRoot));
            if (typeof options.onBatch === 'function') options.onBatch(index, items.length);
            return index < items.length;
        };

        if (!appendBatch()) {
            states.delete(grid);
            return;
        }

        const sentinel = document.createElement('div');
        sentinel.className = 'furai-gallery-load-sentinel';
        sentinel.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        sentinel.style.cssText = 'height:1px; margin:-1px 0 24px; pointer-events:none;';
        grid.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', sentinel);
        state.sentinel = sentinel;

        const finish = () => {
            if (state.observer) state.observer.disconnect();
            if (state.frame) cancelAnimationFrame(state.frame);
            sentinel.remove();
            states.delete(grid);
        };

        const scheduleBatch = () => {
            if (state.frame || !isValid()) return;

            state.frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                state.frame = 0;
                if (!appendBatch()) {
                    finish();
                    return;
                }

                // Re-observe a sentinel that remains inside the preload zone,
                // filling only enough rows ahead of the current viewport.
                if (state.observer && sentinel.isConnected) {
                    state.observer.unobserve(sentinel);
                    state.frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                        state.frame = 0;
                        if (state.observer && sentinel.isConnected && isValid()) {
                            state.observer.observe(sentinel);
                        }
                    });
                }
            });
        };

        if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
            state.observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
                if (entries.some(entry => entry.isIntersecting)) scheduleBatch();
            }, {
                root: observerRoot,
                rootMargin: options.feedRootMargin || '600px 0px',
                threshold: 0
            });
            state.observer.observe(sentinel);
            return;
        }

        const appendFallbackBatch = () => {
            state.frame = 0;
            if (!appendBatch()) {
                finish();
                return;
            }
            state.frame = requestAnimationFrame(appendFallbackBatch);
        };
        state.frame = requestAnimationFrame(appendFallbackBatch);
    };

    return { render, stop };
})();

window.FuraiGalleryFeed = FuraiGalleryFeed;

function getGalleryScrollOwner(element) {
    let node = element?.parentElement || null;

    while (node && node !== document.body) {
        const style = getComputedStyle(node);
        if (/(auto|scroll|overlay)/.test(style.overflowY) && node.scrollHeight > node.clientHeight + 1) {
            return node;
        }
        node = node.parentElement;
    }

    return document.scrollingElement || document.documentElement;
}

function captureBackgroundHistoryScrollAnchor(container) {
    if (!container || container.dataset.bgRendered !== '1' || container.style.display === 'none') return null;

    const owner = getGalleryScrollOwner(container);
    if (!owner) return null;

    const isDocumentOwner = owner === document.scrollingElement || owner === document.documentElement || owner === document.body;
    const ownerRect = isDocumentOwner
        ? { top: 0, bottom: window.innerHeight }
        : owner.getBoundingClientRect();

    const anchor = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('.bg-history-item[data-bg-url]:not([hidden])'))
        .find(item => {
            const rect = item.getBoundingClientRect();
            return rect.bottom > ownerRect.top && rect.top < ownerRect.bottom;
        });

    return {
        owner,
        isDocumentOwner,
        scrollTop: isDocumentOwner ? window.scrollY : owner.scrollTop,
        url: anchor?.dataset.bgUrl || '',
        offset: anchor ? anchor.getBoundingClientRect().top - ownerRect.top : 0
    };
}

function restoreBackgroundHistoryScrollAnchor(state, container) {
    if (!state || !container) return;

    let nextScrollTop = state.scrollTop;

    if (state.url) {
        const anchor = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('.bg-history-item[data-bg-url]'))
            .find(item => item.dataset.bgUrl === state.url);

        if (anchor) {
            const ownerTop = state.isDocumentOwner ? 0 : state.owner.getBoundingClientRect().top;
            nextScrollTop += anchor.getBoundingClientRect().top - ownerTop - state.offset;
        }
    }

    if (state.isDocumentOwner) {
        window.scrollTo(window.scrollX, nextScrollTop);
    } else {
        state.owner.scrollTop = nextScrollTop;
    }
}

function getBackgroundHistoryRenderer(containerId) {
    if (containerId === 'localBgHistory') return renderLocalBgHistory;
    if (containerId === 'entryBgHistory') return renderEntryBgHistory;
    return renderGlobalBgHistory;
}

function queueBackgroundHistorySearch(containerId) {
    const pendingFrame = backgroundHistorySearchFrames.get(containerId);
    if (pendingFrame) cancelAnimationFrame(pendingFrame);

    const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        backgroundHistorySearchFrames.delete(containerId);
        filterBackgroundHistoryUI(containerId);
    });

    backgroundHistorySearchFrames.set(containerId, frame);
}

function filterBackgroundHistoryUI(containerId) {
    const renderer = getBackgroundHistoryRenderer(containerId);
    if (typeof renderer === 'function') renderer();
}

function getBackgroundHistorySearchQuery(containerId) {
    const inputMap = {
        localBgHistory: 'localBgSearchInput',
        globalBgHistory: 'globalBgSearchInput',
        entryBgHistory: 'entryBgSearchInput'
    };

    const inputId = inputMap[containerId] || 'globalBgSearchInput';
    const el = document.getElementById(inputId);

    return el ? el.value.toLowerCase().trim() : '';
}

function renderLocalBgHistory(historyOverride = null) {
    const previewLayer = document.getElementById('localBgPreviewLayer');

    const combinedUpdater = (url) => {
        const cleanUrl = String(url || '').trim();
        const input = document.getElementById('bgUrlInput');

        if (input) input.value = cleanUrl;

        if (previewLayer) {
            applyBackgroundPreviewVisual(previewLayer, cleanUrl);
        }

        updateBackgroundPreview(cleanUrl);

        if (!cleanUrl) {
            const bgCtn = document.getElementById('chatBackgroundCtn');

            if (bgCtn) {
                applyBackgroundVisual(bgCtn, '');
                bgCtn.style.opacity = '';
                applyBackgroundBlurToLayer(bgCtn, 0);
            }
        }
    };
    renderBackgroundHistoryUI('localBgHistory', 'bgUrlInput', combinedUpdater, historyOverride);
}

function renderGlobalBgHistory(historyOverride = null) {
    const globalGridUpdater = (url) => {
        const bgLayer = document.getElementById('globalBgPreviewLayer');
        if (bgLayer) {
            applyBackgroundPreviewVisual(bgLayer, url);
        }
        previewLiveHomeResearcherBackground();
    };
    renderBackgroundHistoryUI('globalBgHistory', 'globalBgUrl', globalGridUpdater, historyOverride);
}

let entryBgInputDebounce = null;

function handleEntryBackgroundInput(value) {
    window.furaiEntryBgPreviewDirty = true;

    if (entryBgInputDebounce) clearTimeout(entryBgInputDebounce);

    entryBgInputDebounce = setTimeout(() => {
        const rawLines = String(value || '').split(/\r?\n/);
        const parsedEntries = rawLines
            .map(parseBackgroundArchiveLine)
            .filter(Boolean);

        if (parsedEntries.length > 0) {
            const history = batchAddToHistory(parsedEntries);
            if (history) renderAllBackgroundHistories(history);
        }
    }, 350);
}

function renderEntryBgHistory(historyOverride = null) {
    const entryUpdater = (url) => {
        window.furaiEntryBgPreviewDirty = true;

        const cleanUrl = String(url || '').trim();
        const input = document.getElementById('entryBgUrl');
        const bgLayer = document.getElementById('entryBgPreviewLayer');

        if (input) input.value = cleanUrl;

        previewFuraiEntryBackgroundSettings();
    };
    renderBackgroundHistoryUI('entryBgHistory', 'entryBgUrl', entryUpdater, historyOverride);
}

function renderAllBackgroundHistories(historyOverride = null) {
    const history = Array.isArray(historyOverride) ? historyOverride : ensureHistoryInit();
    renderLocalBgHistory(history);
    renderGlobalBgHistory(history);
    renderEntryBgHistory(history);
}

const FURAI_ENTRY_RANDOM_WALLPAPER_KEY = 'furai_entry_bg_random';
let furaiSessionRandomHomeWallpaperUrl = '';
let furaiPrivacyLockUnlocked = false;

function getFuraiEntryRandomWallpaperEnabled() {
    const saved = DB.get(FURAI_ENTRY_RANDOM_WALLPAPER_KEY);
    if (saved != null) return saved === true || saved === 'true' || saved === 1 || saved === '1';
    const enabled = DB.get('furai_entry_bg') == null;
    DB.set(FURAI_ENTRY_RANDOM_WALLPAPER_KEY, enabled);
    return enabled;
}

function getFuraiGlobalRandomWallpaperEnabled(mode) {
    const saved = DB.get(`global-bg-random-${mode}`);
    return saved === true || saved === 'true' || saved === 1 || saved === '1';
}

function pickFuraiRandomWallpaperUrl() {
    let chosen = '';
    let count = 0;

    for (const entry of ensureHistoryInit() || []) {
        const url = getBackgroundArchiveUrl(entry);
        if (!url) continue;
        count += 1;
        if (Math.random() * count < 1) chosen = url;
    }

    return chosen;
}

function getFuraiSessionRandomHomeWallpaperUrl(options = {}) {
    if (options.refresh === true) furaiSessionRandomHomeWallpaperUrl = '';
    if (!furaiSessionRandomHomeWallpaperUrl) furaiSessionRandomHomeWallpaperUrl = pickFuraiRandomWallpaperUrl();
    return furaiSessionRandomHomeWallpaperUrl;
}

function previewFuraiEntryBackgroundSettings(options = {}) {
    const layer = document.getElementById('entryBgPreviewLayer');
    if (!layer) return;

    const randomToggle = document.getElementById('entryBgRandomToggle');
    const fixedUrl = getBackgroundPreviewUrlFromInput(document.getElementById('entryBgUrl')?.value || '');
    const useRandom = randomToggle ? randomToggle.checked : getFuraiEntryRandomWallpaperEnabled();
    const previewUrl = useRandom
        ? (getFuraiSessionRandomHomeWallpaperUrl({ refresh: options.refreshRandom === true }) || fixedUrl)
        : fixedUrl;

    applyBackgroundPreviewVisual(layer, previewUrl);
    previewEntryHomeBackground();
}

function getFactoryEntryHomeBackgroundUrl() {
    return "https://user.uploads.dev/file/0628e9c6eb14cc6a05f00ad812bcb1ad.webm";
}

function getFactoryEntryHomeBackgroundBlur() {
    return '3';
}

function getSavedOrFactoryEntryBgValue(key, factoryValue) {
    let savedValue;

    try {
        savedValue = DB.get(key);
    } catch (e) {
        savedValue = undefined;
    }

    // Important:
    // undefined/null = user never chose anything yet, so use factory default.
    // "" = user intentionally chose no background, so keep no background.
    if (savedValue === undefined || savedValue === null) {
        return factoryValue;
    }

    return savedValue;
}

function getEntryHomeBackgroundData() {
    const fixedBgUrl = getSavedOrFactoryEntryBgValue('furai_entry_bg', getFactoryEntryHomeBackgroundUrl());
    const bgOpacity = getSavedOrFactoryEntryBgValue('furai_entry_bg_opacity', '1');
    const bgBlur = getSavedOrFactoryEntryBgValue('furai_entry_bg_blur', getFactoryEntryHomeBackgroundBlur());
    const bgUrl = getFuraiEntryRandomWallpaperEnabled()
        ? (getFuraiSessionRandomHomeWallpaperUrl() || fixedBgUrl)
        : fixedBgUrl;

    return { bgUrl, bgOpacity, bgBlur };
}

function getFuraiBackgroundBlurState(layer) {
    let state = furaiBackgroundBlurStates.get(layer);

    if (!state) {
        state = {
            token: 0,
            blur: 0,
            url: '',
            type: '',
            source: null,
            canvas: null,
            baseCanvas: document.createElement('canvas'),
            paddedCanvas: document.createElement('canvas'),
            blurredCanvas: document.createElement('canvas'),
            resizeObserver: null,
            resizeRaf: 0,
            frameHandle: 0,
            frameMode: '',
            lastFrameTime: 0
        };

        furaiBackgroundBlurStates.set(layer, state);
    }

    return state;
}

function cancelFuraiBackgroundBlurFrame(state) {
    if (!state) return;

    if (state.frameMode === 'video' && state.frameHandle && state.source?.cancelVideoFrameCallback) {
        try { state.source.cancelVideoFrameCallback(state.frameHandle); } catch (e) {}
    } else if (state.frameHandle) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(state.frameHandle);
    }

    state.frameHandle = 0;
    state.frameMode = '';
    state.lastFrameTime = 0;
}

function restoreFuraiBackgroundSource(layer) {
    if (!layer) return;

    const type = layer.dataset.furaiBgType || '';
    const url = layer.dataset.furaiBgUrl || '';

    if (type === 'image') {
        layer.style.backgroundImage = url
            ? `url('${url.replace(/'/g, "%27")}')`
            : '';
    }

    layer.querySelectorAll('video').forEach(video => {
        video.style.visibility = '';
    });
}

function stopFuraiBackgroundBitmapBlur(layer, options = {}) {
    if (!layer) return;

    const state = furaiBackgroundBlurStates.get(layer);
    if (!state) {
        if (options.restoreSource !== false) restoreFuraiBackgroundSource(layer);
        return;
    }

    state.token += 1;
    cancelFuraiBackgroundBlurFrame(state);

    if (state.resizeRaf) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(state.resizeRaf);
        state.resizeRaf = 0;
    }

    if (state.resizeObserver) {
        state.resizeObserver.disconnect();
        state.resizeObserver = null;
    }

    state.source = null;
    state.url = '';
    state.type = '';
    state.blur = 0;

    if (state.canvas) {
        state.canvas.style.display = 'none';

        if (options.removeCanvas === true) {
            state.canvas.remove();
            state.canvas = null;
        }
    }

    if (options.restoreSource !== false) {
        restoreFuraiBackgroundSource(layer);
    }
}

function ensureFuraiBackgroundBlurCanvas(layer, state) {
    if (!state.canvas || !state.canvas.isConnected) {
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.className = 'furai-bg-bitmap-blur';
        canvas.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        layer.appendChild(canvas);
        state.canvas = canvas;
    }

    const position = getComputedStyle(layer).position;
    if (position === 'static') layer.style.position = 'relative';
    layer.style.overflow = 'hidden';

    return state.canvas;
}

function getFuraiBackgroundBlurMetrics(layer, blur, dynamicSource) {
    const rect = layer.getBoundingClientRect();
    const cssWidth = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.width || layer.clientWidth || 1));
    const cssHeight = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.height || layer.clientHeight || 1));
    const maxPixels = dynamicSource ? 921600 : 2073600;
    const renderScale = Math.min(1, Math.sqrt(maxPixels / (cssWidth * cssHeight)));
    const width = Math.max(1, Math.round(cssWidth * renderScale));
    const height = Math.max(1, Math.round(cssHeight * renderScale));
    const blurPx = Math.max(0.01, blur * renderScale);
    const padding = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(blurPx * 3));

    return { width, height, blurPx, padding };
}

function sizeFuraiCanvas(canvas, width, height) {
    if (canvas.width !== width) canvas.width = width;
    if (canvas.height !== height) canvas.height = height;
}

function drawFuraiBackgroundCover(ctx, source, width, height) {
    const sourceWidth = Number(source.videoWidth || source.naturalWidth || source.width || 0);
    const sourceHeight = Number(source.videoHeight || source.naturalHeight || source.height || 0);
    if (!sourceWidth || !sourceHeight) return false;

    const sourceRatio = sourceWidth / sourceHeight;
    const targetRatio = width / height;
    let sx = 0;
    let sy = 0;
    let sw = sourceWidth;
    let sh = sourceHeight;

    if (sourceRatio > targetRatio) {
        sw = sourceHeight * targetRatio;
        sx = (sourceWidth - sw) / 2;
    } else if (sourceRatio < targetRatio) {
        sh = sourceWidth / targetRatio;
        sy = (sourceHeight - sh) / 2;
    }

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
    ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';
    ctx.drawImage(source, sx, sy, sw, sh, 0, 0, width, height);
    return true;
}

function extendFuraiBackgroundEdges(ctx, sourceCanvas, width, height, padding) {
    const fullWidth = width + (padding * 2);
    const fullHeight = height + (padding * 2);

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, fullWidth, fullHeight);
    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
    ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';

    ctx.drawImage(sourceCanvas, padding, padding);

    // Duplicate the exact outermost pixels into the blur padding.
    ctx.drawImage(sourceCanvas, 0, 0, 1, height, 0, padding, padding, height);
    ctx.drawImage(sourceCanvas, width - 1, 0, 1, height, padding + width, padding, padding, height);
    ctx.drawImage(sourceCanvas, 0, 0, width, 1, padding, 0, width, padding);
    ctx.drawImage(sourceCanvas, 0, height - 1, width, 1, padding, padding + height, width, padding);

    ctx.drawImage(sourceCanvas, 0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0, padding, padding);
    ctx.drawImage(sourceCanvas, width - 1, 0, 1, 1, padding + width, 0, padding, padding);
    ctx.drawImage(sourceCanvas, 0, height - 1, 1, 1, 0, padding + height, padding, padding);
    ctx.drawImage(sourceCanvas, width - 1, height - 1, 1, 1, padding + width, padding + height, padding, padding);
}

function renderFuraiBackgroundBitmapBlur(layer, state, source, dynamicSource = false) {
    if (!layer?.isConnected || !source || state.blur <= 0) return false;

    const metrics = getFuraiBackgroundBlurMetrics(layer, state.blur, dynamicSource);
    const { width, height, blurPx, padding } = metrics;
    const paddedWidth = width + (padding * 2);
    const paddedHeight = height + (padding * 2);
    const outputCanvas = ensureFuraiBackgroundBlurCanvas(layer, state);

    sizeFuraiCanvas(state.baseCanvas, width, height);
    sizeFuraiCanvas(state.paddedCanvas, paddedWidth, paddedHeight);
    sizeFuraiCanvas(state.blurredCanvas, paddedWidth, paddedHeight);
    sizeFuraiCanvas(outputCanvas, width, height);

    const baseCtx = state.baseCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const paddedCtx = state.paddedCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const blurredCtx = state.blurredCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const outputCtx = outputCanvas.getContext('2d');

    if (!baseCtx || !paddedCtx || !blurredCtx || !outputCtx) return false;
    if (!drawFuraiBackgroundCover(baseCtx, source, width, height)) return false;

    extendFuraiBackgroundEdges(paddedCtx, state.baseCanvas, width, height, padding);

    blurredCtx.clearRect(0, 0, paddedWidth, paddedHeight);
    blurredCtx.filter = `blur(${blurPx}px)`;
    blurredCtx.drawImage(state.paddedCanvas, 0, 0);
    blurredCtx.filter = 'none';

    outputCtx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
    outputCtx.drawImage(
        state.blurredCanvas,
        padding,
        padding,
        width,
        height,
        0,
        0,
        width,
        height
    );

    outputCanvas.style.display = 'block';

    if (state.type === 'image') {
        layer.style.backgroundImage = 'none';
    } else {
        layer.querySelectorAll('video').forEach(video => {
            video.style.visibility = 'hidden';
        });
    }

    return true;
}

function observeFuraiBackgroundBlurSize(layer, state, render) {
    if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'function') return;

    const persistentResizableLayers = new Set([
        'chatBackgroundCtn',
        'entryBgPreviewLayer',
        'globalLoaderBgLayer',
        'privacyLockBgLayer'
    ]);

    if (!persistentResizableLayers.has(layer.id)) return;

    state.resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
        if (!layer.isConnected) {
            stopFuraiBackgroundBitmapBlur(layer, {
                removeCanvas: true,
                restoreSource: false
            });
            return;
        }

        if (state.resizeRaf) cancelAnimationFrame(state.resizeRaf);

        state.resizeRaf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            state.resizeRaf = 0;
            render();
        });
    });

    state.resizeObserver.observe(layer);
}

function startFuraiDynamicBackgroundBlur(layer, state, source, token, mode) {
    const minimumFrameGap = mode === 'video' ? 33 : 50;

    const renderFrame = now => {
        if (!layer.isConnected) {
            stopFuraiBackgroundBitmapBlur(layer, {
                removeCanvas: true,
                restoreSource: false
            });
            return;
        }

        if (state.token !== token || state.blur <= 0) return;

        if (
            document.visibilityState !== 'hidden' &&
            layer.getClientRects().length &&
            (!state.lastFrameTime || now - state.lastFrameTime >= minimumFrameGap)
        ) {
            renderFuraiBackgroundBitmapBlur(layer, state, source, true);
            state.lastFrameTime = now;
        }

        if (mode === 'video' && source.requestVideoFrameCallback) {
            state.frameMode = 'video';
            state.frameHandle = source.requestVideoFrameCallback(renderFrame);
        } else {
            state.frameMode = 'raf';
            state.frameHandle = requestAnimationFrame(renderFrame);
        }
    };

    renderFrame(performance.now());
}

function applyBackgroundBlurToLayer(layer, blurValue = 0) {
    if (!layer) return;

    const blur = Math.max(0, Number.parseFloat(blurValue) || 0);
    layer.dataset.blur = String(blur);
    layer.style.filter = 'none';
    layer.style.transform = 'none';
    layer.style.transformOrigin = '';

    stopFuraiBackgroundBitmapBlur(layer, {
        removeCanvas: false,
        restoreSource: true
    });

    if (blur <= 0) return;

    const url = String(layer.dataset.furaiBgUrl || '').trim();
    const type = layer.dataset.furaiBgType || (isBackgroundVideoUrl(url) ? 'video' : 'image');
    if (!url) return;

    const state = getFuraiBackgroundBlurState(layer);
    const token = state.token;
    state.blur = blur;
    state.url = url;
    state.type = type;

    if (type === 'video') {
        const video = layer.querySelector('video');
        if (!video) return;

        state.source = video;

        const begin = () => {
            if (state.token !== token || video.readyState < 2) return;

            renderFuraiBackgroundBitmapBlur(layer, state, video, true);
            startFuraiDynamicBackgroundBlur(layer, state, video, token, 'video');
            observeFuraiBackgroundBlurSize(layer, state, () => {
                renderFuraiBackgroundBitmapBlur(layer, state, video, true);
            });
        };

        if (video.readyState >= 2) {
            begin();
        } else {
            video.addEventListener('loadeddata', begin, { once: true });
        }

        return;
    }

    const image = new Image();
    state.source = image;

    let imageReadyHandled = false;

    const renderImage = () => {
        if (imageReadyHandled || state.token !== token || !image.naturalWidth || !image.naturalHeight) return;
        imageReadyHandled = true;

        renderFuraiBackgroundBitmapBlur(layer, state, image, false);

        if (/\.gif(?:[?#].*)?$/i.test(url)) {
            startFuraiDynamicBackgroundBlur(layer, state, image, token, 'image');
        }

        observeFuraiBackgroundBlurSize(layer, state, () => {
            renderFuraiBackgroundBitmapBlur(layer, state, image, false);
        });
    };

    image.addEventListener('load', renderImage, { once: true });
    image.addEventListener('error', () => {
        if (state.token !== token) return;
        stopFuraiBackgroundBitmapBlur(layer, {
            removeCanvas: false,
            restoreSource: true
        });
    }, { once: true });
    image.src = url;

    if (image.complete && image.naturalWidth) {
        renderImage();
    }
}

function applyBackgroundStateToLayer(layer, bgUrl, bgOpacity, bgBlur) {
    if (!layer) return;

    const cleanUrl = String(bgUrl || '').trim();
    const opacity = String(bgOpacity || '1');
    const blur = Math.max(0, Number.parseFloat(bgBlur) || 0);

    if (cleanUrl) {
        applyBackgroundVisual(layer, cleanUrl);
        layer.style.opacity = opacity;
        applyBackgroundBlurToLayer(layer, blur);
    } else {
        applyBackgroundVisual(layer, '');
        layer.style.opacity = '';
        applyBackgroundBlurToLayer(layer, 0);
    }
}

function applyEntryGateBackground() {
    const state = getEntryHomeBackgroundData();
    const locked = !furaiPrivacyLockUnlocked && [true, 'true'].includes(DB.get('furai_acc_locked'));

    [
        [document.getElementById('globalLoaderBgLayer'), true],
        [document.getElementById('privacyLockBgLayer'), locked]
    ].forEach(([layer, show]) => {
        if (!layer) return;
        const url = show ? state.bgUrl : '';
        applyBackgroundPreviewVisual(layer, url);
        layer.style.opacity = url ? state.bgOpacity : '0';
        applyBackgroundBlurToLayer(layer, show && url ? state.bgBlur : 0);
    });
}

function previewEntryHomeBackground() {
    window.furaiEntryBgPreviewDirty = true;

    if (!currentChatId) return;

    let chatData = null;
    try { chatData = DB.get(currentChatId); } catch (e) {}

    if (!chatData || chatData.personality !== 'home') return;

    const bgCtn = document.getElementById('chatBackgroundCtn');
    const bgLayer = document.getElementById('entryBgPreviewLayer');
    const opInput = document.getElementById('entryBgOpacity');
    const blurInput = document.getElementById('entryBgBlur');

    if (!bgCtn || !bgLayer) return;

    const liveUrl = bgLayer.dataset.url || '';
    const liveOpacity = opInput ? opInput.value : '1';
    const liveBlur = blurInput ? blurInput.value : '0';

    applyBackgroundStateToLayer(bgCtn, liveUrl, liveOpacity, liveBlur);
}

const backgroundHistoryRenderContexts = new Map();

const FURAI_WALLPAPER_GRID_OPTIONS = Object.freeze({
    minCardWidth: 180,
    gap: 12,
    mobileColumns: 2,
    initialRows: 4,
    nextRows: 3,
    maxInitial: 24,
    maxNext: 18,

function createFuraiWallpaperCard(options = {}) {
    const url = String(options.url || '').trim();
    if (!url) return null;

    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = ['furai-wallpaper-card', options.className || ''].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
    card.title = String(options.title || '');
    card.tabIndex = 0;
    card.setAttribute('role', 'button');
    card.setAttribute('aria-label', String(options.ariaLabel || options.title || 'Open wallpaper'));

    if (options.selected === true) card.classList.add('is-selected');
    if (typeof options.setupCard === 'function') options.setupCard(card);

    const isVideo = options.isVideo === true;
    const media = document.createElement(isVideo ? 'video' : 'img');
    media.className = ['furai-wallpaper-media', options.mediaClassName || ''].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
    media.dataset.furaiMediaSrc = url;

    if (isVideo) {
        media.muted = true;
        media.loop = true;
        media.autoplay = false;
        media.playsInline = true;
        media.preload = 'none';
        media.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Muted video wallpaper preview');
    } else {
        media.loading = 'lazy';
        media.decoding = 'async';
        media.fetchPriority = 'low';
        media.alt = String(options.alt || '');
    }

    card.appendChild(media);

    if (isVideo) {
        const videoBadge = document.createElement('span');
        videoBadge.className = 'furai-wallpaper-video-badge';
        videoBadge.title = 'Video wallpaper';
        videoBadge.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-video"></i>';
        card.appendChild(videoBadge);
    }

    if (typeof options.decorateCard === 'function') {
        options.decorateCard(card, media);
    }

    return card;
}

function renderFuraiWallpaperGrid(options = {}) {
    const grid = options.grid;
    const items = Array.isArray(options.items) ? options.items : [];

    if (!grid || !items.length || typeof options.createItem !== 'function') return;

    FuraiGalleryFeed.render({
        ...FURAI_WALLPAPER_GRID_OPTIONS,
        items,
        grid,
        createItem: options.createItem,
        scrollRoot: options.scrollRoot || getGalleryScrollOwner(grid),
        initialCount: Number(options.initialCount) || 0,
        renderValid: typeof options.renderValid === 'function'
            ? options.renderValid
            : () => grid.isConnected
    });
}

function bindBackgroundHistoryGallery(container) {
    if (!container || container.dataset.bgGalleryEventsBound === '1') return;
    container.dataset.bgGalleryEventsBound = '1';

    container.addEventListener('click', event => {
        const context = backgroundHistoryRenderContexts.get(container.id);
        if (!context) return;

        const deleteBtn = event.target.closest('[data-bg-delete]');
        if (deleteBtn && container.contains(deleteBtn)) {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();
            const card = deleteBtn.closest('.bg-history-item[data-bg-url]');
            if (card?.dataset.bgUrl) {
                removeFromBackgroundHistory(
                    card.dataset.bgUrl,
                    container.id,
                    context.inputId,
                    context.previewFunc
                );
            }
            return;
        }

        const tile = event.target.closest('.bg-history-item');
        if (!tile || !container.contains(tile)) return;

        const { randomToggle, isEntry, inputId, previewFunc } = context;
        const action = tile.dataset.bgAction || '';

        if (action === 'random') {
            if (randomToggle) randomToggle.checked = true;
            container.querySelectorAll('.bg-history-item.is-selected').forEach(item => item.classList.remove('is-selected'));
            tile.classList.add('is-selected');
            if (isEntry) previewFuraiEntryBackgroundSettings({ refreshRandom: true });
            else if (typeof previewFunc === 'function') previewFunc(pickFuraiRandomWallpaperUrl());
            return;
        }

        if (action === 'none') {
            if (randomToggle) randomToggle.checked = false;
            const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
            if (input) input.value = '';
            if (typeof previewFunc === 'function') previewFunc('');
            else updateBackgroundPreview('');
            container.querySelectorAll('.bg-history-item.is-selected').forEach(item => item.classList.remove('is-selected'));
            tile.classList.add('is-selected');
            return;
        }

        const url = String(tile.dataset.bgUrl || '').trim();
        if (!url) return;

        if (randomToggle) randomToggle.checked = false;
        const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
        if (input) input.value = url;
        if (typeof previewFunc === 'function') previewFunc(url);
        container.querySelectorAll('.bg-history-item.is-selected').forEach(item => item.classList.remove('is-selected'));
        tile.classList.add('is-selected');
    });

    container.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
        if (event.key !== 'Enter' && event.key !== ' ') return;
        if (event.target.closest('button, a, input, textarea, select, [contenteditable="true"]')) return;
        const tile = event.target.closest('.bg-history-item[role="button"]');
        if (!tile || !container.contains(tile)) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        tile.click();
    });
}

function createBackgroundHistoryCard(entry, context) {
    const url = getBackgroundArchiveUrl(entry);
    if (!url) return null;

    return createFuraiWallpaperCard({
        url,
        title: getBackgroundArchiveTooltip(entry),
        ariaLabel: getBackgroundArchiveTooltip(entry) || 'Choose wallpaper',
        className: 'bg-history-item',
        mediaClassName: isBackgroundVideoUrl(url) ? 'bg-history-media bg-video-preview' : 'bg-history-media',
        isVideo: isBackgroundVideoUrl(url),
        selected: !context.randomEnabled && url === context.activeInputValue,
        setupCard: card => {
            card.dataset.bgSearch = getBackgroundArchiveSearchText(entry);
            card.dataset.bgUrl = url;
        },
        decorateCard: card => {
            const deleteButton = document.createElement('button');
            deleteButton.type = 'button';
            deleteButton.className = 'bg-history-delete';
            deleteButton.dataset.bgDelete = '1';
            deleteButton.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Remove wallpaper from archive');
            deleteButton.innerHTML = '&times;';
            card.appendChild(deleteButton);
        }
    });
}

/* --- SHARED WALLPAPER ARCHIVE RENDERER --- */
function renderBackgroundHistoryUI(containerId, inputId, previewFunc, historyOverride = null) {
    const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
    if (!container) return;

    const history = Array.isArray(historyOverride) ? historyOverride : ensureHistoryInit();
    const isLocal = containerId === 'localBgHistory';
    const isEntry = containerId === 'entryBgHistory';
    const savedOpen = container.dataset.bgOpen ? container.dataset.bgOpen === '1' : isLocal;
    const searchQuery = getBackgroundHistorySearchQuery(containerId);
    const forceOpenBySearch = !!searchQuery;
    const isOpen = savedOpen || forceOpenBySearch;
    const scrollAnchor = isOpen && !searchQuery
        ? captureBackgroundHistoryScrollAnchor(container)
        : null;

    FuraiGalleryFeed.stop(container);
    FuraiGalleryMedia.releaseWithin(container);
    container.classList.add('furai-wallpaper-grid');
    container.style.display = isOpen ? 'grid' : 'none';
    container.replaceChildren();
    container.dataset.bgRendered = '0';

    const headerId = isLocal
        ? 'localBgHistoryHeader'
        : (isEntry ? 'entryBgHistoryHeader' : 'globalBgHistoryHeader');
    const header = document.getElementById(headerId);

    if (header) {
        header.style.display = 'flex';
        header.style.alignItems = 'center';
        header.style.cursor = 'pointer';
        header.style.userSelect = 'none';
        header.style.padding = '4px 0';
        header.style.gap = '12px';

        const titleLabel = isLocal
            ? 'Recent Archives'
            : (isEntry ? 'Shared Background Archive' : 'Recent Archives (Global Sync)');
        const arrowIcon = isOpen ? 'fa-chevron-up' : 'fa-chevron-down';
        const arrowText = forceOpenBySearch && !savedOpen ? 'Search' : (isOpen ? 'Hide' : 'Show');

        header.innerHTML = `
            <span><i class="fa-solid fa-clock-rotate-left" style="margin-right:6px;"></i>${titleLabel} <span style="opacity:0.5; font-size:0.9em;">(${history.length})</span></span>
            <span id="${containerId}_toggle_text" style="font-size:11px; font-weight:600; opacity:0.6; text-transform:uppercase;"><i class="fa-solid ${arrowIcon}"></i> ${arrowText}</span>`;
        header.onclick = () => {
            container.dataset.bgOpen = isOpen ? '0' : '1';
            renderBackgroundHistoryUI(containerId, inputId, previewFunc);
        };
    }

    if (!isOpen) return;

    const randomToggle = isEntry
        ? document.getElementById('entryBgRandomToggle')
        : (isLocal ? null : document.getElementById('globalBgRandomToggle'));
    const randomEnabled = randomToggle?.checked === true;
    const activeInputValue = String(document.getElementById(inputId)?.value || '').trim();
    const context = {
        containerId,
        inputId,
        previewFunc,
        isEntry,
        randomToggle,
        randomEnabled,
        activeInputValue
    };

    backgroundHistoryRenderContexts.set(containerId, context);
    bindBackgroundHistoryGallery(container);
    FuraiGalleryMedia.bindSurface(container, {
        bindKey: 'background-history',
        mediaSelector: '.furai-wallpaper-media',
        cardSelector: '.furai-wallpaper-card',
        hideBroken: true
    });

    if (randomToggle) {
        const randomTile = document.createElement('div');
        randomTile.className = 'bg-history-item bg-history-random-item furai-wallpaper-card';
        randomTile.dataset.bgAction = 'random';
        randomTile.title = 'Random Background Wallpaper';
        randomTile.tabIndex = 0;
        randomTile.setAttribute('role', 'button');
        randomTile.innerHTML = `
            <div class="bg-history-special-content">
                <span class="material-symbols-outlined">shuffle</span>
                <span>Random</span>
            </div>`;
        if (randomEnabled) randomTile.classList.add('is-selected');
        container.appendChild(randomTile);
    }

    const noneTile = document.createElement('div');
    noneTile.className = 'bg-history-item bg-history-none-item furai-wallpaper-card';
    noneTile.dataset.bgAction = 'none';
    noneTile.title = 'No background';
    noneTile.tabIndex = 0;
    noneTile.setAttribute('role', 'button');
    noneTile.innerHTML = `
        <div class="bg-history-special-content bg-history-none-content">
            <span class="material-symbols-outlined">hide_image</span>
            <span>None</span>
        </div>`;
    if (!randomEnabled && !activeInputValue) noneTile.classList.add('is-selected');
    container.appendChild(noneTile);

    const filteredHistory = history.filter(entry => {
        const url = getBackgroundArchiveUrl(entry);
        if (!url) return false;
        return matchesExpansionStyleSearch(searchQuery, getBackgroundArchiveSearchText(entry));
    });

    container.dataset.bgRendered = '1';

    if (!filteredHistory.length) {
        const empty = document.createElement('div');
        empty.dataset.bgEmpty = '1';
        empty.textContent = 'No matching wallpapers.';
        empty.style.cssText = 'grid-column:1 / -1; opacity:0.6; font-size:12px; padding:4px 2px;';
        container.appendChild(empty);
        restoreBackgroundHistoryScrollAnchor(scrollAnchor, container);
        return;
    }

    let initialCount = 0;
    if (scrollAnchor?.url) {
        const anchorIndex = filteredHistory.findIndex(entry => getBackgroundArchiveUrl(entry) === scrollAnchor.url);
        if (anchorIndex >= 0) initialCount = anchorIndex + 1;
    }

    renderFuraiWallpaperGrid({
        items: filteredHistory,
        grid: container,
        createItem: entry => createBackgroundHistoryCard(entry, context),
        scrollRoot: getGalleryScrollOwner(container),
        initialCount,
        renderValid: () => container.dataset.bgRendered === '1' && container.style.display !== 'none'
    });

    restoreBackgroundHistoryScrollAnchor(scrollAnchor, container);
}

/* --- SYSTEM RESET (Now restores history too) --- */
function resetGlobalBgToSystem(mode) {
    if(!confirm("Reset Background Settings?\n\nThis will clear the current background URL, reset opacity/blur, AND restore the default history list.")) return;

    // 1. Reset Inputs
    document.getElementById('globalBgUrl').value = '';
    
    // Opacity
    document.getElementById('globalBgOpacity').value = '1'; 
    document.getElementById('globalBgOpacityDisplay').textContent = '1.00';
    
    // Blur
    const blurIn = document.getElementById('globalBgBlur');
    const blurDisp = document.getElementById('globalBgBlurDisplay');
    if(blurIn) blurIn.value = '0';
    if(blurDisp) blurDisp.textContent = '0.0px'; // Updated format
    
    // 2. Update LOCAL PREVIEW
    const layer = document.getElementById('globalBgPreviewLayer');
    if(layer) {
        layer.style.backgroundImage = '';
        layer.style.opacity = '1';
        layer.style.filter = 'none';
        layer.dataset.url = ''; // CRITICAL FIX: Wipe the data tracker
    }

    // 3. WIPE FROM COMPRESSED DATABASE
    DB.remove(`global-bg-${mode}`);
    DB.remove(`global-bg-opacity-${mode}`);
    DB.remove(`global-bg-blur-${mode}`);
    DB.remove(`global-bg-random-${mode}`);

    // 4. Restore History Logic
    let history = [];
    try { history = DB.get('furai_background_history') || []; } catch(e) {}
    const seen = new Set(history.map(getBackgroundArchiveUrl).filter(Boolean));
    const merged = [...history];
    
    getFactoryBackgroundSeedEntries().forEach(entry => {
        const url = getBackgroundArchiveUrl(entry);
        if (!url || seen.has(url)) return;
    
        merged.push(entry);
        seen.add(url);
    });
    
    DB.set('furai_background_history', merged);

    // 5. Refresh Grid
    const globalGridUpdater = (url) => {
        const bgLayer = document.getElementById('globalBgPreviewLayer');
        if(bgLayer) {
            bgLayer.style.backgroundImage = url ? `url('${url}')` : '';
            bgLayer.dataset.url = url || '';
        }
    };
    renderBackgroundHistoryUI('globalBgHistory', 'globalBgUrl', globalGridUpdater);
    
    showToast("Background reset.", "success");
}

// 3. UNIFIED DATA MANAGER (UID Aware & Mapping Fixed)
function getProfileDataUnified(slotId, context) {
    // --- CRITICAL BUG FIX ---
    // Safely map the raw imported data to the unified internal format 
    // so `emotionAvatars` doesn't get lost as an undefined `avatars` variable.
    if (slotId === 'PENDING_IMPORT' && window._pendingImportData) {
        const raw = window._pendingImportData;
        return writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(copyCharacterOpeningExtras({
            uid: raw.uid || '',
            name: raw.name || '',
            hashTag: raw.hashTag || '',
            avatar: raw.avatar || '',
            defaultSprite: raw.defaultSprite || '',
            instruction: raw.instruction || '',
            openingMessage: raw.openingMessage || raw.customGreeting || raw.greeting || raw.initialMessage || '',
            emotions: raw.customEmotions || {},
            avatars: raw.emotionAvatars || {},      // <--- THIS WAS THE MISSING LINK
            emotionSprites: raw.emotionSprites || {}
        }, raw), raw);
    }
    
    let data = { 
        uid: '', name: '', hashTag: '', avatar: '', defaultSprite: '', instruction: '', openingMessage: '',
        openingBackground: '', openingBackgroundOpacity: '1', openingBackgroundBlur: '0', openingLorebook: '',
        groupRosterSourceUid: '', groupRosterSourceIndex: null,
        emotions: {}, avatars: {}, emotionSprites: {} 
    };

    let openingExtrasSource = null;
    
    if (context === 'local') {
        const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
        
        if (slotId === 'user' || slotId === 'local_user') {
            data.uid = profile.user.uid || '';
            data.name = profile.user.name;
            data.hashTag = profile.user.hashTag || ''; 
            data.avatar = profile.user.avatar;
            data.defaultSprite = profile.user.defaultSprite || '';
            const localUserMode = chatPersonalities[currentChatId] || getStoredChatPersonality(currentChatId);
            data.instruction = profile.user.instructions?.[localUserMode] ?? profile.user.instruction ?? '';
            data.openingMessage = profile.user.openingMessage || '';
            data.emotions = profile.user.customEmotions || {};
            data.avatars = profile.user.emotionAvatars || {};
            data.emotionSprites = profile.user.emotionSprites || {};
            openingExtrasSource = profile.user;
        }
        else if (slotId === 'wand' || slotId === 'local_wand') {
            try {
                const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
                data.uid = 'wand_local';
                data.name = chatData.enhancerName || DEFAULT_WAND_DISPLAY_NAME;
                data.hashTag = chatData.enhancerTag || ''; 
                data.avatar = chatData.enhancerAvatar || "https://user.uploads.dev/file/dc15d2a3877ade6e7319206259852fc5.jpg";
                data.instruction = chatData.enhancerInst || "";
                data.openingMessage = chatData.enhancerOpening || '';
                data.emotions = chatData.enhancerCustomEmotions || {};
                data.avatars = chatData.enhancerEmotionAvatars || {};
                data.emotionSprites = chatData.enhancerEmotionSprites || {};
                writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(data, getFuraiResolvedWandProtectedInstructionData(chatData));
                openingExtrasSource = chatData;
            } catch(e){}
        }
        else { 
            const idx = parseInt(slotId.toString().replace('local_bot_', ''));
            const storedBot = profile.bots[idx];
            const bot =
                chatPersonalities[currentChatId] === 'group' && storedBot?.rosterStub === true
                    ? resolveGroupRosterStubForDisplay(storedBot, idx)
                    : storedBot;

            if (bot) {
                data.uid = bot.uid || '';
                data.name = bot.name;
                data.hashTag = bot.hashTag || ''; 
                data.avatar = bot.avatar;
                data.defaultSprite = bot.defaultSprite || '';
                data.instruction = bot.instruction;
                data.openingMessage = bot.openingMessage || bot.customGreeting || bot.greeting || bot.initialMessage || '';
                data.groupRosterSourceUid = bot.groupRosterSourceUid || '';
                data.groupRosterSourceIndex = Number.isInteger(Number(bot.groupRosterSourceIndex))
                    ? Number(bot.groupRosterSourceIndex)
                    : null;
                data.emotions = bot.customEmotions || {};
                data.avatars = bot.emotionAvatars || {};
                data.emotionSprites = bot.emotionSprites || {};
                openingExtrasSource = bot;
            }
        }
    }
    else {
        if (slotId.startsWith('roster_')) {
            const index = parseInt(slotId.replace('roster_', ''));
            let roster = [];
            try { roster = DB.get('globalBotRoster'); } catch(e){}
            if (!roster || roster.length === 0) roster = defaultBots;
            const bot = roster[index] || defaultBots[index] || {};
            
            data.uid = bot.uid || ''; 
            data.name = bot.name;
            data.hashTag = bot.hashTag || ''; 
            data.avatar = bot.avatar;
            data.defaultSprite = bot.defaultSprite || '';
            data.instruction = bot.instruction;
            data.openingMessage = bot.openingMessage || bot.customGreeting || bot.greeting || bot.initialMessage || '';
            data.groupRosterSourceUid = bot.uid || '';
            data.groupRosterSourceIndex = index;
            data.emotions = bot.customEmotions || {};
            data.avatars = bot.emotionAvatars || {};
            data.emotionSprites = bot.emotionSprites || {};
            openingExtrasSource = bot;
        }
        else if (slotId.startsWith('user_')) {
            const mode = slotId.replace('user_', '');
            let d = null;
            try { d = DB.get(`global-user-${mode}`) || null; } catch(e){}
            if (!d) d = createFuraiDefaultUser(mode);

            data.uid = d.uid || '';
            data.name = d.name || '';
            data.hashTag = d.hashTag || '';
            data.avatar = d.avatar || '';
            data.instruction = d.instructions?.[mode] ?? d.instruction ?? '';
            data.openingMessage = d.openingMessage || '';
            data.defaultSprite = d.defaultSprite || '';
            data.emotions = d.customEmotions || {};
            data.avatars = d.emotionAvatars || {};
            data.emotionSprites = d.emotionSprites || {};
            openingExtrasSource = d;
        }
        else if (slotId.startsWith('bot_')) {
            const mode = slotId.replace('bot_', '');
            let b = null;
            try {
                const p = DB.get(`global-profile-${mode}`);
                if (p && Array.isArray(p.bots) && p.bots[0]) b = p.bots[0];
            } catch(e){}
            if (!b) b = createFuraiModeFactoryBot(mode);

            data.uid = b.uid || '';
            data.name = b.name || '';
            data.hashTag = b.hashTag || '';
            data.avatar = b.avatar || '';
            data.instruction = b.instruction ?? '';
            data.openingMessage = b.openingMessage || b.customGreeting || b.greeting || b.initialMessage || '';
            data.defaultSprite = b.defaultSprite || '';
            data.emotions = b.customEmotions || {};
            data.avatars = b.emotionAvatars || {};
            data.emotionSprites = b.emotionSprites || {};
            openingExtrasSource = b;
        }
        else if (slotId === 'wand') {
            const wand = getFuraiGlobalWandProfile();
            data.uid = wand.uid || 'wand_global';
            data.name = wand.name;
            data.hashTag = wand.hashTag || '';
            data.avatar = wand.avatar;
            data.defaultSprite = wand.defaultSprite || '';
            data.instruction = wand.instruction;
            data.openingMessage = wand.openingMessage || '';
            data.emotions = wand.customEmotions || {};
            data.avatars = wand.emotionAvatars || {};
            data.emotionSprites = wand.emotionSprites || {};
            openingExtrasSource = wand;
        }
    }
    if (openingExtrasSource) {
        copyCharacterOpeningExtras(data, openingExtrasSource);
        writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(data, openingExtrasSource);
    }
    
    return data;
}

// 4. UNIFIED SAVE MANAGER (Persists UID + Normalization)
function saveProfileDataUnified(slotId, context, data) {
    if (context === 'local') {
        const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
        
        if (slotId === 'user' || slotId === 'local_user') {
            if (data.uid) profile.user.uid = data.uid;
            profile.user.name = data.name;
            profile.user.hashTag = data.hashTag;
            profile.user.avatar = data.avatar;
            profile.user.defaultSprite = data.defaultSprite;
