            if (data.openingMessage) profile.user.openingMessage = data.openingMessage;
            else delete profile.user.openingMessage;

            writeCharacterOpeningExtras(profile.user, data);

            if (!profile.user.instructions) profile.user.instructions = {};
            profile.user.instructions[chatPersonalities[currentChatId]] = data.instruction;
            writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(profile.user, data);
            profile.user.customEmotions = data.emotions;
            profile.user.emotionAvatars = data.avatars;
            profile.user.emotionSprites = data.emotionSprites;
            profile.profileCustomized = true;

            DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, profile);
        }
        else if (slotId === 'wand' || slotId === 'local_wand') {
            const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);

            chatData.enhancerName = data.name;
            chatData.enhancerTag = data.hashTag;
            chatData.enhancerAvatar = data.avatar;
            chatData.enhancerInst = data.instruction;

            if (data.openingMessage) chatData.enhancerOpening = data.openingMessage;
            else delete chatData.enhancerOpening;

            writeEnhancerOpeningExtrasToChatData(chatData, data);
            writeFuraiLocalWandProtectedInstructionData(chatData, data);

            chatData.enhancerCustomEmotions = data.emotions;
            chatData.enhancerEmotionAvatars = data.avatars;
            chatData.enhancerEmotionSprites = data.emotionSprites;

            DB.set(currentChatId, chatData);
        }
        else { 
            const idx = parseInt(slotId.toString().replace('local_bot_', ''));
            let targetBot = profile.bots[idx];

            if (
                chatPersonalities[currentChatId] === 'group' &&
                targetBot?.rosterStub === true
            ) {
                targetBot = hydrateGroupRosterStub(profile, idx);
            }

            if (targetBot) {
                if (data.uid) targetBot.uid = data.uid;

                if (data.groupRosterSourceUid) {
                    targetBot.groupRosterSourceUid = data.groupRosterSourceUid;

                    if (Number.isInteger(Number(data.groupRosterSourceIndex))) {
                        targetBot.groupRosterSourceIndex = Number(data.groupRosterSourceIndex);
                    } else {
                        delete targetBot.groupRosterSourceIndex;
                    }
                } else {
                    delete targetBot.groupRosterSourceUid;
                    delete targetBot.groupRosterSourceIndex;
                }

                targetBot.name = data.name;
                targetBot.hashTag = data.hashTag;
                targetBot.avatar = data.avatar;
                targetBot.defaultSprite = data.defaultSprite;
                targetBot.instruction = data.instruction;
                writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(targetBot, data);

                if (data.openingMessage) targetBot.openingMessage = data.openingMessage;
                else delete targetBot.openingMessage;

                writeCharacterOpeningExtras(targetBot, data);

                targetBot.customEmotions = data.emotions;
                targetBot.emotionAvatars = data.avatars;
                targetBot.emotionSprites = data.emotionSprites;
                profile.profileCustomized = true;

                DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, profile);
            }
        }
        
        if (document.body.classList.contains('vn-active') && typeof renderVnSprites === 'function') {
            setTimeout(renderVnSprites, 50);
        }

        return;
    }

    // Global Save Logic
    if (slotId.startsWith('roster_')) {
        const idx = parseInt(slotId.replace('roster_', ''));
        let roster = DB.get('globalBotRoster') || JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaultBots));

        while (roster.length <= idx) {
            roster.push(createFuraiBlankLibraryCharacter());
        }

        if (data.uid) roster[idx].uid = data.uid;
        roster[idx].name = data.name;
        roster[idx].hashTag = data.hashTag;
        roster[idx].avatar = data.avatar;
        roster[idx].defaultSprite = data.defaultSprite;
        roster[idx].instruction = data.instruction;
        writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(roster[idx], data);

        if (data.openingMessage) roster[idx].openingMessage = data.openingMessage;
        else delete roster[idx].openingMessage;

        writeCharacterOpeningExtras(roster[idx], data);

        roster[idx].customEmotions = data.emotions;
        roster[idx].emotionAvatars = data.avatars;
        roster[idx].emotionSprites = data.emotionSprites;

        if (roster[idx].isActive === undefined) roster[idx].isActive = false;
        if (roster[idx].inActiveCast === undefined) roster[idx].inActiveCast = false;

        DB.set('globalBotRoster', roster);
    }
    else if (slotId.startsWith('user_')) {
        const mode = slotId.replace('user_', '');
        const key = `global-user-${mode}`;
        const d = DB.get(key) || {};

        d.name = data.name;
        d.hashTag = data.hashTag;
        d.avatar = data.avatar;
        if (!d.instructions || typeof d.instructions !== 'object') d.instructions = {};
        d.instructions[mode] = data.instruction || '';
        delete d.instruction;
        d.defaultSprite = data.defaultSprite;

        if (data.openingMessage) d.openingMessage = data.openingMessage;
        else delete d.openingMessage;

        writeCharacterOpeningExtras(d, data);
        writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(d, data);

        d.customEmotions = data.emotions;
        d.emotionAvatars = data.avatars;
        d.emotionSprites = data.emotionSprites;

        DB.set(key, d);
    }
    else if (slotId.startsWith('bot_')) {
        const mode = slotId.replace('bot_', '');
        const key = `global-profile-${mode}`;
        const p = DB.get(key) || { bots: [{}] };

        if (!p.bots) p.bots = [{}];
        if (!p.bots[0]) p.bots[0] = {};

        if (data.uid) p.bots[0].uid = data.uid;
        p.bots[0].name = data.name;
        p.bots[0].hashTag = data.hashTag;
        p.bots[0].avatar = data.avatar;
        p.bots[0].instruction = data.instruction;
        writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(p.bots[0], data);
        p.bots[0].defaultSprite = data.defaultSprite;

        if (data.openingMessage) p.bots[0].openingMessage = data.openingMessage;
        else delete p.bots[0].openingMessage;

        writeCharacterOpeningExtras(p.bots[0], data);

        p.bots[0].customEmotions = data.emotions;
        p.bots[0].emotionAvatars = data.avatars;
        p.bots[0].emotionSprites = data.emotionSprites;

        DB.set(key, p);
    }
    else if (slotId === 'wand') {
        if (data.name) DB.set('global-group-enhancer-name', data.name);
        else DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-name');

        if (data.hashTag) DB.set('global-group-enhancer-tag', data.hashTag);
        else DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-tag');

        if (data.avatar) DB.set('global-group-enhancer-avatar', data.avatar);
        else DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-avatar');

        if (data.instruction) DB.set('global-group-enhancer-inst', data.instruction);
        else DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-inst');

        if (data.openingMessage) DB.set('global-group-enhancer-opening', data.openingMessage);
        else DB.remove('global-group-enhancer-opening');

        saveGlobalWandOpeningExtras(data);
        writeFuraiGlobalWandProtectedInstructionData(data);

        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-custom-emotions', data.emotions || {});
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-emotion-avatars', data.avatars || {});
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-emotion-sprites', data.emotionSprites || {});
    }
}

// --- CHARACTER SELECTION & LIBRARY MOVEMENT ---

let furaiCharacterSelectionTarget = null;
let pendingImportedCharacterProfile = null;

function getFuraiRosterCharacters() {
    let roster = DB.get('globalBotRoster');
    if (!Array.isArray(roster) || !roster.length) roster = cloneFuraiData(defaultBots);
    return roster;
}

function getFuraiCharacterLibraryDisplayList() {
    const displayList = [];
    const userModes = ['researcher', 'prompter', 'group', 'story', 'maker'];

    userModes.forEach(mode => {
        const saved = DB.get(`global-user-${mode}`) || createFuraiDefaultUser(mode);
        const user = cloneFuraiData(saved);
        user.instruction = user.instructions?.[mode] ?? user.instruction ?? '';
        displayList.push({
            ...user,
            isUser: true,
            userMode: mode,
            originalIndex: `user_${mode}`,
            librarySlotId: `user_${mode}`
        });
    });

    displayList.push({
        ...getFuraiGlobalWandProfile(),
        isWand: true,
        originalIndex: 'wand',
        librarySlotId: 'wand'
    });

    ['researcher', 'prompter', 'story', 'maker'].forEach(mode => {
        const saved = DB.get(`global-profile-${mode}`)?.bots?.[0] || createFuraiModeFactoryBot(mode);
        displayList.push({
            ...cloneFuraiData(saved),
            isSolo: true,
            soloMode: mode,
            originalIndex: `solo_${mode}`,
            librarySlotId: `solo_${mode}`
        });
    });

    getFuraiRosterCharacters().forEach((bot, index) => {
        if (!bot) return;
        displayList.push({
            ...cloneFuraiData(bot),
            isRoster: true,
            originalIndex: index,
            librarySlotId: String(index)
        });
    });

    displayList.forEach((item, index) => {
        item._libraryOrder = index;
    });

    return displayList;
}

function getFuraiLibraryModeLabel(mode) {
    return ({
        researcher: 'Research',
        prompter: 'Prompt',
        group: 'Group',
        story: 'Story',
        maker: 'Character Maker'
    })[String(mode || '')] || capitalize(mode || '');
}

function getFuraiLibrarySlotLabel(id) {
    const slotId = String(id ?? '');
    if (slotId === 'wand') return 'Magic Wand';
    if (slotId.startsWith('user_')) return `${getFuraiLibraryModeLabel(slotId.slice(5))} User`;
    if (slotId.startsWith('solo_')) return `${getFuraiLibraryModeLabel(slotId.slice(5))} AI`;
    if (/^\d+$/.test(slotId)) return `#${Number(slotId) + 1}`;
    return 'Character';
}

function describeFuraiSelectionTarget(target = furaiCharacterSelectionTarget) {
    if (!target) return 'Character Library';
    if (target.scope === 'local' && target.role === 'user') return 'Select User';
    if (target.scope === 'local' && target.role === 'bot') return 'Select Character';
    if (target.scope === 'global' && target.role === 'user') return `Select ${getFuraiLibraryModeLabel(target.mode)} User`;
    if (target.scope === 'global' && target.role === 'bot') return `Select ${getFuraiLibraryModeLabel(target.mode)} AI`;
    if (target.scope === 'global-slot') return `Select ${getFuraiLibrarySlotLabel(target.slotId)}`;
    if (target.scope === 'current-group-add') return 'Select Character';
    if (target.scope === 'wand') return 'Select Magic Wand';
    return 'Select Character';
}

function openCharacterSelection(target) {
    furaiCharacterSelectionTarget = { ...(target || {}) };
    openCharactersModal();
}

let furaiCharacterMoveSourceId = '';

function openCharacterMoveSelection(sourceId) {
    const source = getCharacterLibraryProfileData(sourceId);
    if (!source) return;

    furaiCharacterMoveSourceId = String(sourceId);
    let modal = document.getElementById('furaiCharacterMoveModal');
    if (!modal) {
        modal = document.createElement('div');
        modal.id = 'furaiCharacterMoveModal';
        modal.className = 'modal';
        modal.style.zIndex = '4570';
        modal.style.left = '0';
        modal.style.width = '100%';
        document.body.appendChild(modal);
    }

    const options = getFuraiCharacterLibraryDisplayList()
        .filter(item => String(item.librarySlotId ?? item.originalIndex) !== furaiCharacterMoveSourceId)
        .map(item => {
            const id = String(item.librarySlotId ?? item.originalIndex);
            return `<option value="${escapeHTML(id)}">${escapeHTML(getFuraiLibrarySlotLabel(id))} — ${escapeHTML(item.name || 'Character')}</option>`;
        })
        .join('');

    modal.innerHTML = `
      <div class="modal-content modal-compact" style="--modal-w:460px;">
        <div class="modal-header">
          <h3>Move Character</h3>
          <button type="button" onclick="closeFuraiCharacterMoveModal()">×</button>
        </div>
        <div class="modal-body">
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px;">
            <img src="${escapeHTML(source.avatar || '')}" style="width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:8px;object-fit:cover;flex-shrink:0;" onerror="this.style.display='none'">
            <div style="min-width:0;">
              <div style="font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;">${escapeHTML(source.name || 'Character')}</div>
              <div style="font-size:12px;opacity:.62;margin-top:2px;">From ${escapeHTML(getFuraiLibrarySlotLabel(furaiCharacterMoveSourceId))}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="form-group">
            <label for="furaiCharacterMoveDestination">Move to</label>
            <select id="furaiCharacterMoveDestination" style="width:100%;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border-color);background:var(--input-bg);color:var(--text-color);">
              <option value="" selected disabled>Choose a position…</option>
              ${options}
            </select>
            <div style="font-size:12px;opacity:.62;line-height:1.4;margin-top:7px;">Numbered positions reorder. Moving into a named role exchanges the two characters so neither is lost.</div>
          </div>
          <div class="button-group">
            <button type="button" onclick="closeFuraiCharacterMoveModal()">Cancel</button>
            <button type="button" onclick="confirmFuraiCharacterMove()">Move</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    modal.style.display = 'flex';
}

function closeFuraiCharacterMoveModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('furaiCharacterMoveModal');
    if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
    furaiCharacterMoveSourceId = '';
}

function confirmFuraiCharacterMove() {
    const destination = document.getElementById('furaiCharacterMoveDestination')?.value || '';
    if (!furaiCharacterMoveSourceId || !destination) {
        showToast('Choose a destination first.', 'error');
        return;
    }

    const sourceId = furaiCharacterMoveSourceId;
    const moved = moveFuraiCharacterLibraryItem(sourceId, destination, { keepLibraryOpen: true });
    if (moved) closeFuraiCharacterMoveModal();
}

function closeCharacterSelection() {
    furaiCharacterSelectionTarget = null;
}

function rerenderVisibleMessagesFromDatabase(options = {}) {
    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    const chatData = currentChatId ? DB.get(currentChatId) : null;
    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
    if (!chatMessagesEl || !messages.length) return false;

    const oldScrollHeight = chatMessagesEl.scrollHeight;
    const oldScrollTop = chatMessagesEl.scrollTop;
    const distanceFromBottom = oldScrollHeight - oldScrollTop - chatMessagesEl.clientHeight;
    const selectedUid = typeof getVnMessageUidFromElement === 'function'
        ? getVnMessageUidFromElement(typeof resolveVnSceneTargetElement === 'function' ? resolveVnSceneTargetElement() : null)
        : '';
    const loadedStart = Math.max(0, Number(chatMessagesEl.dataset.loadedStartIndex) || 0);

    Array.from(chatMessagesEl.querySelectorAll('.message'))
        .filter(el => el.id !== 'personality-selector-message' && !isLiveTypingMessage(el))
        .forEach(el => el.remove());

    const fragment = renderMessageSliceToFragment(messages, loadedStart, messages.length);
    chatMessagesEl.appendChild(fragment);
    chatMessagesEl.dataset.loadedStartIndex = String(loadedStart);

    if (options.preserveScroll !== false) {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            chatMessagesEl.scrollTop = Math.max(0, chatMessagesEl.scrollHeight - chatMessagesEl.clientHeight - distanceFromBottom);
        });
    }

    if (document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) {
        syncVnData();
        if (selectedUid) {
            const selected = findRenderedMessageByUid(selectedUid);
            if (selected) setVnSceneTargetFromElement(selected, { autoScroll: false, userLocked: true });
        }
        renderVnMessage('preserve');
    }
    return true;
}

function refreshAfterFuraiRoleSelection(target, profileOverride = null) {
    if (!target) return;

    if (target.scope === 'local') {
        const profile = profileOverride || getChatProfile(currentChatId);
        refreshProfileDependentUI(profile);
        if (typeof rerenderVisibleMessagesFromDatabase === 'function') {
            rerenderVisibleMessagesFromDatabase({ preserveScroll: true, preserveVnTarget: true });
        } else if (typeof loadChat === 'function') {
            loadChat(currentChatId, { refreshSidebar: false });
        }
    } else if (target.scope === 'global') {
        renderGlobalContent(target.mode || currentGlobalTab, { preserveSection: true });
        if (target.role === 'bot' && target.mode === 'researcher' && isHomeScreenActive()) {
            refreshHomeMascot();
        }
    } else if (target.scope === 'group-setup') {
        renderGlobalContent('group', { preserveSection: true });
    } else if (target.scope === 'current-group-add') {
        renderCastSwitchingModal();
        renderGroupBotMenu();
        updateOnlineCount();
    } else if (target.scope === 'wand' && target.local) {
        // Local Wand character selection is already persisted by
        // saveProfileDataUnified(). Refresh its visible identity immediately;
        // do not wait for the profile editor's manual Save button.
        if (typeof renderGroupBotMenu === 'function') renderGroupBotMenu();
        if (typeof updateEnhancerButtonUI === 'function') updateEnhancerButtonUI();
    }

    updateMenuProfiles();
    refreshCharactersGridIfOpen();
}

function refreshOpenFuraiLocalProfileEditor(target) {
    if (!target || target.scope !== 'local') return;

    if (target.role === 'user') {
        const modal = document.getElementById('userProfileModalEl');
        if (modal && getComputedStyle(modal).display !== 'none') {
            openUserProfileModal();
        }
        return;
    }

    if (target.role === 'bot') {
        const botIndex = Number.parseInt(target.botIndex, 10);
        const modal = document.getElementById('botProfileModalEl');
        if (Number.isInteger(botIndex) && botIndex >= 0 && modal && getComputedStyle(modal).display !== 'none') {
            openBotProfileModal(botIndex);
        }
    }
}

function furaiCharacterToUnifiedProfileData(character, mode = 'researcher') {
    const actor = cloneFuraiData(character || {});
    const instruction = actor.instructions?.[mode] ?? actor.instruction ?? '';
    const extras = getCharacterOpeningExtras(actor);
    return writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData({
        uid: actor.uid || '',
        name: actor.name || '',
        hashTag: actor.hashTag || '',
        avatar: actor.avatar || '',
        defaultSprite: actor.defaultSprite || '',
        instruction,
        openingSystemMessage: extras.systemMessage || '',
        openingMessage: getCharacterOpeningMessage(actor),
        openingBackground: extras.background || '',
        openingBackgroundOpacity: extras.backgroundOpacity || '1',
        openingBackgroundBlur: extras.backgroundBlur || '0',
        openingLorebook: extras.lorebook || '',
        emotions: cloneFuraiData(actor.customEmotions || {}),
        avatars: cloneFuraiData(actor.emotionAvatars || {}),
        emotionSprites: cloneFuraiData(actor.emotionSprites || {})
    }, actor);
}

function cleanFuraiLibraryCardMetadata(character) {
    const actor = cloneFuraiData(character || {});
    [
        'isUser', 'isWand', 'isSolo', 'isRoster', 'userMode', 'soloMode',
        'originalIndex', 'librarySlotId', '_libraryOrder', 'actorStartAfterMessageUid',
        'sourceLibraryUid', 'sourceFactoryMode', 'historicalFallback'
    ].forEach(key => delete actor[key]);
    return actor;
}

function writeFuraiCharacterLibrarySlot(slotId, character, options = {}) {
    const id = String(slotId ?? '');
    if (!id || !character) return false;

    if (/^\d+$/.test(id)) {
        const index = Number(id);
        const roster = getFuraiRosterCharacters();
        while (roster.length <= index) roster.push(createFuraiBlankLibraryCharacter());
        const previous = roster[index] || {};
        const next = cleanFuraiLibraryCardMetadata(character);
        next.instruction = next.instructions?.[options.mode || 'researcher'] ?? next.instruction ?? '';
        delete next.instructions;
        if (!next.uid) next.uid = generateUID('roster_bot');

        if (options.preserveDestinationRosterState) {
            ['isActive', 'inActiveCast', 'replyMode', 'activeTimestamp'].forEach(key => {
                if (previous[key] !== undefined) next[key] = previous[key];
                else delete next[key];
            });
        } else {
            if (next.isActive === undefined) next.isActive = false;
            if (next.inActiveCast === undefined) next.inActiveCast = false;
            if (!next.replyMode) next.replyMode = 'auto';
        }

        roster[index] = next;
        DB.set('globalBotRoster', roster);
        return true;
    }

    if (id.startsWith('user_')) {
        const mode = id.slice(5);
        const next = cleanFuraiLibraryCardMetadata(character);
        const instruction = next.instructions?.[mode] ?? next.instruction ?? '';
        next.instructions = cloneFuraiData(next.instructions || {});
        next.instructions[mode] = instruction;
        delete next.instruction;
        ['isActive', 'inActiveCast', 'replyMode', 'activeTimestamp', 'rosterStub', 'groupRosterSourceUid', 'groupRosterSourceIndex'].forEach(key => delete next[key]);
        if (!next.uid) next.uid = generateUID(`library_user_${mode}`);
        DB.set(`global-user-${mode}`, next);
        return true;
    }

    if (id.startsWith('solo_')) {
        const mode = id.slice(5);
        const key = `global-profile-${mode}`;
        const wrapper = cloneFuraiData(DB.get(key) || {});
        const next = cleanFuraiLibraryCardMetadata(character);
        next.instruction = next.instructions?.[mode] ?? next.instruction ?? '';
        delete next.instructions;
        ['isActive', 'inActiveCast', 'replyMode', 'activeTimestamp', 'rosterStub', 'groupRosterSourceUid', 'groupRosterSourceIndex'].forEach(key => delete next[key]);
        if (!next.uid) next.uid = generateUID(`library_ai_${mode}`);
        wrapper.bots = [next];
        DB.set(key, wrapper);
        return true;
    }

    if (id === 'wand') {
        const next = cleanFuraiLibraryCardMetadata(character);
        const instruction = next.instruction ?? Object.values(next.instructions || {})[0] ?? '';
        const extras = getCharacterOpeningExtras(next);
        next.instruction = instruction || '';
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-profile', cloneFuraiData(next));
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-uid', next.uid || generateUID('library_wand'));
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-name', next.name || DEFAULT_WAND_DISPLAY_NAME);
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-avatar', next.avatar || '');
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-sprite', next.defaultSprite || '');
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-tag', next.hashTag || '');
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-inst', instruction || '');
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-opening', getCharacterOpeningMessage(next));
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-opening-background', extras.background || '');
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-opening-background-opacity', extras.backgroundOpacity || '1');
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-opening-background-blur', extras.backgroundBlur || '0');
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-opening-lorebook', extras.lorebook || '');
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-custom-emotions', cloneFuraiData(next.customEmotions || {}));
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-emotion-avatars', cloneFuraiData(next.emotionAvatars || {}));
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-emotion-sprites', cloneFuraiData(next.emotionSprites || {}));
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-chatCount', Number(next.chatCount) || 0);
        DB.set('global-group-enhancer-lastChattedAt', Number(next.lastChattedAt) || 0);
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

function moveFuraiCharacterLibraryItem(sourceId, destinationId, options = {}) {
    const fromId = String(sourceId ?? '');
    const toId = String(destinationId ?? '');
    if (!fromId || !toId) return false;
    if (fromId === toId) {
        if (options.keepLibraryOpen) {
            closeCharacterSelection();
            const titleEl = document.querySelector('#charactersModalEl .modal-header h3');
            if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = 'Character Library';
            const importBtn = document.querySelector('#charactersModalEl .modal-header button[onclick*="openCharacterImportModal"]');
            if (importBtn) importBtn.style.display = 'flex';
            renderCharactersGrid();
        } else {
            closeCharactersModal();
        }
        return true;
    }

    const source = getCharacterLibraryProfileData(fromId);
    const destination = getCharacterLibraryProfileData(toId);
    if (!source || !destination) return false;

    const fromRoster = /^\d+$/.test(fromId);
    const toRoster = /^\d+$/.test(toId);
    const rosterMove = fromRoster && toRoster;
    const before = rosterMove ? getFuraiRosterCharacters() : null;
    let expected;

    try {
        if (rosterMove) {
            expected = cloneFuraiData(before);
            const from = Number(fromId);
            const to = Number(toId);
            if (!expected[from] || !expected[to]) throw 0;
            const [moved] = expected.splice(from, 1);
            expected.splice(to, 0, moved);
            DB.set('globalBotRoster', expected);
        } else if (!writeFuraiCharacterLibrarySlot(toId, source, { preserveDestinationRosterState: toRoster }) ||
                   !writeFuraiCharacterLibrarySlot(fromId, destination, { preserveDestinationRosterState: fromRoster })) {
            throw 0;
        }

        const current = rosterMove ? getFuraiRosterCharacters() : null;
        const valid = rosterMove
            ? current.length === expected.length && current.every((bot, i) => bot?.uid === expected[i]?.uid)
            : doesFuraiSelectedActorMatchSource(getCharacterLibraryProfileData(toId), source) &&
              doesFuraiSelectedActorMatchSource(getCharacterLibraryProfileData(fromId), destination);
        if (!valid) throw 0;
    } catch (error) {
        if (rosterMove) DB.set('globalBotRoster', before);
        else {
            writeFuraiCharacterLibrarySlot(fromId, source);
            writeFuraiCharacterLibrarySlot(toId, destination);
        }
        console.error('Character move rolled back.', error);
        showToast('Character could not be moved. Nothing was changed.', 'error');
        return false;
    }

    const roster = getFuraiRosterCharacters();
    if (isHomeScreenActive() && (fromId === 'solo_researcher' || toId === 'solo_researcher')) refreshHomeMascot();
    updateMenuProfiles();

    if (options.keepLibraryOpen) {
        closeCharacterSelection();
        const titleEl = document.querySelector('#charactersModalEl .modal-header h3');
        if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = 'Character Library';
        const importBtn = document.querySelector('#charactersModalEl .modal-header button[onclick*="openCharacterImportModal"]');
        if (importBtn) importBtn.style.display = 'flex';
        renderCharactersGrid();
    } else {
        closeCharactersModal();
    }

    showToast(`${source.name || 'Character'} moved to ${getFuraiLibrarySlotLabel(toId)}.`, 'success');
    return true;
}

function openFuraiCharacterSelectionPreview(sourceId, event) {
    if (event) event.stopPropagation();
    const actor = getCharacterLibraryProfileData(sourceId);
    if (!actor) return;
    openProfileCard(
        actor.name || 'Character',
        actor.avatar || '',
        actor.instruction || 'No description.',
        actor.hashTag || '',
        null,
        `<div style="font-size:12px;opacity:.65;">${escapeHTML(getFuraiLibrarySlotLabel(sourceId))}</div>`,
        { source: 'character-select', sourceId: String(sourceId) }
    );
}

function getFuraiSelectionPreviewEmotion(source) {
    const target = furaiCharacterSelectionTarget;
    if (!currentChatId || target?.scope !== 'local') return '';

    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    const role = target.role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'ai';
    const actor = role === 'user'
        ? profile?.user
        : profile?.bots?.[Number.parseInt(target.botIndex, 10)];
    if (!doesFuraiSelectedActorMatchSource(actor, source)) return '';

    const uidKey = role === 'user' ? 'userUid' : 'botUid';
    const messages = DB.get(currentChatId)?.messages || [];
    for (let i = messages.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const message = messages[i];
        if (message?.role !== role || String(message?.[uidKey] || '') !== String(actor.uid || '')) continue;

        const emotion = String(message.emotion || '').trim() || detectBotEmotion(message.content || '', actor) || '';
        if (
            emotion &&
            (
                actor.customEmotions?.[emotion] ||
                actor.emotionAvatars?.[emotion] ||
                actor.emotionSprites?.[emotion]
            )
        ) return emotion;
    }
    return '';
}

function openFuraiCharacterProfilePreview(sourceId) {
    const actor = getCharacterLibraryProfileData(sourceId);
    const modal = document.getElementById('expProfilePreviewModalEl');
    if (!actor || !modal) return;

    window.expProfilePreviewData = cloneFuraiData(actor);
    populateExpProfilePreviewModal(window.expProfilePreviewData);

    const emotion = getFuraiSelectionPreviewEmotion(actor);
    const select = document.getElementById('expPreviewEmotionSelect');
    if (emotion && select && Array.from(select.options).some(option => option.value === emotion)) {
        select.value = emotion;
        previewExpCharacterEmotion(emotion);
    }

    if (typeof openModalLayer === 'function') {
        openModalLayer(modal);
    } else {
        modal.style.display = 'flex';
    }
}

function doesFuraiSelectedActorMatchSource(actor, source) {
    if (!actor || !source) return false;
    const expectedSourceUid = String(
        source.sourceLibraryUid || source.groupRosterSourceUid || source.storySourceLibraryUid || source.uid || ''
    ).trim();
    const actualSourceUid = String(actor.sourceLibraryUid || '').trim();

    if (expectedSourceUid && actualSourceUid) return expectedSourceUid === actualSourceUid;

    return (
        String(actor.name || '').trim() === String(source.name || '').trim() &&
        String(actor.avatar || '').trim() === String(source.avatar || '').trim()
    );
}

function selectFuraiCharacterLibraryCard(sourceId) {
    const target = furaiCharacterSelectionTarget;
    if (!target) return false;

    const source = getCharacterLibraryProfileData(sourceId);
    if (!source) return false;
    const label = source.name || 'Character';

    if (target.scope === 'local') {
        const role = target.role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'ai';
        const botIndex = role === 'ai' ? Number.parseInt(target.botIndex, 10) : null;
        const ok = switchFuraiChatRoleActor(currentChatId, {
            role,
            botIndex,
            mode: getStoredChatPersonality(currentChatId)
        }, source);
        if (!ok) return false;

        const persistedProfile = DB.get(`profile-${currentChatId}`);
        const persistedActor = role === 'user'
            ? persistedProfile?.user
            : persistedProfile?.bots?.[botIndex];

        if (!doesFuraiSelectedActorMatchSource(persistedActor, source)) {
            console.error('Selected character does not match the saved chat role.', {
                chatId: currentChatId,
                role,
                botIndex,
                source,
                persistedActor
            });
            showToast('Character switch could not be verified.', 'error');
            return false;
        }

        refreshAfterFuraiRoleSelection(target, persistedProfile);
        closeCharactersModal();
        refreshOpenFuraiLocalProfileEditor(target);
        showToast(`${label} selected for this chat.`, 'success');
        return true;
    }

    if (target.scope === 'current-group-add') {
        const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
        const bot = normalizeFuraiSelectedCharacterForRole(source, {
            role: 'ai',
            mode: 'group',
            botIndex: profile.bots.length,
            replyMode: profile.masterReplyMode || getGlobalCastMode(),
            startAfterMessageUid: getFuraiLastMessageUid(DB.get(currentChatId))
        });
        bot.activeTimestamp = Date.now();
        profile.bots.push(bot);
        profile.profileCustomized = true;
        DB.set(`profile-${currentChatId}`, profile);
        refreshAfterFuraiRoleSelection(target);
        closeCharactersModal();
        showToast(`${label} added to this Group Chat.`, 'success');
        return true;
    }

    if (target.scope === 'wand' && target.local) {
        saveProfileDataUnified('local_wand', 'local', furaiCharacterToUnifiedProfileData(source, getStoredChatPersonality(currentChatId)));
        refreshAfterFuraiRoleSelection(target);
        closeCharactersModal();
        showToast(`${label} selected for Magic Wand.`, 'success');
        return true;
    }

    let destinationId = '';
    if (target.scope === 'global' && target.role === 'user') destinationId = `user_${target.mode}`;
    else if (target.scope === 'global' && target.role === 'bot') destinationId = `solo_${target.mode}`;
    else if (target.scope === 'global-slot') destinationId = String(target.slotId);
    else if (target.scope === 'wand') destinationId = 'wand';

    if (destinationId) {
        const moved = moveFuraiCharacterLibraryItem(sourceId, destinationId);
        if (moved) {
            if (target.scope === 'global') renderGlobalContent(target.mode || currentGlobalTab, { preserveSection: true });
            else if (target.scope === 'global-slot' || target.scope === 'wand') renderGlobalContent('group', { preserveSection: true });
        }
        return moved;
    }
    return false;
}

function openImportReplaceModal(context = 'global') {
    const imported = cloneFuraiData(window._pendingImportData || {});
    if (!imported?.name) return;
    pendingImportedCharacterProfile = imported;

    let modal = document.getElementById('furaiImportReplaceModal');
    if (!modal) {
        modal = document.createElement('div');
        modal.id = 'furaiImportReplaceModal';
        modal.className = 'modal';
        modal.style.zIndex = '4565';
        document.body.appendChild(modal);
    }

    if (context === 'local') {
        const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
        const mode = getStoredChatPersonality(currentChatId);
        const rows = [
            `<button type="button" class="settings-menu-item" onclick="applyFuraiImportedCharacterToLocalRole('user')" style="border:1px solid var(--border-color);margin-bottom:6px;"><span style="flex:1;text-align:left;">User — ${escapeHTML(profile.user?.name || 'User')}</span></button>`,
            ...(profile.bots || []).map((bot, botIndex) => {
                if (!bot || bot.rosterStub === true || bot.localRosterDeleted === true) return '';
                const roleName = mode === 'group' || mode === 'story' ? `#${botIndex + 1}` : 'AI';
                return `<button type="button" class="settings-menu-item" onclick="applyFuraiImportedCharacterToLocalRole('ai', ${botIndex})" style="border:1px solid var(--border-color);margin-bottom:6px;"><span style="flex:1;text-align:left;">${escapeHTML(roleName)} — ${escapeHTML(bot.name || `#${botIndex + 1}`)}</span></button>`;
            })
        ].join('');
        modal.innerHTML = `<div class="modal-content modal-compact" style="--modal-w:520px;--modal-h:80vh;"><div class="modal-header"><h3>Select Role</h3><button onclick="document.getElementById('furaiImportReplaceModal').style.display='none'">×</button></div><div class="modal-body" style="overflow:auto;">${rows}</div></div>`;
    } else {
        const rows = getFuraiCharacterLibraryDisplayList().map(item => {
            const id = String(item.librarySlotId ?? item.originalIndex);
            return `<button type="button" class="settings-menu-item" onclick="replaceFuraiImportTarget('${id}')" style="border:1px solid var(--border-color);margin-bottom:6px;"><span style="flex:1;text-align:left;">${escapeHTML(getFuraiLibrarySlotLabel(id))} — ${escapeHTML(item.name || 'Character')}</span></button>`;
        }).join('');
        modal.innerHTML = `<div class="modal-content modal-compact" style="--modal-w:520px;--modal-h:80vh;"><div class="modal-header"><h3>Replace Library Position</h3><button onclick="document.getElementById('furaiImportReplaceModal').style.display='none'">×</button></div><div class="modal-body" style="overflow:auto;">${rows}</div></div>`;
    }

    modal.style.display = 'flex';
}

function closeFuraiImportReplaceFlow() {
    pendingImportedCharacterProfile = null;
    window._pendingImportData = null;
    const modal = document.getElementById('furaiImportReplaceModal');
    if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
    const charImportModal = document.getElementById('charImportModalEl');
    if (charImportModal) charImportModal.style.display = 'none';
    const makerModal = document.getElementById('makerStudioModalEl');
    if (makerModal) makerModal.style.display = 'none';
}

function applyFuraiImportedCharacterToLocalRole(role, botIndex = null) {
    if (!pendingImportedCharacterProfile || !currentChatId) return;
    const ok = switchFuraiChatRoleActor(currentChatId, {
        role: role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'ai',
        botIndex,
        mode: getStoredChatPersonality(currentChatId)
    }, pendingImportedCharacterProfile);
    if (!ok) return;
    refreshAfterFuraiRoleSelection({ scope: 'local', role: role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'bot', botIndex });
    const name = pendingImportedCharacterProfile.name || 'Imported character';
    const parentTarget = {
        scope: 'local',
        role: role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'bot',
        botIndex: role === 'user' ? null : botIndex
    };
    closeFuraiImportReplaceFlow();
    refreshOpenFuraiLocalProfileEditor(parentTarget);
    showToast(`${name} selected for this chat.`, 'success');
}

function replaceFuraiImportTarget(slotId) {
    if (!pendingImportedCharacterProfile) return;
    const current = getCharacterLibraryProfileData(slotId);
    if (!current) return;
    if (!confirm(`Replace ${getFuraiLibrarySlotLabel(slotId)} [ ${current.name || 'Character'} ] with [ ${pendingImportedCharacterProfile.name} ]?`)) return;
    const replacement = cleanFuraiLibraryCardMetadata(pendingImportedCharacterProfile);
    replacement.uid = current.uid || replacement.uid || generateUID('library_character');
    replacement.libraryCreatedAt = Date.now();
    replacement.chatCount = 0;
    replacement.lastChattedAt = 0;
    writeFuraiCharacterLibrarySlot(slotId, replacement, { preserveDestinationRosterState: /^\d+$/.test(String(slotId)) });
    const name = replacement.name || 'Imported character';
    closeFuraiImportReplaceFlow();
    refreshCharactersGridIfOpen();
    showToast(`${name} saved to ${getFuraiLibrarySlotLabel(slotId)}.`, 'success');
}

function openFuraiCharacterSelector(sourceId, context) {
    if (sourceId === 'PENDING_IMPORT') {
        openImportReplaceModal(context);
        return;
    }

    const id = String(sourceId || '');
    if (context === 'local') {
        // The character library is a child of the profile editor.
        // Keep the parent profile open underneath while the user swaps actors.
        if (id === 'user' || id === 'local_user') {
            return openCharacterSelection({ scope: 'local', role: 'user' });
        }
        if (id === 'wand' || id === 'local_wand') {
            const wandModal = document.getElementById('enhancerSettingsModalEl');
            if (wandModal) wandModal.style.display = 'none';
            return openCharacterSelection({ scope: 'wand', local: true });
        }
        const match = id.match(/(?:local_bot_)?(\d+)/);
        if (match) {
            return openCharacterSelection({ scope: 'local', role: 'bot', botIndex: Number(match[1]) });
        }
    }

    if (context === 'global') {
        if (id === 'wand') return openCharacterSelection({ scope: 'wand', local: false });
        if (id.startsWith('user_')) return openCharacterSelection({ scope: 'global', role: 'user', mode: id.slice(5) });
        if (id.startsWith('bot_')) return openCharacterSelection({ scope: 'global', role: 'bot', mode: id.slice(4) });
        if (id.startsWith('roster_')) return openCharacterSelection({ scope: 'global-slot', slotId: id.slice(7) });
    }
}


function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
    let container = document.getElementById('toast-container');
    if (!container) {
        container = document.createElement('div');
        container.id = 'toast-container';
        document.body.appendChild(container);
    }

    const text = String(message || '');
    const isActionResult = type === 'success' || (
        type !== 'error' &&
        /\b(added|imported|saved|updated|copied|loaded|created|deleted|removed|restored|reset|merged|duplicated|selected|applied|sent|downloaded|exported)\b/i.test(text)
    );
    const placement = isActionResult ? 'bottom' : 'center';
    let stack = container.querySelector(`.toast-stack[data-placement="${placement}"]`);

    if (!stack) {
        stack = document.createElement('div');
        stack.className = 'toast-stack';
        stack.dataset.placement = placement;
        container.appendChild(stack);
    }

    const toast = document.createElement('div');
    toast.className = `toast ${type}`;

    let icon = '';
    if (type === 'success') icon = '<i class="fa-solid fa-check" style="color:var(--primary-color)"></i>';
    if (type === 'error') icon = '<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-exclamation" style="color:var(--danger-color)"></i>';

    toast.innerHTML = `${icon}<span>${text}</span>`;
    stack.appendChild(toast);

    requestAnimationFrame(() => toast.classList.add('show'));

    setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList.remove('show');
        setTimeout(() => {
            toast.remove();
            if (!stack.children.length) stack.remove();
            if (!container.children.length) container.remove();
        }, 320);
    }, 3000);
}

/* --- VN MODE LOGIC --- */
let isVnMode = false;
let vnCurrentIndex = -1;
let vnMessagesCache = [];
let vnSceneTarget = {
    chatId: '',
    type: 'none',
    element: null,
    uid: '',
    liveId: '',
    index: -1,
    autoScroll: false,
    userLocked: false
};

function hasSeenVnPromo() {
    try {
        return localStorage.getItem('furai_vn_toggle_seen') === 'true';
    } catch (e) {
        return false;
    }
}

function markVnPromoSeen() {
    try {
        localStorage.setItem('furai_vn_toggle_seen', 'true');
    } catch (e) {}
    document.body.classList.remove('vn-promo-active');
    document.body.classList.remove('vn-promo-home');
}

function refreshVnPromoState() {
    const body = document.body;
    if (!body) return;

    if (hasSeenVnPromo()) {
        body.classList.remove('vn-promo-active');
        body.classList.remove('vn-promo-home');
        return;
    }

    const vnBtn = document.getElementById('vnToggleBtn');
    if (!vnBtn) {
        body.classList.remove('vn-promo-active');
        body.classList.remove('vn-promo-home');
        return;
    }

    const computed = window.getComputedStyle(vnBtn);
    const isVisible = computed.display !== 'none' && computed.visibility !== 'hidden' && vnBtn.offsetParent !== null;

    let currentPersonality = 'home';
    try {
        currentPersonality =
            chatPersonalities[currentChatId] ||
            DB.get(currentChatId)?.personality ||
            'home';
    } catch (e) {}

    const isHome = currentPersonality === 'home';

    body.classList.toggle('vn-promo-active', isVisible);
    body.classList.toggle('vn-promo-home', isVisible && isHome);
}

// 2. Mode Entry (Reset to Defaults & Sanitize Input)
function isHomeScreenActive() {
    if (document.body?.classList.contains('furai-home-screen-active')) return true;

    // Legacy/race fallback: the Home selector itself is authoritative UI evidence,
    // even if currentChatId or its DB record has not finished initializing yet.
    if (document.getElementById('personality-selector-message')) return true;

    if (!currentChatId) return false;
    try {
        return DB.get(currentChatId)?.personality === 'home';
    } catch (e) {
        return false;
    }
}

function syncHomeModeToggleButtons(nextHomeState) {
    const vnBtn = document.getElementById('vnToggleBtn');
    if (vnBtn) vnBtn.style.display = nextHomeState ? 'none' : 'flex';
    const chatBtn = document.getElementById('chatModeToggleBtn');
    if (chatBtn) chatBtn.style.display = nextHomeState ? 'flex' : 'none';
}

function resetHomeModeSelectorScroll() {
    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    if (chatMessagesEl) chatMessagesEl.scrollTop = 0;
}

function applyHomeBackgroundAfterModeSwitch() {
    applyBackground(currentChatId);
}

function stabilizeHomeScreenAfterModeSwitch() {
    const chatEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    if (chatEl) chatEl.scrollTop = 0;
}

function toggleVnMode(forceState = null) {
    if (forceState === null) markVnPromoSeen();

    if (isHomeScreenActive()) {
        const current = getHomeViewMode() === 'vn';
        const next = forceState === null ? !current : !!forceState;
        renderHomeScreen({ mode: next ? 'vn' : 'chat' });
        return;
    }

    const nextState = (forceState !== null) ? forceState : !isVnMode;
    if (isVnMode === nextState) return;

    isVnMode = nextState;
    const body = document.body;
    const vnOverlay = document.getElementById('vnOverlay');
    const vnBtn = document.getElementById('vnToggleBtn');
    const chatBtn = document.getElementById('chatModeToggleBtn');
    const inputContainer = document.querySelector('.chat-input-container');

    body.classList.remove('furai-home-screen-active', 'home-vn-mode');

    // Save State
    if (currentChatId) {
        try {
            const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
            if(chatData) {
                chatData.viewMode = isVnMode ? 'vn' : 'chat';
                DB.set(currentChatId, chatData);
            }
        } catch(e){}
    }
    
    if (isVnMode) {
        // --- ENTERING VN MODE ---
        body.classList.add('vn-active');
        vnOverlay.style.display = 'flex';
        
        if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
            const avContainer = document.getElementById('vnAvatarContainer');
            const avIcon = document.getElementById('vnAvatarIcon');
            
            if (avContainer) avContainer.classList.add('vn-avatar-hidden');
            if (avIcon) avIcon.textContent = 'frame_person_off';
        }

        if(vnBtn) vnBtn.style.display = 'none';
        if(chatBtn) chatBtn.style.display = 'flex';
        
        if (inputContainer) {
            inputContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
            inputContainer.style.display = ''; 
        }
        body.classList.remove('vn-no-input');

        syncVnData();

        const sharedTarget = resolveVnSceneTargetElement();
        window.furaiCrSelectionPendingForVn = '';

        if (sharedTarget) {
            setVnSceneTargetFromElement(sharedTarget, {
                autoScroll: false,
                userLocked: true
            });
            renderVnMessage('top');
        } else {
            vnAutoScroll = true;
            vnCurrentIndex = getNewestVnMessageIndex();

            const newestVnEl = getVnRenderableMessages()[vnCurrentIndex] || null;
            if (newestVnEl) {
                setVnSceneTargetFromElement(newestVnEl, {
                    autoScroll: true,
                    userLocked: false
                });
            } else {
                resetVnSceneTarget();
            }

            renderVnMessage('bottom');
        }
        resetVnUnreadSessionState();
        if (typeof queueFuraiContextMetaRender === 'function') {
            queueFuraiContextMetaRender();
        }

        if (!localStorage.getItem('furai_ad_hint_seen')) {
            setTimeout(() => {
                showOverlayHint(`
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-key" style="color:#ffca28;"></i>
                    <span> Login 🛠️ to Perchance to disable ads</span>
                `, 5000);
                localStorage.setItem('furai_ad_hint_seen', 'true');
            }, 800); 
        }
        
    } else {
        // --- EXITING VN MODE ---
        body.classList.remove('vn-active');
        body.classList.remove('vn-fullscreen');
        closeVnMoreMenu();
        exitVnFullscreen().catch(() => {});
        
        if (inputContainer) {
            inputContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
            inputContainer.style.display = ''; 
        }
        body.classList.remove('vn-no-input');

        document.querySelectorAll('#chatMessagesEl .message.vn-current-generated-images')
            .forEach(m => m.classList.remove('vn-current-generated-images'));
        
        document.body.classList.remove('vn-generated-images-visible');
        
        vnOverlay.style.display = 'none';
                
        if(vnBtn) vnBtn.style.display = 'flex';
        if(chatBtn) chatBtn.style.display = 'none';
        
        document.getElementById('vnGenCastLayer').style.backgroundImage = '';

        const crTarget = resolveVnSceneTargetElement()
            || (typeof getVnRenderableMessages === 'function'
                ? getVnRenderableMessages()[vnCurrentIndex] || null
                : null);

        if (crTarget) {
            syncFuraiCrVnSelectedMessage(crTarget);
            requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollFuraiMessageIntoCrView(crTarget, 'center'));
        }

        if (typeof queueFuraiContextMetaRender === 'function') {
            queueFuraiContextMetaRender();
        }
    }

    setTimeout(() => {
        refreshVnPromoState();
        if (typeof updatePinnedFactsUI === 'function') updatePinnedFactsUI();
    }, 0);
}

/* --- VN SMART SCROLL (Adaptive Brake) --- */
// Long Text: Brake Enabled (Prevents accidental skips while reading).
// Short Text: Brake Disabled (Allows fast page flipping).

let vnScrollPressure = 0;
let vnPressureDecay = null;
const VN_TURN_THRESHOLD = 800; // Resistance amount for LONG text

let vnPageFlipCooldown = false; // Prevents "machine gun" skipping on short text

let vnTouchStartX = 0;
let vnTouchStartY = 0;
let vnTouchLastX = 0;
let vnTouchLastY = 0;
let vnTouchStartedAt = 0;
let vnTouchSwipeLocked = false;

const VN_SWIPE_MIN_X = 58;
const VN_SWIPE_MAX_Y = 48;
const VN_SWIPE_RATIO = 1.35;
const VN_SWIPE_MAX_TIME = 700;

function setupVnSmartScroll() {
    const vnBody = document.getElementById('vnMessageBody');
    if (!vnBody) return;

    // --- 1. Auto-Scroll Sensor (The "Break Free" Logic) ---
    vnBody.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
        vnAutoScroll =
            isVnViewingNewestMessage() &&
            isNearScrollBottom(vnBody);

        if (!vnAutoScroll && typeof clearVnPinnedMessageElement === 'function') {
            clearVnPinnedMessageElement();
        }

        if (vnAutoScroll && typeof markFinishedVnNewestSeen === 'function') {
            markFinishedVnNewestSeen();
        }
    }, { passive: true });

    // --- 1.5 Mobile Horizontal Swipe ---
    // Swipe left = next VN bubble. Swipe right = previous VN bubble.
    // Vertical movement stays native so long VN text can still scroll.
    vnBody.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
        if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return;
        if (e.touches.length !== 1) return;

        const touch = e.touches[0];

        vnTouchStartX = touch.clientX;
        vnTouchStartY = touch.clientY;
        vnTouchLastX = touch.clientX;
        vnTouchLastY = touch.clientY;
        vnTouchStartedAt = Date.now();
        vnTouchSwipeLocked = false;
    }, { passive: true });

    vnBody.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
        if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return;
        if (e.touches.length !== 1) return;

        const touch = e.touches[0];
        const dx = touch.clientX - vnTouchStartX;
        const dy = touch.clientY - vnTouchStartY;

        vnTouchLastX = touch.clientX;
        vnTouchLastY = touch.clientY;

        const absX = Math.abs(dx);
        const absY = Math.abs(dy);

        if (absX > 12 && absX > absY * VN_SWIPE_RATIO) {
            vnTouchSwipeLocked = true;
            e.preventDefault();
        }
    }, { passive: false });

    vnBody.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
        if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return;

        const dx = vnTouchLastX - vnTouchStartX;
        const dy = vnTouchLastY - vnTouchStartY;
        const absX = Math.abs(dx);
        const absY = Math.abs(dy);
        const elapsed = Date.now() - vnTouchStartedAt;

        const isHorizontalSwipe =
            vnTouchSwipeLocked &&
            absX >= VN_SWIPE_MIN_X &&
            absY <= VN_SWIPE_MAX_Y &&
            absX > absY * VN_SWIPE_RATIO &&
            elapsed <= VN_SWIPE_MAX_TIME;

        if (!isHorizontalSwipe) return;
        if (vnPageFlipCooldown) return;

        if (dx < 0) vnNavigate(1);
        if (dx > 0) vnNavigate(-1);
        
        markVnUserMovedAway();

        vnPageFlipCooldown = true;
        setTimeout(() => { vnPageFlipCooldown = false; }, 250);
    }, { passive: true });

    vnBody.addEventListener('touchcancel', () => {
        vnTouchSwipeLocked = false;
    }, { passive: true });
    
    // --- 2. Existing Wheel Brake Logic ---
    vnBody.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
        // 1. Safety Checks
        if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return;
        
        const el = e.currentTarget;
        const hasScrollbar = el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight;
        const scrollingUp = e.deltaY < 0;
        const scrollingDown = e.deltaY > 0;

        // --- CASE A: SHORT TEXT (No Scrollbar) ---
        // Direct navigation with small cooldown (No Brake needed)
        if (!hasScrollbar) {
            e.preventDefault();
            
            // If recently flipped, ignore to prevent skipping too many pages
            if (vnPageFlipCooldown) return;

            // Simple sensitivity check (ignore tiny trackpad jitters)
            if (Math.abs(e.deltaY) < 15) return;

            if (scrollingUp) vnNavigate(-1);
            if (scrollingDown) vnNavigate(1);

            // Lock flipping for 250ms
            vnPageFlipCooldown = true;
            setTimeout(() => { vnPageFlipCooldown = false; }, 250);
            return;
        }

        // --- CASE B: LONG TEXT (Has Scrollbar) ---
        // Apply "Brake" Logic so user doesn't skip while reading

        // 1. Check boundaries
        const isAtTop = el.scrollTop <= 0;
        const isAtBottom = Math.abs((el.scrollTop + el.clientHeight) - el.scrollHeight) <= 2;

        // 2. Normal Scrolling (Reset Brake)
        // If we are scrolling UP but not at top, OR scrolling DOWN but not at bottom...
        if ((scrollingUp && !isAtTop) || (scrollingDown && !isAtBottom)) {
            vnScrollPressure = 0; 
            return; // Allow native scroll behavior
        }

        // 3. The "Brake" Logic (At Edge)
        e.preventDefault(); 
        vnScrollPressure += e.deltaY; // Accumulate pressure

        // Reset pressure if user stops scrolling for 800ms
        clearTimeout(vnPressureDecay);
        vnPressureDecay = setTimeout(() => { vnScrollPressure = 0; }, 800);

        // 4. Trigger Turn ONLY if Threshold Met
        if (vnScrollPressure <= -VN_TURN_THRESHOLD) {
            vnNavigate(-1);
            vnScrollPressure = 0; 
        } else if (vnScrollPressure >= VN_TURN_THRESHOLD) {
            vnNavigate(1);
            vnScrollPressure = 0; 
        }
    }, { passive: false });
}

// Initialize on load
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', setupVnSmartScroll);

/* --- VN Copy Function --- */
async function vnCopyMsg() {
    const msg = vnMessagesCache?.[vnCurrentIndex];
    const bodyEl = document.getElementById('vnMessageBody');
    const btn = document.getElementById('vnCopyBtn');

    const textToCopy = (
        bodyEl?.innerText ||
        msg?.content ||
        ''
    ).trim();

    if (!textToCopy) {
        showToast?.("No VN message to copy.");
        return;
    }

    const originalHtml = btn?.innerHTML || '';

    const showCopiedState = () => {
        if (!btn) return;

        btn.innerHTML = `
            <i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i>
            <span>Copied</span>
        `;

        clearTimeout(window.vnCopyResetTimer);
        window.vnCopyResetTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            btn.innerHTML = originalHtml || `
                <span class="material-symbols-outlined">content_copy</span>
                <span>Copy</span>
            `;
        }, 900);
    };

    try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(textToCopy);
        showCopiedState();
    } catch(e) {
        const textArea = document.createElement('textarea');
        textArea.value = textToCopy;
        textArea.style.position = 'absolute';
        textArea.style.left = '-9999px';
        textArea.style.top = '0';

        document.body.appendChild(textArea);
        textArea.select();
        document.execCommand('copy');
        document.body.removeChild(textArea);

        showCopiedState();
    }
}

/* --- VN Save to Concept Board Function --- */
async function vnSaveToConceptBoard() {
    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    if (!chatMessagesEl) return;

    const validMessages = Array.from(chatMessagesEl.querySelectorAll('.message'))
        .filter(m => !m.id?.startsWith('typing-') && m.id !== 'personality-selector-message');

    const sourceMsgEl = validMessages[vnCurrentIndex];
    const btn = document.getElementById('vnConceptSaveBtn');

    if (!sourceMsgEl) {
        showToast?.("No VN message to save.");
        return;
    }

    if (btn) btn.disabled = true;

    try {
        const board = await getFuraiConceptBoard();
        if (!board) return;

        let chatData = null;
        try { chatData = currentChatId ? DB.get(currentChatId) : null; } catch(e) {}

        const content = sourceMsgEl.querySelector('.content')?.innerText || vnMessagesCache?.[vnCurrentIndex]?.content || '';
        const speaker =
            sourceMsgEl.querySelector('.chat-username')?.innerText?.trim() ||
            vnMessagesCache?.[vnCurrentIndex]?.name ||
            (sourceMsgEl.classList.contains('user') ? 'User' :
            sourceMsgEl.classList.contains('ai') ? 'FurAI' :
            sourceMsgEl.classList.contains('system') ? '' :
            sourceMsgEl.classList.contains('narrator') ? '' : 'Unknown');

        const info = {
            type: 'Chatlog',
            chatTitle: chatData?.title || document.getElementById('chatTitleEl')?.innerText || 'New Chat',
            speaker,
            role: sourceMsgEl.classList.contains('user') ? 'user' :
                  sourceMsgEl.classList.contains('ai') ? 'ai' :
                  sourceMsgEl.classList.contains('system') ? 'system' :
                  isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(sourceMsgEl.dataset.role) ? sourceMsgEl.dataset.role :
                  sourceMsgEl.classList.contains('narrator') ? 'narrator' : 'message',
            mode: getCurrentChatModeName(),
            date: new Date().toLocaleString(),
            content
        };

        const blob = await makeChatlogImageBlob(info);

        await board.add(blob, {
            folder: 'Chatlog',
            info
        });

        const vnPanel = document.querySelector('.vn-glass-panel') || document.getElementById('vnMessageBody') || sourceMsgEl;
        furaiBoardFly(vnPanel);
    } catch(e) {
        console.error(e);
        showToast?.("Could not save VN chatlog.");
    }

    setTimeout(() => {
        if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
    }, 600);
}

/* --- NEW: VN Generate Image Function --- */
function vnGenImage() {
    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    // FIX: Filter valid messages
    const validMessages = Array.from(chatMessagesEl.querySelectorAll('.message')).filter(m => m.id !== 'personality-selector-message');
    const sourceMsgEl = validMessages[vnCurrentIndex];
    
    if (sourceMsgEl) {
        // Extract raw text for the prompt
        const prompt = sourceMsgEl.querySelector('.content').innerText;
        generateImagesForMessage(sourceMsgEl, prompt);
        showToast("Generating image...", "info");
    }
}

/* --- FIXED AVATAR TOGGLE --- */
function toggleVnAvatar() {
    // 1. Find elements (Try ID first, fallback to class)
    const container = document.getElementById('vnAvatarContainer') || document.querySelector('.vn-avatar-container');
    const icon = document.getElementById('vnAvatarIcon');
    
    if (!container) {
        console.error("Avatar container not found!");
        return;
    }

    // 2. Toggle Class
    container.classList.toggle('vn-avatar-hidden');
    
    // 3. Update Icon (Check if class is present)
    const isHidden = container.classList.contains('vn-avatar-hidden');
    
    if (icon) {
        icon.textContent = isHidden ? 'frame_person_off' : 'frame_person';
    }
}

/* --- VN Chat Actions Wrappers --- */
function getVnEditableMessageRecord() {
    const messageEl = typeof getVnCurrentMessageElement === 'function'
        ? getVnCurrentMessageElement()
        : null;

    if (!messageEl || isLiveTypingMessage(messageEl)) return null;

    const record = typeof getVnDbMessageRecordFromElement === 'function'
        ? getVnDbMessageRecordFromElement(messageEl)
        : null;

    if (!record) return null;

    return {
        ...record,
        messageEl
    };
}

function removeVnRenderedMessage(messageEl, dbIndex) {
    if (messageEl && document.body.contains(messageEl)) {
        messageEl.remove();
    }

    if (typeof refreshVisibleMessageDomIndexes === 'function') {
        refreshVisibleMessageDomIndexes(dbIndex, -1);
    }
}

function vnRegenerate() {
    const record = getVnEditableMessageRecord();
    if (!record) return;

    retryFuraiMessageFromElement(record.messageEl);
}

function vnDeleteMsg() {
    if (!confirm("Delete this message?")) return;

    const record = getVnEditableMessageRecord();
    if (!record) return;

    const { dbIndex, messageEl } = record;

    // Use the canonical Chat Room mutation path so pinned facts, revisions,
    // Standard Summary, Deep Memory, DOM indexes, and VN state all change once.
    if (typeof deleteMessage === 'function' && deleteMessage(messageEl)) {
        const messages = getVnRenderableMessages();
        vnCurrentIndex = Math.min(vnCurrentIndex, Math.max(messages.length - 1, 0));
        syncVnData();
        renderVnMessage('preserve');
        return;
    }

    console.warn('VN delete could not resolve the canonical message mutation path.', dbIndex);
}

function vnEditMsg() {
    const record = getVnEditableMessageRecord();
    if (!record) return;

    const { chatData, msg, dbIndex, messageEl } = record;

    if (!localStorage.getItem('furai_hint_edit_message')) {
        showOverlayHint(`
            <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; text-align:left;">
                <span style="font-size:12px; opacity:0.9; margin-top:4px;">Actively guide and edit the AI responses to maintain quality and consistency.</span>
            </div>
        `, 0);
        localStorage.setItem('furai_hint_edit_message', 'true');
    }

    const editContainer = document.createElement('div');
    editContainer.className = 'edit-container';

    const header = document.createElement('h3');
    header.textContent = 'Edit Message';
    editContainer.appendChild(header);

    const editTextArea = document.createElement('textarea');
    editTextArea.value = String(msg.content || '');

    const editWordCount = document.createElement('span');
    editWordCount.className = 'edit-word-count';

    const syncEditUi = () => {
        editWordCount.textContent = getEditWordCountText(editTextArea.value);
    };

    editTextArea.addEventListener('input', syncEditUi);

    const editFooter = document.createElement('div');
    editFooter.className = 'edit-footer';

    const editButtons = document.createElement('div');
    editButtons.className = 'edit-buttons';

    const saveButton = document.createElement('button');
    saveButton.textContent = 'Save';
    saveButton.onclick = () => {
        const freshChatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
        const freshMsg = freshChatData?.messages?.[dbIndex];

        if (freshMsg) {
            const pinnedIndex = typeof furaiFindPinnedIndex === 'function'
                ? furaiFindPinnedIndex(freshChatData, freshMsg)
                : -1;

            if (typeof updateAiMessageActiveVariantContent === 'function') {
                updateAiMessageActiveVariantContent(freshMsg, editTextArea.value);
            } else {
                freshMsg.content = editTextArea.value;
            }
            bumpFuraiMessageRevision(freshMsg);
            applyFuraiMessageMutationToChatData(freshChatData, dbIndex, 'edit');

            freshChatData.timestamp = Date.now();

            if (pinnedIndex !== -1 && typeof furaiRefreshPinnedFactForMessage === 'function') {
                furaiRefreshPinnedFactForMessage(freshChatData, freshMsg, messageEl, pinnedIndex);
            } else if (typeof furaiRebuildTimelessFacts === 'function') {
                furaiRebuildTimelessFacts(freshChatData);
            }

            DB.set(currentChatId, freshChatData);
            notifyFuraiMessageMutation(currentChatId, dbIndex, 'edit');
            if (typeof invalidateFuraiContextMetaCountCache === 'function') {
                invalidateFuraiContextMetaCountCache(currentChatId);
            }

            const contentEl = messageEl.querySelector('.content');
            if (contentEl) {
                contentEl.innerHTML = formatMessageContent(freshMsg.content);
            }
        }

        syncVnData();
        renderVnMessage('preserve');

        if (typeof updatePinnedFactsUI === 'function') updatePinnedFactsUI();

        editContainer.remove();
    };

    const cancelButton = document.createElement('button');
    cancelButton.textContent = 'Cancel';
    cancelButton.onclick = () => {
        editContainer.remove();
    };

    editButtons.appendChild(saveButton);
    editButtons.appendChild(cancelButton);
    editFooter.appendChild(editWordCount);
    editFooter.appendChild(editButtons);

    editContainer.appendChild(editTextArea);
    editContainer.appendChild(editFooter);

    document.body.appendChild(editContainer);
    editTextArea.focus();
    syncEditUi();
}

function vnSaveEdit() {
    const input = document.getElementById('vnEditInput');
    if (!input) return;

    const record = getVnEditableMessageRecord();
    if (!record) return;

    const { chatData, msg, dbIndex, messageEl } = record;
    const newText = input.value;

    const pinnedIndex = typeof furaiFindPinnedIndex === 'function'
        ? furaiFindPinnedIndex(chatData, msg)
        : -1;

    if (typeof updateAiMessageActiveVariantContent === 'function') {
        updateAiMessageActiveVariantContent(msg, newText);
    } else {
        msg.content = newText;
    }
    bumpFuraiMessageRevision(msg);
    applyFuraiMessageMutationToChatData(chatData, dbIndex, 'edit');

    chatData.timestamp = Date.now();

    if (pinnedIndex !== -1 && typeof furaiRefreshPinnedFactForMessage === 'function') {
        furaiRefreshPinnedFactForMessage(chatData, msg, messageEl, pinnedIndex);
    } else if (typeof furaiRebuildTimelessFacts === 'function') {
        furaiRebuildTimelessFacts(chatData);
    }

    DB.set(currentChatId, chatData);
    notifyFuraiMessageMutation(currentChatId, dbIndex, 'edit');
    if (typeof invalidateFuraiContextMetaCountCache === 'function') {
        invalidateFuraiContextMetaCountCache(currentChatId);
    }

    const contentEl = messageEl.querySelector('.content');
    if (contentEl) contentEl.innerHTML = formatMessageContent(newText);

    syncVnData();
    vnCancelEdit();
    renderVnMessage('preserve');

    if (typeof updatePinnedFactsUI === 'function') updatePinnedFactsUI();
}

function vnCancelEdit() {
    const editor = document.getElementById('vnEditWrapper');
    if (editor) editor.remove();

    const messageBody = document.getElementById('vnMessageBody');
    if (messageBody) messageBody.style.display = 'block';
}

// --- VN MORE MENU + FULLSCREEN / SHOWCASE ---
function closeVnMoreMenu() {
    const menu = document.getElementById('vnMoreMenu');
    const button = document.getElementById('vnMoreBtn');

    if (menu) menu.hidden = true;
    if (button) button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
}

function toggleVnMoreMenu(event) {
    event?.stopPropagation();

    const menu = document.getElementById('vnMoreMenu');
    const button = document.getElementById('vnMoreBtn');
    if (!menu || !button) return;

    const shouldOpen = menu.hidden;
    menu.hidden = !shouldOpen;
    button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(shouldOpen));

    if (shouldOpen) {
        updateVnFullscreenControls();
        applyVnChatFontToggleState();
    }
}

function getCurrentChatDataForVnFontToggle() {
    if (!currentChatId) return null;

    try {
        return DB.get(currentChatId) || null;
    } catch (e) {
        return null;
    }
}

function isVnChatFontEnabledForCurrentChat() {
    const chatData = getCurrentChatDataForVnFontToggle();
    return chatData?.vnUseChatFont !== false;
}

function applyVnChatFontToggleState(chatData = null) {
    const enabled = chatData ? chatData.vnUseChatFont !== false : isVnChatFontEnabledForCurrentChat();

    document.body.classList.toggle('vn-chat-font-clear', !enabled);

    const icon = document.getElementById('vnFontIcon');
    const label = document.getElementById('vnFontLabel');

    if (icon) icon.textContent = enabled ? 'format_color_text' : 'format_clear';
    if (label) label.textContent = enabled ? 'Font Color' : 'Plain Text';
}

function toggleVnChatFont() {
    const chatData = getCurrentChatDataForVnFontToggle();
    if (!chatData || !currentChatId) return;

    chatData.vnUseChatFont = chatData.vnUseChatFont === false;
    DB.set(currentChatId, chatData);

    applyVnChatFontToggleState(chatData);
}

function getVnFullscreenElement() {
    return document.fullscreenElement || document.webkitFullscreenElement || null;
}

async function requestVnFullscreen() {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const request = root.requestFullscreen || root.webkitRequestFullscreen;

    if (!request) {
        throw new Error('Fullscreen is not supported.');
    }

    await request.call(root);
}

async function exitVnFullscreen() {
    if (!getVnFullscreenElement()) return;

    const exit = document.exitFullscreen || document.webkitExitFullscreen;
    if (exit) await exit.call(document);
}

function updateVnFullscreenControls() {
    const fullscreenActive = !!getVnFullscreenElement();
    const showcaseActive = document.body.classList.contains('vn-fullscreen');

    const fullscreenIcon = document.getElementById('vnFullscreenIcon');
    const fullscreenLabel = document.getElementById('vnFullscreenLabel');
    const showcaseIcon = document.getElementById('vnShowcaseIcon');
    const showcaseLabel = document.getElementById('vnShowcaseLabel');

    if (fullscreenIcon) fullscreenIcon.textContent = fullscreenActive ? 'fullscreen_exit' : 'fullscreen';
    if (fullscreenLabel) fullscreenLabel.textContent = fullscreenActive ? 'Exit Fullscreen' : 'Fullscreen';
    if (showcaseIcon) showcaseIcon.textContent = showcaseActive ? 'fullscreen_exit' : 'cinematic_blur';
    if (showcaseLabel) showcaseLabel.textContent = showcaseActive ? 'Exit Showcase' : 'Showcase';
}

function showVnLandscapeHint() {
    if (window.innerWidth > 768) return;

    showOverlayHint(`
        <i class="fa-solid fa-rotate" style="margin-right:8px;"></i>
        Turn phone to Landscape to show more characters
    `, 4000);
}

async function toggleVnFullscreen() {
    closeVnMoreMenu();

    try {
        if (getVnFullscreenElement()) {
            await exitVnFullscreen();
        } else {
            await requestVnFullscreen();
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.warn('Fullscreen could not be changed:', error);
        showToast?.('Fullscreen is unavailable here.', 'error');
    } finally {
        updateVnFullscreenControls();
    }
}

function toggleVnShowcase() {
    closeVnMoreMenu();

    const body = document.body;
    const entering = !body.classList.contains('vn-fullscreen');

    if (entering) {
        // Showcase is the original UI-free VN view. Keep it independent from
        // native browser fullscreen, which is controlled by Fullscreen above.
        const exitButton = document.getElementById('vnExitFsBtn');
        const overlay = document.getElementById('vnOverlay');

        if (exitButton && overlay && overlay.contains(exitButton)) {
            document.body.appendChild(exitButton);
        }

        if (exitButton) {
            exitButton.style.position = 'fixed';
            exitButton.style.zIndex = '2147483647';
        }

        body.classList.add('vn-fullscreen');

        if (typeof renderVnSprites === 'function') {
            renderVnSprites();
        }
    } else {
        body.classList.remove('vn-fullscreen');
        showVnLandscapeHint();
    }

    updateVnFullscreenControls();
    scheduleVnGeneratedImageLayoutSync();
}

function handleVnBrowserFullscreenChange() {
    // Native Fullscreen and Showcase are separate states. A browser fullscreen
    // change must never erase Showcase or its faint exit button.
    updateVnFullscreenControls();
}

window.closeVnMoreMenu = closeVnMoreMenu;
window.toggleVnMoreMenu = toggleVnMoreMenu;
window.vnJumpToBoundary = vnJumpToBoundary;
window.toggleVnChatFont = toggleVnChatFont;
window.toggleVnFullscreen = toggleVnFullscreen;
window.toggleVnShowcase = toggleVnShowcase;

if (!window.__furaiVnFullscreenEventsBound) {
    window.__furaiVnFullscreenEventsBound = true;

    document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', handleVnBrowserFullscreenChange);
    document.addEventListener('webkitfullscreenchange', handleVnBrowserFullscreenChange);

    document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (!event.target.closest('.vn-more-wrap')) closeVnMoreMenu();
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if (event.key === 'Escape') closeVnMoreMenu();
    });
}

// --- FIXED: Sync Data (Parse Int) ---
function syncVnData() {
    vnMessagesCache = [];

    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');

    if (chatMessagesEl && typeof getVnRenderableMessages === 'function') {
        const domMessages = getVnRenderableMessages();

        if (domMessages.length > 0) {
            // Keep the cache length/index-compatible, but hydrate only the small window that VN needs.
            // Mapping every DOM message here is the long-chat freeze source.
            vnMessagesCache = new Array(domMessages.length);
            window.furaiVnDataCacheDirty = false;
            return;
        }
    }

    try {
        const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
        if (chatData && Array.isArray(chatData.messages)) {
            vnMessagesCache = [...chatData.messages];
        }
    } catch(e) {
        vnMessagesCache = [];
    }

    window.furaiVnDataCacheDirty = false;
}

function hydrateFuraiVnMessageCacheWindow(domMessages, centerIndex, lookBehind = 14, lookAhead = 2) {
    if (!Array.isArray(domMessages) || !Array.isArray(vnMessagesCache)) return;

    const center = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.floor(Number(centerIndex) || 0), domMessages.length - 1));
    const start = Math.max(0, center - lookBehind);
    const end = Math.min(domMessages.length - 1, center + lookAhead);

    for (let i = start; i <= end; i++) {
        if (!vnMessagesCache[i] && domMessages[i]) {
            vnMessagesCache[i] = getVnMessageDataFromElement(domMessages[i], null);
        }
    }
}

/* ==========================================================================
   VN MODE: UNIFIED RENDERER & SPRITE ENGINE (MASTER FIX)
   ========================================================================== */

let furaiVnGeneratedImageLayoutFrame = 0;

function scheduleVnGeneratedImageLayoutSync() {
    if (furaiVnGeneratedImageLayoutFrame) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(furaiVnGeneratedImageLayoutFrame);
    }

    furaiVnGeneratedImageLayoutFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        furaiVnGeneratedImageLayoutFrame = 0;
        syncVnGeneratedImageLayout();
    });
}

function syncVnGeneratedImageLayout() {
    const body = document.body;
    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    const grid = chatMessagesEl?.querySelector(
        '.message.vn-current-generated-images .image-grid-container'
    );

    if (!body.classList.contains('vn-active') || !grid) {
        body.classList.remove('vn-generated-images-single-row');
        body.style.removeProperty('--vn-generated-image-single-width');
        chatMessagesEl?.style.removeProperty('--vn-generated-image-bottom-reserve');
        return;
    }

    const cards = Array.from(grid.children).filter(card =>
        card.classList?.contains('gen-card')
    );

    if (!cards.length) {
        body.classList.remove('vn-generated-images-single-row');
        body.style.removeProperty('--vn-generated-image-single-width');
        return;
    }

    const viewportHeight = document.documentElement.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
    const fullscreen = body.classList.contains('vn-fullscreen');
    const vnPanel = document.querySelector('.vn-glass-panel');

    let reserve = 0;

    if (!fullscreen && vnPanel) {
        const panelRect = vnPanel.getBoundingClientRect();
        reserve = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(viewportHeight - panelRect.top + 8));
    }

    chatMessagesEl.style.setProperty(
        '--vn-generated-image-bottom-reserve',
        `${reserve}px`
    );

    // Measure with the natural VN cap first, so a previous smaller fit does not
    // prevent the image from growing again after resize, keyboard toggle, or Showcase.
    body.style.setProperty('--vn-generated-image-single-width', '512px');

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        if (!grid.isConnected) return;

        const liveCards = Array.from(grid.children).filter(card =>
            card.classList?.contains('gen-card')
        );

        const rowTops = [];
        liveCards.forEach(card => {
            const top = Math.round(card.getBoundingClientRect().top);
            if (!rowTops.some(value => Math.abs(value - top) <= 2)) {
                rowTops.push(top);
