            }
        });

        const singleRow = rowTops.length === 1;
        body.classList.toggle('vn-generated-images-single-row', singleRow);

        if (!singleRow) {
            body.style.removeProperty('--vn-generated-image-single-width');
            return;
        }

        const viewportWidth = document.documentElement.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
        const availableHeight = Math.max(120, viewportHeight - reserve - 16);
        const naturalRect = grid.getBoundingClientRect();

        if (!naturalRect.width || !naturalRect.height) return;

        const heightFitScale = Math.min(1, availableHeight / naturalRect.height);
        const widthCap = Math.max(0, viewportWidth - 20);
        const fittedWidth = Math.max(
            1,
            Math.floor(Math.min(512, widthCap, naturalRect.width * heightFitScale))
        );

        body.style.setProperty(
            '--vn-generated-image-single-width',
            `${fittedWidth}px`
        );
    });
}

if (!window.__furaiVnGeneratedImageLayoutBound) {
    window.__furaiVnGeneratedImageLayoutBound = true;
    window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleVnGeneratedImageLayoutSync, { passive: true });
}

if (!window.__vnGeneratedImageWheelBound) {
    window.__vnGeneratedImageWheelBound = true;

    document.addEventListener('wheel', function(e) {
        if (!document.body.classList.contains('vn-active')) return;

        const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
        if (!chatMessagesEl) return;

        const activeGrid = chatMessagesEl.querySelector('.message.vn-current-generated-images .image-grid-container');
        if (!activeGrid) return;

        const target = e.target;

        if (target.closest && target.closest('#chatMessagesEl')) return;

        if (
            target.closest &&
            target.closest(
                '.vn-glass-panel, .chat-header, .chat-input-container, .modal, .lightbox-modal, #onlineListModal, .settings-menu, .mention-suggestions, #musicPlayerModal'
            )
        ) {
            return;
        }

        if (chatMessagesEl.scrollHeight <= chatMessagesEl.clientHeight + 1) return;

        chatMessagesEl.scrollTop += e.deltaY;
        e.preventDefault();
    }, { passive: false });
}

// --- 1. THE MASTER RENDERER ---
// --- FIXED: Renderer with Scroll Modes & CLICKABLE NAME WITH EMOTION ---
window.renderVnMessage = function(scrollMode = 'top') {
    const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');

    if (
        typeof syncVnData === 'function' &&
        (!Array.isArray(vnMessagesCache) || !vnMessagesCache.length || window.furaiVnDataCacheDirty)
    ) {
        syncVnData();
    }
    
    // Keep VN navigation, text bubble, and sprite engine on the same message list.
    const validMessages = getVnRenderableMessages();

    const targetedMessageEl = getVnPinnedMessageElement() || resolveVnSceneTargetElement();
    if (targetedMessageEl) {
        const targetedIndex = validMessages.indexOf(targetedMessageEl);
        if (targetedIndex !== -1) vnCurrentIndex = targetedIndex;
    }
    
    if (!validMessages.length) {
         const vnBody = document.getElementById('vnMessageBody');
         const variantNav = document.getElementById('vnVariantNav');

         if (window.furaiVnCurrentGeneratedImagesEl) {
             window.furaiVnCurrentGeneratedImagesEl.classList.remove('vn-current-generated-images');
             window.furaiVnCurrentGeneratedImagesEl = null;
         }
         document.body.classList.remove('vn-generated-images-visible');

         if (vnBody) vnBody.innerHTML = "<i>No messages yet...</i>";
         if (variantNav) {
             variantNav.innerHTML = '';
             variantNav.style.display = 'none';
         }
         if (typeof renderFuraiVnContextBoundaryLabel === 'function') {
             renderFuraiVnContextBoundaryLabel(null);
         }

         return;
    }

    vnCurrentIndex = Math.min(
        Math.max(parseInt(vnCurrentIndex, 10) || 0, 0),
        validMessages.length - 1
    );
    
    if (typeof hydrateFuraiVnMessageCacheWindow === 'function') {
        hydrateFuraiVnMessageCacheWindow(validMessages, vnCurrentIndex);
    }

    const sourceMsgEl = validMessages[vnCurrentIndex];
    if (!sourceMsgEl) return;

    const previousGeneratedImageEl = window.furaiVnCurrentGeneratedImagesEl || null;
    if (previousGeneratedImageEl && previousGeneratedImageEl !== sourceMsgEl) {
        previousGeneratedImageEl.classList.remove('vn-current-generated-images');
    }

    if (!resolveVnSceneTargetElement()) {
        setVnSceneTargetFromElement(sourceMsgEl, {
            autoScroll: vnAutoScroll,
            userLocked: false
        });
    }

    if (typeof renderVnMessageVariantNav === 'function') {
        renderVnMessageVariantNav(sourceMsgEl);
    }
    if (typeof renderFuraiVnContextBoundaryLabel === 'function') {
        renderFuraiVnContextBoundaryLabel(sourceMsgEl);
    }
    
    const sourceMsgData = getVnMessageDataFromElement(
        sourceMsgEl,
        vnMessagesCache?.[vnCurrentIndex] || null
    );
    
    if (Array.isArray(vnMessagesCache)) {
        vnMessagesCache[vnCurrentIndex] = sourceMsgData;
    }
    
    const hasVnGeneratedImages = !!sourceMsgEl.querySelector('.image-grid-container');
    
    sourceMsgEl.classList.toggle('vn-current-generated-images', hasVnGeneratedImages);
    document.body.classList.toggle('vn-generated-images-visible', hasVnGeneratedImages);

    if (hasVnGeneratedImages) {
        window.furaiVnCurrentGeneratedImagesEl = sourceMsgEl;
    } else if (window.furaiVnCurrentGeneratedImagesEl === sourceMsgEl) {
        window.furaiVnCurrentGeneratedImagesEl = null;
    }

    scheduleVnGeneratedImageLayoutSync();

    if (hasVnGeneratedImages && scrollMode !== 'preserve') {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            chatMessagesEl.scrollTop = 0;
        });
    }

    // --- A. Sync Content & Scroll ---
    const sourceContent = sourceMsgEl.querySelector('.content');
    const vnBody = document.getElementById('vnMessageBody');
    
    let oldScroll = 0;
    if (vnBody) oldScroll = vnBody.scrollTop;

    if (vnBody) {
        vnBody.classList.remove('vn-typing');

        const createdAt = sourceMsgEl.dataset.createdAt || '';
        const displayTime = getEffectiveTimestampEnabled(currentChatId)
            ? formatMessageTimestampDisplay(createdAt)
            : '';

        const vnOrdinal = typeof getFuraiVnMessageOrdinal === 'function'
            ? getFuraiVnMessageOrdinal(sourceMsgEl)
            : 0;

        const timestampParts = [];
        if (displayTime) timestampParts.push(displayTime);
        if (vnOrdinal) timestampParts.push('#' + vnOrdinal);

        vnBody.innerHTML = sourceContent ? sourceContent.innerHTML : "";

        if (timestampParts.length) {
            const metaTail = document.createElement('span');
            metaTail.className = 'vn-message-timestamp-tail';
            metaTail.textContent = `— ${timestampParts.join(' · ')}`;
            vnBody.appendChild(metaTail);
        }
        
        if (scrollMode === 'bottom') vnScrollToBottom();
        else if (scrollMode === 'preserve') vnBody.scrollTop = oldScroll;        
        else vnBody.scrollTop = 0;

        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            if (typeof markFinishedVnNewestSeen === 'function') {
                markFinishedVnNewestSeen();
            }
        });
    }
    
    if (window.updatePinnedFactsUI) updatePinnedFactsUI();

    // --- B. Sync Identity (FIXED: USE INDEX LOOKUP) ---
    const isAnnouncementAgent = sourceMsgEl.dataset.announcementAgent === 'true';
    const sourceName = sourceMsgEl.querySelector('.chat-username');
    const sourceAvatar = isAnnouncementAgent ? null : sourceMsgEl.querySelector('.chat-avatar');
    
    const nameText = sourceName
        ? (getCleanTimestampSpeakerName(sourceName) || 'System')
        : isAnnouncementAgent
            ? String(sourceMsgData?.botNameSnapshot || 'AI').trim() || 'AI'
            : 'System';

    const nameDisplay = document.getElementById('vnNameDisplay');
    const nameHeader = document.querySelector('.vn-name-header');
    const vnAvatarEl = document.getElementById('vnAvatarImg');

    if (nameDisplay) {
        nameDisplay.textContent = nameText;
    }
    
    let targetBot = null;
    let targetUser = null;
    const profile = typeof getChatProfile === 'function' ? getChatProfile(currentChatId) : null;

    if (profile && sourceMsgData) {
        const dbIndex = typeof getRenderedDbMessageIndex === 'function'
            ? getRenderedDbMessageIndex(sourceMsgEl)
            : null;
        const actor = resolveFuraiActorForMessage(currentChatId, sourceMsgData, profile, dbIndex);
        if (sourceMsgEl.classList.contains('ai')) targetBot = actor;
        if (sourceMsgEl.classList.contains('user')) targetUser = actor;
    }

    // CLICKABLE NAME BADGE 
    if (nameHeader) {
        nameHeader.onclick = null;
        
        if (sourceMsgEl.classList.contains('user')) {
            nameHeader.onclick = (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
        
                if (!profile) return;
        
                const personality = chatPersonalities[currentChatId] || 'researcher';
                const userActor = targetUser || profile.user;
                const currentUrl = vnAvatarEl?.src || userActor.avatar || "";
                const desc = userActor.instructions?.[personality] || userActor.instruction || "User";
                const displayName = nameText || userActor.name || "User";
        
                const isActiveUser = profile.user?.uid && userActor.uid === profile.user.uid;
                openProfileCard(displayName, currentUrl, desc, userActor.hashTag, isActiveUser ? 'user' : null, '', {
                    historicalActor: cloneFuraiData(userActor),
                    historicalActorTarget: !isActiveUser && !userActor.historicalFallback ? { role:'user', actorUid:userActor.uid } : null,
                    ...getFuraiRenderedPortraitOptions(vnAvatarEl)
                });
            };
        } 
        else if (sourceMsgEl.classList.contains('ai')) {
            nameHeader.onclick = (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                if(targetBot) {
                    const currentUrl = vnAvatarEl?.src || targetBot.avatar || "";
                    const currentMsgData = sourceMsgData;
                    const botIdx = Number.isInteger(Number(currentMsgData?.botIndex))
                        ? Number(currentMsgData.botIndex)
                        : null;
                    const activeActor = botIdx !== null ? profile?.bots?.[botIdx] : null;
                    const editableTarget = activeActor?.uid === targetBot.uid ? botIdx : null;
                    openProfileCard(targetBot.name, currentUrl, targetBot.instruction || "AI Character", targetBot.hashTag, editableTarget, '', {
                        historicalActor: cloneFuraiData(targetBot),
                        historicalActorTarget: editableTarget === null && !targetBot.historicalFallback ? { role:'ai', botIndex:botIdx, actorUid:targetBot.uid } : null,
                        ...getFuraiRenderedPortraitOptions(vnAvatarEl)
                    });
                }
            };
        }
    }

    // CLICKABLE AVATAR
    const renderedActor = isAnnouncementAgent
        ? null
        : sourceMsgEl.classList.contains('user')
            ? (targetUser || profile?.user)
            : targetBot;
    const vnPortrait = applyFuraiChatPortrait(
        vnAvatarEl,
        renderedActor || {},
        sourceMsgEl.dataset.vnAvatarEmotion || sourceMsgEl.dataset.vnEmotion || '',
        false
    );

    if (renderedActor && vnPortrait.url && (sourceMsgEl.classList.contains('ai') || sourceMsgEl.classList.contains('user'))) {
        vnAvatarEl.onclick = (e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            if (sourceMsgEl.classList.contains('user')) {
                const personality = chatPersonalities[currentChatId] || 'researcher';
                const userActor = targetUser || profile.user;
                const desc = userActor.instructions?.[personality] || userActor.instruction || "User";
                const isActiveUser = profile.user?.uid && userActor.uid === profile.user.uid;
                openProfileCard(nameText, vnAvatarEl.src, desc, userActor.hashTag, isActiveUser ? 'user' : null, '', {
                    historicalActor: cloneFuraiData(userActor),
                    historicalActorTarget: !isActiveUser && !userActor.historicalFallback ? { role:'user', actorUid:userActor.uid } : null,
                    ...getFuraiRenderedPortraitOptions(vnAvatarEl)
                });
            } else if (targetBot) {
                const botIdx = Number.isInteger(Number(sourceMsgData?.botIndex)) ? Number(sourceMsgData.botIndex) : null;
                const editableTarget = botIdx !== null && profile?.bots?.[botIdx]?.uid === targetBot.uid ? botIdx : null;
                openProfileCard(targetBot.name, vnAvatarEl.src, targetBot.instruction, targetBot.hashTag, editableTarget, '', {
                    historicalActor: cloneFuraiData(targetBot),
                    historicalActorTarget: editableTarget === null && !targetBot.historicalFallback ? { role:'ai', botIndex:botIdx, actorUid:targetBot.uid } : null,
                    ...getFuraiRenderedPortraitOptions(vnAvatarEl)
                });
            }
        };
    } else {
        vnAvatarEl.onclick = null;
    }

    // --- C. Sync Controls ---
    // VN owns one shared control bar. Hide it only when the currently viewed
    // source bubble is the unfinished AI-owned message.
    const sourceIsActiveAiMessage = !!window.isFuraiActiveAiMessageElement?.(sourceMsgEl);
    const vnControlsBar = document.querySelector('#vnOverlay .vn-controls-bar');
    if (vnControlsBar) vnControlsBar.style.display = sourceIsActiveAiMessage ? 'none' : 'flex';

    const sourceControls = sourceMsgEl.querySelector('.message-controls');
    const hasGenBtn = sourceControls && sourceControls.querySelector('.gen-img-btn');
    if(document.getElementById('vnGenBtn')) document.getElementById('vnGenBtn').style.display = hasGenBtn ? 'flex' : 'none';
    const hasRegenBtn = sourceControls && sourceControls.querySelector('.regen-btn');
    if(document.getElementById('vnRegenBtn')) document.getElementById('vnRegenBtn').style.display = hasRegenBtn ? 'flex' : 'none';
    const hasConceptSaveBtn = sourceControls && sourceControls.querySelector('.concept-save-btn');
    if(document.getElementById('vnConceptSaveBtn')) document.getElementById('vnConceptSaveBtn').style.display = hasConceptSaveBtn ? 'flex' : 'none';
    
    const hasEditBtn = sourceControls && sourceControls.querySelector('.edit-btn');
    if(document.getElementById('vnEditBtn')) document.getElementById('vnEditBtn').style.display = hasEditBtn ? 'flex' : 'none';
    if(document.getElementById('vnDeleteBtn')) document.getElementById('vnDeleteBtn').style.display = sourceControls ? 'flex' : 'none';

    // --- D. Sync Background ---
    // Generated image grids stay inside their original chat bubble.
    // Do not turn generated pictures into a VN background clone.
    const castLayer = document.getElementById('vnGenCastLayer');
    if (castLayer) {
        castLayer.style.backgroundImage = '';
    
        const imgMatch = sourceContent
            ? sourceContent.innerText.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+?\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)/i)
            : null;
    
        if (imgMatch) {
            castLayer.style.backgroundImage = `url('${imgMatch[0]}')`;
        }
    }

    // --- E. Render Sprites ---
    if (typeof renderVnSprites === 'function') {
        renderVnSprites(sourceMsgEl);
    }
};

// --- VN Focus Mode State ---
let isVnFocusMode = DB.get('furai_vn_focus') === 'true' || DB.get('furai_vn_focus') === true;

function toggleVnFocus() {
    isVnFocusMode = !isVnFocusMode;
    DB.set('furai_vn_focus', isVnFocusMode);
    
    // Update Icon: 'detection_and_zone' (Active) <-> 'zone_person_idle' (Inactive)
    const icon = document.getElementById('vnFocusIcon');
    if (icon) {
        icon.textContent = isVnFocusMode ? 'detection_and_zone' : 'zone_person_idle';
    }
    
    renderVnSprites();
}

/* --- GROUP PHOTO ACHIEVEMENT TRIGGER --- */
function checkGroupPhotoCondition(spriteCount) {
    const isVN = document.body.classList.contains('vn-active');
    const isShowcase = document.body.classList.contains('vn-fullscreen');

    if (isVN && isShowcase && spriteCount >= 6) {
        AchievementManager.unlock('group_photo');
    }
}

/* --- 2. SPRITE ENGINE --- */
function getVnMessageEmotion(msg, actor) {
    const data = actor?.data || {};
    const savedEmotion = String(msg?.emotion || '').trim();

    if (
        savedEmotion &&
        (
            savedEmotion === 'default' ||
            data.emotionSprites?.[savedEmotion] ||
            data.emotionAvatars?.[savedEmotion] ||
            data.customEmotions?.[savedEmotion]
        )
    ) {
        return savedEmotion;
    }

    return detectBotEmotion(msg?.content || '', data) || 'default';
}


// Shared by VN stage sprites and CR portraits so repeated avatars/sprites
// decode once and every mode switch can keep the previous image until ready.
const furaiPortraitAssetPreloadCache = Object.create(null);

function getFuraiVnSpriteDomKey(value) {
    return String(value || '').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_');
}

function preloadFuraiPortraitAsset(url) {
    const safeUrl = String(url || '').trim();
    if (!safeUrl) return Promise.resolve(false);

    const cached = furaiPortraitAssetPreloadCache[safeUrl];
    if (cached) return cached.promise;

    const img = new Image();
    img.decoding = 'async';

    const promise = new Promise(resolve => {
        img.onload = () => resolve(true);
        img.onerror = () => resolve(false);
    });

    furaiPortraitAssetPreloadCache[safeUrl] = { img, promise };
    img.src = safeUrl;

    if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0) return Promise.resolve(true);
    return promise;
}

function preloadFuraiVnSprite(url) {
    return preloadFuraiPortraitAsset(url);
}

function applyFuraiVnSpriteSrc(imgEl, nextUrl) {
    if (!imgEl) return;

    const safeUrl = String(nextUrl || '').trim();
    if (!safeUrl) return;

    if (imgEl.dataset.vnSpriteSrc === safeUrl && imgEl.getAttribute('src') === safeUrl) return;

    const cached = furaiPortraitAssetPreloadCache[safeUrl];
    if (cached && cached.img && cached.img.complete && cached.img.naturalWidth > 0) {
        imgEl.dataset.vnSpriteSrc = safeUrl;
        imgEl.src = safeUrl;
        return;
    }

    const currentUrl = imgEl.dataset.vnSpriteSrc || imgEl.getAttribute('src') || '';

    // Keep the current sprite visible while the next emotion sprite decodes.
    preloadFuraiVnSprite(safeUrl).then(ok => {
        if (!ok) return;
        if (!imgEl.isConnected) return;
        if (imgEl.dataset.vnPendingSpriteSrc !== safeUrl) return;

        imgEl.dataset.vnSpriteSrc = safeUrl;
        imgEl.src = safeUrl;
        delete imgEl.dataset.vnPendingSpriteSrc;
    });

    imgEl.dataset.vnPendingSpriteSrc = safeUrl;

    if (!currentUrl) {
        imgEl.dataset.vnSpriteSrc = safeUrl;
        imgEl.src = safeUrl;
    }
}

function reconcileFuraiVnSpriteLayer(container, slots) {
    if (!container) return;

    const usedKeys = new Set();

    slots.forEach(slot => {
        const domKey = getFuraiVnSpriteDomKey(slot.key);
        if (!domKey) return;

        usedKeys.add(domKey);

        let imgEl = container.querySelector(`img.vn-sprite-slot[data-vn-sprite-key="${domKey}"]`);

        if (!imgEl) {
            imgEl = document.createElement('img');
            imgEl.className = 'vn-sprite-slot';
            imgEl.dataset.vnSpriteKey = domKey;
            imgEl.style.position = 'absolute';
            imgEl.style.bottom = '-3vh';
            imgEl.style.width = 'auto';
            imgEl.style.maxWidth = 'none';
            imgEl.style.objectFit = 'contain';
            imgEl.style.objectPosition = 'bottom center';
            imgEl.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
            imgEl.style.willChange = 'transform, filter';
            imgEl.style.transition = 'transform 0.28s ease, filter 0.22s ease, left 0.28s ease, height 0.28s ease';
            container.appendChild(imgEl);
        }

        imgEl.alt = slot.alt || '';
        imgEl.style.left = slot.left;
        imgEl.style.height = slot.height;
        imgEl.style.transform = slot.transform;
        imgEl.style.filter = slot.filter;
        imgEl.style.zIndex = slot.zIndex;

        applyFuraiVnSpriteSrc(imgEl, slot.src);
    });

    Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('img.vn-sprite-slot')).forEach(imgEl => {
        if (!usedKeys.has(imgEl.dataset.vnSpriteKey || '')) {
            imgEl.remove();
        }
    });
}

function renderVnSprites(sourceMsgEl = null) {
    const container = document.getElementById('vnSpriteLayer');
    if (!container) return;

    if (!sourceMsgEl && typeof getVnPinnedMessageElement === 'function') {
        sourceMsgEl = getVnPinnedMessageElement();
    }

    const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 768;
    const history = Array.isArray(vnMessagesCache) ? vnMessagesCache : [];
    const rawCurrentIndex = parseInt(vnCurrentIndex, 10);

    if (!history.length || !Number.isFinite(rawCurrentIndex)) {
        container.innerHTML = '';
        return;
    }

    const currentIndex = Math.min(Math.max(rawCurrentIndex, 0), history.length - 1);

    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId) || {};
    const safeBots = Array.isArray(profile.bots) ? profile.bots : [];
    const safeUser = profile.user || {};
    const personality = chatPersonalities[currentChatId] || 'researcher'; 

    let currentSpeakerName = ""; 
    const cachedCurrentMsg = history[currentIndex] || null;
    const currentMsg = typeof getVnMessageDataFromElement === 'function'
        ? getVnMessageDataFromElement(sourceMsgEl, cachedCurrentMsg)
        : cachedCurrentMsg;
    
    if (currentMsg) currentSpeakerName = resolveNameFromMsg(currentMsg, profile);

    let rosterOrder = [];
    const currentDbIndex = sourceMsgEl && typeof getRenderedDbMessageIndex === 'function'
        ? getRenderedDbMessageIndex(sourceMsgEl)
        : null;
    const currentMessageUid = currentMsg?.uid || sourceMsgEl?.dataset?.messageUid || '';

    safeBots.forEach((bot, idx) => {
        if (!bot) return;
        const actorAtScene = resolveFuraiLaneActorAtMessage(
            currentChatId,
            profile,
            'ai',
            idx,
            currentMessageUid,
            currentDbIndex
        );
        if (!actorAtScene || actorAtScene.historicalAbsent === true) return;
        rosterOrder.push({
            type: 'bot',
            name: actorAtScene.name || `Character ${idx + 1}`,
            data: actorAtScene,
            index: idx
        });
    });

    const userAtScene = resolveFuraiLaneActorAtMessage(
        currentChatId,
        profile,
        'user',
        null,
        currentMessageUid,
        currentDbIndex
    );
    if (userAtScene && userAtScene.historicalAbsent !== true) {
        rosterOrder.push({
            type: 'user',
            name: userAtScene.name || "User",
            data: userAtScene,
            index: -1
        });
    }

    let visibleActors = new Map(); 
    let currentSpeakerUid = null;

    const getActorSpriteKey = (actor) => {
        if (!actor) return '';

        const uid = actor.type === 'user'
            ? (actor.data?.uid || safeUser.uid || '')
            : (actor.data?.uid || '');

        return uid || `${actor.type}:${actor.index}:${actor.name || ''}`;
    };
    
    const resolveUid = (msg) => {
        if (!msg) return null;

        if (msg.role === 'user') {
            return msg.userUid || safeUser.uid || null;
        }
    
        if (msg.botUid) return msg.botUid;
    
        const botIndex = parseInt(msg.botIndex, 10);
        if (Number.isFinite(botIndex) && safeBots[botIndex]) {
            return safeBots[botIndex].uid || null;
        }
    
        return null;
    };

    if (currentMsg) currentSpeakerUid = resolveUid(currentMsg);

    const findActorForMsg = (msg) => {
        if (!msg) return null;
        if (msg.role === 'user') return rosterOrder.find(r => r.type === 'user') || null;
        const botIndex = parseInt(msg.botIndex, 10);
        if (Number.isFinite(botIndex)) {
            return rosterOrder.find(r => r.type === 'bot' && r.index === botIndex) || null;
        }
        return null;
    };

    if (currentMsg) {
        const actor = findActorForMsg(currentMsg);
        const actorKey = getActorSpriteKey(actor);

        if (actorKey) {
            visibleActors.set(actorKey, {
                ...actor,
                emotion: getVnMessageEmotion(currentMsg, actor)
            });
        }
    }

    if (!isMobile) {
        const onlineCount = rosterOrder.length;
        const windowSize = Math.min(onlineCount, 6); 
        
        for (let i = currentIndex; i >= 0; i--) {
            const msg = history[i];
            if (!msg) continue;
            if (msg.role === 'system' || isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(msg.role)) continue;
            
            const actor = findActorForMsg(msg);
            const actorKey = getActorSpriteKey(actor);

            if (actorKey && !visibleActors.has(actorKey)) {
                visibleActors.set(actorKey, {
                    ...actor,
                    emotion: getVnMessageEmotion(msg, actor)
                });
            }

            if ((currentIndex - i) >= windowSize + 5) break; 
            if (visibleActors.size >= 6) break;
        }
    }

    const stageActors = rosterOrder
        .filter(actor => visibleActors.has(getActorSpriteKey(actor)))
        .map(actor => visibleActors.get(getActorSpriteKey(actor)))
        .filter(Boolean);

    const userIndex = stageActors.findIndex(a => a.type === 'user');
    if (userIndex !== -1 && !isMobile) {
        const userActor = stageActors.splice(userIndex, 1)[0]; 
        const count = stageActors.length + 1; 
        let insertAt = stageActors.length; 

        if (count === 3) insertAt = 1;      
        else if (count === 4) insertAt = 2; 
        else if (count === 5) insertAt = 2; 
        else if (count === 6) insertAt = 3; 

        stageActors.splice(insertAt, 0, userActor); 
    }

    const count = stageActors.length;
    const spriteSlots = [];
    
    const FORMATIONS = { 
        2: [30, 70], 
        3: [30, 55, 70], 
        4: [15, 35, 70, 85], 
        5: [15, 30, 60, 75, 90], 
        6: [10, 25, 45, 55, 75, 90] 
    };
    
    let positions;
    if (count === 1) {
        positions = (stageActors[0].type === 'user') ? [51] : [49];
    } else {
        positions = FORMATIONS[count] || Array.from({length: count}, (_, i) => (100 / (count + 1)) * (i + 1));
    }

    stageActors.forEach((actor, index) => {
        let spriteUrl = "";
        const charData = actor.data;
        const emotion = actor.emotion; 

        if (emotion !== 'default' && charData.emotionSprites && charData.emotionSprites[emotion]) {
            spriteUrl = charData.emotionSprites[emotion];
        }
        if (!spriteUrl && charData.defaultSprite) spriteUrl = charData.defaultSprite;

        if (!spriteUrl) return; 

        let leftPercent = 50;
        let transform = "translateX(-50%)";
        let baseZ = 300 - Math.abs(50 - leftPercent) * 2;
        
        const actorUid = actor.type === 'user'
            ? (actor.data?.uid || safeUser.uid || null)
            : (actor.data?.uid || null);
        
        const actorIndex = Number.isFinite(parseInt(actor.index, 10))
            ? parseInt(actor.index, 10)
            : null;
        
        const currentBotIndex = currentMsg && currentMsg.botIndex !== undefined
            ? parseInt(currentMsg.botIndex, 10)
            : null;
        
        const isSpeaking =
            (currentSpeakerUid && actorUid && currentSpeakerUid === actorUid) ||
            (
                currentMsg?.role === 'ai' &&
                actor.type === 'bot' &&
                Number.isFinite(currentBotIndex) &&
                actorIndex === currentBotIndex
            ) ||
            (!currentSpeakerUid && actor.name === currentSpeakerName);
                
        let filter = "brightness(1.0)"; 

        if (isSpeaking) {
            if (isVnFocusMode) {
                filter = "brightness(1.0) drop-shadow(0 0 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.2))"; 
            } else {
                filter = "brightness(1.0)";
            }
            baseZ += 500; 
        } 
        else if (!currentSpeakerName || currentSpeakerName === "System" || currentSpeakerName === "Narrator") {
            filter = "brightness(1.0)";
        } 
        else {
            if (isVnFocusMode) {
                filter = "brightness(0.6) drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.5))";
                transform += " scale(0.95)";
                baseZ -= 10;
            } else {
                filter = "brightness(1.0)";
            }
        }

        if (isMobile) {
            if (actor.type === 'user') {
                leftPercent = 55; 
                transform += " scaleX(-1)"; 
            } else {
                leftPercent = 45; 
            }
        } else {
            leftPercent = positions[index];
            if (actor.type === 'user') {
                transform += " scaleX(-1)";
            } else {
                if (leftPercent > 50) transform += " scaleX(-1)";
            }
        }

        let height = isMobile ? "96vh" : "96vh";
        if (count === 1) height = isMobile ? "98vh" : "98vh";

        baseZ = 300 - Math.abs(50 - leftPercent) * 2 + (isSpeaking ? 500 : 0);
        if (!isSpeaking && currentSpeakerName && currentSpeakerName !== "System" && currentSpeakerName !== "Narrator" && isVnFocusMode) {
            baseZ -= 10;
        }

        spriteSlots.push({
            key: `${getActorSpriteKey(actor)}:${actor.type}:${actor.index}`,
            src: spriteUrl,
            alt: actor.name || '',
            left: `${leftPercent}%`,
            height,
            transform,
            filter,
            zIndex: String(Math.floor(baseZ))
        });
    });

    reconcileFuraiVnSpriteLayer(container, spriteSlots);

    if (typeof checkGroupPhotoCondition === 'function') checkGroupPhotoCondition(stageActors.length);
    
    const focusIcon = document.getElementById('vnFocusIcon');
    if (focusIcon) {
        focusIcon.textContent = isVnFocusMode ? 'detection_and_zone' : 'zone_person_idle';
    }
}

    refreshHomeMascot();
}

function refreshHomeVnResearcherPreview(useLiveInputs = false) {
    if (!isHomeScreenActive() || getHomeViewMode() !== 'vn') return;

    if (useLiveInputs) {
        const mascot = getHomeMascotSnapshot();
        const liveName = document.getElementById('globalBotName')?.value.trim();
        const liveAvatar = document.getElementById('globalBotAvatar')?.value.trim();
        const liveSprite = document.getElementById('globalBotSprite')?.value.trim();
        if (liveName !== undefined) mascot.name = liveName || mascot.name;
        if (liveAvatar !== undefined) mascot.avatar = liveAvatar;
        if (liveSprite !== undefined) mascot.defaultSprite = liveSprite;
        refreshHomeMascot({ mascot });
    } else {
        refreshHomeMascot();
    }

    applyBackground(currentChatId);
    refreshVnPromoState();
}

/* --- 3. HELPERS --- */
function resolveNameFromMsg(msg, profile) {
    const actor = resolveFuraiActorForMessage(currentChatId, msg, profile);
    if (actor?.name) return actor.name;
    if (msg?.role === 'user') return msg.userNameSnapshot || profile?.user?.name || 'User';
    if (msg?.role === 'ai') return msg.botNameSnapshot || 'Unknown Character';
    return null;
}

function resolveCharData(msg, profile, name) {
    return resolveFuraiActorForMessage(currentChatId, msg, profile) ||
        createFuraiHistoricalFallbackActor(msg, msg?.role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'ai');
}

// Jump to the first or newest VN message without adding a second navigation system.
function vnJumpToBoundary(edge) {
    if (edge === 'end') {
        jumpToNewestMessage();
        return;
    }

    if (typeof syncVnData === 'function') {
        syncVnData();
    }

    const liveMessages = typeof getVnRenderableMessages === 'function'
        ? getVnRenderableMessages()
        : [];

    const navLength = liveMessages.length || vnMessagesCache.length;
    if (!navLength) return;

    const currentIndex = Math.min(
        Math.max(Number.parseInt(vnCurrentIndex, 10) || 0, 0),
        navLength - 1
    );

    // vnNavigate already owns target locking, status state, and top-of-message rendering.
    vnNavigate(-currentIndex);
}

// Re-Run on Nav
function vnNavigate(dir) {
    clearVnPinnedMessageElement();

    if (
        typeof syncVnData === 'function' &&
        (!Array.isArray(vnMessagesCache) || !vnMessagesCache.length || window.furaiVnDataCacheDirty)
    ) {
        syncVnData();
    }

    const liveMessages = typeof getVnRenderableMessages === 'function'
        ? getVnRenderableMessages()
        : [];

    const navLength = liveMessages.length || vnMessagesCache.length;
    const newIndex = vnCurrentIndex + dir;

    if (newIndex >= 0 && newIndex < navLength) {
        const nextMessageEl = liveMessages[newIndex] || null;

        if (nextMessageEl) {
            const nextIsNewestReadable = newIndex >= getLastReadableMessageIndex();

            setVnSceneTargetFromElement(nextMessageEl, {
                autoScroll: nextIsNewestReadable,
                userLocked: !nextIsNewestReadable
            });
        } else {
            vnCurrentIndex = newIndex;
            vnAutoScroll = false;
            clearGenerationVnLiveTarget();
        }

        markVnUserMovedAway();
        
        // [FIX] Navigation snaps to TOP for reading
        renderVnMessage('top');
        
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            const vnBody = document.getElementById('vnMessageBody');
            const viewingNewestReadable = vnCurrentIndex >= getLastReadableMessageIndex();
        
            vnAutoScroll =
                viewingNewestReadable &&
                (!vnBody || isNearScrollBottom(vnBody));

            if (vnAutoScroll && liveMessages[vnCurrentIndex]) {
                setVnSceneTargetFromElement(liveMessages[vnCurrentIndex], {
                    autoScroll: true,
                    userLocked: false
                });
            }
        
            if (typeof refreshVnLiveStatusHint === 'function') {
                refreshVnLiveStatusHint();
            } else if (isVnMagnetStickingToNewest()) {
                hideVnStatusHint();
            }
        });
    }
}

function toggleVnInput() {
    const inputContainer = document.querySelector('.chat-input-container');
    const btnIcon = document.querySelector('button[onclick="toggleVnInput()"] .material-symbols-outlined');
    
    // Toggle State
    const isHidden = inputContainer.classList.toggle('hidden');
    
    // [FIX] Add a class to BODY so CSS works reliably everywhere
    document.body.classList.toggle('vn-no-input', isHidden);
    
    // Update Icon (On = keyboard, Off = keyboard_off)
    if (btnIcon) {
        btnIcon.textContent = isHidden ? 'keyboard_off' : 'keyboard';
    }

    scheduleVnGeneratedImageLayoutSync();
    setTimeout(scheduleVnGeneratedImageLayoutSync, 320);
}

// Key Listener for VN
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    // --- FIX: GLOBAL DETACH ---
    // If typing in ANY input or textarea, ignore navigation keys completely.
    if (['INPUT', 'TEXTAREA'].includes(document.activeElement.tagName)) return;

    // If the wallpaper lightbox is open, DO NOT let VN hijack left/right.
    const lightbox = document.getElementById('imageLightboxEl');
    const wallpaperLightboxOpen =
        lightbox &&
        lightbox.style.display === 'flex' &&
        window.expWallpaperNav;

    if (wallpaperLightboxOpen) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' && typeof closeLightbox === 'function') {
            e.preventDefault();
            closeLightbox();
        }
        return;
    }

    if (!isVnMode) return;
    
    // Left/Right Arrow for VN Nav
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') vnNavigate(-1);
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') vnNavigate(1);
    
    // Esc for Showcase exit
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && document.body.classList.contains('vn-fullscreen')) {
        toggleVnShowcase();
    }
});

// Hook into Send Message without overriding addMessageDOM's VN scroll rules
const originalAddMessage = window.addMessage || addMessage;
window.addMessage = function(role, content, botIndex, insertIndex, meta) {
    if (typeof originalAddMessage === 'function') {
        return originalAddMessage(role, content, botIndex, insertIndex, meta);
    }
    return addMessageDOM(role, content, botIndex, insertIndex, meta);
};

// --- NEW: Global VN Auto-Scroll State ---
let vnAutoScroll = true;

function vnScrollToBottom() {
    const el = document.getElementById('vnMessageBody');
    if (!el) return;

    // --- LOGIC: Only scroll if the "glue" is active ---
    if (!vnAutoScroll) return;

    // 1. Immediate Scroll
    el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight;

    // 2. "Sticky" Logic: Watch for layout shifts (text wrap/images) for 500ms
    if (el.resizeObserverTimeout) clearTimeout(el.resizeObserverTimeout);
    if (el._stickyObserver) el._stickyObserver.disconnect();

    el._stickyObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
        if (vnAutoScroll) el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight; // Check flag inside observer too
    });
    
    el._stickyObserver.observe(el);
    Array.from(el.children).forEach(child => el._stickyObserver.observe(child));

    // Stop observing after 500ms (settled)
    el.resizeObserverTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        if(el._stickyObserver) {
            el._stickyObserver.disconnect();
            el._stickyObserver = null;
        }
    }, 500);
}

    // If you want to force close, remove the if check.
    input.value = ''; // Clear text
    updateChatList(''); // Reset list
    
    document.getElementById('sidebarSearchPanel').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('sidebarSearchTrigger').style.display = 'flex';
}

function startNewChatFromSidebar() {
    if (typeof blockSidebarDuringFastStart === 'function') {
        blockSidebarDuringFastStart(4200);
    }

    if (document.body.classList.contains("furai-livestream-active") && typeof FuraiLivestream !== "undefined") {
        FuraiLivestream.close({ restoreHome: false });
    }

    if (window.FuraiWorkspaceSurfaceManager?.isActive() && typeof closeExpansionModal === 'function') {
        closeExpansionModal({ restoreHome: false });
    }

    startNewChat(null, { forceFreshHome: true });
    
    // Explicitly ensure it is CLOSED on mobile.
    // Do NOT use toggleMenu() here, as startNewChat() might have already closed it,
    // causing toggleMenu() to accidentally re-open it.
    if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
        const sidebar = document.getElementById('menuSidebarEl');
        if (sidebar) sidebar.classList.remove('open');
    }
}

/* --- FOLDER MANAGER (Modal Version) --- */
/* --- FIXED FOLDER MANAGER (DB BASED) --- */
const FolderManager = {
    // Migrated to DB.get (Decompresses if needed, falls back to JSON)
    getFolders: () => {
        const data = DB.get('furai_folders');
        // Handle migration from null or raw array
        return Array.isArray(data) ? data : []; 
    },
    
    // Migrated to DB.set (Compresses)
    saveFolders: (list) => DB.set('furai_folders', list),

    create: (name) => {
        if (!name.trim()) return;
        const list = FolderManager.getFolders();
        list.push({ id: 'f_' + Date.now(), name: name.trim(), isOpen: true });
        FolderManager.saveFolders(list);
        updateChatList();
    },

    delete: (folderId) => {
        let list = FolderManager.getFolders().filter(f => f.id !== folderId);
        FolderManager.saveFolders(list);

        // Move chats back to root
        for (const key of Object.keys(StorageEngine.cache)) {
            if (key.startsWith('chat-')) {
                try {
                    let chat = DB.get(key);
                    if (chat.folderId === folderId) {
                        delete chat.folderId;
                        DB.set(key, chat);
                    }
                } catch(e) {}
            }
        }
        updateChatList();
    },

    rename: (folderId, newName) => {
        let list = FolderManager.getFolders();
        const f = list.find(f => f.id === folderId);
        if (f) {
            f.name = newName.trim();
            FolderManager.saveFolders(list);
            updateChatList();
        }
    },

    merge: (sourceId, targetId) => {
        if (!targetId) return;
        for (const key of Object.keys(StorageEngine.cache)) {
            if (key.startsWith('chat-')) {
                try {
                    let chat = DB.get(key);
                    if (chat.folderId === sourceId) {
                        chat.folderId = targetId;
                        DB.set(key, chat);
                    }
                } catch(e) {}
            }
        }
        FolderManager.delete(sourceId); 
    },

    toggle: (folderId) => {
        let list = FolderManager.getFolders();
        const f = list.find(f => f.id === folderId);
        if (f) {
            f.isOpen = !f.isOpen;
            FolderManager.saveFolders(list);
            updateChatList();
        }
    },
    
    toggleMaster: () => {
        // Config flags like this are fine in raw localStorage
        const current = localStorage.getItem('furai_folders_master_open') !== 'false';
        
        // [FIXED] Use raw localStorage instead of DB.set to match updateChatList's reading logic
        localStorage.setItem('furai_folders_master_open', (!current).toString());
        
        updateChatList();
    }
};

window.FolderManager = FolderManager;

/* --- UI HANDLERS --- */
let pendingFolderAssignChatId = null; // Remembers the chat we are moving

// 1. Open "Create" Mode
function createNewFolderPrompt(chatIdToAssign = null) {
    pendingFolderAssignChatId = chatIdToAssign; // Store if triggered from inside a chat menu

    document.getElementById('folderModalTitle').textContent = "New Folder";
    document.getElementById('folderCreateView').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('folderManageView').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('newFolderNameInput').value = '';
    
    // Temporarily hide the Chat Options modal so they don't overlap
    if (chatIdToAssign) closeChatOptionsModal();
    
    document.getElementById('folderModalEl').style.display = 'flex';
    setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('newFolderNameInput').focus(), 50);
}

function submitCreateFolder() {
    const name = document.getElementById('newFolderNameInput').value;
    if (name && name.trim()) {
        const newName = name.trim();
        const newId = 'f_' + Date.now();
        
        // A. Create the folder manually so we can grab the exact ID
        const list = FolderManager.getFolders();
        list.push({ id: newId, name: newName, isOpen: true });
        FolderManager.saveFolders(list);

        // B. Check if we need to auto-assign a chat to this new folder
        if (pendingFolderAssignChatId) {
            moveChatToFolder(pendingFolderAssignChatId, newId);
            
            // Re-open the chat options menu so the user sees it selected
            setTimeout(() => {
                openChatOptionsModal(pendingFolderAssignChatId);
                pendingFolderAssignChatId = null; // Reset
            }, 150);
        } else {
            // Standard behavior if clicked from the sidebar
            updateChatList();
        }

        closeFolderModal();
    }
}

// 2. Open "Manage" Mode
function openFolderOptions(folderId, event) {
    if(event) event.stopPropagation();
    
    const folders = FolderManager.getFolders();
    const folder = folders.find(f => f.id === folderId);
    if (!folder) return;

    document.getElementById('folderModalTitle').textContent = "Manage Folder";
    document.getElementById('folderCreateView').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('folderManageView').style.display = 'block';
    
    // Fill Data
    document.getElementById('manageFolderId').value = folderId;
    document.getElementById('renameFolderInput').value = folder.name;

    // Fill Merge Dropdown (Exclude self)
    const mergeSelect = document.getElementById('mergeFolderSelect');
    mergeSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Select Folder --</option>';
    
    const others = folders.filter(f => f.id !== folderId);
    if (others.length === 0) {
        mergeSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="" disabled>No other folders available</option>';
        mergeSelect.disabled = true;
    } else {
        mergeSelect.disabled = false;
        others.forEach(f => {
            const opt = document.createElement('option');
            opt.value = f.id;
            opt.textContent = f.name;
            mergeSelect.appendChild(opt);
        });
    }

    document.getElementById('folderModalEl').style.display = 'flex';
}

function submitRenameFolder() {
    const id = document.getElementById('manageFolderId').value;
    const name = document.getElementById('renameFolderInput').value;
    if (name) {
        FolderManager.rename(id, name);
        showToast("Folder renamed");
    }
}

function submitMergeFolder() {
    const sourceId = document.getElementById('manageFolderId').value;
    const targetId = document.getElementById('mergeFolderSelect').value;
    
    if (!targetId) {
        showToast("Please select a target folder", "error");
        return;
    }
    
    if(confirm("Merge all chats into the selected folder? This folder will be deleted.")) {
        FolderManager.merge(sourceId, targetId);
        closeFolderModal();
        showToast("Folders merged");
    }
}

function submitDeleteFolder() {
    const id = document.getElementById('manageFolderId').value;
    if(confirm("Delete this folder? Chats will move to the general history list.")) {
        FolderManager.delete(id);
        closeFolderModal();
    }
}

function closeFolderModal() {
    document.getElementById('folderModalEl').style.display = 'none';
}

/* --- GLOBAL OVERLAY HINT SYSTEM --- */
function showOverlayHint(htmlContent, duration = 3500) {
    let hintEl = document.getElementById('globalOverlayHint');
    if (!hintEl) {
        hintEl = document.createElement('div');
        hintEl.id = 'globalOverlayHint';
        document.body.appendChild(hintEl);
    }

    // Reset state
    hintEl.classList.remove('visible');
    if (window.overlayHintTimeout) clearTimeout(window.overlayHintTimeout);

    // Create the dismissible content
    hintEl.innerHTML = `
        <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; width:100%;">
            <div style="flex:1;">${htmlContent}</div>
            <button class="hint-close-btn" onclick="document.getElementById('globalOverlayHint').classList.remove('visible')">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>
            </button>
        </div>
    `;

    // Show
    setTimeout(() => {
        hintEl.classList.add('visible');

        // NEW: Only set the auto-hide timer if duration is greater than 0
        if (duration > 0) {
            window.overlayHintTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                hintEl.classList.remove('visible');
            }, duration);
        }
    }, 50);
}
