function getFontMetrics(fontKey, surface = 'ux') {
    const normalizedKey = normalizeSavedFontKey(fontKey || 'default');
    const profile = FONT_METRICS[normalizedKey] || FONT_METRICS.default;
    const defaults = surface === 'chat'
        ? DEFAULT_CHAT_FONT_METRICS
        : DEFAULT_UX_FONT_METRICS;

    return {
        ...defaults,
        ...(profile[surface] || {})
    };
}

const remoteFontLoaders = Object.create(null);
let appFontApplyToken = 0;

const FURAI_FONT_KEY_ALIASES = Object.freeze({
    notepad_classic: 'monospace_classic',
    soft_rounded: 'rounded_sans',
    ming: 'ming_editor',
    ming_style: 'ming_editor',
    noto_serif_tc: 'ming_editor',
    kai: 'kai_brush',
    kai_style: 'kai_brush',
    wenkai: 'kai_brush',
    lxgw_wenkai_tc: 'kai_brush',
    calligraphy: 'script_formal',
    formal_calligraphy: 'script_formal',
    fancy_calligraphy: 'script_fancy',
    handwritten: 'script_printed',
    handwritten_print: 'script_printed',
    casual_script: 'script_casual'
});

const FURAI_VALID_FONT_KEYS = new Set([
    'default',
    'rounded_sans',
    'sci_fi_tech',
    'style_dotgothic',
    'code',
    'monospace_classic',
    'ming_editor',
    'kai_brush',
    'comic',
    'script_printed',
    'script_casual',
    'script_formal',
    'script_fancy',
    'book',
    'editorial_serif',
    'gothic_soft',
    'style_blackletter',
    'style_macondo'
]);

function normalizeSavedFontKey(fontKey, fallback = 'default') {
    const rawKey = String(fontKey || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const normalizedKey = FURAI_FONT_KEY_ALIASES[rawKey] || rawKey;

    if (FURAI_VALID_FONT_KEYS.has(normalizedKey)) {
        return normalizedKey;
    }

    const rawFallback = String(fallback || 'default').trim().toLowerCase();
    const normalizedFallback = FURAI_FONT_KEY_ALIASES[rawFallback] || rawFallback;
    return FURAI_VALID_FONT_KEYS.has(normalizedFallback) ? normalizedFallback : 'default';
}

function normalizeOptionalFontKey(fontKey) {
    const rawKey = String(fontKey || '').trim().toLowerCase();

    if (
        !rawKey ||
        rawKey === 'global' ||
        rawKey === '__inherit__' ||
        rawKey === 'inherit' ||
        rawKey === 'follow_global'
    ) {
        return '';
    }

    const normalizedKey = FURAI_FONT_KEY_ALIASES[rawKey] || rawKey;
    return FURAI_VALID_FONT_KEYS.has(normalizedKey) ? normalizedKey : '';
}

const FURAI_TEXT_COLOR_STORAGE_KEY = 'furai_text_colors';

const FURAI_TEXT_COLOR_TARGETS = [
    ['plain', 'Plain text'],
    ['speech', 'Speech / quoted'],
    ['action', 'Action / italic'],
    ['emphasis', 'Emphasis / bold']
];

function getDefaultTextColorHex(key, theme = getCurrentThemeMode()) {
    if (key !== 'emphasis') return '';

    return theme === 'light' ? '#1378E4' : '#FF6D00';
}

function getDefaultTextColorAlpha(key) {
    if (key === 'action') return 0.6;
    if (key === 'emphasis') return 0.9;
    return 1;
}

function makeEmptyTextColorSlot(key = '', theme = getCurrentThemeMode()) {
    return {
        color: getDefaultTextColorHex(key, theme),
        alpha: getDefaultTextColorAlpha(key)
    };
}

function makeEmptyTextColorTheme(theme = getCurrentThemeMode()) {
    return {
        plain: makeEmptyTextColorSlot('plain', theme),
        speech: makeEmptyTextColorSlot('speech', theme),
        action: makeEmptyTextColorSlot('action', theme),
        emphasis: makeEmptyTextColorSlot('emphasis', theme)
    };
}

function normalizeTextColorValue(value) {
    const raw = String(value || '').trim();

    if (!raw) return '';

    const shortHex = raw.match(/^#([0-9a-f]{3})$/i);
    if (shortHex) {
        return '#' + shortHex[1].split('').map(ch => ch + ch).join('').toLowerCase();
    }

    if (/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(raw)) {
        return raw.toLowerCase();
    }

    return '';
}

function normalizeTextColorAlpha(value, key = '') {
    const num = Number(value);

    if (!Number.isFinite(num)) return getDefaultTextColorAlpha(key);

    return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, num));
}

function normalizeTextColorSlot(value, key = '', theme = getCurrentThemeMode()) {
    const fallback = makeEmptyTextColorSlot(key, theme);

    if (typeof value === 'string') {
        return {
            color: normalizeTextColorValue(value) || fallback.color,
            alpha: getDefaultTextColorAlpha(key)
        };
    }

    if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
        const normalizedColor = normalizeTextColorValue(value.color);
        let alpha = normalizeTextColorAlpha(value.alpha, key);

        if (!normalizedColor && key === 'emphasis' && Number(value.alpha) === 1) {
            alpha = fallback.alpha;
        }

        return {
            color: normalizedColor || fallback.color,
            alpha
        };
    }

    return fallback;
}

function normalizeTextColorMap(data) {
    const source = data && typeof data === 'object' ? data : {};
    const map = {
        dark: makeEmptyTextColorTheme('dark'),
        light: makeEmptyTextColorTheme('light')
    };

    ['dark', 'light'].forEach(theme => {
        FURAI_TEXT_COLOR_TARGETS.forEach(([key]) => {
            map[theme][key] = normalizeTextColorSlot(source?.[theme]?.[key], key, theme);
        });
    });

    return map;
}

function textColorThemeHasValues(themeColors, theme = getCurrentThemeMode()) {
    return FURAI_TEXT_COLOR_TARGETS.some(([key]) => {
        const slot = normalizeTextColorSlot(themeColors?.[key], key, theme);
        const defaultSlot = makeEmptyTextColorSlot(key, theme);

        return slot.color !== defaultSlot.color || slot.alpha !== defaultSlot.alpha;
    });
}

function setTextColorTheme(existingMap, theme, nextThemeColors) {
    const map = normalizeTextColorMap(existingMap);
    const safeTheme = theme === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark';

    map[safeTheme] = makeEmptyTextColorTheme(safeTheme);

    FURAI_TEXT_COLOR_TARGETS.forEach(([key]) => {
        map[safeTheme][key] = normalizeTextColorSlot(nextThemeColors?.[key], key, safeTheme);
    });

    if (!textColorThemeHasValues(map.dark, 'dark') && !textColorThemeHasValues(map.light, 'light')) {
        return null;
    }

    return map;
}

function getSavedGlobalTextColors() {
    try {
        return normalizeTextColorMap(DB.get(FURAI_TEXT_COLOR_STORAGE_KEY));
    } catch (e) {
        return normalizeTextColorMap(null);
    }
}

function getResolvedTextColorsForChatData() {
    const theme = getCurrentThemeMode();
    return getSavedGlobalTextColors()[theme];
}

function hexToRgbParts(hex) {
    const safeHex = normalizeTextColorValue(hex);
    if (!safeHex) return null;

    return {
        r: parseInt(safeHex.slice(1, 3), 16),
        g: parseInt(safeHex.slice(3, 5), 16),
        b: parseInt(safeHex.slice(5, 7), 16)
    };
}

function formatTextColorCssValue(slotValue, fallbackHex = '') {
    const slot = normalizeTextColorSlot(slotValue);
    const color = slot.color || normalizeTextColorValue(fallbackHex);
    const rgb = hexToRgbParts(color);

    if (!rgb) return '';

    if (slot.alpha >= 1) {
        return color;
    }

    return `rgba(${rgb.r}, ${rgb.g}, ${rgb.b}, ${slot.alpha})`;
}

function applyTextColorsForChatData() {
    const root = document.getElementById('chatInterfaceEl');
    if (!root) return;

    const colors = getResolvedTextColorsForChatData();
    const fallbackColor = getTextColorPickerFallback();

    FURAI_TEXT_COLOR_TARGETS.forEach(([key]) => {
        const slot = normalizeTextColorSlot(colors[key], key);
        const shouldApply =
            key === 'action' ||
            slot.color ||
            slot.alpha !== getDefaultTextColorAlpha(key);

        const value = shouldApply
            ? formatTextColorCssValue(slot, fallbackColor)
            : '';

        const cssVar = `--furai-text-${key}`;

        if (value) {
            root.style.setProperty(cssVar, value);
        } else {
            root.style.removeProperty(cssVar);
        }
    });
}

function applyTextColorsForCurrentChat() {
    applyTextColorsForChatData();
}

function rgbToHexColor(value) {
    const raw = String(value || '').trim();

    if (/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(raw)) return raw.toLowerCase();

    const rgb = raw.match(/^rgba?\((\d+),\s*(\d+),\s*(\d+)/i);
    if (!rgb) return '';

    return '#' + [rgb[1], rgb[2], rgb[3]]
        .map(num => Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Number(num))).toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
        .join('');
}

function getTextColorPickerFallback() {
    const source = document.getElementById('chatInterfaceEl') || document.body;
    const computed = getComputedStyle(source);
    return rgbToHexColor(computed.getPropertyValue('--text-color') || computed.color) || '#ffffff';
}

function setTextColorField(prefix, key, value) {
    const input = document.getElementById(`${prefix}_${key}`);
    const picker = document.getElementById(`${prefix}_${key}_picker`);
    const normalized = normalizeTextColorValue(value);

    if (input) {
        input.value = normalized;
    }

    if (picker && normalized) {
        picker.value = normalized;
    }

    updateTextColorEditorPreview(prefix);
}

function handleTextColorHexInput(prefix, key) {
    const input = document.getElementById(`${prefix}_${key}`);
    const picker = document.getElementById(`${prefix}_${key}_picker`);
    const normalized = normalizeTextColorValue(input?.value);

    if (picker && normalized) {
        picker.value = normalized;
    }

    updateTextColorEditorPreview(prefix);
}

function clearTextColorField(prefix, key) {
    const input = document.getElementById(`${prefix}_${key}`);
    const alpha = document.getElementById(`${prefix}_${key}_alpha`);
    const defaultSlot = makeEmptyTextColorSlot(key, getCurrentThemeMode());

    if (input) input.value = defaultSlot.color;
    if (alpha) alpha.value = String(defaultSlot.alpha);

    updateTextColorEditorPreview(prefix);
}

function readTextColorEditorValues(prefix) {
    const theme = getCurrentThemeMode();
    const values = makeEmptyTextColorTheme(theme);

    FURAI_TEXT_COLOR_TARGETS.forEach(([key]) => {
        values[key] = normalizeTextColorSlot({
            color: document.getElementById(`${prefix}_${key}`)?.value,
            alpha: document.getElementById(`${prefix}_${key}_alpha`)?.value
        }, key, theme);
    });

    return values;
}

function updateTextColorSwatch(prefix, key) {
    const input = document.getElementById(`${prefix}_${key}`);
    const alpha = document.getElementById(`${prefix}_${key}_alpha`);
    const alphaDisplay = document.getElementById(`${prefix}_${key}_alphaDisplay`);
    const swatchInner = document.getElementById(`${prefix}_${key}_swatchInner`);

    const slot = normalizeTextColorSlot({
        color: input?.value,
        alpha: alpha?.value
    }, key);

    const cssValue = formatTextColorCssValue(slot, getTextColorPickerFallback());

    if (alphaDisplay) {
        alphaDisplay.textContent = `${Math.round(slot.alpha * 100)}%`;
    }

    if (swatchInner) {
        swatchInner.style.background = cssValue;
        swatchInner.style.opacity = '1';
    }
}

function updateTextColorEditorPreview(prefix) {
    FURAI_TEXT_COLOR_TARGETS.forEach(([key]) => {
        updateTextColorSwatch(prefix, key);
    });

    const values = readTextColorEditorValues(prefix);

    FURAI_TEXT_COLOR_TARGETS.forEach(([key]) => {
        const previewEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}_preview_${key}`);
        if (!previewEl) return;

        previewEl.style.color = formatTextColorCssValue(
            normalizeTextColorSlot(values[key], key),
            getTextColorPickerFallback()
        );
    });
}

function buildTextColorPreviewHtml(prefix) {
    return `
        <div data-furai-ui-translate style="margin-top:12px; padding-top:12px; border-top:1px dashed var(--border-color);">
            <div style="font-size:12px; opacity:0.65; margin-bottom:8px;">Preview</div>

            <div class="message ai"
                 style="max-width:100%; margin:0;">
                <div class="message-content-wrapper" style="max-width:100%; min-width:0;">
                    <div class="content" style="white-space:normal; width:auto; max-width:100%; box-sizing:border-box;">
                        <span id="${prefix}_preview_plain">Plain text starts the reply.</span>
                        <span id="${prefix}_preview_speech"> “Quoted speech uses the speech color.”</span>
                        <span id="${prefix}_preview_action" class="furai-action-text" style="font-style:italic;"> The action text leans italic.</span>
                        <span id="${prefix}_preview_emphasis" style="font-weight:700;"> Bold emphasis lands harder.</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    `;
}

function buildTextColorEditorHtml(prefix, savedColors, options = {}) {
    const theme = getCurrentThemeMode();
    const title = options.title || 'Text Colors';
    const hint = options.hint || `Editing current theme: ${theme === 'light' ? 'Light' : 'Dark'}`;
    const fallbackColor = getTextColorPickerFallback();
    const actionHtml = options.actionHtml || '';

    const rows = FURAI_TEXT_COLOR_TARGETS.map(([key, label]) => {
        const slot = normalizeTextColorSlot(savedColors?.[key], key);
        const pickerValue = slot.color || fallbackColor;
        const swatchValue = formatTextColorCssValue(slot, fallbackColor);

        return `
            <div class="furai-text-color-row">
                <label for="${prefix}_${key}" class="furai-text-color-label">${label}</label>

                <input id="${prefix}_${key}"
                       class="furai-text-color-hex"
                       type="text"
                       value="${escapeHTML(slot.color)}"
                       placeholder="Default"
                       maxlength="7"
                       spellcheck="false"
                       inputmode="text"
                       oninput="handleTextColorHexInput('${prefix}', '${key}')">

                <label class="furai-text-color-swatch"
                       title="Pick ${label}">
                    <span id="${prefix}_${key}_swatchInner"
                          class="furai-text-color-swatch-inner"
                          style="background:${swatchValue};"></span>

                    <input id="${prefix}_${key}_picker"
                           type="color"
                           value="${pickerValue}"
                           oninput="setTextColorField('${prefix}', '${key}', this.value)"
                           style="position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; opacity:0; cursor:pointer;">
                </label>

                <div class="furai-text-color-alpha-wrap">
                    <input id="${prefix}_${key}_alpha"
                           type="range"
                           min="0"
                           max="1"
                           step="0.05"
                           value="${slot.alpha}"
                           oninput="updateTextColorEditorPreview('${prefix}')"
                           style="width:100%; height:4px; cursor:pointer; display:block; padding:0;">
                </div>

                <span id="${prefix}_${key}_alphaDisplay"
                      class="furai-text-color-alpha-display">
                    ${Math.round(slot.alpha * 100)}%
                </span>
            </div>
        `;
    }).join('');

    return `
        <div class="furai-text-color-editor">
            <div class="furai-text-color-head">
                <div class="furai-text-color-title-wrap">
                    <div class="furai-text-color-title">${title}</div>
                    <div class="furai-text-color-hint">${hint}</div>
                </div>

                ${actionHtml}
            </div>

            <div class="furai-text-color-rows">
                ${rows}
            </div>

            ${buildTextColorPreviewHtml(prefix)}
        </div>
    `;
}

function renderGlobalTextColorsEditor() {
    const host = document.getElementById('globalTextColorsEditor');
    if (!host) return;

    const theme = getCurrentThemeMode();
    const source = isAccountModalOpen()
        ? getAccountTextColorDraft()
        : getSavedGlobalTextColors();

    const colors = source[theme];

    host.innerHTML = buildTextColorEditorHtml('globalTextColor', colors, {
        title: 'Text Colors',
        hint: `Editing current theme: ${theme === 'light' ? 'Light' : 'Dark'}`,
        actionHtml: `
            <button type="button"
                    onclick="resetGlobalTextColorsForCurrentTheme()"
                    style="border:1px solid var(--border-color); background:var(--input-bg); color:var(--text-color); border-radius:7px; padding:7px 10px; cursor:pointer; font-size:12px; white-space:nowrap;">
                Reset colors
            </button>
        `
    });

    updateTextColorEditorPreview('globalTextColor');
}

function saveGlobalTextColorsFromAccount() {
    captureGlobalTextColorsDraftFromEditor();

    const next = normalizeTextColorMap(getAccountTextColorDraft());
    const hasAnyTextColor =
        textColorThemeHasValues(next.dark, 'dark') ||
        textColorThemeHasValues(next.light, 'light');

    try {
        if (hasAnyTextColor) {
            DB.set(FURAI_TEXT_COLOR_STORAGE_KEY, next);
        } else {
            DB.remove(FURAI_TEXT_COLOR_STORAGE_KEY);
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Failed to save text colors:', e);
    }
}

function resetGlobalTextColorsForCurrentTheme() {
    const theme = getCurrentThemeMode();

    if (isAccountModalOpen()) {
        const draft = getAccountTextColorDraft();
        draft[theme] = makeEmptyTextColorTheme(theme);

        renderGlobalTextColorsEditor();

        if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
            showToast('Text color draft reset for this theme.', 'success');
        }

        return;
    }

    const next = setTextColorTheme(getSavedGlobalTextColors(), theme, makeEmptyTextColorTheme(theme));

    try {
        if (next) {
            DB.set(FURAI_TEXT_COLOR_STORAGE_KEY, next);
        } else {
            DB.remove(FURAI_TEXT_COLOR_STORAGE_KEY);
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Failed to reset text colors:', e);
    }

    renderGlobalTextColorsEditor();
    applyTextColorsForCurrentChat();

    if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
        showToast('Text colors reset for this theme.', 'success');
    }
}

function isAccountModalOpen() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('accountModalEl');
    return !!modal && modal.style.display === 'flex';
}

function getAccountTextColorDraft() {
    if (!accountTextColorDraft) {
        accountTextColorDraft = normalizeTextColorMap(getSavedGlobalTextColors());
    }

    return accountTextColorDraft;
}

function captureGlobalTextColorsDraftFromEditor() {
    if (!isAccountModalOpen()) return;

    const firstInput = document.getElementById('globalTextColor_plain');
    if (!firstInput) return;

    const theme = getCurrentThemeMode();
    const draft = getAccountTextColorDraft();

    draft[theme] = readTextColorEditorValues('globalTextColor');
}

const FURAI_DEFAULT_FONT_STACK = `-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif`;
const FURAI_CHAT_FONT_GLOBAL_VALUE = 'global';
const FURAI_CHAT_FONT_MAIN_VALUE = 'main';

const FURAI_FONT_OPTIONS = [
    ['default', 'Default'],
    ['rounded_sans', 'UI Sans'],
    ['sci_fi_tech', 'Sci-Fi Tech'],
    ['style_dotgothic', 'Retro Pixel'],
    ['code', 'Coding Monospace'],
    ['monospace_classic', 'Classic Monospace'],
    ['ming_editor', 'Ming Style'],
    ['kai_brush', 'Kai Style'],
    ['comic', 'Comic'],
    ['script_printed', 'Handwritten Print'],
    ['script_casual', 'Casual Script'],
    ['script_formal', 'Formal Calligraphy'],
    ['script_fancy', 'Fancy Calligraphy'],
    ['book', 'Text Serif'],
    ['editorial_serif', 'Editorial Serif'],
    ['gothic_soft', 'Old-Style Serif'],
    ['style_blackletter', 'Blackletter'],
    ['style_macondo', 'Medieval']
];

function buildFontOptionsHtml(selectedFont = 'default', options = {}) {
    const includeGlobal = options.includeGlobal === true;
    const includeMain = options.includeMain === true;
    const selectedRaw = String(selectedFont || (includeGlobal ? FURAI_CHAT_FONT_GLOBAL_VALUE : 'default')).trim();
    const selected = selectedRaw === FURAI_CHAT_FONT_GLOBAL_VALUE || selectedRaw === FURAI_CHAT_FONT_MAIN_VALUE
        ? selectedRaw
        : normalizeSavedFontKey(selectedRaw || 'default');
    const optionRows = [
        ...(includeGlobal ? [[FURAI_CHAT_FONT_GLOBAL_VALUE, options.globalLabel || 'Follow Parent Font']] : []),
        ...(includeMain ? [[FURAI_CHAT_FONT_MAIN_VALUE, options.mainLabel || 'Follow Main Font']] : []),
        ...FURAI_FONT_OPTIONS
    ];

    return optionRows.map(([value, label]) => {
        const isSelected = value === selected ? 'selected' : '';
        const optionLabel = value === 'default' ? options.defaultLabel || 'Default' : label;
        return `<option value="${value}" ${isSelected}>${optionLabel}</option>`;
    }).join('');
}

function getSavedInterfaceFont() {
    try {
        return normalizeSavedFontKey(DB.get('furai_ui_font') || 'default');
    } catch (e) {
        return 'default';
    }
}

function hasSavedGlobalFontForMode(mode) {
    const normalizedMode = String(mode || '').trim();
    if (!normalizedMode || normalizedMode === 'home') return false;

    try {
        const savedFont = DB.get(`global-font-${normalizedMode}`);
        return savedFont !== null &&
            savedFont !== undefined &&
            String(savedFont).trim() !== '';
    } catch (e) {
        return false;
    }
}

function getSavedGlobalFontForMode(mode) {
    const normalizedMode = String(mode || '').trim();

    if (!normalizedMode || normalizedMode === 'home') {
        return getSavedInterfaceFont();
    }

    let savedFont = null;

    try {
        savedFont = DB.get(`global-font-${normalizedMode}`);
    } catch (e) {}

    if (savedFont === null || savedFont === undefined || String(savedFont).trim() === '') {
        return getSavedInterfaceFont();
    }

    return normalizeSavedFontKey(savedFont, getSavedInterfaceFont());
}

const FURAI_CHAT_FONT_OVERRIDE_KEY = 'chatFontOverride';

function normalizeChatFontChoice(fontKey) {
    const raw = String(fontKey || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (raw === FURAI_CHAT_FONT_MAIN_VALUE || raw === 'follow_main' || raw === 'follow_main_font') {
        return FURAI_CHAT_FONT_MAIN_VALUE;
    }
    return normalizeOptionalFontKey(raw) || FURAI_CHAT_FONT_GLOBAL_VALUE;
}

function getChatFontChoice(chatData) {
    return normalizeChatFontChoice(chatData?.[FURAI_CHAT_FONT_OVERRIDE_KEY]);
}

function getChatFontOverride(chatData) {
    const choice = getChatFontChoice(chatData);
    return choice === FURAI_CHAT_FONT_GLOBAL_VALUE || choice === FURAI_CHAT_FONT_MAIN_VALUE ? '' : choice;
}

function chatUsesIndependentFont(chatData) {
    return !!getChatFontOverride(chatData);
}

function normalizeChatFontState(chatData) {
    if (!chatData) return false;

    const previousOverrideRaw = String(chatData[FURAI_CHAT_FONT_OVERRIDE_KEY] || '').trim();
    let fontChoice = normalizeChatFontChoice(previousOverrideRaw);
    const legacyFont = String(chatData.fontStyle || '').trim();
    const legacyOwner = String(chatData.fontStyleOwner || '').trim();
    const legacyExplicitOverride =
        legacyOwner === 'chat' ||
        (!legacyOwner && (
            chatData.fontStyleOverride === true ||
            chatData.fontStyleMode === 'custom' ||
            chatData.fontStyleLocked === true
        ));

    if (fontChoice === FURAI_CHAT_FONT_GLOBAL_VALUE && legacyExplicitOverride) {
        fontChoice = normalizeOptionalFontKey(legacyFont) || FURAI_CHAT_FONT_GLOBAL_VALUE;
    }

    const hadLegacyState =
        chatData.fontStyle !== undefined ||
        chatData.fontStyleOwner !== undefined ||
        chatData.fontStyleMode !== undefined ||
        chatData.fontStyleOverride !== undefined ||
        chatData.fontStyleLocked !== undefined;

    if (fontChoice === FURAI_CHAT_FONT_GLOBAL_VALUE) {
        delete chatData[FURAI_CHAT_FONT_OVERRIDE_KEY];
    } else {
        chatData[FURAI_CHAT_FONT_OVERRIDE_KEY] = fontChoice;
    }

    delete chatData.fontStyle;
    delete chatData.fontStyleOwner;
    delete chatData.fontStyleMode;
    delete chatData.fontStyleOverride;
    delete chatData.fontStyleLocked;

    return hadLegacyState || previousOverrideRaw !== (fontChoice === FURAI_CHAT_FONT_GLOBAL_VALUE ? '' : fontChoice);
}

function getChatPersonalityForFontData(chatData) {
    const directPersonality = String(chatData?.personality || '').trim();
    if (directPersonality) return directPersonality;

    const chatId = String(chatData?.id || '').trim();
    const indexedPersonality = chatId && typeof chatPersonalities !== 'undefined'
        ? String(chatPersonalities?.[chatId] || '').trim()
        : '';

    if (indexedPersonality) return indexedPersonality;
    return 'researcher';
}

function getChatFontSelectValue(chatData) {
    return getChatFontChoice(chatData);
}

function resolveChatFontState(chatData) {
    const choice = getChatFontChoice(chatData);
    const mode = getChatPersonalityForFontData(chatData);

    if (choice === FURAI_CHAT_FONT_MAIN_VALUE) {
        return { source: 'main', mode: '', fontKey: getSavedInterfaceFont() };
    }

    const overrideFont = getChatFontOverride(chatData);
    if (overrideFont) {
        return { source: 'chat', mode: '', fontKey: overrideFont };
    }

    return { source: 'global', mode, fontKey: getSavedGlobalFontForMode(mode) };
}

function getChatFontForData(chatData) {
    return resolveChatFontState(chatData).fontKey;
}

function writeChatFontChoice(chatData, fontKey) {
    if (!chatData) return;

    const choice = normalizeChatFontChoice(fontKey);
    if (choice === FURAI_CHAT_FONT_GLOBAL_VALUE) {
        delete chatData[FURAI_CHAT_FONT_OVERRIDE_KEY];
    } else {
        chatData[FURAI_CHAT_FONT_OVERRIDE_KEY] = choice;
    }

    delete chatData.fontStyle;
    delete chatData.fontStyleOwner;
    delete chatData.fontStyleMode;
    delete chatData.fontStyleOverride;
    delete chatData.fontStyleLocked;
}

function refreshCurrentChatFontIfInheritsGlobal(mode = '') {
    if (!currentChatId) return;

    try {
        const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
        if (!chatData || chatUsesIndependentFont(chatData)) return;

        const choice = getChatFontChoice(chatData);
        const currentMode = getChatPersonalityForFontData(chatData);

        if (mode) {
            if (choice !== FURAI_CHAT_FONT_GLOBAL_VALUE || currentMode !== mode) return;
        } else if (choice === FURAI_CHAT_FONT_GLOBAL_VALUE && hasSavedGlobalFontForMode(currentMode)) {
            return;
        }

        void applyChatRenderFontForData(chatData);
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Error refreshing inherited chat font:', e);
    }
}

let furaiChatFontApplySequence = 0;

function setChatFontCssVariables(target, fontStack, metrics) {
    const numberOr = (value, fallback) => Number.isFinite(value) ? value : fallback;
    const scale = numberOr(metrics?.scale, 1);
    const spacing = numberOr(metrics?.spacing, 0);
    const weight = numberOr(metrics?.weight, null);
    const inputScale = scale * numberOr(metrics?.inputScale, 1);
    const nameScale = scale * numberOr(metrics?.nameScale, 1);
    const timestampScale = scale * numberOr(metrics?.timestampScale, 1);
    const vnScale = scale * numberOr(metrics?.vnScale, 1);
    const vnMobileScale = scale * numberOr(metrics?.vnMobileScale, 1);
    const vnNameScale = scale * numberOr(metrics?.vnNameScale, 1);

    target.style.setProperty('--furai-chat-font', fontStack);
    target.style.setProperty('--furai-chat-font-size', `${scale.toFixed(4)}rem`);
    target.style.setProperty('--furai-chat-input-font-size', `${inputScale.toFixed(4)}rem`);
    target.style.setProperty('--furai-chat-name-font-size', `${(0.9 * nameScale).toFixed(4)}rem`);
    target.style.setProperty('--furai-chat-vn-font-size', `${(1.2 * vnScale).toFixed(4)}rem`);
    target.style.setProperty('--furai-chat-vn-mobile-font-size', `${(0.97 * vnMobileScale).toFixed(4)}rem`);
    target.style.setProperty('--furai-chat-vn-name-font-size', `${vnNameScale.toFixed(4)}rem`);
    target.style.setProperty('--furai-chat-timestamp-font-size', `${(0.6875 * timestampScale).toFixed(4)}rem`);
    target.style.setProperty('--furai-chat-letter-spacing', spacing ? `${spacing}em` : 'normal');
    target.style.setProperty('--furai-chat-font-weight', weight ? String(weight) : 'normal');

    target.style.setProperty(
        '--furai-chat-line-height',
        Number.isFinite(metrics?.lineBox) ? `${metrics.lineBox}rem` : 'normal'
    );
    target.style.setProperty('--furai-chat-input-line-height', `${numberOr(metrics?.inputLineBox, 1.4)}rem`);
    target.style.setProperty('--furai-chat-name-line-height', `${numberOr(metrics?.nameLineBox, 1.08)}rem`);
    target.style.setProperty('--furai-chat-vn-line-height', `${numberOr(metrics?.vnLineBox, 1.92)}rem`);
    target.style.setProperty('--furai-chat-vn-mobile-line-height', `${numberOr(metrics?.vnMobileLineBox, 1.3774)}rem`);

    target.style.setProperty('--furai-chat-bubble-pad-y', `${numberOr(metrics?.bubblePadY, 12)}px`);
    target.style.setProperty('--furai-chat-bubble-pad-x', `${numberOr(metrics?.bubblePadX, 12)}px`);
    target.style.setProperty('--furai-chat-input-pad-y', `${numberOr(metrics?.inputPadY, 10)}px`);
    target.style.setProperty('--furai-chat-input-pad-x', `${numberOr(metrics?.inputPadX, 12)}px`);
    target.style.setProperty('--furai-chat-name-pad-y', `${numberOr(metrics?.namePadY, 2)}px`);
    target.style.setProperty('--furai-chat-name-pad-x', `${numberOr(metrics?.namePadX, 7)}px`);
    target.style.setProperty('--furai-chat-name-gap', `${numberOr(metrics?.nameGap, 4)}px`);
    target.style.setProperty('--furai-chat-message-gap', `${numberOr(metrics?.messageGap, 28)}px`);
}

function applyChatRenderFontForData(chatData, options = {}) {
    const chatRoot = document.getElementById('chatInterfaceEl');
    if (!chatRoot || !chatData) return;

    const chatId = String(chatData.id || '').trim();
    if (chatId && currentChatId && chatId !== currentChatId) return;

    const previewState = options.previewState && typeof options.previewState === 'object'
        ? {
            source: String(options.previewState.source || 'preview'),
            mode: String(options.previewState.mode || ''),
            fontKey: normalizeSavedFontKey(options.previewState.fontKey || 'default')
        }
        : null;

    const applySequence = ++furaiChatFontApplySequence;
    const resolvedState = previewState || resolveChatFontState(chatData);
    const normalizedKey = normalizeSavedFontKey(resolvedState.fontKey || 'default');
    const fontStack = normalizedKey === 'default'
        ? FURAI_DEFAULT_FONT_STACK
        : getAppFontStack(normalizedKey);
    const metrics = getFontMetrics(normalizedKey, 'chat');

    if (!fontStack) {
        clearChatRenderFont();
        return;
    }

    setChatFontCssVariables(chatRoot, fontStack, metrics);
    chatRoot.classList.add('chat-render-font-active');
    document.body.classList.add('furai-chat-font-active');
    chatRoot.dataset.chatFontSource = resolvedState.source;
    chatRoot.dataset.chatFontMode = resolvedState.mode;
    chatRoot.dataset.chatFontKey = normalizedKey;

    if (typeof applyVnChatFontToggleState === 'function') {
        applyVnChatFontToggleState(chatData);
    }

    void ensureRemoteFont(normalizedKey).then(() => {
        if (applySequence !== furaiChatFontApplySequence) return;
        if (chatId && currentChatId !== chatId) return;

        if (previewState) {
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                if (applySequence !== furaiChatFontApplySequence) return;
                if (chatId && currentChatId !== chatId) return;
                setChatFontCssVariables(chatRoot, fontStack, metrics);
            });
            return;
        }

        let latestChatData = chatData;
        try {
            if (chatId) latestChatData = DB.get(chatId) || chatData;
        } catch (e) {}

        const latestState = resolveChatFontState(latestChatData);
        const latestKey = normalizeSavedFontKey(latestState.fontKey || 'default');
        if (latestKey !== normalizedKey || latestState.source !== resolvedState.source) {
            void applyChatRenderFontForData(latestChatData);
            return;
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            if (applySequence !== furaiChatFontApplySequence) return;
            if (chatId && currentChatId !== chatId) return;
            setChatFontCssVariables(chatRoot, fontStack, metrics);
        });
    });
}

function clearChatRenderFont() {
    furaiChatFontApplySequence++;

    const chatRoot = document.getElementById('chatInterfaceEl');
    if (!chatRoot) return;

    [
        '--furai-chat-font',
        '--furai-chat-font-size',
        '--furai-chat-input-font-size',
        '--furai-chat-name-font-size',
        '--furai-chat-vn-font-size',
        '--furai-chat-vn-mobile-font-size',
        '--furai-chat-vn-name-font-size',
        '--furai-chat-timestamp-font-size',
        '--furai-chat-letter-spacing',
        '--furai-chat-font-weight',
        '--furai-chat-line-height',
        '--furai-chat-input-line-height',
        '--furai-chat-name-line-height',
        '--furai-chat-vn-line-height',
        '--furai-chat-vn-mobile-line-height',
        '--furai-chat-bubble-pad-y',
        '--furai-chat-bubble-pad-x',
        '--furai-chat-input-pad-y',
        '--furai-chat-input-pad-x',
        '--furai-chat-name-pad-y',
        '--furai-chat-name-pad-x',
        '--furai-chat-name-gap',
        '--furai-chat-message-gap'
    ].forEach(name => chatRoot.style.removeProperty(name));

    chatRoot.classList.remove('chat-render-font-active');
    document.body.classList.remove('furai-chat-font-active');
    document.body.classList.remove('vn-chat-font-clear');
    delete chatRoot.dataset.chatFontSource;
    delete chatRoot.dataset.chatFontMode;
    delete chatRoot.dataset.chatFontKey;
}

function saveChatFontStyle(chatId, fontKey) {
    const targetId = chatId || optionsTargetChatId || currentChatId;
    if (!targetId) return;

    try {
        const chatData = DB.get(targetId);
        if (!chatData) return;

        writeChatFontChoice(chatData, fontKey);
        DB.set(targetId, chatData);

        if (targetId === currentChatId) {
            void applyChatRenderFontForData(chatData);
        }

        if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
            showToast('Chat font updated.', 'success');
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Error saving chat font:', e);
    }
}
      
function ensureGoogleFontsPreconnect() {
    if (!document.getElementById('gf-preconnect-api')) {
        const link = document.createElement('link');
        link.id = 'gf-preconnect-api';
        link.rel = 'preconnect';
        link.href = 'https://fonts.googleapis.com';
        document.head.appendChild(link);
    }

    if (!document.getElementById('gf-preconnect-static')) {
        const link = document.createElement('link');
        link.id = 'gf-preconnect-static';
        link.rel = 'preconnect';
        link.href = 'https://fonts.gstatic.com';
        link.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
        document.head.appendChild(link);
    }
}

function ensureRemoteFont(fontKey) {
    const normalizedKey = normalizeSavedFontKey(fontKey);
    const meta = REMOTE_FONT_META[normalizedKey];
    if (!meta) return Promise.resolve();

    if (remoteFontLoaders[normalizedKey]) return remoteFontLoaders[normalizedKey];

    ensureGoogleFontsPreconnect();

    remoteFontLoaders[normalizedKey] = new Promise(resolve => {
        const existing = document.getElementById(`lazy-font-${normalizedKey}`);
        if (existing) {
            if (document.fonts && meta.probe) {
                document.fonts.load(meta.probe).then(() => resolve()).catch(() => resolve());
            } else {
                resolve();
            }
            return;
        }

        const link = document.createElement('link');
        link.id = `lazy-font-${normalizedKey}`;
        link.rel = 'stylesheet';
        link.href = meta.href;

        link.onload = () => {
            if (document.fonts && meta.probe) {
                document.fonts.load(meta.probe).then(() => resolve()).catch(() => resolve());
            } else {
                resolve();
            }
        };

        link.onerror = () => resolve();
        document.head.appendChild(link);
    });

    return remoteFontLoaders[normalizedKey];
}

function getAppFontStack(fontKey) {
    switch (normalizeSavedFontKey(fontKey)) {
        case 'rounded_sans':
            return `"Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif`;

        case 'sci_fi_tech':
            return `"Oxanium", sans-serif`;
      
        case 'style_dotgothic':
            return `"DotGothic16", sans-serif`;

        case 'code':
            return `"Inconsolata", monospace`;
        
        case 'monospace_classic':
            return `"Courier Prime", monospace`;

        case 'ming_editor':
            return `"Noto Serif TC", serif`;

        case 'kai_brush':
            return `"LXGW WenKai TC", serif`;

        case 'comic':
            return `"Comic Neue", sans-serif`;

        case 'script_casual':
            return `"Caveat", cursive`;

        case 'script_formal':
            return `"Quintessential", cursive`;
        
        case 'script_fancy':
            return `"Italianno", cursive`;

        case 'script_printed':
            return `"Patrick Hand", cursive`;

        case 'book':
            return `"Literata", serif`;

        case 'editorial_serif':
            return `"Cormorant Garamond", serif`;

        case 'gothic_soft':
            return `"Goudy Bookletter 1911", serif`;

        case 'style_blackletter':
            return `"Grenze", serif`;

        case 'style_macondo':
            return `"Macondo", cursive`;

        default:
            return ``;
    }
}

async function applyAppFont(fontKey) {
    const normalizedKey = normalizeSavedFontKey(fontKey || 'default');
    const token = ++appFontApplyToken;

    await ensureRemoteFont(normalizedKey);

    if (token !== appFontApplyToken) return;

    const resolved = normalizedKey === 'default'
        ? FURAI_DEFAULT_FONT_STACK
        : getAppFontStack(normalizedKey);
    const metrics = getFontMetrics(normalizedKey, 'ux');
    const scale = Number.isFinite(metrics?.scale) ? metrics.scale : 1;
    const spacing = Number.isFinite(metrics?.spacing) ? metrics.spacing : 0;
    const weight = Number.isFinite(metrics?.weight) ? metrics.weight : null;
    const root = document.documentElement;

    root.style.setProperty('--furai-ui-font', resolved || FURAI_DEFAULT_FONT_STACK);
    root.style.setProperty('--furai-ux-font-size', `${scale}rem`);
    root.style.setProperty('--furai-ux-letter-spacing', spacing ? `${spacing}em` : 'normal');
    root.style.setProperty('--furai-ux-font-weight', weight ? String(weight) : 'normal');

    document.body.style.fontFamily = 'var(--furai-ui-font)';
    document.body.style.fontSize = scale !== 1 ? `${scale}rem` : '';
    document.body.style.letterSpacing = spacing ? `${spacing}em` : '';
    document.body.style.fontWeight = weight ? String(weight) : '';

    document.body.style.lineHeight = '';
}

function normalizeFuraiAvatarSize(value) {
    const normalized = String(value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (normalized === 'sprite') return 'sprite';
    if (normalized === 'large') return 'large';
    return 'default';
}

let furaiAvatarSizeMode = 'default';

function resolveFuraiPortraitSource(defaultUrl = '', emotionMap = {}, emotion = '') {
    const baseUrl = String(defaultUrl || '').trim();
    const key = String(emotion || '').trim();
    const emotionUrl = key && key !== 'default'
        ? String(emotionMap?.[key] || '').trim()
        : '';

    return {
        url: emotionUrl || baseUrl,
        fallbackUrl: emotionUrl && emotionUrl !== baseUrl ? baseUrl : ''
    };
}

function getFuraiChatPortrait(
    actor = {},
    emotion = '',
    useSpriteMode = furaiAvatarSizeMode === 'sprite' &&
                    !document.body.classList.contains('home-vn-mode')
) {

    const source = resolveFuraiPortraitSource(
        useSpriteMode
            ? (actor?.defaultSprite || actor?.emotionSprites?.default || '')
            : actor?.avatar,
        useSpriteMode ? actor?.emotionSprites : actor?.emotionAvatars,
        emotion
    );

    return {
        ...source,
        isSprite: useSpriteMode && !!source.url
    };
}

function actorHasFuraiPortraitAsset(actor = {}) {
    const directSources = [actor?.avatar, actor?.defaultSprite];
    const mappedSources = [actor?.emotionAvatars, actor?.emotionSprites]
        .flatMap(map => Object.values(map || {}));

    return [...directSources, ...mappedSources]
        .some(url => String(url || '').trim());
}

function applyFuraiPreloadedPortraitSource(img, primaryUrl = '', fallbackUrl = '', handlers = {}) {
    if (!img) return false;

    const token = (img._furaiPortraitLoadToken || 0) + 1;
    img._furaiPortraitLoadToken = token;

    const candidates = [...new Set([primaryUrl, fallbackUrl]
        .map(url => String(url || '').trim())
        .filter(Boolean))];

    if (!candidates.length) {
        handlers.onFail?.();
        img.removeAttribute('src');
        img.style.display = 'none';
        return false;
    }

    const hasCurrentImage = !!(
        img.getAttribute('src') &&
        img.complete &&
        img.naturalWidth > 0
    );

    handlers.onPending?.(hasCurrentImage);

    void (async () => {
        let loadedUrl = '';

        for (const candidate of candidates) {
            if (await preloadFuraiPortraitAsset(candidate)) {
                loadedUrl = candidate;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (img._furaiPortraitLoadToken !== token) return;

        if (!loadedUrl) {
            handlers.onFail?.();
            img.removeAttribute('src');
            img.style.display = 'none';
            return;
        }

        handlers.onShow?.(loadedUrl);

        if (img.getAttribute('src') !== loadedUrl) {
            img.src = loadedUrl;
        }

        img.style.display = '';
    })();

    return true;
}

function applyFuraiChatPortrait(img, actor = {}, emotion = '', useSpriteMode) {
    if (!img) return getFuraiChatPortrait(actor, emotion, useSpriteMode);

    img._furaiPortraitActor = actor;
    img._furaiPortraitEmotion = String(emotion || '').trim();
    img.loading = 'lazy';
    img.decoding = 'async';

    const portrait = getFuraiChatPortrait(actor, emotion, useSpriteMode);
    const slot = img.closest('.furai-chat-portrait-slot') || img._furaiPortraitSlot || null;

    applyFuraiPreloadedPortraitSource(img, portrait.url, portrait.fallbackUrl, {
        onPending: (hasCurrentImage) => {
            if (slot) slot.style.display = '';
            if (!hasCurrentImage) img.style.display = 'none';
        },
        onShow: () => {
            img.classList.toggle('furai-chat-sprite', portrait.isSprite);
            slot?.classList.toggle('furai-chat-portrait-slot-sprite', portrait.isSprite);
            if (slot) slot.style.display = '';
            syncOpenProfileCardToRenderedPortrait(img, actor);
        },
        onFail: () => {
            img.classList.remove('furai-chat-sprite');
            slot?.classList.remove('furai-chat-portrait-slot-sprite');
            if (slot) slot.style.display = 'none';
        }
    });

    return portrait;
}

function createFuraiChatPortraitImage(actor = {}, emotion = '') {
    // Keep one persistent slot whenever this actor has either avatar or sprite art.
    // A hidden slot can therefore become visible immediately when Settings changes.
    if (!actorHasFuraiPortraitAsset(actor)) return null;

    const slot = document.createElement('div');
    slot.className = 'furai-chat-portrait-slot';

    const img = document.createElement('img');
    img.className = 'chat-avatar';
    img._furaiPortraitSlot = slot;
    slot._furaiPortraitImage = img;
    slot.appendChild(img);

    applyFuraiChatPortrait(img, actor, emotion);
    return img;
}

function appendFuraiChatPortrait(messageEl, img) {
    if (!messageEl || !img) return;

    const slot = img.closest('.furai-chat-portrait-slot') || img._furaiPortraitSlot || null;
    if (slot) messageEl.appendChild(slot);
}

function refreshFuraiChatPortraits() {
    const chatRoot = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
    if (!chatRoot) return;

    chatRoot.querySelectorAll('.message .furai-chat-portrait-slot').forEach(slot => {
        const img = slot.querySelector('.chat-avatar') || slot._furaiPortraitImage;
        const actor = img?._furaiPortraitActor;
        if (!img || !actor) return;

        applyFuraiChatPortrait(
            img,
            actor,
            img._furaiPortraitEmotion || ''
        );
    });
}

function refreshFuraiHomeGreetingPortrait(mascot = getHomeMascotSnapshot()) {
    const img = document.getElementById('homeSelectorBotAvatar');
    if (!img) return;

    const button = img.closest('.home-selector-avatar-btn');
    const portrait = getFuraiChatPortrait(mascot);

    applyFuraiPreloadedPortraitSource(img, portrait.url, portrait.fallbackUrl, {
        onPending: (hasCurrentImage) => {
            if (button) button.style.display = 'flex';
            if (!hasCurrentImage) img.style.display = 'none';
        },
        onShow: () => {
            img.classList.toggle('furai-home-sprite', portrait.isSprite);
            button?.classList.toggle('furai-home-sprite-btn', portrait.isSprite);
            if (button) button.style.display = 'flex';
        },
        onFail: () => {
            img.classList.remove('furai-home-sprite');
            button?.classList.remove('furai-home-sprite-btn');
            if (button) button.style.display = 'none';
        }
    });
}

function getSavedFuraiAvatarSize() {
    try {
        return normalizeFuraiAvatarSize(DB.get('furai_chat_avatar_size'));
    } catch (e) {
        return 'default';
    }
}

function updateFuraiAvatarSizeSettingUI(size = null) {
    const normalized = normalizeFuraiAvatarSize(size || getSavedFuraiAvatarSize());
    const mascot = typeof getHomeMascotSnapshot === 'function'
        ? (getHomeMascotSnapshot() || {})
        : {};
    const avatar = String(mascot.avatar || '').trim();
    const sprite = String(
        mascot.defaultSprite ||
        mascot.emotionSprites?.default ||
        ''
    ).trim();

    document.querySelectorAll('.furai-avatar-size-option[data-avatar-size]').forEach(option => {
        const selected = option.dataset.avatarSize === normalized;
        option.classList.toggle('is-selected', selected);
        option.setAttribute('aria-pressed', selected ? 'true' : 'false');
    });

    const previewSources = {
        accountAvatarSizeDefaultPreview: avatar,
        accountAvatarSizeLargePreview: avatar,
        accountAvatarSizeSpritePreview: sprite
    };

    Object.entries(previewSources).forEach(([id, url]) => {
        const preview = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!preview) return;

        preview.style.display = url ? 'block' : 'none';
        if (url && preview.getAttribute('src') !== url) preview.src = url;

        preview.onerror = () => {
            preview.style.display = 'none';
        };
    });
}

function applyFuraiAvatarSize(size, options = {}) {
    const normalized = normalizeFuraiAvatarSize(size);
    const changed = furaiAvatarSizeMode !== normalized;

    furaiAvatarSizeMode = normalized;
    document.body.classList.toggle('furai-avatar-size-large', normalized === 'large');
    document.body.classList.toggle('furai-avatar-use-sprite', normalized === 'sprite');

    if (changed || options.forceRefresh === true) {
        refreshFuraiChatPortraits();
        refreshFuraiHomeGreetingPortrait();
    }

    if (options.updateControls !== false) updateFuraiAvatarSizeSettingUI(normalized);
    return normalized;
}

async function restoreSavedAppFont() {
    try {
        let savedFont = DB.get('furai_ui_font') || 'default';
        savedFont = normalizeSavedFontKey(savedFont);

        if (savedFont === 'monospace_classic' && DB.get('furai_ui_font') === 'notepad_classic') {
            DB.set('furai_ui_font', 'monospace_classic');
        }

        await applyAppFont(savedFont);
    } catch (e) {
        await applyAppFont('default');
    }
}

function applySidebarModePreview(mode) {
    if (!mode) return;
    updateChatList(document.getElementById('chatSearchInput')?.value || '');
}

function previewSidebarMode(mode) {
    applySidebarModePreview(mode);
}

function revertSidebarModePreview() {
    if (accountSidebarPreviewOriginal) {
        const select = document.getElementById('sidebarModeSelect');
        if (select) select.value = accountSidebarPreviewOriginal;
        applySidebarModePreview(accountSidebarPreviewOriginal);
    }
}

function previewAccountFont(fontKey) {
    const normalizedKey = normalizeSavedFontKey(fontKey || 'default');
    void applyAppFont(normalizedKey);
    if (!currentChatId) return;

    try {
        const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
        if (!chatData || chatUsesIndependentFont(chatData)) return;

        const choice = getChatFontChoice(chatData);
        const mode = getChatPersonalityForFontData(chatData);
        if (choice === FURAI_CHAT_FONT_GLOBAL_VALUE && hasSavedGlobalFontForMode(mode)) return;

        accountFontPreviewChatId = currentChatId;
        void applyChatRenderFontForData(chatData, {
            previewState: {
                source: choice === FURAI_CHAT_FONT_MAIN_VALUE ? 'main-preview' : 'mode-main-preview',
                mode,
                fontKey: normalizedKey
            }
        });
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Interface font chat preview failed:', e);
    }
}

function revertAccountFontPreview() {
    const original = normalizeSavedFontKey(accountFontPreviewOriginal || DB.get('furai_ui_font') || 'default');
    const select = document.getElementById('fontStyleSelect');

    if (select) {
        select.value = original;
    }

    void applyAppFont(original);

    const previewChatId = accountFontPreviewChatId;
    accountFontPreviewChatId = null;

    if (previewChatId && previewChatId === currentChatId) {
        try {
            const savedChatData = DB.get(previewChatId);
            if (savedChatData) {
                void applyChatRenderFontForData(savedChatData);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('Interface font chat preview restore failed:', e);
        }
    }
}

function updateEntryGateNoticeVisibility() {
    const notice = document.getElementById('entryGateNotice');
    if (!notice) return;

    let dismissed = false;

    try {
        dismissed = DB.get('furai_entry_gate_notice_ack') === 'true';
    } catch (e) {
        dismissed = localStorage.getItem('furai_entry_gate_notice_ack') === 'true';
    }

    notice.style.display = dismissed ? 'none' : 'block';
}

function dismissEntryGateNotice() {
    try {
        DB.set('furai_entry_gate_notice_ack', 'true');
    } catch (e) {
        localStorage.setItem('furai_entry_gate_notice_ack', 'true');
    }

    updateEntryGateNoticeVisibility();
}
      
// Lightweight machine-translated interface. It changes UI labels only.
// Keep this catalog aligned with AI Furry Generator so both sites offer the same

const FURAI_UI_LANGUAGE_KEY = 'furai_ui_language_v1';

const FURAI_UI_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS = Object.freeze(
    FURAI_UI_LANGUAGE_GROUPS.flatMap(group =>
        group.items.map(option => Object.freeze({
            ...option,
            group: group.label
        }))
    )
);
const FURAI_UI_LANGUAGE_BY_VALUE = new Map(
    FURAI_UI_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS.map(option => [option.value, option])
);
const FURAI_UI_LANGUAGES = new Set(
    FURAI_UI_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS
        .filter(option => option.value !== 'auto')
        .map(option => option.value)
);

// Chat-language hierarchy:
// Settings & Data -> per-mode Global Chat Settings -> per-chat Memo.
// Interface Language and Chat Language are intentionally independent. Never resolve the
// account chat language through the UI or browser language. The resolved instruction
// remains inside the Memo block. English intentionally adds nothing.
const FURAI_CHAT_LANGUAGE_KEY = 'furai_chat_language_v1';
const FURAI_MODE_CHAT_LANGUAGE_KEY_PREFIX = 'global_chat_language_';
const FURAI_CHAT_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS_CACHE = new Map();
const FURAI_CHAT_LANGUAGE_VALUES_CACHE = new Map();

function normalizeFuraiChatLanguageScope(scope) {
    return scope === 'chat' || scope === 'mode' ? scope : 'account';
}

function getFuraiChatLanguageOptions(scope = 'account') {
    const normalizedScope = normalizeFuraiChatLanguageScope(scope);
    const cached = FURAI_CHAT_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS_CACHE.get(normalizedScope);
    if (cached) return cached;

    // Reuse the complete regional Interface Language catalog. Only inheritance
    // choices differ by scope; the actual language list stays identical everywhere.
    const languageOptions = FURAI_UI_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS
        .filter(option => option.value !== 'auto')
        .map(option => Object.freeze({
            value: option.value,
            label: option.value === 'en' ? 'English (default)' : option.label,
            flag: option.flag || '',
            inherits: false,
            group: option.group || 'Languages'
        }));

    let options = languageOptions;

    if (normalizedScope === 'chat') {
        options = [
            { value: 'mode', label: 'Follow Mode Language', flag: '', inherits: true, group: 'Defaults' },
            { value: 'global', label: 'Follow Global Language', flag: '', inherits: true, group: 'Defaults' },
            ...languageOptions
        ];
    } else if (normalizedScope === 'mode') {
        options = [
            { value: 'global', label: 'Follow Global Language', flag: '', inherits: true, group: 'Defaults' },
            ...languageOptions
        ];
    }

    const frozenOptions = Object.freeze(options.map(option => Object.freeze(option)));
    FURAI_CHAT_LANGUAGE_OPTIONS_CACHE.set(normalizedScope, frozenOptions);
    FURAI_CHAT_LANGUAGE_VALUES_CACHE.set(
        normalizedScope,
        new Set(frozenOptions.map(option => option.value))
    );
    return frozenOptions;
}

function normalizeFuraiChatLanguagePreference(value, scope = 'account') {
    const normalizedScope = normalizeFuraiChatLanguageScope(scope);
    const normalized = String(value || '').trim();

    if (!FURAI_CHAT_LANGUAGE_VALUES_CACHE.has(normalizedScope)) {
        getFuraiChatLanguageOptions(normalizedScope);
    }

    if (FURAI_CHAT_LANGUAGE_VALUES_CACHE.get(normalizedScope)?.has(normalized)) {
        return normalized;
    }

    return normalizedScope === 'chat' ? 'mode' : (normalizedScope === 'mode' ? 'global' : 'en');
}

function getFuraiGlobalChatLanguagePreference() {
    let value = null;
    try { value = DB.get(FURAI_CHAT_LANGUAGE_KEY); } catch (error) {}
    return normalizeFuraiChatLanguagePreference(value, 'account');
}

function getFuraiModeChatLanguageKey(mode) {
    return `${FURAI_MODE_CHAT_LANGUAGE_KEY_PREFIX}${String(mode || 'researcher')}`;
}

function getFuraiModeChatLanguagePreference(mode) {
    let value = null;
    try { value = DB.get(getFuraiModeChatLanguageKey(mode)); } catch (error) {}
    return normalizeFuraiChatLanguagePreference(value, 'mode');
}

function resolveFuraiGlobalChatLanguage(preference = getFuraiGlobalChatLanguagePreference()) {
    return normalizeFuraiChatLanguagePreference(preference, 'account');
}

function resolveFuraiModeChatLanguage(mode, preference = getFuraiModeChatLanguagePreference(mode)) {
    const normalized = normalizeFuraiChatLanguagePreference(preference, 'mode');
    return normalized === 'global' ? resolveFuraiGlobalChatLanguage() : normalized;
}

function resolveFuraiChatLanguage(chatData = null, personality = '') {
    const mode = personality || chatData?.personality || chatPersonalities?.[currentChatId] || 'researcher';
    const preference = normalizeFuraiChatLanguagePreference(chatData?.chatLanguage, 'chat');

    if (preference === 'mode') return resolveFuraiModeChatLanguage(mode);
    if (preference === 'global') return resolveFuraiGlobalChatLanguage();
    return preference;
}

function getFuraiChatLanguageInstructionForCode(languageCode) {
    const normalized = normalizeFuraiUiLanguage(languageCode);
    const resolved = normalized === 'auto' ? resolveFuraiUiLanguage() : normalized;
    if (resolved === 'en') return '';

    const option = getFuraiUiLanguageOption(resolved);
    return option?.label ? `Reply in ${option.label}.` : '';
}

function resolveFuraiChatLanguageFromPreference(preference, scope, personality = '') {
    if (scope === 'chat') {
        const normalized = normalizeFuraiChatLanguagePreference(preference, 'chat');
        if (normalized === 'mode') return resolveFuraiModeChatLanguage(personality);
        if (normalized === 'global') return resolveFuraiGlobalChatLanguage();
        return normalized;
    }

    if (scope === 'mode') {
        const normalized = normalizeFuraiChatLanguagePreference(preference, 'mode');
        return normalized === 'global' ? resolveFuraiGlobalChatLanguage() : normalized;
    }

    return resolveFuraiGlobalChatLanguage(preference);
}

function composeFuraiMemoText(memoText, languageCode) {
    const instruction = getFuraiChatLanguageInstructionForCode(languageCode);
    const memo = String(memoText || '').trim();
    return [instruction, memo].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
}

function getFuraiEffectiveMemoText(chatData = null, personality = '') {
    const data = chatData || (currentChatId ? DB.get(currentChatId) : null) || {};
    return composeFuraiMemoText(data.memo || '', resolveFuraiChatLanguage(data, personality));
}

function createFuraiChatLanguageOptionsHtml(scope, selectedValue) {
    const normalized = normalizeFuraiChatLanguagePreference(selectedValue, scope);
    return getFuraiChatLanguageOptions(scope).map(option => {
        const selected = option.value === normalized ? ' selected' : '';
        return `<option value="${escapeHTML(option.value)}"${selected}>${escapeHTML(option.label)}</option>`;
    }).join('');
}

function getFuraiChatLanguagePicker(control) {
    return control?.matches?.('[data-furai-chat-language-picker]')
        ? control
        : control?.closest?.('[data-furai-chat-language-picker]');
}

function getFuraiChatLanguageOption(value, scope) {
    const normalized = normalizeFuraiChatLanguagePreference(value, scope);
    return getFuraiChatLanguageOptions(scope).find(option => option.value === normalized)
        || getFuraiChatLanguageOptions(scope)[0];
}

function furaiChatLanguageOptionIconHtml(option) {
    if (option?.flag) {
        return `<img class="furai-language-flag" src="${getFuraiUiFlagUrl(option.flag)}" alt="" loading="lazy" decoding="async" referrerpolicy="no-referrer" onerror="this.hidden=true">`;
    }

    return '<span class="furai-chat-language-inherit-icon" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fa-solid fa-language"></i></span>';
}

function renderFuraiChatLanguageMenu(picker) {
    const target = getFuraiChatLanguagePicker(picker);
    const menu = target?.querySelector?.('.furai-chat-language-menu');
    const input = target?.querySelector?.('input[type="hidden"]');
    if (!target || !menu || !input) return;

    const scope = target.dataset.furaiChatLanguageScope || 'account';
    const selectedValue = normalizeFuraiChatLanguagePreference(input.value, scope);
    const options = getFuraiChatLanguageOptions(scope);
    const groups = [];

    for (const option of options) {
        const groupName = option.group || 'Languages';
        let group = groups.find(item => item.name === groupName);
        if (!group) {
            group = { name: groupName, options: [] };
            groups.push(group);
        }
        group.options.push(option);
    }

    menu.innerHTML = groups.map(group => `
        <div class="furai-language-group" role="group" aria-label="${escapeFuraiUiLanguageHtml(group.name)}">
          <div class="furai-language-group-label" role="presentation">${escapeFuraiUiLanguageHtml(group.name)}</div>
          ${group.options.map(option => {
              const selected = option.value === selectedValue;
              return `
                <button type="button"
                        class="furai-language-option${selected ? ' is-selected' : ''}"
                        role="option"
                        title="${escapeFuraiUiLanguageHtml(option.label)}"
                        data-furai-chat-language-value="${escapeFuraiUiLanguageHtml(option.value)}"
                        aria-selected="${selected ? 'true' : 'false'}"
                        onclick="window.selectFuraiChatLanguageOption(this)">
                  ${furaiChatLanguageOptionIconHtml(option)}
                  <span>${escapeFuraiUiLanguageHtml(option.label)}</span>
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-check furai-language-option-check" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                </button>`;
          }).join('')}
        </div>`).join('');

    menu.dataset.ready = '1';
}

function syncFuraiChatLanguagePicker(picker, selectedValue) {
    const target = getFuraiChatLanguagePicker(picker);
    const input = target?.querySelector?.('input[type="hidden"]');
    const label = target?.querySelector?.('[data-furai-chat-language-label]');
    const flag = target?.querySelector?.('[data-furai-chat-language-flag]');
    const inheritIcon = target?.querySelector?.('[data-furai-chat-language-inherit]');
    if (!target || !input || !label || !flag || !inheritIcon) return;

    const scope = target.dataset.furaiChatLanguageScope || 'account';
    const normalized = normalizeFuraiChatLanguagePreference(selectedValue ?? input.value, scope);
    const option = getFuraiChatLanguageOption(normalized, scope);

    input.value = normalized;
    label.textContent = option.label;

    if (option.flag) {
        flag.src = getFuraiUiFlagUrl(option.flag);
        flag.hidden = false;
        inheritIcon.hidden = true;
        flag.onerror = () => {
            flag.hidden = true;
            inheritIcon.hidden = false;
        };
    } else {
        flag.hidden = true;
        flag.removeAttribute('src');
        inheritIcon.hidden = false;
    }

    target.querySelectorAll('[data-furai-chat-language-value]').forEach(button => {
        const isSelected = button.dataset.furaiChatLanguageValue === normalized;
        button.classList.toggle('is-selected', isSelected);
        button.setAttribute('aria-selected', isSelected ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
}

function populateFuraiChatLanguageSelect(control, scope, selectedValue) {
    if (!control) return;

    const picker = getFuraiChatLanguagePicker(control);
    if (picker) {
        picker.dataset.furaiChatLanguageScope = scope;
        const menu = picker.querySelector('.furai-chat-language-menu');
        if (menu) {
            menu.dataset.ready = '';
            menu.innerHTML = '';
        }
        syncFuraiChatLanguagePicker(picker, selectedValue);
        return;
    }

    // Backward-compatible fallback for any old/native selector still supplied by an extension.
    control.innerHTML = createFuraiChatLanguageOptionsHtml(scope, selectedValue);
    control.value = normalizeFuraiChatLanguagePreference(selectedValue, scope);
}

function closeFuraiChatLanguageMenus(exceptPicker = null) {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-furai-chat-language-picker]').forEach(picker => {
        if (picker === exceptPicker) return;
        const menu = picker.querySelector('.furai-chat-language-menu');
        const trigger = picker.querySelector('.furai-chat-language-trigger');
        if (menu) {
            menu.hidden = true;
            closeFuraiModalRider(menu, trigger);
        }
        if (trigger) trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    });
}

let furaiChatLanguageDropdownListenersReady = false;
function ensureFuraiChatLanguageDropdownListeners() {
    if (furaiChatLanguageDropdownListenersReady) return;
    furaiChatLanguageDropdownListenersReady = true;

    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
        if (!event.target.closest('[data-furai-chat-language-picker]')) {
            closeFuraiChatLanguageMenus();
        }
    }, { passive: true });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
        if (event.key === 'Escape') closeFuraiChatLanguageMenus();
    });
}

// Inline HTML calls these handlers. Keep them explicitly exposed on window.
window.toggleFuraiChatLanguageMenu = function(trigger, event) {
    event?.preventDefault?.();
    event?.stopPropagation?.();

    const picker = getFuraiChatLanguagePicker(trigger);
    const menu = picker?.querySelector?.('.furai-chat-language-menu');
    if (!picker || !menu) return;

    ensureFuraiChatLanguageDropdownListeners();
    closeFuraiChatLanguageMenus(picker);
    if (typeof closePromptBoosterMenus === 'function') closePromptBoosterMenus();
    if (typeof closeFuraiUiLanguageMenu === 'function') closeFuraiUiLanguageMenu();

    if (menu.dataset.ready !== '1') renderFuraiChatLanguageMenu(picker);

    const shouldOpen = menu.hidden;
    menu.hidden = !shouldOpen;
    trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', shouldOpen ? 'true' : 'false');
    closeFuraiModalRider(menu, trigger);

    if (shouldOpen) {
        openFuraiModalRider(menu, trigger);
        menu.querySelector('.is-selected')?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
        menu.querySelector('.is-selected')?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
};

window.selectFuraiChatLanguageOption = function(button) {
    const picker = getFuraiChatLanguagePicker(button);
    const value = String(button?.dataset?.furaiChatLanguageValue || '');
    if (!picker || !value) return;

    syncFuraiChatLanguagePicker(picker, value);
    closeFuraiChatLanguageMenus();

    const syncTarget = picker.dataset.furaiChatLanguageSync || '';
    if (syncTarget === 'memo') {
        window.syncFuraiMemoLanguageUI?.();
    } else if (syncTarget === 'global-memo') {
        window.syncFuraiGlobalMemoLanguageUI?.(
            picker.dataset.furaiChatLanguageMode || currentGlobalTab
        );
    }
};

    if (!prefixEl) return;
    prefixEl.textContent = instruction || '';
    prefixEl.hidden = !instruction;
}

    '[data-furai-no-translate]', '[contenteditable="true"]',
    'pre', 'code', 'script', 'style', 'noscript', 'svg',
