const furaiUiLanguage = {
    preference: localStorage.getItem(FURAI_UI_LANGUAGE_KEY) || 'auto',
    pendingPreference: null,
    language: 'en',
    cache: Object.create(null),
    cacheTimer: 0,
    scanTimer: 0,
    visibleRootsTimer: 0,
    roots: new Set(),
    scannedVisibleRoots: new WeakSet(),
    textState: new WeakMap(),
    attrState: new WeakMap(),
    valueState: new WeakMap(),
    pending: new Map(),
    queue: [],
    active: 0,
    failures: 0,
    pausedUntil: 0,
    provider: 'google',
    observer: null,
    controlReady: false
};

function normalizeFuraiUiLanguage(value) {
    value = String(value || '').trim();
    if (!value || value === 'auto') return 'auto';
    return FURAI_UI_LANGUAGES.has(value) ? value : 'en';
}

function detectFuraiUiLanguage() {
    const languages = navigator.languages?.length ? navigator.languages : [navigator.language || 'en'];

    for (const item of languages) {
        const value = String(item || '').toLowerCase();
        if (value.startsWith('zh-tw') || value.startsWith('zh-hk') || value.includes('hant')) return 'zh-TW';
        if (value.startsWith('zh')) return 'zh-CN';

        const base = value.split('-')[0];
        const normalizedBase = base === 'nb' || base === 'nn'
            ? 'no'
            : (base === 'fil' ? 'tl' : base);

        if (FURAI_UI_LANGUAGES.has(normalizedBase)) return normalizedBase;
    }

    return 'en';
}

function resolveFuraiUiLanguage(preference = furaiUiLanguage.preference) {
    const normalized = normalizeFuraiUiLanguage(preference);
    return normalized === 'auto' ? detectFuraiUiLanguage() : normalized;
}

function getFuraiUiLanguageOption(value) {
    return FURAI_UI_LANGUAGE_BY_VALUE.get(value) || FURAI_UI_LANGUAGE_BY_VALUE.get('en');
}

function getFuraiUiFlagUrl(flag) {
    return flag ? `https://flagcdn.com/w20/${flag}.webp` : '';
}

function escapeFuraiUiLanguageHtml(value) {
    return String(value || '')
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
}

function renderFuraiUiLanguageOptions() {
    const menu = document.getElementById('furaiUiLanguageMenu');
    if (!menu || menu.dataset.ready === '1') return;

    menu.innerHTML = FURAI_UI_LANGUAGE_GROUPS.map(group => {
        const groupLabel = group.label || 'Automatic';
        const heading = group.label
            ? `<div class="furai-language-group-label" role="presentation">${escapeFuraiUiLanguageHtml(group.label)}</div>`
            : '';

        const options = group.items.map(option => {
            const icon = option.flag
                ? `<img class="furai-language-flag" src="${getFuraiUiFlagUrl(option.flag)}" alt="" loading="lazy" decoding="async" referrerpolicy="no-referrer" onerror="this.hidden=true">`
                : '<span class="furai-language-globe" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fa-solid fa-globe"></i></span>';

            return `
                <button class="furai-language-option"
                        type="button"
                        role="option"
                        data-furai-language="${escapeFuraiUiLanguageHtml(option.value)}"
                        aria-selected="false"
                        onclick="selectFuraiUiLanguage('${escapeFuraiUiLanguageHtml(option.value)}')">
                  ${icon}
                  <span>${escapeFuraiUiLanguageHtml(option.label)}</span>
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-check furai-language-option-check" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                </button>`;
        }).join('');

        return `
            <div class="furai-language-group"
                 role="group"
                 aria-label="${escapeFuraiUiLanguageHtml(groupLabel)}">
              ${heading}
              ${options}
            </div>`;
    }).join('');

    menu.dataset.ready = '1';
    syncFuraiUiLanguageControl();
}

function syncFuraiUiLanguageControl() {
    const input = document.getElementById('furaiUiLanguageSelect');
    const label = document.getElementById('furaiUiLanguageLabel');
    const flag = document.getElementById('furaiUiLanguageFlag');
    const globe = document.getElementById('furaiUiLanguageGlobe');
    if (!input || !label || !flag || !globe) return;

    const selectedValue = normalizeFuraiUiLanguage(
        furaiUiLanguage.pendingPreference || furaiUiLanguage.preference
    );
    const selectedOption = getFuraiUiLanguageOption(selectedValue);
    const detectedOption = getFuraiUiLanguageOption(resolveFuraiUiLanguage('auto'));

    input.value = selectedValue;
    label.textContent = selectedValue === 'auto'
        ? `Auto (${detectedOption.label})`
        : selectedOption.label;

    if (selectedOption.flag) {
        flag.src = getFuraiUiFlagUrl(selectedOption.flag);
        flag.hidden = false;
        globe.hidden = true;
        flag.onerror = () => {
            flag.hidden = true;
            globe.hidden = false;
        };
    } else {
        flag.hidden = true;
        flag.removeAttribute('src');
        globe.hidden = false;
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('#furaiUiLanguageMenu [data-furai-language]').forEach(button => {
        const isSelected = button.dataset.furaiLanguage === selectedValue;
        button.classList.toggle('is-selected', isSelected);
        button.setAttribute('aria-selected', isSelected ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
}

function setFuraiUiLanguage(value) {
    furaiUiLanguage.pendingPreference = normalizeFuraiUiLanguage(value);
    syncFuraiUiLanguageControl();
}

function closeFuraiUiLanguageMenu() {
    const menu = document.getElementById('furaiUiLanguageMenu');
    const trigger = document.getElementById('furaiUiLanguageTrigger');
    if (menu) {
        menu.hidden = true;
        closeFuraiModalRider(menu, trigger);
    }
    if (trigger) trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
}

function toggleFuraiUiLanguageMenu(event) {
    event?.preventDefault?.();
    event?.stopPropagation?.();

    const menu = document.getElementById('furaiUiLanguageMenu');
    const trigger = document.getElementById('furaiUiLanguageTrigger');
    if (!menu || !trigger) return;

    renderFuraiUiLanguageOptions();
    if (typeof closeFuraiChatLanguageMenus === 'function') closeFuraiChatLanguageMenus();
    if (typeof closePromptBoosterMenus === 'function') closePromptBoosterMenus();
    const shouldOpen = menu.hidden;
    menu.hidden = !shouldOpen;
    trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', shouldOpen ? 'true' : 'false');

    closeFuraiModalRider(menu, trigger);

    if (shouldOpen) {
        openFuraiModalRider(menu, trigger);
        menu.querySelector('.is-selected')?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
    }
}

function selectFuraiUiLanguage(value) {
    setFuraiUiLanguage(value);
    closeFuraiUiLanguageMenu();
}

function initFuraiUiLanguageControl() {
    syncFuraiUiLanguageControl();
    if (furaiUiLanguage.controlReady) return;
    furaiUiLanguage.controlReady = true;

    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
        const picker = document.getElementById('furaiUiLanguagePicker');
        if (picker && !picker.contains(event.target)) closeFuraiUiLanguageMenu();

        const help = document.querySelector('.furai-language-help');
        if (help?.open && !help.contains(event.target)) help.open = false;
    }, { passive: true });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
        if (event.key === 'Escape') closeFuraiUiLanguageMenu();
    });
}

function isVisibleFuraiUi(element) {
    return !!element && element.isConnected &&
        !!(element.offsetWidth || element.offsetHeight || element.getClientRects().length);
}

function isExcludedFuraiUi(node) {
    const element = node?.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE ? node : node?.parentElement;
    if (!element) return true;
    if (element.closest(FURAI_UI_HARD_NO_TRANSLATE_SELECTOR)) return true;
    if (element.closest(FURAI_UI_FORCE_TRANSLATE_SELECTOR)) return false;
    return !!element.closest(FURAI_UI_NO_TRANSLATE_SELECTOR);
}

function shouldTranslateFuraiUi(value, maxLength = 360, maxWords = 60) {
    const text = String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    if (text.length < 2 || text.length > maxLength || text.split(/\s+/).length > maxWords) return false;
    if (!/[A-Za-z]/.test(text) || text === 'FurAI') return false;
    if (/https?:\/\/|www\.|^[\w.+-]+@[\w.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$/.test(text)) return false;
    return true;
}

function loadFuraiUiCache() {
    furaiUiLanguage.cache = Object.create(null);

    try {
        const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(FURAI_UI_TRANSLATION_CACHE_KEY) || 'null');
        if (saved?.language === furaiUiLanguage.language && saved.entries) {
            Object.assign(furaiUiLanguage.cache, saved.entries);
        }
    } catch (error) {}
}

function saveFuraiUiCacheSoon() {
    clearTimeout(furaiUiLanguage.cacheTimer);
    furaiUiLanguage.cacheTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        try {
            const keys = Object.keys(furaiUiLanguage.cache);
            if (keys.length > 700) {
                keys.slice(0, keys.length - 600).forEach(key => delete furaiUiLanguage.cache[key]);
            }

            localStorage.setItem(FURAI_UI_TRANSLATION_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
                language: furaiUiLanguage.language,
                entries: furaiUiLanguage.cache
            }));
        } catch (error) {}
    }, 500);
}

async function fetchFuraiUiTranslation(source, language) {
    const fetchJson = async (url, timeoutMs) => {
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);

        try {
            const response = await fetch(url, {
                signal: controller.signal,
                credentials: 'omit',
                referrerPolicy: 'no-referrer',
                cache: 'force-cache'
            });
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Translation unavailable');
            return await response.json();
        } finally {
            clearTimeout(timeout);
        }
    };

    if (furaiUiLanguage.provider === 'google') {
        try {
            const data = await fetchJson(
                'https://translate.googleapis.com/translate_a/single?client=gtx&sl=en&tl=' +
                encodeURIComponent(language) + '&dt=t&q=' + encodeURIComponent(source),
                4500
            );
            const translated = Array.isArray(data?.[0])
                ? data[0].map(part => part?.[0] || '').join('').trim()
                : '';

            if (translated) return translated;
            furaiUiLanguage.provider = 'mymemory';
        } catch (error) {
            furaiUiLanguage.provider = 'mymemory';
        }
    }

    const fallback = await fetchJson(
        'https://api.mymemory.translated.net/get?q=' + encodeURIComponent(source) +
        '&langpair=' + encodeURIComponent('en|' + language),
        6000
    );
    const translated = String(fallback?.responseData?.translatedText || '').trim();
    if (!translated || /^MYMEMORY WARNING/i.test(translated)) {
        throw new Error('Translation unavailable');
    }
    return translated;
}

function requestFuraiUiText(source, apply) {
    if (Date.now() < furaiUiLanguage.pausedUntil) return;
    if (furaiUiLanguage.cache[source]) {
        apply(furaiUiLanguage.cache[source]);
        return;
    }

    if (furaiUiLanguage.pending.has(source)) {
        furaiUiLanguage.pending.get(source).push(apply);
        return;
    }

    furaiUiLanguage.pending.set(source, [apply]);
    furaiUiLanguage.queue.push(source);
    runFuraiUiQueue();
}

function runFuraiUiQueue() {
    while (furaiUiLanguage.active < 2 && furaiUiLanguage.queue.length) {
        const source = furaiUiLanguage.queue.shift();
        furaiUiLanguage.active += 1;

        fetchFuraiUiTranslation(source, furaiUiLanguage.language)
            .then(translated => {
                if (!translated) return;
                furaiUiLanguage.failures = 0;
                furaiUiLanguage.cache[source] = translated;
                saveFuraiUiCacheSoon();
                (furaiUiLanguage.pending.get(source) || []).forEach(apply => apply(translated));
            })
            .catch(() => {
                furaiUiLanguage.failures += 1;
                if (furaiUiLanguage.failures >= 6) {
                    furaiUiLanguage.pausedUntil = Date.now() + 45 * 1000;
                    furaiUiLanguage.queue.length = 0;
                    furaiUiLanguage.pending.clear();
                }
            })
            .finally(() => {
                furaiUiLanguage.pending.delete(source);
                furaiUiLanguage.active -= 1;
                runFuraiUiQueue();
            });
    }
}

function translateFuraiUiTextNode(node) {
    if (!node?.isConnected || node.parentElement?.closest('input, textarea') || isExcludedFuraiUi(node)) return;

    const raw = String(node.nodeValue || '');
    const match = raw.match(/^(\s*)([\s\S]*?)(\s*)$/);
    const current = match?.[2] || raw;
    let state = furaiUiLanguage.textState.get(node);

    if (state && current !== state.source && current !== state.translated) state = null;
    const source = state?.source || current;
    const forcedHost = node.parentElement?.closest(FURAI_UI_FORCE_TRANSLATE_SELECTOR);
    const isForcedContent = !!forcedHost;
    const isLongForcedContent = !!node.parentElement?.closest('[data-furai-ui-translate-long]');
    const maxLength = isLongForcedContent ? 2400 : (isForcedContent ? 700 : 360);
    const maxWords = isLongForcedContent ? 360 : (isForcedContent ? 120 : 60);

    if (!shouldTranslateFuraiUi(source, maxLength, maxWords)) return;

    state ||= {
        source,
        translated: '',
        before: match?.[1] || '',
        after: match?.[3] || ''
    };
    furaiUiLanguage.textState.set(node, state);

    requestFuraiUiText(source, translated => {
        const latest = furaiUiLanguage.textState.get(node);
        if (!latest || latest.source !== source || !node.isConnected) return;
        latest.translated = translated;
        node.nodeValue = latest.before + translated + latest.after;
    });
}

function translateFuraiUiAttribute(element, name) {
    if (!element?.isConnected || isExcludedFuraiUi(element)) return;

    const current = String(element.getAttribute(name) || '').trim();
    if (!shouldTranslateFuraiUi(current)) return;

    let states = furaiUiLanguage.attrState.get(element);
    if (!states) furaiUiLanguage.attrState.set(element, states = Object.create(null));

    let state = states[name];
    if (!state || (current !== state.source && current !== state.translated)) {
        state = states[name] = { source: current, translated: '' };
    }

    requestFuraiUiText(state.source, translated => {
        const latest = furaiUiLanguage.attrState.get(element)?.[name];
        if (!latest || latest.source !== state.source || !element.isConnected) return;
        latest.translated = translated;
        element.setAttribute(name, translated);
    });
}

function splitFuraiUiValueChunks(value, maxLength = 650, maxWords = 110) {
    const tokens = String(value || '').match(/\S+|\s+/g) || [];
    const chunks = [];
    let chunk = '';
    let wordCount = 0;

    const flush = () => {
        if (!chunk) return;
        chunks.push(chunk);
        chunk = '';
        wordCount = 0;
    };

    tokens.forEach(token => {
        const isWord = /\S/.test(token);
        const nextWordCount = wordCount + (isWord ? 1 : 0);
        const exceedsLimit = chunk && (
            chunk.length + token.length > maxLength ||
            nextWordCount > maxWords
        );

        if (exceedsLimit) flush();

        chunk += token;
        if (isWord) wordCount += 1;
    });

    flush();
    return chunks;
}

function translateFuraiUiValueElement(element) {
    if (
        furaiUiLanguage.language === 'en' ||
        !element?.isConnected ||
        !element.readOnly ||
        isExcludedFuraiUi(element)
    ) return;

    const current = String(element.value || '');
    let state = furaiUiLanguage.valueState.get(element);

    if (state && current !== state.source && current !== state.rendered) {
        state = null;
    }

    const source = state?.source || current;
    if (!source.trim() || !/[A-Za-z]/.test(source)) return;

    // Expansion previews can contain full lore artifacts. Keep translation useful
    // without turning one preview into an unbounded burst of network requests.
    if (source.length > 12000 || source.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length > 1800) return;

    if (state && current === state.source && state.rendered !== state.source) {
        element.value = state.rendered;
    }

    if (!state) {
        const chunks = splitFuraiUiValueChunks(source);
        state = {
            source,
            rendered: source,
            chunks,
            translatedChunks: chunks.slice(),
            completedChunks: chunks.map(() => false)
        };
        furaiUiLanguage.valueState.set(element, state);
    }

    state.chunks.forEach((chunk, index) => {
        if (state.completedChunks[index] || !shouldTranslateFuraiUi(chunk, 700, 120)) return;

        requestFuraiUiText(chunk, translated => {
            const latest = furaiUiLanguage.valueState.get(element);
            if (!latest || latest.source !== source || !element.isConnected) return;

            latest.completedChunks[index] = true;
            latest.translatedChunks[index] = translated;
            latest.rendered = latest.translatedChunks.join('');
            element.value = latest.rendered;
        });
    });
}

function getFuraiUiScanContainers(root = document) {
    const isForcedRoot = root !== document && root?.matches?.(FURAI_UI_FORCE_TRANSLATE_SELECTOR);

    if (root === document) {
        return Array.from(new Set([
            ...document.querySelectorAll(FURAI_UI_ROOT_SELECTOR),
            ...document.querySelectorAll(FURAI_UI_FORCE_TRANSLATE_SELECTOR)
        ]));
    }

    if (isForcedRoot || root.matches?.(FURAI_UI_ROOT_SELECTOR)) return [root];
    const nearest = root.closest?.(FURAI_UI_ROOT_SELECTOR);
    return nearest ? [nearest] : [];
}

function scanFuraiUiRoot(root = document) {
    getFuraiUiScanContainers(root).forEach(container => {
        if (!isVisibleFuraiUi(container) || isExcludedFuraiUi(container)) return;

        furaiUiLanguage.scannedVisibleRoots.add(container);
        const walker = document.createTreeWalker(container, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
        let node;
        while ((node = walker.nextNode())) translateFuraiUiTextNode(node);

        container.querySelectorAll('[placeholder],[title],[aria-label]').forEach(element => {
            ['placeholder', 'title', 'aria-label'].forEach(name => {
                if (element.hasAttribute(name)) translateFuraiUiAttribute(element, name);
            });
        });

        if (container.matches?.('[data-furai-ui-translate-value]')) {
            translateFuraiUiValueElement(container);
        }
        container.querySelectorAll('[data-furai-ui-translate-value]').forEach(translateFuraiUiValueElement);
    });
}

function scheduleFuraiUiScan(root = document) {
    if (furaiUiLanguage.language === 'en') return;

    furaiUiLanguage.roots.add(root);
    if (furaiUiLanguage.scanTimer) return;

    furaiUiLanguage.scanTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        furaiUiLanguage.scanTimer = 0;
        const roots = Array.from(furaiUiLanguage.roots);
        furaiUiLanguage.roots.clear();
        const run = () => roots.forEach(scanFuraiUiRoot);

        if (window.requestIdleCallback) {
            requestIdleCallback(run, { timeout: 700 });
        } else {
            run();
        }
    }, 90);
}

function scheduleNewlyVisibleFuraiUiRoots() {
    document.querySelectorAll(FURAI_UI_ROOT_SELECTOR).forEach(root => {
        if (
            isVisibleFuraiUi(root) &&
            !isExcludedFuraiUi(root) &&
            !furaiUiLanguage.scannedVisibleRoots.has(root)
        ) {
            scheduleFuraiUiScan(root);
        }
    });
}

function scheduleNewlyVisibleFuraiUiRootsSoon() {
    if (furaiUiLanguage.visibleRootsTimer) return;
    furaiUiLanguage.visibleRootsTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        furaiUiLanguage.visibleRootsTimer = 0;
        scheduleNewlyVisibleFuraiUiRoots();
    }, 90);
}

function markFuraiConceptBoardUiForTranslation(root = document) {
    if (furaiUiLanguage.language === 'en') return;

    const selector = [
        '#localMediaGallery_root',
        '.localMediaGallery-modal-shell',
        '[data-local-media-gallery-artifact-viewer]'
    ].join(',');
    const scopes = new Set();

    if (root?.matches?.(selector)) scopes.add(root);
    root?.querySelectorAll?.(selector).forEach(scope => scopes.add(scope));

    scopes.forEach(scope => {
        if (scope.matches('#localMediaGallery_root')) {
            scope.querySelectorAll('.localMediaGallery-add-card').forEach(element => {
                element.setAttribute('data-furai-ui-translate', '');
            });
            scheduleFuraiUiScan(scope);
        }

        scope.querySelectorAll('button, label, [placeholder], [aria-label]').forEach(element => {
            if (element.closest(
                '[data-local-media-gallery-item]:not(.localMediaGallery-add-card), ' +
                '.localMediaGallery-folder-row, .localMediaGallery-item-menu-header'
            )) return;
            if (element.matches('button[title="Switch folder"]')) return;
            element.setAttribute('data-furai-ui-translate', '');
        });

        scope.querySelectorAll('.localMediaGallery-modal-header').forEach(header => {
            const titleHost = header.firstElementChild;
            if (!titleHost || titleHost.closest('[data-local-media-gallery-artifact-viewer]')) return;

            const titleElement = titleHost.firstElementChild || titleHost;
            const title = String(titleElement.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
            if (/^(Concept Board|Confirm|Enter text|Add New Item|Save Page|Load(?: into Current Page| Page| Backup)?|Save Backup|Storage(?: & Maintenance)?|Data Rescue|Rename Page|Reorder Pages|Edit item info)$/i.test(title)) {
                titleElement.setAttribute('data-furai-ui-translate', '');
            }
        });
    });
}

function initFuraiUiLanguage() {
    furaiUiLanguage.preference = normalizeFuraiUiLanguage(
        localStorage.getItem(FURAI_UI_LANGUAGE_KEY) || 'auto'
    );
    furaiUiLanguage.language = resolveFuraiUiLanguage();
    document.documentElement.lang = furaiUiLanguage.language;

    // English/default users stop here: no translation cache, observer, requests,
    // menu rendering, or language-picker document listeners are created.
    if (furaiUiLanguage.language === 'en') return;

    loadFuraiUiCache();
    scheduleFuraiUiScan(document);

    furaiUiLanguage.observer = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
        const roots = new Set();

        mutations.forEach(mutation => {
            mutation.addedNodes.forEach(node => {
                const element = node.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE ? node : node.parentElement;
                if (!element) return;

                if (
                    element.matches?.('#localMediaGallery_root, .localMediaGallery-modal-shell, [data-local-media-gallery-artifact-viewer]') ||
                    element.querySelector?.('#localMediaGallery_root, .localMediaGallery-modal-shell, [data-local-media-gallery-artifact-viewer]')
                ) {
                    markFuraiConceptBoardUiForTranslation(element);
                }

                if (element.matches?.(FURAI_UI_ROOT_SELECTOR)) {
                    roots.add(element);
                } else {
                    const nearest = element.closest?.(FURAI_UI_ROOT_SELECTOR);
                    if (nearest) roots.add(nearest);
                }

                element.querySelectorAll?.(FURAI_UI_ROOT_SELECTOR).forEach(item => roots.add(item));
                if (element.matches?.(FURAI_UI_FORCE_TRANSLATE_SELECTOR)) roots.add(element);
                element.querySelectorAll?.(FURAI_UI_FORCE_TRANSLATE_SELECTOR).forEach(item => roots.add(item));
            });
        });

        roots.forEach(root => {
            if (!isExcludedFuraiUi(root) || root.matches?.(FURAI_UI_FORCE_TRANSLATE_SELECTOR)) {
                scheduleFuraiUiScan(root);
            }
        });
    });
    furaiUiLanguage.observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });

    document.addEventListener('click', event => {
        const clickedRoot = event.target?.closest?.(FURAI_UI_ROOT_SELECTOR);
        if (clickedRoot) scheduleFuraiUiScan(clickedRoot);
        scheduleNewlyVisibleFuraiUiRootsSoon();
    }, { passive: true });
}

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initFuraiUiLanguage, { once: true });
} else {
    initFuraiUiLanguage();
}

const normalizeEntryGateCredentialValue = value => String(value || '').trim();

const getEntryGateCredentialParts = kind => {
    if (kind === 'uid') {
        return {
            main: document.getElementById('accUidField'),
            confirm: document.getElementById('accUidConfirmField'),
            wrap: document.getElementById('accUidConfirmWrap')
        };
    }

    return {
        main: document.getElementById('accSafeCodeField'),
        confirm: document.getElementById('accSafeCodeConfirmField'),
        wrap: document.getElementById('accSafeCodeConfirmWrap')
    };
};

const furaiEntryGateCredentialState = {
    savedUid: '',
    confirmedUid: '',
    confirmedDeleteCode: ''
};

const syncEntryGateCredentialConfirmation = kind => {
    const state = furaiEntryGateCredentialState;
    const { main, confirm, wrap } = getEntryGateCredentialParts(kind);
    if (!main || !confirm || !wrap) return false;

    const value = normalizeEntryGateCredentialValue(main.value);
    const confirmedValue = kind === 'uid'
        ? state.confirmedUid
        : state.confirmedDeleteCode;
    const isPreviouslyConfirmed = kind === 'uid'
        ? (value === state.savedUid || value === confirmedValue)
        : value === confirmedValue;

    if (!value || isPreviouslyConfirmed) {
        wrap.hidden = true;
        confirm.value = '';
        confirm.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
        return false;
    }

    const confirmation = normalizeEntryGateCredentialValue(confirm.value);

    if (confirmation && confirmation === value) {
        if (kind === 'uid') state.confirmedUid = value;
        else state.confirmedDeleteCode = value;

        wrap.hidden = true;
        confirm.value = '';
        confirm.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
        return false;
    }

    wrap.hidden = false;
    confirm.setAttribute('aria-invalid', confirmation ? 'true' : 'false');
    return true;
};

window.getEntryGateCredentialValidation = function() {
    const uidPending = syncEntryGateCredentialConfirmation('uid');
    const deleteCodePending = syncEntryGateCredentialConfirmation('deleteCode');
    const uid = normalizeEntryGateCredentialValue(
        document.getElementById('accUidField')?.value
    );
    const isLocked = !!document.getElementById('lockModeToggle')?.checked;

    let message = '';
    let warning = false;

    if (uidPending && deleteCodePending) {
        message = 'Confirm the changed Account Name and Delete Code to save.';
    } else if (uidPending) {
        message = 'Confirm the changed Account Name to save.';
    } else if (deleteCodePending) {
        message = 'Confirm the changed Delete Code to save.';
    } else if (isLocked && !uid) {
        warning = true;
        message = 'Account Name is empty. The entry gate will be a welcome screen anyone can enter. Are you sure?';
    }

    return {
        valid: !uidPending && !deleteCodePending,
        warning,
        message,
        uidPending,
        deleteCodePending
    };
};

window.updateEntryGateCredentialValidation = function() {
    const result = window.getEntryGateCredentialValidation();
    const status = document.getElementById('entryGateCredentialStatus');
    const saveButton = document.getElementById('accountSaveSettingsBtn');

    if (saveButton) saveButton.disabled = !result.valid;

    if (status) {
        status.classList.toggle('is-warning', result.valid && result.warning);
        status.classList.toggle('is-error', !result.valid);
        status.textContent = result.message;
        status.hidden = !result.message;
    }

    return result.valid;
};

const FURAI_ACCOUNT_SECTION_STATE_KEY = 'furai_account_section_state_v1';
const FURAI_ACCOUNT_SCROLL_STATE_KEY = 'furai_account_scroll_top_v1';

let furaiAccountScrollSaveTimer = null;
let furaiAccountViewportRestoreFrame = 0;

function getFuraiAccountModalBody() {
    return document.querySelector('#accountModalEl .modal-body');
}

function readFuraiAccountSectionState() {
    try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(FURAI_ACCOUNT_SECTION_STATE_KEY) || '{}');
        return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : {};
    } catch (error) {
        return {};
    }
}

function writeFuraiAccountSectionState(state) {
    try {
        localStorage.setItem(FURAI_ACCOUNT_SECTION_STATE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state || {}));
    } catch (error) {}
}

function getFuraiAccountSavedScrollTop() {
    const value = Number(localStorage.getItem(FURAI_ACCOUNT_SCROLL_STATE_KEY));
    return Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 ? value : 0;
}

function saveFuraiAccountScrollTop(scrollTop) {
    const value = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(scrollTop) || 0));
    try {
        localStorage.setItem(FURAI_ACCOUNT_SCROLL_STATE_KEY, String(value));
    } catch (error) {}
}

function queueFuraiAccountScrollSave(body = getFuraiAccountModalBody()) {
    if (!body) return;

    clearTimeout(furaiAccountScrollSaveTimer);
    furaiAccountScrollSaveTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        saveFuraiAccountScrollTop(body.scrollTop);
    }, 120);
}

function restoreFuraiAccountScrollTop(scrollTop = getFuraiAccountSavedScrollTop()) {
    const modal = document.getElementById('accountModalEl');
    const body = getFuraiAccountModalBody();
    if (!modal || !body || modal.style.display !== 'flex') return;

    const apply = () => {
        const maxScroll = Math.max(0, body.scrollHeight - body.clientHeight);
        body.scrollTop = Math.min(Math.max(0, Number(scrollTop) || 0), maxScroll);
    };

    apply();
    requestAnimationFrame(apply);
}

function queueFuraiAccountViewportRestore(scrollTop, anchor = null, anchorTop = null) {
    cancelAnimationFrame(furaiAccountViewportRestoreFrame);

    const apply = () => {
        const modal = document.getElementById('accountModalEl');
        const body = getFuraiAccountModalBody();
        if (!modal || !body || modal.style.display !== 'flex') return;

        if (
            anchor instanceof Element &&
            anchor.isConnected &&
            body.contains(anchor) &&
            Number.isFinite(anchorTop)
        ) {
            body.scrollTop += anchor.getBoundingClientRect().top - anchorTop;
        } else {
            const maxScroll = Math.max(0, body.scrollHeight - body.clientHeight);
            body.scrollTop = Math.min(Math.max(0, Number(scrollTop) || 0), maxScroll);
        }
    };

    furaiAccountViewportRestoreFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        apply();
        furaiAccountViewportRestoreFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            apply();
            saveFuraiAccountScrollTop(getFuraiAccountModalBody()?.scrollTop || 0);
            furaiAccountViewportRestoreFrame = 0;
        });
    });
}

function setFuraiAccountSectionCollapsed(section, collapsed, { persist = true } = {}) {
    if (!section) return;

    const key = String(section.dataset.accountSection || '').trim();
    const title = Array.from(section.children).find(child =>
        child.classList?.contains('global-section-title')
    );
    const nextCollapsed = !!collapsed;

    section.classList.toggle('is-collapsed', nextCollapsed);

    if (title) {
        title.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!nextCollapsed));
        title.title = `${nextCollapsed ? 'Expand' : 'Collapse'} ${title.dataset.accountSectionLabel || 'section'}`;
    }

    if (persist && key) {
        const state = readFuraiAccountSectionState();
        state[key] = !nextCollapsed;
        writeFuraiAccountSectionState(state);
    }
}

function toggleFuraiAccountSection(section) {
    if (!section) return;

    const body = getFuraiAccountModalBody();
    const title = Array.from(section.children).find(child =>
        child.classList?.contains('global-section-title')
    );
    if (!body || !title) return;

    const titleTopBefore = title.getBoundingClientRect().top;
    setFuraiAccountSectionCollapsed(
        section,
        !section.classList.contains('is-collapsed')
    );

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        const titleTopAfter = title.getBoundingClientRect().top;
        body.scrollTop += titleTopAfter - titleTopBefore;
        saveFuraiAccountScrollTop(body.scrollTop);
    });
}

function initFuraiAccountSections() {
    const body = getFuraiAccountModalBody();
    if (!body) return;

    const savedState = readFuraiAccountSectionState();
    const sections = body.querySelectorAll(':scope > .furai-account-section[data-account-section]');

    sections.forEach(section => {
        const title = Array.from(section.children).find(child =>
            child.classList?.contains('global-section-title')
        );
        if (!title) return;

        const labelClone = title.cloneNode(true);
        labelClone.querySelectorAll('i, .material-symbols-outlined, .furai-account-section-chevron').forEach(node => node.remove());
        const label = labelClone.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
        const key = String(section.dataset.accountSection || '').trim();
        const isOpen = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(savedState, key)
            ? savedState[key] !== false
            : true;

        title.dataset.accountSectionLabel = label;
        title.setAttribute('role', 'button');
        title.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');

        if (!title.querySelector('.furai-account-section-chevron')) {
            const chevron = document.createElement('i');
            chevron.className = 'fa-solid fa-chevron-down furai-account-section-chevron';
            chevron.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
            title.appendChild(chevron);
        }

        setFuraiAccountSectionCollapsed(section, !isOpen, { persist: false });
    });

    if (body.dataset.accountSectionsReady === '1') return;
    body.dataset.accountSectionsReady = '1';

    body.addEventListener('click', event => {
        const title = event.target.closest('.furai-account-section > .global-section-title');
        if (!title || !body.contains(title)) return;

        event.preventDefault();
        toggleFuraiAccountSection(title.parentElement);
    });

    body.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
        const title = event.target.closest('.furai-account-section > .global-section-title');
        if (!title || !body.contains(title) || (event.key !== 'Enter' && event.key !== ' ')) return;

        event.preventDefault();
        toggleFuraiAccountSection(title.parentElement);
    });

    body.addEventListener('scroll', () => queueFuraiAccountScrollSave(body), { passive: true });

    // Keep the same Settings & Data viewport when preview controls re-render UI.
    // One delegated capture listener covers existing and injected controls without
    // per-control listeners, repeated observers, or scattered scroll state.
    const preserveViewportForEvent = event => {
        const target = event.target;
        if (!(target instanceof Element)) return;
        if (target.closest('.furai-account-section > .global-section-title')) return;

        const control = target.closest(
            'button, select, input[type="checkbox"], input[type="radio"], input[type="range"], input[type="color"], [onclick*="preview"], [onchange*="preview"], [oninput*="preview"]'
        );
        if (!control || !body.contains(control)) return;

        const anchor = control.closest('.furai-account-section') || control;
        queueFuraiAccountViewportRestore(
            body.scrollTop,
            anchor,
            anchor.getBoundingClientRect().top
        );
    };

    body.addEventListener('click', preserveViewportForEvent, true);
    body.addEventListener('change', preserveViewportForEvent, true);
    body.addEventListener('input', preserveViewportForEvent, true);
}

    openAccountModal();

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        setTimeout(() => {
            const modal = document.getElementById('accountModalEl');
            const body = modal ? modal.querySelector('.modal-body') : null;
            const target = document.getElementById('accountEntryGateHomeSection');

            if (target && typeof setFuraiAccountSectionCollapsed === 'function') {
                setFuraiAccountSectionCollapsed(target, false, { persist: true });
            }

            if (body && target) {
                body.scrollTop = Math.max(0, target.offsetTop - 8);
            }
        }, 90);
    });
}

function closeAccountModal() {
    const accountModalBody = getFuraiAccountModalBody();
    if (accountModalBody) saveFuraiAccountScrollTop(accountModalBody.scrollTop);

    closeFuraiUiLanguageMenu();

    const contextMetaToggle = document.getElementById('contextMetaToggle');
    const savedContextMetaEnabled = getFuraiContextMetaEnabled();

    if (
        contextMetaToggle &&
        contextMetaToggle.checked !== savedContextMetaEnabled
    ) {
        applyFuraiContextMetaState(savedContextMetaEnabled);
    }

    if (!accountSidebarPreviewCommitted) {
        revertSidebarModePreview();
    }

    if (!accountFontPreviewCommitted) {
        revertAccountFontPreview();
    }

    if (!accountThemePreviewCommitted) {
        revertAccountThemePreview();
    }

    if (!accountAvatarSizePreviewCommitted) {
        applyFuraiAvatarSize(accountAvatarSizePreviewOriginal || getSavedFuraiAvatarSize(), { updateControls: false });
    }

    accountSidebarPreviewOriginal = null;
    accountSidebarPreviewCommitted = false;
    accountFontPreviewOriginal = null;
    accountFontPreviewCommitted = false;
    accountFontPreviewChatId = null;
    accountThemePreviewOriginal = null;
    accountThemePreviewCommitted = false;
    accountAvatarSizePreviewOriginal = null;
    accountAvatarSizePreviewCommitted = false;
    accountTextColorDraft = null;

    if (window.furaiEntryBgPreviewDirty) {
        applyEntryGateBackground();

        if (currentChatId) {
            let currentData = null;
            try { currentData = DB.get(currentChatId); } catch (e) {}
            if (currentData?.personality === 'home') applyBackground(currentChatId);
        }

        window.furaiEntryBgPreviewDirty = false;
    }
    
    document.getElementById('accountModalEl').style.display = 'none';
}

}

// [Fix 3] Storage Meter Logic
function updateStorageMeter() {
    const bar = document.getElementById('storageBar');
    const text = document.getElementById('storageText');
    const warn = document.getElementById('storageWarning');
    const infoText = document.getElementById('storageInfoText');

    const currentMode =
        normalizeFuraiStorageMode(localStorage.getItem(FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_KEY)) ||
        StorageEngine.mode;

    const isDB = currentMode === FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_INDEXEDDB;

    // Count UTF-8 bytes without joining or copying the entire cache.
    // LOW-RAM CONTRACT: never build one Blob/JSON string from all stored records
    // just to read its size. IndexedDB users may have a large cache, and doing so
    // temporarily duplicates that data in memory when Settings & Data opens.
    const getUtf8ByteLength = value => {
        const text = String(value);
        let bytes = 0;

        for (let index = 0; index < text.length; index++) {
            const code = text.charCodeAt(index);

            if (code < 0x80) {
                bytes += 1;
            } else if (code < 0x800) {
                bytes += 2;
            } else if (code >= 0xD800 && code <= 0xDBFF) {
                const next = text.charCodeAt(index + 1);
                if (next >= 0xDC00 && next <= 0xDFFF) {
                    bytes += 4;
                    index++;
                } else {
                    bytes += 3;
                }
            } else {
                bytes += 3;
            }
        }

        return bytes;
    };

    let totalBytes = 0;
    for (const key of Object.keys(StorageEngine.cache || {})) {
        if (typeof isSiteDataKey === 'function' && !isSiteDataKey(key)) continue;
        totalBytes += getUtf8ByteLength(key);
        totalBytes += getUtf8ByteLength(StorageEngine.cache[key]);
    }

    let sizeStr = "";
    if (totalBytes < 1024) sizeStr = totalBytes + " B";
    else if (totalBytes < 1024 * 1024) sizeStr = (totalBytes / 1024).toFixed(2) + " KB";
    else sizeStr = (totalBytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2) + " MB";

    if (text) text.textContent = `${sizeStr} Used`;

    if (!bar) return;

    if (isDB) {
        // DB mode: show real total stored app data, but no fake 5MB warning meter.
        bar.style.width = '100%';
        bar.style.background = "#00e676";

        if (infoText) {
            infoText.innerHTML = `
                <span style="font-weight:600;">Memory Expansion Active.</span><br>
            `;
        }

        if (warn) warn.style.display = 'none';
        return;
    }

    // localStorage mode: keep the old 5MB warning logic
    const BYTE_LIMIT = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
    const percentage = (totalBytes / BYTE_LIMIT) * 100;

    bar.style.width = Math.min(percentage, 100) + '%';

    if (infoText) {
        infoText.innerHTML = `
            <span style="color:var(--primary-color); font-weight:700;">Free Memory Expansion available.</span><br>
            Old local-storage users can manually upgrade in Settings & Data. Browsers typically allow only 5 MB for local data.
        `;
    }

    if (percentage > 90) {
        bar.style.background = "#f44336";
        if (warn) {
            warn.style.display = 'block';
            warn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-exclamation"></i> <strong>High Usage:</strong> Approaching standard browser limits.';
        }
    } else if (percentage > 70) {
        bar.style.background = "#ff9800";
        if (warn) warn.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
        bar.style.background = "#00e676";
        if (warn) warn.style.display = 'none';
    }
}

function saveAccSettingsAndClose() {
    const validation = window.getEntryGateCredentialValidation();

    if (!validation.valid) {
        window.updateEntryGateCredentialValidation();
        showToast(validation.message, 'error');

        const invalidField = validation.uidPending
            ? document.getElementById('accUidConfirmField')
            : document.getElementById('accSafeCodeConfirmField');

        invalidField?.focus();
        return;
    }

    const selectedUiLanguage = normalizeFuraiUiLanguage(
        document.getElementById('furaiUiLanguageSelect')?.value || furaiUiLanguage.preference
    );
    const uiLanguageChanged = selectedUiLanguage !== furaiUiLanguage.preference;

    saveAccSettings();
    localStorage.setItem(FURAI_UI_LANGUAGE_KEY, selectedUiLanguage);
    accountSidebarPreviewOriginal = document.getElementById('sidebarModeSelect')?.value || 'rich';
    accountSidebarPreviewCommitted = true;
    accountFontPreviewOriginal = normalizeSavedFontKey(document.getElementById('fontStyleSelect')?.value || 'default');
    accountFontPreviewCommitted = true;
    accountFontPreviewChatId = null;
    accountThemePreviewOriginal = getCurrentThemeSetting();
    accountThemePreviewCommitted = true;
    accountAvatarSizePreviewOriginal = getSavedFuraiAvatarSize();
    accountAvatarSizePreviewCommitted = true;
    showToast('Settings saved!', 'success');
    closeAccountModal();
    if (uiLanguageChanged) location.reload();
}

function saveAccSettings() {
    const genImg = document.getElementById('accGenImgInput').value.trim();
    const genName = document.getElementById('accGenNameInput').value.trim();
    const uid = document.getElementById('accUidField').value.trim();
    const isLocked = document.getElementById('lockModeToggle').checked;
    const sidebarMode = document.getElementById('sidebarModeSelect')?.value || 'rich';
    const uiFont = document.getElementById('fontStyleSelect')?.value || 'default';
    const uiTheme = getCurrentThemeSetting();
    const globalChatLanguage = normalizeFuraiChatLanguagePreference(
        document.getElementById('furaiGlobalChatLanguageSelect')?.value,
        'account'
    );
    const contextMetaEnabled = !!document.getElementById('contextMetaToggle')?.checked;
    const avatarSize = document.body.classList.contains('furai-avatar-use-sprite')
        ? 'sprite'
        : (document.body.classList.contains('furai-avatar-size-large') ? 'large' : 'default');
    
    const entryBgUrl = getBackgroundPreviewUrlFromInput(document.getElementById('entryBgUrl')?.value || '');
    const entryBgOpacity = document.getElementById('entryBgOpacity')?.value || '1';
    const entryBgBlur = document.getElementById('entryBgBlur')?.value || '0';
    const previousEntryBgRandom = getFuraiEntryRandomWallpaperEnabled();
    const entryBgRandomEnabled = document.getElementById('entryBgRandomToggle')?.checked !== false;
    
    const deleteCode = document.getElementById('accSafeCodeField').value.trim();
    
    // Use DB.set for compression
    DB.set('furai_acc_gen_img', genImg);
    DB.set('furai_acc_gen_name', genName);
    DB.set('furai_acc_uid', uid);
    DB.set('furai_acc_locked', isLocked);
    DB.set('furai_sidebar_mode', sidebarMode);
    DB.set('furai_ui_font', uiFont);
    DB.set('furai_ui_theme', uiTheme);
    if (globalChatLanguage === 'en') DB.remove(FURAI_CHAT_LANGUAGE_KEY);
    else DB.set(FURAI_CHAT_LANGUAGE_KEY, globalChatLanguage);
    DB.set('furai_chat_avatar_size', avatarSize);
    applyFuraiAvatarSize(avatarSize, { updateControls: false });
    setFuraiContextMetaEnabled(contextMetaEnabled);
    saveGlobalTextColorsFromAccount();

    DB.set('furai_entry_bg', entryBgUrl);
    DB.set('furai_entry_bg_opacity', entryBgOpacity);
    DB.set('furai_entry_bg_blur', entryBgBlur);
    DB.set(FURAI_ENTRY_RANDOM_WALLPAPER_KEY, entryBgRandomEnabled);

    if (entryBgRandomEnabled && previousEntryBgRandom !== entryBgRandomEnabled) {
        getFuraiSessionRandomHomeWallpaperUrl({ refresh: true });
    }
    
    if (entryBgUrl) {
        const rawInput = document.getElementById('entryBgUrl')?.value || '';
        const parsedFirstLine = parseBackgroundArchiveLine(getFirstBgInputLine(rawInput));
        addToBackgroundHistory(parsedFirstLine || entryBgUrl);
    }
    
    if (deleteCode) {
        DB.set('furai_acc_delete_code', deleteCode);
    }
    
    // Update the Sidebar Name visually
    updateSidebarSiteName();
    let activeChatData = null;
    try {
        activeChatData = currentChatId ? DB.get(currentChatId) : null;
    } catch (e) {}
    
    void applyAppFont(uiFont);
    
    if (activeChatData) {
        void applyChatRenderFontForData(activeChatData);
        applyTextColorsForChatData(activeChatData);
    } else {
        clearChatRenderFont();
        applyTextColorsForChatData(null);
    }
    updateChatList(document.getElementById('chatSearchInput')?.value || '');

    applyEntryGateBackground();
    window.furaiEntryBgPreviewDirty = false;
    
    if (currentChatId) {
        let chatData = null;
        try { chatData = DB.get(currentChatId); } catch (e) {}
    
        if (chatData && chatData.personality === 'home') {
            applyBackground(currentChatId);
        }
    }
}

function updateBrowserFavicon(iconUrl) {
    if (!iconUrl) return;

    const ensureFaviconLink = (selector, relValue) => {
        let link = document.querySelector(selector);
        if (!link) {
            link = document.createElement('link');
            link.rel = relValue;
            document.head.appendChild(link);
        }
        return link;
    };

    ensureFaviconLink('link[rel="icon"]', 'icon').href = iconUrl;
    ensureFaviconLink('link[rel="shortcut icon"]', 'shortcut icon').href = iconUrl;
    ensureFaviconLink('link[rel="apple-touch-icon"]', 'apple-touch-icon').href = iconUrl;
}
      
function updateSidebarSiteName() {
    const nameSpan = document.getElementById('sidebarSiteName');
    const logoImg = document.getElementById('sidebarSiteLogo');

    let savedName = '';
    let savedLogo = '';

    try { savedName = DB.get('furai_acc_gen_name'); } catch (e) {}
    try { savedLogo = DB.get('furai_acc_gen_img'); } catch (e) {}

    const finalName = savedName || 'FurAI';
    const finalLogo = savedLogo || 'https://user.uploads.dev/file/5a5ed67b60920ab75d6ecb3539d5fc32.webp';

    if (nameSpan) {
        nameSpan.textContent = finalName;
    }

    if (logoImg) {
        logoImg.src = finalLogo;
    }

    document.title = finalName;

    updateBrowserFavicon(finalLogo);
}

function confirmCleanChatLogsOnly() {
    const msg = [
        "Clean chat logs?",
        "",
        "Deletes:",
        "- Unpinned chats",
        "- Folders with no pinned chats left",
        "",
        "Keeps:",
        "- Pinned chat logs",
        "- Folders that contain pinned chats",
        "- Global characters, lorebooks, music, achievements, backgrounds, and account settings",
        "",
        "This cannot be undone. Save a backup first if needed."
    ].join("\n");

    if (confirm(msg)) {
        cleanChatLogsOnly();
    }
}

function cleanChatLogsOnly() {
    const chatKeys = Object.keys(StorageEngine.cache).filter(key => key.startsWith('chat-'));
    const pinnedFolderIds = new Set();
    const keptPinnedChats = [];

    let deletedChats = 0;
    let deletedProfiles = 0;
    let deletedFolders = 0;
    let deletedActiveChat = false;

    for (const key of chatKeys) {
        let chatData = null;

        try {
            chatData = DB.get(key);
        } catch(e) {
            chatData = null;
        }

        if (!chatData || typeof chatData !== 'object') continue;

        if (chatData.isPinned) {
            keptPinnedChats.push(chatData);

            if (chatData.folderId) {
                pinnedFolderIds.add(chatData.folderId);
            }

            continue;
        }

        const chatId = chatData.id || key;
        const bareId = String(key).replace(/^chat-/, '');
        const idVariants = new Set([chatId, key, bareId].filter(Boolean));
        const shouldClearDeepMemory = Boolean(
            chatData.deepMemoryInitialized ||
            chatData.memoryMode === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP
        );

        if (shouldClearDeepMemory) {
            idVariants.forEach(id => {
                void clearFuraiDeepMemoryRecords(id).catch(error => console.warn('Could not clear cleaned chat Deep Memory:', error));
            });
        }

        DB.remove(key);
        deletedChats++;

        idVariants.forEach(id => {
            clearFuraiMemoryModeCache(id);
            clearFuraiFullHistoryEstimateCache(id);
            releaseFuraiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex(id);
            DB.remove(`profile-${id}`);
            deletedProfiles++;
        });

        if (typeof chatTitles === 'object' && chatTitles) {
            idVariants.forEach(id => delete chatTitles[id]);
        }

        if (typeof chatDrafts === 'object' && chatDrafts) {
            idVariants.forEach(id => delete chatDrafts[id]);
        }

        if (typeof chatPersonalities === 'object' && chatPersonalities) {
            idVariants.forEach(id => delete chatPersonalities[id]);
        }

        if (typeof ongoingGenerations === 'object' && ongoingGenerations) {
            idVariants.forEach(id => delete ongoingGenerations[id]);
        }

        if (typeof mobileSelectedChatId !== 'undefined' && idVariants.has(mobileSelectedChatId)) {
            mobileSelectedChatId = null;
        }

        if (typeof optionsTargetChatId !== 'undefined' && idVariants.has(optionsTargetChatId)) {
            optionsTargetChatId = null;
        }

        if (typeof currentChatId !== 'undefined' && idVariants.has(currentChatId)) {
            deletedActiveChat = true;
        }
    }

    if (typeof FolderManager !== 'undefined' && FolderManager.getFolders && FolderManager.saveFolders) {
        const oldFolders = FolderManager.getFolders();
        const keptFolders = oldFolders.filter(folder => pinnedFolderIds.has(folder.id));

        deletedFolders = oldFolders.length - keptFolders.length;

        if (deletedFolders > 0) {
            FolderManager.saveFolders(keptFolders);
        }
    }

    keptPinnedChats.sort((a, b) => (b.timestamp || 0) - (a.timestamp || 0));

    if (deletedActiveChat) {
        currentChatId = null;

        const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
        if (chatMessagesEl) chatMessagesEl.innerHTML = '';

        const nextPinnedChat = keptPinnedChats[0];

        if (nextPinnedChat && nextPinnedChat.id && typeof loadChat === 'function') {
            loadChat(nextPinnedChat.id);
        } else if (typeof startNewChat === 'function') {
            startNewChat();
        }
    } else if (currentChatId && typeof loadChat === 'function') {
        const stillExists = DB.get(currentChatId);

        if (stillExists) {
            loadChat(currentChatId);
        }
    }

    if (typeof closeChatOptionsModal === 'function') closeChatOptionsModal();
    if (typeof updateChatList === 'function') updateChatList();
    if (typeof updateStorageMeter === 'function') updateStorageMeter();
    if (typeof updatePinnedFactsUI === 'function') updatePinnedFactsUI();

    if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
        showToast(`Deleted ${deletedChats} unpinned chats and ${deletedFolders} unused folders. Pinned chats kept intact.`, 'success');
    }

    return {
        deletedChats,
        deletedProfiles,
        deletedFolders,
        keptPinnedChats: keptPinnedChats.length
    };
}

function isEmptyChatShell(chatData) {
    const messages = Array.isArray(chatData?.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];

    const realMessages = messages.filter(msg => {
        if (!msg || typeof msg !== 'object') return false;

        const role = String(msg.role || msg.type || '').toLowerCase();
        const content = String(msg.content || msg.text || '').trim();

        if (!content) return false;
        if (role === 'system' || role === 'muted-note') return false;

        return role === 'user' ||
               role === 'ai' ||
               role === 'assistant' ||
               isFuraiPublicAnnouncementRole(role) ||
               role === 'cutscene';
    });

    if (realMessages.length === 0) return true;

    if (realMessages.length === 1) {
        const role = String(realMessages[0].role || realMessages[0].type || '').toLowerCase();
        return role === 'ai' || role === 'assistant';
    }

    return false;
}

function deleteStoredChatBundle(key, chatData) {
    const chatId = chatData?.id || key;
    const bareId = String(key).replace(/^chat-/, '');
    const idVariants = new Set([chatId, key, bareId].filter(Boolean));
    const shouldClearDeepMemory = Boolean(
        chatData?.deepMemoryInitialized ||
        chatData?.memoryMode === FURAI_MEMORY_MODE_DEEP
    );

    if (shouldClearDeepMemory) {
        idVariants.forEach(id => {
            void clearFuraiDeepMemoryRecords(id).catch(error => console.warn('Could not clear empty chat Deep Memory:', error));
        });
    }

    DB.remove(key);

    idVariants.forEach(id => {
        clearFuraiMemoryModeCache(id);
        clearFuraiFullHistoryEstimateCache(id);
        releaseFuraiDeepMemoryRuntimeIndex(id);
        if (typeof furaiRoleTimelinePositionCache !== 'undefined') {
            furaiRoleTimelinePositionCache.delete(String(id));
        }
        DB.remove(`profile-${id}`);
    });

    if (typeof chatTitles === 'object' && chatTitles) {
        idVariants.forEach(id => delete chatTitles[id]);
    }

    if (typeof chatDrafts === 'object' && chatDrafts) {
        idVariants.forEach(id => delete chatDrafts[id]);
    }

    if (typeof chatPersonalities === 'object' && chatPersonalities) {
        idVariants.forEach(id => delete chatPersonalities[id]);
    }

    if (typeof ongoingGenerations === 'object' && ongoingGenerations) {
        idVariants.forEach(id => delete ongoingGenerations[id]);
    }

    if (typeof mobileSelectedChatId !== 'undefined' && idVariants.has(mobileSelectedChatId)) {
        mobileSelectedChatId = null;
    }

    if (typeof optionsTargetChatId !== 'undefined' && idVariants.has(optionsTargetChatId)) {
        optionsTargetChatId = null;
    }

    return typeof currentChatId !== 'undefined' && idVariants.has(currentChatId);
}

function confirmCleanEmptyChatsOnly() {
    const msg = [
        "Clean empty chats?",
        "",
        "Deletes:",
        "- Unpinned chats with no real conversation",
        "- Chats that only contain system/setup notes",
        "- Chats that only contain one AI opening/start message",
        "",
        "Keeps:",
        "- Pinned chats",
        "- Any chat with additional user/character/narrator/cutscene messages",
        "",
        "This cannot be undone. Save a backup first if needed."
    ].join("\n");

    if (confirm(msg)) {
        cleanEmptyChatsOnly();
    }
}

function cleanEmptyChatsOnly() {
    const chatKeys = Object.keys(StorageEngine.cache).filter(key => key.startsWith('chat-'));

    let deletedChats = 0;
    let deletedActiveChat = false;

    for (const key of chatKeys) {
        let chatData = null;

        try {
            chatData = DB.get(key);
        } catch (e) {
            chatData = null;
        }

        if (!chatData || typeof chatData !== 'object') continue;
        if (chatData.isPinned) continue;
        if (!isEmptyChatShell(chatData)) continue;

        if (deleteStoredChatBundle(key, chatData)) {
            deletedActiveChat = true;
        }

        deletedChats++;
    }

    if (deletedActiveChat) {
        currentChatId = null;

        const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
        if (chatMessagesEl) chatMessagesEl.innerHTML = '';

        if (typeof startNewChat === 'function') {
            startNewChat();
        }
    } else if (currentChatId && typeof loadChat === 'function') {
        const stillExists = DB.get(currentChatId);

        if (stillExists) {
            loadChat(currentChatId);
        }
    }

    if (typeof closeChatOptionsModal === 'function') closeChatOptionsModal();
    if (typeof updateChatList === 'function') updateChatList();
    if (typeof updateStorageMeter === 'function') updateStorageMeter();
    if (typeof updatePinnedFactsUI === 'function') updatePinnedFactsUI();

    if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
        showToast(`Deleted ${deletedChats} empty chats.`, 'success');
    }
}
      
function confirmClearHistory() {
    const msg = "⚠️ DANGER ZONE: WIPE EVERYTHING?\n\nThis will permanently delete:\n- All Chat Histories\n- All Saved Profiles\n- All Global Settings\n- All Backgrounds\n\nThis cannot be undone. Are you sure?";
    if (confirm(msg)) {
        clearAllHistory(); 
        closeAccountModal();
        updateStorageMeter();
    }
}

function checkPrivacyLock() {
    // 1. Use DB.get to handle both boolean (compressed) and string "true" (legacy)
    const isLocked = DB.get('furai_acc_locked') === 'true' || DB.get('furai_acc_locked') === true;
    
    if (isLocked) {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('privacyLockOverlay');
        
        // 2. Use DB.get for these strings to handle decompression
        const genName = DB.get('furai_acc_gen_name');
        const genImg = DB.get('furai_acc_gen_img'); // <--- CHANGED THIS
        
        if(genName) document.getElementById('lockGenName').textContent = genName;
        if(genImg) document.getElementById('lockGenImg').src = genImg;
        
        applyEntryGateBackground();
        
        overlay.style.display = 'block';
    }
}

// Login Handler
function releaseFuraiPrivacyLock() {
    furaiPrivacyLockUnlocked = true;
    document.getElementById('privacyLockOverlay').style.display = 'none';
    applyBackgroundPreviewVisual(document.getElementById('privacyLockBgLayer'), '');
}

window.handleLockSubmit = function() {
    const inputUser = document.getElementById('lockAccInput').value.trim();
    const inputPass = document.getElementById('lockPassInput').value.trim();
    
    // Use DB.get to ensure we aren't comparing against compressed text
    const savedUser = DB.get('furai_acc_uid');
    const savedDeleteCode = DB.get('furai_acc_delete_code');

    // 1. WIPE LOGIC (If password matches delete code)
    if (savedDeleteCode && inputPass === savedDeleteCode) {
        releaseFuraiPrivacyLock();
        confirmClearHistory(); 
        return;
    }

    // 2. UNLOCK LOGIC
    if (!savedUser || inputUser === savedUser) {
        // Success
        releaseFuraiPrivacyLock();
    } else {
        // --- FAIL STATE ---
        const btn = document.querySelector('#privacyLockOverlay button[onclick*="handleLockSubmit"]');
        if(btn) {
            // Save original state
            const originalText = btn.innerText;
            
            // 1. Change Color to Red
            btn.style.backgroundColor = 'var(--danger-color)';
            
            // 2. Change Text ("Say Something")
            btn.innerText = "Access Denied"; // Or "Wrong Account"
            
            // 3. Shake Effect (Optional, reusing your toast logic style)
            btn.style.transform = "translateX(5px)";
            setTimeout(() => btn.style.transform = "translateX(-5px)", 50);
            setTimeout(() => btn.style.transform = "translateX(0)", 100);

            // 4. Revert after 1.5 seconds
            setTimeout(() => { 
                btn.style.backgroundColor = 'var(--primary-color)';
                btn.innerText = originalText;
            }, 1500);
        }
        showToast("Incorrect Account Name", "error");
    }
};

// Monitor for Quota Errors globally
window.addEventListener('error', (e) => {
    if (e.message && e.message.toLowerCase().includes('quota')) {
        showToast("⚠️ Storage Full! Save failed. Delete old chats immediately.", "error");
        // Force the storage meter to look RED immediately
        const bar = document.getElementById('storageBar');
        if(bar) bar.style.background = "#f44336";
    }
});
