/* --- COLLECTION TRIGGER SYSTEM --- */
const COLLECTION_RULES = {
    'FurAI':    { id: 'col_1',  regex: /\b(controllers?|joysticks?)\b/i },
    'Furberry': { id: 'col_2',  regex: /\b\w*berr(y|ies)\b/i }, // Catches ANY word ending in berry/berries
    'KodBu':    { id: 'col_3',  regex: /\bwrench(es)?\b/i },
    'Zora':     { id: 'col_4',  regex: /\bbriefcase\b/i },
    'Sluggy':   { id: 'col_5',  regex: /\bbones?\b/i },
    'Oakteeth': { id: 'col_6',  regex: /\bflutes?\b/i },
    'Maqaw':    { id: 'col_7',  regex: /\bfishing (rod|pole)\b/i },
    'Perlow':   { id: 'col_8',  regex: /\bwatch(es)?\b/i },
    'Charles':  { id: 'col_9',  regex: /\brings?\b/i },
    'Lora':     { id: 'col_10', regex: /\bsnow ?globes?\b/i }
};

function checkCollectionUnlock(botProfile, content) {
    if (!botProfile || !content) return;

    // Direct name match instead of UID checking
    const lookupKey = botProfile.name === 'Orange Cat (Sluggy)' ? 'Sluggy' : botProfile.name;
    if (!COLLECTION_RULES[lookupKey]) return;

    const rule = COLLECTION_RULES[lookupKey];
    if (AchievementManager.isUnlocked(rule.id)) return;

    if (rule.regex.test(content)) {
        AchievementManager.unlock(rule.id);
    }
}

/* --- LEGION SEARCH SYSTEM (Optimized) --- */
function getLegionSearchBarHTML(targetListId) {
    // 1. Check Achievement
    if (!AchievementManager.isUnlocked('legion')) return '';

    // 2. Render lightweight input
    return `
        <div class="legion-search-bar" style="margin-bottom:10px; position:relative; width:100%; box-sizing:border-box;">
            <input type="text" placeholder="Search (Name, #Tag, Info)..." 
                   oninput="filterLegionList(this.value, '${targetListId}')"
                   style="width:100%; padding:8px 8px 8px 32px; background:var(--input-bg); border:1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius:6px; color:var(--text-color); font-size:13px; outline:none; box-sizing:border-box;">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass" style="position:absolute; left:10px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); opacity:0.5; font-size:12px; pointer-events:none;"></i>
        </div>
    `;
}

function filterLegionList(query, listId) {
    const container = document.getElementById(listId);
    if (!container) return;
    
    // 1. Prepare Query (Lowercase, split by space for "fuzzy" match)
    const terms = query.toLowerCase().trim().split(/\s+/).filter(t => t);
    const items = container.querySelectorAll('[data-search]');
    
    // 2. Batch DOM updates (Fastest method)
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        for (let item of items) {
            const searchStr = item.dataset.search; // Already lowercase from generation
            
            // Check if ALL terms exist in the data string
            const isMatch = terms.every(term => searchStr.includes(term));
            
            // Toggle Visibility directly
            item.style.display = isMatch ? '' : 'none';
        }
    });
}

// --- ACHIEVEMENT COUNTER API ---
let globalAchievementCounts = {};
let achievementCountsLoaded = false;
let achievementCountsFetchPromise = null;
let achievementCountPending = {};

function getAchievementGlobalKey(id) {
    if (!id) return '';
    const str = String(id);
    return str.startsWith('ach_') ? str : 'ach_' + str;
}

function isAchievementCountPending(id) {
    const globalKey = getAchievementGlobalKey(id);
    return !!achievementCountPending[globalKey];
}

function getAchievementCountText(id) {
    const globalKey = getAchievementGlobalKey(id);

    if (!achievementCountsLoaded || isAchievementCountPending(id)) {
        return "Syncing unlock count…";
    }

    const count = globalAchievementCounts[globalKey] || 0;
    return `${count.toLocaleString()} unlocks`;
}

function refreshAchievementCountDisplays(id = null) {
    if (id) {
        const cardCountEl = document.getElementById(`achCount_${id}`);
        if (cardCountEl) cardCountEl.textContent = getAchievementCountText(id);
    }

    const modalCountEl = document.getElementById('achModalCount');
    if (modalCountEl && modalCountEl.dataset.achievementId) {
        modalCountEl.textContent = getAchievementCountText(modalCountEl.dataset.achievementId);
    }
}

async function fetchAchievementCounts() {
    if (achievementCountsFetchPromise) return achievementCountsFetchPromise;

    achievementCountsFetchPromise = (async () => {
        try {
            const fetcher = window.root?.superFetch ? window.root.superFetch : fetch;
            const res = await fetcher(`${EXP_COUNTER_API}/counts`);

            if (res.ok) {
                globalAchievementCounts = await res.json();
                achievementCountsLoaded = true;

                if (typeof updateAchievementUI === 'function') {
                    updateAchievementUI(); 
                }

                refreshAchievementCountDisplays();
            }
        } catch(e) {
            console.warn("Could not load global achievement stats.");
        } finally {
            achievementCountsFetchPromise = null;
        }
    })();

    return achievementCountsFetchPromise;
}

function recordAchievementUnlock(achId) {
    const globalId = getAchievementGlobalKey(achId);
    if (!globalId) return;

    achievementCountPending[globalId] = (achievementCountPending[globalId] || 0) + 1;
    refreshAchievementCountDisplays(achId);

    const fetcher = window.root?.superFetch ? window.root.superFetch : fetch;

    fetcher(`${EXP_COUNTER_API}/click`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ uid: globalId })
    })
    .catch(e => console.warn("Failed to record global achievement unlock"))
    .finally(async () => {
        try {
            await fetchAchievementCounts();
        } finally {
            achievementCountPending[globalId] = Math.max((achievementCountPending[globalId] || 1) - 1, 0);
            if (!achievementCountPending[globalId]) delete achievementCountPending[globalId];

            if (typeof updateAchievementUI === 'function') {
                updateAchievementUI();
            }

            refreshAchievementCountDisplays(achId);
        }
    });
}

/* --- ACHIEVEMENT MANAGER --- */
const AchievementManager = {
    getData: () => DB.get('furai_achievements') || {},
    saveData: (data) => DB.set('furai_achievements', data),
    isUnlocked: (id) => AchievementManager.getData()[id] === true,

    // UNIVERSAL UNLOCK FUNCTION
    unlock: (id) => {
        const data = AchievementManager.getData();
        if (data[id]) return; // Already unlocked

        // 1. Save locally
        data[id] = true;
        AchievementManager.saveData(data);

        // 2. ---> NEW: SILENT GLOBAL TRACKER <---
        recordAchievementUnlock(id);

        // 3. Trigger Overlay
        const info = ACHIEVEMENT_DB[id];
        if (info) {
            const descToUse = info.unlockedDesc || info.desc || "";
            const mode = id.startsWith('col_') ? 'collection' : 'achievement';
            // Pass the ID at the very end
            showGlobalOverlay(info.title, descToUse, info.img, mode, id);
        }

        // 4. Refresh UI
        updateAchievementUI();

        // --- CHAIN REACTION CHECKS ---
        if (id.startsWith('col_')) {
            AchievementManager.checkInfiniteUnlock();
        }
        AchievementManager.checkLegionUnlock();
    },

    checkInfiniteUnlock: () => {
        if (AchievementManager.isUnlocked('infinite_roster')) return;
        const allCollections = ['col_1','col_2','col_3','col_4','col_5','col_6','col_7','col_8','col_9','col_10'];
        const hasAll = allCollections.every(id => AchievementManager.isUnlocked(id));

        if (hasAll) {
            setTimeout(() => { AchievementManager.unlock('infinite_roster'); }, 1000);
        }
    },

    // --- NEW: LEGION CHECK ---
    checkLegionUnlock: () => {
        if (AchievementManager.isUnlocked('legion')) return;
        
        // Condition: Unlock 3 Previous
        const hasGroup = AchievementManager.isUnlocked('group_photo');
        const hasRoster = AchievementManager.isUnlocked('infinite_roster');
        const hasExpansion = AchievementManager.isUnlocked('expansion_pass');

        if (hasGroup && hasRoster && hasExpansion) {
            setTimeout(() => { AchievementManager.unlock('legion'); }, 1200);
        }
    },

    // --- UPDATED LIMIT LOGIC ---
    // Group Photo expands 5 -> Infinite Online.
    // Infinite Roster removes the 50 additional custom-character cap.
    // Legion is used for Group Character Search and roster slot deletion.
    getGroupLimit: () => {
        return AchievementManager.isUnlocked('group_photo') ? 9999 : 5;
    }
};

function updateAchievementUI() {
    Object.keys(ACHIEVEMENT_DB).forEach(id => {
        const isUnlocked = AchievementManager.isUnlocked(id);
        const data = ACHIEVEMENT_DB[id];
        
        // 1. Handle Overlay (Lock Screen)
        const overlayEl = document.getElementById(`achOverlay_${id}`);
        if (overlayEl) {
            // Logic: Hide if unlocked, Show if locked
            overlayEl.style.display = isUnlocked ? 'none' : 'flex';

            // Ensure content exists (The Lock Icon + Text)
            // We do this check to avoid constantly overwriting innerHTML
            if (!isUnlocked) {
                if (id.startsWith('col_')) {
                    // Collection: Mystery mark instead of a hard lock
                    if (!overlayEl.innerHTML.includes('?')) {
                        overlayEl.innerHTML = '<span style="font-size:24px; font-weight:bold; opacity:0.5; font-family:sans-serif;">?</span>';
                    }
                } else {
                    // Main Achievement: Icon + Text
                    if (!overlayEl.innerHTML.includes('fa-lock')) {
                        overlayEl.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-lock"></i>Locked';
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // 2. Handle Card Visuals & Clicks
        const cardEl = document.getElementById(`achCard_${id}`);
        if (cardEl) {
            // Apply Click Listener (Mobile Support)
            cardEl.onclick = () => {
                if (isUnlocked) {
                    // Show full details
                    const mode = id.startsWith('col_') ? 'collection' : 'achievement';
                    // ---> FIX: Added ', id' to the end of this call <---
                    showGlobalOverlay(data.title, isUnlocked ? data.unlockedDesc || data.desc : data.lockedDesc, data.img, mode, id);
                } else {
                    // Show "Locked" toast
                    showToast((data.lockedDesc || "Find this item to unlock!"), "error");
                }
            };
            cardEl.style.cursor = 'pointer';

            // --- FIX: OPACITY CONTROL ---
            // Unlocked = 1 (Bright)
            // Locked = 0.6 (Dim)
            cardEl.style.opacity = isUnlocked ? '1' : '0.6';

            // Visual State (Grayscale vs Color)
            // Note: We don't touch opacity here anymore because the overlay handles the dimming
            if (id.startsWith('col_')) {
                const img = cardEl.querySelector('img');
                if (isUnlocked) {
                    // cardEl.style.opacity = '1'; // Removed: Let the overlay removal handle brightness
                    cardEl.title = `${data.title}: ${data.desc}`;
                    if (img) {
                        img.style.filter = 'none';
                        if (img.src !== data.img) img.src = data.img;
                    }
                } else {
                    // cardEl.style.opacity = '0.6'; // Removed: The CSS overlay makes it look dim enough
                    cardEl.title = "???";
                    if (img) {
                        img.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%)';
                        // Mystery Placeholder logic
                        const placeholderUrl = COLLECTION_PLACEHOLDERS[id] || data.img;
                        if (img.src !== placeholderUrl) img.src = placeholderUrl;
                    }
                }
            } else {
                // Main Achievements
                const img = cardEl.querySelector('img');
                if (img) img.style.filter = isUnlocked ? 'none' : 'grayscale(100%)';
                
                const titleEl = document.getElementById(`achTitle_${id}`);
                const descEl = document.getElementById(`achDesc_${id}`);
                
                if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = data.title;
                if (descEl) descEl.textContent = isUnlocked ? data.unlockedDesc : data.lockedDesc;

                // ---> INJECT GLOBAL COUNTER (Steam Style) <---
                if (titleEl && descEl) {
                    let countEl = document.getElementById(`achCount_${id}`);
                    
                    // Create the badge if it doesn't exist yet
                    if (!countEl) {
                        countEl = document.createElement('span');
                        countEl.id = `achCount_${id}`;
                        // Subtle style: faded text, no bold, no custom colors
                        countEl.style.cssText = "font-size:10px; color:var(--text-color); opacity:0.5; margin-top:1px; margin-bottom:3px;";
                        // Move to front: Insert exactly between Title and Description
                        titleEl.parentNode.insertBefore(countEl, descEl);
                    }
                    
                    countEl.textContent = getAchievementCountText(id);
                }
                // -------------------------------------
            }
        }
    });
}

/* --- ACHIEVEMENT POPUP HELPER (Fixes ReferenceError) --- */
function showGlobalOverlay(title, desc, imgUrl, mode = 'achievement', id = null) {
    // 1. Create the modal HTML dynamically if it doesn't exist yet
    let el = document.getElementById('achievementModal');
    if (!el) {
        el = document.createElement('div');
        el.id = 'achievementModal';
        el.setAttribute('data-furai-ui-translate', '');
        // Container: Dark overlay background
        el.style.cssText = "display:none; top:0; left:0; position: fixed; width:100%; height:100%; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.85); z-index:99999; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; text-align:center; animation: fadeIn 0.3s; font-family:sans-serif;";
        
        el.innerHTML = `
            <div style="
                transform: scale(0.9); 
                animation: popIn 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275) forwards; 
                background: var(--sidebar-bg); 
                padding: 30px; 
                border-radius: 12px; 
                border: 2px solid var(--primary-color); 
                max-width: 350px; 
                width: 90%;
                box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);">
                
                <div id="achModalHeader" style="font-size: 18px; color: var(--primary-color); font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 20px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-transform: uppercase;">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-trophy" style="margin-right: 6px;"></i> Unlocked
                </div>
                
                <img id="achModalImg" src="" style="width:100px; height:100px; border-radius:8px; border:2px solid var(--border-color); box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); margin-bottom:20px; object-fit:cover; background:#000;">
                
                <div id="achModalTitle" style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; color: var(--text-color); margin-bottom: 2px;"></div>
                
                <div id="achModalCount" style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-color); opacity: 0.5; margin-bottom: 12px;"></div>
                
                <div id="achModalDesc" style="font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-color); opacity:0.8; line-height: 1.4; margin: 0 auto 24px auto;"></div>
                
                <button onclick="document.getElementById('achievementModal').style.display='none'" 
                        style="padding:10px 30px; background:var(--primary-color); color:var(--btn-text-color); font-weight:bold; border:none; border-radius:50px; cursor:pointer; font-size:14px; transition: opacity 0.2s;"
                        onmouseover="this.style.opacity='0.9'" onmouseout="this.style.opacity='1'">
                    Awesome!
                </button>
            </div>
        `;
        document.body.appendChild(el);
    }

    // 2. Populate Data
    document.getElementById('achModalImg').src = imgUrl;
    document.getElementById('achModalTitle').textContent = title;
    document.getElementById('achModalDesc').textContent = desc;

    // ---> Inject the Counter <---
    const countEl = document.getElementById('achModalCount');
    if (id) {
        countEl.dataset.achievementId = id;
        countEl.textContent = getAchievementCountText(id);
        countEl.style.display = 'block';
    } else {
        countEl.dataset.achievementId = '';
        countEl.style.display = 'none';
    }

    // Adjust Header Text for Collection Items vs Main Achievements
    const headerEl = document.getElementById('achModalHeader');
    if (mode === 'collection') {
        headerEl.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-star" style="margin-right: 6px;"></i> Item Found';
    } else {
        headerEl.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-trophy" style="margin-right: 6px;"></i> Unlocked';
    }

    // 3. Show and translate the freshly populated popup UI.
    el.style.display = 'flex';
    if (typeof scheduleFuraiUiScan === 'function') scheduleFuraiUiScan(el);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   CHARACTERS MODAL (Roster Viewer & Launcher)
   ========================================================================== */

let charsSearchQuery = "";
let charsSortMode = localStorage.getItem('furai_chars_sort') || "slot";
let characterLibraryEditToken = 0;

function setCharacterLibrarySort(mode) {
    charsSortMode = mode || 'slot';
    localStorage.setItem('furai_chars_sort', charsSortMode);
    renderCharactersGrid();
}

function compareCharacterLibraryName(a, b) {
    return String(a?.name || '').localeCompare(String(b?.name || ''), undefined, {
        sensitivity: 'base',
        numeric: true
    });
}

function compareCharacterLibraryStableOrder(a, b) {
    const aOrder = Number(a?._libraryOrder);
    const bOrder = Number(b?._libraryOrder);
    const safeA = Number.isFinite(aOrder) ? aOrder : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
    const safeB = Number.isFinite(bOrder) ? bOrder : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
    return safeA - safeB;
}

function getCharacterLibraryCreatedAt(item) {
    if (!item?.isRoster) return 0;

    const createdAt = Number(item.libraryCreatedAt);
    if (Number.isFinite(createdAt) && createdAt > 0) return createdAt;

    // Best-effort compatibility for old roster records created before
    // libraryCreatedAt existed. Missing dates remain unknown, not "year zero".
    const legacyTimestamp = Number(item.timestamp);
    return Number.isFinite(legacyTimestamp) && legacyTimestamp > 0
        ? legacyTimestamp
        : 0;
}

function isCharacterLibraryUsageMeasured(item) {
    return !!item && (item.isRoster === true || item.isSolo === true);
}

function compareCharacterLibraryKnownDate(a, b, direction) {
    const aTime = getCharacterLibraryCreatedAt(a);
    const bTime = getCharacterLibraryCreatedAt(b);
    const aKnown = aTime > 0;
    const bKnown = bTime > 0;

    // Unknown legacy dates always stay after real dates for both Newest and Oldest.
    if (aKnown !== bKnown) return aKnown ? -1 : 1;
    if (!aKnown) return compareCharacterLibraryStableOrder(a, b);

    const diff = direction === 'asc'
        ? aTime - bTime
        : bTime - aTime;

    return diff || compareCharacterLibraryStableOrder(a, b);
}

function compareCharacterLibraryUsage(a, b, property, direction) {
    const aMeasured = isCharacterLibraryUsageMeasured(a);
    const bMeasured = isCharacterLibraryUsageMeasured(b);

    // User profiles and Magic Wand do not collect these metrics.
    if (aMeasured !== bMeasured) return aMeasured ? -1 : 1;
    if (!aMeasured) return compareCharacterLibraryStableOrder(a, b);

    const aValue = Math.max(0, Number(a?.[property]) || 0);
    const bValue = Math.max(0, Number(b?.[property]) || 0);
    const diff = direction === 'asc'
        ? aValue - bValue
        : bValue - aValue;

    return diff || compareCharacterLibraryStableOrder(a, b);
}

function sortCharacterLibraryList(displayList) {
    if (!Array.isArray(displayList) || charsSortMode === 'slot') return displayList;

    displayList.sort((a, b) => {
        if (charsSortMode === 'name_asc') {
            return compareCharacterLibraryName(a, b) ||
                compareCharacterLibraryStableOrder(a, b);
        }

        if (charsSortMode === 'name_desc') {
            return compareCharacterLibraryName(b, a) ||
                compareCharacterLibraryStableOrder(a, b);
        }

        if (charsSortMode === 'date_desc') {
            return compareCharacterLibraryKnownDate(a, b, 'desc');
        }

        if (charsSortMode === 'date_asc') {
            return compareCharacterLibraryKnownDate(a, b, 'asc');
        }

        if (charsSortMode === 'chatted_desc') {
            return compareCharacterLibraryUsage(a, b, 'chatCount', 'desc');
        }

        if (charsSortMode === 'chatted_asc') {
            return compareCharacterLibraryUsage(a, b, 'chatCount', 'asc');
        }

        if (charsSortMode === 'recent_chat') {
            return compareCharacterLibraryUsage(a, b, 'lastChattedAt', 'desc');
        }

        if (charsSortMode === 'stale_chat') {
            return compareCharacterLibraryUsage(a, b, 'lastChattedAt', 'asc');
        }

        return compareCharacterLibraryStableOrder(a, b);
    });

    return displayList;
}

function bringCharacterLibraryEditorToFront() {
    const editor = document.getElementById('globalSettingsModalEl');
    if (!editor || getComputedStyle(editor).display === 'none') return;

    const library = document.getElementById('charactersModalEl');
    const libraryVisible = library && getComputedStyle(library).display !== 'none';

    if (libraryVisible) {
        editor.classList.add('global-settings-over-character-library');

        const libraryZ = parseInt(getComputedStyle(library).zIndex, 10);
        const editorZ = parseInt(getComputedStyle(editor).zIndex, 10);
        const safeLibraryZ = Number.isFinite(libraryZ) ? libraryZ : 2900;

        if (!Number.isFinite(editorZ) || editorZ <= safeLibraryZ) {
            editor.style.setProperty('z-index', String(safeLibraryZ + 20), 'important');
        }
    }

    if (window.ModalStackManager?.bringToFront) {
        window.ModalStackManager.bringToFront(editor, {
            above: libraryVisible ? library : 'charactersModalEl'
        });
    }

    if (libraryVisible) {
        const finalLibraryZ = parseInt(getComputedStyle(library).zIndex, 10);
        const finalEditorZ = parseInt(getComputedStyle(editor).zIndex, 10);

        if (
            Number.isFinite(finalLibraryZ) &&
            (!Number.isFinite(finalEditorZ) || finalEditorZ <= finalLibraryZ)
        ) {
            editor.style.setProperty('z-index', String(finalLibraryZ + 20), 'important');
        }
    }
}

function afterCharacterLibraryEditorRender(token, callback) {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            if (token !== characterLibraryEditToken) return;

            if (typeof callback === 'function') callback();

            bringCharacterLibraryEditorToFront();
        });
    });
}

function openCharactersModal() {
    closeMainMenuModals('charactersModalEl');
    ensureGlobalRosterBotUids();

    const selectionMode = !!furaiCharacterSelectionTarget;
    const localSelectionMode = furaiCharacterSelectionTarget?.scope === 'local';
    const titleEl = document.querySelector('#charactersModalEl .modal-header h3');
    if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = selectionMode ? describeFuraiSelectionTarget() : 'Character Library';

    const importBtn = document.querySelector('#charactersModalEl .modal-header button[onclick*="openCharacterImportModal"]');
    if (importBtn) importBtn.style.display = !selectionMode || localSelectionMode ? 'flex' : 'none';

    document.getElementById('charsSearchInput').value = '';
    charsSearchQuery = '';
    const charsSortSelect = document.getElementById('charsSortSelect');
    if (charsSortSelect) charsSortSelect.value = charsSortMode;

    const searchInput = document.getElementById('charsSearchInput');
    if (searchInput) {
        const searchWrapper = searchInput.parentElement;
        searchWrapper.style.display = AchievementManager.isUnlocked('legion') ? '' : 'none';
    }

    renderCharactersGrid();
    openModalLayer('charactersModalEl');
    const menu = document.getElementById('mainMenuDropdown');
    if (menu) menu.classList.remove('show');
}

function closeCharactersModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('charactersModalEl');
    if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
    const grid = document.getElementById('charsGridContainer');
    if (grid) grid.innerHTML = '';
    closeCharacterSelection();
    const titleEl = document.querySelector('#charactersModalEl .modal-header h3');
    if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = 'Character Library';
    const importBtn = document.querySelector('#charactersModalEl .modal-header button[onclick*="openCharacterImportModal"]');
    if (importBtn) importBtn.style.display = 'flex';
}

function refreshCharactersGridIfOpen() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('charactersModalEl');
    const container = document.getElementById('charsGridContainer');

    if (!modal || !container || modal.style.display === 'none') return;

    renderCharactersGrid();
}

let charsRenderTimeout = null;

function queueCharactersGridRender(query) {
    charsSearchQuery = query || '';

    if (charsRenderTimeout) clearTimeout(charsRenderTimeout);

    charsRenderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        renderCharactersGrid();
    }, 160);
}
      
function renderCharactersGrid() {
    const container = document.getElementById('charsGridContainer');
    if (!container) return;

    const selectionMode = !!furaiCharacterSelectionTarget;
    const searchQuery = charsSearchQuery.trim();
    let displayList = getFuraiCharacterLibraryDisplayList();

    if (selectionMode) {
        displayList = displayList.filter(bot => !bot.isRoster || !isUneditedGlobalFreeSlot(bot, Number(bot.originalIndex)));
    }

    if (searchQuery) {
        displayList = displayList.filter(bot => smartSearchMatch(
            `${bot.catalogTitle || ''} ${bot.name || ''} ${getFuraiVisibleTagText(bot.hashTag)} ${bot.instruction || ''} ${getFuraiLibrarySlotLabel(bot.librarySlotId)}`,
            searchQuery
        ));
    }

    sortCharacterLibraryList(displayList);
    let html = `<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:12px;padding-bottom:24px;">`;

    if (!selectionMode && !searchQuery) {
        const canAddSlot = canAddGlobalCharacterSlot('group');
        const sub = !canAddSlot
            ? 'Unlock Infinite Roster'
            : (typeof hasInfiniteRosterUnlock === 'function' && hasInfiniteRosterUnlock() ? '' : `Up to ${FURAI_CHARACTER_SLOT_LIMIT} additional characters`);
        html += `
          <div class="exp-card" style="height:115px;padding:10px;justify-content:center;align-items:center;cursor:${canAddSlot ? 'pointer' : 'not-allowed'};border:1px dashed var(--border-color);background:rgba(125,125,125,.05);" onclick="${canAddSlot ? 'addNewGlobalSlot(); renderCharactersGrid();' : 'showCharacterSlotLimitToast();'}">
            <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;opacity:${canAddSlot ? '.75' : '.45'};color:var(--text-color);">
              <i class="fa-solid ${canAddSlot ? 'fa-plus' : 'fa-lock'}" style="font-size:24px;margin-bottom:8px;color:${canAddSlot ? 'var(--primary-color)' : 'var(--text-color)'};"></i>
              <span style="font-weight:600;font-size:13px;">Add New Character</span>
              ${sub ? `<span style="font-size:11px;opacity:.65;margin-top:2px;">${sub}</span>` : ''}
            </div>
          </div>`;
    }

    displayList.forEach(bot => {
        const id = String(bot.librarySlotId ?? bot.originalIndex);
        const characterTagSearchEnabled = document.getElementById('charsSearchInput')?.parentElement?.style.display !== 'none';
        const tagHtml = createFuraiTagChipsHTML(bot.hashTag, {
            searchKind: characterTagSearchEnabled ? 'character' : '',
            className: 'furai-character-card-tags'
        });
        const displayName = bot.catalogTitle || bot.name || 'Character';
        const safeName = escapeForInline(bot.name || 'Character');
        const safeAvatar = escapeForInline(bot.avatar || '');
        const safeInst = escapeForInline(bot.instruction || '');
        const safeTag = escapeForInline(bot.hashTag || '');
        const count = Number(bot.chatCount) || 0;
        const roleLabel = getFuraiLibrarySlotLabel(id);
        const cardClick = selectionMode ? `onclick="selectFuraiCharacterLibraryCard('${escapeForInline(id)}')"` : '';
        const cardStyle = selectionMode
            ? 'min-height:115px;cursor:pointer;position:relative;'
            : 'min-height:115px;';

        const selectionCountBadge = selectionMode
            ? `<div class="exp-action-btn furai-select-chat-count" title="Chats"><i class="fa-regular fa-message"></i><span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">${count}</span></div>`
            : '';
        const countDisplay = selectionMode
            ? ''
            : `<button class="exp-action-btn" title="Chat" style="height:26px;padding:0 10px;" onclick="startChatWithCharacter('${escapeForInline(id)}')"><i class="fa-regular fa-message"></i><span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;margin-left:6px;">${count}</span></button><button class="exp-action-btn" title="Actions" style="height:26px;width:30px;padding:0;" onclick="openCharacterLibraryActionMenu(event, '${escapeForInline(id)}')"><i class="fa-solid fa-ellipsis-vertical"></i></button>`;

        html += `
          <div class="exp-card" style="${cardStyle}" ${cardClick}>
            ${selectionCountBadge}
            <div class="exp-card-img-container">
              ${safeAvatar ? `<img src="${safeAvatar}" class="exp-char-img" onerror="this.style.display='none'" onclick="${selectionMode ? `openFuraiCharacterSelectionPreview('${escapeForInline(id)}', event)` : `event.stopPropagation(); openProfileCard('${safeName}','${safeAvatar}','${safeInst}','${safeTag}',null)`}">` : ''}
            </div>
            <div class="exp-card-content" style="justify-content:space-between;">
              <div class="exp-row-top" style="margin-bottom:2px;${selectionMode ? 'padding-right:58px;' : ''}"><div class="exp-title" style="font-size:14px;">${escapeHTML(displayName)}</div></div>
              ${tagHtml}
              <div class="exp-desc" style="-webkit-line-clamp:2;font-size:11.5px;">${escapeHTML(bot.instruction || 'No description.')}</div>
              <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;margin-top:auto;">
                <div class="exp-creator" style="margin:0;opacity:.55;font-size:11px;">${escapeHTML(roleLabel)}</div>
                <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;">${countDisplay}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>`;
    });

    html += '</div>';
    container.innerHTML = html;
    initFuraiDynamicTagLayouts(container);
}

let characterLibraryActionMenuBound = false;

function isCharacterLibraryRosterId(id) {
    return /^\d+$/.test(String(id || ''));
}

function closeCharacterLibraryActionMenu() {
    const menu = document.getElementById('characterLibraryActionMenu');
    if (menu) menu.style.display = 'none';
}

function ensureCharacterLibraryActionMenu() {
    let menu = document.getElementById('characterLibraryActionMenu');

    if (!menu) {
        menu = document.createElement('div');
        menu.id = 'characterLibraryActionMenu';
        menu.className = 'char-lib-action-menu';
        document.body.appendChild(menu);
    }

    if (!characterLibraryActionMenuBound) {
        characterLibraryActionMenuBound = true;

        document.addEventListener('click', event => {
            if (!event.target.closest('#characterLibraryActionMenu')) {
                closeCharacterLibraryActionMenu();
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
            if (event.key === 'Escape') closeCharacterLibraryActionMenu();
        });
    }

    return menu;
}

function openCharacterLibraryActionMenu(event, id) {
    event.stopPropagation();

    const menu = ensureCharacterLibraryActionMenu();
    const targetId = String(id);
    const isRosterSlot = isCharacterLibraryRosterId(targetId);
    menu.dataset.targetId = targetId;
    menu.innerHTML = `
        <button type="button" onclick="runCharacterLibraryAction('edit', this)">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-pen fa-fw"></i><span>Edit</span>
        </button>
        <button type="button" onclick="runCharacterLibraryAction('move', this)">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right-arrow-left fa-fw"></i><span>Move</span>
        </button>
        <button type="button" onclick="runCharacterLibraryAction('duplicate', this)">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-code-fork fa-fw"></i><span>Duplicate</span>
        </button>
        <button type="button" onclick="runCharacterLibraryAction('share', this)">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-share-nodes fa-fw"></i><span>Share</span>
        </button>
        <button type="button" class="danger" ${isRosterSlot ? '' : 'disabled'} onclick="runCharacterLibraryAction('delete', this)">
            <i class="fa-solid ${isRosterSlot ? (hasLegionUnlock() ? 'fa-trash' : 'fa-lock') : 'fa-ban'} fa-fw"></i>
            <span>${isRosterSlot && !hasLegionUnlock() ? 'Delete (Legion)' : 'Delete'}</span>
        </button>`;

    const rect = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const menuWidth = 168;
    const menuHeight = 190;
    const left = Math.max(8, Math.min(window.innerWidth - menuWidth - 8, rect.right - menuWidth));
    const top = Math.max(8, Math.min(window.innerHeight - menuHeight - 8, rect.bottom + 6));
    menu.style.left = `${left}px`;
    menu.style.top = `${top}px`;
    menu.style.display = 'block';
    if (typeof scheduleFuraiUiScan === 'function') scheduleFuraiUiScan(menu);
}

function runCharacterLibraryAction(action, btnEl) {
    const menu = document.getElementById('characterLibraryActionMenu');
    const id = menu?.dataset?.targetId;
    if (id === undefined || id === null || id === '') return;

    closeCharacterLibraryActionMenu();

    if (action === 'edit') return editCharacterFromModal(id);
    if (action === 'move') return openCharacterMoveSelection(id);
    if (action === 'duplicate') return duplicateCharacterLibraryItem(id);
    if (action === 'share') return shareRosterCharacter(id, btnEl);
    if (action === 'delete') return deleteCharacterLibraryItem(id);
}

function getCharacterLibraryProfileData(id) {
    const targetId = String(id ?? '');

    if (targetId === 'wand') {
        return cloneFuraiData(getFuraiGlobalWandProfile());
    }

    if (targetId.startsWith('user_')) {
        const mode = targetId.slice(5);
        const saved = cloneFuraiData(DB.get(`global-user-${mode}`) || createFuraiDefaultUser(mode));
        saved.instruction = saved.instructions?.[mode] ?? saved.instruction ?? '';
        return saved;
    }

    if (targetId.startsWith('solo_')) {
        const mode = targetId.slice(5);
        return cloneFuraiData(DB.get(`global-profile-${mode}`)?.bots?.[0] || createFuraiModeFactoryBot(mode));
    }

    if (isCharacterLibraryRosterId(targetId)) {
        return cloneFuraiData(getFuraiRosterCharacters()[Number(targetId)] || null);
    }

    return null;
}

function duplicateCharacterLibraryItem(id) {
    const source = getCharacterLibraryProfileData(id);
    if (!source) {
        showToast("Could not find character to duplicate.", "error");
        return;
    }

    let roster = DB.get('globalBotRoster');
    if (!roster || roster.length === 0) roster = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaultBots));

    if (!canAddCharacterSlotToRoster(roster)) {
        showCharacterSlotLimitToast();
        return;
    }

    const clone = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(source));

    clone.uid = typeof generateUID === 'function'
        ? generateUID('roster_bot')
        : `roster_bot_${Date.now()}`;
    clone.sourceLibraryUid = clone.uid;

    clone.name = `${clone.name || 'Character'} Copy`;
    clone.libraryCreatedAt = Date.now();
    clone.chatCount = 0;
    clone.lastChattedAt = 0;
    clone.isActive = false;
    clone.inActiveCast = false;
    clone.replyMode = 'auto';

    delete clone.isUser;
    delete clone.isWand;
    delete clone.isSolo;
    delete clone.isRoster;
    delete clone.userMode;
    delete clone.soloMode;
    delete clone.originalIndex;

    roster.push(clone);
    DB.set('globalBotRoster', roster);

    renderCharactersGrid();
    showToast(`Duplicated "${source.name || 'Character'}" into Character Library.`, "success");
}

function deleteCharacterLibraryItem(id) {
    if (!isCharacterLibraryRosterId(id)) {
        showToast("This profile is protected. Use Edit to change or reset it.", "error");
        return;
    }

    deleteGlobalBot(Number.parseInt(id, 10));
}

function editCharacterFromModal(id) {
    const token = ++characterLibraryEditToken;
    const targetId = String(id);

    if (targetId === 'wand') {
        openGlobalSettingsModal({
            keepCharacterLibrary: true,
            initialTab: 'group'
        });

        afterCharacterLibraryEditorRender(token, () => {
            getGlobalSettingsSectionInnerByTitle('Magic Wand');
        });

        return;
    }

    if (targetId.startsWith('user_')) {
        const mode = targetId.replace('user_', '');

        openGlobalSettingsModal({
            keepCharacterLibrary: true,
            initialTab: mode
        });

        afterCharacterLibraryEditorRender(token, () => {
            getGlobalSettingsSectionInnerByTitle('User Profile');
        });

        return;
    }

    if (targetId.startsWith('solo_')) {
        const mode = targetId.replace('solo_', '');

        openGlobalSettingsModal({
            keepCharacterLibrary: true,
            initialTab: mode
        });

        afterCharacterLibraryEditorRender(token, () => {
            getGlobalSettingsSectionInnerByTitle('Character Settings');
        });

        return;
    }

    const rosterIndex = Number.parseInt(targetId, 10);
    if (!Number.isFinite(rosterIndex)) return;

    openGlobalSettingsModal({
        keepCharacterLibrary: true,
        initialTab: 'group'
    });

    afterCharacterLibraryEditorRender(token, () => {
        editGlobalBot(rosterIndex);
    });
}

function shareRosterCharacter(id, btnEl) {
    const bot = getCharacterLibraryProfileData(id);

    if (!bot) return;

    ['charsShareName', 'charsShareTag', 'charsShareAvatar', 'charsShareSprite', 'charsShareInst', 'charsShareOpeningSystemMessage', 'charsShareOpening', 'charsShareOpeningBackground', 'charsShareOpeningLorebook', 'charsShareIndex'].forEach(inputId => {
        if (!document.getElementById(inputId)) {
            const input = document.createElement(inputId === 'charsShareInst' || inputId === 'charsShareOpeningSystemMessage' || inputId === 'charsShareOpening' || inputId === 'charsShareOpeningLorebook' ? 'textarea' : 'input');
            input.id = inputId;
            input.style.display = 'none';
            document.body.appendChild(input);
        }
    });

    document.getElementById('charsShareName').value = bot.name || '';
    document.getElementById('charsShareTag').value = bot.hashTag || '';
    document.getElementById('charsShareAvatar').value = bot.avatar || '';
    document.getElementById('charsShareSprite').value = bot.defaultSprite || '';
    document.getElementById('charsShareInst').value = bot.instruction || '';
    document.getElementById('charsShareOpening').value = bot.openingMessage || bot.customGreeting || bot.greeting || bot.initialMessage || '';

    const openingExtras = getCharacterOpeningExtras(bot);
    document.getElementById('charsShareOpeningSystemMessage').value = openingExtras.systemMessage || '';
    document.getElementById('charsShareOpeningBackground').value = openingExtras.background || '';
    document.getElementById('charsShareOpeningLorebook').value = openingExtras.lorebook || '';

    document.getElementById('charsShareIndex').value = id;

    openShareMenu(btnEl, 'charsShareName', 'charsShareAvatar', 'charsShareInst');
}

function getCharacterUsageMatchKey(bot) {
    if (!bot) return '';

    const uid = String(bot.uid || '').trim();
    if (uid) return `uid:${uid}`;

    const name = String(bot.name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const avatar = String(bot.avatar || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const tag = String(bot.hashTag || '').trim().toLowerCase();

    if (!name && !avatar && !tag) return '';

    return `fallback:${name}|${avatar}|${tag}`;
}

function findGlobalRosterIndexForCharacter(bot, roster) {
    if (!bot || !Array.isArray(roster)) return -1;

    const sourceUid = getGroupRosterSourceUid(bot);

    if (sourceUid) {
        const sourceIndex = roster.findIndex(rosterBot =>
            String(rosterBot?.uid || '').trim() === sourceUid
        );

        if (sourceIndex !== -1) return sourceIndex;
    } else {
        const linkedIndex = Number(bot.groupRosterSourceIndex);

        if (
            Number.isInteger(linkedIndex) &&
            linkedIndex >= 0 &&
            roster[linkedIndex]
        ) {
            return linkedIndex;
        }
    }

    const targetKey = getCharacterUsageMatchKey(bot);
    if (!targetKey) return -1;

    return roster.findIndex(rosterBot => getCharacterUsageMatchKey(rosterBot) === targetKey);
}

function incrementGlobalRosterBotUsageByIndex(index, now = Date.now()) {
    const idx = Number.parseInt(index, 10);
    if (!Number.isFinite(idx)) return false;

    let roster = DB.get('globalBotRoster');
    if (!roster || roster.length === 0) roster = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaultBots));
    if (!roster[idx]) return false;

    roster[idx].chatCount = (roster[idx].chatCount || 0) + 1;
    roster[idx].lastChattedAt = now;

    DB.set('globalBotRoster', roster);
    return true;
}

function incrementGlobalRosterBotUsageByBot(bot, now = Date.now()) {
    if (!bot) return false;

    let roster = DB.get('globalBotRoster');
    if (!roster || roster.length === 0) roster = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaultBots));

    const index = findGlobalRosterIndexForCharacter(bot, roster);
    if (index < 0) return false;

    roster[index].chatCount = (roster[index].chatCount || 0) + 1;
    roster[index].lastChattedAt = now;

    DB.set('globalBotRoster', roster);
    return true;
}

function markLocalBotSnapshotAsChatted(bot, now = Date.now()) {
    if (!bot) return;

    bot.chatCount = (bot.chatCount || 0) + 1;
    bot.lastChattedAt = now;
}

function markStartedGroupChatRosterAsChatted(profile) {
    if (!profile || !Array.isArray(profile.bots)) return;

    const roster = getCurrentGroupRosterSource();

    const now = Date.now();
    const countedKeys = new Set();
    let changed = false;

    profile.bots.forEach(bot => {
        if (!bot || !bot.inActiveCast || !bot.isActive) return;

        const key = getCharacterUsageMatchKey(bot);
        if (!key || countedKeys.has(key)) return;

        const index = findGlobalRosterIndexForCharacter(bot, roster);
        if (index < 0) return;

        countedKeys.add(key);

        roster[index].chatCount = (roster[index].chatCount || 0) + 1;
        roster[index].lastChattedAt = now;
        changed = true;
    });

    if (changed) {
        DB.set('globalBotRoster', roster);
    }

    refreshCharactersGridIfOpen();
}

function markAddedGroupRosterCharacterAsChatted(bot) {
    if (!bot) return;

    const now = Date.now();

    // Keep the local chat snapshot honest.
    markLocalBotSnapshotAsChatted(bot, now);

    // Also update the global Character Library item when this local bot still maps to one.
    incrementGlobalRosterBotUsageByBot(bot, now);

    refreshCharactersGridIfOpen();
}

function markStartedSoloModeAiAsChatted(personality) {
    if (!personality || personality === 'group' || personality === 'home') return;

    incrementCharacterLaunchCount(`solo_${personality}`);
    refreshCharactersGridIfOpen();
}

function incrementCharacterLaunchCount(id) {
    const now = Date.now();

    if (id === 'wand') {
        // Magic Wand / Narrator is a utility profile, not a chatted character.
        return;
    }
    
    if (typeof id === 'string' && id.startsWith('user_')) {
        // User profile cards are persona/profile presets, not chatted characters.
        return;
    }

    if (typeof id === 'string' && id.startsWith('solo_')) {
        const mode = id.replace('solo_', '');
        const key = `global-profile-${mode}`;

        let p = DB.get(key);
        if (!p || !p.bots || !p.bots[0]) {
            p = {
                user: createFuraiDefaultUser(mode),
                bots: [createFuraiModeFactoryBot(mode)],
                profileCustomized: false
            };
        }

        p.bots[0].chatCount = (p.bots[0].chatCount || 0) + 1;
        p.bots[0].lastChattedAt = now;
        DB.set(key, p);
        return;
    }

    incrementGlobalRosterBotUsageByIndex(id, now);
}

function startChatWithCharacter(id) {
    abortCurrentGeneration();
    closeCharactersModal();

    const targetId = String(id);
    incrementCharacterLaunchCount(id);

    // Compatibility launch for mode-specific AI cards. New role assignments are
    // snapshotted with fresh actor IDs so later global edits cannot rewrite this chat.
    if (targetId.startsWith('solo_')) {
        const mode = targetId.replace('solo_', '');
        const now = Date.now();
        const newChatId = 'chat-' + now;
        const savedProfile = DB.get(`global-profile-${mode}`);
        const sourceBot = savedProfile?.bots?.[0] || createFuraiModeFactoryBot(mode);
        const savedUser = DB.get(`global-user-${mode}`) || savedProfile?.user || DB.get('global-profile-user') || createFuraiDefaultUser(mode);

        const bot = normalizeFuraiSelectedCharacterForRole(sourceBot, {
            role: 'ai',
            mode,
            botIndex: 0,
            replyMode: 'auto',
            startAfterMessageUid: ''
        });
        const user = normalizeFuraiSelectedCharacterForRole(savedUser, {
            role: 'user',
            mode
        });

        const chatName = bot.name || 'AI';
        const newChat = applyCharacterOpeningExtrasToChat({
            id: newChatId,
            title: `Chat with ${chatName}`,
            messages: buildCharacterOpeningMessages(sourceBot, bot, mode, {
                role: 'ai',
                botIndex: 0,
                timestamp: now
            }),
            timestamp: now,
            personality: mode,
            viewMode: resolveSharedOrInheritedViewMode()
        }, sourceBot);

        const newProfile = {
            user,
            bots: [bot],
            profileCustomized: true,
            rosterMode: 'snapshot'
        };

        chatPersonalities[newChatId] = mode;
        window.chatPersonalities = chatPersonalities;
        DB.set(newChatId, newChat);
        DB.set(`profile-${newChatId}`, newProfile);
        loadChat(newChatId);
        showToast(`Started ${mode} chat with ${chatName}!`, 'success');
        return;
    }

    // Legacy utility/user cards remain launchable, but they now enter through the
    // same snapshot Group Chat path rather than cloning the entire Character Library.
    if (targetId === 'wand' || targetId.startsWith('user_')) {
        let sourceCharacter = null;

        if (targetId === 'wand') {
            sourceCharacter = {
                ...cloneFuraiData(getFuraiGlobalWandProfile()),
                uid: 'utility_magic_wand'
            };
        } else {
            const mode = targetId.replace('user_', '');
            const user = DB.get(`global-user-${mode}`) || DB.get('global-profile-user') || createFuraiDefaultUser(mode);
            sourceCharacter = {
                ...cloneFuraiData(user),
                uid: user.uid || generateUID('source_user'),
                instruction: user.instructions?.[mode] || user.instruction || ''
            };
        }

        createTempChat(sourceCharacter);
        return;
    }

    // Character Library launch: select one source and snapshot it into a new chat.
    const index = Number.parseInt(targetId, 10);
    let roster = DB.get('globalBotRoster');
    if (!Array.isArray(roster) || roster.length === 0) roster = cloneFuraiData(defaultBots);
    if (!Number.isInteger(index) || !roster[index]) {
        showToast('Could not find that Character Library entry.', 'error');
        return;
    }

    createTempChat(roster[index]);
}

function setupTagScroll() {
    const el = document.getElementById('expTagsContainer');
    if (!el || el.dataset.expWheelBound === 'true') return;

    el.dataset.expWheelBound = 'true';

    // Map vertical scroll wheel to horizontal tag scrolling.
    el.addEventListener('wheel', (evt) => {
        if (evt.deltaY !== 0) {
            evt.preventDefault();
            el.scrollLeft += evt.deltaY;
        }
    }, { passive: false });
}

function queueExpansionRender() {
    if (expRenderTimeout) clearTimeout(expRenderTimeout);

    expRenderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        renderExpansionContent();
    }, 180);
}

function ensureExpansionMainHeaderButton() {
    let btn = document.getElementById('expMainSubmitBtn');
    if (btn) return btn;

    const headerRight = document.querySelector('.chat-header-right');
    if (!headerRight) return null;

    btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.id = 'expMainSubmitBtn';
    btn.className = 'furai-exp-main-submit-btn';
    btn.type = 'button';
    btn.title = 'Submit & Share';
    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-paper-plane"></i><span>Submit & Share</span>';
    btn.onclick = openExpSubmitGuide;

    headerRight.insertBefore(btn, headerRight.firstChild);
    return btn;
}

const FuraiWorkspaceSurfaceManager = (() => {
    const entries = new Map();
    const history = [];
    let activeId = '';
    let shellPrepared = false;
    let previousTitle = '';

    const getSurface = surfaceOrId =>
        typeof surfaceOrId === 'string'
            ? document.getElementById(surfaceOrId)
            : surfaceOrId;

    const clearWorkspaceBackground = () => {
        const bgCtn = document.getElementById('chatBackgroundCtn');
        if (!bgCtn) return;

        if (typeof applyBackgroundVisual === 'function') {
            applyBackgroundVisual(bgCtn, '');
        } else {
            if (typeof stopBackgroundVideo === 'function') stopBackgroundVideo(bgCtn);
            bgCtn.style.backgroundImage = '';
        }

        bgCtn.innerHTML = '';
        bgCtn.classList.remove('bg-video-loading');
        bgCtn.style.opacity = '';
        bgCtn.style.filter = 'none';
        bgCtn.style.transform = 'none';
        document.body.classList.remove('chat-bg-active');
    };

    const prepareShell = () => {
        if (shellPrepared) return;

        if (document.body.classList.contains('furai-livestream-active') && typeof FuraiLivestream !== 'undefined') {
            FuraiLivestream.close({ restoreHome: false, keepTitle: true });
        }

        if (typeof closeOnlineList === 'function') closeOnlineList();

        const titleEl = document.getElementById('chatTitleEl');
        previousTitle = titleEl?.textContent || 'Home';

        const toolEl = document.getElementById('toolContainerEl');
        if (toolEl) toolEl.style.display = 'none';

        const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
        if (chatMessagesEl) chatMessagesEl.style.display = 'none';

        const inputWrap = document.querySelector('.chat-input-container');
        if (inputWrap) inputWrap.style.display = 'none';

        const homeSpiritLayer = document.getElementById('homeVnSpiritLayer');
        if (homeSpiritLayer) homeSpiritLayer.innerHTML = '';

        const vnOverlay = document.getElementById('vnOverlay');
        if (vnOverlay) vnOverlay.style.display = 'none';

        document.body.classList.remove('furai-home-screen-active', 'vn-active', 'vn-no-input', 'vn-fullscreen', 'home-vn-mode');
        document.body.classList.add('furai-workspace-active');
        clearWorkspaceBackground();

        const onlineCount = document.getElementById('onlineCountEl');
        if (onlineCount) onlineCount.style.display = 'none';

        const vnBtn = document.getElementById('vnToggleBtn');
        if (vnBtn) vnBtn.style.display = 'none';

        const chatBtn = document.getElementById('chatModeToggleBtn');
        if (chatBtn) chatBtn.style.display = 'none';

        const sidebar = document.getElementById('menuSidebarEl');
        if (sidebar && window.innerWidth <= 768) sidebar.classList.remove('open');

        shellPrepared = true;
    };

    const hideEntry = entry => {
        if (!entry?.surface) return;

        entry.surface.style.display = 'none';
        entry.surface.classList.remove('is-active');
        if (entry.activeClass) entry.surface.classList.remove(entry.activeClass);
        if (entry.bodyClass) document.body.classList.remove(entry.bodyClass);
        entry.surface.style.removeProperty('z-index');
        delete entry.surface.dataset.stackLayer;

        if (entry.temporarySurfaceClass) {
            entry.surface.classList.remove('furai-workspace-surface');
        }
    };

    const showEntry = entry => {
        const surface = entry?.surface;
        if (!surface) return null;

        if (surface.parentElement !== document.body) {
            document.body.appendChild(surface);
        }

        surface.classList.add('furai-workspace-surface');
        if (entry.activeClass) surface.classList.add(entry.activeClass);
        surface.classList.add('is-active');
        surface.style.removeProperty('z-index');
        delete surface.dataset.stackLayer;
        surface.style.display = entry.display || 'flex';

        if (entry.bodyClass) document.body.classList.add(entry.bodyClass);

        const titleEl = document.getElementById('chatTitleEl');
        if (titleEl && entry.title) titleEl.textContent = entry.title;

        return surface;
    };

    const open = (surfaceOrId, options = {}) => {
        const surface = getSurface(surfaceOrId);
        if (!surface) return null;

        prepareShell();

        const id = surface.id || options.id;
        if (!id) return null;

        if (options.resetHistory === true) {
            history.splice(0);
        }

        if (activeId && activeId !== id) {
            const current = entries.get(activeId);
            hideEntry(current);

            if (options.rememberCurrent !== false) {
                history.push(activeId);
            }
        }

        const entry = {
            surface,
            title: options.title || '',
            bodyClass: options.bodyClass || '',
            activeClass: options.activeClass || '',
            display: options.display || 'flex',
            temporarySurfaceClass: options.temporarySurfaceClass === true
        };

        entries.set(id, entry);
        activeId = id;
        return showEntry(entry);
    };

    const restoreShell = (options = {}) => {
        document.body.classList.remove(
            'furai-workspace-active',
            'expansion-pass-main-active',
            'expansion-workshop-active'
        );

        const chatMessagesEl = document.getElementById('chatMessagesEl');
        if (chatMessagesEl) chatMessagesEl.style.display = '';

        const inputWrap = document.querySelector('.chat-input-container');
        if (inputWrap) inputWrap.style.display = '';

        const onlineCount = document.getElementById('onlineCountEl');
        if (onlineCount) onlineCount.style.display = '';

        const vnBtn = document.getElementById('vnToggleBtn');
        if (vnBtn) vnBtn.style.display = '';

        const chatBtn = document.getElementById('chatModeToggleBtn');
        if (chatBtn) chatBtn.style.display = '';

        const titleEl = document.getElementById('chatTitleEl');
        if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = previousTitle || 'Home';

        if (typeof applyBackground === 'function') {
            applyBackground(currentChatId);
        }

        previousTitle = '';
        shellPrepared = false;

        if (options.restoreHome !== false) {
            let restored = false;

            if (currentChatId && typeof loadChat === 'function') {
                try {
                    restored = loadChat(currentChatId, { refreshSidebar: false }) !== false;
                } catch (e) {
                    restored = false;
                }
            }

            if (!restored && typeof initChatUI === 'function') {
                initChatUI();
            }
        }
    };

    const back = (options = {}) => {
        if (activeId) hideEntry(entries.get(activeId));

        const previousId = history.pop() || '';
        if (previousId && entries.has(previousId)) {
            activeId = previousId;
            return showEntry(entries.get(previousId));
        }

        activeId = '';
        restoreShell(options);
        return null;
    };

    const closeAll = (options = {}) => {
        if (activeId) hideEntry(entries.get(activeId));
        history.splice(0).forEach(id => hideEntry(entries.get(id)));
        activeId = '';
        restoreShell(options);
    };

    const isActive = id =>
        id ? activeId === id : !!activeId;

    return {
        open,
        back,
        closeAll,
        prepareShell,
        isActive,
        get activeId() { return activeId; }
    };
})();

window.FuraiWorkspaceSurfaceManager = FuraiWorkspaceSurfaceManager;

async function openExpansionMainScreen() {
    const openToken = ++furaiRemoteExpansionOpenToken;

    document.body.classList.remove('exp-opened-from-cast');
    document.body.classList.remove('exp-opened-from-character-import');

    closeMainMenuModals(['expansionModalEl']);

    const modalEl = document.getElementById('expansionModalEl');
    const contentBody = document.getElementById('expContentBody');
    const tagsContainer = document.getElementById('expTagsContainer');
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('expSearchInput');

    ensureExpansionMainHeaderButton();
    setupTagScroll();
    bindExpansionDelegatedActions();

    // =====================================================================
    // ROUTE-FIRST CONTRACT — NEVER WAIT FOR DATA OR CARD RENDER BEFORE OPEN
    // =====================================================================
    // The sidebar action must switch to the Expansion Pass surface immediately.
    // Awaiting dynamic import or rendering cards first makes the clicked button
    // appear frozen even though work is happening. Open the lightweight shell,
    // let the browser paint it, then load and render the remote content.
    if (contentBody) {
        contentBody.innerHTML = `
            <div style="min-height:180px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; color:var(--text-muted); font-size:13px;">
                <span class="furai-mini-spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span>
                <span data-furai-ui-translate>Loading Expansion Pass...</span>
            </div>
        `;
    }
    if (tagsContainer) tagsContainer.replaceChildren();
    if (searchInput) searchInput.disabled = true;

    if (modalEl) {
        FuraiWorkspaceSurfaceManager.open(modalEl, {
            title: 'Expansion Pass',
            bodyClass: 'expansion-pass-main-active',
            activeClass: 'expansion-main-view',
            temporarySurfaceClass: true,
            rememberCurrent: false,
            resetHistory: true
        });
    }

    const menu = document.getElementById('mainMenuDropdown');
    if (menu) menu.classList.remove('show');
    markExpansionPassSeen();

    // Guarantee the route and loading state receive a paint before import work.
    await new Promise(resolve => requestAnimationFrame(resolve));
    if (openToken !== furaiRemoteExpansionOpenToken) return;

    try {
        const loaded = await ensureExpansionPassDataLoaded();
        if (loaded === null || openToken !== furaiRemoteExpansionOpenToken) return;
    } catch (err) {
        if (isFuraiRemoteAbortError(err) || openToken !== furaiRemoteExpansionOpenToken) return;
        console.error(err);

        if (contentBody) {
            contentBody.innerHTML = `
                <div style="min-height:180px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; color:var(--text-muted); text-align:center;">
                    <span data-furai-ui-translate>Could not load Expansion Pass.</span>
                    <button type="button" data-furai-ui-translate onclick="window.openExpansionMainScreen()">Retry</button>
                </div>
            `;
        }
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Could not load Expansion Pass.', 'error');
        return;
    }

    // Keep remote parsing and the heavier card render out of the click frame.
    await new Promise(resolve => requestAnimationFrame(resolve));
    if (openToken !== furaiRemoteExpansionOpenToken) return;

    renderExpansionTags();
    renderExpansionContent();
    if (searchInput) searchInput.disabled = false;

    checkExpansionGate();
    refreshExpClickCounts(true);
}

function openExpansionFromCastModal() {
    document.body.classList.add('exp-opened-from-cast');
    openExpansionModal({ preserveRouteClass: 'exp-opened-from-cast' });
}

function openExpansionFromCharacterImportModal() {
    document.body.classList.add('exp-opened-from-character-import');

    openExpansionModal({
        keepOpenIds: ['charactersModalEl'],
        above: 'charImportModalEl',
        preserveRouteClass: 'exp-opened-from-character-import'
    });
}


function openExpansionFromLorebookEditor() {
    openExpansionModal({
        keepOpenIds: ['lorebookLibraryModal', 'lorebookEditModal'],
        above: 'lorebookEditModal'
    });
}
      
async function openExpansionModal(options = {}) {
    if (FuraiWorkspaceSurfaceManager.isActive()) {
        closeExpansionModal({ restoreHome: false });
    }

    const openToken = ++furaiRemoteExpansionOpenToken;

    const modalForClassicOpen = document.getElementById('expansionModalEl');
    if (modalForClassicOpen) modalForClassicOpen.classList.remove('expansion-main-view');

    if (options.preserveRouteClass !== 'exp-opened-from-cast') {
        document.body.classList.remove('exp-opened-from-cast');
    }

    if (options.preserveRouteClass !== 'exp-opened-from-character-import') {
        document.body.classList.remove('exp-opened-from-character-import');
    }

    const keepOpenIds = Array.isArray(options.keepOpenIds)
        ? options.keepOpenIds.filter(Boolean)
        : [];

    closeMainMenuModals(['expansionModalEl', ...keepOpenIds]);

    try {
        const loaded = await ensureExpansionPassDataLoaded();
        if (loaded === null || openToken !== furaiRemoteExpansionOpenToken) return;
    } catch (err) {
        if (isFuraiRemoteAbortError(err)) return;
        console.error(err);
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Could not load Expansion Pass.', 'error');
        return;
    }

    setupTagScroll();
    bindExpansionDelegatedActions();

    renderExpansionTags();
    renderExpansionContent(); // Render immediately after remote data loads.

    const modalEl = document.getElementById('expansionModalEl');

    if (modalEl) {
        if (window.openModalLayer) {
            window.openModalLayer(modalEl, { above: options.above });
        } else {
            modalEl.style.display = 'flex';
        }
    }

    const menu = document.getElementById('mainMenuDropdown');
    if(menu) menu.classList.remove('show');

    checkExpansionGate();
    markExpansionPassSeen();

    // --- Fetch Counts in Background ---
    refreshExpClickCounts(true);
}

/* --- NEW: Gate & Unlock System --- */
function checkExpansionGate() {
    const isUnlocked = AchievementManager.isUnlocked('expansion_pass');
    const contentBody = document.getElementById('expContentBody');
    const existingPromo = document.getElementById('expPromoOverlay');
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('expSearchInput');
    const tagsContainer = document.getElementById('expTagsContainer');

    if (existingPromo) existingPromo.remove(); // Reset UI state

    if (isUnlocked) {
        // UNLOCKED STATE
        if (contentBody) {
            contentBody.classList.remove('exp-locked');
            contentBody.style.pointerEvents = ''; // Reset to default
            contentBody.style.opacity = '1';
        }
        if (searchInput) searchInput.disabled = false;
        if (tagsContainer) tagsContainer.style.pointerEvents = '';
    } else {
        // LOCKED STATE: Secure the body AND the search bar to stop bypasses
        if (contentBody) {
            contentBody.classList.add('exp-locked');
            contentBody.style.pointerEvents = 'none'; 
            contentBody.style.opacity = '0.5';
        }
        if (searchInput) searchInput.disabled = true;
        if (tagsContainer) tagsContainer.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
        
        // Render Promo Popup
        const promo = document.createElement('div');
        promo.id = 'expPromoOverlay';
        promo.className = 'exp-promo-overlay';
        promo.innerHTML = `
            <div class="exp-promo-card">
                <div class="exp-promo-icon">
                    <img src="https://user.uploads.dev/file/25b40d189d0f769b8d34a45d9532ef13.webp" alt="AI Furry Generator Logo" width="200" style="border-radius: 8px;">
                </div>
                <div class="exp-promo-text">Check our website dedicated for image generation</div>
                <a href="https://perchance.org/ai-furry-generator?utm_source=furai&utm_medium=perchance" target="_blank" class="exp-promo-btn" onclick="unlockExpansionPass()">
                    <span>Visit & Unlock</span> <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square"></i>
                </a>
                <span class="exp-promo-sub">Free, unlimited, and furry community</span>
                <button class="exp-promo-cancel" onclick="denyExpansionPass()">Maybe Later</button>
            </div>
        `;
        document.querySelector('#expansionModalEl .modal-content').appendChild(promo);
    }
}

function unlockExpansionPass() {
    AchievementManager.unlock('expansion_pass');
    
    // INSTANT removal, no fade delay blocking clicks
    const promo = document.getElementById('expPromoOverlay');
    if (promo) promo.remove(); 
    
    // Instantly unlock everything
    const contentBody = document.getElementById('expContentBody');
    if (contentBody) {
        contentBody.classList.remove('exp-locked');
        contentBody.style.pointerEvents = ''; // Reset
        contentBody.style.opacity = '1';
    }
    
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('expSearchInput');
    if (searchInput) searchInput.disabled = false;
    
    const tagsContainer = document.getElementById('expTagsContainer');
    if (tagsContainer) tagsContainer.style.pointerEvents = '';
}

function denyExpansionPass() {
    const promo = document.getElementById('expPromoOverlay');
    if (promo) promo.remove();
    
    // Completely lock the interface so they can't bypass it
    const contentBody = document.getElementById('expContentBody');
    if (contentBody) {
        contentBody.classList.add('exp-locked');
        contentBody.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
        contentBody.style.opacity = '0.5';
    }
    
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('expSearchInput');
    if (searchInput) searchInput.disabled = true;
    
    const tagsContainer = document.getElementById('expTagsContainer');
    if (tagsContainer) tagsContainer.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
    
    showToast("Expansion content is locked, preview only.", "info");
}

function closeExpansionModal(options = {}) {
    const modal = document.getElementById('expansionModalEl');
    const wasWorkspace = FuraiWorkspaceSurfaceManager.isActive();

    // Any pending open/load/render result from before this close is stale.
    furaiRemoteExpansionOpenToken++;

    document.body.classList.remove('exp-opened-from-cast');
    document.body.classList.remove('exp-opened-from-character-import');

    expRenderToken++;
    stopExpWallpaperFeed();

    const content = document.getElementById('expContentBody');
    FuraiGalleryMedia.releaseWithin(content);

    if (expRenderTimeout) {
        clearTimeout(expRenderTimeout);
        expRenderTimeout = null;
    }

    if (wasWorkspace) {
        FuraiWorkspaceSurfaceManager.closeAll({
            restoreHome: options.restoreHome !== false
        });
    } else if (modal) {
        modal.classList.remove('expansion-main-view', 'furai-workspace-surface', 'is-active');

        if (window.closeModalLayer) {
            window.closeModalLayer(modal);
        } else {
            modal.style.display = 'none';
            modal.style.removeProperty('z-index');
        }
    }

    document.body.classList.remove(
        'expansion-pass-main-active',
        'expansion-workshop-active'
    );

    // Clear rendered DOM, search/tag UI, and promo overlay to free modal memory.
    const contentBody = document.getElementById('expContentBody');
    if (contentBody) contentBody.replaceChildren();

    const tagsContainer = document.getElementById('expTagsContainer');
    if (tagsContainer) tagsContainer.replaceChildren();

    const searchInput = document.getElementById('expSearchInput');
    if (searchInput) {
        searchInput.value = '';
        searchInput.disabled = false;
    }

    const promo = document.getElementById('expPromoOverlay');
    if (promo) promo.remove();

    activeExpTags.clear();
    expSortMode = 'newest';
    expSortReverse = false;

    // Stop any preview music and release its source.
    if (expAudioPreview) {
        try { expAudioPreview.pause(); } catch (e) {}
        try {
            expAudioPreview.removeAttribute('src');
            expAudioPreview.load();
        } catch (e) {}
        expAudioPreview = null;
    }

    // Strict free-after-close: remote DB arrays, pending dynamic-import loads,
    // and background count payloads are discarded after the route closes.
    hardUnloadExpansionRemoteData();
    hardUnloadExpansionCountData();
}

/* --- 4. TAG LOGIC --- */
function renderExpansionTags() {
    const container = document.getElementById('expTagsContainer');
    if (!container) return;

    activeExpTags.delete('Popular');
    activeExpTags.delete('Random');

    const isAllActive = activeExpTags.size === 0;
    const sortIcon = expSortReverse ? 'fa-arrow-up-wide-short' : 'fa-arrow-down-wide-short';
    const sortTitle = expSortReverse ? 'Reverse order' : 'Default order';

    let tagsToRender = [...EXP_TAGS];
    if (isExpNsfw && !tagsToRender.includes('NSFW')) {
        tagsToRender.push('NSFW');
    }

    const getTagDisplayLabel = (tag) => tag === 'New' ? 'Recent' : tag;

    const sortHtml = `
        <span class="exp-sort-control" data-furai-ui-translate>
            <button type="button"
                    class="exp-sort-dir-btn ${expSortReverse ? 'active' : ''}"
                    onclick="toggleExpSortOrder()"
                    title="${sortTitle}"
                    aria-label="${sortTitle}">
                <i class="fa-solid ${sortIcon}"></i>
            </button>

            <select id="expSortSelect" class="exp-sort-select" onchange="setExpSortMode(this.value)" title="List Order">
                <option value="newest" ${expSortMode === 'newest' ? 'selected' : ''}>Newest</option>
                <option value="trending" ${expSortMode === 'trending' ? 'selected' : ''}>Trending</option>
                <option value="popular" ${expSortMode === 'popular' ? 'selected' : ''}>Top</option>
                <option value="random" ${expSortMode === 'random' ? 'selected' : ''}>Random</option>
            </select>
        </span>
    `;

    const tagHtml = tagsToRender.map(tag => {
        let isActive = false;
        if (tag === 'All') isActive = isAllActive;
        else isActive = activeExpTags.has(tag);

        const label = getTagDisplayLabel(tag);
        const title = tag === 'New' ? 'Items added in the last 30 days' : '';
        return `<button class="exp-tag ${isActive ? 'active' : ''}" data-furai-ui-translate onclick="toggleExpTag('${tag}')" title="${title}">${label}</button>`;
    }).join('');

    container.innerHTML = sortHtml + tagHtml;
}

function setExpSortMode(mode) {
    const allowed = new Set(['newest', 'trending', 'popular', 'random']);
    expSortMode = allowed.has(mode) ? mode : 'newest';

    renderExpansionTags();
    renderExpansionContent();
}

function toggleExpSortOrder() {
    expSortReverse = !expSortReverse;

    renderExpansionTags();
    renderExpansionContent();
}

function getExpSortDateKey(item) {
    const published = String(item?.date || '').trim();
    return parseExpDateOnly(published) ? published : '0000-00-00';
}

function getExpOrderKey(item) {
    return Number(item?.orderIndex || item?.sourceIndex || 0);
}

function getExpSourceKindKey(item) {
    return String(item?.sourceKind || item?.type || '');
}

function getExpSortAgeDays(item, todayMs) {
    const publishedAt = parseExpDateOnly(item?.date);
    if (!publishedAt) return 999999;

    const ageDays = Math.floor((todayMs - publishedAt.getTime()) / 86400000) + 1;
    return Math.max(1, ageDays);
}

function getExpTrendingScore(item, todayMs) {
    const count = Number(expClickCounts[String(item?.uid || '')] || 0);
    return count / getExpSortAgeDays(item, todayMs);
}

function compareExpItemsBySort(a, b, todayMs) {
    let result = 0;

    if (expSortMode === 'popular') {
        result = (Number(expClickCounts[String(b?.uid || '')] || 0)) - (Number(expClickCounts[String(a?.uid || '')] || 0));
    } else if (expSortMode === 'trending') {
        result = getExpTrendingScore(b, todayMs) - getExpTrendingScore(a, todayMs);
    } else {
        result = getExpSortDateKey(b).localeCompare(getExpSortDateKey(a));
    }

    if (result === 0 && expSortMode !== 'newest') {
        result = getExpSortDateKey(b).localeCompare(getExpSortDateKey(a));
    }

    if (result === 0) {
        result = getExpSourceKindKey(a).localeCompare(getExpSourceKindKey(b));
    }

    if (result === 0) {
        result = getExpOrderKey(b) - getExpOrderKey(a);
    }

    if (result === 0) {
        result = String(b?.uid || '').localeCompare(String(a?.uid || ''));
    }

    return expSortReverse ? -result : result;
}

function toggleExpTag(tag) {
    const exclusiveTypeTags = ['Character', 'Lorebook', 'Preset', 'Wallpaper', 'Music'];
    const exclusiveSortTags = ['Popular', 'Random'];

    const skinConflictTags = ['Lorebook', 'Preset', 'Wallpaper', 'Music'];
    const utilityConflictTags = ['Wallpaper', 'Music'];

    if (tag === 'All') {
        activeExpTags.clear();
    } else {
        if (activeExpTags.has(tag)) {
            activeExpTags.delete(tag);
        } else {
            if (exclusiveTypeTags.includes(tag)) {
                exclusiveTypeTags.forEach(t => activeExpTags.delete(t));
            }

            if (exclusiveSortTags.includes(tag)) {
                exclusiveSortTags.forEach(t => activeExpTags.delete(t));
            }

            // clicking a conflicting type should kick out Skin
            if (skinConflictTags.includes(tag)) {
                activeExpTags.delete('Skin');
            }

            // clicking a conflicting type should kick out Utility
            if (utilityConflictTags.includes(tag)) {
                activeExpTags.delete('Utility');
            }

            // clicking Skin should remove its incompatible type tags
            if (tag === 'Skin') {
                skinConflictTags.forEach(t => activeExpTags.delete(t));
            }

            // clicking Utility should remove its incompatible type tags
            if (tag === 'Utility') {
                utilityConflictTags.forEach(t => activeExpTags.delete(t));
            }

            activeExpTags.add(tag);
        }
    }

    renderExpansionTags();
    renderExpansionContent();
}

// --- EXPANSION PASS STATE & GUIDE ---
