let expMasterUnlockRunning = false;

function normalizeExpMasterUnlockCode(value) {
    return String(value || '')
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/\ufe0f/g, '')
        .replace(/⬆|↑/g, 'up')
        .replace(/⬇|↓/g, 'down')
        .replace(/⬅|←/g, 'left')
        .replace(/➡|→/g, 'right')
        .replace(/🅱/g, 'b')
        .replace(/🅰/g, 'a')
        .replace(/[^a-z]/g, '');
}

function isExpMasterUnlockCode(value) {
    return normalizeExpMasterUnlockCode(value) === 'upupdowndownleftrightleftrightba';
}

async function activateMemoryExpansionSilently() {
    const currentMode =
        normalizeFuraiStorageMode(localStorage.getItem(FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_KEY)) ||
        StorageEngine.mode;

    if (currentMode === FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_INDEXEDDB) {
        setFuraiStorageRuntimeMode(FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_INDEXEDDB);
        return true;
    }

    const backup = {};
    const keys = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
        keys.push(localStorage.key(i));
    }

    keys.forEach(key => {
        if (!key) return;

        const val = localStorage.getItem(key);
        backup[key] = val;
        StorageEngine.cache[key] = val;
    });

    await StorageEngine.bulkImport(backup);

    setFuraiStorageRuntimeMode(FURAI_STORAGE_MODE_INDEXEDDB);

    return true;
}

async function triggerExpMasterUnlock() {
    if (expMasterUnlockRunning) return;
    expMasterUnlockRunning = true;

    try {
        await activateMemoryExpansionSilently();

        const unlockData = AchievementManager.getData();
        
        Object.keys(ACHIEVEMENT_DB).forEach(id => {
            if (!unlockData[id]) {
                unlockData[id] = true;
                recordAchievementUnlock(id);
            }
        });
        AchievementManager.saveData(unlockData);

        if (typeof updateAchievementUI === 'function') updateAchievementUI();
        if (typeof updateStorageMeter === 'function') updateStorageMeter();

        const promo = document.getElementById('expPromoOverlay');
        if (promo) promo.remove();

        const contentBody = document.getElementById('expContentBody');
        if (contentBody) {
            contentBody.classList.remove('exp-locked');
            contentBody.style.pointerEvents = '';
            contentBody.style.opacity = '1';
        }

        const searchInput = document.getElementById('expSearchInput');
        if (searchInput) searchInput.disabled = false;

        const tagsContainer = document.getElementById('expTagsContainer');
        if (tagsContainer) tagsContainer.style.pointerEvents = '';

        renderExpansionTags();
        renderExpansionContent();

        const legionInfo = ACHIEVEMENT_DB.legion || {};
        
        showGlobalOverlay(
            "Legion Awakened",
            "Master code accepted. All achievements and prestige tools are open. Your existing chats, characters, wallpapers, music, and settings were not touched.",
            legionInfo.img || "https://user.uploads.dev/file/3cc6d97b4cd5dee5471b9c16e83d8b46.webp",
            "achievement",
            "legion"
        );

    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Master unlock failed:", e);
        showToast("Unlock display failed. Check console for details.", "error");
    } finally {
        expMasterUnlockRunning = false;
    }
}

function syncAdultUnlockState(options = {}) {
    const {
        syncForum = false,
        syncExpansion = true,
        renderExpansion = true
    } = options;

    hasVerifiedAge = true;
    localStorage.setItem('furai_age_verified', 'true');

    if (syncExpansion) {
        isExpNsfw = true;
        localStorage.setItem('furai_exp_nsfw_unlocked', 'true');

        const nsfwGuide = document.getElementById('expGuideNsfwSection');
        if (nsfwGuide) nsfwGuide.style.display = 'block';

        if (renderExpansion) {
            if (typeof renderExpansionTags === 'function') renderExpansionTags();
            if (typeof updateExpSafetyHintBtn === 'function') updateExpSafetyHintBtn();
            if (typeof renderExpansionContent === 'function') renderExpansionContent();
        }
    }

    if (syncForum && typeof activateNsfwMode === 'function') {
        activateNsfwMode();
    }
}

function expSectionHeader(label, items, sectionType = '') {
    const count = Array.isArray(items) ? items.length : 0;
    const safeSectionType = escapeForInline(sectionType);
    const safeLabel = escapeForInline(label);

    const bulkBtn = sectionType
        ? `<button class="exp-bulk-btn"
                   data-furai-ui-translate
                   data-exp-bulk="${safeSectionType}"
                   onclick="event.stopPropagation(); window.expBulkDownloadVisible('${safeSectionType}')"
                   title="Import visible ${safeLabel} (${count})">
               <i class="fa-solid fa-download"></i>
           </button>`
        : '';

    return `
        <div class="date-category-header">
            <span class="exp-section-title-text" data-furai-ui-translate>${label} (${count})</span>
            ${bulkBtn}
        </div>
    `;
}

function shuffleArray(arr) {
    const copy = [...arr];
    for (let i = copy.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
        [copy[i], copy[j]] = [copy[j], copy[i]];
    }
    return copy;
}

function normalizeSmartSearchText(value) {
    return String(value || '')
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim();
}

function parseSmartSearchQuery(query) {
    const raw = String(query || '');
    const parts = [];
    const regex = /"([^"]+)"|(\S+)/g;
    let match;

    while ((match = regex.exec(raw)) !== null) {
        const exact = !!match[1];
        const value = normalizeSmartSearchText(match[1] || match[2]);

        if (value) {
            parts.push({ value, exact });
        }
    }

    return parts;
}

function smartSearchMatch(haystack, query) {
    const text = normalizeSmartSearchText(haystack);
    const terms = parseSmartSearchQuery(query);

    if (!terms.length) return true;

    const tokens = new Set(
        text
            .split(/[^a-z0-9]+/i)
            .map(t => t.trim())
            .filter(Boolean)
    );

    return terms.every(term => {
        if (term.exact) {
            if (term.value.includes(' ')) {
                return text.includes(term.value);
            }

            return tokens.has(term.value);
        }

        return text.includes(term.value);
    });
}

function createExpWallpaperGridItem(wp) {
    const wallTitleHtml = expTextHtml(wp.title);
    const wallUid = String(wp.uid || '');
    const wallUidAttr = escapeExpHtml(wallUid);
    const badgeHtml = createExpStatusBadgeHTML(wp, { overlay: true });

    return createFuraiWallpaperCard({
        url: wp.img,
        title: wp.title || 'Wallpaper',
        ariaLabel: `Preview wallpaper: ${wp.title || 'Wallpaper'}`,
        className: 'exp-wall-item',
        mediaClassName: 'exp-wall-media',
        isVideo: isExpVideoUrl(wp.img),
        setupCard: card => {
            card.dataset.expAction = 'preview-wallpaper';
            card.dataset.expUid = wallUid;
            card.setAttribute('data-furai-ui-translate', '');
        },
        decorateCard: card => {
            const count = document.createElement('div');
            count.className = 'furai-wallpaper-count';
            count.innerHTML = `
                <i class="fa-solid fa-eye"></i>
                <span id="exp-count-${wallUidAttr}">${getExpCountText(wp.uid)}</span>`;
            card.appendChild(count);

            const overlay = document.createElement('div');
            overlay.className = 'exp-wall-overlay';
            overlay.innerHTML = `
                <div class="furai-wallpaper-title-row">
                    ${badgeHtml}
                    <span data-furai-ui-translate>${wallTitleHtml}</span>
                </div>`;
            card.appendChild(overlay);
        }
    });
}

function renderExpWallpaperGrid(items, grid, renderToken) {
    stopExpWallpaperFeed();

    if (renderToken !== expRenderToken || !grid.isConnected || !items.length) return;

    expWallpaperFeedGrid = grid;
    const contentRoot = grid.closest('#expContentBody');

    renderFuraiWallpaperGrid({
        items,
        grid,
        createItem: createExpWallpaperGridItem,
        scrollRoot: contentRoot || getGalleryScrollOwner(grid),
        renderValid: () => renderToken === expRenderToken
    });
}

  
/* --- 5. CONTENT RENDERER --- */
function renderExpansionContent() {
    updateExpSafetyHintBtn();

    const renderToken = ++expRenderToken;

    const searchInputEl = document.getElementById('expSearchInput');
    if (!searchInputEl) return;

    const query = searchInputEl.value.toLowerCase().trim();

    // --- 1. SECRET CHEAT CODE CHECK ---
    if (isExpMasterUnlockCode(searchInputEl.value)) {
        searchInputEl.value = '';
        triggerExpMasterUnlock();
        return;
    }
    
    if (query === 'nsfw' || query === 'erp') {
        searchInputEl.value = ''; // Clear the input immediately
        triggerExpNsfwGate();     // Trigger Age verification
        return; // Halt rendering until gate is resolved
    }

    const container = document.getElementById('expContentBody');
    if (!container) return;

    stopExpWallpaperFeed();
    FuraiGalleryMedia.releaseWithin(container);
    container.replaceChildren();
    
    // --- 2. FILTERING LOGIC ---
    let filtered = EXPANSION_DATA.filter(item => {
        const lowerItemTags = getExpItemTagKeys(item);
        
        // A. NSFW Filter
        const hasNsfwTag = lowerItemTags.includes('nsfw');
        if (hasNsfwTag && !isExpNsfw) return false;

        // B. Standard Tag Filter (AND Logic)
        if (activeExpTags.size > 0) {
             for (let tag of activeExpTags) {
                 if (!lowerItemTags.includes(tag.toLowerCase())) return false;
             }
        }

        // C. Smart Search Filter
        if (query) {
            const tagsString = getExpSearchTagText(item);
            const str = [
                item.title || '',
                item.creator || '',
                item.desc || '',
                item.previewText || '',
                tagsString
            ].join(' ');
        
            if (!smartSearchMatch(str, searchInputEl.value)) return false;
        }
        return true;
    });

    // --- 3. SORT ---
    if (expSortMode === 'random') {
        filtered = shuffleArray(filtered);
        if (expSortReverse) filtered.reverse();
    } else {
        const today = new Date();
        const todayMs = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate()).getTime();
        filtered.sort((a, b) => compareExpItemsBySort(a, b, todayMs));
    }
    
    // --- 4. CATEGORIZE ---
    const categories = { 'character': [], 'preset': [], 'lorebook': [], 'wallpaper': [], 'music': [] };
    filtered.forEach(item => { if(categories[item.type]) categories[item.type].push(item); });
    
    // Store ONLY the currently visible filtered view.
    // Bulk buttons and wallpaper navigation must use this, not EXPANSION_DATA.
    window.expCurrentVisibleSections = {
        character: categories.character.slice(),
        preset: categories.preset.slice(),
        lorebook: categories.lorebook.slice(),
        wallpaper: categories.wallpaper.slice(),
        music: categories.music.slice()
    };
    window.currentWallpaperList = window.expCurrentVisibleSections.wallpaper;

    // --- 5. RENDER SECTIONS ---
    
    // Characters
    if (categories.character.length > 0) {
        container.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', expSectionHeader('Characters / Skins', categories.character, 'character'));
        const grid = document.createElement('div');
        grid.className = 'exp-section-grid';
        grid.innerHTML = categories.character.map(createExpItemHTML).join('');
        container.appendChild(grid);
    }

    // Presets
    if (categories.preset.length > 0) {
        container.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', expSectionHeader('Presets', categories.preset, 'preset'));
        const grid = document.createElement('div');
        grid.className = 'exp-section-grid exp-story-grid';
        grid.innerHTML = categories.preset.map(createExpItemHTML).join('');
        container.appendChild(grid);
    }
      
    // Lorebooks
    if (categories.lorebook.length > 0) {
        container.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', expSectionHeader('Lorebooks', categories.lorebook, 'lorebook'));
        const grid = document.createElement('div');
        grid.className = 'exp-section-grid exp-story-grid';
        grid.innerHTML = categories.lorebook.map(createExpItemHTML).join('');
        container.appendChild(grid);
    }
      
    // Wallpapers
    if (categories.wallpaper.length > 0) {
        const wallpaperItems = window.currentWallpaperList;

        container.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', expSectionHeader('Wallpapers', wallpaperItems, 'wallpaper'));

        const grid = document.createElement('div');
        grid.className = 'exp-wall-grid furai-wallpaper-grid';
        container.appendChild(grid);

        renderExpWallpaperGrid(wallpaperItems, grid, renderToken);
    }
    
    // Music
    if (categories.music.length > 0) {
        container.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', expSectionHeader('Music', categories.music, 'music'));
        const grid = document.createElement('div');
        grid.className = 'exp-section-grid';
        grid.innerHTML = categories.music.map(createExpItemHTML).join('');
        container.appendChild(grid);
    }

    if (filtered.length === 0) container.innerHTML = `<div data-furai-ui-translate style="text-align:center; padding:20px; opacity:0.6;">No items found.</div>`;

    if (furaiUiLanguage.language !== 'en') {
        scheduleFuraiUiScan(document.getElementById('expansionModalEl') || container);
    }
}

/* --- HELPER: Bulletproof Inline String Escaper --- */
function escapeForInline(str) {
    if (!str) return "";
    return str
        .replace(/\\/g, "\\\\")   // 1. Escape backslashes
        .replace(/'/g, "\\'")     // 2. Escape single quotes (for the JS string)
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")  // 3. Escape double quotes (for the HTML attribute)
        .replace(/\n/g, "\\n")    // 4. Escape newlines
        .replace(/\r/g, "\\r");   // 5. Escape carriage returns
}

function escapeExpHtml(value) {
    return String(value ?? '')
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
}

function expCommentsAllowed(item) {
    return readFuraiRemoteBoolean(item?.allowComments, true);
}

function getExpCommentChannel(item) {
    const rawKey = String(item?.uid || item?.title || 'item')
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
        .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
        .slice(0, 70);

    return `furai-exp-${rawKey || 'item'}`;
}

function createExpCommentButtonHTML(item, extraClass = '') {
    if (!expCommentsAllowed(item)) return '';

    const safeItem = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(item)).replace(/'/g, "%27");
    const isIdCardButton = extraClass.split(/\s+/).includes('exp-id-card-comment-btn');
    const baseClass = isIdCardButton ? 'exp-comment-btn' : 'exp-action-btn exp-comment-btn';
    const className = [baseClass, extraClass].filter(Boolean).join(' ');

    return `
        <button type="button"
                class="${className}"
                data-furai-no-translate
                title="Comments"
                data-exp-action="comments"
                data-exp-item="${safeItem}"
                onclick="event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); openExpComments('${safeItem}')">
            <i class="fa-regular fa-comment-dots"></i>
            ${isIdCardButton ? '<span>Comments</span>' : ''}
        </button>
    `;
}

function isDesktopExpCharacterCommentLayout() {
    if (window.matchMedia) {
        return window.matchMedia('(min-width: 769px)').matches;
    }

    return window.innerWidth >= 769;
}

function bindExpProfileDescriptionScrollHandoff(shell) {
    const cardModal = document.getElementById('profileCardModal');
    const scroller = shell?.querySelector('[data-exp-profile-inline-scroller]');

    if (!cardModal || !scroller) return;
    if (scroller.dataset.expPagerInputBound === 'true') return;

    scroller.dataset.expPagerInputBound = 'true';

    const canUseMobilePager = () =>
        cardModal.classList.contains('exp-inline-comments-active') &&
        !isDesktopExpCharacterCommentLayout();

    const getOuterMax = () =>
        Math.max(0, scroller.scrollHeight - scroller.clientHeight);

    const normalizeWheelDelta = event => {
        let delta = Number(event.deltaY) || 0;

        if (event.deltaMode === 1) {
            delta *= 16;
        } else if (event.deltaMode === 2) {
            delta *= Math.max(1, scroller.clientHeight);
        }

        return delta;
    };

    const canLeaveNestedScroller = (target, direction) => {
        const desc = target?.closest?.('#pCardDesc');
        if (!desc || !scroller.contains(desc)) return true;

        const innerMax = Math.max(0, desc.scrollHeight - desc.clientHeight);
        if (innerMax <= 1) return true;

        if (direction > 0) {
            return desc.scrollTop >= innerMax - 1;
        }

        return desc.scrollTop <= 1;
    };

    let wheelIntent = 0;
    let wheelIntentTimer = 0;
    let pagerLockedUntil = 0;
    let pagerAnimationFrame = 0;

    const resetWheelIntentSoon = () => {
        clearTimeout(wheelIntentTimer);
        wheelIntentTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            wheelIntent = 0;
        }, 110);
    };

    const isPagerAnimating = () =>
        pagerAnimationFrame !== 0 ||
        scroller.dataset.expPagerAnimating === 'true';

    const applyTerminalPage = showComments => {
        const outerMax = getOuterMax();
        const commentsPage = Boolean(showComments && outerMax > 0);

        scroller.scrollTop = commentsPage ? outerMax : 0;
        shell.classList.toggle('is-mobile-comments-page', commentsPage);
        scroller.dataset.expPagerAnimating = 'false';
        scroller.dataset.expPagerPage = commentsPage ? 'comments' : 'preview';
    };

    const settleToNearestPage = () => {
        if (!canUseMobilePager() || isPagerAnimating()) return;

        const outerMax = getOuterMax();
        if (outerMax <= 0) {
            applyTerminalPage(false);
            return;
        }

        if (scroller.scrollTop <= 2) {
            applyTerminalPage(false);
            return;
        }

        if (scroller.scrollTop >= outerMax - 2) {
            applyTerminalPage(true);
            return;
        }

        moveToPage(scroller.scrollTop >= outerMax / 2 ? 1 : -1);
    };

    const moveToPage = direction => {
        if (isPagerAnimating()) return false;

        const outerMax = getOuterMax();
        if (outerMax <= 0) return false;

        const showComments = direction > 0;
        const targetTop = showComments ? outerMax : 0;
        const startTop = scroller.scrollTop;
        const distance = targetTop - startTop;

        if (Math.abs(distance) <= 2) {
            applyTerminalPage(showComments);
            return false;
        }

        const startedAt = performance.now();
        const durationMs = 150;

        pagerLockedUntil = startedAt + durationMs + 70;
        wheelIntent = 0;
        scroller.dataset.expPagerAnimating = 'true';

        const animate = now => {
            const progress = Math.min(1, (now - startedAt) / durationMs);
            const eased = progress < 0.5
                ? 4 * progress * progress * progress
                : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * progress + 2, 3) / 2;

            scroller.scrollTop = startTop + distance * eased;

            if (progress < 1) {
                pagerAnimationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
                return;
            }

            pagerAnimationFrame = 0;
            applyTerminalPage(showComments);
        };

        pagerAnimationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        return true;
    };

    scroller.addEventListener('wheel', event => {
        if (!canUseMobilePager()) return;

        const deltaY = normalizeWheelDelta(event);
        if (Math.abs(deltaY) < 0.5) return;

        const direction = deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1;
        if (!canLeaveNestedScroller(event.target, direction)) return;

        const outerMax = getOuterMax();
        if (outerMax <= 0) return;

        const currentlyComments = shell.classList.contains('is-mobile-comments-page');
        const hasDestination =
            (direction > 0 && !currentlyComments) ||
            (direction < 0 && currentlyComments);

        if (!hasDestination) return;

        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();

        if (isPagerAnimating() || performance.now() < pagerLockedUntil) return;

        if (wheelIntent && Math.sign(wheelIntent) !== direction) {
            wheelIntent = 0;
        }

        wheelIntent += deltaY;
        resetWheelIntentSoon();

        if (Math.abs(wheelIntent) >= 8) {
            moveToPage(direction);
        }
    }, { passive: false, capture: true });

    let lastTouchY = null;
    let touchIntent = 0;

    scroller.addEventListener('touchstart', event => {
        lastTouchY = event.touches?.[0]?.clientY ?? null;
        touchIntent = 0;
    }, { passive: true, capture: true });

    scroller.addEventListener('touchmove', event => {
        if (!canUseMobilePager()) {
            lastTouchY = event.touches?.[0]?.clientY ?? null;
            touchIntent = 0;
            return;
        }

        const currentY = event.touches?.[0]?.clientY;
        if (!Number.isFinite(currentY) || !Number.isFinite(lastTouchY)) {
            lastTouchY = currentY ?? null;
            return;
        }

        const deltaY = lastTouchY - currentY;
        lastTouchY = currentY;

        if (Math.abs(deltaY) < 0.5) return;

        if (isPagerAnimating()) {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();
            return;
        }

        const direction = deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1;
        if (!canLeaveNestedScroller(event.target, direction)) {
            touchIntent = 0;
            return;
        }

        const outerMax = getOuterMax();
        if (outerMax <= 0) return;

        const currentlyComments = shell.classList.contains('is-mobile-comments-page');
        const hasDestination =
            (direction > 0 && !currentlyComments) ||
            (direction < 0 && currentlyComments);

        if (!hasDestination) return;

        // Once the nested content reaches its boundary, the outer pager owns
        // the gesture. Prevent native free-scrolling so it cannot stop halfway.
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();

        if (touchIntent && Math.sign(touchIntent) !== direction) {
            touchIntent = 0;
        }

        touchIntent += deltaY;

        if (Math.abs(touchIntent) >= 10) {
            moveToPage(direction);
            touchIntent = 0;
        }
    }, { passive: false, capture: true });

    const clearTouch = () => {
        lastTouchY = null;
        touchIntent = 0;
        settleToNearestPage();
    };

    scroller.addEventListener('touchend', clearTouch, {
        passive: true,
        capture: true
    });
    scroller.addEventListener('touchcancel', clearTouch, {
        passive: true,
        capture: true
    });

    scroller.addEventListener('scrollend', settleToNearestPage, {
        passive: true
    });
}
function ensureExpProfileInlineCommentsPanel() {
    const cardModal = document.getElementById('profileCardModal');
    const originalCard = cardModal ? cardModal.querySelector(':scope > .profile-card') : null;
    if (!cardModal || !originalCard) return null;

    let shell = document.getElementById('expProfileInlineShell');

    if (!shell) {
        shell = document.createElement('div');
        shell.id = 'expProfileInlineShell';
        shell.className = 'exp-profile-inline-shell';
        shell.setAttribute('data-furai-no-translate', '');
        shell.onclick = event => event.stopPropagation();

        shell.innerHTML = `
            <div class="exp-profile-inline-header">
                <div class="exp-profile-inline-title">
                    <i class="fa-regular fa-comment-dots"></i>
                    <span data-exp-profile-inline-title>Character Comments</span>
                </div>

                <button type="button"
                        class="exp-profile-inline-close"
                        onclick="closeProfileCard()"
                        title="Close">×</button>
            </div>

            <div class="exp-profile-inline-body" data-exp-profile-inline-scroller>
                <div class="exp-profile-inline-preview"
                     data-exp-profile-inline-preview></div>

                <div class="exp-profile-inline-comment-page"
                     data-exp-profile-inline-comment-page>
                    <div class="exp-profile-inline-comments">
                        <div class="exp-profile-inline-mobile-comments-header">
                            <span class="exp-profile-inline-mobile-comments-icon"
                                  aria-hidden="true">
                                <i class="fa-regular fa-comment-dots"></i>
                            </span>
                            <span class="exp-profile-inline-mobile-comments-copy">
                                <strong>Comments</strong>
                                <small data-exp-profile-inline-mobile-title></small>
                            </span>
                        </div>

                        <div class="exp-profile-inline-comments-host"
                             data-exp-profile-inline-comments></div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;

        const scroller = shell.querySelector('[data-exp-profile-inline-scroller]');

        let mobilePagerFrame = 0;
        scroller?.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            if (mobilePagerFrame) return;

            mobilePagerFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                mobilePagerFrame = 0;
                if (scroller.dataset.expPagerAnimating === 'true') return;

                const maxScroll = Math.max(0, scroller.scrollHeight - scroller.clientHeight);

                if (scroller.scrollTop <= 2) {
                    shell.classList.remove('is-mobile-comments-page');
                } else if (maxScroll > 0 && scroller.scrollTop >= maxScroll - 2) {
                    shell.classList.add('is-mobile-comments-page');
                }
            });
        }, { passive: true });

        cardModal.appendChild(shell);
    }

    const previewSlot = shell.querySelector('[data-exp-profile-inline-preview]');
    if (previewSlot && !previewSlot.contains(originalCard)) {
        previewSlot.appendChild(originalCard);
    }

    bindExpProfileDescriptionScrollHandoff(shell);

    return shell;
}

function restoreExpProfileCardToModalRoot() {
    const cardModal = document.getElementById('profileCardModal');
    const shell = document.getElementById('expProfileInlineShell');
    const card = shell ? shell.querySelector('.profile-card') : null;

    if (cardModal && card) {
        cardModal.insertBefore(card, shell);
    }
}

function hideExpProfileInlineComments() {
    const cardModal = document.getElementById('profileCardModal');
    const shell = document.getElementById('expProfileInlineShell');

    if (cardModal) {
        cardModal.classList.remove('exp-inline-comments-active');
    }

    if (shell) {
        const commentsSlot = shell.querySelector('[data-exp-profile-inline-comments]');
        const scroller = shell.querySelector('[data-exp-profile-inline-scroller]');

        if (commentsSlot) commentsSlot.innerHTML = '';
        if (scroller) {
            scroller.scrollTop = 0;
            scroller.dataset.expPagerAnimating = 'false';
            scroller.dataset.expPagerPage = 'preview';
        }

        shell.classList.remove('is-mobile-comments-page');
        delete shell.dataset.expCommentChannel;
        shell.style.display = '';
    }

    restoreExpProfileCardToModalRoot();
}

function showExpProfileInlineComments(item) {
    if (!item || item.type !== 'character') return false;
    if (!expCommentsAllowed(item)) return false;

    const cardModal = document.getElementById('profileCardModal');
    const shell = ensureExpProfileInlineCommentsPanel();
    if (!cardModal || !shell) return false;

    const channel = getExpCommentChannel(item);
    const fullUrl = getExpCommentEmbedUrl(item);
    const titleEl = shell.querySelector('[data-exp-profile-inline-title]');
    const mobileTitleEl = shell.querySelector('[data-exp-profile-inline-mobile-title]');
    const commentsSlot = shell.querySelector('[data-exp-profile-inline-comments]');
    const scroller = shell.querySelector('[data-exp-profile-inline-scroller]');

    if (!commentsSlot) return false;

    const rawCharacterName = String(item.title || item.name || 'Character');
    const characterName = escapeHTML(rawCharacterName);

    if (titleEl) {
        titleEl.innerHTML = `${characterName} Comments`;
        titleEl.title = `${rawCharacterName} Comments`;
    }

    if (mobileTitleEl) {
        mobileTitleEl.textContent = rawCharacterName;
        mobileTitleEl.title = rawCharacterName;
    }

    cardModal.classList.add('exp-inline-comments-active');
    shell.classList.remove('is-mobile-comments-page');

    if (scroller) {
        scroller.dataset.expPagerAnimating = 'false';
        scroller.dataset.expPagerPage = 'preview';
        scroller.scrollTop = 0;
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            scroller.scrollTop = 0;
        });
    }

    if (shell.dataset.expCommentChannel === channel) return true;

    shell.dataset.expCommentChannel = channel;

    commentsSlot.innerHTML = `
        <div class="tool-loading-mask" style="position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:10;">
            <div class="modern-spinner"></div>
            <div class="loading-text">Loading Comments...</div>
        </div>

        <iframe class="exp-comment-iframe"
                src="${fullUrl}"
                allow="clipboard-read *; clipboard-write *;"
                onload="
                    const mask = this.previousElementSibling;
                    if (mask) {
                        mask.style.opacity = '0';
                        setTimeout(() => mask.remove(), 300);
                    }
                "></iframe>
    `;

    return true;
}
          
let expCommentParentObserver = null;

function getExpCommentParentLayer(item = {}) {
    const preferredIds = item?.type === 'character'
        ? ['profileCardModal', 'expStoryModal', 'imageLightboxEl', 'expansionModalEl']
        : ['expStoryModal', 'imageLightboxEl', 'profileCardModal', 'expansionModalEl'];

    return preferredIds
        .map(id => document.getElementById(id))
        .find(layer => {
            if (!layer) return false;
            const style = getComputedStyle(layer);
            return style.display !== 'none' && style.visibility !== 'hidden';
        }) || null;
}

function keepExpCommentModalAbovePreview(modal, parentLayer = null) {
    if (!modal || modal.dataset.expCommentOpen !== 'true') return;
    if (getComputedStyle(modal).display === 'none') return;

    if (typeof bringModalToFront === 'function') {
        bringModalToFront(modal, { above: parentLayer });
    }

    // Final guard against delayed preview/modal mutations raising the preview again.
    const currentZ = Number.parseInt(getComputedStyle(modal).zIndex, 10) || 0;
    const parentZ = parentLayer
        ? (Number.parseInt(getComputedStyle(parentLayer).zIndex, 10) || 0)
        : 0;
    const safeZ = Math.max(2147483000, currentZ, parentZ + 20);

    modal.style.setProperty('z-index', String(safeZ), 'important');
}

function openExpComments(encodedItem) {
    let item = null;

    try {
        item = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(encodedItem));
    } catch (err) {
        console.error(err);
        showToast("Could not open comments.", "error");
        return;
    }

    if (!expCommentsAllowed(item)) return;

    const modal = document.getElementById('expCommentModal');
    const titleEl = document.getElementById('expCommentTitle');
    const container = document.getElementById('expCommentIframeContainer');

    if (!modal || !container) {
        showToast("Missing comment modal.", "error");
        return;
    }

    const isLight = document.body.classList.contains('light-theme');
    const channel = getExpCommentChannel(item);

    const expCommentBaseConfig =
        typeof baseForumConfig !== 'undefined'
            ? baseForumConfig
            : {
                reverseCommentOrder: true,
                loadFonts: "Open Sans",
                messageBubbleStyle: `font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif; font-weight: 500; padding: 10px 10px; border-radius:5px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color);`,
                containerStyle: "width: 100%; height: 100%;",
                width: "100%",
                height: "100%",
                customEmojis: FURAI_CUSTOM_EMOJI_URL,
                customEmojiSize: 1.33,
                loneCustomEmojiSizeMultiplier: 2.8,
                adminPasswordHash: "bb6ef9b28663b5e7ce46a3a81b2bd21d4e0fea3ad79c26ffd3a43381722055ca",
                adminFlair: " MOD ",
                deleteButtonIcon: "✕",
                submitButtonText: "submit",
                submitButtonStyle: furaiCommentSubmitButtonStyle,
                settingsButtonStyle: furaiCommentSettingsButtonStyle,
                hideFullscreenButton: true
            };

    const config = {
        ...expCommentBaseConfig,
        channel,
        commentPlaceholderText: "Be respectful. Share constructive feedback, discussion, or appreciation.",
        forceColorScheme: isLight ? 'light' : 'dark',
        allowBots: false,
        submitButtonText: "Comment"
    };

    const baseUrl = `https://comments-plugin.perchance.org/embed/ai-furry-generator+${channel}`;
    const fullUrl = `${baseUrl}?adminPasswordHash=${expCommentBaseConfig.adminPasswordHash}#${encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(config))}`;

    if (titleEl) {
        titleEl.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-comment-dots"></i> Comments · ${escapeExpHtml(item.title || 'Expansion Item')}`;
    }

    const parentLayer = getExpCommentParentLayer(item);
    modal.dataset.expCommentOpen = 'true';

    if (typeof openModalLayer === 'function') {
        openModalLayer(modal, {
            parent: parentLayer,
            above: parentLayer
        });
    } else {
        modal.style.display = 'flex';
    }

    if (expCommentParentObserver) {
        expCommentParentObserver.disconnect();
        expCommentParentObserver = null;
    }

    if (parentLayer) {
        expCommentParentObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
            requestAnimationFrame(() => keepExpCommentModalAbovePreview(modal, parentLayer));
        });
        expCommentParentObserver.observe(parentLayer, {
            attributes: true,
            attributeFilter: ['style', 'class']
        });
    }

    keepExpCommentModalAbovePreview(modal, parentLayer);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => keepExpCommentModalAbovePreview(modal, parentLayer));
    setTimeout(() => keepExpCommentModalAbovePreview(modal, parentLayer), 80);
    setTimeout(() => keepExpCommentModalAbovePreview(modal, parentLayer), 240);

    container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="tool-loading-mask" style="position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:10;">
            <div class="modern-spinner"></div>
            <div class="loading-text">Loading Comments...</div>
        </div>
        <iframe class="exp-comment-iframe"
                src="${fullUrl}"
                allow="clipboard-read *; clipboard-write *;"
                onload="
                    const mask = this.previousElementSibling;
                    if (mask) {
                        mask.style.opacity = '0';
                        setTimeout(() => mask.remove(), 300);
                    }
                "></iframe>
    `;
}

function closeExpComments() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('expCommentModal');
    const container = document.getElementById('expCommentIframeContainer');

    if (expCommentParentObserver) {
        expCommentParentObserver.disconnect();
        expCommentParentObserver = null;
    }

    if (modal) {
        delete modal.dataset.expCommentOpen;

        if (typeof closeModalLayer === 'function') {
            closeModalLayer(modal);
        } else {
            modal.style.display = 'none';
            modal.style.removeProperty('z-index');
        }
    }

    if (container) container.innerHTML = '';
}

window.openExpComments = openExpComments;
window.closeExpComments = closeExpComments;

function bindExpansionDelegatedActions() {
    const contentBody = document.getElementById('expContentBody');

    if (contentBody && contentBody.dataset.expWallpaperEventsBound !== 'true') {
        contentBody.dataset.expWallpaperEventsBound = 'true';

        FuraiGalleryMedia.bindSurface(contentBody, {
            bindKey: 'exp-wallpaper',
            mediaSelector: '.furai-wallpaper-media',
            cardSelector: '.furai-wallpaper-card'
        });

        contentBody.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
            if (event.key !== 'Enter' && event.key !== ' ') return;

            const card = event.target.closest?.('[data-exp-action="preview-wallpaper"]');
            if (!card) return;

            event.preventDefault();
            card.click();
        });
    }

    if (window.expDelegatedActionsBound) return;

    window.expDelegatedActionsBound = true;

    document.addEventListener('click', async (event) => {
        const actionEl = event.target.closest('[data-exp-action]');
        if (!actionEl) return;

        const expansionModal = document.getElementById('expansionModalEl');
        const storyModal = document.getElementById('expStoryModal');
        const profileCardModal = document.getElementById('profileCardModal');
        const imageLightbox = document.getElementById('imageLightboxEl');

        const isInsideExpansion =
            (expansionModal && expansionModal.contains(actionEl)) ||
            (storyModal && storyModal.contains(actionEl)) ||
            (profileCardModal && profileCardModal.contains(actionEl)) ||
            (imageLightbox && imageLightbox.contains(actionEl));

        if (!isInsideExpansion) return;

        const action = actionEl.dataset.expAction;

        if (action !== 'preview-story') {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();
        }

        if (action === 'search-label') {
            expSearchByLabel(actionEl.dataset.expLabel || '');
            return;
        }

        if (action === 'comments') {
            openExpComments(actionEl.dataset.expItem || '');
            return;
        }

        if (action === 'preview-wallpaper') {
            const uid = String(actionEl.dataset.expUid || '');
            const item = (window.currentWallpaperList || []).find(wallpaper => String(wallpaper?.uid || '') === uid);
            if (!item) return;

            recordExpClick(uid);
            previewWallpaperV2(encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(item)).replace(/'/g, "%27"));
            return;
        }
        
        if (action === 'preview-char') {
            previewExpChar(actionEl.dataset.expItem || '');
            return;
        }

        if (action === 'import-char') {
            recordExpClick(actionEl.dataset.expUid || '');
            importExpansionChar(actionEl.dataset.expContent || '', actionEl.dataset.expTitle || '');
            return;
        }

        if (action === 'toggle-audio') {
            toggleExpansionAudio(actionEl.dataset.expContent || '', actionEl);
            return;
        }

        if (action === 'add-playlist') {
            recordExpClick(actionEl.dataset.expUid || '');
            addExpToPlaylist(actionEl.dataset.expTitle || '', actionEl.dataset.expContent || '');
            return;
        }

        if (action === 'preview-story') {
            previewExpStory(actionEl.dataset.expItem || '');
            return;
        }

        if (action === 'import-chatlog') {
            importExpansionChatlogPreset(actionEl.dataset.expContent || '', actionEl.dataset.expUid || '');
            return;
        }

        if (action === 'copy-backup') {
            recordExpClick(actionEl.dataset.expUid || '');

            try {
                await navigator.clipboard.writeText(actionEl.dataset.expContent || '');
                showToast('Backup link copied!', 'success');
            } catch (err) {
                console.error(err);
                showToast('Could not copy backup link.', 'error');
            }

            return;
        }

        if (action === 'import-lorebook') {
            recordExpClick(actionEl.dataset.expUid || '');

            if (window.LorebookManager && typeof LorebookManager.importFromExpansion === 'function') {
                LorebookManager.importFromExpansion(actionEl.dataset.expItem || '');
            }

            return;
        }

        if (action === 'copy-options') {
            openExpCopyOptions(actionEl.dataset.expUid || '', actionEl.dataset.expContent || '');
        }
    });
}

function expTextHtml(value) {
    return escapeExpHtml(value).replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
}


const EXP_NEW_BADGE_DAYS = 10; // New icon badge only.
const EXP_RECENT_FILTER_DAYS = 30; // Recent tab/filter span.

function parseExpDateOnly(dateText) {
    const match = String(dateText || '').trim().match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
    if (!match) return null;

    return new Date(Number(match[1]), Number(match[2]) - 1, Number(match[3]));
}

function getExpTodayDateString() {
    const now = new Date();
    const year = now.getFullYear();
    const month = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const day = String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');

    return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
}

function getExpDateAgeMs(dateText) {
    const valueDate = parseExpDateOnly(dateText);
    if (!valueDate) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;

    const now = new Date();
    const today = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());

    return today.getTime() - valueDate.getTime();
}

function isExpDateWithinDays(dateText, days) {
    const ageMs = getExpDateAgeMs(dateText);
    return ageMs >= -86400000 && ageMs <= days * 86400000;
}

function isExpItemNewBadge(item) {
    return isExpDateWithinDays(item?.date, EXP_NEW_BADGE_DAYS);
}

function isExpItemUpdatedBadge(item) {
    return isExpDateWithinDays(item?.update, EXP_NEW_BADGE_DAYS);
}

function isExpItemRecent(item) {
    return isExpDateWithinDays(item?.date, EXP_RECENT_FILTER_DAYS);
}

function isExpItemRecentlyUpdated(item) {
    return isExpDateWithinDays(item?.update, EXP_RECENT_FILTER_DAYS);
}

function isExpItemNew(item) {
    // Backward-compatible alias for the Recent tab/filter logic.
    return isExpItemRecent(item);
}

const EXP_META_LABEL_KEYS = new Set([
    'all',
    'popular',
    'random',
    'character',
    'lorebook',
    'preset',
    'wallpaper',
    'music',
    'nsfw',
    'new',
    'recent',
    'update',
    'updated'
]);

const EXP_HIDDEN_TAG_PREFIX = FURAI_HIDDEN_TAG_PREFIX;

function normalizeExpItemTags(rawTag) {
    return splitFuraiTagLabel(rawTag).map(tag => ({
        ...tag,
        isMeta: EXP_META_LABEL_KEYS.has(tag.key)
    }));
}

function getExpItemTagKeys(item) {
    const dateDrivenKeys = new Set(['new', 'recent', 'update', 'updated']);
    const keys = item && Array.isArray(item.tags)
        ? item.tags
            .flatMap(normalizeExpItemTags)
            .map(tag => tag.key)
            .filter(key => key && !dateDrivenKeys.has(key))
        : [];

    if (isExpItemRecent(item)) {
        keys.push('new');
    }

    if (isExpItemRecentlyUpdated(item)) {
        keys.push('update');
    }

    return keys;
}

function getExpSearchTagText(item) {
    const dateDrivenKeys = new Set(['new', 'recent', 'update', 'updated']);
    const visibleTags = item && Array.isArray(item.tags)
        ? item.tags
            .flatMap(normalizeExpItemTags)
            .filter(tag => tag.display && !dateDrivenKeys.has(tag.key) && (!tag.isHidden || isExpNsfw))
            .map(tag => tag.display)
        : [];

    if (isExpItemRecent(item)) visibleTags.push('Recent');
    if (isExpItemNewBadge(item)) visibleTags.push('New');
    if (isExpItemRecentlyUpdated(item)) visibleTags.push('Update', 'Updated');
    if (item?.type) visibleTags.push(item.type);

    if (item?.type === 'preset') {
        visibleTags.push(getExpPresetKind(item));
    }

    return visibleTags.join(' ');
}

function getExpVisibleLabelTags(item) {
    if (!item || !Array.isArray(item.tags)) return [];

    const seen = new Set();
    const labels = [];

    item.tags.flatMap(normalizeExpItemTags).forEach(tag => {
        if (!tag.display) return;
        if (tag.isMeta) return;
        if (tag.isHidden && !isExpNsfw) return;
        if (seen.has(tag.key)) return;

        seen.add(tag.key);
        labels.push(tag);
    });

    return labels;
}

function expSearchByLabel(label) {
    const cleanLabel = String(label || '').replace(/"/g, '').trim();
    if (!cleanLabel) return;

    const input = document.getElementById('expSearchInput');
    if (input) input.value = `"${cleanLabel}"`;

    activeExpTags.clear();

    renderExpansionTags();
    renderExpansionContent();

    const body = document.getElementById('expContentBody');
    if (body) body.scrollTop = 0;

    const profileCard = document.getElementById('profileCardModal');
    if (profileCard) profileCard.style.display = 'none';

    const storyModal = document.getElementById('expStoryModal');
    if (storyModal) storyModal.style.display = 'none';

    const lightbox = document.getElementById('imageLightboxEl');
    if (lightbox && lightbox.style.display !== 'none' && typeof closeLightbox === 'function') {
        closeLightbox();
    }
}

function createExpLabelPillsHTML(item, options = {}) {
    const labels = [];

    if (options.includePresetKind && item?.type === 'preset') {
        const kind = getExpPresetKind(item) === 'backup' ? 'backup' : 'chatlog';
        labels.push({
            display: kind,
            isHidden: false,
            isNeutral: true
        });
    }

    getExpVisibleLabelTags(item).forEach(tag => labels.push(tag));

    if (!labels.length) return '';

    const className = options.className ? ` ${String(options.className)}` : '';
    const dynamicRows = getFuraiDynamicTagRows(options);

    let visibleLabels = labels;
    let overflowLabels = [];

    if (!dynamicRows) {
        const visibleLimit = getFuraiTagChipLimit(options);
        visibleLabels = labels.slice(0, visibleLimit);
        overflowLabels = labels.slice(visibleLimit).map(label => ({
            display: label.display,
            isNeutral: !!label.isNeutral,
            prefixHash: false
        }));
    }

    const chips = visibleLabels.map(label => {
        const safeLabelHtml = escapeExpHtml(label.display);
        const safeTitle = escapeExpHtml(`Search exact label: ${label.display}`);
        const safeLabelAttr = escapeExpHtml(label.display);
        const safeLabelEncoded = encodeURIComponent(label.display).replace(/'/g, "%27");
        const entryPayload = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({
            display: label.display,
            isNeutral: !!label.isNeutral,
            prefixHash: false
        })).replace(/'/g, '%27');

        const classes = [
            'exp-label-pill',
            label.isNeutral ? 'is-neutral' : '',
            dynamicRows ? 'furai-tag-source' : ''
        ].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
        const sourceData = dynamicRows ? ` data-furai-tag-entry="${entryPayload}"` : '';

        return `<button type="button"
                        class="${classes}"
                        data-furai-ui-translate
                        title="${safeTitle}"
                        data-exp-action="search-label"
                        data-exp-label="${safeLabelAttr}"
                        ${sourceData}
                        onclick="event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); expSearchByLabel(decodeURIComponent('${safeLabelEncoded}'))">${safeLabelHtml}</button>`;
    });

    if (overflowLabels.length) {
        chips.push(createFuraiTagOverflowButtonHTML(overflowLabels, { searchKind: 'exp' }));
    }

    const dynamicAttrs = dynamicRows
        ? ` data-furai-dynamic-tags="1" data-furai-tag-rows="${dynamicRows}" data-furai-tag-search-kind="exp"`
        : '';

    return `
        <div class="exp-label-pills${className}"${dynamicAttrs}>
            ${chips.join('')}
        </div>
    `;
}

function getSafeExpCreatorLink(item) {
    const raw = String(item?.creatorLink || item?.creatorUrl || item?.creatorBio || '').trim();
    if (!raw) return '';

    try {
        const parsed = new URL(raw, window.location.href);
        if (parsed.protocol !== 'http:' && parsed.protocol !== 'https:') return '';
        return parsed.href;
    } catch (e) {
        return '';
    }
}

function createExpCreatorHTML(item) {
    const creator = String(item?.creator || '').trim();
    if (!creator) return '';

    const creatorHtml = expTextHtml(creator);
    const byHtml = '<span data-furai-ui-translate>by</span>';
    const creatorLink = getSafeExpCreatorLink(item);
    if (!creatorLink) {
        return `${byHtml} <span data-furai-no-translate>${creatorHtml}</span>`;
    }

    const safeHref = escapeExpHtml(creatorLink);
    return `${byHtml} <a class="exp-creator-link"
                  data-furai-ui-translate
                  href="${safeHref}"
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  title="Open creator profile"
                  onclick="event.stopPropagation()"><span data-furai-no-translate>${creatorHtml}</span><i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a>`;
}

/* --- 6. ITEM HTML GENERATOR (Bulletproof Version) --- */
function createExpItemHTML(item) {
    if (item.title === "Coming Soon...") return '';

    const titleHtml = expTextHtml(item.title);
    const creatorTxt = createExpCreatorHTML(item);
    const descHtml = expTextHtml(item.desc || item.previewText || "No description.");
    const imgAttr = escapeExpHtml(item.img);
    const uidAttr = escapeExpHtml(item.uid);
    const chatTitleAttr = escapeExpHtml(`Chat with ${item.title || ''}`);
    
    // 1. Object String: encodeURIComponent handles {}, [], and "". We force it to handle ' with %27.
    const safeItem = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(item)).replace(/'/g, "%27");
    
    // 2. Direct Strings: Run through our new bulletproof escaper
    const titleDataAttr = escapeExpHtml(item.title || '');
    const contentDataAttr = escapeExpHtml(item.content || '');
    const uidDataAttr = escapeExpHtml(item.uid || '');

    // One shared badge renderer keeps Character, Music, Lorebook, Preset,
    // Wallpaper, NSFW, New, and Update contrast behavior identical.
    const badgeHtml = createExpStatusBadgeHTML(item);

    // --- CHARACTER CARD ---
    if (item.type === 'character') {
        return `
            <div class="exp-card exp-character-click-card" data-exp-action="preview-char" data-exp-item="${safeItem}">
                <div class="exp-card-img-container">
                    <img src="${imgAttr}" class="exp-char-img" loading="lazy">
                </div>
                <div class="exp-card-content">
                    <div class="exp-row-top">
                        <div class="exp-title" data-furai-ui-translate>${badgeHtml}${titleHtml}</div>
                        <button class="exp-action-btn" data-furai-ui-translate title="${chatTitleAttr}" data-exp-action="import-char" data-exp-uid="${uidDataAttr}" data-exp-content="${contentDataAttr}" data-exp-title="${titleDataAttr}">
                            <i class="fa-regular fa-message"></i>
                            <span id="exp-count-${uidAttr}" style="font-size:12px; font-weight:600; opacity:0.9;">${getExpCountText(item.uid)}</span>
                        </button>
                    </div>
                    <div class="exp-creator">${creatorTxt}</div>
                    <div class="exp-desc" data-furai-ui-translate-long>${descHtml}</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
    }

    // --- MUSIC CARD ---
    if (item.type === 'music') {
        return `
            <div class="exp-card">
                <div class="exp-music-cover" data-exp-action="toggle-audio" data-exp-content="${contentDataAttr}">
                    <img src="${imgAttr}" style="width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; border-radius:6px;">
                    <div class="exp-play-overlay" style="border-radius:6px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-play"></i></div>
                </div>
                <div class="exp-card-content">
                    <div class="exp-row-top">
                        <div class="exp-title" data-furai-ui-translate>${badgeHtml}${titleHtml}</div>
                        <div class="exp-row-actions">
                            ${createExpCommentButtonHTML(item)}
                            <button class="exp-action-btn" data-furai-ui-translate title="Add to Playlist" data-exp-action="add-playlist" data-exp-uid="${uidDataAttr}" data-exp-title="${titleDataAttr}" data-exp-content="${contentDataAttr}">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-plus"></i>
                                <span id="exp-count-${uidAttr}" style="font-size:12px; font-weight:600; opacity:0.9;">${getExpCountText(item.uid)}</span>
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="exp-creator">${creatorTxt}</div>
                    <div class="exp-desc" data-furai-ui-translate-long>${descHtml}</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
    }
    
    // --- LOREBOOK / PRESETS ---
    if (item.type === 'lorebook' || item.type === 'preset') {
    
        const isPreset = item.type === 'preset';
        const isLorebook = item.type === 'lorebook';
        const presetKind = isPreset ? getExpPresetKind(item) : '';
    
        // Dynamic Label
        const btnTitle = isPreset
            ? (presetKind === 'backup' ? "Copy Backup Link" : "Import Chatlog")
            : (isLorebook ? "Add to Bookshelf" : "Copy Content / Link");
    
        let actionType = 'copy-options';
        let iconMarkup = '<i class="fa-regular fa-copy"></i>';
        
        if (isPreset) {
            if (presetKind === 'chatlog') {
                actionType = 'import-chatlog';
                iconMarkup = '<i class="fa-regular fa-comments"></i>';
            } else {
                actionType = 'copy-backup';
                iconMarkup = '<i class="fa-regular fa-floppy-disk"></i>';
            }
        } else if (isLorebook) {
            actionType = 'import-lorebook';
            iconMarkup = '<i class="fa-regular fa-bookmark"></i>';
        }
        
        return `
            <div class="exp-card exp-story-card" data-exp-action="preview-story" data-exp-item="${safeItem}">
                <img src="${imgAttr}" class="exp-story-bg-img" loading="lazy" decoding="async" alt="">
                
                <div class="exp-card-content exp-story-card-content">
                    <div class="exp-row-top">
                        <div class="exp-title" data-furai-ui-translate>${badgeHtml}${titleHtml}</div>
                        <div class="exp-row-actions">
                            <button class="exp-action-btn" data-furai-ui-translate title="${btnTitle}" data-exp-action="${actionType}" data-exp-item="${safeItem}" data-exp-uid="${uidDataAttr}" data-exp-content="${contentDataAttr}">
                                ${iconMarkup}
                                <span id="exp-count-${uidAttr}" style="font-size:12px; font-weight:600; opacity:0.9; margin-left:6px;">${getExpCountText(item.uid)}</span>
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="exp-creator">${creatorTxt}</div>
                    <div class="exp-desc" data-furai-ui-translate-long>${descHtml}</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
    }

    return '';
}

function isExpVideoUrl(url) {
    if (typeof isBackgroundVideoUrl === 'function') {
        return isBackgroundVideoUrl(url);
    }

    return /\.(mp4|webm|mov|m4v|ogv)(?:[?#].*)?$/i.test(String(url || '').trim());
}

function expMediaAttr(value) {
    if (typeof expAttr === 'function') return expAttr(value);

    return String(value || '')
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
}

function renderExpPreviewMedia(url, className, extraAttrs) {
    const cleanUrl = String(url || '').trim();
    const safeUrl = expMediaAttr(cleanUrl);
    const attrs = extraAttrs || '';

    if (isExpVideoUrl(cleanUrl)) {
        return `
            <video data-furai-media-src="${safeUrl}"
                   class="${className}"
                   muted
                   loop
                   playsinline
                   preload="metadata"
                   ${attrs}></video>
        `;
    }

    return `
        <img data-furai-media-src="${safeUrl}"
             class="${className}"
             width="220"
             height="220"
             loading="lazy"
             decoding="async"
             fetchpriority="low"
             ${attrs}>
    `;
}
      
/* --- 7. ACTION HANDLERS --- */
window.expWallpaperNav = null;
window.expWallpaperSwipeState = null;
let expWallpaperLightboxObserver = null;

function navigateExpWallpaperLightbox(direction) {
    const nav = window.expWallpaperNav;
    if (!nav) return;

    const targetUid = direction === 'prev' ? nav.prevUid : nav.nextUid;
    const targetSafe = direction === 'prev' ? nav.prevSafe : nav.nextSafe;

    if (!targetSafe) return;

    if (targetUid && typeof recordExpClick === 'function') {
        recordExpClick(targetUid);
    }

    previewWallpaperV2(targetSafe);
}

function shouldIgnoreExpWallpaperSwipe(target) {
    return !!(
        target &&
        target.closest &&
        target.closest('.exp-lightbox-desc, .exp-lightbox-btn, button, a, input, textarea, select')
    );
}

function bindExpWallpaperSwipe(lightbox) {
    if (!lightbox || lightbox.dataset.expSwipeBound === 'true') return;

    lightbox.dataset.expSwipeBound = 'true';
    lightbox.classList.add('exp-wallpaper-swipe-active');

    lightbox.addEventListener('touchstart', handleExpWallpaperTouchStart, { passive: true });
    lightbox.addEventListener('touchmove', handleExpWallpaperTouchMove, { passive: true });
    lightbox.addEventListener('touchend', handleExpWallpaperTouchEnd, { passive: true });
    lightbox.addEventListener('touchcancel', resetExpWallpaperSwipe, { passive: true });
}

function unbindExpWallpaperSwipe() {
    const lightbox = document.getElementById('imageLightboxEl');
    if (!lightbox || lightbox.dataset.expSwipeBound !== 'true') return;

    lightbox.removeEventListener('touchstart', handleExpWallpaperTouchStart);
    lightbox.removeEventListener('touchmove', handleExpWallpaperTouchMove);
    lightbox.removeEventListener('touchend', handleExpWallpaperTouchEnd);
    lightbox.removeEventListener('touchcancel', resetExpWallpaperSwipe);

    delete lightbox.dataset.expSwipeBound;
    lightbox.classList.remove('exp-wallpaper-swipe-active');

    resetExpWallpaperSwipe();
}

function resetExpWallpaperSwipe() {
    window.expWallpaperSwipeState = null;
}

function handleExpWallpaperTouchStart(e) {
    const lightbox = document.getElementById('imageLightboxEl');

    if (!lightbox || lightbox.style.display !== 'flex' || !window.expWallpaperNav) {
        resetExpWallpaperSwipe();
        return;
    }

    if (
        e.touches.length !== 1 ||
        shouldIgnoreExpWallpaperSwipe(e.target) ||
        (typeof isZoomed !== 'undefined' && isZoomed)
    ) {
        resetExpWallpaperSwipe();
        return;
    }

    const touch = e.touches[0];

    window.expWallpaperSwipeState = {
        startX: touch.clientX,
        startY: touch.clientY,
        lastX: touch.clientX,
        lastY: touch.clientY
    };
}

function handleExpWallpaperTouchMove(e) {
    const state = window.expWallpaperSwipeState;
    if (!state || e.touches.length !== 1) return;

    const touch = e.touches[0];

    state.lastX = touch.clientX;
    state.lastY = touch.clientY;
}

function handleExpWallpaperTouchEnd() {
    const state = window.expWallpaperSwipeState;
    if (!state) return;

    const deltaX = state.lastX - state.startX;
    const deltaY = state.lastY - state.startY;
    const absX = Math.abs(deltaX);
    const absY = Math.abs(deltaY);

    resetExpWallpaperSwipe();

    if (absX < 52 || absX <= absY * 1.25) return;

    if (deltaX < 0) {
        navigateExpWallpaperLightbox('next');
    } else {
        navigateExpWallpaperLightbox('prev');
    }
}

function handleWallpaperLightboxKeydown(e) {
    const lightbox = document.getElementById('imageLightboxEl');
    if (!lightbox || lightbox.style.display !== 'flex' || !window.expWallpaperNav) return;

    const activeTag = document.activeElement ? document.activeElement.tagName : '';
    if (['INPUT', 'TEXTAREA'].includes(activeTag)) return;

    // Wallpaper zoom is safe because swipe/arrow navigation pauses while zoomed.
    if (typeof isZoomed !== 'undefined' && isZoomed) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            resetLightboxZoom();
        }
        return;
    }

    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        navigateExpWallpaperLightbox('prev');
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        navigateExpWallpaperLightbox('next');
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape' && typeof closeLightbox === 'function') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        closeLightbox();
    }
}

// A. Preview & Import (Characters)
function previewExpChar(encodedItem) {
    const item = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(encodedItem));
    const labelPillsHtml = createExpLabelPillsHTML(item, {
        className: 'exp-label-pills-id-card'
    });
    const commentHtml = isDesktopExpCharacterCommentLayout()
        ? createExpCommentButtonHTML(item, 'exp-id-card-comment-btn')
        : '';

    openProfileCard(
        item.title,
        item.img,
        item.previewText || item.desc,
        "",
        null,
        labelPillsHtml + commentHtml,
        {
            source: 'exp-character',
            expCommentItem: item
        }
    );
}

let furaiDirectExpansionImportInFlight = false;

async function importExpansionChar(url, name) {
    const directSelectionRoute =
        document.body.classList.contains('exp-opened-from-character-import') &&
        !!getActiveLocalCharacterSelectionTarget();

    if (directSelectionRoute) {
        if (furaiDirectExpansionImportInFlight) return;
        furaiDirectExpansionImportInFlight = true;
        const localSelectionParentToRefresh = getActiveLocalCharacterSelectionTarget();

        try {
            const loadedSource = await fetchFuraiCharacterImportSource(url);
            const charData = normalizeImportData(loadedSource.rawData);

            if (
                (loadedSource.importedViewMode === 'vn' || loadedSource.importedViewMode === 'chat') &&
                !charData.viewMode
            ) {
                charData.viewMode = loadedSource.importedViewMode;
            }

            if (!applyImportedCharacterToActiveSelection(charData)) return;

            const importModal = document.getElementById('charImportModalEl');
            if (importModal) {
                if (typeof closeModalLayer === 'function') closeModalLayer(importModal);
                else importModal.style.display = 'none';
            }

            if (typeof closeProfileCard === 'function') closeProfileCard();
            if (typeof closeExpProfilePreviewModal === 'function') closeExpProfilePreviewModal();
            if (typeof closeExpansionModal === 'function') closeExpansionModal();
            closeCharactersModal();
            refreshOpenFuraiLocalProfileEditor(localSelectionParentToRefresh);
        } catch (error) {
            console.error(error);
            showToast(`Could not import ${name || 'this character'}.`, 'error');
        } finally {
            furaiDirectExpansionImportInFlight = false;
        }
        return;
    }

    if (typeof openCharacterImportModal !== 'function') return;

    const fromCastExpansion = document.body.classList.contains('exp-opened-from-cast');

    if (fromCastExpansion && typeof openManageLocalImportModal === 'function') {
        openManageLocalImportModal({ hideExpansionButton: true });
    } else {
        openCharacterImportModal({ hideExpansionButton: true });
    }

    const furaiTab = document.querySelector('#charImportModalEl [data-char-import-mode="furai"]');
    if (furaiTab) furaiTab.click();

    const input = document.getElementById('charImportFuraiLink');
    if (input) {
        input.value = url;
        showToast('Source link loaded! Select import target.', 'success');
    }

    if (typeof closeProfileCard === 'function') closeProfileCard();
    if (typeof closeExpProfilePreviewModal === 'function') closeExpProfilePreviewModal();
}

async function importExpansionChatlogPreset(url, uid) {
    if (!url) {
        showToast("Missing chatlog link.", "error");
        return;
    }

    try {
        let fetchUrl = url;

        try {
            const parsedUrl = new URL(url, window.location.href);
            const chatValue =
                parsedUrl.searchParams.get('chat') ||
                parsedUrl.searchParams.get('chat_share');

            if (chatValue) {
                fetchUrl = resolveFuraiUploadFileUrl(chatValue);
            }
        } catch (e) {}

        if (String(url).includes("data=")) {
            const cMatch = String(url).match(/data=([^~]+)~([^&]+)/);
            if (cMatch) fetchUrl = `https://user.uploads.dev/file/${cMatch[2]}`;
        }

        if (fetchUrl === url) {
            fetchUrl = resolveFuraiUploadFileUrl(url);
        }

        const fetcher = window.root?.superFetch ? window.root.superFetch : fetch;
        const res = await fetcher(fetchUrl);
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Could not fetch chatlog preset.");

        const json = await parseFuraiSharedJsonResponse(res);
        if (!json.chat || !json.chat.id) throw new Error("Invalid chatlog preset.");

        const newChatId = 'chat-' + Date.now();
        const newChatData = json.chat;
        const sourceChatId = String(newChatData.id || '');

        newChatData.id = newChatId;
        remapFuraiDeepMemoryAuthorityForNewChat(newChatData, sourceChatId, newChatId);
        newChatData.timestamp = Date.now();

        if (!String(newChatData.title || '').endsWith("(Imported)")) {
            newChatData.title = `${newChatData.title || "Imported Chat"} (Imported)`;
        }

        if (typeof resolveSharedOrInheritedViewMode === 'function') {
            newChatData.viewMode = resolveSharedOrInheritedViewMode(newChatData.viewMode, url);
        }

        if (typeof normalizeChatMessageStorage === 'function') {
            normalizeChatMessageStorage(newChatData);
        }

        DB.set(newChatId, newChatData);
        if (json.profile) DB.set(`profile-${newChatId}`, json.profile);

        if (newChatData.background) addToBackgroundHistory(newChatData.background);

        recordExpClick(uid);
        loadChat(newChatId);

        showToast("Chatlog imported!", "success");
    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        showToast("Import failed: " + e.message, "error");
    }
}

// B. Wallpaper Lightbox (Updated Layout)
function previewWallpaperV2(safeObj) {
    const item = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(safeObj));
    const safeObjInline = String(safeObj).replace(/'/g, "%27");
    const lightbox = document.getElementById('imageLightboxEl');
    const imgEl = document.getElementById('lightboxImg');
    
    if (lightbox && imgEl) {
        openLightbox(item.img);

        let overlay = document.getElementById('expWpOverlay');
        if (!overlay) {
            overlay = document.createElement('div');
            overlay.id = 'expWpOverlay';
            overlay.className = 'exp-lightbox-overlay';
            lightbox.appendChild(overlay);
        }

        // --- NAVIGATION LOGIC (Fixed Positioning + Keyboard Support) ---
        let navHtml = '';
        window.expWallpaperNav = null;

        if (window.currentWallpaperList && window.currentWallpaperList.length > 1) {
            const currentIndex = window.currentWallpaperList.findIndex(w => w.uid === item.uid);
            if (currentIndex > -1) {
                const prevItem = window.currentWallpaperList[(currentIndex - 1 + window.currentWallpaperList.length) % window.currentWallpaperList.length];
                const nextItem = window.currentWallpaperList[(currentIndex + 1) % window.currentWallpaperList.length];
                const safePrev = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(prevItem)).replace(/'/g, "%27");
                const safeNext = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(nextItem)).replace(/'/g, "%27");

                window.expWallpaperNav = {
                    prevUid: prevItem.uid,
                    nextUid: nextItem.uid,
                    prevSafe: safePrev,
                    nextSafe: safeNext
                };

                document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleWallpaperLightboxKeydown);
                document.addEventListener('keydown', handleWallpaperLightboxKeydown);
                bindExpWallpaperSwipe(lightbox);

                navHtml = `
                    <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); navigateExpWallpaperLightbox('prev')" style="left:20px; top:50%; position: fixed; transform:translateY(-50%); background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5); color:white; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:50%; cursor:pointer; font-size:18px; z-index:3020; pointer-events:auto; transition:background 0.2s;" onmouseover="this.style.background='var(--primary-color)'" onmouseout="this.style.background='rgba(0,0,0,0.5)'"><i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-left"></i></button>
                    <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); navigateExpWallpaperLightbox('next')" style="right:20px; top:50%; position: fixed; transform:translateY(-50%); background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5); color:white; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:50%; cursor:pointer; font-size:18px; z-index:3020; pointer-events:auto; transition:background 0.2s;" onmouseover="this.style.background='var(--primary-color)'" onmouseout="this.style.background='rgba(0,0,0,0.5)'"><i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-right"></i></button>
                `;
            }
        } else {
            document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleWallpaperLightboxKeydown);
            unbindExpWallpaperSwipe();
        }

        // New Layout: Header Row (Title + Button) -> Meta -> Desc
        const titleHtml = expTextHtml(item.title);
        const creatorHtml = createExpCreatorHTML(item);
        const labelPillsHtml = createExpLabelPillsHTML(item, { className: 'exp-label-pills-lightbox' });
        const descHtml = expTextHtml(item.description || item.desc || '');
        const commentBtnHtml = createExpCommentButtonHTML(item, 'exp-lightbox-btn exp-lightbox-comment-btn');
        
        overlay.innerHTML = `
            ${navHtml}
            <div class="exp-lightbox-header">
                <div class="exp-lightbox-title" data-furai-ui-translate>${titleHtml}</div>
                <div class="exp-lightbox-actions">
                    ${commentBtnHtml}
                    <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); archiveExpansionWallpaper('${safeObjInline}')" 
                            class="exp-lightbox-btn" data-furai-ui-translate title="Archive / Use">
                        <i class="fa-regular fa-bookmark"></i>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div class="exp-lightbox-meta">${creatorHtml}</div>
            ${labelPillsHtml}
            <div class="exp-lightbox-desc" data-furai-ui-translate-long>${descHtml}</div>
        `;
        overlay.style.display = 'flex';

        if (furaiUiLanguage.language !== 'en') {
            scheduleFuraiUiScan(overlay);
        }

        if (expWallpaperLightboxObserver) {
            expWallpaperLightboxObserver.disconnect();
        }

        const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
            if (lightbox.style.display !== 'none') return;

            overlay.style.display = 'none';
            observer.disconnect();
            if (expWallpaperLightboxObserver === observer) {
                expWallpaperLightboxObserver = null;
            }
        });
        expWallpaperLightboxObserver = observer;
        observer.observe(lightbox, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style'] });
    }
}

// C. Music Actions
function toggleExpansionAudio(url, coverEl) {
    const icon = coverEl.querySelector('i');
    
    if (expAudioPreview && expAudioPreview.src === url && !expAudioPreview.paused) {
        expAudioPreview.pause();
        icon.className = "fa-solid fa-play";
        return;
    }

    if (expAudioPreview) {
        expAudioPreview.pause();
        document.querySelectorAll('.exp-play-overlay i').forEach(i => i.className = "fa-solid fa-play");
    }

    expAudioPreview = new Audio(url);
    expAudioPreview.volume = 0.5;
    expAudioPreview.play();
    icon.className = "fa-solid fa-stop";

    expAudioPreview.onended = () => {
        icon.className = "fa-solid fa-play";
    };
}

function addExpToPlaylist(title, url) {
    // 1. Force load existing data first. 
    // Without this, the system sees an empty [] list and overwrites your old songs.
    if (typeof loadPlaylist === 'function') {
        loadPlaylist();
    }

    if (typeof currentPlaylist !== 'undefined') {
        // Prevent duplicates
        const exists = currentPlaylist.some(track => track.url === url);
        if (exists) {
            showToast("Song already in playlist.", "info");
            return;
        }

        currentPlaylist.push({ name: title, url: url });
        savePlaylist();
        showToast(`"${title}" added to playlist!`, "success");
        
        // Refresh UI if open
        if(typeof renderPlaylist === 'function') renderPlaylist();
    }
}

/* --- NEW: Story Card Logic (Lorebooks & Presets) --- */
async function previewExpStory(encodedItem) {
    const item = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(encodedItem));
    const safeItem = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(item)).replace(/'/g, "%27");
    const modal = document.getElementById('expStoryModal');
    
    // 1. Populate Banner Header
    const banner = document.getElementById('expStoryBanner');
    banner.style.backgroundImage = `url('${item.img}')`;
    document.getElementById('expStoryTitle').textContent = item.title;
    document.getElementById('expStoryCreator').innerHTML = createExpCreatorHTML(item);
    
    const presetKindEl = document.getElementById('expStoryPresetKind');
    const storyLabelPillsHtml = createExpLabelPillsHTML(item, { className: 'exp-label-pills-preview' });

    // Preset/Lorebook comments belong inside this preview.
    // Their comment modal opens as a child layer above the preview and leaves it mounted underneath.
    const storyCommentBtn = document.getElementById('expStoryCommentBtn');

    if (storyCommentBtn) {
        if (expCommentsAllowed(item)) {
            storyCommentBtn.style.display = 'inline-flex';
            storyCommentBtn.onclick = (event) => {
                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopPropagation();
                openExpComments(safeItem);
            };
        } else {
            storyCommentBtn.style.display = 'none';
            storyCommentBtn.onclick = null;
        }
    }
    
    if (presetKindEl) {
        if (item.type === 'preset') {
            const kind = getExpPresetKind(item) === 'backup' ? 'backup' : 'chatlog';
            const label = kind === 'backup' ? 'Backup Data' : 'Chatlog';
            const icon = kind === 'backup'
                ? '<i class="fa-regular fa-floppy-disk"></i>'
                : '<i class="fa-regular fa-comments"></i>';
    
            presetKindEl.className = `exp-preset-kind ${kind}`;
            presetKindEl.style.display = 'inline-flex';
            presetKindEl.style.alignItems = 'center';
            presetKindEl.style.gap = '6px';
            presetKindEl.innerHTML = `${icon}<span>${label}</span>`;
        } else {
            presetKindEl.className = '';
            presetKindEl.removeAttribute('style');
            presetKindEl.style.display = 'none';
            presetKindEl.innerHTML = '';
        }
    }

    // 2. Populate Preview Text (With Read More logic)
    const previewEl = document.getElementById('expStoryPreview');
    const readMoreBtn = document.getElementById('expStoryReadMore');

    let storyLabelEl = document.getElementById('expStoryLabelPills');
    if (!storyLabelEl) {
        storyLabelEl = document.createElement('div');
        storyLabelEl.id = 'expStoryLabelPills';
    }
    
    const storyHeaderEl = document.getElementById('expStoryCreator')?.parentNode;
    if (storyHeaderEl && storyLabelEl.parentNode !== storyHeaderEl) {
        storyHeaderEl.appendChild(storyLabelEl);
    }
    
    storyLabelEl.innerHTML = storyLabelPillsHtml;
    storyLabelEl.style.display = storyLabelPillsHtml ? 'block' : 'none';
    
    previewEl.textContent = item.previewText || item.desc || "";

    if (furaiUiLanguage.language !== 'en') {
        scheduleFuraiUiScan(modal);
    }
    
    // --- FIX: NO CLAMPING FOR PRESETS ---
    if (item.type === 'preset') {
        previewEl.style.display = 'block'; // Fully expand text immediately
        readMoreBtn.style.display = 'none'; // Cancel the button
    } else {
        previewEl.style.display = '-webkit-box'; // Reset to clamped mode for lorebooks
        readMoreBtn.style.display = 'none';      // Hide button initially
    }
    
    // Show modal briefly to calculate heights
    modal.style.display = 'flex';
    
    setTimeout(() => {
        // Only run the overflow check if it's NOT a preset
        if (item.type !== 'preset' && previewEl.scrollHeight > previewEl.clientHeight) {
            readMoreBtn.style.display = 'block';
            readMoreBtn.onclick = () => {
                if (previewEl.style.display === '-webkit-box') {
                    previewEl.style.display = 'block'; // Expand
                    readMoreBtn.innerHTML = '[ Show Less ]';
                } else {
                    previewEl.style.display = '-webkit-box'; // Collapse
                    readMoreBtn.innerHTML = '[ Read More ]';
                }
            };
        }
    }, 50);

    // 3. Handle True Content Area (Fetching logic)
    const contentBox = document.getElementById('expStoryContentText');
    const loading = document.getElementById('expStoryContentLoading');
    const contentHeader = document.querySelector('#expStoryModal h4'); // Target the "Content" header
