    const hiddenBlock = document.getElementById('expStoryHiddenLoreBlock');
    const hiddenBox = document.getElementById('expStoryHiddenLoreInstructions');

    const applyLorePreviewText = (rawText) => {
        const lore = splitFuraiLoreInstructions(rawText);
        contentBox.value = lore.publicText;
        contentBox.style.display = 'block';

        if (hiddenBlock && hiddenBox) {
            hiddenBox.value = lore.hiddenText;
            hiddenBlock.style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    if (hiddenBlock) hiddenBlock.style.display = 'block';
    if (hiddenBox) hiddenBox.value = '';
    
    // --- FIX: ABORT FETCH & HIDE UI FOR PRESETS ---
    if (item.type === 'preset') {
        if (hiddenBlock) hiddenBlock.style.display = 'none';
        if (contentHeader) contentHeader.style.display = 'none';
        contentBox.style.display = 'none';
        loading.style.display = 'none';
        return; // Stop execution here! No downloading massive JSONs.
    }

    // For Lorebooks, ensure the header is visible (in case a preset hid it previously)
    if (contentHeader) contentHeader.style.display = 'block';

    contentBox.style.display = 'none';
    contentBox.value = '';
    loading.style.display = 'none';

    const contentStr = item.content || "";
    
    // Preview legacy text/JSON and new gzip artifacts without blocking the gallery render.
    if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(contentStr)) {
        loading.style.display = 'block';
        try {
            const fetcher = window.root?.superFetch ? window.root.superFetch : fetch;
            const res = await fetcher(resolveFuraiUploadFileUrl(contentStr));

            if (res.ok) {
                const artifact = await readFuraiLibraryArtifactResponse(res, {
                    type: item.type === 'glossary' ? 'glossary' : 'lorebook',
                    title: item.title,
                    cover: item.img
                });
                applyLorePreviewText(artifact.content);
            } else {
                applyLorePreviewText("Failed to load content from URL: \n" + contentStr);
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.warn('Expansion lore preview failed:', error);
            applyLorePreviewText("Error fetching data.");
        } finally {
            loading.style.display = 'none';
        }
    } else {
        applyLorePreviewText(contentStr);
    }
}

// --- EXPANSION CLICK COUNTER SYSTEM ---
const EXP_COUNTER_API = "https://furai-counter.nccufcc.workers.dev";
let expClickCounts = {}; // Stores { "char_16": 45, "bg_2": 1205 }
let expCountsLoaded = false;
let expCountsFetchPromise = null;
let expCountsRefreshTimer = null;
let expCountsFetchToken = 0;

function formatClickCount(num) {
    if (!num) return "0";
    if (num >= 1000000) return (num / 1000000).toFixed(1) + 'M';
    if (num >= 1000) return (num / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'k';
    return num.toString();
}

function getExpCountText(uid) {
    if (!expCountsLoaded) return "…";

    const uidStr = String(uid || '');
    return formatClickCount(expClickCounts[uidStr] || expClickCounts[uid] || 0);
}

function updateExpVisibleCountLabels() {
    const body = document.getElementById('expContentBody');
    if (!body) return;

    body.querySelectorAll('[id^="exp-count-"]').forEach(el => {
        const uid = el.id.slice('exp-count-'.length);
        el.textContent = getExpCountText(uid);
    });
}

async function refreshExpClickCounts(shouldRender = true) {
    if (expCountsFetchPromise) return expCountsFetchPromise;

    const fetchToken = ++expCountsFetchToken;

    expCountsFetchPromise = (async () => {
        try {
            const fetcher = window.root?.superFetch ? window.root.superFetch : fetch;
            const res = await fetcher(`${EXP_COUNTER_API}/counts`);

            if (fetchToken !== expCountsFetchToken) return;

            if (res.ok) {
                const counts = await res.json();

                if (fetchToken !== expCountsFetchToken) return;

                expClickCounts = counts || {};
                expCountsLoaded = true;

                if (shouldRender && document.getElementById('expansionModalEl')?.style.display === 'flex') {
                    if (expSortMode === 'popular' || expSortMode === 'trending') {
                        renderExpansionContent();
                    } else {
                        updateExpVisibleCountLabels();
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch(e) {
            console.warn("Failed to load counts, keeping counters in syncing state.");
        } finally {
            if (fetchToken === expCountsFetchToken) expCountsFetchPromise = null;
        }
    })();

    return expCountsFetchPromise;
}

function hardUnloadExpansionCountData() {
    expCountsFetchToken++;
    clearTimeout(expCountsRefreshTimer);
    expCountsRefreshTimer = null;
    expCountsFetchPromise = null;
    expClickCounts = {};
    expCountsLoaded = false;
}

function scheduleExpCountsRefresh() {
    clearTimeout(expCountsRefreshTimer);
    expCountsRefreshTimer = setTimeout(() => refreshExpClickCounts(true), 700);
}

function recordExpClick(uid, options = {}) {
    if (!uid) return Promise.resolve(false);

    const uidStr = uid.toString();
    const force = options.force === true;
    const refresh = options.refresh !== false;

    let clickedItems = [];

    try {
        const saved = localStorage.getItem('furai_exp_clicks');
        if (saved) clickedItems = JSON.parse(saved);
        if (!Array.isArray(clickedItems)) clickedItems = [];
    } catch(e) {
        clickedItems = [];
    }

    const alreadyClicked = clickedItems.includes(uidStr);

    if (!force && alreadyClicked) {
        return Promise.resolve(false);
    }

    if (!alreadyClicked) {
        clickedItems.push(uidStr);
        if (clickedItems.length > 1000) clickedItems.shift();
        localStorage.setItem('furai_exp_clicks', JSON.stringify(clickedItems));
    }

    const countDisplay = document.getElementById(`exp-count-${uidStr}`);

    if (expCountsLoaded) {
        expClickCounts[uidStr] = (expClickCounts[uidStr] || 0) + 1;

        if (countDisplay) {
            countDisplay.textContent = formatClickCount(expClickCounts[uidStr]);
            countDisplay.style.display = "inline-block";
            countDisplay.style.transform = "scale(1.2)";
            countDisplay.style.transition = "transform 0.2s";
            setTimeout(() => countDisplay.style.transform = "scale(1)", 200);
        }
    } else if (countDisplay) {
        countDisplay.textContent = "…";
        countDisplay.style.display = "inline-block";
    }

    const fetcher = window.root?.superFetch ? window.root.superFetch : fetch;

    return fetcher(`${EXP_COUNTER_API}/click`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ uid: uidStr })
    })
    .then(res => {
        if (res && res.ok === false) throw new Error("Counter request failed.");
        return true;
    })
    .catch(e => {
        console.error("Counter update failed", e);
        return false;
    })
    .finally(() => {
        if (refresh) scheduleExpCountsRefresh();
    });
}

async function recordExpBulkClicks(successItems) {
    const uids = [...new Set(
        successItems
            .map(item => item?.uid)
            .filter(Boolean)
            .map(uid => uid.toString())
    )];

    if (!uids.length) return 0;

    let recorded = 0;

    for (const uid of uids) {
        const ok = await recordExpClick(uid, {
            force: true,
            refresh: false
        });

        if (ok) recorded++;
    }

    scheduleExpCountsRefresh();
    return recorded;
}

function getExpVisibleSectionItems(sectionType) {
    const sections = window.expCurrentVisibleSections || {};
    const items = sections[sectionType] || [];
    return Array.isArray(items) ? items.filter(Boolean) : [];
}

function getExpPresetKind(item) {
    if (!item) return 'unknown';

    const explicit = String(item.presetKind || item.presetType || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    if (explicit === 'chatlog' || explicit === 'backup') return explicit;

    const content = String(item.content || '').toLowerCase();

    if (/(^|[?&])backup(?:_share)?=/.test(content)) return 'backup';
    if (/(^|[?&])chat(?:_share)?=/.test(content)) return 'chatlog';

    const text = [
        item.title || '',
        item.desc || '',
        item.previewText || '',
        Array.isArray(item.tags) ? item.tags.join(' ') : ''
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

    if (
        text.includes('backup') ||
        text.includes('full system restore') ||
        text.includes('wipe your current chat history') ||
        text.includes('restore from')
    ) {
        return 'backup';
    }

    return 'chatlog';
}

function isExpChatlogPreset(item) {
    return getExpPresetKind(item) === 'chatlog';
}

function getExpCharacterFetchUrl(item) {
    const raw = String(item?.content || '').trim();
    if (!raw) return '';

    try {
        return resolveFuraiCharacterImportUrl(raw);
    } catch (e) {
        return raw;
    }
}

function getExpChatPresetFetchUrl(item) {
    const raw = String(item?.content || '').trim();
    if (!raw) return '';

    try {
        return resolveFuraiUploadFileUrl(raw);
    } catch (e) {
        return raw;
    }
}

const FuraiExpInstallFlow = (() => {
    let paused = false;
    let resume = null;
    let stack = null;
    let controlToast = null;
    let statusToast = null;
    let label = '';
    let total = 0;
    const sleep = ms => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

    function ensureUi() {
        if (controlToast?.isConnected && statusToast?.isConnected) {
            return { controlToast, statusToast };
        }

        let container = document.getElementById('toast-container');
        if (!container) {
            container = document.createElement('div');
            container.id = 'toast-container';
            document.body.appendChild(container);
        }

        stack = container.querySelector('[data-furai-exp-install-stack="1"]');
        if (!stack) {
            stack = document.createElement('div');
            stack.className = 'toast-stack furai-exp-install-stack';
            stack.dataset.furaiExpInstallStack = '1';
            container.appendChild(stack);
        }

        controlToast = document.createElement('div');
        controlToast.className = 'toast info furai-exp-install-control-toast show';
        controlToast.innerHTML = `
            <span class="furai-exp-install-spinner">
                <span class="furai-mini-spinner"></span>
                <button type="button" title="Pause"><span class="material-symbols-outlined">pause</span></button>
            </span>
        `;

        statusToast = document.createElement('div');
        statusToast.className = 'toast info furai-exp-install-status-toast show';
        statusToast.innerHTML = '<span class="furai-exp-install-text"></span>';

        controlToast.querySelector('button').onclick = () => setPaused(!paused);
        stack.append(controlToast, statusToast);

        return { controlToast, statusToast };
    }

    function setText(value) {
        const ui = ensureUi();
        const textEl = ui.statusToast.querySelector('.furai-exp-install-text');
        ui.statusToast.dataset.baseText = String(value || '');

        if (textEl) {
            textEl.textContent = paused
                ? `${ui.statusToast.dataset.baseText} · Paused`
                : ui.statusToast.dataset.baseText;
        }
    }

    function setPaused(value) {
        paused = !!value;
        if (!controlToast || !statusToast) return;

        controlToast.classList.toggle('is-paused', paused);

        const button = controlToast.querySelector('button');
        const icon = button?.querySelector('.material-symbols-outlined');

        if (button) button.title = paused ? 'Resume' : 'Pause';
        if (icon) icon.textContent = paused ? 'play_arrow' : 'pause';

        setText(statusToast.dataset.baseText || '');

        if (!paused && resume) {
            const resolve = resume;
            resume = null;
            resolve();
        }
    }

    async function waitIfPaused() {
        if (paused) {
            await new Promise(resolve => {
                resume = resolve;
            });
        }
    }

    function start(sectionType, count) {
        label = ({
            character: 'Character',
            lorebook: 'Lorebook',
            preset: 'Preset',
            wallpaper: 'Wallpaper',
            music: 'Music'
        })[sectionType] || 'Item';

        total = count;
        paused = false;
        setText(`Preparing ${total} ${label}${total === 1 ? '' : 's'}…`);
    }

    async function before(item, index) {
        await waitIfPaused();
        setText(`Installing ${label}: ${item?.title || 'Untitled'} · ${index + 1}/${total}`);
    }

    async function after(message) {
        setText(message);
        await sleep(520);
    }

    async function finish(message, failed = false) {
        await waitIfPaused();

        const ui = ensureUi();
        const spinner = ui.controlToast.querySelector('.furai-exp-install-spinner');

        ui.controlToast.classList.toggle('error', failed);
        ui.controlToast.classList.toggle('success', !failed);
        ui.statusToast.classList.toggle('error', failed);
        ui.statusToast.classList.toggle('success', !failed);

        if (spinner) {
            spinner.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid ${failed ? 'fa-circle-exclamation' : 'fa-check'}"></i>`;
        }

        setText(message);
        await sleep(1300);

        const container = stack?.parentElement;
        stack?.remove();

        if (container && !container.children.length) {
            container.remove();
        }

        stack = null;
        controlToast = null;
        statusToast = null;
        paused = false;
        resume = null;
        label = '';
        total = 0;
    }

    return {
        start,
        before,
        after,
        finish,
        get active() {
            return !!(controlToast || statusToast);
        }
    };
})();

window.FuraiExpInstallFlow = FuraiExpInstallFlow;

function setExpBulkButtonBusy(sectionType, isBusy) {
    const btn = document.querySelector(`[data-exp-bulk="${sectionType}"]`);
    if (!btn) return;

    if (!btn.dataset.expIdleTitle) {
        btn.dataset.expIdleTitle = btn.title || 'Import visible items';
    }

    btn.disabled = !!isBusy;
    btn.setAttribute('aria-busy', isBusy ? 'true' : 'false');
    btn.title = isBusy ? 'Importing visible items...' : btn.dataset.expIdleTitle;

    btn.innerHTML = isBusy
        ? `<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i>`
        : `<i class="fa-solid fa-download"></i>`;
}

async function expBulkDownloadVisible(sectionType) {
    const items = getExpVisibleSectionItems(sectionType);

    if (!items.length) {
        showToast("No visible items in this section.", "info");
        return;
    }

    if (FuraiExpInstallFlow.active) {
        showToast("An Expansion install is already running.", "info");
        return;
    }

    setExpBulkButtonBusy(sectionType, true);
    FuraiExpInstallFlow.start(sectionType, items.length);

    try {
        const handlers = {
            character: expBulkImportCharacters,
            lorebook: expBulkImportLorebooks,
            preset: expBulkImportPresets,
            wallpaper: expBulkImportWallpapers,
            music: expBulkImportMusic
        };

        const handler = handlers[sectionType];
        if (!handler) throw new Error("Unknown section type.");
        await handler(items);
    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        await FuraiExpInstallFlow.finish("Bulk import failed: " + e.message, true);
    } finally {
        setExpBulkButtonBusy(sectionType, false);
    }
}

window.expBulkDownloadVisible = expBulkDownloadVisible;

window.expBulkDownloadVisible = expBulkDownloadVisible;
window.setExpBulkButtonBusy = setExpBulkButtonBusy;

function expMakeBulkResult(items) {
    return {
        total: Array.isArray(items) ? items.length : 0,
        added: 0,
        skipped: 0,
        successItems: []
    };
}

function expMarkBulkAdded(result, item) {
    result.added++;
    result.successItems.push(item);
}

function expMarkBulkSkipped(result) {
    result.skipped++;
}

async function expFinishBulkImport(result, word) {
    await recordExpBulkClicks(result.successItems);

    const message = `${word || "Added"} ${result.added}. Skipped: ${result.skipped}.`;

    if (FuraiExpInstallFlow.active) {
        await FuraiExpInstallFlow.finish(message, result.added === 0);
    } else {
        showToast(message, result.added ? "success" : "error");
    }
}

function expCleanUrl(url) {
    return String(url || '').trim();
}


const FURAI_FACTORY_EXP_CHARACTER_MAP = Object.freeze({
    char_1: 'wand', char_2: 'sys_lora_010', char_3: 'sys_charles_009', char_4: 'sys_perlow_008',
    char_5: 'sys_maqaw_007', char_6: 'sys_oakteeth_006', char_7: 'sys_sluggy_005', char_8: 'sys_zora_004',
    char_9: 'sys_kodbu_003', char_10: 'sys_furberry_002', char_11: 'sys_furai_001',
    char_12: 'sys_furai_prompter', char_13: 'sys_furai_researcher', char_17: 'sys_furai_maker', char_26: 'sys_furai_story'
});

const FURAI_FACTORY_EXP_LOREBOOK_MAP = Object.freeze({
    lore_1: 'lb_def_group', lore_2: 'lb_def_prompter', lore_3: 'lb_def_researcher',
    lore_4: 'lb_def_maker', lore_14: 'lb_def_story'
});

function expGetFactoryCharacterCandidate(item) {
    const localUid = FURAI_FACTORY_EXP_CHARACTER_MAP[String(item?.uid || '')];
    if (!localUid) return null;

    if (localUid === 'wand') {
        return getFuraiGlobalWandProfile();
    }

    const mode = Object.keys(FURAI_MODE_FACTORY_IDS).find(key => FURAI_MODE_FACTORY_IDS[key] === localUid);
    if (mode) return DB.get(`global-profile-${mode}`)?.bots?.[0] || createFuraiModeFactoryBot(mode);

    const savedRoster = DB.get('globalBotRoster');
    const roster = Array.isArray(savedRoster) ? savedRoster : defaultBots;
    return roster.find(bot => bot?.uid === localUid) || null;
}

function expHasGlobalCharacterDuplicate(charData, item = null) {
    const savedRoster = DB.get('globalBotRoster');
    const roster = Array.isArray(savedRoster) ? savedRoster : defaultBots;
    const name = String(charData?.name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const avatar = String(charData?.avatar || '').trim();
    const instruction = String(
        getFuraiEffectiveCharacterInstruction(charData) || charData?.personality || ''
    ).trim();
    const factoryCandidate = expGetFactoryCharacterCandidate(item);

    if (!name) return true;
    if (factoryCandidate && (
        avatar && String(factoryCandidate.avatar || '').trim() === avatar ||
        instruction && String(getFuraiEffectiveCharacterInstruction(factoryCandidate)).trim() === instruction
    )) return true;

    return roster.some(bot => {
        const botName = String(bot?.name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const botAvatar = String(bot?.avatar || '').trim();
        const botInstruction = String(
            getFuraiEffectiveCharacterInstruction(bot) || bot?.personality || ''
        ).trim();

        return botName === name && (
            avatar && botAvatar === avatar ||
            instruction && botInstruction === instruction
        );
    });
}

function expHasLorebookDuplicate(item) {
    const lib = DB.get('furai_lorebook_library') || [];
    const title = String(item?.title || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const contentUrl = expCleanUrl(item?.content);
    const factoryLocalId = FURAI_FACTORY_EXP_LOREBOOK_MAP[String(item?.uid || '')];

    if (!title) return true;

    return lib.some(book => {
        if (factoryLocalId && String(book?.id || '') === factoryLocalId) return true;
        const bookTitle = String(book?.title || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const bookSource = expCleanUrl(book?.sourceUrl || book?.expansionUrl || '');

        return bookTitle === title || (contentUrl && bookSource === contentUrl);
    });
}

function expEnsurePlaylistLoaded() {
    if (typeof loadPlaylist === 'function') {
        loadPlaylist();
    }

    if (!Array.isArray(currentPlaylist)) {
        currentPlaylist = [];
    }
}

function expHasMusicDuplicate(url, seenUrls = null) {
    const cleanUrl = expCleanUrl(url);
    if (!cleanUrl) return true;

    if (seenUrls && seenUrls.has(cleanUrl)) return true;

    if (!Array.isArray(currentPlaylist)) {
        currentPlaylist = [];
    }

    const playlistDuplicate = currentPlaylist.some(track =>
        expCleanUrl(track?.url) === cleanUrl
    );

    if (playlistDuplicate) return true;

    const factoryDuplicate = Array.isArray(FACTORY_PLAYLIST) && FACTORY_PLAYLIST.some(track =>
        expCleanUrl(track?.url) === cleanUrl
    );

    return factoryDuplicate;
}

async function expBulkImportCharacters(items) {
    const result = expMakeBulkResult(items);
    const fetcher = window.root?.superFetch ? window.root.superFetch : fetch;

    for (const [index, item] of items.entries()) {
        await FuraiExpInstallFlow.before(item, index);
        let outcome = `Skipped Character: ${item?.title || 'Untitled'}.`;

        try {
            const fetchUrl = getExpCharacterFetchUrl(item);
            if (!fetchUrl) {
                expMarkBulkSkipped(result);
                continue;
            }

            const res = await fetcher(fetchUrl);
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch character.");

            const charData = normalizeImportData(await parseFuraiCharacterJsonResponse(res));
            if (expHasGlobalCharacterDuplicate(charData, item)) {
                expMarkBulkSkipped(result);
                continue;
            }

            const added = addToGlobalRoster(charData, {
                silentLimit: true,
                silentToast: true,
                deferRefresh: true
            });

            if (added === false) {
                expMarkBulkSkipped(result);
                continue;
            }

            expMarkBulkAdded(result, item);
            outcome = `Installed Character: ${charData.name || item?.title || 'Untitled'}.`;
        } catch (e) {
            expMarkBulkSkipped(result);
            console.warn("Skipped character:", item?.title, e);
        } finally {
            await FuraiExpInstallFlow.after(outcome);
        }
    }

    refreshCharactersGridIfOpen();
    if (document.getElementById('globalSettingsModalEl')?.style.display === 'flex') {
        renderGlobalContent('group');
    }

    await expFinishBulkImport(result, "Added");
}

async function expBulkImportLorebooks(items) {
    const result = expMakeBulkResult(items);
    const fetcher = window.root?.superFetch ? window.root.superFetch : fetch;

    for (const [index, item] of items.entries()) {
        await FuraiExpInstallFlow.before(item, index);
        let outcome = `Skipped Lorebook: ${item?.title || 'Untitled'}.`;

        try {
            if (!item?.content || expHasLorebookDuplicate(item)) {
                expMarkBulkSkipped(result);
                continue;
            }

            const res = await fetcher(resolveFuraiUploadFileUrl(item.content));
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch lorebook.");

            const artifact = await readFuraiLibraryArtifactResponse(res, {
                type: item.type === 'glossary' ? 'glossary' : 'lorebook',
                title: item.title,
                cover: item.img
            });
            const content = String(artifact.content || '');
            if (!content.trim()) throw new Error("Empty lorebook.");

            const lib = DB.get('furai_lorebook_library') || [];
            lib.unshift({
                id: 'lb_' + Date.now() + '_' + result.added,
                type: artifact.type,
                title: artifact.title || item.title || 'Untitled Lorebook',
                hashTag: artifact.hashTag || item.hashTag || '',
                cover: artifact.cover || item.img || 'https://aigc.uploads.dev/image/43116958b5f56c72831461750228a3500c7f471bd9499de482c01ee66e62be24.jpeg',
                content,
                sourceUrl: item.content,
                expansionUrl: item.content,
                timestamp: Date.now(),
                isDefault: false
            });

            DB.set('furai_lorebook_library', lib);
            expMarkBulkAdded(result, item);
            outcome = `Installed Lorebook: ${item.title || 'Untitled'}.`;
        } catch (e) {
            expMarkBulkSkipped(result);
            console.warn("Skipped lorebook:", item?.title, e);
        } finally {
            await FuraiExpInstallFlow.after(outcome);
        }
    }

    if (typeof LorebookManager?.render === 'function') LorebookManager.render();
    await expFinishBulkImport(result, "Imported");
}

async function expBulkImportPresets(items) {
    const result = expMakeBulkResult(items);
    const fetcher = window.root?.superFetch ? window.root.superFetch : fetch;
    let lastChatId = '';

    for (const [index, item] of items.entries()) {
        await FuraiExpInstallFlow.before(item, index);
        let outcome = `Skipped Preset: ${item?.title || 'Untitled'}.`;

        try {
            if (!isExpChatlogPreset(item)) {
                expMarkBulkSkipped(result);
                continue;
            }

            const fetchUrl = getExpChatPresetFetchUrl(item);
            if (!fetchUrl) {
                expMarkBulkSkipped(result);
                continue;
            }

            const res = await fetcher(fetchUrl);
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch preset.");

            const json = await parseFuraiSharedJsonResponse(res);
            if (!json.chat || !json.chat.id) throw new Error("Not a chatlog preset.");

            const newChatId = 'chat-' + Date.now() + '-' + result.added;
            const newChatData = json.chat;
            const sourceChatId = String(newChatData.id || '');

            newChatData.id = newChatId;
            remapFuraiDeepMemoryAuthorityForNewChat(newChatData, sourceChatId, newChatId);
            newChatData.timestamp = Date.now();

            if (!String(newChatData.title || '').endsWith("(Imported)")) {
                newChatData.title = `${newChatData.title || item.title || 'Imported Chat'} (Imported)`;
            }

            newChatData.viewMode = resolveSharedOrInheritedViewMode(newChatData.viewMode);
            DB.set(newChatId, newChatData);

            if (json.profile) DB.set(`profile-${newChatId}`, json.profile);
            if (newChatData.background) addToBackgroundHistory(newChatData.background);

            lastChatId = newChatId;
            expMarkBulkAdded(result, item);
            outcome = `Installed Preset: ${item.title || newChatData.title || 'Untitled'}.`;
        } catch (e) {
            expMarkBulkSkipped(result);
            console.warn("Skipped preset:", item?.title, e);
        } finally {
            await FuraiExpInstallFlow.after(outcome);
        }
    }

    if (lastChatId) loadChat(lastChatId);
    await expFinishBulkImport(result, "Imported");
}

async function expBulkImportWallpapers(items) {
    const result = expMakeBulkResult(items);
    const entriesToAdd = [];
    let archivedWallpapers = [];

    try {
        archivedWallpapers = DB.get('furai_background_history') || [];
    } catch (e) {}

    const knownUrls = new Set(archivedWallpapers.map(getBackgroundArchiveUrl).filter(Boolean));

    for (const [index, item] of items.entries()) {
        await FuraiExpInstallFlow.before(item, index);
        let outcome = `Skipped Wallpaper: ${item?.title || 'Untitled'}.`;

        try {
            const entry = makeBackgroundArchiveEntryFromExpansion(item);
            const url = getBackgroundArchiveUrl(entry);

            if (!entry || !url || knownUrls.has(url)) {
                expMarkBulkSkipped(result);
                continue;
            }

            knownUrls.add(url);
            entriesToAdd.push(entry);
            expMarkBulkAdded(result, item);
            outcome = `Installed Wallpaper: ${item.title || 'Untitled'}.`;
        } catch (e) {
            expMarkBulkSkipped(result);
            console.warn("Skipped wallpaper:", item?.title, e);
        } finally {
            await FuraiExpInstallFlow.after(outcome);
        }
    }

    if (entriesToAdd.length) {
        batchAddToHistory(entriesToAdd);
        if (typeof renderLocalBgHistory === 'function') renderLocalBgHistory();
        if (typeof renderGlobalBgHistory === 'function') renderGlobalBgHistory();
    }

    await expFinishBulkImport(result, "Added");
}

async function expBulkImportMusic(items) {
    const result = expMakeBulkResult(items);
    const seenUrls = new Set();

    expEnsurePlaylistLoaded();

    for (const [index, item] of items.entries()) {
        await FuraiExpInstallFlow.before(item, index);
        let outcome = `Skipped Music: ${item?.title || 'Untitled'}.`;

        try {
            const url = expCleanUrl(item?.content);
            if (!url || expHasMusicDuplicate(url, seenUrls)) {
                expMarkBulkSkipped(result);
                continue;
            }

            currentPlaylist.push({
                name: item.title || 'Untitled Track',
                url
            });

            seenUrls.add(url);
            expMarkBulkAdded(result, item);
            outcome = `Installed Music: ${item.title || 'Untitled'}.`;
        } catch (e) {
            expMarkBulkSkipped(result);
            console.warn("Skipped music:", item?.title, e);
        } finally {
            await FuraiExpInstallFlow.after(outcome);
        }
    }

    if (result.added > 0) savePlaylist();
    await expFinishBulkImport(result, "Added");
}

// --- EXPANSION COPY OPTIONS LOGIC ---
let pendingExpCopy = { uid: '', url: '' };

function openExpCopyOptions(uid, url) {
    pendingExpCopy = { uid, url };
    
    // Reset the Content button UI in case it was stuck loading previously
    const btnContent = document.getElementById('expBtnCopyContent');
    if (btnContent) {
        btnContent.innerHTML = `
            <i class="fa-solid fa-file-lines" style="color:var(--text-color);"></i>
            <strong>Copy Content</strong>
            <span>Copy the full text</span>
        `;
    }
    
    document.getElementById('expCopyOptionsModal').style.display = 'flex';
}

function triggerExpCopyLink() {
    if (!pendingExpCopy.url) return;
    
    // Record click and copy
    recordExpClick(pendingExpCopy.uid);
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(pendingExpCopy.url);
    
    showToast('Link copied to clipboard!', 'success');
    document.getElementById('expCopyOptionsModal').style.display = 'none';
}

async function triggerExpCopyContent() {
    if (!pendingExpCopy.url) return;
    
    const btn = document.getElementById('expBtnCopyContent');
    const originalHtml = btn.innerHTML;
    
    // Set UI to loading state
    btn.innerHTML = `
        <i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin" style="color:var(--primary-color);"></i>
        <strong>Fetching...</strong>
        <span>Downloading content</span>
    `;
    
    try {
        // Use Perchance's superFetch to bypass CORS if available, otherwise fallback to normal fetch
        const fetcher = window.root?.superFetch ? window.root.superFetch : fetch;
        const res = await fetcher(resolveFuraiUploadFileUrl(pendingExpCopy.url));
        
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load file.");
        
        // Decode legacy plain files and new gzip artifacts by signature.
        const decodedText = await readFuraiArtifactTextResponse(res);
        const libraryArtifact = parseFuraiLibraryArtifactText(decodedText, {});
        let textData = decodedText;
        try {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(decodedText);
            textData = typeof parsed?.content === 'string'
                ? parsed.content
                : JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2);
        } catch (error) {
            textData = libraryArtifact.content || decodedText;
        }

        // Copy the actual decoded content to clipboard.
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(textData);
        
        // Record click and cleanup
        recordExpClick(pendingExpCopy.uid);
        showToast('File content copied!', 'success');
        document.getElementById('expCopyOptionsModal').style.display = 'none';
        
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Fetch error:", e);
        showToast("Failed to fetch content. Copy Link instead.", "error");
        // Revert button UI if it fails
        btn.innerHTML = originalHtml;
    }
}

    if (makerOpeningLoreInstructions) makerOpeningLoreInstructions.value = '';

    if (makerCreatorNotes) makerCreatorNotes.value = '';
    
    updateOpeningBackgroundOpacityDisplay('maker', '1');
    updateOpeningBackgroundBlurDisplay('maker', '0');

    if (secretInp) secretInp.value = '';
    mountFuraiProtectedInstructionEditor(
        'makerProtectedInstructionHost',
        secretInp?.closest('.form-group'),
        {}
    );
    
    // Reset Previews
    applyFuraiEditorAvatarPreview('makerAvatarPreview', starterAvatarUrl);
    document.getElementById('makerSpritePreview').style.display = 'none';
    
    // Reset Temp Emotions for Maker
    window.makerTempEmotions = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_EMOTION_KEYWORDS));
    window.makerTempAvatars = {};
    window.makerTempSprites = {};

            ? 'Save to Character Library'

        addBtn.onmouseout = canAddSlot ? function() { this.style.borderColor = 'var(--border-color)'; this.style.background = 'var(--sidebar-bg)'; } : null;

        if (canAddSlot) {
            addBtn.removeAttribute('aria-disabled');
            addBtn.onclick = () => processMakerImport('add_slot');
