        }
    }, 50);
}

function processMakerImport(target) {
    let name = document.getElementById('makerNameInput').value.trim();
    let hashTag = getFuraiTagInputValue('makerTagInput');
    let avatar = document.getElementById('makerAvatarInput').value.trim();
    let sprite = document.getElementById('makerSpriteInput').value.trim();
    let openingSystemMessage = document.getElementById('makerOpeningSystemMessage') ? document.getElementById('makerOpeningSystemMessage').value.trim() : "";
    let openingMessage = document.getElementById('makerOpeningInput') ? document.getElementById('makerOpeningInput').value.trim() : "";
    let openingExtras = readCharacterOpeningExtrasFromDomOrProfile('makerNameInput', {});
    
    let instructionText = document.getElementById('makerInstInput').value.trim();
    let secretText = document.getElementById('makerSecretInput') ? document.getElementById('makerSecretInput').value.trim() : "";
    let protectedData = readFuraiProtectedInstructionEditorData('makerProtectedInstructionHost');
    if (!protectedData) return;

    // Basic Validation
    if (!name && !instructionText) {
        showToast("Please provide a Name or Character Data.", "error");
        return;
    }

    // Default name only. An intentionally blank avatar stays blank.
    if (!name) name = "New Character";

    // Grab the Temp Emotions that were defined via the Emotion Editor button
    let customEmotions = window.makerTempEmotions || JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_EMOTION_KEYWORDS));
    let emotionAvatars = window.makerTempAvatars || {};
    let emotionSprites = window.makerTempSprites || {};
    
    let finalInstruction = instructionText;

    // Merge the secret into the main instruction
    if (secretText) {
        finalInstruction += `\n\n[SECRET]\n${secretText}\n[/SECRET]`;
    }

    // Optional Check: Did they paste a full sheet that INCLUDES visual blocks?
    let parsedData = parseHumanReadableProfile(instructionText);
    if (parsedData) {
        if (!hasFuraiProtectedInstructions(protectedData) && hasFuraiProtectedInstructions(parsedData)) {
            protectedData = normalizeFuraiProtectedInstructionData(parsedData);
        }

        // If the parser successfully separated the text, use the clean instruction
        if (parsedData.instruction) {
            finalInstruction = parsedData.instruction;
            // Re-apply the secret block if the parsed string overwrote it
            if (secretText) {
                finalInstruction += `\n\n[SECRET]\n${secretText}\n[/SECRET]`;
            }
        }
        
        // If the pasted text had explicit avatars/emotions, they override the temp vars
        if (parsedData.customEmotions && Object.keys(parsedData.customEmotions).length > 0) customEmotions = parsedData.customEmotions;
        if (parsedData.emotionAvatars && Object.keys(parsedData.emotionAvatars).length > 0) emotionAvatars = parsedData.emotionAvatars;
        if (parsedData.emotionSprites && Object.keys(parsedData.emotionSprites).length > 0) emotionSprites = parsedData.emotionSprites;
        if (!openingSystemMessage && parsedData.openingSystemMessage) openingSystemMessage = parsedData.openingSystemMessage;
        if (!openingMessage && parsedData.openingMessage) openingMessage = parsedData.openingMessage;

        const hasDomOpeningSystemMessage = !!openingSystemMessage || !!openingExtras.systemMessage;
        const hasDomOpeningBackground = !!openingExtras.background;
        const hasDomOpeningLorebook = !!openingExtras.lorebook;
        const hasDomCreatorNotes = !!openingExtras.creatorNotes;

        openingExtras = getCharacterOpeningExtras({
            openingSystemMessage: hasDomOpeningSystemMessage ? (openingSystemMessage || openingExtras.systemMessage) : (parsedData.openingSystemMessage || ""),
            openingBackground: hasDomOpeningBackground ? openingExtras.background : (parsedData.openingBackground || ""),
            openingBackgroundOpacity: hasDomOpeningBackground ? openingExtras.backgroundOpacity : (parsedData.openingBackgroundOpacity || openingExtras.backgroundOpacity || "1"),
            openingBackgroundBlur: hasDomOpeningBackground ? openingExtras.backgroundBlur : (parsedData.openingBackgroundBlur || openingExtras.backgroundBlur || "0"),
            openingLorebook: hasDomOpeningLorebook ? openingExtras.lorebook : (parsedData.openingLorebook || ""),
            creatorNotes: hasDomCreatorNotes
                ? openingExtras.creatorNotes
                : mergeFuraiPublicTextAliases(parsedData.creatorNotes, parsedData.creator_notes)
        });
    }

    // Build the standardized Character Object
    const charData = writeFuraiProtectedInstructionData({
        ver: "1.0",
        type: "character",
        name: name,
        hashTag: hashTag,
        avatar: avatar,
        defaultSprite: sprite,
        instruction: finalInstruction,
        openingSystemMessage: openingSystemMessage || openingExtras.systemMessage,
        openingMessage: openingMessage,
        openingBackground: openingExtras.background,
        openingBackgroundOpacity: openingExtras.backgroundOpacity,
        openingBackgroundBlur: openingExtras.backgroundBlur,
        openingLorebook: openingExtras.lorebook,
        creatorNotes: openingExtras.creatorNotes,
        creator_notes: openingExtras.creatorNotes,
        customEmotions: customEmotions,
        emotionAvatars: emotionAvatars,
        emotionSprites: emotionSprites
    }, protectedData);

    // Route it to the existing Import mechanics!
    let importSucceeded = true;

    if (target === 'temp_chat') {
        createTempChat(charData);
    } else if (target === 'replace_global') {
        openGlobalReplacementSelector(charData);
    } else if (target === 'replace_local') {
        openLocalReplacementSelector(charData);
    } else if (target === 'replace') {
        // backward compatibility for older maker buttons
        if (currentChatId) {
            openLocalReplacementSelector(charData);
        } else {
            openGlobalReplacementSelector(charData);
        }
    } else if (target === 'add_slot') {
        importSucceeded = addToGlobalRoster(charData) !== false;
    } else if (target === 'add_local_slot') {
        importSucceeded = addToLocalRoster(charData) !== false;
    }

    if (!importSucceeded) return;
    
    // Close Modal
    document.getElementById('makerStudioModalEl').style.display = 'none';
}

window.syncGlobalWandMuteButton = function(btn = null) {
    const targetBtn = btn || document.getElementById('globalWandMuteToggleBtn');
    if (!targetBtn) return;

    const isMuted = DB.get('global-group-enhancer-muted') === true;
    const icon = targetBtn.querySelector('i');
    const label = targetBtn.querySelector('span');

    targetBtn.dataset.muted = isMuted ? '1' : '0';
    targetBtn.title = isMuted ? 'Silent by default' : 'Announcement by default';

    if (icon) {
        icon.className = `fa-solid ${isMuted ? 'fa-volume-xmark' : 'fa-bullhorn'}`;
    }

    if (label) {
        label.textContent = isMuted ? 'Silent' : 'Announcement';
    }
};

window.toggleGlobalWandMute = function(btn) {
    const isMuted = !(DB.get('global-group-enhancer-muted') === true);
    DB.set('global-group-enhancer-muted', isMuted);

    syncGlobalWandMuteButton(btn);
};

/* --- WORD COUNT ENGINE --- */
const FURAI_CONTEXT_COUNTER_SECTION_BY_ID = Object.freeze({
    furaiLivestreamInstructionInput:'primaryCharacter', furaiLivestreamMemoInput:'memo', memoInput:'memo', summaryTextInput:'facts',
    refTextInput:'lorebook', makerInstInput:'primaryCharacter', makerSecretInput:'primaryCharacter', storyCastLoreInput:'storyCast',
    storyCastSecretInput:'storyCast', userInstructionInput:'userProfile', userSecretInput:'userProfile', botInstructionInput:'primaryCharacter',
    botSecretInput:'primaryCharacter', globalUserInst:'userProfile', globalUserSecret:'userProfile', globalBotInst:'primaryCharacter',
    globalBotSecret:'primaryCharacter', globalMemoText:'memo', globalRefText:'lorebook', editGlobalBotInst:'castMember', editGlobalBotSecret:'castMember'
});
const furaiContextCounterTimers = new Map();
function getFuraiContextCounterSection(ids) {
    for (const id of ids) {
        if (id === 'lbEditContentInput') return document.getElementById('lbEditType')?.value === 'glossary' ? 'glossary' : 'lorebook';
        if (FURAI_CONTEXT_COUNTER_SECTION_BY_ID[id]) return FURAI_CONTEXT_COUNTER_SECTION_BY_ID[id];
    }
    return '';
}
function queueFuraiContextCounter(displayId, text, words, section) {
    clearTimeout(furaiContextCounterTimers.get(displayId));
    furaiContextCounterTimers.set(displayId, setTimeout(() => {
        const el = document.getElementById(displayId);
        if (!el) return;
        const tokens = estimateTokens(text), contextWindow = getFuraiContextWindow(), ratio = tokens / Math.max(1, contextWindow);
        const percent = ratio * 100, percentText = percent < 10 ? percent.toFixed(1) : Math.round(percent).toString();
        el.textContent = `${words.toLocaleString()} words · ${percentText}% context`;
        el.style.color = ratio >= 0.5 ? 'var(--danger-color)' : ratio >= 0.35 ? '#ff9800' : 'var(--text-color)';
        el.style.opacity = ratio >= 0.35 ? '1' : '0.55';
        el.style.fontWeight = ratio >= 0.35 ? '600' : 'normal';
        el.title = `${getFuraiSectionRule(section).label}: 35% is a size warning and 50% is high-use guidance, not a hard limit. Clipping occurs only when the combined prompt exceeds the shared budget.`;
        furaiContextCounterTimers.delete(displayId);
    }, 240));
}
window.updateWordCountUI = function(sourceIds, displayId, limit) {
    const ids = Array.isArray(sourceIds) ? sourceIds : [sourceIds];
    let text = ids.map(id => document.getElementById(id)?.value || '').join(' ');

    if (ids.length === 1 && ids[0] === 'memoInput') {
        text = getFuraiMemoDraftPromptText();
    } else if (ids.length === 1 && ids[0] === 'globalMemoText') {
        text = getFuraiGlobalMemoDraftPromptText(currentGlobalTab);
    }

    const val = text.trim();
    const count = val ? val.split(/\s+/).length : 0, displayEl = document.getElementById(displayId);
    if (!displayEl) return;
    displayEl.style.color = 'var(--text-color)'; displayEl.style.opacity = '0.5'; displayEl.style.fontWeight = 'normal';
    const section = getFuraiContextCounterSection(ids);
    if (section) {
        displayEl.textContent = `${count.toLocaleString()} words`;
        queueFuraiContextCounter(displayId, val, count, section);
    } else displayEl.textContent = count > limit ? `${count}/${limit} words` : `${count} words`;
};
window.getFuraiWordCount = function(text) {
    const val = String(text || '').trim();
    return val === '' ? 0 : val.split(/\s+/).length;
};
window.updateKeyFactsWordCountUI = function() {
    const displayEl = document.getElementById('timelessWordCount');
    if (!displayEl) return;
    const chatData = currentChatId ? DB.get(currentChatId) : null;
    if (chatData && typeof furaiEnsureManualKeyFacts === 'function') furaiEnsureManualKeyFacts(chatData);
    const text = [document.getElementById('timelessFactsInput')?.value || '', ...(chatData?.pinnedFacts || []).map(pin => pin?.factText || '')].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
    const count = getFuraiWordCount(text);
    displayEl.style.color = 'var(--text-color)'; displayEl.style.opacity = '0.5'; displayEl.style.fontWeight = 'normal';
    displayEl.textContent = `${count.toLocaleString()} words`;
    queueFuraiContextCounter('timelessWordCount', text, count, 'facts');
};

function openGlossaryModal() {
    const personality = chatPersonalities[currentChatId] || 'researcher';
    let currentGlos = "";

    try {
        let chatData = DB.get(currentChatId) || {};
        currentGlos = chatData.glossary !== undefined ? chatData.glossary : (DB.get(`global_glossary_${personality}`) || "");
    } catch(e) {
        currentGlos = "";
    }
    
    document.getElementById('glosTextInput').value = currentGlos;
    document.getElementById('glosTextInput').dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
    document.getElementById('glossaryModalEl').style.display = 'flex';
    
    const menu = document.getElementById('settingsMenu');
    if (menu && menu.classList.contains('show')) menu.classList.remove('show');
}

function closeGlossaryModal() {
    document.getElementById('glossaryModalEl').style.display = 'none';
}

function saveGlossary() {
    let text = document.getElementById('glosTextInput').value; 
    if (!currentChatId) return;

    try {
        let chatData = DB.get(currentChatId);
        if (chatData) {
            chatData.glossary = text;
            DB.set(currentChatId, chatData);
        }
    } catch(e) { console.error("Error saving glossary:", e); }
    
    closeGlossaryModal();
}

function resetGlossary() {
    const personality = chatPersonalities[currentChatId] || 'researcher';
    document.getElementById('glosTextInput').value = DB.get(`global_glossary_${personality}`) || "";
    document.getElementById('glosTextInput').dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
}

/* ==========================================================================
   ACC MIGRATION ENGINE (The Bridge)
   Parses Dexie JSON/GZIP, Validates DB Signatures, and Maps to FurAI
   ========================================================================== */

async function triggerACCImport() {
    const fileInput = document.getElementById('accImportFileInput');

    if (!fileInput) {
        showToast("ACC import input missing.", "error");
        return;
    }

    fileInput.onchange = async (e) => {
        const file = e.target.files[0];
        if (!file) return;

        showBackupProgress(
            'Importing from ACC...',
            `Reading ${file.name || 'ACC export'}...`,
            5
        );

        try {
            await waitForBackupProgressFrame();

            let jsonText = "";

            if (file.name.endsWith('.gz')) {
                setBackupProgress(12, 'Decompressing ACC export...', 'Importing from ACC...');
                await waitForBackupProgressFrame();

                const ds = new DecompressionStream("gzip");
                const stream = file.stream().pipeThrough(ds);
                const response = await new Response(stream);
                jsonText = await response.text();
            } else {
                setBackupProgress(12, 'Reading ACC export...', 'Importing from ACC...');
                await waitForBackupProgressFrame();

                jsonText = await file.text();
            }

            setBackupProgress(30, 'Parsing ACC data...', 'Importing from ACC...');
            await waitForBackupProgressFrame();

            const json = JSON.parse(jsonText);

            setBackupProgress(38, 'Checking ACC file signature...', 'Importing from ACC...');
            await waitForBackupProgressFrame();

            if (json.formatName !== "dexie" || !json.data || json.data.databaseName !== "chatbot-ui-v1") {
                throw new Error("Invalid ACC Export file. Signature mismatch.");
            }

            await processACCMigration(json.data.data, (percent, detail) => {
                setBackupProgress(percent, detail, 'Importing from ACC...');
            });

            setBackupProgress(100, 'ACC migration complete.', 'Importing from ACC...');
            await waitForBackupProgressFrame();

            showToast("ACC Migration Complete!", "success");
            updateChatList();
            closeAccountModal();
        } catch (err) {
            console.error("ACC Import Error:", err);
            showToast("Migration Failed: " + (err.message || "Corrupted Data"), "error");
        } finally {
            fileInput.value = '';
            hideBackupProgress(350);
        }
    };

    fileInput.click();
}

window.triggerACCImport = triggerACCImport;

window.triggerACCImport = triggerACCImport;

async function processACCMigration(tables, onProgress) {
    // A. Helper to extract specific tables
    const getTable = (name) => tables.find(t => t.tableName === name)?.rows || [];
    
    const accChars = getTable('characters');
    const accThreads = getTable('threads');
    const accMessages = getTable('messages');
    const accLore = getTable('lore');

    const reportProgress = typeof onProgress === 'function'
        ? onProgress
        : () => {};

    const yieldToUi = () => new Promise(resolve => {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => setTimeout(resolve, 0));
    });

    reportProgress(45, 'Importing ACC characters and chats...');
    await yieldToUi();
      
    // B. Build Lookups for Speed
    const charMap = {};
    accChars.forEach(c => charMap[c.id] = c);

    const loreMap = {};
    accLore.forEach(l => loreMap[l.id] = l);

    let importedChats = 0;
    let globalRosterUpdated = false;
    let globalRoster = DB.get('globalBotRoster') || JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaultBots));
    const masterMode = getGlobalCastMode(); 

    // --- NEW: FOLDER CREATION LOGIC ---
    let targetFolderId = null;
    if (accThreads.length > 0) {
        targetFolderId = 'f_' + Date.now();
        const folders = FolderManager.getFolders();
        folders.unshift({ // Add to top of folder list
            id: targetFolderId, 
            name: `ACC Imports (${new Date().toLocaleDateString()})`, 
            isOpen: true 
        });
        FolderManager.saveFolders(folders);
    }
    // ----------------------------------

    // C. Thread & Message Mapping
    const totalThreads = Math.max(1, accThreads.length);
    let processedThreads = 0;
    
    for (const thread of accThreads) {
        processedThreads++;
    
        if (processedThreads === 1 || processedThreads % 3 === 0 || processedThreads === totalThreads) {
            const percent = 50 + (processedThreads / totalThreads) * 42;
    
            reportProgress(
                percent,
                `Migrating chats... ${processedThreads}/${totalThreads}`
            );
    
            await yieldToUi();
        }
        const tMessages = accMessages.filter(m => m.threadId === thread.id).sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
        if (tMessages.length === 0) continue;

        const botIdsInThread = new Set();
        if (thread.characterId) botIdsInThread.add(thread.characterId); 
        tMessages.forEach(m => {
            if (m.characterId >= 0) botIdsInThread.add(m.characterId); 
        });

        const furaiBots = [];
        const botIdToIndex = {};

        Array.from(botIdsInThread).forEach((cId) => {
            const accC = charMap[cId];
            if (!accC) return;

            let overrides = {};
            if (cId === thread.characterId && thread.character) overrides = thread.character;

            const name = overrides.name || accC.name || "Unknown";
            const avatar = overrides.avatar?.url || accC.avatar?.url || '';

            let inst = overrides.roleInstruction || accC.roleInstruction || "";
            if (accC.customCode) inst += "\n\n[Note: This bot originally utilized custom JavaScript which could not be ported.]";

            let libraryTemplate = globalRoster.find(gb => gb.name === name && gb.instruction === inst);
            if (!libraryTemplate) {
                libraryTemplate = {
                    uid: generateUID('acc_library'),
                    name,
                    avatar,
                    defaultSprite: "",
                    instruction: inst,
                    isActive: false,
                    inActiveCast: false,
                    replyMode: masterMode,
                    customEmotions: cloneFuraiData(DEFAULT_EMOTION_KEYWORDS),
                    emotionAvatars: {},
                    emotionSprites: {}
                };
                globalRoster.push(libraryTemplate);
                globalRosterUpdated = true;
            }

            const actor = normalizeFuraiSelectedCharacterForRole(libraryTemplate, {
                role: 'ai',
                mode: 'group',
                botIndex: furaiBots.length,
                replyMode: masterMode,
                startAfterMessageUid: ''
            });
            actor.name = name;
            actor.avatar = avatar;
            actor.instruction = inst;

            furaiBots.push(actor);
            botIdToIndex[cId] = furaiBots.length - 1;
        });

        if (furaiBots.length === 0) continue;

        const uName = thread.userCharacter?.name || "User";
        const uAvatar = thread.userCharacter?.avatar?.url || '';
        const importedUser = normalizeFuraiSelectedCharacterForRole({
            uid: generateUID('acc_user_source'),
            name: uName,
            avatar: uAvatar,
            instruction: ''
        }, {
            role: 'user',
            mode: 'group'
        });

        const profile = {
            user: importedUser,
            bots: furaiBots,
            profileCustomized: true,
            masterReplyMode: masterMode,
            rosterMode: 'snapshot'
        };

        const furaiMsgs = [];
        tMessages.forEach((m, sourceIndex) => {
            const text = m.message || "";
            if (!text) return;

            const base = {
                uid: generateUID('msg'),
                content: text,
                timestamp: Number(m.creationTime || m.timestamp || thread.creationTime || Date.now()) + sourceIndex,
                sortKey: furaiMsgs.length
            };

            if (m.characterId === -1) {
                furaiMsgs.push({
                    ...base,
                    role: 'user',
                    userUid: importedUser.uid,
                    userNameSnapshot: importedUser.name
                });
            } else if (m.characterId === -2) {
                furaiMsgs.push({ ...base, role: 'system' });
            } else if (m.characterId >= 0) {
                const bIdx = botIdToIndex[m.characterId] !== undefined ? botIdToIndex[m.characterId] : 0;
                const actor = furaiBots[bIdx] || furaiBots[0];
                furaiMsgs.push({
                    ...base,
                    role: 'ai',
                    botIndex: bIdx,
                    botUid: actor.uid,
                    botNameSnapshot: actor.name
                });
            }
        });

        let refText = "";
        if (thread.loreBookId && loreMap[thread.loreBookId]) {
            refText = loreMap[thread.loreBookId].text || "";
        }

        // --- EXTRACT ACC SUMMARIES ---
        let bestSummary = "";
        let bestSummaryIndex = 0;
        
        tMessages.forEach((m, idx) => {
            if (m.summariesEndingHere && typeof m.summariesEndingHere === 'object') {
                const levels = Object.keys(m.summariesEndingHere).map(Number).filter(n => !isNaN(n));
                if (levels.length > 0) {
                    const maxLevel = Math.max(...levels);
                    bestSummary = m.summariesEndingHere[maxLevel];
                    bestSummaryIndex = idx;
                }
            }
        });
        // -----------------------------

        // SAFELY MAP ACC DATES TO FURAI
        const accCreationTime = thread.creationTime || Date.now();
        const accLastActive = thread.lastMessageTime || accCreationTime;

        // Use the original creation time. Appending "-ACC" safely prevents collisions
        // while allowing FurAI's parseInt() to gracefully ignore the letters and read the exact date.
        const newChatId = `chat-${accCreationTime}-ACC-${importedChats}`;
        
        const chatData = {
            id: newChatId,
            title: (thread.name || `ACC Chat with ${furaiBots[0].name}`) + " (ACC)",
            messages: furaiMsgs,
            timestamp: accLastActive, // Preserves chronological sorting in your history list!
            personality: 'group',
            viewMode: resolveSharedOrInheritedViewMode(),
            folderId: targetFolderId,
            summary: bestSummary,
            lastSummaryIndex: bestSummaryIndex 
        };
        
        // EXPLICITLY set it, even if empty, so it overrides the Global Default
        chatData.reference = refText || "";
        
        const primaryAccBot = charMap[thread.characterId];
        if (primaryAccBot && primaryAccBot.reminderMessage) {
            chatData.memo = primaryAccBot.reminderMessage;
        }

        DB.set(newChatId, chatData);
        DB.set(`profile-${newChatId}`, profile);
        importedChats++;
    }

    // D. Edge Case: "All characters, no chats" export mode
    if (accThreads.length === 0 && accChars.length > 0) {
        reportProgress(70, `Importing characters... 0/${accChars.length}`);
        await yieldToUi();
    
        accChars.forEach((accC, index) => {
            const inst = accC.roleInstruction + (accC.customCode ? "\n\n[Note: Custom JavaScript could not be ported.]" : "");
            if (!globalRoster.some(gb => gb.name === accC.name && gb.instruction === inst)) {
                globalRoster.push({
                    uid: generateUID('acc_bot'),
                    name: accC.name || "Unknown",
                    avatar: accC.avatar?.url || '',
                    defaultSprite: "",
                    instruction: inst,
                    isActive: false,
                    inActiveCast: false,
                    replyMode: masterMode,
                    customEmotions: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_EMOTION_KEYWORDS)),
                    emotionAvatars: {},
                    emotionSprites: {}
                });
                globalRosterUpdated = true;
            }
    
            if (index % 10 === 0 || index === accChars.length - 1) {
                reportProgress(
                    70 + ((index + 1) / accChars.length) * 22,
                    `Importing characters... ${index + 1}/${accChars.length}`
                );
            }
        });
    
        await yieldToUi();
    }

    // E. Finalize Saves
    reportProgress(94, 'Saving imported ACC data...');
    await yieldToUi();
    
    if (globalRosterUpdated) {
        DB.set('globalBotRoster', globalRoster);
    }
    
    reportProgress(98, 'Refreshing FurAI chat list...');
    await yieldToUi();
    
}

/* =========================================
   CONTEXT BUDGET + TOKEN SENSOR
   ========================================= */
const TOKEN_FALLBACK_CAP = 6000;
let cachedFuraiTextPluginMeta;
const FURAI_TOKEN_COUNT_CACHE_MAX = 220;
const FURAI_TOKEN_COUNT_CACHE_MIN_CHARS = 160;
const furaiTokenCountCache = new Map();

function clearFuraiTokenCountCache() {
    furaiTokenCountCache.clear();
    if (typeof clearFuraiFullHistoryEstimateCache === 'function') clearFuraiFullHistoryEstimateCache();
    else window.furaiFullHistoryTokenEstimateCache = null;
}
function getFuraiTextPluginMeta() {
    if (cachedFuraiTextPluginMeta !== undefined) return cachedFuraiTextPluginMeta || {};
    cachedFuraiTextPluginMeta = null;
    try {
        if (typeof generateText === 'function') {
            const meta = generateText({ getMetaObject: true });
            if (meta && typeof meta === 'object' && typeof meta.then !== 'function') cachedFuraiTextPluginMeta = meta;
        }
    } catch(e) { console.warn('FurAI token meta fallback active:', e); }
    return cachedFuraiTextPluginMeta || {};
}
function refreshFuraiTextPluginMeta() {
    const previous = cachedFuraiTextPluginMeta || {};
    cachedFuraiTextPluginMeta = undefined;
    const next = getFuraiTextPluginMeta();
    if (previous.countTokens !== next.countTokens || previous.idealMaxContextTokens !== next.idealMaxContextTokens) clearFuraiTokenCountCache();
    return next;
}

function getFuraiContextWindow() {
    const meta = getFuraiTextPluginMeta();
    const detectedLimit = Number(meta.idealMaxContextTokens);
    return Number.isFinite(detectedLimit) && detectedLimit > 0 ? detectedLimit : TOKEN_FALLBACK_CAP;
}

function getFuraiReplyReserve(contextWindow = getFuraiContextWindow()) {
    if (contextWindow >= 32000) return Math.min(3000, Math.max(2000, Math.floor(contextWindow * 0.08)));
    if (contextWindow >= 16000) return 1600;
    if (contextWindow >= 8000) return 1200;
    return 1000;
}

function getFuraiSafetyReserve(contextWindow = getFuraiContextWindow()) {
    return Math.min(1200, Math.max(300, Math.floor(contextWindow * 0.04)));
}

function getFuraiContextBudget() {
    const contextWindow = getFuraiContextWindow();
    const replyReserve = getFuraiReplyReserve(contextWindow);
    const safetyReserve = getFuraiSafetyReserve(contextWindow);
    const usablePrompt = Math.max(800, contextWindow - replyReserve - safetyReserve);

    return { contextWindow, replyReserve, safetyReserve, usablePrompt };
}

// Persistent sections share one static pool. Percentages are priorities during real overflow, not hard lanes.
const FURAI_CONTEXT_CORE_RESERVE = 360;
const FURAI_CONTEXT_SECTION_RULES = {
    primaryCharacter: { label: 'Primary Character', pct: 0.64 },
    userProfile:      { label: 'User Profile',       pct: 0.08 },
    userProfilePlain: { label: 'User Profile',       pct: 0.06 },
    castKnowledge:    { label: 'Cast Knowledge',     pct: 0.24 },
    castMember:       { label: 'Cast Member',        pct: 0.06 },
    storyCast:        { label: 'Story Cast',         pct: 0.24 },
    lorebook:         { label: 'Lorebook',           pct: 0.13 },
    glossary:         { label: 'Glossary',           pct: 0.04 },
    summary:          { label: 'Summary',            pct: 0.11 },
    facts:            { label: 'Key Facts',          pct: 0.04 },
    deepMemory:       { label: 'Deep Memory',        pct: 0.055 },
    memo:             { label: 'Memo',               pct: 0.035 },
    cue:              { label: 'One-Time Cue',       pct: 0.04 }
};
function getFuraiRecentHistoryFloor(budget = getFuraiContextBudget(), hasHistory = true) {
    if (!hasHistory) return 0;
    const usable = Math.max(800, Number(budget?.usablePrompt) || 0);
    return Math.min(2400, Math.max(700, Math.floor(usable * 0.18)));
}
function getFuraiOptionalStaticPool(budget = getFuraiContextBudget(), hasHistory = true) {
    const usable = Math.max(800, Number(budget?.usablePrompt) || 0);
    return Math.max(260, usable - getFuraiRecentHistoryFloor(budget, hasHistory) - FURAI_CONTEXT_CORE_RESERVE);
}
function getFuraiSectionRule(section) {
    return FURAI_CONTEXT_SECTION_RULES[section] || { label: 'Context', pct: 0.10 };
}
const FURAI_CHARACTER_CONTEXT_SECTIONS = new Set([
    'primaryCharacter', 'userProfile', 'userProfilePlain', 'castKnowledge', 'castMember', 'storyCast'
]);
function resetFuraiContextTrimEvents() {
    window.furaiLastContextTrimEvents = [];
}
function recordFuraiContextTrimEvent(event) {
    if (!window.furaiLastContextTrimEvents) window.furaiLastContextTrimEvents = [];
    const next = {
        section: event.section || 'context', label: event.label || 'Context',
        before: Math.round(Number(event.before) || 0), after: Math.round(Number(event.after) || 0)
    };
    if (!window.furaiLastContextTrimEvents.some(item =>
        item.section === next.section && item.label === next.label && item.before === next.before && item.after === next.after
    )) window.furaiLastContextTrimEvents.push(next);
}
function getFuraiContextTrimEvents() {
    return Array.isArray(window.furaiLastContextTrimEvents) ? window.furaiLastContextTrimEvents : [];
}

function allocateFuraiWeightedRequests(items, budget) {
    const limits = new Map(items.map(item => [item.key, 0]));
    const active = items.filter(item => item.request > 0);
    budget = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(budget) || 0));
    const total = active.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.request, 0);
    if (!active.length || !budget) return limits;
    if (total <= budget) {
        active.forEach(item => limits.set(item.key, item.request));
        return limits;
    }

    const weightScale = Math.max(1, active.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.weight, 0));
    active.forEach(item => limits.set(item.key, Math.min(item.request, Math.floor(budget * item.weight / weightScale))));
    let left = budget - [...limits.values()].reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);

    while (left > 0) {
        const unmet = active.filter(item => limits.get(item.key) < item.request);
        if (!unmet.length) break;
        const weightTotal = unmet.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.weight, 0) || unmet.length;
        const roundBudget = left;
        let spent = 0;
        for (const item of unmet) {
            const room = item.request - limits.get(item.key);
            const share = Math.max(1, Math.floor(roundBudget * (item.weight || 1) / weightTotal));
            const grant = Math.min(room, share, left - spent);
            limits.set(item.key, limits.get(item.key) + grant);
            spent += grant;
            if (spent >= left) break;
        }
        if (!spent) break;
        left -= spent;
    }
    return limits;
}

function planFuraiContextSections(entries, budget = getFuraiContextBudget(), options = {}) {
    const pool = getFuraiOptionalStaticPool(budget, options.hasHistory !== false);
    const items = entries.map((entry, index) => {
        const section = entry.section || 'context';
        const raw = String(entry.text || '');
        const tokens = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(entry.tokens ?? estimateTokens(raw)) || 0));
        return {
            ...entry,
            key: entry.key || `${section}-${index}`,
            section,
            raw,
            tokens,
            request: tokens,
            weight: Math.max(0.001, Number(entry.weight) || getFuraiSectionRule(section).pct),
            group: FURAI_CHARACTER_CONTEXT_SECTIONS.has(section) ? 'characters' : section
        };
    });

    const groups = new Map();
    for (const item of items) {
        let group = groups.get(item.group);
        if (!group) {
            const isCharacters = item.group === 'characters';
            group = {
                key: item.group,
                request: 0,
                weight: isCharacters ? 0.64 : getFuraiSectionRule(item.section).pct,
                max: pool,
                items: []
            };
            groups.set(item.group, group);
        }
        group.items.push(item);
        group.request = Math.min(group.max, group.request + item.request);
    }

    const groupLimits = allocateFuraiWeightedRequests([...groups.values()], pool);
    const limits = new Map();
    for (const group of groups.values()) {
        const entryLimits = allocateFuraiWeightedRequests(group.items, groupLimits.get(group.key) || 0);
        entryLimits.forEach((value, key) => limits.set(key, value));
    }
    return { pool, items, groups, groupLimits, limits };
}

function trimFuraiTextToTokenLimit(text, maxTokens, options = {}) {
    text = String(text || '');
    maxTokens = Math.floor(Number(maxTokens));

    if (!text.trim()) return text;
    if (!Number.isFinite(maxTokens) || maxTokens <= 0) return '';
    if (estimateTokens(text) <= maxTokens) return text;

    const marker = options.marker || '\n[...trimmed to fit context budget...]\n';
    const markerTokens = Math.max(1, estimateTokens(marker));
    const contentBudget = Math.max(1, maxTokens - markerTokens);

    const findCharsForBudget = (source, tokenBudget) => {
        if (tokenBudget <= 0) return 0;
        let lo = 0;
        let hi = source.length;
        while (lo < hi) {
            const mid = Math.ceil((lo + hi) / 2);
            if (estimateTokens(source.slice(0, mid)) <= tokenBudget) lo = mid;
            else hi = mid - 1;
        }
        return lo;
    };

    if (options.keepTail) {
        const headBudget = Math.max(1, Math.floor(contentBudget * 0.30));
        const tailBudget = Math.max(1, contentBudget - headBudget);
        const headChars = findCharsForBudget(text, headBudget);
        const reversedTail = text.split('').reverse().join('');
        const tailCharsReversed = findCharsForBudget(reversedTail, tailBudget);
        const tail = reversedTail.slice(0, tailCharsReversed).split('').reverse().join('');
        return text.slice(0, headChars).trimEnd() + marker + tail.trimStart();
    }

    const keepChars = findCharsForBudget(text, contentBudget);
    return text.slice(0, keepChars).trimEnd() + marker;
}

function fitFuraiContextSections(entries, options = {}) {
    const plan = planFuraiContextSections(entries, options.budget, options);
    const fitted = {};

    for (const item of plan.items) {
        const maxTokens = plan.limits.get(item.key) || 0;
        if (!item.raw.trim() || item.tokens <= maxTokens) {
            fitted[item.key] = item.raw;
            continue;
        }

        const label = item.label || getFuraiSectionRule(item.section).label || 'Context';
        recordFuraiContextTrimEvent({ section: item.section, label, before: item.tokens, after: maxTokens });
        const marker = item.marker || `\n[${label} trimmed: ${item.tokens.toLocaleString()} → ${maxTokens.toLocaleString()} tokens. Shorten this section for fuller memory.]\n`;
        fitted[item.key] = trimFuraiTextToTokenLimit(item.raw, maxTokens, { ...item, marker });
    }
    return fitted;
}

function makeFuraiTokenCacheSignature(text, counterMode) {
    const len = text.length;
    const sampleSize = 96;
    const middleStart = Math.max(0, Math.floor(len / 2) - Math.floor(sampleSize / 2));

    const sample =
        text.slice(0, sampleSize) +
        '\u241E' +
        text.slice(middleStart, middleStart + sampleSize) +
        '\u241E' +
        text.slice(Math.max(0, len - sampleSize));

    let hash = 2166136261;
    for (let i = 0; i < sample.length; i++) {
        hash ^= sample.charCodeAt(i);
        hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619);
    }

    return `${counterMode}|${len}|${hash >>> 0}`;
}

function getFuraiCachedTokenCount(text, counterMode) {
    if (text.length < FURAI_TOKEN_COUNT_CACHE_MIN_CHARS) return null;

    const key = makeFuraiTokenCacheSignature(text, counterMode);
    if (!furaiTokenCountCache.has(key)) return null;

    const value = furaiTokenCountCache.get(key);
    // LRU touch.
    furaiTokenCountCache.delete(key);
    furaiTokenCountCache.set(key, value);
    return value;
}

function setFuraiCachedTokenCount(text, counterMode, value) {
    if (text.length < FURAI_TOKEN_COUNT_CACHE_MIN_CHARS) return value;

    const key = makeFuraiTokenCacheSignature(text, counterMode);
    furaiTokenCountCache.set(key, value);

    while (furaiTokenCountCache.size > FURAI_TOKEN_COUNT_CACHE_MAX) {
        const oldestKey = furaiTokenCountCache.keys().next().value;
        furaiTokenCountCache.delete(oldestKey);
    }

    return value;
}

function estimateTokens(text) {
    if (!text || typeof text !== 'string') return 0;

    const meta = getFuraiTextPluginMeta();
    const countTokens = meta.countTokens;
    const counterMode = typeof countTokens === 'function' ? 'plugin' : 'fallback4';

    const cached = getFuraiCachedTokenCount(text, counterMode);
    if (cached !== null) return cached;

    if (typeof countTokens === 'function') {
        try {
            const counted = countTokens(text);
            if (Number.isFinite(Number(counted))) {
                return setFuraiCachedTokenCount(text, counterMode, Number(counted));
            }
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    return setFuraiCachedTokenCount(text, 'fallback4', Math.ceil(text.length / 4));
}

function getFuraiRemainingHistoryTokens(promptWithoutHistory = '', historyPrefix = '') {
    const budget = getFuraiContextBudget();
    const staticTokens = estimateTokens(String(promptWithoutHistory || ''));
    const prefixTokens = estimateTokens(String(historyPrefix || ''));
    return Math.max(0, budget.usablePrompt - staticTokens - prefixTokens);
}

function buildTruncatedHistoryByChars(messagesArray, maxChars = 12000) {
    let currentLength = 0;
    let includedMessages = [];

    for (let i = messagesArray.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const msgStr = messagesArray[i];
        if (!msgStr) continue;

        if (currentLength + msgStr.length > maxChars && includedMessages.length > 0) {
            includedMessages.unshift("\n[...earlier messages in this chat were removed to save memory...]\n");
            break;
        }
        
        includedMessages.unshift(msgStr);
        currentLength += msgStr.length;

        if (currentLength > maxChars) {
            if (i > 0) includedMessages.unshift("\n[...earlier messages in this chat were removed to save memory...]\n");
            break;
        }
    }

    return includedMessages.join('\n');
}

function buildTruncatedHistoryByTokens(messagesArray, maxTokens) {
    maxTokens = Math.floor(Number(maxTokens));
    if (!Number.isFinite(maxTokens) || maxTokens <= 0) maxTokens = 1;

    let currentTokens = 0;
    let includedMessages = [];
    let firstKeptIndex = 0;
    let droppedCount = 0;

    for (let i = messagesArray.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const msgStr = messagesArray[i];
        if (!msgStr) continue;

        const msgTokens = estimateTokens(msgStr + '\n');

        if (currentTokens + msgTokens > maxTokens && includedMessages.length > 0) {
            droppedCount = i + 1;
            firstKeptIndex = i + 1;
            includedMessages.unshift("\n[...earlier messages in this chat were removed to save memory...]\n");
            break;
        }

        // Keep the newest message intact even if it is unusually long.
        includedMessages.unshift(msgStr);
        currentTokens += msgTokens;
        firstKeptIndex = i;

        if (currentTokens > maxTokens) {
            if (i > 0) {
                droppedCount = i;
                firstKeptIndex = i;
                includedMessages.unshift("\n[...earlier messages in this chat were removed to save memory...]\n");
            }
            break;
        }
    }

    window.furaiLastHistoryFitStats = {
        maxTokens,
        usedTokens: currentTokens,
        totalCount: Array.isArray(messagesArray) ? messagesArray.length : 0,
        keptCount: Math.max(0, (Array.isArray(messagesArray) ? messagesArray.length : 0) - droppedCount),
        droppedCount,
        firstKeptIndex
    };

    return includedMessages.join('\n');
}

function buildTruncatedHistory(messagesArray, limit = 12000) {
    const opts = typeof limit === 'object' && limit !== null ? limit : { maxChars: limit };

    if (Number.isFinite(Number(opts.maxTokens))) {
        return buildTruncatedHistoryByTokens(messagesArray, opts.maxTokens);
    }

    return buildTruncatedHistoryByChars(messagesArray, opts.maxChars || 12000);
}

function buildFuraiBudgetedHistory(messagesArray, historyPrefix, promptWithoutHistory, meta = {}) {
    const recentHistoryBudget = getFuraiRemainingHistoryTokens(promptWithoutHistory, historyPrefix);
    let historyText = buildTruncatedHistory(messagesArray, { maxTokens: recentHistoryBudget });

    const marker = '[...earlier messages in this chat were removed to save memory...]';
    const fitStats = window.furaiLastHistoryFitStats || {};
    const baseStartIndex = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(meta.baseStartIndex) || 0));
    const rawSummaryAnchor = Number(meta.summaryAnchorIndex), summaryAnchorIndex = Number.isInteger(rawSummaryAnchor) ? rawSummaryAnchor : -1;
    const totalMessages = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(meta.totalMessages) || 0));
    const firstKeptIndex = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(fitStats.firstKeptIndex) || 0));
    const sourceMessages = Array.isArray(meta.sourceMessages) ? meta.sourceMessages : [];
    const firstLiveSource = sourceMessages[firstKeptIndex] || null;
    const firstLiveUid = String(firstLiveSource?.uid || '').trim();

    let firstLiveIndex = baseStartIndex + firstKeptIndex;
    if (firstLiveUid) {
        const chatData = DB.get(meta.chatId || currentChatId) || {};
        const dbMessages = Array.isArray(chatData.messages) ? chatData.messages : [];
        const uidIndex = dbMessages.findIndex(msg => String(msg?.uid || '') === firstLiveUid);
        if (uidIndex !== -1) firstLiveIndex = uidIndex;
    }

    const hasSummary = summaryAnchorIndex >= 0 && !!String(historyPrefix || '').trim();
    const hasDroppedFullMessages = String(historyText || '').includes(marker), firstUncoveredIndex = hasSummary ? summaryAnchorIndex + 1 : 0;
    const wasHistoryTrimmed = hasDroppedFullMessages && (!hasSummary || firstLiveIndex > firstUncoveredIndex);
    const wasSummarized = hasSummary && firstLiveIndex > 0;
    const summarizedBeforeIndex = wasSummarized ? Math.min(firstLiveIndex, firstUncoveredIndex) : 0;
    const boundaryMode = wasHistoryTrimmed ? 'trim' : 'summary';

    if (hasDroppedFullMessages && hasSummary && !wasHistoryTrimmed) historyText = historyText.replace(marker, '');
    saveFuraiContextFitMeta({
        chatId: meta.chatId || currentChatId,
        generatedAt: Date.now(),
        contextWindow: getFuraiContextBudget().contextWindow,
        historyBudget: recentHistoryBudget,
        historyUsed: fitStats.usedTokens,
        sourceCount: fitStats.totalCount,
        keptCount: fitStats.keptCount,
        droppedCount: fitStats.droppedCount,
        firstLiveIndex,
        firstLiveUid,
        totalMessages,
        summarizedBeforeIndex,
        trimmed: wasHistoryTrimmed,
        hasBoundary: firstLiveIndex > 0 && (wasHistoryTrimmed || wasSummarized),
        boundaryMode
    });

    if (wasHistoryTrimmed) recordFuraiContextTrimEvent({
        section: 'recentHistory', label: 'Recent Chat History',
        before: estimateTokens((messagesArray || []).join('\n')), after: recentHistoryBudget
    });
    if ((wasHistoryTrimmed || wasSummarized) && firstLiveUid && firstLiveIndex > 0) {
        setFuraiPromptContextBoundary({
            chatId: meta.chatId || currentChatId,
            firstLiveIndex,
            firstLiveUid,
            totalMessages,
            mode: boundaryMode,
            dropped: firstLiveIndex
        });
    } else {
        clearFuraiPromptContextBoundary(meta.chatId || currentChatId);
    }

    return String(historyPrefix || '') + historyText;
}

function calculateContextTokens() {
    const budget = getFuraiContextBudget();
    const historyFloor = getFuraiRecentHistoryFloor(budget, true);
    const staticPool = getFuraiOptionalStaticPool(budget, true);

    let tokens = {
        characters: 0,
        lorebook: 0,
        memo: 0,
        summary: 0,
        deepMemory: 0,
        total: 0,
        contextWindow: budget.contextWindow,
        replyReserve: budget.replyReserve,
        safetyReserve: budget.safetyReserve,
        usablePrompt: budget.usablePrompt,
        historyFloor,
        staticPool,
        coreReserve: FURAI_CONTEXT_CORE_RESERVE,
        historyRoom: budget.usablePrompt,
        historyRoomWithoutSummary: budget.usablePrompt,
        historyFit: getFuraiContextFitMeta(currentChatId),
        sectionWarnings: [],
        trimEvents: getFuraiContextTrimEvents()
    };

    if (!currentChatId) return tokens;

    const chatData = DB.get(currentChatId) || {};
    const profile = getChatProfile(currentChatId);
    const personality = chatPersonalities[currentChatId] || 'researcher';

    let charText = "";
    if (profile && profile.user) {
        const userStatus = getUserChatStatus(profile);
        if (userStatus !== 'silent') {
            charText += (profile.user.name || "") + " " + getFuraiContextInstructionForStatus(
                getFuraiEffectiveModeCharacterInstruction(profile.user, personality),
                userStatus
            );
        }
    }
    if (profile && profile.bots) {
        if (personality === 'story') {
            const narrator = profile.bots[0];
            if (narrator) {
                charText += (narrator.name || "") + " " + getFuraiEffectiveCharacterInstruction(narrator);
            }
    
            const storyCastText = buildStoryCastContextBlock(currentChatId);
            if (storyCastText) {
                charText += " " + storyCastText;
            }
        } else {
            profile.bots.forEach(b => {
                if ((personality === 'group' || personality === 'maker') && !b.inActiveCast) return;

                const status = (personality === 'group' || personality === 'maker')
                    ? getBotChatStatus(b)
                    : 'online';
                const label = getFuraiParticipantLabel(b.name || '', status);
                if (!label) return;

                charText += label + " " + getFuraiContextInstructionForStatus(
                    getFuraiEffectiveCharacterInstruction(b),
                    status
                );
            });
        }
    }
    tokens.characters = estimateTokens(charText);

    let loreText = "";
    let globalRef = DB.get(`ref_text_${personality}`);
    if (globalRef === null || globalRef === undefined) globalRef = defaultReferences[personality] || "";
    loreText += chatData.reference !== undefined ? chatData.reference : globalRef;
    tokens.lorebook = estimateTokens(loreText);

    tokens.memo = estimateTokens(getFuraiMemoTextForLiveTokenEstimate(chatData, personality));

    const summaryUsable = getFuraiSummaryAnchorIndex(chatData, chatData.messages || []) >= 0;
    const summaryTokens = summaryUsable ? estimateTokens((chatData.summaryBlocks || []).filter(block => !block?.stale).map(b => b.text).join(' ')) : 0;
    const factTokens = estimateTokens(getFuraiAuthoritativeMemoryText(chatData));
    const deepMemoryTokens = window.furaiDeepMemoryLastContext?.chatId === currentChatId
        ? Math.max(0, Number(window.furaiDeepMemoryLastContext.tokens) || estimateTokens(window.furaiDeepMemoryLastContext.text || ''))
        : 0;
    const withSummaryPlan = planFuraiContextSections([
        { key: 'characters', section: 'primaryCharacter', tokens: tokens.characters },
        { key: 'lorebook', section: 'lorebook', tokens: tokens.lorebook },
        { key: 'summary', section: 'summary', tokens: summaryTokens },
        { key: 'facts', section: 'facts', tokens: factTokens },
        { key: 'deepMemory', section: 'deepMemory', tokens: deepMemoryTokens },
        { key: 'memo', section: 'memo', tokens: tokens.memo }
    ], budget, { hasHistory: true });
    const noSummaryPlan = planFuraiContextSections([
        { key: 'characters', section: 'primaryCharacter', tokens: tokens.characters },
        { key: 'lorebook', section: 'lorebook', tokens: tokens.lorebook },
        { key: 'facts', section: 'facts', tokens: factTokens },
        { key: 'deepMemory', section: 'deepMemory', tokens: deepMemoryTokens },
        { key: 'memo', section: 'memo', tokens: tokens.memo }
    ], budget, { hasHistory: true });
    const roomFor = plan => Math.max(0, tokens.usablePrompt - tokens.coreReserve - [...plan.limits.values()].reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0));
    tokens.historyRoomWithoutSummary = roomFor(noSummaryPlan);
    const exactDormant = summaryTokens > 0 && Number(tokens.historyFit?.version || 0) >= 2 &&
        tokens.historyFit?.summarizedBeforeIndex === 0 && tokens.historyFit?.trimmed !== true &&
        tokens.historyFit?.totalMessages === (chatData.messages || []).length &&
        (!tokens.historyFit?.contextWindow || tokens.historyFit.contextWindow === tokens.contextWindow);
    tokens.summaryDormant = exactDormant || (summaryTokens > 0 &&
        getFuraiFullHistoryTokenEstimate(currentChatId, chatData.messages || [], chatData) <= Math.floor(tokens.historyRoomWithoutSummary * 0.92));

    const activePlan = tokens.summaryDormant ? noSummaryPlan : withSummaryPlan;
    const limit = key => activePlan.limits.get(key) || 0;
    const sharedLimits = {
        characters: limit('characters'), lorebook: limit('lorebook'),
        summary: limit('summary') + limit('facts'), deepMemory: limit('deepMemory'), memo: limit('memo')
    };
    tokens.summary = factTokens + (tokens.summaryDormant ? 0 : summaryTokens);
    tokens.deepMemory = deepMemoryTokens;
    tokens.total = tokens.characters + tokens.lorebook + tokens.memo + tokens.summary + tokens.deepMemory;
    tokens.historyRoom = roomFor(activePlan);

    const addWarning = (key, label, amount) => {
        const allowed = sharedLimits[key];
        if (amount > allowed) tokens.sectionWarnings.push({ key, label, amount, limit: allowed });
    };
    addWarning('characters', 'Characters / Cast', tokens.characters);
    addWarning('lorebook', 'Lorebook', tokens.lorebook);
    addWarning('summary', 'Memory — Summary & Facts', tokens.summary);
    addWarning('deepMemory', 'Deep Memory Recall', tokens.deepMemory);
    addWarning('memo', "Director's Memo", tokens.memo);

    return tokens;
}

function getFuraiTrimEventSignature(events = getFuraiContextTrimEvents()) {
    return (events || [])
        .map(e => `${e.label}:${Math.round(e.before)}>${Math.round(e.after)}`)
        .join('|');
}

function showFuraiContextTrimToastOnce() {
    // Long chats naturally keep the newest messages inside the active context.
    // Keep that history-fit detail in Tokens, but do not interrupt the user with a toast.
    const events = getFuraiContextTrimEvents().filter(event => event?.section !== 'recentHistory');
    if (!events.length) return;

    const signature = `${currentChatId || 'no-chat'}::${getFuraiTrimEventSignature(events)}`;
    if (!signature || window.furaiLastTrimToastSignature === signature) return;
    window.furaiLastTrimToastSignature = signature;

    const count = events.length;
    const message = count === 1
        ? 'Some context was clipped. Open Tokens for details.'
        : `${count} context sections were clipped. Open Tokens for details.`;

    if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
        showToast(message, 'warning');
        return;
    }

    let toast = document.getElementById('furaiContextTrimToast');
    if (!toast) {
        toast = document.createElement('div');
        toast.id = 'furaiContextTrimToast';
        toast.style.cssText = 'z-index:999999;position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:76px;transform:translateX(-50%);max-width:min(390px,calc(100vw - 28px));padding:10px 13px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid rgba(255,152,0,.45);background:var(--input-bg,#222);color:var(--text-color,#eee);box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.35);font:13px/1.45 Open Sans,sans-serif;text-align:left;opacity:0;transition:opacity .18s ease;cursor:pointer;';
        toast.onclick = () => {
            if (typeof openTokenModal === 'function') openTokenModal();
        };
        document.body.appendChild(toast);
    }

    toast.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation" style="margin-right:6px;color:#ff9800;"></i>${message}`;
    clearTimeout(window.furaiContextTrimToastTimer);
    toast.style.opacity = '1';
    window.furaiContextTrimToastTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        toast.style.opacity = '0';
    }, 4200);
}

function finalizeFuraiContextTrimNotice() {
    updateTokenButtonUI();
    showFuraiContextTrimToastOnce();
    if (typeof queueFuraiContextMetaRender === 'function') queueFuraiContextMetaRender();
}

let furaiTokenButtonUiFrame = 0;

function updateTokenButtonUI() {
    if (furaiTokenButtonUiFrame) return;

    // Context estimation can scan large chat/memory sections. Multiple settings
    // updates in the same paint must share one calculation instead of repeating it.
    furaiTokenButtonUiFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        furaiTokenButtonUiFrame = 0;

        const btn = document.getElementById('tokenMenuBtn');
        const iconSlot = document.getElementById('tokenBtnWarningIcon');
        if (!btn || !iconSlot) return;

        const tokens = calculateContextTokens();
        const nextState = (
            tokens.total > tokens.usablePrompt ||
            (tokens.sectionWarnings && tokens.sectionWarnings.length > 0)
        ) ? 'danger' : (tokens.total > tokens.usablePrompt * 0.7 ? 'near' : 'clear');

        if (iconSlot.dataset.furaiTokenState === nextState) return;
        iconSlot.dataset.furaiTokenState = nextState;

        if (nextState === 'danger') {
            iconSlot.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-exclamation" style="color: var(--danger-color); margin-left: 8px; font-size: 14px;"></i>';
        } else if (nextState === 'near') {
            iconSlot.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-regular fa-circle-question" style="opacity: 0.5; margin-left: 8px; font-size: 14px;"></i>';
        } else {
            iconSlot.replaceChildren();
        }
    });
}

function openTokenModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('tokenModalEl');
    const container = document.getElementById('tokenStatsContainer');
    const summary = document.getElementById('tokenBudgetSummary');
    if (!modal || !container) return;

    const renderId = (openTokenModal.renderId || 0) + 1;
    openTokenModal.renderId = renderId;
    modal.style.display = 'flex';
    container.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:9px; min-height:90px; opacity:.72;"><span class="furai-mini-spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span><span>Calculating context…</span></div>';
    if (summary) summary.innerHTML = '';

    const menu = document.getElementById('settingsMenu');
    if (menu) menu.classList.remove('show');

    requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        if (openTokenModal.renderId !== renderId || modal.style.display !== 'flex') return;

        refreshFuraiTextPluginMeta();
        const tokens = calculateContextTokens();
        const renderBar = (label, amount, color, maxVal) => {
            const percentage = Math.min((amount / Math.max(1, Number(maxVal) || 1)) * 100, 100);
            return `
            <div style="margin-bottom:6px;">
                <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-size:13px; margin-bottom:6px; font-weight:500;">
                    <span>${label}</span>
                    <span style="font-family:monospace; opacity:.9;">${Math.round(amount).toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
                <div style="width:100%; height:6px; background:var(--border-color); border-radius:4px; overflow:hidden;">
                    <div style="width:${percentage}%; height:100%; background:${color}; transition:width .4s ease-out;"></div>
                </div>
            </div>`;
        };
        const renderRow = (label, value, muted = false) => `
            <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:6px; ${muted ? 'opacity:.72;' : ''}">
                <span>${label}</span>
                <span style="font-family:monospace;">${Math.round(value).toLocaleString()}</span>
            </div>`;
        const warnings = tokens.sectionWarnings || [];
        const trimEvents = tokens.trimEvents || [];
        const warningRows = warnings.map(w => `
            <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; margin-top:6px;">
                <span>${w.label}</span>
                <span style="font-family:monospace; white-space:nowrap;">${Math.round(w.amount).toLocaleString()} / ${Math.round(w.limit).toLocaleString()}</span>
            </div>`).join('');
        const trimRows = trimEvents.slice(-6).map(e => `
            <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; margin-top:6px;">
                <span>${e.label}</span>
                <span style="font-family:monospace; white-space:nowrap;">${Math.round(e.before).toLocaleString()} → ${Math.round(e.after).toLocaleString()}</span>
            </div>`).join('');
        const warningsHtml = !warnings.length && !trimEvents.length ? '' : `
            <div style="padding:10px 11px; border:1px solid rgba(255,152,0,.45); background:rgba(255,152,0,.10); border-radius:8px; font-size:12px; line-height:1.35;">
                <div style="font-weight:700; margin-bottom:4px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i> Context clipping warning</div>
                <div style="opacity:.78;">All non-empty sections share the available pool. Priority weights apply only when their combined content exceeds it.</div>
                ${warningRows ? `<div style="margin-top:8px; border-top:1px dashed rgba(255,152,0,.35); padding-top:4px;">${warningRows}</div>` : ''}
                ${trimRows ? `<div style="margin-top:8px; border-top:1px dashed rgba(255,152,0,.35); padding-top:4px;"><div style="opacity:.78; margin-bottom:2px;">Last generation trims:</div>${trimRows}</div>` : ''}
            </div>`;

        const totalColor = tokens.total > tokens.usablePrompt
            ? 'var(--danger-color)'
            : (tokens.total > tokens.usablePrompt * .7 ? '#ff9800' : '#00e676');
        const historyFit = tokens.summaryDormant && Number(tokens.historyFit?.version || 1) < 2 && tokens.historyFit?.summarizedBeforeIndex > 0 ? null : tokens.historyFit;
        const previewBoundary = historyFit ? null : getFuraiPreviewContextBoundary();
        const historyAmount = historyFit ? historyFit.historyUsed : tokens.historyRoom;
        const historyMax = historyFit ? Math.max(1, historyFit.historyBudget) : tokens.usablePrompt;
        const historyLabel = historyFit ? 'Recent History Used — last reply' : 'Recent History Capacity';
        const exactHistoryStatus = tokens.summaryDormant
            ? `All ${(historyFit?.sourceCount || 0).toLocaleString()} eligible messages were used in full. The saved Summary stayed dormant.`
            : historyFit?.trimmed
                ? `${historyFit.keptCount.toLocaleString()} of ${historyFit.sourceCount.toLocaleString()} eligible messages were used in full${historyFit.summarizedBeforeIndex > 0 ? '; earlier chat is represented by Summary, while some newer history was also trimmed' : ''}.`
                : historyFit?.summarizedBeforeIndex > 0
                    ? 'Messages above the marker are represented by Summary. Every later eligible message was used in full.'
                    : `All ${(historyFit?.sourceCount || 0).toLocaleString()} eligible messages were used in full.`;
        const previewHistoryStatus = tokens.summaryDormant
            ? 'All eligible current history fits in full. The saved Summary is stored but is not sent.'
            : previewBoundary?.mode === 'summary'
                ? 'Earlier messages are represented by Summary. The marker shows where full-detail history begins.'
                : previewBoundary
                    ? 'This saved chat exceeds the current recent-history capacity. The boundary is estimated until the next reply.'
                    : 'All eligible current history fits in full. Exact usage is recorded after the next reply.';
        const jumpButtonHtml = getFuraiContextJumpButtonHtml();

        container.innerHTML = `
            ${warningsHtml}
            ${jumpButtonHtml ? `<div style="margin:0 0 12px;">${jumpButtonHtml}</div>` : ''}
            ${renderBar('Persistent Context Load', tokens.total, totalColor, tokens.usablePrompt)}
            ${renderBar(historyLabel, historyAmount, '#00e676', historyMax)}
            <div style="margin:0 0 12px; font-size:13px; line-height:1.45; opacity:.76;">${historyFit ? exactHistoryStatus : previewHistoryStatus}</div>
            <div style="font-size:13px; opacity:.72; margin:0 0 12px; line-height:1.45;">Recent history uses every token left after the real non-empty context sections.</div>
            <div style="border-top:1px dashed var(--border-color); margin:6px 0 12px;"></div>
            ${renderBar('Characters / Cast', tokens.characters, 'var(--primary-color)', tokens.usablePrompt)}
            ${renderBar('Lorebook', tokens.lorebook, '#9c27b0', tokens.usablePrompt)}
            ${renderBar('Memory — Summary & Facts', tokens.summary, '#2196f3', tokens.usablePrompt)}
            ${tokens.deepMemory > 0 ? renderBar('Deep Memory Recall', tokens.deepMemory, '#00acc1', tokens.usablePrompt) : ''}
            ${renderBar('Memo', tokens.memo, '#ffca28', tokens.usablePrompt)}
        `;

        if (summary) {
            summary.innerHTML = `
                ${renderRow('Total Context Window', tokens.contextWindow)}
                ${renderRow('Reply Reserve', tokens.replyReserve, true)}
                ${renderRow('Safety Buffer', tokens.safetyReserve, true)}
                <div style="border-top:1px dashed var(--border-color); padding-top:10px; margin-top:10px;">
                    ${renderRow('Usable Prompt Tokens', tokens.usablePrompt)}
                    <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:6px; opacity:.72;"><span>Character Overflow Weight</span><span style="font-family:monospace;">64%</span></div>
                    ${renderRow('History Anti-Starve Floor', tokens.historyFloor, true)}
                    ${renderRow('Core Prompt Reserve', tokens.coreReserve, true)}
                    ${renderRow('Optional Static Pool', tokens.staticPool, true)}
                    ${renderRow('Summary Source Batch', getFuraiSummarySourceLimit(tokens.contextWindow), true)}
                </div>
                <div style="border-top:1px dashed var(--border-color); padding-top:10px; margin-top:10px; font-size:11.5px; opacity:.72; line-height:1.45;">
                    <div><b>Context Window</b> − Reply Reserve − Safety Buffer = <b>Usable Prompt</b>.</div>
                    <div><b>Optional Pool</b> = Usable Prompt − History Floor − Core Reserve.</div>
                    <div>All non-empty optional fields share this pool. One field may borrow all of it; the 35% and 50% editor markers are warnings, not caps.</div>
                    <div>Standard Summary begins near 88% usage and targets about 68%. Its batch size adapts to the model, safety buffer, and reserved summary output.</div>
                    <div style="margin-top:4px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-calculator" style="margin-right:4px;"></i> Token counts use Perchance’s counter when available; fallback: &approx;4 characters per token.</div>
                    <div>Approximation: <b>1 token</b> &approx; 0.75 words; <b>1 word</b> &approx; 1.3 tokens.</div>
                </div>`;
        }
    }));
}

    document.getElementById('tokenModalEl').style.display = 'none';
}

// --- DYNAMICALLY HIDES UNNECESSARY FIELDS ---
window.updateSubmitFormFields = function() {
    const type = document.getElementById('subType').value;
    
    const descGroup = document.getElementById('subCardDescGroup');
    const previewGroup = document.getElementById('subPreviewTextGroup');
    const linkGroup = document.getElementById('subContentLinkGroup');
    const imgLabel = document.getElementById('subImgUrlLabel');
    const bottomGrid = document.getElementById('bottomLinksGrid');
    
    if (type === 'Wallpaper') {
        // Wallpapers: Hide Card Desc and Content Link. Keep Preview Text (for Lightbox).
        descGroup.style.display = 'none';
        previewGroup.style.display = 'block';
        linkGroup.style.display = 'none';
        
        // Wallpaper uses the original URL for the lazy gallery preview and full view.
        imgLabel.innerHTML = 'Wallpaper Image URL <span style="color:var(--danger-color);">*</span>';
        bottomGrid.style.gridTemplateColumns = '1fr'; 
        
    } else if (type === 'Music') {
        // Music: Keep Card Desc, Hide Preview Text.
        descGroup.style.display = 'block';
        previewGroup.style.display = 'none';
        linkGroup.style.display = 'block';
        
        imgLabel.innerHTML = 'Cover Art URL'; // Optional
        bottomGrid.style.gridTemplateColumns = '1fr 1fr'; 
        
    } else {
        // Character, Lorebook, Preset: Show everything.
        descGroup.style.display = 'block';
        previewGroup.style.display = 'block';
        linkGroup.style.display = 'block';
        
        imgLabel.innerHTML = 'Preview Image URL'; // Optional
        bottomGrid.style.gridTemplateColumns = '1fr 1fr'; 
    }
};

    const modal = document.getElementById('expSubmitGuideModal');
    if (!modal) return;

    if (nsfwBtn) nsfwBtn.style.display = isExpNsfw ? 'flex' : 'none';

    modal.style.display = 'flex';
