    if (body) body.scrollTop = 0;
}

// --- EXP SUBMIT FORMAT: ready-to-drop FurAI DB block ---
function cleanExpSubmitValue(value) {
    return String(value ?? '')
        .replace(/\r/g, '')
        .trim();
}

function escapePerchanceDbSpecialChars(value) {
    const text = String(value ?? '');
    let out = '';

    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
        const ch = text[i];
        const needsEscape = ch === '[' || ch === ']' || ch === '{' || ch === '}';
        const alreadyEscaped = i > 0 && text[i - 1] === '\\';

        if (needsEscape && !alreadyEscaped) out += '\\';
        out += ch;
    }

    return out;
}

function formatExpDbValue(value) {
    return escapePerchanceDbSpecialChars(
        cleanExpSubmitValue(value).replace(/\n/g, '\\n')
    );
}

function getExpTypeMeta(type) {
    const map = {
        Character: { type: 'character', prefix: 'char', tag: 'Character' },
        Wallpaper: { type: 'wallpaper', prefix: 'bg', tag: 'Wallpaper' },
        Music: { type: 'music', prefix: 'song', tag: 'Music' },
        Lorebook: { type: 'lorebook', prefix: 'lore', tag: 'Lorebook' },
        Preset: { type: 'preset', prefix: 'set', tag: 'Preset' }
    };

    return map[type] || map.Character;
}

function makeExpUid(prefix) {
    return `${prefix}_${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
}

function makeExpDbBlockName() {
    // Numeric suffix keeps compatibility with fur-ai-db buildExpansionData(), which reads /^exp\d+$/.
    return `exp${Date.now()}`;
}

function makeExpTags(rawTags, defaultTag) {
    const seen = new Set();
    const tags = String(rawTags || '')
        .split(',')
        .map(t => cleanExpSubmitValue(t))
        .filter(Boolean)
        .filter(t => t.toLowerCase() !== 'new')
        .filter(t => {
            const key = t.toLowerCase();
            if (seen.has(key)) return false;
            seen.add(key);
            return true;
        });

    const hasTag = (tagName) =>
        tags.some(t => t.toLowerCase() === tagName.toLowerCase());

    if (!hasTag(defaultTag)) {
        tags.unshift(defaultTag);
    }

    return tags;
}

function formatExpTagsCsv(tags) {
    return tags.map(formatExpDbValue).join('|');
}

function isValidExpCreatorLink(value) {
    const raw = String(value || '').trim();
    if (!raw) return true;

    try {
        const parsed = new URL(raw);
        return parsed.protocol === 'http:' || parsed.protocol === 'https:';
    } catch (e) {
        return false;
    }
}

function generateSubmissionText(mode = 'safe') {
    const submissionPrefix = [
        mode === 'nsfw' ? ':NSFW_column1::NSFW_column2::NSFW_column3::NSFW_column4:' : '',
        ':SUBMISSION_column1::SUBMISSION_column2::SUBMISSION_column3::SUBMISSION_column4::SUBMISSION_column5::SUBMISSION_column6:',
        ':FurAI_column_1::FurAI_column_2::FurAI_column_3:'
    ].filter(Boolean).join('\n');

    const typeRaw = document.getElementById('subType').value || 'Character';
    const meta = getExpTypeMeta(typeRaw);

    const title = document.getElementById('subTitle').value || 'Untitled';
    const creator = document.getElementById('subCreator').value || 'Anonymous';
    const creatorLink = document.getElementById('subCreatorLink')?.value.trim() || '';
    const tagsRaw = getFuraiTagInputValue('subTags');
    const cardDesc = document.getElementById('subCardDesc').value || '';
    const previewText = document.getElementById('subPreviewText').value || '';
    const imgUrl = document.getElementById('subImgUrl').value || '';
    const contentLink = document.getElementById('subContentLink').value || '';
    const allowComments = document.getElementById('subAllowComments')?.checked !== false;

    const blockName = makeExpDbBlockName();
    const uid = makeExpUid(meta.prefix);
    const tags = makeExpTags(tagsRaw, meta.tag);

    const lines = [
        blockName,
        `  uid = ${formatExpDbValue(uid)}`,
        `  type = ${formatExpDbValue(meta.type)}`,
        `  date = ${formatExpDbValue(getExpTodayDateString())}`,
        `  title = ${formatExpDbValue(title)}`,
        `  creator = ${formatExpDbValue(creator)}`
    ];

    if (creatorLink) {
        lines.push(`  creatorLink = ${formatExpDbValue(creatorLink)}`);
    }

    if (meta.type !== 'wallpaper') {
        lines.push(`  desc = ${formatExpDbValue(cardDesc)}`);
    } else {
        lines.push(`  desc = ${formatExpDbValue(previewText || cardDesc)}`);
    }

    if (meta.type === 'character' || meta.type === 'lorebook' || meta.type === 'preset') {
        lines.push(`  previewText = ${formatExpDbValue(previewText)}`);
    }

    lines.push(`  img = ${formatExpDbValue(imgUrl)}`);

    if (meta.type !== 'wallpaper') {
        lines.push(`  content = ${formatExpDbValue(contentLink)}`);
    }

    if (meta.type === 'preset') {
        const presetKind = getExpPresetKind({
            type: 'preset',
            title,
            desc: cardDesc,
            previewText,
            content: contentLink,
            tags
        });
        lines.push(`  presetKind = ${formatExpDbValue(presetKind)}`);
    }

    lines.push(`  allowComments = ${allowComments ? 'true' : 'false'}`);
    lines.push(`  tagsCsv = ${formatExpTagsCsv(tags)}`);

    return `${submissionPrefix}\n${lines.join('\n')}`;
}

function openDirectSubmitIframe(mode) {
    if (mode === 'nsfw' && (!hasVerifiedAge || !isExpNsfw)) {
        openAdultAccessGate('exp-submit');
        return;
    }

    const type = document.getElementById('subType').value;
    const title = document.getElementById('subTitle').value.trim();
    const creator = document.getElementById('subCreator').value.trim();
    const creatorLink = document.getElementById('subCreatorLink')?.value.trim() || '';
    const imgUrl = document.getElementById('subImgUrl').value.trim();
    const contentLink = document.getElementById('subContentLink').value.trim();

    if (!title || !creator || (type === 'Wallpaper' && !imgUrl) || (type !== 'Wallpaper' && !contentLink)) {
        showToast("Please fill in all required (*) fields.", "error");
        return;
    }

    if (!isValidExpCreatorLink(creatorLink)) {
        showToast("Creator bio / website must use a valid http:// or https:// URL.", "error");
        return;
    }

    const text = generateSubmissionText(mode);
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).catch(e => console.error("Clipboard err", e));

    const isNsfw = mode === 'nsfw';
    const channel = isNsfw ? 'nsfwsubmit' : 'submit';
    const isLight = document.body.classList.contains('light-theme');

    const config = {
        reverseCommentOrder: true,
        loadFonts: "Open Sans",
        commentPlaceholderText: isNsfw
            ? "⚠︎ Your nickname must include 18+ before posting. Paste your copied Expansion Pass submission into #nsfwsubmit."
            : "Paste your copied Expansion Pass submission into #submit. PG-13 / SFW only.",
        messageBubbleStyle: "font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; padding: 10px; border-radius:6px; border: 1px solid #444;",
        containerStyle: "width: 100%; height: 100%;",
        width: "100%",
        height: "100%",
        customEmojis: baseForumConfig.customEmojis,
        customEmojiSize: baseForumConfig.customEmojiSize,
        loneCustomEmojiSizeMultiplier: baseForumConfig.loneCustomEmojiSizeMultiplier,
        adminPasswordHash: baseForumConfig.adminPasswordHash,
        adminFlair: baseForumConfig.adminFlair,
        deleteButtonIcon: baseForumConfig.deleteButtonIcon,
        forceColorScheme: isLight ? 'light' : 'dark',
        allowBots: false,
        submitButtonText: isNsfw ? "🔞 submit" : "Submit",
        submitButtonStyle: furaiCommentSubmitButtonStyle,
        settingsButtonStyle: furaiCommentSettingsButtonStyle,
        hideFullscreenButton: true
    };

    const baseUrl = `https://comments-plugin.perchance.org/embed/ai-furry-generator+${channel}`;
    const fullUrl = `${baseUrl}?adminPasswordHash=${baseForumConfig.adminPasswordHash}#${encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(config))}`;

    const container = document.getElementById('directSubmitIframeContainer');
    if (!container) {
        showToast("Error: Missing Iframe Container HTML", "error");
        return;
    }

    container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="tool-loading-mask" id="directSubmitMask" style="position:absolute; z-index:10;">
            <div class="modern-spinner"></div>
            <div class="loading-text">Loading Submission Panel...</div>
        </div>
        <iframe src="${fullUrl}" style="width:100%; height:100%; border:none;" allow="clipboard-read *; clipboard-write *;"></iframe>
    `;

    setTimeout(() => {
        const mask = document.getElementById('directSubmitMask');
        if (mask) {
            mask.style.opacity = '0';
            setTimeout(() => mask.remove(), 300);
        }
    }, 1500);

    const titleEl = document.getElementById('directSubmitTitle');
    if (titleEl) {
        titleEl.innerHTML = isNsfw
            ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-fire" style="margin-right:6px; color:var(--danger-color);"></i> Submit to #nsfwsubmit'
            : '<i class="fa-solid fa-paper-plane" style="margin-right:6px; color:var(--primary-color);"></i> Submit to #submit';
    }

    const modal = document.getElementById('directSubmitModal');
    if (window.openModalLayer) {
        window.openModalLayer(modal);
    } else if (modal) {
        modal.style.display = 'flex';
    }
}

function closeDirectSubmitModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('directSubmitModal');
    if (window.closeModalLayer) {
        window.closeModalLayer(modal);
    } else if (modal) {
        modal.style.display = 'none';
    }

    // FREE RAM INSTANTLY: Destroy the iframe so it stops running in the background
    const container = document.getElementById('directSubmitIframeContainer');
    if (container) container.innerHTML = '';
}

/* ==========================================================================
   UNIVERSAL MODAL OUTER-LAYER DISMISSAL + TEMP DRAFT BEHAVIOR
   Backdrop click:
   - save current form fields as a temporary draft
   - hide the modal only
   - do not trigger X / cancel / DB save logic

   X / Cancel:
   - discard temporary draft
   - restore the modal's opening values before closing

   Save / Update:
   - let the original save function commit normally
   - clear temporary draft afterward
   ========================================================================== */

const FuraiModalDrafts = {
    sessions: new WeakMap(),
    timers: new WeakMap(),
    tracked: new Set(),
    contextEpoch: 0
};

function getFuraiModalDraftId(modal) {
    if (!modal.id) {
        modal.dataset.furaiDraftId = modal.dataset.furaiDraftId || `furaiModal_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
    }

    return modal.id || modal.dataset.furaiDraftId;
}

function isFuraiModalVisible(modal) {
    if (!modal) return false;

    const style = window.getComputedStyle(modal);
    return style.display !== 'none' && style.visibility !== 'hidden' && !modal.hidden;
}

function getFuraiModalDraftControls(modal) {
    return Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('input, textarea, select')).filter(el => {
        const type = (el.type || '').toLowerCase();

        return !el.disabled &&
               type !== 'button' &&
               type !== 'submit' &&
               type !== 'reset' &&
               type !== 'file' &&
               !el.closest('[data-draft-ignore="true"]');
    });
}

function getFuraiModalDraftControlKey(el, index) {
    return el.id ||
           el.name ||
           el.getAttribute('data-draft-key') ||
           `${el.tagName.toLowerCase()}:${index}`;
}

function readFuraiModalDraft(modal) {
    const draft = {};

    getFuraiModalDraftControls(modal).forEach((el, index) => {
        const key = getFuraiModalDraftControlKey(el, index);
        const type = (el.type || '').toLowerCase();

        if (type === 'checkbox' || type === 'radio') {
            draft[key] = {
                type,
                checked: !!el.checked,
                value: el.value
            };
            return;
        }

        draft[key] = {
            type,
            value: el.value
        };
    });

    return draft;
}

function writeFuraiModalDraft(modal, draft, shouldNotify = true) {
    if (!modal || !draft) return;

    getFuraiModalDraftControls(modal).forEach((el, index) => {
        const key = getFuraiModalDraftControlKey(el, index);
        if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(draft, key)) return;

        const saved = draft[key];
        const type = (el.type || '').toLowerCase();

        if (type === 'checkbox' || type === 'radio') {
            el.checked = !!saved.checked;
        } else {
            el.value = saved.value ?? '';
        }

        if (shouldNotify) {
            el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        }
    });
}

function normalizeFuraiButtonText(btn) {
    return (btn?.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().toLowerCase();
}

function getFuraiButtonOnclickText(btn) {
    return (btn?.getAttribute('onclick') || '').toLowerCase();
}

function isFuraiSaveButton(btn) {
    const text = normalizeFuraiButtonText(btn);
    const onclickText = getFuraiButtonOnclickText(btn);

    return text === 'save' ||
           text.startsWith('save ') ||
           text === 'update' ||
           text.startsWith('update ') ||
           text === 'confirm' ||
           text.startsWith('confirm ') ||
           text === 'continue' ||
           onclickText.includes('save') ||
           onclickText.includes('update') ||
           onclickText.includes('confirm');
}

function isFuraiCancelButton(btn) {
    const text = normalizeFuraiButtonText(btn);
    const onclickText = getFuraiButtonOnclickText(btn);

    return text === '×' ||
           text === 'cancel' ||
           text.startsWith('cancel ') ||
           onclickText.includes('close') ||
           onclickText.includes("display='none'") ||
           onclickText.includes('display="none"');
}

function modalHasFuraiSaveButton(modal) {
    return Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')).some(btn => isFuraiSaveButton(btn));
}

function getFuraiCurrentContextIdentity() {
    const chatId = typeof currentChatId !== 'undefined' && currentChatId
        ? String(currentChatId)
        : '';

    let personality = '';
    try {
        personality = chatId
            ? String(chatPersonalities?.[chatId] || DB.get(chatId)?.personality || '')
            : '';
    } catch (e) {}

    const globalTab = typeof currentGlobalTab !== 'undefined'
        ? String(currentGlobalTab || '')
        : '';

    return { chatId, personality, globalTab };
}

function getFuraiModalDraftScopeKey(modal) {
    const context = getFuraiCurrentContextIdentity();
    const parts = [
        `epoch:${FuraiModalDrafts.contextEpoch}`,
        `modal:${getFuraiModalDraftId(modal)}`,
        `chat:${context.chatId}`,
        `personality:${context.personality}`,
        `globalTab:${context.globalTab}`,
        `explicit:${String(modal.dataset.furaiDraftScope || '')}`
    ];

    const identityControls = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll(
        'input[type="hidden"], [data-furai-draft-scope-key], input[data-index], textarea[data-index], select[data-index]'
    ));

    identityControls.forEach((el, index) => {
        const key = el.id || el.name || el.getAttribute('data-furai-draft-scope-key') || `identity:${index}`;
        const value = 'value' in el ? el.value : el.getAttribute('data-furai-draft-scope-key');
        const dataIndex = el.getAttribute('data-index');
        parts.push(`${key}:${String(value ?? '')}:${String(dataIndex ?? '')}`);
    });

    if (modal.id === 'lorebookLibraryModal' || modal.id === 'lorebookEditModal') {
        try {
            parts.push(`libraryContext:${String(LorebookManager?.context || '')}`);
            parts.push(`libraryTarget:${String(LorebookManager?.targetInput || '')}`);
            parts.push(`libraryTab:${String(LorebookManager?.currentViewTab || '')}`);
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    if (modal.id === 'charactersModalEl') {
        try {
            parts.push(`characterSelection:${JSON.stringify(furaiCharacterSelectionTarget || null)}`);
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    return parts.join('|');
}

function ensureFuraiModalDraftSession(modal) {
    if (!modal) return null;

    FuraiModalDrafts.tracked.add(modal);

    const scopeKey = getFuraiModalDraftScopeKey(modal);
    let session = FuraiModalDrafts.sessions.get(modal);

    if (!session || session.scopeKey !== scopeKey) {
        session = {
            scopeKey,
            base: null,
            temp: null,
            tempDismissed: false
        };
        FuraiModalDrafts.sessions.set(modal, session);
        delete modal.dataset.furaiTempDismissed;
    }

    return session;
}

function clearFuraiModalDraft(modal) {
    if (!modal) return;

    FuraiModalDrafts.sessions.delete(modal);
    delete modal.dataset.furaiTempDismissed;
}

function invalidateFuraiModalDraftContexts() {
    FuraiModalDrafts.contextEpoch += 1;
    FuraiModalDrafts.tracked.forEach(clearFuraiModalDraft);
}

function captureFuraiModalBaseIfNeeded(modal) {
    if (!modal || !modalHasFuraiSaveButton(modal)) return;

    const session = ensureFuraiModalDraftSession(modal);
    if (session && !session.base) {
        session.base = readFuraiModalDraft(modal);
    }
}

function restoreFuraiModalTempIfNeeded(modal) {
    if (!modal || !modalHasFuraiSaveButton(modal)) return;

    const session = ensureFuraiModalDraftSession(modal);
    if (!session) return;

    if (session.tempDismissed && session.temp) {
        writeFuraiModalDraft(modal, session.temp, true);
        return;
    }

    captureFuraiModalBaseIfNeeded(modal);
}

function queueFuraiModalDraftSync(modal) {
    if (!modal || !modalHasFuraiSaveButton(modal)) return;

    const oldTimer = FuraiModalDrafts.timers.get(modal);
    if (oldTimer) clearTimeout(oldTimer);

    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        if (isFuraiModalVisible(modal)) {
            restoreFuraiModalTempIfNeeded(modal);
        }
    }, 0);

    FuraiModalDrafts.timers.set(modal, timer);
}

function softDismissFuraiModalWithTempDraft(modal) {
    if (!modal || !modalHasFuraiSaveButton(modal)) return false;

    captureFuraiModalBaseIfNeeded(modal);
    const session = ensureFuraiModalDraftSession(modal);
    if (!session) return false;

    session.temp = readFuraiModalDraft(modal);
    session.tempDismissed = true;

    modal.dataset.furaiTempDismissed = 'true';
    modal.style.display = 'none';

    return true;
}

function restoreFuraiModalBaseBeforeCancel(modal) {
    if (!modal || !modalHasFuraiSaveButton(modal)) return;

    const session = ensureFuraiModalDraftSession(modal);
    if (session?.base) {
        writeFuraiModalDraft(modal, session.base, true);
    }

    clearFuraiModalDraft(modal);
}

let furaiModalDraftBodyObserver = null;

function watchFuraiModalDraft(modal) {
    if (!modal || modal.dataset.furaiDraftWatcher === 'true') return;

    modal.dataset.furaiDraftWatcher = 'true';
    FuraiModalDrafts.tracked.add(modal);

    const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
        queueFuraiModalDraftSync(modal);
    });

    observer.observe(modal, {
        attributes: true,
        attributeFilter: ['style', 'class', 'hidden'],
        childList: true,
        subtree: true
    });

    queueFuraiModalDraftSync(modal);
}

function initFuraiModalDraftWatchers() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.modal').forEach(watchFuraiModalDraft);

    if (furaiModalDraftBodyObserver || !document.body) return;

    furaiModalDraftBodyObserver = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
        mutations.forEach(mutation => {
            mutation.addedNodes.forEach(node => {
                if (!node || node.nodeType !== 1) return;
                if (node.classList?.contains('modal')) watchFuraiModalDraft(node);
                node.querySelectorAll?.('.modal').forEach(watchFuraiModalDraft);
            });
        });
    });

    furaiModalDraftBodyObserver.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true
    });
}

// Capture a newly rendered target before the first edit changes it.
document.addEventListener('focusin', event => {
    const modal = event.target?.closest?.('.modal');
    if (!modal || !modalHasFuraiSaveButton(modal)) return;
    captureFuraiModalBaseIfNeeded(modal);
}, true);

const FURAI_CONTEXT_BOUND_SURFACE_IDS = [
    'chatOptionsModalEl',
    'userProfileModalEl',
    'botProfileModalEl',
    'referenceModalEl',
    'glossaryModalEl',
    'summaryModalEl',
    'tokenModalEl',
    'memoModalEl',
    'enhancerSettingsModalEl',
    'backgroundModalEl',
    'castSwitchingModalEl',
    'storyCastLoreModalEl',
    'storyChatCastModalEl',
    'makerStudioModalEl',
    'emotionEditorModal',
    'lorebookEditModal',
    'lorebookLibraryModal',
    'globalSettingsModalEl',
    'charactersModalEl',
    'charImportModalEl',
    'expProfilePreviewModalEl'
];

const FuraiUiContextLifecycle = (() => {
    let epoch = 0;

    const hideLayer = id => {
        const layer = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!layer || !isFuraiModalVisible(layer)) return;

        if (window.ModalStackManager?.close) {
            window.ModalStackManager.close(layer);
        } else {
            layer.style.display = 'none';
        }
    };

    const closeContextSurfaces = () => {
        const profileCard = document.getElementById('profileCardModal');
        if (profileCard && isFuraiModalVisible(profileCard) && typeof closeProfileCard === 'function') {
            closeProfileCard();
        }

        const globalSettings = document.getElementById('globalSettingsModalEl');
        if (globalSettings && isFuraiModalVisible(globalSettings) && typeof closeGlobalSettingsModal === 'function') {
            closeGlobalSettingsModal();
        }

        const characters = document.getElementById('charactersModalEl');
        if (characters && isFuraiModalVisible(characters) && typeof closeCharactersModal === 'function') {
            closeCharactersModal();
        }

        FURAI_CONTEXT_BOUND_SURFACE_IDS.forEach(id => {
            if (id === 'globalSettingsModalEl' || id === 'charactersModalEl') return;
            hideLayer(id);
        });

        if (typeof closeCharacterSelection === 'function') {
            closeCharacterSelection();
        }
    };

    const invalidateDelayedUiWork = () => {
        try { characterLibraryEditToken += 1; } catch (e) {}
        try { expProfilePreviewOpenToken += 1; } catch (e) {}
        try { furaiMemoryModalHydrateToken += 1; } catch (e) {}
        try { furaiRemoteExpansionOpenToken += 1; } catch (e) {}
        try { furaiHistoricalEmotionContext = null; } catch (e) {}
        try { furaiHistoricalProfileEditContext = null; } catch (e) {}
    };

    const transition = (reason = 'context-change', options = {}) => {
        epoch += 1;
        invalidateDelayedUiWork();
        invalidateFuraiModalDraftContexts();

        if (options.closeSurfaces !== false) {
            closeContextSurfaces();
        }

        document.body.dataset.furaiUiContextEpoch = String(epoch);
        document.body.dataset.furaiUiContextReason = String(reason || 'context-change');
        return epoch;
    };

    return {
        transition,
        invalidateDelayedUiWork,
        closeContextSurfaces,
        get epoch() { return epoch; }
    };
})();

window.FuraiUiContextLifecycle = FuraiUiContextLifecycle;

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initFuraiModalDraftWatchers);
} else {
    initFuraiModalDraftWatchers();
}

document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
    const btn = event.target.closest('button');
    if (!btn) return;

    const modal = btn.closest('.modal');
    if (!modal || !modalHasFuraiSaveButton(modal)) return;

    if (isFuraiSaveButton(btn)) {
        const visibleParents = ModalStackManager.getVisibleParents(modal);
        setTimeout(() => {
            clearFuraiModalDraft(modal);
            ModalStackManager.restoreParents(visibleParents);
            ModalStackManager.bringToFront(modal);
        }, 0);
        return;
    }

    if (isFuraiCancelButton(btn)) {
        restoreFuraiModalBaseBeforeCancel(modal);
    }
}, true);

document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
    if (!event.target.classList.contains('modal') &&
        !event.target.classList.contains('lightbox-modal') &&
        !event.target.classList.contains('profile-card-overlay')) {
        return;
    }

    // Save-button modals get soft temp-dismiss behavior.
    // This must run before the old close-button fallback.
    if (event.target.classList.contains('modal') && softDismissFuraiModalWithTempDraft(event.target)) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        return;
    }

    // 1. Handle Profile Card
    if (event.target.id === 'profileCardModal' && typeof closeProfileCard === 'function') {
        closeProfileCard();
        return;
    }

    // 2. Handle Lightbox
    if (event.target.id === 'imageLightboxEl' && typeof closeLightbox === 'function') {
        closeLightbox();
        return;
    }

    // 3. Handle Gallery
    if (event.target.id === 'panelCtn' && typeof toggleGallery === 'function') {
        toggleGallery();
        return;
    }

    // 4. Handle Forum
    if (event.target.id === 'forumOverlayEl' && typeof toggleForum === 'function') {
        toggleForum();
        return;
    }

    // 5. Handle non-save standard modals normally.
    const closeBtn = Array.from(event.target.querySelectorAll('button')).find(btn => {
        const onClickStr = (btn.getAttribute('onclick') || '').toLowerCase();

        return onClickStr.includes('close') ||
               onClickStr.includes('display=\'none\'') ||
               onClickStr.includes('display="none"') ||
               btn.textContent.trim() === '×';
    });

    if (closeBtn) {
        closeBtn.click();
    } else {
        ModalStackManager.close(event.target);
    }
});

let pendingShareLinkExport = null;

function openShareLinkWarning(chatId, scope = 'single') {
    if (localStorage.getItem('furai_skip_share_link_warning') === 'true') {
        showCloudExportUI(chatId, scope);
        return;
    }

    pendingShareLinkExport = { chatId, scope };

    const textEl = document.getElementById('shareLinkWarningText');
    const neverEl = document.getElementById('shareLinkNeverShowAgain');

    if (neverEl) neverEl.checked = false;

    if (textEl) {
        if (scope === 'global') {
            textEl.innerHTML = `
                This creates one uploaded export copy and gives you a restore link. It is not cloud sync and will not update automatically.<br><br>
                The copy may include chats, characters, lorebooks, glossaries, music playlist, backgrounds, settings, and other local data.
            `;
        } else {
            textEl.innerHTML = `
              <div style="font-size:14px; line-height:1.62; color:var(--text-color); opacity:0.96;">
                This creates one uploaded export copy and gives you a shareable link. It is not cloud sync and will not update automatically.<br><br>
                Includes messages, local chat setup and local roster, memo, current lorebook / glossary, and current background.<br><br>
                Excludes music, global settings, global characters, full background archive, and full library lorebooks / glossaries.
              </div>
            `;
        }
    }

    document.getElementById('shareLinkWarningModal').style.display = 'flex';
}

function closeShareLinkWarning() {
    document.getElementById('shareLinkWarningModal').style.display = 'none';
    pendingShareLinkExport = null;
}

function confirmShareLinkWarning() {
    const neverEl = document.getElementById('shareLinkNeverShowAgain');
    if (neverEl && neverEl.checked) {
        localStorage.setItem('furai_skip_share_link_warning', 'true');
    }

    const pending = pendingShareLinkExport;
    closeShareLinkWarning();

    if (pending) {
        showCloudExportUI(pending.chatId, pending.scope);
    }
}

function syncImportedAchievementCounts(prevData = {}, nextData = {}) {
    if (!nextData || typeof nextData !== 'object') return;

    for (const id in nextData) {
        if (nextData[id] === true && prevData[id] !== true && ACHIEVEMENT_DB[id]) {
            recordAchievementUnlock(id);
        }
    }
}

function openGlobalLorebookLibraryFromMainMenu() {
    closeMainMenuModals('lorebookLibraryModal');
    LorebookManager.openLibrary(null, 'library');

    const dropdown = document.getElementById('mainMenuDropdown');
    if (dropdown) dropdown.classList.remove('show');
}
</script>
